data.title: Member of Technical Staff – MTS
data.description:
Join us as we work to create a thriving ecosystem that delivers accessible, high-quality, and sustainable healthcare for all. 

Role Summary

Build software that helps athenahealth solve complex healthcare business challenges at scale. The Member of Technical Staff will develop and maintain backend services and cloud-based applications that support high-volume claim resolution workflows, improve operational efficiency, and contribute to reliable product experiences for customers and internal teams. This role is based in Chennai, India and follows a hybrid work model. The person in this role will collaborate with engineers, product partners, and other stakeholders to deliver maintainable, scalable solutions using modern software development practices. This position reports to the Manager, Engineering. 

Team Summary

Our Collector R&D teams are building new and evolving services for athenahealth customers. We work on solving complex business problems for a broad set of stakeholders, including customers, internal technology-enabled services teams, and multiple BPO vendors. Much of this work involves designing and implementing workflows that manage large volumes of claim resolution activity, with a focus on improving visibility, throughput, and operational consistency. 

These systems support work that may be completed manually by operations partners or automated to improve overall productivity. That means our teams build software that helps route work, manage exceptions, connect business rules to execution paths, and create a more efficient experience across revenue cycle operations. The engineering work often involves balancing scale, reliability, maintainability, and evolving business needs across distributed systems. 

As a Member of Technical Staff, this role contributes directly to the development of backend services and microservices that power these workflows. Success in this role requires solid software engineering fundamentals, experience working with service-based systems, and the ability to collaborate effectively across functions. The team values clear communication, practical problem solving, and thoughtful engineering that improves outcomes for customers and internal users. Source context: the Collector R&D team summary provided in your prompt and athenahealth engineering JD guidance on MTS back-end roles: 

Essential Job Responsibilities

- Develop backend applications and services using Java to support business-critical workflows and platform capabilities. 
 - Build and maintain scalable microservices that integrate with internal platforms and dependent systems. 
 - Implement cloud-based solutions on AWS with attention to reliability, security, and maintainability. 
 - Collaborate with engineers, product managers, and other stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical solutions. 
 - Create and enhance APIs and service integrations that support high-volume transactional workflows. 
 - Troubleshoot application and service issues, identify root causes, and deliver fixes that improve system stability. 
 - Contribute to code reviews, unit testing, and team engineering practices that improve software quality and consistency. 
 - Optimize application performance and service interactions to support scalability and operational efficiency. 
 - Use AI tools, where appropriate, to improve productivity in day-to-day engineering work, such as understanding unfamiliar code, drafting test cases, summarizing technical information, or exploring implementation options, while reviewing outputs carefully before applying them. 

Additional Job Responsibilities

- Document technical designs, implementation details, and service dependencies for shared understanding across the team. 
 - Participate in sprint planning, backlog refinement, and estimation activities. 
 - Support deployment, release validation, and post-release monitoring for assigned services or features. 
 - Assist in improving CI/CD workflows and development practices across the team. 
 - Contribute to monitoring and alerting improvements that help detect and resolve production issues. 
 - Partner with adjacent teams to align on API contracts, integration points, and shared dependencies. 
 - Share technical knowledge through walkthroughs, documentation, and collaborative problem-solving sessions. 
 - Identify opportunities to simplify workflows or reduce manual effort through service enhancements and automation. 

Expected Education & Experience

- 2 to 4 years of software engineering experience in backend development, distributed systems, or related application development work. 
 - Hands-on experience with Java for building and maintaining production applications. 
 - Experience developing or supporting microservices and service-based architectures. 
 - Working knowledge of AWS and cloud application deployment concepts. 
 - Experience building or consuming RESTful APIs and integrating with distributed systems. 
 - Understanding of software engineering fundamentals, including object-oriented design, testing, debugging, and version control. 
 - Experience working in Agile or iterative development environments with cross-functional teams. 
 - Ability to analyze technical issues, communicate clearly, and contribute practical solutions. 
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience. 

About Athenahealth

Our vision: In an industry that becomes more complex by the day, we stand for simplicity. We offer IT solutions and expert services that eliminate the daily hurdles preventing healthcare providers from focusing entirely on their patients - powered by our vision to create a thriving ecosystem that delivers accessible, high-quality, and sustainable healthcare for all. 

Our company culture: Our talented employees - or athenistas, as we call ourselves - spark the innovation and passion needed to accomplish our vision. We are a diverse group of dreamers and do-ers with unique knowledge, expertise, backgrounds, and perspectives. We unite as mission-driven problem-solvers with a deep desire to achieve our vision and make our time here count. Our award-winning culture is built around shared values of inclusiveness, accountability, and support. 

Our DEI commitment: Our vision of accessible, high-quality, and sustainable healthcare for all requires addressing the inequities that stand in the way. That's one reason we prioritize diversity, equity, and inclusion in every aspect of our business, from attracting and sustaining a diverse workforce to maintaining an inclusive environment for athenistas, our partners, customers and the communities where we work and serve. 

What We Can Do For You

Along with health and financial benefits, athenistas enjoy perks specific to each location, including commuter support, employee assistance programs, tuition assistance, employee resource groups, and collaborative workspaces - some offices even welcome dogs. 

We also encourage a better work-life balance for athenistas with our flexibility. While we know in-office collaboration is critical to our vision, we recognize that not all work needs to be done within an office environment, full-time. With consistent communication and digital collaboration tools, athenahealth enables employees to find a balance that feels fulfilling and productive for each individual situation. 

In addition to our traditional benefits and perks, we sponsor events throughout the year, including book clubs, external speakers, and hackathons. We provide athenistas with a company culture based on learning, the support of an engaged team, and an inclusive environment where all employees are valued. 

Learn more about our culture and benefits here: athenahealth. com/careers

data.description:
Description

Are you looking for an opportunity to build a highly available, large scale, enterprise-wide software solution? Does it excite you to find patterns and build generic, composable software solutions to solve complex problems? Are you looking for inventing newer and simpler ways of building solutions? If so, we are looking for you to fill a challenging position in Amazon Payroll Technology team. 

Payroll Technology at Amazon is all about enabling our business to perform at scale as efficiently as possible with no defects. As Amazon's workforce grows, both in size and geography, Amazon's payroll operations become increasingly complex, and our customers are asked to do more with less. Process can only get them so far, and that's where we come in with technology solutions to integrate and automate systems, detect defects before payment, and provide insights. As an SDE II on our team, you will be responsible for leading the architecture, design, development and launch of some of the core product features. You will have significant influence on our overall strategy by helping define these product features, drive the system architecture, and spearhead the best practices to delivery high quality products. 

This position requires that you are a significant and autonomous contributor. Your work is consistently high quality. You solve complex problems, applying appropriate technologies and best practices. Your focus is on designing, developing and effectively applying automated solutions that test major portions of software (e. g. , significant component, set of features, mid-size application, service, etc. ). You prevent and find defects early. You apply software testing techniques, such as equivalence class partitioning, boundary value testing, etc. You build complete test and/or measurement solutions (e. g. , performance, load, scalability, usability, etc. ) You use data from testing, deployment, and production to measure quality and provide actionable improvement to the product. You write code that an SDE unfamiliar with the system can understand. You are proficient in a broad range of design approaches and know when it is appropriate to make trade-offs. Your solutions are pragmatic. You do things with the proper level of complexity the first time (or at least minimize incidental complexity). You consider the legacy of the code you produce, limiting the use of short-term workarounds. You create flexible software without over-engineering. You re-use where possible, while being judicious about introducing dependencies. You are efficient with resource usage (e. g. , designing to avoid impacting the system under test. )

This is an exciting opportunity for a seasoned engineer. In this position, you will play a leading role in the architecture, design, implementation and deployment of large-scale and complex financial applications. You will push your design and architecture limits by inventing and simplifying complex problems. You have strong verbal and written communication skills, are self-driven, and can deliver high quality results in a fast-paced environment. You will work with Amazon engineering and business teams across the globe in planning, designing, executing and implementing this new platform. 

Basic Qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
 - 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
 - Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred Qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
 - Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

data.title: Sr Mgr Quality Assurance- On Site CMO Manager
data.description:
We Are Teva

We're Teva, a leading innovative biopharmaceutical company, enabled by a world-class generics business. Whether it's innovating in the fields of neuroscience and immunology or delivering high-quality medicine worldwide, we're dedicated to addressing patients' needs now and in the future. Here, you will be part of a high-performing, inclusive culture that values fresh thinking and collaboration. You'll have the room to grow, the flexibility to balance life with work, and the opportunity to better health worldwide, together. 

Our Team, Your Impact

The On-site CMO Manager - ExM Quality serves as the Quality lead located at assigned Contract Manufacturing Organizations (CMOs) and key suppliers, ensuring compliant manufacturing, release, and supply of Teva products across global markets. The role provides end-to-end quality oversight, risk management, and QMS governance for external manufacturing operations, ensuring adherence to cGMP requirements, regulatory expectations, Teva quality standards, and Quality Technical Agreements while supporting uninterrupted product supply

How You'll Spend Your Day

- Pharmaceutical QMS (Deviations, CAPA, Change Control, Investigations, APR/PQR, Validation, SOPs). 
 - CMO/Supplier Quality Management and cGMP compliance oversight. 
 - Global regulatory requirements (USFDA, EMA, Health Canada, and international markets). 
 - Product transfers, commercialization, process changes, and lifecycle management. 
 - Quality risk management, NTM/GNTM, complaint handling, and escalation management. 
 - Regulatory inspections, customer audits, and health authority interactions. 
 - Quality Technical Agreements (QTA) and supplier qualification programs. 
 - Quality KPIs, audit CAPAs, stability programs, and continuous improvement initiatives. 
 - Cross-functional stakeholder management and leadership communication. 
 - External Manufacturing (ExM) quality oversight. 
 - Should also possess basic knowledge in Supply Chain, Regulatory Affairs, and MS&T processes. 

Long Description

Shop Floor Quality Oversight

- Serve as Teva's on-site quality representative, maintaining a strong quality presence across CMO site operations. 
 - Participate in daily production and operational review meetings to provide quality oversight and ensure alignment with production objectives. 
 - Monitor adherence to cGMP requirements, approved procedures, and quality standards through routine shop floor engagement. 
 - Provide real-time visibility and escalation of critical quality events, deviations, compliance concerns, and operational risks. 

Manufacturing Operations Monitoring

- Provide continuous oversight of manufacturing activities to ensure uninterrupted execution of production plans and supply commitments. 
 - Monitor production schedules, batch progression, and operational performance to identify potential delays, bottlenecks, and execution risks. 
 - Maintain visibility of equipment downtime, resource constraints, and operational challenges that may impact product quality or supply continuity. 
 - Escalate emerging risks and critical issues to relevant Teva stakeholders in a timely manner to support proactive decision-making and issue resolution. 

Investigation, Quality Systems & Execution Support

- Support and provide effective challenges during investigations to ensure robust root cause identification and sustainable corrective actions. 
 - Monitor investigation progress and ensure timely closure of deviations, CAPAs, and quality actions. 
 - Verify implementation and effectiveness of corrective and preventive actions to drive continuous compliance improvement. 
 - Partner with site quality and operations teams to facilitate timely batch documentation review, record closure, and release readiness activities. 

Operational Excellence & Continuous Improvement

- Drive and support site-level quality, compliance, and operational excellence initiatives. 
 - Partner with cross-functional teams to identify opportunities for process improvement, simplification, and performance enhancement. 
 - Support Lean and Operational Excellence programs to improve efficiency, compliance, and manufacturing reliability. 
 - Provide independent assessments and insights on site performance, quality culture, and operational effectiveness through regular reporting and governance forums. 

Risk Management & Stakeholder Engagement

- Proactively identify, assess, and escalate quality, compliance, operational, and supply risks to ensure timely mitigation and resolution. 
 - Act as the primary on-site liaison between the CMO and Teva's External Manufacturing (ExM) Quality organization. 
 - Provide timely and actionable reporting to ExM Quality Leadership and relevant Teva functions to enable informed decision-making and rapid issue resolution. 
 - Facilitate effective communication, collaboration, and alignment between site personnel and Teva stakeholders to support business and quality objectives. 

Your Skills And Experience

- Bachelor's/master's degree in Pharmacy, Chemistry, or related field. 
 - 12+ years of experience in pharmaceutical quality assurance, with strong exposure to CMO management. 
 - Experience in Quality Management Systems and CMO oversight. 
 - Proficient in TrackWise, Veeva, regulatory compliance, and audit management. 

How We'll Take Care Of You

At Teva India, care is at the heart of how we work. From your first day, you'll be welcomed into a people-first culture built on inclusion, respect, and belonging. 

That support extends to you and your loved ones through benefits designed for real life. These include comprehensive medical insurance, OPD coverage, annual health checkups, term life and accident insurance, and confidential emotional wellbeing support through our Optum Employee Assistance Program. You'll also enjoy healthy meals at work, holistic wellbeing initiatives, and volunteering programs that help you give back to the community. 

Your growth matters too. You'll have opportunities to build future-ready skills, collaborate on projects with global teams, explore internal career opportunities, and learn through programs such as our AI-enabled Teva Twist program, R&D Academy, continuing education, and mentorship. 

Join our vibrant workplace, where we celebrate milestones, festivals, achievements, and community impact together. 

Already Working @Teva?

Make sure to apply through our internal career site on Twist-your one-stop shop for career development

Teva's Equal Employment Opportunity Commitment

It is Teva's global policy that equal employment opportunity be provided without regard to age, race, creed, color, religion, sex, disability, pregnancy, medical condition, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, ancestry, veteran status, national or ethnic origin or any other legally recognized status entitled to protection under applicable laws. Overview

The Senior QA Engineering Manager leads quality engineering strategy and execution across one or more product portfolios, owning both the technical direction of test automation and the people leadership of a QA engineering organization. This leader partners closely with engineering, product, and delivery teams to embed quality throughout the software lifecycle, builds and scales high-performing automation and QA team - including offshore and distributed talent - and drives a zero-defect culture through rigorous metrics, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement. The role blends hands-on technical leadership in test automation architecture, CI/CD, and AI-based testing with senior people-management responsibilities such as hiring, coaching, and career development. 

Responsibilities

Quality strategy and automation leadership

- Define and own the test automation strategy across multiple products and portfolios, architecting scalable API-first and UI automation suites built on shared, reusable test libraries. 
 - Guide teams to evaluate and adopt new tools and technologies - including AI-based test automation frameworks, and RPA - to provide faster feedback to development teams. 
 - Establish the test strategy covering data management, pre-production/staging environments, system integration, and end-to-end testing. 
 - Drive CI/CD practices and cloud-based tooling (Azure/AWS) across the QA function. 
 - Oversee Quality Corrective Action Board (CAB) and Zero-Defect Planning (ZDP) processes; track defect leakage and lead root cause analysis (RCA) to continuously improve test coverage. 
 - Actively participate in sprint planning and estimation, providing effort and timeline estimates for automation and QA deliverables to support predictable, on-time releases. 
 - Define and report key quality metrics - including functional and automation test coverage, defect density, and test execution velocity - to drive data-driven quality decisions. 

Team leadership and people management

- Lead, coach, and grow a team of QA and automation engineers and QA leads - including offshore and distributed staff - fostering an inclusive, high-performing culture. 
 - Own hiring, onboarding, performance management, career development, and retention for the QA engineering organization. 
 - Set clear goals, provide regular feedback, and manage team knowledge-building and cross-training across key applications. 
 - Act as a change agent, championing quality ownership and continuous improvement across the QA program. 

Cross-functional partnership and reporting

- Partner with product management, engineering, delivery, and operations to translate roadmap priorities into achievable, quality-driven engineering plans. 
 - Develop effective relationships with key stakeholders - product owners, agile managers, business analysts, delivery teams, and technical working groups. 
 - Produce sprint-level activity reports and quality metrics for senior management; support release-readiness reporting and relevant New Product Development (NPD) phases. 
 - Communicate technical strategy, quality status, risks, and tradeoffs clearly to technical and non-technical audiences. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - 12 or more years of overall IT/software experience, including 10 or more years leading automation or QA engineering teams and 5 or more years of direct people management. 
 - Strong hands-on experience in Java and exposure to Python, with proven ability to architect and scale automation suites spanning API test automation (primary) and UI test automation, built on shared, reusable test libraries. 
 - Proficiency with RestAssured, TestNG, Playwright, and BDD-Cucumber, along with CI/CD tooling such as Jenkins, Gitlab, Nexus, and Maven. 
 - Experience with AI-based test automation and applying AI-driven development lifecycle (AIDLC) practices to accelerate test design, execution, and maintenance. 
 - Exposure to AWS cloud technologies and modern DevOps practices. 
 - Experience in healthcare, payer, or other regulated, data-intensive domains, including deidentified, HIPAA-compliant test data practices; US healthcare and EDI (e. g. , X12/HIPAA transactions) knowledge is a plus
 - Familiarity with data analytics platforms or machine learning systems is a plus. 
 - Strong understanding of Agile methodology and quality management best practices. 

Skills And Competencies

- Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to influence a wide range of audiences and win support without formal reporting authority. 
 - Strong organizational skills and adaptive to rapidly changing priorities and workloads. 
 - Comfortable partnering with remote and distributed team members across the US, India, and other geographies, within a matrixed organization. 
 - Results-oriented, empowering leader with strong emotional intelligence and a demonstrated ability to coach and develop talent. 
 - Innovative and self-motivated, with a strong sense of urgency and quality ownership. 
 - Exhibits behaviours consistent with Cotiviti values: Customer Driven, Accountability, Open, Collaborative.

By combining agentic AI, machine learning, data, and automation, you will design and scale intelligent learning experiences that accelerate skill development, improve learner and customer outcomes, and strengthen organizational capability.

It will help reimagine how people discover, build, apply, and sustain skills, creating agentic experiences that understand context, orchestrate learning resources and actions, and continuously adapt to learner needs and business priorities.

Strategic Program Management

Document & Speech Intelligence

data.description:
About Sirion

Sirion is the world's leading AI-native Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) platform. Global enterprises use Sirion to author, negotiate, manage, and extract value from their contracts, using generative AI for extraction, conversational search, and AI-assisted negotiation. With more than 7 million contracts and close to $800B in contract value under management, Sirion is recognized as a leader by Gartner, IDC, and Spend Matters. 

Power the Future of AI & Why This Role Matters

We are looking for an AI Automation Engineer with 4-6 years of Python development experience and hands-on experience building AI-powered and agentic automation solutions. The ideal candidate combines strong Python backend skills with practical knowledge of LLMs, AI agents, RAG, tool calling, and workflow orchestration. 

As part of Sirion's Automation team, you will design, build, and deploy intelligent automations in which AI agents reason over contracts and business data, call APIs and tools, and execute multi-step processes end-to-end, with appropriate human-in-the-loop controls. 

How You'll Make an Impact

- Design, develop, and deploy agentic AI automations that use LLMs, tool/function calling, memory, and multi-step reasoning to automate business processes end-to-end. 
 - Build agent workflows using frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, AutoGen, or similar. 
 - Build AI agents that interact with APIs, databases, documents, web applications, and external tools. 
 - Design and implement RAG-based solutions using embeddings, vector databases, and semantic search. 
 - Integrate OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, or other LLM APIs into production systems, including prompt engineering and structured outputs. 
 - Develop scalable backend services and APIs in Python using FastAPI, Flask, or Django REST Framework. 
 - Build human-in-the-loop checkpoints, guardrails, and error-handling/retry logic so automations run reliably in production. 
 - Develop asynchronous and event-driven workflows where required. 
 - Evaluate agent quality, accuracy, latency, and cost; monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize automations in production. 
 - Work with databases such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, or Redis. 
 - Deploy and maintain solutions using Docker and CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Write clean, maintainable, testable, production-ready Python code. 
 - Collaborate with product managers, architects, business stakeholders, and engineering teams to identify automation opportunities and translate requirements into technical solutions. 
 - Stay current with developments in Generative AI and Agentic AI. 

Skills & Experience You Bring to the Table

Python & Backend Development

- 4-6 years of professional experience in Python development. 
 - Strong understanding of OOP, data structures, exception handling, and concurrency (asyncio/threading). 
 - Hands-on experience with FastAPI, Flask, Django, or Django REST Framework. 
 - Strong experience developing and consuming REST APIs. 
 - Good understanding of SQL and relational databases (PostgreSQL/MySQL); MongoDB/Redis experience preferred. 

Agentic AI / GenAI

- Hands-on experience building LLM-powered applications beyond proofs of concept. 
 - Understanding of agentic AI architecture, including planning, tool use, memory, and autonomous multi-step workflows. 
 - Experience with one or more agent frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, or AutoGen. 
 - Experience with tool/function calling and integrating external APIs and tools with LLMs. 
 - Understanding of RAG, embeddings, vector databases, and semantic search. 
 - Experience with LLM APIs such as OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, or equivalent. 
 - Good understanding of prompt engineering and structured LLM outputs. 
 - Experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol) and AI tool integrations. 
 - Experience building multi-agent systems. 

Cloud & DevOps

- Experience with Docker and containerized applications. 
 - Understanding of CI/CD pipelines and tools such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or GitLab CI. 
 - Exposure to AWS, Azure, or GCP. 
 - Experience with logging, monitoring, debugging, and production deployments. 

Education & Soft Skills

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, Engineering, or a related field. 
 - Strong problem-solving and analytical skills. 
 - Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams. 
 - Strong communication and documentation skills. 

Good to Have

- Experience with RPA or workflow automation platforms such as UiPath, Automation Anywhere, Power Automate, or n8n. 
 - Experience with document AI: extracting and processing data from PDFs, contracts, or other unstructured documents. 
 - Exposure to Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) or enterprise SaaS platforms. 
 - Experience with task and message queues such as Celery, RabbitMQ, or Kafka. 
 - Experience with Kubernetes. 
 - Experience working with open-source/local LLMs and Hugging Face models. 
 - Understanding of LLM evaluation, observability, guardrails, and cost optimization. 
 - Basic understanding of frontend technologies such as React, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS. 

What We Are Looking For

The ideal candidate is strong in Python backend development and has built real AI/agentic automation solutions, not just theoretical knowledge of Generative AI. Candidates should be able to demonstrate projects that combine LLMs + tools/APIs + orchestration + backend services, preferably deployed in production. 

Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We are an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion. We do not discriminate on the basis of any characteristic protected by law, and we provide reasonable accommodations for applicants with disabilities. These principles apply across all of our employment practices. 

Excited About This Opportunity?

We'd love to hear from you! Apply through the Sirion Careers page and follow the steps listed there.

Job Details

Job Description: 

The Role And Impact

As a GPU Validation Engineer, you will play a critical role in ensuring the functional accuracy, performance, and reliability of Intel's cutting-edge GPUs. You will define, develop, and execute robust validation methodologies to test interactions between GPU features across hardware and software layers. Your work will directly impact the quality and performance of Intel GPUs, enabling seamless integration into diverse systems and driving innovation in graphics and compute technologies. 

Business Group

You will be part of Intel's Data Center Group (DCG), which leads the development of technologies that power the world's data-centric infrastructure. This group focuses on shaping the future of cloud computing, AI, and high-performance computing by delivering solutions that advance Intel's leadership in data processing and connectivity. Joining DCG offers an exciting opportunity to contribute to groundbreaking products that support Intel's broader mission of enabling global progress through technology. 

Key Responsibilities

- Develop and execute functional validation plans for GPUs, ensuring comprehensive test coverage across hardware and software components. 
 - Analyze and debug silicon issues to identify root causes, resolve failures, and optimize GPU designs. 
 - Test and validate system-level interactions between GPU features using advanced validation infrastructure. 
 - Collaborate with architecture, design, verification, and manufacturing teams to refine validation methodologies and processes. 
 - Review proposed design changes to assess their impact on validation timelines, tasks, and performance goals. 
 - Design and implement post-silicon validation infrastructure, including behavioral checkers, performance monitors, and coverage tools. 
 - Publish detailed validation reports summarizing key findings, results, and recommendations. 
 - Maintain and improve validation strategies to support product specifications and enhance overall GPU functionality. 
 - Defines, develops, and performs functional validation for GPUs, focusing on validation of interaction of GPUs, media, display and system level features. Applies various hardware and software level tools and techniques to ensure validation coverage and that performance, power, and area goals are met. 
 - Reviews proposed design changes to assess impact on validation plans, tasks, and timelines. 
 - Develops GPU validation methodologies, executes validation plans, and collaborates with other engineers for design optimization, troubleshooting, and failure analysis. 
 - Performs silicon debug to identify root causes and resolves all functional and triage failures for GPU issues. Tests interactions between various GPU features using validation infrastructure. 
 - Develops post silicon validation infrastructure (e. g. , performance monitors, behavioral checkers, state space coverage) and test environment used in validation testing. 
 - Publishes GPU validation reports summarizing all validation activities performed, reviews results, and communicates to relevant teams. 
 - Works with architecture, design, verification, board, platform, and manufacturing teams to maintain and improve debug, validation test strategy, methodologies, and processes for graphics interfaces and to meet desired product specifications.

- Bachelor's degree in a relevant field and 9+ years of experience, or a Master's degree with 6+ years, or a Ph. D. with 4+ years working in GPU validation, silicon debugging, or related domains.

 - Experience with silicon debug processes, triage failure analysis, and system-level validation. 
 - Strong technical expertise in GPU architecture, media, and display technologies.

data.description:
Vestas is the global leader in sustainable energy solutions and a driving force in the wind energy industry. Our core business encompasses the development, manufacturing, sales, installation, and servicing of wind turbines worldwide. At Vestas, we are committed to accelerating the transition to renewable energy while creating innovative solutions that deliver value to our customers and stakeholders. 

Digital Solutions & Development > Digital Solutions > Autonomous Flows - IN

The Autonomous Flows Advisors team sits within Vestas' Digital Development Platform and accelerates the AI and automation transformation across the business. We act as internal advisors and enablers, partnering with product teams and business areas across the value chain (R&D, commercial, manufacturing, supply chain, services and business services) to help shape the AI strategy, scope high-impact solutions, and ensure responsible, scalable AI adoption. We work closely with cyber, legal, and data governance, and collaborate with both technical and non-technical stakeholders at all levels. As an AI Innovation Lead, you will support the redesign and operationalize frontline workflows using AI and automation. Working closely with the business teams, local technology leads, and global product teams, you will help translate business priorities into measurable workflow transformations and operational prototypes. You'll be responsible for implementing the local solutions while keeping in mind potential risks and opportunities to turn your solutions into global product features. This is not a research or purely strategic role. You will be expected to get into the details, challenge assumptions, and deliver tangible innovation. 

Responsibilities

As an AI Innovation Lead, you will play an instrumental role in our efforts to enable the Vestas AI transformation. You will be responsible for: 

- Supporting the mapping and redesign of frontline workflows together with the relevant business teams - Assessing data readiness, technical feasibility, and implementation complexity for proposed automation initiatives
 - Supporting the definition of success metrics and expected business outcomes for each AI initiative, in collaboration with stakeholders
 - Developing local automations in collaboration with business stakeholders and subject matter experts
 - Connecting automations to relevant enterprise data and systems using approved integrations and connectors
 - Testing deployed prototypes with live frontline data and iteratively improving solution quality based on structured SME feedback and evaluation results
 - Identifying recurring workflow patterns, reusable components, and enterprise-scaling opportunities
 - Translating learnings into a structured backlog for global solutions product owners

Qualifications

To be successful in this role, you need to be a highly motivated, energetic, and self-driven person, who can work independently and collaboratively with a diverse set of stakeholders. We imagine that you have most of the qualifications and competences below: 

- A relevant degree in a quantitative field (IT, physics, mathematics, etc. ), business transformation, or similar, combining strong technical understanding and excellent communication skills - At least 3 years of relevant experience in a similar role
 - Practical understanding of automation and AI use cases, limitations, and pitfalls
 - Hands-on experience building AI, automation, or software solutions using modern AI development tools
 - Experience with product discovery, business process redesign, automation, operational excellence, or digital transformation initiatives

Competencies

- Pragmatic and structured approach to problem solving, with a focus on value creation
 - Excellent communication skills, both oral and written - Ability to work across complex organizations and manage conflicting stakeholder interests
 - Ability to translate complex AI concepts into clear, actionable language for non-technical stakeholders
 - You seek to constantly acquire new knowledge, stay up to date within AI, and challenge yourself
 - Fluent spoken and written English is a prerequisite

What We Offer

- Purpose. An opportunity to impact climate change and the future of next generations through automation and AI. 
 - Steep learning curve. You will be joining a strong team of AI advisors with both broad and deep knowledge. That means that you will have somebody to learn from, just as we will invest in continuous learning, knowledge sharing, and upskilling. 
 - Strong relationships. We will strive to build an informal environment of mutual trust and a tightly knit team, where we can support and inspire each other to deliver great impact for Vestas. 
 - Opportunity to shape your role. We have been asked to scale and anchor the impact of AI and automation across Vestas. The rest is up to us.

 - Commitment to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. Everyone can thrive and bring their unique perspectives and skills to the team.

Your primary location will be in Chennai, India

Please note: We do amend or withdraw our jobs and reserve the right to do so at any time, including prior to the advertised closing date. Please be advised to apply on or before 30th Nov 2026

data.description:

Here, you will find more than just a job-you will find purpose and pride. 

We are seeking a Principal Automation Engineer to define automation architecture, technical roadmaps, and engineering standards for API, UI, integration, and end-to-end testing. NET frameworks, establish CI/CD quality gates, guide cross-team adoption, and resolve complex automation and testability challenges across distributed products. 

What You'll Be Doing

 - Define coding standards, branching and review practices, framework governance, versioning, documentation, and contribution models. 
 - Establish pipeline strategy for pull-request validation, daily smoke tests, staged regression, release qualification, and automated quality gates. 
 - Guide teams on automation suitability, testability, coverage modelling, risk-based selection, and reduction of flaky or low-value tests. 
 - Lead technical reviews, proofs of concept, framework migrations, tool evaluations, and resolution of complex cross-service failures. 
 - Define dashboards and metrics for coverage, reliability, execution time, defect containment, failure causes, and productivity gains. 
 - Partner with architecture, software, DevOps, cybersecurity, systems, and verification leaders to embed quality throughout delivery. 
 - Mentor automation engineers and build engineering capability through reusable assets, coaching, and technical communities of practice. 

What You'll Bring

- B. E. /B. Tech in Computer Science, Electronics & Communication, Electrical Engineering, or a related field. 
 - 10 years of experience defining automation architecture, technical roadmaps, and engineering standards for API, UI, integration, and end-to-end testing. 
 - Mandatory: Systems-oriented Quality Engineer with a strong understanding of how products, services, and components interconnect; able to see the broader product architecture and decompose requirements to capture use cases holistically. 
 - Mandatory: Hands-on Automation Architect with advanced C# and . NET skills and a strong understanding of software design principles, dependency injection, concurrency, asynchronous execution, and extensible architecture. 
 - Mandatory: Hands-on experience architecting and developing REST API automation frameworks using RestSharp. 
 - Mandatory: Strong hands-on experience with NUnit or Selenium or playwright for test automation. 
 - Mandatory: Working knowledge of GraphQL (GQL) and experience validating GraphQL APIs. 
 - Mandatory: Solid understanding of test data management principles, strategies, and reusable data provisioning approaches. 
 - Mandatory: Strong awareness of Kubernetes and containerized test environments. 
 - Good understanding of communication protocols, particularly SIP, and hands-on exposure to SIPp for protocol-level testing. 
 - Expertise in API contracts, distributed systems, microservices, event-driven integrations, databases, authentication, authorization, and service virtualization. 
 - Deep experience with Git, CI/CD architecture, parallel execution, automated reporting, and quality gates. 
 - Proven ability to improve framework reliability, diagnose flaky tests, optimize execution, and drive adoption across multiple teams. 
 - Strong technical leadership, stakeholder communication, mentoring, and architecture decision-making skills. 

Preferred Skills

- Experience with Allure reporting is preferred. 
 - Experience with Postman is good to have. 
 - Experience with Azure, Docker, infrastructure-as-code, message brokers, observability platforms, and cloud-native test environments. 
 - Experience validating healthcare platforms, HL7/FHIR integrations, connected devices, or regulated software products. 
 - Knowledge of security, accessibility, performance, reliability, and resilience testing within a unified automation strategy. 
 - Relevant Microsoft, cloud, architecture, or testing certification is advantageous. 
 - Knowledge of SIP infrastructure and media components such as Kamailio, FreeSWITCH, RTPEngine, SBCs, registrars, RTP, and WebRTC. 
 - Experience with Azure Key Vault, Azure App Configuration, Azure Cache for Redis, Azure Web PubSub, Terraform, KEDA, and container security tooling. 
 - Familiarity with IEC 62304, ISO 13485, risk management, cybersecurity expectations, and quality systems for regulated healthcare software. 
 - Experience with Jira, Jama, validated toolchains, Agile/Scrum delivery, and formal release-readiness reviews. 
 - Experience leading a team of automation testers toward a common goal. 

Equal Employment Opportunity

Baxter is an equal opportunity employer. Baxter evaluates qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, protected veteran status, disability/handicap status or any other legally protected characteristic. 

Reasonable Accommodations

Baxter is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities globally. If, because of a medical condition or disability, you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application or interview process, please click on the link here and let us know the nature of your request along with your contact information.

Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced Salesforce Technical Lead with 8-12 years of Salesforce ecosystem experience and a proven track record of working with enterprise clients, leading technical teams, and delivering complex Salesforce implementations. 

The ideal candidate will possess strong hands-on development expertise, excellent solution design capabilities, solid knowledge of Salesforce DevOps and CI/CD practices, and the ability to translate complex business requirements into scalable, secure, and maintainable technical solutions. 

The candidate will lead and mentor Salesforce developers, conduct client-facing technical discussions, drive architectural decisions, and manage end-to-end technical delivery.  - Strong understanding of REST/SOAP APIs, Named Credentials, OAuth, and enterprise integrations. 
 - Strong knowledge of Salesforce security, sharing models, governor limits, performance optimization, and data modelling. 
 - Strong experience with Sales Cloud and Service Cloud. 
 - Experience with solution design, technical discovery, effort estimation, and translating business requirements into implementation plans. 
 - Solid understanding of Salesforce DevOps, CI/CD, release management, and deployment automation. 
 - Hands-on experience with Git/GitHub, Salesforce DX, VS Code, and automated deployment tools.

data.title: Shopify Development Lead (AI Enabled eCommerce)
data.description:
Shopify Team Lead - AI-Enabled E-commerce

Business Unit: Shop LC (US)

Location: Jaipur, Rajasthan, India

Experience: 7-12 Years

Employment Type: Full-time

Work Mode: Onsite

Contact: himanshu. singh@vaibhavglobal. com

About VGL Group

Vaibhav Global Limited (VGL) is a leading electronic retailer of jewelry and lifestyle products. In FY 2023-24, VGL reported a turnover of approximately $365 million and employs over 4, 000 people globally, including more than 3, 000 employees in Jaipur, India. 

Multi-Channel Presence

VGL reaches customers across multiple markets through its television, e-commerce, and digital retail platforms: 

- Shop LC (USA): Reaches over 60 million homes through live television broadcasts and has a strong e-commerce presence. 
 - TJC (UK): Reaches over 27 million homes through television and digital platforms. 
 - Shop LC Germany: Broadcasts to over 40 million homes, strengthening VGL's presence in Europe. 
 - Ideal World (UK): Acquired in 2023, a leading teleshopping and digital retail platform. 
 - Mindful Souls: Acquired in 2023, a subscription-based e-commerce brand specializing in spiritual and wellness products. 

Social Impact & ESG Initiatives

- Your Purchase Feeds. . . : VGL's flagship meal donation program has provided over 99 million meals to schoolchildren across India, the US, and the UK. 
 - Employee Volunteering: Encourages employees to contribute two hours every month to charitable activities. 
 - Sustainability: Focuses on renewable energy, waste reduction, and environmentally responsible initiatives. 
 - Green Initiatives: Recognized by IGBC for excellence in green built environments at its Jaipur SEZ facility. 
 - ESG Recognition: Awarded a Combined ESG Rating of 72 (Strong) by ICRA ESG Ratings Limited. 

Talent & Culture

- Humanocracy & Micro-Enterprises: Promotes a decentralized and empowered work culture, enabling small, agile teams to drive innovation and ownership. 
 - Talent Density & Meritocracy: Focuses on building high-performing teams, recognizing talent, and fostering a culture of excellence. 
 - Great Place to Work Certified: Recognized as a Great Place to Work across India, the US, the UK, and China. 

Recognition & Achievements

- Top Exporter Award: Recognized by GJEPC for its leadership in the export of silver and colored gemstones from India. 
 - Operational Excellence: Demonstrates a strong track record in value-driven retail and customer-centric growth. 

Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced Shopify Team Lead - AI-Enabled E-commerce to lead the architecture, development, integration, and delivery of scalable, high-performance Shopify e-commerce solutions for Shop LC. 

This role combines hands-on Shopify engineering expertise with technical leadership and AI-enabled software development practices. The ideal candidate should have strong experience in Shopify Plus, modern web technologies, custom application development, API integrations, event-driven architecture, and cloud-based services. 

In addition to leading engineering delivery, the candidate will drive the adoption of AI-assisted Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) practices to improve developer productivity, code quality, automation, and overall engineering efficiency. 

The role requires a hands-on technical leader who can build and mentor a high-performing engineering team while establishing AI-first development practices and scalable engineering standards. 

Key Responsibilities

1. Shopify Engineering & Architecture

- Lead the development, enhancement, and maintenance of Shopify Plus and Shopify-based e-commerce platforms. 
 - Design scalable solutions using Shopify Liquid, APIs, GraphQL, Webhooks, Shopify Functions, Extensions, and Custom Apps. 
 - Own technical architecture, system integrations, performance optimization, security, and scalability. 
 - Review technical designs, architecture decisions, source code, and pull requests to maintain engineering standards. 
 - Collaborate with Product, Architecture, DevOps, QA, and Business teams to translate business requirements into effective technical solutions. 2. Custom Application Development & Integration

- Lead the design and development of custom applications and backend services supporting Shopify ecosystems. 
 - Develop scalable applications using React, Remix, Node. js, and other modern web technologies. 
 - Design and implement Backend-for-Frontend (BFF) and API-driven architectures. 
 - Build and maintain integrations between Shopify, enterprise systems, and third-party platforms. 
 - Develop reusable APIs, services, and integration components to support business requirements. 
 - Ensure application reliability, maintainability, security, and performance. 3. Event-Driven Architecture & Backend Engineering

- Design and implement reliable event-driven systems and asynchronous workflows between Shopify and backend applications. 
 - Work with Apache Kafka, including producers, consumers, topics, partitions, consumer groups, retry mechanisms, and error handling. 
 - Manage Shopify Webhooks, including registration, event processing, reliability, retries, idempotency, and monitoring. 
 - Leverage Redis for caching, session and token management, distributed locking, and performance optimization. 
 - Design and maintain reliable backend services and integrations with appropriate error handling and fault tolerance. 4. Database Management & Optimization

- Design, develop, and optimize database solutions using PostgreSQL and Microsoft SQL Server. 
 - Work with database schema design, stored procedures, complex queries, and transaction management. 
 - Ensure data consistency, concurrency management, and efficient database connectivity through connection pooling. 
 - Manage data migration, synchronization, and integration across multiple systems. 
 - Implement effective caching and database performance optimization strategies. 5. AI-Enabled Engineering & Development Lifecycle (ADLC)

- Drive the adoption of AI-assisted Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) practices across the engineering team. 
 - Leverage AI coding assistants such as Cursor, Claude, GitHub Copilot, and equivalent tools to improve development productivity. 
 - Integrate AI into different stages of the development lifecycle, including: 
 - Requirement analysis and refinement
 - Technical solution and design generation
 - Code generation and development
 - Unit and integration test generation
 - Code reviews and debugging
 - Documentation and refactoring
 - Test automation and deployment support
 - Establish effective human-in-the-loop development practices to ensure quality, accuracy, and accountability. 
 - Define AI-assisted coding standards, engineering guardrails, and governance practices. 
 - Evaluate AI-generated code for security, performance, scalability, maintainability, and architectural compliance. 
 - Develop reusable prompts, coding patterns, AI agent workflows, and engineering standards. 
 - Explore and implement AI agents, agentic development workflows, and automated engineering processes. 
 - Drive AI adoption across the team to improve development speed, engineering quality, and overall delivery efficiency. 6. Team Leadership & Delivery Management

- Lead, mentor, and develop a team of Shopify engineers and full-stack developers. 
 - Translate business requirements into technical specifications, user stories, and development tasks. 
 - Provide technical direction, conduct architecture discussions, and oversee code and design reviews. 
 - Ensure timely delivery of high-quality, scalable, and maintainable solutions. 
 - Identify technical risks, dependencies, and opportunities for process improvement. 
 - Establish engineering best practices around coding standards, automation, testing, and observability. 
 - Provide technical guidance during production issues and incident resolution. 
 - Foster a culture of ownership, collaboration, continuous learning, and innovation. 

Required Technical Skills & Expertise

Technical Area - Required Skills

Shopify - Shopify Plus, Shopify APIs, GraphQL, Liquid

Shopify Development - Custom Apps, Extensions, Functions, Webhooks

Frontend Development - React. js, JavaScript, TypeScript

Backend Development - Node. js, Remix, REST APIs, GraphQL

Messaging & Event Processing - Apache Kafka, Event-Driven Architecture

Caching - Redis

Databases - PostgreSQL, Microsoft SQL Server

System Integration - REST APIs, GraphQL, Webhooks, Third-Party Integrations

Cloud Technologies - Microsoft Azure, AWS, or equivalent

DevOps & Deployment - CI/CD, Git, Containers; Kubernetes preferred

AI-Assisted Development - Cursor, Claude, GitHub Copilot, or equivalent

Software Architecture - Microservices, BFF, Event-Driven Architecture

AI & Engineering Leadership Expectations

The candidate should demonstrate the ability to move beyond traditional software development and establish an AI-first engineering environment. 

They should understand how AI can be effectively integrated across the entire development lifecycle: 

Requirement Analysis → Solution Design → Development → Testing → Code Review → Deployment → Monitoring

The candidate should be capable of: 

- Identifying opportunities to automate repetitive engineering activities through AI. 
 - Building and implementing AI agents to support development, testing, code reviews, and deployment workflows. 
 - Establishing appropriate human oversight, security controls, and AI governance practices. 
 - Implementing automated testing, AI-assisted code reviews, and agentic development workflows. 
 - Ensuring AI-generated solutions meet enterprise engineering standards for quality, security, scalability, and maintainability. Experience implementing AI agents, AI orchestration, automated PR reviews, AI-based testing, or agentic SDLC/ADLC workflows will be a strong advantage. 

Good to Have

- Strong hands-on experience with Shopify Plus and large-scale e-commerce platforms. 
 - Experience migrating e-commerce platforms from other technologies to Shopify. 
 - Experience with Kafka-based enterprise integration architecture. 
 - Experience with Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), Kubernetes, or equivalent cloud infrastructure. 
 - Familiarity with Application Insights, Datadog, ELK Stack, or similar observability tools. 
 - Experience with Shopify Functions and Checkout Extensions. 
 - Advanced experience with GraphQL and API performance optimization. 
 - Experience optimizing website performance and Core Web Vitals. 
 - Experience implementing AI agents, agentic workflows, and AI-enabled development automation.

data.title: Manager - Build Quality, Inspection & Expediting
data.description:
About Hygenco: 

Hygenco aims to be a global leader in deploying Green Hydrogen and Green Ammonia-powered

industry solutions. We develop and deploy scaled-up, commercially attractive Green Hydrogen

and Green Ammonia production assets. We combine our in-house expertise in renewable power, 

process industry, gases, and project financing with the latest innovation and know-how from our

network of global OEMs and EPC firms. Hygenco is founded by industry professionals bringing in

combined 30+ years of experience in Construction, Renewables, Operations & Maintenance, Investment banking and Private Equity. 

- Requires extensive travel to fabricator works · Reports to the Head of Modularisation & Package Delivery. 

- Make sure every skid we ship is built right, tested right and documented right, and leaves the fabricator's works on the date we promised. 

Hygenco builds, owns and operates some of India's first commercial-scale green hydrogen plants. Its Modularisation & Package Delivery team turns process designs into complete, tested, skid-mounted units, built by qualified fabricators and delivered ready for site installation. 

The role

You own the build of every package from purchase order to dispatch: the inspection & test plan, surveillance at the fabricator's works, the factory acceptance test (FAT), the records and the schedule. The boundaries are clear. A peer qualifies the fabricators; the technology owner sets the acceptance criteria, and the plant engineering team holds design authority; and for higher-risk packages, the company's separate Asset Integrity (QA/QC) function inspects independently and releases them for shipment. You release all other packages, and a concession is never yours to grant. 

What you'll own

- Inspection & test plans (ITPs) for every package, including the Asset Integrity function's hold and witness points on higher-risk packages. 
 - Procedure review before work starts: fabricators' quality plans and welding, NDT and test procedures (WPS, PQR, WPQ), and a register of the procedures you have approved, for reuse on repeat builds. 
 - In-shop surveillance: materials, fit-up, welding, NDT, pressure and leak testing, painting and preservation. 
 - Statutory and third-party inspection: IBR and PESO/CCOE inspections and third-party inspectors; for higher-risk packages, the Asset Integrity function assigns the agency. 
 - Factory acceptance tests: plan, organise and witness them; the technology owner accepts performance, and the Asset Integrity function witnesses higher-risk packages. 
 - Release for shipment of every package outside the Asset Integrity function's risk-tiered programme, with a complete record book. 
 - Non-conformances (NCRs) to closure; any concession needs the technology owner's written approval, and also the Asset Integrity function's for higher-risk packages. 
 - Expediting: milestone plans, vendor visits, and early warning and escalation before a date is lost. 
 - Build data for the supplier scorecard, which Vendor Development & Sourcing owns, and a small team of inspectors and expeditors as volume grows. 

How success will be measured

In your first 12-18 months, and every year after, success looks like this: 

- On-time-in-full dispatch against committed dates. 
 - First-time FAT acceptance, and fewer NCRs from one build of a package to the next. 
 - Zero statutory or code release exceptions, and no package shipped with an incomplete record book. 
 - The same inspection rigour on the tenth build as on the first. 

Why this role, and why now

Much of India's first hydrogen equipment is being built by shops that know oil, gas and chemicals skids, but not yet hydrogen. You will set up how we inspect and expedite from the first build, and the plans and procedures you approve will be reused build after build. 

What we're looking for

- A mechanical, production or metallurgical engineering degree, with 10-15 years in inspection, supplier quality or expediting of fabricated process equipment. 
 - At least five years on process skids or modular packages, much of it inside fabrication shops rather than at site. 
 - Hands-on welding and NDT judgment; CSWIP 3. 1, AWS CWI or NDT Level II certification is a plus. 
 - Working knowledge of ASME Section VIII, IX and B31. 3, IBR, PESO/CCOE and ISO 3834. 
 - Proactive expediting, with a record of recovering slippage at the vendor's works. 
 - Based in Pune, with heavy travel to fabricators in Maharashtra and Gujarat. Hydrogen or oxygen service experience is a plus, not a requirement. 

If you want to decide whether India's first hydrogen packages are built right, we'd like to hear from you.

You will be part of the core team at GE Vernova Electrification Software (GEV ESW) Business that is using software to enable de-carbonized future of energy for the planet by designing, building, delivering, and maintaining software applications & services for next generation Grid Software that orchestrates 40% of the world's power today. 

GridOS is a new software portfolio of GEV ESW that helps utilities manage and orchestrate the sustainable Energy Grid. As Sr. Manager in GridOS Platform organization, you will be responsible for leading teams to design, build, deliver and maintain software products and shared services. 

You will work with global set of leaders to provide input to strategy, plan work, drive delivery of high-quality software using agile development practices. You will be responsible for hiring, onboarding, building and engaging high performing software development teams. You will apply your knowledge of people management, software development methodologies, best practices, and proven processes to hire, onboard, engage, retain and lead teams to deliver a high-quality platform software - GridOS Data Fabric on budget and on time. 

Job Description

In this role, you will: 

- Build and manage a world class team to consistently deliver complex Data Mesh features using next-gen technologies and methodologies adopted from industry wide practices. 
 - Responsible for full software lifecycle including activities such as requirement analysis, documentation/procedures and implementation. 
 - Typically, a 1st line manager of professionals or a 2nd line manager of a professional department. Developing specialized knowledge in their discipline. Serves as best practice/quality resource. Has awareness of latest technical developments in Data Engineering. 
 - Contributes towards strategy and policy development and ensure delivery within area of responsibility. 
 - Uses judgment to make decisions or solve moderately complex tasks or problems in areas of operational/product management, manufacturing, technology or engineering. 
 - Assist in developing standards consistent with compliance requirements
 - Troubleshoot and remedy availability/performance issues
 - You will hire, onboard, build and engage the Grid Engineering team specifically GridOS Platform and Shared Services team allocated to you. 
 - You will contribute to delivery of next generation grid software that enables energy transition by integrating renewables and distributed energy resources to the main power grid. 
 - Contribute to development of strategy for organization including resource development, innovation and execution strategy and help execute the strategy. 
 - Actively present leadership updates to GE executive sponsors and customers. 
 - Quickly learn, internalize, and develop a strong understanding of key priorities and the customers
 - Align with stakeholders to ensure that data and process changes required in systems are implemented in accordance with project objectives and timelines
 - Provide day to day work direction for team members engaged in projects and delivery using agile processes
 - Facilitate and coach software engineering teams on requirements estimate and work sizing. 
 - Drive a continuous learning culture to help guide continuous improvements. 
 - Provide leadership on Lean/Agile principles and development practices. 
 - Actively pursue new methods and practices to increase productivity and drive agile development practices in team
 - Utilize project management tools to track progress and recognize key risk areas for specific implementations
 - Assist in the resolution of conflicting priorities through the proactive communication of requirements, timelines and stakeholders. 
 - Operate as an engaged leader who serves as a subject matter and technical expert for assigned programs and development initiatives
 - Work with system leaders and functional teams to ensure products and services adhere to compliance and controllership standards

Desired Characteristics

Technical Expertise

- Strong oral and written communication skills. 
 - Strong interpersonal and leadership skills. 
 - Demonstrated ability to analyse and resolve problems. 
 - Demonstrated ability to lead programs / projects. 
 - Experience building scalable Web applications
 - Experience with Container technologies and Microservices architecture
 - Strong Data Engineering experience
 - Good knowledge of Data Mesh
 - Familiarity Relational and NoSQL databases
 - Solid understand and experience in Distributed Systems
 - Good experience in software development using Java / . NET
 - Experience in usage of Gen AI for SDLC
 - Experience working in Unix/Linux operating systems and shell scripting
 - A strong sense of ownership, urgency, and drive
 - Ability to work independently and collaboratively
 - Experience in Agile methodologies

Business Acumen

- Evaluates technology to drive features and roadmaps. Maps technology trends to internal vision
 - Differentiates buzzwords from value proposition. Embraces technology trends that drive excellence beyond traditional practices (e. g. , Test automation in lieu of traditional QA practices)
 - Balances value propositions for competing stakeholders. Recommends a well-researched recommendation of buy vs. build solution. 
 - Conveys the value proposition for the company by assessing financial risks and gains of decisions and return on investment (ROI). 
 - Manages the process of building and maintaining a successful alliance. 
 - Understands and successfully applies common analytical techniques, including ROI, SWOT, and Gap analyses. Able to clearly articulate the business drivers relevant to a given initiative

Leadership

- Influences through others; builds direct and "behind the scenes" support for ideas. 
 - Pre-emptively sees downstream consequences and effectively tailors influencing strategy to support a positive outcome. Uses experts or other third parties to influence
 - Able to verbalize what is behind decisions and downstream implications. 
 - Continuously reflecting on success and failures to improve performance and decision-making. Understands when change is needed. Participates in technical strategy planning
 - Proactively identifies and removes project obstacles or barriers on behalf of the team. Able to navigate accountability in a matrixed organization
 - Communicates and demonstrates a shared sense of purpose. Learns from failure

Personal Attributes

 - Influences and energizes other toward the common vision and goal. Maintains excitement for a process and drives to new directions of meeting the goal even when odds and setbacks render one path impassable

data.title: Lead AI Engineer
data.description:
Role Summary

As a Lead AI Engineer, you will own the architecture and delivery of GenAI-based systems that integrate large language models (LLMs), multi-agent workflows, and embedding-powered retrieval solutions. You will guide cross-functional pods, define engineering standards, and drive innovation through scalable, production-grade intelligent applications. You will lead a team of associates both functionally and admin responsibilities. 

Key Responsibilities

- Architect enterprise-grade GenAI systems using modular LLM APIs, agent orchestration frameworks, and embedding pipelines
 - Design and implement autonomous agent workflows with context management, multi-agent coordination, and task delegation
 - Optimize performance, latency, and accuracy through experimentation with prompt strategies, retrieval layers, and caching logic
 - Lead solution reviews, enforce prompt safety and governance, and ensure alignment with security protocols
 - Collaborate with platform, product, and engineering leads to define reusable patterns and scalable AI capabilities
 - Guide engineering pods on GenAI design principles, system reliability, and prompt lifecycle management
 - Build and maintain reusability assets - SDKs, templates, shared agent logic - to accelerate delivery velocity across teams
 - Stay up to date with advancements in LLM tooling, orchestration abstractions, and prompt optimization techniques

Required Qualifications

- 6 to 8+ years of experience in software, AI, or ML engineering roles, including significant experience designing, delivering, and operating production-grade GenAI or agentic AI applications
 - Proven experience leading the technical delivery of LLM-powered products or agent-based solutions, including solution design, engineering guidance, and operational readiness
 - Strong technical foundation in Python and modern backend engineering patterns, with practical experience building AI-enabled application services and APIs
 - Hands-on experience with Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Studio, Semantic Kernel, LangChain, AutoGen, or equivalent platforms and orchestration frameworks, including real-world use of LLM APIs, prompt workflows, tool calling, and agent coordination
 - Strong experience designing and implementing retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and vector-based patterns using platforms such as Azure AI Search, Pinecone, Weaviate, FAISS, or equivalent
 - Experience building and deploying cloud-native AI services using technologies such as Azure Functions, Azure Container Apps, FastAPI, Docker, Azure DevOps, GitHub, or equivalent engineering and deployment platforms
 - Solid understanding of CI/CD, containerization, automated testing, and production deployment practices for AI-driven systems
 - Practical experience with observability and operational tooling such as Application Insights, OpenTelemetry, Azure Monitor, Datadog, New Relic, or equivalent, including monitoring of reliability, latency, and cost
 - Exposure to Model Context Protocol (MCP), agent-to-agent (A2A) interaction patterns, or similar context-sharing and distributed agent communication approaches
 - Strong ownership mindset across the full SDLC, including design, build, deployment, support, reliability improvement, and long-term maintainability
 - Proven ability to raise engineering quality through code reviews, technical mentoring, design guidance, and reuse of shared patterns and components
 - Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across engineering, architecture, product, and platform teams

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience leading the design or implementation of agentic AI workflows involving multi-step reasoning, tool orchestration, and reusable orchestration patterns
 - Experience with Microsoft AI Foundry, Azure Machine Learning, Azure AI / Copilot Studio, or equivalent platforms used for enterprise AI solution development and experimentation
 - Familiarity with enterprise integration and application ecosystems, including AI integration with APIs, workflow platforms, and downstream business systems
 - Experience contributing to reusable GenAI accelerators, prompt libraries, orchestration templates, internal AI developer platforms, or engineering toolkits
 - Familiarity with AI governance, safety, observability, and cost-management tooling, including token usage analytics, quality evaluation, and guardrail implementation
 - Experience supporting technical direction for other engineers through architecture reviews, implementation guidance, and technical mentoring
 - Ability to communicate complex technical decisions clearly to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders
 - Experience operating in a build-own-operate product environment with strong expectations around reliability, supportability, and continuous improvement

Our Commitment to a Culture of Inclusion & Belonging

Ecolab is committed to fair and equal treatment of associates and applicants and furthering the principles of Equal Opportunity to Employment. We will recruit, hire, promote, transfer and provide opportunities for advancement based on individual qualifications and job performance in all matters affecting employment, compensation, benefits, working conditions, and opportunities for advancement. Ecolab will not discriminate against any associate or applicant for employment because of race, religion, color, creed, national origin, citizenship status, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and expressions, genetic information, marital status, age, or disability.
