Summary

The Senior Manager, Software Engineering responsible for leading and managing the employees who develop, debug, test, deploy and support code to be deployed in systems/products/equipment for various applications. They write, debug, maintain, and test software in various common languages and for software at various levels in the hierarchy (from Firmware to Application). Software creation follows an agreed to development process (such as Agile, Scrum, etc. ) and complies with the product life cycle development (phase/gate deliverables). 

The Senior Manager, Software Engineering manages cross functional teams with other designers, customers, manufacturing engineering and project leadership to ensure robust and high quality product development. Enhance designs with feedback from reviews in areas such as manufacturing, test, supply chain, reliability, industrial design and simulations. 

Detailed Description

Performs tasks such as, but not limited to, the following: 

- Lead the design, development and implementation of technical solutions for complex projects, involving multiple domains. Participate in project planning and scheduling. 
 - Take responsibility for non-technical elements of an engineering project (people, financials etc. )
 - Review and interpret customer specifications and may act as primary customer contact. 
 - Analyze trade-offs in complex systems and recommend solutions. Develops deployment strategies and plans. 
 - Lead the deployment of strategic complex programs and coordinate site-wide deployment efforts. 
 - May manage relationships with key vendors/partners. 
 - Analyze, design and develop tests and test-automation suites. 
 - Design and develop a processing platform using various configuration management technologies. 
 - Test software development methodology (may be done in agile environment)
 - Provide ongoing maintenance, support and enhancements in existing systems and platforms. 
 - Collaborate cross-functionally with customers, users, project managers and other engineers including Peer-Reviews to achieve elegant solutions. 
 - Provide recommendations for continuous improvement. 
 - Work alongside other engineers on the team to elevate technology and consistently apply best practices. 
 - Keep up to date with relevant industry knowledge and regulations

Prior Technical Knowledge

- Solid C, C++ programming skills. 
 - In-depth understanding of Linux kernel, device driver, IPC, U-boot. 
 - Familiarity with Linux application development. Knowledge of real time OS like ThreadX is a plus. 
 - Knowledge of BMC including IPMI, SDR, SEL, FRU records, SOL, IPMB, Side-band LAN, KCS and KVM. 
 - Knowledge of Redfish and other management protocols. 
 - Experience with board bringup. 
 - Working knowledge of BMC related Hardware such as ARM, BMC chip (AST 2500, AST2600, Pilot 4 etc. ), HW-monitor and Super-IO, NC-SI NIC, phy. 
 - Working knowledge of common bus such as I2C, IPMB, PMBUS, SPI, LPC, UART, JTAG. 
 - Experience with OpenBMC is a plus. 
 - Experience with one or more of the following standards/technologies: SCSI, SES, RAID, SAS, SATA, SSD, SMART, PCI Express, HBA, network protocol TCP/UDP, etc is a plus. 
 - Experience with PSoC or MCU firmware development is a plus. 

Knowledge/Skills/Competencies

- Project Management - Ability to manage/lead complex, multiple line engineering projects that may also involve other functions. Demonstrate solid understanding of the technical, financial and people aspects of the project. Able to create a project/change management plan and ensure that the project is delivered within the assigned time and budget. Ability to recognize project barriers and develop mitigation plans 
 - Leadership - Demonstrate "People & Team Leadership Behaviors" as per Celestica Leadership Imperatives. 
 - Financial Acumen / Business Planning - Ability to create financial plans for your projects, align them internally with your line of management and other functions and externally if needed. Create project plans, profitability calculations, risk and sensitivity analysis, able to recognize barriers and mitigate profitability risks. Fully knowledgeable about internal and external financial reporting, accounting and tax requirements relevant to your area of expertise. 
 - The following competencies may also be required: Coaching/Mentoring; Communication/Negotiation/Presentation; Creative Problem Solving; Customer Interaction/Stakeholder Management; Quality & Lean; Working Effectively with Others; D/PFMEA; 8D/Corrective Action; Equipment Safety; Design of Experiments (DOE). 

Physical Demands

- Duties of this position are performed in a normal office environment. 
 - Duties may require extended periods of sitting and sustained visual concentration on a computer monitor or on numbers and other detailed data. 
 - Repetitive manual movements (e. g. , data entry, using a computer mouse, using a calculator, etc. ) are frequently required. 
 - Occasional travel may be required. 

Typical Experience

- 12 to 18 years

Typical Education

Bachelor degree or consideration of an equivalent combination of education and experience. 

Educational Requirements may vary by Geography

Notes

This job description is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties and responsibilities of the position. Employees are held accountable for all duties of the job. Job duties and the % of time identified for any function are subject to change at any time. 

Celestica is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against on any protected status (including race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran or disability status or other characteristics protected by law). 

At Celestica we are committed to fostering an inclusive, accessible environment, where all employees and customers feel valued, respected and supported. Special arrangements can be made for candidates who need it throughout the hiring process. Please indicate your needs and we will work with you to meet them. 

Company Overview

Celestica, Inc. (NYSE: CLS; TSX: CLS) is a technology leader dedicated to driving customer success and market advancements. With deep expertise in design, engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, and platform solutions, Celestica enables critical data center infrastructure for AI, cloud, and hybrid cloud and advances technologies in high-growth markets. With a talented team and a strategic global network, Celestica helps its customers achieve competitive advantages. 

Today, Celestica delivers innovative supply chain solutions globally to customers in strategic two operating and reporting segments: Advanced Technology Solutions (ATS) and Connectivity and Cloud Solutions (CC): 

ATS: This segment serves customers in complex, regulated and high-reliability markets such as Industrial & Smart Energy, Aerospace & Defense, Semiconductor Capital Equipment, and HealthTech. It is engineering led, with deep expertise in design, manufacturing and lifecycle solutions. 

CCS: This segment focuses on high-performance technology solutions and services for the data center, serving hyperscalers, digital native customers and enterprises. Celestica's Platform Solutions offering provides innovative and customizable computing, storage and networking solutions enabling AI-driven growth. 

Built on a legacy of trust and performance, Celestica has earned its reputation by delivering results in complex and fast-changing markets. Celestica exceeds customer expectations by identifying trends and staying ahead of the curve. Backed by comprehensive capabilities and a global network across North America, Europe and Asia, Celestica helps customers gain competitive advantage with the quality, flexibility and resiliency they need to respond quickly to shifts in demand. Guided by a bold vision to accelerate market advancements, Celestica delivers innovative solutions and technologies that turn complexity into opportunity. Anchored in teamwork and commitment, Celestica strives to be the most trusted partner to its customers and colleagues worldwide.

Celestica does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruitment agencies or fee based recruitment services.

data.title: Senior Software Development Engineer, Payroll Tech
data.description:
Description

Are you ready to architect highly available, large-scale enterprise software platforms that solve complex, ambiguous problems? We're seeking a Senior Software Development Engineer to join Amazon's Finance Automation Payroll Technology team, where you'll define the technical vision for core product areas and transform how we enable accurate, timely payroll processing across multiple countries at scale. 

Key job responsibilities

Design and architect scalable, reliable solutions for complex payroll and financial systems that integrate across multiple services, countries, and regulatory environments

Own the technical vision end-to-end for one or more core product areas, from problem definition through architecture, delivery, launch, and long-term operational health

Drive alignment across engineering, product, and finance stakeholders by translating ambiguous business needs into clear technical strategies and decomposing them into actionable plans

Establish and elevate quality standards through automated testing strategies, operational readiness practices, meaningful metrics, and a review culture that makes high quality the team's default

Mentor and develop engineers at all levels through code reviews, design discussions, and knowledge sharing, while leading by example in technical decision-making

A day in the life

As a Senior Software Development Engineer on our Payroll Technology team, you'll focus on designing and building systems that ensure every Amazonian gets paid accurately, on time, and in compliance with global regulations. Your day might include collaborating with engineering and finance stakeholders to decompose complex business challenges into clear technical strategies, leading architecture discussions that span multiple services and teams, and conducting code reviews that elevate the quality bar across the organization. You'll also mentor engineers at various levels, establish practices and tooling that make high quality the team's default, and work across time zones with colleagues globally to plan and deliver the next generation of our payroll platform. 

About The Team

We are a dedicated team building first-of-its-kind systems to streamline payroll processing and provide an excellent pay experience for Amazonians worldwide. Our mission is to enable our business to pay every team member accurately, on time, and at scale, with zero defects. As Amazon's workforce grows in size and geography, payroll operations become increasingly complex, and we're solving this through technology rather than process alone. You'll join a collaborative group focused on building systems that track and monitor payroll accuracy and compliance across countries and regions. We're excited to work with someone who can help us shape our multi-year roadmap and establish the engineering practices that will define our team's future. 

Basic Qualifications

- 7+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
 - 5+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience
 - 4+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
 - Knowledge of professional software engineering & best practices for full software development life cycle, including coding standards, software architectures, code reviews, source control management, continuous deployments, testing, and operational excellence
 - Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team
 - Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

Preferred Qualifications

- 4+ years of full stack development experience
 - 4+ years of programming using a modern programming language such as Java, C++, or C#, including object-oriented design experience

data.title: Principal Data Lead (Data Engineering with Full-Stack Dev) - Investment Systems
data.description:
Company Overview

KKR is a leading global investment firm that offers alternative asset management as well as capital markets and insurance solutions. KKR aims to generate attractive investment returns by following a patient and disciplined investment approach, employing world-class people, and supporting growth in its portfolio companies and communities. KKR sponsors investment funds that invest in private equity, credit and real assets and has strategic partners that manage hedge funds. KKR's insurance subsidiaries offer retirement, life and reinsurance products under the management of Global Atlantic Financial Group. References to KKR's investments may include the activities of its sponsored funds and insurance subsidiaries. 

Position Summary

We are seeking a Principal Data Lead to set the technical direction of our Reference Data Platform - the system of record that masters, governs, and distributes the firm's core reference data (parties, instruments, portfolios, and accounts. This is a hands-on technical leadership role: you will own the end-to-end architecture of a layered, event-driven data platform - spanning sourcing, ingestion, entity mastering, a bitemporal golden copy, and an API-first distribution layer - and drive it from vision to production. You will be the senior-most engineering voice on reference data, shaping platform strategy, establishing engineering standards across teams, and partnering with product, data, and infrastructure leaders to deliver a scalable, vendor-agnostic master data capability. The ideal candidate is an expert Python engineer and data architect with deep experience in master data management (MDM) and reference data within the financial industry - including market data and vendor feeds - combined with hands-on experience applying Generative AI to data platforms, distributed data processing, and building reusable, independently scalable platform components. 

We are operating in a 4-day in office, 1-day flexible work arrangement. 

Roles & Responsibilities

- Own the architecture of a layered reference-data platform, defining the contracts between sourcing, ingestion, mastering, golden-copy, and distribution layers so each is independently buildable, deployable, and scalable. 
 - Set technical direction for entity mastering - standardization, blocking, matching, survivorship, and crosswalk/lineage - designing rules as configuration (data, not code) that scale from exact-match fast paths to full-population fuzzy resolution. 
 - Architect the durable golden copy: a bitemporal, point-in-time source of truth with match evidence, per-attribute provenance, and a schema-last serving model that adapts to new sources and domains without migration. 
 - Define the event-driven backbone and cadence model (start-of-day, intraday, end-of-day, and on-demand) enabling batch today and real-time streaming (CDC / Kafka) without re-architecture. 
 - Design the API-first, self-documenting distribution surface (REST, curated data products, subscriptions) governed by data contracts and consumable by applications, analytics, and AI/agents. 
 - Drive the platform's storage and compute strategy over an open lakehouse (Apache Iceberg, Snowflake) and elastic compute (Spark), ensuring an open, vendor-agnostic, no-lock-in foundation. 
 - Establish engineering standards, reference patterns, and a reusable component library (a layered monorepo) that make capabilities build-once, reuse-everywhere across domains. 
 - Lead cross-team technical design reviews, resolve the hardest architectural trade-offs, and align engineering execution with the firm's data strategy. 
 - Champion data quality, governance, security, entitlements, audit, and observability as first-class, cross-cutting foundations of the platform. 
 - Mentor senior and staff engineers, grow technical depth across the team, and set the bar for engineering excellence. 
 - Partner with product and business stakeholders to translate reference-data needs into a durable, scalable platform roadmap. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - 12+ years of professional software engineering experience, including significant time as a technical lead or architect of data-intensive platforms. 
 - Expert-level proficiency in Python for building production services, data pipelines, and platform frameworks. 
 - Proven experience architecting master data management (MDM) or reference/entity-data systems - entity resolution, survivorship, golden records, crosswalk, and lineage. 
 - Deep data engineering expertise: data modeling, ETL/ELT design, distributed processing (Spark), and data distribution patterns at scale. 
 - Hands-on experience designing API-first services and event-driven / streaming architectures (e. g. , Kafka, CDC). 
 - Strong command of modern data storage - relational, non-relational, and lakehouse formats (e. g. , Apache Iceberg) - and SQL. 
 - Experience with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform) and cloud-native deployment (containers, Kubernetes/EKS, CI/CD). 
 - Deep domain experience with reference and master data in the financial industry - parties / legal entities, instruments, portfolios, and accounts - and the identifier, hierarchy, and cross-referencing challenges specific to it. 
 - Hands-on experience integrating and mastering market data and vendor/administrator feeds (e. g. , Bloomberg, exchange, and fund-servicing sources), including normalization, cross-referencing, and point-in-time handling. 
 - Practical experience applying Generative AI / LLMs to data platforms - e. g. , grounded retrieval over governed data, entity-resolution and data-quality assistance, or AI/agent-ready data access with provenance guarantees. 
 - A track record of setting technical direction, driving architecture across teams, and mentoring senior engineers. 
 - Excellent judgment on architectural trade-offs, and the communication skills to align engineering, product, and business stakeholders. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Familiarity with bitemporal / point-in-time data modeling and governed, auditable data systems. 
 - Experience with workflow orchestration (e. g. , Dagster, Airflow) and lakehouse catalogs (e. g. , Polaris, Nessie, Glue). 
 - Exposure to commercial or vendor MDM/ontology platforms (e. g. , Palantir Foundry) and experience integrating them as pluggable engines within an open architecture. 
 - Experience building agentic workflows or retrieval-augmented systems on top of enterprise data, and familiarity with LLM evaluation, guardrails, and grounding techniques. 
 - Experience with legal-entity identifiers and standards (e. g. , LEI, GLEIF) and regulatory reference-data requirements.

You will own the cross-architecture build environment and CI/CD pipeline, mentoring engineers to raise the bar for a platform deployed in tens of thousands of global customer environments. 

Key Responsibilities

- Own PA-VM platform health from UEFI boot path through Linux process supervision into firewall data-plane and HA/VPN control-plane daemons. 
 - Debug regressions across private and public cloud hypervisors and CPU architectures. 
 - Design and maintain Docker-based cross-architecture build environments for multi-format PA-VM images. 
 - Operate and evolve CI/CD pipelines with cherry-pick automation and hardware-in-the-loop regression gates. 
 - Design HA and VPN subsystem improvements for both on-prem and cloud-native environments. 
 - Instrument the fleet with telemetry, structured logging, automated crash-dump collection, and quality dashboards. 
 - Mentor engineers through complex debugging, drive architecture reviews, and run blameless post-mortems for P1 escapes. 
 - Partner cross-functionally with QA, Release Engineering, and Product Management to ship fixes safely. 

Qualifications

- 10+ years of hands-on systems engineering on Linux-based appliances or virtualized platforms. 
 - Deep Linux systems expertise including boot/init flow, process supervisors, journald, cgroups, and core dumps. 
 - Hands-on virtualization experience across private and public cloud hypervisors like KVM, ESXi, AWS Nitro, and GCP KVM. 
 - Proficiency with both x86_64 and ARM64 platforms, including debugging ARM-specific regressions. 
 - Working knowledge of HA stateful failover and cloud-native HA patterns. 
 - Working knowledge of IPsec and SSL VPN protocols, including IKEv1/IKEv2 state machines and cryptographic agility. 
 - Proficiency in Docker-as-build-environment, including multi-arch manifests and hermetic builds. 
 - CI/CD proficiency across multiple release trains using Jenkins, GitLab CI, Buildkite, or GitHub Actions. 
 - Experience with image-format conversion and marketplace publishing automation. 
 - Expertise in observability for distributed appliances using tools like Prometheus, Grafana, or OpenTelemetry. 
 - Demonstrated Senior/Staff-level leadership in architecture review, mentorship, and driving code-quality standards. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Prior experience shipping a commercial network security product such as firewall, VPN, SASE, or SD-WAN. 
 - Kernel programming or kernel-module experience including netfilter, XFRM, or cryptodev. 
 - Contributions to open-source infrastructure projects like KVM, QEMU, libvirt, or systemd. 
 - Experience with FIPS 140-2 or FIPS 140-3 certification processes. 
 - Experience operating multiple active release trains simultaneously with hot-patch or zero-downtime upgrade semantics. 
 - Working knowledge of GRE/VXLAN/Geneve overlays, BGP, OSPF, and modern routing stacks. 
 - Experience using Rust or Go for systems-level tooling, alongside C/C++ and Python.

The Automation Engineer (Site Commissioning) is responsible for on-site commissioning, testing, troubleshooting, and stabilization of automation systems including FLS ECS, SCADA, and PLC platforms (Rockwell, Siemens, ABB). 

This role is highly hands-on and requires working in live plant environments to ensure safe startup, reliable operation, and performance optimization of process units.

 - Instrument calibration validation 
 - Signal verification from field to PLC/SCADA 
 - Perform hot commissioning: 
 - Equipment-wise startup (motors, drives, feeders, screens, mills) 
 - Interlock validation and permissive checks 
 - Commission FLS ECS (Expert Control System) and integrate with plant PLCs 
 - Support first material flow and ramp-up to design capacity

 - Rockwell (ControlLogix / CompactLogix) 
 - Siemens (S7 / TIA Portal) 
 - ABB (AC800M / 800xA)

 - Incorrect interlocks 
 - Sequence failures 
 - Timing issues 
 - Fine-tune control logic based on actual plant behaviour 
 - SCADA / ECS Commissioning

 - FLS ECS / ECS Control enter 
 - WinCC / FactoryTalk / ABB 800xA 
 - Test: 
 - Graphics and operator screens 
 - Alarm systems and priorities 
 - Trends and data logging 
 - Ensure operator usability during live operation 
 - Field Troubleshooting 
 - Diagnose and resolve: 
 - Instrument issues (level, pressure, flow, vibration) 
 - Signal noise / incorrect readings 
 - Communication failures: 
 - Modbus, Profibus, Profinet, Ethernet/IP 
 - Coordinate with: 
 - Electrical team (MCC, drives) 
 - Mechanical team (equipment readiness) 
 - Process team (operating conditions) 
 - Process Stabilization & Optimization 
 - Tune control loops (PID tuning under real load) 
 - Optimize sequences for: 
 - Smooth startup/shutdown 
 - Reduced trips and false alarms 
 - Implement ECS logic improvements: 
 - Expert rules 
 - Interlock refinement 
 - Integration & Communication 
 - Ensure seamless communication between: 
 - PLC ↔ SCADA ↔ ECS 
 - PLC ↔ Drives / Field devices 
 - Configure and troubleshoot: 
 - OPC communication 
 - Network architecture (industrial Ethernet) 
 - Support edge device integration (if CMS / analytics deployed) 
 - Documentation & Handover 
 - Update: 
 - As-built logic 
 - I/O lists 
 - Interlock documents 
 - Prepare commissioning reports: 
 - Test results 
 - Issue logs 
 - Modifications done 
 - Support handover to operations team with training

Required Skills

Core Field Skills

- Strong hands-on experience in: 
 - Loop checking 
 - Commissioning sequences 
 - Live troubleshooting 
 - Ability to read: 
 - P&IDs 
 - Wiring diagrams 
 - Control logic

Automation Skills

- PLC programming & debugging: 
 - Ladder, FBD, basic Structured Text 
 - SCADA/ECS configuration and testing 
 - Strong understanding of: 
 - Interlocks 
 - Permissives 
 - Trip logic

Industrial Communication

- Hands-on troubleshooting: 
 - Modbus TCP/IP 
 - Profibus / Profinet 
 - Ethernet/IP 
 - Basic network diagnostics

Domain Knowledge (Highly Preferred)

- Mining / Mineral processing plants

 - Crushers, mills, flotation cells, vibrating screens, thickeners , Rotary Kilns, Filter Press, 
 - Understanding of real plant problems: 
 - Choking, overload, vibration, wear

Soft Skills (Critical For Site Role)

- Ability to work under pressure during startup 
 - Quick decision-making in plant conditions 
 - Strong coordination with multiple teams 
 - Willingness for: 
 - Travel 
 - Shift work 
 - Shutdown work

Experience

Typical Work Conditions

- On-site (plant environment) 
 - Long commissioning hours during startup

KPIs / Success Metrics

- Successful startup without major delays

 - Reduction in trips and alarms / Smooth handover to operations

data.title: Engineering Manager
data.description:
About Hevo: 

At Hevo, we are changing the way companies leverage data to drive user experience, growth, and business processes. There has been a fundamental change in the amount of data companies are generating on a day-to-day basis. More and more users in an organization are now looking to use data to drive business decisions. Data is no longer a second-class citizen and companies are seeing data as a competitive advantage. We see this change and we are on a mission to change the way companies leverage their data. 

With a technology platform processing more than 100 billion records a month and doubling itself every 6 months, Hevo is poised for exponential growth in the coming future. This position provides a unique opportunity to create a massive impact on all existing and future customers of Hevo through technology innovation. 

If you are the one who is looking to take a leap of faith and work on the technology of the future, if you obsess over customer satisfaction and experience then we are looking for you. 

About the Role: 

We're looking for an experienced Engineering Manager to lead the development of highly scalable, reliable, and secure platform services and database connectors that power mission-critical data pipelines for thousands of enterprise customers. These pipelines connect to modern data warehouses such as Snowflake, BigQuery, and Databricks, as well as Data Lakes like Apache Iceberg. 

This is a rare opportunity to own and build foundational systems, solve complex engineering challenges, and lead a high-impact team delivering best-in-class performance at scale. 

You will play a central role in shaping our platform vision, driving high accountability, and fostering a culture of technical excellence and high performance-while working closely with cross-functional stakeholders across product, program, support, and business teams. 

What You'll Do: 

- Lead, mentor and inspire a team of software engineers who take pride in ownership and delivering impact. 
 - Ensure operational excellence through proactive monitoring, automated processes, and a culture of continuous improvement with strong accountability. 
 - Drive a strong quality-first mindset, embedding it into the development lifecycle-from design to deployment. 
 - Drive technical leadership through architecture reviews, code guidance, and solving critical platform challenges. 
 - Build and operate multi-tenant, distributed backend systems at scale. 
 - Act as a technical leader-you've operated at least at Tech Lead, Staff Engineer, or Principal Engineer level in your career. 
 - Champion a culture of high accountability, clear ownership, and high visibility across engineering and cross-functional stakeholders. 
 - Collaborate deeply with Product, Program, Support, and Business functions to drive alignment and execution. 
 - Embed principles of observability, reliability, security, and auditability into all aspects of the platform. 
 - Inspire the team to pursue engineering excellence, driving best-in-class implementations and visible results. 
 - Define and track data-driven KPIs to ensure operational efficiency, performance, and team effectiveness. 
 - Take end-to-end ownership of product lines, ensuring on-time delivery and customer success. 
 - Contribute to team growth, hiring, and building an inclusive, learning-focused engineering environment. 

What We're Looking For: 

- 10+ years of experience in backend or systems software development. 
 - 2+ years in a formal or informal Engineering Manager, Sr. Engineering Manager, or Tech Lead role in a fast-paced engineering environment. 
 - Progression through senior IC roles like Tech Lead, Staff, or Principal Engineer. 
 - Strong experience with distributed systems, cloud-native architectures, and multi-tenant platforms. 
 - Proven ability to drive cross-team collaboration with product, support, business, and program teams. 
 - Demonstrated ability to drive accountability, set clear goals, and raise the performance bar for the team. 
 - Expertise in system design, scalability, performance optimization, and cost control. 
 - Proven track record of mentoring engineers, guiding architecture, and leading impactful initiatives. 
 - Clear communicator, adept at both strategy and execution. 

Bonus Points: 

- Experience with data engineering platforms, ETL systems, or database internals. 
 - Exposure to product-driven companies, especially in infrastructure, SaaS, or backup/data systems. 
 - Demonstrated history of fast-tracked growth or high-visibility impact. 
 - Led or contributed to re-architecture or greenfield systems at scale.

Role Title - Engineering Manager

Business Unit- Corp Tech

Location- Bangalore- Manyata tech Park

Impact and Contributions: This role sits within the Document Retention & Archiving (DRA) Crew in COO Transformation Technology, where our squads design, build and operate secure, scalable and resilient content platforms for the enterprise. You will help shape the future of our cloud-first platforms and services, ensuring they meet business needs while aligning with modern engineering principles, secure-by-design practices and operational excellence standards. 

As a hands-on people leader, you will lead the Software Engineering Chapter and work across DRA squads and crews to build shared capability, guide technical direction and enable consistent engineering outcomes. You will partner with Product Owners, Staff Engineers, architects and other chapter leads to strengthen delivery, platform evolution and run excellence across DRA. 

Key Responsibilities

- Demonstrate a strong risk mindset by proactively identifying, discussing and acting on current and emerging engineering, operational, security and compliance risks. 
 - Build, lead and inspire an inclusive, engaged team of engineers, setting clear expectations and creating an environment of psychological safety, constructive challenge and accountability. 
 - Coach and develop engineers through regular feedback, career planning, mentoring and succession development, while raising engineering capability across the chapter and broader practice. 
 - Translate business and technology strategy into an executable engineering roadmap, quarterly priorities and a well-managed backlog. 
 - Provide technical leadership across squads and influence architecture, design and engineering outcomes without becoming a delivery bottleneck. 
 - Establish consistent engineering standards, reusable platform patterns, automation frameworks and guardrails aligned with enterprise practices. 
 - Champion cloud-native, platform engineering and secure-by-design practices across software delivery and operations. 
 - Build a best-in-class run capability, with clear ownership of reliability, resilience, observability, incident learning, disaster recovery and continuous improvement. 
 - Partner effectively with product, architecture, cyber security, risk and operations stakeholders to manage complex dependencies and deliver sustainable outcomes. 
 - Promote engineering productivity through CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, GitOps, automated testing and self-service capabilities. 
 - Balance customer outcomes, delivery pace, technical debt, operational risk, sustainability and cloud cost when making investment decisions. 
 - Guide the responsible evaluation and adoption of emerging technologies, including AI-enabled solutions and intelligent automation. 

Requirement-

We use a broad range of tools, languages and frameworks. You do not need to be the deepest specialist in every technology; however, you will need sufficient breadth and depth to set direction, challenge designs, manage technical risk and coach engineers across the following areas: 

- Engineering leadership: Significant enterprise software engineering experience, including a proven record of leading high-performing teams and influencing outcomes across multiple squads. 
 - Software engineering: Strong working knowledge of modern application development using C#/. NET, Java/J2EE with Spring Boot, Python or comparable languages, together with design patterns, secure coding and automated testing strategies. 
 - APIs and integration: Experience governing API design and lifecycle practices, including OpenAPI, REST and SOAP, microservices, event-driven architectures and integration technologies such as Kafka, MQ, Apache Camel, Temporal or MuleSoft. 
 - Cloud architecture: Strong experience leading cloud migration and modernisation, with depth in AWS, networking, identity, load balancing, storage, compute, managed databases and highly available architecture patterns. 
 - Kubernetes and platform engineering: Practical understanding of Kubernetes and managed platforms such as EKS or AKS, containerised workloads, Helm, ingress, networking, reusable platform patterns and self-service engineering capabilities. 
 - DevSecOps and automation: Experience establishing CI/CD, GitOps and Infrastructure as Code practices using technologies such as GitHub Actions, Argo CD, CloudFormation or equivalent tooling, with appropriate software supply-chain controls. 
 - Reliability and operations: Demonstrated leadership in observability, monitoring, alerting, incident management, reliability engineering, resilience, disaster recovery and business continuity for mission-critical services. 
 - Security and risk: Strong knowledge of defence in depth, secure-by-design approaches, IAM, encryption, secrets management, public cloud obligations, compliance controls and engineering governance. 
 - Data platforms: Understanding of relational and NoSQL technologies such as PostgreSQL, Oracle and MongoDB, plus data architecture, integration, real-time processing and scalable API-based data services. 
 - Cost and performance: Ability to guide cloud cost optimisation, capacity and performance decisions using FinOps practices and tools such as Apptio Cloudability or equivalents. 
 - AI and emerging technology: Awareness of AI-enabled solutions, Retrieval-Augmented Generation, agent-based workflows and machine learning integration, with the judgement to assess value, risk and operational readiness. 
 - Communication and delivery: Excellent stakeholder communication, architectural decision-making and experience working with Agile delivery methods in complex enterprise environments. 

Education Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

data.title: Senior Engineering Manager - Mobile
data.description:
Job Title: Senior Engineering Manager - Mobile

Location: Hybrid

Job Type: Full-time

ServiceChannel Managers are the drivers of technology and team excellence, turning ideas into impactful solutions. As Senior Engineering Manager - Mobile, you will lead the team that builds and evolves our mobile product suite: native iOS and Android applications for service-request management and field-technician workflows, the supporting mobile SDKs, and our new React Native (hybrid) initiative. You are responsible for the design and delivery of these solutions, ensuring proven mobile architecture and engineering best practices. Prospective candidates must have deep, hands-on experience in native iOS (Swift) and native Android (Kotlin) development as well as React Native, and experience guiding teams across all three. They must understand secure mobile development, the app release lifecycle, and be able to define and enforce engineering standards across platforms. 

Collaborating with global teams, you will provide technical direction, mentor engineers, and shape our strategy for balancing native and hybrid development. Join us to be part of a diverse and inclusive work environment, where innovation, leadership, and collaboration drive success. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead multiple teams and tech leads; set org-level goals, structure and operating cadence, and be accountable for the combined delivery, quality and reliability outcomes. 
 - Set multi-year technical vision and architecture direction for the product area; establish architecture governance, design reviews and engineering standards across teams. 
 - Represent engineering to senior and executive leadership; communicate status, risks, trade-offs and strategy clearly, and influence cross-organization priorities and dependencies. 
 - Drive organization-wide engineering excellence: quality, security, reliability, cost efficiency and developer-experience programs with measurable targets. 
 - Lead complex cross-team and cross-region programs, resolve conflicts and escalations, and foster a culture of ownership, inclusion and continuous improvement. 
 - Own commitments and delivery outcomes for the mobile team(s), ensuring predictable and high-quality execution across iOS, Android and React Native. 
 - Define and drive the mobile technical strategy, including when to use native vs. React Native, and lead the incremental adoption of React Native alongside existing native apps and SDKs (brownfield integration, shared modules, migration paths). 
 - Translate product and business goals into clear technical deliverables and execution plans. 
 - Mentor and coach team members, supporting their professional growth; build cross-platform skills so engineers can work effectively across iOS, Android and React Native. 
 - Ensure feature and quality parity across platforms and applications; drive reuse of shared components, design systems and SDKs. 
 - Own the mobile release lifecycle: CI/CD, code signing, App Store / Google Play submissions, phased rollouts, feature flags, hotfixes, and OS/SDK version upgrades (new iOS, Android and React Native releases). 
 - Monitor delivery and app-health metrics (velocity, crash-free rate, ANRs, startup time, app size, ratings, adoption) and take corrective action when needed. 
 - Act as the primary technical and delivery point of contact for product, business, and leadership stakeholders; partner closely with Product Management and Design to shape roadmaps and manage expectations. 
 - Lead collaboration with backend, DevOps, QA, security and customer-support teams; coordinate API contracts and versioning with backend teams. 
 - Own the quality of customer-facing mobile SDKs, including API design, versioning, documentation and backward compatibility. 
 - Drive offline-first, sync, performance, accessibility and localization standards across apps. 
 - Continuously improve engineering processes; drive adoption of best practices around incident management, postmortems and root-cause analysis. 
 - Ensure compliance with security, privacy and regulatory requirements (secure storage, authentication, certificate handling, data protection, store policies). 
 - Conduct regular 1-on-1s, own performance management (goal setting, mid-cycle check-ins, annual reviews), and plan team capacity to meet roadmap commitments while avoiding burnout. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related technical discipline. 
 - Minimum of 11 years of hands-on experience in mobile development, including significant production experience in both native iOS and native Android, and at least 1-2 years with React Native (or a demonstrated track record of rapidly leading hybrid adoption). 
 - 4+ years of experience leading engineering teams, including at least 2+ years managing teams (people management, technical leadership and delivery ownership), with a track record of hiring and developing leaders. 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with keen attention to detail. 
 - Executive-level communication and stakeholder management skills; excellent communication, collaboration and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively in cross-functional and global teams. 

Required Technical Skills

- iOS: Expert in Swift (Objective-C a plus), UIKit and SwiftUI, Xcode, Swift Package Manager / CocoaPods, Core Data or equivalent persistence, and linting tools such as SwiftLint. 
 - Android: Expert in Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Android Jetpack libraries, Gradle (Kotlin DSL) and multi-module architectures, dependency injection, coroutines/Flow, and performance tooling such as baseline profiles. 
 - React Native: Strong experience with React Native, TypeScript/JavaScript, React fundamentals, native modules/bridges, and integrating React Native into existing native iOS and Android apps. 
 - Solid understanding of mobile architecture patterns (MVVM, Clean Architecture, modularization) and strong grasp of coding best practices and scalable design. 
 - Experience building and maintaining reusable mobile SDKs/libraries distributed to internal or external consumers. 
 - Hands-on experience with mobile CI/CD (GitHub Actions, Fastlane or similar), app signing, App Store Connect and Google Play Console. 
 - Solid understanding of the SDLC and familiarity with tools such as JIRA and GitHub. 
 - Knowledge of mobile security best practices (secure storage, Keychain/Keystore, certificate pinning, OWASP MASVS). 

Preferred Skills & Experience

- Experience with Firebase (Crashlytics, Analytics, Remote Config, Cloud Messaging) 
 - Experience with mobile observability and monitoring (crash reporting, APM, logging) and data-driven app-health management. 
 - Experience migrating native apps to React Native or Kotlin Multiplatform / other cross-platform approaches.

data.title: NPI Quality Lead
data.description:
About The Business

Tata Electronics Private Limited (TEPL) is a greenfield venture of the Tata Group with expertise in manufacturing precision components. 

Tata Electronics (a wholly owned subsidiary of Tata Sons Pvt. Ltd. ) is building India's first AI-enabled state-of-the-art Semiconductor Foundry. This facility will produce chips for applications such as power management IC, display drivers, microcontrollers (MCU) and high-performance computing logic, addressing the growing demand in markets such as automotive, computing and data storage, wireless communications and artificial intelligence. 

Tata Electronics is a subsidiary of the Tata group. The Tata Group operates in more than 100 countries across six continents, with the mission 'To improve the quality of life of the communities we serve globally, through long term stakeholder value creation based on leadership with Trust. '

Role Summary

The NPI Quality Lead - OSAT is responsible for end‐to‐end quality planning and execution during new product introduction at external assembly & test (OSAT) partners. This role drives product and process qualification, builds robust control plans, ensures readiness for ramp, and achieves target DPPM/FPY through data‐driven problem solving. You will be the single‐threaded owner for NPI quality at OSAT-leading gates, aligning design/manufacturing/test stakeholders, and ensuring flawless launch to mass production (MP). 

Key Responsibilities

NPI Quality Planning & Governance

Own NPI quality deliverables from concept to MP: quality plan, control plan, PFMEA/DFMEA inputs, MSA, SPC strategy, sampling plans, and Run@Rate readiness. 

- Lead phase‐gate reviews (e. g. , PRQ/POR/ES/CS/MP) and drive issue closure across design, packaging, test, and supplier teams. 
 - Define CTQs/CTPs, PPV/FAI criteria, golden lot strategy, and qualification lots (ES/CS/MP). 
 - Align acceptance criteria with product requirements (e. g. , performance, reliability, package integrity, test coverage). 

Supplier (OSAT) Readiness & Process Control

- Validate OSAT readiness for assembly & test flows (e. g. , wafer sort handoff, die attach, wire bond / flip‐chip, mold, singulation, final test, burn‐in). 
 - Review and approve OSAT process documentation: traveller/routers, work instructions, control charts, change management procedures, and escape prevention controls. 
 - Implement robust SPC (control charts, control limits, reaction plans) for critical steps; drive MSA (GR&R) for inline and end‐of‐line measurements. 
 - Ensure material control (lots, traceability, moisture sensitivity, bake, MSD handling, labeling, pack‐out). 

Qualification & Reliability

- Plan and execute package/product qualification per target standards and customer segment: 
 - Automotive: AEC‐Q100/Q104 alignment, IATF 16949 processes, PPAP‐like evidence pack. 
 - Industrial/Consumer: JEDEC JESD47/22/94 as applicable. 
 - Define qual matrices, sample sizes, and acceptance criteria; assess results (e. g. , HTOL, HAST/uHAST, TC, THB, BHAST, AC, drop, warpage/co‐planarity, BIB/burn‐in). 
 - Coordinate FA (FIB/SEM/CSAM/X‐ray/decap) and drive 8D for any qual test failures with clear containment, corrective and preventive actions. 
Test Strategy & Yield/Reliability Improvement

- Partner with Test Engineering to ensure test coverage, guard bands, OBA/OLA, correlation, and outlier screening are adequate for NPI risk profile. 
 - Monitor DPPM, FPY, bin paretos, retest/rework, drift and excursions; lead DOE and root‐cause analysis to drive yield up and escapes down. 
 - Build escape prevention and early‐warning systems (e. g. , SPC triggers, stop‐ship criteria, deviation controls, recipe locks, recipe checksum audits). 

Documentation, Compliance & Change Management

- Own the NPI Quality Pack: Control Plan, PFMEA, MSA studies, SPC control setup, qualification report, FA reports, deviations, 8D records, and readiness checklist. 
 - Ensure compliance to QMS (e. g. , ISO 9001; Automotive: IATF 16949 core tools-APQP/PPAP, MSA, SPC, FMEA, 8D). 
 - Assess and approve OSAT PCNs; manage ECN/PDN/PCN impacts to customers and internal stakeholders. 

Stakeholder & Customer Interface

- Act as the quality voice for NPI with Design, Pkg Eng, Test Eng, Reliability, Supplier Quality, and Operations. 
 - Support customer audits, qualification evidence packs, and early customer samples/CS trials with rapid feedback loops. 
 - Provide executive‐level updates on NPI quality risk, readiness, and mitigation plans. 

Essential Attributes

- Strong command of quality tools: PFMEA/DFMEA, Control Plans, MSA (GR&R), SPC (X‐bar/R, IMR, Cpk/Ppk), DOE, 8D/5Why, Ishikawa. 
 - Hands‐on experience with reliability/qualification per JEDEC/AEC, and FA workflows (CSAM, X‐ray, SEM/FIB, decap, SAM/warpage). 
 - Data analysis proficiency (e. g. , Minitab/JMP; SQL/Python a plus). 
 - Excellent communication and leadership; capable of influencing OSAT teams and cross‐functional stakeholders. 
 - Experience with layered process audits (LPA), process capability studies for advanced packaging (FC, WLCSP, SiP). 

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Engineering (Electrical, Electronics, Materials, Mechanical, Industrial) or related. 

Desired Experience Level

10+ years in semiconductor manufacturing/assembly/test quality, and in NPI and supplier/OSAT management.

data.title: AI Architect - GenAI & Agentic Systems

Drive Innovation in GenAI and Automation

Role Overview

We are looking for an AI Architect/Lead (Grade 140) to design, build, and deploy automation and Generative AI solutions end to end, from architecture and prototypes to production systems with strong post-deployment monitoring. You will work with cross-functional teams to drive agentification and shape platform capabilities used across the organization. 

Key Responsibilities

- Architect end-to-end AI and automation solutions on cloud-native platforms, from design through production. 
 - Build agentic systems: LLMs and other Generative AI models (diffusion, audio/video), RAG pipelines, and multi-agent orchestration with frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, and MCP. 
 - Build agent harnesses: tool orchestration, memory, verification loops, and guardrails such as permissions, sandboxing, and human approval for risky actions. 
 - Develop automation frameworks, and apply prompt and context engineering (retrieval, memory, context compaction) to improve accuracy, grounding, and relevance. 
 - Deploy through scalable CI/CD pipelines on Azure and/or AWS, with safe rollout and rollback. 
 - Monitor after release, with observability for traces, logs, latency, errors, token usage, and cost. 
 - Measure and improve through evaluation-driven development: quality and agent metrics, task suites, LLM-as-judge, regression tests on every prompt, model, or tool change, and benchmarking of cloud AI services. 
 - Partner with engineering, product, and business stakeholders on prototypes and demos, and drive adoption. 

What We're Looking For

Core Technical Skills

- Strong proficiency in Python and hands-on development experience. 
 - Hands-on experience with Azure and/or AWS. 
 - Experience building backend services and APIs, with automated tests around them. 
 - Experience with CI/CD and safe rollout of services, including secrets management, identity, and environment promotion.

- Practical experience with Generative AI, including LLM-based systems. 
 - Strong understanding of RAG architectures, embeddings, vector databases, and grounding strategies.

 - Experience with LLM and agent observability and evaluation (LangSmith, OpenTelemetry, or similar): quality metrics, agent metrics, traces, cost, and latency. 
 - Understanding of agent failure modes and defences: hallucination, prompt injection, and context rot. 

Nice-to-have skills

- Solid understanding of SQL and data handling for analytics or AI workflows. 
 - Hands-on experience deploying LLM and agent services on Azure OpenAI or a comparable platform, including structured outputs and versioned prompts or models. 
 - Hands-on experience with multi-modal AI (speech, transcription, synthesis, or related domains).

 - Curious, self-driven learner who actively explores and applies new AI frameworks and tools. 
 - Ability to work independently while delivering high-impact, production-ready solutions. 
 - Clear communicator, able to explain technical concepts, demonstrate solutions, and articulate trade-offs effectively.

Job Description

Renesas is seeking a highly experienced Sr. Staff /Principal DFT Engineer to drive end-to-end DFT execution for advanced SoCs/MCUs. The candidate should possess deep expertise across the complete DFT lifecycle, from test architecture definition through silicon bring-up and production test deployment. 

Key Responsibilities

- Define and drive SoC-level DFT architecture and test strategy, including Scan, ATPG, MBIST, LBIST, JTAG/IJTAG, SSN, and test compression. 

- Own the complete DFT flow from test architecture, RTL design & integration, DFT verification, scan insertion, ATPG, coverage closure, and signoff.

- Develop and deploy scalable DFT methodologies, automation frameworks, and best practices. 

- Collaborate with Design, Verification, Physical Design, and Test Engineering teams. 

- Provide technical leadership and mentor engineers across projects. 

Qualifications

Education &Experience: 

- B. E. /B. Tech. , M. E. /M. Tech. , or Ph. D. in Electronics or related field. 
 - 15+ years of hands-on DFT experience with successful delivery of multiple SoCs. 

Proven expertise in: 

- DFT Architecture & Test Planning

- DFT RTL Design & Integration

- Scan Insertion & ATPG

- MBIST, LBIST, JTAG/IJTAG

- GLS & Signoff

- Silicon Bring-up, Debug & Diagnosis

- Strong hands-on experience with Tessent, Genus/Fusion Compiler, VCS/Xcelium, and Conformal/Formality. 

- Strong automation and scripting skills using Python, TCL, Perl, or Shell. 

- Leadership & Soft Skills 
 - Strong technical leadership with the ability to influence cross-functional and global teams. 

- Demonstrated ownership, accountability, and execution excellence. 

- Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and debugging skills. 

- Proven mentoring and coaching capabilities to develop engineering talent. 

- Self-motivated, collaborative, and results-oriented with a continuous improvement mindset. 

Additional Information

data.title: Field Engineer
data.description:
Who We Are

Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1, 500 firms in 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $10 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end-to-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and levels of complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, São Paulo, London, Edinburgh, Geneva, Warsaw, Dubai, Pune and Singapore. 

The Role

As a Field Engineer you will embed directly with clients to architect and build mission-critical integrations, automations, and data solutions. Operating at the intersection of engineering and client success, you will serve as Addepar's technical vanguard - translating complex business requirements into production-grade systems while driving onboarding efficiency and operational scale. You will be the technical expert across Addepar's full solution suite - from API integrations and automation frameworks to advanced data platforms (including our white-labeled Databricks offering, ADX) and AI-driven tooling - solving our clients' most challenging problems. This role combines a forward-deployed model with deep technical expertise in modern software engineering and financial data systems. 

Applicants must have legal authorization to work in the country where this role is based on the first day of employment. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position. 

What You'll Do

- Deploy directly to client sites (virtual or in-person) to architect, build, and deliver custom integrations, automations, and data pipelines using Addepar's APIs, ADX (Databricks), and modern engineering tools
 - Design and implement production-grade solutions that dramatically improve client onboarding efficiency, reduce time-to-value, and enable operational scale
 - Build intelligent automation leveraging AI, LLMs, and machine learning to solve complex data transformation, validation, and reconciliation challenges
 - Serve as the technical owner for ADX implementations, designing robust data infrastructure within Databricks to streamline client data onboarding and analytics
 - Translate ambiguous client requirements into flexible, scalable technical solutions through deep discovery, prototyping, and iterative delivery
 - Write production-quality Python code for ETL pipelines, API integrations, data validation frameworks, and automation tooling
 - Lead technical workstreams end-to-end, from requirements gathering through production deployment, owning outcomes and client success
 - Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Services teams to identify opportunities for productization and influence platform roadmap
 - Develop internal tools, frameworks, and best practices that accelerate delivery across the broader team
 - Effectively set, manage, and communicate technical expectations with both client stakeholders and internal cross-functional teams
 - Prioritize and context-switch effectively across simultaneous client engagements, seeing each through to successful completion
 - Act as a technical advisor and trusted partner to clients, proactively identifying opportunities to drive additional value

Who You Are

- Minimum 3+ years of experience in software engineering, data engineering, or forward-deployed technical roles
 - Advanced proficiency in Python with experience building production-grade applications, APIs, and data pipelines
 - Strong understanding of REST APIs, authentication patterns, and integration architecture
 - Hands-on experience with Databricks, Spark, and distributed data processing frameworks
 - Proficiency in SQL and experience working with large-scale datasets across relational and NoSQL databases
 - Experience designing and implementing ETL/ELT pipelines for complex data transformations
 - Familiarity with AI/ML tools and experience implementing LLM-driven automation solutions
 - Strong understanding of financial data domains including portfolio management, performance analytics, and multi-asset class portfolios
 - Exceptional problem-solving abilities with a solutions-oriented mindset and bias for action
 - Outstanding communication skills with the ability to translate technical concepts for non-technical audiences
 - Proven ability to thrive in ambiguous, fast-paced environments while maintaining high-quality standards
 - Experience with version control (Git), CI/CD pipelines, and modern software development practices
 - Independent, adaptable, and entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for client impact
 - Strong work ethic, proactive approach, and high contributing teammate

Our Values

- Act Like an Owner - Think and operate with intention, purpose and care. Own outcomes. 
 - Build Together - Collaborate to unlock the best solutions. Deliver lasting value. 
 - Champion Our Clients - Exceed client expectations. Our clients' success is our success. 
 - Drive Innovation - Be bold and unconstrained in problem solving. Transform the industry. 
 - Embrace Learning - Engage our community to broaden our perspective. Bring a growth mindset. 

In addition to our core values, Addepar is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We seek to bring together diverse ideas, experiences, skill sets, perspectives, backgrounds and identities to drive innovative solutions. We commit to promoting a welcoming environment where inclusion and belonging are held as a shared responsibility. 

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation. 

PHISHING SCAM WARNING: Addepar is among several companies recently made aware of a phishing scam involving con artists posing as hiring managers recruiting via email, text and social media. The imposters are creating misleading email accounts, conducting remote "interviews, " and making fake job offers in order to collect personal and financial information from unsuspecting individuals. Please be aware that no job offers will be made from Addepar without a formal interview process. Additionally, Addepar will not ask you to purchase equipment or supplies as part of your onboarding process. If you have any questions, please reach out to ta-operations@addepar. com.

data.title: AI Test Engineer
data.description:
Position Overview: 

• Experience in software testing, specializing in Artificial Intelligence (AI) systems and assure quality of an Agentic AI platform built using LLMs, LangChain/LangGraph, CrewAI, and related orchestration frameworks. The role includes testing autonomous agent behaviour, multi agent workflows, RAG pipelines, tool integrations, and domain-specific flows across insurance scenarios such as claims, underwriting, and policy servicing. The role involves validating AI/ML models, ensuring robustness of end-to-end machine learning workflows, and driving quality engineering practices across data, models, and deployment environments. The engineer will collaborate with data scientists, ML engineers, and DevOps teams to ensure trustworthy, scalable, and production-ready AI solutions. 

• strong analytical skills, experience with AI workflow testing, and the ability to design robust test suites for dynamic reasoning systems. 

• Strong understanding of both manual and automated testing methodologies, with the ability to design, develop, and execute test scripts. 

• Responsible for the testing and delivery of parts of a product, in accordance with the customer's requirements and interpersonal quality norms. 

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, along with a proactive approach to identify and resolve issues, are essential. 

• Responsible for ensuring that the testing process is efficient, effective, and aligned with project goals and timelines. 

Responsibilities / Job Description

• Design and execute test strategies for machine learning models (classification, regression, NLP, CV, etc. ). 

• Validate model accuracy, fairness, bias detection, explainability, and robustness under varying datasets. 

• Perform adversarial testing and edge-case validation for AI systems. 

• Test autonomous agents, multi-step reasoning paths, and state transitions. 

• Validate correctness, grounding, consistency, and safety of LLM outputs. 

• Evaluate prompt robustness and behavioral variations across scenarios. 

• Validate retrieval accuracy, grounding quality, and hallucination reduction. 

• Test vector store behavior, document chunking logic, and retriever configurations. 

• Validate fallback behaviors when tools or external services fail. 

• Execute adversarial, prompt-injection, and red team style testing. 

• Validate compliance with data privacy, business rules, and insurance guidelines. 

• Benchmark LLM latency, throughput, and multi-agent performance. 

• Validate concurrency handling, degradation logic, and retry mechanisms. 

• Document test cases, behavior maps, prompt variations, and evaluation reports. 

• Work closely with AI engineers and SMEs to refine agent workflows. 

• Functional & Non-Functional Testing: 

o Conduct API testing for AI services and model endpoints. o Validate performance, scalability, and latency of AI inference services. 

o Perform security testing for data pipelines and model-serving endpoints. •

Quality Governance & Compliance: 

o Ensure compliance with AI ethics, data privacy, and regulatory standards. 

o Establish KPIs for model quality (precision, recall, F1-score, drift detection). 

o Document test strategies, results, and provide audit-ready evidence. 

• Collaboration & Leadership: 

o Work closely with data scientists, ML engineers, and DevOps teams to integrate testing into the AI lifecycle. 

o Mentor junior testers and contribute to building reusable test accelerators. 

o Represent the testing function in client discussions, providing insights on AI quality assurance. 

• Develop automated test frameworks for AI/ML pipelines. 

• Implement synthetic data generation for edge-case testing. 

• Conduct bias and fairness testing across diverse datasets. 

• Validate monitoring dashboards for model drift and performance degradation. 

• Perform regression testing for retrained models. 

• Create reusable test assets for AI projects (scripts, datasets, frameworks). 

• Provide detailed defect analysis and SLA-driven closure. 

Required Skills

• Strong experience in software testing (manual + automation) with focus on AI systems. 

• Hands-on expertise in Python for test automation, data validation, and AI testing scripts. 

• Knowledge of Gen AI frameworks (Langchain, Langgraph, CrewAI). 

• Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI). 

• Strong understanding of data validation, model evaluation metrics, and drift detection. 

• API testing experience (REST, GraphQL) with tools like Postman or REST Assured. 

• Solid knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) for AI deployments. 

• Exposure to AI ethics and compliance testing. 

• Knowledge of containerization & orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes). 

• Experience with Big Data ecosystems (Spark, Hadoop) for large-scale AI testing. 

• Familiarity with observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK stack). 

• Understanding of security testing for AI pipelines (data poisoning, adversarial attacks).

data.description:
Job Description: Sales Manager - The World Ecademy (TWE)

Experience: 4-5 years

Industry: Education / EdTech / Online Schooling

Location: Whitefield, Bangalore. 

Employment Type: Full-time

About The World Ecademy: 

The World Ecademy (TWE) is a new-age online homeschooling platform offering flexible Indian and international curriculum pathways from Pre-Primary to Grade 12. We aim to provide quality education through personalised learning, individual attention and technology-enabled teaching. 

Role Overview: 

We are looking for an enthusiastic, result-oriented Sales Manager to lead our admissions sales team, manage leads generated through multiple channels, improve conversion rates and drive student enrolments. 

The ideal candidate should be hands-on, capable of guiding and motivating the sales team, handling challenging parent interactions, and personally taking ownership of difficult leads that require additional counselling and follow-up to close admissions. 

Key Responsibilities: 

1. Lead Management and Conversion: 

- Monitor and manage leads generated through digital marketing, website enquiries, referrals and other sources. 
 - Ensure timely follow-ups, effective lead allocation and systematic tracking of every enquiry through the sales pipeline. 
 - Analyse lead quality, conversion rates and lead ageing to identify gaps and improve performance. 
 - Personally handle high-potential, difficult or stalled leads that the sales team is unable to convert, and drive them towards enrolment. 
 - Work closely with Digital marketing team and ensure the quality of leads 
 - Ensure the entire lead management is handed on CRM

2. Sales Team Management: 

- Monitor daily sales activities, calls, follow-ups, counselling sessions and enrolment closures. 
 - Guide, mentor and motivate sales executives to improve their counselling and conversion skills. 
 - Review individual performance, identify skill gaps and provide regular feedback and training. 
 - Conduct regular team reviews to track targets, address challenges and ensure accountability. 

3. Admissions and Parent Counselling: 

- Understand TWE's academic offerings, curriculum options, teaching model, fee structure and unique selling points. 
 - Effectively communicate TWE's value proposition to parents and address their concerns regarding online schooling, curriculum, fees and admissions. 
 - Support the team in handling objections, negotiating appropriately and closing enrolments. 
 - Ensure a professional and positive parent experience throughout the admissions process. 

4. Target Achievement and Reporting: 

- Take ownership of monthly and annual enrolment targets. 
 - Develop and implement strategies to improve lead-to-enrolment conversion rates. 
 - Maintain accurate CRM records, sales reports, follow-up schedules and conversion dashboards. 
 - Coordinate with the marketing team to share feedback on lead quality, campaign performance and parent requirements. 
 - Forecast enrolments, identify potential revenue gaps and recommend corrective actions. 

Required Qualifications and Skills: 

- 4-5 years of experience in sales, preferably in education or a related service industry. 
 - Proven experience in handling leads generated through digital marketing, managing a sales team and achieving enrolment or revenue targets. 
 - Strong communication, counselling, negotiation and closing skills. 
 - Ability to handle challenging parent conversations and convert difficult or high-potential leads. 
 - Experience using CRM systems, lead management tools and sales reporting dashboards. 
 - Strong analytical, problem-solving and team leadership abilities. 
 - Willingness to be hands-on rather than limiting the role to monitoring and reporting. 

The Ideal Candidate: We are looking for someone who is: 

- Target-driven: Focused on achieving enrolment goals and improving conversions. 
 - Hands-on: Willing to personally step in and close challenging sales. 
 - Proactive: Identifies gaps and takes corrective action without waiting for instructions. 
 - A team leader: Coaches, motivates and holds the sales team accountable. 
 - Eager to learn and grow: Enthusiastic, adaptable and open to learning TWE's model and evolving sales strategies. 
 - Solution-oriented: Approaches challenges positively and finds practical ways to overcome objections and close admissions. 

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs): 

- Performance will be evaluated based on: 
 - Achievement of monthly and annual enrolment targets. 
 - Lead-to-enrolment conversion rate. 
 - Follow-up efficiency and reduction in uncontacted or ageing leads. 
 - Individual sales executive performance and overall team productivity. 
 - Successful conversion of difficult and high-potential leads. 
 - Accuracy of CRM updates, sales reporting and enrolment forecasting. 

If you are a driven sales professional who enjoys leading teams, solving conversion challenges and turning enquiries into enrolments, we would love to hear from you.

data.title: Service Desk Manager
data.description:
Brief Description

We're looking for a Service Desk Manager with a strong technical support background to lead the day-to-day operations of our Service Desk. You'll drive first line and escalation support performance, keep incident and ticket management sharp, and build a team of technically skilled analysts who deliver excellent customer outcomes, all while acting as the go-to escalation point when things get critical. 

What You'll Do

- Lead and develop a team of technical and non-technical support analysts, ensuring they're fully trained across all supported systems, platforms, and processes
 - Own the team's technical performance call/ticket quality, first-contact resolution, productivity, and adherence to SLAs
 - Manage shift rosters and resourcing to maintain 24/7 coverage, including on-call and after-hours support
 - Monitor incident and ticket management against defined ITSM processes, identifying technical skill gaps and rolling out targeted training
 - Own onboarding and technical readiness for new services and customers transitioning into the Service Desk, ensuring a smooth path to steady state support
 - Act as Escalation Manager for incidents and service impacting issues, driving technical triage, coordinating with resolver groups, and keeping stakeholders updated until resolution. 
 - Lead root cause analysis on recurring issues. 
 - Manage performance against KPIs, feedback, and monthly 1: 1s
 - Stay current on the technologies and platforms your team supports, and keep building your own technical depth. 

Requirements

What You'll Bring

- 5+ years' experience managing a Service Desk or technical support team in an IT Services environment
 - Solid hands-on background in technical/IT support you understand the systems your team troubleshoots, not just the process around them
 - Strong knowledge of ITSM ticketing and call management systems (ServiceNow experience)
 - Experience in incident management, root cause analysis, and escalation handling
 - Proven people management experience leading a large technical team
 - Strong stakeholder management and the ability to translate technical issues for non-technical audiences
 - Analytical mindset comfortable deep-diving into technical/performance data as well as owning the bigger strategic picture
 - ITIL Foundation certification (minimum)

A Few Things to Know

This role supports a 24/7 service desk, so flexibility for out-of-hours emergencies, escalations, and on-call rotations is essential. You'll lead from the front line, working hands-on with your team's technical queue while collaborating with an internationally distributed team across multiple time zones.

data.title: Solutions Architect
data.description:
As a Solutions Architect, you will design the technical blueprint behind some of the world's

largest sports, media and entertainment platforms. You will work at the meeting point of client

business goals and engineering execution: shaping architectures, de-risking delivery, and

guiding teams from first conversation to production at scale. If you enjoy solving hard, 

ambiguous problems, explaining complex systems simply, and building AI-first products used by

millions, we want to hear from you!

Key Responsibilities: 

- Lead technical discovery with clients to understand business goals, existing systems and

constraints, and turn them into clear solution architectures. 

- Design scalable, secure and cost-efficient cloud architectures (AWS/GCP/Azure) for

web, mobile, TV and backend platforms. 

- Own architecture decisions across microservices, APIs, data pipelines, event-driven

systems and integrations with third-party platforms. 

- Build effort estimates, technical proposals and delivery roadmaps, and support pre-sales

conversations with credible, well-reasoned solutions. 

- Guide engineering teams through implementation, reviewing designs and code to make

sure what's built matches the architecture and quality bar. 

- Drive non-functional excellence: performance, high availability, observability, security

and compliance at massive scale. 

- Evaluate and prototype emerging technologies, especially GenAI/LLM and agentic

systems, and recommend where they create real business value. 

- Define architecture standards, reusable reference architectures and best practices

across Proximity's engagements. 

- Mentor engineers and tech leads, and contribute to knowledge-sharing through

Proximity Talks, blogs and thought leadership. 

Requirements

- 12-15 years of software engineering experience, with at least 3 years in a solutions

architect, technical architect or tech lead role. 

- Strong hands-on background in at least one backend stack (Java/Kotlin, Go, Node. js or

Python) and a solid grasp of frontend and mobile architectures. 

- Deep expertise in cloud platforms (AWS preferred), containers and orchestration

(Docker, Kubernetes), and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform or similar). 

- Proven experience designing distributed, high-traffic systems: microservices, caching, 

CDNs, queues/streams (Kafka, SQS/PubSub), and SQL/NoSQL databases. 

- Strong understanding of system design trade-offs: scalability, latency, availability, 

security and cost. 

- Experience translating business requirements into technical solutions, writing

architecture documents, and producing estimates and proposals. 

- Excellent communication skills, with the ability to present to both C-level stakeholders

and engineering teams. 

- Ability to break down complex problems into simple, practical solutions that serve

business needs. 

- Comfortable working in ambiguity and across multiple clients, time zones and priorities

Benefits

- Best-in-class salary: We hire strong talent and compensate accordingly
 - Proximity Talks: Meet and learn from designers, engineers, product leaders, and AI practitioners
 - Continuous learning: Work with a world-class team and stay close to the latest in AI, engineering, and product development
 - High-impact work: Build AI-first systems and products used at scale by global clients

About Us

Proximity is the trusted technology, design, and consulting partner for some of the biggest Sports, Media and Entertainment companies in the world! We're headquartered in San Francisco and have offices in Palo Alto, Dubai, Mumbai, and Bangalore. Since 2019, Proximity has created and grown high-impact, scalable products used by 370 million daily users, with a total net worth of $45. 7 billion among our client companies. 

We are Proximity - a global team of coders, designers, product managers, geeks, and experts. We solve complex problems and build cutting edge tech, at scale.
