data.title: SENIOR JAVA BACK END ENGINEER -SDE3
data.description:
About the Role: 

As an SDE-3 Backend Engineer, you will serve as a technical backbone for our core platform. You will lead the design, development, and delivery of highly scalable, resilient backend systems while mentoring engineers and setting benchmarks for architecture and engineering excellence. You will own modules end-to-end-driving distributed transactions, database optimizations, event-driven messaging, and cloud deployments while ensuring strict enterprise-grade security and zero-downtime reliability. 

The "Knockout Criteria" (Non-Negotiables)

 Experience & Leadership: 8-10 years of total backend engineering experience with a minimum of 2+ years of engineering team leadership and technical mentorship. 

 Core Backend Mastery: Advanced hands-on expertise in Java 17/21, Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, Spring Security, Microservices architecture, REST APIs, and GraphQL (preferred). 

 Distributed Systems & Messaging: Deep experience with message brokers and event streaming: Kafka, RabbitMQ, and Amazon SQS. 

 Data Tier Proficiency: Advanced optimization with relational and NoSQL databases: PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, and Redis. 

 Cloud & Infrastructure: Hands-on mastery of AWS (EC2, S3, RDS, IAM, CloudFront, CloudWatch), Docker, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, and CI/CD pipelines. 

 Design, Reliability & Resilience: Proven expertise in SOLID principles, Design Patterns, Clean Architecture, Hexagonal Architecture, TDD, Resilience4j, Saga Pattern, and Distributed Transactions. 

 Observability & Security: Proficiency in OAuth2, JWT, OWASP API Security, OpenTelemetry, ELK Stack, Prometheus, Grafana, Zipkin, Blue-Green deployments, Canary releases, and Feature Flags. 

 Domain Preference: Prior experience in Healthcare/HealthTech and hands-on exposure to AI/LLM integrations are strongly preferred but not mandatory. 

1. Architecture Design & System Scalability

·            Architect, build, and optimize high-throughput, low-latency microservices powering the WONDRx health data ecosystem. 

·            Implement distributed architectural patterns (Saga, Event Sourcing, Circuit Breakers) to guarantee data consistency and system resilience. 

·            Drive database indexing, query optimization, caching strategies, and performance tuning across SQL and NoSQL engines. 

2. Engineering Excellence, Reliability & Observability

·            Enforce Clean Architecture, TDD, and modular design patterns across all code repositories. 

·            Implement zero-trust security controls, API gateway authentication (OAuth2/JWT), and OWASP security safeguards. 

·            Configure comprehensive observability suites (Open Telemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, ELK) to monitor production health and automate incident alerting. 

3. Team Leadership, Mentorship & Collaboration

·            Lead and mentor backend engineers through technical design reviews, pair programming, and structured code audits. 

·            Partner closely with Product, QA, DevOps, and AI/ML engineering pods to guarantee on-time, production-grade releases. 

·            Own release management strategies, including Blue-Green deployments, Canary rollouts, and feature flag lifecycles.

data.description:
About Onit

We're redefining the future of legal operations through the power of AI. Our cutting-edge platform streamlines enterprise legal management, matter management, spend management and contract lifecycle processes, transforming manual workflows into intelligent, automated solutions. 

We're a team of innovators using AI at the core to help legal departments become faster, smarter, and more strategic. As we continue to grow and expand the capabilities of our new AI-centric platform, we're looking for bold thinkers and builders who are excited to shape the next chapter of legal tech. 

If you're energized by meaningful work, love solving complex problems, and want to help modernize how legal teams operate, we'd love to meet you. 

Position Summary

The Senior Software Engineer, Full-Stack builds substantial, interactive features inside Onit's enterprise legal operations platform, spanning enterprise legal management, matter management, spend management, and contract lifecycle management. Working across a Ruby on Rails backend and a modern JavaScript frontend, this individual contributor delivers data-dense, accurate, and resilient user experiences that fit seamlessly into the workflows legal teams rely on every day. The role partners closely with design, product, and the architecture team, owning features end to end from API to interface, with a strong focus on edge cases, performance, accessibility, and test coverage. 

Key Responsibilities

- Build substantial, interactive features inside an existing enterprise product, without disrupting the workflows they sit within. 
 - Implement data visualizations (line charts, comparison tables, range indicators) where the visual encoding carries real meaning and small inaccuracies mislead users. 
 - Build filtering and comparison controls that update complex views in real time. 
 - Implement every state the feature can be in: loading, error, empty, and the cases where there is insufficient data to show a comparison at all. These matter as much as the primary path. 
 - Build and extend Ruby on Rails APIs, consume APIs built by the architecture team, and push back early when a contract does not serve the interface well. 
 - Work closely with design, matching intent precisely and raising discrepancies rather than approximating. 
 - Make sure features load asynchronously and never block or slow the workflows they are embedded in. 
 - Build for accessibility and cross-browser consistency. 
 - Instrument features so the team can measure how they are actually used. 
 - Write tests that cover behavior, including the degraded cases. 

Required Skills

- 6+ years building production web applications, with significant frontend ownership and hands-on backend development. 
 - Strong backend experience with Ruby on Rails: building and modifying APIs, data models, and services, not only consuming them. 
 - Strong proficiency with a modern JavaScript framework (React, Angular, or Vue) and solid JavaScript/TypeScript fundamentals, including a real understanding of rendering and state management, not just framework APIs. 
 - Experience building data-dense interfaces: charts, tables, dashboards, or comparison views where accuracy of presentation matters. 
 - Experience working inside large existing codebases: reading unfamiliar code, following established conventions, and avoiding regressions. 
 - Demonstrable care for edge cases, empty states, and error handling, backed by automated tests (e. g. , RSpec and frontend testing frameworks). 
 - Strong collaboration with designers and product managers; asks clarifying questions before building. 
 - Working proficiency with AI coding tools (e. g. , Claude, GitHub Copilot) to accelerate development, debugging, and test writing, with the judgment to review and validate AI-generated code before it ships. 

Benefits & Perks That Support You

Onit offers a comprehensive total rewards package designed to support the whole employee at work and beyond: 

Health Coverage: Employee and immediate family members. 

Time Away: Flexible paid time off and 10 company paid holidays annually. 

Family Support: Exceptional paid leave for birth parents, non-birth parents, and caregivers. Onit also offers surrogacy and adoption reimbursement. 

Income Protection: 100% employer-paid life and disability insurance. 

Additional Coverage Options: Voluntary benefits including hospital indemnity, critical illness, accident. 

Tax-Advantaged Accounts: Flexi, NPS. 

Community Engagement: One paid volunteer day each year to give back to the community. 

Our Commitment to Applicants

We know that not everyone will check every box in a job description. At Onit, we value diversity, inclusion, and authenticity. If you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification, we encourage you to apply. You may be exactly who we're looking for. 

Onit Values

Customer First - Customer success is our success. We deliver value, listen, and act on customer needs. 

Purposeful Innovation - Innovation fuels our growth. We harness creativity to solve problems and lead with the intentions and expertise. 

Win as One - Teamwork is how we win. We are accountable, act with integrity, and communicate openly. 

Intentional Growth - Our people are the difference. We create an environment with compelling work, impactful contributions, and career growth.

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. data.title: Senior Backend Engineer
data.description:
About Mesh

At Mesh, our mission is to enable consumers to pay and be paid with any asset. Today, trillions of dollars in tokenized assets exist but remain largely unusable for everyday commerce. Mesh is bridging this gap by making crypto payments reliable, useful, and ubiquitous. We combine a powerful orchestration engine with a seamless consumer app to unlock liquidity for the world. Backed by leading investors like SBI, Money Forward, Paradigm, Dragonfly, Galaxy, and PayPal Ventures, we are building the infrastructure for the next era of the global economy. Join us!

Overview

Mesh is looking for a talented and experienced Software Engineer with a strong background in backend engineering. As a member of our team, you will play a crucial role in building the foundation of the world's first global crypto payments network. In this role, you'll operate across the full stack, from backend systems to user-facing applications. You'll work closely with cross-functional teams across engineering, product, and design to lead the development of secure, seamless, and scalable financial experiences. As one of our most senior technical leaders, you'll play a critical role in defining system architecture, mentoring engineers, and influencing product strategy. We're especially excited to meet candidates based in Bangalore, where you'll collaborate closely with our core team and help drive our engineering culture from the ground up. 

What You'll Do

- Develop and maintain backend services and APIs
 - Work closely with Azure cloud services for deployment and scalability. 
 - Conduct thorough testing, debugging, and prompt resolution of software defects. 
 - Stay up-to-date with industry trends and emerging technologies. 
 - Contribute to code reviews, architectural decisions, and system design. 
 - Create high-quality, efficient, and reliable code following best practices. 
 - Optimize performance and scalability of backend systems for handling large data volumes. 
 - Stay updated on the latest trends and technologies in fintech/crypto and backend development. 
 - Build crypto first and secure products to facilitate traditional financial activity, such as payments, transfers etc. 

Who You Are

- 5-7 years of professional experience as a Backend Software Engineer, preferably in the fintech/crypto industry. 
 - Strong proficiency in backend programming languages such as C#, Java, Scala, Go, etc. 
 - A security first mindset: with good knowledge of common security concepts such as AuthN, AuthZ, SAML, API security, encryption etc
 - An understanding of crypto concepts such as blockchains, RPCs, self custody wallets etc
 - Solid understanding of RESTful API design principles and microservices architecture. 
 - Familiarity with cloud platforms such as Azure. 
 - Knowledge of DevOps practices and CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Excellent communication and collaboration abilities. 

Why You'll Love It Here

At Mesh, you're not stepping into a typical role-you're joining a rocket ship in mid-liftoff. You'll tackle complex, meaningful problems that actually move an industry forward, working alongside a sharp, motivated team that moves quickly, collaborates deeply, and expects everyone to operate with ownership. This is the kind of place where you'll see your work ship fast, make real impact, and be able to point to something and say, "I built that. " You'll grow fast, level up your skills, and get a front-row seat to how a high-growth company scales from the inside, with competitive comp, solid benefits, and room to stretch your craft all coming standard. If you're energized by building, learning, and shaping something big-this is where you'll want to be. 

In-Office Expectations

Employees based in our San Francisco, New York, and Bangalore hubs are expected to work from the office at least 40% of the time (approximately two days per week). This expectation may vary slightly depending on role, team, and business needs. Certain roles that require closer cross-functional collaboration or operational support may have additional in-office requirements, which will be discussed during the interview process. Our hybrid approach is designed to balance meaningful in-person collaboration, team building, and real-time decision-making with the flexibility to work remotely. We believe this structure supports strong execution while preserving autonomy and focus time. 

How We Care For Our Team

We believe great work happens when people feel valued and supported. That starts with competitive salary and equity that grows as you and the company grow, plus comprehensive health coverage for you and your family. We offer unlimited PTO-and we mean it. Take the time you need to recharge and show up at your best. 

We're invested in your growth with a dedicated budget for courses, conferences, and certifications. Work from wherever you're most productive with our remote-friendly approach, and count on having the top-tier tools and equipment you need to do exceptional work. 

Mesh Pay is committed to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, genetic information, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, lawful alien status, national origin, age, marital status, and non-job related physical or mental disability, or protected veteran status. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

data.title: BSP Stability Staff Engineer - Customer Engineering Team
data.description:
Company

Qualcomm India Private Limited

Job Area

Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Software Applications Engineering

General Summary

JOB OVERVIEW

This position is part of the Qualcomm Customer Engineering Group, which collaborates closely with automotive partners and customers - from concept through commercialization - across Qualcomm's broad Snapdragon Automotive platform portfolio. The team supports all aspects of embedded software including hardware and software architecture, feature bring-up, platform integration, software customization, system validation, and complex debugging efforts that are critical to product launch. 

This is a Staff-level Software Applications Engineering position focused on BSP and HLOS Stability for Qualcomm Snapdragon Automotive platforms. The primary mission of this role is to own, triage, debug, and resolve system stability issues across IVI, ADAS, and FLEX segments for global automotive customers. The role spans multiple OS environments including QNX (HQX) and HGY (Hypervisor Gunyah with Linux/Android GVM), covering both QNX PVM and multi-OS virtualized stacks. 

The successful candidate will serve as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) for platform stability, driving cross-functional collaboration between the Customer Engineering team, Dev/Platform SW teams, and OEM/Tier-1 customers. As a Staff Engineer, this individual will also provide technical leadership, mentor engineers, define debug methodologies, and contribute to the continuous improvement of stability tools and automation frameworks. 

Key Responsibilities

System Stability - Debugging & Resolution

- Lead triage and root-cause analysis of system stability issues (crashes, hangs, watchdog resets, panics, SOC resets) across QNX (HQX) and HGY (Gunyah) platforms for automotive customers. 
 - Debug kernel crashes, process crashes, resource-manager failures, and OS-level hangs on QNX IVI, ADAS, and FLEX variants. 
 - Analyze full ramdumps, minidumps, and guest-dumps (QNX/Android/Linux GVM) using Crashscope, QXDM, QDSS traces, and other Qualcomm diagnostic toolchains. 
 - Identify, isolate, and drive resolution of stability regressions across chipset generations (Gen3, Gen4, Gen4. 5, Gen5) on both HQX and HGY stacks. 
 - Own stability-related Change Requests (CRs) end-to-end - from initial triage through root-cause analysis, patch validation, and integration into customer branches. 
 - Collaborate with Dev/PLT teams to diagnose Linux kernel panics, Android GVM crashes, and Gunyah hypervisor-level faults within the HGY multi-OS virtualized stack. 
 - Investigate stability failures related to HLOS system services, BSP drivers, inter-VM communication (GLINK, IPCC, SMP2P), and framework-level issues. 
 - Drive MTBF (Mean Time Between Failures) improvements for customer SPs targeting ADAS/IVI production SOP milestones. 

Customer Engagement & Technical Support

- Serve as the primary technical point of contact for stability-related issues from automotive OEM and Tier-1 customers across regions. 
 - Analyze and triage stability CRs submitted via customer issue tracking systems; provide timely, technically accurate responses and resolution paths. 
 - Support Automotive RFI (AutoRFI) assessments for stability-related NRE scoping, communicating technical complexity and resource requirements. 
 - Engage with customers during bring-up, pre-CS, and post-CS phases to proactively identify and mitigate stability risks. 
 - Provide on-site customer support as required during critical program milestones. 
 - Collaborate with NA, EU, and India CE teams to ensure 24/7 global follow-the-sun stability support. 

Stability Testing, Tools & Automation

- Drive development and validation of stability test automation frameworks for HGY and QNX platforms (e. g. , Axiom-based stability pools, CI/CD integration). 
 - Enable and validate security hardening passes that impact stability: Syzcaller, KASAN, UBSAN, KTSAN, CFI, PTRAUTH on HGY Linux-based stacks. 
 - Develop and maintain automated ramdump/minidump parsers and triage tools to reduce mean time to diagnosis. 
 - Partner with APT (Automated Platform Test) teams to define test cases targeting top stability hitters across program milestones. 
 - Create and maintain debug guides, triage runbooks, and reusable diagnostic artifacts for stability issues across QNX and HGY platforms. 
 - Track and analyze stability trends across program stages (Bringup → ES → L0-L4 → FC → CS) and communicate risk to program and customer teams. 

Technical Leadership & Mentorship

- Serve as the stability SME for the BDC CE BSP team, providing architectural guidance on platform stability design and debugging strategy. 
 - Lead cross-functional stability reviews with Dev, APT, PDT, and CE teams; drive root-cause analysis (RCA) delivery to enable new test case generation. 
 - Mentor junior and mid-level engineers on system stability concepts, QNX/HGY platform architecture, debugging methodology, and customer engagement. 
 - Influence feature design and architecture decisions to proactively prevent system instability in future Snapdragon Automotive SPs. 
 - Scale technical knowledge through reusable documentation, training materials, and knowledge-base contributions (e. g. , Confluence, CE KnowledgeBase). 

Minimum Qualifications

Education & Experience

One Of The Following

- B. E. / B. Tech in Engineering, Computer Science, Electronics, or related field with 8+ years of Software Applications Engineering, Embedded Systems, or related experience. 
 - M. Tech / M. S. in relevant field with 6+ years of experience. 
 - Ph. D. in relevant field with 4+ years of experience. 

Required Technical Skills

- 3+ years of hands-on experience debugging system stability issues on embedded platforms (crashes, panics, watchdog resets, kernel oops). 
 - 3+ years of experience with C, C++, Python, or similar languages in an embedded/real-time environment. 
 - Strong knowledge of QNX OS architecture: process management, IPC, resource managers, POSIX interfaces, and real-time scheduling. 
 - Experience debugging QNX-based systems using ramdump parsers (QXDM Crashscope), QDSS traces, and guestdump analysis. 
 - Hands-on experience with QNX HQX platform: BSP drivers, power management, framework services, and OS-level debugging. 
 - Experience with Linux kernel debugging (kernel panic, KASAN, UBSAN, ftrace, perf) on automotive or embedded platforms. 
 - Understanding of multi-OS hypervisor stacks: VM communication (GLINK, IPCC), hypervisor fault isolation, guest OS crash analysis. 
 - Experience with automotive embedded debugging tools: QDSS, QFIL, QXDM, Axiom, Crashscope, and PCAT. 
 - 3+ years of customer-facing technical support experience. 
 - Strong written and verbal communication skills, with demonstrated ability to document RCAs and communicate technical findings to cross-functional teams. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Staff-level experience owning platform stability for production automotive programs (IVI / ADAS / FLEX) from bringup through SOP. 
 - Deep expertise in HGY (Gunyah Hypervisor) platform stability: Linux PVM, Android GVM, and multi-OS virtual stack crash analysis. 
 - Experience with QNX stability areas: SSR (Subsystem Restart), PIL (Peripheral Image Loader), SMMU faults, memory corruption, ECC errors, and HAB (Hypervisor Access Bridge) failures. 
 - Experience triaging and resolving issues across HLOS and non-HLOS boundary: GLINK/IPCC communication failures, shared memory corruption, VMM/VDEV faults. 
 - Familiarity with Qualcomm Snapdragon Automotive chipsets: SA8255P, SA8775P, SA8650P, SA8295P across Gen3 / Gen4 / Gen4. 5 / Gen5. 
 - Experience with security-related stability testing: Syzcaller fuzzing, KASAN, UBSAN, KTSAN, CFI, and PTRAUTH on Linux-based platforms. 
 - Experience working with Axiom automation infrastructure for automotive stability testing and CI/CD integration. 
 - Familiarity with ASPICE process compliance, ASIL functional safety considerations, and automotive program delivery cycles. 
 - Proven experience collaborating with global automotive OEM/Tier-1 customers (e. g. , Mercedes-Benz, BMW, Bosch, LGE, Ford, Harman, Rivian) on stability escalations. 
 - Experience with AutoRFI processes, NRE scoping, and CDEV (Chipset Development) activities within CE programs. 
 - Knowledge of MTBF analysis, stability dashboards (Tempus/Tableau), and workload-based stability trend analysis. 

Minimum Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 4+ years of Software Applications Engineering, Software Development experience, or related work experience. 

OR

Master's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 3+ years of Software Applications Engineering, Software Development experience, or related work experience. 

OR

PhD in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 2+ years of Software Applications Engineering, Software Development experience, or related work experience. 

- 2+ years of experience with Programming Language such as C, C++, Java, Python, etc.

data.title: Sr SDET I
data.description:
Job Description

We are looking for a Sr SDET 1 to improve the quality, reliability, and release confidence of products. You will work closely with software engineers, product managers, and other quality engineers to design test strategies, build maintainable automation, and make quality part of the development lifecycle. A key part of the role is validating features before they reach the QA environment, providing fast feedback while changes are still in the development process. 

The role has a strong hands-on focus on browser automation using C#, Selenium WebDriver, and NUnit. You will contribute to our existing end-to-end test framework and CI pipelines and help ensure that critical workflows across the applications are covered by fast, trustworthy, and diagnosable tests. 

Requirements

RESPONSIBILITIES

- 3-5 years of experience in software quality engineering, test automation. 
 - Hands-on experience building browser automation with Selenium WebDriver and a test framework such as NUnit. 
 - Solid knowledge of object-oriented programming, automation testing, databases, networking, web services and UI applications
 - Strong knowledge of CI/CD and build pipelines
 - Experience with Jira, Azure DevOps or similar issue tracking tools
 - Experience testing Angular/React applications. 
 - Experience with NUnit parallel execution, test sharding, and managing shared or environment-specific test data. 
 - Experience testing REST or GraphQL APIs alongside browser-based workflows. 
 - Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate across engineering, product, and quality teams. 
 - Degree in computer science, information systems, or similar technical education preferred

Principal Accountabilities

- Plan and perform pre-merge verification of feature changes before they are promoted to the QA environment, helping teams catch regressions early. 
 - Build and extend automated tests in C# using Selenium WebDriver and NUnit, following the framework's page-object and component-part patterns. 
 - Keep tests focused on one logical behavior, with clear setup, assertions, reporting, and cleanup. 
 - Use API clients for efficient test-data setup and cleanup where appropriate, while validating user-visible behavior through the UI. 
 - Make test runs safe to execute in parallel through isolated data, appropriate user and environment selection, and tracked resource cleanup. 
 - Identify coverage gaps, maintain test inventories or coverage documentation, and recommend the right level of testing for new and changed features. 
 - Review test code and pipeline changes, coach teammates, and promote pragmatic quality engineering practices across the team. 
 - Diagnose failures using test output, screenshots, browser logs, and CI artifacts; distinguish product defects from test, data, and environment issues. 
 - Partner with frontend and platform engineers to improve testability, including advocating for stable automation hooks when needed. 

Qualifications

- Strong knowledge of C# or other object-oriented languages
 - Strong knowledge or software architecture including SOLID, design patterns and design principles
 - Knowledge of system architecture (such as microservices, containers, multi process applications and APIs
 - Practical use of AI tools in day-to-day engineering activities, such as test design, code assistance, debugging, or summarizing test results, with the judgment to review and validate AI-generated output. 
 - Familiarity with mobile application testing or mobile automation frameworks is a plus. 
 - Experience in insurance, property restoration, construction, or remodeling software. 

About Us

Our People, Our Culture

At F5, we strive to bring a better digital world to life. Our teams empower organizations across the globe to create, secure, and run applications that enhance how we experience our evolving digital world. We are passionate about cybersecurity, from protecting consumers from fraud to enabling companies to focus on innovation. 

Everything we do centers around people. That means we obsess over how to make the lives of our customers, and their customers, better. And it means we prioritize a diverse F5 community where each individual can thrive. 

As a Senior Software Development Engineer bridges software development and quality assurance, writing code to build automated test frameworks, validate complex system architectures, and lead quality strategy across engineering teams. 

Core Responsibilities

- AI-Driven Automation Infrastructure: Design, build, and scale end-to-end automated testing frameworks, integrating AI agents for autonomous test generation, maintenance, and self-healing suites. 
 - Framework Architecture: Develop and maintain scalable test tooling and infrastructure across backend APIs, distributed cloud architectures, and web/mobile interfaces. 
 - AI & LLM Validation: Establish testing strategies for features powered by Large Language Models (LLMs), focusing on prompt regression, hallucination detection, bias evaluation, and determinism. 
 - Code & Quality Reviews: Act as a technical subject matter expert (SME) for code hygiene, guiding design reviews, and evaluating testability and architectural health. 
 - Test Strategy & Coverage: Define and drive test strategies spanning functional, regression, API, performance, load, contract, and chaos/resilience engineering.

 - Debugging & Root Cause Analysis: Investigate complex system failures, performance bottlenecks, race conditions, and production issues.

 - Mentorship: Guide junior and mid-level engineers while advocating for a strong quality-first culture.

- Experience: Typically 5 to 9+ years of combined experience in software development, backend engineering, or specialized SDET/test engineering roles.

Position Type

Full time

Type Of Hire

Experienced (relevant combo of work and education)

Are you curious, motivated, and forward-thinking? At FIS, you'll have the opportunity to support the coordination and delivery of meaningful projects that connect financial services with modern technology. Our talented people empower us, and we believe in being part of a team that is open, collaborative, entrepreneurial, passionate, and above all, fun. 

About The Team

You will be part of our QA and Test Services (QATS) team, supporting quality engineering initiatives for critical client applications. In this role, you will contribute to Manual, Functional, and Automation testing practices across delivery teams, working closely with QA leads, SDETs, engineering, and business stakeholders. You will help execute test strategy, improve product quality, and support reliable releases through well-planned testing and CI/CD-aligned automation. 

What You Will Be Doing

- Analyze business and functional requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria to identify test conditions, scenarios, and edge cases. 
 - Perform Manual and Functional testing across application components, services, and end-to-end business flows, including smoke, sanity, regression, integration, and UAT support. 
 - Prepare, review, and maintain high-quality test cases, test scenarios, and test data with clear steps, expected results, and coverage mapping. 
 - Execute test cases (manual and automated), log defects with clear reproduction steps, track them to closure, and share concise test execution and status reports. 
 - Manage test artifacts in Jira and Zephyr - create and run test cycles, link test cases to stories and defects, and maintain traceability from requirement → test case → execution → defect. 
 - Participate in requirement walkthroughs, sprint planning, daily stand-ups, defect triage, and release readiness reviews. 
 - Perform API testing across REST, SOAP, and RPC interfaces using tools such as Postman or Bruno, and validate request/response payloads, status codes, and business rules. 
 - Contribute to Automation testing by building and maintaining automated tests for Web Applications and Web Services using Playwright, Selenium, and related tools in Java/C#. 
 - Support Unit Test practices with clear code coverage and meaningful assertions where applicable. 
 - Help integrate automated tests into DevOps pipelines and CI tools (for example Jenkins/Bamboo) under guidance of senior team members. 
 - Identify candidates for automation from the existing manual regression suite and convert them progressively. 
 - Apply object-oriented programming principles using Java/C# when writing or maintaining automation code. 
 - Follow coding standards, SDLC best practices, and quality engineering guidelines consistently. 
 - Analyze system behavior and troubleshoot issues across UI, API, and data layers with strong problem-solving skills. 
 - Document test strategy inputs, reusable test patterns, and lessons learned for wider team adoption. 
 - Collaborate with QA and engineering teams to establish test cases, test data, and environment readiness across environments. 
 - Support quality-focused infrastructure and operational documentation. 
 - Assist in building and integrating GenAI, LLM, and Agentic AI solutions to accelerate QA activities such as test case generation, test data creation, and defect analysis. 
 - Explore emerging technologies such as MCP, multi-agent systems, and AI-assisted testing to improve delivery outcomes. 
 - Identify recurring issues and process gaps, and apply AI-assisted solutions where appropriate. 

What You Bring

- 2+ years of relevant work experience in software quality engineering, covering Manual, Functional, and Automation testing. 
 - Strong hands-on experience in Manual and Functional testing - requirement analysis, test case design, test data preparation, execution, and defect lifecycle management. 
 - Practical working experience with Jira and Zephyr (or equivalent test management tools) for test case preparation, test cycle execution, defect tracking, and requirement traceability. 
 - 2+ years of hands-on experience in API testing (REST, SOAP, RPC) using Postman, Bruno, or similar tools. 
 - 2+ years of hands-on Automation Testing experience with frameworks such as Selenium, Playwright, XUnit, or NUnit. 
 - Working programming skills in Java/C#/Python with understanding of object-oriented programming fundamentals. 
 - Working knowledge of DevOps and Continuous Integration tooling. 
 - Good knowledge of XML and HTML. 
 - Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills (verbal and written English). 
 - Ability to learn new technologies quickly and work effectively across functional teams. 
 - Basic understanding of architecture design concepts and software development lifecycle processes. 
 - Exposure to GenAI, LLMs, Prompt Engineering, RAG, or Agentic AI concepts. 
 - Practical use of GitHub Copilot for faster and higher-quality delivery across test cases, test data, and automation. 
 - Curiosity and willingness to learn, evaluate, and apply emerging AI technologies responsibly. 

Added Bonus if you have

- Experience in financial services or payment domain. 
 - Familiarity with ISO 8583 message format. 
 - Exposure to BDD/TSS frameworks such as Cucumber or SpecFlow. 
 - Awareness of code coverage/quality tools such as SonarQube. 
 - Exposure to C#, Java, Python, Oracle PL/SQL, Postman, or Bruno. 
 - Hands-on experience with JavaScript, PowerShell, CSS, or related test automation ecosystem tools. 

What We Offer You

- An exciting opportunity to be part of the world's leading FinTech product organization. 
 - A vibrant team environment and the opportunity to build a career in the core banking/payments domain. 
 - Competitive salary and attractive benefits including GHMI/Hospitalization coverage for employees and dependents. 
 - A multifaceted role with a high degree of responsibility and a wide range of opportunities. 
 - A broad range of professional education and personal development possibilities - FIS is your final career step

Privacy Statement

FIS is committed to protecting the privacy and security of all personal information that we process in order to provide services to our clients. For specific information on how FIS protects personal information online, please see the Online Privacy Notice. 

Sourcing Model

Recruitment at FIS works primarily on a direct sourcing model; a relatively small portion of our hiring is through recruitment agencies. FIS does not accept resumes from recruitment agencies which are not on the preferred supplier list and is not responsible for any related fees for resumes submitted to job postings, our employees, or any other part of our company.

data.title: Principal Site Reliability Engineer
data.description:
Job Description

Designs and architects infrastructure and service to ensure reliability and functionality. Forecasts demands and responds to capacity needs. Collaborates with software development teams to develop reliable and scalable infrastructures. Exercises judgment when performing data collection to maintain and optimize operations and reliability. Leverages advanced knowledge to perform incident response and/or maintenance tasks. Provides comprehensive health and performance reporting. Identifies and recommends opportunities for automation. Communicates comprehensive information about services and proactively anticipates and articulates the potential impact of changes. Provides comprehensive support for technology and documents incidents. Conducts advanced experiments with new tools and develops and maintains advanced knowledge of site reliability trends. 

Responsibilities

Mandatory

- 5+ years of hands-on experience across software development, site reliability engineering, monitoring, and automation, with demonstrated ownership of production platforms. 
 - Strong programming skills in Python and experience developing backend services, REST APIs, integrations, and event-driven workflows. 
 - Proven experience building monitoring and observability solutions that collect and analyze alerts, metrics, logs, and service context. 
 - Hands-on experience integrating AI/LLM capabilities into applications for incident analysis, contextual recommendations, and operational decision support. 
 - Ability to develop reusable agents that combine live monitoring data, historical incidents, and previous remediation actions to recommend next steps. 
 - Experience implementing alert correlation, deduplication, enrichment, and prioritization to reduce noise and improve incident detection. 
 - Strong experience developing automated remediation workflows with approval controls, execution validation, audit trails, and recovery safeguards. 
 - Experience integrating monitoring platforms with incident management systems, knowledge repositories, and notification or escalation services. 
 - Strong understanding of distributed systems, Linux, networking, databases, and application performance, with the ability to translate failure patterns into platform capabilities. 
 - Experience applying software engineering practices, including automated testing, code reviews, CI/CD, version control, and secure development. 
 - Ability to evaluate platform reliability and AI output quality, measure operational outcomes, and improve capabilities using engineer feedback. 
 - Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work with monitoring teams, service owners, and engineers to onboard services and define requirements. 

Good-to-Have

- Experience with agentic AI frameworks, tool calling, retrieval-augmented generation, and vector databases. 
 - Knowledge of anomaly detection, time-series analysis, and predictive techniques for identifying recurring alarm patterns. 
 - Experience building centralized notification services, automated escalation calls, and incident communication workflows. 
 - Familiarity with OCI, Kubernetes, and Infrastructure-as-Code tools such as Terraform or Ansible. 
 - Experience with observability platforms such as OCI Observability, Prometheus, Grafana or equivalent tools. 
 - Exposure to Oracle Database and Exadata monitoring, performance diagnostics, and remediation automation. 
 - Experience using AI coding assistants to improve operational scripts and validate proposed changes. 
 - Knowledge of SLOs, error budgets, and incident metrics such as detection time, recovery time, and recurrence rate. 

Key Responsibilities

Capacity Ingestion and Management: 

- Designs and architects infrastructure and/or service according to terms for reliability and functionality. 
 - Forecasts demands for infrastructure and responds to capacity needs, ensuring systems have sufficient resources to handle current and future workloads and identifying resource gaps. 
 - Collaborates with the software development team to develop infrastructures, ensuring features are reliable and scalable according to deployment requirements. 
 - Proactively identifies opportunities for prototyping and drives prototyping initiatives (e. g. , testing new applications or infrastructures, assisting in onboarding) to explore novel approaches. 

Incident and Service Lifecycle Management: 

- Exercises judgment when performing data collection, triage, technical analysis, and redirection to maintain and optimize operations and infrastructure reliability. 
 - Takes proactive steps to monitor services, maintain up-to-date knowledge of their performance, and document their condition. 
 - Leverages advanced knowledge to perform incident response, root cause analyses, and/or maintenance on assigned services (e. g. , software installs, version upgrades, security updates, backup and recovery). 
 - Provides comprehensive health and performance reporting and takes appropriate actions based on trends in data. 
 - May perform provisioning to support infrastructure, applications, and services. 
 - May experiment with new approaches for and performs decommissioning (e. g. , shutting down servers, removing data from databases) to remove objects that are no longer needed. 

Automation: 

- Identifies and recommends opportunities for automation and assesses potential benefits to enhance operational efficiency. 
 - Develops and implements design, automation tools, or scripts to provide solutions, gather metrics, monitor, analyze, mitigate, or remediate issues/defects within infrastructures. 
 - Conducts testing on moderately complex automations to ensure they perform tasks correctly and produce expected results. 

Technical Communication and Guidance: 

- Writes release notes and/or communicates comprehensive information about the scale, capacity, security, performance attributes, and requirements of services and technology with customers and immediate and related teams. 
 - Proactively anticipates and articulates the potential impact of infrastructure, feature, and tool changes, considering their impact across team operations. 
 - Serves as a resource to team members on what information to communicate and how to communicate. 

Troubleshooting and Resolution: 

- Provides comprehensive operational support for technology, serving as a key escalation point for incidents and moderately complex issues arising within Oracle services. 
 - Drives and actively participates in on-call shifts to address issues. 
 - Executes the resolution of technical issues spanning multiple services, applying advanced investigation and debugging techniques to achieve SLOs (service level objectives). 
 - Documents incidents according to reporting methods and performs root cause analyses, capturing essential information for analysis and future reference. 
 - Performs post-mortem procedures to prevent incident reoccurrence. 

Innovation and Improvement: 

- Conducts advanced experiments and evaluations of cutting-edge tools and technologies to optimize infrastructure performance and reliability, taking proactive steps to adhere to security standards. 
 - Identifies and seeks opportunities to execute improvements for performance bottlenecks and deployments, ensuring efficient resource usage, speed, and scalability. 
 - Develops and maintains advanced knowledge of site reliability trends, sharing valuable insights and information with senior team members, management, and beyond to promote innovative building, testing, deploying, and running services. 
 - Performs moderately complex analyses and provides clear data on production to drive business development decisions (e. g. , design changes). 

Core Responsibilities

Planning & Execution: 

- Manages and coordinates moderately complex tasks, monitoring timelines and deliverables to ensure timely completion and adherence to requirements for a moderately sized project or initiative. Efficiently delegates, monitors, and prioritizes work across multiple projects, providing technical oversight and adjusting plans to address shifts in resources or timelines. 

Collaboration & Partnership: 

- Collaborates across the organization to align on expectations and achieve shared objectives. Leverages understanding of business leaders, stakeholders, and/or customers to ensure proposed solutions meet their needs. Supports inclusivity by actively seeking and listening to diverse perspectives, ensuring others feel heard and respected. 

Problem Solving: 

- Identifies and addresses moderately complex issues by analyzing a wide range of data and/or information to identify solutions in accordance with standard practices. Proactively escalates unresolved or critical issues with a thorough assessment and suggests potential solutions. Reviews, contributes to, and documents problem solving strategies. 

Continuous Learning: 

- Pursues learning opportunities to expand knowledge and skills and/or tools in new areas and stays abreast of the latest industry trends and best practices. Proactively seeks and leverages ongoing feedback and training to improve skills. Coaches and mentors junior team members, fostering continuous learning and knowledge sharing within and across teams. 

Continuous Improvement: 

- Develops ideas, recommends updates, and/or collaborates on the implementation of process improvements to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows across teams, and evaluates the impact on key stakeholders. Solicits feedback from others on ideas for alternative approaches and methods for continued improvement. 

Performance and Development: 

- Contributes to the talent development pipeline by participating in candidate interviews, assessing candidates, and providing hiring recommendations. 

About Us

Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives. 

True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That's why we're committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs. 

We're committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation-request_mb@oracle. com or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States. 

Oracle is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans' status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Oracle will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.

data.title: Application Engineering Technical Lead - II // Lead Full Stack Engineer
data.description:
About Vanguard

Founded in 1975, Vanguard is one of the world's leading investment management companies. The firm offers investments, advice, and retirement services to tens of millions of individual investors around the globe-directly, through workplace plans, and through financial intermediaries. 

Vanguard India

Vanguard's office in India is a significant milestone in our global expansion. We are committed to establishing an enduring technology center in Hyderabad, Telangana and are excited to be adding talent who will focus on Artificial Intelligence (AI), mobile, and cloud-based technologies that drive our business outcomes and deliver a world-class experience for our clients. 

Role Summary

The Application Engineering Technical Lead II leads the design and delivery of scalable, secure, cloud-native applications and platform capabilities. This role combines hands-on engineering with technical leadership across Java, AWS, event-driven/serverless architecture, APIs, modern front-end technologies, and platform engineering. 

The ideal candidate brings deep software engineering experience, strong AWS expertise, technical leadership capabilities, and experience working within the financial services industry. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead the design and development of scalable applications and event-driven, serverless solutions on AWS. 
 - Provide technical leadership and hands-on engineering across Java, Spring Boot, Node. js, React, Angular, and APIs. 
 - Build and enhance reusable platform capabilities, infrastructure, tooling, and shared services. 
 - Drive platform reliability, scalability, security, and operational excellence through effective coding, testing, monitoring, and engineering practices. 
 - Design and integrate REST/GraphQL APIs, microservices, and event-driven architectures. 
 - Apply Infrastructure as Code, including CloudFormation, and support automated CI/CD and cloud deployments. 
 - Improve developer experience through reusable engineering patterns, automation, documentation, and self-service capabilities. 
 - Lead troubleshooting and resolution of complex application and production issues and participate in production support/on-call activities. 
 - Establish strong engineering practices across code quality, testing, observability, monitoring, and continuous delivery. 
 - Mentor engineers, lead technical discussions and design reviews, and collaborate with engineering, product, and business stakeholders. 

Qualifications And Skills

- Minimum 10 years of overall software engineering experience, including at least 3 years in a technical leadership role. 
 - Bachelor's degree (B. E. /B. Tech) in Computer Science or a related field, or a Master's degree/Diploma in Computer Science. 
 - Strong hands-on development experience with Java, along with Spring Boot, Node. js, Angular, React, TypeScript, APIs, and microservices. Working knowledge of Python is beneficial. 
 - Strong AWS experience, including cloud-native, serverless and event-driven architectures, with knowledge of services such as Lambda, ECS, EC2, S3, IAM, SNS, SQS, CloudFormation, and CloudWatch. 
 - Strong understanding of REST APIs, GraphQL, HTTP patterns, distributed systems, and event-driven application design. 
 - Experience with CI/CD, version control, automated testing, Infrastructure as Code, Docker, and Kubernetes. 
 - Experience with relational/NoSQL databases, caching, and messaging technologies such as PostgreSQL, Oracle, DB2, DynamoDB, Redis, and Kafka. 
 - Strong understanding of platform engineering, reusable engineering patterns, developer tooling, self-service capabilities, and developer experience. 
 - Experience with production monitoring and observability using tools such as Honeycomb, Splunk, and AWS CloudWatch, with the ability to troubleshoot complex production issues. 
 - Experience delivering technology solutions within banking, financial services, or financial-sector environments. 
 - Strong technical leadership, mentoring, stakeholder collaboration, communication, and problem-solving skills. 

Location

This role is based in Hyderabad, Telangana at Vanguard India. Only qualified external applicants will be considered. 

Our mission

Vanguard adheres to a simple purpose: To take a stand for all investors, to treat them fairly, and to give them the best chance for investment success. 

Our commitment to you

Benefits

Vanguard takes the same long-term view of your success-at work and in life-with Benefits and Rewards packages that reflect what you care about, throughout all the phases and stages of your life. Our Total Rewards programs provide you and your loved ones with wellness support for key areas in your life: 

Financial wellness

We're committed to enabling your financial success and provide competitive offers and programs. 

Physical wellness

We're committed to providing benefits that support your physical health and wellness. 

Personal wellness

We're committed to providing resources that help support the full scope of your life. 

How We Work

Vanguard has implemented a hybrid working model for most of our employees (crew members), designed to capture the benefits of enhanced flexibility while enabling in-person learning, collaboration, and connection. We believe our mission-driven and highly collaborative culture is a critical enabler to support long-term client outcomes and enrich the employee experience.

data.title: Software Development Engineer 1
data.description:
About The Team / Role

In today's software development landscape, collaboration, E2E accountability, problem solving and streamlined workflows are key to achieving efficiency and delivering high-quality solutions that solve customer problems and generate business outcomes. We believe in the power of integrated engineering, where development, quality, and agility skills blend together throughout the solution delivery pipeline. In this role, you'll be a champion for this approach, fostering a culture of shared ownership and breaking down silos to ensure a smooth and efficient flow of innovation to customers. 

How You'll Make An Impact

- Collaborate with stakeholders throughout the SDLC to translate requirements into high-quality, reliable, cost-effective, and maintainable solutions that solve customer problems and generate business outcomes. 
 - Design, develop, and implement high quality software components with a focus on Continuous Delivery principles and practices. 
 - Champion integrated engineering practices within the organization, fostering collaboration and shared ownership between development, operations, and security teams. Deliver technical and administrative support for live applications, promoting automation and proactive monitoring and self-recoverability, rapid incident response, and continuous improvement. 
 - Analyze existing systems and processes to identify bottlenecks and opportunities for improvements to flow. 
 - Full-Stack / Backend Development: Design, develop, test, and deploy clean, maintainable, and efficient code using Java and JavaScript. 
 - Database Management: Write optimized queries, design data schemas, and manage both relational (MySQL, Oracle) and NoSQL database integrations. 
 - Component Design: Apply Object-Oriented Programming (OOPS) principles and design patterns to translate functional requirements into scalable technical modules. 
 - Algorithm & Data Structure Application: Select and implement optimal data structures and algorithms to solve performance bottlenecks and ensure low-latency system behavior. 
 - Collaboration & Code Reviews: Actively participate in peer code reviews, sprint planning, and technical discussions to lift code quality and team standards. 
 - System Quality & Reliability: Write unit, integration, and functional tests to maintain high code coverage and minimize production defects. 

Core Skills

- Programming/Software Development: This skill remains the foundation. Proficiency in programming languages and development methodologies is essential for designing, developing, and implementing software components in an integrated engineering environment. A strong focus on continuous delivery practices is crucial. 
 - Testing Quality assurance is paramount. The ability to design, execute, and analyze various types of tests to ensure deployments meet established acceptance criteria remains essential. 
 - Requirements Management : Understanding requirements throughout the software delivery lifecycle is critical. This ensures alignment with business needs, avoids rework, and fosters collaboration with stakeholders. 
 - Software Design: While automation might play a larger role in integrated engineering, a combined understanding of software development practices and design principles is still valuable. This ensures creating maintainable, scalable, and secure applications. 
 - Measurement: Data-driven decision making is crucial. The ability to define and establish measurement frameworks, along with KPIs related to software delivery and performance, helps identify areas for improvement. 

Additional Valuable Skills

- Configuration Management: Managing configurations with IaC tools is essential for consistent and repeatable deployments. However, the specific emphasis on configuration management might be slightly lower since integrated engineering often emphasizes infrastructure automation. 
 - Application Support : While IT Service Support (SERV) covers some aspects of application support, this skill can be relevant if the role has a stronger focus on troubleshooting and supporting specific applications. 
 - Systems Integration: While integration activities might be streamlined, understanding system integration principles can be valuable, especially if the role involves integrating various software components. 
 - Release and Deployment Management: Effectively managing software releases and deployments is crucial. However, in an integrated engineering environment, automation tools and streamlined processes might reduce the manual effort involved compared to traditional release cycles. 
 - Methods and Tools : The right tools automate tasks, improve decision-making, and ensure consistent practices. This is crucial for efficiency, data-driven development, and staying current in a rapidly evolving field. 

Experience You Will Bring

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience). 
 - Minimum of 2 years of experience in software engineering and delivery. 
 - Strong understanding of continuous delivery principles and practices. 
 - Exposure to Cloud Infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Proficiency in multiple programming languages and technologies (Java, JavaScript, Python). 
 - Familiarity with Java frameworks such as Spring Boot or Hibernate. 
 - Thorough understanding of Object-Oriented Programming (OOPS) concepts (Abstraction, Encapsulation, Inheritance, Polymorphism). 
 - Strong foundation in Data Structures & Algorithms (Arrays, Linked Lists, Trees, Graphs, Hashing, Sorting/Searching). 
 - Strong problem-solving and analytical skills. 
 - Excellent communication and collaboration skills. 
 - Ability to work independently and as part of a cross-functional team.

data.description:
Accellor is an AI-native services firm focused on delivering measurable business outcomes through advanced AI, data, and engineering capabilities. We help global innovators and Fortune 100 enterprises modernize their architectures, scale operations, and operationalize intelligence across the enterprise. 

Our core focus centers on transforming advanced AI from proofs-of-concept into production-grade systems. Spanning AI solutions, robust data services, enterprise applications, and product engineering - we tailor our offerings to the distinct operational needs of industries such as healthcare, life sciences, telecom, retail, financial services, and technology. 

Operating as an extension of our clients' teams, we combine design thinking with technology-agnostic architectures to ensure faster time-to-value and seamless system interoperability. From initial strategy to full-scale deployment, we build intelligent, connected ecosystems that drive sustained enterprise value and redefine the future of transformation. 

Job Description

Technical Leadership & Architecture

- Own the architecture for backend services and platforms - microservices boundaries, API contracts, data models, and inter-service communication patterns. 
 - Make and document key technical decisions (build vs. buy, sync vs. async, consistency vs. availability trade-offs) and align teams around them. 
 - Set and enforce engineering standards: code quality, testing strategy, observability, and operational readiness. 

People & Team Leadership

- Directly manage, mentor, and grow a team of backend engineers, including running 1: 1s, setting goals, giving feedback, and supporting career development. 
 - Plan, distribute, and track work across the team - breaking down epics, sequencing delivery, and removing blockers so the team ships predictably. 
 - Mentor junior and mid-level engineers through pairing, code review, and design coaching, raising the bar for the whole team rather than being the single point of delivery. 
 - Partner with product, architecture, and other engineering leads to translate business goals into technical roadmaps and realistic commitments. 

Delivery & Engineering Execution

- Lead by example with hands-on contribution to high-impact and complex parts of the codebase. 
 - Design and operate microservices: service decomposition, API design (REST/gRPC/GraphQL), versioning, and backward compatibility. 
 - Build event-driven and asynchronous workflows using message queues and streaming platforms (Kafka, RabbitMQ, SQS, or similar). 
 - Design data persistence and caching strategies across relational and NoSQL stores, with appropriate use of caching layers (Redis/Memcached) for performance and scale. 

Scalability, Reliability & Security

- Ensure systems are designed for scale, resilience, and graceful degradation - load balancing, rate limiting, retries, circuit breakers, and idempotency. 
 - Drive observability across services: structured logging, metrics, distributed tracing, and actionable alerting. 
 - Enforce backend security best practices: authentication/authorization (OAuth2, OIDC, JWT), least-privilege access, secrets management, and secure handling of data in transit and at rest. 
 - Own production quality - on-call leadership, incident response, root-cause analysis, and follow-through on remediation. 

Collaboration & Governance

- Collaborate with DevOps and platform teams on CI/CD, containerization, and deployment strategy for backend services. 
 - Recommend and implement standards for code organization, service ownership, and technical governance across teams. 

Requirements

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. 
 - 7+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a strong track record of building and operating production backend systems at scale. 
 - Demonstrated experience leading both projects and people - owning end-to-end delivery for a team, managing engineers directly, and mentoring juniors. You must be able to point to specific teams you've grown and projects you've driven to delivery. 
 - Languages & Frameworks: Deep expertise in at least one major backend stack (e. g. , Java/Spring Boot, Go, Python, Node. js, or C#/. NET) and the ability to work fluently across more than one. 
 - Distributed Systems & Microservices: Strong, demonstrable experience designing and operating microservices and distributed systems in production. 
 - APIs: Hands-on expertise designing and evolving APIs (REST, gRPC, or GraphQL), including contracts, versioning, and documentation. 
 - Messaging & Async: Practical experience with message queues / event streaming (Kafka, RabbitMQ, SQS, etc. ). 
 - Data: Strong SQL skills and solid experience with relational databases, plus working knowledge of NoSQL stores and data modeling for scale. 
 - Caching: Hands-on experience with caching strategies and tools (Redis, Memcached). 
 - Containers & Orchestration: Hands-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes. 
 - Networking: Solid understanding of networking fundamentals - HTTP/HTTPS, TLS, DNS, service discovery, and load balancing. 
 - Version Control & Practices: Strong Git/GitOps proficiency and a deep commitment to code review, testing, and CI/CD.

data.title: Frontline Engineer
data.description:
Job Description

We are Omnissa!

Omnissa is the first AI-driven digital work platform, built to support flexible, secure, work-from-anywhere experiences. We integrate industry-leading solutions-including Unified Endpoint Management, Virtual Apps and Desktops, Digital Employee Experience, and Security & Compliance into a seamless, autonomous workspace that adapts to how people work. Our platform boosts employee engagement while optimizing IT operations, security, and cost. 

Guided by our Core Values Act in Alignment, Build Trust, Foster Inclusiveness, Drive Efficiency, and Maximize Customer Value, we're growing rapidly and committed to delivering meaningful impact. If you're passionate about shaping the future of work, we'd love to hear from you. 

What is the opportunity?

We are seeking a Frontline Engineer (MDM and Quality Systems Side of Experience is Mandate) to own product quality end-to-end from test strategy and automation to the full lifecycle of field-reported issues that reach engineering. This is a core engineering role, not a support function. It sits at the intersection of proactive quality ownership and reactive field intelligence, treating every real-world issue as a signal that strengthens the system. 

Quality Systems Engineers design and build the test gates that keeps the product reliable. They also serve as the engineering first responder when complex, high-priority issues arrive from the field - investigating, reproducing, and distilling them into precise, engineering-ready work items. Critically, the patterns they uncover flow back into test coverage, observability improvements, and product design, closing the loop between what customers experience and what engineering builds next. 

This role owns metrics across two dimensions: the health of the product as measured through traditional quality indicators, and the health of the field feedback pipeline as measured through incoming service request volume, field issue triage velocity, and the rate at which systemic issues are eliminated. Both dimensions matter equally. 

Key Responsibilities

- Test Strategy & Quality Engineering
 - Design, develop, and maintain test plans, test cases, and automated test suites covering functional, regression, integration, and system-level scenarios
 - Own test automation strategy and contribute to frameworks that improve coverage, speed, and reliability across release cycles
 - Evaluate the product through the lens of usability and supportability - not just correctness - and proactively surface gaps before they reach customers
 - Participate in design and code reviews to embed quality thinking upstream in the development lifecycle
 - Track and report on quality health metrics including defect escape rates, test coverage, automation pass rates, and release readiness signals
 - Contribute to improvements in logging, diagnostics, and system observability that make the product easier to validate and debug

- Field Issue Investigation & Engineering Triage
 - Act as the engineering first responder for complex, high-priority issues arriving from the field, owning investigation and triage end-to-end
 - Perform rapid technical analysis using logs, monitoring systems (e. g. , Logz. io: Modern Observability Powered by AI ), and production data to assess severity, impact scope, and failure patterns
 - Conduct deep technical debugging across distributed systems, APIs, services, and code paths to isolate and narrow suspected root causes
 - Reproduce complex field issues in local or shared environments, ensuring reliable alignment with production behavior
 - Enrich issue tickets with complete technical context - logs, configurations, network traces, reproduction steps, and system behavior details - so engineering teams can act without additional clarification
 - Identify duplicate issues and link them to existing defects or known issues to maintain clean, accurate JIRA hygiene
 - Collaborate with Core Engineering to validate hypotheses and confirm failure points through structured analysis
 - Validate fixes in patches or releases and ensure proper issue closure including regression verification
 - Systemic Quality Improvement & Feedback Loop
 - Analyze patterns across field issues and incoming customer service requests to identify systemic gaps in test coverage, observability, or product behavior
 - Translate field intelligence into concrete engineering improvements: new test cases, observability instrumentation, documentation, or product design changes
 - Participate in retrospectives for significant incidents and ensure findings produce durable improvements - not just one-time fixes
 - Partner with TPMs and Engineering leadership to track field issue SLAs and resolution progress across priority tiers
 - Build and contribute to automation, scripts, and AI-assisted workflows that reduce repetitive triage work and improve engineering throughput
 - Set up and maintain development and test environments required for issue reproduction and validation workflows
 - Recommend and implement improvements to system observability, UX signals, and diagnostics that reduce future field issue volume
Required Qualifications

- Strong software engineering foundation with the ability to read, debug, and reason across distributed systems and microservices
 - Hands-on experience in software quality engineering, including test design, test automation, and defect lifecycle management
 - Experience investigating production systems using logs, monitoring tools, and observability platforms
 - Solid understanding of APIs, client-server architectures, and modern distributed systems
 - Strong analytical and structured problem-solving ability for ambiguous, high-priority issues
 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills for cross-functional work with Engineering, TPMs, and product stakeholders

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience in enterprise device management (UEM) domains such as Apple, Android, Windows, or similar platforms
 - Familiarity with AI-assisted engineering tools (Cursor, Claude, Rovo, or equivalent)
 - Background in sustaining engineering, field engineering, or production systems engineering
 - Experience building or owning test automation frameworks or developer productivity tooling
 - Familiarity with observability platforms and structured log analysis

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

- Field Health & Issue Pipeline
 - Volume and trend of incoming customer service requests over time
 - Volume and trend of field issues routed to engineering for investigation
 - Time to first technical assessment of field issues
 - SLA compliance for high-priority field issues
 - Successful reproduction rate of customer-reported issues
 - Time to identify root cause or failure domain
 - Percentage of issues fully enriched and ready for engineering action without follow-up
 - Number of recurring issue patterns eliminated through systemic improvements
 - Product Quality
 - Defect escape rate and regression rate across releases
 - Test automation coverage and pass rate
 - Reduction in duplicate defects and improved JIRA hygiene
 - Contributions to logging, observability, or test coverage that measurably reduce field issue volume
 - Release readiness signal accuracy - how well pre-release quality metrics predict post-release stability
Why This Role Matters

Most engineering organizations treat product quality and field issue response as separate concerns, handled by separate teams. Quality Systems Engineers reject that separation. They own both and in owning both, they create something neither function can create alone, a continuous, closed-loop system where real-world customer experience directly shapes what gets tested, what gets instrumented, and what gets built next. 

The result is compounding: field issues get resolved faster, the same issues stop recurring, and the product becomes measurably more stable with every release cycle. This is quality engineering operating at its highest level of impact. 

Location: India (Bangalore)

Location Type: HYBRID

Travel Expectations: Yes

Education: Bachelor's Degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience.

This is hard, urgent, selfless work-but it's work worth doing. If you're driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us. 

Technical Lead Architect

Tech@Lilly

Title

Technical Lead Architect -Full Stack

Job Type

Full-Time Employee
