data.title: Sr SDET - Performance Testing
data.description:
About HighLevel: 

HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes. 

To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently. 

Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2. 5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability. 

Our People

With over 2, 000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home. 

Our Impact

Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1. 5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. We're proud to be a part of that. 

Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts . 

About the Role: 

HighLevel is looking for a Sr. SDET with 5+ years of experience to play a crucial role in ensuring the quality, performance, and scalability of our products. We are seeking engineers who thrive in a fast-paced startup environment, enjoy problem-solving, and stay updated with the latest models and solutions. This is a great opportunity to work on cutting-edge performance testing strategies and contribute to the success of our products. 

Responsibilities: 

- Performance baselines for critical services: SLIs, SLOs, and latency, throughput, and error-rate targets, plus workload models built from production traffic and real customer behaviour
 - A shared performance testing framework and production-like environments (Kubernetes and cloud, test data included) that product-team SDETs can use without starting from scratch, and the evaluation of new tools through PoCs
 - Automated performance regression checks in CI/CD, with trend reports that catch regressions before release
 - Load, stress, soak, and spike testing, and capacity planning ahead of peak events
 - Root cause analysis of bottlenecks across API, database, queue, and frontend layers, using traces, metrics, logs, and profiling, in partnership with development, DevOps, and infrastructure teams
 - Strong understanding of distributed systems, microservices architecture, concurrency, rate limiting and common performance bottlenecks
 - Ability to interpret performance metrics, translate findings into actionable engineering recommendations, and influence technical decisions across engineering teams
 - Supervise and mentor junior team members and contribute to capability building initiatives to raise the performance bar across the team

Requirements: 

- 5+ years in performance, scalability, or reliability engineering or testing, with examples of finding and fixing bottlenecks in production-scale systems
 - Hands-on experience with at least one modern load-testing tool (k6, Gatling, or Locust), including realistic workload modeling and distributed load generation, and strong programming skills in Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or Java
 - Experience using observability tooling (for example New Relic, Prometheus/Grafana, OpenTelemetry) to isolate root cause across API, database, and queue layers, with a solid grasp of REST service performance, concurrency, and caching
 - Experience integrating performance tests into CI/CD pipelines with pass/fail thresholds
 - Working knowledge of Kubernetes and at least one major cloud (GCP, AWS, or Azure) to deploy and debug test environments

Nice to Have: 

- Runtime profiling and thread or heap analysis on the JVM or Node. js (GC behavior, event-loop lag)
 - Frontend performance experience: Core Web Vitals, Lighthouse, real user monitoring
 - Experience applying AI-assisted tooling to test design or result analysis
 - Experience with NoSQL or search datastores and message brokers at scale
 - Chaos or resilience testing, and safe testing in production (canaries, shadow traffic)

data.title: Lead Back End Engineer
data.description:
This is a leadership role in our engineering team - not just a cog in the wheel. 

This is not a "maintenance" role. This is engineering leadership-owning the backend architecture of a global, privacy-first communication platform. You'll lead by example, guide a high-calibre team, and ensure our backend systems remain blazing-fast, rock-solid, and uncompromising on security. You'll be at the intersection of code and leadership-mentoring engineers, driving architectural decisions, and setting engineering standards that define how a global product is built. 

Who are we?

We are a young product company scaling fast and outgrowing the startup tag-with global scale in our crosshairs. We don't do "okay. " We give everything we've got to build the best communication platform in the world. Our team includes engineers from IIT and other top institutions-people who care deeply about the craft, performance, and purpose. You'll learn more in 6 months here than most engineers do in 3 years elsewhere. We're intense. High-strung. Focused. Our team includes engineers from IIT and other top-tier

backgrounds. But what defines us is not our degrees-it's our refusal to compromise on quality, performance, or privacy. 

What are we building?

WrkTalk is the world's first zero-access, zero-spam enterprise communication product that operates on a structural privacy architecture. One that's already earned the trust of large enterprises like L&T Finance, Adani Group, and Kalyan Jewellers - just to name a few of our enterprise clients. This is not an MVP. This is production-grade software that secures communication for thousands-and soon, millions-of professionals worldwide. 

What's the role?

• Architect backend systems in NestJS and Golang to meet global scale and enterprise-grade performance. 

• Drive design for microservices, real-time comms (WebSockets, WebRTC), and data stores (PostgreSQL, Redis). 

• Lead code reviews, enforce coding standards, and maintain CI/CD discipline. 

• Mentor and upskill backend engineers. 

• Collaborate cross-functionally with frontend, DevOps, and product leaders. 

• Own technical problem-solving-anticipate bottlenecks, make hard calls, and prevent tech debt from being parked for "later. "

• Manage task allocation, workflow discipline, and ensure smooth collaboration with frontend and DevOps. 

The tech here is serious. 

We work on socket-driven comms infrastructure, distributed control towers, multi-category encryption, root detection, app kill-switches, dynamic guest access, device-level lockout, and OOO/ DND logic layered with smart whitelisting. This is not lightweight app dev. This is protocol-layer decision-making. 

Who should apply?

• 6-8+ years in backend engineering, with at least 2 years in a leadership role. 

• Expertise in Golang and Node. js (NestJS). 

• Strong database tuning skills (PostgreSQL, Redis). 

• Solid understanding of Docker, Kubernetes, and scalable deployment. 

• Experience building real-time systems at scale. 

• Proven ability to lead technical discussions and inspire engineering teams. 

• Track record of shipping production-grade, high-performance systems. 

Why should you join?

• Because you want to own backend architecture-not just follow it

• Because you'll work directly with established founders, not buried under layers

• Because you'll ship real, deeply engineered features used by large number of enterprise users

• Because you'll grow 10x faster here-in experience, learning, and impact

• And because if you walk this road with us for 3-4 years, it'll catapult you into a tech orbit or fame and glory you never imagined

Where are we located?

We're based in Navi Mumbai and building for the world.

data.description:
Role: Project Design Manager

Location: Gurugram

This is a full-time role working 40 hours a week. Work from Office. 

Role Objective

As a Project Design Manager, you'll play a pivotal role in shaping the design and technical direction of projects that deliver sustainable, resilient water and water recycling solutions. Leading a multidisciplinary design team, you'll develop innovative, value-driven designs that protect and enhance our environment while ensuring safe, affordable, and future-ready infrastructure for the East of England. 

You'll take ownership of the design journey - from concept through delivery - guiding your team to produce right-first-time engineering outputs that champion low carbon, digital innovation, and environmental stewardship. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Lead the design and technical delivery of clean water and water recycling projects, across both infrastructure (pipelines, pumping stations) and non-infrastructure (treatment and storage) schemes. 
 - Develop Engineering Project Plans encompassing design scope, programme, cost, risk, and resource planning. 
 - Collaborate with engineering discipline leads to define design approaches, set technical standards, and ensure design integration across civil, mechanical, electrical, and process disciplines. 
 - Drive innovation and digital design, supporting the move towards fully attributed 3D and BIM-enabled models. 
 - Champion sustainable design by embedding low-carbon thinking, nature-based solutions, and whole-life value considerations. 
 - Engage with suppliers, partners, and stakeholders to review and integrate third-party design inputs effectively. 
 - Ensure all design work meets CDM and health & safety requirements, producing high-quality outputs that meet end-user and operational needs. 
 - Provide clear leadership to your project design team - mentoring, developing, and inspiring individuals to achieve their potential. 
 - Work collaboratively with project managers, environmental and planning specialists, procurement, and construction teams to deliver projects efficiently and affordably. 

About You: 

You will ideally have: 

- A degree in engineering or equivalent qualification, preferably chartered or working towards chartered status. 
 - Strong design management experience, ideally within the water or environmental infrastructure sectors. 
 - Proven ability to lead multidisciplinary engineering teams to deliver high-quality, sustainable design outcomes. 
 - Technical understanding of clean water or water recycling systems, pipelines, or treatment processes. 
 - Experience of working within a design and build or collaborative project delivery environment. 
 - Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, able to translate complex technical information clearly. 
 - A commitment to safety, sustainability, and continuous improvement, with a passion for digital design and innovation. 

Depending on your skills, experience, and interests, you could be aligned to one of our four business units: 

Water

The Water Business Unit provides strategic design and technical support across the clean water network - from infrastructure planning to treatment resilience - ensuring secure and efficient water supplies for future generations. 

- Water Infrastructure Portfolio - PDM to lead potable water pipeline projects driven by regional growth or mains renewal. 
 - National Infrastructure Portfolio - PDM to work alongside some of the major infrastructure projects (rail / highways / energy) in the region focusing on protecting and diverting all the affected Anglian Water assets (potable and wastewater). 
 - Water Non-Infrastructure Portfolio - PDM to lead multi-disciplinary engineering teams to deliver clean water non- infrastructure design (treatment works; pumping stations; ground water abstraction). Significant programmes of work include nitrate removal; PFAS removal and upgrades to potable water treatment works. 

Water Recycling (East and West)

Our Water Recycling teams are responsible for the design and optimization of wastewater projects and treatment solutions (both infra and non infra). We drive innovations to enhance environmental outcomes and improve the sustainability of our network. 

Place Based Thinking

Delivering some of the largest and most complex projects within the @one Alliance, this team focuses on integrated solutions that protect communities, improve resilience, and deliver value across multiple sites and catchments. 

Why Join Us?

- This is a fantastic opportunity to work with one of the UK's most progressive design and delivery alliances. You'll play a key role in designing the next generation of water and water recycling assets that respond to the region's most pressing environmental challenges. 
 - We offer a culture that values creativity, technical excellence, and professional growth, with continuous learning and opportunities to shape the way we design and deliver sustainable infrastructure. 
 - We reward our people fairly and transparently, with a strong emphasis on inclusion, wellbeing, and long-term career development.

data.title: Lead Software Engineer - (Web Platform)
data.description:
Bitwarden promotes better internet security and safety with the leading open source password management solution for individuals, teams, and business organizations. Our philosophy on security is that "we are all in this together" - we continue to offer a full-featured free version of Bitwarden so that everyone can be protected with strong password management. We also provide enterprise-grade solutions to some of the largest companies in the world, and will continue to innovate in the identity and authentication market as the world starts to grow beyond passwords. Read more on the Bitwarden blog. 

As a Tech Lead for our Web Platform team, you will be responsible for leading the technical direction and supporting the engineering effort of a team focused on building and maintaining the core web application tooling and client services that support all of our web-based clients. This includes our web application, Electron-based desktop client, browser extension, and CLI, as well as other clients and additional Products in the future. You will be expected to own and understand the entirety of the team's domain, and be able to support the other engineers on the team as well as engage in well-reasoned discussions with other technical leaders in the organization. 

RESPONSIBILITIES

- Update and maintain Bitwarden's web monorepo tooling, including our nx monorepo packaging infrastructure, our webpack build pipelines, and our npm package management systems. 
 - Drive repo-wide modernization initiatives, such as migrating to Vite and pnpm or adopting nx, including any coordination with other teams within the organization. 
 - Work closely with your manager to maintain the technical roadmap for the team, ensuring that core platform dependencies are up to date and emerging technologies are considered for potential adoption. 
 - Unblock and support other engineers on the team. 
 - Collaborate with other Tech Leads to ensure that cross-team technical direction is aligned when initiatives span team boundaries. 
 - Serve as a representative of the team in technical discussions and be able to speak authoritatively about your domain. 
 - Set the example for thorough code reviews, using them to spread knowledge on the team and ensure high standards for code quality. 
 - Occasionally review & approve bug fixes submitted by the user community

WHAT YOU BRING TO BITWARDEN

- 8-10 years of expertise in modern web application build and packaging pipelines, including strong demonstrated experience with managing and updating nx, webpack, Vite, npm, and pnpm. 
 - Extensive experience with cross-platform web application development - understanding how to work within and support Electron environments and browser extensions and the limitations and nuances of their APIs. 
 - A bias for long-horizon thinking, ensuring that decisions made today build stable and maintainable tooling for the future. 
 - Experience on a Platform team, where other teams are your customers, and you are responsible for ensuring that their feature development can be done with tooling as a support and not a hindrance. 
 - Experience using AI tooling in your development and testing workflow (Anthropic Claude preferred)
 - Collaborative and adaptable mindset
 - Openness and authenticity combined with excellent communication skills
 - Excitement and enthusiasm for open source and for better internet security 
 - Excellent problem-solving skills - you might not know all the answers, but you know how to find and communicate the solution

WHY WORK WITH US

- Our user community loves us and we love them. Come to work each day with a sense of purpose as we bring a more secure internet experience to everyone from our friends and family to the world's largest organizations. 
 - Become an expert. You'll get immersed in the prominent technology markets of security and open source software. 
 - We are dedicated to building a diverse and talented team. Work remotely with motivated and supportive team members across the world. 
 - Learn and grow. Take on new challenges with the support of your team, and join our #growth-club to continue personal and professional development. 
 - At Bitwarden, we are passionate about what we do, but not necessarily everything we do. Our engineering team makes it a policy to carve out some time for personal growth, learning, skill building and pursuing personal passions that positively impact the team and company. To ensure that everyone has time to reaffirm their purpose and grow, you are encouraged to self-direct up to 15% of your week to what you feel is important for the company and for yourself. 

Equal Opportunity Employer

We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone can do their best work. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and make employment decisions based on skills, experience, qualifications, and business needs.

data.title: Development Team Lead
data.description:
About Magellan: 

Magellan supports companies and organizations in their digital, organizational, and technological transformation. Our teams work across application modernization, cloud, data, cybersecurity, employee experience, and operational performance. Joining Magellan means working in a collaborative consulting environment where technical expertise, knowledge sharing, continuous learning, and meaningful client impact are at the heart of how we work. 

The Role

We are looking for an experienced Lead Full Stack Developer & DevOps Lead to provide hands-on technical leadership to our Full Stack and DevOps engineering teams in India. You will be the technical reference connecting architecture, development, cloud/infrastructure, product teams, and client stakeholders while remaining close to code, design decisions, production readiness, and engineering quality. 

Location: Open for Pune & Bangalore

Experience: 10 to 15 Years+

Your leadership will focus on three pillars

- Technical Leadership & Mentorship - lead design decisions, architecture reviews, code quality, engineering standards, technical problem solving, and the growth of engineers. 
 - AI-Assisted Engineering - drive practical adoption of generative AI across the software development lifecycle to accelerate delivery, improve quality, automate repetitive work, and strengthen engineering productivity. 
 - DevOps & Production Excellence - own engineering readiness from code to production, including CI/CD, cloud-native deployment, observability, release governance, security, reliability, and Go-to-Production practices

What You'll Do

Technical Design & Full Stack Engineering

- Lead the architecture and technical roadmap of scalable, secure, maintainable web applications. 
 - Guide and contribute to front-end engineering using Angular, TypeScript, HTML, and CSS. 
 - Lead back-end engineering of enterprise services and APIs using Java and Spring Boot. 
 - Guide data modelling and persistence across relational databases such as SQL Server; exposure to MongoDB or other NoSQL technologies is valuable. 
 - Drive technical trade-off decisions, architecture reviews, code reviews, complex troubleshooting, and engineering standards. 
 - Promote microservices, API-first and event-driven design principles where appropriate. 

AI-Assisted Engineering

- Champion AI-assisted development across design, coding, refactoring, debugging, testing, documentation, and engineering analysis. 
 - Define practical guardrails and best practices for responsible use of generative AI in software delivery. 
 - Hands-on experience with modern AI coding tools is expected; strong proficiency with Gemini CLI is highly preferred. 

DevOps, Cloud & Go-to-Production

- Lead the design and continuous improvement of CI/CD pipelines using GitLab CI/CD. 
 - Guide containerization with Docker and orchestration using Kubernetes. 
 - Drive Infrastructure-as-Code practices using Terraform and Ansible. 
 - Own release readiness across staging and production, including validation gates, change controls, security checks, rollback readiness, and enterprise Go-to-Production governance. 
 - Ensure strong monitoring, logging, observability, incident response, root-cause analysis, and operational reliability. 
 - Guide cloud-native delivery on GCP and/or enterprise internal cloud platforms. 

Leadership & Collaboration

- Lead, mentor, and upskill Full Stack and DevOps engineers through technical coaching, reviews, and hands-on guidance. 
 - Build a strong engineering culture around software craftsmanship, automated testing, security-by-design, reliability, and continuous improvement. 
 - Collaborate closely with architects, product managers, infrastructure/cloud teams, and business stakeholders. 
 - Challenge requirements constructively and translate business needs into pragmatic, robust technical solutions. 
 - Represent Magellan with clients as a trusted technical leader with strong communication, ownership, and service orientation. 

What We're Looking For

Experience

- 10 -12 years of professional experience across full stack software engineering, systems engineering, and DevOps/Ops, including proven technical leadership or team leadership responsibilities. 
 - Strong track record managing complex application lifecycles from architecture and development through production deployment and operations. 
 - Experience working in enterprise environments with structured release / Go-to-Production governance. 
 - Consulting or client-facing technical delivery experience is strongly valued. 
 - Bachelor's degree in computer science, Software Engineering, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. 

Core Technical Skills

- Expert-level Angular, TypeScript, HTML, and CSS. 
 - Deep Java and Spring Boot expertise, including enterprise API and service development. 
 - Strong SQL and relational database skills; SQL Server experience is valuable. 
 - Strong Git / GitLab and GitLab CI/CD experience. 
 - Hands-on Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, and Ansible experience. 
 - Strong GCP / cloud-native knowledge and practical experience with observability, monitoring, and production troubleshooting. 
 - Strong understanding of secure software delivery, DevSecOps principles, automated testing, and release quality. 

Good to Have

- MongoDB or other NoSQL database experience. 
 - Microservices, event-driven architectures, distributed systems, and API-driven design. 
 - GitOps practices and pipeline/security hardening. 
 - Cloud / DevOps certifications, architecture credentials, or formal technical leadership training. 

What Will Make You Successful

- You combine hands-on technical depth with the ability to lead and influence engineers. 
 - You make sound architectural decisions without losing sight of delivery, maintainability, security, and operational reality. 
 - You communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders and can confidently represent engineering decisions to clients. 
 - You bring ownership, discipline, curiosity, mentoring ability, and a strong focus on production safety and engineering excellence. 

Working With Us

This is a permanent, hybrid opportunity based in Bangalore or Pune, India. You will work with multidisciplinary and international teams on high-impact transformation initiatives while helping shape modern engineering practices across Full Stack, DevOps, cloud, and AI-assisted software delivery.

data.title: Senior Engineering Manager [T500-30590]
data.description:
Marriott International Inc. , headquartered in Bethesda, Maryland, USA, was founded in May 1927 by J. Willard Marriott and Alice S. Marriott with a modest nine-seat A&W root beer stand. Guided by the family's leadership and core principles, Marriott International today has grown into a global hospitality giant, operating approximately 9, 000 properties and over 30 leading brands in more than 140 countries and territories. 

From such humble beginnings to becoming the world's largest hotel company, Marriott International has never stopped searching for inventive ways to serve its customers, provide opportunities for its associates, and grow their business. At Marriott Tech Accelerator center (MTA), Hyderabad, India, Marriott is exploring the world we live in and all its possibilities. At Marriott Tech Accelerator, we are a team of passionate engineering minds dedicated to creating and building cutting-edge solutions that streamline operations and elevate guest experiences. 

Marriott Tech Accelerator center is fully owned and operated by ANSR. All associates at Marriott Tech Accelerator will be ANSR employees, delivering services exclusively to ANSR's client, Marriott International. 

Role Title: Senior Engineering Manager

Position Summary: 

The Senior Manager leads a Loyalty product engineering team of engineers and product owners that owns a set of Marriott Bonvoy loyalty capabilities end to end, from backlog to production. Depending on what the portfolio needs, the role leads a multi-year build program, an ongoing run portfolio of enhancements and production support, or both. The leader directly manages lead engineers, engineers and product owners, brings technical judgment to design and delivery decisions, and builds the in-house capability that lets Marriott Tech Accelerator own Loyalty products and platforms rather than staff them. 

Indicative focus: delivery, release and run 30%; people leadership 25%; product leadership 20%; technical leadership 15%; capability building 10%. The balance shifts with the operating model the role is leading. 

Key Responsibilities: 

Own Loyalty Capabilities End to End: 

- Own a set of Loyalty capabilities end to end with one team of engineers and product owners, from backlog and refinement through release and production. 
 - Run one-team refinement: product owners and engineers shape, size and sequence work together, with clear acceptance criteria, dependencies and non-functional requirements agreed before work is committed. 
 - Measure outcomes for members and the business rather than output, and make scope, sequencing and trade-off decisions with product and business leaders in clear business language. 
 - Lead delivery in whichever operating model the portfolio needs: multi-year build programs with fixed milestones, continuous enhancement and production support (BAU and L3), or a mix of both. 
 - Own planning, estimation, risks and dependencies across teams, architects and partners, and give early visibility when plans change. 

Release and Run a Mission-Critical Platform: 

- Own release management for the teams led: release calendars, change approval, environment strategy and deployment pipelines across custom-built services and SaaS platforms, with quality gates agreed with Quality Engineering. 
 - Partner with SRE, DevOps and platform teams to meet SLOs and SLAs for an always-on platform; lead incident response, root-cause analysis and problem management. 
 - Drive adoption of engineering standards, information security, SDLC and IT governance, balancing delivery speed with quality and operational risk. 
 - Improve continuously using DORA measures (deployment frequency, lead time, change failure rate, time to restore), escaped defects and service levels. 

Lead People: 

- Directly manage lead engineers, engineers and product owners end to end: hiring, goals, performance reviews, promotions and managing underperformance. 
 - Grow lead engineers into managers and shape team structures to fit the operating model, with succession for critical roles so delivery never rests on one person. 
 - Set clear priorities and short-term resource plans, and build an inclusive culture that models Marriott values in a high-pressure, matrixed environment. 
 - Retain and grow talent in a competitive market through career paths, coaching and early action on attrition risk. 

Build the Capability Centre: 

- Build Marriott Tech Accelerator ownership of Loyalty products and platforms: take over work from partners and vendors with structured knowledge transfer, and collaborate across time zones with US-based product, architecture and business teams. 
 - Drive adoption of modern engineering practices, including automation and AI-assisted development and testing, with measurable gains in quality and throughput. 

Management Competencies: 

Competency Area: 

- Leadership: Communication; leading through vision and values; managing change; sound judgement; professional presence; strategy development. 
 - Managing Execution: Building successful teams; strategy execution; setting high performance standards; taking accountability for results. 
 - Building Relationships: Global mindset; inclusive collaboration; strategic partnerships; influence across functions and locations. 
 - Talent and Organisational Capability: Developing others; adapting team structures, assignments, and work processes to organisational needs. 
 - Professional Expertise: Continuous learning; technical acumen; SDLC and development methodologies; information security; business acumen. 

Skills and Experience: 

- 12+ years in software development, including 5+ years of direct people management with lead engineers reporting in. 
 - Has led both a multi-year build or transformation program and an ongoing run portfolio (enhancements, production support, L3), and can explain how each was run differently. 
 - Has led delivery on a platform that combines custom-built services (Java/Spring or similar) with an enterprise SaaS platform (Salesforce, ServiceNow, SAP, Dynamics or similar), including the integrations, data flows and release coordination between them. Salesforce experience will be a strong plus. 
 - Experience in a product operating model, ideally in product companies or global capability centres; services-firm experience should include multi-year ownership of a single product or platform. Experience leading product owners or business analysts is a strong plus. 
 - Hands-on engineering background with current technical judgment across services and APIs, cloud, CI/CD, observability, automated testing and production operations. 
 - Experience with Agile at scale (preferably SAFe) and ITIL 4 service practices. 
 - Has managed distributed teams across time zones, including vendor and partner teams. 
 - Strong communication, negotiation and influencing skills; able to translate technical considerations into clear business language and drive decisions. 
 - Knowledge of hospitality or loyalty business environments is preferred. Education and Certifications: 

- Undergraduate degree or equivalent experience/certification

Work location: Hyderabad, India. 

Work mode: Hybrid

Marriott's core values: 

At Marriott, our core values make us who we are. We believe that success is never final. As we change and grow, the beliefs that are most important to us stay the same-putting people first, pursuing excellence, embracing change, acting with integrity, and serving our world. Being part of Marriott Tech Accelerator means being part of a proud history and a thriving culture.

data.title: Engineering Manager, Endpoint Security Platform
data.description:
Role Summary: 

You will own the people, delivery and full lifecycle of a unified endpoint security platform: from roadmap and build, through safe release and operations, to support and end-of-life. The platform protects Windows, macOS, Linux, mobile, servers, virtual desktops, cloud workloads, containers and IoT/OT devices. It spans prevention (EPP), detection and response (EDR/XDR), and posture and compliance management, at a scale of millions of endpoints. 

You will build and lead high-performing engineering teams, run the platform as a reliable service, and make sure every agent and content update reaches customers safely. 

Key Responsibilities: 

A. People leadership and organization

- Lead, coach and grow a multi-team organization, including first-line managers and senior technical staff. 
 - Run performance management: goals, regular one-on-ones, reviews, promotions, career ladders, and addressing underperformance. 
 - Design the org structure and team boundaries (agent, cloud backend, console, data pipeline, QA, SRE) and plan headcount and capacity. 
 - Own hiring end to end: interview loops, hiring bar, sourcing scarce skills (kernel, eBPF, macOS internals), and onboarding. 
 - Build an inclusive, accountable culture that works across sites and time zones; track engagement and retention. 

B. Product lifecycle management

- Own the end-to-end lifecycle of agents, cloud services and console: roadmap, build, release, support, deprecation and end-of-life. 
 - Run separate release pipelines for agent code and detection content (signatures, rules, models), each with its own validation gates. 
 - Implement staged rollouts: canary and ring deployments, feature flags, kill switches, automatic rollback, and customer-controlled update channels (N, N-1, N-2). 
 - Define the agent version support matrix, long-term support (LTS) releases, and deprecation and EOL policies, while keeping APIs and policies backward compatible. 
 - Deliver day-zero support for new Windows, macOS, Linux kernel and distribution releases through beta OS programs. 
 - Plan customer migrations between platform versions, editions or acquired products. 

C. Architecture and technical oversight

- Partner with principal engineers and architects on the end-to-end platform design: agent/sensor, multi-tenant cloud backend, management console, APIs and data pipeline. 
 - Run architecture and design reviews; make and document build-vs-buy-vs-partner decisions. 
 - Keep the agent framework modular (AV, EDR, firewall, device control, DLP, application control) with minimal CPU, memory and I/O footprint. 
 - Lead the move of kernel-dependent capabilities toward user-mode frameworks as OS vendors restrict kernel access (for example, the Windows endpoint security platform), without losing visibility or tamper resistance. 

D. Detection, prevention, response and AI

- Work with threat researchers and detection engineers to deliver behavioral detection, exploit prevention, ransomware protection and rollback, fileless malware defense and memory protection. 
 - Own MLOps for detection models: deployment, drift monitoring, false-positive management and defense against adversarial ML. 
 - Deliver GenAI features such as investigation copilots, natural-language threat hunting and agentic SOC workflows, with clear guardrails and evaluation. 
 - Extend protection to AI tools on the endpoint, such as local AI agents and MCP servers that employees run. 
 - Build response actions: host isolation, process kill, quarantine, remote shell, live forensics and automated playbooks. 
 - Map capabilities to MITRE ATT&CK and validate them through red-team and adversary-emulation testing. 

E. Telemetry, data and analytics

- Deliver high-throughput ingestion and stream processing (Kafka or similar) and a security data lake for hunting and analytics. 
 - Enable XDR by correlating endpoint, identity (ITDR), network, email, browser and cloud signals. 
 - Manage telemetry cost: tiering, retention, sampling and cost per protected endpoint. 
 - Build privacy into the pipeline: data minimization, PII pseudonymization, regional data residency and per-tenant retention. 

F. Management console, APIs and integrations

- Deliver centralized policy management, role-based access control, fleet visibility and compliance dashboards. 
 - Provide documented REST/GraphQL APIs and integrations with SIEM, SOAR, ITSM, IAM, MDM and vulnerability management tools. 
 - Support SaaS, private cloud, on-prem and air-gapped deployments, plus enterprise rollout tooling (Intune, SCCM, Jamf, Ansible) and VDI optimization. 

G. Reliability, operations and incident management

- Define SLOs and SLIs for the cloud platform and agent fleet; build observability and fleet health monitoring. 
 - Own on-call design, incident response, blameless postmortems and follow-up actions. 
 - Lead major incidents, including communication with customers, executives, Legal and PR. 
 - Plan capacity, disaster recovery and multi-region failover. 
 - Build large-scale quality engineering: an OS and device compatibility lab, performance benchmarking, chaos and fault-injection testing, soak testing, and false-positive testing against known-good software before each release. 

H. Product security, compliance and regulation

- Embed secure SDLC: threat modeling, SAST/DAST, fuzzing, dependency and supply-chain security, SBOM, reproducible builds and code signing. 
 - Run a product security incident response team (PSIRT): coordinated vulnerability disclosure, bug bounty, CVEs and security advisories for the product itself. 
 - Meet regulatory reporting duties, including the EU Cyber Resilience Act (24-hour reporting of actively exploited vulnerabilities from September 2026; full obligations and CE marking from December 2027), NIS2, DORA (for financial-sector customers), CERT-In incident reporting and the India DPDP Act. 
 - Drive certifications such as ISO 27001, SOC 2, Common Criteria, FedRAMP, FIPS 140-3 and GDPR/data residency, as applicable. 
 - Plan post-quantum cryptography migration for agent-to-cloud communication and code signing. 
 - Support independent testing: AV-Test, AV-Comparatives, MITRE ATT&CK evaluations, and Gartner/Forrester assessments. 

I. Business, budget and stakeholder management

- Own the engineering budget: headcount, cloud spend, tools, licences, vendors and contractors. 
 - Partner with Product Management on roadmap, packaging, editions and prioritization; contribute to pricing and P&L discussions. 
 - Track the competitive landscape and feed it into roadmap decisions. 
 - Lead technical due diligence and integration for acquisitions. 
 - Ensure open-source licence compliance, including GPL considerations for Linux kernel modules and eBPF. 
 - Engage key customers and partners on architecture reviews, escalations and feedback; represent engineering to executives. 

Required qualifications

- Education: B. E. /B. Tech/M. Tech/MS in Computer Science, Information Security, Electronics or a related field. An MBA or management training is a plus. 

Experience: 

- 8-10 years in software product development, with at least 6 years in cybersecurity (endpoint security strongly preferred). 
 - At least 4 years managing engineering teams, including managing other managers or tech leads, and 10+ engineers at once. 
 - At least 3 years of prior hands-on engineering or architecture work on systems, security or distributed cloud software. 
 - A proven record of shipping and operating enterprise security products at scale, including at least one full release lifecycle from launch to end-of-life. 
 - Experience owning production operations: on-call, SLOs and leading major incidents. 

Leadership and management skills

- Hiring, coaching, performance management and building manager and tech-lead pipelines.

About Backblaze

Backblaze is the object storage leader in the open cloud movement, fueling customer success with cloud storage built purposefully to unlock budgets, unburden administrators, and unleash innovators. Together with our partners, we're helping customers break free from the restrictive, overpriced legacy solutions that hold them back, and blaze forward with the full power of the open cloud in their hands. 

Founded in 2007, we scaled the business with less than $3 million in outside funding until 2021, when we did a traditional IPO on the Nasdaq stock exchange. Today, Backblaze generates over $100m in revenue and is the leading specialized storage cloud - managing over three billion gigabytes of data storage for 500K+ customers in 175+ countries, including businesses, developers, IT professionals, and individuals. 

About The Role

We are seeking a Site Reliability Engineer II (SRE II) to help ensure the stability, scalability, and reliability of our services and infrastructure. This role focuses on building automation, maintaining observability, and supporting incident response to keep customer-facing systems performing at their best. The SRE will collaborate with engineering, product, and operations teams to embed reliability practices into day-to-day development and operations while contributing to tools and processes that improve efficiency and reduce manual effort. 

Key Responsibilities

Service Reliability & Operations

- Support the availability and durability of critical services across production environments. 
 - Monitor service health using SLIs, SLOs, and error budgets, and escalate issues when thresholds are at risk. 
 - Participate in on-call rotations, incident response, and post-incident reviews to drive service improvements. 
 - Follow established ITIL/OSS processes (incident, change, problem, and capacity management). 

Automation & Tooling

- Develop automation for common operational tasks, reducing manual intervention and toil. 
 - Contribute to monitoring, logging, and alerting frameworks (e. g. , Prometheus, Grafana, Catchpoint, ELK). 
 - Work with CI/CD pipelines, configuration management, and infrastructure as code tools (Terraform, Ansible, Jenkins). 
 - Write scripts (Bash, Python, Go, etc. ) to improve system reliability and efficiency. 

Collaboration

- Partner with engineering, product, and operations teams to support resilient system design and operations. 
 - Assist in capacity planning and disaster recovery exercises. 
 - Work with vendors and service providers to troubleshoot service issues and track SLA performance. 
 - Document systems, share learnings, and help grow a reliability-minded engineering culture. 

Continuous Improvement

- Contribute to playbooks, runbooks, and operational documentation. 
 - Identify recurring issues and propose long-term improvements. 
 - Promote reliability-focused practices within development and operations teams. 

Qualifications

Education & Experience

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience). 
 - 2-4 years of experience in site reliability, systems engineering, or operations. 
 - Exposure to large-scale, production-grade systems. 

Technical Skills

- Solid Linux systems administration and troubleshooting skills.

 - Understanding of containers (Kubernetes, Docker) and microservices concepts.

At this point, we hope you're feeling excited about the job description you're reading. Even if you don't meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply. Learning, developing, and growing are key parts of our culture. We're eager to meet people who believe in our mission and can contribute to our team in various ways. At Backblaze, we value being fair and good to our customers, partners, and employees. That's why diversity, equity, and inclusion are at the core of our values. data.title: Senior Software Engineer - Fullstack
data.description:
About Onit

We're redefining the future of legal operations through the power of AI. Our cutting-edge platform streamlines enterprise legal management, matter management, spend management and contract lifecycle processes, transforming manual workflows into intelligent, automated solutions. 

We're a team of innovators using AI at the core to help legal departments become faster, smarter, and more strategic. As we continue to grow and expand the capabilities of our new AI-centric platform, we're looking for bold thinkers and builders who are excited to shape the next chapter of legal tech. 

If you're energized by meaningful work, love solving complex problems, and want to help modernize how legal teams operate, we'd love to meet you. 

Position Summary

The Senior Software Engineer, Full-Stack builds substantial, interactive features inside Onit's enterprise legal operations platform, spanning enterprise legal management, matter management, spend management, and contract lifecycle management. Working across a Ruby on Rails backend and a modern JavaScript frontend, this individual contributor delivers data-dense, accurate, and resilient user experiences that fit seamlessly into the workflows legal teams rely on every day. The role partners closely with design, product, and the architecture team, owning features end to end from API to interface, with a strong focus on edge cases, performance, accessibility, and test coverage. 

Key Responsibilities

- Build substantial, interactive features inside an existing enterprise product, without disrupting the workflows they sit within. 
 - Implement data visualizations (line charts, comparison tables, range indicators) where the visual encoding carries real meaning and small inaccuracies mislead users. 
 - Build filtering and comparison controls that update complex views in real time. 
 - Implement every state the feature can be in: loading, error, empty, and the cases where there is insufficient data to show a comparison at all. These matter as much as the primary path. 
 - Build and extend Ruby on Rails APIs, consume APIs built by the architecture team, and push back early when a contract does not serve the interface well. 
 - Work closely with design, matching intent precisely and raising discrepancies rather than approximating. 
 - Make sure features load asynchronously and never block or slow the workflows they are embedded in. 
 - Build for accessibility and cross-browser consistency. 
 - Instrument features so the team can measure how they are actually used. 
 - Write tests that cover behavior, including the degraded cases. 

Required Skills

- 6+ years building production web applications, with significant frontend ownership and hands-on backend development. 
 - Strong backend experience with Ruby on Rails: building and modifying APIs, data models, and services, not only consuming them. 
 - Strong proficiency with a modern JavaScript framework (React, Angular, or Vue) and solid JavaScript/TypeScript fundamentals, including a real understanding of rendering and state management, not just framework APIs. 
 - Experience building data-dense interfaces: charts, tables, dashboards, or comparison views where accuracy of presentation matters. 
 - Experience working inside large existing codebases: reading unfamiliar code, following established conventions, and avoiding regressions. 
 - Demonstrable care for edge cases, empty states, and error handling, backed by automated tests (e. g. , RSpec and frontend testing frameworks). 
 - Strong collaboration with designers and product managers; asks clarifying questions before building. 
 - Working proficiency with AI coding tools (e. g. , Claude, GitHub Copilot) to accelerate development, debugging, and test writing, with the judgment to review and validate AI-generated code before it ships. 

Benefits & Perks That Support You

Onit offers a comprehensive total rewards package designed to support the whole employee at work and beyond: 

Health Coverage: Employee and immediate family members. 

Time Away: Flexible paid time off and 10 company paid holidays annually. 

Family Support: Exceptional paid leave for birth parents, non-birth parents, and caregivers. Onit also offers surrogacy and adoption reimbursement. 

Income Protection: 100% employer-paid life and disability insurance. 

Additional Coverage Options: Voluntary benefits including hospital indemnity, critical illness, accident. 

Tax-Advantaged Accounts: Flexi, NPS. 

Community Engagement: One paid volunteer day each year to give back to the community. 

Our Commitment to Applicants

We know that not everyone will check every box in a job description. At Onit, we value diversity, inclusion, and authenticity. If you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification, we encourage you to apply. You may be exactly who we're looking for. 

Onit Values

Customer First - Customer success is our success. We deliver value, listen, and act on customer needs. 

Purposeful Innovation - Innovation fuels our growth. We harness creativity to solve problems and lead with the intentions and expertise. 

Win as One - Teamwork is how we win. We are accountable, act with integrity, and communicate openly. 

Intentional Growth - Our people are the difference. We create an environment with compelling work, impactful contributions, and career growth. 

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

About The Role

Abnormal protects organizations from cyber threats across email, identity, collaboration, and cloud applications. The Abnormal Data Platform (ADP) provides the data foundations that power detection and customer-facing products. Within ADP, the DIP Ingestion team builds the integrations and runtime systems that bring data from these platforms into Abnormal. Reliable, timely data is the foundation for the products and detection systems our customers depend on. 

We're looking for a Software Engineer II to build and operate backend services and ingestion pipelines at scale. You'll own complex features from a defined product or platform need through design, implementation, launch, and production support. Your work may span new source integrations, improvements to our ingestion framework, snapshot ingestion, and the reliability and freshness of data flowing to downstream teams. You'll have room to grow your technical judgment while working closely with experienced engineers and product partners. 

What you'll do

- Build and improve secure, scalable integrations that collect data from third-party APIs and deliver it reliably to Abnormal's downstream systems. 
 - Own complex, well-scoped features end to end: clarify requirements, propose an approach, break work into milestones, implement, test, roll out, and measure the outcome. 
 - Contribute to ingestion-platform capabilities such as reusable connector patterns, self-serve integration workflows, and snapshot and event-ingestion paths. 
 - Use AI-assisted tools to accelerate integration development, testing, and troubleshooting while validating their output and maintaining ownership of production quality. 
 - Improve ingestion freshness, correctness, and reliability by defining and tracking service-level goals, strengthening error handling and alerts, and investigating data gaps or delays. 
 - Diagnose issues across vendor APIs, ingestion services, and downstream interfaces; participate in the team's on-call rotation and turn recurring failures into durable fixes. 
 - Collaborate asynchronously with engineers and partners across product and platform teams. Participate in design discussions and code reviews, and document the systems you change. 

What we're looking for

- 3+ years of software engineering experience, including hands-on development of production backend services in Python. 
 - Experience owning the delivery of complex features: turning a clearly defined problem into a technical approach, implementation, and successful launch. 
 - Strong fundamentals in backend design, APIs, data modeling, testing, debugging, and performance. 
 - Experience operating services in production and using logs, metrics, and alerts to investigate and resolve issues. 
 - Familiarity with cloud services and deployment practices, ideally AWS. 
 - Clear written communication and the ability to clarify ambiguous requirements with teammates and stakeholders across functions and time zones. 
 - Care for correctness, code quality, and the customer impact of data reliability. 

Nice to have

- Experience with Go, Kafka or another messaging system, and distributed data pipelines. 
 - Experience integrating with third-party SaaS APIs, including authentication, pagination, rate limits, and inconsistent source data. 
 - Familiarity with Docker or other container technologies and SQL databases. 
 - Experience with batch or snapshot ingestion, workflow orchestration, or configuration-driven integration frameworks.

Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95, 000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first - developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact. 

A Day in the Life

At Medtronic, we are committed to driving software engineering excellence that delivers transformative impact in healthcare and beyond. As a Sr. Principal Software Engineer with a focus on Software Engineering Capabilities, Excellence Metrics, and Patient Safety, you will be at the forefront of ensuring that our software systems meet the highest standards of quality, safety, and efficiency. You will be working with software teams in Cardiaovascular, Medical Surgical and Neuroscience portfolios at MEIC, and will play a key role in promoting best practices, driving continuous improvement, and ensuring that our software solutions align with both technical and regulatory requirements. This is a leadership role responsible for setting and monitoring software excellence deliverables, ensuring patient safety standards, and fostering a culture of innovation and collaboration across the organization. Reports to the Director of Software Technology. Collaborates with cross-functional teams (business analysts, developers, end-users) to understand requirements and deliver solutions. 

Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned

Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with engineering, product management, and quality teams to assess project progress and ensure alignment with software excellence metrics, quality goals, and maturity standards. 

Software Maturity & KPIs: Drive software maturity initiatives, tracking KPIs such as defect density, technical debt, and code quality. Implement frameworks to ensure reliability, scalability, and maintainability across the software lifecycle. 

DevOps Integration: Oversee the integration of DevOps practices, optimizing CI/CD pipelines, automating testing, and improving deployment processes to enhance efficiency and system reliability. 

Optimizing Tools & Processes: Lead the evaluation and optimization of software tools and development processes, ensuring teams use the most effective solutions for code analysis, automation, and collaboration. 

Technical Reviews: Conduct critical reviews of software components to ensure best practices, code quality, and adherence to industry standards. Guide teams in optimizing development cycles and improving testing strategies. 

Regulatory Compliance & Patient Safety: Ensure software meets regulatory requirements and patient safety standards by driving initiatives like Design for Reliability and Manufacturability (DRM) and Quality Improvement Plans. Mentorship & Skill Development: Provide technical leadership and mentorship, fostering a culture of continuous learning and ensuring the team stays current with industry trends and best practices. 

Leveraging Reusable Solutions: Promote the reuse of software components and frameworks across teams, enhancing efficiency and consistency while reducing development time. 

Continuous Improvement: Analyze performance data to identify areas for improvement, leading initiatives to enhance software quality, safety, and user experience. Implement process improvements through regular assessments and industry benchmarking. 

Stakeholder Communication: Regularly update stakeholders on progress, software maturity, and quality metrics, providing strategic recommendations for process improvements and alignment with business objectives. 

Required Knowledge And Experience

- B-Tech/BE in Computer Science, Electronics, or related field with 20+ years of experience in Software and Systems Engineering, OR
 - ME/M-Tech with 18+ years of relevant experience. 
 - Proven experience leading the development and delivery of enterprise-scale software systems with a focus on quality, reliability, and maintainability. 
 - Expertise in defining and implementing software quality metrics and ensuring adherence to best practices in software development and testing. 
 - Deep understanding of software engineering processes, including agile methodologies, continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines, and DevOps practices. 
 - Experience driving software process improvement initiatives, leveraging data to enhance software development efficiency and product quality. 
 - Hands-on experience with Design for Reliability and Manufacturability (DRM) principles, driving their integration into the software product lifecycle. 
 - Familiarity with patient safety standards and industry regulations such as ISO 13485 and IEC 62304 for safety-critical systems, particularly in healthcare or medical device industries. 
 - Demonstrated ability to lead technical reviews, conduct code analysis, and ensure alignment with regulatory and industry standards. 
 - Preferrable experience in developing software systems for regulated industries such as healthcare, aerospace, or automotive, where safety and quality are critical. 
 - Preferrable expertise in statistical process control, Six Sigma, or other process improvement methodologies to drive quality improvement initiatives. 
 - Preferrable experience working with cloud-native or distributed systems, particularly in optimizing their reliability and scalability. 
 - Preferrable hands-on experience with software maturity models, such as CMMI, and their application in driving software excellence and continuous improvement. 
 - Preferrable previous leadership roles in driving cross-functional quality improvement initiatives, particularly in environments requiring stringent safety and regulatory compliance. 

Physical Job Requirements

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees assigned to this position, but they are not an exhaustive list of all the required responsibilities and skills of this position.

If you have any questions, concerns regarding the authenticity of a communication alleged to have been made by or on behalf of Medtronic, please contact us immediately at AskHR@medtronic. com.

data.title: Senior IoT System Architect (Pune/Gurugram/Pondicherry)
data.description:
Requisition ID: 72762

About Whirlpool India

Whirlpool of India Limited, headquartered in Gurugram, is a leading home appliances company dedicated to enhancing life at home and inspiring generations through its trusted brands. The company operates three state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities in Faridabad, Pune & Puducherry, each reflecting Whirlpool's commitment to providing best-in-class consumer solutions. Further driving innovation, the company has a Technology & Engineering Center, where India's world-class talent architects the next generation of home innovation. In the 2024-25 fiscal year, Whirlpool of India reported approximately INR 8110 Cr in annual revenue and employed 2193 people. More information is available at www. india. whirlpool. in

The Team You Will Be a Part Of

The Software Engineering team designs, develops or coordinates development/troubleshooting or debugging of moderately complex software programs for enhancements and new products. Performs high-level design/modeling to convert stakeholder needs into software solutions. Develops software and tools in support of design, infrastructure and technology platforms. Determines hardware compatibility and/or influences hardware design. Develops the architectural guidelines, specifications, and technical standards and communicates to stakeholders. 

This Role In Summary

We are looking for a Senior IoT System Architect to define, design and govern the technical blueprint for our next-generation smart connected appliances. In this role, you will be the primary technical authority owning the end-to-end IOT architecture-from low-level appliance microcontrollers and local wireless mesh networks to cloud telemetry pipelines and mobile API interfaces. You will translate product requirements into secure, scalable, and low-latency physical-to-digital systems, ensuring our appliance fleet is built for massive global scale. 

Your Responsibilities Will Include

End-to-End Product Architecture & Topology

- System Design: Define and document the comprehensive edge-to-cloud system architecture, defining state machines, data flow topologies, and Interface Control Documents (ICDs) across hardware, firmware, cloud, and applications. 
 - Hardware & Component Evaluation: Lead the technical evaluation and selection of microcontrollers (MCUs), System-on-Chips (SoCs), and RF modules based on strict memory, power-budget, thermal, and Bill of Materials (BOM) cost constraints. 
 - Edge Intelligence: Architect localized data processing and edge computing strategies on the appliance to handle real-time sensor analytics, predictive maintenance, and fault-detection algorithms. 

Embedded Control & Smart Home Ecosystems

- OS & Bus Governance: Oversee the integration of Real-Time Operating Systems (FreeRTOS, Zephyr) with low-level appliance application loops running on ARM Cortex-M/A or ESP32 chipsets via internal buses (I2C, SPI, UART). 
 - Ecosystem Interoperability: Architect native support for industry-standard smart home ecosystems (Apple HomeKit, Google Home, Amazon Alexa) with a heavy focus on the deployment of the Matter protocol over Thread and Wi-Fi networks. 
 - Northbound Protocols: Define and enforce message styling and data schemas utilizing MQTT (with Device Shadows), CoAP, WebSockets, and REST APIs for appliance control and telemetry reporting. 

Scalable Cloud Integration & Data Architecture

- Cloud Fleet Management: Architect device-to-cloud ingestion pathways targeting AWS IoT Core, Azure IoT Hub, or Google Cloud, ensuring maximum availability and connection persistence for millions of active units. 
 - Containerized Microservices: Guide backend teams on building high-performance, containerized microservices architectures using Docker and Kubernetes running on Node. js, Python, or C#. 
 - Telemetry Data Infrastructure: Structure scalable data streaming and ingestion pipelines capable of feeding Time-Series Databases, SQL, and NoSQL (Redis) for long-term machine performance analysis. 

Advanced Security, Provisioning & Lifecycle

- Hardware-Rooted Security: Implement an absolute zero-trust device security architecture utilizing Secure Boot, hardware-based cryptographic elements (HSMs, STSAFE), and mutual authentication (mTLS). 
 - Fail-Safe OTA: Architect robust, dual-bank Over-the-Air (OTA) firmware update mechanisms with built-in rollback capabilities to eliminate the risk of bricking appliances in the field. 
 - Lifecycle Management: Define production-line device provisioning workflows and frictionless end-user Wi-Fi/BLE onboarding procedures. 

Minimum Requirements

Education & Experience: 

- Education: Bachelor's or Master's Degree (MS/MTech highly preferred) in Electrical Engineering (EE), Electronics & Communication Engineering (ECE), Computer Engineering, or Computer Science or Internet of Things (IoT) Technologies. 
 - Minimum 10+ years of experience in product development, with at least 7+ years specifically focused on IoT system architecture or integration for physical hardware/appliances. 

Technical Skills

- Firmware/Hardware: Master-level competency in Bare-metal C/C++, RTOS environments, and debugging using digital electronics principles (interpreting schematics, scopes, logic analyzers). 
 - Cloud & DevOps: Deep expertise in containerized environments (Docker/K8s), serverless components, and microservices patterns. 
 - Methodologies: Experience with Operational Excellence (OPEX) frameworks, continuous integration pipelines (CI/CD), and Git-based workflow models. 

Preferred Skills And Experiences

Technical Leadership & Compliance

- Multidisciplinary Liaison: Act as the central architectural bridge aligning Hardware Engineering, Embedded Firmware, Cloud/DevOps, QA, and Product Management teams. 
 - Technical Mentorship: Drive architectural reviews, mentor senior engineering staff, and advocate for Agile/Scrum development best practices and robust version control. 
 - Regulatory Compliance: Ensure the systemic architecture natively supports global regulatory certifications, safety standards, and energy efficiency metrics IEC 60335, BEE, GDPR. 

Core Traits

- Exceptional problem-solving skills and a systemic approach to troubleshooting complex, distributed bugs. 
 - Strong communication skills to articulate complex architectural decisions to non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Project Management Certification; 
 - OPEX Knowledge and Experience; 
 - Understanding of electrical and electronic engineering principles, including circuit design, power systems, digital electronics, hardware, software and sensor technologies; 
 - Problem-solving skills; 
 - Understanding of industry standards, safety regulations, and energy efficiency requirements applicable to home appliances. Knowledge of certification processes (e. g. , UL, IEC) is beneficial; 
 - Collaboration skill to work within a multidisciplinary team, including engineers, designers, and technicians; 
 - Ability to work in a fast-paced environment with shifting priorities and tight deadlines; 
 - Effective time management skills to ensure timely completion of tasks and projects. 

What We Offer

N/A

Connect with us and learn more about Whirlpool India. See what it's like to work at Whirlpool by visiting Whirlpool Careers. Additional information about the company can be found on Facebook, Instagram and YouTube. 

At Whirlpool India, we value and celebrate diversity. Whirlpool India is committed to equal employment opportunity and prohibits any discrimination on the basis of race or ethnicity, religion, sex, pregnancy, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, age, physical or mental disability, veteran status, or any other category protected by applicable law.

data.description:
JOB PURPOSE

Senior Manager, QMS supports the implementation of ISO, ISAGO and other Standards in addition to ensuring continuous improvement in operations and support functions with consistency in processes which support the mission, vision and objectives of AISATS. 

Senior Manager, QMS interacts with Senior Management and staff as well as external agencies to define, acquire, monitor and validate QMS performance. He/ She also manages a team of talents who are accountable for the delivery of data, information and knowledge about AISATS. 

SPECIFIC RESPONSIBILITIES

Senior Manager - QMS shall be responsible for the successful management of one or more Audits within the BU. He/she shall monitor the QMS and Service excellence levels to ensure compliance of the Operations with the regulators policies, ISAGO, ISO Standards and other company requirements. He/she shall also hold the responsibility and role of a Management Representative and Lead Auditor to ensure compliances to the above mentioned standards. 

- Responsible for every aspect of the QMS/QC function from Audit Planning, Conduct of Audits, & Implementation, Corrective Action & Closure, Monitoring & Verification, Feedback/follow up and re audit where necessary
 - Converts data collected during internal audits into information and provide necessary statistics to Senior Management for Management Review. 
 - Responsible for strategizing and defining the Internal Audit Plan and review the implementation of the Annual Plan across the company while streamlining the Audits to minimize disruptions/duplications on operations. 
 - Assist the BU Head to implement the Quality Policy, Quality Manual and measureable Quality Targets in accordance to ISO 9001: 2015 that is appropriate to AISATS goals and supports strategies devised by the senior management to achieve those policies. 
 - Implement and maintain the processes needed for seamless QMS functioning. 
 - Monitor measure and analyze the QMS within the organization and make continuous improvements to suit AISATS operations and changing environment/policies. 
 - Initiate and implement process/certification projects involving continual improvement and best industry standards. 
 - Ensure implementation of an effective system of document and record controls. 
 - Ensure development of a system of identification and traceability of process and records. 
 - Implement the internal audit program to verify that the QMS conforms to planned arrangements. 
 - Coordinates audit follow-up and closure activities, to see that recommendations have been implemented or otherwise resolved. 
 - Perform Internal Audits at other stations as and when asked to. 
 - Analysis of the data collected on the effectiveness of the QMS and evaluate where the continuous improvement of the QMS can be made. 
 - Manage the Quality Management team in carrying out routine activities and persuading reluctant employees within AISATS to change their way of working to incorporate quality methods. 
 - Ensure that Quality Control mechanism is in place such that operation functions have an active process of conducting self-audits to ensure compliance/conformity to various standards. 
 - Overlooks the Safety Audits performed at the station and ensures that the Safety function is performing as required. 
 - Ensure the protection of data archives and the integrity, security, confidentiality and privacy of data, information and knowledge of AISATS. 
 - Support Senior Management- AISATS, in ensuring smooth functioning of the internal Audit department and document the Internal Audit monthly report for providing an update to the AISATS Senior management on Internal Audit activities and challenges. 
 - Responsible for managerial review and approval of the audit report, Discusses audit results with management to ensure recommendations are understood, accepted and appropriate corrective action is proposed. Assures that appropriate auditee responses to the audit report are received. 
 - Developing programs to support the effective implementation of QMS as stated in the Quality Manual and Process Manual. 
 - Translate documented requirements into functional specifications. 
 - •Perform any other functions as required by the BU Head
 - Responsible and accountable for overall quality, safety and security of operations. 
 - You will be responsible and accountable to make necessary operational decisions related to safety and security matters at all times whilst on duty. 

EDUCATIONAL QUALIFICATIONS

- Master's/University Degree with minimum 10 years of working experience of which at least 02 years in a managerial/supervisory capacity in the Aviation Industry
 - Certified Internal Auditor with an in-depth knowledge of the auditing field. 

RELEVANT EXPERIENCE

Senior Manager , QMS should possess the following experiences: 

- 2- 4 years in Quality Assurance / Quality control (operations) environment, successful management of multiple projects involving multi-cultural teams. 
 - Have demonstrated ability in preparing senior management reports and data analysis. 
 - Have the appropriate skill set, to set and manage priorities. 
 - Exceptional command over Ms Office and QMS (ISO 9001: 2015), ISAGO norms. Business Statistics would be an advantage. 
 - Excellent command over written and spoken English with the ability to document operational business case scenarios, develop process flow documentation. 
 - In-depth knowledge on the ISO 9001: 2015, ISAGO guidelines and QMS functioning. 

PERSONAL CHARACTERISTICS & BEHAVIOUR

For a successful role as Senior Manager, QMS, he/she should have the following traits: 

- Demonstrate excellent managerial and leadership skills
 - Good communicator and able to relate to all levels of staff
 - A team player and leader at handling cross-sectional teams
 - Comprehend and translate complex data and its relationship to trends and observations
 - Must be a good decision maker to come out with practical solutions
 - Must have good interpersonal skills and maintain good relations with stakeholders involved.
