Work Type: On-site

Experience: 4-5 years

About Zintlr

Zintlr is a B2B sales intelligence platform that helps sales teams understand who they are selling to by combining contact and company data with AI-generated personality and psychographic profiles. 

The Role

We're looking for a hands-on Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) who can take ownership of backend engineering while working closely with product and customer-facing teams to solve complex business and technical challenges. This is an individual contributor role with leadership responsibilities-you will be expected to write production code, make architectural decisions, build tailored solutions and integrations, and lead a small team of engineers. 

You should be comfortable working directly with evolving business requirements, translating customer needs into scalable technical solutions, and taking ownership from problem discovery and solution design through development, deployment, and production. The role requires someone who can balance strong engineering fundamentals with customer needs and business priorities in a fast-paced startup environment. 

What You'll Do

1. Backend Engineering & Architecture

- Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend services and REST APIs using Python, Django, and Django REST Framework. 
 - Own backend architecture and make technical decisions around service design, data models, API contracts, and system performance. 
 - Design reliable APIs with appropriate authentication, pagination, filtering, versioning, and backward compatibility. 
 - Work hands-on with MongoDB, Redis, and relational databases, making informed decisions around data modelling, indexing, caching, and query optimisation. 
 - Build and maintain asynchronous workflows, background jobs, and task queues using Celery or equivalent technologies. 
 - Integrate third-party APIs and data providers, ensuring robust handling of rate limits, retries, timeouts, and failures. 
 - Build and extend backend capabilities to support complex use cases, specialised workflows, and evolving requirements across different customer scenarios. 
 - Identify technical bottlenecks and improve the scalability, maintainability, and reliability of backend systems. 2. Production Ownership & Reliability

- Take end-to-end ownership of backend services from development and testing through deployment and production maintenance. 
 - Diagnose and resolve production issues independently, conduct root-cause analysis, and implement preventive measures. 
 - Establish and maintain appropriate logging, monitoring, metrics, and alerting for backend services. 
 - Optimise application performance, including API latency, database queries, resource utilisation, and background job execution. 
 - Maintain Docker-based development and deployment workflows and contribute to reliable CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Follow secure coding practices and ensure customer data is handled appropriately. 
 - Maintain code quality through automated testing, error handling, and appropriate documentation. 3. Technical Leadership & Team Ownership

- Lead and mentor a team of 3-4 backend engineers while remaining actively involved in coding and technical execution. 
 - Break down product requirements into technical tasks, estimate effort, prioritise work, and drive delivery within agreed timelines. 
 - Review code and technical designs, enforce engineering standards, and ensure the team follows sound development practices. 
 - Identify technical risks early, resolve blockers, and hold ownership of the quality and reliability of the team's output. 
 - Help engineers improve through code reviews, technical discussions, and hands-on guidance. 
 - Participate in technical interviews and support the onboarding of new engineers. 4. Product & Business Alignment

- Work closely with product and leadership to translate business requirements into practical, maintainable technical solutions. 
 - Work closely with product and customer-facing teams to understand specific business requirements, identify gaps in existing capabilities, and translate them into practical technical solutions. 
 - Develop tailored integrations, workflows, and backend enhancements to address complex requirements, balancing immediate business needs with long-term product scalability and maintainability. 
 - Take end-to-end ownership of solving ambiguous technical problems, from understanding the underlying requirement and evaluating possible approaches to implementation, deployment, and validation. 
 - Challenge requirements when necessary and identify simpler approaches that deliver the intended business outcome. 
 - Evaluate build-versus-buy decisions and weigh engineering effort against business impact, cost, and long-term maintainability. 
 - Take responsibility for technical trade-offs rather than relying on predefined instructions for every decision. 
 - Use AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or similar tools to improve engineering productivity and code quality. 

What We're Looking For

Must-Have

- 4-5 years of hands-on backend development experience, with strong production experience in Python, Django, and Django REST Framework. 
 - Demonstrated ability to design, build, deploy, and maintain backend services independently. 
 - Strong understanding of API design, database modelling, query optimisation, caching, concurrency, and failure-handling patterns. 
 - Practical experience with MongoDB, Redis, and relational databases. 
 - Experience building and operating asynchronous workflows using Celery or an equivalent task queue. 
 - Working knowledge of Docker, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and production debugging. 
 - Experience integrating third-party APIs and building reliable systems around external dependencies. 
 - Prior experience mentoring engineers, leading technical execution, or owning a backend module or service end to end. 
 - Ability to make technical decisions independently and take accountability for the results. 
 - Ability to translate ambiguous business requirements into technical solutions, with experience building custom integrations, tailored workflows, or extending existing product capabilities. 

Good to Have

- Experience integrating LLM APIs, such as OpenAI or Anthropic, into product features. 
 - Familiarity with search and indexing technologies such as Elasticsearch. 
 - Experience with data pipelines, large-scale data processing, or data-intensive applications.

data.title: Team Lead - Product Improvements
data.description:
Main Responsibilities And Tasks

Burckhardt Compression is seeking a technically strong and innovative engineering leader to drive product improvement initiatives across reciprocating compressor products and related rotating equipment. The role will be responsible for identifying, conceptualizing, prioritizing, and executing engineering improvements that enhance product performance, reliability, manufacturability, quality, cost competitiveness, and customer value. The ideal candidate combines deep mechanical design expertise with strong innovation, project leadership, and cross-functional collaboration skills. This role will act as a catalyst for continuous improvement, transforming field feedback, quality concerns, operational challenges, and new technology opportunities into tangible product enhancements. 

Product Improvement Leadership

- Lead and drive Product Improvement Cell with end-to-end ownership of strategic improvement initiatives. 
 - Develop and maintain a structured pipeline of product improvement opportunities based on customer feedback, field issues, workshop observations, testing results, quality data, value engineering inputs, and technological advancements. 
 - Identify opportunities to improve product reliability, performance, manufacturability, maintainability, safety, and lifecycle cost. 
 - Drive standardization and modularization initiatives to improve engineering efficiency and reduce complexity. 
 - Generate innovative concepts for product enhancement and next-generation solutions. 
 - Lead feasibility studies, concept evaluations, technical risk assessments, business cases, and project charters. 
 - Prepare and present improvement proposals to Engineering Steering Committees and management forums. 
 - Evaluate emerging technologies, materials, manufacturing methods, and digital solutions for application in compressor products and components. 

Engineering Design Excellence

- Review and validate designs, assemblies, part drawings, and design modifications for technical robustness. 
 - Lead design reviews and challenge existing design practices to achieve superior engineering solutions. 
 - Ensure compliance with relevant international standards including ASME, API, ASTM, ISO, NACE, PED, and customer specifications. 
 - Support critical engineering decisions through calculations, simulations, testing, and root cause investigations. 
 - Lead complex technical investigations arising from field failures, quality issues, and operational challenges. 
 - Drive Root Cause Analysis using structured methodologies such as 8D, Why-Why Analysis, FMEA, Fault Tree Analysis, and Design Reviews. 
 - Establish preventive and corrective actions to eliminate recurrence. 
 - Capture and institutionalize lessons learned into engineering standards and design guidelines. 

Project Management

- Lead multiple improvement projects from ideation through implementation and benefit realization. 
 - Define project scope, timelines, milestones, risk mitigation plans, stakeholder responsibilities, and success criteria. 
 - Track project progress and ensure on time delivery of measurable business benefits. 

Digitalization & Engineering Productivity

- Lead engineering automation and digital transformation initiatives. 
 - Improve engineering productivity through advanced use of Power BI, SAP, Teamcenter, NX, VBA, AI-enabled solutions, and other digital tools. 
 - Identify opportunities to eliminate manual effort, reduce engineering lead times, and improve data-driven decision-making. 

Team Leadership

- Lead and mentor a team of mechanical engineers. 
 - Allocate work, review deliverables, and ensure technical excellence. 
 - Develop team competencies, innovation mindset, and continuous improvement culture. 
 - Coach engineers in problem-solving, design excellence, and project execution. 
 - Facilitate alignment among stakeholders and drive implementation of approved improvements. 
 - Build strong relationships with internal and external experts to accelerate innovation and problem solving. 

Education, Experience And Languages

- Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Mechanical Engineering. 
 - Master's Degree (M. Tech. / M. E. ) from a reputed institute is preferred. 
 - 10+ years of industrial experience preferably in rotating equipment. 
 - Proven experience leading product improvement, value engineering, cost optimization, design enhancement, and cross-functional engineering initiatives. 
 - Proficiency in English language and knowledge of German language will be an added advantage. 

Burckhardt Compression creates leading compression solutions for a sustainable energy future and the long-term success of its customers. The Group is the only global manufacturer that covers a full range of reciprocating compressor technologies and services. Since 1844, its passionate, customer-oriented and solution-driven workforce has set the benchmark in the gas compression industry.

We are looking for an experienced and detail-oriented Quality Engineer with proven expertise in Control Components, valve assemblies, hydraulic & pneumatic systems, cryogenic systems and precision manufacturing and vehicle level system integration. 

The ideal candidate will ensure process integrity, product reliability, and compliance with international aerospace and manufacturing standards through systematic quality planning, inspection, and process validation. 

Key Responsibilities

- Prepare and review Quality Assurance Plans (QAPs) for machining, fabrication, welding, valve assembly and Additive Manufacturing. 
 - Conduct testings of raw material, in-process and final inspection of precision-machined components, control components & valves, pressure vessels, and assemblies. 
 - Lead part qualification and validation activities including FAI, PPAP, and APQP in accordance with aerospace requirements. 
 - Oversee assembly and integration quality for cryogenic system, flow-control systems, tanks, and propulsion subassemblies. 
 - Conduct Testing and evaluate the test results and preparation of Quality Assessment Reports. 
 - Validate and monitor special processes such as various types of welding (GTAW, GMAW, EB, Laser, Plasma) and additive manufacturing (3D printing). 
 - Review and interpret engineering drawings (GD & T), specifications, and international standards such as ASTM, ASME, AWS, ISO, and DIN to ensure compliance during inspection and testing. 
 - Execute Failure Mode Effect Analysis, Corrective & Preventive Action, and Root Cause Analysis to resolve nonconformities and improve process performance. 
 - Preparation of non-conformance reports, and presentation to various technical committees. 
 - Manage supplier quality audits, vendor capability assessments, and ensure quality compliance for procured components and valve parts. 
 - Support customer audits, QMS certification audits, and maintain complete documentation of inspection and quality records. 
 - Supervise calibration and verification of inspection tools, ensuring traceability and accuracy.

Key Skills & Knowledge

- Expertise in cryogenic valves, pressure vessels, and flow-control assemblies. 
 - Strong understanding of precision machining and aerospace-grade manufacturing. 
 - Knowledge of valve functional testing, pressure testing, helium leak testing, and assembly inspection. 
 - Proficient in engineering drawing interpretation, GD&T, and tolerance analysis. 
 - Hands-on experience with CMM, Micrometres, gauges, and basic knowledge of NDT methods (UT, PT, RT, LPT). 
 - Familiar with WPS, PQR, WPQ and welding inspection documentation. 
 - Understanding of international standards like AS9100D, AWS D17. 1, ASTM, and ISO related to aerospace and valve systems.

 - Exposure to Lean Manufacturing, 5S, Kaizen, and process improvement methodologies.

data.description:
We are looking for an IP Manager to join NVIDIA's Networking front-end design team! In this role, you will lead and manage a cluster of IP teams responsible for both design and design verification (DV) of complex hardware IP blocks across NVIDIA's next-generation SmartNIC and DPU products. You will own the end-to-end delivery of IPs - from micro-architecture definition and RTL implementation through functional verification, lint/CDC/RDC closure, synthesis, and silicon readiness. 

We are looking for someone who thrives on building high-performing teams, driving IP execution across multiple parallel projects, and partnering with architecture, SoC integration, physical design, software, and program management teams to deliver world-class silicon. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Lead, mentor, and grow a team of design and verification engineers across a cluster of IP blocks. You will define team structure, hiring plans, and career development paths to build a strong, scalable organization. 
 - Own the end-to-end execution of IP delivery - micro-architecture, RTL design, functional verification, coverage closure, assertions, formal verification, and synthesis handoff. You will set quality bars, review schedules, and drive milestone adherence across your IP cluster. 
 - Define and drive verification strategies, test plans, coverage goals, and sign-off criteria for your IPs. Your team will develop UVM-based constrained-random and directed test environments, achieve functional and code coverage targets, and ensure robust regression infrastructure. 
 - Partner with architecture, SoC integration, physical design, DFT, firmware, and software teams to resolve cross-functional dependencies, close interface specifications, and ensure seamless IP integration. We will look to you to identify risks early, drive trade-off decisions, and align technical priorities across stakeholders. 
 - Establish and improve design and verification methodologies, best practices, reuse strategies, and automation flows to increase team productivity and IP quality across tape-outs. 

What We Need To See

- B. Sc. or M. Sc. in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or equivalent experience. 
 - 10+ years of experience in ASIC/SoC design or verification, including 2+ years in a people management or technical leadership role managing multi-engineer teams. 
 - Strong understanding of digital design fundamentals - RTL coding (Verilog/SystemVerilog), micro-architecture, timing, clocking, reset, power management, and synthesis constraints. 
 - Strong understanding of verification methodologies - e-specman/UVM, constrained-random verification, coverage-driven verification, assertions (SVA), and formal verification techniques. 
 - Experience managing IP delivery across the full lifecycle - specification, design, verification, synthesis handoff, and post-silicon support. 
 - Demonstrated ability to manage multiple IPs or projects in parallel, balancing resources, schedules, and quality trade-offs. 
 - Experience with EDA tools for simulation, lint, CDC, RDC, synthesis, and debug. 
 - Ability to communicate technical status, risks, and trade-offs clearly to engineering leadership and cross-functional partners. 

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

- Experience with high-speed interfaces such as PCIe, NVLink, HBM, DDR, or high-speed SerDes IP blocks. 
 - Experience building or scaling verification infrastructure - regression frameworks, coverage automation, CI/CD pipelines for hardware, or emulation/FPGA prototyping flows. 
 - Hands-on experience with scripting and automation using Python, Perl, TCL, or shell scripting to improve team workflows. 
 - Background in GPU, networking, or AI/HPC-related IP domains is a strong plus.

data.title: Lead Software Engineer
data.description:
SDE-3 - Platform

Backend Engineering | Distributed Systems | System Design

About Mstack

Mstack is building the world's first AI-native chemical company. 

We combine AI, scientific R&D, software and real-world manufacturing to dramatically shorten the time it takes to move from a chemical idea to commercial production. Our technology powers Chemstack AI, our chemistry intelligence platform, as well as a growing set of products across commerce, internal operations, automation, analytics and decision-making. 

As Mstack grows, software is becoming the operating layer connecting our customers, scientists, commercial teams, supply chain and manufacturing ecosystem. 

About the Platform Team

The Platform team builds the technology foundation that powers products across Mstack. 

Some of our systems support Chemstack AI, including agentic workflows, enterprise applications and scientific tooling. But the Platform team works across a much broader problem space. 

We are building systems for commerce, operational workflows, internal automation, metrics and decision-making, and shared capabilities that allow teams across Mstack to build products faster. 

Our goal is not to create isolated applications. We want to build reusable engineering primitives, services and platforms that can support multiple products while remaining reliable, secure and easy to evolve. 

The Role

- We are looking for an SDE-3 who is strong in backend engineering and enjoys solving difficult systems problems. 
 - You will design and build services that sit underneath critical products and workflows across Mstack. The problems you work on may involve distributed systems, asynchronous workflows, high-volume APIs, event-driven architectures, long-running jobs, data consistency, reliability and failure recovery. 
 - You will be expected to do more than implement a design handed to you. You should be able to take an ambiguous problem, understand the product and system constraints, design the architecture, reason through trade-offs, and take the system all the way to production. 
 - Systems design is core to this role. You should be comfortable thinking about what happens when traffic grows 10x, when dependencies fail, when a job runs for hours, when the same message is delivered twice, or when a system has to evolve without breaking existing users. 

What You'll Do

Design backend systems

- Design services, APIs, data models and system boundaries for new products and platform capabilities. 
 - Work through trade-offs around consistency, availability, latency, throughput, maintainability and cost. 
 - Move comfortably from a product requirement to a concrete architecture and execution plan. Build distributed and asynchronous systems

- Design and operate systems involving queues, event streams, background jobs and workflow orchestration. 
 - Build systems where work may take seconds, minutes or hours and still needs to remain reliable across retries, crashes and deployments. 
 - Think carefully about idempotency, retries, ordering, concurrency, backpressure and failure recovery. Own systems end to end

- Take ownership from design through implementation, testing, deployment and production operations. 
 - Be responsible not only for whether the code works, but whether the system behaves correctly in production. Build APIs and platform services

- Design clean interfaces that allow other teams and products to build on top of your systems. 
 - Create reusable platform capabilities rather than repeatedly solving the same problem inside individual applications. Work with complex data flows

- Build systems that move and transform data across multiple services and workflows. 
 - Reason about transaction boundaries, consistency models, caching, indexing, schema evolution and data lifecycle. Engineer for reliability

- Design for failures before they happen. 
 - Build appropriate observability, metrics, logging and tracing so systems are understandable when something goes wrong. 
 - Participate in debugging production incidents and improve systems based on what we learn. Make systems scalable

- Identify bottlenecks before they become production problems. 
 - Improve application, database and infrastructure performance as workloads grow. 
 - Know when horizontal scaling solves the problem and when the architecture itself needs to change. Raise engineering standards

- Contribute to architecture reviews, code reviews and engineering discussions. 
 - Help improve how the team approaches system design, testing, reliability and maintainability. 
 - Mentor engineers when appropriate and help the team make better technical decisions. 

What We're Looking For

- 7+ years of professional software engineering experience, primarily working on backend or distributed systems. 
 - Strong fundamentals in data structures, algorithms, operating systems, networking and databases. 
 - Strong experience designing and operating production backend systems. 
 - Strong system-design ability and clear reasoning about architectural trade-offs. 
 - Experience designing APIs, service boundaries and data models. 
 - Experience with relational databases, including indexing, transactions, locking and query performance. 
 - Experience with asynchronous processing using queues, event systems or background workers. 
 - Strong understanding of concurrency, retries, idempotency and common distributed-system failure modes. 
 - Experience debugging production systems using logs, metrics and traces. 
 - Understanding of caching and the consistency trade-offs it introduces. 
 - Experience building systems that have scaled meaningfully in traffic, data volume or complexity. 
 - Strong coding ability in at least one backend language such as Python, Go, Java or similar. 
 - Experience with at least one major cloud platform such as AWS, GCP or Azure. 
 - Ability to independently take a technical problem from ambiguity to production. 

Systems Design Expectations

Systems design is a significant part of the engineering bar for this role. We care less about memorised templates and more about whether you can identify the important constraints, make assumptions explicit, and reason through trade-offs. 

You should be comfortable discussing questions such as: 

- How would you design a service that needs to handle millions of requests reliably?
 - When would you choose synchronous communication versus an event-driven architecture?
 - How do you make a job safe to retry?
 - How do you prevent duplicate processing in a distributed system?
 - When should data live in one database versus separate services?
 - How do you evolve an API without breaking existing consumers?
 - How do you design for partial failure and slow dependencies?
 - How would you build a workflow that needs to run reliably for several hours?
 - When should you use caching, and how do you keep cached data correct?
 - How do you identify whether a scaling problem comes from compute, database, network or architecture?

Nice to Have

- Go or Python in production. 
 - PostgreSQL or other relational databases at scale. 
 - Kafka, SQS, Pub/Sub or similar messaging systems. 
 - Kubernetes and containerized production environments. 
 - Infrastructure as code and strong production operations practices. 
 - Workflow orchestration systems. 
 - Microservices or service-oriented architectures. 
 - Distributed tracing and observability platforms. 
 - Multi-tenant B2B systems and enterprise security patterns. 
 - High-volume commerce or transaction systems. 
 - AI or agentic systems, including MCP or tool-based agent architectures. 
 - Search, indexing, retrieval infrastructure, or data-intensive analytics platforms. 

How We Think About Backend Engineering

We care about engineers who understand that production systems are more than application code. A strong backend engineer should be able to ask: 

- Where can this system fail?
 - What happens when the database becomes slow?
 - Can this request safely be retried?
 - What if the same event arrives twice?
 - What state should be persisted?
 - Which operations require strong consistency?
 - What should happen during a partial outage?
 - How will we understand this system six months after it goes live?
 - What assumptions stop being true when the workload grows 10x?
 - Are we building something reusable or adding another one-off service?Writing clean code matters. Knowing what system should be built in the first place matters even more at this level. 

Why Mstack

- Work on systems that connect software and the physical world
 - The systems we build influence real scientific, commercial and operational workflows rather than existing only behind a screen. 
 - Solve problems across multiple domains
 - You may work on AI infrastructure one quarter and commerce or operational systems the next. The engineering principles remain the same, but the problems are rarely repetitive. 
 - Build foundations, not just features
 - The Platform team is responsible for capabilities that multiple products and teams can build upon. Good technical decisions have leverage across the company. 
 - Own meaningful architecture
 - Many of the systems that Mstack will need at scale are being designed today. You will have the opportunity to shape those systems rather than simply operate infrastructure designed years ago. 
 - Work close to the problem
 - Engineers work directly with product teams and domain experts. You will understand why a system is being built, not just receive a ticket describing what to implement. 

What Success Looks Like

- Within your first few months, you should be able to independently own a meaningful backend system or platform capability from design to production. 
 - You should be able to understand an ambiguous problem, propose an architecture, identify its risks and trade-offs, and drive the implementation. 
 - Over time, we expect you to become one of the engineers people rely on for difficult systems-design decisions. You should raise the quality of the systems around you through better architecture, stronger reliability practices, thoughtful abstractions and high engineering standards. 
 - We value demonstrated engineering ability over a particular degree or career path. 
 - If you have built systems you are proud of, we would love to hear about what you designed, what scale it operated at, where it failed, and what you would do differently today.

data.title: PRINCIPAL, SOFTWARE ENGINEER
data.description:
About Team

GDF (Global Data Foundation) is part of Walmart's AI & Data organization - the team building the foundational data platforms that power AI, analytics, and decision-making across every Walmart banner and geography, from supply chain and merchandising to customer experience and enterprise AI agents. Our newly created platform team is chartered with building next-generation data infrastructure at Walmart scale: reliable, high-throughput data pipelines, distributed processing systems, and platform capabilities that downstream teams across Walmart depend on every day. 

What You'll Do

- Design, build, and operate large-scale batch and streaming data pipelines using Spark, Java, and Python, processing data at Walmart scale. 
 - Apply strong software engineering fundamentals - clean architecture, automated testing, CI/CD, code review discipline - to data engineering work; this is a software engineering role that specializes in data, not a script-writing role. 
 - Apply domain-oriented design, system design, and low-level design (LLD) rigor to ambiguous data and platform problems - evaluating dependencies, trade-offs, failure modes, scalability, cost, and long-term durability before writing a line of code. 
 - Flex into platform/software engineering work when needed: build and maintain services, APIs, and distributed systems that data pipelines depend on, contributing directly to GDF's broader platform codebase. 
 - Integrate AI, GenAI, and agentic capabilities directly into the data platform: embeddings/vector search for data discovery, LLM-assisted data quality and anomaly detection, agentic pipeline monitoring and self-healing, AI-assisted schema and lineage documentation. 
 - Partner with data scientists and ML engineers to build feature pipelines, model-serving data paths, and the data infrastructure that MLOps depends on. 
 - Own data quality, observability, and governance for the pipelines and datasets you build, with a strong Operational Excellence / Engineering Excellence discipline. 
 - Participate in and lead architecture and design reviews spanning both data engineering and platform engineering domains. 
 - As a Principal engineer, set technical direction and best practices across multiple teams and the broader GDF platform without needing a management title - mentor other engineers and influence GDF's broader data engineering standards. 
 - Continuously evaluate emerging Big Data, cloud, and AI/agentic technologies, adopting them pragmatically where they improve reliability, productivity, or business value. 

What You'll Bring

- Genuinely hands-on coding: 12+ years of professional software engineering experience with significant hands-on data engineering at scale; strong proficiency in Java and Python is required, and strong working knowledge of Spark for distributed data processing is required, not optional. Additional experience with Go, C++, or Scala is a plus. 
 - Operational Excellence (OE) and Engineering Excellence (EE) mindset is a required skill, not a nice-to-have: SLO/SLA ownership, incident management and blameless post-incident reviews, proactive reliability and quality metrics, and continuous improvement built into how you ship, not bolted on afterward. 
 - Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - Deep experience with the Big Data ecosystem - Spark, Hadoop/HDFS, Hive, Kafka, workflow orchestration (Airflow or equivalent) - including batch and streaming processing, and large-scale data transformation. 
 - Strong data platform fundamentals: data modeling, ETL/ELT pipeline design, data quality and observability, data governance, and integration with lakehouse architectures (e. g. , Delta Lake, BigQuery, Databricks). 
 - Full exposure to AI and Agentic technologies: hands-on experience integrating model APIs and GenAI/LLM tooling, building or operating agentic workflows (tool-calling agents, multi-step autonomous systems), working with embeddings/vector search, and applying MLOps practices (feature stores, model lifecycle, retraining pipelines) - not just conceptual awareness. 
 - Working literacy in platform engineering: microservices, API design, Kubernetes or equivalent orchestration, CI/CD, and cloud-native practices - enough to flex into platform/software engineering work confidently. 
 - Strong distributed systems fundamentals: event-driven patterns, service contracts, asynchronous processing, and fault tolerance at scale - paired with strong system design, domain-oriented design (DDD), and low-level design (LLD) skills, and demonstrated ability to evaluate trade-offs, failure modes, scalability, and cost when owning production code. 
 - Strong software engineering craftsmanship: testing strategy, code review standards, design patterns, and system design for high-throughput data systems.

 - Strong communication skills, including cross-team collaboration. 
 - Ability to deliver basic functionality and iterate rapidly.

data.title: Senior DevOps and Infrastructure Engineer
data.description:
NVIDIA is looking for a Senior DevOps and Infrastructure Engineer to work in SW Infra Cloud Infrastructure Team. SW Infra is a global organization within NVIDIA. This group works with various other groups within NVIDIA such as Graphics Processors, Mobile Processors, Deep Learning, Artificial Intelligence and Driverless Cars to cater to their infrastructure needs. These cloud services provide almost half a million automated jobs per day on thousands of servers helping with the productivity of thousands of NVIDIA's software engineers worldwide. The cloud hosts a heterogeneous mix of machines and devices with various operating systems (Windows/Linux/Android), a multitude of hardware platforms both NVIDIA GPUs and Tegra Processors. Are you passionate about distributed infrastructure and looking for sophisticated, critical issues, ready to build the next generation of cloud services, design creative solutions, mine through data to uncover real problems and fix them? We are excited to onboard a fun-loving person like you. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Support OpenStack Team Operations queue working within our Infrastructure and Cloud Operations Environments. 
 - Develop and support OpenStack Services and Cloud based operations, monitoring, troubleshooting and assisting triage and resolution of bugs, and KPI investigations. 
 - Work closely with world-class SRE, PaaS, Image and Infrastructure engineers, architects, technical product managers and application developers to support code development and setting the best strategies in place for a product launch. 
 - Solve sophisticated problems involving multi-site OpenStack Regional Deployments supporting NVIDIA products. 
 - Collaborate with multi-functional teams, including system engineering, software engineering, mechanical/thermal engineering, operations, data center teams, external vendors, and other partners to successfully deliver a reliable and robust platform from concept to deployments. 
 - Directly contribute to the overall quality of deployments and improve time to market for next gen products. 

What We Need To See

- Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Computer Science or Software Engineering, or equivalent experience. 
 - 8+ years of relevant experience supporting Openstack with Ironic. 
 - Thorough understanding of the PXE process, including host configuration (BIOS and network card), general network configurations such as VLANs, switch port settings, and cabling. 
 - Knowledge of services involved in PXE booting, such as DHCP (DNSMASK), TFTP, HTTP, and ISCSI, essential for troubleshooting. 
 - Familiarity with OpenStack services and their interactions, including nova, nova placement, Neutron, Glance, Cinder, and Ironic. 
 - Ability to troubleshoot across different OpenStack applications, comprehend the OpenStack deployment process, and understand service dependencies and order of operations. 
 - Proficiency in using AI DevOps Tools, Python coding. 
 - Expertise in supporting third-party services like MySQL, RabbitMQ, CEPH, HaProxy, and Keepalived. 
 - Ability to use tools such as Ansible, Gitlab, Jenkins, Grafana, DataDog and Elastic Search for successful system configuration and maintenance. 

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

- Experience with Openstack Ironic, ML2 and Baremetal provisioning
 - Familiarity working in large scale R&D/QA environments, for product bring ups. 
 - Experience with running OpenStack in Containerized Environment
 - Background with Linux, RHEL, Anisible, Bash and Python. 
 - Familiarity with Jenkins, Ansible and REST APIs. 

NVIDIA is leading the way in groundbreaking developments in Artificial Intelligence, High-Performance Computing and Visualization. The GPU, our invention, serves as the visual cortex of modern computers and is at the heart of our products and services. Our work opens new universes to explore, enables outstanding creativity and discovery, and powers what were once science fiction inventions from artificial intelligence to autonomous cars. NVIDIA is looking for phenomenal people like you to help us accelerate the next wave of artificial intelligence. Widely considered to be one of the technology world's most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us. If you're creative and passionate about new technologies we want you on our team!

Toast is driven by building the restaurant platform that helps restaurants adapt, take control, and get back to what they do best: building the businesses they love. We're seeking a Software Engineer II to work within our team focused on building impactful capabilities that empower restaurants to drive Guest engagement, retention and growth. The team will help shape the future of how restaurants use technology to connect with their guests - increasingly through AI-powered tools and experiences that drive automation, personalization and smarter decision-making. You will be a key part of a high-impact, high-ownership engineering team solving complex challenges in a fast-moving product space. Your role will balance technical excellence alongside a strong product mindset to solve for continuous growth within both the team and our product space.

 - React SPAs leveraging Tailwind, GraphQL and Storybook.

 - PostgreSQL, Dynamodb for persistence.

What You'll Need To Thrive (Requirements)

AI at Toast

At Toast, one of our company values is that we're hungry to build and learn. Our total rewards package goes beyond great earnings potential and provides the means to a healthy lifestyle with the flexibility to meet Toasters' changing needs. Learn more about our benefits at https: //careers. toasttab. com/toast-benefits.

All hiring decisions are made by people. To learn more: https: //careers. toasttab. com/ai-in-hiring

We embrace a hybrid work model that fosters in-person collaboration while valuing individual needs. Our goal is to build a strong culture of connection as we work together to empower the hospitality community, regardless of location. Please visit the Locations page on our career site to learn more about our in-office expectations by region: https: //careers. toasttab. com/locations-toast

People Are the Secret Ingredient in Our Recipe for Success

At Toast, our employees are our secret ingredient-when they thrive, we thrive. We strive to build a culture grounded in authenticity, respect, and humility, where every Toaster has a real opportunity to grow, contribute, and do their best work-raising the bar in delivering exceptional experiences for our customers and each other. 

Apply today!

As part of this commitment, we strive to provide reasonable accommodations for persons with disabilities to enable them to access the hiring process. data.title: Software Development Engineer II
data.description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business. 

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere. 

Software Development Engineer II, ML Systems - Marketing (Meta/SEM Bidding)

Introduction to the team

We create and deliver an aligned, dedicated marketing strategy to fuel each Expedia Group brand's success. Since our travelers interact with us through our brands, we have a brand focus in our marketing, while leveraging the scale and efficiency we've built in functional expertise. 

The Meta/SEM Bidding Programs team builds and operates the high-scale data and machine learning systems that power our bidding programs. We are looking for a Software Development Engineer II who writes clean, reliable, production-grade software and partners closely with machine learning engineers to build the pipelines, services, and platform that bring ML models to life in production. 

In this role, you will

- Implement and enhance well-scoped software and data components within complex, business-critical services - from design input through coding, testing, deployment, and production support, with guidance on larger decisions. 
 - Build and maintain the data pipelines, services, and infrastructure that support model training, evaluation, and serving, working alongside ML engineers to turn experimental workflows into robust production systems. 
 - Contribute to batch and streaming (online) data and inference workflows, learning how models are trained, served, and monitored at scale. 
 - Instrument systems and pipelines to capture operational and quality metrics (latency, throughput, errors, and key business signals), and help diagnose and resolve production issues. 
 - Participate in code reviews, on-call rotations, and incident response, taking ownership of the reliability and observability of the components you build. 
 - Use AI as a co-pilot across the software development lifecycle - to clarify requirements, generate and refine code, and strengthen automated tests - and apply generative AI/LLM techniques where they add value. 

Experience And Qualifications

- Strong problem-solving skills - the ability to deeply understand a problem and reason clearly about the right approach - which we value above any single technology. 
 - 2+ years of relevant professional experience building and shipping production software, ideally including data-intensive or backend services in a cloud or hybrid environment. 
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field; or Equivalent related professional experience. 
 - A strong command of Python, along with experience building APIs and services (FastAPI, REST). 
 - Solid software engineering fundamentals - data structures, algorithms, testing, and version control. 
 - Experience building, deploying, and supporting distributed systems and cloud services on AWS, including contributing to monitoring, alerting, and basic performance improvements. 
 - Experience running containerized and orchestrated workloads with Kubernetes at scale. 
 - Working knowledge of Go and Spark (Scala/PySpark) or similar big data frameworks, including basic evaluation, optimization, and debugging of large-scale data processing applications. 
 - Familiarity with a range of databases (e. g. , Hive, Iceberg, Postgres) and workflow orchestration tools (e. g. , Airflow, Flyte, Argo). 
 - Exposure to MLOps practices (CI/CD for ML, experiment tracking, model registry, deployment and monitoring tooling) and to machine learning concepts or ML pipelines - deep ML expertise is not required, but curiosity and a willingness to grow into data/ML engineering are important. 
 - Hands-on experience using AI-assisted engineering tools (e. g. , GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, or equivalent) in day-to-day work, consistent with Expedia Group's expectation that engineers actively build and apply AI skills. 

Accommodation requests

Expedia Group is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience. If you need an accommodation or adjustment due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a request at https: //expedia. service-now. com/askeg?id=job_accommodation. 

About Expedia Group

Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands - Expedia, Hotels. com, and Vrbo - along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease. 

Important notice

Employment opportunities and job offers at Expedia Group will always come from Expedia Group's Talent Acquisition and hiring teams. Never share sensitive personal information unless you are confident of the recipient. Expedia Group does not extend job offers via email or messaging tools to individuals with whom we have not made prior contact. Our email domain is @expediagroup. com. The official place to find and apply for roles is https: //careers. expediagroup. com/jobs/. 

Equal Opportunity

Role Overview

The Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) will partner closely with business, product, and engineering teams to reimagine end-to-end processes at Capgemini using AI and agentic systems. This role sits at the intersection of business design, strategy, product design, and hands-on engineering, owning AI led solutions from problem discovery through production deployment. 

FDEs will work directly with stakeholders to identify high-impact opportunities, translate ambiguous business problems into technical architectures, and rapidly build, test, and deploy AI-powered solutions that materially transform how work gets done.

Discovery & Problem Framing

- Partner with business and operational teams to deeply understand existing workflows, pain points, constraints, and business objectives, helping shape future-state operating models enabled by AI and agentic solutions 
 - Identify opportunities where AI, LLMs, and agentic systems can drive step-change improvements in efficiency, quality, or user experience 
 - Translate loosely defined business challenges into clear problem statements, success metrics, and technical requirements

 - Partner with stakeholders to define target-state business processes and operating models enabled by AI and agentic systems. 
 - Facilitate workshops to align business goals, user needs, process redesign, and AI capabilities. 
 - Develop business cases, value hypotheses, and adoption strategies for AI-led transformation initiatives. 
 - Ensure proposed solutions deliver measurable business outcomes beyond task-level automation. 

Solution Design

- Design end-to-end AI-led solutions and agentic system architectures, including business workflows, data flows, model selection, orchestration patterns, and human-in-the-loop controls. 
 - Collaborate with product, risk, and platform teams to ensure solutions are scalable, secure, explainable, and compliant 
 - Rapidly prototype concepts to validate feasibility and value before full build-out

Build & Iterate

 - Iterate quickly based on stakeholder feedback, usage data, and performance metrics

Deployment & Adoption

 - Partner with platform and operations teams to ensure reliability, scalability, and maintainability 
 - Support organizational change management, user adoption, and value realization by working closely with business owners, end users, and delivery teams

Required Qualifications

- 12+ Yrs of experience with Strong software engineering experience (e. g. , Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or similar) 
 - Hands-on experience building and deploying AI/ML or LLM-powered applications 
 - Experience translating ambiguous business problems into working technical solutions 
 - Comfort working directly with non-technical stakeholders in fast-moving, high-ambiguity environments 
 - Strong systems thinking and ability to design end-to-end workflows

Preferred Qualifications

 - Background in process improvement, operations, or digital transformation initiatives

What Success Looks Like

- Business teams can point to materially improved processes enabled by your solutions

data.title: Senior Supplier Quality Engineer
data.description:
NVIDIA is seeking a talented and experienced Senior Supplier Quality Engineer (SQE) to join our SQE team. The successful candidate will play a key role in ensuring the highest quality of NVIDIA boards and networking switch products. As a Senior SQE, you will have the opportunity to work closely with NVIDIA's suppliers and manufacturing partners to develop and implement outstanding quality programs for PCBAs, system boards, and networking switches. Your primary responsibility will be to represent NVIDIA's supplier quality interests, collaborating with internal engineering and operations teams to improve product quality, reliability, manufacturing performance, and supplier execution. 

You will work closely with teams such as hardware engineering, product engineering, manufacturing engineering, product quality engineering, operations, and commodity management to drive continuous improvement. Additionally, you will be responsible for monitoring and reporting supplier quality performance and driving corrective and preventive actions. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Responsible to lead end-to-end supplier quality activities for PCBAs, system boards, and networking switch products. 
 - Drive supplier quality activities throughout the product lifecycle, including supplier readiness, NPI, qualification, production ramp, and sustaining phases. 
 - Collaborate with engineering organizations to investigate and resolve board- and system-level failures, including electrical, mechanical, manufacturing, and component-related issues. 
 - Lead failure investigations, root-cause analysis, corrective actions, and preventive actions using structured problem-solving methodologies. 
 - Lead supplier and manufacturing process audits to ensure compliance with NVIDIA quality requirements and industry standards. 
 - Monitor supplier quality performance using quality metrics and statistical methods, identify improvement opportunities, and drive continuous quality improvement programs. 
 - Work with suppliers to improve manufacturing processes, increase yield, reduce defects, strengthen process controls, and improve overall product quality. 

What We Need To See

- MS or BS in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or equivalent experience, with 8+ years of relevant experience in supplier quality, manufacturing, or the electronics industry. 
 - Professional knowledge of PCB/PCBA manufacturing processes, including SMT, reflow, soldering, inspection, and board assembly. 
 - Solid understanding of electronics manufacturing, component quality, workmanship requirements, and process controls. 
 - In-depth knowledge of quality and reliability concepts, including qualification, reliability testing, and failure analysis. 
 - Familiarity with board- and component-level failure analysis techniques, including X-ray, cross-sectioning, D&P, thermal analysis, and electrical fault isolation. 
 - Supplier quality management experience and knowledge of problem-solving methodologies, including 8D, 5-Why, FMEA, and SPC. 
 - Experience leading supplier corrective actions and root-cause investigations for manufacturing and field-quality issues. 
 - Ability to analyze quality and manufacturing data, identify trends, and drive improvement actions. 
 - Self-motivated, dedicated, and able to work with minimal supervision in a fast-paced environment. 
 - Proficiency in written and spoken English, with excellent communication skills. 

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

- Experience with networking switches, servers, or DataCenter hardware products. 
 - Knowledge of high-speed networking technologies, including Ethernet, switch ASICs, optical modules, and high-speed connectors. 
 - Experience working with CMs, ODMs, PCB suppliers, and electronic component suppliers. 
 - Ability to read and interpret electrical schematics and mechanical drawings. 
 - Familiarity with industry standards and quality practices such as IPC-A-610, JEDEC standards, AQL sampling, and other relevant quality and reliability requirements. 
 - Demonstrated ability to lead complex, cross-functional supplier quality initiatives and drive sustainable improvements. 

With competitive salaries and a generous benefits package, we are widely considered to be one of the technology world's most desirable employers, and we have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us. Due to outstanding growth, our best-in-class teams are rapidly growing, so if you're creative and autonomous with a real passion for technology, we want to hear from you. 

, , JR2023581

What You'll Do

- Provide technical leadership across multiple teams and backend systems, owning the architecture of high-throughput, low-latency services built primarily on Java and Spring Boot. 
 - Drive architecture decisions for distributed systems, including service boundaries, data modelling, storage choices, and scalability, so the platform stays future-proof as volume and complexity grow.

 - Mentor senior and junior engineers through design reviews, code reviews, and pair programming, raising the technical bar and fostering a culture of ownership and continuous learning. 
 - Design and build systems that make effective use of Redis across a range of patterns, such as caching, real-time counters, rate limiting, distributed locking, pub/sub, and streams, alongside other datastores. 
 - Build and evolve event-driven and asynchronous systems using messaging and streaming platforms such as Kafka. 
 - Lead the integration of AI into our products and engineering workflows, including LLM-powered features, agentic workflows, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and tool integrations via the Model Context Protocol (MCP). 
 - Champion AI-assisted software development across the team, setting standards for how engineers use coding agents and AI tools responsibly to improve speed and quality. 
 - Establish and enforce engineering best practices around API design, code quality, testing, security, and data privacy, with healthcare compliance expectations in mind. 
 - Design observability strategies (metrics, logging, tracing, alerting) using tools such as Grafana and Prometheus to proactively identify bottlenecks and ensure production stability. 
 - Lead deep-dive investigations into complex production issues and drive root-cause fixes and blameless postmortems. 
 - Drive knowledge sharing across engineering through technical documentation, design forums, and internal talks. 

Who You Are

- 8+ years of backend engineering experience, with a track record of designing and delivering large-scale distributed systems in production. 
 - Deep expertise in Java (17+) and the Spring ecosystem (Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, Spring Data), including a solid understanding of JVM internals, concurrency, and performance tuning. 
 - Strong working knowledge of Redis, including its data structures, persistence and clustering models, and how to apply it to problems beyond caching, with a clear understanding of its trade-offs at scale. 
 - Solid experience with relational and NoSQL databases (e. g. , MySQL, PostgreSQL, Aerospike, Cassandra or similar), including query optimisation and schema design. 
 - Experience with messaging and streaming systems such as Kafka, and with designing resilient, idempotent, event-driven architectures. 
 - Strong grounding in microservices, REST/gRPC API design, and distributed systems fundamentals (consistency, partitioning, fault tolerance). 
 - Experience with cloud platforms (GCP or AWS), containerisation (Docker, Kubernetes), and owning CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Working knowledge of current AI trends and their practical engineering application: LLM APIs, prompt and context engineering, agentic systems, RAG and vector databases, MCP, and evaluation of AI system quality and reliability. 
 - Hands-on experience using AI coding tools (such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or Cursor) in day-to-day development, with a clear view of where they help and where human judgment is essential. 
 - Proven ability to lead technical work across multiple teams, influence architectural decisions without direct authority, and mentor senior engineers. 
 - Clear communicator who can explain complex technical trade-offs to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Experience in ad tech (programmatic advertising, RTB, DSP/SSP systems) or healthcare data platforms is a plus. 
 - Experience building production LLM features, including guardrails, cost and latency optimisation, and observability for AI workloads, is a plus. 
 - Familiarity with big data processing frameworks such as Spark or Flink is a plus. 
 - Contributions to open-source projects, or experience with technical writing or speaking, are a plus.

data.title: Quality Manager, Quality Assurance
data.description:
Company Description

Medicine moves forward here. So will you. 

Ergomed is a specialist clinical research organization focused on rare disease and select oncology indications. We focus on the most complex trials, the studies where experience, judgement, and rigorous operational accountability make the biggest difference. We partner with small to midsize biotech companies to move promising therapies through early phase development, so they reach the patients sooner. 

We choose complex work on purpose. Rare disease and oncology trials carry real operational risk, and our people are experts at reducing it, protecting timelines, data quality and the experience of sites and patients at the same time. It is demanding, meaningful work, and no one here forgets that patients cannot wait. 

That is why culture matters to us as much as capability. We have built a collaborative, international team where people share ideas, grow their careers and are trusted to take ownership early. With colleagues across North America, South America, Europe, Asia and Australia, we value teamwork, flexibility and a real commitment to work-life balance, because good science comes from people who feel supported. 

If you want work with purpose, the agility to make an impact and a team that cares about the people behind the work as much as the work itself, we would love to hear from you. 

Job Description

The Quality Manager position is key in fostering a culture of quality within the Company organization and acts as an ambassador for the QA department. The Quality Manager, Quality Assurance has an active role in the preparation, maintenance, and execution of the internal and vendor Strategic and Annual Audit Program as well as leading all aspects of the design, implementation and management of internal and vendor audits and corresonding quality risk management activities. Core responsibilities of the Quality Manager are

- Audit Universe
 - Develops and maintains the internal Quality Risk Assessment methodology. 
 - Develops and maintains a comprehensive Audit Universe. 
 - Leads Quality Assurance activities in relation to procurement and vendor oversight. 
 - Develops, maintains, and manages mechanisms that assure ongoing monitoring and compliance with all applicable laws and regulations including but not limited to EU GVP, USFDA CFRs, JMPA and ICH-E6. 
 - Partners closely with Vendor Management and operations teams, driving risk-based and compliant audit strategy. 
 - Auditing and Audit management
 - Coordinates and contributes to internal system and/or vendor audits initiated by the Company, according to the Company Audit Plan, including effective management of pre-audit and post-audit activities. 
 - As required, and within their area of GxP expertise, conducts audits or coordinates audit documentation peer review and quality control activities. 
 - Other
 - For Client contracted services within Quality Assurance area, undertakes activities in relation to the Quality as a Service, such as planning, coordinating or conducting audits, and providing GxP QA consultantcy in line with their expertise and experience. 
 - Monitors compliance within the organization to ensure early identification and review its impact on audit strategy, audit plans and its execution. 
Qualifications

- Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in biomedical sciences, natural sciences, health sciences, or another relevant scientific discipline, or an equivalent combination of advanced education and relevant industry experience
 - Experience: 
 - Experience with both GVP and GCP regulatory requirements, or a willingness to broaden your expertise
 - At least 3 years of direct auditing experience in GCP (e. g. investigational sites, TMFs, Vendors) and / or GVP area (e. g. safety case processing and reporting)
 - At least 2 years of experience in audit program management including the development and maintenance of risk-based audit plans
 - Skills: Organization skills, attention to details, excellent communication and facilitation skills within a global organization, proactive, fluent in English
Additional Information

When you join Ergomed Group, you make a difference by helping to bring safe and effective pharmaceutical treatment to patients around the world. You'll join a passionate and collaborative team of experts in clinical research, pharmacovigilance, and quality consulting. 

We are diverse in many ways, yet our values unite us. Our values are how we work, not words on a wall. If they sound like you, you will feel at home here. 

- Quality: we hold ourselves to the standard patients deserve. 
 - Integrity and trust: we do the right thing, especially when it is hard. 
 - Drive and passion: we care about the outcome, because someone is waiting on it. 
 - Agility and responsiveness: we move quickly, because patients cannot wait. 
 - Belonging: everyone is welcome, and every voice counts. 
 - Collaborative partnerships: we go further by going together. 

We look forward to welcoming your application.

- Strong technical expertise in HVAC&R product/component testing, psychometrics, refrigeration systems, instrumentation, and DAQ

 - Strong knowledge of international testing standards, validation practices, and quality systems

B. Tech in Mechanical engineering with 10+ Years relevant experience in HVAC& R product & component Validation, Operations of Psychrometric Lab, Controlled ambient chambers.

EY is a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services. Technology is at the heart of what we do and deliver at EY. Technology solutions are integrated in the client services we deliver and are key to our innovation as an organization. 

Fueled by strategic investment in technology and innovation, Client Technology seeks to drive growth opportunities and solve complex business problems for our clients through building a robust platform for business and powerful product engine that are vital to innovation at scale. EY Technology: 

Technology has always been at the heart of what we do and deliver at EY. We need technology to keep an organization the size of ours working efficiently. We have 250, 000 people in more than 140 countries, all of whom rely on secure technology to be able to do their job every single day. Where Is The Work

Monday to Thursday, work onsite with your colleagues. Fridays, choose your work location, balancing what your work requires. 

Key Responsibilities

- Collaborate with test requestors, product engineering teams, and other stakeholders to understand test objectives, validation requirements, and success criteria, and to develop test setup concepts, execution plans, and schedules.

 - Review test data for completeness, accuracy, and consistency, and prepare professional test reports that clearly summarize test methods, results, conclusions, risks, and recommendations. 
 - Follow standard operating procedures (SOPs) for test setup, test execution, data collection, and laboratory practices, while ensuring adherence to established standards and processes. 
 - Stay current with applicable international, industry, and internal testing standards, validation practices, and laboratory processes relevant to HVAC and refrigeration products and components.

 - Maintain the integrity of engineering and laboratory systems by reinforcing process discipline, documentation quality, traceability, and the consistent use of standard work. 
 - Promote awareness and implementation of industry standards and best practices, with particular emphasis on technology, safety, and quality in laboratory operations. 
 - Deliver ongoing technical training and knowledge-sharing to technicians, engineers, and the broader engineering community as needed. 
 - Support the operation, maintenance, troubleshooting, and continuous reliability of laboratory infrastructure, including breakdown maintenance, sensor calibration, and DAQ system upkeep. 
 - Troubleshoot HVAC and refrigeration test units, including challenges related to refrigeration system performance, controls, instrumentation, and test setup functionality. 
 - Contribute to safe, efficient, and compliant lab operations while supporting cross-functional project execution and business priorities. 

Key Competencies

- Strong knowledge of HVAC&R product and component testing and validation standards. 
 - Ability to manage psychrometric laboratory operations, testing priorities, and execution schedules. 
 - Strong capability in test data interpretation, engineering judgment, and deriving meaningful conclusions. 
 - Demonstrated commitment to Engineering Process Excellence, documentation rigor, and standard work discipline. 
 - Experience in instrumentation selection, commissioning, and integration with data acquisition systems. 
 - Strong troubleshooting skills in HVAC&R test units, including refrigeration system performance and electrical controls. 
 - Strong technical foundation in thermal calculations, including psychrometric and refrigeration system analysis. 
 - Familiarity with sheet metal structure design and engineering tools such as AutoCAD and/or Pro/E. 
 - Strong project management, planning, and cross-functional coordination skills. 
 - Technical leadership and coaching capability for technicians and engineering teams. 
 - Focus on safety, quality, continuous improvement, and laboratory operational excellence. 

Qualifications

B. Tech Mechanical, 3+ Years of experience in HVAC&R Product Testing.

data.title: Lead Design Engineer – Solar Rooftop
data.description:
Lead Design Engineer - Solar Rooftop  

Job Title: Lead Design Engineer / Solar Engineering Lead (Rooftop PV)

Department: Engineering & Projects (EPC)

Experience Required: 6 - 10+ years (with a strong portfolio in C&I

rooftop projects)

Education Qualification: B. E. / B. Tech or M. Tech in Electrical/Renewable/Civil Engineering

Location: New Delhi (with occasional travel to project sites across India)

Role Overview

The Lead Design Engineer will head the rooftop solar design division from the New Delhi corporate

office. This individual will steer the engineering team, approve complex system designs, and drive

the technical execution of Residential, Commercial, and Industrial (C&I) solar projects. The role

combines technical mastery in PV system sizing, structural/electrical compliance, on-site technical

validation, and team leadership to optimize costs and maximize energy yield. 

Key Responsibilities

● Site Surveys & Engineering Assessments: Lead critical on-site technical surveys and feasibility assessments for complex or high-capacity C&I rooftops; validate physical roof integrity, shading obstructions, and point of grid interconnection. 

● Project Engineering Discussions: Lead strategic technical consultations and engineering alignments with corporate clients, project management consultants (PMCs), structural checkers, and state utility officials. 

● Team Leadership & Quality Assurance: Direct, mentor, and review the output of a team of solar design engineers and CAD drafters. Establish design standards, engineering workflows, and comprehensive review checklists. 

● Advanced System & Structural Design: Oversee and finalize complex electrical layouts including LT/HT panels, net-metering integration, transformer selection, and system protection schemes. Review and sign off on custom Module Mounting Structure (MMS) configurations for atypical roofs. 

● Simulation & Yield Optimization: Approve finalized PVsyst energy yield assessments, PR estimations, shadow analyses, and comprehensive technical-commercial proposals for high-value contracts. 

● Cross-Functional & Vendor Management: Collaborate with the Procurement team to vet, test, and onboard standard components (modules, inverters, structures) and optimize Balance of System (BOS) costs. 

Technical Skills & Software Mastery

Design & Analysis Software: Expert-level command over AutoCAD, PVsyst, HelioScope, SketchUp, and specialized drone mapping or structural modeling software. 

Electrical Infrastructure: In-depth understanding of HT/LT switchgear, protection relays, earthing calculations, and grid-tied/hybrid central and string inverter technologies. 

Regulations & Standards: Thorough knowledge of Indian Electricity Rules, CEA regulations, state-specific net-metering/open-access guidelines, and international safety codes (IEC, IS). 

Desired Leadership Attributes

● Proven Leadership: Demonstrated track record of managing engineering teams and scaling up C&I solar project portfolios. 

● Mobility & Flexibility: Readiness for occasional short-notice travel to project locations across India to conduct critical surveys and resolve on-site engineering challenges. 

● Strategic Value Engineering: Strong focus on cost-reduction strategies, material optimization, and maximizing client ROI without compromising safety or compliance.

data.title: Senior Engineer - Reliability
data.description:
About River

River is a design company building personal transportation for livelihood. We focus on creating multi-utility products for those independently carving their own path. We're building from the ground up, bringing together design, engineering and technology to solve real, everyday problems. Our signature two-wheeler, Indie - The SUV of Scooters, is built to be a dependable companion for getting things done. 

Today, we're 1, 500+ people strong, headquartered in Bengaluru, and have raised our Series C. 

River is backed by leading global automotive OEMs, international tech investors, and top institutional asset managers, including Yamaha Motor, Al-Futtaim Automotive Group, Toyota Ventures, Mitsui & Co. , Marubeni Ventures, Lowercarbon Capital, Maniv Mobility, Elev8 Venture Partners, Claypond Capital, Trucks Venture Capital, 360 ONE Asset, HDFC AMC, Singularity AMC, Anicut Capital, and JIF Capital. 

Key Responsibilities

- Familiar with reliability spec ( ISO, IEC, GM3172, MIL Std etc. )
 - Determine reliability requirements of components and systems to achieve company targets
 - Recommends experiment designs or test methods, prepares samples and reliability test plans and own data collection, analysis & reporting
 - Requires extensive experience in testing of modules and systems, performing statistical analysis of the experimental data, and presenting status updates and reports
 - Recommend new design fixtures and follow up with suppliers to secure the test setup within the deadlines
 - Develop failure modes and effects analysis and fault tree analysis. Advises design engineering on selection, application and test of mechanical, electrical, electronic and electro-mechanical parts & systems
 - Develop standard methods, training's and methodologies and ensure implementation within organization for competence development, share lessons learnt and develop best practice guidelines
 - Participate in the product design process to understand product features, functions and life cycle events to plan for reliability assessment along with DFMEA knowledge
 - Identification, evaluation and prioritization of risks in early project stage/phase
 - Lead failure analysis efforts of test and field failures for root cause identification and implementation using problem solving techniques like 8D, 5WHYs/FRACAS

Ideal Candidate

- Overall 6 to 9 years of experience in Reliability testing & Validation
 - BE/ B. Tech in electrical or mechanical engineering or a related subject
 - Working knowledge of data visualization tools & techniques ( e. g. Reliasoft, Weibull, MS excel etc. )
 - Knowledge of statistical methods used for reliability analysis & design of validation test regimes
 - Weibull analysis, Failure rate, MTTF, MTBF, Reliability & critical parts prediction and minitab software for data visualization and analysis
 - Familiar with the design, operation and environment of automotive electrification
 - Design For Reliability (DFR) techniques
 - Experience in applying Reliability & safety processes and tools e. g. Fault Tree analysis (FTA), Failure Modes Effects & Criticality Analysis (FMECA), failure reporting analysis and corrective action system (FRACAS) along with Reliability block diagrams (RBD)
 - Reliability demonstration Testing, Optimization of Test samples size and Test duration by using various aging laws to define Reliability/Durability Testing, QALT (Quantitative accelerated Life Testing), HALT (Highly Accelerated Life Testing), HASS (Highly Accelerated Stress screening), FEA & Physics of Failure (PoF) techniques
 - Hands-on experience in testing under various loads like Vibration, Thermal, Bumps, Ingress protection, Solar radiation, Flammability etc. 
 - Able to communicate effectively, work flexibility in a multi-disciplinary team and on own initiative

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Software Development Engineer in Test - AI based in India.

In this role, you will go beyond traditional software testing by designing advanced evaluation frameworks for LLMs, AI agents, copilots, and RAG-based applications. Accountabilities

 - Automated AI Validation: Build automated validation pipelines for LLM-generated outputs using structured assertions, semantic scoring, embeddings, and evaluation metrics. Create synthetic and benchmark datasets to validate different AI scenarios. 
 - Agentic Systems Testing: Validate multi-agent orchestration workflows, agent planning and execution, memory retention, context management, tool calling, function calling, and structured outputs. Test MCP (Model Context Protocol) integrations and interoperability. 
 - Prompt and Context Engineering: Contribute to prompt engineering, context engineering, and prompt optimization strategies to improve AI response quality, reliability, and consistency.

 - Experience integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines and working with Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, OCI, or GCP.

 - Experience working in Agile or Scrum environments and collaborating effectively with multidisciplinary engineering teams.
