data.title: Team Lead - R&D
data.description:
ETAP empowers customers to make informed decisions throughout the life cycle of their projects with innovative software solutions for electrical systems. By applying ETAP solutions, customers experience continuous intelligence during design and engineering and into operations and maintenance using a unified electrical digital twin platform. ETAP supports customers in their digital transformation and sustainable energy transitions for a green and smart future, helping them to prioritize safety, maximize reliability, and stay resilient. 

Our employees' passion for excellence, innovation, and customer satisfaction is our most-prized resource. If you share that passion - and want to be part of a company that leads the energy transition towards a cleaner and more resilient world for future generations - we invite you to join us!

ETAP is committed to creating a diverse work environment and is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. 

ETAP

Job Description

Job Title: Team Lead - R&D

Location: Delhi, India

Employment Type: Full-time

The job

We are looking for an R&D Technical Lead to lead software development and R&D activities for ETAP Real-Time products. The role focuses on SCADA, ADMS, real-time power-system applications, communication protocols, product testing, and engineering solutions. You will work closely with global R&D, Product Management, QA/Testing, and Project Engineering teams to develop innovative solutions, improve product quality, and address evolving market and customer requirements. This position will contribute to strengthening ETAP's local R&D capabilities in India and supporting software localization and innovation initiatives. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead and coordinate R&D and product development activities, providing technical guidance, reviewing solutions, mentoring developers, and resolving technical challenges. 
 - Coordinate verification and validation (V&V), functional, integration, and regression testing, ensuring defects and Incident Reports (IRs) are investigated, tracked, and resolved. 
 - Manage development tasks, testing activities, defects, and priorities in Jira, monitor progress against timelines, and communicate risks, blockers, and dependencies. 
 - Evaluate new technologies, communication protocols, and market requirements; develop proofs of concept (PoCs) and contribute to product performance, reliability, scalability, and usability improvements. 
 - Collaborate with global R&D, Product Management, QA/Testing, and Project Engineering teams on technical reviews, release planning, product demonstrations, troubleshooting, and technical documentation. 

Essential Requirements

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Instrumentation, or a related technical field. 
 - Typically 3-6 years of relevant experience in software development, R&D, or engineering software, preferably involving SCADA, real-time systems, industrial automation, or power-system applications. 
 - Strong programming knowledge in C#, . NET, or . NET Framework; experience with software design, debugging, performance analysis, and system integration. 
 - Working knowledge of databases and development tools, including SQL, PostgreSQL or SQL Server, REST APIs, Git, and Visual Studio. 
 - Experience coordinating technical activities or guiding development teams, with good problem-solving, planning, communication, and team coordination skills. 

Desired Skills And Competencies

- Knowledge of SCADA, EMS, DMS, OMS, ADMS, FEP, FLISR, real-time monitoring, HMI, alarms, events, trends, and historical data. 
 - Familiarity with industrial communication protocols such as OPC UA/DA, IEC 60870-5-104, DNP3, Modbus, and IEC 61850, along with power-system operation and protection fundamentals. 
 - Experience with V&V, product testing, Jira and Incident Report management, troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, and release coordination; knowledge of C++, Java, Python, Node. js, MongoDB, or AI/ML concepts is an advantage. 
 - Demonstrates technical leadership, curiosity, and a continuous-improvement mindset, with a strong focus on innovation, customer impact, accountability, and collaboration across local and global teams. 

ETAP requires all successful applicants to undergo and pass a comprehensive background check before they start employment. Background checks will be conducted in accordance with local laws and may, subject to those laws, include proof of educational attainment, employment history verification, proof of work authorization, criminal records, identity verification, credit check. Certain positions dealing with sensitive and/or third party personal data may involve additional background check criteria. 

ETAP is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to being an exemplary employer with an inclusive culture, developing a workplace environment where all our employees are treated with dignity and respect. We value diversity and the expertise that people from different backgrounds bring to our business. 

Come and join ETAP to create the transformative technology that enables our customers to engineer a better world.

- Be involved in the industrialization of new projects (before end phase 2), FPDRs and SOPs and facilitate by his / her actions proper start ups.

data.title: Engineering Manager - Quality
data.description:
INSPIRE | EXHILARATE | DELIGHT

For over seven decades, Chalhoub Group has been a partner and creator of luxury experiences in the Middle East. In its pursuit to excel as a hybrid luxury retailer, the Group has curated a portfolio of over 10 owned brands and strengthened its distribution and marketing expertise for over 400 international names across luxury fashion, beauty, jewellery, watches, eyewear, and art de vivre categories. 

Every step at Chalhoub Group is taken to build a future where luxury dreams become reality - bridging cultures and crafting memorable experiences for our consumers. Be it by constantly reinventing itself, committing to innovation, or embracing new technologies, the Group is shaping the future of luxury retail. It delivers seamless omnichannel experiences across more than 950 stores, online platforms, and mobile apps. Driving this innovation journey is The Greenhouse - the Group's innovation hub, incubator, and accelerator for startups and emerging businesses, regionally and globally. 

Chalhoub Group fosters a people-at-heart culture rooted in diversity, equity, and inclusion, and a workplace catalysed by forward thinking and future-proofing. Today, it brings together over 16, 000 talented professionals across eight countries in the Middle East, with a presence in LATAM. 

Sustainability is at the core of the Group's strategy, guided by a clear commitment to people, partners, and the planet. Chalhoub Group is proud to be a member of the United Nations Global Compact, a signatory of the Women's Empowerment Principles, and to have pledged to reach Net Zero by 2040. 

What You'll Be Doing

Own the Quality Governance capability, defining enterprise quality standards, managing release quality gates, and tracking defect metrics to continuously improve delivery quality across engineering teams. 

- Define and own enterprise quality standards and QA methodologies across engineering teams, ensuring consistent, high-quality delivery. 
 - Manage release quality gates, governing entry and exit criteria so releases meet defined quality and business requirements before go-live. 
 - Track and analyze defect metrics and quality analytics using tools such as TestRail to identify trends and drive continuous improvement. 
 - Own release management from a quality perspective, ensuring quality sign-off and release readiness across releases. 
 - Own UAT readiness, quality sign-off, and post-release defect triage for major launches, ensuring business and technical stakeholders have clear entry and exit criteria. 
 - Lead and develop the QA team, set technical direction, mentoring engineers, and building QA capability. 
 - Report quality posture, release risk, and defect trends to engineering leadership through concise dashboards and agreed improvement actions. 
 - Partner with engineering and product teams to embed quality practices early in the SDLC and report on quality posture to leadership. 
 - Drive continuous improvement of QA processes, incorporating AI-assisted defect analytics and predictive quality insights to prioritize testing effort. 
 - Plan, design, execute, and document functional, integration, end-to-end, and regression testing for assigned scope. 

What You'll Need To Succeed

- 10+ years of hands-on experience in quality engineering and QA, including defining quality standards and managing release quality gates. 
 - Strong command of QA standards, QA methodologies, release management, and defect analytics, with hands-on experience using tools such as TestRail. 
 - Proven experience leading or mentoring QA engineers and driving continuous improvement in delivery quality. 
 - Understanding quality metrics and reporting to support data-driven quality decisions. 
 - Experience supporting quality governance in ecommerce or retail technology environments with complex integrations, releases, and business cutovers
 - Familiarity with AI-assisted defect analytics and predictive quality insights to enhance testing effectiveness. 
 - Experience with organizing testing for multiple integrated systems

What We Can Offer You

With us, you will turn your aspirations into reality. We will help shape your journey through enriching experiences, learning and development opportunities and exposure to different assignments within your role or through internal mobility. Our Group offers diverse career paths for those who are extraordinary, every day. 

We recognise the value that you bring, and we strive to provide a competitive benefits package which includes health care, child education contribution, remote and flexible working policies as well as exclusive employee discounts. 

Using GenAI in Your Application Process

To support a fair and consistent experience for all candidates, we ask that assessments and interviews are completed independently and without assistance from generative AI tools. This ensures we understand your strengths, your thinking, and how you approach real situations. 

We Invite All Applicants to Apply

It Takes Diversity Of Thought, Culture, Background, Differing Abilities and Perspectives to truly Inspire, Exhilarate and Delight our customers. At Chalhoub Group, we are committed to inclusion and diversity. 

We welcome all applicants to apply and be part of our exciting future. We ensure equal opportunity for all our applicants without regard to gender, age, race, religion, national origin or disability status.

data.title: Lead, Tech (Trading Systems)
data.company: D. E. Shaw India Private Limited
data.description:
The D. E. Shaw group is a global investment and technology development firm with more than $115 billion in investment capital as of September 1, 2026, and offices in North America, Europe, and Asia. Since our founding in 1988, our firm has earned an international reputation for successful investing based on innovation, careful risk management, and the quality and depth of our staff. We have a significant presence in the world's capital markets, investing in a wide range of companies and financial instruments in both developed and developing economies. 

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join our Trading Systems team at our firm's offices in Bengaluru, Hyderabad, or Gurugram. The team builds and maintains critical infrastructure supporting the firm's trading applications, including an in-house messaging middleware platform that delivers latency in the tens of microseconds while processing hundreds of thousands of messages per second, and a firmwide monitoring and alerting framework for front-office technology applications and systems. In this senior individual contributor role, you will serve as the technical authority for both platforms, driving architectural direction, developing performance-critical code, and ensuring their reliability and scalability across trading teams. 

WHAT YOU'LL DO DAY-TO-DAY: 

In this role, you will design, develop, and optimize high-performance systems using Java, with Python and C++ for client libraries and tooling. You will drive architectural decisions involving scalability, sharding, fault tolerance, durability, failover, and real-time data streaming while diagnosing complex production issues related to memory leaks, network connections, message delivery, latency, and alerting. You will also lead critical production changes, releases, disaster recovery exercises, and operational readiness initiatives while minimizing trading impact. Additionally, you will collaborate with trading, feeds, and infrastructure teams to understand requirements, support platform adoption, and resolve technical escalations. You will contribute to engineering excellence through code and design reviews, improved test coverage, mentoring engineers, and developing tools to enhance observability and production diagnostics. 

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR: 

The ideal candidate should hold-

Basic qualifications: 

- 5 - 6. 5 years of hands-on software engineering experience, with demonstrated ownership of production systems
 - Excellent computer science fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, operating systems, networking, concurrency, and memory management, with the ability to reason about system performance
 - Expertise in at least one programming language, preferably Java, with an exceptional understanding of JVM internals, garbage collection, and multithreading
 - Experience designing distributed, fault-tolerant, low-latency, or high-throughput systems, with excellent high-level and low-level design skills
 - Exceptional analytical and problem-solving abilities, with experience diagnosing complex production issues and driving them to resolution
 - Sound technical judgment, attention to detail, and the ability to balance system performance, reliability, and operational risk
 - Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across teams and influence technical decisions

Preferred qualifications: 

- Experience with distributed messaging middleware or event-streaming systems
 - Familiarity with monitoring and observability frameworks, including metrics, tracing, dashboards, and alerting
 - Programming experience in Python or C++
 - Experience developing LLM-based or agentic tools and automation frameworks

Interested candidates can apply through our website: https: //www. deshawindia. com/recruit/jobs/Ads/Link/LeadTradingSysNov26

We encourage candidates with relevant experience looking to restart their careers after a break to apply for this position. Learn about Recommence, our gender-neutral return-to-work initiative. 

The Firm offers excellent benefits, a casual, collegial working environment, and an attractive compensation package. For further information about our recruitment process, including how applicant data will be processed, please visit https: //www. deshawindia. com/careers

Members of the D. E. Shaw group do not discriminate in employment matters on the basis of sex, race, colour, caste, creed, religion, pregnancy, national origin, age, military service eligibility, veteran status, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, or any other protected class.

Your role

As a Senior Embedded Test Engineer at Atlas Copco Group, you will play a critical role in ensuring the quality and reliability of embedded software across a range of advanced industrial products. Your responsibilities include comprehensive verification of embedded software through manual and automated testing, collaboration with cross-disciplinary engineering teams to refine requirements, and the development of Python-based automation to expand regression coverage and enhance testing efficiency. 

You will be embedded within a multidisciplinary team responsible for cutting-edge products such as PLC controllers utilizing CODESYS and Straton, vacuum pump controllers, industrial communication modules, and EtherCAT-based devices. This role demands hands-on expertise in setting up and executing functional, integration, and system tests, managing test artifacts within tools such as Jira Xray, and advancing automated testing frameworks integrated with continuous integration pipelines like TeamCity and Jenkins. 

Your day-to-day tasks will also include thorough analysis of test failures through logs and system behavior observations, defect tracking and retesting, and contributing to the continuous improvement of QA practices and automation tools. You will provide technical guidance and mentorship to peers, influencing quality standards and methodologies across projects. 

Technical and Product Environment

You will work with embedded operating systems, network stacks, industrial communication protocols (such as Modbus, EtherNet/IP, EtherCAT, CANopen), hardware interfaces, and automated test systems. This environment balances both legacy and modern technologies, providing a stimulating setting for innovation and technical growth. 

Key Responsibilities

- Collaborate with product owners and developers during sprint planning to ensure test coverage aligns with acceptance criteria. 
 - Create, maintain, and execute detailed test plans and cases, both manual and automated, ensuring traceability to requirements. 
 - Develop and enhance Python-based automation frameworks and scripts to increase regression test efficiency and reliability. 
 - Perform embedded system testing on physical hardware and hardware simulators, including hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) testing. 
 - Analyze, document, and report identified defects, facilitating resolution through close cooperation with the development team. 
 - Integrate automated tests into continuous integration workflows to provide rapid feedback on software quality. 
 - Provide technical leadership in QA best practices, contributing to process improvements, and coaching junior QA engineers. 
 - Maintain detailed test documentation and contribute to project documentation to support compliance and audit requirements. 

To succeed, you will need

- Minimum five years of experience in software testing, with proven expertise in embedded systems and Python automation. 
 - Strong capability in defining and executing functional, integration, and regression test suites based on user requirements. 
 - Experience with test management tools such as Jira Xray, defect tracking, and continuous integration systems like TeamCity or Jenkins. 
 - Ability to independently lead QA activities, prioritize tasks effectively, and provide technical mentorship. 
 - Familiarity with embedded hardware, communication protocols, and debugging methodologies. 

In return, we offer

- Join a prestigious global industrial leader with a legacy spanning over 150 years, committed to innovation and excellence.

 - Engage in challenging projects developing next-generation embedded systems using advanced technology.

 - Benefit from a workplace culture that emphasizes mutual care, sustainability, and social responsibility. 
 - Enjoy a competitive total rewards program, including comprehensive insurance coverage, educational support, and flexible working arrangements to promote work-life balance.

data.description:
Company Overview

Docusign brings agreements to life. Over 1. 5 million customers and more than a billion people in over 180 countries use Docusign solutions to accelerate the process of doing business and simplify people's lives. With intelligent agreement management, Docusign unleashes business-critical data that is trapped inside of documents. Until now, these were disconnected from business systems of record, costing businesses time, money, and opportunity. Using Docusign's Intelligent Agreement Management platform, companies can create, commit, and manage agreements with solutions created by the #1 company in e-signature and contract lifecycle management (CLM). 

What you'll do

We are seeking a skilled and independent Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) at the P3 (Career) level to join our Quality Engineering team in Bengaluru. In this role, you will design, develop, and maintain scalable test automation frameworks across enterprise SaaS platforms - including Salesforce, Oracle ERP, MuleSoft integrations, and UiPath workflow automation - ensuring the highest levels of product quality across the end-to-end digital and direct customer journey. A critical differentiator of this role is your ability to independently apply AI testing methodologies - including LLM evaluation, prompt testing, hallucination detection, and AI-assisted STLC practices - to ensure quality for both traditional and AI-powered product features. You will leverage Docusign's internal AI quality tooling (including the Quality Agent powered by CrewAI) and evaluator frameworks (such as Arize AX) to accelerate test delivery and improve coverage consistency. 

This is an individual contributor role reporting to the Senior Manager, SDET. 

Responsibility

- Design, develop, and maintain scalable and reusable test automation frameworks for enterprise applications across Salesforce Sales, Service & Experience Clouds, Oracle ERP, and MuleSoft integrations
 - Independently own test coverage across multiple product components including UI, API, backend, data validation, integration, and regression testing
 - Develop and execute comprehensive test plans, test cases, and test scripts for end-to-end business flows aligned to acceptance criteria
 - Drive shift-left quality practices by partnering with developers and platform architects early in the SDLC to identify testability gaps and integrate quality into design
 - Own test coverage metrics, dashboarding, and quality reporting to leadership
 - Perform exploratory, functional, SIT, regression, and UAT testing for critical releases; support production smoke testing and hypercare post go-live
 - Identify requirement gaps, provide robust edge cases and error-handling scenarios beyond documented functionality, and contribute to continuous quality improvemen
 - Apply Docusign's AI testing framework to evaluate LLM-powered features and agentic AI workflows (e. g. , Quality Agent, XDR Agents, Leads Agent)
 - Design and execute prompt test suites to validate LLM output accuracy, consistency, tone, and alignment with expected outcomes across diverse input scenarios
 - Conduct hallucination detection and post-processing fact-checking for LLM-generated content; validate that AI outputs are grounded in retrieved context
 - Validate training/validation datasets for missing values, data leakage, class imbalance, duplicates, and biased sampling
 - Execute model quality testing using metrics such as accuracy, precision/recall, F1, ROC-AUC, and regression error (MAE/RMSE) as applicable to the model type
 - Verify model behavior under noisy, incomplete, adversarial, or out-of-distribution inputs
 - Validate prompt-injection resistance, jailbreak detection, harmful/toxic content filtering, and secure handling of sensitive data and PII
 - Implement AI evaluator frameworks using tools such as Arize AX for offline evaluation (datasets, experiments) and online testing (tracing, drift monitoring, confidence scoring)
 - Track hallucination rates, latency variability, token cost, and model confidence thresholds in collaboration with MLOps teams
 - Apply human-in-the-loop (HITL) evaluation practices to systematically assess AI output quality - helpfulness, correctness, compliance - where automated metrics are insufficient
 - Leverage Docusign's internal Quality Agent (CrewAI-powered, Azure OpenAI-backed) to accelerate test case generation from Jira user stories, reducing manual effort and improving STLC throughput
 - Test retrieval relevance, semantic search accuracy (Azure AI Search), context window utilization, and end-to-end response quality for RAG-based AI features
 - Build and maintain robust, reusable automation suites for functional, regression, integration, performance, and data validation testing
 - Automate end-to-end business flows using UiPath or equivalent low-code/RPA automation platforms; build solutions that reduce manual effort for repetitive processes
 - Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI or equivalent) to support rapid, reliable releases and continuous quality gates

data.title: Supervisor III, Applications Development
data.description:
The Opportunity

Oversees day-to-day operational objectives through the supervision of a team of application development engineers, ensuring efficient software build, release, deployment, and configuration management. Sets objectives that directly impact operational plans, contributing to the implementation of new applications, deployment frameworks, automation processes, and software quality standards. Evaluates and refines work methods, recommending enhancements to improve software implementation effectiveness, deployment efficiency, and system stability. Works on technical challenges that require data analysis, troubleshooting, and strategic consideration of infrastructure dependencies. Communicates regularly with internal teams, including QA, IT, and cloud operations, to align release strategies with organizational priorities. Engages external partners, vendors, and stakeholders to ensure smooth coordination in deployment efforts and software updates. 

About The Role

We are converting this position from contract to full-time. Sanjay built the automation layer that now vets every release. We need someone who owns the quality strategy, manages a small team of test engineers, and keeps our AI-driven test infrastructure running as product demands grow. 

You will report to the Senior QA Manager, Development team. You will work with product, platform, and DevOps teams. You decide what "good enough to ship" means for our applications; you build the systems that prove it. 

What You'll Own

Automation architecture. Design and maintain test frameworks on the Appvance AI Quality Platform. You decide how tests get structured, how data flows through them, and where they plug into our release pipeline. 

- Team management. Directly manage 2-4 test automation engineers. Set their weekly priorities. Review their pull requests. Run 1: 1s. Write their annual performance reviews. You decide who takes which feature area. You decide whether their work meets our standards before it merges. 
 - AI application testing. Build test suites that validate LLM-based features. Test prompt regression. Verify RAG workflows. Detect hallucinations. Validate agent behavior. Use LangChain and LangSmith. 
 - Scripting and tooling. Write and review Appvance Designer Scripts. Write JavaScript/TypeScript code. Build API test suites for REST and GraphQL. You set the coding standards others follow. 
 - CI/CD integration. Wire tests into GitHub Actions, Jenkins, and AWS deployments. When a build fails, your tests tell us why within minutes. 
 - Cross-platform coverage. Ensure web, mobile, desktop, and API layers each have appropriate automated coverage. Cover functional, regression, smoke, integration, end-to-end, security, performance, and database scenarios. 
 - Quality metrics. Track failure rates, flakiness, coverage gaps, and release-blocking defects. Present these to leadership in plain language. 
 - Hiring and growth. Interview candidates for automation roles. Write growth plans for your reports. Push them toward harder problems. Do not let them stay comfortable. 
 - Incident support. Join production release calls. Respond to critical incidents when automation uncovers-or misses-something that hits customers. 

What You've Done Before

- 2-3 years hands-on with the Appvance AI Quality Platform, including Appvance Designer Scripting. 
 - You write clean JavaScript ES6+ and TypeScript. You read production-grade code and you write it. 
 - You tested AI-powered applications with LangChain and LangSmith. You validated prompts. You checked response accuracy. You verified RAG pipelines. 
 - You built or maintained test frameworks for UI, API, database, and cross-browser scenarios. 
 - You integrated test suites into Git, GitHub, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, AWS, and CI/CD workflows. 
 - You worked with SQL (MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQL Server) and NoSQL (MongoDB) data stores. 
 - You know REST APIs, GraphQL, JSON/XML, OAuth 2. 0, JWT. 
 - You worked in Agile/Scrum. You know SDLC, STLC, and defect lifecycle. 
 - You managed or mentored at least one other engineer, even informally. 
 - Bachelor's or master's in CS, IT, or equivalent. 

How You Work

- You debug like a detective. When a test fails, you do not re-run it and hope. You trace the failure to its source. 
 - You write code others can read. Your scripts have clear structure. You comment where needed. Your naming stays consistent. 
 - You communicate across roles. You explain a flaky test to a product manager. You explain a coverage gap to a director. 
 - You care about shipping speed. You know the difference between a test that catches real bugs and a test that slows releases but adds no value. 
 - You give direct feedback. Your reports know where they stand because you tell them. 

Work Environment

- Hybrid, following our Coimbatore office policy. 
 - Primarily computer-based work. 
 - Availability for production releases and critical incidents as needed. 

Disclaimer

Technical Lead - Software: 

Build software that powers semiconductor manufacturing. 

We're looking for a Technical Lead who enjoys solving complex business and engineering problems, not just writing code. 

You will build software that drives semiconductor manufacturing automation, working closely with product teams, domain experts, customers, and engineers to deliver meaningful operational impact. 

This role is for someone who combines strong software engineering fundamentals with sound technical judgement. Someone who can move comfortably across different layers of the system, understand the underlying business problem, and make pragmatic technology decisions that stand the test of time. 

If you're excited by learning how the business works, challenging assumptions, simplifying complexity, and building high-quality systems end-to-end, we'd love to talk to you. 

What You'll Do

- Lead the design and development of scalable, reliable software solutions for semiconductor manufacturing automation. 
 - Drive architecture and technical direction across services, making pragmatic technology choices based on scalability, reliability, simplicity, and maintainability. 
 - Work across the stack when needed, including frontend, backend, databases, messaging, infrastructure, Kubernetes configurations, agentic/AI-powered systems, and helm charts. 
 - Partner with product managers, customers, and domain experts to understand semiconductor manufacturing workflows and translate operational challenges into effective software solutions. 
 - Deliver solutions that improve manufacturing outcomes such as productivity, quality, throughput, automation, and operational efficiency. 
 - Mentor engineers through technical coaching, design reviews, and code reviews. 
 - Improve system reliability, observability, performance, and operational excellence. 
 - Influence product direction through technical judgement and growing domain expertise. 

What We're Looking For

Core engineering capabilities

- 8+ years of software engineering experience building and operating production-grade systems. 
 - Strong foundations in software design, distributed systems, data structures, algorithms, and system architecture. 
 - Strong experience designing and building backend services using technologies such as Python, TypeScript, NestJS, or similar. 
 - Experience developing modern web applications using frameworks such as React or Angular. 
 - Experience selecting and working with relational and NoSQL databases based on application needs. 
 - Experience in data science, machine learning, reinforcement learning related projects
 - Experience designing event-driven architectures and message-based systems. 
 - Experience deploying, operating, and troubleshooting applications on Kubernetes. 
 - Experience developing software for complex operational environments such as manufacturing automation, factory operations, industrial engineering, engineering workflows, or productivity platforms is a plus. 
 - Exposure to AI, machine learning, agentic systems, analytics, optimization, or simulation-based software solutions is a plus. 

More importantly. . . 

We value engineering judgement over experience with any specific technology. 

You should be able to: 

- Select the right tool for the problem rather than forcing a favorite technology. 
 - Challenge complexity and simplify architectures where possible. 
 - Balance short-term delivery needs with long-term maintainability. 
 - Understand trade-offs and make pragmatic engineering decisions. 
 - Learn unfamiliar domains quickly and apply that understanding to product decisions. 

You'll thrive here if you. . . 

- Are curious about how products create business value. 
 - Enjoy learning domain knowledge, not just technology. 
 - Take ownership beyond your immediate component or service. 
 - Can zoom out from implementation details and think at a system level. 
 - Care deeply about software quality, reliability, and customer outcomes. 
 - Prefer solving hard problems over working within narrowly defined boundaries. 

What Success Looks Like

- You become a trusted technical leader across the team. 
 - Your architectural decisions improve product scalability and maintainability. 
 - Engineers seek your input on complex technical challenges. 
 - You influence both technical and product decisions. 
 - You develop enough semiconductor manufacturing knowledge to help shape solutions, not just implement requirements.

data.description:
Who We Are

Applied Materials is the global leader in materials science and engineering solutions that are at the foundation of virtually every new semiconductor chip and advanced display in the world. The equipment that we create and service is essential to advancing AI and accelerating the commercialization of next-generation semiconductor chips. Join us and push the boundaries of materials science and engineering in a company at the foundation of the electronics industry. The work we do together advances the world's technology. 

What We Offer

Location: 

Bangalore, IND

You'll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible-while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more. 

At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We're committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits. 

As a Software Engineer at Applied Materials, you'll dive deep into ground-breaking technologies-like machine learning and AI-to craft novel software solutions that solve our customers' high-value problems. Our Software Engineers are responsible for designing, prototyping, developing, and debugging software solutions for semiconductor equipment components and devices to ensure quality and functionality. You'll develop software documentation and test procedures, troubleshoot software problems, and communicate with internal customers to understand project requirements. As part of our team, you'll contribute your expertise in intricate systems, deciphering code, and anticipating software behaviors to ensure Applied remains the leader in the semiconductor and display sectors. 

Our Team

The YTG group develops, builds, and ships advanced test systems for the display and packaging industry. These systems leverage high-speed electron beam microscopes and custom electronics to acquire signals and images, enabling complex data analysis and image processing to detect defects in memory and processor chips. The software team controls the electron beam and acquires/processes data and images, collaborating across Germany and India. 

Your Opportunity

Join us to shape the next generation of our products by driving end-to-end solutions that span software and hardware. You'll collaborate with experts in Germany and cross-functional teams in Bangalore to deliver customer-focused outcomes, accelerate time-to-market, and uplift engineering efficiency. 

Roles and Responsibilities

- Systems & Architecture Ownership: Lead design discussions and produce architecture artifacts for modules spanning software + hardware interfaces (device I/O, data acquisition, algorithms, GUI/UX). 
 - Hands-on Engineering (C++/Python on Linux): Implement performant, maintainable components and services; define clear interfaces/contracts; contribute to reviews and refactoring. 
 - Build/Run & DevOps Collaboration: Partner with DevOps on CI/CD, artifact hygiene, and observability (logging/metrics/tracing); contribute to reliability. 
 - Performance & Reliability: Design for resilience and rollback; strengthen test strategies (unit/integration/system). 
 - Cross-geo Collaboration: Work closely with engineering counterparts across globe. 

Our Ideal Candidate

- Solution-First Mindset: Think beyond programming languages-own the customer problem and the end-to-end solution across software, hardware, and operations. 
 - Strong Systems Design: Experience designing systems that integrate software + hardware (sensors, motion/controls, device drivers, embedded/RT interactions). 
 - AI-Assisted Development: Comfortable using AI-assisted developer tooling and prompt-based workflows to accelerate design documentation, code scaffolding/refactoring, test generation, and troubleshooting-while verifying outputs and following responsible-use guidelines. 
 - DevOps & Computing Curiosity: Keen to engage with CI/CD, artifact management, containerized build environments, and performance/compute trade-offs. 
 - Collaboration & Communication: Clear communicator who aligns cross-functional stakeholders and documents decisions effectively. 

Qualifications

Education: B. Tech/M. Tech in Computer Science, Electronics, or related fields. 

Experience: Typically, 14-18 years in relevant roles (exceptional candidates outside this range welcome with demonstrated system design depth). 

- Proficiency in C++ (modern standards) and Python on Linux. 
 - Experience with system design and integration across software + hardware platforms. 
 - Familiarity with build tools (e. g. , CMake/Make) and toolchains (gcc/clang); strong debugging/profiling on Linux. 
 - Exposure to testing frameworks and code quality practices (unit/integration, static analysis, formatting/linting). 

Domain Plus: Background in semiconductor is a strong advantage. 

Additional Qualifications (Nice To Have)

- Experience with Qt for GUI/controls. 
 - Exposure to real-time/embedded OS and multi-processor systems. 

Location & Travel

Primary location: Bangalore, India

Skills Matrix

Must-Have

- C++ (modern) and Python on Linux
 - Systems design across software + hardware
 - Linux build & toolchains (CMake/Make, gcc/clang)
 - Testing & code quality practices
 - AI-assisted development (prompt-led, responsible use)

Nice-to-Have

- Qt GUI/controls
 - Real-time/embedded OS experience
 - DevOps collaboration (CI/CD, observability)

 - Support Database Platform Engineering in the development and deployment of NoSQL technologies like Redis, MongoDB and Cassandra in high SLA environments. Support of RDBMS technology will be a plus. This includes, but is not limited to implementation of the following:

Qualifications

About The Role

You will report to the Senior QA Manager, Development team. You will work with product, platform, and DevOps teams. You decide what "good enough to ship" means for our applications; you build the systems that prove it.

Automation architecture. Design and maintain test frameworks on the Appvance AI Quality Platform. You decide how tests get structured, how data flows through them, and where they plug into our release pipeline. 

- Team management. Directly manage 2-4 test automation engineers. Set their weekly priorities. Review their pull requests. Run 1: 1s. Write their annual performance reviews. You decide who takes which feature area. You decide whether their work meets our standards before it merges. 
 - AI application testing. Build test suites that validate LLM-based features. Test prompt regression. Verify RAG workflows. Detect hallucinations. Validate agent behavior. Use LangChain and LangSmith. 
 - Scripting and tooling. Write and review Appvance Designer Scripts. Write JavaScript/TypeScript code. Build API test suites for REST and GraphQL. You set the coding standards others follow. 
 - CI/CD integration. Wire tests into GitHub Actions, Jenkins, and AWS deployments. When a build fails, your tests tell us why within minutes. 
 - Cross-platform coverage. Ensure web, mobile, desktop, and API layers each have appropriate automated coverage. Cover functional, regression, smoke, integration, end-to-end, security, performance, and database scenarios. 
 - Quality metrics. Track failure rates, flakiness, coverage gaps, and release-blocking defects. Present these to leadership in plain language. 
 - Hiring and growth. Interview candidates for automation roles. Write growth plans for your reports. Push them toward harder problems. Do not let them stay comfortable. 
 - Incident support. Join production release calls. Respond to critical incidents when automation uncovers-or misses-something that hits customers. 

What You've Done Before

- 2-3 years hands-on with the Appvance AI Quality Platform, including Appvance Designer Scripting. 
 - You write clean JavaScript ES6+ and TypeScript. You read production-grade code and you write it. 
 - You tested AI-powered applications with LangChain and LangSmith. You validated prompts. You checked response accuracy. You verified RAG pipelines. 
 - You built or maintained test frameworks for UI, API, database, and cross-browser scenarios. 
 - You integrated test suites into Git, GitHub, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, AWS, and CI/CD workflows. 
 - You worked with SQL (MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQL Server) and NoSQL (MongoDB) data stores. 
 - You know REST APIs, GraphQL, JSON/XML, OAuth 2. 0, JWT. 
 - You worked in Agile/Scrum. You know SDLC, STLC, and defect lifecycle. 
 - You managed or mentored at least one other engineer, even informally. 
 - Bachelor's or master's in CS, IT, or equivalent. 

How You Work

- You debug like a detective. When a test fails, you do not re-run it and hope. You trace the failure to its source. 
 - You write code others can read. Your scripts have clear structure. You comment where needed. Your naming stays consistent. 
 - You communicate across roles. You explain a flaky test to a product manager. You explain a coverage gap to a director. 
 - You care about shipping speed. You know the difference between a test that catches real bugs and a test that slows releases but adds no value. 
 - You give direct feedback. Your reports know where they stand because you tell them. 

Work Environment

- Hybrid, following our Coimbatore office policy. 
 - Primarily computer-based work. 
 - Availability for production releases and critical incidents as needed.

data.title: Assistant Manager - Profee Quality
data.description:
Job Family

Coding Quality OP (India)

Travel Required

Up to 25%

Clearance Required

None

What You Will Do

- Plans, monitors, direct and evaluate QA production on a daily basis. Ensures that daily schedules are met and communicates with Director, and Coding Operations if situations occur that hinder meeting deadlines. If system issues or other emergencies delay QA, an implement measures/schedules to return to established schedules at the earliest possible time. This should be done closely with each quality specialist to ensure the needs are met and that satisfy our client requirements. 
 - Responsible for ensuring that the QA communicates a valid, workable schedule for his or her client each week. Accurate, sensible & on-time. **If this doesn't happen properly, it's the responsibility of the Lead QA Specialist to make it happen promptly. 
 - Review medical record documentation for accuracy in code assignment of the primary/secondary diagnosis and procedures using ICD-9-CM and CPT-4 coding conventions. Sequence the diagnosis and procedures using coding guidelines. When applicable, ensure MS-DRG/APC assignment is accurate. Abstract and compile data from medical records for appropriate optimal/complaint reimbursement for hospital and/or professional charges. This involves reviewing code assignments that are not straightforward or the documentation in the record is inadequate, ambiguous, or unclear for coding purposes. 
 - Answers queries from the quality staff on a day to day basis and escalating to the Director of Coding as necessary. 
 - Meets agreed sampling targets and accuracy. 
 - Keeps abreast of coding guidelines and reimbursement reporting requirements. 
 - Documents QA data on teams of QA/coders and records findings in the QA system (Guide Audit), which will be for reporting to the client, identifying risk areas, development of training and education programs and development/implementation of standardization within the organization. This also involves guidance and mentorship of coders. 
 - Helps to ensure that continuing education is planned, scheduled and completed for all coding/QA teams through the coordination of the US. 
 - Coordinates scheduled quality meetings with the QA and production staff. 
 - Brings identified concerns to Guidehouse's coding compliance management for discussion. 
 - Project Launch - Active involvement in project launch sessions along with team leaders to understand the coding process. 
 - Have a rotational arrangement and is flexible to work with any given team as assigned. 
 - Abides by the Standards of Ethical Coding as set forth by the American Health Information Management Association and adheres to official coding guidelines. -
 - Maintain a thorough understanding of anatomy and physiology, medical terminology, disease processes and surgical techniques to effectively apply ICD-9-CM and CPT-4 coding guidelines to inpatient and outpatient diagnoses and procedures. 
 - Assist with research and development and presentation of continuing education programs on areas of specialization. 
 - Assist with special projects as required. Example: Focused audits; client launches, etc. 
 - Shall understand and abide by the organizations' information security policy and protect the confidentiality, integrity and availability of all information assets. 
 - Shall report incidents related to security of information to concerned authorities. 

What You Will Need

- Key Skills: Medical Coding 
 - Exp. Level: 8+years
 - Qualifications: Accredited medical coders (CCA, CCS, CPC, CPC-H) with at least 6+ years' experience. 
 - Ensure data collection capability in relevant systems and business processes
 - Strong analytical, research, and organizational skills required. 
 - ICD-10-PCS coding systems, ensuring accuracy and compliance with all regulatory and reimbursement requirements

What Would Be Nice To Have

- Superior problem-solving abilities
 - Experience mentoring and training Team Leader and Associates. 
 - A flexible mindset to learn. 
 - Excellent detail-oriented skills and a highly reliable work ethic. 
 - Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Outlook, Excel). 
 - Ready to invest in Automation opportunities for process/business improvement. 

About Guidehouse India

At Guidehouse India, we're redefining what's possible by creating opportunities that change lives. Guidehouse is a global professional services firm that delivers advisory, technology, and managed services to clients across both the commercial and public sectors. Our teams turn bold ideas into solutions that transform industries, strengthen communities, and drive meaningful impact worldwide. 

Across our Chennai, Trivandrum, and Gurugram locations, you'll find opportunities where your passion and curiosity help shape what comes next. With cutting edge benefits, innovative learning and development programs, and a people first culture, we empower our people to lead with purpose. 

We continue to expand our teams and capabilities across India, investing in state-of-the-art offices and high impact work. Here, you'll collaborate with experts from around the world, build deep expertise, explore new domains, and accelerate your professional growth while making a real impact. 

What We Offer

At Guidehouse India, we are committed to supporting the well-being of our people and their families at every stage of life. We offer competitive compensation and a comprehensive benefits package designed to help you thrive both inside and outside the workplace. 

Our benefits include resources such as in house physician consultations, nutritious food options at the workplace, and confidential counseling through our Employee Assistance Program, along with other wellness focused offerings that support your overall well being. 

Our comprehensive learning and development programs ensure you're continuously upskilled and ready to tackle what's next, so you can shape your own career path while contributing to meaningful, purpose driven work. 

Important Fraud Notice

All official recruitment communications from Guidehouse will come from email addresses ending in @guidehouse. com or @myworkday. com. Guidehouse never charges fees, requests money transfers, or collects payments from educational institutions for recruitment events. Please do not share banking or personal financial information with anyone claiming to represent Guidehouse for hiring purposes. 

Contact Us

If you have visited our website to explore career opportunities or to apply for a position and have questions, please contact the Guidehouse Recruiting team at IndiaRecruiting@guidehouse. com. All information you provide will be kept confidential and used only as required to support the recruitment process. 

To learn more about Guidehouse in India, visit www. guidehouse. com/india. 

Guidehouse does not accept unsolicited resumes through or from search firms or staffing agencies. All unsolicited resumes will be considered the property of Guidehouse and Guidehouse will not be obligated to pay a placement fee.

Bangalore, IND

At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We're committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits. 

Manager IV, Manufacturing Engineering

OMS Center of Excellence (OMS COE)

~50 engineers, technical leads & managers

PORTFOLIO

Multiple Business Units & product lines

LEADERSHIP

Manager-of-managers; multi-level structure

Position Summary

The Manager IV, Manufacturing Engineering leads the OMS organization across multiple Business Units and is accountable for manufacturing documentation readiness, operational performance, digital transformation, and organizational capability. The role leads approximately 50 engineers through managers and technical leaders and partners with Manufacturing, NPI, Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, and Operations leadership. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead and develop a multi-level organization of Manufacturing Engineering Managers, technical leads, engineers, and contractors; own workforce planning, succession, engagement, and leadership development. 
 - Own end-to-end OMS/iOMS delivery across multiple BUs for NPI, HVM, supplier and contract manufacturing, and field installation programs. 
 - Align OMS priorities, capacity, and execution plans with product roadmaps, factory requirements, build schedules, and customer commitments. 
 - Drive OMS readiness, mapping readiness, FTR, OTTC, SLA adherence, productivity, quality-escape reduction, and NC/redline closure performance. 
 - Establish operating mechanisms, scorecards, standards, risk reviews, RCCA, and executive escalation processes to ensure predictable execution. 
 - Define and execute the OMS digital roadmap, including automation, AI-enabled solutions, next-generation platforms, and model-based manufacturing capabilities. 
 - Serve as the senior OMS interface for BU and functional leaders; influence decisions affecting manufacturability, factory readiness, quality, and delivery. 
 - Build technical capability in OMS/iOMS, manufacturing processes, BOM and product structures, change management, PLM/MES integration, and problem solving. 

Scope & Business Impact

- Organization of approximately 50 engineers with an internal management and technical leadership hierarchy. 
 - Accountability across multiple Business Units, product portfolios, manufacturing programs, and global stakeholders. 
 - Direct impact on build quality, manufacturing cycle time, product and factory readiness, scalability, and customer satisfaction. 

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Manufacturing, Industrial Engineering, or a related technical discipline; advanced degree preferred. 
 - 12+ years experience in manufacturing engineering, product engineering, or manufacturing operations, including leadership of managers and large technical teams. 
 - Experience with NPI, HVM, manufacturing readiness, product documentation, operational excellence, and complex electromechanical or semiconductor equipment. 
 - Strong executive communication, cross-functional influence, organizational change leadership, and data-driven decision-making skills. 
 - Working knowledge of PLM, CAD, SAP, MES/iOMS, digital manufacturing, automation, and AI-enabled engineering solutions is preferred. 

Leadership Competencies

Strategic leadership

- Business acumen
 - Organizational development
 - Operational excellence
 - Customer focus
 - Executive influence
 - Innovation
 - Change leadership
 - Collaboration
 - Results orientation

Success Measures

- Consistent OMS readiness, quality, delivery, and productivity performance across supported BUs. 
 - A strong leadership pipeline, engaged workforce, and scalable organizational capability. 
 - Measurable business value from standardization, continuous improvement, automation, AI, and digital transformation. 
 - Improved stakeholder confidence and predictable support for product introductions, production ramps, supplier builds, and field requirements. 

Position requires understanding of Applied Materials global Standards of Business Conduct and compliance with these standards at all times. This includes demonstrating the highest level of ethical conduct reflecting Applied Materials' core values.

Full time

Assignee / Regular

Travel: 

Yes, 10% of the Time

Yes

The company focuses on reliable packaging options that comply with regulatory standards and are tailored to specific client requirements. A team of specialists collaborates closely with customers to develop customized solutions with strong attention to detail and rigorous quality. 
Role Description The Quality Assurance Manager is a full-time, on-site role based in Uttar Pradesh, India. This role oversees the implementation and maintenance of quality management systems for pharmaceutical packaging operations, ensuring compliance with relevant regulatory and industry standards. Day-to-day responsibilities include developing and updating QA policies and procedures, planning and conducting internal audits, reviewing batch records and documentation, and managing deviation, CAPA, and change-control processes.  - Experience with regulatory compliance (e. g. , GMP, ISO standards) and documentation control in a pharmaceutical or related manufacturing environment.

 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across cross-functional teams. 
 - Strong organizational and time-management abilities, with attention to detail and a focus on continuous improvement. 
 - Bachelor's degree in Pharmacy, Engineering, Quality Management, or a related field; advanced qualifications or certifications in QA are an advantage. 
 - Prior experience in pharmaceutical manufacturing quality functions is highly beneficial.

data.title: Head of Quality & Customer Satisfaction
data.description:
Location: Bangalore - Indraprastha, India

Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we're driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust. 

Present in India since 1953, Thales is headquartered in Noida and has other operational offices and sites spread across Delhi, Gurugram, Bengaluru and Mumbai, among others. Over 2200 employees are working with Thales and its joint ventures in India. Since the beginning, Thales has been playing an essential role in India's growth story by sharing its technologies and expertise in Defence, Aerospace and Cyber & Digital sectors. Thales has two engineering competence centres in India - one in Noida focused on Cyber & Digital business, while the one in Bengaluru focuses on hardware, software and systems engineering capabilities for both the civil and defence sectors, serving global needs. The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair & Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry. 

The Quality and Customer Satisfaction Manager guarantees the quality of deliverables, compliance with customer requirements and the performance of operations, while improving Customer Satisfaction and operational maturity. 

He/she leads the continuous improvement of the Function to optimize its competitiveness. He/she manages the Quality team within his/her scope. 

Description Of Activities Significant

Quality Management

- Develop the leadership of its QCS scope in accordance with the rules and expectations of the group's leadership
 - Ensure the effectiveness of the "alert and veto" processes to the company's management and, ultimately, to the COO
 - Promote the QCS function internally

Performance Quality

Job Overview

Role: - Perspec Tool and Libraries Product Engineering

Key Responsibilities

- Lead the development and enhancement of the Perspec System Verifier tool and its associated libraries. 
 - Collaborate closely with R&D teams to design, implement, and improve verification methodologies and product features. 
 - Work with field application engineers and end customers to understand their verification challenges and provide effective solutions using Perspec tools and libraries. 
 - Drive the integration of Perspec with various verification environments, including ARM, RISC-V, PCIe, and performance verification domains. 
 - Provide technical leadership in one or more verification domains such as: 
 - ARM Architecture: Multi-core coherency, power management, memory subsystem, exception handling, and advanced power scenarios. 
 - RISC-V Architecture: PMP (Physical Memory Protection), privilege modes, cache coherency, and exception level transitions. 
 - PCI Express (PCIe): Root Complex and Endpoint configuration, DMA operations, interrupts (MSI/MSI-X), power management, error injection, and advanced PCIe features. 
 - Performance Verification: Industry-standard benchmarks (CoreMark, Dhrystone, LMbench), adaptive traffic profiles, and system performance analysis. 
 - Other Protocols: AMBA CHI, ACE-Lite, and other SoC protocols with emphasis on multi-core verification. 
 - Lead product engineering efforts to ensure the tool and libraries meet customer needs and industry standards. 
 - Support and guide the development of reusable verification scenarios and test suites. 
 - Participate in customer engagements, providing expert advice and troubleshooting complex verification issues. 
 - Mentor and coach junior engineers and cross-functional teams on Perspec tool usage and best practices.

- Strong background in product engineering or verification tool development. 
 - Deep understanding of SoC verification challenges across ARM, RISC-V, PCIe, and performance domains. 
 - Experience collaborating with R&D, field application engineers, and customers.

 - Excellent communication and leadership skills. 
 - Ability to translate customer requirements into product features and verification solutions.

Renesas is one of the top global semiconductor companies in the world. We strive to develop a safer, healthier, greener, and smarter world, and our goal is to make every endpoint intelligent by offering product solutions in the automotive, industrial, infrastructure and IoT markets. Renesas employs roughly 21, 000 people in more than 30 countries worldwide. As a global team, our employees actively embody the Renesas Culture, our guiding principles based on five key elements: Transparent, Agile, Global, Innovative, and Entrepreneurial. Renesas believes in, and has a commitment to, diversity and inclusion, with initiatives and a leadership team dedicated to its resources and values. At Renesas, we want to build a sustainable future where technology helps make our lives easier. Join us and build your future by being part of what's next in electronics and the world. 

Job Description

The Sr System Software Validation Engineer serves as embedded and system software domain expert, driving software quality, evaluation and validation objectives, and technical execution while collaborating closely with systems, firmware/software, validation, and platform develop teams. 

As part of one of Renesas's fastest growing product lines, you will have the opportunity to directly impact customer experience through work on software products that enable feature rich hardware to shine. If you like problem-solving, working with systems involving SW/FW/HW, and switching between multiple languages and paradigms, we'd like to hear from you. If you seek a place to shine with no artificial barriers apply now!

Key Responsibilities

- Lead software and system validation planning and execution of embedded products, applications and solutions utilizing a wide portfolio of Renesas products
 - Drive system level software technical decisions, ensuring robustness, usability and completeness of embedded solutions

 - Identify and mitigate system-level technical risks, ensuring highest user experience
 - Planning and execution of new product prototype bring-up, bench-testing, and evaluation. 
 - Support creation and review of technical documentation (Datasheets, User Manuals/Guides, Application Notes)
 - Contribute to reference designs, development platforms, and documentation to enable broad customer adoption. 
 - Gather and drive clarity on software requirements from diverse groups including customers, application engineers, hardware, and firmware engineers

Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electronics Engineering, Computer Science or Computer Engineering
 - 5-7 years experience in embedded firmware/software development required across multiple IoT application segments
 - Strong understanding of Software Architecture and Design principles, Behavior-Driven Development and unit testing approaches
 - Knowledge of ARM and RISC processors

 - Proven experience delivering production‐quality embedded software for MCU and MPU based platforms. 
 - Good understanding of motor control software, real‐time systems, and embedded development workflows. 
 - Working knowledge (hands‐on preferred) of one or more host-side technology stacks, such as: 
 - C/C++/ RTOS (FreeRTOS, Zephyr)
 - C#/. NET / Python (automation/tools, GUIs, packaging)

 - Experience in developing Agentic Tools
 - Excellent organizational skills, attention to detail and accuracy 
 - Demonstrates creative thinking in debug and troubleshooting skills and building solutions
 - Experience in DevOps including JIRA, Confluence and GitLab preferred
 - Must have highly developed written and verbal cross-functional communication skills
 - Ability to work effectively in a multicultural, cross-functional environment. Preferred qualifications

- Experience supporting embedded development platforms or reference designs with broad customer adoption across Robotics, Edge AI and Industrial IoT applications
 - Execute firmware validation of boot flows, power/clock/reset, memory subsystems, interconnects, and interfaces across stress, corner, and fault scenarios. 
 - Drive system bring‐up on evaluation boards, development boards and reference designs

Renesas is an embedded semiconductor solution provider driven by its Purpose, To Make Our Lives Easier. data.description:
Job Description

Be part of something bigger. Decode the future. 

At Electrolux, as a leading global appliance company, we strive every day to shape living for the better for our consumers, our people and our planet. We share ideas and collaborate so that together, we can develop solutions that deliver enjoyable and sustainable living. 

Come join us as you are. We believe diverse perspectives make us stronger and more innovative. In our global community of people from 100+ countries, we listen to each other, actively contribute, and grow together. 

Join us in our exciting quest to build the future home. 

All About The Role

As Performance Engineer, you will report directly to the Platform Engineering and SRE Engineering Manager. 

The Performance Engineer will be part of our Cloud Native organization, will work closely with our Product teams in eCommerce, Digital Marketing and other Consumer solutions and be involved in the full Software Lifecycle. We already have a solid, modern Engineering foundation and want to continuously improve in a dynamic, iterative manner. 

You'll own how we prove that our consumer platforms perform at scale: from understanding how customers really use our systems, through designing realistic load and performance tests, to finding bottlenecks and seeing the fixes through. This is both a creative and a detail-oriented role in a very multicultural environment. We want you to be bursting with opinions and passionate about sharing, as well as executing them in a collaborative way. 

About The CDI Experience Organization

The Consumer Direct Interaction Experience Organization is a Digital Product Organization responsible for delivering tech solutions to our end-users and consumers across both pre-purchase and post-purchase journeys. We are organized in 15+ digital product areas, providing solutions ranging from Contact Center, E-commerce, Marketing, and Identity to AI. 

At CDI XO, Electrolux Group's Consumer Direct Interaction Organization, we are transforming everyday life through digital innovation. 

Our engineers help design and build solutions, big and small, to enable a range of highly connected Consumer Market solutions in a modern distributed landscape. Our new team members will be working at the cutting edge of Cloud Native technology and patterns. We strive to develop, build, deploy and run intelligently. 

What You'll Do

- Gather and analyse performance requirements and architectural dependencies with product teams, architects and business stakeholders. 
 - Build workload models from production evidence (observability data, gateway logs, real user monitoring) so that tests reflect how customers actually use our platforms. 
 - Design, develop, execute and monitor the full range of performance tests: load, stress, soak, spike and scalability, at both API and client side. 
 - Create and maintain performance testing frameworks, and integrate them into CI/CD pipelines so performance is checked continuously, not just before a release. 
 - Automate manual and repetitive performance testing activities, and treat test scripts, configuration and dashboards as code (no point and click). 
 - Analyse application, infrastructure and database performance issues, find complex bottlenecks, and drive tuning initiatives through to completion. 

Work across a stack that includes: 

- Observability platforms such as Datadog, Dynatrace, and Azure Monitor. 
 - Enterprise SaaS and PaaS systems in the eCommerce, Finance and Logistics arenas. 
 - Cloud-native architectures on Microsoft Azure, including Kubernetes and microservices. 
 - Build performance dashboards, prepare reports and give clear, evidence-based updates to technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Manage test environments and test data, and make the gaps between test and production environments visible. 
 - Work with SRE colleagues to tie performance targets to SLOs and SLIs, and use test results to protect Error Budgets. 
 - Identify risks and issues early, and give actionable recommendations. 
 - Collaborate with developers, architects, DevOps teams and business stakeholders to choose the right design solutions and make sure performance objectives are met. 
 - Mentor engineers in performance engineering practices, and stay current with tools and industry trends. 

But. . . the most important thing is that you are genuinely passionate about performance engineering and continuous improvement. 

Who Are You

- 5 to 8 years of experience in performance testing and engineering. 
 - 4+ years of hands-on experience with Apache JMeter. 
 - 2+ years of hands-on experience with BlazeMeter. 
 - Strong monitoring experience with Dynatrace and Datadog. 
 - Hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure. 
 - Proficiency in scripting with Java, Python and/or JavaScript. 
 - Strong experience automating performance testing, with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices. 
 - Good knowledge of SQL and databases such as PostgreSQL. 
 - Experience with client-side performance testing and performance monitoring dashboards. 
 - Proven ability to identify complex performance bottlenecks and give optimisation recommendations. 
 - Knowledge of Kubernetes, microservices and cloud-native architectures. 
 - Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments, including requirement gathering, stakeholder management and sprint-based delivery. 
 - Experience working with customers to understand deployment architectures and use cases. 
 - Strong analytical, troubleshooting and communication skills; self-driven, flexible and able to work independently in a fast-paced environment. 
 - Computer Science/Software Engineering related degree. 
 - Fluent English, written and spoken. 

Desirable Qualifications And Experience

- Knowledge of AWS. 
 - Heap dump and thread dump analysis. 
 - Experience with Git. 
 - Experience with SAP systems, particularly SAP Commerce Cloud. 
 - Strong understanding of Datadog RUM.

About The Role

Grade Level (for internal use):

Role

Lead DevSecOps Engineer - Enterprise Developer Platform and Toolchain

The Team

The Enterprise Developer Platform & Toolchain team owns the platforms, tools and capabilities that support software engineers across S&P Global. Our remit spans DevOps, DevSecOps, FinOps, Platform Engineering, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) and Developer Experience (DevEx). We partner with divisional DevOps/TechOps teams and Information Security (InfoSec) to establish consistent controls and governance across the software development lifecycle (SDLC). As a globally distributed team, we build services, policies and automated controls that secure the developer toolchain while keeping our platforms simple, consistent and engineer friendly. 

The Impact

As Lead DevSecOps Engineer, you will set the direction for how S&P Global secures the way its software is built and delivered. You will own the SDLC security strategy, policy framework and roadmap, lead a team of DevSecOps engineers, and turn policy into automated, sustainable controls across the developer toolchain. Working closely with platform and SRE leaders, divisional DevOps/TechOps teams, InfoSec and Business Information Security Officers (BISOs), you will raise the organisation's security posture and audit readiness - without slowing engineers down. 

What's In It For You

- Enterprise-scale ownership: Lead end-to-end delivery of security controls across GitHub Enterprise, GitHub Actions, OIDC, Checkmarx, SonarQube, Wiz, Artifactory/Xray, Vault, Okta/SailPoint and Splunk. 
 - Emerging technology: Shape governance for AI-assisted development (Copilot controls, MCP, agent guardrails) and software supply chain security (SBOM, signing, SLSA). 
 - Visibility and influence: Engage directly with senior leaders and auditors on high-profile initiatives tied to company strategy, across frameworks including SOX, SOC 2, ISO 27001 and NIST SSDF. 
 - Growth: Build and grow a team, and access innovation projects, training, knowledge sharing and support for security certifications such as CISSP, CISM and CSSLP. 

Responsibilities

Strategy and Leadership

- Own the SDLC security strategy, policy framework and roadmap, aligned with InfoSec and audit requirements. 
 - Lead, mentor and grow a team of DevSecOps engineers, and drive delivery of toolchain hardening programmes. 
 - Report on security posture, risk and remediation progress to senior stakeholders. 
 - Partner with platform, SRE and engineering leaders to ensure controls are automated, sustainable and widely adopted. 

Security Engineering and Tooling

- Define and implement baseline security policies and automated guardrails across source control and CI/CD environments. 
 - Integrate, manage and tune code quality and application security tools, including SonarQube, Checkmarx and Wiz, within developer workflows. 
 - Harden build infrastructure and software supply chain controls, including artifact management with JFrog Artifactory/Xray. 
 - Provision, secure and optimise AWS services supporting the developer platform, including EC2, ECS/EKS, Lambda, S3, IAM and CloudFormation/CDK. 
 - Lead security architecture reviews and incident response for toolchain security events. 

Governance, Risk and Compliance

- Govern application security and supply chain tooling, including exception management and remediation service-level agreements (SLAs). 
 - Triage security findings, prioritise vulnerabilities by risk and track remediation to closure. 
 - Establish governance for credentials, secrets and non-human identities across the developer toolchain. 
 - Define governance for AI-assisted development tools and developer endpoint security. 
 - Monitor sensitive configuration changes, implement alerting and own audit readiness and compliance evidence. 

What We're Looking For

Experience and Leadership

- 8+ years of experience in DevSecOps, application security or security engineering, including leading teams or programmes. 
 - Proven ability to define security policy and standards, translate them into technical enforcement, and drive adoption across a large organisation. 
 - Strong knowledge of compliance frameworks (e. g. , SOX, SOC 2, ISO 27001) and identity governance. 
 - Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence engineering teams and senior leaders. 

Technical Skills

- Deep expertise in designing, automating and securing enterprise-scale CI/CD pipelines, including common pipeline and source control threats. 
 - Hands-on knowledge of GitHub Enterprise Cloud, GitHub Actions, runners, rulesets and policies. 
 - Strong understanding of repository lifecycle management and Git practices, including Conventional Commits, semantic versioning, trunk-based development/GitFlow and pull request workflows. 
 - Hands-on experience with static application security testing (SAST), software composition analysis (SCA), secrets scanning and cloud security tooling. 
 - Knowledge of identity and access management, including single sign-on (SSO), role-based access control (RBAC) and least privilege. 
 - Proficiency with infrastructure as code (Terraform, CloudFormation or CDK) and familiarity with configuration management tools. 
 - Experience with AWS compute, networking, storage, IAM and container orchestration (ECS/EKS), including AWS security best practices. 
 - Strong scripting and automation skills in Python or Bash; familiarity with TypeScript/Node. js. 
 - Understanding of configuration management databases (CMDBs) and ITIL-aligned change management, including approvals and audit trails. 
 - Awareness of AI tool governance and developer endpoint security, including mobile device management (MDM). 

Nice to Have

- Experience with AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot and Cursor, and with developer agents/MCP integrations. 
 - Contributions to open-source Backstage plugins or internal developer platform (IDP) ecosystems. 
 - Familiarity with compliance as code and policy engines such as OPA or Sentinel. 
 - Experience with software supply chain frameworks and practices such as SLSA, SBOM generation and artifact signing. 
 - Security certifications such as CISSP, CISM, AWS Certified Security - Specialty. 
 - Cloud or Kubernetes certifications such as AWS Solutions Architect, AWS DevOps Engineer, CKA or CKAD. 

Technical Environment

SAST/SCA tooling, including Checkmarx, SonarQube and GitHub Advanced Security (GHAS)

Preferred Qualifications

What's In It For You?

Advancing Essential Intelligence.

We're more than 35, 000 strong worldwide-so we're able to understand nuances while having a broad perspective. Our team is driven by curiosity and a shared belief that Essential Intelligence can help build a more prosperous future for us all. From finding new ways to measure sustainability to analyzing energy transition across the supply chain to building workflow solutions that make it easy to tap into insight and apply it.
