data.title: Manager, Machine Learning Engineering
data.description:
Smarsh is a global leader in digital communications compliance and intelligence. We help the world's most regulated industries - financial services, healthcare, government - capture, archive, and analyse communications at scale. Our Cognition Engineering organisation is at the heart of this mission, building the AI and ML capabilities that power Smarsh's next generation of products

About the role

We are looking for an experienced Engineering Manager to lead and grow the Cortex team. This is a hands-on leadership role: you will manage a talented team of ML and delivery engineers, drive technical delivery of AI service initiatives, and help define the direction of Smarsh's AI platform capability. 

You will report directly to a Senior ML Engineering Manager and will be the primary engineering leader for the Cortex team on the ground in Bangalore. You will work closely with Smarsh's Applied Machine Learning team - who build and train our in-house models - as well as Product Management, Technical Program Management (TPM), the Fabric platform organization, and sister Cognition teams: Cognition Logic and Cognition Analytics, all part of the wider Enterprise Conduct organisation. 

This role is AI-first. You will be expected to champion and actively use AI-powered engineering productivity tools - including Windsurf and Claude Code - and embed these practices into the team's day-to-day ways of working. 

What You Will Do

Team Leadership & People Management

- Lead, mentor and grow a team of 4 ML Engineers and 1 Delivery Engineer across India and the UK. 
 - Run effective 1: 1s, performance conversations, and career development planning. 
 - Foster a high-trust, high-performance team culture grounded in continuous improvement. 
 - Manage hiring, onboarding, and team capacity planning as Cortex expands. 

Technical Delivery & Model Operations

- Own end-to-end delivery of Cortex initiatives - from planning and scoping to production release and post-go-live operational support. 
 - Drive delivery of new capabilities including Audio Analytics as a Service, In App Translation and Intelligent Agent Review. 
 - Work closely with the Applied ML team to take in-house models from research handoff through to production-grade deployment - managing integration, validation, and operational readiness. 
 - Own and evolve Cortex's gated model deployment pipeline: ensuring models progress through automated quality gates, shadow mode, canary, and full rollout stages with clear promotion and rollback criteria. 
 - Establish model evaluation and monitoring frameworks - tracking quality, performance drift, and SLO compliance in production. 
 - Maintain and improve Cortex's operational SLOs, reliability posture, and incident response process. 
 - Ensure engineering practices, code quality, and architectural decisions meet Smarsh engineering standards. 

AI-First Ways of Working

- Actively use and champion AI productivity tooling: Windsurf, Claude Code, and similar tools. 
 - Set the standard for how the team leverages AI-assisted development to increase velocity and code quality. 
 - Identify and help to introduce new AI tooling where it adds measurable value to the team. 

Technical Strategy, Stakeholder Management & Developer Experience

- Contribute to the Cortex technical roadmap, working with engineering leadership, Product Management, and TPM to align delivery to business priorities. 
 - Build strong working relationships with the Applied Machine Learning team - acting as a bridge between model development and production AI service deployment. 
 - Partner closely with sister Cognition teams - Cognition Logic and Cognition Analytics - to align on shared platform patterns, APIs, and service contracts within the Enterprise Conduct organisation. 
 - Engage proactively with the Fabric organisation on infrastructure, platform standards, and shared tooling dependencies. 
 - Represent Cortex in cross-team forums, architecture reviews, and planning sessions - advocating for Cortex consumers' developer experience. 
 - Help to drive the AI Service Catalogue vision: discoverable, well-documented, and operationally excellent services that product engineers across Smarsh can consume with confidence

What You Bring

- 2+ years of engineering management experience, ideally in an AI/ML, platform, or MLOps context. 
 - Solid track record of delivering production ML or AI services at scale. 
 - Experience working at the interface between applied research or ML teams and production engineering - you understand how to take a model from handoff to a reliable, monitored service. 
 - Experience managing distributed teams across geographies and time zones. 
 - Demonstrated ability to build trusted relationships with Product, TPM, and platform stakeholders - translating business priorities into engineering plans and vice versa. 
 - Experience with COGs analysis and FinOps practices for AI/ML workloads - you understand how to track, attribute, and optimise infrastructure and inference costs, and can make informed build vs. buy decisions on managed services. 
 - Solid release management and planning experience - you can own a release calendar, coordinate cross-team dependencies, manage risk gates, and ensure smooth, well-communicated production deployments. 
 - Hands-on engineering background - you can credibly engage with technical design decisions and code reviews. 

Technical Skills

- Proficiency in Python; familiarity with Kotlin or JVM-based frameworks is a plus. 
 - Experience with cloud-native AI/ML infrastructure: AWS (Bedrock, SageMaker, EKS), Kubernetes, and Kafka. 
 - Solid understanding of audio and NLP model architectures - specifically Parakeet (ASR), NeMo framework, and XLM-R based multilingual models. 
 - Solid MLOps foundations with practical production experience across the full model lifecycle - including experiment tracking, model registry management, gated deployment strategies (shadow mode, canary, blue/green with automated quality gates), drift detection, rollback handling, and SLO-linked promotion criteria. 
 - Understanding of ML model serving patterns, including inference optimisation and managed inference platforms (e. g. Triton Inference Server). 
 - Solid understanding of modern AI/ML architectures and system design patterns - including transformer-based models, agentic workflows, RAG, and multi-agent orchestration - with the ability to engage credibly in technical design discussions and evaluate trade-offs. 
 - Comfort with operational excellence practices: SLOs, observability, incident management, and on-call culture. 

AI Productivity & Tooling

- Active user of AI-powered coding assistants (Windsurf, Claude Code, or similar). 
 - Genuine conviction that AI tooling meaningfully accelerates engineering teams - and a desire to prove it. 
 - Ability to coach engineers on effective use of AI tools and to separate hype from practical value. 

Leadership & Communication

- Clear, direct communicator - able to translate complex technical topics for non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Data-driven approach to engineering decisions and team health. 
 - Comfortable with ambiguity and capable of bringing structure to new problem spaces. 
 - Collaborative leader who builds trust quickly across cultures and time zones. 

Why Smarsh?

Smarsh hires lifelong learners with a passion for innovating with purpose, humility and humor. Collaboration is at the heart of everything we do. We work closely with the most popular communications platforms and the world's leading cloud infrastructure platforms. We use the latest in AI/ML technology to help our customers break new ground at scale. We are a global organization that values diversity, and we believe that providing opportunities for everyone to be their authentic self is key to our success. Smarsh leadership, culture, and commitment to developing our people have all garnered Comparably. com Best Places to Work Awards. Come join us and find out what the best work of your career looks like

Together, we are proudly rooted in our deep legacy as we stand at the forefront of the media revolution. When you join Nielsen, you will join a dynamic team committed to excellence, perseverance, and the ambition to make an impact together. We champion you, because when you succeed, we do too. We enable your best to power our future. 

Job Description

Gracenote, a Nielsen company, is dedicated to connecting audiences to the entertainment they love, powering a better media future for all people. We are the content data business unit of Nielsen that powers innovative entertainment experiences for the world's leading media companies. Our entertainment metadata and connected IDs deliver advanced content navigation and discovery to connect consumers to the content they love and discover new ones Gracenote's Data Platform is the central hub for millions of pieces of TV entertainment data used daily by clients and partners worldwide. It provides the critical services that structure and model data for our editorial, ingest, and delivery systems. This data powers entertainment solutions for the top cable, OTT, CE, and digital clients, reaching hundreds of millions of consumers. 

The Director of DevOps & Platform Engineering Gracenote India will be central to the success of our infrastructure, cloud platform, and engineering enablement teams across geographies. This role is fundamental to the growth and technical excellence of the Gracenote engineering organization as a whole. Key goals of this role are to establish technical rigor, operational efficiency, and a robust platform engineering culture. You will be responsible for managing compute infrastructure, cloud native and managed services, observability stacks, and cloud cost optimization (FinOps), while collaborating closely with local and global stakeholders to ensure high availability, scalability, and security for Gracenote's products. 

Responsibilities

- Manage and scale multiple teams of DevOps, and Cloud Infrastructure engineers in India, with direct and indirect managerial responsibilities. 
 - Work with local and global management across all relevant organizational partners to ensure the success, productivity, and operational alignment of assigned teams. 
 - Create a culture based on Nielsen values, fostering collaboration, continuous learning, and engineering excellence across platform operations. 
 - Establish operating rhythm and cadence within areas of responsibility to ensure transparent communication, inclusive leadership, and a positive, high-retention environment for engineers. 
 - Track and drive key performance indicators (KPIs) including system availability/SLA performance, incident resolution times, infrastructure productivity, cloud spend efficiency, and employee retention. 
 - Oversee and manage Gracenote's AWS footprint, including large-scale compute resources and AWS-managed services such as AWS Glue, Amazon MSK (Managed Streaming for Apache Kafka), EKS, EMR, RDS, and S3. 
 - Drive Kubernetes platform operations (Amazon EKS), focusing on automated scaling, cluster management, workload security, and operational reliability. 
 - Own and evolve the in-house observability stack based on Grafana, Loki, Prometheus, and related telemetry tools to ensure end-to-end visibility across microservices and data pipelines. 
 - Lead FinOps and cloud cost management initiatives, establishing robust cost tracking, forecasting, efficiency benchmarks, and continuous resource optimization strategies without compromising performance. 
 - Apply an automation-first mindset to Infrastructure as Code (IaC), CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and self-healing systems. 
 - Coordinate and maintain a strong talent pipeline. 
 - Continuously assess, streamline, and improve DevOps processes, incident management workflows, and infrastructure reliability standards. 
 - Ensure strict adherence to toolings, governance, and security best practices within the Product Development Lifecycle. 
 - Represent the India DevOps and Platform Engineering organization in cross-functional engagements (e. g. , Product, Software Engineering, Architecture, and Data Science). 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's/Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering. 
 - 12+ years of experience working in DevOps, Cloud Infrastructure. 
 - Proven track record in people management, team building, and leading multi-disciplinary DevOps teams in a global environment. 
 - 8-10 years of hands-on experience with cloud infrastructure, CI/CD tools, Infrastructure as Code (e. g. , Terraform, CloudFormation), and scripting (Python, Shell, Go, etc. ). 
 - 5+ years of dedicated experience managing production AWS environments at scale, specifically focusing on Amazon EKS and AWS native managed services (AWS Glue, MSK, EMR, S3, RDS, DynamoDB). 
 - Deep expertise in open-source and custom observability tools, particularly Grafana, Loki, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry, or ELK stack. 
 - Proven track record in FinOps-managing cloud budgets, identifying cost inefficiencies, implementing auto-scaling/spot instances, and tracking cloud spend metrics. 
 - Strong foundation in Kubernetes architecture, containerization, microservices deployment, and networking/security policies. 
 - Good understanding of enterprise workflow and business tools such as JIRA, Confluence, OpsGenie, Gitlab, and CI/CD tools (e. g. , Jenkins, GitLab CI). 
 - Strong critical thinking, incident response leadership, and analytical problem-solving skills. 
 - Sense of curiosity, operational discipline, and high attention to detail. 

Additional Information

Please be aware that job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by scammers seeking personal data or money. Nielsen recruiters will only contact you through official job boards, LinkedIn, or email with a nielsen. com domain. Be cautious of any outreach claiming to be from Nielsen via other messaging platforms or personal email addresses. Always verify that email communications come from an @nielsen. com address. If you're unsure about the authenticity of a job offer or communication, please contact Nielsen directly through our official website or verified social media channels.

This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence. 

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk. 

About the Team  Authentication tells you who someone is. Authorization decides what they can do, and doing that well at scale is hard. Role-based access breaks down as applications grow, and AI agents are changing who, and what, asks for access. Auth0 FGA solves this with fine-grained authorization. Its engine is OpenFGA, a CNCF incubating open source project that Okta maintains with contributors from other companies, and Auth0 FGA runs that same engine as a managed service. 

FGA DevEx owns how developers experience both: our SDKs, CLI, IDE plugins, Helm charts and docs, all developed in the open. The FGA group owns its product end to end, from infrastructure to docs, so we move quickly and see our work reach developers. 

Our guiding principle: one developer experience, many deployment models. 

About the role  We're hiring a Staff Engineer to set the technical direction for everything the team owns, and to mentor the senior engineers who build it, starting with our SDKs in Go, JavaScript, . NET, Python, Java and more. From there, you'll shape where the developer experience goes next, from how our SDKs evolve to new surfaces like MCP servers. You'll partner with the Core team on API design, so every new capability feels natural in each language. 

This is an individual contributor role. You'll work closely with the engineering manager, who owns people and delivery

ResponsibilitiesSet the direction: 

- Define and drive the technical direction for FGA DevEx across open source and SaaS, and turn it into a roadmap with the engineering manager and the product team. 
 - Build support for that direction across the team, the FGA group and open source community  
 - Mentor the team's senior engineers, and raise the level of everyone around you. 
 - Establish how a new team builds software, from design reviews and coding standards to how we test and ship, and set the quality bar. 
 - Make the calls that are hard to undo: when an API is ready to ship across every language, how it evolves, and when to deprecate. 
 - Be the voice of developer experience across FGA: partner with the Core team on API design and with internal teams such as Integrations, and flag developer friction wherever you see it. Own the Platform:   

- Architect our SDKs in Go, JavaScript, . NET, Python and Java, including the generator every client is built from. 
 - Set the standards every SDK follows, from authentication and error handling to retries and rate limiting. 
 - Shape the tooling and content around the SDKs: the CLI, IDE integrations, Helm charts, GitHub automation, docs and examples. 
 - Drive the release and versioning strategy across all divisions  
 - Grow our open source community: build the contributor and maintainer base beyond the team today, and make it easy for outside developers to contribute. Requirements
 - 8+ years as a software engineer, including time leading the technical direction of a team or a significant area, with or without the title. 
 - Strong proficiency in at least one of Go, JavaScript/TypeScript, C#/. NET, Python or Java, and the curiosity to work across several. 
 - Experience building software other developers use: SDKs, API clients, libraries, developer platforms, CLIs or tooling. 
 - A strong sense of API design and ergonomics, and of how an interface should feel in different languages. 
 - Clear communication and a track record of influencing decisions across teams and with outside contributors, without relying on authority. Nice to have

- Contributing to, maintaining or leading open source projects. 
 - Building with code generation tools such as OpenAPI Generator and templating frameworks. 
 - Designing resilient clients: authentication flows, retries and rate limiting. 
 - Setting up GitHub Actions and release automation. 
 - Working in authorization or identity, such as OAuth, RBAC or ReBAC. #P24600_3385570

  

The Okta Experience

- Supporting Your Well-Being  
 - Driving Social Impact  
 - Developing Talent and Fostering Connection + CommunityWe are intentional about connection. Our global community, spanning over 20 offices worldwide, is united by a drive to innovate. Your journey begins with an immersive, in-person onboarding experience designed to accelerate your impact and connect you to our mission and team from day one.

data.description:
The driving force behind our success has always been the people of AspenTech. What drives us, is our aspiration, our desire and ambition to keep pushing the envelope, overcoming any hurdle, challenging the status quo to continually find a better way. You will experience these qualities of passion, pride and aspiration in many ways - from a rich set of career development programs to support of community service projects to social events that foster fun and relationship building across our global community. 

The Role

The driving force behind our success has always been the people of AspenTech. Founded more than 30 years ago by the best and brightest engineers at MIT, we continue to tackle the most complex challenges in process manufacturing. Our aspenONE software enables our customers to achieve operational excellence by increasing capacity, improving margins, and reducing costs, while becoming more energy efficient, ensuring safety, and shrinking their carbon footprint. This is a place where people are fiercely passionate about technology and have a desire to make a difference through the application of engineering and software technologies to solve real business problems. As a Software Developer with focus on software packaging and deployment, you will build and maintain software deployment solutions for our aspenONE software and push the deployment technology to make it easier for our customers to adopt our latest technologies. Based in our Pune, India office you will collaborate closely with other members of geographically dispersed Products teams, coordinating closely with colleagues focused on delighting customers via delivering robust products. 

Your Impact

We are seeking an experienced Senior Software Developer with 4-7 years of professional software development experience to design, develop, test, and maintain high-quality software solutions across desktop, web, and cloud environments. 

The ideal candidate will have strong programming and problem-solving skills, a solid understanding of software design and architecture, and hands-on experience throughout the software development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, design, implementation, testing, deployment, troubleshooting, and maintenance. The successful candidate should also have experience leveraging AI-assisted development tools to improve development efficiency and software quality, including accelerating coding, debugging, testing, code review, troubleshooting, and documentation, while applying sound engineering judgment to validate AI-generated solutions. 

- Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain high-quality software applications, services, and components across desktop, web, and cloud environments.

 - Participate in all phases of the software development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, technical design, implementation, code review, testing, deployment, troubleshooting, and maintenance. 
 - Contribute to software design and architecture, evaluating technical alternatives and developing solutions that consider scalability, reliability, performance, security, and maintainability. 
 - Develop software applications, services, APIs, utilities, and automation using technologies such as C#, C++, and other appropriate programming and scripting languages.

 - Develop and maintain unit, integration, and automated tests to ensure software quality, reliability, and regression prevention. 
 - Leverage AI-assisted development tools to improve efficiency across software design, coding, debugging, testing, code review, refactoring, troubleshooting, and technical documentation. 
 - Critically review and validate AI-generated code and technical recommendations to ensure correctness, security, performance, quality, and maintainability. 
 - Collaborate effectively with developers, architects, QA, DevOps, product teams, and other stakeholders to understand requirements, develop technical solutions, and resolve complex issues. 
 - Participate actively in technical design reviews, code reviews, technical discussions, and knowledge sharing within the development team. 
 - Integrate software development and delivery processes with version control systems such as Git and Perforce and automated CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Work with container technologies, such as Docker and Kubernetes, to support modern application development and deployment environments. 
 - Work with SQL and NoSQL database technologies as required by application designs and product architectures. 
 - Troubleshoot complex software issues, perform root-cause analysis, and implement effective and sustainable solutions. 
 - Apply Agile development practices to deliver high-quality software in a timely and predictable manner. 
 - Provide technical guidance and share software development best practices with less-experienced developers. 
 - Identify opportunities to leverage AI, automation, and modern development tools to reduce repetitive work, streamline development workflows, and improve engineering productivity and software quality. 

What You'll Need

- 4-7 years of professional software development experience, with demonstrated experience designing, developing, testing, and maintaining production software. 
 - Strong programming and coding skills, with the ability to independently design, implement, test, debug, and maintain complex software components and features. 
 - Strong proficiency in C# and/or C++, with a solid understanding of object-oriented programming and modern software development practices. 
 - Strong understanding of software engineering principles, object-oriented design, design patterns, data structures, algorithms, and software design concepts. 
 - Solid understanding of software architecture principles and the ability to translate product and technical requirements into effective software designs. 
 - Strong understanding of the end-to-end software development lifecycle, including requirements, design, development, testing, deployment, and maintenance. 
 - Experience developing desktop and/or web applications, including services and APIs. 
 - Experience developing and deploying software in cloud environments, preferably AWS or Azure. 
 - Experience with software testing and quality engineering practices, including unit testing, integration testing, automated testing, debugging, and defect resolution. 
 - Experience effectively leveraging AI-assisted software development tools to improve coding, debugging, testing, code review, refactoring, troubleshooting, documentation, and overall development efficiency. 
 - Ability to critically evaluate and validate AI-generated code and technical recommendations, applying sound engineering judgment to ensure correctness, security, performance, quality, and maintainability. 
 - Experience with CI/CD, build automation, and modern software development and delivery practices. 
 - Experience with version control systems, such as Git and Perforce. 
 - Experience with container technologies, such as Docker and Kubernetes. 
 - Solid understanding of SQL and/or NoSQL database technologies and their use in software applications. 
 - Working knowledge of Windows and/or Linux operating systems. 
 - Experience working within an Agile software development environment. 
 - Strong analytical, debugging, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to independently investigate complex technical issues and develop effective solutions. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly communicate technical concepts, designs, decisions, issues, and solutions. 
 - Strong collaboration and teamwork skills, with the ability to work effectively across development teams and with cross-functional stakeholders.

data.title: Full-Stack Developer
data.description:
Join Revun as a Full-Stack Developer to scale web applications using cutting-edge technology. Build robust API integrations and enhance coding with AI tools, working in a fast-paced environment. 

About Revun

Revun is the software platform and infrastructure layer behind modern property operations. Where other tools solve one piece of the puzzle, Revun unifies leasing, payments, maintenance, communications, compliance, reporting, and brokerage workflows into a single operating system. Owners, property managers, brokerages, leasing teams, maintenance companies, and REITs all operate from the same connected platform, with role-based experiences that adapt to each stakeholder. Based in Toronto, Ontario, Canada. 

About The Role

As a Full-Stack Developer at Revun, you'll be at the forefront of scaling our web applications. Your day-to-day tasks include reviewing sprint tasks, refactoring backend logic in Laravel, and designing responsive frontends using Tailwind CSS. You will engage with third-party API integration and leverage AI coding assistants to enhance your workflows. 

Working closely with the Lead Developer and reporting to the Technical Lead/Founder, your responsibilities include delivering clean, modular code, ensuring zero-downtime deployments, and accelerating development velocity through AI tools. Your success will be assessed by your ability to meet sprint deadlines and ship functional code features consistently. 

Within the first 90 days, you'll focus on successfully integrating APIs and leveraging AI tools to accelerate development while maintaining strong code standards. A successful candidate is resourceful, embraces modern coding tools, and communicates progress effectively. 

What you will do

- Deliver clean, modular, and scalable code using Laravel and Tailwind CSS or any other modern frontend framework to enhance web application performance and client project outcomes. 
 - Review sprint tasks, manage pull requests, and refactor backend logic in collaboration with the team, ensuring consistency and quality. 
 - Write and refactor both backend logic in Laravel and design responsive frontend layouts using Tailwind CSS and Blade components. 
 - Test and debug third-party API connections, handle complex payloads, and manage error logs effectively. 
 - Leverage AI coding assistants to draft boilerplate structures, write unit tests, and iterate on feature implementation rapidly. 
 - Complete assigned feature sprints, conduct code reviews, and test API endpoints to ensure stability and performance. 
 - Optimize database queries, perform security audits of input validations, and update documentation for integrated modules to maintain system integrity. 
 - Successfully integrate APIs and leverage AI tools within the first 90 days to accelerate development velocity while maintaining rigorous code standards. 
 - Troubleshoot unforeseen API documentation errors and resolve merge conflicts or unexpected breaking changes efficiently. 

What we are looking for

- At least 4 years of hands-on experience in web development with SaaS or client applications. 
 - In-depth experience with PHP and the Laravel framework for building robust applications. 
 - Strong proficiency in full-stack Laravel development, including backend services and frontend frameworks such as Vue. js or any similar JavaScript framework. 
 - Hands-on experience integrating REST APIs, payment gateways, and CRM systems like Zoho. 
 - Solid understanding of MySQL, database schema design, and Git version control workflows. 
 - Fluent in English, with excellent spoken and written communication skills. 
 - Clear communication skills in providing progress updates and resolving development issues. 

Nice to have

- Experience in software development within the IT sector. 
 - Proficiency in AI-assisted development tools like Cursor, Claude, and OpenAI APIs to enhance coding speed and quality. 
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field. 

What we offer

CAD $18, 000 to $30, 000 per year. 

Benefits

- Remote work flexibility
 - Professional development opportunities

Schedule

Monday to Friday, 9: 00 AM - 5: 00 PM (EST Timezone). 

What happens next

Our recruitment partner will be in touch with you about your application. 

If you meet the requirements for the role, they will send you a link to an online video interview that you complete in your own time - there is no appointment to book and nothing to install. 

Your completed interview is then shared with us to review alongside your application, and we will let you know what happens next.

data.description:
At EY, you'll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we're counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all. 

Job Title: Senior Manager - Platform Engineering

Summary: 

We are looking for a highly skilled and experienced Senior Manager - Platform Engineering to lead the strategy, engineering, and operations of a scalable enterprise platform supporting data products and corporate finance transformation. 

This role combines platform architecture, engineering execution, and people leadership, with accountability for secure, reliable, and cost-efficient shared capabilities. The ideal candidate will enable application and data engineering teams through self-service infrastructure, standardized delivery workflows, and a strong developer experience, supporting finance transformation solutions across P2P, O2C, R2R, and FP&A. 

You will own the platform engineering roadmap, delivery governance, and team development, partnering with product, architecture, security, and business leaders to improve engineering productivity and deliver measurable business outcomes across client engagements. 

Responsibilities: 

Technology & Architecture Leadership

- Own the platform engineering strategy and architecture roadmap, aligning cloud infrastructure, shared services, and modernization priorities with business and product goals. 
 - Lead the design and evolution of secure, resilient cloud-native platforms, including container orchestration, networking, identity, secrets management, and standardized environments. 
 - Establish engineering standards, reference architectures, infrastructure-as-code patterns, and automated guardrails for consistent provisioning and operation of platform services. 
 - Enable application, data, and AI/ML workloads through reusable platform capabilities, APIs, integration patterns, and scalable compute and storage services. 
 - Own CI/CD and release engineering capabilities, including automated testing, security checks, artifact management, deployment strategies, and rollback readiness. 
 - Provide technical leadership for critical incidents, architectural reviews, and complex engineering decisions; drive root-cause analysis and durable corrective actions. 

Delivery & Operational Excellence

- Lead delivery planning and governance across platform workstreams, managing priorities, dependencies, risks, and commitments against agreed business outcomes. 
 - Embed agile, DevOps, and SRE practices, including service ownership, observability, on-call readiness, incident response, and tested disaster recovery. 
 - Define and track service-level indicators and objectives, agreed SLAs, and engineering delivery metrics to improve reliability, deployment performance, and recovery times. 
 - Drive capacity planning, performance optimization, and FinOps practices; manage platform budgets and vendors to improve cost efficiency without compromising reliability. 
 - Partner with security and governance teams to embed access controls, vulnerability remediation, auditability, data protection, and compliance requirements into platform operations. 

Team Leadership & Talent Management

- Lead and scale multidisciplinary platform engineering teams spanning cloud infrastructure, DevOps, SRE, and automation; develop engineering managers and technical leads. 
 - Build a high-performance, inclusive engineering culture grounded in accountability, collaboration, continuous learning, and measurable outcomes. 
 - Own workforce planning, hiring, performance management, succession planning, and capability development aligned with the platform roadmap. 
 - Coach managers and engineers on technical judgment, execution discipline, stakeholder engagement, and career growth; delegate effectively while maintaining accountability. 

Business & Stakeholder Management

- Partner with product teams, enterprise architects, security leaders, finance transformation stakeholders, and clients to translate business needs into platform priorities. 
 - Balance platform investment, delivery capacity, risk, and business value; align stakeholders on trade-offs, service expectations, and measurable outcomes. 
 - Support solutioning, proposals, and client discussions with platform architecture, delivery estimates, operating models, and cost considerations. 
 - Communicate roadmap progress, investment needs, service health, delivery risks, and business impact clearly to executive stakeholders. 

Platform & Product Mindset

- Manage the platform as an internal product, using developer feedback and adoption metrics to prioritize capabilities that reduce friction and accelerate delivery. 
 - Build self-service workflows, reusable infrastructure modules, service catalogs, and standardized delivery paths with clear documentation and onboarding. 
 - Measure platform value through adoption, developer satisfaction, onboarding time, delivery lead time, and reduced operational toil; enable secure analytics and AI use cases. 

Qualifications

Education & Experience

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - 12+ years of experience across software engineering, cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, or SRE, including substantial architecture and delivery ownership. 
 - 5+ years of engineering people-management experience, with a demonstrated track record of leading multiple teams and developing engineering managers or technical leads. 

Technical Expertise

- Deep experience with at least one major cloud platform (Azure, AWS, or GCP), including networking, identity, security, resilience, and cloud operating models. 
 - Strong expertise in cloud-native architecture, containers, Kubernetes, infrastructure as code (e. g. , Terraform), and automated environment provisioning. 
 - Experience with CI/CD, GitOps, observability, and automation using relevant tools and languages (e. g. , GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, Argo CD, OpenTelemetry, Python, or Go). 
 - Strong understanding of APIs, microservices, distributed systems, and shared platform services; experience enabling data platforms and integration workloads. 
 - Experience with secure-by-design engineering, identity and access management, secrets management, software supply-chain security, and enterprise governance. 

Operational & Delivery Skills

- Proven ability to deliver enterprise platform programs, manage cross-team dependencies, and establish effective execution and risk governance. 
 - Experience implementing DevOps and SRE practices, including SLOs, error budgets, incident management, post-incident reviews, and disaster recovery testing. 
 - Strong understanding of scalability, capacity planning, performance tuning, cloud cost optimization, budget ownership, and vendor management. 

Domain & Functional Knowledge

- Understanding of enterprise data and application needs; exposure to corporate finance processes (P2P, O2C, R2R, and FP&A) is preferred. 
 - Experience supporting finance transformation, analytics platforms, or other data-intensive enterprise products is highly desirable. 

Leadership & Behavioral Skills

- Strong people leadership, organizational planning, and talent development skills, with the ability to lead through managers and technical leads. 
 - Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, including executive-level engagement and influence across business and technology teams. 
 - Ability to balance long-term platform strategy with pragmatic delivery, sound technical judgment, and hands-on engagement when needed. 
 - High ownership mindset focused on platform adoption, developer productivity, reliability, and measurable business outcomes. 

EY | Building a better working world

data.description:
Quality Control Manager

  

Role Summary

We are seeking a technically strong and system-driven Quality Control Manager who can lead inspections, ensure quality compliance, handle defect analysis, resolve problems, and drive continuous improvements. Fastener industry experience and hands-on operation of QC equipment is required. 

Key Responsibilities

• Ensure product quality meets drawing requirements, standards, and customer specifications. 

• Lead incoming, checklists, in-process, and final inspections for all fastener products. 

• Conduct defect analysis, root cause analysis (RCA), and drive corrective actions (CAPA). 

• Maintain quality documentation, reports, calibration records and QA data. 

• Operate and supervise use of Profile Projector, Hardness Testing Machine, Metallurgy Setup, and Calibration Tools. 

• Improve quality processes, strengthen SOPs, and ensure systematic quality checks. 

• Coordinate with production and customer teams for issue resolution. 

• Lead internal audits and support external/customer audits. 

• Ensure all measuring instruments are calibrated and functioning accurately

• Continuously improve Products and Processes

What we are looking for?

  

Technical Skills

• Strong knowledge of fastener quality assurance processes

• Hands-on experience with QA equipment such as Profile Projector, Hardness Tester, Metallurgy testing, and gauges

• Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings and technical specifications

• Knowledge of inspection methods, defect analysis, and quality documentation

• Understanding of calibration systems and quality compliance requirements

  

Soft Skills

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

• Ability to enforce discipline and ensure system and SOP compliance

• Clear communication and coordination with cross-functional teams

• Detail-oriented, responsible, and quality-focused mindset

• Leadership ability to guide inspectors and shop-floor teams

Experience

• Minimum 4 years of hands-on experience in Quality Control within fastener manufacturing

Education

• Diploma / Degree in Mechanical Engineering or related technical field

Why Join Brimag?

• Take Ownership: Lead QA systems and ensure zero-defect output. 

• Make a Difference: Your decisions directly improve product quality and customer trust. 

• Grow with Us: Clear growth path toward Senior QC Manager or Quality Head.

Our company cultivates a professional, collaborative, and performance-driven work environment built on trust, accountability, and continuous improvement. Our working structure & Environment are designed to enable employees to contribute effectively, innovate responsibly, and grow professionally.

You shall report to the Senior Management / Director. lead the quality inspection and assurance function, coordinating closely with Production, Operations, and Customer teams.

You will lead a high-visibility platform engineering function tied directly to company strategy, working with GitHub Enterprise Cloud, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, AWS, Terraform and Backstage. What We're Looking For

 - Strong hands-on experience with GitHub Enterprise Cloud (administration, Actions, hosted runners, GHAS) and Azure DevOps.

Nice to Have

 - Experience with AI-assisted development tools (GitHub Copilot, Cursor IDE) and developer agents/MCP integrations.

Description

Amazon Devices is an inventive research and development company that designs and engineer high-profile devices like the Kindle family of products, Fire Tablets, Fire TV, Health Wellness, Amazon Echo & Astro products. We are looking for exceptional engineers to join the SOC development team and help develop the next generation of chips based on a revolutionary architecture. 

Work hard. Have Fun. Make History. 

The Role

At Amazon, as a Manager - Test engineer you will be instrumental in bringing New Product from first silicon testing, ramp up to be ready for Production Volume Test and improving the Product Yield at all stages of manufacturing the product working with the OSAT (Outsourced Semiconductor Assembly & Test) vendors. Design, collect and Analyze Test Data during Verification and Correlation Process to meet Product Specification and Manufacturability Criteria, while working closely with Test Engineer from the OSAT. Support Test Operations to test and ship Engineering Samples and Production quantities. 

Key job responsibilities

- First silicon debug with Design and OSAT Test Engineering. 
 - Defines test program flows and methods for solid test coverage. 
 - Drive final test yield analysis and corrective actions
 - First silicon debug with Design and OSAT Test Engineering. 
 - Finalize wafer-sort and final test programs in support of production
 - Drive product to meet yield and test time/cost goals. 
 - Analyze yield at Engineering Sample phase and Characterize NPI product performances and manufacturing yield window including bench correlation to meet product requirements. 
 - Identify and implement root cause solutions to yield loss mechanisms through statistical data analysis and failure analysis techniques. 
 - Transfer product knowledge to OSAT sustaining engineer
 - Manage Test Contractor (OSAT) in early production stage

Basic Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science or equivalent
 - Knowledge of the semiconductor industry, processes, technologies and key suppliers
 - 10+ years or more experience in semiconductor digital design, test and/or product engineering for complex SoC's
 - Must have hands on experience & solid understanding of SOC development cycle in multiple ASIC projects
 - Hands on experience in successful new product introductions for multiple complex, high-volume SoCs in advanced process nodes
 - Strong knowledge of new product introduction from first silicon through product qualification and characterization
 - Good analytical, communication, team work, and troubleshooting and problem solving skills required
 - Managing a team of Test Engineers

Preferred Qualifications

- Master's degree or Ph. D. degree in Electrical Engineering or related field

The Software Developer 2 supports Arctic Wolf's Engineering organization by helping ensure the quality, reliability, and performance of Aurora Endpoint Security and our cloud-based services. This person partners closely with Engineering and Product teams to drive test automation, improve release confidence, and strengthen engineering productivity through modern quality engineering and AI-assisted development practices. 

As a Developer 2, Quality Engineering at Arctic Wolf, you will:

 - Investigate, troubleshoot, document, and track product defects, partnering with teammates to drive timely resolution and root cause analysis
 - Contribute to the ongoing evolution of the automation framework, improving product quality, test coverage, and release confidence over time

What We're Looking For

- 2-5 years of professional automation development experience, with real framework-building work, not just script writing
 - Strong Python skills, with hands-on experience designing automation frameworks, Pytest-based test suites, CLI tools, and endpoint validation scenarios
 - Comfort building and running automation across Windows, macOS, and Linux, with an understanding of how platform differences affect framework design
 - Experience designing, developing, and maintaining automation solutions that improve product quality, reliability, and engineering efficiency
 - Working knowledge of AWS, including EC2 launch types, S3, CloudWatch logs, metrics, and alarms, and IAM roles, policies, and security controls

 - Familiarity with Docker-based development and build environments

Nice to Have

- Ansible for fleet configuration and provisioning
 - Exposure to cybersecurity products, distributed systems, or SaaS platforms
 - Experience with databases and SQL queries, or Bazel
 - Experience with VMware, Hyper-V, or AWS or Azure infrastructure

Benefits

All wolves receive compelling compensation and benefits packages, including: 

- Equity for all employees 
 - 18 days annual leave, flexible holidays & festivals, and paid volunteer days 
 - Training and career development programs 
 - Comprehensive private benefits plan including medical insurance for you and your family, life insurance (3x compensation), and personal accident insurance. 
 - A modern workplace in Helios Business Park in Bengaluru

Security Requirements

At Arctic Wolf, protecting our people, customers, and data is fundamental to how we operate. All employees are expected to uphold our commitment to security, privacy, and compliance by following internal information security policies, standards, and controls designed to safeguard the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of business, customer, employee, and other confidential information and to support compliance with applicable legal and regulatory requirements. 

Depending on the role and where permitted by applicable law, employment may be subject to background verification and additional regulatory, security, or compliance requirements, including obligations related to data protection and export control laws, and authorization requirements where applicable. 

Your next big opportunity starts here - apply today and help us end cyber risk.

The Windows Enterprise and Security (ENS) team builds foundational capabilities that keep the Windows client and server operating systems secure and trusted at global scale. ENS spans core Windows security investments such as hardwarebacked security, cryptography, identity and authentication, and enterprisegrade management capabilities-critical to keeping Windows dependable for customers across enterprises and governments. 

As a Senior Software Engineer in ENS India, you will design and ship security and enterprise features that land broadly across the Windows ecosystem. You'll work closely with partner teams (including engineering counterparts in Redmond) to build secure-by-design, reliable-by-default solutions that meet the bar for global deployment.

Work on security and enterprise capabilities that protect billions of Windows users and the enterprises that depend on Windows. 

Build foundational security and management features that shape Windows' trust model and long-term platform resilience.

As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

data.title: SDET Analyst
data.description:
Job Description

Summary of This Role

Performs and participates in application development and testing to apply continuous quality and testability of code throughout the software development lifecycle. Builds quality within the software development process with automated testing suites providing a comprehensive view from code quality to functionality. Uses quality paradigms to provide real time quality with use of automation and frequent regression testing. Designs / develops and maintains automation frameworks and automation test suites and scripts with continuous integration, testing, deployment and delivery. Conducts performance, load, security and service virtualization testing. 

What Part Will You Play?

- Participates in all steps of the software development life cycle and is accountable for producing quality code. Participates within a collaborative software development approach to identify and recommend practices for quality assurance at the source using automation. Conducts basic impact analysis, evaluates and identifies affects to regression test suites, testability of code, and application performance to reduce negative influences on continuous testing. Performs quality checks along with updating of automation scripts. Identifies and designs basic testing suites for test driven development (TDD) and behavior driven development (BDD) to allow early and frequent testing as the software is developed. 
 - Writes and executes moderately complex application tests at the source code level to prevent hidden errors (i. e. , white box testing) within unit and component testing. Identifies and suggests moderate improvements for code quality to improve deficiencies from functionality through structure of code for performance and maintainability. Builds, maintains and reviews mid-level unit and component test suites and conducts automated white box tests. Identifies basic improper coding and code quality issues. Integrates white box test suites with continuous integration (CI) tools. Programs and creates basic to mid-level test cases using unit and component testing tools for code level testing. 
 - Develops standard software tools, frameworks and utilities for validation / verification activities and end-to-end functional testing of software. Identifies and recommends tools and frameworks for testing and creates automated tools for generic use and maintainability. Writes standard code that uses / exercises non-user interface (UI) components like application program interface's (API's), representational state transfer API (RESTful API), and web services similar to the end user to develop frameworks for testing. Integrates automated suites with continuous integration (CI) tools for frequent execution. 
 - Installs and uses basic to moderately complex CI frameworks in continuous testing and continuous deployment / delivery. Builds, customizes, and deploys basic to moderately complex test environments and test automation frameworks. Performs basic to moderately complex scripting, data generation, and other methods to maintain automation infrastructure throughout the development. Integrates CI tools with other testing infrastructure and develops basic to moderately complex reporting / metrics on CI. 
 - Uses performance, load, security, and service virtualization testing tools to conduct basic testing, analysis and results interpretation. Builds, scripts, and generates data used in testing. Analyzes moderately complex system performance and responses during loads. Applies a basic knowledge of procedures, methodology and/or application standards to include payment card industry and security related compliance to testing activities using automation. Applies knowledge of service virtualization concepts and its applicability for application testing. 
 - Works with stakeholders, business, developers and other analysts to develop test plans, conditions and cases (set of inputs, execution preconditions, and expected outcomes developed for a particular objective, such as to exercise a particular program path or to verify compliance with a specific requirement) to be used in testing, and learns to perform test data conditioning and execution of test sets. Begins to build a base knowledge of using multiple environments to validate test conditions and reviews data values while learning the various components of the systems and the applications. Reports, tracks defects and defect resolutions, closure and participates in root cause analysis. 
 - Acts as a single point of contact for assigned small, less complex client projects with regard to test activities. Coordinates the test activities assigned to the test team to include, reviewing of client test plans cases and scripts, prioritizing test execution when necessary and providing feedback to internal and external clients. 
 -

What Are We Looking For in This Role?

Minimum Qualifications

- Bachelor's Degree - Software Engineering, Information Systems or other Technical degree; additional experience in lieu of degree will be considered
 - Typically Minimum 2 Years Relevant Exp - Professional experience with software testing, coding, designing, and developing

Preferred Qualifications

- Master's Degree - Software Engineering, Information Systems or other Technical degree
 - Typically Minimum 4 Years Relevant Exp - Experience developing automated testing strategies in a variety of environments and frameworks

What Are Our Desired Skills and Capabilities?

- SKILLS / KNOWLEDGE - Developing professional expertise, applies company policies and procedures to resolve a variety of issues. 
 - JOB COMPLEXITY - Works on problems of moderate scope where analysis of situations or data requires a review of a variety of factors. Exercises judgment within defined procedures and practices to determine appropriate action. Builds productive internal/external working relationships. 
 - SUPERVISION - Normally receives general instructions on routine work, detailed instructions on new projects or assignments. 
 - Software Development Life Cycle / Testing Methodologies - Agile - Scrum, Kanban, Test Driven Development, Behavior Driven Development, etc. 
 - Programming Languages - Java, selenium, C#, Perl, Python, Groovy, Oracle, SQL, etc. 
 - Testing tools - Application Lifecycle Management, Unit Testing, Security, Application Programming Interface, Mobile, Continuous Integration, harness, Service Virtualization, etc.

This is a high-impact, high-ownership role.  - Strong understanding of ETL/ELT architecture, data pipelines, data integration, data transformation, orchestration, and full/incremental data-load patterns. 
 - Experience working with Oracle Fusion application data, FDI extensions, enterprise reporting requirements, and custom data integrations. 
 - Strong understanding of data warehousing, dimensional modeling, semantic modeling, data integration architecture, and analytical/reporting architectures. 
 - Experience with data validation, reconciliation, data-quality controls, source-to-target mapping, logging, monitoring, and observability. 
 - Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills with experience in production support, root-cause analysis, performance tuning, and resolution of complex data and analytics issues. 
 - Experience supporting development through production lifecycle activities, including design, development, testing, UAT, deployment, upgrades, releases, migrations, and production stabilization. 
 - Understanding of cloud data architecture, data sharing, security, governance, metadata, performance, and operational reliability. 
 - Familiarity with software and data engineering best practices, including Git/version control, code reviews, development standards, documentation, and CI/CD concepts. 
 - Ability to lead technical discussions, guide developers, review technical designs, identify technical risks and dependencies, and drive solutions across multiple teams. 
 - Strong collaboration and communication skills with the ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions and communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

data.description:
For more than 30 years, SonicWall  has delivered a partner-first unified cybersecurity portfolio that helps SMBs, MSPs, and IT teams consolidate network security, endpoint security, security service edge (SSE), and threat response across hybrid environments. By bringing connected technology, real-time threat intelligence, automation, and expert services together, SonicWall helps organizations simplify security operations, achieve better security outcomes, and lower total cost of ownership. Backed by a global ecosystem of more than 17, 000 partners, SonicWall delivers enterprise-grade protection built for SMB and mid-market realities.   

For more information, visit www. sonicwall. com or follow us on X, LinkedIn, Facebook, and Instagram.   

Role OverviewWe are looking for an experienced and technically strong Senior QA Manager to own end-to-end quality for cloud applications, cloud security products, and associated services. 

This is a high-impact leadership role responsible for defining the quality strategy, driving automation and test infrastructure investments, and partnering closely with Product Management, Engineering, DevOps, Cloud Infrastructure, Security, Release Engineering, and Support teams to ensure high standards of reliability, scalability, security, and customer trust. 

The role requires a strong understanding of cloud applications and distributed systems, along with good networking and security fundamentals. You will help shape how quality is built into the product lifecycle, from requirements and architecture reviews through continuous testing, release readiness, production validation, and post-release improvements. 

Key ResponsibilitiesQuality Strategy & Release Ownership

 - Drive testing for high transaction volumes, concurrent users, API scalability, service interactions, resource utilization, failover, recovery, and scaling. 
 - Establish performance and reliability benchmarks for major releases. 
 - Partner with Engineering and Cloud Infrastructure teams to identify performance and scalability risks. Execution Excellence & Metrics

 - Defect leakage and escape rate

 - Release quality and predictability
 - Production incident trends
 - Customer-impacting defects
 - Lead release readiness and quality reviews with senior stakeholders. 
 - Drive root cause analysis for production escapes and systemic quality gaps. 
 - Convert production and customer learnings into preventive quality improvements. People Leadership & Stakeholder Influence
 - Build, mentor, and retain a strong QA organization comprising leads and senior engineers. 
 - Lead and scale geographically distributed QA/Quality Engineering teams. 
 - Set clear expectations, career paths, technical growth plans, and performance goals. 
 - Develop technical and leadership capabilities within the QA organization. 
 - Influence Engineering, Product Management, DevOps, Cloud Infrastructure, and Security leadership to prioritize quality and customer impact. 
 - Represent QA in leadership forums, customer escalations, incident reviews, and cross-functional initiatives. 
 - Foster a culture of ownership, engineering excellence, automation, and continuous improvement. Required Skills & Experience
 - 10-12+ years of experience in software QA/Quality Engineering, with 4+ years in QA leadership or people management. 
 - Strong experience testing cloud applications, SaaS products, distributed systems, or cloud security products. 
 - Good understanding of cloud, networking, and security fundamentals. 
 - Working knowledge of TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, TLS/SSL, routing, load balancing, proxies, VPNs, and network security concepts. 
 - Understanding of cloud networking concepts such as VPC/VNet, subnets, security groups, firewalls, and private/public connectivity.

 - Experience owning quality for complex software releases. 
 - Proven experience managing and developing QA teams. 
 - Strong automation and CI/CD experience. 
 - Experience with performance, scalability, resiliency, and reliability testing. 
 - Good understanding of security testing and secure software development practices. 
 - Excellent communication, collaboration, and stakeholder-management skills. Good to Have
 - Experience with AWS, Azure, or GCP. 
 - Experience with SaaS and multi-tenant applications. 
 - Experience testing cloud security or cybersecurity products. 
 - Experience with Kubernetes, containers, and cloud-native architectures. 
 - Exposure to security testing and vulnerability assessment. 
 - Exposure to SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, FIPS, or similar compliance programs. 
 - Experience with observability, monitoring, logging, and production diagnostics. 
 - Experience handling customer escalations and production incident RCA. 
 - Experience using AI/ML for test automation, test generation, defect analysis, or quality engineering. What Success Looks Like

data.title: Lead Validation Engineer
data.description:
Job Description Summary

Responsable de la conception, du développement et du test des logiciels intégrés (micrologiciels), des plates-formes et des systèmes contrôlant et fonctionnant sur des périphériques devant être adaptés aux besoins du matériel qu'ils doivent contrôler et sur lequel ils doivent s'exécuter (c'est-à-dire qui contrôle directement les fonctions en temps réel d'un dispositif physique tel que des moteurs, des alternateurs, des vannes, des ventilateurs et d'autres dispositifs et produits). Cela nécessite généralement une compréhension approfondie des caractéristiques du périphérique physique contrôlé, des fonctions en temps réel qu'il est censé exécuter, ainsi que la capacité de concevoir, de développer, d'implémenter et de tester la logique et les logiciels nécessaires à l'exécution de la fonctionnalité temps réel. Habituellement adapté aux produits et services de divers comptes de résultat. Exerce une influence sur les opérations département et est responsable de la planification et/ou de l'exécution. Ce rôle jouit d'une certaine autonomie, mais est axé sur l'exécution d'activités au sein d'une discipline opérationnelle couverte par les pratiques et procédures fonctionnelles standard. Un certain discernement peut être nécessaire, mais généralement dans le cadre d'une orientation. 

Job Description

Rôles et responsabilités

- Conçoit, design et/ou programme/développe un petit module ou un grand composant, une fonctionnalité, un ensemble de fonctionnalités, une zone de fonctionnalités complète ou un produit logiciel intégré complet. Les domaines d'expertise peuvent inclure, sans toutefois s'y limiter, les réseaux, les systèmes d'exploitation, la cybersécurité, les bases de données ou les applications. Peut être responsable de la création d'un produit entier. [Les petites équipes utiliseront ce rôle pour inclure toutes les phases du cycle de conception/développement jusqu'à la sortie]
 - Développer une connaissance approfondie d'une discipline technique. Se fonde sur une expérience antérieure et une expertise technique acquise pour mettre en œuvre une politique/stratégie. 
 - Compréhension approfondie des principaux facteurs opérationnels ; utilise cette compréhension pour accomplir son propre travail. Compréhension approfondie de la manière dont le travail de sa propre équipe s'intègre aux autres équipes et contribue à son domaine. 
 - Fait preuve de discernement et est en capacité de proposer différentes solutions en dehors des paramètres définis, dans le cadre d'une orientation. Se fonde sur une expérience antérieure et la formation professionnelle pour résoudre des tâches simples. Possède les compétences techniques et l'esprit d'analyse nécessaires à la résolution de problèmes. Peut utiliser plusieurs sources internes en dehors de sa propre équipe pour prendre des décisions. 
 - Un poste à ce niveau est susceptible d'être un contributeur individuel, avec des compétences interpersonnelles éprouvées ou un People Leader capable d'embaucher et de développer des talents. Fournit des conseils informels aux nouveaux membres de l'équipe. 

Qualifications De Base

- 
 - Pour les rôles en dehors des États-Unis - Ce rôle nécessite une expérience significative de la fonction et de la station de travail audio numérique. Connaissances de niveau équivalent à une licence dans une université accréditée (ou un baccalauréat avec une expérience dans un domaine pertinent). 
 - Pour les rôles aux États-Unis - Licence d'une université accrédité (ou diplôme d'études secondaires et/ou diplôme d'étude général avec au moins 4 ans d'expérience dans la fonction). 

Caractéristiques souhaitées

- Solides compétences en communication orale et écrite. Solides compétences relationnelles et de leadership. Capacité à influencer les autres et à diriger de petites équipes. Mener des initiatives d'envergure et d'impact modérés. Capacité à coordonner plusieurs projets simultanément. Identification efficace des problèmes et compétences en résolution de problèmes. Capacités d'analyse et d'organisation prouvées. Remarque : Pour se conformer aux exigences légales américaines en matière d'immigration et autres, il est nécessaire de préciser le nombre minimum d'années d'expérience requis pour tout poste basé aux États-Unis. Pour les rôles en dehors des États-Unis, pour assurer la conformité avec la législation applicable, les juristes doivent mentionner le niveau d'expérience requis et non PAS un nombre minimum d'années. Cette description de poste a pour but de fournir un guide détaillé du rôle. Toutefois, il n'est pas prévu de modifier ou de restreindre et/ou d'élargir de quelque manière que ce soit les tâches requises de chaque employé, telles qu'elles sont définies dans leur contrat de travail respectif et/ou convenues d'un commun accord entre un employé et son responsable. 

Additional Information

Relocation Assistance Provided: Yes

data.title: AI Architect
data.description:
Job Description

Shape ZenseAI. QI and ZenseAI. AssureAI

- Architect and evolve the platform suite across both engines: the 18-agent ZenseAI. QI stack (DeepSpeci, CaseGeni, Auto-PlayPilot, DataGeni, Secure-Xi, Perf-Xi, Insights360, RIA and Accessibility Intelligence) and the four-pillar ZenseAI. AssureAI framework (Data Quality, Model Evaluation, Trustworthiness, and Scalability & Security). 
 - Design and refine the archetype-specific assurance lifecycles for Classical ML, Generative AI and Agentic AI, including the signature eight-axis agentic trajectory scorecard graded on every run. 
 - Keep the platforms LLM-agnostic and deployable on any client stack - on-prem, cloud or hybrid - as model-mixing and constant provider churn become the market norm. 
 - Own technical roadmap decisions for accelerators such as the Agentic Foundry (a 25-blueprint reference matrix) and the curated, swap-ready tooling ecosystem around each archetype. 

Lead Evaluation-Driven Development

- Build and govern eval suites - ground-truth Q&A sets, LLM-as-judge rubrics, frozen baselines - that gate every release rather than validate it after the fact. 
 - Own trajectory grading, red/purple/blue-team probes and safety attestations for agentic and generative systems, and drift monitoring and fairness audits for classical ML. 
 - Translate evaluation results into release decisions: eval-threshold gates, red-team severity floors, canary and shadow deployments, and rollback rehearsals. 
 - Bring evaluation-driven development practice into client engagements - showing, not just telling, how a live harness beats a one-time audit. 

Own Presales and Client Proposals

- Respond to RFPs, RFIs and client proposals across both engines, translating client requirements into a defensible solution architecture and commercial structure. 
 - Architect engagements across the full ladder - AI QA Assessment, AI QA Transformation, Managed AI QA - and fast-starts such as the LLM Health Check, Agent Stress Test and Compliance Sprint. 
 - Build estimates, staffing plans and technical win themes that hold up under client and internal scrutiny, across client-managed, risk-reward and Zensar-managed commercial models. 

Present and Articulate Value to Clients

- Present the ZenseAI. QI and ZenseAI. AssureAI value proposition directly to client stakeholders - from QA Directors and Heads of AI/ML Engineering to CTOs, Chief Risk Officers and Chief AI Officers - adapting the narrative to each audience. 
 - Lead client workshops and technical walkthroughs, including guiding a CIO through the Agentic Foundry in a single session. 
 - Build and deliver executive trust scorecards and portfolio risk heat maps that make the assurance story board-ready. 

Represent Zensar in Client Captives for Sales

- Present live in client captive sessions and sales pursuits as the senior technical voice for Quality Intelligence, alongside account and sales leadership. 
 - Run and narrate proof-of-concept demonstrations that turn a client's stated risk into a small, credible proof - the practice's proof-first approach to closing. 
 - Represent the practice at partner and industry forums as the practice's thought leadership and pipeline develop. 

Build Practice IP and Mentor the Next Generation

- Contribute reusable accelerators, reference architectures and industry packs across BFSI, TMT, and Manufacturing & Retail back into the practice's IP base. 
 - Mentor and help build out the practice's emerging AI-specialist roles - Prompt Engineer, LLM-Eval Engineer, Agent Architect, Trajectory Eval Engineer, Knowledge/RAG Engineer, AI Security Analyst and Adversarial Red/Blue Team Lead. 
 - Support GenAI and AI-enablement training for QI associates across the practice. 

Responsibilities

Must-Have

- Approximately 17-21 years of overall technology experience, including a substantial, hands-on foundation in Quality Engineering / Test Engineering - automation architecture, test strategy and the full software testing lifecycle - not AI experimentation layered on top of a thin QE background. 
 - Working architectural knowledge of agentic AI systems: multi-agent orchestration, tool use, memory, and the operational risks specific to agents - unauthorised tool calls, trajectory drift, memory leakage across accounts. 
 - Direct experience with evaluation-driven development: building or governing eval suites, LLM-as-judge frameworks, ground-truth datasets, frozen baselines and red-teaming / adversarial testing for generative or agentic systems. 
 - Strong client-interfacing capability: comfortable owning technical content in an RFP response, presenting to CXO-level stakeholders, and holding the room in a live client or sales captive setting. 
 - Ability to talk convincingly across both deterministic QE and probabilistic AI assurance - the "one estate" narrative is the core sell, and the architect has to embody it, not just recite it. 
 - Familiarity with the regulatory and standards backdrop shaping AI assurance conversations: EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF and ISO/IEC 42001. 

Qualifications

- Approximately 17-21 years of overall technology experience, including a substantial, hands-on foundation in Quality Engineering / Test Engineering - automation architecture, test strategy and the full software testing lifecycle - not AI experimentation layered on top of a thin QE background. 
 - Working architectural knowledge of agentic AI systems: multi-agent orchestration, tool use, memory, and the operational risks specific to agents - unauthorised tool calls, trajectory drift, memory leakage across accounts.

About Us

Part of the $4. 8 billion RPG Group, we're a community of 10, 000+ innovators across 30+ global locations, including Milpitas, Seattle, Princeton, Cape Town, London, Zurich, Singapore, and Mexico City. Lead Network Engineer
data.description:
BETSOL is a cloud-first digital transformation and data management company offering products and IT services to enterprises in over 40 countries. BETSOL team holds several engineering patents, is recognized with industry awards, and BETSOL maintains a net promoter score that is 2x the industry average. 

BETSOL's open source backup and recovery product line, Zmanda (Zmanda. com), delivers up to 50% savings in total cost of ownership (TCO) and best-in-class performance. 

BETSOL Global IT Services (BETSOL. com) builds and supports end-to-end enterprise solutions, reducing time-to-market for its customers. 

BETSOL offices are set against the vibrant backdrops of Broomfield, Colorado and Bangalore, India. 

We take pride in being an employee-centric organization, offering comprehensive health insurance, competitive salaries, volunteer programs, and scholarship opportunities. Office amenities include a fitness center, cafe, and recreational facilities. 

Learn more at betsol. com

Job Description

BETSOL is looking for a Network Lead Engineer to own how that network is designed, secured and evolved. This is a design and build role. You will set the network architecture and standards, lead projects from requirements through cutover, and make the technical calls on routing, segmentation, security and cloud connectivity. Day-to-day monitoring, ticket handling and first- and second-line troubleshooting with our IT and NOC teams; you are the engineering authority they escalate complex design problems to, and the person who removes the root causes so those problems stop recurring. 

Key responsibilities

Architecture and design

- Own the end-to-end network architecture across BETSOL offices, data center and colocation sites, and cloud environments, including target-state designs and a multi-year roadmap. 
 - Design LAN, WAN and SD-WAN topologies, routing (BGP, OSPF), segmentation and high-availability patterns, and document them as reference architectures and high- and low-level designs. 
 - Design hybrid and multi-cloud connectivity for Azure and AWS: VNet/VPC architecture, hub-and-spoke and transit designs, ExpressRoute or Direct Connect, site-to-site VPN and private endpoints. 
 - Define network standards: addressing and IP management, naming, configuration baselines, hardware and software lifecycle, and capacity planning. 

Network security and zero trust

- Design and own next-generation firewall policy architecture, micro-segmentation and secure remote access. 
 - Lead the move toward a zero trust and SASE model, including secure web gateway and private access services, in partnership with the security team. 
 - Build network controls and evidence that satisfy ISO/IEC 27001 audits and customer security reviews, and remediate network findings from vulnerability scans and penetration tests. 
 - Design DNS, DDoS protection, web application firewall and load-balancing patterns for internet-facing services. 

Project leadership and delivery

- Lead network projects such as office build-outs, data center migrations, SD-WAN rollouts, firewall refreshes and cloud landing zones, from requirements and design through implementation and cutover. 
 - Write implementation and rollback plans, lead change reviews, and execute or supervise high-risk changes during planned windows. 
 - Evaluate vendors and technologies, run proofs of concept, and produce build-versus-buy recommendations with cost estimates. 
 - Work with cloud, DevOps, security and application teams so network design is part of solution design from the start, not an afterthought. 

Automation and engineering excellence

- Automate configuration, compliance checks and provisioning using Python, Ansible and Terraform, and manage network configuration as code with version control. 
 - Define observability for the network (telemetry, flow data, synthetic checks and meaningful alerts) so operations teams detect issues before users do. 
 - Act as the final technical escalation point for complex design-level problems, lead root cause analysis, and drive permanent architectural fixes. 
 - Mentor network engineers, review their designs and changes, and build runbooks and knowledge so the operations team can run the network independently. 

Qualifications

Required qualifications

- 8+ years of network engineering experience, including at least 2 years in a lead or architect capacity owning designs and projects end to end. 
 - Deep expertise in routing and switching (BGP, OSPF, VLANs, VRFs, QoS) and enterprise WAN or SD-WAN design. 
 - Hands-on design experience with next-generation firewalls such as Palo Alto, Fortinet or Cisco, including policy architecture and segmentation. 
 - Practical cloud networking experience in Azure and/or AWS, including hybrid connectivity. 
 - Network automation skills with Python and Ansible or Terraform. 
 - CCNP Enterprise or CCNP Security, or an equivalent professional-level certification. 
 - Strong written design documentation and the ability to explain trade-offs, cost and risk to technical and non-technical leaders. 
 - Network Certifications such as CCNP, CCIE, CCDE or equivalent (Azure Network Engineer Associate, AWS Advanced Networking etc. ). 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with zero trust and SASE platforms such as Zscaler, Prisma Access or Netskope. 
 - Experience with Kubernetes networking, service mesh or cloud load balancers. 
 - Familiarity with ISO/IEC 27001, SOC 2 network controls and audit evidence. 
 - Experience in an IT services or managed services company supporting multiple customer environments.
