Company Description Texila American University Consortium (TAU-C), based in India, is the holding company for a group of global educational institutions, including Texila American University Guyana, Texila American University Zambia, and Texila e-Learning. The consortium delivers a wide range of academic and professional programs designed to meet international standards in higher education. TAU-C and its subsidiaries currently educate and train over 4, 000 students from more than 70 countries, creating a diverse and multicultural learning environment. Team members at TAU-C contribute to shaping educational experiences for learners worldwide and supporting the growth of the consortium's global footprint. 

Role Description The Assistant Team Lead - Admissions is a full-time, on-site role located in Coimbatore. This role supports the admissions team in managing the end-to-end admissions process, including responding to inquiries, guiding prospective learners through application requirements, and ensuring timely follow-up. The Assistant Team Lead helps coordinate and assign daily tasks to admission associates, monitors application pipelines, and maintains accurate records in admissions systems. They collaborate with academic and administrative departments to align admissions decisions with program criteria and institutional policies. The role also involves contributing to outreach initiatives, improving applicant experience, preparing regular admission reports, and supporting continuous process improvement within the admissions function.

 - Drive lead conversion and ensure achievement of individual and team admission targets. 
 - Monitor daily follow-ups, lead pipelines, applications, and admission closures. 
 - Ensure timely and accurate processing of student applications and documentation. 
 - Coordinate with academic, finance, and other internal departments. 
 - Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly admission performance reports. 
 - Handle escalated student and parent queries professionally. 
 - Support team training, performance improvement, and operational efficiency. Eligibility & Experience

data.title: Solutions Architect II, Direct Tax Technology
data.description:
Description

Are you passionate about transforming tax technology through innovation? Amazon's Direct Tax Technology team is seeking a Solutions Architect II to revolutionize how tax professionals work. In this role, you'll leverage modern technologies including Python and generative AI to design and implement solutions that empower Amazon's Direct Tax Reporting and Compliance organization. You'll tackle complex technical challenges at unprecedented scale, building world-class systems that drive efficiency and enable tax professionals to meet Amazon's unique global challenges. 

This is an opportunity to make a significant impact by architecting solutions that transform tax operations for one of the world's most innovative companies. You'll work at the intersection of tax domain expertise and modern cloud technologies, creating elegant technical solutions that directly improve how Amazon's tax team operates at a global scale. 

Key job responsibilities

Design and implement scalable tax technology solutions using Python, generative AI, and modern development practices to solve complex tax processing challenges

Define front-end architectures and user experiences, owning specific technical components while establishing best practices for model development and solution design

Collaborate with tax professionals, Product Managers, and fellow Solutions Architects to translate customer requirements into technical specifications that engineering teams can execute

Lead end-to-end solution architecture for tax technology projects, including planning, design, implementation, testing, and continuous process improvement as part of an autonomous team

Mentor and develop other Solutions Architects by sharing technical expertise, facilitating knowledge transfer, and contributing to team growth through code reviews and technical guidance

A day in the life

Your day blends creative problem-solving with hands-on technical work. You might start by architecting a generative AI solution to streamline tax compliance workflows, then collaborate with tax professionals to refine user experience requirements. After lunch, you'll dive into Python modeling to optimize data processing pipelines, followed by a design review where you mentor junior architects on best practices. The afternoon could include troubleshooting a technical challenge with your team, contributing to solution planning, and ending with a customer workshop where you demonstrate how new capabilities will transform their tax operations. 

About The Team

The Direct Tax Technology team sits within Amazon's Tax organization and is dedicated to supporting tax professionals in the Tax Reporting and Compliance group with innovative technology solutions and streamlined processes. Our team tackles the unique and complex challenges that come with operating at Amazon's scale, building systems that enhance processing efficiency and empower our internal customers. 

We foster a culture of innovation and collaboration where technical excellence meets business impact. Our mission is to continuously evolve tax technology capabilities, ensuring our tax professionals have the tools they need to succeed. Join a team where your work directly influences how Amazon manages tax compliance and reporting, and where you'll have opportunities to explore emerging technologies like generative AI while growing your skills alongside talented engineers and architects. 

Basic Qualifications

- 4+ years of specific technology domain areas (e. g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience
 - 2+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
 - 10+ years of IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries experience

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience working within software development or Internet-related industries
 - Experience migrating or transforming legacy customer solutions to the cloud
 - Experience working with AWS technologies from a dev/ops perspective

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https: //amazon. jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you're applying in isn't listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

data.title: AI Tech solution Architect
data.description:
Overview

We are looking for a Product Architect for our Image recognition solution, responsible for the end-to-end technical architecture of the product. You will bridge product strategy and engineering execution, defining how the product scales across markets, integrates with enterprise systems, and evolves with AI/CV innovation. This role works in close partnership with the Global Lead, mobile/SDK engineering team, Backend engineering, data science teams, and S&T leadership. You will own architecture decisions across mobile, backend, cloud infrastructure, ML inference, and data pipelines - ensuring the platform meets global security, compliance, and performance standards while remaining agile enough to support continuous market deployments. 

Responsibilities

Platform Architecture & Design

- Define and maintain the end-to-end technical architecture for the IR product across mobile, API, ML pipeline, and cloud layers
 - Design scalable, multi-region cloud infrastructure on Azure (API Management, Blob Storage, Azure Functions, Cosmos DB, KubeRay/Ray Serve)
 - Lead architecture decisions for mobile app features, edge/cloud validation modes, and offline-first mobile scenarios
 - Ensure architecture supports high-volume concurrent field usage for global markets
 - Define data contracts, API schemas, and integration patterns between mobile app, SDK, backend services, and Salesforce apps

AI/CV Integration & Innovation

- Architect the ML inference pipeline for computer vision models including SKU detection, planogram compliance, and share-of-shelf measurement
 - Design model deployment and versioning strategies using KubeRay/Ray Serve or equivalent orchestration platforms
 - Collaborate with data science teams to establish model accuracy baselines, A/B testing frameworks, and continuous learning pipelines
 - Evaluate and integrate emerging AI capabilities - including LLMs, VLMs, and agentic AI - into the IR Product platform roadmap

Mobile & Integration Architecture

- Define iOS and Android architecture standards for geo-fencing, image capture, local caching, and sync behaviour
 - Establish mobile contractor technical standards, code review frameworks, and platform-specific constraints documentation
 - Design Salesforce integration patterns for field rep workflows, task assignments, and audit result reporting
 - Architect authentication, session management, and device-level security controls for global field deployments

Infrastructure, Reliability & Security

- Own infrastructure architecture for reliability, fault tolerance, and disaster recovery - including GCS fault tolerance and Redis integration for KubeRay head pod stability
 - Define storage architecture and lifecycle policies to address accumulation issues (zip files, image blobs, log data) at scale
 - Conduct root cause analysis (RCA) for critical infrastructure incidents and produce executive-grade escalation documentation
 - Ensure infrastructure architecture meets GDPR, India DPDP Act, and market-specific data privacy regulations for GPS and biometric data

Data Governance & Compliance Architecture

- Design privacy-by-design data flows for GPS location data, field rep identifiers, and store imagery in compliance with GDPR, DPDP, and other applicable frameworks
 - Define data residency, data minimisation, and retention policies across global cloud deployments
 - Establish security architecture standards for mobile app communications, API authentication, and cloud storage access controls

Stakeholder Engagement & Documentation

- Produce clear, executive-facing architecture documentation, TRDs (Technical Requirements Documents) in partnership with the Global PM
 - Present architecture proposals and trade-off analyses to leadership and cross-functional stakeholders
 - Mentor Engineering team on product architecture standards and best practices
 - Maintain a living architecture registry - covering system diagrams, ADRs (Architecture Decision Records), and integration maps

Qualifications

Experience

- 12-15+ years in software/product architecture roles, with at least 3 years in mobile-first or AI/ML-integrated platforms
 - Proven experience architecting cloud-native platforms on Azure (API Management, Functions, Blob Storage, Cosmos DB)
 - Hands-on experience with ML inference infrastructure - KubeRay, Ray Serve, TorchServe, or equivalent
 - Strong background in mobile architecture for iOS and/or Android, including offline-first design patterns
 - Experience with computer vision, image recognition, or retail execution platforms strongly preferred
 - Prior exposure to FMCG, CPG, or retail technology platforms is a significant advantage

Technical Skills

- Cloud: Azure (primary), AWS/GCP (secondary) - infrastructure design, cost optimisation
 - Mobile: iOS (Swift/Objective-C), Android (Kotlin/Java), cross-platform considerations (React Native, Flutter)
 - ML/AI: Model serving pipelines, MLOps practices, CV model deployment (object detection, classification)
 - Integration: REST APIs, event-driven architectures (Kafka, Service Bus)
 - Data: Cosmos DB, PostgreSQL, Data bricks, cloud storage lifecycle management, data governance frameworks
 - DevOps: Kubernetes, Docker, CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure monitoring and alerting

Soft Skills & Behaviours

- Exceptional ability to translate complex technical architecture into clear, business-relevant narratives for executive audiences
 - Strong cross-functional collaborator - equally effective with product managers, data scientists, field operations leads, and compliance teams
 - Demonstrated ownership mindset - proactively identifies risks, escalates with solutions, and drives resolution end-to-end
 - Comfortable operating in ambiguous, multi-market environments with competing priorities
 - Excellent written communication - capable of producing publication-quality TRDs, PRDs, and architecture decision records

data.title: Head of Data Science GSC
data.description:
Job Title: Head of Data Science, India GSC

- We are looking for a principal-level developer who still wants to build and cares deeply about design. You will develop the user experience, APIs and supporting services for an internal platform that helps people across Asset Management understand the data behind business processes and improve its quality. Based in the Data and Analytics Office, you will work closely with business users and collaborate with data, AI and Technology colleagues to turn ideas into useful software. Technology leads production deployment and ongoing service operation, so you will build in partnership with them to the standards required for a secure, scalable and supported product. 

In This Role, You Will

This role suits you if you: 

- build complete web applications with modern TypeScript front ends (whether Angular, React or Vue) and Python services behind them, deployed through pipelines to the cloud; 
 - have shipped applications to production that people use, and can show the results; 
 - care about design as much as code, and simplifying things is your instinct; 
 - are comfortable developing within a business-led data team while collaborating closely with Technology to bring applications into production; 
 - have a history of building and launching things, at work or in your own time, and a portfolio that shows it. 
 - It is unlikely to suit you if your recent role has been mainly architecture or oversight rather than hands-on coding, if you have not built Python back-end services, or if you have worked on only one side of the stack. Experience beyond the core profile is welcome, but it cannot replace it. 

Build data applications end to end

- Design and build the platform from interface to data layer, including TypeScript front ends (Angular or React), Python services and APIs (FastAPI ), and the data access, integration and transformation code behind them. 
 - Translate loosely defined business and user needs into pragmatic designs and working software, iterating with users from prototype to pilot and, with Technology, into supported production services. 
 - Architect for scale and change with clean service boundaries, performance under real load, and code that stays easy to extend as the platform grows. 
 - Work with Technology colleagues on cloud deployment (Google Cloud), automated CI/CD pipelines, monitoring and the requirements for a secure and supported production service. 
 - Build reusable components, API patterns and templates that make each subsequent platform capability faster to deliver. 

Design Experiences People Want To Use

- Own UX and UI end to end. Understand business users' needs, sketch and test flows, and take designs from wireframe to polished interface without depending on a separate design team. 
 - Simplify relentlessly, turning business processes, metadata, ownership, lineage, data-quality rules and exceptions into clear, intuitive views, and personalise experiences to each user's role and needs. 
 - Design iteratively, using usage analytics and user feedback to measure engagement and refine what works. 
 - Establish a design system and front-end patterns, built to accessibility standards (WCAG 2. 2 AA). 

Work with data , technology and AI colleagues

- Work with Data Architecture and Governance and Data Product Owners so platform capabilities reflect agreed data models, definitions, ownership and controls. 
 - Partner closely with Technology architects, engineers and service colleagues on solution design, integration, security, deployment and support. Technology will lead production readiness, controlled release and ongoing service operation. 
 - Bring the work of data scientists and AI specialists into the platform where it adds value, with appropriate APIs, guardrails and telemetry.

data.title: New Product Development Manager
data.description:
Job description

Position Overview: 

We are looking for an experienced Manager New Product Development (Appliances) to lead the end-to-end development and launch of new home and kitchen appliance products. The ideal candidate must have strong hands-on experience in the appliances category, including product development, vendor/OEM management, product specifications, sampling, testing, costing, compliance, commercialization and new product launches. The role will work closely with vendors and internal cross-functional teams to bring innovative, reliable, safe and commercially viable appliance products to market. 

Key Responsibilities: 

- Appliances Category Development: Drive new product development specifically for home and kitchen appliances, with a strong understanding of product functionality, consumer use cases, category trends, and technical requirements. 
 - Market Research & Consumer Insights: Conduct market research, analyze customer feedback, ratings, reviews, complaints and category trends to identify new product opportunities and improvements to existing products. 
 - New Product Launch Management: Own and coordinate end-to-end new product launches from concept identification and product specification through sampling, validation, commercialization and market launch. 
 - Product Specification Development: Define detailed product specifications including wattage, voltage, capacity, material, motor or heating performance, safety features, accessories, functionality and user requirements. 
 - Competitive Benchmarking: Benchmark competitor appliances across features, specifications, technology, performance, design, price points, customer ratings, reviews and pain points to develop differentiated products. 
 - Vendor / OEM / ODM Development: Identify, evaluate, onboard, and manage domestic and international appliance manufacturers, OEMs, and ODM partners based on capability, quality, cost, capacity, compliance and delivery performance. 
 - Vendor Management & Coordination: Maintain strong vendor relationships, follow up on development timelines, resolve technical and commercial issues, and ensure timely completion of samples, tooling, pilot production and bulk production. 
 - Sample Development & Validation: Manage multiple sample iterations, coordinate testing, capture feedback, drive design and engineering corrections, and ensure final golden-sample approval before commercialization. 
 - Technical Evaluation & Product Testing: Work closely with QA and vendors to evaluate product performance, durability, electrical safety, usability, reliability and functional consistency prior to launch. 
 - Compliance & Certification: Coordinate applicable regulatory and compliance requirements for electrical appliances, including BIS/ISI, product safety, testing, labeling, packaging and other statutory requirements as relevant. 
 - Costing & Commercial Negotiation: Work with vendors on BOM understanding, target costing, tooling and mould costs, MOQ, lead time, payment terms and commercial negotiations to achieve desired cost and margin targets. 
 - Pilot & Mass Production Readiness: Coordinate pilot batches, pre-production validation, manufacturing readiness, quality checkpoints and smooth transition from development to mass production. 
 - Quality & Reliability Improvement: Analyze product failures, customer complaints, returns, warranty concerns, ratings, and reviews to identify root causes and implement corrective and preventive actions with vendors. 
 - Return Reduction: Develop product-level actions to reduce customer-initiated returns by addressing quality, functionality, usability, packaging and expectation-related issues. 
 - Packaging & Branding Coordination: Collaborate with packaging, brand, and design teams to ensure appliance packaging protects the product, communicates specifications clearly, complies with labeling requirements and optimizes cost and volumetric weight. 
 - Innovation & Product Roadmap: Identify emerging appliance technologies, features, consumer needs, and category opportunities to build a strong new product pipeline and long-term category roadmap. 
 - Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with QA, Procurement, Packaging, Ecommerce, Marketing, Supply Chain, Customer Care, Finance and other stakeholders to ensure successful product commercialization. 
 - Project Management: Manage multiple appliance development projects simultaneously with clear milestones, timelines, risk tracking, dependencies, stakeholder updates and launch ownership. 
 - Post-launch Performance Monitoring: Track early-stage product performance, customer feedback, defects, reviews, service issues and returns after launch and drive timely improvements wherever required. 

Mandatory Experience & Qualifications: 

- Bachelors degree in Engineering, Electrical / Electronics Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Business Administration, Product Management, or a related field. 
 - Minimum 5-10 years of experience in New Product Development / Product Management, with mandatory hands-on experience in the Home / Kitchen Appliances category. 
 - Candidates must have worked on appliance products such as mixer grinders, blenders, choppers, induction cooktops, electric kettles, air fryers, rice cookers, OTGs or similar electrical home appliances. 
 - Proven experience in handling end-to-end new product launch initiatives from concept / sourcing stage through commercialization and market launch. 
 - Strong experience in vendor, OEM, or ODM management, including vendor evaluation, development follow-up, negotiation, quality coordination and production readiness. 
 - Good understanding of appliance specifications, product testing, electrical safety, regulatory requirements, quality parameters and manufacturing processes. 
 - Strong analytical, problem-solving, negotiation and project-management skills. 
 - Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to work effectively across cross-functional teams. 
 - Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment while maintaining strong attention to detail. 

Preferred Exposure: 

- Experience working with consumer durable, D2C, ecommerce, kitchen appliance, or home appliance brands. 
 - Exposure to domestic and/or international supplier sourcing and product development. 
 - Experience in cost optimization, value engineering, tooling, mould development and product improvement projects. Interested folks please post your resumes to hr_team@theindusvalley. in

Safe is not a typical corporate environment. We are a high-intensity, mission-driven team. We value builders who want to define a category and work alongside people who are equally committed to excellence. 

- Extreme Ownership: We don't do "not my job. " We hire people who see a gap and own the solution from start to finish.

 - Radical Candor: We move too fast for politics or sugar-coating. We value direct, honest feedback that helps us find the right answer quickly.

The Perks & Ownership: 

We want our team to feel like owners because they are owners. We trust our people to manage their results and their time. 

- Meaningful Equity: Every "Safestar" is a shareholder. You aren't just an employee; you are a partner in our success.

 - Comprehensive Benefits: We provide top-tier medical insurance and wellness benefits to ensure you and your family are well cared for. 
 - Career Trajectory: We are growing aggressively. For high-performers, the path for advancement moves at the speed of your ambition. 

We are seeking an experienced and passionate Android Engineer to join our engineering team. As an SDE II, you will work closely with Design, Product, AI, Backend, and Platform teams to develop and deliver secure, scalable, and high-performance mobile applications that help organizations predict and prevent cyber breaches. 

You will be the primary owner of our Android application, bringing it to feature parity with our iOS app while delivering high-fidelity UI, smooth animations, and a polished user experience.  - Use AI for code generation, debugging, refactoring, test creation, documentation, code reviews, and development acceleration. 
 - Demonstrate strong engineering judgment by reviewing, validating, and improving AI-generated code before production use. 
 - Contribute to Safe's AI-first engineering culture and continuously identify opportunities to improve engineering productivity through AI-assisted workflows. Code Review

- Conduct thorough code reviews to maintain code quality, identify opportunities for improvement, and share constructive feedback with team members. Problem Solving

- Proactively identify gaps, ambiguities, or missing specifications in designs and requirements - propose solutions rather than waiting for clarification. 
 - Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues, identifying root causes and implementing effective solutions. 
 - Analyze production issues and implement preventive measures to improve application stability, reliability, and performance. Collaboration

- Collaborate with the iOS team to ensure visual and behavioral consistency across platforms. 
 - Collaborate closely with Product Managers, Designers, Backend Engineers, Architects, and other stakeholders to ensure alignment between technical solutions and business objectives. 
 - Work effectively across teams to deliver seamless user experiences. Project Execution

- Play a key role in project planning, execution, and timely delivery of features, ensuring adherence to project timelines and scope. 
 - Take ownership of deliverables and drive projects from conception to production. 

Essential Skills/ Qualifications/ Experience: 

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field. 
 - 3-5 years of professional experience in Android application development. 
 - Strong proficiency in Kotlin and Android SDK. 
 - Experience building and shipping production-grade Android applications. 
 - Strong understanding of Android architecture patterns, including MVVM, Clean Architecture, and modular application design. 
 - Experience with Jetpack Compose and modern Android UI development. 
 - Hands-on experience with Coroutines, Flow, and asynchronous programming. 
 - Experience with Hilt dependency injection framework. 
 - Experience in consuming RESTful APIs and integrating backend services. 
 - Strong understanding of mobile application performance optimization and debugging. 
 - Experience with local persistence technologies such as Room. 
 - Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and modern software development practices. 
 - Hands-on experience with AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor, GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or equivalent. 
 - Strong understanding of software engineering fundamentals and the ability to critically evaluate, validate, and improve AI-generated code. 
 - Experience participating in technical design discussions and architecture decisions. 
 - Ability to work in a fast-paced environment with high ownership. 
 - Strong problem-solving and debugging skills. 
 - Experience in converting Figma designs to production screens. 
 - Experience with custom drawing and data visualization on Android (Canvas API, custom Compose drawing, or charting libraries). 

Nice to have: 

- Experience building enterprise SaaS applications. 
 - Experience with Sentry observability tools. 
 - Experience with KMP (Kotlin Multiplatform). 
 - Knowledge of mobile security best practices, authentication, OAuth, SSO, and JWT. 
 - Experience working with cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure. 
 - Experience building AI-native applications or integrating AI/LLM-powered capabilities into mobile applications.

Ever wondered what would a convergence of online and offline advertising systems looks like? Ever wondered how we can bridge the gap between sponsored search, display, video ad formats? Ever thought how we can write our own ad servers which serve billions of requests in near real time?

Our Advertising and Marketing Technology team is building an end-to-end advertising and marketing platform that is key to Walmart's overall growth strategy. We use cutting edge data mining , analytics and optimization algorithms to ingest and analyze Walmart's proprietary online and in-store data, encompassing 95% of American households. Importantly, we build smart data systems that deliver relevant retail ads and experiences that connect our customers with the brands and products they love. 

What You'll Do

Lead the data engineering team in the design, development, and maintenance of our data applications. 

Champion the use of AI in data engineering applications

Lead efforts for engineering and operational excellence

Work with the product team to gather requirements and translate them into technical specifications. 

Architect and implement back end solutions that meet the needs of the business. 

Mentor and coach junior developers on data engineering technologies. 

Set and enforce coding standards and best practices. 

Participate in code reviews and bug fixing. 

Stay up-to-date on the latest data engineering technologies. 

Design, build, test and deploy cutting edge solutions at scale, impacting multi-billion-dollar business. 

Proactively monitor, identify, and escalate issues or root causes of systemic issues

Be the consummate team player with a demonstrable ability to learn quickly. amazing ability to get stuff done. 

Interact with Walmart engineering teams across geographies to leverage expertise and contribute to the tech

Work with data science team to implement data analytics pipelines

Enable data scientists, business and product partners to fully leverage our platform

Lead the discovery phase of medium to large projects to come up with high-level design

What You'll Bring

BE or MS degree in Computer Science or a related technical field and 6+ years experience

Experience with a variety of programming languages and frameworks such as Spark, Hive, BigQuery, Java, Python. 

Experience in bootstrap production and non-prod environments in public/private cloud. 

Solid knowledge of Linux systems with the ability to troubleshoot issues in complex, distributed, multi-tier architectures. Excellent debugging and problem solving capability. 

Good written and verbal communication skills

Experience collaborating with multiple teams

Follows the industry trends in the online world

About Walmart Global Tech

Imagine working in an environment where one line of code can make life easier for hundreds of millions of people. That's what we do at Walmart Global Tech. We're a team of software engineers, data scientists, cybersecurity expert's and service professionals within the world's leading retailer who make an epic impact and are at the forefront of the next retail disruption. People are why we innovate, and people power our innovations. We are people-led and tech-empowered. 

We train our team in the skillsets of the future and bring in experts like you to help us grow. We have roles for those chasing their first opportunity as well as those looking for the opportunity that will define their career. Here, you can kickstart a great career in tech, gain new skills and experience for virtually every industry, or leverage your expertise to innovate at scale, impact millions and reimagine the future of retail. 

Work

Walmart's culture sets us apart, and we know being together helps us innovate, learn and grow great careers. This role is based in our [Bangalore/Chennai] office for daily work, with the flexibility for associates to manage their personal lives. 

Benefits

Beyond our great compensation package, you can receive incentive awards for your performance. Other great perks include a host of best-in-class benefits maternity and parental leave, PTO, health benefits, and much more. 

Belonging

We aim to create a culture where every associate feels valued for who they are, rooted in respect for the individual. Our goal is to foster a sense of belonging, to create opportunities for all our associates, customers and suppliers, and to be a Walmart for everyone. 

At Walmart, our vision is "everyone included. " By fostering a workplace culture where everyone is-and feels-included, everyone wins. Our associates and customers reflect the makeup of all 19 countries where we operate. By making Walmart a welcoming place where all people feel like they belong, we're able to engage associates, strengthen our business, improve our ability to serve customers, and support the communities where we operate. 

Equal Opportunity Employer

Walmart, Inc. , is an Equal Opportunities Employer - By Choice. We believe we are best equipped to help our associates, customers and the communities we serve live better when we really know them. That means understanding, respecting and valuing unique styles, experiences, identities, ideas and opinions - while being inclusive of all people.

data.description:
As CohnReznick grows, so do our career opportunities. As one of the world's top professional services firms, and in support of our global workforce strategy, we're growing our operations in India! We create rewarding careers in advisory, assurance, and tax with team members who value innovation and collaboration in everything they do!

CohnReznick helps organizations optimize performance, manage risk, and maximize value through CohnReznick LLP (assurance services) and CohnReznick Advisory LLC (advisory and tax services). Together, the firm provides leaders with deep industry knowledge and relationships, solutions to address clients' unique business goals and risks, and insight on how emerging market forces can drive opportunity. With offices worldwide, the firm serves organizations around the world as an independent member of Nexia. 

We currently have an exciting career opportunity for an Associate Manager to join the Private Client Services team in our Tax practice. 

CohnReznick is a hybrid firm and most of our professionals are located within a commutable distance to one of our offices. This position is considered hybrid which means team members are expected to be thoughtful and intentional in how they create opportunities for in-person collaboration. While the cadence of in-office presence is determined at the team level, our professionals are encouraged to be in the office/together in person on average 3 days a week. 

JOB LOCATION - Coimbatore

YOUR TEAM. 

This position will support our Tax team and this team Prepares and or Review US Federal Income tax returns of Individuals. 

WHY COHNREZNICK?

At CohnReznick, we're united by a common mission to create opportunity, value, and trust for our clients, our people, and our communities. Whether it's working alongside your peers to solve a client challenge, or volunteering together at the local food bank, there are so many ways to find your "why" at the firm. 

We believe it's important to balance work with everyday life - and make time for enjoyment and fun. We invest in a robust Total Rewards package that includes everything from generous PTO, a flexible work environment, expanded parental leave, extensive learning & development, and even paid time off for employees to volunteer. 

YOUR ROLE. 

Responsibilities include but not limited to: 

- Review complex US federal and state tax returns prepared by Seniors, Associates and Experienced Associates, including individual / Form 1040. 
 - Ensure compliance with firm quality standards, tax regulations, and engagement-specific instructions, maintaining a high level of accuracy and consistency. 
 - Identify technical issues, risks, and process inefficiencies; provide clear, actionable, and value-added review comments to enhance quality and team learning. 
 - Manage day‐to‐day execution of assigned engagements or workstreams under manager oversight. 
 - Coordinate workflow, timelines, and task allocation across seniors and associates. 
 - Monitor progress against budgets and deadlines; proactively identify and flag risks related to capacity, quality, or timing. 
 - Serve as the primary operational point of contact for US teams on assigned engagements. 
 - Lead training sessions and knowledge-sharing initiatives to strengthen team capability in U. S. taxation and processes. 

YOUR EXPERIENCE. 

The successful candidate will have: 

- Strong technical expertise in U. S. taxation and solid understanding of accounting principles. 
 - Proven ability to lead teams, manage deliverables, and collaborate effectively with U. S. stakeholders. 
 - Strong analytical thinking with the ability to proactively identify and resolve risks and issues. 
 - Ability to train, mentor, and develop team members in a structured and scalable manner. 
 - Bachelor's or Master's degree in accounting or related field. 
 - Minimum 5+ years of relevant experience in U. S. taxation
 - Experience with U. S. tax software such as CCH Axcess, Go-System, OneSource, ProSystem, and CCH Engagement/CaseWare

In addition, please take a moment to review our Universal Job Standards. 

Studies have shown that we are less likely to apply to jobs unless we meet every single qualification. At CohnReznick, we are dedicated to building a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace, so if you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we still encourage you to apply. You may be just the right candidate for this or one of our other roles. 

"CohnReznick" is the brand name under which CohnReznick LLP and CohnReznick Advisory LLC and their respective subsidiaries provide professional services. CohnReznick LLP and CohnReznick Advisory LLC (and their respective subsidiaries) practice in an alternative practice structure in accordance with the AICPA Code of Professional Conduct and applicable law, regulations, and professional standards. CohnReznick LLP is a licensed CPA firm that provides attest services to its clients. CohnReznick Advisory LLC provides tax and business consulting services to its clients. CohnReznick Advisory LLC and its subsidiaries are not licensed CPA firms. 

CohnReznick is an equal opportunity employer, committed to a diverse and inclusive team to drive business results and create a better future every day for our team members, clients, partners, and communities. We believe a diverse workforce allows us to match our growth ambitions and drive inclusion across the business. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, or protected veteran status and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability.

data.title: Principal Engineer, AI
data.description:
At SAFE Security, our mission is bold and ambitious: We Will Build CyberAGI - a super-specialized system of intelligence that autonomously predicts, detects, and remediates threats. This isn't just a vision-it's the future we're building every day, with the best minds in AI, cybersecurity, and risk. At SAFE, we empower individuals and teams with the freedom and responsibility to align their goals, ensuring we all move towards this goal together. 

We operate with radical transparency, autonomy, and accountability-there's no room for brilliant jerks. We embrace a culture-first approach, offering an unlimited vacation policy, a high-trust work environment, and a commitment to continuous learning. For us, Culture is Our Strategy-check out our Culture Memo to dive deeper into what makes SAFE unique. 

As a Principal Engineer - AI, you will define and lead the technical direction of AI systems that power Safe's CRQ, CTEM, and TPRM products, including agentic workflows, RAG pipelines, LLM orchestration, and AI-native developer tooling. You'll be the hands-on architect behind Safe's AI engineering stack, bridging model intelligence with production-grade infrastructure. 

You'll collaborate with product, data, and platform teams to design scalable, explainable, and enterprise-ready systems. This is a high-impact, technical leadership role that will shape how AI is built, deployed, and governed across Safe. 

Core Responsibilities: 

- Architect Safe's AI Systems: Design and scale AI-driven components - LLM orchestration, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), vector stores, prompt pipelines, and AI microservices. Drive architecture for AI observability, safety, and evaluation (precision, recall, F1, hallucination detection, cost metrics). 
 - Productionize AI Agents: Build multi-turn, goal-oriented agent systems that automate reasoning across TPRM, CTEM, and CRQ domains (e. g. , control reviews, issue RCA, automated responses). Ensure reliability, traceability, and deterministic behavior in production. 
 - AI Infrastructure & Platform Ownership: Partner with Platform & DevOps teams to operationalize model serving (AWS SageMaker, Bedrock, or self-hosted Llama), build AI APIs, and manage model lifecycle and versioning. Establish feature stores, embedding management, and in-memory retrieval layers. 
 - Data Pipeline & Knowledge Graph Integration: Work with Data Engineering to design pipelines for structured and unstructured data ingestion, semantic indexing, and context retrieval (Snowflake + Iceberg + LlamaIndex). 
 - AI Evaluation, Monitoring & Governance: Define internal frameworks for golden dataset validation, LLM evaluation (LangFuse/LangSmith), and safety enforcement policies. Implement human-in-the-loop (HITL) mechanisms and continuous feedback loops. 
 - Mentor & Multiply: Guide AI and backend engineers on architectural design, experimentation methodologies, and prompt optimization. Collaborate with product leaders to translate abstract AI goals into measurable engineering deliverables. 

Minimum Qualifications: 

- Experience: 12+ years total experience in software engineering, including 4+ years building AI/ML systems or large-scale data/LLM infrastructure. 
 - MLOps & Infra: Familiar with model versioning, CI/CD for ML, and performance optimization for real-time inference. 
 - Applied AI Focus: Practical understanding of evaluation metrics, hallucination detection, RAG reliability, and enterprise AI safety. 

Core Technical Skills: 

- Strong programming fundamentals in Python, Go, or TypeScript
 - Deep understanding of LLM-based architectures, prompt engineering, and RAG pipelines
 - Hands-on experience with LangChain, LlamaIndex, or equivalent orchestration frameworks
 - Vector databases (FAISS, Pinecone, Weaviate, Redis Vector, or Milvus)
 - Cloud model deployment (AWS SageMaker, Bedrock, Vertex AI, or custom inference APIs)
 - Data systems: Snowflake, Iceberg, S3, Postgres/MySQL

Preferred Qualifications: 

- Experience integrating AI into cybersecurity or risk management products
 - Familiarity with multi-agent systems and autonomous workflows (CrewAI, LangGraph, AutoGen)
 - Experience building AI evaluation dashboards and AI observability stacks
 - Knowledge of knowledge graphs, semantic search, or retrieval pipelines
 - Exposure to data governance, compliance, or SOC2/ISO 27001 environments
 - Published research, open-source contributions, or prior leadership of AI teams is a strong plus

If you're passionate about cyber risk, thrive in a fast-paced environment, and want to be part of a team that's redefining security, we want to hear from you! 🚀

 - Strong expertise in at least one server-side programming language such as Node. js, Python, or Go. 
 - Hands-on experience designing and developing APIs and backend services. Experience with TypeScript and frameworks such as Express is preferred. 
 - Good understanding of SQL and NoSQL databases and their appropriate use across different workloads. 
 - Strong understanding of cloud computing concepts and hands-on experience with a major cloud provider such as AWS, GCP, or Azure. 
 - Experience building and deploying applications in containerized environments. 
 - Proven track record of building and delivering high-performance and scalable platforms in a fast-paced engineering environment. 
 - Strong understanding of system design, distributed systems, scalability, reliability, and multi-tenant architectures. 
 - Strong leadership and communication skills, with the ability to lead and mentor engineers toward technical excellence. 
 - Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking abilities.

AI / LLM Skills: 

- Strong working knowledge of Generative AI and LLM fundamentals, including how LLMs work, tokens, context windows, prompting, hallucinations, embeddings, and common model limitations. 
 - Hands-on experience using AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or equivalent, with the ability to critically review and validate AI-generated code, tests, and technical solutions.

 - Ability to define how AI-powered capabilities should be evaluated, including the use of golden datasets, appropriate accuracy metrics, regression testing, human evaluation, and LLM-as-a-judge where appropriate.

Snowflake is about empowering enterprises to achieve their full potential - and people too. With a culture that's all in on impact, innovation, and collaboration, Snowflake is the sweet spot for building big, moving fast, and taking technology - and careers - to the next level. 

Snowflake redefined the data landscape over a decade ago, and our biggest opportunity is also our customers' biggest challenge: migration. For every enterprise ready to harness the AI Data Cloud, there is a complex web of legacy systems that can take years and millions of dollars to untangle. We believe generative AI is the key. We are building products that don't just move data, but understand and rewrite the logic of entire data applications. 

We are hiring a Software Engineering Manager, AI Migrations (Forward Deployed) to work at the intersection of customer delivery and product engineering. In this hybrid role, you will lead a team of Forward Deployed Engineers who work directly with customers and partners on complex migrations, while also driving the development of AI-powered migration tools and products. Your team will be the bridge between field realities and product innovation, turning hard-won migration patterns into scalable, automated solutions. 

AS A SOFTWARE ENGINEERING MANAGER, AI MIGRATIONS AT SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL: 

Lead and develop the team

- Manage and mentor a team of Forward Deployed Engineers, giving clear feedback and building growth paths
 - Recruit, hire and onboard engineers who can succeed in both customer delivery and engineering
 - Grow technical delivery leads and engineering leaders, including staff-level engineers
 - Foster a culture of creativity, innovation and practical decision-making

Deliver customer migrations

- Lead complex migrations from legacy platforms such as Oracle, Teradata, Netezza and SQL Server to Snowflake
 - Provide strategic oversight so projects align with customer objectives and Snowflake's goals
 - Act as the primary escalation point for delivery, working closely with customers and system integrators
 - Stay hands-on in strategic projects to assess quality and unblock teams
 - Partner with sales teams to scope opportunities, estimate effort, develop proposals and support account strategy

Build AI-powered migration products

- Drive the design, development and iteration of AI-powered migration tools based on real customer needs
 - Guide the team in building AI-first products, including code translation, developer co-pilots and semantic validation
 - Turn field insights into engineering roadmap items and product improvements
 - Partner with Engineering and Product Management to align priorities and deliver high-quality solutions
 - Develop and share best practices, utilities and accelerators that speed up migrations and feed back into the product

Drive cross-functional impact

- Influence go-to-market strategy and lead improvements across Sales and Engineering
 - Encourage knowledge sharing between field engineers and product engineering teams
 - Present migration strategy, product vision and business outcomes to technical and executive audiences

OUR IDEAL SOFTWARE ENGINEERING MANAGER WILL HAVE: 

- A university degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or a related field, or equivalent experience
 - 7+ years of experience in technical roles spanning customer-facing delivery and engineering
 - 5+ years of people management experience, mentoring and developing technical teams
 - 3+ years of experience building and delivering enterprise software products, ideally involving AI/ML or developer tools
 - A proven track record of leading teams through complex data platform migrations and cloud transformations
 - A strong foundation in databases, data warehousing and data processing, with hands-on experience on large-scale systems such as Oracle, Teradata, Netezza, SQL Server, Greenplum or Hadoop
 - A deep understanding of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure or GCP) and the full data analytics stack, including ETL, data platform design and BI
 - Extensive hands-on expertise in SQL and scripting (Python, Perl or Bash)
 - Experience scoping engagements, including delivery estimates, proposals and project plans
 - The flexibility to step into product manager, program manager or architect roles when needed
 - Excellent presentation skills for technical and executive audiences

BONUS POINTS FOR: 

- Experience with data integration and transformation tools such as Informatica, DataStage, Talend, Matillion or dbt
 - Experience with BI tools such as Tableau, MicroStrategy or Business Objects
 - Experience building GenAI-powered developer tools, such as code translation or co-pilots

Snowflake is growing fast, and we're scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake. 

How do you want to make your impact?

data.description:
About Us

Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid. 

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale - tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world. 

Join Visa and do work that matters - to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you. 

Overview

Job Description

Within VISA Value Added Services, our mission is to build differentiated acceptance, issuing and risk and security products for merchants, acquirers, issuers and partners across all segments, verticals and geographies. 

Visa is seeking a Senior Director of Software Engineering to lead engineering for key capabilities within the Risk and Security Solutions (RAS) organization. This is a deeply technical role for an AI-forward engineering leader who combines organizational leadership with strong hands-on software engineering, architecture and delivery ownership. 

You will lead a high-performing team of engineers and AI agents responsible for building and operating high-scale, mission-critical, distributed systems that power customer-facing risk and security products. You will be expected to go beyond directional leadership: this role requires an AI-forward leader who can personally engage in architecture, design, code reviews, technical problem solving, production issue resolution, and where necessary hands-on code contribution to accelerate delivery, unblock teams, and raise the engineering bar. You will own the technical strategy and execution for systems that must meet demanding requirements for availability, resilience, throughput, latency, security, compliance, and operability. You will work closely with Product, Architecture, Security, SRE/Operations and partner teams across geographies to deliver customer value with speed and quality. 

Essential Functions

- Own the technical architecture, design, implementation, and delivery of customer-facing Risk & Security products and platform capabilities. 
 - Translate product strategy into scalable, secure, resilient, and operable distributed systems. 
 - Actively participate in code, design and architecture reviews, root-cause analysis, and contribute code when needed to unblock teams or accelerate critical initiatives. 
 - Establish and enforce engineering standards for agentic development lifecycle, context engineering, code quality evals, performance, scalability, availability, observability, maintainability, and secure software delivery. 
 - Partner with Product Management, Cybersecurity, SRE/Operations to deliver solutions that maximize customer value, platform health, and execution predictability. 
 - Build and execute technology roadmaps that balance business priorities, engineering sustainability, technical debt reduction, and operational efficiency. 
 - Drive adoption of engineering best practices including CI/CD, test automation and telemetry. 
 - Communicate technical strategy, execution status, key tradeoffs, risks, and architectural decisions clearly to senior leadership. 
 - Attract, retain and grow high-performing engineering talent. 
 - Enable technical and process innovation through thought leadership and influence. 
 - Understand current and future trends within the payments industry. 

Required Key Competencies

- Led a team of 40+ made up of full-time employees, contractors and AI agents. 
 - Proven hands-on technical leadership by actively participating in code and design reviews. 
 - Built a culture of engineering excellence (context engineering, code quality evals, security, performance, scalability, availability, resilience etc. )
 - Effectively managed complex technical interdependencies across geographical teams. 
 - Partnered with product management in developing a strategy and roadmap that align with business and engineering goals. 
 - Partnered with remote teams to ensure alignment across product development. Bring a global mindset. 
 - Demonstrated ability to hire, coach, retain, and develop high-performing engineers and engineering leaders while raising the overall technical bar of the organization. 
 - Enabled innovation through thought leadership and influence. 
 - Deep expertise in building and operating high-scale distributed systems with demanding requirements for latency, throughput, resilience, security, and availability. 
 - Strong architectural judgment across service decomposition, API design, asynchronous messaging, data consistency, caching, failure isolation, and recovery strategies. 
 - Excellent execution leadership with the ability to align teams, prioritize effectively, manage risk, and deliver against commitments in ambiguous or high-pressure environments. 
 - Strong cross-functional partnership skills with the ability to influence Product, Operations, and senior stakeholders through technical credibility and data-driven communication. 

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager. 

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications: 

- 18+ years of relevant work experience with a bachelor's degree or with an Advanced degree

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with Agentic development and effective use of AI models, tools and agents. 
 - Significant experience leading the design and delivery of complex, enterprise-scale distributed systems in domains with high transaction volume, integration complexity, and stringent non-functional requirements. 
 - Strong hands-on engineering background in Java, Go, Rust, JavaScript etc. and modern backend development frameworks, with experience in concurrent or reactive architectures such as Vertx, or similar. 
 - Proven experience building microservices and service-based platforms using HTTP, REST, gRPC JSON, and modern service contract/interface design patterns. 
 - Strong working knowledge of distributed web architecture, including service discovery, containerized deployment models, distributed caching, event streaming, NoSQL, and RDBMS technologies. 
 - Experience designing and operating highly available, fault-tolerant, scalable, and observable services in production environments. 
 - Strong understanding of event-driven architecture, enterprise integration patterns, asynchronous processing, and API-based system interoperability. 
 - Experience with DevOps and modern software delivery practices, including CI/CD, automated testing, deployment automation, release orchestration, and capacity/performance planning. 
 - Strong understanding of application and platform security, including secure design, secure coding, access control, threat awareness, and contemporary security risks and controls. 
 - Experience with Agile engineering practices, technical governance, roadmap planning, dependency management, and execution in globally distributed organizations. 
 - Demonstrated ability to identify, communicate, and mitigate technical, operational, and delivery risk across a portfolio of products or multiple engineering teams. 
 - Strong analytical, architectural, and organizational leadership skills, with the ability to influence senior leadership and drive decisions through clarity, technical depth, and disciplined execution. 

Visa is an EEO Employer

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

data.title: SDE II - AI Platform
data.description:
Most boards and executives are currently flying blind when it comes to cyber risk. They are guessing. At Safe, we've built an AI-driven engine that finally gives the C-Suite a clear, quantified, and real-time view of their security posture. We don't just provide data; we provide certainty. 

We are a $170M Series C-funded category leader. We don't play in the mid-market; we operate at the highest levels of global enterprise. Today, we are proud to serve 10% of the Fortune 500, protecting global icons such as Apple, Netflix, AT&T, Verizon, and Victoria's Secret. 

As we scale toward our next chapter, we are looking for high-performers who want to do the best work of their careers at the intersection of AI and Cybersecurity. 

The Culture Memo: Our Operating System

Safe is not a typical corporate environment. We are a high-intensity, mission-driven team. We value builders who want to define a category and work alongside people who are equally committed to excellence. 

- Extreme Ownership: We don't do "not my job. " We hire people who see a gap and own the solution from start to finish. 
 - The Elite Standard: We serve the most sophisticated companies on the planet. Our work must be bulletproof. Whether it's a line of code or a sales deck, we aim for Tier-1 quality every time. 
 - Methodology & Rigor: We don't wing it. From Force Management and MEDDICC in sales to data-driven sprints in engineering, we rely on proven frameworks to stay disciplined and predictable. 
 - Radical Candor: We move too fast for politics or sugar-coating. We value direct, honest feedback that helps us find the right answer quickly. 
 - The Series C Hustle: We have the stability of a well-funded leader but the heart of a startup. 

The Perks & Ownership: 

We want our team to feel like owners because they are owners. We trust our people to manage their results and their time. 

- Meaningful Equity: Every "Safestar" is a shareholder. You aren't just an employee; you are a partner in our success. 
 - Unlimited Leaves: We don't believe in clock-watching. We offer unlimited leave because we trust you to take the time you need to recharge while staying committed to the mission. 
 - Comprehensive Benefits: We provide top-tier medical insurance and wellness benefits to ensure you and your family are well cared for. 
 - Career Trajectory: We are growing aggressively. For high-performers, the path for advancement moves at the speed of your ambition. 

AI is not a side project at Safe - it is the engine behind how we quantify cyber risk for the world's largest enterprises. Agentic services, LLM analytics, and inference workloads run in production, on real customer data, under enterprise security constraints. 

You will own the platform underneath all of it: GPU clusters, inference serving, model lifecycle, and the developer-facing abstractions on top, so every engineering and AI/ML team at Safe ships AI workloads without rebuilding infrastructure each time. 

This is a platform and infrastructure engineering role, not an ML research role. We want an engineer who has operated GPUs in production, not only consumed them. 

AI platform is your primary charter. As an SDE II on the platform team, you will also contribute to core platform engineering, multi-tenant microservices, APIs, and cloud architecture, and carry the same review, mentoring, and delivery ownership as every SDE II at Safe. 

What You'll Do: 

- Build the AI platform: APIs, SDKs, and self-service workflows so AI/ML engineers deploy, version, evaluate, and monitor workloads without touching raw infrastructure. 
 - Own GPU infrastructure: Cluster design, provisioning, scheduling, isolation, and utilisation optimisation across shared multi-team demand. 
 - Run inference in production: vLLM, Triton, KServe, or Ray - continuous batching, autoscaling, model routing, and multi-model serving against real latency and throughput SLOs. 
 - Optimize relentlessly: Drive tokens/sec, p99 latency, GPU utilization, and cost per token through quantization, batching strategy, and capacity planning. 
 - Engineer GPU-aware Kubernetes: GPU Operator, device plugins, GPU-aware scheduling, MIG partitioning, and distributed workloads over NCCL. 
 - Debug the hard layer: GPU OOMs, driver and CUDA runtime mismatches, interconnect bottlenecks, throughput regressions. 
 - Build the MLOps backbone: Model registry and versioning, CI/CD for AI workloads, and safe rollout/rollback. 
 - Own the evaluation layer: Offline and online eval harnesses, golden datasets, LLM-as-a-judge scoring, accuracy and hallucination metrics, and automated regression gates so no model, prompt, or quantisation change ships without a measured quality verdict. 
 - Make it observable: Response quality and accuracy drift, latency, throughput, GPU utilisation, and per-tenant cost - with SLOs, alerting, and incident response. 
 - Secure and multi-tenant by default: AuthN/AuthZ, secrets, data protection, tenant isolation, and governed access to models and GPUs. 
 - Codify and lead: Terraform for everything, HA and DR designed in, plus architecture direction and mentoring across teams. 
 - Contribute beyond AI: Design and build secure, multi-tenant microservices and APIs on AWS, run thorough code reviews, and own feature delivery end-to-end with Product and Design. 

What We're Looking For: 

- 2-4 years building and operating production software and infrastructure, with senior ownership of systems end to end. 
 - Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - Strong Python and/or Go - you write and review production services, not just scripts and manifests. 
 - Deep Kubernetes and Docker: scheduling, resource management, operators, networking, debugging under load. 
 - Strong Linux, networking, storage, and distributed systems fundamentals. 
 - Production AWS/Azure/GCP experience - Lambda, API Gateway, EC2, S3, RDS and equivalents - with Terraform as your default way of working. 
 - Working knowledge of SQL and NoSQL databases, including schema design and performance tuning. 
 - Experience building and operating backend services and APIs in a multi-tenant SaaS product. 
 - Leadership, code review, and mentoring skills, with end-to-end ownership of delivery in an agile environment. 
 - Hands-on with a managed ML/AI platform - AWS SageMaker, Bedrock, GCP Vertex AI, or Azure ML - including where it fits and where self-managed infrastructure wins on cost or control. 
 - Track record on HA, scalability, and DR in multi-tenant environments. 
 - Solid observability and CI/CD practice - metrics, traces, SLOs, automated delivery. 
 - Experience building or operating AI evaluation systems - accuracy and quality measurement, LLM-as-a-judge pipelines, eval datasets, and regression testing for models and prompts. 
 - Background in platform engineering, infrastructure, SRE, distributed systems, AI infrastructure, or MLOps/LLMOps. 

GPU & AI Experience (Required)

- Hands-on GPU cluster operations: provisioning, capacity planning, and day-2 ownership. 
 - NVIDIA ecosystem and CUDA - drivers, container runtime, toolkit compatibility, and their failure modes. 
 - GPU scheduling, allocation, isolation, and utilisation optimisation across competing workloads. 
 - Kubernetes GPU workloads: GPU Operator, device plugins, GPU-aware scheduling. 
 - GPU troubleshooting and tuning: memory/OOM, driver faults, interconnect and throughput bottlenecks. 
 - LLM inference and model serving in production (vLLM, Triton, KServe, Ray or equivalent) with demonstrated cost and performance gains. 
 - Managed AI platform experience - SageMaker (training jobs, endpoints, inference components) or equivalent - alongside self-managed GPU serving. 

Nice to Have: 

SageMaker HyperPod, Bedrock, or Vertex AI at scale · DCGM and Prometheus/Grafana for GPU fleets · MIG and GPU partitioning in multi-tenant setups · NCCL and distributed GPU workloads · quantization and inference optimization (FP8/INT8, AWQ/GPTQ, speculative decoding, KV-cache tuning) · LLM observability and tracing (Langfuse, OpenTelemetry for LLMs) · eval frameworks and human-in-the-loop labeling · PyTorch profiling · GPU cluster schedulers and queueing · vector databases, RAG, LLM gateways, agentic systems · TypeScript/Express API development · React or other modern frontends · security or compliance-bound environments. 

What Success Looks Like: 

- AI teams deploy and roll back models through self-service workflows, with no manual infrastructure work per deployment. 
 - GPU utilisation is measured, forecast, and consistently optimised across the shared fleet. 
 - Cost per token falls quarter over quarter, with the numbers on a dashboard. 
 - Inference SLOs hold under peak enterprise load, and GPU incidents drop in frequency and time-to-resolve. 
 - No model, prompt, or optimisation change reaches production without passing automated accuracy and quality evaluation.

data.title: Senior DevOps & Cloud Security Engineer
data.description:
We are looking for a hands-on Senior DevOps & Cloud Security Engineer to own and continuously improve our AWS. Infrastructure, deployment platform, observability and operational security. This is an ownership role for someone who can independently design, implement, troubleshoot and operate production systems without day-to-day guidance from another AWS specialist. 

You will work closely with application engineers to make deployments repeatable, production systems reliable, security controls effective and operational issues diagnosable. The role goes beyond initial cloud setup: you will own the platform as our products and engineering team evolve. 

What you will own

AWS infrastructure & Linux operations

• Design, configure and operate AWS environments using services such as ECS, ECR, EC2, VPC, ALB/NLB, Route 53, ACM, IAM, RDS, Elastic ache, Amazon MQ and S3. 

• Administer Ubuntu/Linux systems, Nginx reverse proxies, TLS certificates, DNS, networking, system services, permissions, storage and resource utilisation. 

• Design secure network boundaries, service-to-service connectivity, environment separation and production access patterns. 

• Troubleshoot production incidents independently and document architecture, operational procedures and recovery steps. 

Infrastructure as code & CI/CD

• Build and maintain infrastructure using Terraform and/or AWS CloudFormation; keep infrastructure reproducible, reviewed and version controlled. 

• Develop and maintain GitHub Actions and/or Bitbucket Pipelines for builds, tests, container publishing, deployment and release approvals. 

• Implement safe release strategies, health checks, database migration practices, rollback procedures and deployment traceability. 

• Automate routine infrastructure and operational tasks using shell scripting and, where useful, Python. 

Security & secure delivery

• Implement least-privilege IAM, MFA, controlled administrative access, secrets management, credential rotation and appropriate encryption at rest and in transit. 

• Maintain security groups, network controls, patching, container image hygiene and secure configuration baselines. 

• Integrate dependency, secret, container and infrastructure-as-code scanning into development and deployment workflows. 

• Monitor and remediate findings from relevant AWS security services, such as CloudTrail, GuardDuty, Security Hub and Config, where appropriate. 

• Support HIPAA-related technical safeguards and audit evidence for systems handling sensitive healthcare data; minimise PHI exposure in logs and operational tooling. 

Observability & reliability

• Implement centralised structured logging, metrics, dashboards, actionable alerts and distributed tracing whereappropriate, using CloudWatch and/or Open Telemetry-based tooling. 

• Monitor ECS services, databases, queues, application health, deployment status, capacity and background data-sync processes. 

• Define useful health checks, service-level indicators (SLIs), service-level objectives (SLOs), alert thresholds and incident runbooks. 

• For data-sync/adaptor services, monitor heartbeats, last successful sync, lag, throughput, retries, failures and queue backlogs. 

• Establish backup monitoring, restoration tests, disaster-recovery procedures, incident reviews and root-cause remediation. 

Cost, capacity & platform improvement

• Review cloud spend, resource utilisation, scaling behaviour and capacity trends; recommend cost improvements without compromising reliability or security. 

• Reduce manual operational work through automation and self-service deployment workflows. 

• Continuously improve platform standards as new services, environments and product requirements are introduced. 

Required experience and skills

• Typically 6-9 years of relevant hands-on DevOps, cloud infrastructure, platform engineering or production operations experience. 

• Strong practical AWS experience operating production workloads-not just training, certification or console-based setup. 

• Solid Ubuntu/Linux administration, networking fundamentals, DNS, TLS, Nginx, Docker and container troubleshooting. 

• Hands-on experience with ECS and ECR, IAM, VPC, load balancers, CloudWatch and managed data services. 

• Production CI/CD experience with GitHub Actions and/or Bitbucket Pipelines. 

• Practical infrastructure-as-code experience with Terraform or CloudFormation. 

• A security-first mindset, including access control, secrets, patching, encryption, auditability and vulnerability remediation. 

• Ability to independently diagnose unfamiliar failures, explain trade-offs and make sound production decisions. 

• Clear written communication and a habit of documenting architecture, changes, incidents and operational procedures. 

Good to have

• AWS certifications such as Solutions Architect - Associate/Professional, SysOps Administrator or Security Specialty. 

• Experience with Open Telemetry, Grafana, Prometheus, Sentry or similar observability tools. 

• Experience supporting healthcare, fintech or other systems with sensitive data and formal security requirements. 

• Knowledge of SLOs, incident management, disaster recovery, vulnerability management and cloud cost optimization. 

What success looks like

• Developers can deploy through documented, repeatable pipelines without requiring manual execution for every release. 

• Production health and critical background processing are visible through useful dashboards and alerts. 

• High-priority infrastructure and security findings are tracked, prioritised and remediated with evidence. 

• Backups and recovery procedures are tested rather than merely configured. 

• Infrastructure changes are version-controlled, reviewable and reproducible. 

• Operational incidents are diagnosed systematically, documented and followed by corrective actions.

About American Airlines:

INTRO: 

Are you ready to explore a world of possibilities, both at work and during your time off Join our American Airlines family, and you'll travel the world, grow your expertise, and become the best version of you. As you embark on a new journey, you'll tackle challenges with flexibility and grace, learning new skills and advancing your career while having the time of your life. Feel free to enrich both your personal and work life and hop onboard!

WHY YOU'LL LOVE THIS JOB: 

- As one diverse, high-performing team dedicated to technical excellence, you will focus relentlessly on delivering unrivaled digital products that drive a more reliable and profitable airline. 
 - The SRE domain is responsible for enabling innovation and velocity of change while ensuring system reliability focusing on the critical features and functionality within products and platforms. It handles monitoring, automating, and improving the reliability, performance and availability of software systems. Team members in this domain work on tasks such as automating manual processes and operations, building effective monitoring & alerting into systems, participating in system design and capacity planning and ensuring the smooth operation of systems applications with a focus on application availability and preventing incidents. 

WHAT YOU'LL DO: 

This list is intended to reflect the current job but there may be additional essential functions (and certainly non-essential job functions) that are not referenced. Management will modify the job or require other tasks be performed whenever it is deemed appropriate to do so, observing, of course, any legal obligations including any collective bargaining obligations. 

- Ensure key stakeholders, product owners, and platform owners are informed of reliability concerns and their potential impact on the customers' experience. 
 - Design, code, test and deliver solutions to automate manual operation (i. e. , "TOIL"). 
 - Participate in operations support and on-call rotation shifts (could include weekends and holidays), for SRE supported systems and products with a focus on implementing long-term solutions for any problems identified. 
 - Collaborate with stakeholders such as product and platform owners, to define service level objectives (SLOs), and service-level indicators (SLIs) for system operations focused on the critical features of the customers journey and experience. 
 - Track and manage reliability performance against agreed SLOs, in partnership with IT monitoring teams or other stakeholders, and ensure systems continue to meet SLOs over time. 
 - Provide expert knowledge on reliability approaches, to ensure our organization achieves its goals and roadmap for reliability. 
 - Champion reliability being treated as a feature in products and platforms and promote the concept across all phases of the software development life cycle. 
 - Create dashboards and reports to communicate key metrics, to product owners and key stakeholders. 
 - Contribute to documentation and runbooks for owned applications based on operational experience, user feedback, and application changes

ALL YOU'LL NEED FOR SUCCESS: 

Minimum Qualifications - Education & Prior Job Experience: 

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Technology, Information Systems (CIS/MIS), Engineering or related technical discipline, or equivalent experience/training
 - 1+ years of experience designing, developing, and implementing large-scale solutions in production environment. Preferred Qualifications - Education & Prior Job Experience 
 - Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Technology, Information Systems (CIS/MIS), Engineering or related technical discipline, or equivalent experience/training 
 - Airline Industry experience

Skills, Licenses, and Certifications: 

- Configure and maintain Dynatrace monitoring solutions across applications, servers, cloud, and infrastructure. 
 - Create dashboards, alerts, management zones, and monitoring policies. 
 - Monitor application performance, availability, and system health. 
 - Perform incident management, troubleshooting, and root cause analysis (RCA). 
 - Analyze logs, metrics, traces, and events for issue resolution. 
 - Support production systems to ensure high availability and reliability. 
 - Implement synthetic monitoring and real user monitoring (RUM). 
 - Define and maintain SLIs, SLOs, and SLAs. 
 - Automate operational and monitoring tasks using scripting tools. 
 - Monitor cloud and container platforms including Kubernetes and Docker. 
 - Collaborate with DevOps, Infrastructure, and Application teams for deployment and performance optimization. 
 - Perform capacity planning, performance tuning, and system optimization. 
 - Integrate Dynatrace with CI/CD pipelines and ITSM tools. 
 - Prepare operational reports, monitoring documentation, and RCA reports. 
 - Ensure proactive monitoring and continuous improvement of platform reliability. 

LANGUAGE / COMMUNICATION SKILLS: 

- Ability to effectively communicate both verbally and written with all levels within the organization
 - Physical ability necessary to safely and successfully perform the essential functions of the position, with or without any legally required reasonable accommodations that do not pose an undue hardship. Note: If the Company has reason to question an employee's physical ability to safely and/or successfully perform the position's essential job functions, the HR team generally will engage in an interactive process to determine whether a reasonable accommodation is appropriate. HR (working with the operation) ordinarily first speaks with the team member directly and they mutually identify the physical demands of the job that are or may be impacted by the employee's obvious or known condition. Then, if necessary, HR would request medical documentation from the team member's treating physician or others to confirm the employee's ability to perform those essential job functions safely and successfully.
