Rooted in a commitment to collaboration and inclusivity, Revantage goes beyond traditional corporate services and acts as a trusted partner. Across offerings that include finance, technology, human resources and operations, Revantage proactively anticipates stakeholder needs, recruits exceptional talent and enables its business partners to thrive.

At Revantage, we have exceptional people who live our values and help us pursue better every day. We offer dynamic and meaningful work, competitive compensation, benefits, and flexibility. We listen and take action to ensure our organization evolves to reflect our employees' voices and support an inclusive culture. 

Our demonstrated commitment to our people and collaborative culture have earned us numerous awards as a top employer. 

Our culture is built on our shared core values and commitment to be:

Leaders - We commit to continuous improvement

Enthusiasts - We face challenges with optimism and believe anything is possible

Achievers - We expect high standards for ourselves and enable the success of our teams

Partners - We deliver value and positive impact to our partners

Grow your career with us. As a member of our team, you'll gain hands-on experience in the real estate industry and benefit from a supportive environment that fosters personal and professional growth. 

Job Description Summary

We are looking for a Platform Engineering/DevOps/SRE Engineer to join our infrastructure team. In this role, you will design, build, and maintain scalable platforms and infrastructure that power our applications. You will bridge development and operations, focusing on reliability, automation, and operational excellence. This is a hands-on role combining platform architecture, infrastructure as code, monitoring, and incident response. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design, implement, and maintain scalable, secure, and highly available cloud infrastructure primarily on Microsoft Azure and Databricks, with working knowledge of AWS or GCP
 - Build and manage infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform, Azure Resource Manager (ARM), Ansible, Helm, and Argo CD. 
 - Develop, optimize, and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Docker, and other modern DevOps toolsets. 
 - Implement and enhance observability solutions including Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack, Datadog, and Dynatrace to ensure platform health, performance, and reliability. 
 - Drive SRE best practices by defining and managing SLAs, SLOs, Error Budgets, and reliability metrics. 
 - Establish and improve operational KPIs such as MTTA (Mean Time to Acknowledgment), MTTD (Mean Time to Detect), MTTR (Mean Time to Recovery), MTBF (Mean Time Between Failures). 
 - Participate in on-call rotations, incident management, root cause analysis (RCA), and implementation of preventive and corrective actions. 
 - Troubleshoot and resolve infrastructure, networking, platform, and application performance issues across distributed cloud environments. 
 - Automate manual operational processes and develop reusable tooling, runbooks, and operational documentation. 
 - Partner closely with engineering, architecture, security, and product teams to deliver resilient and scalable platform solution
 - Champion cloud security, governance, compliance (SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, CIS benchmarks), infrastructure modernization, and cost optimization initiatives. 
 - Evaluate, recommend, and integrate emerging technologies and tools to continuously improve the platform ecosystem. 
 - Experience managing production incidents, SRE practices, and reliability engineering frameworks. 
 - Strong scripting and automation skills using Python, Bash, PowerShell, or similar technologies. 

Required Qualifications

- 3-5 years of hands-on experience in DevOps, SRE, platform engineering, or infrastructure roles 
 - Strong proficiency in one or more cloud platforms: Azure, GCP or AWS
 - Experience with infrastructure as code tools (Terraform, ARM, Ansible, or equivalent)
 - Solid understanding of containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes)
 - Experience with CI/CD tools and pipeline development
 - Proficiency in at least one programming language (Python, Go, Bash, Java) for scripting and automation
 - Familiarity with monitoring and logging tools (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, Datadog, or similar)
 - Understanding of Linux/Unix system administration and networking fundamentals
 - Experience responding to incidents and debugging production issues
 - Strong communication skills and ability to work cross-functionally with development teams

Preferred Qualifications/Certification

- BE/ B Tech in Computer Science, ECE/Electrical Engineering. 
 - DevOps or Cloud Certification in Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP) is preferred. 
 - Certifications in Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and Configuration Management tools such as Terraform and Ansible are highly desirable. 
 - Relevant certifications such as Azure DevOps Engineer Expert, AWS DevOps Engineer Professional, Google Professional Cloud DevOps Engineer, HashiCorp Terraform Associate, or Red Hat Ansible Automation will be an added advantage. 

Technical Environment

Our stack includes Terraform, CI/CD pipelines, multi-cloud deployments, and modern monitoring and observability tools. We value automation, documentation, and a strong operational culture.

We are Lockers team! We solve the problem of package delivery to customers. A lot of time Amazon customers have to go through hassles of coordinating delivery time with carriers and are not able to receive their packages. We solve this problem for them. We allow customer to get their package (and do their returns) when and where they want. In other words, we make the package delivery asynchronous in nature. Is that an important problem? Draw a comparison with how messaging solutions like AWS SQS / JMS are critical part of tech architecture, the same way we are becoming important to package delivery. 

We've been established for over a decade, boasting a network of over 50, 000 lockers globally across NA, EU, and the FE, facilitating the delivery of millions of packages monthly. Despite this, we continue to identify ourselves as a startup due to our operational style and scalability. Our key stakeholders and dependencies are centralized under unified leadership, enabling us to make swift decisions and execute rapidly. Over the past three years, we've successfully launched two new products. Presently, we're embarking on the development of the latest generation of lockers designed to accept packages from any carrier or retailer, with robust return capabilities. This ambitious endeavor aims to facilitate a tenfold scale-up within the next three years, aligning with our strategic goals. hoichoi is India's leading Bengali OTT platform, the digital arm of SVF, Eastern India's largest media & entertainment company. We stream 650+ Bengali movies, 185+ originals, and 3000+ hours of content to an audience of ~250 million Bengalis worldwide. We're part of the wider SVF ecosystem alongside Sooper (AI-led micro-drama OTT) and LoglineAI (AI-native creative studio), and we're on a mission to entertain everyone in their native language. 

The Role : 

We are looking for engineers (backend heavy + AI Native) to join our tech team based in Kolkata. This role sits at the core of revenue infrastructure - covering payment orchestration, subscription lifecycle, and high-scale backend systems. 

You won't maintain systems. You'll design, ship, and scale them. Every deployment impacts millions of users and real revenue. 

Please note : This would be an onsite role from Kolkata

What You'll Own + Key Responsibilities : 

- Own end-to-end technical decisions - API contracts, data models, service boundaries, and integration patterns - across a live, high-traffic streaming platform. 
 - Think architecturally first: identify the right abstraction, lead the trade-off conversation, and document decisions that the broader team can reason about and build on. 
 - Use AI-native development tools (Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot) as your default workflow - not as shortcuts, but as force multipliers where you own the output and know when to override. 
 - Lead technical design reviews for new capabilities, surfacing risks, edge cases, and cross-system dependencies before a single line gets committed. 
 - Diagnose and resolve production issues across backend systems - trace root causes, write clean fixes, and prevent recurrence through deliberate design choices. 
 - Partner closely with product, growth, content, and data teams to translate fast-moving business requirements into robust, maintainable backend solutions. 
 - Contribute to hoichoi Cortex - our central data aggregation and intelligence layer - by designing clean API contracts and data flows that connect content signals, user behaviour, and business metrics. 
 - Evaluate and integrate third-party services, LLM APIs, and external tools - making deliberate build-vs-buy-vs-compose decisions with clear justifications. 
 - Review code that a future-you would be proud to maintain: readable, testable, and defensible. 

If you have : 

- 2-4+ years of backend engineering experience with production ownership - at least one system that real users depend on and you were responsible for. 
 - Strong fundamentals in at least one backend language and comfort reasoning about system design, data modelling, and API contracts. 
 - Ability to read a system, understand its constraints, and make architectural recommendations - not just execute tickets handed down to you. 
 - Experience working in a fast-moving product team where requirements change mid-sprint and priorities shift without warning. 
 - Default user of AI coding tools (Cursor, Copilot, Claude Code, etc. ) on real shipped features - with at least one concrete example where AI generated significant code that you evaluated, debugged, or chose to override. 
 - Comfort with ambiguity: you can move without complete information and know when to decide independently versus when to ask. 

And (or) also have : 

- Familiarity with streaming or media tech: CDNs, adaptive bitrate, DRM, or video processing pipelines. 
 - Experience with event-driven architectures, message queues (Kafka, SQS, RabbitMQ), or distributed microservices. 
 - Prior work on data pipelines, analytics integrations, or internal developer tooling. 
 - Exposure to LLM APIs, prompt engineering, or AI-augmented product features shipped to real users. 

Candidates must have an active GitHub or portfolio for skill evaluation. 

Culture & How We Work

At hoichoi, the best idea wins, not the biggest title. We operate in small, cross-functional teams where content, product, growth, and tech sit close together, argue productively, and occasionally steal each other's snacks. It's a lot like a kitchen during a house party: slightly chaotic, everyone's doing three things at once, but somehow the food comes out great. 

Ownership here isn't a buzzword; it's the default setting. If something's broken, you don't file a ticket and wait. You're the person who notices the printer is jammed and just fixes it instead of pretending you didn't see it. We ship fast, measure what works, and iterate. Think less 'perfect deck' and more 'let's see if real viewers actually care. '

When big moments arrive, we stretch. But we're equally serious about keeping the pace sustainable, because burnt-out teams build neither great products nor great stories. If that sounds like your kind of chaos, we should talk.

data.title: SDE III ngineering Productivity (AI)
data.description:
Most boards and executives are currently flying blind when it comes to cyber risk. They are guessing. At Safe, we've built an AI-driven engine that finally gives the C-Suite a clear, quantified, and real-time view of their security posture. We don't just provide data; we provide certainty. 

We are a $170M Series C-funded category leader. We don't play in the mid-market; we operate at the highest levels of global enterprise. Today, we are proud to serve 10% of the Fortune 500, protecting global icons such as Apple, Netflix, AT&T, Verizon, and Victoria's Secret. 

As we scale toward our next chapter, we are looking for high-performers who want to do the best work of their careers at the intersection of AI and Cybersecurity. 

The Culture Memo: Our Operating System

Safe is not a typical corporate environment. We are a high-intensity, mission-driven team. We value builders who want to define a category and work alongside people who are equally committed to excellence. 

- Extreme Ownership: We don't do "not my job. " We hire people who see a gap and own the solution from start to finish. 
 - The Elite Standard: We serve the most sophisticated companies on the planet. Our work must be bulletproof. Whether it's a line of code or a sales deck, we aim for Tier-1 quality every time. 
 - Methodology & Rigor: We don't wing it. From Force Management and MEDDICC in sales to data-driven sprints in engineering, we rely on proven frameworks to stay disciplined and predictable. 
 - Radical Candor: We move too fast for politics or sugar-coating. We value direct, honest feedback that helps us find the right answer quickly. 
 - The Series C Hustle: We have the stability of a well-funded leader but the heart of a startup. 

The Perks & Ownership: 

We want our team to feel like owners because they are owners. We trust our people to manage their results and their time. 

- Meaningful Equity: Every "Safestar" is a shareholder. You aren't just an employee; you are a partner in our success. 
 - Unlimited Leaves: We don't believe in clock-watching. We offer unlimited leave because we trust you to take the time you need to recharge while staying committed to the mission. 
 - Comprehensive Benefits: We provide top-tier medical insurance and wellness benefits to ensure you and your family are well cared for. 
 - Career Trajectory: We are growing aggressively. For high-performers, the path for advancement moves at the speed of your ambition. 

This role exists to change how engineering at Safe gets work done - not to add AI tools on top of today's workflow, but to rebuild the engineering operating model around AI, automation, and redesigned process, and to prove the gain in numbers. 

You will look across the full lifecycle - requirements, design, implementation, review, testing, deployment, operations, incidents, documentation - find where engineers lose time, and decide what actually fixes it: an AI agent, an automation, a platform capability, or a process change. Then build it to production quality, drive adoption, and measure whether cycle time moved. 

This is not a Developer Experience, DevOps, or internal-tools role. It is a software engineering role whose product is engineering throughput. 

Why This Role Exists

Engineering output is the constraint on how fast we ship against Fortune 500 demand. AI can lift it - but most organizations bolt AI onto unchanged workflows and get a chat window. The leverage is in redesigning the workflow around what AI can now do, putting agents inside CI, review, testing, and incident response, giving them real engineering context, and setting guardrails so engineers move fast without lowering the bar. 

The objective is not AI adoption. It is materially higher engineering output, speed, and quality. 

What You'll Do: 

- ind the bottlenecks: Instrument how engineering time is actually spent - cycle time, review latency, CI failures, test authoring, operational toil, onboarding - and rank problems by recoverable hours. 
 - Pick the right instrument: Decide per bottleneck whether the answer is AI, automation, conventional software, or process change. Reject AI where it's the wrong tool. 
 - Apply AI across the lifecycle: AI-assisted development and refactoring, first-pass code review, test generation and suite optimization, automated documentation and release notes, design analysis, automated migrations, AI-assisted debugging, incident investigation, and root-cause analysis. 
 - Build engineering agents: Agents that diagnose CI failures, investigate production issues, write tests, run dependency upgrades, propose security fixes, analyze PRs, and execute repetitive migrations - human-in-the-loop by default, autonomy earned per workflow. 
 - Redesign the process: Rework code review, testing, CI, and incident management for a world where AI does the first pass - and define what stays human-owned and where approval is mandatory. 
 - Build the platform: AI gateway, agent runtime and workflow orchestration, codebase intelligence, engineering context retrieval, and deep Git/CI/observability/ticketing integrations - plus APIs and SDKs so teams build their own AI workflows on it. 
 - Solve the context problem: Give agents permission-aware access to code, architecture docs, service ownership, deployment state, telemetry, incidents, and standards - and own retrieval quality and freshness. 
 - Set the guardrails: Quality, security, privacy, access control, approval gates, auditability, and evaluation for AI-generated change. 
 - Prove the impact and drive adoption: Baseline, experiment, publish results, kill what doesn't move the metric, and mentor teams into the patterns that work. 

How We Measure Success: 

Not by tools built, experiments run, LLM calls, or chatbot users. By outcomes: reduced cycle time and repetitive work, faster PR review and CI failure resolution, fewer escaped defects, faster incident diagnosis, less operational toil, shorter onboarding, higher deployment frequency and throughput, and real adoption of AI workflows. 

What We're Looking For: 

- 6+ years building production software, with SDE3-level ownership of systems in production. 
 - Strong Python, Java, Go, or equivalent - you ship production services and review others' code. 
 - Solid distributed systems, API and microservice, and software architecture grounding. 
 - Hands-on cloud infrastructure and CI/CD experience. 
 - Demonstrated developer tooling and automation work that other engineers actually used. 
 - Practical experience with LLMs and agentic systems in real systems, not only experiments. 
 - Ability to reason quantitatively about workflows: baseline, hypothesis, experiment, measured result. 
 - Strong writing and the ability to influence engineering teams without authority. 

Nice to Have

LLM APIs and model orchestration · production AI agents with tool use · RAG, retrieval, and vector databases · MCP or similar tool/context protocols · LLM evaluation, prompt and context engineering, AI observability · GitHub/GitLab APIs and deep CI/CD integration · Kubernetes and cloud platforms · internal developer platforms · DORA/SPACE-style engineering measurement · security or compliance-bound environments. 

SDE3 Expectations

Not an execution-only role. You identify org-wide productivity problems without being handed a backlog, work across teams, read both technical and process bottlenecks, build for scale rather than prototypes, influence without authority, prove improvements quantitatively, and mentor engineers into AI-first ways of working. 

What Success Looks Like: 

- In 90 days: Engineering time-spend is baselined, top bottlenecks are quantified in recoverable hours, and the first automation is shipped and in use. 
 - AI does the first pass: Code review, test generation, and CI failure diagnosis run through AI workflows by default; humans review judgment, not mechanics. 
 - Cycle time drops measurably quarter over quarter, attributable to specific changes. 
 - Agents carry real load across defined workflows, with approval gates, audit trails, and tracked reliability - while escaped defects and security findings do not rise. 

If you're passionate about cyber risk, thrive in a fast-paced environment, and want to be part of a team that's redefining security, we want to hear from you! 🚀

data.title: Software Development Engineer II – Sensors / Systems & Security Engineering
data.description:
Most boards and executives are currently flying blind when it comes to cyber risk. They are guessing. At Safe, we've built an AI-driven engine that finally gives the C-Suite a clear, quantified, and real-time view of their security posture. We don't just provide data; we provide certainty. 

We are a $170M Series C-funded category leader. We don't play in the mid-market; we operate at the highest levels of global enterprise. Today, we are proud to serve 10% of the Fortune 500, protecting global icons such as Apple, Netflix, AT&T, Verizon, and Victoria's Secret. 

As we scale toward our next chapter, we are looking for high-performers who want to do the best work of their careers at the intersection of AI and Cybersecurity. 

The Culture Memo: Our Operating System

Safe is not a typical corporate environment. We are a high-intensity, mission-driven team. We value builders who want to define a category and work alongside people who are equally committed to excellence. 

- Extreme Ownership: We don't do "not my job. " We hire people who see a gap and own the solution from start to finish. 
 - The Elite Standard: We serve the most sophisticated companies on the planet. Our work must be bulletproof. Whether it's a line of code or a sales deck, we aim for Tier-1 quality every time. 
 - Methodology & Rigor: We don't wing it. From Force Management and MEDDICC in sales to data-driven sprints in engineering, we rely on proven frameworks to stay disciplined and predictable. 
 - Radical Candor: We move too fast for politics or sugar-coating. We value direct, honest feedback that helps us find the right answer quickly. 
 - The Series C Hustle: We have the stability of a well-funded leader but the heart of a startup. 

The Perks & Ownership: 

We want our team to feel like owners because they are owners. We trust our people to manage their results and their time. 

- Meaningful Equity: Every "Safestar" is a shareholder. You aren't just an employee; you are a partner in our success. 
 - Unlimited Leaves: We don't believe in clock-watching. We offer unlimited leave because we trust you to take the time you need to recharge while staying committed to the mission. 
 - Comprehensive Benefits: We provide top-tier medical insurance and wellness benefits to ensure you and your family are well cared for. 
 - Career Trajectory: We are growing aggressively. For high-performers, the path for advancement moves at the speed of your ambition. 

Role Overview: 

We are looking for an SDE II - Sensors to build customer-deployed security software that runs inside enterprise environments and continuously discovers assets, evaluates exposures, and securely communicates telemetry back to SAFE. 

This role is suited for engineers with strong C++, Go or Python programming skills, Windows/Linux, networking, and cybersecurity fundamentals, particularly those who have worked on endpoint agents, security sensors, network/security products, or other long-running system software. 

What You'll Do: 

- Design and develop lightweight security sensors/agents running inside customer environments. 
 - Build capabilities for asset discovery, network scanning, vulnerability detection and exposure validation. 
 - Develop reliable, long-running system software with a focus on performance, resource usage, concurrency, and stability. 
 - Work extensively with Windows/Linux internals, processes, sockets, filesystems, networking and system APIs. 
 - Build communication between distributed sensors and the SAFE cloud with secure authentication, encryption, retries and offline recovery. 
 - Implement sensor lifecycle management, including installation, configuration, health monitoring and software/rule updates. 
 - Debug complex issues spanning application code, operating systems, customer networks, proxies, firewalls and infrastructure. 
 - Build strong diagnostics, telemetry and logging so problems can be investigated without requiring direct access to customer systems. 
 - Participate in low-level and high-level design discussions and independently own well-defined components/features through production. 

What We're Looking For: 

- 3-6 years of software development experience, preferably building systems, infrastructure or security products. 
 - Strong programming experience in one or more of C++, Go or Python. 
 - Strong understanding of Windows/Linux and operating-system fundamentals. 
 - Good understanding of networking concepts, including: 
 - TCP/IP and sockets
 - DNS
 - HTTP/HTTPS
 - TLS
 - Proxies
 - Routing
 - NAT
 - Firewalls and network segmentation
 - Experience with multithreading/concurrency, asynchronous programming and inter-process communication. 
 - Understanding of software security and secure communication practices. 
 - Ability to troubleshoot issues independently across code, OS and network boundaries. 

Strongly Preferred: 

- Experience building endpoint agents, sensors, collectors, daemons or system services. 
 - Experience working on cybersecurity, endpoint security, vulnerability management, micro-segmentation, EDR or network security products. 
 - Experience building software deployed across large heterogeneous enterprise environments. 
 - Familiarity with CVE, CVSS, vulnerability scanners and exposure management. 
 - Experience with secure auto-update / software distribution mechanisms. 
 - Familiarity with containers and technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes. 
 - Experience developing software that needs to operate reliably across Windows and Linux environments. 

What Good Looks Like: 

You should be comfortable going beyond: 

"The API returned an error. "

and investigating: Sensor → process → socket → DNS → proxy/firewall → network → cloud service to determine exactly where and why something failed. 

You should be equally comfortable reasoning about: 

- Why is a process consuming excessive CPU or memory
 - Why communication works in one customer network but fails in another
 - How to safely upgrade thousands of deployed sensors
 - How to recover when a sensor loses connectivity for several hours
 - How to execute security scans without destabilising customer infrastructure
 - How to collect enough diagnostics to troubleshoot systems you cannot directly access

The ideal candidate is fundamentally a systems/security engineer who can build reliable software, rather than a conventional CRUD/backend application developer. 

If you're passionate about cyber risk, thrive in a fast-paced environment, and want to be part of a team that's redefining security, we want to hear from you! 🚀

data.title: Principal Software Engineer
data.description:
There are NO limits to your career: come shape the future and be part of a truly unique global culture at OutSystems!

Principal Platform Engineer, DevSecOps

Who are we?

We provide the agentic systems platform that enterprise leaders trust to build and secure their applications, agents, and mission critical systems. 

Release Engineering owns the pipelines, controls and release infrastructure every OutSystems release passes through, so security and availability are built into how we ship. 

How can you help us?

We are hiring a Principal Engineer to own the technical strategy for securing the inner loop of our delivery: the images, repositories, registries and developer workflows that every build starts from. 

The work is concrete. Base images reach our builds through several registries, and their provenance has to be consistent across all of them. Our GitHub organization operates under governance and DLP controls that are still maturing. Security findings need to reach engineers inside their workflow, early enough to act on and tuned so that signal beats noise. You would own how these fit together and build a meaningful part of it yourself. 

In This Role You Are Expected To

- Own the technical strategy for inner-loop security across R&D: set direction, make the trade-off calls, and bring engineering, product and security leadership along. 
 - Stay hands-on. Design and build what you architect (base image pipelines, registry policy, GitHub automation, IaC modules, security tooling), own critical paths yourself, and work in the code alongside the team. 
 - Own the base image supply: hardened image provenance, lifecycle and rebuild automation, so every build starts from a known-good foundation. 
 - Govern the registries: what can be pushed, pulled and promoted, by whom, and with what provenance, so nothing reaches a build outside the governed path. 
 - Own GitHub governance: organization-level policy, access and DLP controls, repository standards, and the automation that keeps hundreds of repositories compliant without slowing engineers down. 
 - Build security into the SDLC from the start: automated SAST, DAST, SCA and secrets detection in developer workflows, tuned to keep false positives low. 
 - Produce the provenance and evidence the release path depends on, so verification at deploy time is automatic rather than manual. 
 - Lead cross-team technical initiatives that raise engineering standards across the organization, and lead architecture and design reviews at a strategic level. 
 - Mentor engineers at every level, beyond your immediate team. 
 - Apply AI and agents to how release and security engineering work gets done. 
 - Write the standards others build against: security baselines, IaC patterns, repository and image standards, based on what you have implemented yourself. 

What You Need To Succeed In This Job

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related field, or equivalent experience. 
 - You have owned the security of a source-to-build platform (repositories, images, registries, developer tooling) end to end, at scale, for a large engineering organization. 
 - Deep security engineering background: software supply chain security at the source (hardened images, registry governance, provenance), SDLC security gating, secrets management and source control governance. 
 - Hands-on experience with GitHub at organization scale: policies, GitHub Actions, GitHub Advanced Security or equivalent, and API-driven automation. 
 - Hands-on experience with Kubernetes and container tooling, a major cloud (Azure and/or AWS), CI/CD at scale, Terraform, and modern SDLC languages (Python, . NET). 
 - Working knowledge of SOC 2 Type 2 and FedRAMP Moderate, including how their controls apply to source control and build integrity. 
 - A track record of cross-team technical leadership and mentoring without formal management authority. 
 - Working hours with meaningful overlap with our European teams, and willingness to work across time zones. 
 - Fluency in English, written and spoken, and excellent communication skills. 

Nice to have

- Familiarity with hardened base image distributions (such as Chainguard), SLSA, Sigstore or SBOM tooling in production. 
 - Experience building agentic systems or AI agents applied to developer workflows. 
 - Experience in platform engineering or developer experience for large engineering organizations. 

What do we have to offer you?

- A company that keeps growing, changing and innovating, with room for teams to be proactive and creative. 
 - Career opportunities, including promotions and moves to other teams in the company. 
 - Colleagues who are smart, hardworking and driven, spread across the globe. 
 - We work to four company values: Trust, Customer Success, Innovation and Alignment. We act as one global OutSystems team, which for this role means working as one with your counterpart in Portugal. 

To see what working in OutSystems Engineering is like, follow our day-to-day work and technical challenges on our engineering channels. 

Are you ready for the next step in your career? Then we'd love to hear from you. 

More about OutSystems

OutSystems is a leading AI Development Platform built for the enterprise. Global organizations trust OutSystems to rapidly build mission-critical apps and agents, modernize legacy processes with agentic systems, and govern their entire AI portfolio across complex regulatory environments, all on one unified platform. 

As the future becomes agentic, our customers need us now more than ever. While AI has opened the door to extraordinary possibilities, most large organizations find themselves stuck on one side of the "enterprise gap" because AI by itself doesn't solve their complex use cases and business challenges. OutSystems bridges the "enterprise gap" by combining the speed of generative AI with a deterministic, enterprise-grade framework. We provide the tools for teams of any size to deliver high-quality, reliable AI solutions that drive real business impact. 

We are looking for passionate, talented, and motivated people to join us as we empower organizations to build, deploy, and scale the next generation of enterprise software. While we are leading the charge into the agentic era, our mission is broader: we are the platform enterprise leaders trust to evolve their entire business, accelerating innovation through secure, governed human-AI collaboration. 

OutSystems is a global company, with more than 900k developer community members, 1, 700 employees, more than 600 partners, and thousands of active customers in over 75 countries and across 21 industries. Founded in 2001, OutSystems now has offices in the United States, United Kingdom, the Netherlands, Portugal, Germany, the UAE, Japan, Hong Kong, Malaysia, Australia, India, and Singapore, and includes a thriving, worldwide community of remote employees. 

Our customers are some of the world's most recognizable brands across diverse industries- such as Toyota, Heineken, Bosch, KeyBank, and UCLA-who trust OutSystems to deliver ROI and transformational impact. 

Consistently recognized as a leader by top analyst firms Gartner, IDC and Forrester, OutSystems continues to shape the future of enterprise software development in the agentic era. We are proud to be named a leader in more than 100 categories on G2, including #1 in Customer Satisfaction in Enterprise Low Code Development, and most recently as a leader in AI Agent Building in the G2 Spring 2026 Reports. 

Working at OutSystems

Our culture is built on our core values of Trust, Customer Success, Innovation, and Alignment. We operate as one global OutSystems team, taking ownership to pursue our vision of being the AI platform enterprise leaders trust to build, secure, and evolve their most critical applications and systems. 

What do we have to offer you?

- A company at the vanguard of the agentic revolution, where we don't just react to AI innovation-we architect it. Joining OutSystems means stepping onto a high-growth rocket ship that combines the fearless agility of a startup with the sophisticated, global foundation of an enterprise powerhouse. 
 - Real growth opportunities. We don't just talk about development; we invest in it through structured programs designed to scale your expertise. Whether you are aiming for vertical progression, exploring lateral moves into new domains, or mastering specialized AI skills through our Professional Development Fund and Internal Mobility Program, we provide the resources to get you there. 
 - A global collective of world-class talent, where you'll collaborate with enterprise software legends and sought-after thought leaders. At OutSystems, our industry experts aren't just visionaries-they are accessible, approachable mentors who are deeply invested in your growth as we architect the agentic future together. 

OutSystems nurtures an inclusive culture where talented individuals from all backgrounds are empowered to learn, experiment and make an impact. . We believe that driving our next phase of growth requires the radical creativity that only comes from diverse perspectives. We are committed to building a team as global and diverse as the organizations we serve, ensuring every individual can perform to their full potential. As an equal opportunity employer, all qualified applicants receive equal consideration regardless of race, origin, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, veteran status, or any other protected status.

About The Role

The Cloud Engineer designs, builds, and operates core cloud platform capabilities with a primary focus on AWS, while supporting Azure and Google Cloud Platform (GCP) where required. This role is responsible for delivering standardized, automated, and reusable cloud foundations-such as account provisioning, identity integration, networking baselines, and deployment pipelines-that enable application teams to move quickly without compromising security, governance, or reliability. 

The Cloud Engineer works closely with Cloud Engineering, Architecture, Security, and Operations to translate architectural standards into durable platform services. The emphasis is on automation-first delivery, infrastructure-as-code, and building platforms that scale through consistency rather than manual effort. 

#BetterDaysStartNow

Principal Cloud Engineer

The Cloud Engineer designs, builds, and operates core cloud platform capabilities with a primary focus on AWS, while supporting Azure and Google Cloud Platform (GCP) where required. This role is responsible for delivering standardized, automated, and reusable cloud foundations-such as account provisioning, identity integration, networking baselines, and deployment pipelines-that enable application teams to move quickly without compromising security, governance, or reliability.

The emphasis is on automation-first delivery, infrastructure-as-code, and building platforms that scale through consistency rather than manual effort. 

Cloud Engineering & Delivery

Observability & Reliability

Security, Governance & Compliance Enablement

Documentation & Enablement

Minimum Qualifications

- 8+ years of experience in cloud engineering, Cloud Engineering, or DevOps roles. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with AWS; exposure to Azure and/or GCP strongly preferred. 
 - Proven proficiency with Infrastructure as Code, preferably Terraform.

 - Strong written communication skills with the ability to produce clear technical documentation and platform standards. 

What Success Looks Like

- Platform services are reliable, repeatable, and consumed broadly by application teams. 
 - Cloud environments launch with consistent security, networking, and governance baselines. 
 - Manual effort decreases as automation and self-service increase. 
 - Platform standards are implemented in code, not enforced through meetings. 
 - Application teams can move faster because the platform "just works. "

Physical Job Requirements

Working within Pune R&D Engineering, this role develops UI, API, and integration test automation using Playwright and JavaScript, integrates it into Jenkins CI/CD pipelines, and drives automation best practices, test data strategy, and quality metrics across the team. Partnering closely with developers and product teams, the Senior SDET investigates complex failures, performs root cause analysis, and helps the team ship high-quality releases with confidence.

 - Quality Practices: Drive automation best practices, test data strategy, and quality metrics, and report on quality trends to engineering leadership.

data.title: QA Automation Engineer Playwright
data.description:
Position: QA Engineer

Location: Pune

ACS-I India is looking for a junior automation QA engineer with one to four years of experience to join the Quality Engineering team. The engineer writes, maintains, and runs automated tests for web applications and APIs that support chemical, scientific, and laboratory data. The work is done with guidance from senior engineers, and the engineer uses GenAI assistants to work faster while remaining responsible for the quality of every test committed. 

The role suits engineers early in their automation career. Engineers at the lower end of the range work on assigned tests and fixes with close guidance. Engineers at the upper end own automation for a module of the product and support newer team members. 

Job Responsibilities

Test automation

- Write, maintain, and run automated end-to-end UI tests using Selenium WebDriver with TestNG (Java) or PyTest (Python), and with Playwright where the team uses it. 
 - Extend the existing automation frameworks with new page objects, utilities, and test data handling, following the design set by senior engineers. 
 - Enhance, debug, and execute existing browser-automation suites written in Java with Selenium and TestNG, or in Python with Selenium and PyTest. 
 - Write human-readable scenarios in Gherkin using Cucumber or Behave, and bind them to step definitions. 
 - Build and run API integration tests with the Karate Framework or an equivalent tool, covering positive, negative, and edge cases. 
 - Investigate failing tests, separate product defects from test defects and environment issues, and fix timing problems, dynamic locators, and unstable tests. 
 - Publish test results with Allure Reports, including attachments and history, and flag flaky and slow tests to the team. 

Pipelines and version control

- Run, monitor, and troubleshoot automated test jobs in Jenkins, including the nightly regression, and report failures to the team with clear evidence. 
 - Update simple stages of a Jenkinsfile under guidance, and learn to author declarative pipelines over time. 
 - Support test runs on AWS-hosted test environments, and read logs and results in services such as CloudWatch and S3. 
 - Work in Git every day: use feature branches, raise pull requests, respond to review comments, merge and rebase changes, and resolve merge conflicts in the test repositories, following the team's branching strategy. 

Test design and quality practice

- Analyze requirements and user stories, design test cases and test data, including edge cases, and recommend which scenarios to automate first. 
 - Perform manual and exploratory testing where automation does not yet cover a feature. 
 - Log defects with clear steps, evidence, and severity, verify fixes, and take part in sprint refinement, planning, and retrospectives. 
 - Learn the chemical and scientific data domain, including workflows, units of measurement, and data visualizations, and apply it in test design. 

GenAI-assisted quality engineering

- Use GitHub Copilot and AI-native IDEs such as Windsurf to write, refactor, and debug automation code, and review and understand every suggestion before committing it. 
 - Use Claude to draft test cases and edge-case scenarios from requirements and domain specifications, and check each result against the source requirement. 
 - Follow the organization's guidelines on code and data confidentiality when using AI tools, and share useful techniques with the team. 

Growth

- Pair with senior engineers, take part in code reviews, and build the skills to design and extend automation frameworks. 

Technologies and tools

Java or Python, Selenium WebDriver, TestNG, PyTest, Unittest, Playwright, Allure Framework, Cucumber, Behave, Gherkin, Karate Framework, Git, Jenkins (Jenkinsfile), AWS (EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, CloudWatch), GitHub Copilot, Windsurf, Claude, defect tracking tools such as Jira

Job Requirements

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in computer science, software engineering, information technology, chemical engineering, chemistry, or an equivalent technical discipline. 
 - One to four years of experience in software QA, including at least one year of hands-on test automation on commercial or project work. 
 - Programming: working proficiency in Java (object-oriented concepts and collections) or Python (data structures and basic asynchronous programming). 
 - UI automation: hands-on experience with Selenium WebDriver and a test runner (TestNG for Java, PyTest or Unittest for Python), including locator strategies, waits, and the page object model. Playwright experience in TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, or Java for end-to-end web tests. 
 - Git: comfortable with branching, merging, pull requests, and resolving merge conflicts. 
 - Testing fundamentals: understanding of test case design, the software development and testing lifecycles, the defect lifecycle, and smoke, regression, and exploratory testing. 
 - API testing: understanding of REST, JSON, and HTTP status codes, and experience testing APIs with Karate, Postman, or a similar tool. 
 - Continuous integration: able to run jobs and read results in Jenkins or a similar CI tool. 
 - Debugging: able to investigate failing tests, including timing issues, dynamic locators, and network state. 
 - Clear communication: reports defects and status clearly in writing and in team discussions. 
 - Responsible use of AI tools: willing to use GenAI assistants daily and to verify their output before relying on it. 
 - Commitment to learning: learns on the job and outside of work, welcomes feedback, and is willing to pair with others. 

Nice to have

- Allure Framework setup, including attachments, dashboards, and historical trends. 
 - BDD experience with Cucumber or Behave. 
 - Hands-on experience with the Karate Framework. 
 - Jenkins pipeline authoring in declarative or scripted form. 
 - Git branching strategies such as Gitflow, and webhook integration. 
 - AWS services such as EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, and CloudWatch as they apply to test infrastructure. 
 - Experience with GitHub Copilot, Windsurf, or Claude, including writing prompts for test design. 
 - Experience tracking flaky-test rates and pipeline execution time. 
 - Experience testing applications in the chemical, petrochemical, pharmaceutical, materials science, or laboratory information management domains, and familiarity with units of measurement and scientific data visualizations.

Virginia Transformer is the largest U. S. -owned manufacturer of power transformers in North America, with over 50 years of experience delivering engineered-to-order transformer solutions across Data Center, Utility, Industrial, and Renewable Energy markets. 

Following significant growth, we are expanding our engineering team in India to support our next phase of expansion. 

Role Overview

We are seeking skilled and experienced Control Design Engineer with strong technical expertise in the design and development of control systems for Power Transformers, Auto Transformers, and Switchgear. 

The selected candidates will be responsible for developing control schematics, RTCC and OLTC control systems, cooling fan controls, wiring diagrams, control panel designs, and engineering documentation while ensuring compliance with customer specifications and applicable industry standards. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design and develop electrical control systems for Power Transformers, Auto Transformers, and Switchgear. 
 - Prepare control schematics, wiring diagrams, and detailed engineering drawings for transformer control panels. 
 - Design and develop RTCC (Remote Tap Changer Control) panels and OLTC (On-Load Tap Changer) control circuits. 
 - Develop control circuits for transformer cooling fans, temperature monitoring, alarms, and protection systems. 
 - Work with Current Transformers (CT), auxiliary circuits, and associated control and protection components. 
 - Support integration of transformer control systems with SCADA and PLC-based automation systems. 
 - Perform electrical load calculations, wire sizing, and selection of circuit protection devices. 
 - Review customer specifications, technical requirements, and engineering documentation. 
 - Prepare Bills of Materials (BOM), component specifications, and design notes.

 - Ensure designs comply with applicable IEEE, ANSI, IEC, and customer-specific requirements.

 - Ensure design accuracy, timely completion of engineering deliverables, and adherence to quality standards. 
 - Support engineering improvements, design standardization, and technical documentation. 

Qualifications & Experience

- Bachelor's Degree or Diploma in Electrical Engineering, Electrical & Electronics Engineering, or a related discipline. 
 - 4-10 years of relevant experience in transformer control design, switchgear engineering, or electrical control panel design. 
 - Hands-on experience in transformer control schematics, RTCC panels, OLTC controls, and panel wiring. 
 - Knowledge of electrical control circuits, protection systems, and electrical engineering drawings. 
 - Understanding of SCADA and PLC integration will be an added advantage. 
 - Experience in Power Transformer or Auto Transformer control design is preferred. 
 - Familiarity with relevant industry standards and engineering practices. 

Preferred Technical Skills

 - Auto Transformer Control Systems
 - RTCC & OLTC Control Circuits
 - Control Panel Design & Engineering
 - Transformer Cooling Control Systems
 - SCADA & PLC Integration
 - Electrical Wiring Diagrams & Schematics
 - Current Transformer (CT) Circuits
 - Load Calculations & Wire Sizing
 - Circuit Protection & Component Selection
 - Bill of Materials (BOM) Preparation
 - CAD / Electrical Design Software
 - IEEE / ANSI / IEC Standards

Key Competencies

- Strong Technical Knowledge
 - Engineering Judgment & Analytical Thinking
 - Problem-Solving & Decision-Making
 - Attention to Detail & Design Accuracy
 - Ownership & Accountability
 - Teamwork & Cross-Functional Collaboration
 - Effective Communication
 - Design Quality & Process Discipline
 - Learning Agility & Adaptability
 - Timely Engineering Delivery

Why Join Virginia Transformer?

- Global Exposure: Work closely with USA-based engineering and manufacturing teams. 
 - Engineering Excellence: Contribute to technically challenging engineered-to-order transformer projects. 
 - High-Growth Environment: Be part of an organization expanding into its next 3X growth phase. 
 - Career Development: Opportunities for technical advancement and professional growth. 
 - Innovation: Contribute to engineering improvements, automation, and design standardization. 

Ready to Power Your Career?

Join Virginia Transformer Corp - The Commitment Company. 

We are looking for motivated engineering professionals with strong technical expertise, ownership, problem-solving capabilities, and a commitment to engineering excellence.

data.title: Team Lead - Cargo Operations & Capacity Planning
data.description:
Job Purpose

Supervises and coordinates the daily activities of the Cargo Operations and Load Planning team to ensure efficient, accurate, and compliant cargo operations across the network. The role supports operational excellence by overseeing load planning, monitoring team performance, providing guidance to planners, and ensuring adherence to safety, regulatory, and operational standards. 

Key Result Responsibilities

- Supervise the planning and coordination of daily cargo operations, including general cargo, courier, special cargo, and interline shipments. 
 - Plan and manage team rosters to ensure adequate staffing levels, operational coverage, and compliance with duty time requirements. 
 - Ensure accurate load plans are prepared and released to Ground Handling Agents (GHAs), maintaining full compliance with operational, safety, and regulatory requirements. 
 - Monitor load planner performance and provide coaching, feedback, and on-the-job training to maintain and improve operational standards. 
 - Optimize aircraft belly space utilization while prioritizing safety, weight and balance limitations, and regulatory compliance. 
 - Oversee intra-country trucking coordination as assigned and interline cargo connections to ensure seamless cargo movement. 
 - Ensure critical system changes (cargo reservations, weight amendments, HS codes, AWB corrections) are accurately executed in a timely manner. 
 - Monitor EDI messaging accuracy (FFM, FWB, FHL) and initiate corrective actions where discrepancies are identified. 

Key Result Responsibilities - Continued

- Identify operational backlogs, discrepancies, or delayed flights, and coordinate effective recovery and mitigation plans. 
 - Ensure accurate documentation and reporting of operational deviations, incidents, and corrective actions. 
 - Collaborate closely with internal stakeholders including Station Operations, Flight Operations, Revenue Management, and Cargo Sales to ensure smooth and efficient cargo operations across the network. 

People Management

- Provides direction, coaching and guidance to team members for their career and professional development. 
 - Creates a conducive working environment to build and sustain a performance driven, engaged, and committed team. 
 - Ensures people management responsibilities are handled effectively in line with company procedures. 

Qualifications (Academic, Training, Languages)

- Bachelor's degree in Aviation, Logistics, Supply Chain Management, or related field preferred. Certification in Air Cargo Operations, Load Planning, or Dangerous Goods regulations is a plus. 
 - Strong computer literacy, including Microsoft Office and cargo system applications. 
 - Ability to work under pressure in a 24x7 operational environment with shift schedules. 
 - Fluent in English; additional languages a plus. 
 - Strong understanding of cargo operations, load planning principles, and airline operational procedures. 
 - Ability to supervise, mentor, and coordinate a team of planners effectively. 
 - Analytical and problem-solving skills to optimize load planning and operational efficiency. 
 - Excellent communication, coordination, and stakeholder management abilities. 

Work Experience

- 4 - 6 years of experience in air cargo operations, with at least 2 years in a supervisory or team leading role.

data.title: Supervising Associate For Netting And Settlement
data.description:
At EY, you'll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we're counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all. 

Supervising Associate - Netting and Settlement

Finance and Accounting: Controlling

Role purpose. 

Lead the day-to-day delivery of the NetPay netting and settlement process, ensuring accurate reconciliation of intercompany balances, timely settlement, strong controls and a consistent service experience for participating EY member firms. The role combines operational ownership with people leadership, member-firm onboarding, stakeholder management, escalation management and continuous improvement. 

Key Responsibilities

- NetPay operations and settlement delivery
 - Own and coordinate daily NetPay operations across participating member firms, ensuring activities are completed accurately, on time and in line with agreed controls and service expectations. 
 - Oversee the review and matching of intercompany invoices and open positions across AP and AR, ensuring completeness, consistency and timely resolution of discrepancies. 
 - Coordinate the identification and exchange of missing documents and support member firms in correcting mismatches, disputed invoices and other exceptions. 
 - Review periodic netting and payment calculations and confirm that settlement outputs are complete, accurate and appropriately validated before circulation. 
 - Monitor member-firm payment execution and support the correct application and clearing of receipts and payments. 
 - Maintain operational trackers, reconciliations, evidence and process documentation to support transparency, control and audit readiness. 

- Member-firm onboarding and adoption
 - Partner with member firms to onboard them into NetPay, from initial engagement and process assessment through readiness, testing, implementation and transition to business-as-usual operations. 
 - Explain NetPay requirements, roles, timelines, controls, data and documentation expectations to local Finance, AP, AR, Treasury and Controlling stakeholders. 
 - Develop onboarding plans, track dependencies and risks, and coordinate actions across the central netting team and member-firm stakeholders. 
 - Facilitate onboarding workshops, process walkthroughs and knowledge-transfer sessions; provide post-go-live support and stabilize operations. 
 - Monitor adoption and compliance after onboarding, address gaps and promote consistent use of the standard NetPay process. 

- Team management and capability development
 - Provide day-to-day direction, work allocation and prioritization for the Netting and Settlement team, balancing operational deadlines, onboarding activity and improvement initiatives. 
 - Review team output for quality, completeness and timeliness; provide practical coaching and feedback to strengthen technical and stakeholder-management capability. 
 - Ensure adequate coverage, effective handovers and clear ownership of recurring activities, exceptions and follow-ups. 
 - Create an inclusive, collaborative environment that encourages accountability, knowledge sharing, continuous learning and proactive problem solving. 
 - Identify training needs, maintain process knowledge and support the development of subject-matter expertise and succession capability within the team. 

- Stakeholder and escalation management
 - Act as the primary operational point of contact for participating member firms and central stakeholders on NetPay, netting and settlement matters. 
 - Build effective working relationships across geographies and functions, align expectations and provide clear, concise updates on operational status, risks, issues and decisions required. 
 - Manage escalations relating to unmatched items, missing documents, disputed invoices, delayed payments, process non-compliance and service delivery concerns. 
 - Perform root-cause analysis, agree corrective actions with relevant stakeholders and monitor actions through closure. 
 - Escalate material risks and unresolved issues to leadership promptly, supported by facts, impact assessment and recommended next steps. 

- Quality, controls and process improvement
 - Drive a strong quality and control culture through defined review checks, exception monitoring, ageing analysis and timely corrective action. 
 - Identify recurring issues, control gaps, manual effort and process bottlenecks; translate observations into practical improvement initiatives. 
 - Lead or support standardization, simplification and automation opportunities that improve accuracy, cycle time, transparency and stakeholder experience. 
 - Define and monitor relevant operational measures, quality indicators and action plans; use data and trends to prioritize improvement opportunities. 
 - Maintain standard operating procedures, process maps, control documentation and other governance materials so they remain current and usable. 
 - Support internal and external audit requirements relating to intercompany netting and settlement, including timely provision of evidence and resolution of observations. 

- Reporting and governance
 - Prepare and review weekly operational reporting for participating member firms, providing visibility of invoice status, exceptions, ageing, pending actions and key risks. 
 - Provide regular management updates covering delivery performance, onboarding progress, escalations, quality, improvement initiatives and decisions required. 
 - Facilitate operational governance calls and ensure actions, owners and target dates are clearly documented and followed through. 
 - Ensure compliance with applicable accounting requirements, EY policies, legal requirements and locally agreed operating procedures. 
To qualify for the role, you must have

- Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration or a related field. 
 - Relevant experience in intercompany accounting, AP, AR, financial accounting, netting, settlement, treasury operations or a comparable finance process. 
 - Demonstrated experience coordinating or supervising a team, including work allocation, quality review, coaching and delivery oversight. 
 - Experience managing stakeholders across countries, functions and levels, with confidence in handling operational escalations and competing priorities. 
 - Working knowledge of ERP and accounting systems; experience with SAP is preferred. 
 - Strong understanding of reconciliations, transaction matching, exception management, payment flows and financial controls. 
 - Ability to analyze operational data, identify root causes and translate findings into sustainable process improvements. 
 - Good written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex issues clearly and drive actions to closure. 
 - Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively in a global, cross-cultural team environment. 

What We Look For

- People who combine finance process knowledge with sound judgment, service orientation and the confidence to lead through operational complexity. 
 - Professionals who are curious, collaborative and willing to challenge existing ways of working while protecting quality and control. 
 - Individuals who can create trusted relationships with member firms and motivate a team to deliver reliable outcomes. 

What We Offer

EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic global delivery network. In this role, you will collaborate with EY teams across geographies and contribute to a process that supports accurate, timely and transparent intercompany settlement. 

- Continuous learning: Develop the mindset and skills to navigate what comes next. 
 - Success as defined by you: Use the tools and flexibility available to make a meaningful impact. 
 - Transformative leadership: Build the insight, coaching capability and confidence needed to lead effectively. 
 - Diverse and inclusive culture: Use your voice, value different perspectives and help others contribute at their best. 

EY | Building a better working world

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets. 

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate. 

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

data.title: Consulting Manager
data.description:
Role Overview

OFI Services is seeking a Technical Consulting Manager to lead the architecture and delivery of enterprise-grade solutions across cloud, data, AI and automation platforms. You will define how solutions are designed and built, choose the right platforms and services for each concern, and ensure that teams deliver them to a high engineering standard. You will own technical direction and delivery quality, guide a team of engineers and consultants, and act as the escalation point for complex architecture, integration and performance challenges. 

This is a design-and-lead role, not an individual-contributor build role. The ideal candidate has a track record of architecting large solutions that teams then build and operate, and remains technical enough to challenge designs, review code and make sound platform choices. You will also grow into broader team and client leadership. 

Key Responsibilities

Solution Architecture and Design

- Define the end-to-end technical architecture for enterprise solutions, from requirement gathering and discovery through design, build, testing, deployment, hypercare and production support. 
 - Select and justify platforms and services (build, buy or configure) against client needs, cost, security and scalability, using standard or custom platforms as appropriate. 
 - Review and approve solution designs, data models and code produced by the team; set engineering standards, architecture decision records and peer-review practices. 
 - Produce reference architectures, patterns and reusable accelerators that can be applied across engagements. Cloud, Platform and DevOps Engineering

- Architect solutions on GCP, Microsoft Azure and the wider Microsoft ecosystem (for example Microsoft Fabric, Power Platform, Entra ID and Microsoft 365), selecting best-in-class services for each need. 
 - Establish Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD and DevOps standards (for example Terraform or Bicep with GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps or Cloud Build) with automated testing, environment promotion and release governance. 
 - Design identity and access management, secrets management and security controls, including role-based access, single sign-on, least-privilege and audit trails. 
 - Define observability, monitoring, alerting and incident management practices across applications, data pipelines and AI workloads (for example OpenTelemetry, Azure Monitor and Google Cloud Operations). 
 - Guide non-functional design: performance, resilience, disaster recovery, cost management (FinOps) and compliance. Data Engineering and Knowledge Platforms

- Oversee the design and optimisation of data platforms and pipelines: ingestion, ETL/ELT, orchestration, data modelling, data quality and lineage. 
 - Lead integration with enterprise applications such as SAP ECC/S/4HANA, Oracle, Salesforce and ServiceNow, ensuring data quality, scalability and performance. 
 - Design knowledge graph solutions (for example Neo4j and other graph or semantic technologies) and ontologies that connect enterprise data for analytics, search and AI use cases. 
 - Set standards for data governance, security, access control and data validation. AI, Automation and Enterprise Platforms

- Design AI solutions that use large language models appropriately, including hosted models such as Claude and self-hosted or open-weight models run through tools such as Ollama, with attention to retrieval, agents, guardrails, evaluation, data privacy and cost. 
 - Architect extensions and integrations on SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP), including the use of SAP Joule and AI capabilities within SAP landscapes. 
 - Lead intelligent automation design using UiPath and related tools such as Power Automate, combining RPA, APIs and AI in governed, scalable operating models. 
 - Oversee process intelligence solutions, including Celonis (PQL, object-centric process mining, Action Flows and AI features), where these form part of the client solution. Delivery and Team Leadership

- Own delivery of engagements end to end: scoping, estimation, planning, solution delivery, hypercare and handover to production support. 
 - Lead, coach and develop a team of consultants and engineers; run staffing, performance reviews and career development. 
 - Mentor the team, run technical training and support certification paths across cloud, data and platform skills. 
 - Manage engagement financials, including budgets, utilisation, forecasting and margin. 
 - Build reusable assets, templates and best practices, and set delivery quality standards for the team. Client and Practice Leadership

- Act as the senior technical contact for business sponsors, process owners and IT leadership; manage expectations, risks, scope and escalations. 
 - Support pre-sales and solutioning: discovery workshops, architecture proposals, demos, proofs of value, sizing and statements of work. 
 - Track the technology landscape and vendor roadmaps (cloud, SAP, AI and automation) and share new capabilities with the team and clients. 
 - Represent OFI in client steering committees and internal practice forums. Required Skills and Experience

Architecture and Delivery

- Proven experience designing and delivering enterprise-scale solutions, where the team builds to your architecture and you own design quality and delivery outcomes. 
 - Ability to evaluate standard versus custom platforms and make clear, defensible technology choices. 
 - Ability to estimate effort, manage technical risk and lead delivery across multiple concurrent workstreams. Cloud and Engineering Practices

- Strong working knowledge of GCP and/or Azure, and of Microsoft platforms and tools. 
 - Hands-on grounding in Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD, DevOps, identity and access management, and observability, with the judgement to choose best-in-class tooling for each. Platforms, AI and Automation

- Experience with SAP BTP and SAP Joule, UiPath, and LLM platforms such as Claude and Ollama. 
 - Experience with knowledge graphs (Neo4j and similar technologies), including data modelling and query languages such as Cypher. 
 - Working knowledge of Celonis or other process mining platforms is an advantage (see Good to Have). Data Engineering

- Good understanding of data engineering tools and concepts: ETL/ELT, orchestration, data warehouses and lakehouses, streaming and batch processing, data modelling, governance and quality. 
 - Working knowledge of SQL and Python (Spark is a plus), sufficient to review designs and code and guide the team. 
 - Experience integrating enterprise applications such as SAP, Oracle, Salesforce and ServiceNow. Required Qualifications

- 10+ years of experience in software, data or cloud engineering, solution architecture or technology consulting, with at least 5 years architecting enterprise solutions and at least 3 years leading teams or workstreams. 
 - Proven record of delivering enterprise programmes across at least two industries or business domains (for example finance, supply chain, procurement or manufacturing). 
 - Excellent communication, stakeholder management and executive presentation skills. 
 - Strong problem-solving ability and comfort working with ambiguity. 
 - Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science or a related field (Master's or MBA preferred). Good to Have

- Hands-on experience with Celonis, including PQL and object-centric process mining. 
 - Exposure to AWS in addition to GCP and Azure. 
 - Experience with agentic AI patterns, the Model Context Protocol (MCP) and AI governance frameworks. 
 - Experience with Task Mining or other process intelligence tools.

data.description:
Req ID: 387939

NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now. 

We are currently seeking a Salesforce Architect to join our team in Bangalore, Karnātaka (IN-KA), India (IN). 

"Key Responsibilities

- Own end-to-end solution architecture across Agentforce, Salesforce CPQ and Revenue Cloud Advanced. 
 - Architect agent-assisted and agentic workflows across opportunity, configuration, pricing, quoting, contracting, ordering and revenue lifecycle processes. 
 - Design agent orchestration patterns, including tool/function calling, workflow delegation, multi-agent patterns, state management and memory. 
 - Architect integration of Agentforce with Salesforce automation, Apex, Flow, APIs, MuleSoft and external enterprise services. 
 - Define appropriate use of LLMs, deterministic logic, workflow engines and traditional automation, rather than defaulting all use cases to generative AI. 
 - Design context engineering and retrieval strategies, including structured/unstructured grounding, retrieval depth, metadata filtering and relevance optimization. 
 - Establish secure agent action patterns using least-privilege access, guardrails, validation, approval checkpoints and human-in-the-loop mechanisms. 
 - Define AI evaluation frameworks covering answer quality, grounding, hallucination, task completion, tool selection, latency and business outcomes. 
 - Establish observability across agent reasoning paths, actions, integration failures, token/credit consumption and operational performance. 
 - Assess model and platform trade-offs across quality, latency, context window, cost, privacy and enterprise constraints. 
 - Architect resilient action layers and transactional integration patterns for revenue processes where consistency and recoverability are critical. 
 - Advise programs on consumption-based economics, AI credit/token optimization and architectural approaches to control run-time cost. 
 - Lead architecture reviews, design authorities and technical governance across global delivery teams. 
 - Mentor technical architects, developers and Agentforce specialists. 

Required Technical Expertise

- Salesforce Agentforce and associated agentic architecture concepts. 
 - Salesforce CPQ and Revenue Cloud Advanced / Revenue Lifecycle Management. 
 - Salesforce Sales Cloud and core platform architecture. 
 - Agent orchestration and tool/function calling. 
 - Multi-agent architectures, delegation and coordination patterns. 
 - Agent state, short/long-term memory and session/context management. 
 - MCP and agent-to-agent interoperability concepts/patterns. 
 - RAG, semantic/vector search, embeddings, chunking and retrieval optimization. 
 - Context engineering beyond basic prompt engineering. 
 - Evaluation frameworks and AI observability. 
 - AI safety, grounding, guardrails and least-privilege action design. 
 - LLM model selection and architectural trade-offs. 
 - Classic NLP concepts including intent classification, entity extraction, semantic similarity and ranking. 
 - Apex, Lightning Platform, Flow, APIs and enterprise integration patterns. 
 - Strong understanding of asynchronous processing, transaction boundaries, resiliency, retries and idempotency. 
 - Security architecture including sharing, CRUD/FLS, permission models and data protection. 

Preferred Qualifications

- 15+ years overall technology experience; 10+ years in Salesforce CPQ / Revenue Cloud architecture. 
 - Proven experience architecting enterprise CPQ / Quote-to-Cash implementations. 
 - Salesforce Application/System/Technical Architect credentials strongly preferred. 
 - Agentforce and Revenue Cloud-related certifications or demonstrable implementation experience. 
 - Experience with MuleSoft and large enterprise integration landscapes preferred.

data.title: Sr Architect, Solutions- (GCP, Cloud Spanner) [T500-30573]
data.description:
About T-Mobile: 

T-Mobile US, Inc. (NASDAQ: TMUS), headquartered in Bellevue, Washington, is America's supercharged Un-carrier, connecting millions through its strong nationwide network and flagship brands, T-Mobile and Metro by T-Mobile. Customers benefit from an unmatched combination of value, quality, and exceptional service experience. 

TMUS Global Solutions: 

TMUS Global Solutions is a world-class technology powerhouse accelerating the company's global digital transformation. With a culture built on growth, inclusivity, and global collaboration, the teams here drive innovation at scale, powered by bold thinking. 

ABOUT THE ROLE: 

- Own the Architecture of Customer Truth
 - The Data Architect, CDP owns the end-to-end architecture of T-Mobile's Customer Data Platform - the system of record for 100M+ customer profiles, now moving to Google Cloud to deliver real-time customer context, near-real-time signals, and sub-50ms API access. Any agent, store associate, or digital channel should see a customer's prior conversation and continue from there. 
 - You will architect how clickstream, care, store, and network data flows into Cloud Spanner (low-latency store), BigQuery (analytics), and a knowledge graph exposed via GraphQL and MCP servers - while leading coexistence with the Azure estate (Databricks, Snowflake, Data Factory, Event Hubs, Cosmos DB) to reuse proven ETL. 

RESPONSIBILITIES: 

What You'll Do: 

Platform Architecture & Real-Time Customer Context: 

- Own the end-to-end CDP architecture across Spanner, BigQuery, Pub/Sub, Dataflow, and the Azure lakehouse; define what lives in Spanner (current state), BigQuery (history), and the lakehouse
 - Design the unified customer profile and interaction-context model and own Spanner as the low-latency system of record (keys, hotspots, multi-region, change streams, DR) at sub-50ms reads

Streaming, Clickstream & Pipeline Architecture: 

- Design NRT ingestion with Pub/Sub and Dataflow (Beam) into Spanner and BigQuery, with data contracts, schema evolution, exactly-once semantics, and replay patterns
 - Codify reusable CDC, SCD Type 2, and late-arriving-data patterns; partner with NBA and T-Engage to cut signal latency to sub-five minutes

Hybrid-Cloud Migration: 

- Architect Azure-to-GCP data movement with STS and BigQuery-Spanner sync to reuse existing Databricks, Data Factory, and Snowflake ETL; lead the phased plan to migrate or retire Cosmos DB, Redis, Event Hubs, and Functions with dual-run and rollback criteria

Knowledge Graph, GraphQL & MCP: 

- Architect the customer knowledge graph on Spanner (ontology, identity resolution, Customer 360), the sub-50ms GraphQL API, and secure MCP servers on Cloud Run for AI agent access to CDP data

Governance, Operations & Technical Leadership: 

- Define data quality, lineage, and access standards (Dataplex, Unity Catalog, TISS-310), IAM/VPC-SC/CMEK controls, and standards for compute (Cloud Run, Dataproc, Dataflow, Composer), SLOs, FinOps, Terraform, and CI/CD
 - Serve as architectural authority - lead design reviews, maintain the runbook and ADRs, mentor engineers, and partner with product, analytics, and AI/ML teams

QUALIFICATIONS: 

What You'll Bring - Required Experience: 

- Overall (8+ years): Bachelor's in Computer Science or related field (or equivalent); 8+ years in data engineering and architecture, 4+ as a data architect or principal engineer owning a large-scale production platform. 
 - Google Cloud data platform (3+ years): Production data platforms on GCP, including IAM, VPC Service Controls, and cost governance. 
 - Cloud Spanner (2+ years): Schema and primary key design, interleaving, indexes, hotspot avoidance, change streams, and multi-region capacity planning. 
 - BigQuery (3+ years): Partitioning and clustering, reservations and cost control, Spanner federation, and BigQuery-to-Spanner (reverse ETL) data movement. 
 - Streaming & NRT pipelines (3+ years): Pub/Sub, Dataflow (Beam), Kafka, Event Hubs, or Spark Structured Streaming with exactly-once semantics, watermarking, and clickstream ingestion at scale. 
 - APIs & low-latency serving (3+ years): Designing REST/gRPC services, including 2+ years with GraphQL (schema design, federation, caching) against p99 targets under 50ms. 
 - Graph & identity resolution (2+ years): Knowledge-graph or property-graph modeling (Spanner Graph, Neo4j, or Cosmos DB), ontology design, and entity/identity resolution for Customer 360. 
 - AI & MCP integration (1+ year): Building or securing MCP servers, LLM/agent tool integrations, or Vertex AI-based data access patterns. 
 - Databricks, Spark & Delta Lake (4+ years): Spark internals and tuning, Delta Lake, Delta Live Tables, Unity Catalog, and medallion architecture, to reuse and migrate existing ETL. 
 - Azure & Snowflake (3+ years): Data Factory, Event Hubs, Cosmos DB, Redis, Functions, and App Service, plus Snowflake architecture, to lead a hybrid-cloud migration. 
 - Data modeling & ETL (5+ years): Dimensional, Data Vault, and medallion models; idempotent ETL/ELT (CDC, SCD Type 2); expert SQL and advanced PySpark. 
 - Platform engineering (3+ years): Terraform/IaC, CI/CD, Cloud Run, Dataproc, and Composer or Airflow; SLOs, observability, and FinOps. 
 - Leadership (3+ years): Leading architecture decisions across engineering, analytics, and product teams, with strong communication to technical and executive audiences.

data.description:
