EY GDS - RCT

Manager - Data, Cloud & AI Engineering

Manager - Technology Consulting

Experience: Strictly 8+ years

Mandatory eligibility: 

Candidates must have 8 or more years of relevant professional experience, including hands-on Python, advanced SQL, cloud, AI, and Financial Crime Compliance domain experience. Candidates below 8 years or without any mandatory capability are not eligible. 

The opportunity

Lead the delivery of data, cloud, and AI-enabled Financial Crime solutions for global financial services clients. This Manager role combines technical depth with delivery leadership, stakeholder management, team development, and end-to-end ownership. The successful candidate will shape solutions across KYC, AML, Transaction Monitoring, Sanctions, and Fraud while remaining close enough to the technology to guide architecture, review critical designs, resolve delivery risks, and assure quality. 

Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced Manager with strong Python and advanced SQL capability, practical cloud and AI delivery experience, and broad Financial Crime Compliance knowledge. The role owns outcomes from discovery and estimation through design, build, testing, deployment, transition, and production stabilization. It also includes team leadership, work planning, governance, financial oversight, client communication, and development of reusable assets and delivery standards. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead end-to-end delivery of Financial Crime technology workstreams, programs, or managed-service outcomes. 
 - Own solution scope, delivery plans, milestones, dependencies, risks, issues, quality, resource needs, and stakeholder commitments. 
 - Provide technical direction for Python applications, advanced SQL solutions, cloud architecture, data pipelines, APIs, analytics, and AI components. 
 - Translate KYC, AML, Transaction Monitoring, Sanctions, and Fraud requirements into scalable technical solutions and delivery roadmaps. 
 - Partner with compliance SMEs, product owners, architects, engineering teams, data teams, model-risk stakeholders, QA, infrastructure, and operations. 
 - Lead design reviews, code and SQL quality reviews, architecture decisions, defect triage, performance tuning, release readiness, and production stabilization. 
 - Ensure appropriate security, privacy, auditability, explainability, data lineage, model governance, monitoring, and regulatory-control considerations. 
 - Drive automation, reusable components, engineering standards, knowledge assets, and continuous improvement across the delivery lifecycle. 
 - Prepare and present status, decisions, risks, dependencies, and recovery plans to senior client and internal stakeholders. 
 - Support proposals, solutioning, effort estimation, staffing, capability development, and account growth activities. 

Deliverable ownership

- Accountable for agreed deliverables, acceptance criteria, delivery schedule, quality, and business outcomes across assigned workstreams. 
 - Build and maintain integrated delivery plans covering requirements, design, data readiness, engineering, testing, deployment, transition, and support. 
 - Establish governance routines, delivery metrics, RAID management, change control, escalation paths, and executive reporting. 
 - Validate estimates, capacity, sequencing, dependencies, and release scope; act early on slippage, quality gaps, or unresolved decisions. 
 - Ensure traceability from business and compliance requirements to technical design, test evidence, deployment artefacts, and operational handover. 
 - Coordinate cross-team dependencies and secure timely sign-offs from business, compliance, technology, model-risk, security, and operations stakeholders. 
 - Own defect closure, production-readiness checks, go-live decisions, warranty support, and lessons learned for assigned deliveries. 

Team management and leadership

- Lead multidisciplinary teams of software engineers, data engineers, analysts, QA professionals, and domain specialists. 
 - Define team structure, roles, goals, operating model, work allocation, and individual accountability for delivery outcomes. 
 - Provide regular coaching, technical mentoring, feedback, recognition, and career-development support. 
 - Monitor capacity, utilization, skills coverage, onboarding, knowledge transfer, succession needs, and delivery continuity. 
 - Foster a collaborative, inclusive, quality-focused environment with clear standards for ownership and communication. 
 - Resolve delivery conflicts, remove blockers, manage escalations, and support sound decisions under competing priorities. 
 - Identify capability gaps and create targeted upskilling plans across Python, SQL, cloud, AI, and Financial Crime domain knowledge. 

Mandatory Technical Skills

- Python: Strong hands-on experience designing and reviewing production-grade Python solutions, including object-oriented design, data processing, APIs, testing, logging, exception handling, security, and performance optimization. 
 - Advanced SQL: Expert-level capability in complex joins, common table expressions, window functions, stored procedures, query optimization, large-volume analysis, reconciliation, data profiling, and investigation queries. 
 - Cloud: Mandatory delivery experience with Microsoft Azure, AWS, or GCP, covering solution design, deployment, data services, security, monitoring, integration, scalability, and operational support. 
 - AI: Mandatory practical experience delivering AI or machine-learning capabilities, including generative AI or predictive analytics, model or prompt evaluation, API integration, responsible AI controls, security, explainability, and production monitoring. 
 - Engineering leadership: Ability to guide architecture, review code and designs, define standards, oversee CI/CD, manage non-functional requirements, and resolve complex technical issues. 
 - Data and integration: Experience with data pipelines, APIs, batch processing, data quality, lineage, metadata, and integration across enterprise platforms. 

Mandatory Financial Crime domain knowledge (2 or more mandatory)

- KYC / CDD / EDD: Customer onboarding, identity and document checks, customer risk rating, beneficial ownership, periodic review, remediation, and enhanced due diligence. 
 - AML: Financial crime risk indicators and typologies, alert and case workflows, investigations, escalation, regulatory reporting concepts, and control effectiveness. 
 - Transaction Monitoring (TM): Scenario and rule logic, thresholds, segmentation, alert generation, tuning, back-testing, false-positive reduction, and data-quality controls. 
 - Sanctions: Customer and payment screening, watchlists, potential-match handling, disposition workflows, screening effectiveness, and data quality. 
 - Fraud: Fraud indicators, transaction and event analysis, rules or models, alert prioritization, investigation workflows, case outcomes, and prevention controls. 

AI leadership expectations

- Identify and prioritize AI use cases for alert triage, investigation support, entity resolution, anomaly detection, document analysis, quality assurance, and engineering productivity. 
 - Ensure human oversight, explainability, privacy, security, bias assessment, auditability, model-risk alignment, and appropriate use of regulated data. 
 - Define measurable acceptance criteria and monitoring for accuracy, grounding, latency, reliability, operational risk, and business value. 
 - Use AI-assisted engineering tools responsibly for code, testing, documentation, and analysis while maintaining review and security controls. 

Good to have

- Actimize: Experience delivering, enhancing, integrating, or supporting NICE Actimize solutions for Transaction Monitoring, AML, sanctions, fraud, alerting, or case management. 
 - SAS: Experience with SAS programming, SAS AML, SAS Fraud Management, analytics workflows, data preparation, or migration and modernization initiatives. 
 - Exposure to Spark, Databricks, Kafka, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Airflow, Azure Data Factory, or equivalent modern data and DevOps tooling. 
 - Experience supporting proposals, commercial estimates, statements of work, delivery financials, and senior client presentations. 

Experience And Education

- Experience: Strictly 8+ years of relevant professional experience in technology delivery, software or data engineering, cloud, AI, analytics, or Financial Crime Technology. 
 - Leadership: Demonstrated ownership of complex deliverables and experience managing multidisciplinary teams and senior stakeholders. 
 - Mandatory combination: Python, advanced SQL, cloud, AI, and practical experience across the Financial Crime Compliance domain are required. 
 - Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Data Science, or a related field. 

What Success Looks Like

- Predictable delivery with clear ownership, transparent governance, controlled risk, strong quality, and timely stakeholder decisions. 
 - Scalable Python, SQL, cloud, and AI solutions aligned to Financial Crime controls and operational needs. 
 - A high-performing team with clear accountability, stronger capability, and sustainable delivery practices. 
 - Client confidence built through technical credibility, concise communication, proactive escalation, and measurable outcomes. 

What Working At EY Offers

You will lead meaningful Financial Crime Technology assignments in an interdisciplinary environment that values quality, practical learning, collaboration, responsible innovation, and knowledge exchange. The role provides opportunities to shape client outcomes while growing teams and capability across data engineering, cloud, AI, and Financial Crime Compliance. 

Apply only if you meet the 8+ years requirement and all mandatory technical, leadership, and domain criteria. 

EY | Building a better working world

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets. 

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate. 

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

data.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer
data.description:
Strength in Trust

OneTrust's mission is to enable innovation through the responsible use of data and AI. We believe that ensuring data is trusted shouldn't slow teams down-it should accelerate what's possible. This led us to develop the first technology platform for responsible data use in 2016. Today, with AI representing the latest and most impactful expansion of data yet, OneTrust is once again redefining what responsible innovation looks like. OneTrust, the AI‐Ready Governance PlatformTM, unifies regulatory intelligence, automation, and connected governance workflows so businesses can continue to move at the speed of AI while ensuring good governance to prevent data misuse at scale. Trusted by thousands of organizations worldwide, OneTrust is shaping the future where trusted data becomes a transformative force for business and society. 

The Challenge

- As Senior Staff Software Engineer develop strategic methods and principles to improve the technical stability and efficiency of the company's products/services. 
 - You lead and influence several teams and initiatives. 

Your Mission

- Has deep knowledge of entire system and can jump into code in any component and fire fight and contribute. Makes decisions on product direction and internals based on deep subject matter knowledge. 
 - Sets product direction and has ownership over large components. Thinks both strategically and tactically, keeping in mind both technical goals and company goals. 
 - Given long term strategic goals, can lay out a path across many versions. Participates in and supports initiatives outside of main area of responsibility. Provides technical leadership for projects including 3-4 individuals. 
 - Builds strong relationships in their own team and across the company. Understands multiple points of view and drives a process to conclusions in a timely and respectful manner. 
 - Mentor others with high-level technical guidance. Improve the company's technical prowess. Put customers first and set strategic short-term targets. Take up open-ended problems. 
 - Designing, coding, and debugging software. 
 - Improving the performance of existing software. 
 - Providing training to other engineers. 
 - Maintaining and upgrading existing software. 
 - Recommending new technologies that can help increase productivity. 
 - Supervising and overseeing the technical aspects of projects. 
 - Investigating software-related complaints and making necessary adjustments to ensure optimal software performance. 
 - Regularly attending team meetings to discuss projects, brainstorm ideas, and put forward solutions to any issues. 
 - Work with testing team to develop performance test plans and cases. 
 - Research and collect product information and support the development of specifications and requirements for consideration. 

You Are

- High technical and/or technological competence
 - Strong documentation, analytical and problem-solving skills
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related technical field 
 - Minimum of 10+ years of hands-on experience with Java based development projects using RESTful APIs, SpringBoot, Micro services. 
 - Strong analytical skills. 
 - Good communication skills. 
 - Excellent organizational and leadership skills
 - Proven experience in high-level programming languages, like Java. 
 - Proven experience in software development methodologies. 
 - Proven experience building complex web systems. 

Extra Awesome

- Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related technical or business field
 - Expertise with running web services at scale. 

Where we Work

We are embracing an office-first culture, encouraging three days a week in office for most roles, with meaningful opportunities to collaborate and celebrate in person. 

Each role may have specific requirements or flexibility depending on the scope of the position, so we encourage you to verify this with your recruiter during your first interview. 

Benefits

As an employee at OneTrust, you will be part of the OneTeam. That means you'll receive support physically, mentally, and emotionally so that you can do your best work both in and out of the office. This includes comprehensive healthcare coverage, flexible PTO, equity RSUs, annual performance bonus opportunities, retirement account support, 14+ weeks of paid parental leave, career development opportunities, company-paid privacy certification exam fees, and much more. Specific benefits differ by country. For more information, talk to your recruiter or visit onetrust. com/careers. 

Resources

Check out the following to learn more about OneTrust and its people: 

- OneTrust Careers on YouTube
 - @LifeatOneTrust on Instagram

Your Data

You have the right to have your personal data updated or removed. You also have the right to have a copy of the information OneTrust holds about you. Further details about these rights are available on the website in our Privacy Overview. You can change your mind at any time and have your personal data removed from our database. In order to do this you must contact us and let us know you wish to be removed. The request should be made on the Data Subject Request Form. 

Recruitment fraud warning: OneTrust is aware of scams involving false offers of employment with our company. The fraudulent jobs, interviews and job offers use fake websites, email addresses, group chat and text messages. Be aware that we never ask candidates for personal information, IDs or bank information during the interview process. We do not interview prospective candidates via instant message or group chat, and do not require candidates to purchase products or services, or process payments on our behalf as a condition of any employment offer. Please note that any legitimate interview availability requests will come directly from a OneTrust recruiter with an "@onetrust. com" email address. You may also receive legitimate emails from "@us. greenhouse-mail. io". Recruiters will only reach out to candidates who have applied for a role through our ATS (Greenhouse) or prospects via LinkedIn InMail. Job offers will come from a recruiter and may have a "@docusign. net" email address. For more information or if you have been targeted please reach out to askrecruiting@onetrust. com. 

Our Commitment to You

When you join OneTrust you are stepping onto a launching pad - the countdown has begun. The destination? A career without boundaries working alongside a diverse and inclusive crew who is passionate about doing meaningful work. As a pioneer, your voice and expertise will help chart the direction of an entirely new category. Our commitment to putting people first starts with you. Your growth is part of the mission. Our goal is to give you the power to embark on the next phase of your uniquely, unique career. 

OneTrust provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by local laws.

data.description:

data.title: Sr Engineer HPC Platform Base SW IRC302375
data.description:
Description

We are seeking an experienced Automotive SoC Platform Software Engineer to design, develop, and integrate foundational software for next-generation automotive electronic control units and computing platforms. In this role, you will lead the development of Board Support Packages (BSP), device drivers, OS abstractions, and low-level communication infrastructure across high-performance automotive system-on-chip (SoC) architectures (e. g. , Qualcomm SA8xxx, Renesas R-Car, NVIDIA Orin, TI). You will collaborate closely with hardware, systems, functional safety, and software teams to deliver secure, real-time, deterministic, and safety-compliant platform foundation software from early silicon bring-up to production release. 

Requirements

Experience: 7+ years of experience with a minimum of 4 years of SoC platform (BSP, POSIX, Adaptive Platform, SoC Drivers. . . etc. ) development experience and 3+ years of experience in automotive, AD/ADAS, or other embedded system low-level domains. 

- Strong experience in C/C++ development for automotive embedded systems, with the ability to develop automotive SoC platform foundation software. 

Technical experience with: 

- SoC Architecture: Qualcomm SA8xxx, Renesas RCAR, Nvidia Orin, TI. 
 - Communication Protocols: PCIe, SPI, UART, XCP, CAN, Ethernet, USB. 
 - Memory Management: UFS, DDR, Flash ROM, MMU. 
 - SoC related: Inter Core Communication, Tensor Processing, Servers, Accelerators, POSIX OS, QNX, RTOS, middleware, hypervisor and container engines. 
 - Good experience of Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery. 
 - Strong Understanding of CPU/GPU architectures, data structures, OS internals, multi-threading, inter-process communications, memory management techniques. 
 - Extensive hands-on experience in BSP porting and device driver internals. 

Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or Electronics Engineering

Job responsibilities

- Foundation Software & BSP Development
 - Architect, design, develop, and optimize automotive SoC platform foundation software, Board Support Packages (BSP), and low-level device drivers in C/C++. 
 - Lead board bring-up, OS porting, and platform initialization across multi-core, heterogeneous CPU/GPU/accelerator architectures. 
 - Configure and develop drivers for high-speed and automotive communication interfaces, including PCIe, Ethernet, CAN, SPI, UART, USB, and XCP. 
 - Implement and optimize low-level memory management and storage drivers for DDR, UFS, Flash ROM, and configure MMU/MPU subsystems. 
 - OS, Hypervisor & Runtime Platforms
 - Integrate, configure, and maintain POSIX-compliant operating systems, real-time operating systems (RTOS), QNX, and automotive virtualization layers/hypervisors. 
 - Implement robust inter-core communication (IPC), inter-process communication mechanisms, and resource virtualization across heterogeneous compute engines (CPU, GPU, Tensor Processing Units/accelerators). 
 - Support container engines and middleware execution environments tailored for automotive software stacks. 
 - Drive low-level performance profiling, multi-threading optimization, memory leak mitigation, and latency minimization. 
 - Hardware-Software Integration & Bring-Up
 - Analyze schematics, IC datasheets, and electrical block diagrams to configure pin multiplexing, clocks, power domains, and low-level peripheral controllers. 
 - Troubleshoot complex low-level hardware/software timing issues using hardware debuggers, oscilloscopes, and logic analyzers. 
 - Work closely with hardware engineering teams during prototyping, silicon bring-up, and engineering validation test (EVT) phases. 
 - Automotive Quality, Safety & Security
 - Implement secure boot flows, cryptographic authentication methods, and integrate hardware crypto algorithms for system integrity. 
 - Ensure code quality, maintainability, and standard compliance using MISRA C/C++ rules, static analysis, and code review processes. 
 - Support development within V-Model, ASPICE, and ISO 26262 functional safety frameworks, adhering to automotive cybersecurity guidelines. 
 - Participate in CI/CD pipeline automation to ensure automated builds, continuous integration, static analysis, and regression testing on target hardware benches.

data.title: Senior AI Engineer - Chat & Agent Systems
data.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior AI Engineer - Chat & Agent Systems based in India. 

We are looking for an experienced AI Engineer to take a leading technical role in the development of advanced chat and agent-based systems. In this hands-on position, you will shape technical direction, own system design, and contribute directly to production Python development. You will translate product requirements into reliable, maintainable solutions while raising engineering standards across the team. You will also mentor junior engineers, guide architectural decisions, and strengthen code quality through thoughtful reviews. A key part of the role will be advancing the team's use of AI coding agents throughout the software development lifecycle. This is an opportunity to combine strong software engineering fundamentals with practical expertise in building and operating production-grade agentic applications. 

Accountabilities

Responsibilities

You will lead the technical design and delivery of chat-team projects while remaining closely involved in implementation. Your responsibilities will include: 

- Own the technical design, architecture, and delivery of chat-team projects. 
 - Help define engineering priorities, standards, and day-to-day technical decisions. 
 - Translate product requirements into simple, scalable, and maintainable system designs. 
 - Write high-quality production Python code and develop clear abstractions without unnecessary complexity. 
 - Review pull requests, assessing correctness, maintainability, test coverage, and overall design quality. 
 - Mentor junior developers, providing practical guidance on programming fundamentals, system design, and code quality. 
 - Diagnose production issues across application code, agent workflows, prompts, models, data, and infrastructure. 
 - Improve system reliability, observability, latency, and operating costs. 
 - Promote effective use of AI coding agents across exploration, planning, implementation, testing, debugging, and code review. 
 - Identify opportunities to automate and improve engineering workflows while maintaining accountability for code quality. 
 - Help the team adopt responsible, effective agentic coding practices and become more AI-native. 

Requirements

The ideal candidate combines strong software engineering fundamentals with hands-on experience building LLM-powered applications and using AI coding agents. The following qualifications and skills are expected: 

- Approximately 4-5 years of professional software engineering experience. 
 - Strong proficiency in Python, including idiomatic, typed, testable, and maintainable production code. 
 - Solid programming fundamentals and consistently sound engineering judgment. 
 - Experience designing, delivering, and operating production systems. 
 - Strong understanding of API design, data modeling, concurrency, error handling, and observability. 
 - Ability to create useful abstractions while keeping systems simple and understandable. 
 - Experience writing automated tests using tools such as pytest. 
 - Ability to conduct meaningful code reviews and clearly explain technical recommendations. 
 - Experience mentoring junior developers and helping improve their engineering capabilities. 
 - Strong ownership, initiative, problem-solving skills, and the ability to drive improvements across a team. 
 - Clear written and verbal communication skills. 

Agentic Systems Experience

Hands-on experience building LLM-powered or agentic applications is required. Relevant experience includes: 

- Building tool-calling or multi-step workflows using LangGraph or comparable agent frameworks. 
 - Designing conversation state, context management, and execution flows. 
 - Working with model APIs, structured outputs, retrieval, and grounding techniques. 
 - Supporting streaming responses and asynchronous execution. 
 - Evaluating prompts, models, and end-to-end agent behavior. 
 - Instrumenting and debugging LLM applications with Langfuse, LangSmith, or similar observability platforms. 
 - Managing the reliability, latency, and cost of production LLM systems. 

Expertise in every named tool is not expected. A strong understanding of the underlying engineering principles and the ability to adapt as the ecosystem evolves are more important. 

Agentic Coding Experience

The candidate should be highly proficient in agentic coding workflows and understand how to use coding agents as engineering tools rather than simply as code generators. This includes: 

- Using coding agents effectively for exploration, planning, implementation, testing, debugging, and code review. 
 - Providing agents with appropriate context, constraints, and verification steps. 
 - Critically evaluating generated code for correctness, security, maintainability, and unnecessary complexity. 
 - Designing development workflows that ensure engineers remain accountable for the code produced. 
 - Identifying repeatable team processes that can be improved through agents and automation. 
 - Teaching junior developers to use coding agents effectively without compromising their engineering fundamentals. 
 - Leading practical initiatives that improve development speed and help establish AI-native engineering practices. 

Success in this role will be reflected in clearer technical decisions, simpler system designs, stronger test coverage, more effective code reviews, and increasingly independent junior developers. You will also help make production issues easier to diagnose and resolve, establish responsible AI-assisted development practices, and improve the long-term maintainability and reliability of the codebase. 

Benefits

- Fully remote position based in India. 
 - Full-time employment. 
 - Hands-on technical leadership and ownership of key engineering projects. 
 - Opportunity to shape engineering standards and influence the team's technical direction. 
 - Opportunity to work on production-grade AI and agentic systems. 
 - Opportunity to mentor developers and help advance AI-native engineering practices. 

How Jobgether Works

We use an AI-powered matching process to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team. 

We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!

Why Apply Through Jobgether?

Data Privacy Notice: By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Jobgether will process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy and share relevant information with the hiring employer. This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). You may exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection) at any time. 

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. data.title: Principal AI Engineer
data.description:
Our Engineering organisation is scaling its AI Engineering capabilities under new leadership, creating an opportunity to build the next generation of AI at Rapid7. We're looking for Principal AI Engineers to join us and help shape what comes next by defining and influencing the technical direction of our LLM and agentic AI systems. As a Principal AI Engineer, you'll raise the bar for engineering standards, and build truly cutting edge greenfield solutions that deliver real impact for our Global customers. Through your technical leadership and mentoring, you'll help shape our product and platform investments and influence how we build and scale AI across the organisation. 

About The Team

AI is reshaping cybersecurity on both sides. Attackers can use AI to strike at machine speed, and only AI-powered defense can keep up. At the same time, organizations can only adopt AI with confidence if it is secure. Rapid7 sits at the intersection of security and AI, and we are building industry-defining products for this new era. 

Rapid7's AI Engineering team builds the AI that powers our security platform. We are AI engineers and applied scientists who take models from research to production, combining open-source and frontier LLMs, AI agents, and fast predictive models with more than 20 years of Rapid7 security expertise. Our work drives core use cases across Detection and Response, such as alert triage, threat investigation, and automated response, and Exposure and Remediation, such as vulnerability prioritization, attack surface risk assessment, and guided remediation. Together, these help customers stop threats faster and fix what matters most. 

About The Role

As a Principal AI Engineer, you will set the technical direction for how Rapid7 builds, tunes and serves LLMs and agentic systems across its security products. You understand LLMs from the ground up, from transformer internals and training to fine-tuning and inference optimization, and you stay hands-on with the hardest problems. You know where LLMs shine and where they fall short, and you treat them as one tool in the AI toolbox, alongside predictive AI and classical ML, choosing the right approach for each problem. Specifically your focus will be to: 

- Define the architecture and technical roadmap for LLM and agentic AI systems across Detection and Response and Exposure and Remediation
 - Lead model strategy: when to use frontier or open-source models, and when to fine-tune, distill, or post-train
 - Fine-tune, distill and post-train open-source LLMs on security data, from data curation through training, evaluation and deployment
 - Set engineering standards for context engineering, inference optimization, and evaluation across teams
 - Optimize LLM inference at scale with techniques such as speculative decoding, KV-cache management, continuous batching, quantization and custom kernels, balancing quality, latency and cost
 - Establish evals as the release gate for every AI system we ship
 - Lead design reviews and resolve the hardest technical trade-offs
 - Stay hands-on: prototype and build critical model, training and inference code yourself
 - Mentor Staff and Senior engineers and shape product and platform investment

The Skills And Qualities You'll Bring Include

- 12+ years of software or ML engineering experience, including 2+ years building production LLM or agentic AI systems. A PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, AI or a related field is preferred, or equivalent depth of expertise demonstrated through industry experience and technical contributions
 - A track record of building scalable, production-grade AI systems used across multiple teams or products with a strong history of organization-wide impact through technical leadership, mentoring, and shared platforms and standards
 - LLMs from first principles: deep understanding of transformer architecture, attention, tokenization and positional encodings, and how models are trained and served, with the ability to implement core components from scratch
 - PyTorch: expert-level, including custom model code, training loops, mixed precision and distributed training (e. g. , FSDP, DeepSpeed)
 - Fine-tuning and post-training: hands-on full and parameter-efficient fine-tuning (LoRA, QLoRA) of open-weight LLMs, distillation, and preference or RL-based methods (e. g. , DPO, GRPO)
 - Context engineering: retrieval, memory, and context management for long-running agent workflows
 - Inference optimization: deep knowledge of prefill and decode, KV-cache management (e. g. , PagedAttention, prefix caching), continuous batching, speculative decoding, FlashAttention and quantization, and serving at scale with vLLM, SGLang or TensorRT-LLM
 - Evals: defining evaluation strategy and benchmarks for LLM and agent systems
 - Strong predictive AI and classical ML fundamentals, and the judgment to choose between them and LLMs based on accuracy, latency and cost
 - Strong distributed systems and Python fundamentals
 - Takes ownership of significant technical outcomes across multiple teams, proactively identifying and addressing risks, driving complex challenges to resolution and ensuring solutions deliver against agreed technical and customer objectives
 - Strong communicator with the ability to explain technical trade-offs to engineering, product, and leadership audiences
 - Builds strong cross functional partnerships across Engineering, Product, and other teams to align on technical direction and deliver shared outcomes
 - Connects customer needs and business priorities to technical decisions, evaluating the value, cost and trade-offs of AI solutions to ensure investments deliver measurable customer and business outcomes
 - Embody our core values to foster a culture of excellence that drives meaningful impact and collective success

Preferred Skills And Experience

- Experience pre-training or training LLMs from scratch
 - Experience writing GPU kernels (CUDA or Triton) and profiling GPU workloads

· Define manufacturing test, diagnostics, and yield enhancement strategy.

· Review third-party IP test readiness and integration requirements.

What You Will Achieve

In this role, you will: 

- Perform method transfers/ validations / method verifications to the complex analytical techniques
 - Interpret and evaluate data for accuracy, precision, trends, and potential cGMP impact, recommending appropriate corrective actions. 
 - Ensure all documentation and quality records comply with Good Manufacturing Practices and Good Laboratory Practices and are filed according to existing policies. 
 - Review and revise Standard Operating Procedures, analytical methods, and related documents to keep them current. 
 - Conduct analyses on finished products, raw materials, and components, including data entry, review, and approval in a computerized database. 
 - Contribute to the completion of complex projects, manage time effectively to meet targets, and develop plans for work activities within a team, while exercising judgment with reliance on supervisor and working under their direction.

 - Monitor critical process parameters (CPPs) and critical quality attributes (CQAs).

 - Handle change control activities and ensure timely implementation and closure of related CAPA actions.

 - Excellent organizational skills and strong ability to multi-task

Job Title: Sr. Manager - Quality and Sourcing | Home Appliance

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced and industry-seasoned Product Head to lead New Product Development (NPD), Existing Product Enhancement, Sourcing, and Quality Excellence for our kitchen and home appliances portfolio. 

This role is not only responsible for launching new products but also for continuously upgrading and improving our existing product line - through better design, improved specifications, feature enhancements, packaging upgrades, cost engineering, and quality optimization. 

The ideal candidate must have deep experience in the kitchen & home appliances industry, strong understanding of manufacturing and sourcing ecosystems (India & China), and a proven track record of building scalable product systems and high performing teams. 

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership & Team Management

• Instill ownership, accountability, and proactive execution within the sourcing and quality teams. 

• Set performance standards, KPIs, and continuous improvement goals for the department. 

New Product Development (NPD)

o Concept development

o Market research & benchmarking

o Technical specification finalization

o Sampling & prototyping

o Costing & feasibility

Existing Product Enhancement

o Packaging quality

Customer Review Analysis & Improvement Implementation

• Categorize feedback into actionable themes (performance, durability, packaging, defects, usability).

• Coordinate with sourcing and quality teams to implement corrective actions.

• Track and present before-and-after performance metrics (rating improvement, complaint reduction, return reduction). 

• Conduct quarterly product performance review based on real customer data. 

• Improve product ratings and customer satisfaction through quality upgrades

Product Line Expansion & Portfolio Growth

Sourcing Strategy & Vendor Management (India & China)

• Maintain a robust vendor ecosystem with alternatives to mitigate supply risk.

Quality Assurance & Compliance

Cost Optimization & Value Engineering

Systems, SOPs & Process Institutionalization (High Priority)

o Sampling approvals

o Production quality checkpoints

o NPD timelines

o Quality performance

• Build a culture of continuous improvement and process discipline. 

Qualifications & Experience

Must-Have:

• Strong exposure to India & China sourcing ecosystems. 

• Deep knowledge of product development lifecycle and appliance manufacturing. 

• Demonstrated track record in: 

o Product enhancement

- Are you curious, excited by experimentation, and always looking for a better way of doing things?

If so, we would love to hear from you!

We are looking to hire ambitious, and value-adding talent to join Modulr, the fastest growing payments business in the UK and Europe. The Principal Engineer is a hands-on individual contributor role with broad technical influence across multiple teams within our Engineering, CTO team. In this role you will work in a cross-functional team who are asked to solve a problem, rather than be handed a task to do. This is an excellent opportunity to work in a high-growth environment with a fast-paced and collaborative culture where you will have great opportunities to work on challenging problems. 

About Us

At Modulr our mission is to move money efficiently to power business productivity. We are building a new digital payments service to make money flow more efficiently through businesses and the economy. This is a new type of payments account that is built for businesses that need faster, easier and more reliable ways to move money. 

Our flexible platform and innovative approach allows our customers to utilise our payments account instead of a traditional bank account. Our accounts come with a sort code and account number, access to payment systems (eg Faster Payments and Visa) and everything our customers need from a payments account. They can instantly open as many accounts as they need, automate how they make and receive payments as well as the reconciliation processes these create. All in real time, 24/7 through their own systems utilising our API that integrates into any platform. 

Our founding team has a wealth of experience in the payments industry and growing successful businesses. Modulr is backed by payments giants PayPal Ventures and FIS Ventures, as well as startup and scale up specialists Blenheim Chalcot, General Atlantic, Frog and Highland Europe which enables us to leverage their resources and expertise to drive our growth initiatives. These partnerships provide us with the necessary provisions to propel our business to new heights. 

Modulr values

- Building the extraordinary and going that extra mile
 - Owning the opportunity, be passionate and proud of the time you invest
 - Move at pace, reach your goals faster with us supporting you each step of the way
 - Achieve it together, working as a team and being a Modulite

The Tech Team

At Modulr we are focused on building autonomous squads that are focused on working in the best possible way. We operate in a tribes and squad model with each area focused on a particular growth area. Each squad is small and cross-functional. We have big ambitions and have many interesting challenges ahead. Our strategy is to provide our customers with seamless connectivity into payment schemes both domestically and overseas no matter where they're based.

- Lead in Design, analysis and documentation of products, systems or subsystems, setting the technical direction for key parts of the platform.

About You

Technical knowledge required

We believe that by seeing Modulr, and the world, from all sorts of angles, we can make life better for all. Job Purpose: Associate - Quality (Civil) is responsible for supporting quality assurance and control activities for civil components in renewable energy projects by ensuring adherence to quality plans, specifications, and standards. This role is responsible for conducting field inspections, coordinating with contractors and vendors, resolving quality issues, and maintaining documentation, contributing to the overall project quality, compliance, and safety standards for civil works. 

Responsibilities

Quality Assurance and Documentation: 

Ensure QA requirements are developed and aligned with technical specifications and project standards for all civil components in renewable energy projects. 

Prepare, review, and update Site Quality Plans (SQPs), Site Field Quality Plans (SFQPs), and Quality Inspection Reports (QIRs) for civil structures across wind, solar & hybrid projects. 

Maintain comprehensive documentation and ensure adherence to QA protocols and inspection requirements. 

Complete all inspections within 12 hours of receiving a Inspection call from vendor and Issue Material Dispatch Clearance Certificates (MDCC) after acceptance of materials, supporting the timely supply to project sites. 

Field Inspections And Audits

Conduct regular inspections and site audits for civil structures to ensure compliance with SFQPs and project standards. 

Identify and document non-conformities (NCs), work on root cause analysis (RCA), and implement corrective and preventive actions (CAPA) to eliminate recurring issues. 

Coordinate with inspection agencies or team members for efficient scheduling and completion of on-site civil inspections. 

Vendor And Contractor Coordination

Work closely with contractors and vendors to communicate and enforce QA standards and inspection requirements. 

Conduct vendor assessments and evaluate the quality of materials, concrete, rebar, foundations, and other civil works components. 

Provide on-site technical guidance to contractors to enhance understanding and execution of quality requirements. 

Issue Resolution And Continuous Improvement

Ensure timely identification and resolution of quality issues on-site by liaising with the Field Quality Assurance (FQA) team. 

Contribute to the preparation of "lessons learned" reports to facilitate continuous improvement and update QA protocols for future projects. 

Support quality-related improvement projects, such as Kaizen initiatives, to enhance project execution and field inspection quality. 

Compliance And Safety Assurance

Ensure compliance with safety regulations, environmental guidelines, and quality standards at project sites. 

Promote a safety-oriented culture by following organizational protocols and conducting quality-related safety checks during field inspections. 

Report on QA performance and inspection status to support compliance with internal and external audits. 

Reporting And Communication

Compile monthly Quality Assurance reports, including status updates, audit findings, and inspection results. 

Communicate inspection outcomes and issues effectively to internal and external stakeholders to ensure alignment and timely actions. 

Support team members and share knowledge on best practices in civil quality assurance for continuous capability enhancement. 

Key Stakeholders - Internal

Project Team

Procurement and Supply Chain Department

Safety Department

Construction Site Teams

Key Stakeholders - External

Contractors and Subcontractors

Vendors and Material Suppliers

Third-Party Inspection Agencies

Regulatory Authorities and Compliance Auditors

Qualifications

Educational Qualification: 

Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering or related field. 

Certifications in Quality Assurance, Civil Construction Standards, or related quality management practices preferred. 

Work Experience

7+ years of experience in quality assurance within civil construction, with a focus on renewable energy projects (wind, solar & hybrid). 

Hands-on experience with site inspections, audits, and quality control processes for civil engineering works. 

Strong understanding of quality protocols, root cause analysis (RCA), and corrective action/preventive action (CAPA) for civil structures. 

Knowledge of industry standards such as ISO, IEC, and relevant construction codes.

The Position

Company Overview
At Roche, we believe every patient deserves the best care possible, and we are dedicated to developing innovative solutions that transform lives. As part of our global digital health and diagnostics initiatives, our product squads build complex, large-scale software solutions. Quality Engineering is not just a final check-it is a core pillar of our product strategy, ensuring safety, reliability, and unparalleled user experience. 

Position Summary

As an Expert SDET, acting as a Solution Architect, specialized in Open Source Test Automation, you will operate as a strategic domain authority across multiple cross-functional product squads within a specific domain. You will sit at the intersection of business strategy, software architecture, and quality engineering. You are accountable for designing robust, open-source automation frameworks, handling ambiguous quality requirements, managing complex stakeholder landscapes, and mentoring junior engineers. You are also directly accountable for defining the long-term Quality Engineering architecture for test automation open source solutions. You will act as a trusted advisor, driving the transition from standard QA execution to highly strategic, automated Quality Engineering. 

Key Responsibilities

- Test Automation Architecture Definition & Governance
 - Open Source Architecture: Define, govern, and drive the adoption of scalable, efficient and fit for purpose open source test automation frameworks (e. g. , Selenium, Playwright, Robot Framework, Appium, . . . ) to be used as enterprise solutions across multiple functions. Establish reusable architectural components and design patterns for the Test Automation Quality Engineering practice
 - Technology Fit Analysis: Evaluate, select, and govern the implementation of all new testing tools and infrastructure components to ensure alignment with enterprise architecture standards. Accountable for having the right tools and frameworks and compliant decommission if required for those that would be out of lifecycle
 - Strategy & Planning: Own the design, delivery and validation of effective open source testing automation solutions that cover enterprise wise needs, identify gaps and opportunities to enhance the portfolio of solutions and define the strategy and the delivery plans
 - CI/CD Integration: Align with E3 (Engineering Excellence and Experience) strategy to foster the usage of test automation frameworks within CI/CD workflows making sure automated testing suites can be directly embedded into DevOps CI/CD pipelines to ensure continuous quality and rapid feedback loops
 - Quality Analysis & Problem Solving (Problem Domain)
 - Root Cause Analysis: Define and institutionalize the methodologies for diagnosing and resolving highly critical, cross-domain quality incidents and production defects
 - Requirement Synthesis: Elicit, analyze, and synthesize complex, sometimes ambiguous stakeholder needs regarding software quality, usability, and data integrity
 - Traceability: Ensure comprehensive test and quality requirements traceability across solutions
 - Impact Evaluation: Evaluate how changes in scope impact overarching software quality and map out immediate and long-term implications within the product domain
 - Stakeholder Management & Strategic Influence
 - Trusted Advisor: Build strong relationships across multiple functional areas and product squads. Act as a trusted technical advisor by showing a deep understanding of the healthcare/business domain
 - Expectation Alignment: Develop and execute stakeholder communication plans. Proactively shape stakeholder perspectives and align engineering teams with overall project and business goals
 - Conflict Resolution: Facilitate technical workshops, manage stakeholder maps, and resolve alignment issues or miscommunications regarding project risks and quality tradeoffs
 - Leadership, Accountability & Mentorship
 - Serve as the definitive Solution Architect and technical authority, owning the architectural decisions and quality risk mitigation for the most complex solutions and act as a mentor for simple ones
 - Mentorship: Mentor and coach Senior and junior SDETs and team leads on advanced quality engineering practices and architectural patterns
 - Communities of Practice (CoPs): Key opinion leader for Roche's internal Quality Engineering Communities of Practice that covers test automation, supporting the definition of organization-wide engineering processes on scope, testing methodologies, and architectural standards

Qualifications & Experience
Required Technical Experience: 

- Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience)
 - Automation Expertise: Minimum of 10-14+ years of progressive experience, including 3+ years in a Principal or Solution Architecture role, with a definitive specialization in building open-source automation frameworks from scratch
 - Coding Proficiency: Strong programming skills in languages commonly used in open-source testing (e. g. , Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python)
 - API & UI Testing: Demonstrated expertise in testing UI components as well as backend services (RESTful APIs, Microservices)
 - CI/CD & Cloud: Solid experience with version control (Git) and continuous integration tools (e. g. , GitLab CI, Jenkins, GitHub Actions)

Mandatory Architecture Expertise: Proven track record designing enterprise-wide test frameworks, distributed execution grids, and cloud testing platforms. 

Mandatory AI & DevSecOps Expertise: 

- Architecture experience with AI testing frameworks (Applitools, Functionize, Mabl, or custom LLM/RAG testing agents)
 - Hands-on mastery of Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, AWS/Azure, Jenkins/GitHub Actions, and security tools (SonarQube, Snyk, OWASP ZAP)

ITSM & CSV Mastery: Deep expertise in ServiceNow platform integration and regulatory validation processes (CSV, GAMP5, 21 CFR Part 11) within healthcare or life sciences. 

Leadership: Ability to lead cross-functional consensus across AI/ML Engineering, Enterprise Architecture, Information Security, and Regulatory Compliance teams. 

Core Competencies & Soft Skills: 

- Analytical Thinking: Advanced logical reasoning skills to identify hidden software defects, quality risks, and architectural gaps
 - Navigating Ambiguity: Proven ability to manage business analysis activities on complex projects where requirements are highly fluid or loosely defined
 - Strategic Influencing: Exceptional communication skills with a track record of driving consensus among cross-functional stakeholders (Product Owners, Developers, and Business Leads)

With our comprehensive portfolio of solutions, hoteliers can manage distribution, retailing, payments, operations, and more. Providing hoteliers the tools to maximize revenue, improve operational efficiency, and deliver personalized guest experiences that drive satisfaction.

By prioritizing stability, scalability, and data-driven insights, we equip hoteliers to adapt and thrive in an ever-changing landscape, ready for whatever comes next. 

Aven Hospitality serves hoteliers around the globe with the industry's most innovative and comprehensive suite of technology services and products. Our solutions empower hotels and hotel chains to deliver true hospitality reliably and at scale, improving guest experience throughout the traveler journey. 

Our team is comprised of the hospitality industry's most innovative and entrepreneurial leaders, and together we form the fastest growing business unit of a $4B+ global technology company. Candidates who join our team must thrive in fast-paced, entrepreneurial environments and be committed to serving the needs of our hospitality customers around the globe. If this sounds like you, we welcome the opportunity to get to know you better. 

Position Summary

The Connectivity Certifications organization at Aven Hospitality (AH) defines and delivers a compelling connectivity value proposition that enables high impact business outcomes for our customers. The team operates in a highly consultative manner, serving as both product and technical experts, while partnering with Sales and Account Management, Product and Engineering teams to design and deliver optimal connectivity solutions. 

The Connectivity Certification Analyst will perform review, testing, troubleshooting and certification of new system interfaces utilizing XML and JSON API specifications for our Property Connect (fulfillment) and Channel Connect (distribution) interfaces to the SynXis Central Reservation System (CRS) platform. The primary responsibilities will be reviewing message formats and system specifications for new interfaces being developed between vendors, customers, and internal staff and providing vendor and technical support for these certifications. The Connectivity Certification Analyst will also interact extensively with our product, development and QA teams and will be expected to participate in technical discussions about integration issues as well as product directions and strategies. This individual should have knowledge in a variety of technical areas including familiarity with hospitality technology standards including Open Travel, HTNG, XML, JSON, reading technical specifications, client and server systems, networking concepts and an understanding of programming concepts and tools. 

Key Responsibilities

Facilitate custom API solutions across customers, partners, and internal teams. 

Onboard new API connectivity partners and customer, ensuring consistent certification standards and best practices. 

Ensure the ongoing success and performance of existing integrations while ensuring adherence to commercially-agreed upon standards. 

Collaborate with Sales and Account Management to support new and existing partner opportunities. 

Work closely with Product and Engineering teams to troubleshoot integration product functionality, testing and defect remediation. 

Deliver customer and partner satisfaction through strong collaboration, transparency, and technical leadership. 

Strengthen adoption of the Aven Hospitality Platform by ensuring integrations deliver measurable business value. 

Key Knowledge And Skill Requirements

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

Proven experience in API quality assurance and certification processes, including functional and integration testing of SOAP and REST services, with proficiency in XML and JSON payload validation. 

Experience with SaaS solutions

Excellent verbal and written communication skills

Familiar with technical specifications

Strong experience with OTA, HTNG, Opera OHIP and OXI standards is preferred

The individual should be able to work as part of a team or work independently on assigned tasks, and the ability to handle multiple assignments simultaneously

Knowledge of software development life cycle and release process would be helpful

Hotel Operations and Property Management System (PMS), Central Reservation Systems (CRS), Customer Relation Management (CRM) or 3rd party channel experience is ideal

Proficient with relational databases such as Oracle or SQL

Qualifications / Experience

4+ years of API and integration experience

Four-year college degree or relevant experience in a related field

Experience In Hospitality Or Travel Distribution Industry Preferred

Experience working with technical and business stakeholders

Strong working knowledge of Aven Hospitality products and services

Expertise in SOAP and REST APIs

Relational or non-relational database query experience

We will give careful consideration to your application and review your details against the position criteria. You will receive separate notification as your application progresses.

We are looking for a Senior Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) to drive quality engineering and automation across Securonix products, including SIEM, ThreatQ (Threat Intelligence Platform/TIP), and associated cloud, microservices, data, and security capabilities. 

Role Overview: 

As a Senior SDET, you will design and build scalable automation solutions across API, UI, backend, integration, and end-to-end workflows.  - Strong hands-on experience with Pytest, including fixtures, parametrization, reusable libraries, and framework design. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with Playwright for UI and end-to-end automation. 
 - Strong experience in REST API automation and testing. 
 - Experience designing or contributing to scalable automation frameworks-not only individual test scripts.

 - Experience with SQL and backend/data validation.

 - Strong collaboration skills for working with Engineering, Product, DevOps, and other QA/SDET teams. 
 - Passion for automation, cybersecurity, AI, and modern quality engineering. 

Why Join Securonix?

Work at the intersection of cybersecurity, AI, automation, cloud, and large-scale data platforms while building quality-engineering solutions for products used by global enterprises. This role provides significant ownership of automation strategy and an opportunity to influence how quality is engineered across Securonix product lines. 

Benefits:

data.title: Lead Back End Engineer
data.description:
This is a leadership role in our engineering team - not just a cog in the wheel. 

This is not a "maintenance" role. This is engineering leadership-owning the backend architecture of a global, privacy-first communication platform. You'll lead by example, guide a high-calibre team, and ensure our backend systems remain blazing-fast, rock-solid, and uncompromising on security. You'll be at the intersection of code and leadership-mentoring engineers, driving architectural decisions, and setting engineering standards that define how a global product is built. 

Who are we?

We are a young product company scaling fast and outgrowing the startup tag-with global scale in our crosshairs. We don't do "okay. " We give everything we've got to build the best communication platform in the world. Our team includes engineers from IIT and other top institutions-people who care deeply about the craft, performance, and purpose. You'll learn more in 6 months here than most engineers do in 3 years elsewhere. We're intense. High-strung. Focused. Our team includes engineers from IIT and other top-tier

backgrounds. But what defines us is not our degrees-it's our refusal to compromise on quality, performance, or privacy. 

What are we building?

WrkTalk is the world's first zero-access, zero-spam enterprise communication product that operates on a structural privacy architecture. One that's already earned the trust of large enterprises like L&T Finance, Adani Group, and Kalyan Jewellers - just to name a few of our enterprise clients. This is not an MVP. This is production-grade software that secures communication for thousands-and soon, millions-of professionals worldwide. 

What's the role?

• Architect backend systems in NestJS and Golang to meet global scale and enterprise-grade performance. 

• Drive design for microservices, real-time comms (WebSockets, WebRTC), and data stores (PostgreSQL, Redis). 

• Lead code reviews, enforce coding standards, and maintain CI/CD discipline. 

• Mentor and upskill backend engineers. 

• Collaborate cross-functionally with frontend, DevOps, and product leaders. 

• Own technical problem-solving-anticipate bottlenecks, make hard calls, and prevent tech debt from being parked for "later. "

• Manage task allocation, workflow discipline, and ensure smooth collaboration with frontend and DevOps. 

The tech here is serious. 

We work on socket-driven comms infrastructure, distributed control towers, multi-category encryption, root detection, app kill-switches, dynamic guest access, device-level lockout, and OOO/ DND logic layered with smart whitelisting. This is not lightweight app dev. This is protocol-layer decision-making. 

Who should apply?

• 6-8+ years in backend engineering, with at least 2 years in a leadership role. 

• Expertise in Golang and Node. js (NestJS). 

• Strong database tuning skills (PostgreSQL, Redis). 

• Solid understanding of Docker, Kubernetes, and scalable deployment. 

• Experience building real-time systems at scale. 

• Proven ability to lead technical discussions and inspire engineering teams. 

• Track record of shipping production-grade, high-performance systems. 

Why should you join?

• Because you want to own backend architecture-not just follow it

• Because you'll work directly with established founders, not buried under layers

• Because you'll ship real, deeply engineered features used by large number of enterprise users

• Because you'll grow 10x faster here-in experience, learning, and impact

• And because if you walk this road with us for 3-4 years, it'll catapult you into a tech orbit or fame and glory you never imagined

Where are we located?

We're based in Navi Mumbai and building for the world.

data.title: Development Manager
data.description:
Development Manager

Location: Kaplan India

Reports to: Head of Applications, Engineering & Architecture

Employment type: Full-time

Role summary

Kaplan International Pathways is a leading provider of global education, centered around our students. 

Technology is at the heart of what we do, and delivery discipline matters because we operate across

multiple platforms, partners, and time zones. 

We are seeking a strategic and technical Development Manager to join our Application Engineering and

Architecture Team. This role is unique: you will own the "production line" of our software delivery. 

While we have multiple distributed development teams shipping code, we need to eliminate friction and

ensure seamless integration. 

You will not just be managing people; you will be the architect of our flow. You will coordinate teams

to optimise cadence, professionalise our release capability, and ensure that our delivery ordering

prevents technical debt. You will be the guardian of our platform's integrity and the driver of our

engineering velocity. 

As the Development Manager you will work intimately with the QA Manager, Solution Architects, 

Partners, and the Portfolio Delivery Team. Your mission is to streamline our development cycle through

lightweight governance, automation, and artificial intelligence. 

Detailed responsibilities

Release Management: 

• Enforce the Operational Readiness Review (ORR). You have the authority to say, "No Go. "

• Ensure that before code goes live, Service Level Objectives (SLOs) are met, telemetry is active

and run books are updated. 

• Coordinate release schedules across concurrent, distributed development teams to prevent

environment contention and deployment collisions. 

• Act as the conductor of the "Release Train, " ensuring it runs on time, in the correct order, and

that inter-team dependencies are resolved before deployment day. 

• Partner with the QA Manager to enforce the Release-Confidence (RC) Score as a hard gate in

your pipelines, preventing low-quality code from blocking the flow for other high-performing

teams

Pipeline Governance & Policy-as-Code: 

• Own the definition and evolution of our CI/CD pipeline standards. 

• Drive the implementation of "Policy-as-Code" and automated quality gates to catch issues early

(Shift Left), ensuring that no non-compliant build ever reaches production. 

• Work with Solution Architects to define and operationalise "Green Lane" patterns, our

automated, low-friction paths for low-risk changes. 

• Move us away from heavy manual governance for standard changes, enabling high-trust teams

to bypass red tape and increasing our overall DORA metrics/velocity. 

Operational Excellence & Incident Command: 

• Act as the primary Incident Commander for major deployment failures or outages. 

• Lead the Root Cause Analysis (RCA) process, ensuring we don't just fix the bug, but

systematically prevent the recurrence of the failure scenario. 

You'll also carry out other duties, within the broad scope and spirit of your role, as requested by your

manager. Our business continuously evolves, so your role will too. 

What you'll bring to the role

Essential Skills & Experience

• Demonstrable experience managing software delivery in a complex, multi-team environment

(e. g. , managing interdependencies between distinct Scrum teams or 3rd party vendors). 

• Deep understanding of modern branching strategies (GitFlow vs. Trunk-Based Development), 

semantic versioning, and the ability to resolve complex merge/deployment conflicts. 

• Practical, hands-on experience with CI/CD tooling (ArgoCD/Jenkins, Azure DevOps, GitHub

Actions) and Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform/Bicep). You understand how to build the pipes, 

not just use them. 

• A proven track record of reducing cycle time (lead time for changes) and deployment failure

rates through automation and process re-engineering. 

• Strong ability to negotiate with Dev Leads and Project Managers to ensure adherence to our

governance standards. 

Desirable Skills & Experience

• Experience enforcing code quality and release standards on external/offshore development

partners. 

• with Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) concepts, specifically implementing SLOs and Error

Budgets to govern release velocity. 

• Experience using tools to visualise flow metrics (e. g. , DORA metrics) to drive continuous

improvement. 

Our Tech Stack

You will be working within a modern, diverse ecosystem that includes the following and much more: 

• Version Control: GitHub, Bitbucket. 

• CI/CD & DevOps: ArgoCD, Azure DevOps Pipelines, GitHub Actions. 

• Infrastructure: Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform, Bicep). 

• Cloud Providers: AWS and Azure ecosystems. 

• Observability: OTEL (OpenTelemetry), RED method monitoring. 

• Platforms: Salesforce (and satellite services), Microsoft 365, Standard Web Applications.

Monitors and improves the maintenance of the production unit by overseeing maintenance staff and equipment; ensures employees comply with safety procedures and standards.

 - Managing the erection & commissioning, ensuring completion of project in minimum turnaround time and effective resource utilization to maximize the output. 
 - Maintenance of manipulators, hydraulic presses, pneumatic presses, pneumatic nut runners, oil pulse tools, shut off tools, DC nut runners of IR-CP-ATLAS-Desoutter, Electro mono rails, Over Head, I-beam, SLAT conveyors, docking machines, leak test machines, Number punching machines,

Degree or equivalent experience desired

Skill Descriptors

 - Identifies tasks or outputs that require accuracy and detail-level attention.

Effective Communications: Understanding of effective communication concepts, tools and techniques; ability to effectively transmit, receive, and accurately interpret ideas, information, and needs through the application of appropriate communication behaviors.

- Delivers helpful feedback that focuses on behaviors without offending the recipient.

Performance Management: Knowledge of successful performance management techniques; ability to apply organization's performance management system, practices, and tools to developing and improving individual, team, and organizational performance. 

Level Basic Understanding:

Planning and Organizing: Knowledge of the process of planning and arranging tasks and resources; ability to plan and organize both time and resources to get things completed while structuring and maintaining work in a systematic and highly methodical way.

Total Productive Maintenance (TPM): Knowledge of total productive maintenance principles, methods, and processes; ability to maximize machinery effectiveness through active involvement of all supporting departments.

data.description:
Responsibilities

Job purpose

People Leader, accountable for providing leadership for Process Engineers within the Engineering & Process Technology group through creating shared vision & values, developing and utilising talent and driving performance. Leads and directs programs with the objective to enhance engineering productivity and efficiency. 

Principal Accountabilities

Leadership

Manage EHS through management of change, behavioural safety and ensuring a safe work environment and compliant with Business and Group operating standards, procedures and systems. 

Drive results through aligning the team with business strategy and goals, establishing clear standards of engineering excellence, and setting clear direction and accountabilities through performance management whilst providing balanced feedback at the most critical times to maintain momentum and a strong sense of ownership. 

Act as a change agent, lead, support and contribute to change programmes, driving and championing the implementation, gaining acceptance to enable an agile and engaged team. 

Feed into workforce plans to ensure the right resourcing requirements for current and future business needs. This includes understanding current and future capability needs and addressing those through development interventions. 

Lead succession planning to ensure a strong talent pipeline and to mitigate critical skills gaps. 

Inspire growth through career conversations, developing talent and ensuring the team has the skills and experiences to deliver, develop and progress careers within JM - Honeywell. 

Ensure all team members have up to date Personal Development Plans, which are reviewed on a regular basis and provide input into training planning to ensure team members have access to relevant and appropriate training opportunities. 

Provide input to Engineering resource planning to ensure developmental objectives are known and addressed. 

Support team development and ensure team are appropriately aligned to the technical career path based on their capability and business need. Provide input to the Grade Review Process. 

Responsible for allocating resource to basic engineering/development projects according to business demands. 

Instil trust and value differences, generating confidence and safety with others through openness and authenticity, modelling high standards of honesty, transparency and integrity whilst promoting a team environment that values, encourages, and supports differences. 

Develop employee engagement strategy for the team to motivate and drive engagement. 

Facilitate collaboration with shared values for engineering to partner across teams and functions to create high performing teams to achieve common goals. 

Provide input and recommendations on reward and benefits processes for team e. g. annual review. 

Carry out people and business processes within HR and Business systems (e. g. Workday process initiation, leave & expense approvals, etc). 

In conjunction with other Engineering Managers, establish and maintain engineering capability across CT's offices. 

Execution & Delivery (Program Management)

Maintain and enhance the capabilities and productivity within the Engineering & Process Technology function. 

Initiate and lead major transformation projects to scale and grow engineering capacity and capability for the organization. 

Deputise for the Engineering Management Director, as required. 

Drive L&D/training requirements and transition into an Engineering Academy. 

- Monitor and assess the training requirements of new starters and current engineering staff.

 - Work with the Talent Acquisition team to develop recruitment campaigns to attract new hires. 
 - Set the standard for competencies and capabilities required for new hires, and methodology for assessment. 
 - Review CVs, interview candidates and recommend outcomes.

- Approve BEP engineering documentation as required. 
 - Approve basic engineering package execution strategy and engineering hour estimation. 
 - Ensure procedures are reviewed and updated as required. 
 - Identify and prepare new procedures/guidance as required by Engineering. 
 - Identify improvements to Engineering tools and methodologies, implementing improvement programs as required. 
 - Support Lead Engineers in project execution. 
To take on any other duties which are within the employee's skills and abilities whenever reasonably instructed. 

Scope

Primary interactions are within CT E&PT Leadership team and CT's engineering service providers. 

Planning horizon 1-3 months tactical, 3-36 months for S&OP process resourcing, 5 years for strategic engineering footprint. 

People leadership & development. 

Special factors

Geography global. 

Up to 25% international and domestic travel on average can be expected. 

Flex work patterns to accommodate working across different time zones, when required. 

Qualifications

Person specification

This describes what is required to do the job, it may not describe the current job holder but should describe the typical attributes or traits needed for success in the position. 

Qualifications/ Knowledge/ Experience

(Technical/ professional knowledge and skills competency)

Degree In Chemical Engineering Or Equivalent Experience Essential

Understanding of technology development, engineering and licencing Essential

Member of a recognised Professional Institution Desirable

Personal Skills And Key Competencies

Leaderships Skills - ability to lead and motivate a technical team Essential

People Development - support individuals to learn and develop continuously to meet their career goals and organisations goals Essential

Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written - ability to explain complex issues clearly & technical concepts to a non-technical audience Essential

Ability to influence key stakeholders to achieve business objectives & effective decision making Essential

Ability to collaborate across function lines to drive required decisions and outcomes Essential

Innovative approach to engineering execution Essential

Excellent planning skills - goal setting, task breakdown, prioritisation, realistic scheduling and resource allocation Essential

Organisational Awareness Essential

Ability to build effective teams and instil trust Essential

Strategic Thinking & Direction Setting Essential

Strong focus on continuous improvement, driving innovation and ability to facilitate change and deliver change programmes Essential

A global mindset and experience of working in a multi-cultural environment Essential

About Us

Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world's most mission-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We serve the building, industrial and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer.
