Are you a passionate developer with an agile mindset? And would you like to be a strategically important part of the organization in one of the world's leading software providers within the Fintech industry? Then you should join SimCorp as a C# & APL Senior/Lead Software Engineer!

WHO WE ARE?

For over 50 years, we have worked closely with large and global investment and asset managers to become the world's leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 2, 500+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, educational backgrounds, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds in general. 

SimCorp is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated in our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best-in-class solutions to our clients. While striving to deliver client value, we believe it is vital to consider our people and our planet in every business decision we make. Acting responsibly is not optional. It is essential. 

WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US

We are building and evolving Investment Foundation, a top-priority project for SimCorp right now and we are building this area to meet our strategic decisions and deliver more outcomes. We are looking for an experienced Software Engineer with expertise in C#, a deep understanding of its ecosystems and a strong background in object-oriented programming. The ideal candidate should be familiar with the . NET framework, skilled in designing and implementing architectural patterns. Additionally, proficiency in automated testing platforms, unit tests, and Git for code versioning, along with experience in Azure environments, is highly desirable. You will be part of an engineering team, contributing to everything from architecture and component design to performance and accessibility and responsible for delivering functionality that enables clients to make investment decisions with our back-office applications. The ideal candidate should have an eagerness to learn APL (A Programming Language). Prior experience with APL isn't required, we provide comprehensive training and a supportive environment to help you succeed. Our company also partly owns Dyalog APL, ensuring the language remains actively maintained and relevant. For now, the most of our work is done in APL. 

WHY SIMCORP, WHY NOW

Simcorp is growing rapidly in the market and we see increasing demand from existing and potential clients. That's why SimCorp is investing in creating a development area Area that is placed uniquely in our Product development ecosystem to meet our top priority strategic decisions and deliver valuable outcomes for our clients. You would be working on topics that touch different areas of Simcorp Dimension which places you in a unique position to view

What You Will Be Responsible For

As a Senior/Lead Engineer, you will help drive both technical excellence and team execution, end-to-end: 

- Lead design and development of backend systems in APL (current core). 
 - Architect scalable, secure, high-performance solutions as we move toward cloud-native approaches on Microsoft Azure. 
 - Mentor and guide engineers through code reviews, technical planning and agile ways of working. 
 - Partner closely with Product and engineering peers to deliver outcomes that matter, fast feedback, reliable delivery and maintainable code. 
 - Drive code quality and reliability via unit testing, integration testing, CI/CD and pragmatic engineering standards. 
 - Identify performance bottlenecks and bugs and devise sustainable solutions. 
 - Use Git-based workflows and work effectively in a continuous integration environment. 
 - Collaborate with cross-located teams and contribute to shared ways of working across sites. 
 - Require excellent business and communication skills and to be able to understand client specific requirements. 

Note: Designation Might vary based on the interview & the Expereince level. 

Your Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in computer science, information technology, or a related field. 
 - 5+ years of software development experience. 
 - Strong engineering fundamentals: object-oriented design, architecture patterns, clean code, and pragmatic problem solving. 
 - Solid experience in C#/. NET (Core/Framework) and building backend systems (APIs, services, integrations). 
 - Familiarity with APIs (REST/streaming patterns) and messaging concepts (e. g. , service bus patterns). 
 - Proficient understanding of code versioning tools such as Git. 
 - Experience with automated testing and CI/CD, plus strong code review habits. 
 - Acquaintance with AI tools and ML is a plus 
 - Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently and as part of a team. 
 - Comfortable collaborating with multiple stakeholders and communicating clearly in an international environment. 

APL READINESS

- You don't need prior APL experience. What matters is curiosity and willingness to learn. We provide training and a supportive environment to help you succeed, and SimCorp partly owns Dyalog APL, helping ensure the language remains actively maintained and relevant. 

NICE-TO-HAVE

- FinTech / regulated-industry experience. 
 - Exposure to vector-based or functional languages (helpful for ramping up in APL). 
 - Experience in a technical leadership role. 

Benefits

Benefits Competitive salary, bonus scheme, and pension are essential for any work agreement. However, at SimCorp, we believe we can offer more. Therefore, in addition to the traditional benefit scheme, we provide an excellent work & life balance: flexible work hours, and a hybrid workplace model. On top of that, we have IP sprints where you have time you can spend on mastering your skills as well as contributing to the company's development. There is never just only one route, we practice an individual approach to professional development to support the direction you want to take. 

NEXT STEPS

Please click below to apply or get in touch with Aditya Gurijala, Recruitment Consultant or you may send an email to aditya. gurijala@simcorp. com to learn more about the vacancy and what SimCorp has to offer regarding salary, benefits, and perks. Role: Senior Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) / DevOps Engineer

Location: Viman Nagar, Pune (Work From Office)

Experience: 10+ Years

Timings: 3: 00 PM - 12: 00 AM (Monday - Friday)

About The Role

On-Call Rotation Required (24/7 Production Support)

We are seeking a highly experienced Senior Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) / DevOps Engineer responsible for ensuring the reliability, scalability, security, observability, and performance of mission-critical production systems. This role combines strong DevOps automation expertise with true SRE ownership, including incident management, on-call participation, reliability engineering, observability, root cause analysis, and proactive system improvements. 

The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in Microsoft Azure, Kubernetes, OpenTelemetry, Golden Signals monitoring, and modern SRE practices. They should be capable of balancing incident response with long-term engineering initiatives that improve reliability, reduce operational toil, and strengthen system resilience. 

Key Responsibilities

1. Incident Response & On-Call Ownership

- Participate in 24/7 on-call rotation for production systems. 
 - Rapidly diagnose, mitigate, and resolve high-severity production incidents. 
 - Lead Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and post-mortem documentation. 
 - Implement corrective and preventive actions to avoid recurrence. 
 - Drive improvements in Mean Time to Recovery (MTTR). 
 - Maintain and improve SLAs, SLOs, and reliability objectives. 

2. Reliability Engineering & SRE Practices

- Implement and champion Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) best practices. 
 - Define, measure, and improve SLIs, SLOs, SLAs, and Error Budgets. 
 - Engineer solutions to eliminate repetitive operational work (toil reduction). 
 - Conduct reliability reviews and capacity planning exercises. 
 - Improve system redundancy, failover strategies, and disaster recovery readiness. 
 - Continuously improve service availability, latency, and operational excellence. 

3. Cloud & Infrastructure Engineering

- Design, manage, and optimize infrastructure on Microsoft Azure (Mandatory). 
 - Manage Azure Virtual Machines, Networking, Storage, IAM, Azure Monitor, and cloud-native services. 
 - Experience with AWS services such as EC2, S3, RDS, IAM, VPC, and CloudWatch is preferred. 
 - Exposure to Google Cloud Platform (GCP) is a plus. 
 - Administer and optimize Kubernetes clusters and containerized workloads. 
 - Manage Helm deployments and Kubernetes-based applications. 
 - Implement Infrastructure as Code (Terraform preferred). 
 - Support Git-based workflows using GitHub, GitLab, or Azure Repos. 

4. Monitoring, Observability & Performance Engineering

- Design and implement observability solutions using OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, CloudWatch, and Azure Monitor. 
 - Build and maintain distributed tracing frameworks using OpenTelemetry. 
 - Establish monitoring based on Golden Signals: 
 - Latency
 - Traffic
 - Errors
 - Saturation
 - Design symptom-based alerting focused on user impact. 
 - Analyze performance bottlenecks and optimize application and infrastructure performance. 
 - Improve logging, tracing, and monitoring strategies across distributed systems. 

5. AI & Cloud-Native Workloads (Good to Have)

- Support deployment and operations of Azure AI Services and AI Foundry solutions. 
 - Assist in infrastructure design for RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) workloads. 
 - Ensure scalability, reliability, and observability of AI/ML systems in production. 

6. Security & Compliance

- Apply cloud security best practices including IAM, network segmentation, and secrets management. 
 - Support vulnerability remediation and security initiatives. 
 - Collaborate with development and security teams to meet compliance requirements. 

Required Technical Skills

Core Engineering

- Strong scripting/programming skills in Python and Bash. 
 - Good knowledge of Go (Golang) is a plus. 
 - Deep understanding of Linux systems administration. 
 - Strong networking fundamentals (DNS, TCP/IP, Load Balancing, SSL/TLS).

Cloud & Infrastructure

Monitoring & Observability

Preferred Qualifications

What We're Looking For

data.title: Sr. Software Engineer, .NetFullstack ReactJS
data.description:
A career that's the whole package!

At Conga, we've built a community where our colleagues can thrive. Here you'll find opportunities to innovate and support growth through individual and team development, all within an environment where every voice is heard. 

Conga lines up commercial operations so companies run as connected, smarter businesses. By unifying the people and processes that drive commerce, Conga aligns pricing, quoting, contracting, rebates, and communications so teams stay in sync and buyers keep moving forward. The result is trusted decisions, consistent buyer experiences, and profitable growth. More than 10, 000 customers worldwide, including over 50% of the Fortune 100®, trust Conga when commercial complexity is high and global impact is on the line. 

Job Title: Sr. Software Engineer

Location: Bangalore

Reports to: Director, Software Engineering

A quick snapshot. . . 

We are looking for a talented Senior Software Engineer to help us build next gen Conga products. We want to hire unbelievably bright developers, who are a joy to work with, love to work with others, solve problems, listen well, and lead as appropriate. We believe in using the best tools for the task at hand so the ability and desire to learn new programming languages and technologies is a must. All of this adds up to an exciting, challenging, and always interesting place to work, where hard problems are found and solved every day. 

Why it's a big deal. . . 

This is one of the critical roles in the engineering team where a Senior Software Engineer will maintain front-end and back-end aspects of application development. This role works on multiple technologies and databases to make sure the product development moves towards rapid development, rich controls, more scalable, and better security. It is a challenging role working on the latest tech stack and a dynamic & rewarding environment. 

Are you the person we're looking for?

Front-end Technologies. You should have 5+ years of experience in Front-end technologies like HTML5, CSS3, JQuery, Javascript, Bootstrap, and at least 2+ years of experience in ReactJS. 

Deployment & Collaboration Tools. You should have experience working with container-based platforms like Docker/ Kubernetes and be proficient with source control and team collaboration tools (GitHub, Jira, Microsoft teams). 

Backend Technologies. You should have hands-on experience in backend technologies, API, design patterns, architecture, C# & SQL Query, and good to have Microservices. 

Education. A bachelor's degree in Engineering or equivalent. 

Here's What Will Give You An Edge. . . 

Passionate Coder. Proactive, self-driven, and enjoys solving complex problems, not just in the primary area of responsibility but across boundaries. Identify and implement best practices for coding as well as development processes and perform as a trusted contributor requiring little to no supervision and demonstrating the ability to meet deadlines, exceed goals, and create benchmarks for success. 

Strong communication and interpersonal skills. You're not just comfortable engaging in collaborative discussions, but initiating them, too. You are skilled at reading and adapting to different communication styles. When you speak you are clear and concise. Your strong listening skills foster connection with our clients and allow you to accurately collect the right information so you can resolve issues in the most expedient way. 

Analytical thinker and creative problem solver. You can see issues holistically and follow the flow of the stack to get to the root of the matter -- a key skill in this role. But where you really shine is with your ability to identify creative solutions to unique customer requirements. This is critical for ensuring our customer issues are resolved in a manner that meets or exceeds their expectations without increasing their costs. 

Ability to meet deadlines. You are able to perform as a trusted contributor requiring little to no supervision and demonstrating the ability to meet deadlines, exceed goals, and create benchmarks for success. 

Did we pique your interest?

If this sounds like the kind of job you would love in the kind of environment where you would thrive, please click apply. We'd love to hear from you!

Preferred Resume Format

We accept resumes in any format, we suggest using PDF or plain text. These formats help ensure that your resume's formatting remains intact, making it easier for our recruiters to review your application promptly. 

Don't meet every requirement for the role?

Studies have shown that women and members of ethnic minorities are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. At Conga we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace, so if you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You just might be the right candidate for this or other roles. 

Additional Information

Conga is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, age, national origin, disability, parental or pregnancy status, marriage and civil partnership, sexual orientation, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. Conga is not open to third party solicitation or resumes for our posted FTE positions. Resumes received from third party agencies that are unsolicited will be considered complimentary. 

Conga's Applicant Privacy Statement

The information you provide during the application process will be used in accordance with Conga's Applicant Privacy Statement (https: //conga. com/applicant-privacy-statement). By submitting your application, you acknowledge and agree to the terms outlined in this privacy statement.

data.title: Senior Software Engineer
data.description:
Pattern is a leading eCommerce data and growth company headquartered in the Silicon Slopes tech hub in Lehi, Utah, with global offices in Europe, China, Australia, the Middle East, and Canada. Named to the Inc. 500 list of the fastest-growing companies in the US, Pattern has made its mark in the industry. Some of the biggest consumer brands - including Skullcandy, Nestle, Clorox, Kong, Panasonic, Tumi, and PopSockets - trust Pattern with their business, and Pattern has recruited talent from Amazon, eBay, Adobe, PepsiCo, Apple, Google, and Oracle. 

Pattern values data and the engineering required to take full advantage of it. As a Senior Software Engineer on the AI Platforms team, you will build the systems that turn Pattern's data into automated, accountable action for our brand partners. 

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

- Platform services: design, build and run the backend services that receive events, track cases, decide whether an agent should run, and resume work when a person responds. 
 - Correctness: own the platform's correctness guarantees: 
 - idempotency; 
 - deduplication of repeated signals; 
 - locking against concurrent runs; 
 - recovery from crashed or stuck runs; 
 - a complete audit trail of what each agent did. 
 - Agents: build and evolve agents that follow business SOPs. Decide which steps belong in deterministic code, which need the model's judgement, and which must stay with a person. 
 - Tools: build MCP tool servers that give agents safe, well-described access to internal data and services, with clear input and output schemas. 
 - Human-in-the-loop: integrate approval flows: request approvals, verify signed callbacks, handle partial approval, rejection and expiry, and make sure only approved work is executed. 
 - Evaluations: write evals for agents and tools (golden datasets, regression suites, trace review) and use them as the gate for shipping prompt, model and tool changes. 
 - Observability and cost: instrument services and agents with tracing, metrics and logs. Track model cost per case, and keep agents from running when nothing has changed. 
 - Safety: apply guardrails, including: 
 - treating external content as untrusted input; 
 - keeping money and policy rules in code, not in prompts; 
 - never automating systems Pattern policy forbids. 
 - Cross-team work: make changes across service boundaries with the teams that own sensors, task management, approvals and the Pi web app, including in a second language (Python or Ruby on Rails) when the work requires it. 
 - Requirements: translate business requirements (SOPs, approval rules, escalation paths) into clear designs, tickets and runnable systems. 
 - Production support: support production, including on-call triage when an automation misbehaves. 
 - Leadership (Senior): mentor other engineers, review their designs and code, and help set engineering standards for AI work on the team. 
What We Expect

Senior Software Engineer (5-7 years)

- 3+ years of production experience in your primary backend language. 
 - Designs new components end to end, such as the case-tracking service, and takes ambiguous problems to a clear design. 
 - Owns a production service, including being on call. 
 - Has shipped and measured an LLM-powered feature they owned. 
 - Mentors engineers and reviews designs and code. 

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, a related field, or equivalent professional experience. 
 - 5-7 years of professional software engineering experience, mostly on backend systems. 
 - Primary skill set (one of the following): 
 - TypeScript and Python , with production experience in TypeScript (3+ years) and solid working experience in Python; or 
 - TypeScript and Ruby on Rails , with production experience in either (3+ years) and solid working experience in the other. 
You should be comfortable reading and making changes in the language you use less. 

- Experience designing APIs and webhooks, including authentication and signature verification. 
 - Has shipped at least one LLM-powered feature in production: tool or function calling, structured outputs, and a way to measure whether it works. 
 - Comfort with AWS (ECS or containers, S3, IAM at minimum) and with Docker. 
 - Production ownership, monitoring, alerting, incident response and root-cause analysis. 
 - Excellent engineering practice: version control, code review, automated testing, and small, reviewable changes. 
 - Strong written and spoken communication, including turning ambiguous business processes into clear technical designs. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with PostgreSQL in production: data modelling, transactions, indexing, and concurrency control (row locking, optimistic versioning, unique constraints). 
 - Experience with background jobs and queues (for example BullMQ, Sidekiq, Celery, SQS or Kafka), including retries, idempotency and dead-letter handling. 
 - Experience building agents or agent platforms: multi-step workflows, human approval steps, memory or state across runs. 
 - Experience building or consuming MCP servers, or similar tool-integration layers. 
 - Experience with LLM evaluation and observability tools such as Opik, Langfuse, LangSmith, Braintrust or Promptfoo. 
 - Familiarity with agent frameworks and SDKs (for example the Vercel AI SDK, OpenAI Agents SDK or LangGraph), and with LLM gateways or routers. 
 - Experience with durable workflow or event-driven patterns: transactional outbox, leases, Temporal, Step Functions or event sourcing. 
 - Experience with OpenTelemetry tracing. 
 - eCommerce or marketplace domain experience (Amazon, Walmart, Shopify or similar). 
 - Experience working productively with AI coding agents (for example Claude Code) on a large existing codebase. 

Your first 90 days

- Days 1-30: 
 - Learn the platform end to end: follow one automation from sensor detection to approved, completed work. 
 - Ship small fixes in the agents platform and a tool server. 
 - Be able to explain how a repeat signal is prevented from creating duplicate work. 
 - Days 31-60: 
 - Own a component, such as part of the case-tracking service, an approval integration or a set of MCP tools. 
 - Add an evaluation suite that catches a real regression. 
 - Close one reliability gap, for example concurrent events or stuck runs. 
 - Days 61-90: 
 - Lead the delivery of a new automation use case across sensors, agent, tools and approvals (Software Engineer II: own a major part of it). 
 - Ship it with the evaluations, monitoring, shadow-mode run and rollback plan that make it safe to leave running. 
 Our core values

- Data Fanatics: Our edge is always found in the data 
 - Partner Obsessed: We are obsessed with partner success 
 - Team of Doers: We have a bias for action 
 - Game Changers: We encourage innovation

Why Pattern?

- The company is a rocket ship experiencing phenomenal growth 
 - We have tailwinds and a long runway; we're barely scratching the surface 
 - We have big opportunities that will get you energized and excited 
 - Great benefits including time off, insurance, competitive pay

Pattern provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability, genetic information, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. data.description:
Senior Full Stack Engineer

Position Overview: Build and scale Visteon's AI products end to end, from the user interface to the backend services and the cloud systems they run on. Own features from design through production, and make sure our applications stay fast, secure and reliable as usage grows. Work closely with AI/ML, product, design and QA teams, and stay hands-on in solving complex engineering problems. 

Key Objectives of this Role: 

- Build complete web or mobile applications, from the first screen to release, using any modern frontend stack. 
 - Turn designs into fast, accessible and easy-to-use screens that work well on all screen sizes. 
 - Build and maintain shared UI components and manage app state and data flow in a clean, predictable way. 
 - Design and build APIs and backend services that are secure, well documented and easy to use. 
 - Design databases that stay fast as data grows and choose the right storage for each need (SQL, NoSQL, cache or file storage). 
 - Use caching, background job queues and message queues to reduce load and keep systems responsive. 
 - Build secure login and access control and protect data in storage and in transit. 
 - Deploy applications to the cloud (AWS, Azure or GCP) using containers and set up systems that scale with traffic. 
 - Find and fix performance problems across the full stack, from slow screens to slow queries and overloaded servers. 
 - Set up logging, monitoring and alerts so problems are found and fixed quickly. 
 - Take part in code reviews, design discussions and technical decisions, and help keep cloud costs under control. 

Key Performance Indicators: 

- On-time delivery of features with high quality and few production issues. 
 - Application performance, uptime and ability to handle growing traffic. 
 - Test coverage and reliability of releases. 
 - Reuse of shared components, services and deployment patterns across the team. 
 - Feedback and satisfaction from product, design and AI teams. 

Key Year One Deliverables: 

- Deliver multiple features end to end, from design through production. 
 - Improve backend performance and scaling for at least one key product. 
 - Build or improve reusable UI components and backend service templates. 
 - Set up or strengthen CI/CD pipelines, monitoring and alerting for owned services. 
 - Document architecture and deployment practices so others can build on them. 

Qualification, Experience and Skills: 

- bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related discipline. 
 - 5+ years of hands-on experience in full stack development. 
 - Strong skills in at least one modern frontend technology (web or mobile) and at least one backend language. 
 - Solid knowledge of relational databases, SQL, caching, REST APIs, authentication and application security. 
 - Hands-on experience deploying and running applications on a cloud platform using containers (Docker or similar). 
 - Proven experience scaling backend systems, such as handling higher traffic, load balancing or improving database performance. 
 - Ability to learn a new language or framework quickly when needed. 
 - Good to have: Kubernetes, Terraform, CI/CD pipelines, monitoring tools (Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog), microservices, and experience with AI products such as LLM apps, AI agents, vector databases or model deployment. 

Key Behaviours: 

- Critical Thinking

 - Ownership

Visteon Culture: If you thrive in a fast-paced, organizational culture that requires agility, adaptability, and a growth mindset from its employees to thrive and stay ahead of the curve Visteon is the place. data.description:
This is where your work makes a difference. 

At Baxter, we believe every person-regardless of who they are or where they are from-deserves a chance to live a healthy life. It was our founding belief in 1931 and continues to be our guiding principle. We are redefining healthcare delivery to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond. 

Our Baxter colleagues are united by our Mission to Save and Sustain Lives. Together, our community is driven by a culture of courage, trust, and collaboration. Every individual is empowered to take ownership and make a meaningful impact. We strive for efficient and effective operations, and we hold each other accountable for delivering exceptional results. 

Here, you will find more than just a job-you will find purpose and pride. 

Your Role at Baxter

Lead Baxter's Electrical & Electronics Hardware Engineering organization in Bangalore, driving New Product Development (NPD), platform expansion, and sustaining engineering initiatives across the Patient Support Systems (PSS), Global Surgical Solutions (GSS), and Nurse Call portfolios. Build and develop a high-performing team of electrical and electronics engineers, fostering a culture of technical excellence, innovation, accountability, and continuous learning. Provide strategic and technical leadership for the design, development, verification, and lifecycle management of complex medical devices, connected healthcare systems, and communication platforms, ensuring delivery of safe, reliable, compliant, and scalable solutions that support business growth, product innovation, and customer needs. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Provide technical leadership for the design and development of complex medical devices, connected healthcare systems, and communication platforms utilizing analog circuits, digital electronics, mixed-signal architectures, embedded hardware, power electronics, sensors and controls, and communication and networking technologies. 
 - Serve as the technical authority for hardware architecture, Electromagnetic Interference/Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMI/EMC) compliance, electrical safety, reliability engineering, design verification and validation, obsolescence management, and Design for Manufacturability (DFM) and Design for Serviceability (DFS). 
 - Drive execution of global product development programs, ensuring delivery of commitments related to quality, cost, schedule, performance, and regulatory compliance. 
 - Act as the primary hardware engineering leader for the CCS Bangalore R&D organization and a strategic partner to global R&D stakeholders across multiple development centers. 
 - Collaborate with engineering leadership and project teams across the United States, France, and Germany to drive alignment on product strategy, technology roadmaps, engineering standards, development methodologies, resource planning, and capability development. 
 - Lead global architecture reviews, design reviews, technical governance forums, and cross-site engineering initiatives to ensure technical excellence and consistency. 
 - Influence senior leadership decisions through technical guidance, risk assessments, innovation recommendations, and investment prioritization. 
 - Establish and strengthen Bangalore as a strategic center of excellence for electrical and electronics hardware engineering within the global CCS organization. 
 - Recruit, develop, mentor, and retain top engineering talent while leading performance management, succession planning, organizational capability development, and career growth initiatives. 
 - Develop future technical leaders, architects, and subject matter experts while fostering a highly engaged, innovative, and collaborative engineering culture across geographically distributed teams. 
 - Define and execute multi-year electrical and electronics technology roadmaps across CCS product portfolios. 
 - Drive standardization, platform architectures, design reuse, and engineering best practices to improve efficiency, scalability, and product quality. 
 - Champion innovation in connected medical devices, smart patient care systems, healthcare communication solutions, embedded intelligence, and digital healthcare technologies. 
 - Strengthen engineering capabilities through the adoption of modern engineering tools, digital technologies, and advanced design methodologies. 
 - Lead the transformation of hardware product development through Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Digital Engineering technologies. 
 - Drive adoption of AI-enabled solutions across requirements engineering, architecture exploration, schematic and PCB optimization, design verification automation, reliability prediction, risk analysis, Failure Modes and Effects Analysis (FMEA), failure investigations, regulatory documentation generation, and engineering knowledge management. 
 - Promote modern development practices leveraging Generative AI, Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE), Digital Twins, simulation-driven design, and data-driven engineering workflows. 
 - Establish best practices for the responsible use of AI within regulated medical device environments while ensuring compliance with quality and regulatory requirements. 
 - Partner with Digital, IT, and Engineering Excellence organizations to improve engineering productivity, accelerate innovation, reduce development cycle times, and enhance product quality. 

What You'll Bring

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a related field. 
 - 15+ years of product development experience in electrical and electronics engineering, including ownership of complex product development programs. 
 - 5+ years of engineering leadership experience with a proven track record of building, developing, and leading high-performing engineering teams. 
 - Demonstrated success leading globally distributed New Product Development (NPD) teams within regulated industries, preferably medical devices or healthcare technology. 
 - Strong knowledge of FDA Design Controls, ISO 13485 (Medical Devices Quality Management Systems), ISO 14971 (Medical Device Risk Management), IEC 60601 (Medical Electrical Equipment Safety), and medical device development and commercialization processes. 
 - Expertise in analog, digital, and mixed-signal hardware design, Electromagnetic Interference/Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMI/EMC) engineering, embedded systems, power electronics, and complex electromechanical medical devices. 
 - Proven ability to lead hardware architecture, design verification and validation, reliability engineering, and lifecycle management activities for regulated products. 
 - Experience driving technology roadmaps, platform strategies, engineering standardization, and innovation initiatives across global organizations. 
 - Strong understanding of Design for Manufacturability (DFM) and Design for Serviceability (DFS) principles and their application in product development. 
 - Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams including systems engineering, software engineering, mechanical engineering, quality, regulatory affairs, manufacturing, and product management. 
 - Knowledge of connected healthcare systems, communication technologies, networking protocols, and digital health solutions. 
 - Experience leveraging Artificial Intelligence (AI), Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE), Digital Twins, simulation-driven design, and other digital engineering methodologies is preferred. 
 - Strong business acumen, strategic thinking, problem-solving, stakeholder management, and decision-making skills. 
 - Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to influence technical teams, executive leadership, and global stakeholders.

data.title: New Product Introduction Manager
data.description:
Do you want to be part of creating a safer world? Without thinking about it, you meet us in your everyday life - at home, in transit, and at work. We are at the airport, where you commute, where you work, play and shop. Diverse in our offering, our customer outreach and in our mindset, Gunnebo Entrance Control is leading the transformation of the security business through digitalisation and connectivity for the continuous developments of smart entrance control. 

If you are passionate about being part of an exciting transformation journey working with a global, multi-cultural and highly motivated organisation, this is the opportunity for you. Gunnebo Entrance Control is small enough to see your ideas come to fruition, and big enough to realise your career goals. 

Role Overview

The NPI Manager is responsible for driving manufacturing readiness of new and significantly changed products across GEC globally, ensuring an effective and controlled transition from product development into repeatable series production. 

Acting as the key integration point between R&D, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Quality and other relevant functions, the NPI Manager leads the Manufacturing Readiness Review (MRR) process across product-development projects, ensuring manufacturing requirements, risks and readiness gaps are identified early, assigned to accountable owners and resolved before production launch. 

The role strengthens the R&D-to-Manufacturing transition by embedding DFM/DFA, manufacturing readiness and launch preparation throughout product development, while technical and functional deliverables remain owned by the respective teams. 

Requirements

- Lead and drive the Manufacturing Readiness Review (MRR) process across GEC product-development projects globally, ensuring consistent application and timely closure of readiness requirements
 - Establish the NPI and manufacturing-readiness plan for new products, platforms and significant product changes from development through production launch
 - Coordinate R&D, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Quality and other relevant stakeholders to ensure manufacturing-readiness deliverables are completed at the required project maturity
 - Drive DFM/DFA and manufacturing involvement early in product development, identifying manufacturability, assembly, process and manufacturing-cost risks before design maturity
 - Ensure product information required for manufacturing readiness is complete and appropriately released, including drawings, BOMs, software/firmware, spare parts, test instructions, packaging and relevant product documentation
 - Drive readiness of the production system, including ERP BOMs, production-line setup, assembly instructions, tooling and equipment, test equipment, pre-production builds and operator training
 - Coordinate supply-chain readiness covering new suppliers, supplier tooling, production-volume component costs, inventory planning and critical/long-lead components
 - Ensure manufacturing quality readiness through appropriate sample approval, critical-feature identification and closure of manufacturing non-conformances before production launch
 - Drive prototype, pilot and pre-production builds to validate manufacturing processes, assembly methods, tooling, test methods and production documentation prior to series production
 - Monitor manufacturing-readiness status and key production-readiness indicators, ensuring gaps have clear owners, actions and completion dates, and escalate unresolved risks that could affect production launch
 - Ensure product-cost and manufacturing assumptions are validated as the product approaches production, working with relevant functions where gaps against agreed targets are identified
 - Capture industrialisation and first-build lessons learned and apply them across future product introductions to strengthen consistent and repeatable NPI practices across GECRequirements

- Bachelor's or master's degree in Mechanical, Manufacturing, Industrial, Mechatronics
 - 10+ years of relevant experience, with significant experience in New Product Introduction, industrialisation, manufacturing engineering or product development
 - Proven experience transitioning engineered products from development through manufacturing readiness into series-production launch
 - Strong practical knowledge of DFM/DFA, manufacturing processes, assembly methods, tooling, fixtures and production-line readiness
 - Strong understanding of the complete NPD/NPI lifecycle, including design development, prototype builds, validation, industrialisation and production ramp-up
 - Experience leading structured Manufacturing Readiness Reviews or equivalent production-readiness processes within cross-functional product-development environments
 - Strong experience working across R&D, Manufacturing, Quality, Supply Chain and Procurement
 - Practical understanding of BOM/PDM/ERP maturity, engineering change control, manufacturing documentation and production release
 - Good understanding of product costing, manufacturing cost drivers, supplier readiness, inventory management and long-lead components
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving capability with a practical, hands-on approach to resolving design-to-manufacturing issues
 - Ability to influence, challenge and drive actions across global functions and manufacturing locations without relying on direct functional authority
 - Experience with electromechanical products, industrial equipment, automation, entrance control/security products or similar engineered products would be advantageous  

About us

The Gunnebo Group is a global leader in security, offering innovative products and services to protect and control the flow of people, and to safely secure valuables. Through our businesses and customers in retail, public transport, public and commercial buildings, industrial and high-risk sites and banking, we operate worldwide through our 3, 400 employees, 25 country locations and 10 production facilities. Serving customers in over 100 markets, together we create a safer world. 

Gunnebo Entrance Control specialises in entrance control solutions that enable our customers with increased efficiency, safety and end-user experience. Our wide range of products are designed to create a safe environment without restricting freedom of movement, whether it is to enter the lobby of a company, a supermarket, an entertainment area, an industrial area or public transport. We shape the future of people flow management. 

Benefits

Diversity Statement

Gunnebo Entrance Control is an equal opportunity employer. We know that great minds don't think alike, and it takes all kinds of minds to make our products so unique. We welcome applications from all backgrounds and employment decisions are made without regards to race, colour, religion, origin, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, or any other dimension of diversity.

data.title: Engineering Manager – Power Transformer Design
data.description:
Engineering Manager - Power Transformer Design

Company: Virginia Transformer India Pvt. Ltd. 

Department: Engineering - Power Transformer Design

Location: On Site

Employment Type: Full-Time

Experience Required: 15+ Years

Product Range: Oil-Immersed Power Transformers up to 250 MVA, 230 kV Class

Job Summary

We are seeking a highly experienced and technically proficient Engineering Manager - Power Transformer Design to lead multidisciplinary engineering teams responsible for the electrical, electromagnetic, dielectric, thermal, mechanical, and structural design of large power transformers. 

The ideal candidate will possess extensive hands-on transformer design experience, strong engineering leadership capabilities, manufacturing knowledge, and commercial awareness. This role involves close collaboration with our US-based engineering and manufacturing teams to ensure compliance with customer specifications, IEEE/ANSI standards, performance requirements, cost targets, and project timelines. 

Key Responsibilities

1. Engineering Leadership & Team Management

- Lead and manage multidisciplinary transformer design teams covering electrical, mechanical, design verification, drafting, and engineering support. 
 - Plan engineering resources, establish performance objectives, and ensure timely completion of engineering deliverables. 
 - Conduct technical design reviews and provide engineering guidance and approvals. 
 - Mentor engineers and strengthen technical capabilities through training, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement. 2. Electrical & Electromagnetic Design

- Oversee transformer electromagnetic design, including core sizing, winding configurations, conductor selection, and loss optimization. 
 - Review short-circuit impedance calculations, stray losses, leakage flux, and winding current density. 
 - Provide technical guidance on insulation coordination, dielectric design, and short-circuit withstand capability. 
 - Oversee transformer thermal design, winding hot-spot analysis, and cooling systems, including ONAN, ONAF, and OFAF. 3. Mechanical & Structural Design

- Provide technical leadership in transformer tank design, structural supports, core-and-coil clamping, and mechanical integrity. 
 - Review winding axial and radial forces, mechanical clearances, and structural safety requirements. 
 - Oversee cooling equipment integration, transportation requirements, and mechanical design validation. 
 - Promote effective use of 3D CAD, FEA, and engineering analysis tools. 4. Design Verification & Technical Risk Management

- Establish design verification, validation, and technical approval procedures. 
 - Review critical dielectric, thermal, electromagnetic, and mechanical design parameters. 
 - Investigate complex engineering issues, manufacturing deviations, test failures, and field-related problems. 
 - Lead root-cause analysis and implement corrective and preventive actions. 5. Manufacturing & Testing Support

- Coordinate with US-based manufacturing, quality, testing, procurement, and project management teams. 
 - Ensure engineering designs are optimized for manufacturability, reliability, and cost efficiency. 
 - Provide technical support for factory acceptance testing and customer witness testing. 
 - Support resolution of engineering-related manufacturing and product performance issues. 6. Standards, Quality & Customer Requirements

- Ensure compliance with applicable IEEE, ANSI, IEC, and customer-specific standards. 
 - Maintain strong working knowledge of IEEE C57. 12. 00, C57. 12. 90, C57. 12. 10, and C57. 91. 
 - Review customer technical specifications, engineering calculations, drawings, and technical documentation. 
 - Participate in technical discussions, design reviews, and customer engineering clarifications. 7. Design Optimization & Engineering Development

- Drive value engineering, material optimization, cost reduction, and design standardization. 
 - Improve engineering productivity through automation, standardized calculation tools, and design databases. 
 - Strengthen integration between electrical design, mechanical design, CAD, ERP, and engineering BOM systems. 
 - Implement engineering process improvements and effective design change management. 

Required Qualifications & Experience

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or a closely related discipline; Master's degree preferred. 
 - Minimum 15 years of progressive experience in oil-immersed power transformer design and manufacturing. 
 - At least 5 years of experience in engineering leadership or design management. 
 - Proven experience designing or technically approving power transformers rated 100 MVA and above. 
 - Strong experience with 115 kV, 138 kV, and 230 kV voltage classes. 
 - Expertise in transformer electromagnetic, dielectric, thermal, mechanical, and structural design. 
 - In-depth knowledge of IEEE/ANSI standards and North American utility requirements. 
 - Experience managing multidisciplinary engineering teams. 
 - Strong knowledge of transformer manufacturing processes, factory testing, and technical problem resolution. 
 - Excellent leadership, analytical, problem-solving, communication, and decision-making skills. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience working with transformer manufacturers supplying major North American utilities. 
 - Previous responsibility for complete design approval of transformers rated 150-250 MVA. 
 - Experience with autotransformers, generator step-up transformers, and network transformers. 
 - Knowledge of transformer design software, 2D/3D electromagnetic simulation, FEA, and thermal analysis tools. 
 - Experience in engineering automation, design standardization, and cost optimization. 
 - Familiarity with customer technical audits, product qualification, and design validation processes. 

Why Join Virginia Transformer?

Be part of a global engineering organization, contribute to technically challenging power transformer projects, and collaborate with experienced professionals supporting the North American power industry. 

Interested candidates are encouraged to apply through LinkedIn. 

Company Website: https: //www. vatransformer. com/

data.description:
Company Description: Ayati Devices Pvt. Ltd. is a medical technology company focused on developing innovative medical devices for diabetic foot screening, peripheral neuropathy assessment, vascular assessment, plantar pressure mapping, and microcirculation imaging. Our product portfolio includes VIBRASENSE, VIBRASENSE+T, VASOSENSE, PODOGRAPH, ANGIOCAM, and related solutions. 

With products commercialised and deployed across multiple markets, Ayati is strengthening its engineering capabilities to scale product development, improve reliability, standardise technical architecture, and accelerate innovation. 

Role Description: We are looking for an experienced and technically strong Head - Product Engineering & Operations to oversee engineering implementation, technical architecture, design integrity, and product readiness across Ayati's medical device portfolio. 

The role will work closely with the CEO, Product Leads, and cross-functional engineering teams to ensure that product requirements are translated into robust engineering solutions, implementation is technically sound, and products meet defined performance, reliability, safety, manufacturability, and regulatory requirements. 

The ideal candidate will have a strong background in electronics, embedded systems, sensors, firmware, and multidisciplinary product development, preferably within the medical device industry. 

This is a hands-on technical leadership role requiring the ability to review engineering designs, challenge technical decisions, identify implementation gaps, resolve complex engineering issues, and establish systematic engineering governance across multiple products. 

Key Responsibilities: 

A. Technical Architecture & Design Reviews

- Review and validate system architecture, technical specifications, electronics, embedded firmware, software interfaces, mechanical integration, and sensor technologies across the product portfolio. 
 - Evaluate design decisions, technology choices, component selection, interfaces, performance trade-offs, and system-level dependencies. 
 - Conduct periodic technical design reviews and ensure that engineering decisions are supported by sound technical reasoning and evidence. 
 - Guide teams in resolving complex technical issues and determining appropriate engineering solutions. B. Engineering Implementation & Execution Oversight

- Oversee the translation of product requirements and specifications into engineering implementation. 
 - Review implementation progress across hardware, firmware, software, mechanical engineering, and system integration. 
 - Challenge assumptions, identify gaps between requirements and implementation, and ensure that critical technical risks are addressed. 
 - Establish engineering milestones, technical review checkpoints, and objective completion criteria. 
 - Ensure that engineering changes are evaluated for their impact on product performance, reliability, safety, cost, manufacturing, and regulatory compliance. C. Verification, Validation & Product Release

- Establish a structured process for design verification, system integration testing, performance testing, reliability testing, and product validation. 
 - Ensure that product requirements are traceable to design outputs, test protocols, test results, and acceptance criteria. 
 - Review test plans, test reports, failure analysis, and engineering evidence before major product releases. 
 - Work closely with Quality Assurance and Regulatory Affairs to ensure appropriate design controls and documentation. 
 - Ensure that field failures, customer complaints, and recurring technical issues are analysed systematically and translated into corrective and preventive actions. D. Cross-Product Technology & Platform Development

- Identify common technology platforms, reusable hardware and firmware modules, software components, communication protocols, and development tools across products. 
 - Standardise engineering practices, interfaces, design guidelines, component selection, and technical documentation. 
 - Improve product performance, reliability, serviceability, and lifecycle management. E. Manufacturing & Product Industrialisation

- Work closely with manufacturing, production, procurement, and quality teams to ensure products are designed for manufacturability, assembly, testing, and serviceability. 
 - Review BOM optimisation, component alternatives, design simplification, and cost-reduction initiatives without compromising product performance or safety. 
 - Establish manufacturing test procedures, calibration methods, acceptance criteria, and troubleshooting guidelines. 
 - Support production ramp-up, yield improvement, root-cause analysis, and resolution of recurring manufacturing issues. 
 - Ensure that engineering changes are properly evaluated and implemented across production. F. Engineering Governance & Team Leadership

- Establish a consistent engineering review and reporting mechanism across all products. 
 - Work with Product Leads to review development plans, technical risks, resource requirements, dependencies, and release readiness. 
 - Mentor engineers and strengthen technical problem-solving, design review, documentation, and testing practices. 
 - Build a culture of engineering accountability, evidence-based decision-making, and continuous improvement. 
 - Escalate significant technical risks, deviations, and delays with clear recommendations and mitigation plans. G. Quality, Risk & Regulatory Collaboration

- Ensure engineering activities align with applicable medical device quality management and design control requirements. 
 - Work with Quality and Regulatory teams on risk management, design history documentation, verification evidence, change control, and product lifecycle requirements. 
 - Support compliance with applicable standards, including ISO 13485, IEC 60601 series, ISO 14971, IEC 62304, IEC 62366-1, and relevant cybersecurity requirements, as applicable to individual products. 

Required Technical Skills & CompetenciesCore technical competencies

- Strong understanding of electronics design, sensors, signal conditioning, instrumentation, and embedded hardware. 
 - Strong knowledge of embedded firmware development, microcontrollers, peripheral interfaces, communication protocols, debugging, and system integration. 
 - Experience with hardware-software integration, device connectivity, data acquisition, calibration, and performance optimisation. 
 - Ability to review PCB designs, schematics, firmware architecture, software interfaces, and system-level design documentation. 
 - Working knowledge of mobile applications, cloud connectivity, cybersecurity, and data architecture. 
 - Understanding of mechanical design, product packaging, reliability engineering, and design for manufacturing. 
 - Strong knowledge of verification and validation methodologies, test engineering, root-cause analysis, and reliability assessment. Medical device and quality competencies

- Experience with medical device product development and commercialisation. 
 - Familiarity with design controls, design verification and validation, risk management, change control, and product lifecycle management. 
 - Working knowledge of ISO 13485, ISO 14971, IEC 60601, and other relevant medical device standards. 
 - Ability to work with Quality and Regulatory Affairs teams to establish appropriate technical evidence and documentation. 
Qualifications & Experience
 - Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electronics & Communication Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Instrumentation, Biomedical Engineering, Embedded Systems, or a related discipline. 
 - Approximately 10-15 years of relevant engineering experience, including significant experience in product development and technical leadership. 
 - Demonstrated experience taking multidisciplinary products from design and development through verification, manufacturing, and commercialisation. 
 - Experience in medical devices, healthcare instrumentation, diagnostic equipment, industrial electronics, or other safety-critical products is strongly preferred. 
 - Prior experience in a startup or growth-stage product company, where hands-on execution and structured problem-solving are equally important, will be an advantage. 

Expected Outcomes in the First 3 Months
 - Establish a technical assessment and engineering review process covering all commercialised products. 
 - Review the architecture, implementation status, technical risks, and lifecycle challenges of each product. 
 - Identify and prioritise critical gaps in product performance, reliability, design documentation, testing, and manufacturing. 
 - Implement a standard technical readiness and release review framework. 
 - Establish product-wise engineering dashboards covering requirements, development, testing, risks, open issues, and release status. 
 - Identify common technology platforms and opportunities for engineering standardisation. 
 - Develop a prioritised roadmap for improving engineering quality, product reliability, and development efficiency. 
 - Reduce the CEO's dependency on direct, day-to-day engineering reviews while maintaining strong technical oversight and decision-making visibility. 

Personal Attributes
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities. 
 - Technically rigorous, detail-oriented, and evidence-driven. 
 - Comfortable challenging existing engineering decisions constructively. 
 - Able to understand complex technical details without losing sight of business priorities. 
 - Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain technical risks and trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Capable of balancing speed of execution with product quality, safety, and reliability. 
 - High ownership, accountability, and willingness to get hands-on when required. 
 - Comfortable working in a fast-growing, multidisciplinary medical technology organisation.

From facilitating high-stakes internal and third-party ISO audits to leading multi-stakeholder task forces during critical quality escapes, you will provide the strategic direction and technical rigor needed to protect product integrity and foster a culture of quality ownership across global, distributed teams.

- Process Improvement & Re-engineering: Apply advanced analytical techniques, Lean Six Sigma methodologies, and Agile practices to identify bottlenecks, eliminate waste, and optimize delivery workflows for enhanced efficiency and throughput.

 - Advanced Problem Solving & RCA: Lead cross-functional teams through complex defect escapes, customer incidents, and pipeline anomalies using structured methodologies (8D, DMAIC, 5 Whys, Fishbone / Ishikawa). 
 - Closed-Loop Corrective & Preventive Actions (CAPA): Drive the end-to-end execution, tracking, and post-implementation validation of CAPA initiatives, monitoring long-term trends to ensure systemic recurrence prevention. 
 - Quality Analytics & Statistical Process Control (SPC): Define, monitor, and report key quality performance indicators (KPIs, SLAs, Cost of Poor Quality); utilize statistical process control tools to monitor process capability (SPC) and variation. 
 - Cultural Transformation & Risk Management: Institutionalize a proactive culture of Risk-Based Thinking across the business unit, integrating proactive risk assessments (e. g. , FMEA) into project lifecycles and release pipelines. 
 - Global Team & Stakeholder Leadership: Lead and mentor global quality professionals, providing strategic vision, coaching on quality tools, and aligning cross-functional teams without formal authority. 

Who are you?

Key Qualifications And Skills

- Education: Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Technology, Computer Science, Quality Management, or a related technical discipline. 
 - Experience: 10+ years of total professional experience in quality assurance, process engineering, or operational excellence, including 7-8+ years of specialized experience in QMS governance and structured problem solving. 
 - Certifications: 
 - ISO 9001 Lead Auditor Certification is required. 
 - Lean Six Sigma Green Belt is required (Black Belt is a significant advantage). 
 - Certifications/experience in CMMI, ASPICE, or EFQM / Malcolm Baldrige Business Excellence models are highly valued. 
 - Problem Solving & Quality Tools: Demonstrated mastery of structured root cause analysis (8D, DMAIC, Fishbone, 5 Whys) and risk mitigation tools (FMEA, Hazard & Risk Analysis). 
 - Statistical & Analytical Acumen: Hands-on experience implementing Quality Assurance metrics, Statistical Process Control (SPC), control charting, and data-driven trend analysis. 
 - Agile & Change Management: Proven track record of managing organizational change and driving quality practices within Agile/DevOps and continuous integration environments. 
 - Domain Knowledge (Advantage): Domain expertise in GIS / Digital Mapping, Spatial Data pipelines, Automotive OEM data workflows, or large-scale data platform ingestion is a strong plus. 
 - Tooling Proficiency: Strong working familiarity with collaboration and analytics platforms such as Jira, Jira Service Management, Confluence, Tableau / Power BI, and statistical tools (e. g. , Minitab, Excel analytics). 
 - Communication & Influence: Exceptional executive communication, stakeholder management, and facilitation skills with the ability to influence cross-functional technical teams and present insights to senior leadership. 
HERE is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, age, gender identity, sexual orientation, marital status, parental status, religion, sex, national origin, disability, veteran status, and other legally protected characteristics. 

Who are we?

HERE Technologies is a location data and technology platform company. We empower our customers to achieve better outcomes - from helping a city manage its infrastructure or a business optimize its assets to guiding drivers to their destination safely. 

At HERE we take it upon ourselves to be the change we wish to see. We create solutions that fuel innovation, provide opportunity and foster inclusion to improve people's lives. At Baxter, we believe every person-regardless of who they are or where they are from-deserves a chance to live a healthy life. It was our founding belief in 1931 and continues to be our guiding principle. We are redefining healthcare delivery to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.

Here, you will find more than just a job-you will find purpose and pride. 

Your Role at Baxter

The Verification & Validation (V&V) Engineer II is responsible for independently planning, executing, and documenting verification and validation activities for medical devices with minimal supervision. In addition to providing technical expertise and support in these areas, the incumbent may also be responsible for requisitioning resources, defining requirements, initiating activities, developing specifications, preparing documentation, and delivering training. 

This position is based in Bangalore and reports to the V&V Manager for the Patient Support Systems(PSS) / Global Surgical Solutions (GSS) unit within Healthcare Systems & Technologies (HST). 

What You'll Be Doing

- Author, execute, document, summarize, and report verification and validation (V&V) test activities for components, subsystems, and complete device systems, including but not limited to: 
 - Developing and executing Test Plans, Test Protocols, Test Procedures, and User and Functional Requirements Testing. 
 - Developing and executing Installation Qualification, Operational Qualification, and Performance Qualification (IQ/OQ/PQ) Protocols. 
 - Support compliance with regulatory and quality requirements and ensure their timely closure prior to the completion of design outputs and program deliverables. 
 - Support laboratory qualification activities and productivity improvement initiatives, including testing, fixture development, equipment calibration, and data collection. 
 - Diagnose, isolate, and investigate product issues and problem reports. Drive product improvements and support the resolution of defects and bugs. 
 - Collaborate with external test laboratories and test houses for activities such as Electromagnetic Interference (EMI) and Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC) testing of electrical boards and complete devices, including defining test scope, authoring test plans and procedures, overseeing test execution, and consolidating test reports. 
 - Ensure compliance with Good Documentation Practices (GDP) and Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) throughout the Verification and Validation process. 
 - Participate in continuous improvement activities by supporting the implementation of process and product quality improvement initiatives. 
 - Contribute to Verification and Validation process improvements and test automation initiatives. 
 - Maintain awareness of current regulatory requirements, industry trends, and their impact on the verification and validation status of products, equipment, and processes. 
 - Support Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) with regulatory responses, inspections, and audits, as required. 
 - Adhere to the Baxter Quality Management System (QMS) and support internal and external quality audits. 
 - Present findings and objective evidence clearly and effectively, including the rationale for applicability, non-applicability, and exclusions. 
 - Identify and report quality or compliance concerns and take appropriate corrective and preventive actions as necessary. 

What You'll Bring

- Bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering, Electrical Engineering, Software Engineering, Computer Science, Biomedical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related field. 
 - 3 to 7 years of experience in software, hardware, and system verification and validation (V&V) testing. 
 - Relevant technical testing and reliability engineering experience in electro-mechanical, electrical, or software-based products. 
 - Strong understanding of test methods, validation processes, and techniques used to verify product performance across software, mechanical, electrical, functional, and environmental testing domains. 
 - Experience authoring and executing system-, subsystem-, and module-level verification and validation plans, test protocols, test procedures, and test reports. 
 - Understanding of hardware and software product development methodologies, verification strategies, and testing best practices. 
 - Familiarity with reliability engineering principles, reliability analysis, and statistical methods used to assess product reliability and performance. 
 - Experience in medical device or similar regulated product development, including design verification and validation (V&V), system integration involving hardware and software, risk management, reliability engineering, process validation, and quality systems. 
 - Strong knowledge of medical device design verification and validation principles is preferred. 
 - Understanding of and adherence to Food and Drug Administration (FDA), ISO International Organization for Standardization (ISO), and International Electrotechnical Commission (IEC) regulations, standards, and design control requirements. 
 - Demonstrated ability to achieve objectives and successfully manage multiple projects simultaneously. 
 - Self-motivated with strong interpersonal, communication, and collaboration skills.

Qualifications for the role :

 - 3 years of relevant work experience in Automation systems & controls with relevant process experience in Cement /Mining /Metals /Pulp & Pape
 - Should have fair knowledge in Automation systems for manufacturing industries. It is desirable to have experience in handling automation system engineering & commissioning for process industries like Metals/Pulp & Paper/cement/mining.

 - Knowledge of IT/ Network/ Peripherals like UPS, Printer, PC's, Server components of DCS
 - Knowledge in field devices/instruments

 - Should have experience in handling site works like installation, I/O Checks, panel testing & power on checks, system architecture set-up, individual equipment trials & integrated cold trials.

data.title: Senior Test Engineer
data.description:
Job Description

This role owns production continuity and test health for released products, driving rapid resolution of manufacturing and yield issues while building a proactive sustaining system, working closely with various AT sites & engineers across globes. The engineer leads root-cause analysis, corrective actions, and cross-functional problem solving across design, quality, and operations teams. Sustaining learnings are systematically fed back to new product development to strengthen future product, validation, and test strategies. 

What You Will Do

As Sustaining Lead, you will own production stability end-to-end - resolving critical manufacturing, test, yield, and reliability issues with urgency while eliminating recurring problems through rigorous root-cause and permanent corrective action. You will develop and execute strategies to continuously improve yield and reduce test cost across the product portfolio, working directly with factory teams to implement solutions and sustain gains on the production floor. You will identify trends and risks before they escalate, continuously improve the sustaining process (prioritization, escalation, closure, and automation), and drive measurable improvements in test coverage, test time, and overall product robustness. You will partner closely with Test, Product, Design, Quality, Manufacturing, and Operations teams to close complex issues and build a structured feedback loop that transfers sustaining learnings into development to improve future designs and test strategies. You will establish clear ownership and accountability within the sustaining team and develop the team's technical problem-solving capabilities. 

What We Are Looking For

We are looking for an engineer with hands-on ATE and production test experience - including familiarity with ETS800, ETS364 & ETS88 tester platforms (software and hardware) - a strong background in structured problem solving (8D, RCCA, or equivalent), and a track record of driving yield and cost improvements in a high-volume manufacturing environment. The ideal candidate combines deep technical judgment, strong analog fundamental skills and pcb design experience with cross-functional knowledge - able to work across design, quality, factory, and operations teams, influence without direct authority, and build systems and processes that scale. Experience with sustaining metrics, data analysis, and proactive risk identification is essential; 

Qualifications

Minimum requirements: 

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering
 - 5+ years of relevant experience
 - ATE experience on Teradyne Eagle or equivalent analog ATE (iFlex, LTX, VLCT), although Eagle experience is preferred and is a differentiator
 - Characterization test program and hardware development experience, Production test program and hardware development experience
 - Strong technical knowledge of electronic devices and circuits, and Analog test techniques
 - Data analysis skills using Spotfire, dataPower or equivalent tool based on STDF
 - Experienced with various lab equipment such as scopes, power supplies, sourcemeters, loads etc. 
 - Experience with product engineering activities such as yield improvement and test time reduction
 - Strong understanding of the IC product development process, from concept to volume production

Preferred Qualifications

- Mixed signal test techniques and experience with developing mixed-signal tests on TI roadmap testers
 - Experienced with test program and hardware offload to TI offshore manufacturing sites
 - Proficiency in programming/scripting in C++, Python
 - Revision control tools experience : Subversion, Git
 - Demonstrated strong analytical and problem solving skills
 - Strong verbal and written communication skills
 - Ability to work in teams and collaborate effectively with people in different functions
 - Strong time management skills that enable on-time project delivery
 - Demonstrated ability to build strong, influential relationships
 - Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced and rapidly changing environment
 - Ability to take the initiative and drive for results

About Us

Why TI?

- The future starts here. As a TIer, you'll play a critical role in defining the next era of semiconductor technology and help create the innovations that shape the world around us. 
 - Surround yourself with a team of innovators who value your unique perspective and will challenge you to bring your best self to work every day. We believe that fostering a culture of collaboration fuels both personal growth and technological breakthroughs. Explore our company culture . 
 - At TI, your success goes beyond your work. Take advantage of comprehensive benefits designed to support your total well-being at work and in life, from competitive compensation to extensive health coverage and wellness programs. Learn more about our benefits offerings . 

About Texas Instruments

Texas Instruments Incorporated (Nasdaq: TXN) is a global semiconductor company that designs, manufactures and sells analog and embedded processing chips for markets such as industrial, automotive, data center, personal electronics and communications equipment. At our core, we have a passion to create a better world by making electronics more affordable through semiconductors. This passion is alive today as each generation of innovation builds upon the last to make our technology more reliable, more affordable and lower power, making it possible for semiconductors to go into electronics everywhere. Learn more at TI. com . 

Texas Instruments is an equal opportunity employer and supports a diverse, inclusive work environment. 

If you are interested in this position, please apply to this requisition. 

About The Team

TI does not make recruiting or hiring decisions based on citizenship, immigration status or national origin. However, if TI determines that information access or export control restrictions based upon applicable laws and regulations would prohibit you from working in this position without first obtaining an export license, TI expressly reserves the right not to seek such a license for you and either offer you a different position that does not require an export license or decline to move forward with your employment.
