data.title: Senior Staff/ VP SDET (Software Development Engineer in Test)
data.description:
Who We Are

Galaxy Digital Inc. (Nasdaq: GLXY) is a global leader in digital assets and data center infrastructure, growing the economy that runs on code. Galaxy delivers the onchain infrastructure that connects institutions to digital assets, including trading, advisory, asset management, staking, self-custody, and tokenization. Galaxy also develops and operates data center infrastructure to power AI and HPC workloads. Anchored by its Helios campus in Texas, Galaxy is building a multi-gigawatt pipeline of more than 5. 7 GW of potential capacity, positioning it among the largest and fastest-growing data center developers in North America. 

The Company is headquartered in New York City, with offices across North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia. 

Additional information about Galaxy's businesses and products is available on www. galaxy. com. 

What We Value

We are a diverse team of free thinkers, and fast movers united to help investors and creators energize the global economy. We are looking for individuals who thrive in a culture of builders and overachievers and embrace high performance, transparent feedback, and a mission-first approach. Our culture shapes our way of working and gets us where we want to be. 

- Seek Excellence. 
 - Be Selective To Be Effective. 
 - Be Highly Aligned, Loosely Coupled. 
 - Disagree Transparently. 
 - Encourage Independent Decision-Making. 
 - Build Dream Teams. 

About The Role

We're hiring Senior and Staff SDETs to embed across our product teams and raise the bar for quality engineering at Galaxy. You'll work on systems that move real value - crypto and fiat across institutional-grade platforms. The problems are complex, the stakes are high, and the teams are small enough that your work will have outsized impact. 

This isn't a "write tests and throw them over the wall" role. You'll shape how your team thinks about quality - designing automation strategies, influencing architecture for testability, and driving reliability across the stack. Depending on your strengths and interests, you'll be placed on one of our product teams: Lending, Trading, Operations, Custody, Settlement, Staking, Derivatives, or Retail (mobile apps on Android and iOS). 

We're looking for excellent engineers first - we'll find the right seat together. 

What You'll Do

- Design, build, and maintain test automation frameworks and suites for APIs, backend services, web and mobile UI (Android/iOS), and blockchain-integrated components. 
 - Define and drive the quality strategy for your product team - test planning, coverage analysis, risk assessment, and release readiness. 
 - Partner closely with developers, DevOps, and product managers to shift quality left and influence system design for testability. 
 - Analyze test results, production incidents, and system behavior to identify patterns and drive systemic improvements. 
 - Build and maintain CI/CD-integrated test pipelines that give teams fast, reliable feedback. 
 - Leverage AI-assisted development tools to accelerate test creation, code analysis, and automation workflows. 
 - Contribute to performance testing, security validation, and observability practices. 
 - Mentor other engineers on testing practices, code quality, and automation design. 

Additionally At Staff Level

- Set technical direction for quality engineering across multiple teams or domains. 
 - Drive cross-team alignment on testing standards, frameworks, and tooling. 
 - Identify high-impact quality problems before they're obvious and build consensus around solutions. 
 - Act as a trusted technical advisor to engineering leadership. 

What You Bring

Required

- 8+ years of experience in quality engineering or software development in test, with meaningful ownership of automation strategy and execution. 
 - Strong programming skills in Python (primary) or similar (JavaScript, Java, Go). 
 - Proven experience designing and maintaining automation frameworks (e. g. , Pytest, Robot Framework, Selenium, Playwright, Postman/Newman). 
 - Deep understanding of API testing, microservices architectures, and distributed systems. 
 - Experience with Git, GitHub workflows, CI/CD tools (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, CircleCI), and issue tracking (JIRA). 
 - Strong debugging and analytical skills - comfortable with logs, metrics, and traces (Datadog, Grafana, Prometheus). 
 - Experience working in Agile environments with close collaboration across engineering and product. 
 - Clear, proactive communication - you surface risks, share context, and keep people aligned. 
 - Experience using AI-assisted development tools (e. g. , LLM-based coding assistants) to accelerate engineering work, with an eagerness to push those practices further. 

Preferred

- Experience in financial services, fintech, or digital assets / crypto. 
 - Familiarity with blockchain APIs, wallets, smart contracts, or on-chain data. 
 - Experience with Web3 testing tools (Hardhat, Brownie, Foundry). 
 - Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure). 
 - Knowledge of contract testing (Pact), test data management, or service virtualization. 
 - Performance or security testing experience (Locust, k6, OWASP). 
 - Track record of mentoring engineers and raising team capabilities. 
 - Experience building, testing, or working with AI agents and agentic workflows. 

Why Galaxy

- Work across institutional crypto infrastructure - trading, lending, custody, staking, derivatives, and more. 
 - An AI-forward engineering culture - we invest in tools and practices that multiply what engineers can do. 
 - Small teams, real ownership, and direct impact on systems that matter. 
 - A culture that values engineering excellence, trust, and accountability. 
 - Competitive compensation, equity, and comprehensive benefits. 
 - Mumbai office with flexibility for remote work within India. 

What We Offer

- Competitive base salary and discretionary bonus
 - Company-paid health and protective benefits for employees and their eligible dependents
 - Free virtual coaching and counseling sessions
 - Opportunities to learn about the Crypto industry
 - Smart, entrepreneurial, and fun colleagues
 - Employee Resource Groups
 - Benefits may vary depending on location. 

Apply now and join us on our mission to engineer a new economic paradigm. 

Galaxy respects diversity and seeks to provide equal employment opportunities to all employees and job applicants for employment without regard to actual or perceived age, race, color, creed, religion, sex or gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, lactation and related medical conditions), gender identity or gender expression (including transgender status), sexual orientation, marital or partnership or caregiver status, ancestry, national origin, citizenship status, disability, military or veteran status, protected medical condition as defined by applicable state or local law, genetic information or predisposing genetic characteristic, or other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws and ordinances. 

We will endeavor to make a reasonable accommodation to the known limitations of a qualified applicant with a disability unless the accommodation would impose an undue hardship on the operation of our business. If you believe you require such assistance to complete the application process or to participate in an interview, please contact careers@galaxy. com.

data.title: Quality Analyst
data.description:
TechnipFMC is committed to driving real change in the energy industry. Our ambition is to build a sustainable future through relentless innovation and global collaboration - and we want you to be part of it. You'll be joining a culture that values curiosity, expertise, and ideas as well as equal opportunities, inclusion, and authenticity. Bring your unique energy to our team of more than 21, 000 people worldwide, and discover a rewarding, fulfilling, and varied career that you can take in anywhere you want to go. 

Job Purpose

- Ensure the highest level of quality in our products by performing Quality checks of the Supplier/Internal manufacturing records according to PO, Industry, Engineering & Project Requirements. 
 - Responsible for identifying any discrepancies or inconsistencies in technical specifications, drawings, testing methods, and Supplier/Internal manufacturing records. 
 - This includes complex technical review of various Test certificates and reports to make decision on Authorization of Supplier and TechnipFMC Parts Shipment. 
 - Work within existing systems towards resolving the Supplier and TechnipFMC Non-Conformance Report - by Review, Creation, Coordination and Closure activities. 
 - Work with Global SMEs to check and approve the Supplier pre-production procedure approvals. 
 - Collaborate with Supplier Quality, Plant Quality, Engineering, Procurement, Planning, Delivery and Project team to ensure Quality and Delivery targets are achieved. 

Job Description

- Perform Quality checks of Supplier/Internal manufacturing records to authorize the shipment of parts according to engineering & project requirements. 
 - Communicate non-conformance findings to the internal & external stakeholders and record them in SAP/Intelex
 - Drives supplier/internal Non-conformances report creation/coordination/closure through SAP/Intelex. 
 - Work with subject matter expert, project & client to get the supplier pre-manufacturing records approval through eSMDR tool & SAP
 - Using the SAP/ECM and database systems facilitates to make create or modify Quality notifications. Also to upload and download documents using the same SAP platform. 
 - Execute new scope of work within the team
 - Maintain /share Lessons learnt or Best Practices
 - Attend internal stakeholders meetings to address non conformances. 
 - May participate in process standardization activities. Recommend process improvements to increase efficiency and reduce cost. 
 - May execute root cause analysis(RCA). Work on Containment, Corrective & Preventive Actions(CAPA). 
 - May Investigating customer complaints and non-conformances
 - May support as Point of contact for a small region/plant and is responsible for managing communication team & manager (region/plant) and assign work to a new joiners & mentor them
 - May Support in monitoring and analyzing quality performance metrics Developing and coordinating root cause analysis and corrective action plans
 - May support to Identify & report errors in engineering requirements

You Are Meant For This Job If

- Bachelor of Engineering/Master of Engineering (Mechanical Engineering)
 - Minimum 2 Years of Experience in Quality Function. (Assurance/Control)
 - Shall have thorough Technical Understanding on Industry Standards (API, ISO, ASME, ASTM, 
 - NORSOK, DNV), Engineering practices, Manufacturing techniques, Material Engineering, Destructive and Non-destructive Testing, Measuring Instruments, and Engineering Drawing. 
 - Shall be able to identify and understand the technical details of various certificates and reports associated with Manufacturing Processes and Testing of materials. 
 - Hands on experience in complex review of Reports related to various Manufacturing and Special Processes such as Non-Destructive Examination (PT, MT, UT, PAUT, RT), Heat Treatment, Welding, Coating, etc. 
 - Shall be able to read, interpret & make decision on acceptance of various reports as per the Industry/Engineering Requirements/Project Requirements. 
 - Shall be able to read, and interpret Engineering Drawing requirements related to Dimensions, GD & T, Welding, Coating, Lifting, and Markings. 
 - Thorough experience in using various applications for the day-to-day execution - Outlook (email), Microsoft Office (Excel, Power Point, Word) and SAP/ERP (any other relevant). 
 - Shall be able to demonstrate understanding of steps involved in resolving Non-Conformance Report Process. 
 - Ability to demonstrate the understanding of Quality Tools used in problem solving. 
 - Shall have Good Communication skills to work with Global Functional teams. 
 - Flexibility to work in different shifts based on the need (Global regions: US/ER)

Skills

- Control of Non-Conformances 
 - Communication Skills and Abilities 
 - Manufacturing Processes: Fabrication 
 - Manufacturing Processes: Welding / NDE 
 - Manufacturing Records Review and Coordination 
 - Digital Collaboration 
 - Digital Thinking 
 - Analysis and Problem Solving 
 - Root Cause Analysis 
 - Management of Change 
 - Documentation Requirements for Compliance 
 - Ability to understand ASY/ TST 
 - Industry and Domain Knowledge

Being a global leader in the energy industry requires an inclusive and diverse environment. data.title: Associate, SDET (Software Development Engineer In Test)
data.description:
Who We Are

Galaxy Digital Inc. (Nasdaq: GLXY) is a global leader in digital assets and data center infrastructure, growing the economy that runs on code. Galaxy delivers the onchain infrastructure that connects institutions to digital assets, including trading, advisory, asset management, staking, self-custody, and tokenization. Galaxy also develops and operates data center infrastructure to power AI and HPC workloads. Anchored by its Helios campus in Texas, Galaxy is building a multi-gigawatt pipeline of more than 5. 7 GW of potential capacity, positioning it among the largest and fastest-growing data center developers in North America. 

The Company is headquartered in New York City, with offices across North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia. 

Additional information about Galaxy's businesses and products is available on www. galaxy. com. 

What We Value

We are a diverse team of free thinkers, and fast movers united to help investors and creators energize the global economy. We are looking for individuals who thrive in a culture of builders and overachievers and embrace high performance, transparent feedback, and a mission-first approach. Our culture shapes our way of working and gets us where we want to be. 

- Seek Excellence. 
 - Be Selective To Be Effective. 
 - Be Highly Aligned, Loosely Coupled. 
 - Disagree Transparently. 
 - Encourage Independent Decision-Making. 
 - Build Dream Teams. 

About The Role

We're hiring Senior and Staff SDETs to embed across our product teams and raise the bar for quality engineering at Galaxy. You'll work on systems that move real value - crypto and fiat across institutional-grade platforms. The problems are complex, the stakes are high, and the teams are small enough that your work will have outsized impact. 

This isn't a "write tests and throw them over the wall" role. You'll shape how your team thinks about quality - designing automation strategies, influencing architecture for testability, and driving reliability across the stack. Depending on your strengths and interests, you'll be placed on one of our product teams: Lending, Trading, Operations, Custody, Settlement, Staking, Derivatives, or Retail (mobile apps on Android and iOS). 

We're looking for excellent engineers first - we'll find the right seat together. 

What You'll Do

- Design, build, and maintain test automation frameworks and suites for APIs, backend services, web and mobile UI (Android/iOS), and blockchain-integrated components. 
 - Define and drive the quality strategy for your product team - test planning, coverage analysis, risk assessment, and release readiness. 
 - Partner closely with developers, DevOps, and product managers to shift quality left and influence system design for testability. 
 - Analyze test results, production incidents, and system behavior to identify patterns and drive systemic improvements. 
 - Build and maintain CI/CD-integrated test pipelines that give teams fast, reliable feedback. 
 - Leverage AI-assisted development tools to accelerate test creation, code analysis, and automation workflows. 
 - Contribute to performance testing, security validation, and observability practices. 
 - Mentor other engineers on testing practices, code quality, and automation design. 

Additionally At Staff Level

- Set technical direction for quality engineering across multiple teams or domains. 
 - Drive cross-team alignment on testing standards, frameworks, and tooling. 
 - Identify high-impact quality problems before they're obvious and build consensus around solutions. 
 - Act as a trusted technical advisor to engineering leadership. 

What You Bring

Required

- 5+ years of experience in quality engineering or software development in test, with meaningful ownership of automation strategy and execution. 
 - Strong programming skills in Python (primary) or similar (JavaScript, Java, Go). 
 - Proven experience designing and maintaining automation frameworks (e. g. , Pytest, Robot Framework, Selenium, Playwright, Postman/Newman). 
 - Deep understanding of API testing, microservices architectures, and distributed systems. 
 - Experience with Git, GitHub workflows, CI/CD tools (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, CircleCI), and issue tracking (JIRA). 
 - Strong debugging and analytical skills - comfortable with logs, metrics, and traces (Datadog, Grafana, Prometheus). 
 - Experience working in Agile environments with close collaboration across engineering and product. 
 - Clear, proactive communication - you surface risks, share context, and keep people aligned. 
 - Experience using AI-assisted development tools (e. g. , LLM-based coding assistants) to accelerate engineering work, with an eagerness to push those practices further. 

Preferred

- Experience in financial services, fintech, or digital assets / crypto. 
 - Familiarity with blockchain APIs, wallets, smart contracts, or on-chain data. 
 - Experience with Web3 testing tools (Hardhat, Brownie, Foundry). 
 - Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure). 
 - Knowledge of contract testing (Pact), test data management, or service virtualization. 
 - Performance or security testing experience (Locust, k6, OWASP). 
 - Track record of mentoring engineers and raising team capabilities. 
 - Experience building, testing, or working with AI agents and agentic workflows. 

Why Galaxy

- Work across institutional crypto infrastructure - trading, lending, custody, staking, derivatives, and more. 
 - An AI-forward engineering culture - we invest in tools and practices that multiply what engineers can do. 
 - Small teams, real ownership, and direct impact on systems that matter. 
 - A culture that values engineering excellence, trust, and accountability. 
 - Competitive compensation, equity, and comprehensive benefits. 
 - Mumbai office with flexibility for remote work within India. 

What We Offer

- Competitive base salary and discretionary bonus
 - Company-paid health and protective benefits for employees and their eligible dependents
 - Free virtual coaching and counseling sessions
 - Opportunities to learn about the Crypto industry
 - Smart, entrepreneurial, and fun colleagues
 - Employee Resource Groups
 - Benefits may vary depending on location. 

Apply now and join us on our mission to engineer a new economic paradigm. 

Galaxy respects diversity and seeks to provide equal employment opportunities to all employees and job applicants for employment without regard to actual or perceived age, race, color, creed, religion, sex or gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, lactation and related medical conditions), gender identity or gender expression (including transgender status), sexual orientation, marital or partnership or caregiver status, ancestry, national origin, citizenship status, disability, military or veteran status, protected medical condition as defined by applicable state or local law, genetic information or predisposing genetic characteristic, or other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws and ordinances. 

We will endeavor to make a reasonable accommodation to the known limitations of a qualified applicant with a disability unless the accommodation would impose an undue hardship on the operation of our business. If you believe you require such assistance to complete the application process or to participate in an interview, please contact careers@galaxy. com.

data.title: SoC Verification Technical Lead
data.description:
Alternate Job Title: 

- SoC Verification Technical Lead

We Are

Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow. 

You Are

You have spent years in the trenches of SoC verification, where the difference between a chip that tapes out on schedule and one that slips six months often comes down to a verification plan you wrote in week two. You know that verification is not just about coverage numbers, it is about understanding what can actually break in silicon and making sure it does not. 

Leading a team does not mean delegating and disappearing. You are in the weaveform debugger alongside your engineers when a protocol violation shows up at 2am, and you can spot a gap in a testbench architecture during a design review without needing to see the code. You have learned to read a customer's SOC spec and immediately know where the risk lives, whether it is in the interconnect, the power domain crossings, or that custom accelerator block nobody wants to talk about yet. 

You do not wait for perfect requirements. You ask the right questions, build a verification plan that actually maps to what can go wrong, and adjust as the design evolves. At Synopsys, you will work directly with customers building chips for AI, automotive, aerospace, and high-performance computing, and the verification strategies you build will determine whether their silicon works. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Lead verification execution for customer SoC, subsystem, and IP projects, from verification planning through signoff, working directly with customer engineering teams to define scope and deliverables
 - Lead verification teams of 3-4 engineers, assigning tasks, reviewing testbenches and coverage reports, and mentoring engineers through complex debug scenarios
 - Develop verification plans that map customer requirements to testbench architecture, coverage goals, and resource allocation, then track execution and adjust as designs evolve
 - Integrate and deploy Synopsys VCS, Verdi, and third-party VIP for protocols like PCIe, Ethernet, USB, and DDR into customer verification environments
 - Debug complex multi-protocol and multi-domain SoC issues using waveform analysis, coverage analysis, and cross-functional collaboration with design, architecture, and post-silicon teams
 - Identify project risks early, propose mitigation strategies, and communicate status and blockers to Synopsys management and customer stakeholders
 - Drive methodology improvements across the SSG verification team, whether that is UVM reuse strategies, regression optimization, or new tool adoption

The Impact You Will Have

- Your verification plans and execution will directly determine whether customer chips tape out on schedule or slip quarters, affecting product launch timelines for AI accelerators, automotive SoCs, and aerospace systems
 - The engineers you mentor will grow into technical leads themselves, building verification capability across Synopsys that scales to future customer engagements
 - Your early identification of design risks and verification gaps will prevent costly respins and post-silicon surprises for customers building chips in 5nm and below
 - The methodology improvements you drive will reduce verification cycle time and improve coverage quality across dozens of SSG projects annually
 - Your direct customer engagement will shape how leading semiconductor companies adopt and deploy Synopsys EDA tools and IP in their verification flows
 - The testbench architectures and VIP integration strategies you build will become reusable assets for future projects, compressing ramp time for new customer engagements
 - Your technical leadership will help Synopsys win and retain customer relationships in high-performance computing, automotive, and aerospace markets where verification complexity is a competitive differentiator

What You'll Need

- Bachelor's or Master's in Electronics Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field with 5+ years of hands-on SoC, subsystem, or IP verification experience
 - Deep technical expertise in UVM testbench development, coverage analysis, verification planning, and complex multi-domain debug
 - Proven experience leading verification teams through full project cycles, including resource planning, task assignment, and delivery against customer schedules
 - Strong working knowledge of industry-standard protocols such as PCIe, Ethernet, USB, or DDR, and how they interact in real SoC architectures
 - Hands-on proficiency with Synopsys VCS, Verdi or equivalent waveform analysis tools, and integration of third-party VIP into verification environments
 - Experience with ARM-based technologies including Coresight debug infrastructure, processor architecture, or AMBA protocols is a strong plus
 - Solid understanding of ASIC design flows, RTL design concepts, and how verification fits into the broader chip development process

Who You Are

- You can walk into a customer meeting, hear a high-level SoC architecture description, and walk out with a verification plan that identifies the three highest-risk areas before anyone else in the room sees them
 - When a regression fails at 3am and your team is stuck, you can look at the waveform, the coverage report, and the testbench code and know within 15 minutes whether it is a real bug or a testbench issue
 - You give feedback that makes engineers better, not just feedback that makes you feel heard, and your team knows the difference
 - You do not let a project drift. If a customer requirement is vague or a timeline is unrealistic, you say so early and propose a path forward that actually works
 - You can explain a complex protocol violation to a customer architect, a verification coverage gap to your manager, and a UVM sequence bug to a junior engineer, and all three conversations will be clear and useful
 - You stay current on verification methodology and tooling not because it is required but because you care about doing this work well, and you bring that knowledge back to your team

The Team You'll Be Part Of

You will join the System Solutions Group (SSG), a team that delivers end-to-end SoC design and verification services to Synopsys customers across automotive, high-performance computing, aerospace, and defense. SSG works on everything from individual IP blocks to full turnkey SoCs, partnering with customers ranging from startups to industry leaders and government agencies. Your verification work will span subsystems and full chips, and you will collaborate closely with Synopsys architecture, design, EDA application engineering, and sales teams to deploy tool and IP solutions that solve real customer problems. 

Rewards And Benefits

We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

data.description:
Company: Zintlr

Location: Hebbal / Ganganagar, Bengaluru

Work Type: On-site

Experience: 4-5 years

About Zintlr

Zintlr is a B2B sales intelligence platform that helps sales teams understand who they are selling to by combining contact and company data with AI-generated personality and psychographic profiles. 

The Role

We're looking for a hands-on Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) who can take ownership of backend engineering while working closely with product and customer-facing teams to solve complex business and technical challenges. This is an individual contributor role with leadership responsibilities-you will be expected to write production code, make architectural decisions, build tailored solutions and integrations, and lead a small team of engineers. 

You should be comfortable working directly with evolving business requirements, translating customer needs into scalable technical solutions, and taking ownership from problem discovery and solution design through development, deployment, and production. The role requires someone who can balance strong engineering fundamentals with customer needs and business priorities in a fast-paced startup environment. 

What You'll Do

1. Backend Engineering & Architecture

- Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend services and REST APIs using Python, Django, and Django REST Framework. 
 - Own backend architecture and make technical decisions around service design, data models, API contracts, and system performance. 
 - Design reliable APIs with appropriate authentication, pagination, filtering, versioning, and backward compatibility. 
 - Work hands-on with MongoDB, Redis, and relational databases, making informed decisions around data modelling, indexing, caching, and query optimisation. 
 - Build and maintain asynchronous workflows, background jobs, and task queues using Celery or equivalent technologies. 
 - Integrate third-party APIs and data providers, ensuring robust handling of rate limits, retries, timeouts, and failures. 
 - Build and extend backend capabilities to support complex use cases, specialised workflows, and evolving requirements across different customer scenarios. 
 - Identify technical bottlenecks and improve the scalability, maintainability, and reliability of backend systems. 2. Production Ownership & Reliability

- Take end-to-end ownership of backend services from development and testing through deployment and production maintenance. 
 - Diagnose and resolve production issues independently, conduct root-cause analysis, and implement preventive measures. 
 - Establish and maintain appropriate logging, monitoring, metrics, and alerting for backend services. 
 - Optimise application performance, including API latency, database queries, resource utilisation, and background job execution. 
 - Maintain Docker-based development and deployment workflows and contribute to reliable CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Follow secure coding practices and ensure customer data is handled appropriately. 
 - Maintain code quality through automated testing, error handling, and appropriate documentation. 3. Technical Leadership & Team Ownership

- Lead and mentor a team of 3-4 backend engineers while remaining actively involved in coding and technical execution. 
 - Break down product requirements into technical tasks, estimate effort, prioritise work, and drive delivery within agreed timelines. 
 - Review code and technical designs, enforce engineering standards, and ensure the team follows sound development practices. 
 - Identify technical risks early, resolve blockers, and hold ownership of the quality and reliability of the team's output. 
 - Help engineers improve through code reviews, technical discussions, and hands-on guidance. 
 - Participate in technical interviews and support the onboarding of new engineers. 4. Product & Business Alignment

- Work closely with product and leadership to translate business requirements into practical, maintainable technical solutions. 
 - Work closely with product and customer-facing teams to understand specific business requirements, identify gaps in existing capabilities, and translate them into practical technical solutions. 
 - Develop tailored integrations, workflows, and backend enhancements to address complex requirements, balancing immediate business needs with long-term product scalability and maintainability. 
 - Take end-to-end ownership of solving ambiguous technical problems, from understanding the underlying requirement and evaluating possible approaches to implementation, deployment, and validation. 
 - Challenge requirements when necessary and identify simpler approaches that deliver the intended business outcome. 
 - Evaluate build-versus-buy decisions and weigh engineering effort against business impact, cost, and long-term maintainability. 
 - Take responsibility for technical trade-offs rather than relying on predefined instructions for every decision. 
 - Use AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or similar tools to improve engineering productivity and code quality. 

What We're Looking For

Must-Have

- 4-5 years of hands-on backend development experience, with strong production experience in Python, Django, and Django REST Framework. 
 - Demonstrated ability to design, build, deploy, and maintain backend services independently. 
 - Strong understanding of API design, database modelling, query optimisation, caching, concurrency, and failure-handling patterns. 
 - Practical experience with MongoDB, Redis, and relational databases. 
 - Experience building and operating asynchronous workflows using Celery or an equivalent task queue. 
 - Working knowledge of Docker, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and production debugging. 
 - Experience integrating third-party APIs and building reliable systems around external dependencies. 
 - Prior experience mentoring engineers, leading technical execution, or owning a backend module or service end to end. 
 - Ability to make technical decisions independently and take accountability for the results. 
 - Ability to translate ambiguous business requirements into technical solutions, with experience building custom integrations, tailored workflows, or extending existing product capabilities. 

Good to Have

- Experience integrating LLM APIs, such as OpenAI or Anthropic, into product features. 
 - Familiarity with search and indexing technologies such as Elasticsearch. 
 - Experience with data pipelines, large-scale data processing, or data-intensive applications. 
 - Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure. 
 - Experience working in a B2B SaaS or early-stage startup environment. 

How You Work

- Ownership: You take responsibility for outcomes, not just assigned tasks, and follow through until solutions are stable in production. 
 - Technical judgement: You can explain your design choices, understand trade-offs, and make decisions based on practical constraints. 
 - Execution: You work independently, prioritise effectively, and deliver without needing constant follow-ups. 
 - Business thinking: You understand that engineering decisions must support product goals and business outcomes. 
 - Problem-solving mindset: You can work through unclear or evolving requirements, understand the problem behind the request, and build practical solutions that deliver business value without creating unnecessary technical complexity. 
 - Continuous learning: You actively learn new tools and technologies and apply them where they create value. 
 - AI adoption: You use AI-assisted development tools thoughtfully to improve speed without compromising code quality or engineering judgement. 

Why Zintlr

- Own meaningful backend systems and contribute directly to product and customer outcomes. 
 - Work closely with the founders and leadership on technical and product decisions. 
 - Lead a small engineering team while remaining hands-on with real engineering challenges. 
 - Work in a fast-moving environment where ownership, sound judgement, and execution matter.

data.title: Manager, Customer Identity, Security Engineering
data.description:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence. 

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk. 

Get to know Okta

Okta is The World's Identity Company. We free everyone to safely use any technology-anywhere, on any device or app. Our Workforce and Customer Identity Clouds enable secure yet flexible access, authentication, and automation that transforms how people move through the digital world, putting Identity at the heart of business security and growth.   

At Okta, we celebrate a variety of perspectives and experiences. We are not looking for someone who checks every single box - we're looking for lifelong learners and people who can make us better with their unique experiences.   

Join our team! We're building a world where Identity belongs to you. 

The Role

We seek a technical, research-minded Security Engineering Manager to lead security engineering teams within Auth0 Customer Identity. Your teams' work spans two areas. The first is threat protection: providing general and AI-driven threat intelligence in partnership with Identity Security, and researching how attackers leverage AI, how we build AI-assisted defenses, and how we protect AI workloads across our products, infrastructure, and customer tenants. The second is software development for security: building micro-services and tooling that secure Customer Identity products and infrastructure, including how secrets are generated, stored, distributed, rotated, and retired. 

This role leads teams embedded within the Customer Identity product unit and works across multiple functions to deliver proactive threat intelligence, get ahead of emerging attack vectors, and build the security software that protects our platform, supporting the growth of our global Customer Identity business. 

We are an engineering-focused organization that seeks to stay on the cutting edge of security technology and the threat landscape. In this role you will set direction for teams that don't just assess our current security posture - they research what we should be protecting customers from one to two years ahead, build the software that delivers those protections, and help put AI-assisted defenses and secure-by-default secrets handling into the hands of the teams and customers who protect their tenants. 

You will lead a globally distributed group of talented engineers who share a passion for security and enjoy solving complex problems at scale. This role works closely with and alongside the broader Okta Security team in support of Okta's company-wide security strategy and Okta's Secure Identity Commitment. 

You will stay technical enough to challenge designs, evaluate research, review software architecture, and earn the respect of strong engineers, while spending most of your time on leadership: hiring, growing, and retaining your teams and shaping their roadmaps. 

Responsibilities: 

- Hire, lead, coach, and develop globally distributed teams of security engineers (Senior through Staff), building a culture of research discipline, technical excellence, and ownership
 - Define and execute a multi-quarter roadmap for your teams, aligned with Customer Identity business goals and Okta's company-wide security strategy, and balance investment and prioritization across them
 - Lead the delivery of scalable, reliable micro-services and automation that secure Customer Identity products and infrastructure, including secrets storage, rotation, access control, auditing, and workload identity
 - Drive adoption of secure-by-default secrets handling across Auth0 engineering teams, and reduce the risk from hard-coded, long-lived, or over-privileged credentials
 - Research the emerging AI threat landscape and translate it into a forward-looking (12-24 month) view of what we need to protect ourselves and our customers from, then prioritize investments in detection, tooling, and protections to get there
 - Direct research and protections against emerging general and AI-driven security threats targeting Auth0 and Auth0's customers - including traditional identity attacks as well as adversarial ML, prompt injection, abuse of agentic protocols (MCP, A2A, UCP), and data poisoning - as they apply to identity systems and customer tenants
 - Guide the review and hardening of Auth0's AI security offering, using analysis of past incidents to drive improvements such as new detection signals, heuristic updates, and data labeling enhancements, while identifying gaps and recommending mitigations before they're exploited
 - Partner with the identity security teams to help customers strengthen their own tenant security posture through comprehensive defenses and security countermeasures
 - Partner across Product, Engineering, and Identity Security leadership to turn research into shipped protections for customer tenants, both proactively (hardening posture before an attack) and during active incidents (accelerating detection, triage, and response)
 - Drive adoption of scalable security solutions and automation that operationalize threat defenses and secrets protections at scale
 - Own and influence high-impact security architecture decisions across Auth0 and Okta Customer Identity infrastructure to support long-term threat resilience
 - Collaborate with the Okta Security team on security operations and, where relevant, support investigations, root cause analysis, and remediation
 - Advise stakeholders on mitigation strategies for security risks, including end-of-life software and vulnerabilities, in support of the teams that own patching
 - Communicate risk, progress, and trade-offs clearly to senior leadership, and turn research into clear guidance for engineering and product teams
 - Manage team health, prioritization, and delivery across time zones, including IndiaWhat this position is not:   

- Dedicated application security, line-by-line code review, or compliance-focused leadership
 - Owning reactive patch and vulnerability management as a primary function - this role is about getting ahead of threats, not chasing them
 - A purely people-management role without technical depthRequirements: 

- You have 8+ years of experience in security engineering, with a strong foundation in cloud infrastructure and/or product security
 - You have 3+ years of experience managing security or software engineering teams, with a track record of hiring, developing, and retaining strong engineers
 - You have a hands-on development background - Go / Node preferred - sufficient to guide the design and review of micro-services, evaluate prototypes, and steer the building of security tooling and AI-powered defenses
 - You have hands-on experience with AI/ML security - attacking, defending, or both (e. g. , adversarial ML, LLM/prompt-injection attacks, agentic-system or model abuse), and an interest in using AI to build defenses, not just to study attacks
 - You have working knowledge of secrets management and cryptographic key handling (e. g. , vaulting, rotation, short-lived credentials, workload identity)
 - You have working knowledge and hands-on experience with one or more of the following: 
 - AWS and/or Azure security
 - Kubernetes
 - You have strong knowledge of OWASP security standards and frameworks (including the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications) and secure coding best practices
 - You have a strong foundation in secure software development lifecycle best practices

data.title: Platform Software Engineer - Core Infrastructure
data.description:
Nexthink is the leader in digital employee experience management software. The company provides IT leaders with unprecedented insight allowing them to see, diagnose and fix issues at scale impacting employees anywhere, with any application or network, before employees notice the issue. As the first solution to allow IT to progress from reactive problem solving to proactive optimization, Nexthink enables its more than 1, 500 customers to provide better digital experiences to more than 25+ million employees. Dual headquartered in Lausanne, Switzerland and Boston, Massachusetts, Nexthink has 9 offices worldwide. 

Nexthink helps IT teams delight people at work. Behind that promise sits a platform that takes in trillions of events a day from more than 15 million devices, running on a cell-based architecture that spans AWS regions around the world. The Core Infrastructure team builds and runs the AWS foundation that the whole of engineering depends on. The company has grown from on-prem to cloud and is now making room for new kinds of work, including AI and agent workloads, so there is plenty of genuinely interesting work to do on the layer underneath it all. 

Job Description

What you will do

- Design, deploy, and run AWS infrastructure from end to end: from the edge and networking through to the multi-account cell architecture and the EKS platform. 
 - Move between operational work, automation, requests from other engineering teams, and greenfield design, depending on what the platform needs that week. 
 - Automate as much as sensibly possible: the infrastructure-as-code and GitOps that provision, upgrade, and keep the whole estate consistent and free of drift. 
 - Work closely with the product and feature teams, turning what they need into self-service capabilities and helping them stay autonomous. 
 - Keep the platform reliable, secure, and cost-effective: upgrades, autoscaling, observability, and security hardening and compliance (FedRAMP, FIPS). You will share the on-call rotation with the rest of the team. 
 - Help the architecture grow: design new capabilities and take the platform to the next level of scale, resilience, and new kinds of workload. How we work

A few things that are true about this team and, we think, make it a good place to build: 

- It is a team with real ownership. You look after your own areas and make the call on what is best for the platform, rather than working through a queue of tickets someone else has written. 
 - We do not work in a silo. We spend a lot of time with the teams who build on us, including a good deal of design work together, so the platform grows around what people genuinely need. 
 - The scale keeps it interesting. A cell-based setup across several regions on modern AWS tooling is a good deal more involved, and more rewarding, than a single-region estate. 
 - We are improving something that already works. The platform is live and doing its job. Our task is to take it from good to really good, so the problems are about pushing things further rather than wiring up the basics. 
 - Like everyone here we use AI tools day to day, and we are steadily moving the more repetitive operational work onto automation. We would rather have engineers than operators, and we do the automation carefully, because infrastructure is not somewhere to be careless. 

Qualifications

Who you are

This matters to us more than any single item on the list below. We are looking for someone who: 

- Works well on their own. You can join a call, understand what a team really needs, and come back with a sensible plan. You think about the problem rather than wait to be told what to do. 
 - Communicates clearly and enjoys working with people. Requests come from a lot of directions, and you are comfortable with that. If you have done this in a smaller company or a lean team, that experience counts for a great deal here. 
 - Is pragmatic and cares about quality. You know when something needs doing now and when it needs doing properly, and you can juggle a few things at once without dropping any of them. What you will bring

The essentials

- A solid cloud infrastructure background and good software-engineering habits, usually around 5+ years as a Platform, DevOps, Software, or Site Reliability Engineer. 
 - A degree in Computer Science, Engineering or related field; or the equivalent in real experience. 
 - Strong hands-on AWS across networking, edge, and compute (for example VPC, CloudFront, API Gateway, EKS). 
 - Solid Kubernetes (ideally Amazon EKS) and infrastructure as code (Terraform or OpenTofu), with a GitOps mindset. 
 - Comfortable moving between operational work, automation, requests from other teams, and new design, and prioritising sensibly across them. 
 - A production mindset: you care about uptime, security, and efficiency. And you communicate clearly in English. Nice to have

- Experience in or near a compliance-driven environment (FedRAMP or FIPS is a real plus). 
 - Building self-service internal developer platforms with modern tooling. 
 - Working with cell-based or multi-region architectures at scale. 

Additional Information

Have a look at how Nexthink scales to trillions of events per day with Amazon MSK, powers real-time alerts with Amazon Managed Service for Apache Flink, and builds enterprise AI agents with fine-tuned LLMs on Amazon SageMaker. 

We are the pioneers and trailblazers of a global IT Market Category (DEX) that is shaping the future of how the world works, giving our customers' IT Teams total digital visibility across their enterprise. Our innovative solutions integrate real-time analytics, automation, and employee feedback across all endpoints. This enables our IT teams to solve complex technical challenges, create ever more productive workplaces, and deliver happy, satisfied employees in the digital workplace. 

With over 1200 employees across 5 continents, Nexthink operates as One Team, connecting, collaborating and innovating to continuously grow. We call our employees 'Nexthinkers' and our commitment to diversity, inclusion, and equity is second to none. We currently have over 75 nationalities working with us, from all cultures and backgrounds, speaking many different languages

If you are looking for a change and like a nice atmosphere, lots of challenges, and having fun while working, this is a great opportunity for you!

Check what we offer: 

- 💼 Permanent Contract and a competitive compensation package. 
 - 🩺 Health insurance through our partnership with Bajaj, including OPD coverage for dental, vision, health check-ups, consultations, and pharmacy expenses. 
 - 🏡 Hybrid work model balancing office and remote work, with a structured approach for new hires to foster connections and onboarding. 
 - 🏖️ Flexible Hours and unlimited vacation (employees have unlimited paid time off on top of the 22 days of holidays we offer). Plus, company-paid bank holidays (12), sick days (10-30), bereavement leave (5), and 3 days per year for volunteering. 
 - 📚 Free access to professional training platforms to explore your interests and enhance your skills. 
 - 🛡️ Stay covered against accidents, bodily injuries, and disabilities with our personal accident insurance policy, providing assurance with coverage up to three times your annual CTC. 
 - 🍼 New mothers are entitled to up to 26 weeks of maternity leave, with the flexibility to use up to 8 weeks before the expected delivery and the remaining 18 weeks after. Birth fathers can take 6 weeks of paternity leave, while adoptive parents are eligible for 26 weeks of leave for mothers and 6 weeks for fathers. 
 - 💰 Under the Payment of Gratuity Act, receive gratuity at the rate of 15 days of basic pay for every completed year of service, provided you've been employed by the company for a minimum of 5 years. Gratuity is payable at retirement or resignation based on your last drawn basic pay. 
 - 📣 Bonuses for referring successful hires after three months of continuous employment. 

Please note that not all the benefits listed above are available for temporary, contract, and internship roles. To ensure you have the most up-to-date information, we recommend checking with your Recruitment Partner.

data.description:
About Snapmint

Founded by IIT Bombay alumni (Nalin Agrawal, Anil Gelra, Abhineet Sawa), Snapmint is building India's most loved payment brand. We pioneered Pay in 3 through UPI and are also home to India's leading 0% EMI e-commerce app - giving millions of Indians the freedom to shop now and pay in monthly instalments, with no extra cost and no credit card required. 

Today, Snapmint has crossed 50M+ app downloads and is the preferred payment partner for 2, 000+ leading consumer brands, including Zepto, ixigo, Adani, District Store, Titan and many more. We're on a mission to make fair, transparent credit accessible to Young India - and make payments simple, enjoyable and worry-free. 

Headquartered in Mumbai, with offices across major metros including Bengaluru, Gurugram, Delhi and Jaipur, we're building at the intersection of commerce, credit, technology and culture. If you want to work on a product used by millions, build a brand people genuinely love, and help redefine how the next generation of India pays and spends you'll fit right in. 

Come build Snapmint and help us change how India pays. 

About the Role

We are looking for a SDE 3 / Staff Engineer to build and scale Snapmint's Search & Discovery platform across its e-commerce ecosystem. The role will own search relevance, query understanding, indexing, and ranking systems, enabling fast, personalized, and highly relevant product discovery at scale. 

- Role Title: SDE 3 / Staff Engineer
 - Department: Technology
 - Employment Type: Fulltime
 - Experience: 6-10 Years
 - Location: Bangalore
 - Working Model: Work from Office - 5 Days per Week

What You Own

- Own the architecture and evolution of high-scale, low-latency Search & Discovery services, serving millions of search requests with strong reliability and performance. 
 - Build query understanding systems covering spell correction, synonym expansion, transliteration, multilingual search, intent detection, query rewriting, and attribute extraction. 
 - Own near-real-time catalog indexing pipelines to keep search indexes synchronized with catalog, pricing, inventory, and merchant updates. 
 - Drive search relevance and ranking using BM25, semantic search, Learning-to-Rank, business signals, and personalization. 
 - Build and improve search experiences including autocomplete, query suggestions, facets, filters, zero-result recovery, and related searches. 
 - Partner with Catalog, Personalization, Data Science, and Product teams to improve product discoverability and search quality. 
 - Define and optimize search metrics such as CTR, conversion rate, zero-result rate, recall, and latency through experimentation and A/B testing. 
 - Drive architecture, scalability, observability, performance optimization, and production excellence for the Search platform. 

What You Bring

- 5+ years of experience building scalable backend systems using modern programming languages. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with Elasticsearch, OpenSearch, or Apache Solr. 
 - Deep understanding of Information Retrieval, including inverted indexes, analyzers, tokenization, BM25, faceting, query parsing, indexing, and relevance tuning. 
 - Experience building query understanding systems, including spell correction, synonym expansion, query normalization, transliteration, and attribute extraction. 
 - • Experience designing scalable search APIs and near-real-time indexing pipelines for large product catalogs. 
 - Understanding semantic search, embeddings, and hybrid lexical semantic retrieval. 
 - Experience with Learning-to-Rank or ML-based ranking models in production search systems. 
 - Strong understanding of distributed systems, caching, search performance optimization, and low-latency system design

Good to Have

- Experience building e-commerce or marketplace search systems. 
 - Experience using LLMs for query understanding, query rewriting, or conversational search. 
 - Experience running online experiments and A/B testing to improve search relevance and business metrics. 

Why Snapmint

- Be Part of a 10X-100X Journey - Help build and scale and be part of a high-growth story. 
 - Raise the Bar - Learn from people who raise the bar. 
 - Solve Hard Problems - Work on meaningful, high-impact challenges. 
 - Own the Outcome - Take ownership and make things happen. 
 - Move Fast, Build Fast - Turn ideas into action, not backlogs. 
 - Make Real Impact - See your work reach millions of customers. 
 - Grow with Snapmint - Take on bigger challenges as we scale

Explore Snapmint

- Embrace and drive a culture of accountability for engineering-leverage and adoption outcomes. Build platform capabilities that solve recurring problems once, well, for many teams-reducing per-team build and operate toil while ensuring consistency and compliance by default through high-quality, lean designs and implementations.

Create technical specifications, codify recurring patterns into reusable components and golden paths, and write high-quality, supportable, scalable code and review code of other engineers, mentoring them, to ensure all platform KPIs (adoption, reliability-by-design, and developer experience) are met or exceeded.  - Develop lean platform capabilities through rapid, inexpensive experimentation to solve the real needs of consuming engineering teams. Engage with those teams before, during, and after delivery to ensure the right capability is delivered at the right time-and adopted, not shelved. 
 - Adopt a mindset that favors action and evidence over extensive planning. Utilize a leaning-forward approach to navigate complexity and uncertainty, delivering platform capabilities as lean, adoption-validated increments rather than big-bang builds, and keeping them supportable and maintainable. 
 - Work collaboratively with empowered, cross-functional partners: engineering, SRE, security and risk, data governance, and engineering leadership and architecture. Integrate their constraints into the paved roads so that the secure, compliant, and reliable path is the easy path. Deliver capabilities that are admissible-by-design and submit them for admission, co-defining service-level objectives with SRE, who set production standards and own the admission decision. Foster a collaborative environment that enhances team synergy and innovation. 
 - Possess deep expertise in platform engineering and modern AI/ML infrastructure-internal developer platforms, MLOps/LLMOps, model serving, retrieval and vector infrastructure, eval and observability tooling, policy-as-code, container orchestration, IaC, and CI/CD at platform scale-including AI and Agentic SSDLC to deliver self-service, governed capabilities with full automation from discovery to production to operations and all quality checks through the SSDLC lifecycle. Be a role model, leveraging these techniques to optimize platform solutioning and delivery. Demonstrate strong understanding of the full lifecycle of platform and product development, focusing on continuous improvement and learning. 
 - Quickly acquire domain knowledge of the enterprise data estate and the AI use-case patterns the platform must serve. Translate the needs of engineering teams, reference architectures, and governance requirements into reusable frameworks, the data platform, and governance-as-code enforcement. Be a valuable, flexible, and dedicated team member, supportive of teammates, and focused on quality and tech debt payoff. 
 - Exhibit exceptional communication skills, capable of articulating complex technical concepts clearly and compellingly. Inspire and influence teammates and product teams through well-structured arguments and trade-offs supported by evidence. Create coherent narratives that align technical solutions with business objectives. 
 - Engage and collaborate with product engineering teams at all organizational levels, including customers as needed. Build and maintain constructive relationships, fostering a culture of co-creation and shared momentum towards achieving product goals. Align diverse perspectives and drive consensus to create feasible solutions. 

The team: US Deloitte Technology Product Engineering has modernized software and product delivery, creating a scalable, cost-effective model that focuses on value/outcomes that leverages a progressive and responsive talent structure. As Deloitte's primary internal development team, Product Engineering delivers innovative digital solutions to businesses, service lines, and internal operations with proven bottom-line results and outcomes. It helps power Deloitte's success. It is the engine that drives Deloitte, serving many of the world's largest, most respected companies. We develop and deploy cutting-edge internal and go-to-market solutions that help Deloitte operate effectively and lead in the market. Our reputation is built on a tradition of delivering with excellence. 

The successful candidate will possess: 

- Excellent interpersonal and organizational skills, with the ability to handle diverse situations, complex projects, and changing priorities, behaving with passion, empathy, and care. 

Required Qualifications: 

- A bachelor's degree in computer science, software engineering, data science, machine learning, or related discipline. Experience is the most relevant factor. 

Hands On experience with BOOMI INTEGRATION. 

- 10 + years of software and platform engineering experience with most of the following: Angular, React, NodeJS, Python(Mandatory), , C#, . NET, Java, Rust, SQL/NoSQL, PyTorch, TensorFlow, LangChain, LangGraph, LangSmith, LangFuse, Terraform, as well as unit, integration, and end-to-end testing frameworks & tools, specifically BDD, Gherkin, Cucumber, Playwright, and Selenium.

data.title: Manager – R&D, Regulatory & Quality (Nutraceuticals)
data.description:
Salary - 7. 5 - 10. 5 LPA

Company: BetterHerbs

Location: Sec 58, Noida

Experience: 5 - 7 Years

Employment: Full-time

BetterHerbs is a fast-growing D2C wellness brand building clean, science-backed nutrition products for kids and mothers. Trusted by 2, 50, 000+ customers across India, our portfolio spans pregnancy nutrition, lactation, child development, focus, and hormonal wellness. We combine Ayurvedic wisdom with modern nutritional science to create products designed for the modern Indian family. 

We are looking for a hands-on R&D, Regulatory & Quality Manager who can take ownership of products from idea → formulation → manufacturer → compliance → quality → commercial launch. 

Key Responsibilities

1. Product R&D & New Product Development

- Work on new nutraceutical, functional nutrition and Ayurvedic product formulations. 

- Convert product briefs into technically feasible and commercially viable formulations. 

- Research ingredients, dosage levels, bioavailability, safety and scientific evidence. 

- Evaluate proteins, vitamins, minerals, herbal extracts, DHA, probiotics and other functional ingredients. 

- Coordinate formulation trials, sampling, flavour/taste optimization and pilot batches with manufacturers. 

- Review and improve existing formulations for efficacy, ingredient quality, taste, cost and clean-label positioning. 

- Coordinate stability and shelf-life studies and ensure products meet specifications throughout shelf life. 

2. FSSAI & Regulatory Compliance

- Ensure formulations comply with applicable FSSAI regulations, permitted ingredients and dosage/RDA requirements. 

- Review product labels, ingredient lists, nutritional information, warnings and mandatory declarations. 

- Review product claims, website communication, packaging and marketing claims from a regulatory perspective. 

- Maintain regulatory documentation and product dossiers for all SKUs. 

- Track changes in FSSAI regulations and proactively highlight risks or required changes. 

- Coordinate with regulatory consultants/labs/manufacturers wherever required. 

3. Quality Assurance & QC

- Define and review specifications for raw materials and finished products. 

- Review COAs, microbiological reports, heavy-metal reports and other relevant test reports. 

- Develop product-wise testing protocols and ensure periodic testing through NABL/FSSAI-recognised laboratories where applicable. 

- Investigate quality complaints, batch deviations and product inconsistencies and drive corrective/preventive actions. 

- Maintain batch-wise quality documentation and ensure consistency across production batches. 

- Conduct/coordinate manufacturer and supplier quality audits. 

4. Manufacturer & Vendor Management

- Identify and evaluate suitable third-party manufacturers and ingredient suppliers. 

- Evaluate vendors on quality, technical capability, compliance, pricing and scalability. 

- Coordinate trials, quotations, MOQ negotiations, commercial batches and production timelines. 

- Maintain ingredient/vendor specifications and qualification documentation. 

- Work closely with manufacturers to resolve formulation, production and quality issues. 

- Develop alternate vendors for critical ingredients and products to reduce supply risk. 

5. Product Commercialisation

Own the technical side of the complete launch cycle: 

Product Brief → Ingredient Research → Formulation → Costing → Sampling → Stability/Testing → FSSAI Compliance → Packaging Review → Pilot Batch → Commercial Production → QC Release

Work closely with Founders, Marketing, Operations, Procurement, Designers and Manufacturing Partners to launch products within agreed timelines. 

Ideal Candidate

- B. Tech/M. Tech Food Technology / M. Sc Food Science, Nutrition, Biotechnology / B. Pharma/M. Pharma or related discipline. 

- 5-7 years of relevant experience in nutraceuticals, dietary supplements, functional foods or nutrition products. 

- Strong practical understanding of FSSAI nutraceutical/health supplement regulations, labelling and claims. 

- Hands-on exposure to product formulation and third-party/contract manufacturing. 

- Understanding of raw-material specifications, COAs, stability studies and finished-product testing. 

- Experience dealing with ingredient suppliers, laboratories and manufacturers. 

- Strong documentation, analytical and project-management skills. 

Preferred

Experience working with products such as: 

Protein powders | Vitamins & Minerals | Kids Nutrition | Pregnancy/Lactation Nutrition | Herbal/Ayurvedic Supplements | Drops/Liquids | Gummies | Probiotics

What We're Looking For

We don't need someone who only coordinates with vendors. 

We want a person who can question a formulation, understand the science behind ingredients, identify regulatory risks, challenge manufacturers on quality and independently drive a product from concept to commercial production.

data.title: Engineering Director
data.description:
Dezerv's next chapter runs on AI, data, and architecture that can scale with us and the person who leads that build will shape what this platform becomes. 

Engineering here isn't executing a roadmap someone else wrote. It's deciding what gets built, what gets killed, and where AI actually changes the game for a platform handling sensitive financial data at real scale. 

About Dezerv

Dezerv is a house of investing solutions for India's high-net-worth and affluent families, co-founded by Sandeep Jethwani, Vaibhav Porwal, and Sahil Contractor who between them have run over USD 7 billion in assets across JP Morgan, UBS, and BNP Paribas. We're backed by Premji Invest, Accel, Elevation, and Matrix, and our clients have trusted us with over ₹17, 000+ crore of their wealth. 

Investing is stressful. Building wealth is slow and unforgiving. We're building the platform that fixes that deep investment expertise, paired with technology, minus the cost and anxiety of a traditional advisory relationship. We've grown fast because we're genuinely good at this, transparent on fees, and modern in how we build. 

What are we trying to solve/mission?

We are passionate about helping Indians invest better. We manage investments with active oversight to help both sophisticated and new investors build long-term wealth across various market conditions. 

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Engineering Manager to lead independently across ambiguous business and technology domains at a pivotal moment for Dezerv. This is a Business Partner level role: you'll own the strategic direction of an entire business or multiple businesses irrespective of product boundaries, managing multiple teams or a significantly large single team - of senior engineers and the managers who lead them. 

Our roadmap ahead is ambitious scaling core platform capabilities, deepening our data and decisioning infrastructure, and embedding AI into how we build and how our product works. You'll set that direction, not just execute against it, partnering with founders and department heads to shape what Dezerv's platform becomes next. 

What You'll Own

Team Leadership & People Growth

- Manage multiple teams (or a significantly large single team) spanning multiple job families, composed of senior engineers (SDE-3 and Tech Leads) and the engineering managers who lead them
 - Grow senior engineers into principal engineers consistently, and develop engineering managers into independent leaders creating new opportunities and areas for your most senior people to grow further
 - Hire senior and principal engineers independently, and build the team structures, communication channels, and accountability mechanisms that bring predictability to execution across the organisation
 - Instill a culture of high ownership, technical rigor, innovation, and intellectual honesty about tradeoffs where teams take calculated risks without fearing failure. 
 - Build structured feedback loops, development plans, and career paths that help engineers grow, not just deliver. 

Technical & Business Direction

- Own the overall business vision and annual (1-year+) roadmap in partnership with business, product, and design and drive the decisions required to achieve it independently, even where the business opportunity and architectural strategy are both unknown
 - Understand the strategic importance of technology to the business and influence larger priorities and trade-offs build vs. buy vs. outsource vs. AI-assisted and decide the future of a product or architecture (improve, invent, deprecate, simplify)
 - Champion the responsible adoption of AI across the engineering org from AI-assisted development workflows (code generation, review, testing) to evaluating where LLMs and agentic systems can meaningfully improve our product and internal tooling
 - Define aspirational goals for the operational state of the overall architecture, and enable teams to create and evolve architectures independently
 - Spot opportunities and bottlenecks in architecture and team structures, and drive best practices across the organisation
 - Dive deep into code when it matters debugging, reviewing critical paths, unblocking engineers on hard problems while maintaining high standards for system design, performance, observability, and reliability across a fintech-grade platform handling sensitive financial data. 

Execution & Influence

- Establish the team structures, communication channels, tracking, and accountability mechanisms that bring predictability to execution across the organisation. 
 - Identify large risks and opportunities, unlock customer value, and influence other teams to collaborate with yours to solve for them. 
 - Demonstrate high judgement on high-cost, high-risk decisions, finding two-way-door approaches that let the organisation innovate and move forward. 
 - Drive strategic communication between senior leadership across the organisation irrespective of team or function boundaries and lead external communication with partners, vendors, and beyond. 
 - Consistently reduce the cost and effort spent on products and business areas already built and in operation
 - Bring a data-driven lens to engineering decisions, using AI-powered tooling to increase team velocity and code quality without compromising rigor. 
 - Partner closely with product managers to shape problem statements, not just execute solutions, ensuring engineering output translates directly into business outcomes and a better client experience. 

What We're Looking For

- 12+ years of total software engineering experience, with 5+ years managing teams of 20+ engineers spanning multiple teams led by multiple engineering managers. 
 - A track record of leading independently in ambiguous business and technology domains, owning strategic direction across an entire business not a single product. 
 - Demonstrated ability to grow senior engineers into principal-level talent and to develop other engineering managers. 
 - Strong technical depth in one or more of: distributed systems, backend architectures, API design, data infrastructure with the ability to simplify and evolve architecture across multiple systems for scale, performance, and reduced maintenance
 - Proven high judgement on high-cost, high-risk decisions, including buy vs. build vs. outsource trade-offs and decisions on the future of products and architectures. 
 - Hands-on experience integrating AI/LLM-based tools into engineering workflows or product surfaces you understand both the potential and the limits
 - Experience shipping products at scale in fast-paced, high-growth tech organizations (fintech preferred). 
 - Strong communication skills and the ability to align and influence cross- functional stakeholders including founders, department heads, and external partners. 
 - A builder's mindset pragmatic, comfortable with complete ambiguity, and genuinely curious about where new - age tech is headed in software engineering. 

Why Dezerv

- Shape the technology behind an industry-defining investing platform, at a stage where your architectural and AI adoption decisions will compound. 
 - Own the strategic direction of an entire business with real autonomy to decide the future of major products and architectures. 
 - Work alongside an ambitious, high-calibre engineering, product, and design team and directly with founders who've built and scaled before. 
 - A fast-paced, learning-driven culture that rewards initiative, technical excellence, and genuine curiosity about what's next.

data.title: QA Engineer Quality, Compliance & Security
data.description:
Kuvaka Tech · Indore (on-site) · Full-time · ₹3-4. 5 LPA · 1-2 years · Immediate Joiners Preferred

What We're Building

Kuvaka Tech builds AI software for healthcare in India, for hospitals, clinics and public health programmes. 

Much of the work in an Indian hospital still happens on paper, from memory or over the phone. Patientsqueue to register and repeat their symptoms at every desk. Doctors write notes after the consultation. 

Insurance claims get rejected because the record is incomplete, and patient calls go unanswered. 

We build the products that take this work off doctors and hospital staff: AI that takes a patient's history, documents consultations and surgeries, prepares medical coding and insurance claims, and handles patient calls and follow-ups, along with a complete hospital management system that also connects to the software hospitals already use. Everything works by voice, in the languages doctors and patients actually speak, so a patient who can't read can use it as easily as a specialist in a metro hospital. 

The Role

You'll own quality, compliance and security across the whole platform. In healthcare, a bug can mean a wrong medical record or exposed patient data, so you decide when something is ready to ship. 

How We Work

• We work in pods. Each pod has a Forward Deployed Engineer who owns the product and a Founder's Office member who acts as delivery manager. 

• QA is a shared team across all pods, so you test what every pod builds. 

• You plan testing around each pod's release timelines and set priorities when several pods ship at once. 

• Developers test their own code first. You go deeper. 

What You'll Own

• Testing: write test plans and cases, run manual and regression testing before every release, and

sign off releases. 

• Automation: build and maintain automated tests for web, mobile and APIs (Playwright or Selenium, Appium, Postman or similar). 

• Voice AI testing: check accuracy across Indian languages, accents and noisy settings, and verify

that records match what was actually said. 

• Load and performance testing: find what breaks when a busy hospital uses the platform at once

(JMeter, k6 or Locust). 

• UAT: prepare UAT scripts, run UAT with the pod's delivery manager, and track sign-off. 

• Compliance: keep the platform aligned with the DPDP Act 2023 and ABDM standards (consent, 

data retention, access logs), check automated calling against TRAI rules (DLT, DND, calling hours), and maintain audit evidence. 

• Security: test against the OWASP Top 10, run basic VAPT, check access control and secrets handling, and coordinate external security audits. 

• Bug tracking: write clear reports and follow every issue through to a verified fix. 

You'll Fit If You

• Have 1-2 years of experience in software testing. 

• Have written automated tests in Python or JavaScript and tested APIs with Postman or similar. 

• Understand the OWASP Top 10 and have done some hands-on security testing. 

• Can read a regulation like the DPDP Act and turn it into a practical checklist. 

• Write bug reports a developer can act on without asking you a question. 

• Live in Indore or are open to relocating. 

Good to have: ISTQB, Burp Suite or OWASP ZAP, experience with healthcare, fintech or other regulated products. 

Hours and Hiring Process

Monday to Friday, 10 am to 7 pm, on-site at our Indore office. This is a priority hire, so we're moving fast and prefer immediate joiners. 

1. Shortlisting

2. Interview 1

3. Task

4. Final interview

How To Apply

Apply on LinkedIn and, in the screening question, list three bugs you'd look for first in a voice-AI app that talks to patients in Hindi, and why. Applications without it won't be reviewed.

Test areas will span across Functional, System level and Customer Qual centric tests. You would exhibit high degree of competency in understanding NVMe/PCIe specifications, NVMe Cloud SSD Specifications, along with understanding Customer specific requirements.  - Candidate should be highly skilled on using AI tools to generate Code, report generation, root cause and debugging activities. Candidate should be highly skilled on using AI tools to generate Code, report generation, root cause and debugging activities. 
 - Ability to collaborate well with cross functional teams, articulate expectations and drive various task forces to achieve short term and long-term goals at Sandisk. 

Qualifications

 - Strong proficiency in defect tracking tools and test management platforms
 - Advanced analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to investigate complex technical issues

Qubist Solutions is expanding our engineering team, and we are looking for a rigorous and detail-oriented Aerospace System Testing Engineer. In this role, you will bridge system design, software, and hardware to ensure our airborne products meet the highest levels of safety, reliability, and regulatory compliance. 

What You Will Do: 

- Design, develop, and execute system-level test plans and procedures for complex avionics architectures.
