As an Applied AI Architect for the Meta Enterprise Platform, you are the strategic technical advisor who helps enterprise customers understand the full potential of our Enterprise AI products (such as Model API) and design the right architectures to unlock that value. You combine deep knowledge of Generative AI with enterprise architecture expertise and effective communication skills to guide customers from initial discovery through successful deployment, ongoing adoption and expansion. This role combines pre-sales technical leadership with post-sales customer adoption and expansion. You will design scalable architectures, develop evaluation frameworks, create reference implementations, and serve as the technical authority that gives customers and internal stakeholders the confidence to purchase. You are the architect of the blueprint - ensuring the right technical foundation is in place before and during implementation. You will not just design architectures; you will help to deploy end-to-end AI solutions that drive actual AI usage such as API consumption and business ROI. You will own the customer's technical success from the initial scoping phase through to live production deployment, post-sales adoption and growth. 

Applied AI Architect, Meta Enterprise Platform (India) Responsibilities: 

- **Technical Discovery & Solution Design** - Partner with sales to deeply understand customer requirements, business context, and existing technology stacks. Translate these into clear, technically feasible AI solution architectures and integration plans
 - **Technical Account Ownership** - Establish technical account plans covering current use cases, adoption milestones and agreed measures of value. Review API usage, technical account health and blockers. Qualify additional use cases and help build the technical case for expansion. Coordinate specialist input where needed and follow through on agreed actions
 - **AI Architecture Advisory** - Serve as the primary technical advisor throughout the customer's AI / API adoption journey. Guide architecture decisions around LLM selection, RAG patterns, prompt engineering strategies, agentic workflow and tool use, data pipelines, and enterprise integration points
 - **Evaluation & Proof of Value** - Design and guide customer evaluation frameworks (evals) to measure AI performance for specific use cases. Create compelling demos, reference architectures, and lightweight POCs that demonstrate practical value and feasibility. Agree acceptance criteria for quality, latency, cost and reliability, linking evaluation results to customer business goals and a decision on production deployment
 - **Enterprise Trust & Governance** - Address enterprise security, compliance, and governance requirements (SOC2, ISO 27001, GDPR). Navigate complex sales lifecycles involving IT, Legal, Security, and executive stakeholders to build technical confidence
 - **Cross-Functional Collaboration** - Act as the bridge between customers and internal Product, Engineering, and PMM teams. Gather technical feedback, identify common integration patterns, surface product gaps, and contribute field insights that shape the product roadmap and GTM strategy
 - **Thought Leadership & Enablement** - Create technical content including architecture guides, best-practice documentation, and industry-specific solution briefs. Enable the broader sales and partner ecosystem with technical training and reusable assets
 - **Hands-on Solutions** - Act as the primary technical owner for strategic accounts. Assist in the design, prototyping, and deployment planning for customer full-stack applications, RAG pipelines, and custom integrations using our AI APIs. Contribute reference implementations and technical reviews
 - **Rapid Prototyping** - Translate customer business problems into concrete technical plans. Rapidly develop and iterate on functional proofs-of-concept (POCs) to demonstrate immediate value
 - **Production Implementation** - Guide customers through the "Integration Wall. " Navigate enterprise security, legacy databases, and complex infrastructures
 - **Technical Advisory** - Serve as the subject matter expert on Generative AI architecture, prompt engineering, model evaluation, and AI security/guardrails for C-level executives and lead developers
 - **Travel** - Flexibility to travel up to 30% of the time

Minimum Qualifications: 

- Experience engaging enterprise customers through the sales lifecycle, purchasing and deployment decisions, involving multiple stakeholders across IT, Security, Legal, and executive leadership
 - Comfortable with Python and able to build lightweight demos, scripts, and reference implementations (not expected to write production-grade application code)
 - Familiarity with the Generative AI ecosystem: APIs, prompt engineering, RAG architectures, vector databases, and evaluation frameworks. Ability to use LLM APIs to build and evaluate lightweight demos, prototypes and reference implementations
 - Ability to design use-case-specific evaluation tests and assess quality, latency, cost and reliability against agreed customer requirements and business goals

data.title: RTL Design Lead/IC Front-End Architect/Datapath Lead
data.description:
About Lumilens

At Lumilens we are building the critical photonics infrastructure that powers tomorrow's AI supercomputing. From chip-to-chip optical interconnects to scalable photonic engines, Lumilens is unlocking a new era of computing faster, cooler, and massively more efficient. 

We're a well-funded startup backed by Mayfield and led by veterans who've built and scaled some of the most transformative technologies in the industry. 

This isn't incremental innovation, it's a ground-floor opportunity to rethink the optical layer from the silicon up. The market is moving fast, and we're moving faster. You'll work alongside a team of world-class engineers solving some of the hardest challenges in optics, systems, and scale. Every line of code, every design decision, every breakthrough you help deliver will shape the infrastructure of tomorrow. 

If you're looking for mission, momentum, and the chance to make an outsized impact, jump on the rocket ship. We're just getting started. 

About The Role

You own verification end to end for a first-of-its-kind chiplet. As a founding hire you define the methodology before there's RTL to verify - this role is on the critical path, and getting the coverage strategy and regression infrastructure right early is the single biggest schedule lever we have. 

About the role. You define the digital front-end micro-architecture - the spec the design team implements - and personally own the high-speed datapath that moves data between UCIe and the optical front end. This is the architectural center of the chip: the datapath, the UCIe streaming interface, in-house IP, and the interface to the optical engine all converge in your blocks. As a founding hire you set the partitioning, interfaces, and coding/CDC standards the whole front end follows. 

What You'll Own

- Front-end micro-architecture and block partitioning; the architecture spec the RTL team builds to. 
 - Front-end design methodology and quality: RTL coding standards, lint, CDC/RDC signoff, and clean-RTL policy across the team. 
 - The high-speed datapath: per-lane alignment/deskew/mux, the UCIe streaming /RDI adapter, elastic FIFOs, and custom logic. 
 - Transport/link framing/mapping and the adaptation logic. 
 - Timing- and floorplan-aware micro-architecture: pipelining, retiming, and partitioning for physical closure at multi-hundred-Gbps (with the backend team). 
 - Clocking, reset, and low-power architecture - clock/reset domains, gating strategy, and UPF power intent. 
 - Establish designer-level verification: block-level testbenches/sanity checks and assertion (SVA) coverage that designers own before handoff to DV. 
 - Architectural DFT and debug provisioning - scan-friendly structure and on-die observability/controllability for a die you can't probe (with the DFT and DV leads). 
 - IP integration and interface/register conventions; parameterization for configurability across lane counts/configurations. 
 - Architectural trade-offs with the modelling lead (latency, buffering, datapath sampling/observability) and the DV lead (verifiability and debug). 
 - Lead, grow, and mentor the front-end design team as the group scales (datapath, interfaces, integration). 

Required

- 10+ years digital design / micro-architecture, with lead ownership of a high-throughput datapath or SerDes-adjacent SoC. 
 - Experience designing the datapath of a network switch/NIC card or memory controller at a major XPU / fabric vendor (or a comparable high-throughput, high-reliability datapath). 
 - Solid understanding of scale-up vs. scale-out interconnect architectures and their bandwidth/latency trade-offs. 
 - Strong SystemVerilog RTL and timing-aware micro-architecture at multi-hundred-Gbps aggregate rates; CDC discipline. 
 - Working command of UCIe/PCIe/CXL datapath concepts and high-speed lane alignment/deskew. 
 - Proven ownership of front-end design methodology - lint/CDC/RDC signoff, clocking/reset architecture, and design-for-test and physical-closure collaboration. 
 - Track record translating system requirements into an implementable, verifiable architecture spec. 

Preferred

- UCIe (or PCIe/CXL/CHI) interface architecture; die-to-die / chiplet experience. 
 - FEC/coding datapath familiarity (e. g. , Reed-Solomon) and gray-code mapping. 
 - Optical transceiver, CPO, or linear-drive optics background; advanced-node (N5/N3/N2) design experience. 

What we offer

 - Comprehensive benefits package including health, dental, and vision
 - Professional development opportunities and certification support
 - Access to cutting-edge technology and cloud platforms
 - Collaborative work environment with cross-functional teams

Lumilens is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status.

data.title: Senior AI Engineer (Ahmedabad Candidates Only)
data.description:
Senior AI Engineer

Ahmedabad · Full-time · On-site only

Brainy Neurals is an AI-native engineering company in Ahmedabad with nine years of shipping production AI, bootstrapped from one person to a team of fifteen-plus. We're an NVIDIA Inception member and ISO 27001 certified. Our work sits in two areas, Physical AI (camera and sensor systems that decide at the edge, like visual inspection on a production line) and Documentation AI that takes manual effort out of document-heavy business processes. 

This role is for an engineer who builds those systems, not one who assembles them from whatever an AI coding tool produces. You'll train models on client data that is messy, badly lit and inconsistently labelled, then get them running inside a real workflow with accuracy numbers attached. The founder is an AI architect who started out optimizing models in C++ for edge devices, so your architecture decisions get reviewed by someone who has made them before. 

What you'll do
 - Build computer vision systems that go to production. Detection, segmentation, tracking and classification trained on custom client data, evaluated honestly, and deployed where someone depends on the output being right. 
 - Own document AI end to end. Layout analysis, printed and handwritten recognition, extraction into structured schemas, validation rules that catch bad reads, and retrieval over document sets large enough that naive chunking falls apart. 
 - Fine-tune and evaluate LLMs and VLMs for client-specific tasks. Build the eval harness before the model, so what you report is a measured number and not an impression from ten examples. 
 - Design the architecture of what you build and write it down before code starts. Data flow, model serving, API contracts, failure handling, latency and cost per inference, all of it open to review by the team. 
 - Read papers in your area, reproduce the parts that matter, and say plainly when a published result does not survive contact with client data. We'd rather hear that early than six weeks into a delivery. 
 - Ship it properly. Docker, CI/CD pipelines, cloud deployment, monitoring once it's live, and APIs that the rest of the team can integrate against without asking you how they work. 

What we're looking for
 - Two to three years building computer vision in production, with depth rather than breadth. You've trained on your own annotated data, debugged why a model fell apart on the client's camera angle, and taken something from a notebook to a running service. 
 - Real OCR knowledge. You understand why recognition degrades on skewed scans, faint handwriting, stamped and overlapping text, multi-column layouts and forms where people write outside the boxes. You know which problems belong to preprocessing, which to the model, and which to the post-processing rules. 
 - Theory and practice in RAG and fine-tuning, both. Chunking and embedding choices, retrieval evaluation, reranking, LoRA and QLoRA against full fine-tuning, and a clear view of when each is the wrong call. You should be able to defend these choices on a whiteboard. 
 - Strong Python and working C++. You can read someone else's C++ inference code and make it faster without breaking it. 
 - System architecture ability that goes past contributing a module. You've designed a whole system, made the tradeoffs, and lived with the consequences. Docker, cloud, DevOps practice, CI/CD and API design are part of your normal working vocabulary. 
 - Communication that holds up in a client room. You'll explain model limitations to a quality head who does not care about your loss curve, and you'll work alongside annotation, delivery and other engineers rather than disappearing into a branch for a month. 

Preferred, not required
 - Edge AI experience. Quantization, pruning, ONNX, TensorRT, Jetson or similar hardware, and the discipline of fitting a model into a power and memory budget. 
 - Exposure to regulated document domains such as pharma GMP documentation, insurance or banking operations, where a wrong extraction has a cost attached. 

Not a fit if
 - Most of your recent code came out of an AI coding tool and you cannot explain the parts you kept. We use AI tools heavily and expect you to use them too, which is exactly why we need you to know the math and the failure modes underneath what you ship. 
 - Your vision experience is coursework, tutorials and Kaggle on clean public datasets. 
 - You've only ever called a hosted API and have never trained or fine-tuned anything on your own data. 
 - You want remote or hybrid. This role is fully on-site at our Ahmedabad office, every working day, with no work-from-home arrangement. 

What you get
 - Hard problems on real client data, in vision and document AI, instead of a backlog of CRUD tickets with a model bolted on. 
 - Architecture reviews with a founder who has shipped edge AI in C++, and room to argue your position when you think he's wrong. 
 - Research time that counts as work, because our differentiation depends on us knowing the literature better than the client's other vendors. 
 - Direct client exposure from early on, which is how engineers here end up leading delivery. 

Role details
 - Location: Our Ahmedabad office, on-site, no work from home and no hybrid
 - Reports to: The founder and AI architect
 - Compensation: Fixed salary matched to your depth, not to your years
 - Selection: A short take-home on a vision or OCR problem with your reasoning written out, then a live architecture and paper discussion where we go deep on what you submitted

How to applyEmail humans@brainyneurals. com with "AI Engineer" in the subject line, and send us these four things. 

- Your resume, plus GitHub or anything else that shows code you wrote yourself. 
 - One vision or OCR system you built, covering the data you trained on, the accuracy you reached, what it was deployed on and where it still fails. 
 - One paper you implemented or reproduced, and what you learned from the gap between the paper and your results. 
 - Your expected CTC and your notice period.

Senior Engineer: STA Methodology & Sign-off Lead

Bangalore

EnCharge AI is a leader in advanced AI hardware and software systems for edge-to-cloud computing. EnCharge's robust and scalable next-generation in-memory computing technology provides orders-of-magnitude higher compute efficiency and density compared to today's best-in-class solutions. The high-performance architecture is coupled with seamless software integration and will enable the immense potential of AI to be accessible in power, energy, and space constrained applications. EnCharge AI launched in 2022 and is led by veteran technologists with backgrounds in semiconductor design and AI systems. 

Staff Engineer: STA Methodology & Sign-off Lead

We are seeking a high-caliber Staff or Senior Staff Engineer to architect and lead our SOC Static Timing Analysis (STA) Methodology along with execution responsibilities to eliminate the bottle-necks in STA and build bridges. 

This is a critical role for a forward-thinking engineer who excels at defining the frameworks and flows required to navigate the complexities of modern, large-scale SOC designs. Engineer will have scope to bridge Architecture, CAD, RTL, and Physical Design to establish a predictable, high-performance, and scalable path to tape-out. 

The Role As the lead for STA Methodology, you will own the sign-off architecture and the timing convergence strategy. Rather than just executing runs, you will build the "engine" that enables execution-defining flows, qualifying tools, establishing margin strategies (AOCV/LVF/POCV), and driving cross-functional alignment to meet aggressive Power, Performance, and Area (PPA) targets. 

Key Responsibilities

- Sign-off Methodology & Architecture: Define and own full-chip SOC timing sign-off criteria, including Multi-Mode Multi-Corner (MMMC) definitions, derate strategies, and operating condition mapping for functional, shift, and capture modes. 
 - Flow Development & Left-Shift Automation: Architect, deploy, and maintain advanced STA and ECO flows. Develop methodologies to proactively identify structural timing issues and predict physical design bottlenecks early in the RTL/Synthesis phases. 
 - Tool Benchmarking & Deployment: Evaluate, qualify, and deploy new EDA tool features and capabilities (with a strong emphasis on Cadence Tempus) to improve Quality of Results (QoR), optimize memory/runtime efficiency, and streamline hierarchical timing models. 
 - Custom Automation Infrastructure: Architect scalable, robust automation utilities (Tcl, Python, Perl) to standardize constraint (SDC) management, automate cross-domain timing audits, and accelerate the ECO loop across distributed design teams. 
 - Cross-Functional Enablement: Partner with Physical Design to define optimal clock tree synthesis (CTS) methodologies and floorplanning guidelines. Guide DFT and RTL teams on methodology to resolve structural bottlenecks (e. g. , NoC timing, complex CDC paths). Requirements & Qualifications

- Experience: 7+ years of hands-on experience in VLSI design, with a primary focus on STA Methodology, flow development, and sign-off criteria at advanced process nodes (7nm, 5nm, or below). 
 - Technical Mastery: 
 - Deep expertise in building flows around industry-standard sign-off tools, with a strong preference for Cadence Tempus. 
 - Mastery of Multi-Mode Multi-Corner (MMMC) flow architecture, Hierarchical (ILM/ETM) vs. Flat timing strategies, and constraint (SDC) validation methodologies. 
 - Strong understanding of advanced node timing phenomena, including waveform propagation, crosstalk, and statistical margining (LVF/POCV). 
 - Critical Thinking: Proven ability to architect broad flow solutions and debug systemic tool or methodology bottlenecks, rather than just fixing isolated timing violations. 
 - Soft Skills: Strong leadership presence with the ability to define technical standards, influence cross-functional teams, and drive methodology adoption in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

Job Description

As part of the Development Engineering team, the Control Software Designer designs, supports, and troubleshoots control systems for Injection Molding Machines(IMM) and Mold controllers. This role operates in a fast-paced, innovative environment and focuses on developing creative, high-quality solutions to complex technical challenges. 

Key Responsibilities/Areas Of Accountability: 

- Design control systems for IMM and Mold controller applications including servo drive and servo-hydraulic controls, injection molding process control. 
 - Provide functional, design specifications and validation plans for new IMM and Mold controller functionality. 
 - Software development of machine sequences (PLC IEC 61131-3), process control, human-machine interface(HMI) in Windows environment. 
 - Troubleshoot and debug real-time and non-real-time software. 
 - Document software changes using resources such as TFS/VSTS and Azure DevOps. 
 - Document development, design changes and production design activities. 
 - Communicate design with other design groups and businesses. 

Requirements: 

- Bachelor's Degree or higher in Electrical & Electronics/ECE/Instrumentation/Software Engineering preferred, or equivalent. 
 - Minimum 5 years hands-on experience in automated control system design and troubleshooting preferred. 
 - Machine design/develop with Beckhoff, Siemens, GE, ABB and Allen Bradley products background are preferred. 
 - PLC structured text language design and programming using IEC 61131-3. 
 - Experience in programming using C, C++, C# or other high-level languages for HMI applications (Ruby). 
 - Strong knowledge of PC based control systems and embedded system. 
 - Strong Knowledge of control theory and model-based design principles. 
 - Knowledge of PLC's and motion controllers. 
 - Working knowledge of standard industrial communication networks and protocols such as RS232, RS485, Ethernet, CANOpen, Profibus, Profinet and EtherCAT. 
 - Ability to read control circuits using Eplan as a resource. 
 - Experience with Beckhoff TwinCAT3. 
 - Experience designing, debugging and deploying software in VSTS development environment. 
 - Machine design/develop with Beckhoff, Siemens, GE, ABB and Allen Bradley products background are preferred. 
 - Experience in Agile software design process and Test Driven Development methodologies. 
 - Familiarity and experience with AI and it's use in software development, ideation, and the creation of tools
 - Strong proficiency in English with effective verbal, written. 

Personal Qualifications: 

- Ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly, verbally and in writing. 
 - A quick independent learner, able to digest and understand complex concepts. 
 - An intelligent thinker, able to formulate hypotheses, troubleshoot, analyze, and propose solutions. 
 - Highly creative with the ability to develop multiple concepts to resolve problems. 
 - Capable of Working in a multi-disciplined international team with excellent personal organization skills. 

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a competitive compensation and benefits package and excellent opportunities for growth and advancement. We are committed to equal employment opportunity and respect, value and welcome diversity in our workplace. Husky TechnologiesTM also values being a great place to work and strives to maintain a safe workplace. Accordingly, Husky TechnologiesTM conditions all offers of employment on satisfactory completion of background checks. No agency or telephone inquiries please.

A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.

- Engineering degree or relevant certification

data.title: Modelling Lead (SystemC / Virtual-Platform Architect)
data.description:
About Lumilens

At Lumilens we are building the critical photonics infrastructure that powers tomorrow's AI supercomputing. From chip-to-chip optical interconnects to scalable photonic engines, Lumilens is unlocking a new era of computing faster, cooler, and massively more efficient. 

We're a well-funded startup backed by Mayfield and led by veterans who've built and scaled some of the most transformative technologies in the industry. 

This isn't incremental innovation, it's a ground-floor opportunity to rethink the optical layer from the silicon up. The market is moving fast, and we're moving faster. You'll work alongside a team of world-class engineers solving some of the hardest challenges in optics, systems, and scale. Every line of code, every design decision, every breakthrough you help deliver will shape the infrastructure of tomorrow. 

If you're looking for mission, momentum, and the chance to make an outsized impact, jump on the rocket ship. We're just getting started. 

About the role. You will build the executable model of the chip before silicon exists. Your architecture models will settle the decisions that are expensive to change late, including datapath latency, throughput, buffer sizing, and control-loop tuning. Your reference models will become the golden checkers the verification team scores against, and the platform will run real firmware months ahead of RTL. This is a founding, critical-path role: the virtual platform is what unblocks the firmware and architecture work in parallel with design. 

What You'll Own

- A SystemC/TLM-2. 0 virtual platform - MCU (ISS-backed) + peripherals + memory map + a UCIe transactor + host stub - that firmware runs on pre-RTL. 
 - Architecture/performance models: architectural trade studies, end-to-end datapath throughput and latency, FIFO/buffer sizing, design-space/configuration exploration. 
 - Golden reference models handed to DV as scoreboards. 
 - Behavioral models of the analog and control circuits. 
 - Partner with the FE architect and firmware lead to keep model, RTL, and firmware views coherent. 

Required

- 8+ years in architecture/performance modelling or virtual-platform development for complex SoCs. 
 - Strong SystemC and TLM-2. 0; solid modern C++. 
 - Built or led a virtual platform / ESL model that real firmware ran on for pre-silicon bring-up. 
 - Integrating a third-party ISS (e. g. , Arm or RISC-V) into a SystemC/TLM platform; modelling buses, memory maps, and peripherals. 
 - Architecture/performance modelling judgment - knowing what to abstract versus model faithfully. 
 - Comfortable spanning hardware micro-architecture and embedded software. 

Preferred

- Familiarity with High-speed serial links and die-to-die / chiplet interconnects, and link-layer concepts such as FEC and equalization (e. g. PCIe, UALink, Ethernet or memory-semantic interconnects like CXL). 
 - Experience feeding golden models into a UVM/DV verification flow. 
 - Modelling for mixed-signal or optical/SerDes systems, including control-loop / plant modelling. 
 - High-throughput datapath modelling. 

What we offer

- Competitive salary commensurate with experience
 - Comprehensive benefits package including health, dental, and vision
 - Professional development opportunities and certification support
 - Access to cutting-edge technology and cloud platforms
 - Collaborative work environment with cross-functional teams

Lumilens is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status.

data.title: Staff ML Engineer
data.description:
Cohesity is the leader in AI-powered data security. Over 13, 600 enterprise customers, including over 85 of the Fortune 100 and nearly 70% of the Global 500, rely on Cohesity to strengthen their resilience while providing Gen AI insights into their vast amounts of data. Formed from the combination of Cohesity with Veritas' enterprise data protection business, the company's solutions secure and protect data on-premises, in the cloud, and at the edge. Backed by NVIDIA, IBM, HPE, Cisco, AWS, Google Cloud, and others, Cohesity is headquartered in Santa Clara, CA, with offices around the globe. 

We've been named a Leader by multiple analyst firms and have been globally recognized for Innovation, Product Strength, and Simplicity in Design , and our culture. 

Want to join the leader in AI-powered data security?

Staff ML Engineer

Level: Staff Software Engineer (Level 5)

Team: Gaia Emblem Engine

Location: India | Type: Full-Time

About The Role

Cohesity is looking for a Staff ML Engineer (Level 5) to help design and scale the Gaia Emblem engine, the intelligence layer powering our next-generation data platform. In this role, you will architect and build large-scale, production-grade ML/LLM systems - spanning model serving, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), GPU infrastructure, and distributed backend services. As a Staff-level engineer, you will set technical direction, mentor senior engineers, and partner closely with Product and Data Engineering to bring Gaia Emblem's roadmap to life. 

Key Responsibilities

- Architect and drive the technical roadmap for the Gaia Emblem engine, including LLM integration, RAG pipelines, and prompt-engineering frameworks. 
 - Design and operate scalable, GPU-aware infrastructure on Kubernetes (vanilla K8s, OpenShift, EKS, GKE, or equivalent), including GPU scheduling, autoscaling, and costefficient resource utilization. 
 - Build resilient, high-throughput distributed systems and microservices exposed via gRPC and REST APIs. 
 - Own data engineering pipelines feeding ML workflows, including ingestion, transformation, and storage across SQL, NoSQL, and search systems (PostgreSQL, Redis, Elasticsearch). 
 - Define and enforce engineering best practices: CI/CD, test automation, observability, and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Helm). 
 - Lead design reviews, set coding and architectural standards, and mentor engineers across the organization. 
 - Partner with Product, Applied ML, and SRE teams to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions. 
 - Drive root-cause debugging and performance optimization across distributed, GPUbacked services. 
 - Evaluate and introduce new tools, frameworks, and infrastructure patterns to keep Gaia Emblem at the forefront of applied ML engineering. 

Experience

Minimum Qualifications

- 10+ years of professional software engineering experience, including 8+ years building distributed, production-grade backend systems. 
 - 3+ years of hands-on experience with LLM-based systems, RAG architectures, or applied ML infrastructure. 
 - Demonstrated experience operating services on Kubernetes (vanilla K8s, OpenShift, EKS, GKE, or similar) at production scale, including GPU-backed workloads. 
 - Track record of technical leadership: driving architecture decisions, leading crossteam initiatives, and mentoring engineers at Staff/Senior level. 

Education

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field required. 
 - Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related field preferred. 

Required Skills

- Languages: Python, Java, Go, JavaScript
 - ML/AI: LLMs, Prompt Engineering, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
 - Infrastructure & Cloud: Kubernetes (platform-agnostic - vanilla K8s, OpenShift, EKS, GKE, or equivalent), GPU Scheduling, Docker, Helm Charts, Terraform, AWS, Cloud Computing
 - Distributed Systems & APIs: Distributed Systems, Microservices, gRPC, REST APIs
 - Data & Storage: Data Engineering, SQL, NoSQL, PostgreSQL, Redis, Elasticsearch, Databases
 - Engineering Practices: CI/CD, DevOps, Test Automation, Git, Debugging, ObjectOriented Programming (OOP)

Preferred / Nice-to-Have Skills

- Node. js, Back-End Web Development
 - Jenkins and other CI/CD tooling
 - Experience with formal verification or correctness-focused engineering practices
 - Prior experience in enterprise data protection, storage, or infrastructure software

Expectations from the Role

- Operate with Staff-level ownership: define the "what" and "how" for a major component of Gaia Emblem, not just execute tickets. 
 - Balance long-term architectural vision with pragmatic, incremental delivery. 
 - Act as a force multiplier - raise the technical bar of the team through design reviews, documentation, and mentorship. 
 - Communicate complex technical trade-offs clearly to both engineering and nonengineering stakeholders. 
 - Be hands-on: this role is expected to write and review production code regularly, not purely architect from a distance. 

Data Privacy Notice for Job Candidates: 

For information on personal data processing, please see our Privacy Policy. 

Equal Employment Opportunity Employer (EEOE)

Cohesity is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin or nationality, ancestry, age, disability, gender identity or expression, marital status, veteran status or any other category protected by law.

data.title: CG Supervisor
data.description:
Eyeline is a global team of risk takers, innovators and perfectionists who achieve creative visions and have fun doing it. A dynamic workforce nestled within the industry's most intriguing cities, united by a drive to push the boundaries of storytelling. Learn more. 

The CG Supervisor oversees the day-to-day operations of the show within the facility. They will be responsible for ensuring clear communication to the 3D team within the show, and that the 3D departments deliver on time. Along with the VFX Supervisor, they are responsible for artistic cohesion with the client. 

Key Responsibilities

- Works directly with the leadership team and other VFX Supervisors to determine and advise technical solutions
 - Ensures quality of work is of the highest standards
 - Advises and ensures timely delivery of production department assignments and scheduling
 - Collaborates with other department managers on dailies, workflow, and pipeline strategies, providing ongoing improvement to processes and methodology
 - Responsible for workflow, organization, shot continuity, grain continuity, and quality control metrics
 - Will be expected to spot check individual work of other artists and evaluate quality and efficiency of team's work
 - Mentors team members and conducts performance evaluations
 - Assesses quality, problem solves, and escalates as needed
 - Serves as a key technical expert on shows as well as facility
 - Other duties as assigned

Qualifications

- Minimum six (6) years of live-action visual effects experience on high profile feature films
 - Demonstrates strong technical and leadership capabilities
 - Experience in leading, mentoring, and training large teams
 - Exceptional artistic skills and organizational skills; understands how to prioritize the necessary tasks and assignments
 - Ability to communicate creative and technical thoughts and ideas clearly, verbally, and in written form
 - Well rounded working knowledge of the technical and artistic aspects of live-action and visual effects, as well as a deep understanding of CG pipelines
 - Experience and knowledge of all 3D areas (modeling, rigging, texturing, look development, character FX, FX, and lighting)
 - Keenness to learn Flowline (our proprietary software)
 - Ability to take direction positively, work well within a team, and thrive under the pressure of tight deadlines
 - Bachelor`s Degree in a relevant field or equivalent
 - Experience in 3ds Max

About Us

Eyeline is a global creative studio partnering with storytellers to turn their ambitions into stunning reality. By blending the time-honored craft of filmmaking with breakthrough technologies, we unlock bold, cinematic visions at scale. Our three pillars - VFX, Studios and Labs - form the creative spine of Eyeline, guiding how we think, work, and show up in every frame. 

At Eyeline, we believe technology serves artistry and our people are the soul behind everything we do, deepening creative connection, rather than replacing it. We build worlds with exceptional craft and precision, working hand in hand with our creative partners from concept to final pixel. 

Netflix Investment- Eyeline

With the support of Netflix's investment in our pipeline, infrastructure, and workforce, we're pushing the boundaries of what's possible in visual effects and virtual production technology. In addition to our work with Netflix, we continue to partner with a wide range of long-standing and new clients worldwide. 

Come as you are

We are looking for those seeking to take risks with us, those driven by passion for their craft. To us, these are key ingredients that we look for in our team. We are committed to ensuring fair and equal treatment of your application. When you apply for a role with us, you will receive consideration based solely on your qualifications.

data.description:
About The Role

As an Engineering Manager at Uber, you will lead a team of engineers and engineering managers in the development of global solutions, collaborating closely with product managers, data scientists, and other engineering teams. 

This role, within the Bangalore-based Payments organization (Disbursements Processing), entails leading, mentoring, and managing a high-performing, diverse team. This organization aims to leverage Payments as a competitive advantage by optimizing the paying and payment processes for both users and the business. 

The Disbursements Processing team manages global earner payouts, encompassing the following responsibilities: 

- Collaboration with over 20+ global external partners to facilitate worldwide earner payments. 
 - Ensuring a reliable and consistent payout experience. 
 - Developing and managing a scalable engineering platform with continuous enhancements. 
 - Guaranteeing reliable weekly payments for 10 million earners globally. 

---- What the Candidate Will Do ----

- Lead a 10-person engineering team and be responsible for: 
 - Ideating, developing, and delivering payment product platforms. 
 - Operational and engineering excellence initiatives. 
 - Career growth within the organization by developing Staff-level individual contributors. 
 - Creating organizational and cross-organizational impact by designing, iterating on, and delivering processes that support Uber engineering. 
 - Partnering with diverse roles and individuals across various disciplines such as product management, talent acquisition, data science, and product design, spanning from fresh graduates to experienced professionals. 

Basic Qualifications

- Experience in engineering management (4+ years), demonstrating the ability to manage a larger team
 - Skilled in guiding, mentoring, and coaching technically proficient teams, leveraging technical expertise and analytical abilities. Able to architect and design robust, high-scale systems, encouraging engineers to think broadly and generically in their solutions. 
 - Knowledgeable in large-scale distributed systems, SQL/NoSQL storage, cloud services (AWS, GCP, OCI), transactional updates, asynchronous processing (Kafka), logging, monitoring, observability, and performance tuning. 
 - Experienced in working with globally distributed, cross-functional teams, coordinating efforts to deliver multi-area solutions. 
 - Proficient in cross-functional collaboration, influencing PMs, designers, data scientists, and upstream business/infrastructure teams to identify, prioritize, and solve problems. 
 - Proven ability to grow teams, recruit/retain strong engineering leaders, and manage performance. 
 - Familiar with client-side architecture for large native mobile and web platform teams, covering dependency management, feature flagging, UI trade-offs, and funnel design. 
 - Adaptable to a strong, reliability-focused engineering culture while prioritizing business stakeholder value. Possesses self-learning capabilities, strong time management for scaling, precise communication, and strong collaborative traits. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with payments, including understanding global and regional nuances. 
 - Proven ability to execute complex initiatives, delivering resilient, high-performing systems on time and meeting business goals and user needs. 
 - Background in product experimentation, including statistical knowledge, experimentation mechanics, and analysis skills to interpret, debug, and challenge experimental results. 

Ready to Ride?

This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook - it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves - we'd love to hear from you. 

You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. Explore our benefits. 

Offices remain key to collaboration and Uber's culture. Unless approved for full remote work, employees must spend at least 50% of their time in-office. Some roles, like those at greenlight hubs, require full-time in-office presence. Ask your Recruiter for details about this role's requirements. 

Uber is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing this form.

Job Category

Software Engineering

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn't a buzzword - it's a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all. 

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You're in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce. 

The Experience

We are seeking a lead full stack engineer with enterprise software engineering experience to drive the architecture, technical roadmap, and execution for our next-generation Security Assurance Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) platform. In this role, you will hold end-to-end technical ownership over the platform's core engines-including policy as code, compliance as code, automated evidence collection, telemetry and alerting, and risk evaluation modules. 

Beyond hands-on development in Python, Java, and modern front-end frameworks, you will act as a primary technical leader: defining system architecture, scoping and planning multi-quarter technical initiatives, and guiding distributed feature teams from concept through deployment. You will also pioneer the team's operational strategy around AI coding assistants (e. g. , Claude, Gemini, OpenAI) to accelerate output and elevate code quality across the engineering organization. 

What You'll Actually Be Doing

- End-to-End Ownership: Take technical ownership of complex, multi-system initiatives, driving architectural decisions, technical specifications, phase planning, and execution across the delivery lifecycle. 
 - Architecture & System Design: Architect resilient, cloud-native microservice architectures that process large-scale compliance telemetry, support automated evidence ingestion, and execute low-latency risk evaluation engines. 
 - Roadmap & Project Planning: Partner with Product Management, Security Architects, and GRC leaders to translate broad business and regulatory strategies into detailed technical roadmaps, milestones, and sprint backlogs. 
 - Technical Governance: Establish engineering standards, perform high-impact code and architecture reviews, enforce secure coding guidelines, and institute rigorous CI/CD and testing benchmarks across the engineering org. 
 - Policy & Governance as Code: Design and implement extensible Policy as Code and Compliance as Code engines (e. g. , leveraging Open Policy Agent/OPA or custom evaluation frameworks) and runtime platforms (e. g. CSPM, EDR, etc) that dynamically audit infrastructure and enterprise controls. Constrain the outputs of AI coding assistants with declarative machine-readable rules. 
 - Automated Evidence Collection: Lead the design of automated evidence collection pipelines integrating with multi-cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP), identity providers, enterprise security tools, CI/CD pipelines, ticketing systems, and productivity / corporate applications (Workday, Netsuite, etc). 
 - Risk & Regulatory Modeling: Build dynamic risk analysis engines and auditing interfaces capable of mapping continuous technical evidence against major regulatory standards (NIST 800-53, ISO 27001, SOC 2). 
 - AI-Assisted Engineering: Lead the adoption and integration of AI coding assistants (e. g. , Claude, Gemini, OpenAI APIs) across the engineering lifecycle to optimize team productivity, automate test generation, and streamline refactoring. 
 - Mentorship: Actively mentor senior and mid-level engineers across time zones, fostering a culture of technical excellence, accountability, and continuous learning. 
 - Lead cross-functional alignment and technical discussions across a geographically dispersed team operating in an asynchronous-first culture. 

You're Our Person If. . . 

- Experience: 6-13 years of professional full-stack software engineering experience, including 3+ years at the Senior Member of Technical Staff (SMTS) or Lead Member of Technical Staff (LMTS) level leading technical projects and distributed engineering teams. 
 - Project Ownership Track Record: Proven experience taking complex SaaS platforms or enterprise software projects from architectural inception to production delivery. 
 - Strategic Execution: Demonstrated ability to break down ambiguous business requirements into high-level architecture designs, concrete technical epics, and actionable execution plans. 
 - Systems Engineering: Deep mastery of both Python and Java, including enterprise frameworks (e. g. , FastAPI, Django, Flask, Spring Boot) and microservices design patterns. 
 - Front-End Architecture: Advanced proficiency in modern JavaScript/TypeScript frameworks (React, Vue, or Angular), with experience designing scalable component libraries and complex data visualization dashboards. 
 - AI Tooling & Innovation: Advanced proficiency in leveraging AI coding assistants (Claude, Gemini, OpenAI, GitHub Copilot) to accelerate delivery, paired with a strategic vision for integrating AI into technical workflows. 
 - Data & Cloud Systems: Strong expertise in relational (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and NoSQL/graph databases, distributed data processing, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and public cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP). 
 - Regulatory Frameworks: Working knowledge of regulatory standards including NIST SP 800-53, ISO/IEC 27001, and SOC 2 (Trust Services Criteria). 
 - Compliance Engineering: Direct experience building or architecting systems around continuous control monitoring, automated audit trails, or policy engine evaluation (e. g. , OPA/Rego). 

Even Better If. . . 

- Prior experience architecting commercial GRC tools, Security Information and Event Management (SIEM), or Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM) systems. 
 - Practical experience implementing Open Policy Agent (OPA) or similar policy-as-code domain tools at scale. 
 - Security certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, or Cloud Security Specialties. 
 - Experience with Salesforce platform including Lightning Web Components, Apex, and SOQL

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you'll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we'll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future - but to redefine what's possible - for yourself, for AI, and the world.

data.title: Sr Lead - SNOW Lead
data.description:
About Northern Trust

As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world's most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions. 

Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide. 

With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24, 000 partners, we serve the world's most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service. 

Job Overview

Northern Trust is looking for an experienced Senior Lead to join its Technology Development Centre in Pune/Bangalore, India and provide quality engineering leadership for enterprise ServiceNow applications across multiple modules and shared platform capabilities. 

The role is accountable for defining and driving the overall test strategy, functional and integration test delivery, ServiceNow Automated Test Framework (ATF) adoption, regression automation, defect governance, and release-quality readiness across ServiceNow initiatives and platform releases. 

The Senior Lead will partner with Product Owners, business stakeholders, platform architects, Business Analysts, Developers, Quality Engineers, Operations and vendor teams to embed quality throughout the delivery lifecycle and ensure stable, secure and audit-ready releases. 

Application Domain

- IT Service Management (ITSM): Incident, Problem, Change, Request, Knowledge, Major Incident and Service Catalog
 - IT Operations Management (ITOM): Discovery, Event Management, Service Mapping and Configuration Management Database (CMDB)
 - Customer Service Management (CSM), HR Service Delivery (HRSD), Strategic Portfolio Management (SPM) and App Engine
 - Integrated Risk Management (IRM), Security Operations, IT Asset Management, Software Asset Management and other enabled modules
 - Service Portal / Employee Center, mobile, reporting, Performance Analytics, integrations, access controls and shared platform services

Required Technical Skills

- Strong hands-on testing experience across multiple ServiceNow modules and shared platform capabilities. 
 - Strong ServiceNow ATF knowledge, including test and suite design, reusable/custom test steps, regression execution, test data, reporting and maintenance. 
 - Experience validating forms, workflows, Flow Designer, business rules, client scripts, UI policies, notifications, approvals, SLAs, scheduled jobs and reports. 
 - Strong functional, integration, system, regression, smoke, sanity and end-to-end testing experience. 
 - Experience validating REST/SOAP APIs, IntegrationHub, MID Server, file-based interfaces and upstream/downstream integrations. 
 - Strong database and data-validation skills, including SQL, reconciliation, transformations, migration validation and data integrity. 
 - Experience with Azure DevOps, ServiceNow Test Management, Jira or equivalent tools. 
 - Understanding of CI/CD, source control, automated quality gates, platform upgrades and release management. 
 - Exposure to performance, reliability, security and accessibility testing is desirable. 

Roles & Responsibilities

Quality Engineering and Test Leadership

- Own the quality engineering and test strategy for enterprise ServiceNow applications across modules, integrations and shared services. 
 - Define scope, estimates, approach, entry and exit criteria, quality gates, regression strategy and release-readiness criteria. 
 - Lead planning, execution, monitoring and closure across concurrent initiatives, enhancements, defects, upgrades and releases. 
 - Apply risk-based testing to prioritize business-critical workflows, cross-module dependencies and high-impact platform changes. 
 - Ensure traceability between requirements, processes, test coverage, evidence, defects and release outcomes. 
 - Identify environment, test-data, integration and access dependencies early and drive timely resolution. 

Cross-Module Functional Testing

- Validate core ITSM processes and end-to-end fulfillment workflows. 
 - Validate ITOM, Discovery, Event Management, Service Mapping, CMDB data quality and service relationships where applicable. 
 - Validate CSM, HRSD, SPM, IRM, Security Operations, Asset Management and App Engine solutions based on implementation scope. 
 - Validate module-specific and cross-platform roles, ACLs, assignment rules, data segregation, audit history and persona-based experiences. 
 - Validate integrations and cross-module dependencies for complete processing and data consistency. 
 - Translate business and technical requirements into positive, negative, boundary, integration and regression scenarios. 

ATF and Test Automation

- Define, establish and govern the ServiceNow ATF automation strategy and framework. 
 - Identify high-value regression scenarios using business criticality, execution frequency, stability and maintenance cost. 
 - Build and maintain scalable ATF suites across modules and shared platform services. 
 - Establish standards for reusability, naming, maintainability, test data, evidence, execution and reporting. 
 - Partner with developers and platform teams on custom ATF steps and complex automation constraints. 
 - Assess automation coverage after configuration changes, new modules and platform upgrades. 
 - Integrate automated tests into release and CI/CD processes where applicable. 

Defect, Data and Release Governance

- Lead defect triage, severity and priority assessment, business-impact articulation and resolution tracking. 
 - Govern SQL and data validation for interfaces, transformations, reconciliation and migration outcomes. 
 - Provide clear quality status, metrics, risks, dependencies, constraints and mitigation plans. 
 - Drive release-readiness reviews and provide quality recommendations based on objective evidence. 
 - Ensure testing artifacts meet governance, security, compliance and audit needs. 
 - Use defect and execution trends to drive preventive actions and continuous improvement. 

Leadership and Stakeholder Management

- Act as the functional and technical quality escalation point for ServiceNow testing. 
 - Coach and mentor Quality Engineers and vendor teams across functional testing and automation practices. 
 - Partner with Product, Platform, Business, Technology and Operations stakeholders to align priorities. 
 - Drive consistent standards, engineering practices, reporting and delivery discipline. 
 - Reduce dependency on repetitive manual testing through sustainable ATF coverage and knowledge development. 

Required Functional / Platform Knowledge

ServiceNow Platform

- Strong understanding of ServiceNow tables, forms, workflows, Flow Designer, business rules, client scripts, UI policies, notifications and scheduled jobs. 
 - Working knowledge of users, groups, roles, ACLs, update sets, application scopes and platform upgrades. 
 - Understanding of Service Portal / Employee Center, dashboards, reports, Performance Analytics and mobile where applicable. 
 - Ability to assess shared-platform changes, cross-module dependencies and regression impact. 

ServiceNow Modules

- Broad functional knowledge of ITSM, including Incident, Problem, Change, Request, Knowledge, Service Catalog and Major Incident Management. 
 - Working understanding of ITOM, Discovery, Event Management, Service Mapping and CMDB. 
 - Exposure to one or more additional modules such as CSM, HRSD, SPM, IRM, Security Operations, Asset Management, Software Asset Management or App Engine. 
 - Ability to learn and test new ServiceNow modules based on business priorities without limiting the role to one product area. 

Integration, Database and Data Validation

- Strong understanding of relational data concepts and ServiceNow table relationships. 
 - Proficiency in SQL for backend and interface validation where external databases are involved. 
 - Experience validating APIs, IntegrationHub, MID Server and file-based integrations. 
 - Ability to validate completeness, accuracy, integrity, reconciliation, transformations and migration outcomes. 
 - Understanding of CMDB data quality, identification and reconciliation concepts is desirable. 

Required Skills

- Proven experience leading Software Quality Engineering for complex enterprise ServiceNow implementations. 
 - Strong hands-on ServiceNow testing and ATF experience. 
 - Broad ServiceNow functional and platform knowledge with ability to engage business and technical stakeholders. 
 - Strong integration, database and SQL testing capability. 
 - Excellent test strategy, planning, defect management and release-governance experience. 
 - Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, facilitation and influencing skills. 
 - Ability to manage multiple releases, priorities, risks and dependencies concurrently. 
 - Strong leadership and mentoring capability across distributed internal and vendor teams. 

Personal Qualifications & Skills

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience. 
 - 13+ years of experience in Software Quality Engineering / Testing, preferably including enterprise ServiceNow platform delivery. 
 - Demonstrated leadership through ownership, accountability, sound judgment and decision-making in a Lead Individual Contributor role. 
 - Ability to communicate effectively with senior stakeholders, Product Owners, platform leaders and delivery teams. 
 - Proactive, detail-oriented and quality-driven mindset with strong execution focus. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with large-scale ServiceNow implementations, transformations or platform upgrades. 
 - ServiceNow certifications or formal training in the platform, ATF or one or more product modules. 
 - Experience working in financial services, banking or another highly regulated enterprise environment. 
 - Exposure to AI-assisted quality engineering, intelligent test design or agentic testing workflows is advantageous. 

Role outcome: Establish sustainable quality ownership across the ServiceNow platform, strengthen cross-module functional and integration assurance, expand ATF regression coverage, and improve confidence in stable, secure and audit-ready releases

Working with Us

As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve. 

Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust's history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities. 

Reasonable Accommodation

Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs. com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with. 

About Our Bangalore Office

The Northern Trust Bangalore office, established in 2005, is home to over 5, 600 employees. In this stunning office space, we offer fantastic amenities which include our Arrival Hub - Jungle, the GameZone, and the Employee Experience Zone that appeal to both clients and employees. Learn more.

Job Description

In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be: 

- Boiler & Turbine Control Excellence - Innovate and optimize PID loops for combustion, drum level, and feedwater control, ensuring seamless and highly efficient turbine performance with intelligent load-sharing strategies. 
 - Improve Steam Temperature Control - Implement new control strategies, such as spray attemperation and reheater tuning, to maintain efficient steam conditions, minimize thermal stress, and increase plant longevity. 
 - Advanced Combustion Optimization - Drive efficiency by fine-tuning air-fuel ratios, enhancing emissions control, and optimizing burner management systems for superior heat rate and flame stability. 
 - Improving Unit Rate & Load Optimization - Developing smart load demand control strategies, fine-tuning heat rate optimization, and improving turbine governor tuning to increase fuel efficiency and grid stability. 
 - Reliable Drum Level & Feedwater Control - Engineer multi-element drum level controls with adaptive tuning, ensuring outstanding stability under fluctuating load conditions while minimizing shrink and swell effects. 
 - Implement brand new MPC strategies to minimize process variability, improve system stability, and seamlessly integrate with advanced DCS/PLC systems. 
 - DCS Commissioning (Emerson Ovation) - Lead with expertise in configuring, programming, and commissioning DCS, optimizing plant performance, and ensuring smooth power plant operations. 
 - Innovative Fuzzy Logic & Advanced Control - Harness intelligent control solutions, integrating fuzzy logic with PID and MPC for unparalleled efficiency, adaptability, and process excellence. 
 - Data-Driven Process Optimization & Performance Enhancement - Analyze critical operational data to identify growth opportunities, drive efficiency, and collaborate with plant teams to ensure a future-ready power plant.

- Deep expertise in control system engineering, power plant automation, and turbine control, enabling seamless process optimization.

 - Mastery of Model Predictive Control (MPC), multivariable control, and fuzzy logic control, enhancing automation and performance.

data.description:
ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD. 

At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world's most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future. 

Whether you're designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger - technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we'll advance your career. 

ASIC DESIGN VERIFICATION LEAD

The Role

Adaptive and Embedded Computing Group (AECG) seeks a Senior Staff Silicon Design Verification Engineer to provide technical leadership and expertise in the verification of cutting-edge DRAM Memory Controller IPs (DDR5, LPDDR6, HBM4), high-speed Crypto, and Network-on-Chip (NoC). You will be responsible for architecting, developing, and utilizing simulation and/or formal-based verification environments at both block and SoC-level to achieve first-pass silicon success. 

The Person

The ideal candidate has a proven track record in driving strategies and successfully executing verification strategies for Pre-Silicon Design IP and/or SOC designs. They should be strong team players with excellent communication and leadership skills, capable of positively and strategically influencing design teams to improve overall product quality. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead the verification of high-speed Crypto, Network-on-Chip (NoC), cutting-edge DRAM Memory controller (DDR5, LPDDR6, HBM4) designs, ensuring the highest standards of quality and performance. 
 - Architect, develop, and use simulation and/or formal-based verification environments at IP and SoC-level. 
 - Lead and manage verification teams, including planning, execution, tracking, verification closure, and delivery to programs. 
 - Develop and execute comprehensive verification plans, including testbenches and test cases. 
 - Collaborate with design, architecture, and software teams to define and implement verification strategies. 
 - Utilize advanced verification methodologies, including UVM, formal verification, and assertion-based verification. 
 - Mentor and guide junior engineers, fostering a collaborative and innovative team environment. 

Preferred Experience

- Require hands on experience with verification of state-of-the-art memory controllers such as DDR, LPDDR, and HBM. Requires strong understanding of current memory controller protocols and calibration (DDR3/4/5, LPDDR4/5/6, HBM2/3/4), board skew and jitter modeling. 
 - Require proven track record in technical leadership of teams with 5+ engineers. This includes planning, execution, tracking, verification closure, and delivery to programs. 
 - Require experience with development of UVM and System Verilog test benches and usage of simulation tools/debug environments such as Synopsys VCS or Cadence Xcelium. 
 - Require strong understanding of state of the art of verification techniques, including assertion and metric-driven verification. Experience as a verification architect, establishing the verification methodology, tools and infrastructure for high-performance IP and/or VLSI designs is a plus. 
 - Require familiarity with verification management tools as well as an understanding of database management particularly as it pertains to regression management. 
 - Experience with formal property checking tools such as VC Formal (Synopsys), JasperGold (Cadence), and Questa Formal (Mentor) is a plus. 
 - Experience with gate-level simulation, power-aware verification is a plus. 
 - Experience with silicon debug at the tester and board level, is a plus. 

Academic Credentials

- Require BS w/ 8+ yrs or MS w/ 6+ yrs or PhD w/ 3+ yrs in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or Computer Science.

Position Summary

Deloitte Cyber understands the unique challenges and opportunities businesses face in cybersecurity. Join our team to deliver powerful insights to help our clients navigate the ever-changing threat design and technology as we partner with clients to transform their security posture. 

As a Manager at Deloitte Consulting, you will lead the design and delivery of enterprise-scale SOAR programs across a portfolio of client engagements. You will own technical strategy, manage multi-disciplinary teams, drive practice growth through pursuit support and offering development, and serve as a trusted advisor to senior client stakeholders. Your role spans engagement leadership, people development, intellectual property creation, and shaping how Deloitte brings AI-augmented security automation to market. 

Work you'll do

As a Manager on the Cyber Operate team, you will be responsible for: 

- Leading end-to-end delivery of security orchestration, automation, and response (SOAR) engagements across client environments, including scope, timelines, quality, and risk management
 - Defining SOAR architecture, operating models, and implementation roadmaps, including platform selection, integrations, playbook design, and operationalization
 - Designing and implementing artificial intelligence (AI)-enabled security automation use cases, including large language model (LLM)-supported triage, incident summarization, and human-in-the-loop workflows
 - Managing teams of consultants and analysts, including work planning, delivery oversight, coaching, and performance development
 - Supporting practice growth through proposals, solution design, effort estimation, reusable assets, and intellectual property development

The team

Cyber Operate teams manage clients' critical cyber assets either as a fully managed service or in partnership with clients. They deliver skilled talent, cutting-edge technologies, and robust processes to operate client cyber capabilities. This includes managing the identity lifecycle, security operations, threat intelligence, application security, business transformation, and ensuring continuous compliance. Services include Cyber-as-a-Service, Managed Application Security, and Managed Extended Detect & Respond (MXDR). 

Location: Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune/Chennai

Shift Timings: 2: 00 PM to 11: 00 PM IST

- 8+ years of experience in cybersecurity
 - 5+ years of experience in SOAR engineering, security automation, or security operations

This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work. 

Professional development

data.title: R&D Engineering, Director
data.description:
We Are

Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow. 

You Are

You have spent two decades building embedded memory IP that actually ships in products, not just passes tape-out reviews, and you know the difference between a circuit that works in simulation and one that survives process variation at 3nm. Leading teams is not about org charts for you, it is about knowing when to step into a schematic review because the bit cell leakage numbers do not add up, and when to step back because your engineer has the answer but needs space to find it. 

You think in full flows. Architecture decisions ripple into layout constraints, layout choices show up in characterization data, and characterization data feeds back into compiler automation. You have debugged enough memory compiler issues to know that the problem is rarely where it first appears, and you ask the kind of questions that get to root cause without wasting three days. 

Managing multiple projects across FinFET nodes does not rattle you. You prioritize without drama, communicate blockers before they become crises, and keep your team focused on what actually moves the schedule. When a customer escalates a timing model issue, you do not deflect, you own it, pull in the right people, and drive it closed. 

At Synopsys, you will lead a team that builds the memory IP behind the semiconductors powering AI, automotive, and mobile products worldwide. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Lead a team of memory design engineers developing SRAM, Register File, TCAM, and ROM architectures and circuit implementations for advanced process nodes including FinFET
 - Own the full memory design flow from bit cell analysis and architecture through schematic entry, simulation, layout planning, characterization, verification, and model generation
 - Drive low-power, area-efficient embedded memory circuit design and supervise layout activities, interfacing directly with CAD teams on verification and compiler automation
 - Manage project timelines, prioritize tasks across multiple concurrent projects, and resolve technical and scheduling issues proactively to ensure on-time delivery
 - Build and maintain relationships with cross-functional teams including characterization, verification, and customer-facing engineering to align on deliverables and resolve escalations
 - Apply and expand expertise in memory compiler development, transistor-level circuit design, and variation-aware design techniques for deep submicron technologies
 - Mentor engineers, facilitate technical problem-solving, and foster collaboration across multi-site teams in Hyderabad and globally

The Impact You Will Have

- Deliver embedded memory IP that powers leading-edge semiconductor products across AI, automotive, mobile, and high-performance computing markets
 - Enable Synopsys customers to meet aggressive area, power, and performance targets by providing robust, scalable memory solutions that work in silicon
 - Reduce time-to-market for memory compiler releases by streamlining design flows, improving automation, and catching issues earlier in the development cycle
 - Strengthen Synopsys reputation as a trusted memory IP partner by resolving customer escalations quickly and delivering high-quality timing and power models
 - Build a high-performing team culture where engineers grow technically, take ownership, and consistently deliver complex projects on schedule
 - Drive process improvements that increase team productivity, reduce characterization cycles, and improve compiler quality metrics
 - Shape the technical direction of embedded memory IP development at Synopsys by contributing expertise in advanced node challenges and circuit innovation

What You'll Need

- BE/B. Tech/ME/M. Tech/MS in Electrical and Electronics Engineering from a recognized university
 - 20+ years of hands-on experience in embedded memory design including SRAM, Register File, TCAM, and ROM architecture and circuit implementation
 - Deep expertise across the full memory design flow: architecture, schematic design, layout planning, characterization, timing analysis, and model generation
 - Proven experience leading and managing engineering teams, delivering complex projects on schedule, and resolving technical and project issues across multiple priorities
 - Strong proficiency in transistor-level circuit design for deep submicron and FinFET technologies, including variation-aware design techniques
 - Mastery of Perl and Python for design automation and scripting
 - Experience with memory compiler development and automation is a strong plus

Who You Are

- You can walk into a schematic review, spot a leakage path or timing violation in minutes, and explain the fix in a way that helps the engineer learn, not just comply
 - When a project is slipping, you do not wait for the weekly status meeting, you pull the team together, identify the real blocker, and adjust the plan that day
 - You know how to say no to a customer request that will derail the schedule without burning the relationship, and you can explain the tradeoff in terms they actually care about
 - Debugging a characterization mismatch across process corners does not frustrate you, it engages you, because you know the answer is in the data and you will find it
 - You build trust by doing what you say you will do, owning mistakes when they happen, and giving your team credit when things go right
 - You are comfortable working across time zones and geographies, and you adapt your communication style to make sure nothing gets lost in translation

The Team You'll Be Part Of

You will lead a team within the Embedded Memory and Logic group at Synopsys, part of the Solutions Group. This team is responsible for developing standard and custom embedded SRAMs, ROMs, and TCAMs, delivering both functional and physical memory views through advanced memory compilers. The team covers the full spectrum of memory IP development, from bit cell analysis and architecture design to characterization, verification, and model generation. Your team will work closely with CAD, verification, and customer-facing engineering teams across Synopsys global sites to deliver memory IP that enables the design of complex integrated circuits for leading-edge semiconductor products. 

Rewards and Benefits

We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.
