data.description:
At TTEC Digital, we coach clients to ensure their employees feel valued, and fully supported, because an amazing customer experience is an employee first process. Our vision is the same, a place where employees know they can thrive. 

TTEC Digital seeks a Senior Software Engineer (Platform - Backend / AI/ML / Integrations) to join our team. This role is a full-time and fully remote opportunity!

The work: 
We're an innovation group inside TTEC (NASDAQ: TTEC), building the next generation of AI CX tools - automated QA, conversational analytics, knowledge assist, and agentic automation - for the world's biggest brands and the millions of customers they serve. We move like an early-stage startup, backed by the scale, distribution, and enterprise client base of a company that's been obsessed with customer experience since 1982. 

This is the rare seat where getting in early actually matters at scale. TTEC is a public company at an AI inflection point. Ship the right products into thousands of live enterprise deployments and you don't just move a metric - you move the trajectory of the company and the value of the stock. The leverage is real, and the work compounds. 

Who We Hire - The DNA

- Self-starters and do-ers with grit - hackers in the best sense, with a startup mentality and a show-me bias: working software over slides, prototypes over proposals. 
 - Want to learn, love new technology. This platform is built on the latest technology, and that technology changes and advances monthly. You adapt to change quickly - new tools, new models, new priorities - without drama. 
 - Master debuggers and problem solvers. You love solving complex problems, you think outside the box, and you multitask across domains without losing the thread. 
 - AI-native. You work with AI on all levels - you understand the technology around you (LLMs, SLMs, RAG, knowledge graphs, agents, training, eval) and you use AI tools daily to exponentially increase your velocity. 
 - Distributed-systems literate. High-efficiency, event-driven, low-latency systems are our world; you understand what that demands. 
 - Innovators who ship. You demonstrate ideas easily, fail fast, and move forward. You make committed timelines and hit them. 
 - You consider yourself exceptional - and you like winning. So do we. 
 - No one will have everything in this description. We're looking for well-rounded, smart people who move fast

What You Will Do: 
The role: 

- One senior developer role, three specialization tracks. We build voice, desktop, intelligence, and AI combined into a single real-time platform - event-driven, high-throughput, low-latency
 - You'll build Go services on the event bus, AI/ML services and pipelines, or connector frameworks to CCaaS/CRM/telephony - most engineers here end up touching more than one
 - This is a startup environment on a fast train: 1-week sprints, Friday demos, fail fast and move forward. 

What you'll own: 

- Services on the event bus (NATS-class)
 - high-throughput transactional data models and WebSocket backends
 - Your track's slice - AI/ML pipelines (RAG, streaming inference, eval) or connectors (CCaaS/CTI, CRM, SIP/RTP) or core platform services
 - Your latency budget
 - your committed timelines. 

Who you are: 

- You consider yourself exceptional - and can show it
 - Self-starter, hacker, grit, loves to learn, loves winning
 - You demonstrate ideas easily: a working prototype beats a slide deck every time
 - You understand requirements and stay locked on them - we work with all-new technology constantly, and you don't get wrapped around shiny objects
 - You evaluate fast, adopt what earns it, and keep shipping. Fail fast, move forward. A team player who makes and hits committed timelines

What You Will Bring: 

- 7+ years backend; 3+ languages across your career. HIGH++ proficiency in GoLang - mandatory and tested; production Go at scale, not dabbled. Medium-strength Python or another scriptable language. 
 - Event-driven systems in production (NATS / Kafka / Redpanda-class) - you think in pub/sub. Heavy WebSocket, real-time, low-latency. 
 - Mid-tier or better hands-on AI experience in the code and product - you've built with LLM APIs, embeddings, RAG, or model serving, not just chatted with a bot. And you use AI-assisted development daily to multiply your velocity. 
 - Strong ++ for data graph/knowledge graph background, or hands-on AI/ML model experience (training, serving, eval). 
 - Efficiency in development - we deal in speed. You ship clean code fast, unblock yourself, and your estimates hold. 
 - A master debugger - you read unfamiliar code, a stack trace, or a flaky partner API and see it; you know where the breakpoint goes. 
 - GCP preferred. Voice (SIP/RTP/SIPREC), CCaaS/CTI, or desktop-adjacent experience a strong plus depending on track. 

Track emphasis: 

- Backend/Platform: data models, event bus, plugin runtime
 - AI/ML: deeper Python, production GenAI/NLU, streaming inference, eval frameworks, RAG
 - Integrations: CCaaS/CTI platforms (Genesys, Amazon Connect, NICE, Five9), CRM connectors, SIP/RTP, fault-tolerant connector design. 

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

Summary

Position Summary

Applied AI Platform Engineer (PEGA Systems Engineer) - Lead Software Engineer I

Role Overview: As an Applied AI Platform Engineer (PEGA Systems Engineer) , you will actively engage in your engineering craft, taking a hands-on approach to building the platforms, tooling, accelerators, and frameworks that other engineering teams build on. Your expertise will be pivotal in delivering platform capabilities that delight the engineers who depend on them, while driving tangible leverage and value across Deloitte's AI engineering investments. You will leverage your extensive engineering craftsmanship and advanced proficiency across platform engineering, distributed systems, and modern AI/ML and Data infrastructure, consistently demonstrating your exemplary track record in delivering high-quality, reusable, outcome-focused solutions. The ideal candidate will be a role-model leader and mentor, collaborating with cross-functional teams to design, build, and operate the enabling layer for AI engineering at scale. 

Key Responsibilities: 

- Embrace and drive a culture of accountability for engineering-leverage and adoption outcomes. Build platform capabilities that solve recurring problems once, well, for many teams-reducing per-team build and operate toil while ensuring consistency and compliance by default through high-quality, lean designs and implementations. 
 - Serve as the technical advocate for the platform as a product, ensuring capability integrity, feasibility, and alignment with the needs of the engineering teams who consume it. Lead requirement discovery with consuming teams, low-level architecture and component design of platform services, frameworks, and the AI control plane, and their development, testing, integration, and support. 
 - Maintain accountability for the integrity of the platform architecture and for the enterprise tech-stack conformance baseline that engineering teams build against. Manage platform dependencies, code design, implementation, the data and policy-as-code enforcement layers, and the OpenTelemetry-based instrumentation substrate-building capabilities that are operable, instrumented, performant, and drift-resistant by design, to the production standards set by SRE. Stay hands-on, self-driven, and continuously learn new approaches, languages, and frameworks. Create technical specifications, codify recurring patterns into reusable components and golden paths, and write high-quality, supportable, scalable code and review code of other engineers, mentoring them, to ensure all platform KPIs (adoption, reliability-by-design, and developer experience) are met or exceeded. Demonstrate collaborative skills to work effectively with diverse teams. 
 - Develop lean platform capabilities through rapid, inexpensive experimentation to solve the real needs of consuming engineering teams. Engage with those teams before, during, and after delivery to ensure the right capability is delivered at the right time-and adopted, not shelved. 
 - Adopt a mindset that favors action and evidence over extensive planning. Utilize a leaning-forward approach to navigate complexity and uncertainty, delivering platform capabilities as lean, adoption-validated increments rather than big-bang builds, and keeping them supportable and maintainable. 
 - Work collaboratively with empowered, cross-functional partners: engineering, SRE, security and risk, data governance, and engineering leadership and architecture. Integrate their constraints into the paved roads so that the secure, compliant, and reliable path is the easy path. Deliver capabilities that are admissible-by-design and submit them for admission, co-defining service-level objectives with SRE, who set production standards and own the admission decision. Foster a collaborative environment that enhances team synergy and innovation. 
 - Possess deep expertise in platform engineering and modern AI/ML infrastructure-internal developer platforms, MLOps/LLMOps, model serving, retrieval and vector infrastructure, eval and observability tooling, policy-as-code, container orchestration, IaC, and CI/CD at platform scale-including AI and Agentic SSDLC to deliver self-service, governed capabilities with full automation from discovery to production to operations and all quality checks through the SSDLC lifecycle. Be a role model, leveraging these techniques to optimize platform solutioning and delivery. Demonstrate strong understanding of the full lifecycle of platform and product development, focusing on continuous improvement and learning. 
 - Quickly acquire domain knowledge of the enterprise data estate and the AI use-case patterns the platform must serve. Translate the needs of engineering teams, reference architectures, and governance requirements into reusable frameworks, the data platform, and governance-as-code enforcement. Be a valuable, flexible, and dedicated team member, supportive of teammates, and focused on quality and tech debt payoff. 
 - Exhibit exceptional communication skills, capable of articulating complex technical concepts clearly and compellingly. Inspire and influence teammates and product teams through well-structured arguments and trade-offs supported by evidence. Create coherent narratives that align technical solutions with business objectives. 
 - Engage and collaborate with product engineering teams at all organizational levels, including customers as needed. Build and maintain constructive relationships, fostering a culture of co-creation and shared momentum towards achieving product goals. Align diverse perspectives and drive consensus to create feasible solutions. 

The team: US Deloitte Technology Product Engineering has modernized software and product delivery, creating a scalable, cost-effective model that focuses on value/outcomes that leverages a progressive and responsive talent structure. As Deloitte's primary internal development team, Product Engineering delivers innovative digital solutions to businesses, service lines, and internal operations with proven bottom-line results and outcomes. It helps power Deloitte's success. It is the engine that drives Deloitte, serving many of the world's largest, most respected companies. We develop and deploy cutting-edge internal and go-to-market solutions that help Deloitte operate effectively and lead in the market. Our reputation is built on a tradition of delivering with excellence. 

The successful candidate will possess: 

- Excellent interpersonal and organizational skills, with the ability to handle diverse situations, complex projects, and changing priorities, behaving with passion, empathy, and care. 

Required Qualifications: 

- A bachelor's degree in computer science, software engineering, data science, machine learning, or related discipline. Experience is the most relevant factor. 

Prior experience with enterprise case management & low-code workforce platforms (PEGA) is important. 

- 10 + years of software and platform engineering experience with most of the following: Angular, React, NodeJS, Python(Mandatory), , C#, . NET, Java, Rust, SQL/NoSQL, PyTorch, TensorFlow, LangChain, LangGraph, LangSmith, LangFuse, Terraform, as well as unit, integration, and end-to-end testing frameworks & tools, specifically BDD, Gherkin, Cucumber, Playwright, and Selenium. 
 - 3+ years of experience designing, building, and operating AI/ML platform or infrastructure, with hands-on experience across building tooling for MLOps/LLMOps, model serving, retrieval and vector infrastructure, and eval/observability instrumentation for LLM integration (OpenAI, Anthropic, or open-source models). 
 - 3+ years of experience with cloud-native engineering on any of the cloud hyperscalers such as Azure, AWS, or GCP-including their AI/ML services such as Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, or Vertex AI-as well as container orchestration (Kubernetes, Docker), Big Data, Databricks, CI/CD at platform scale, and distributed systems. 
 - 1+ years of experience establishing engineering standards and golden paths, including actively leading, mentoring, and guiding team members in the adoption and continuous improvement of these standards, treating the platform as a product. 
 - Prior experience with AI control-plane and agent-runtime patterns: model/LLM gateway, A2A and MCP integration, agent runtimes (e. g. , Google ADK, Amazon Bedrock AgentCore), guardrails (PII redaction, prompt-injection, content, tool permissioning/tool-RBAC), policy-as-code, and multi-tenant isolation. 
 - Prior experience with enterprise data platform engineering: data pipelines, self-service and data-product enablement, governance-as-code enforcement, and metadata/lineage. 
 - Prior software engineering experience with the understanding of Business Context Diagrams (BCD), sequence/activity/state/entity relationship/data flow diagrams, OOP/OOD, data structures, algorithms, and code instrumentations, and AI-augmented spec-driven development. 
 - Prior experience using methodologies & tools such as XP, Lean, DevSecOps, SRE, ADO, GitHub, SonarQube, and ArgoCD to deliver high-quality platforms and products rapidly. 

Other: 

- Ability to travel 10%, on average, based on the work you do and products you build.

Summary

Position Summary

MES Opcenter Ex-core - Manager, Functional Transformation

As a Manager at Deloitte Consulting Services, you will design, develop, and deploy enterprise-scale software solutions, lead the creation of robust pipelines and manage code deployment across environments. You will collaborate with cross-functional, global teams to translate functional requirements into effective deliverables, independently guiding and mentoring junior team members. Your role spans the full project lifecycle, including estimation, planning, execution, and tracking key metrics for analysis, ensuring high-quality and timely delivery of solutions. 

Work you'll do

- Providing functional and technical support for Siemens manufacturing execution system solutions, including Opcenter, APS, AIP, and Connect MOM, across manufacturing environments. 
 - Leading requirements gathering, solution design, prototyping, testing, training, and support procedures for Siemens Opcenter implementations. 
 - Conducting workshops and customer design sessions to validate requirements, define future-state processes, and document Opcenter MES solutions. 
 - Designing integrations across plant control systems, enterprise resource planning, product lifecycle management, advanced planning and scheduling, and laboratory information management systems. 
 - Leading project teams, supporting proposal development, and contributing to the growth of Deloitte's Siemens Manufacturing Execution System offering. 

The team

Our Enterprise Performance team is at the forefront of enterprise technology, working across finance, supply chain, and IT operations to support the delivery of holistic performance improvement and digital transformation. The Enterprise Performance team leverages deep industry knowledge, strong analytical skills, and practical approaches to address clients' toughest business challenges. Our professionals as part of the Supply Chain Network Operations (SCNO) service line within Enterprise Performance focus on helping organizations achieve sustainable competitive advantage throughout their operations, spanning product development, planning, sourcing, manufacturing, logistics, and distribution. By aligning high-level goals with frontline execution, we ensure our clients realize real value and improved performance across every stage of their supply chain and operations.

Shift Timings: 11 AM to 8 PM or 2 PM to 11 PM IST, as per business requirements

Required: 

Required: 

- Bachelor of Technology (B. Tech), Master of Technology (M. Tech), or Master of Business Administration (MBA).

 - Hands-on experience configuring and customizing Opcenter Execution Core, including modeling, Designer, and Portal Studio. 
 - Experience with Mendix and Opcenter-Mendix integration. 
 - Hands-on experience developing interfaces using CN MOM / MOM Connect and integrating manufacturing execution system solutions with enterprise resource planning, product lifecycle management, advanced planning and scheduling, laboratory information management systems, and plant control systems.

 - Experience with Java, C# . NET, Oracle, Structured Query Language (SQL), SQL Server, stored procedures, and regulated requirements including Good Practice (GxP), Good Automated Manufacturing Practice (GAMP), and 21 CFR Part 11.

- Experience with Siemens MES global manufacturing suites, including Opcenter, APS, AIP, and Connect MOM.

data.description:
Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all. 

Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever. 

As a Senior/Staff Engineer, NAND Product Development in Non-Volatile Engineering (NVE) group at Micron Technology, Inc. , you will be responsible for test flow development and testing strategies with emphasis on Test Chips for Micron's pioneering 3D NAND memory. You will be collaborating with multiple teams like Test Solutions Engineering on test code development, Design Engineering on testmode implementation, and validating and debugging testmodes and test results via simulation and post silicon validation of the tests. Provide critical test solutions that will be used to screen the quality and reliability failures on Micron's NAND products. 

Responsibilities

- NAND Testchip test flow development and validation
 - Run pre si Verilog (Digital) and Analog design simulations to verify testmodes. 
 - Define and improve post si testing methods to address new experimental designs, process or debug issues on devices manufactured at Micron's R&D and Fab10 Manufacturing facilities
 - Perform device characterization and electrical failure analysis (EFA)
 - Collaborate with Test Solutions Engineering on test code development. 
 - Collaborate with Design Engineering on testmode implementation, pre si verification and post si validation of testmodes. 
 - Collaborate with Process Integration, yield engineering to improve overall die yield and meet the critical turning points planned for the Testchip. 
 - Leverage AI tools to automate the tools and workflow
 - Applying Artificial Intelligence in workflows to improve build efficiency

Qualifications

- 6-8+ years of experience in VLSI, semiconductor industry
 - Solid base of mixed-signal VLSI such as analog circuits and systems, digital logic and RTL design. 
 - Excellent data analysis, problem solving, and decision-making skills
 - Knowledge of Flash memory architecture and operation
 - Knowledge of bench testing equipment (o-scope, logic analyzer, Nextest Magnum, etc)
 - Knowledge of statistical and data analysis tools
 - Knowledge on Yield3, JMP is preferred. 
 - Fundamental programming/scripting skills (C/C++, Python, Perl, Verilog, Verilog-AMS, WREAL). 
 - Knowledge of firmware and assembly level programming. 
 - Effective communication and presentation skills
 - Self-motivated and hardworking
 - Validated ability to partner successfully with other groups to build strong multi-functional relationships and meet customer needs

Education

- This position requires a Bachelor's or Master's degree or equivalent experience in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering etc. with at least 5 years of confirmed experience.

data.title: Assurance Engineering Platform Developer SMTS / LMTS
data.description:
Description

The Experience

We are seeking a lead full stack engineer with enterprise software engineering experience to drive the architecture, technical roadmap, and execution for our next-generation Security Assurance Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) platform. In this role, you will hold end-to-end technical ownership over the platform's core engines-including policy as code, compliance as code, automated evidence collection, telemetry and alerting, and risk evaluation modules. 

Beyond hands-on development in Python, Java, and modern front-end frameworks, you will act as a primary technical leader: defining system architecture, scoping and planning multi-quarter technical initiatives, and guiding distributed feature teams from concept through deployment. You will also pioneer the team's operational strategy around AI coding assistants (e. g. , Claude, Gemini, OpenAI) to accelerate output and elevate code quality across the engineering organization. 

What You'll Actually Be Doing

- End-to-End Ownership: Take technical ownership of complex, multi-system initiatives, driving architectural decisions, technical specifications, phase planning, and execution across the delivery lifecycle. 
 - Architecture & System Design: Architect resilient, cloud-native microservice architectures that process large-scale compliance telemetry, support automated evidence ingestion, and execute low-latency risk evaluation engines. 
 - Roadmap & Project Planning: Partner with Product Management, Security Architects, and GRC leaders to translate broad business and regulatory strategies into detailed technical roadmaps, milestones, and sprint backlogs. 
 - Technical Governance: Establish engineering standards, perform high-impact code and architecture reviews, enforce secure coding guidelines, and institute rigorous CI/CD and testing benchmarks across the engineering org. 
 - Policy & Governance as Code: Design and implement extensible Policy as Code and Compliance as Code engines (e. g. , leveraging Open Policy Agent/OPA or custom evaluation frameworks) and runtime platforms (e. g. CSPM, EDR, etc) that dynamically audit infrastructure and enterprise controls. Constrain the outputs of AI coding assistants with declarative machine-readable rules. 
 - Automated Evidence Collection: Lead the design of automated evidence collection pipelines integrating with multi-cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP), identity providers, enterprise security tools, CI/CD pipelines, ticketing systems, and productivity / corporate applications (Workday, Netsuite, etc). 
 - Risk & Regulatory Modeling: Build dynamic risk analysis engines and auditing interfaces capable of mapping continuous technical evidence against major regulatory standards (NIST 800-53, ISO 27001, SOC 2). 
 - AI-Assisted Engineering: Lead the adoption and integration of AI coding assistants (e. g. , Claude, Gemini, OpenAI APIs) across the engineering lifecycle to optimize team productivity, automate test generation, and streamline refactoring. 
 - Mentorship: Actively mentor senior and mid-level engineers across time zones, fostering a culture of technical excellence, accountability, and continuous learning. 
 - Lead cross-functional alignment and technical discussions across a geographically dispersed team operating in an asynchronous-first culture. 

You're Our Person If. . . 

- Experience: 6-13 years of professional full-stack software engineering experience, including 3+ years at the Senior Member of Technical Staff (SMTS) or Lead Member of Technical Staff (LMTS) level leading technical projects and distributed engineering teams. 
 - Project Ownership Track Record: Proven experience taking complex SaaS platforms or enterprise software projects from architectural inception to production delivery. 
 - Strategic Execution: Demonstrated ability to break down ambiguous business requirements into high-level architecture designs, concrete technical epics, and actionable execution plans. 
 - Systems Engineering: Deep mastery of both Python and Java, including enterprise frameworks (e. g. , FastAPI, Django, Flask, Spring Boot) and microservices design patterns. 
 - Front-End Architecture: Advanced proficiency in modern JavaScript/TypeScript frameworks (React, Vue, or Angular), with experience designing scalable component libraries and complex data visualization dashboards. 
 - AI Tooling & Innovation: Advanced proficiency in leveraging AI coding assistants (Claude, Gemini, OpenAI, GitHub Copilot) to accelerate delivery, paired with a strategic vision for integrating AI into technical workflows. 
 - Data & Cloud Systems: Strong expertise in relational (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and NoSQL/graph databases, distributed data processing, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and public cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP). 
 - Regulatory Frameworks: Working knowledge of regulatory standards including NIST SP 800-53, ISO/IEC 27001, and SOC 2 (Trust Services Criteria). 
 - Compliance Engineering: Direct experience building or architecting systems around continuous control monitoring, automated audit trails, or policy engine evaluation (e. g. , OPA/Rego). 

Even Better If. . . 

- Prior experience architecting commercial GRC tools, Security Information and Event Management (SIEM), or Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM) systems. 
 - Practical experience implementing Open Policy Agent (OPA) or similar policy-as-code domain tools at scale. 
 - Security certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, or Cloud Security Specialties. 
 - Experience with Salesforce platform including Lightning Web Components, Apex, and SOQL

data.title: R&D Engineer, Staff Engineer
data.description:
Alternate Job Titles

- Library Validation Engineer
 - Library Development and Release Engineer
 - Power Library Modeling Engineer
 - Semiconductor Library Engineer
 - IP Library Validation Staff Engineer

We Are

Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow. 

You Are

You have spent years building and validating semiconductor libraries that have to work in production, not just pass a test suite. You know that a library view delivered without proper power modeling or incomplete validation creates a cascade of problems for design teams three months later, and you are the kind of engineer who catches those gaps before they ship. You think in terms of flows, not just files. When you see a library deliverable, you are already mapping the characterization chain, the build dependencies, the APL model generation steps, and the release checkpoints that need to happen for it to land correctly. 

Debugging does not intimidate you. Whether it is a SPIPROF model mismatch, a CDEV extraction issue, or a release flow that broke overnight, you dig in, trace the root cause, and fix it with clarity. You automate the repetitive parts because you have better things to do than run the same validation script manually for the tenth time. Python and Shell are tools you reach for without thinking, and you have built enough automation to know what makes a script maintainable versus what makes it a liability six months later. 

At Synopsys, you will work on libraries and power models that enable real chips to tape out. The work is technical, the standards are high, and what you validate matters. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Create and validate library views across multiple formats and technology nodes to support diverse design and signoff requirements
 - Develop, validate, and package library deliverables for internal teams and external customer releases, ensuring completeness and correctness
 - Generate and validate Apache Power Library models including SPIPROF, Current, CDEV, and PWCDEV for power integrity and signoff flows
 - Execute comprehensive quality checks across library builds, APL models, and release packages to catch issues before they reach downstream users
 - Debug and resolve complex issues in characterization flows, APL model generation, build validation, and release processes
 - Build and maintain Python and Shell automation to improve validation coverage, reduce manual effort, and increase release velocity
 - Collaborate with characterization, design, CAD, QA, and release teams to align on requirements, troubleshoot blockers, and deliver on schedule

The Impact You Will Have

- Enable design teams and customers to meet tape-out schedules by delivering high-quality, validated library deliverables on time
 - Reduce downstream design issues by catching library and APL model inconsistencies early through rigorous validation
 - Accelerate release cycles by building automation that replaces manual validation steps and improves flow reliability
 - Improve power signoff accuracy by delivering validated SPIPROF, CDEV, and PWCDEV models that reflect real silicon behavior
 - Drive quality improvements across the library development pipeline by identifying gaps in validation coverage and closing them
 - Solve customer-reported library and APL issues quickly, reducing support escalations and maintaining customer trust
 - Contribute to continuous improvement efforts that make validation flows faster, more robust, and easier to maintain

What You'll Need

- Bachelor's or Master's in Electronics Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience
 - 5+ years of hands-on experience in library development, validation, or characterization for semiconductor IP or EDA flows
 - Strong proficiency in Python and Shell scripting for automation, validation, and workflow orchestration
 - Deep understanding of library views, formats, and their role in digital and custom design flows
 - Experience with Apache Power Library models such as SPIPROF, Current, CDEV, or PWCDEV is a strong plus
 - Solid debugging skills across complex multi-step flows involving characterization, model generation, and release processes
 - Ability to work across teams and communicate technical issues clearly to design, CAD, QA, and release stakeholders

Who You Are

- You can trace a library issue from a customer report back through the build flow, characterization run, and source data without getting lost
 - You write automation that other engineers can actually use, not just scripts that work on your machine
 - You know when to escalate and when to dig deeper, and you do not let blockers sit unresolved while you wait for someone else to fix them
 - You can explain a complex APL model discrepancy to a design engineer in two minutes without losing the technical detail that matters
 - You care about the quality of what ships, not just whether it passed the checklist
 - You are comfortable working in a global team across time zones, asynchronously when needed and in real time when it helps

The Team You'll Be Part Of

Your recruiter will share more about the team structure and mission during the interview process. 

Rewards and Benefits

We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

data.title: NVMQRA Solid State Drive (SSD) Quality and Reliability Engineer
data.description:
Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all. 

Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever. 

Job Description

As a Non-Volatile Memory QRA (NVMQRA) Solid State Drive (SSD) Quality and Reliability Engineer at Micron Technology, Inc. , you will you will be responsible for managing quality and reliability of Micron SSD products as these products enter into high volume production phase of product lifecycle. 

You will perform reliability testing and data analysis on material associated with sustaining qualifications through change requests, product proliferations, special work requests and conversions. You will also take part in the management of product deviation events, through participation in product containment activities and providing quality and reliability evaluation plans for risk assessment. 

You will also manage the outgoing quality and reliability (OQRM) metrics. You are expected to conduct failure analysis from qualification, evaluation and OQRM failures and report the resulting data. You can expect to conduct global meetings to determine product priorities or product dispositions. 

In this role you will work with various Engineering and Quality Reliability Assurance Groups to provide technical support, expertise, consultation and training. You should expect to support customers both internal and external to Micron on an on-going basis. 

Responsibilities And Tasks

Manage Reliability evaluations for deviation management

- Determine a reliability evaluation/trials plan
 - Identify and manage material for sampling
 - Perform data analysis of reliability tests results and/or by conducting failure analysis
 - Close out evaluation and provide feedback to stakeholders

Identify deviated material within Material Review Board (MRB)

- Take part in containment activities
 - Determine a reliability evaluation/trials plan
 - Identify and manage material for sampling
 - Perform data analysis of reliability tests results and/or by conducting failure analysis
 - Determine disposition of materials
 - Close out evaluation and provide feedback to stakeholders

Manage and coordinate various inputs from various stakeholders in Quality Reliability

- Collaborate with discrete component product quality and reliability team for product reliability evaluations/trials/plans
 - Collaborate with package quality and reliability team for package-related reliability evaluations/trials/plans

Manage Product Outgoing Quality and Reliability Monitoring

- Provide the plan for operations to execute for SSD product OQRM data collection
 - Analyze the data from Micron Manufacturing Execution System (MES) such as MAM
 - Use statistical analysis tools to provide conclusions and verify results
 - Summarize the reult of analyzed data through a regular OQRM metrics report

Digital & AI Tool Usage

- Leverage AI-powered tools (e. g. , Microsoft Copilot, agentic AI platforms, and other generative AI solutions) to enhance engineering effectiveness, automate routine tasks, analyze large datasets, and improve decision quality. 
 - Drive adoption of AI-enabled workflows to increase productivity, reduce cycle time, and improve knowledge sharing within the organization. 

Provide Expertise, Consultation and Training

- Communicate Globally with NAND, Firmware, BUs and Engineering Groups for priority management
 - Provide training to engineers and technicians within and outside of the group
 - Maintain knowledge base (lessons learned) within the group for each SSD market segment
 - Stay abreast of Quality and Reliability issues of Micron NAND components
 - Provide consultation for audits, RMA, and customer issues

Education

- Required: Masters' Degree in Electrical / Electronics/ Computer Engineering
 - Desired: PhD in Electrical/Electronics/Computer Engineering
 - Candidates without a Master's degree may also be considered if they possess relevant experience in Product Engineering Failure Analysis (EFA) and a strong semiconductor industry background

Experience

- 2-7 years of experience in any of the following: 
 - Solid State Drives Product/Device engineering
 - Non-volatile Memory Product/Device engineering
 - Non-volatile Memory Process integration engineering
 - Quality/Reliability engineering in semiconductor area
 - Demonstrated ability to effectively utilize Generative AI and Agentic AI platforms (e. g. , Microsoft Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT, or equivalent tools) to enhance failure analysis efficiency, automate workflows, accelerate data-driven decision making, and improve technical documentation. 
 - Candidates should be comfortable integrating AI-assisted solutions into daily engineering activities while applying appropriate technical judgment and data governance practices. 

Qualifications

- Basic knowledge and understanding of wafer fabrication process
 - Basic knowledge and understanding of device physics
 - Basic knowledge and understanding of NAND device operation
 - Basic knowledge and understanding of solid state drive operation
 - Knowledge of various Solid State drive protocol standards such as SATA, PCIe, or NVMe
 - Strong knowledge and understanding of semiconductor reliability statistics
 - Good verbal and written communication skills
 - Good time management and multi-tasking skills

About Micron Technology, Inc. 

We are an industry leader in innovative memory and storage solutions transforming how the world uses information to enrich life for all. With a relentless focus on our customers, technology leadership, and manufacturing and operational excellence, Micron delivers a rich portfolio of high-performance DRAM, NAND, and NOR memory and storage products through our Micron® and Crucial® brands. VK Enterprises focuses on unconventional, contemporary designs that appeal to fashion-forward customers seeking fresh looks. Team members work in a dynamic environment where creativity, speed, and attention to detail are key to delivering high-quality garments to the market. 

Role Description The Quality Assurance Manager is a full-time, on-site role based in Vapi. This role is responsible for overseeing quality standards across the production process, from fabric and trims inspection to final garment checks. Day-to-day tasks include establishing and updating quality control procedures, supervising QA/QC staff, conducting in-line and final inspections, and coordinating with design, merchandising, and production teams to resolve quality issues. The Quality Assurance Manager will analyze defect trends, implement corrective and preventive actions, maintain documentation and compliance with relevant standards, and collaborate with suppliers to ensure consistent product quality. The role also involves training team members on quality requirements and supporting continuous improvement initiatives to enhance customer satisfaction and reduce returns. 

Qualifications

- Experience in apparel or textile Quality Assurance/Quality Control, including setting quality standards and conducting in-line and final inspections.

data.title: DevOps Lead
data.description:
Vantive is a vital organ therapy company on a mission to extend lives and expand possibilities for patients and care teams everywhere. For 70 years, our team has driven meaningful innovations in kidney care. As we build on our legacy, we are deepening our commitment to elevating the dialysis experience through digital solutions and advanced services, while looking beyond kidney care and investing in transforming vital organ therapies. Greater flexibility and efficiency in therapy administration for care teams, and longer, fuller lives for patients- that is what Vantive aspires to deliver. 

We believe Vantive will not only build our leadership in the kidney care space, it will also offer meaningful work to those who join us. At Vantive, you will become part of a community of people who are focused, courageous and don't settle for the mediocre. Each of us is driven to help improve patients' lives worldwide. Join us in advancing our mission to extend lives and expand possibilities. 

Lead, DevOps

Job Description

Role Summary

We are seeking an experienced DevOps erve as the primary DevOps Capability Representative and subject matter expert for assigned product teams, assessing DevOps maturity, identifying capability gaps, recommending improvement opportunities, and guiding teams through the implementation and adoption of approved standards, practices, and enterprise capabilities. 

Responsibilities

- Own and advance a designated DevOps capability domain, defining its implementation patterns, adoption strategy, technical direction, roadmap, and continuous improvement initiatives. 
 - Serve as the primary DevOps Capability Representative and subject matter expert for assigned product teams, providing technical leadership, standards guidance, architecture direction, and capability adoption support. 
 - Lead DevOps excellence evaluations by establishing maturity baselines, assessing current-state capabilities, defining and tracking key performance indicators, performing gap analyses, measuring progress against target-state objectives, and recommending improvement opportunities. 
 - Lead DevOps capability adoption across product teams by assessing current-state maturity, identifying capability gaps, establishing implementation backlogs, defining roadmaps, and driving adoption of enterprise DevOps standards. 
 - Perform application, platform, and team readiness assessments to identify technical, operational, process, skills, and capability gaps. Conduct gap assessments against enterprise cloud requirements, engineering standards, architecture principles, security requirements, and DevOps standards, and define remediation plans to address identified deficiencies. 
 - Lead the planning and execution of DevOps transformation and implementation initiatives, including roadmap development, backlog establishment, work prioritization, effort estimation, resource planning, budget forecasting, and day-to-day delivery coordination. 
 - Assign, lead, and support DevOps Engineers embedded within product teams to accelerate capability adoption, standards implementation, platform modernization, and delivery improvements. 
 - Ensure all engagements include structured coaching, mentoring, knowledge transfer, documentation, and capability enablement activities that increase team self-sufficiency and reduce long-term dependency on embedded DevOps support. 
 - Establish clear engagement objectives, success criteria, transition plans, and exit criteria that enable operational ownership to be successfully transferred to product teams once capabilities have been adopted. 
 - Provide low-level solution architecture and low-level cloud architecture guidance, ensuring applications, platforms, delivery pipelines, and operational practices remain aligned with enterprise standards, architecture principles, and strategic technology direction. 
 - Design, review, and contribute Infrastructure as Code (IaC), application deployment specifications, automation scripts, and reusable implementations that improve scalability, security, reliability, and operational efficiency. 
 - Lead and promote observability and monitoring practices that improve visibility into application and platform health, reliability, performance, and operational effectiveness. 
 - Integrate security controls and tooling into development pipelines and partner with engineering teams to embed security throughout the software development lifecycle. 
 - Apply and promote DevOps good practices, industry standards, enterprise architecture principles, and approved engineering patterns across product teams and platforms. 
 - Define and promote standard implementation patterns, ensuring teams leverage approved enterprise platforms, shared services, and reusable capabilities whenever practical and appropriate. 
 - Track delivery milestones, capability adoption progress, implementation outcomes, and team objectives, proactively identifying risks and driving corrective actions when required. 
 - Perform code reviews, architecture reviews, standards compliance reviews, and change-control assessments to identify quality, security, reliability, and compliance gaps. 
 - Promote awareness and adoption of enterprise platforms, shared services, engineering capabilities, and reusable solutions available across the organization. 
 - Create opportunities for experimentation, proof-of-concepts, pilot implementations, and innovation initiatives that improve engineering effectiveness, accelerate adoption, and support the evolution of DevOps capabilities. 
 - Stay current with emerging technologies, industry trends, automation practices, cloud capabilities, observability approaches, and AI-driven engineering techniques, recommending solutions that improve the repeatability, reliability, security, and efficiency of software delivery. 
 - Demonstrate initiative, maintain a continuous learning mindset, and support the ongoing evolution of the assigned DevOps capability domain. 

Requirements

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. 
 - 6+ years of experience in IT operations, DevOps, platform engineering, or a related discipline. 
 - Deep expertise in at least one designated DevOps capability domain, such as CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, cloud architecture, observability and monitoring, deployment automation, platform engineering, or DevSecOps. 
 - Strong technical background in DevOps practices, including cybersecurity and secure software delivery. 
 - Experience with low-level solution architecture, Infrastructure as Code, low-level cloud architecture, and observability and monitoring. 
 - Expert knowledge of continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD). 
 - Demonstrated understanding of the Software Development Lifecycle. 
 - Experience with Agile development and Scrum methodologies. 
 - Strong knowledge of DevOps good practices and relevant industry standards. 
 - Excellent project-management, problem-solving, and analytical skills. 
 - Strong communication, presentation, interpersonal, and stakeholder-management skills, including written and verbal communication. 
 - Strong English-language skills and comfort communicating in English with technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Demonstrated ability to coach, mentor, and teach technical concepts to engineers and product teams. 
 - Ability to work independently, take initiative, and drive projects and capability outcomes to completion. 
 - Capability-ownership mindset with accountability for technical quality, adoption, standards, and continuous improvement. 
 - Demonstrated ability to balance hands-on technical leadership with team and people leadership. 
 - Experience assessing candidates for technical positions. 
 - Demonstrated ability to quickly develop a working understanding of new technologies. 
 - Fast learner with a strong willingness to acquire and apply new skills. 
 - Demonstrated ability to accept feedback and take action. 

Preferred Qualification

- AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Associate, or a comparable cloud certification, is a plus

Reasonable Accommodation

data.title: Junior Mobile Performance Tester
data.description:
Job Description

Junior Native Mobile Performance Testing Engineer

Primary Technologies: Apache JMeter | BlazeMeter | BrowserStack

Experience Required: 2-4 Years

Primary Specialization: Native Android and iOS Application Performance Testing

Position Summary

We are seeking a motivated, hands-on Junior Native Mobile Performance Testing Engineer with experience in Apache JMeter, BlazeMeter, and BrowserStack to support performance testing of enterprise-native Android and iOS applications. 

This position focuses specifically on native mobile applications installed and executed on Android and iOS devices-not mobile websites, mobile browsers, or responsive web applications. 

The ideal candidate will have practical experience developing and executing performance test scripts, working with REST APIs, supporting cloud-based load tests, and automating native mobile application scenarios on real devices. 

The engineer will work alongside senior performance engineers, mobile developers, and infrastructure teams to execute performance tests, collect and analyze results, identify performance issues, and contribute to improving native mobile application responsiveness, stability, and scalability. 

This is a hands-on technical position requiring foundational performance testing knowledge, strong scripting and troubleshooting capabilities, and a willingness to develop advanced mobile performance engineering skills. 

Key Responsibilities

Native Android and iOS Application Performance Testing

- Assist in developing and executing performance tests for native Android and iOS applications. 
 - Perform performance validation of installed native mobile applications using Android APK and iOS IPA packages. 
 - Execute test scenarios covering application launch, screen navigation, user interactions, and critical business transactions. 
 - Measure and document application response times, transaction completion times, and overall responsiveness. 
 - Support testing across different Android and iOS devices, operating system versions, and network conditions. 
 - Collect application logs, execution results, and available device performance metrics. 
 - Assist in identifying performance issues related to mobile applications, network connectivity, APIs, and backend services. 
 - Execute test scenarios and analyze results under normal and elevated backend load conditions. 

JMeter and BlazeMeter Performance Testing

- Develop, maintain, and execute JMeter scripts for REST API and HTTP(S) performance testing. 
 - Implement basic to intermediate parameterization, correlation, assertions, JSON extraction, and test-data management. 
 - Configure and execute load tests using BlazeMeter under guidance from senior engineers. 
 - Support load, stress, spike, and endurance testing activities. 
 - Execute predefined workload models involving concurrent users, transaction pacing, and ramp-up/ramp-down configurations. 
 - Monitor and analyze response times, throughput, transactions per second, error rates, and response-time percentiles. 
 - Troubleshoot script execution errors, authentication failures, and test-data issues. 
 - Maintain reusable performance testing scripts and documentation. 

BrowserStack Native Mobile Application Testing

- Execute native Android and iOS application tests using BrowserStack real-device infrastructure. 
 - Develop, maintain, and execute mobile automation scripts using Appium or equivalent automation frameworks. 
 - Automate native application interactions, including login, screen navigation, user actions, and business workflows. 
 - Configure and execute test scenarios across different physical Android and iOS devices. 
 - Support parallel execution of BrowserStack native application automation and JMeter/BlazeMeter backend load tests. 
 - Capture native application execution timings, logs, and available device diagnostics. 
 - Assist senior engineers in correlating real-device application responsiveness with backend API performance. 

Important: Candidates must have experience with or demonstrate practical knowledge of native mobile application testing. Experience limited to testing websites through mobile browsers is not sufficient. 

Performance Monitoring, Analysis, and Reporting

- Monitor application and infrastructure performance using tools such as Dynatrace, Datadog, AppDynamics, Splunk, or comparable platforms. 
 - Collect and analyze performance test execution results, logs, and monitoring data. 
 - Identify performance trends, elevated response times, transaction failures, and resource utilization issues. 
 - Assist senior engineers with performance bottleneck investigation and root cause analysis. 
 - Document performance defects with supporting evidence and reproducible test conditions. 
 - Prepare test execution summaries, performance metrics, charts, and status reports. 
 - Work with development, DevOps, and infrastructure teams to validate fixes and execute performance regression tests. 
 - Participate in Agile sprint activities and support in-sprint performance testing. 

Required Technical Skills

- Apache JMeter: Hands-on experience creating and executing HTTP(S)/REST API performance test scripts. 
 - BlazeMeter: Working knowledge of cloud-based load execution, performance test configuration, monitoring, and reporting. 
 - BrowserStack: Practical experience with or strong working knowledge of native Android/iOS application testing on real devices. 
 - Mobile Automation: Working experience with Appium or a similar mobile application automation framework. 
 - Native Mobile Applications: Understanding of installed Android APK and iOS IPA applications, application navigation, API communication, and mobile application behavior. 
 - API Testing: Experience with REST APIs, HTTP methods, request/response validation, JSON, and authentication. 
 - Scripting: Knowledge of Java, JavaScript, Python, or another relevant scripting language. 
 - Performance Metrics: Understanding response time, throughput, concurrency, transaction rates, error rates, and resource utilization. 
 - Monitoring: Basic experience with an APM or observability solution. 
 - Defect Management: Experience documenting, tracking, and retesting performance issues. 

Required Experience And Qualifications

- 2-4 years of experience in software performance testing, QA automation, or a related engineering role, with practical exposure to performance testing. 
 - Hands-on experience developing and executing JMeter performance scripts. 
 - Working knowledge or project experience with BlazeMeter. 
 - Exposure to BrowserStack real-device testing of native Android or iOS applications. 
 - Experience developing or executing Appium-based native mobile automation scripts. 
 - Basic understanding of native mobile application architecture and backend API interactions. 
 - Familiarity with performance test execution, metric collection, result analysis, and reporting. 
 - Experience working in Agile software development environments. 
 - Strong problem-solving, troubleshooting, and communication skills. 
 - Ability to work independently on assigned testing activities while collaborating with senior engineers. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience testing both native Android and iOS applications. 
 - Experience executing mobile automation in parallel with backend load tests. 
 - Familiarity with Android Studio Profiler, Apple Instruments, or other native mobile diagnostic utilities. 
 - Knowledge of mobile application CPU, memory, startup-time, rendering, and battery performance metrics. 
 - Experience with mobile network conditions such as Wi-Fi, 4G, and 5G. 
 - Familiarity with AWS or other cloud platforms. 
 - Experience with Git, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, or other CI/CD tools. 
 - Experience with application monitoring platforms such as Dynatrace or Datadog. 
 - Knowledge of Android App Bundles (AAB) and mobile application distribution. 
 - Traditional web application performance testing. 
 - Exposure to Tricentis NeoLoad or other commercial performance testing tools. 

Web performance testing is a secondary, nice-to-have skill and does not replace native mobile application testing experience. 

Expected Outcomes

The Successful Candidate Will Be Expected To

- Develop and maintain reliable JMeter performance test scripts. 
 - Successfully execute BlazeMeter load tests and document the results. 
 - Execute automated native Android/iOS application scenarios on BrowserStack. 
 - Support concurrent backend load testing and real-device mobile performance validation. 
 - Collect relevant performance metrics, logs, and application diagnostics. 
 - Identify and document performance issues for investigation by senior engineers and development teams. 
 - Produce accurate test execution reports and performance summaries. 
 - Contribute to reusable performance testing assets and continuous testing improvements. 
 - Demonstrate increasing independence in native mobile performance testing activities. 

Technical Screening Questions

- Native Mobile Application Testing

What is the difference between testing a native Android/iOS application and testing a website in a mobile browser? Describe your experience testing installed APK or IPA applications. 

- JMeter Performance Scripting

Explain how you would create a JMeter script to test a REST API used by a native mobile application. How would you handle authentication, parameterization, and dynamic response values?

- BlazeMeter Test Execution

Describe your experience executing performance tests using BlazeMeter. How do you configure a test, monitor its execution, and interpret response times, throughput, and error rates?

- BrowserStack and Appium

How would you use BrowserStack and Appium to execute a native Android or iOS application test? What types of application interactions and execution metrics would you capture?

- Performance Testing and Analysis

If a native mobile application becomes slow while a JMeter load test is running against its backend APIs, what information would you collect to help determine the cause of the performance degradation?

Senior vs. Junior - Responsibility comparison

This matrix can help recruiters distinguish between the two positions. 

Competency

Junior Engineer (2-4 years)

Senior Engineer (5-10 years)

JMeter

Develop and maintain scripts

Architect complex scripts and frameworks

BlazeMeter

Configure and execute tests

Design distributed workload strategies

BrowserStack

Execute and maintain native app tests

Architect real-device testing solutions

Appium

Develop and execute automation

Design and troubleshoot automation frameworks

Workload modeling

Execute predefined models

Design production-representative workloads

Mobile diagnostics

Collect and interpret metrics

Perform advanced diagnostics and profiling

APM

Monitor and identify anomalies

Perform root cause analysis

Test strategy

Follow established strategies

Define strategy and acceptance criteria

Reporting

Prepare execution summaries

Deliver detailed recommendations

Leadership

Collaborate and learn

Mentor engineers and lead implementation

Recommended screening priorities - Junior role

Recommendation: For this junior position, emphasize demonstrated JMeter scripting capability and actual native mobile application testing experience. Candidates should have practical exposure to BlazeMeter, BrowserStack, and Appium, but they should not be expected to independently architect an enterprise performance framework. 

The key hiring distinction is that the Senior Engineer designs and leads the native mobile performance testing solution, while the Junior Engineer develops scripts, executes tests, analyzes initial results, and maintains automation within that solution.

Where and when: Ludhiana (office likely in Model Town). Monday to Saturday, 8am to 8pm. Hybrid, with more site work in the first months. 

The role: Our team collects camera-based data in factories and commercial sites and uploads it daily. You will hire and manage the field team (mostly freshers), working with our existing team lead. Legal and CA support are in-house. You will do many things at first; dedicated project manager and tech hires will join later. The team could grow to about 40 people within 12 months, across nearby industrial and commercial hubs. 

What you will do

- Hire, onboard and train up to 12 field operators. 
 - Plan daily site deployment and keep the team on target for data volume, site diversity and quality. 
 - Track attendance, daily output, equipment and daily uploads. 
 - Handle HR and admin: offer letters, NDAs, payroll inputs, vendors and expenses. 
 - Help set up the Ludhiana office and plan expansion to nearby industrial hubs as the team grows. 
 - Support campus and intern hiring (tech hiring is not only yours). 

What we need

- 6 to 10 years of experience, based in Ludhiana. 
 - Hired and managed many freshers or blue-collar staff, plus some white-collar hiring. 
 - Has run a team against daily targets, ideally one that grew quickly. 
 - Comfortable on site and travelling to nearby towns, and with long hours (8am to 8pm, six days). 
 - Hustle and a sales mindset; comfortable with a target-based bonus. 
 - Fluent Punjabi and Hindi, good Excel or Sheets, clear email English.

 - A role that can grow into leading a team of up to 50 people.

Responsibilities

 - Hands-on experience with lab equipment including oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, signal generators, spectrum analyzers, and power measurement instruments. 
 - Proficiency in Python scripting for automation, test development, and data analysis. 
 - Strong understanding of interfaces and protocols such as I2C, SPI, UART, GPIO, MIPI CSI-2, and USB. 
 - Proven experience defining validation strategies and leading complex validation efforts across multiple product programs.

data.description:
Role purpose

This is a hands-on role for an engineer who leads by building. You'll lead engineering on a multi-year programme to modernize and migrate a large portfolio of middle-office applications to AWS. You'll write production code across primarily front end (ReactJS front ends, TypeScript, NodeJS, npm/pnpm etc. , DevOps pipelines). You'll also set up and run the UI team's AI-augmented delivery model, using AI agents and assistants to speed up discovery, code conversion, testing and deployment while meeting the control standards a global custodian needs. 

Key responsibilities

Hands-on UI engineering

- Build ReactJS front ends that replace legacy desktop and GWT/PowerBuilder UIs, including state management, component libraries, SSO/MFA integration and accessibility. 
 - Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines (Harness or similar), infrastructure-as-code (Terraform), containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), secrets management (Vault/CyberArk) and observability. 
 - Write reference implementations, templates and starter projects that the rest of the team and AI agents follow. 
 - Do daily code reviews and pair with engineers, and debug production-grade issues yourself. 

Engineering leadership

- Lead the modernization engineering team and set standards for architecture, code quality, testing and release. 
 - Own technical delivery plans, estimates and release quality, working with Architecture, Platform, Data, QE and the existing application support teams. 
 - Lead engineering for cutover, parallel runs and handover to run teams. 

AI-augmented delivery

- Use AI tools hands-on every day (for example GitHub Copilot, Devin, Blitzy and agent frameworks), and lead from your own experience of what works. 
 - Build agent workflows, prompt libraries and codebase knowledge context (knowledge graphs, MCP connections to Jira, Confluence, ServiceNow and SharePoint). 
 - Apply AI to reverse-engineering legacy code, generating specs, converting code and generating tests. 
 - Track AI productivity and quality (throughput, defect rates, rework, cost per migrated application) and report outcomes to leadership. 

Risk, controls and governance

- Put human review checkpoints, audit trails and secure-coding gates on all AI-generated code, in line with State Street technology risk, information security and model governance policies. 
 - Make sure business logic extracted by AI is checked by subject-matter experts and confirmed through reconciliation before go-live. 

People and capability

- Hire, coach and grow a permanent full-stack engineering team, and build AI fluency across the team. 
 - Manage vendor and temporary capacity and make sure knowledge transfers to permanent staff. 

Required Experience And Skills

- 12+ years in software engineering, still actively coding, with 5+ years leading engineering teams on modernization or cloud migration programmes. 
 - ReactJS: strong in modern React (hooks, TypeScript, Redux or similar), component design, testing (Jest/React Testing Library) and building data-heavy enterprise UIs. 
 - DevOps: practical experience with CI/CD (Harness, Jenkins or GitHub Actions), Terraform, Docker, Kubernetes/ECS/EKS, Git workflows, automated testing and quality gates. 
 - AWS: compute, networking, IAM and managed services, and how to design for HA/DR. 
 - AI: proven hands-on use of AI coding assistants and agents in delivery, with measurable results. 
 - Comfort reading and reverse-engineering legacy code
 - Experience delivering in a regulated financial services environment. 

Preferred

- Knowledge of investment servicing or middle-office areas: trade capture, confirmation, settlement, collateral, reconciliation, investment accounting. 
 - Experience building MCP servers, knowledge graphs or retrieval-augmented context for engineering agents. 
 - AWS Professional-level or equivalent certification.

data.title: DevOps Engineer - Manager
data.description:
Role purpose

You'll build and run the CI/CD pipelines which build state of the art application platforms and deploy AWS infrastructure for a multi-year programme moving a large portfolio of middle-office applications to AWS. This is a hands-on engineering role: most of your day is spent writing pipeline code, Terraform and scripts, and fixing builds and deployments. You'll work closely with full-stack application teams (ReactJS and Java), database engineers and SRE. 

Key responsibilities

Build tooling

- Set up and maintain front-end builds with npm and pnpm, vite, babel etc including workspaces/monorepos, dependency caching, lockfile management and private registries. 
 - Set up and maintain Java builds with Maven and Gradle, including multi-module projects, dependency management and build performance. 
 - Publish and version artifacts through Artifactory (or similar), and keep builds reproducible. 

CI/CD pipelines

- Design and build pipelines in Harness and GitHub Actions for build, test, security scanning and deployment across all environments. 
 - Create reusable pipeline templates so application teams can onboard quickly and consistently. 
 - Add quality and security gates: unit tests, code coverage, SAST/SCA scanning, container image scanning and approval steps. 
 - Support blue/green and canary deployments, automated rollback and release tracking that meets State Street change management requirements. 

Infrastructure as code and AWS

- Write and maintain Terraform modules for AWS: VPC, IAM, EC2, ECS/EKS, ALB, S3, RDS and related services. 
 - Manage Terraform state, module versioning and policy checks; detect and fix configuration drift. 
 - Build and run container platforms (Docker, ECS/EKS) for application workloads. 
 - Integrate secrets management (HashiCorp Vault/CyberArk) into pipelines and runtime environments. 

Linux

- Build, harden and automate Linux servers and container images for applications moving off Solaris and Windows. 
 - Write Shell and Python scripts for automation, troubleshooting and operational tasks. 
 - Support migration of batch jobs and file transfers to the target platform (e. g. AutoSys, MFX/SFTP). 

Reliability and collaboration

- Work with SRE to add logging, metrics and alerting (e. g. Dynatrace, Splunk) to pipelines and environments. 
 - Troubleshoot build, deployment and environment issues for application teams. 
 - Document runbooks and standards, and use AI assistants (e. g. GitHub Copilot) to speed up pipeline, Terraform and script development, with review. 

Required Experience And Skills

- 5+ years in DevOps, build or platform engineering roles. 
 - Front-end builds: practical experience with npm and pnpm for React/TypeScript projects. 
 - Java builds: strong experience with Maven and Gradle. 
 - Terraform: writing production modules and managing state for AWS. 
 - AWS: hands-on experience with core compute, networking, IAM, containers and managed services. 
 - CI/CD: building pipelines in Harness and/or GitHub Actions; Jenkins experience is a plus. 
 - Linux: strong administration, hardening and scripting (Bash, Python). 
 - Docker and Kubernetes/ECS/EKS. 
 - Git, branching strategies and pull-request workflows. 

Preferred

- Experience in a regulated financial services environment. 
 - Experience with secrets management (Vault, CyberArk) and security scanning tools (e. g. SonarQube, Black Duck, Checkmarx). 
 - Experience with database change pipelines (Liquibase/Flyway). 
 - AWS certification (DevOps Engineer or SysOps Administrator) and/or HashiCorp Terraform certification. 

Success measures (first 12 months)

- Reusable pipeline templates adopted by all modernization and migration teams. 
 - All target environments provisioned through Terraform, with no manual infrastructure changes. 
 - Faster, more reliable builds and deployments, measured against a baseline. 
 - No audit findings related to pipeline controls or secrets handling.

Back-end Development (primary)

 - Build event-driven integrations with Kafka and IBM MQ, including message design, error handling, retries and idempotency. 
 - Write efficient data access against Oracle (JPA/Hibernate and SQL), working with database engineers on schema design and performance. 
 - Rebuild legacy business logic as clean, testable services, working with business analysts and subject-matter experts to confirm behaviour. 
 - Write unit, integration and contract tests, and help with performance and resilience testing. 

AWS

data.title: Global Network Performance Lead, Emerging Product & GenAI
data.description:
Responsibilities
About the team
The Emerging Products and Gen AI Partner Portfolio Performance team (EP) is responsible for implementing the Emerging Products content moderation BPO strategy and for maintaining a strong, steady, and performing portfolio of vendors and footprint of sites. This team also supports the internal risk assurance frameworks across the vendor ecosystem. 

About the role
As the Global Network Performance Lead (GNPL), you will drive performance, quality, and operational excellence across the EP network, spanning both in-house (IH) teams and outsourced BPO partners. The role focuses on building strong, long-term stakeholder relationships, ensuring consistent delivery against company standards, and enabling scalable, high-performing operations. 

You will monitor network performance, support escalation and recovery where required, and act as a key connector between TikTok, internal teams, and external partners. The objective is to optimise network-wide performance, maximise value, and support sustainable growth through aligned operating models. 
This role is accountable for supporting and managing TikTok's EP network, including IH teams and external partners. Responsibilities include overseeing the outsourcing of EP lines of business, ensuring strong collaboration with IH teams, and driving performance, compliance, and value creation through effective relationship and contract management. 

The GNPL must be a highly effective communicator with strong relationship-building skills and experience in operations and programme management. A passion for continuous improvement is essential, along with the ability to operate in a fast-paced, cross-functional, multi-geographical environment and navigate both IH and partner dynamics. 

The role requires the ability to manage multiple initiatives, adapt to change, and influence across Partner Management, IH operations, and Trust & Safety. The successful candidate will report to the Global Head of Emerging Products and GenAI Operations, provide business leadership across the EP network, and support both IH teams and outsourcing partners. Regular travel will be required. 

Responsibilities
1. Strategy
- Execute the Emerging Products content moderation BPO global strategy, ensuring a steady, scalable, and high-performing Partner portfolio. 
- Drive the global footprint strategy, enabling regional flexibility, resilience, and growth through site launches, expansions, and new lines of business. 
- Support business growth and new initiatives by shaping operating models and capability development. 
- Identify opportunities to expand existing Partner relationships in line with business and platform needs. 

2. Operations
- Drive operational excellence across sites, improving quality, delivery, efficiency, and moderator experience while reducing friction and complexity. 
- Monitor and manage performance against KPIs, including quality, delivery, pricing adherence, and compliance. 
- Analyse operational and performance data to inform planning, optimisation, and leadership decisions. 
- Serve as the primary point of contact between internal stakeholders and external Partners, ensuring alignment and accountability. 
- Collaborate with global, cross-functional teams to design and implement scalable Partner solutions. 

3. Sourcing & Contracts
- Lead and support end-to-end RFP processes, including requirements definition, Partner engagement, evaluation, and recommendations. 
- Partner with Procurement, Legal, Finance, and stakeholders on BPO contract negotiations, covering pricing, commercial terms, SLAs, and protections. 
- Own contract lifecycle management, including renewals, amendments, scope changes, site changes, and onboarding new lines of business. 
- Drive cost transparency and financial discipline through Partner cost analysis, pricing governance, and performance tracking. 

4. Risk & Governance
- Identify and mitigate operational, financial, and compliance risks through performance management, footprint analysis, capacity planning, and workforce oversight. 
- Conduct regular business reviews and support audits and governance assessments to ensure contractual and regulatory compliance. 
- Analyse business processes and controls to identify risks, gaps, and improvement opportunities. 
- Provide clear performance, risk, and financial reporting to EP leadership, including insights and recommended actions. 

5. Innovation & Industry Expertise
- Maintain strong end-to-end operational expertise to enable effective challenge and optimisation. 
- Stay current on Trust & Safety and BPO industry trends, including GenAI-enabled solutions. 
- Partner with stakeholders and vendors to explore, pilot, and scale innovations that enhance quality, efficiency, and platform safety. 

Qualifications
Minimum Qualification: 
- Fluent in English
- Bachelor's degree or higher. 
- 5+ years' experience in operations or programme management, with proven oversight of global In House and BPO partners operations across multiple regions, including performance and governance. 
- Demonstrated ability to design and deliver innovative solutions that support partner and business operations. 

Preferred Qualifications: 
- Strong capability to operate effectively in cross-functional, global environments, working both independently and as part of a team. 
- Highly organised, with a proven ability to manage high workloads and tight deadlines in fast-paced settings. 
- Strong interpersonal, motivational, and intercultural skills, with the ability to represent the company confidently with external partners. 

Trust & Safety
Content that this role interacts with includes images, video, and text related to every-day life, but it can also include (but is not limited to) bullying; hate speech; child safety; depictions of harm to self and others, and harm to animals. Hence, it is possible that this role will be exposed to harmful content on a daily basis. 

TikTok recognises that keeping our platform safe for the TikTok communities is no ordinary job which can be both rewarding and psychologically demanding and emotionally taxing for some. This is why we are sharing the potential hazards, risks and implications in this unique line of work from the start, so our candidates are well informed before joining. 

We are committed to the wellbeing of all our employees and promise to provide comprehensive and evidence-based programs, to promote and support physical and mental wellbeing throughout each employee's journey with us. We believe that wellbeing is a relationship and that everyone has a part to play, so we work in collaboration and consultation with our employees and across our functions in order to ensure a truly person-centred, innovative and integrated approach. 

About TikTok
TikTok is the leading destination for short-form mobile video. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. TikTok's global headquarters are in Los Angeles and Singapore, and we also have offices in New York City, London, Dublin, Paris, Berlin, Dubai, Jakarta, Seoul, and Tokyo. 

Why Join Us
Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect - and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day. 
We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us. 

Diversity & Inclusion
TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.
