data.title: Senior Silicon Power Engineer
data.description:
NVIDIA has been redefining computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. Today, we are tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. As an NVIDIAN, you will address challenges spanning architecture, silicon, firmware, software, and production - and excellent judgment matters as much as technical depth! We are the Silicon Power Team within the Silicon Co-Design Group. We architect and deliver groundbreaking solutions for productizing NVIDIA's chips across consumer, professional, server, embedded, mobile, and automotive markets. Silicon characterization, correlation to arch and design expectations, product spec finalization, and productization techniques and infrastructure are our day-to-day work - always on the bleeding edge of the industry. Small decisions here have outsized impact on performance, efficiency, reliability, bring-up speed, and ultimately what the product delivers in the field. 

Role

We are hiring a Senior Silicon Power Engineer to own power-feature productization on a flagship silicon program. This is not a coordination role, and it is not a compliance role - it is the seat where power features either work at scale or become the reason a program slips. The two highest-leverage problems in this seat: 

- Close the hardest multi-functional power failures before they gate a program. Take ambiguous, cross-boundary issues across architecture, firmware, validation, and platform to root-cause closure - with productized fixes and reusable methodology the next program can inherit. 
 - Build AI-enabled characterization as a real capability, not a demo. Every bring-up generates terabytes of characterization, shmoo, and telemetry data. Deploy AI workflows for data analysis, metric extraction, trend detection, and cross-bring-up correlation - with the guardrails and validation discipline to make them trustworthy enough to gate production decisions!

What You'll Be Doing

- Lead the effort across architecture, validation, firmware, software, and production teams to keep the program's power and low-power productization strategy clear, executable, and on track. 
 - Characterize and validate new power-saving features, debug silicon issues, and work with SW/FW teams to productize industry-defining capabilities. 
 - Resolve complex silicon issues through structured hypotheses, measurement plans, and root-cause closure - and codify the fixes as reusable methodology across programs. 
 - Design and deploy AI-enabled workflows to automate data analysis, metric extraction, trend checks, and report generation across multiple bring-ups - with explicit guardrails and measurable workflow impact. 
 - Serve as the key technical owner for multi-functional decisions, issues, and tradeoffs across power, thermal, performance, firmware, and schedule constraints. 
 - Partner with globally distributed teams - system architects, chip and board designers, SW/FW engineers, applications, reliability specialists, ATE engineers, and PMs - including counterpart engineers in India and other major hubs. 

What We Need To See

- BS + 5 years, or MS + 4 years, in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience), with a proven track record in post-silicon bring-up and validation of silicon power features on complex ASIC or SoC programs. 
 - Deep hands-on expertise in power-saving mechanisms, power characterization, tester-to-system correlation, and lab fundamentals (oscilloscopes, DMM, DAQ, debuggers) - with at least one specific example of taking an ambiguous power failure to root-cause closure with a productized fix. 
 - Strong end-to-end understanding of silicon behavior across architecture, firmware, validation, and platform interactions, and a demonstrated ability to make sound tradeoff decisions across power, thermal, performance, firmware, design, validation, and schedule constraints. 
 - Demonstrated AI-enabled workflow you built or scaled for silicon characterization or validation - with adoption beyond yourself, measurable workflow impact, and clear validation discipline, observability, and guardrails. 

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

- Deep hands-on subsystem expertise across Windows and Linux low-power states, silicon power behavior, transistor/device physics, silicon reliability, and aging mechanisms - including original power-analysis methodology adopted by other programs. 
 - Silicon-level impact you personally drove - faster bring-up, stronger characterization coverage, better debug turnaround, or methodology improvements that reduced risk across programs, backed by artifacts, patents, or published technical work. 
 - Experience partnering deeply with a counterpart team in India or another major engineering hub - shared on-call, shared metrics, and shared culture across geographies. 
 - AI work that goes beyond personal-copilot use - agentic workflows, RAG-grounded debug assistants, ML-driven characterization analytics, or automated trend detection - deployed at team scope with adoption metrics

If you want to solve ambiguous silicon problems, build original methodology rather than inherit it, and use AI with the rigor required for production decisions, this role offers unusually broad ownership and unusually high leverage ! We are looking for someone who improves how NVIDIA characterizes, validates, and productizes power features across ASIC programs.

Job Description

AI Architect - Modern AI Applications

The Impact You'll Make in this Role

As a AI Architect with deep expertise in Machine learning, Agentic AI, Generative AI, and Natural Language Understanding (NLU), you will lead high-impact AI Platform development for HIS applications. In this role, you will be a hands-on research and development leader - driving technical breakthroughs, designing novel AI architectures, and directly influencing the integration of advanced AI into mission-critical healthcare products. You will collaborate closely with other scientists, engineers, and domain experts to create platform/solutions that are explainable, reliable, and transformative for healthcare operations. 

This role is focused on building scalable AI platforms and frameworks from scratch and is not a data science or model experimentation role. 

Key Responsibilities

Healthcare-Focused AI Development

- Architect, design and develop AI platform to support large language models to handle healthcare-specific language, regulatory requirements, and ethical considerations. 
 - Frameworks which can support AI pipelines that can process structured and unstructured healthcare data (FHIR, HL7, clinical notes, claims data).

Technical Leadership

Operational & Compliance Excellence

- Implement rigorous model evaluation frameworks for accuracy, robustness, and fairness.

 - Partner with engineering to move research prototypes into production environments. 

Required Qualifications

- Master's in Computer Science, AI, Machine Learning, or related field AND 10+ years of experience in developing AI/ML platform on Cloud & on-Prem. 

Or

 - Proficiency in Python, and modern ML libraries. 
 - Experience with GenAI, LLMs, transformer architectures, and advanced Model Routing (dynamically selecting and orchestrating open-source vs. proprietary models based on latency, cost, and capability tiers). 
 - Skilled with AI development tools and frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, Hugging Face, LangChain, LlamaIndex). 
 - Deep expertise in building enterprise-grade RAG systems, including advanced chunking, hybrid search, vector database management, and retrieval optimization. 
 - Hands-on experience with autonomous AI agents and reasoning systems, specifically mastering Agent-to-Agent (A2A) communication protocols and the Model Context Protocol (MCP) for multi-agent orchestration. 
 - Advanced skills in Agent Context Management, including context window optimization, stateful memory injection, caching strategies, and managing long-running agent contexts. 
 - Proven ability in Observability, Logging, and Scalable systems, including specialized LLM/Agent tracing to monitor reasoning steps, token usage, and system latency. 
 - Strong track record applying AI architectures to scalable, generic enterprise platforms and complex use cases. 
 - Strong background with cloud platforms, On-Prem deployments, and MLOps/LLMOps practices. 
 - Strong background in containerization and infrastructure as code (Kubernetes, Terraform, etc. ). 

Preferred Skills

- Experience with Knowledge Graph DBs (e. g. , Neo4j), NoSQL/SQL databases, and native Vector databases, particularly in designing advanced GraphRAG and hybrid-retrieval architectures. 
 - Familiarity with advanced multi-agent orchestration frameworks (e. g. , LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, Semantic Kernel) for complex, stateful workflow execution.

 - Experience with LLM Evaluation frameworks (e. g. , Ragas, TruLens, LLM-as-a-Judge) to continuously monitor and score agent reasoning and RAG retrieval quality.

data.title: Data Quality Engineer (Data QE)
data.description:
Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced Data Quality Engineer (Data QE) to ensure the quality, accuracy, reliability, and integrity of data across enterprise data platforms. The ideal candidate will have strong experience in Data Warehousing, Medallion Architecture, ETL/ELT testing, Data Governance, Data Quality frameworks, Data Lineage, and test automation. This role will be responsible for validating data pipelines from multiple source systems such as CDP, GA4, BigQuery, and Azure Blob Storage into Snowflake, and ensuring accurate reporting in Power BI. 

Required Experience

- __ years of experience in Data Quality Engineering, Data Warehouse Testing, or Data Validation. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with PostgreSQL, Microsoft SQL Server, Snowflake and BigQuery. 
 - Experience validating enterprise Data Warehouse solutions and Medallion Architecture implementations. 
 - Proven experience performing Source-to-Target validation from CDP, GA4, BigQuery, Blob Storage, PostgreSQL, and MSSQL into Snowflake. 
 - Experience in validating Power BI reports, dashboards, semantic models, and KPIs. 
 - Strong understanding of ETL/ELT data processing, data transformations, and data lineage. 
 - Experience working with Data Governance, Data Quality, Metadata Management, Data Lineage, Data Dictionary, and Data Catalog solutions. 
 - Experience with Data Quality tools such as Soda or equivalent. 
 - Experience designing, executing, and automating test cases for large-scale data platforms using SQL, Python, and PySpark. 
 - Experience integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions. 

Key Responsibilities

Data Validation & Testing

- Perform end-to-end data validation across the data lifecycle, including ingestion, transformation, storage, and reporting. 
 - Validate data movement from source systems including: 
 - Customer Data Platforms (CDP)
 - Google Analytics 4 (GA4)
 - Google BigQuery
 - Azure Blob Storage
 - PostgreSQL
 - MSSQL
 - Snowflake
 - Perform comprehensive Source-to-Target (S2T) data validation between source systems and Snowflake. 
 - Validate data accuracy, completeness, consistency, uniqueness, and timeliness across datasets. 
 - Execute data reconciliation and data profiling activities. 
 - Conduct source-to-target validation across databases, data lakes, and data warehouses. 
 - Validate schema changes, constraints, indexes, stored procedures, functions, triggers, and views. 
Medallion Architecture Validation

- Validate data across Bronze, Silver, and Gold layers within the Medallion Architecture. 
 - Verify data transformations, cleansing, aggregations, and business rules between layers. 
 - Ensure data quality controls are enforced throughout the Medallion framework. 

ETL/ELT Testing

- Test and validate ETL/ELT pipelines and data transformations. 
 - Validate business mappings, transformation logic, and data lineage. 
 - Verify incremental and full-load processes. 
 - Perform regression, integration, functional, and end-to-end testing of data pipelines. 
 - Identify and troubleshoot data discrepancies across source and target systems. 

Snowflake Data Validation

- Validate data ingestion, transformations, and storage within Snowflake. 
 - Perform large-scale data validation using SQL and automation scripts. 
 - Validate Snowflake views, tables, materialized views, stored procedures, and data sharing mechanisms. 

Power BI Testing

- Validate datasets, data models, measures, KPIs, and dashboards. 
 - Ensure Power BI reports accurately reflect Snowflake data. 
 - Verify report-level calculations, filters, row-level security, and business metrics. 
 - Perform end-to-end testing from source systems through Snowflake into Power BI. 

Data Governance & Data Management

- Validate implementation of Data Governance policies and standards. 
 - Ensure compliance with enterprise data quality and governance requirements. 
 - Validate and maintain: 
 - Data Lineage
 - Data Dictionary
 - Metadata Management
 - Business Glossary
 - Data Catalogs

This is where your work makes a difference. 

At Baxter, we believe every person-regardless of who they are or where they are from-deserves a chance to live a healthy life. It was our founding belief in 1931 and continues to be our guiding principle. We are redefining healthcare delivery to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.

Lead Baxter's Electrical & Electronics Hardware Engineering organization in Bangalore, driving New Product Development (NPD), platform expansion, and sustaining engineering initiatives across the Patient Support Systems (PSS), Global Surgical Solutions (GSS), and Nurse Call portfolios. Build and develop a high-performing team of electrical and electronics engineers, fostering a culture of technical excellence, innovation, accountability, and continuous learning. Provide strategic and technical leadership for the design, development, verification, and lifecycle management of complex medical devices, connected healthcare systems, and communication platforms, ensuring delivery of safe, reliable, compliant, and scalable solutions that support business growth, product innovation, and customer needs. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Provide technical leadership for the design and development of complex medical devices, connected healthcare systems, and communication platforms utilizing analog circuits, digital electronics, mixed-signal architectures, embedded hardware, power electronics, sensors and controls, and communication and networking technologies. 
 - Serve as the technical authority for hardware architecture, Electromagnetic Interference/Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMI/EMC) compliance, electrical safety, reliability engineering, design verification and validation, obsolescence management, and Design for Manufacturability (DFM) and Design for Serviceability (DFS). 
 - Drive execution of global product development programs, ensuring delivery of commitments related to quality, cost, schedule, performance, and regulatory compliance. 
 - Act as the primary hardware engineering leader for the CCS Bangalore R&D organization and a strategic partner to global R&D stakeholders across multiple development centers. 
 - Collaborate with engineering leadership and project teams across the United States, France, and Germany to drive alignment on product strategy, technology roadmaps, engineering standards, development methodologies, resource planning, and capability development. 
 - Lead global architecture reviews, design reviews, technical governance forums, and cross-site engineering initiatives to ensure technical excellence and consistency. 
 - Influence senior leadership decisions through technical guidance, risk assessments, innovation recommendations, and investment prioritization. 
 - Establish and strengthen Bangalore as a strategic center of excellence for electrical and electronics hardware engineering within the global CCS organization. 
 - Recruit, develop, mentor, and retain top engineering talent while leading performance management, succession planning, organizational capability development, and career growth initiatives. 
 - Develop future technical leaders, architects, and subject matter experts while fostering a highly engaged, innovative, and collaborative engineering culture across geographically distributed teams. 
 - Define and execute multi-year electrical and electronics technology roadmaps across CCS product portfolios. 
 - Drive standardization, platform architectures, design reuse, and engineering best practices to improve efficiency, scalability, and product quality. 
 - Champion innovation in connected medical devices, smart patient care systems, healthcare communication solutions, embedded intelligence, and digital healthcare technologies. 
 - Strengthen engineering capabilities through the adoption of modern engineering tools, digital technologies, and advanced design methodologies. 
 - Lead the transformation of hardware product development through Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Digital Engineering technologies. 
 - Drive adoption of AI-enabled solutions across requirements engineering, architecture exploration, schematic and PCB optimization, design verification automation, reliability prediction, risk analysis, Failure Modes and Effects Analysis (FMEA), failure investigations, regulatory documentation generation, and engineering knowledge management. 
 - Promote modern development practices leveraging Generative AI, Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE), Digital Twins, simulation-driven design, and data-driven engineering workflows. 
 - Establish best practices for the responsible use of AI within regulated medical device environments while ensuring compliance with quality and regulatory requirements. 
 - Partner with Digital, IT, and Engineering Excellence organizations to improve engineering productivity, accelerate innovation, reduce development cycle times, and enhance product quality. 

What You'll Bring

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a related field. 
 - 15+ years of product development experience in electrical and electronics engineering, including ownership of complex product development programs. 
 - 5+ years of engineering leadership experience with a proven track record of building, developing, and leading high-performing engineering teams. 
 - Demonstrated success leading globally distributed New Product Development (NPD) teams within regulated industries, preferably medical devices or healthcare technology. 
 - Strong knowledge of FDA Design Controls, ISO 13485 (Medical Devices Quality Management Systems), ISO 14971 (Medical Device Risk Management), IEC 60601 (Medical Electrical Equipment Safety), and medical device development and commercialization processes. 
 - Expertise in analog, digital, and mixed-signal hardware design, Electromagnetic Interference/Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMI/EMC) engineering, embedded systems, power electronics, and complex electromechanical medical devices. 
 - Proven ability to lead hardware architecture, design verification and validation, reliability engineering, and lifecycle management activities for regulated products. 
 - Experience driving technology roadmaps, platform strategies, engineering standardization, and innovation initiatives across global organizations. 
 - Strong understanding of Design for Manufacturability (DFM) and Design for Serviceability (DFS) principles and their application in product development. 
 - Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams including systems engineering, software engineering, mechanical engineering, quality, regulatory affairs, manufacturing, and product management. 
 - Knowledge of connected healthcare systems, communication technologies, networking protocols, and digital health solutions. 
 - Experience leveraging Artificial Intelligence (AI), Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE), Digital Twins, simulation-driven design, and other digital engineering methodologies is preferred. 
 - Strong business acumen, strategic thinking, problem-solving, stakeholder management, and decision-making skills. 
 - Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to influence technical teams, executive leadership, and global stakeholders. 

Equal Employment Opportunity

Baxter is an equal opportunity employer. Baxter evaluates qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, protected veteran status, disability/handicap status or any other legally protected characteristic.

About This Role

We are seeking a AWS DevOps & Performance Engineer with 6-8 years of experience in CI/CD, Chaos Engineering, cloud infrastructure, automation and performance engineering.  - Monitor test executions and provide BAU troubleshooting for framework, AWS infrastructure, IAM, CI/CD, performance and resilience issues

If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best. 

What's In It For You

Opportunity to deepen your experience in AWS cloud-native engineering, DevOps and infrastructure automation. Exposure to large-scale, containerised environments using resilence, performance automation. Opportunities to work across CI/CD automation, cloud platforms distributed applications, observability and Chaos Engineering. Experience collaborating across multiple projects and with stakeholders with diverse technical expertise. Opportunity to contribute knowledge and support the development of DevOps and AWS Cloud capabilities across the team. 

What Skills You Will Learn

Advanced approaches to AWS cloud infrastructure automation and deployment. Designing resilient cloud-native distributed systems and applying Chaos Engineering practices. Building and improving automated CI/CD pipelines using modern DevOps practices. Managing and scaling Kubernetes-based containerised environments. Applying Terraform and scripting to infrastructure automation. Using Datadog and Grafana within cloud observability practices. Strengthening stakeholder management, troubleshooting and cross-team technical collaboration.

This includes, but is not limited to, discrimination based on race, colour, age, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, ethnicity, disability, religion or belief, political affiliation, trade union membership, nationality, citizenship, indigenous status, medical condition, HIV status, neurodiversity, social origin, cultural background, marital or civil partnership status, or socio-economic background.

We challenge and innovate in order to connect people, businesses, and communities across the world. Delighting our customers and earning their loyalty drive us, and we experiment, learn fast and get it done, together.

data.description:
This is where  your work makes a difference. 

At Baxter, we believe every person-regardless of who they are or where they are from-deserves a chance to live a healthy life. It was our founding belief in 1931 and continues to be our guiding principle. We are redefining healthcare delivery to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond. 

Our Baxter colleagues are united by our Mission to Save and Sustain Lives. Together, our community is driven by a culture of courage, trust, and collaboration. Every individual is empowered to take ownership and make a meaningful impact. We strive for efficient and effective operations, and we hold each other accountable for delivering exceptional results. 

Here, you will find more than just a job-you will find purpose and pride.   

Your Role at Baxter

  

Lead Baxter's Electrical & Electronics Hardware Engineering organization in Bangalore, driving New Product Development (NPD), platform expansion, and sustaining engineering initiatives across the Patient Support Systems (PSS), Global Surgical Solutions (GSS), and Nurse Call portfolios. Build and develop a high-performing team of electrical and electronics engineers, fostering a culture of technical excellence, innovation, accountability, and continuous learning. Provide strategic and technical leadership for the design, development, verification, and lifecycle management of complex medical devices, connected healthcare systems, and communication platforms, ensuring delivery of safe, reliable, compliant, and scalable solutions that support business growth, product innovation, and customer needs. 

  

  

What You'll Be Doing

  

- Provide technical leadership for the design and development of complex medical devices, connected healthcare systems, and communication platforms utilizing analog circuits, digital electronics, mixed-signal architectures, embedded hardware, power electronics, sensors and controls, and communication and networking technologies.                               

- Serve as the technical authority for hardware architecture, Electromagnetic Interference/Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMI/EMC) compliance, electrical safety, reliability engineering, design verification and validation, obsolescence management, and Design for Manufacturability (DFM) and Design for Serviceability (DFS). 
 - Drive execution of global product development programs, ensuring delivery of commitments related to quality, cost, schedule, performance, and regulatory compliance. 
 - Act as the primary hardware engineering leader for the CCS Bangalore R&D organization and a strategic partner to global R&D stakeholders across multiple development centers. 
 - Collaborate with engineering leadership and project teams across the United States, France, and Germany to drive alignment on product strategy, technology roadmaps, engineering standards, development methodologies, resource planning, and capability development. 
 - Lead global architecture reviews, design reviews, technical governance forums, and cross-site engineering initiatives to ensure technical excellence and consistency. 
 - Influence senior leadership decisions through technical guidance, risk assessments, innovation recommendations, and investment prioritization. 
 - Establish and strengthen Bangalore as a strategic center of excellence for electrical and electronics hardware engineering within the global CCS organization. 
 - Recruit, develop, mentor, and retain top engineering talent while leading performance management, succession planning, organizational capability development, and career growth initiatives. 
 - Develop future technical leaders, architects, and subject matter experts while fostering a highly engaged, innovative, and collaborative engineering culture across geographically distributed teams. 
 - Define and execute multi-year electrical and electronics technology roadmaps across CCS product portfolios. 
 - Drive standardization, platform architectures, design reuse, and engineering best practices to improve efficiency, scalability, and product quality. 
 - Champion innovation in connected medical devices, smart patient care systems, healthcare communication solutions, embedded intelligence, and digital healthcare technologies. 
 - Strengthen engineering capabilities through the adoption of modern engineering tools, digital technologies, and advanced design methodologies. 
 - Lead the transformation of hardware product development through Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Digital Engineering technologies. 
 - Drive adoption of AI-enabled solutions across requirements engineering, architecture exploration, schematic and PCB optimization, design verification automation, reliability prediction, risk analysis, Failure Modes and Effects Analysis (FMEA), failure investigations, regulatory documentation generation, and engineering knowledge management. 
 - Promote modern development practices leveraging Generative AI, Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE), Digital Twins, simulation-driven design, and data-driven engineering workflows. 
 - Establish best practices for the responsible use of AI within regulated medical device environments while ensuring compliance with quality and regulatory requirements. 
 - Partner with Digital, IT, and Engineering Excellence organizations to improve engineering productivity, accelerate innovation, reduce development cycle times, and enhance product quality. 

  

  

What You'll Bring

  

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a related field. 
 - 15+ years of product development experience in electrical and electronics engineering, including ownership of complex product development programs. 
 - 5+ years of engineering leadership experience with a proven track record of building, developing, and leading high-performing engineering teams. 
 - Demonstrated success leading globally distributed New Product Development (NPD) teams within regulated industries, preferably medical devices or healthcare technology. 
 - Strong knowledge of FDA Design Controls, ISO 13485 (Medical Devices Quality Management Systems), ISO 14971 (Medical Device Risk Management), IEC 60601 (Medical Electrical Equipment Safety), and medical device development and commercialization processes. 
 - Expertise in analog, digital, and mixed-signal hardware design, Electromagnetic Interference/Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMI/EMC) engineering, embedded systems, power electronics, and complex electromechanical medical devices. 
 - Proven ability to lead hardware architecture, design verification and validation, reliability engineering, and lifecycle management activities for regulated products. 
 - Experience driving technology roadmaps, platform strategies, engineering standardization, and innovation initiatives across global organizations. 
 - Strong understanding of Design for Manufacturability (DFM) and Design for Serviceability (DFS) principles and their application in product development. 
 - Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams including systems engineering, software engineering, mechanical engineering, quality, regulatory affairs, manufacturing, and product management. 
 - Knowledge of connected healthcare systems, communication technologies, networking protocols, and digital health solutions. 
 - Experience leveraging Artificial Intelligence (AI), Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE), Digital Twins, simulation-driven design, and other digital engineering methodologies is preferred. 
 - Strong business acumen, strategic thinking, problem-solving, stakeholder management, and decision-making skills. 
 - Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to influence technical teams, executive leadership, and global stakeholders. 

  

  

Equal Employment Opportunity

Baxter is an equal opportunity employer. Baxter evaluates qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, protected veteran status, disability/handicap status or any other legally protected characteristic.

Baxter is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities globally. If, because of a medical condition or disability, you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application or interview process, please click on the link here and let us know the nature of your request along with your contact information.

The Sr. CQV Engineer will be responsible for leading the efforts for commissioning, qualification, and validation of equipment/ systems, and processes in the production of Drug substances/ Drug Product/ Sterile Facilities/ API/ OSDs, as well as the Utility system, HVAC system and Area.

 - Ensure effective resource planning, including coordinating materials, spares and consumables for commissioning and qualification activities.

Here's what you'll need

 - Strong project management skills with the ability to handle multiple priorities across national and international locations.

 - Familiarity with paperless validation software such as KNEAT and Valgenesis is an advantage.

- Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and a results-oriented mindset. 
 - Strong project management and organizational skills.

data.description:
Why Harvey

At Harvey, we're transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we're reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come. 

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We're scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth - personal, professional, and financial - is unmatched. 

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission - operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you. 

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today - and we're just getting started. 

Role Overview

Harvey is building the infrastructure foundation behind one of the most ambitious AI product companies in the world. Our Core Infrastructure team powers every user interaction across Harvey's legal AI platform, which already processes billions of prompt tokens and millions of daily requests for leading law firms, enterprises, and other high-stakes customers. 

We are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead Core Infrastructure from Bengaluru as we scale the platform, the team, and the next generation of Harvey products. This is a high-leverage role for a builder-leader who can grow strong engineers, drive technical execution, and raise the bar on reliability, performance, security, and developer velocity. 

This is not a pure operations role. Core Infrastructure at Harvey is responsible for building new systems as well as hardening existing ones, with an emphasis on architecture, scale, and long-term platform leverage rather than reactive firefighting alone. 

Harvey is in a build era, not a maintenance era. New product surfaces ship rapidly, and India engineering is expected to play a foundational role in shaping the architecture, culture, and roadmap of Harvey's next decade. 

At Harvey, we value Decisiveness, Simplicity, and the mindset that Job's Not Finished. We move fast, prioritize clarity, and are always striving for excellence. If this resonates with you, we'd love to hear from you. 

Why This Role Matters

Core Backend Infrastructure exists to "deliver core infrastructure that powers our products and teams, " and its current mission is operational excellence at scale. The team serves two critical user groups: external customers who need Harvey to be as reliable as the tools it replaces, and internal product engineering teams who need infrastructure they can build on without firefighting. 

The systems this team owns are directly tied to Harvey's next wave of growth, including agent infrastructure, database resilience, site reliability, vector search, job execution, regional data residency, and multi-cloud scale. 

What You'll Do

- Lead, hire, and develop a high-agency infrastructure team in Bengaluru, creating a culture of accountability, technical excellence, and strong mentorship. 
 - Own delivery for core infrastructure investments spanning cloud infrastructure, observability, container orchestration, reliability, and platform foundations. 
 - Partner closely with Product Engineering, Security, and adjacent platform teams so infrastructure accelerates product delivery instead of constraining it. 
 - Guide technical strategy across multi-cloud infrastructure, including Azure- and GCP-based systems, Kubernetes orchestration, networking, container management, and infrastructure as code. 
 - Drive operational excellence through better observability, incident response, disaster recovery, runbooks, alerting, and recovery tooling. 
 - Help the organization scale safely by improving system design quality, hardening critical paths, and pushing durable solutions to reliability bottlenecks before they become customer-facing failures. 
 - Partner with AI and product teams to support Harvey's next major product surfaces, including agent workflows, model infrastructure, and large-scale document processing systems. 
 - Contribute as a hands-on technical leader when needed, especially in architecture reviews, incident leadership, prioritization, and high-stakes cross-functional programs. 

Representative Problems You May Lead

- Hardening the Agent Platform so product teams can ship AI agent experiences with resource isolation, authenticated sandbox access, and resilient execution. 
 - Improving database resilience and recovery so incidents are mitigated quickly and the main database never becomes the bottleneck during critical events. 
 - Raising site reliability through stronger alerting, failover strategy, autoscaling, and runbooks so customers are never the first to know Harvey is degraded. 
 - Scaling vector and retrieval infrastructure that underpins document-heavy workflows and enterprise search, including migrations that improve reliability and unlock new capabilities. 
 - Building a multi-region, enterprise-grade platform that meets strict data residency, security, and uptime expectations for global customers. 

What We're Looking For

- 12+ years of hands-on backend infrastructure or platform engineering experience in production environments
 - 5+ years of engineering management experience. 
 - Deep technical strength across cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, networking, observability, CI/CD, and infrastructure-as-code tooling such as Terraform or Pulumi. 
 - A track record of designing and scaling reliable distributed systems, with strong judgment around performance, fault tolerance, and operational tradeoffs. 
 - Experience leading complex cross-functional initiatives and translating ambiguous platform needs into clear execution plans and measurable outcomes. 
 - Strong people leadership: hiring well, coaching engineers, creating accountability, and building a healthy, high-performing team culture. 
 - Clear communication and calm execution during incidents, escalations, and high-stakes customer-impacting situations. 
 - A systems mindset, bias for simplicity, and the ability to raise standards while keeping teams moving fast. 

Nice to Have

- Experience with AI/ML infrastructure, high-throughput inference systems, or model platform reliability. 
 - Experience operating multi-tenant, security-sensitive platforms for enterprise or regulated customers. 
 - Familiarity with Azure at scale; GCP or AWS experience also transfers well. 
 - Experience supporting global, follow-the-sun operations or building teams across regions. 

Additional Information

- Work eligibility: Must be authorized to work in India. Visa sponsorship is not available for this role.

As a Staff Software Engineer on the Core Infrastructure team at Harvey, you'll play a critical role in designing and building new infrastructure systems while equally scaling and strengthening our existing infrastructure. Our infrastructure is the foundation that powers every user interaction with Harvey - processing billions of prompt tokens and millions of daily requests across our global legal AI platform.

 - Partner with Product Engineering and Security teams to ensure our infrastructure is an accelerant, not a constraint

 - Long track record building and scaling complex, large-scale distributed systems
 - Deep proficiency with cloud infrastructure platforms (Azure preferred; GCP or AWS experience transfers well)

 - Solid understanding of Kubernetes, container orchestration, networking, and cloud security at scale
 - Experience with observability tools (Datadog, Sentry) and incident response practices (PagerDuty, Incident. io)

Nice to Have

- Experience building infrastructure for AI/ML workloads or high-throughput inference systems
 - Background with distributed rate limiting, load balancing, or quota management systems

data.title: Software Development Manager, AWS Just Walk Out
data.description:
Description

As part of the AWS Solutions organization, we have a vision to provide business applications, leveraging Amazon's unique experience and expertise, that are used by millions of companies worldwide to manage day-to-day operations. We will accomplish this by accelerating our customers' businesses through delivery of intuitive and differentiated technology solutions that solve enduring business challenges. We blend vision with curiosity and Amazon's real-world experience to build opinionated, turnkey solutions. Where customers prefer to buy over build, we become their trusted partner with solutions that are no-brainers to buy and easy to use. 

Just Walk Out builds technology enables a new kind of stores with no lines and no checkout-you just grab and go! Customers simply use the Amazon Go app to enter the store, take what they want from our selection of fresh, delicious meals and grocery essentials, and go!

Our checkout-free shopping experience is made possible by our Just Walk Out Technology, which automatically detects when products are taken from or returned to the shelves and keeps track of them in a virtual cart. When you're done shopping, you can just leave the store. Shortly after, we'll charge your Amazon account and send you a receipt. Our Just Walk Out Technology uses a variety of technologies including vision, sensor fusion, and advanced machine learning. Innovation is part of our DNA! Our goal is to be Earths' most customer centric company and we are just getting started. We need people who want to join an ambitious program that continues to push the state of the art in vision, machine learning, distributed systems and hardware. 

As a Software Development Manager, you will own delivery of cross functional initiatives to build new features and improve Just Walk Out experience. You will manage a team of 6-10 software development engineers to build and enhance the shopping experience in Just Walk out stores. 

Key job responsibilities

We are looking for an individual that thrives by creating high-bar engineering culture. You'll be chartered with building software that deliver critical capabilities to our AWS Just Walk out business enabling bar raising customer experience, embed operational knowledge and encode best practices into everything we do. 

We have a team culture that encourages innovation and we expect team members and management alike to take high degree of ownership for their program vision and execution of ideas. Beyond a strong engineering, data storage/modeling, visualization, and front-end background, a successful candidate will have experience successfully leading teams, developing people, and building a scalable infrastructure. We are looking for someone that is a self-starter, someone that approaches complex business questions with data and curiosity, and a person that dives below the surface to identify the root cause and "so what" rather than just superficial trends

About The Team

Just Walk Out (JWO) is an AWS technology that eliminates checkout lines using computer vision, sensors, & AI. JWO operates across multiple countries, spanning stadiums, airports, college campuses, & Amazon fulfillment centers. We run multiple business models - including vision-based stores & RFID checkout - & we're growing fast. As we scale into new markets & verticals, we're deploying LLMs for shopper support, building AI agents that can operate autonomously, & re-architecting our platform to serve multiple businesses across countries with varying tax, privacy, & regulatory requirements. 

Diverse Experiences Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications & skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying. 

Why AWS Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's most comprehensive & broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing & never stopped innovating - that's why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products & services to power their businesses. 

Inclusive Team Culture AWS values curiosity & connection. Our employee-led & company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion & empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, & passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do. 

Mentorship & Career Growth We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship, & other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional. 

Basic Qualifications

- 2+ years of engineering team management experience
 - 7+ years of engineering experience
 - 8+ years of leading the definition and development of multi tier web services experience
 - Knowledge of engineering practices and patterns for the full software/hardware/networks development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, certification, and livesite operations
 - Experience partnering with product or program management teams

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience in communicating with users, other technical teams, and senior leadership to collect requirements, describe software product features, technical designs, and product strategy
 - Experience in recruiting, hiring, mentoring/coaching and managing teams of Software Engineers to improve their skills, and make them more effective, product software engineers
 - Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https: //amazon. jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. data.title: NoC Design Lead
data.description:
(×2 openings) Location: Bangalore, India

|

Company: LTSCT - L&T Semiconductor Technologies Limited Reporting To: Chandra - Senior Architect, DC HW Systems

|

Experience: 10+ years (mandatory) Role Summary We are hiring two NoC Design Leads to own the stacked Network-on-Chip that forms the data backbone of xPU - 4 physical planes delivering 12 TB/s cross-section bandwidth. You will architect and implement coherency, routing, QoS, and bandwidth allocation across the BFOS arrays, banked SRAM, HBM controllers, UCIe links, and the host interface. This role is central to sustaining the extreme bandwidth and latency targets the compute architecture demands. Key Responsibilities

- Architect and implement the 4-plane stacked NoC delivering 12 TB/s cross-section bandwidth across all on-chip and off-chip endpoints. 
 - Define topology, routing algorithms, virtual channels, and arbitration to guarantee deadlock-free, high-throughput data movement. 
 - Design QoS and bandwidth-allocation mechanisms balancing traffic between dual BFOS arrays, 512 SRAM banks, HBM controllers, UCIe, and host. 
 - Own the on-chip coherency protocol and its interaction with SRAM, HBM, and the host-interface coherency layer. 
 - Drive micro-architecture, RTL, and integration of routers, network interfaces, buffers, and clock-domain crossings. 
 - Model and analyze latency, bandwidth, and congestion via cycle-accurate simulation and traffic generators; close performance targets. 
 - Collaborate with PD on floorplan-aware NoC partitioning across the 4 physical planes and with DFT/verification on coverage. 
 - Define QoR/performance metrics, mentor engineers, and represent NoC in architecture and integration reviews. Required Skills & Experience
 - 10+ years designing on-chip interconnects/NoCs or coherent fabrics for high-performance SoCs. 
 - Deep understanding of NoC topologies (mesh, torus, crossbar, stacked/multi-plane), routing, flow control, and QoS. 
 - Strong grasp of cache-coherency protocols (MESI/MOESI-class, directory-based) and memory-consistency models. 
 - Expertise in RTL design (SystemVerilog) of routers, arbiters, buffers, and asynchronous/CDC interfaces. 
 - Hands-on performance modeling and analysis - cycle-accurate simulation, traffic modeling, bandwidth/latency closure. 
 - Experience with commercial or in-house NoC generators/IP and their integration methodology. 
 - Familiarity with high-bandwidth memory (HBM) and chiplet interconnect (UCIe) traffic characteristics. 
 - Proficiency in scripting (Python/Perl) for performance analysis and verification support. 
 - Strong micro-architecture, specification, and documentation skills. 
 - Demonstrated technical leadership and cross-team collaboration. Preferred Qualifications
 - Experience with multi-plane or 3D-stacked NoC architectures. 
 - Background in AI accelerator or GPU dataflow interconnects. 
 - Familiarity with formal verification of coherency/deadlock properties. 
 - M. Tech/MS in EE/ECE/CS or equivalent.

data.title: Team Lead, ADM Operations
data.description:
Who We Are

Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1, 500 firms in 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $10 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end-to-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and levels of complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, São Paulo, London, Edinburgh, Geneva, Warsaw, Dubai, Pune and Singapore. 

The Role

Addepar has just launched an Alternatives Product offering that gives Addepar clients the option to have their Private Funds data extracted, processed, validated, and ingested directly from Private Fund documents for a more automated end-to-end solution for handling Alternatives on the platform. This white-glove solution combines proprietary machine learning technology that automatically extracts data from Private Funds documents and human-in-loop review to validate any documents that fail to pass confidence and data quality checks. 

As part of the broader Addepar Data organization, the Alternatives Data Ops team is responsible for the human-in-loop review of Private Funds documents, ensuring clients' Alternatives data is processed, validated, and available in Addepar in a timely manner. This role will include managing a team and reviewing Private Fund statements, modifying data that has been incorrectly extracted by our machine learning models, and reprocessing the data within SLAs. The Alternatives Data Ops team plays a critical role in the success of Addepar's Alternatives offering and requires daily communications with the Alternatives Product Team, Machine Learning Operations, clients, data providers (GPs and Fund Admins), and additional personnel across the organization. 

Applicants must have legal authorization to work in the country where this role is based on the first day of employment. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position. 

What You'll Do

- Lead and manage a team of Analysts & Senior Analysts ensuring effective work allocation, timely delivery. 
 - Act as a Subject matter expert & support the team on complex document processing
 - Guide and oversee the team in troubleshooting complex Private Fund statement processing exceptions
 - Perform quality reviews and assist the team in modifying incorrectly extracted data
 - Track and drive key team performance metrics, including SLA compliance, processing accuracy, and throughput. 
 - Act as a primary escalation point for operational and data quality issues. 
 - Partner with our Machine Learning Operations team to identify and relabel documents for model retraining
 - Engage clients, GPs, or Fund Admins on statement data related inquiries
 - Support the Maintenance Alternatives Data Operations workflow procedures and play-books. 
 - Identify opportunities for automation, process optimization, and standardization. 
 - Partner with Product and Engineering to implement new processes and tooling features that improve Alternatives Data processing UX and increase operational workflow efficiency. 

Who You Are

- Minimum 5+ years of experience in a relevant role and domain
 - Minimum 2+ years of people Team leader experience
 - Bachelor's or Master's degree in Finance, Business Administration, Commerce, Economics, or a related field
 - Experience in Private equity / Alternatives investment process
 - Experience in the financial investment/advisory industry with strong knowledge of capital markets, middle/back-office operations systems, and preferably with experience dealing with Alternatives (Private/Draw-down) Funds reporting statements and data
 - Track record of demonstrating excellent attention to detail, effective problem-solving skills, and an ability to thrive in a fast paced environment
 - Outstanding communication and interpersonal skills for engaging clients, data providers, and internal stakeholders across Sales, Services, and R&D
 - Highly self-motivated to take on responsibility, forward thinking and pragmatic, and possess a collaborative team-player mentality
 - Technical skills preferred in any or all of the following: Microsoft Excel, Google Suite, Atlassian Jira/Confluence, SQL, Salesforce, or other common financial services systems and applications
 - Willing to work in overlapping US/EMEA shifts or flexible hours to align with global stakeholders

Our Values

- Act Like an Owner - Think and operate with intention, purpose and care. Own outcomes. 
 - Build Together - Collaborate to unlock the best solutions. Deliver lasting value. 
 - Champion Our Clients - Exceed client expectations. Our clients' success is our success. 
 - Drive Innovation - Be bold and unconstrained in problem solving. Transform the industry. 
 - Embrace Learning - Engage our community to broaden our perspective. Bring a growth mindset. 

In addition to our core values, Addepar is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We seek to bring together diverse ideas, experiences, skill sets, perspectives, backgrounds and identities to drive innovative solutions. We commit to promoting a welcoming environment where inclusion and belonging are held as a shared responsibility. 

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation. 

PHISHING SCAM WARNING: Addepar is among several companies recently made aware of a phishing scam involving con artists posing as hiring managers recruiting via email, text and social media. The imposters are creating misleading email accounts, conducting remote "interviews, " and making fake job offers in order to collect personal and financial information from unsuspecting individuals. Please be aware that no job offers will be made from Addepar without a formal interview process. Additionally, Addepar will not ask you to purchase equipment or supplies as part of your onboarding process. If you have any questions, please reach out to ta-operations@addepar. com.

data.title: Robotics & Automation Engineer
data.description:
Job Summary

We are seeking a Robotics & Automation Engineer to design, develop, and test robotic mechanisms, motion-control systems, sensor integration, and semi-autonomous positioning capabilities for Eco-Scanner. 

The candidate will work on intelligent mechanical movement, motorized alignment, sensor feedback, automated calibration support, and hardware-software integration to help transform the existing prototype into a reliable, intelligent diagnostic platform. 

Key Responsibilities

•

Design and develop robotic mechanisms and automation systems for medical-device positioning and alignment. 

•

Integrate servo motors, stepper motors, actuators, encoders, IMUs, proximity sensors, and other suitable sensing components. 

•

Develop closed-loop motion-control algorithms for accurate and repeatable positioning. 

•

Implement sensor-assisted alignment of imaging components within predefined mechanical and safety limits. 

•

Develop semi-autonomous positioning and correction functions based on sensor feedback and system measurements. 

•

Build operator-guidance features that detect positioning errors and recommend appropriate corrective actions. 

•

Integrate motor controllers, microcontrollers, embedded processors, and robotics software with the Eco-Scanner hardware platform. 

•

Develop calibration routines, motion sequences, homing procedures, and fault-detection mechanisms. 

•

Implement safety interlocks, movement limits, emergency-stop functionality, and appropriate collision-prevention measures. 

•

Evaluate system repeatability, positioning accuracy, mechanical stability, response time, and operational reliability. 

•

Collaborate with embedded systems, mechanical design, AI/ML, and biomedical engineering teams to improve system performance. 

•

Develop simulation models, prototypes, test procedures, technical documentation, and engineering reports. 

•

Support the development of future robotic accessories and modular automation capabilities for diagnostic applications. 

Required Qualifications

•

B. Tech/B. E. or M. Tech in Robotics, Mechatronics, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Communication Engineering, Automation, or a related discipline. 

•

Foundational knowledge of robotics, kinematics, sensors, actuators, and motion-control systems. 

•

Programming proficiency in Python, C++, or embedded C. 

•

Understanding of feedback control, motor drivers, microcontrollers, and hardware-software integration. 

•

Ability to troubleshoot electromechanical systems and conduct practical experiments. 

•

Strong analytical, problem-solving, and multidisciplinary collaboration skills. 

Preferred Skills

•

Experience with ROS 2, MoveIt, Gazebo, or other robotics simulation and development frameworks. 

•

Familiarity with PID control, encoder feedback, coordinate transformations, and trajectory planning. 

•

Experience with STM32, ESP32, ARM-based systems, PLCs, or industrial motion controllers. 

•

Knowledge of computer vision, sensor fusion, IMUs, depth sensing, or machine-vision-based alignment. 

•

Familiarity with CAD tools, rapid prototyping, 3D printing, and electromechanical assembly. 

•

Exposure to medical robotics, imaging systems, laboratory automation, or safety-critical automation. 

Key Development Objectives

The engineer will contribute to: 

1. 

Sensor-guided positioning and alignment of relevant imaging components. 

2. 

Semi-autonomous correction of detected positioning errors within validated limits. 

3. 

Automated calibration assistance and system-status monitoring. 

4. 

Reliable motion control with operator override and safety interlocks. 

5. 

Integration of robotics and automation features into the Eco-Scanner modular platform. 

Ideal Candidate

We are looking for a hands-on engineer who enjoys building real robotic systems, integrating sensors and actuators, developing control algorithms, and converting experimental prototypes into functional engineering solutions. 

Fresh graduates with strong robotics projects, competition experience, internships, or working prototypes are encouraged to apply. 

What We Offer

•

An opportunity to develop robotics and automation technologies for a healthcare innovation. 

•

Hands-on involvement in prototype development, motion control, intelligent sensing, and system integration. 

•

Collaboration with multidisciplinary hardware, AI, software, and biomedical teams. 

•

Opportunities to take ownership of engineering projects and grow with the company. 

•

Performance-based salary increments and promotion opportunities within six months, subject to performance evaluation and company policy. 

Application Requirements

Applicants should submit a resume describing relevant robotics projects, automation systems, control algorithms, embedded programming, CAD designs, or working prototypes. 

Safety Considerations

All automated movement and alignment functions must operate within validated mechanical and operational limits. Medical imaging workflows must include appropriate safety interlocks, operator supervision, and applicable radiation-safety controls. Autonomous movement must not compromise patient safety or imaging quality.

data.title: SW QA Engineer - Simcenter Flightstream
data.description:
We are Siemens

Siemens Digital Industries Software is a leading provider of solutions for the design, simulation, and manufacture of products across many different industries. Formula 1 cars, skyscrapers, ships, space exploration vehicles, and many of the objects we see in our daily lives are being conceived and manufactured using our software. 

Siemens Digital Industries Software is seeking a talented and driven Software Quality Assurance Engineer to join our Quality Assurance team and contribute to the continued growth and development of our industry-leading CAE/CFD solutions. 

In this role, you will contribute across the software development lifecycle of Simcenter Flightstream, helping ensure the quality, accuracy, reliability, and robustness of capabilities used for aerodynamic, hydrodynamic, and multidisciplinary analysis. 

As a key member of the Quality Assurance team, you will independently design, develop, and execute manual and automated test cases, validate software capabilities delivered by the Development team, and analyze complex technical results. You will combine strong engineering knowledge with a quality mindset to identify issues, assess risks, improve test coverage, and continuously enhance testing tools and processes. 

The ideal candidate has a strong foundation in aerodynamics, CFD, or aircraft design, combined with excellent analytical thinking, attention to detail, problem-solving skills, and programming ability. 

Key Responsibilities

 - Investigate and manage defects: Identify, reproduce, document, and track software defects; communicate risks effectively and collaborate with Development teams to support timely investigation and resolution. 
 - Improve quality engineering practices: Identify opportunities to improve test coverage, automation, tools, and processes, contributing to the continuous improvement of the overall QA approach. 
 - Collaborate globally: Work effectively with a globally distributed and cross-functional team, contributing technical expertise and participating in projects across Quality Assurance, Development, and other engineering functions. 

Qualifications

- Master's degree in Aeronautical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Ocean Engineering, or a related technical discipline. 
 - Strong academic background or professional experience in Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD), aerodynamics, hydrodynamics, aircraft design, or related engineering disciplines.

 - Knowledge of panel methods, vortex-lattice methods, or other reduced-order aerodynamic methods.

 - Strong analytical, problem-solving, and attention-to-detail skills, combined with excellent verbal and written communication skills in English. 

Preferred Skills

- Hands-on experience with Simcenter Flightstream and/or Simcenter STAR-CCM+, including the ability to create, configure, analyze, and troubleshoot complex simulation cases. 
 - Experience with software quality assurance, validation, verification, or regression testing of engineering or scientific software. 
 - Experience managing or troubleshooting Windows and Linux test environments. 
 - Experience creating technical reports, visualizations, and engineering performance indicators. 
 - Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively in a globally distributed and matrix organization. 
 - Strong ownership mindset, self-motivation, and commitment to continuous learning and technical development. 

Why Us

At Siemens Software, flexibility is how we work - hybrid by default, built on trust and autonomy. Together, 30, 000 people across more than 200 countries build technology that shapes the real world. You'll grow through real projects, strong technical peers, and global mobility, backed by the scale and benefits of an industrial software leader. data.title: Principal Software Architect
data.description:
About The Role

We are looking for a technically strong software engineering leader to own software quality, architecture and integrated delivery across our India software organisation. Our robots depend on multiple software disciplines working together reliably. You will help shape technology strategy and organisational direction, and translate that into sound architectural decisions, strong engineering practices and dependable execution. This is a hands-on leadership role combining technical depth, people management and accountability for outcomes. 

Location: Bengaluru, Karnataka, Reports to: Chief Technology Officer

- Experience: 10+ years

About Us

We are building robots to maintain, organise and reset common public and commercial spaces - offices, campuses, venues and other high-traffic facilities. We are building a hybrid end-to-end architecture where classical and modern methods work together for maximum reliability and robustness, with R&D in Bengaluru and Wellington, New Zealand. 

What You Will Do

Technology direction and architecture: help shape technology strategy and drive architecture decisions across robot software, cloud services, data processing and model training infrastructure. Own system-level requirements - latency, compute and memory budgets, end-to-end reliability. Establish clear interfaces and component ownership, and resolve technical trade-offs across the stack. 

Software quality, security and engineering practices: set and embed standards for code quality, testing, documentation, observability and secure development. Own the software security review and audit process across robot and cloud systems, working with specialists where needed. Build quality into everyday development through effective reviews, automated validation and measurable acceptance criteria. 

Integrated software delivery: own delivery across teams, turning product priorities into realistic plans with clear commitments, dependencies and milestones. Resolve execution bottlenecks and hold teams accountable for working software and demonstrated robot behaviour. 

Integration, resilience and release readiness: own integration and release readiness across robot software, cloud services, and data and training pipelines, including Kubernetes. Define and validate behaviour during connectivity loss, service degradation and component failures, including safe fallback, recovery and rollback. Establish reproducible builds and simulation, hardware-in-the-loop, on-robot and cloud testing. 

Hands-on technical leadership: stay close to implementation through critical design and code work, complex debugging and direct involvement in the most consequential technical problems. 

People and team development: lead and develop engineers and technical leads; build capability through hiring, coaching, clear performance expectations and stronger technical ownership. 

Cross-team alignment: bring teams together around shared technical decisions and delivery outcomes, including teams outside your reporting line. 

Experience

- At least 10 years in robotics or AI, including technical leadership roles
 - Strong understanding of autonomy systems such as VLA/VLM models, SLAM, planning, perception and ML-based decision-making
 - Python, C++, ROS, and ML stacks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow
 - Experience with robotics, embedded systems, autonomous systems or comparable products where software interacts with physical hardware
 - Practical experience improving automated testing, continuous integration, release processes and production reliability
 - Evidence of delivering programmes spanning multiple teams, including teams outside your reporting line
 - Experience architecting and operating cloud platforms, containerised workloads, and large-scale data processing or model training pipelines

What Success Looks Like

- Teams deliver predictably against a shared plan, with clear ownership and fewer late integration surprises
 - Architecture supports product goals and makes the software easier to extend, test and maintain
 - Releases produce measurable improvements in robot behaviour and reliability
 - Recurring failures, escaped defects and avoidable engineering rework decrease
 - Engineers and technical leads grow in capability, ownership and execution independence

Skills: - Robotics, Software architecture, Autonomy systems, ROS, C++, Python, Kubernetes, Cloud platforms, CI/CD, Software security, Engineering leadership and Hardware-in-the-loop testing

 - Must have experience in communicating with suppliers and customers, internally and externally.

data.title: Sr Construction & Commissioning Manager HVDC
data.description:
Job Description Summary

The Senior HVDC Construction and Commissioning Manager is accountable for the strategic oversight, technical leadership, and overall management of site execution teams. This role provides technical and project leadership for the planning, coordination, construction, installation, testing, and commissioning of High Voltage Direct Current (HVDC) projects. The position requires periodic travel to project sites, particularly during critical construction & commissioning phases and major shutdown or outage events. 

This role ensures that project execution is delivered safely, on schedule, within budget, and in compliance with technical specifications, quality standards, and contractual requirements. 

Job Description

Construction Management

- Support on-site construction activities for HVDC converter stations, substations, cable systems, and associated infrastructure with primary responsibility of managing commissioning. 
 - Coordinate site managers, subcontractors, and suppliers to achieve commissioning milestones. 
 - Oversee installation of major equipment such as converters, transformers, valves, reactors, GIS/AIS equipment, cooling systems, and control/protection systems. 

Technical Leadership

- Development of the work methodology and detailed day-to-day execution plan for the refurbishment of HVDC components (Valves and Control Systems) in alignment with the approved outage schedule. 
 - Oversee commissioning of HVDC converter systems, transformers, valves, switchgear, smoothing reactors, cooling systems, AC/DC yard equipment, and control/protection systems. 
 - Lead troubleshooting and root-cause analysis for issues encountered during testing and energization. 
 - Ensure technical compliance with design documents, grid code requirements, contractual specifications, and industry standards. 
 - Support engineering teams in resolving design changes, non-conformances, and site technical queries. 

Commissioning Management

- Development of pre-commissioning and commissioning documentation, checklists, and reporting formats. 
 - Plan and manage pre-commissioning, commissioning, energization, and performance testing activities for HVDC systems. 
 - Coordinate system integration and interface testing between electrical, control, protection, telecom, and SCADA systems. 
 - Ensure commissioning procedures, test protocols, and acceptance criteria are developed, reviewed, and approved. 
 - Lead troubleshooting and resolution of technical issues during testing and energization. 
 - Support handover of commissioned systems to the client and operations team. 

Environment, Health, & Safety (EHS) and Quality

- Promote and enforce a strong safety culture across all site activities. 
 - Ensure compliance with EHS regulations, permit-to-work systems, lockout/tagout procedures, and project-specific safety requirements. 
 - Ensure all construction and commissioning work meets applicable quality standards, codes, and contractual obligations. 

Stakeholder Coordination and Reporting

- Serve as the main point of contact for commissioning-related matters with the client, project management, OEMs, and grid operators. 
 - Participate in progress reviews, readiness assessments, and milestone meetings. 
 - Report commissioning progress, issues, risks, and recovery plans to project leadership. 
 - Support final acceptance testing, handover, and project closeout activities. 

Documentation and Compliance

- Ensure site documentation is complete and up to date, including inspection records, test reports, punch lists, and as-built documentation. 
 - Verify compliance with grid codes, customer specifications, and applicable international standards. 
 - Support factory acceptance tests (FAT), site acceptance tests (SAT), and final project documentation closure. 

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Engineering, or a related technical discipline. 
 - Extensive experience in HVDC, substations, power transmission, or large utility-scale electrical infrastructure projects. 
 - Strong experience in both construction management and commissioning of high-voltage electrical systems. 
 - Proven knowledge of converter stations, protection and control systems, testing procedures, and energization processes. 
 - Proven ability to manage multi-disciplinary teams in a remote/distributed capacity. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience managing large, complex EPC or turnkey HVDC projects. 
 - Knowledge of LCC and/or VSC HVDC technologies. 
 - Experience working with multinational teams, contractors, and clients across multiple geographies. 
 - Ability to interpret technical drawings, specifications, and commissioning procedures. 
 - Strong data analysis skills for reporting project performance, risks, and recovery plans. 

Typical Experience Profile

- 15+ years of experience in power transmission, substation, or HVDC projects
 - 8+ years in a site leadership, construction management, or commissioning leadership role
 - Demonstrated experience with high-voltage equipment installation, testing, and energization

Working Conditions

- Office-based role with significant domestic travel requirements. 
 - Work may involve remote project locations, outage windows, and high-pressure commissioning periods. 
 - Availability for field troubleshooting and critical milestone support is necessary. Depending on project requirements, site assignments may involve extended on-site deployments for prolonged durations. 

Additional Information

Relocation Assistance Provided: Yes
