The lead will work closely with cross-functional teams, including engineering, quality assurance, and manufacturing, to support the successful delivery of projects. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead and coordinate CQV projects, ensuring timely execution and compliance with industry regulations. 
 - To prepare C&Q plans in line with the strategic goals of the client and manage timely and compliant delivery of the plan. 
 - Ensure all commissioning and qualification procedures are implemented and adhered to at office and at site level. 
 - Track progress of C&Q activities as required and provide regular project updates and status reports to stakeholders. 
 - Ensure effective resource planning, including coordinating materials, spares and consumables for commissioning and qualification activities. 
 - Identify and mitigate project risks while ensuring project deliverables meet required quality and compliance standards. 
 - Provide leadership in team meetings and facilitate problem-solving discussions to ensure project milestones are met. 
 - Act as the primary point of contact between clients, internal teams, and external vendors to drive project success. 
 - Management of Contractors and Vendors, document control, punch list management. 
 - Participate in design, constructability, and commissioning reviews to ensure technical aspects are covered in the Commissioning Plan and schedule. 
 - Well versed with risk-based approaches to C&Q (e. g. , ASTM E2500, ISPE)
 - Conduct risk assessments and gap analysis for process equipments/ systems, facilities and utilities, to identify critical process parameters and control strategies. 
 - Developing system boundaries for the system at an early stage of C&Q. 
 - Complete the development, review and execution of validation plans, URSs/DQ/TMs/FATs/SATs/IQ/OQ protocols/reports. 
 - Experienced in commissioning and qualifying CIP & SIP systems. 
 - Participate in design document reviews and ensure that quality aspects are included in design. 
 - Review vendor documents (CTOPs/ VTOPs) to support commissioning and qualification requirements. 
 - Ensures C&Q non-conformances or deviations are minimized during execution of CQV activities. For issues that do arise ensure they are closed out in a timely manner. 
 - Track and confirm closure of actions items identified through FAT, HAZOP, Design Qualification and other reviews. 
 - Perform shakedown during commissioning and qualification of systems on site. 
 - Field Walkdowns of systems as part of transfer of ownership of the system from Construction. 
 - System Startup activities

Working Conditions

- The position requires travel and/ or deputation to other sites or manufacturing facilities. 
 - Ability to work in a cleanroom environment and adhere to gowning requirements. 
 - Flexibility to work outside of regular business hours as needed to support project timelines

Here's what you'll need

- Bachelor's degree in engineering, Life Sciences, or a related field. Advanced degree preferred. B. Pharm. , M. Pharm. , B. Tech or BE or MSc. 
 - 10-15 year's experience in CQV within the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry, specifically in drug substance manufacturing. 
 - Candidates must have proven experience of carrying out commissioning and qualification activities on multiple projects. 
 - Have functioned as CQV Lead level for at least one Project. 

Technical Skills

- Experience with paperless validation software such as KNEAT and/ or Valgenesis. 
 - In-depth knowledge of cGMP, FDA, EMA, and other relevant regulatory requirements. 
 - Strong project management skills with the ability to handle multiple priorities across national and international locations. 
 - Experience with process validation and computer system validation. 
 - Experience on DCS/ PCS system such as Delta-V, 800xA, etc. 
 - Familiarity with Construction management software such as EIDA, PIMS, Aconex, is an advantage. 
 - Familiarity with paperless validation software such as KNEAT and Valgenesis is an advantage. 

Soft Skills

- Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and a results-oriented mindset. 
 - Strong project management and organizational skills. 
 - Effective communication and interpersonal skills. 
 - Ability to work independently and as part of a team. 

At Jacobs we value people. Having the right balance of belonging, career and lifestyle enables us to consistently deliver and exceed clients' expectations. 

Working alongside industry leaders, you will have the opportunity to develop your career working on key projects in an environment which encourages collaboration, knowledge sharing and innovation. To support your professional growth, Jacobs flexible working arrangements, extended leave options and a host of social, health and wellbeing events and initiatives will underpin our commitment to you. 

At Jacobs it's all about what you do, not where you are, which counts!

We value collaboration and believe that in-person interactions are crucial for both our culture and client delivery. We empower employees with our hybrid working policy, allowing them to split their work week between Jacobs offices/projects and remote locations enabling them to deliver their best work. 

Your application experience is important to us, and we're keen to adapt to make every interaction even better. If you require further support or reasonable adjustments with regards to the recruitment process (for example, you require the application form in a different format), please contact the team via Careers Support.

data.title: FMI Lead Program Integrator
data.description:
Job Description Summary

We are seeking a hands-on FMI/Recall Program Leader who can independently take complex field-action programs from initiation through closure in a highly regulated environment. This individual will convert ambiguity into clear execution plans, drive global cross-functional alignment, maintain control of schedule, cost, risk, compliance and closure readiness, and deliver predictable program outcomes with minimal leadership intervention. 

The successful candidate combines strong program execution with sound judgement, effectively distinguishing issues that can be resolved within the team from those requiring escalation. When escalation is necessary, they bring clear recommendations, decision options and business impact assessments rather than simply reporting issues. 

In addition to program delivery, this role is expected to continuously improve the FMI/Recall operating model through Lean thinking, data-driven management, workflow simplification, digital enablement and responsible use of AI-enabled tools. 

GE HealthCare is a leading global medical technology and digital solutions innovator. Our mission is to improve lives in the moments that matter. Unlock your ambition, turn ideas into world-changing realities, and join an organization where every voice makes a difference, and every difference builds a healthier world. 

Job Description

Core responsibilities: 

FMI / Recall Program Leadership (85%)

- Own End-to-End Program ExecutionLead assigned FMI and Recall programs from initiation through applicable F5/F6 closure Milestones in accordance with approved Quality Management System procedures and program plans. Maintain complete accountability for execution, closure readiness and program outcomes. 
 - Develop and Execute Integrated Program PlansEstablish and maintain program plans, critical paths, milestones, resource forecasts, budget outlooks, governance mechanisms and execution strategies. Drive alignment across global stakeholders to deliver approved commitments. 
 - Lead Cross-Functional ExecutionServe as the primary program leader across Engineering, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, Service, Supply Chain, Product and regional stakeholders. Drive decisions, approvals, issue resolution and milestone achievement through influence and collaboration. 
 - Manage Risk, Ambiguity and EscalationsProactively identify risks, issues, dependencies and changes. Demonstrate sound judgement in determining when leadership escalation is required. Present clear recommendations, recovery options, business impacts and decision requirements to enable timely action. 
 - Drive Closure Readiness and ComplianceEnsure completion of reconciliation activities, objective evidence, approvals and regulatory-closure documentation. Maintain audit-ready program records and compliance with approved procedures. 
 - Operate a Disciplined Execution Management SystemLead a consistent Heartbeat operating rhythm using dashboards, program linearity, action ageing, visual management and fact-based performance reviews. Maintain accurate schedule, cost, quality, risk and closure-readiness information as the program source of truth. 
 - Lead Resources and Continuous ImprovementCoordinate execution priorities across Closure Analysts, consultants and external partners. Develop resource forecasts, manage utilisation and identify productivity, cycle-time and cost-to-serve improvements through Lean methodologies. 
 - Provide Leadership Visibility and Decision SupportDeliver concise, decision-oriented program updates, risk assessments, recommendations and recovery plans to functional and business leadership. Drive program to closure with minimal leadership intervention. 

Digital Enablement and Process Transformation (approximately 15%)

- Identify and prioritise opportunities for workflow simplification, automation, analytics and improved operational visibility across FMI/Recall processes. 
 - Partner with Digital, Software, Data, AI, Cybersecurity, Quality and Validation teams to define requirements and support solution deployment. 
 - Champion adoption, training, value realisation and responsible use of approved digital and AI-enabled solutions. 
 - Track and communicate measurable operational benefits from digital initiatives. 

Key performance outcomes

- Predictable achievement of approved field-action milestones and closure commitments. 
 - Improved program linearity, action ageing, risk visibility and escalation effectiveness. 
 - Complete, accurate and audit-ready execution and closure documentation. 
 - Clear program ownership with reduced leadership intervention in routine execution. 
 - Effective delivery and oversight of internal, consultant and partner resources. 
 - Measurable cycle-time, productivity, quality, cost or user-experience improvements from Lean and digital initiatives. 

Key Stakeholder Groups

- Collaborates across Engineering, Quality, Regulatory, Service, Operations, Finance, Digital, business leadership, and relevant external partners to drive program execution and closure

Educational Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Science, Business, Operations or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience where permitted by local policy. 

Required Skillsets

- At least 9+ years of experience in engineering, service, quality, operations, program/project management or a related field, including at least 5 years leading cross-functional projects or programs in a regulated environment. 
 - Demonstrated experience managing schedules, risks, actions, resources, budgets and stakeholder communication across complex programs. 
 - Strong execution discipline, organisational capability and ability to manage multiple concurrent priorities. 
 - Effective written and verbal communication, including presenting program status, risks and recommendations to leadership. 
 - Ability to influence without direct authority in a global, matrixed organisation. 
 - Fluent written and spoken English. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Working knowledge of medical-device Quality Management Systems, product lifecycle, risk management, ISO 13485, ISO 14971 or applicable post-market regulatory expectations. 
 - Experience supporting medical-device field actions, recalls, post-market programs, quality programs or regulated service deployments. 
 - Experience with Computed Tomography, Molecular Imaging, installed-base operations or software/service deployment. 
 - Experience overseeing consultants, contractors, closure analysts or external engineering/service partners. 
 - PMP, PMI-ACP, SAFe, Lean/Six Sigma or equivalent program-management or continuous-improvement certification. 
 - Experience supporting workflow automation, analytics, digital process improvement or AI-enabled business initiatives. 

Tools and systems

- Proficiency with Microsoft 365 collaboration and reporting tools. 
 - Experience with program planning, action tracking, dashboards or data-visualisation tools. 
 - Familiarity with quality, service, product lifecycle, installed-base or document-management systems is desirable. 
 - Ability to use approved digital and AI-enabled tools responsibly for productivity and decision support; software development expertise is not required. 

Leadership Expectations

- Takes ownership for outcomes, not activities. 
 - Demonstrates sound judgement in complex, ambiguous and time-sensitive situations. 
 - Influences across a global matrix organisation without formal authority. 
 - Creates clarity, alignment and momentum in highly cross-functional programs. 
 - Drives work to closure through disciplined execution and accountability. 

Inclusion and Diversity

GE Healthcare is an Equal Opportunity Employer where inclusion matters. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law. 

We expect all employees to live and breathe our behaviors: to act with humility and build trust; lead with transparency; deliver with focus, and drive ownership - always with unyielding integrity. 

Our total rewards are designed to unlock your ambition by giving you the boost and flexibility you need to turn your ideas into world-changing realities. Our salary and benefits are everything you'd expect from an organization with global strength and scale, and you'll be surrounded by career opportunities in a culture that fosters care, collaboration and support.

data.title: Principal Pre-Silicon Firmware Lead
data.description:
Description

Invent the future with us. 

Ampere is a semiconductor design company for a new era, leading the future of computing with an innovative approach to CPU design focused on high-performance, energy efficient AI compute. 

As a pioneer in the new frontier of energy efficient high-performance computing, Ampere is part of the Softbank Group of companies driving sustainable computing for AI, Cloud, and edge applications. 

Join us at Ampere and work alongside a passionate and growing team - we'd love to have you apply!

About The Role

We are seeking a Principal Pre-Silicon Firmware Lead to architect and implement low-level software for our next-generation microcontrollers/ SoCs. You will bridge the gap between hardware architecture and final software delivery. You will own the pre-silicon development lifecycle-including driver development for CAN/CAN-FD/CAN XL stacks -using high-performance enterprise emulation environments and ensures hardware-software co-design that satisfies strict ISO 26262 safety and high-quality engineering frameworks up to ASIL-D. 

What You'll Achieve

Technical Leadership & Hardware Co-Design

- Drive firmware architecture and technical roadmaps for in-house microcontroller/ SOCs. 
 - Align development milestones with SoC architecture, RTL design, verification, and post-silicon validation teams. 
 - Provide technical mentorship and enforce rigorous coding standards (MISRA C/C++). 
 - Author comprehensive design specifications, firmware architecture documentation, and test strategies. 

Pre-Silicon Validation & Emulation

- Develop early boot code, low-level drivers, and runtime firmware targeting pre-silicon environments. 
 - Lead virtual bring-up and hardware-software co-verification using both enterprise emulation platforms like Cadence Palladium/ Synopsys ZeBu. 
 - Optimize firmware execution speed
 - Debug complex, deep-silicon anomalies using JTAG/SWD debuggers, logic analysers, and internal emulator trace features. 

Communication Drivers & Protocols

- Design, implement, and optimize highly robust peripheral drivers for CAN, CAN-FD, and CAN XL. 
 - Develop and maintain critical application layer protocols, featuring standard diagnostics (ISO 14229), network management, and heavy-duty diagnostic framing fault handling. 
 - Design, implement and Integrate communication driver stacks into industry standard layers (e. g. , AUTOSAR MCAL interfaces). 
 - Deep knowledge of priority-based identifier arbitration, bit-stuffing mechanisms, and cyclical redundancy check (CRC) validation

Safety & Quality Compliance

- Enforce absolute compliance with ISO 26262 safety requirements. 
 - Participate in safety analyses (FMEA, root cause analysis) to ensure driver-level fault-handling routines are deterministic. 

About You

- Bachelor's degree with 8 years or Master's degree with 6 years of experience in embedded firmware development, specifically within the embedded semiconductor or safety-critical industry
 - 3+ years acting as a Technical Lead or Principal Engineer guiding architectural decisions and mentoring engineering teams. 
 - Expert proficiency in Embedded C with strict adherence to MISRA guidelines. 
 - Deep knowledge of embedded MCU/SoC architectures, including ARM Cortex-M/R or multi-core safety architectures. 
 - Direct hands-on experience with hardware emulation platforms, specifically Cadence Palladium and/or Synopsys ZeBu systems
 - Authoritative understanding of industrial fieldbus architectures (ISO 11898 standard family), physical/data link layers, priority-based identifier arbitration, bit-stuffing mechanisms, and diagnostic implementations
 - Proficient with professional embedded pipelines, including ARM compiler toolchains, JTAG debuggers (e. g. , Lauterbach), and emulation control scripts
 - Experience with ISO 26262 functional safety requirements up to ASIL-D
 - Understanding of HSM/SHE concepts and secure boot requirements
 - Experience building automated testing setups using Python and continuous integration tools (e. g. , Jenkins)

What We'll Offer

At Ampere we believe in taking care of our employees and providing a competitive total rewards package that includes base pay, cash long-term incentive, and comprehensive benefits. 

Benefits Highlights Include

- Premium medical, dental, vision insurance, parental benefits including creche reimbursement, as well as a retirement plan, so that you can feel secure in your health, financial future and child care during work. 
 - Generous paid time off policy so that you can embrace a healthy work-life balance 
 - Fully catered lunch in our office along with a variety of healthy snacks, energizing coffee or tea, and refreshing drinks to keep you fueled and focused throughout the day. 

And there is much more than compensation and benefits. At Ampere, we foster an inclusive culture that empowers our employees to do more and grow more. We are excited to share more about our career opportunities with you through the interview process. 

Ampere is an inclusive and equal opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from all backgrounds. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, citizenship, religion, age, veteran and/or military status, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, physical or mental disability, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law.

TechLead- Verification Methodology / CAD / Automation Engineer

Experience - 6-12 years

Job Summary

We are looking for a Tech Lead - Verification Methodology/CAD/Automation Engineer to drive verification infrastructure, methodology, automation, and productivity across IP and SoC verification teams. 

The candidate will build scalable verification frameworks, automate verification workflows, improve regression infrastructure, and partner with design verification teams to establish efficient and reusable methodologies. 

Key Responsibilities

- Own and drive verification methodology and infrastructure across projects. 
 - Develop scalable frameworks for simulation, regression, coverage, debug, and verification signoff. 
 - Build and maintain verification CAD/automation flows. 
 - Develop automation scripts and tools using Python, Tcl, Perl, Shell, and/or C++. 
 - Automate test generation, compilation, regression execution, result collection, coverage analysis, and reporting. 
 - Develop infrastructure for large-scale UVM/SystemVerilog verification environments. 
 - Improve simulation and regression turnaround time through parallelization and optimization. 
 - Integrate simulation, lint, CDC/RDC, formal, coverage, and other verification tools into common workflows. 
 - Develop dashboards and metrics for verification quality, coverage, regression health, and project status. 
 - Debug infrastructure and tool-flow issues and provide rapid support to verification teams. 
 - Establish reusable verification components, scripts, libraries, and methodology guidelines. 
 - Drive adoption of best practices across multiple verification teams. 
 - Evaluate new verification technologies and tools and recommend improvements. 
 - Work closely with EDA vendors to troubleshoot tool issues and improve flows. 
 - Support migration and integration of new EDA tool versions and methodologies. 
 - Develop documentation and training for verification teams. 
 - Mentor verification CAD/methodology engineers and provide technical leadership. 

Required Technical Skills

- Strong experience in verification methodology, CAD, and automation. 
 - Strong programming/scripting skills in Python, Tcl, Perl, Shell, and preferably C/C++. 
 - Strong understanding of SystemVerilog/UVM. 
 - Experience with simulation tools such as VCS, Xcelium, Questa, or equivalent. 
 - Experience building and maintaining regression infrastructure. 
 - Strong knowledge of coverage collection and analysis. 
 - Understanding of verification flows including: 
 - Simulation 
 - UVM 
 - Lint 
 - CDC/RDC 
 - Formal 
 - Code/functional coverage 
 - Regression 
 - Debug 
 - Strong Linux/Unix environment experience. 
 - Excellent automation and problem-solving skills. 

Preferred Experience

- Experience with large-scale SoC/IP verification environments. 
 - Experience integrating multiple EDA tools into a unified verification flow. 
 - Experience with CI/CD infrastructure such as Jenkins, GitLab CI, or equivalent. 
 - Experience with distributed/parallel regression infrastructure. 
 - Experience with cloud-based or scalable compute environments. 
 - Knowledge of databases, dashboards, APIs, or web-based verification infrastructure is an advantage. 
 - Experience working with EDA vendors and managing tool-flow issues. 

Leadership Expectations

- Act as the technical owner for verification methodology and automation. 
 - Identify opportunities to improve verification productivity, quality, and turnaround time. 
 - Define and enforce verification methodology standards. 
 - Mentor engineers and drive adoption of common frameworks. 
 - Work across multiple projects and teams to solve infrastructure challenges. 
 - Strong ability to balance immediate project requirements with long-term methodology improvements. 

Education

B. E. /B. Tech/M. E. /M. Tech in Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, VLSI, or a related discipline.

A technology-first engineering leader who combines deep technical credibility with the ability to lead engineering at scale. The individual should be capable of challenging architecture decisions, driving product engineering excellence and building modern, scalable banking technology platforms. 

Role Overview

We are looking for a Head of Engineering to lead the technology and engineering charter for our Trade and Supply Chain Finance products. 

The ideal candidate should be a strong product engineering leader with deep experience in building and scaling enterprise banking platforms. The role requires a solid engineering foundation, strong understanding of microservices architecture, API design and cloud-native technologies, and the ability to make critical architectural and technology decisions. 

This is not purely a people-management role. We are looking for someone who has personally grown through engineering and product development and continues to remain close to architecture, technology and the product build lifecycle. 

Key Responsibilities

- Own the end-to-end engineering charter for Trade and Supply Chain Finance products, covering architecture, development, engineering quality, scalability and technology evolution. 
 - Define and drive the engineering and technology roadmap aligned with product and business strategy. 
 - Own key architecture and technology decisions, ensuring scalability, performance, security, reliability and maintainability. 
 - Drive the evolution of products toward microservices, API-first and cloud-native architectures. 
 - Lead and develop high-performing engineering teams while maintaining strong technical depth and staying close to the engineering lifecycle. 
 - Drive engineering excellence across design, coding standards, DevSecOps, automation, testing, performance and release quality. 
 - Lead AWS-based/cloud-native engineering and deployment practices. 
 - Drive effective adoption of Java, Python and open-source technologies across the engineering stack. 
 - Partner closely with Product, Architecture, Delivery and Business teams to translate product strategy into scalable technology solutions. 
 - Identify opportunities to incorporate AI/ML and GenAI capabilities into product and engineering workflows. 

Must-Have Experience

- 20+ years of overall technology/Banking/Engineering experience, with significant leadership experience.

 - Strong preference for direct experience in Trade Finance and/or Supply Chain Finance technology/products
 - Proven product engineering/build experience - must have built and scaled technology products, rather than primarily managing delivery or teams.

The position requires deep technical skills in fluid and piping systems, expert proficiency with Creo, strong PLM experience, and the ability to define and own tools and processes that streamline layout creation, quoting, and product development. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead TCS/SFN design deliverables through all NPDI stages, from concept to product launch, ensuring technical robustness and manufacturability.

 - Drive supplier engagement, define specifications, support RFQs, and validate supplier designs for manufacturability and cost effectiveness. 
 - Provide technical ownership of future configurator and rapid layout tools (e. g. , CPQ-Creo integration, Revit) to streamline quoting and design processes. 
 - Mentor mechanical engineers and review custom order learnings to feed back into NPDI modules and roadmap planning. 
 - Ensure adherence to ASME/ASHRAE standards and internal design guidelines for liquid-cooled piping systems. 

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering. 
 - 10+ years of experience in piping and fluid systems, preferably in data center liquid cooling, HVAC, hydronics, or process cooling, with direct experience in Technical
 - Cooling Systems (TCS) / Secondary Fluid Networks (SFN) highly desirable. 
 - Expert proficiency with PTC Creo for assemblies, layouts, routing, and detailed drawings. 
 - Strong working knowledge of PLM systems (e. g. , Oracle PD Cloud, Windchill) for BOM management, engineering change control, and design lifecycle management. 
 - Proven record of leading NPDI projects using Stage Gate or equivalent processes, ensuring integration across application engineering, NPDI, and ETO workflows. 
 - Hands-on validation experience including pressure/leak testing, flow and thermal testing, cleanliness protocols, and condensation/dew point checks. 
 - Knowledge of ASME and ASHRAE guidelines for liquid cooling and piping systems. 
 - Deep expertise in DFM/DFA principles, weld/braze methods, and supplier fabrication processes. 
 - Strong documentation skills, including preparation of PFDs, P&IDs, test reports, engineering change orders, and sustaining handoffs. 
 - Excellent English communication skills (written and verbal). 
 - Demonstrated ability to work effectively with global engineering teams across regions. 
 - Strong leadership, organizational, and collaboration skills. 
 - Proven ability to define and own engineering tools and configurators that enable rapid layout creation, quoting, and design reuse. 

Preferred Skills

- Direct experience with TCS/SFN systems for high-density data centers, AI, or HPC applications. 
 - Experience with hydraulic modeling for loop balancing, pressure-drop analysis, and system sensitivity studies. 
 - Exposure to CFD or other thermal/fluid simulation tools. 
 - Experience with sanitary or high-cleanliness stainless-steel piping, orbital welding, flushing, passivation, and contamination control. 
 - Experience with PP-R/PP-RCT or other engineered polymer piping systems. 
 - Experience overseeing prototype builds, FAT/SAT, commissioning, and validation reporting. 
 - Experience with modular/prefabricated liquid-cooling systems, CPQ tools, Creo automation, or Revit workflows.

data.title: Senior Software Architect/Technical Lead
data.description:
Schedule: Monday to Friday, 4: 00 AM-1: 00 PM EST

Compensation: C$54, 000-C$78, 000 annually, based on experience and qualifications

About Revun

Revun is the software platform and infrastructure layer behind modern property operations. 

The platform brings together CRM functionality, leasing workflows, maintenance operations, payments, owner and vendor payouts, communications, compliance, reporting, AI automation, staff dashboards, tenant/owner/vendor portals, third-party integrations, and multiple user roles into one connected operating system. 

We are looking for a highly experienced Senior Software Architect / Technical Lead to take technical ownership of the platform, lead the engineering team, evaluate the existing technology, strengthen the architecture, and help move the product toward a stable commercial launch. 

About The Role

This is not a purely advisory architecture position. 

You will be expected to understand the existing application at a deep technical level, challenge weak technical decisions, lead developers, review engineering quality, identify technical and architectural risks, and determine what should be retained, improved, refactored, replaced, or rebuilt. 

You will serve as a senior technical authority for the platform and work directly with company leadership and product management. 

The right candidate will combine deep hands-on engineering experience with architecture expertise and engineering leadership. 

How to Apply

Apply with your resume. If your background aligns with the position, you'll receive an email with a link to complete a short pre-recorded video interview within 24-48 hours of applying. 

What You Will Do

- Take technical ownership of the architecture, engineering quality, technical audit, and launch readiness of Revun. 
 - Conduct a detailed assessment of the existing frontend, backend, databases, APIs, integrations, AI workflows, infrastructure, security, permissions, financial workflows, deployment processes, and overall codebase. 
 - Determine what should be retained, improved, refactored, replaced, or rebuilt based on technical risk, business impact, development effort, and long-term scalability. 
 - Identify technical debt, architectural weaknesses, security vulnerabilities, scalability risks, data-integrity issues, incomplete workflows, development problems, and launch blockers. 
 - Lead and provide technical direction to remote frontend, backend, integration, AI/automation, DevOps/cloud, and QA engineering resources. 
 - Evaluate developer capabilities, technical output, estimates, code quality, productivity, and ability to execute assigned work. 
 - Review code and pull requests, challenge weak engineering decisions, resolve technical blockers, and ensure developers follow established architectural and development standards. 
 - Translate product and business requirements into scalable technical solutions and engineering plans. 
 - Work closely with the Technical Product Manager to evaluate technical feasibility, dependencies, complexity, timelines, and trade-offs before development begins. 
 - Strengthen platform architecture across APIs, databases, authentication, authorization, role-based access control, audit logging, permissions, workflow automation, and system integrations. 
 - Review financial-system reliability across payments, owner/vendor payouts, ledger activity, reconciliation, transaction history, audit trails, and reporting. 
 - Evaluate AI/LLM functionality for reliability, structured outputs, hallucination risk, privacy, security, monitoring, cost control, and measurable business value. 
 - Improve integration reliability through APIs, webhooks, queues, retries, rate-limit handling, logging, monitoring, idempotency, and failed-sync recovery. 
 - Establish and enforce engineering standards covering code reviews, branching, testing, QA, CI/CD, deployments, documentation, monitoring, incident response, and production release controls. 
 - Provide leadership with clear assessments of technical risks, engineering performance, development progress, architecture decisions, resource requirements, and launch readiness. 

What We Are Looking For

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, or a closely related technical field. 
 - 12+ years of professional software engineering experience, with significant hands-on development experience. 
 - 4+ years in software architecture or senior technical leadership, such as Senior Software Architect, Technical Architect, Principal Engineer, Staff Engineer, Technical Lead, Lead Engineer, or equivalent. 
 - Demonstrated experience architecting and leading the development of complex, production SaaS applications. 
 - Strong backend and platform architecture expertise, including databases, APIs, distributed systems, authentication, authorization, RBAC, security, scalability, performance, and data integrity. 
 - Strong understanding of modern frontend architecture and the ability to evaluate frontend engineering decisions and code quality. 
 - Experience inheriting an existing software platform and determining what should be retained, refactored, replaced, or rebuilt. 
 - Experience leading and technically managing multidisciplinary engineering teams, including frontend and backend developers. 
 - Ability to evaluate developer capability, challenge estimates, identify weak engineering practices, and hold technical resources accountable for their work. 
 - Strong experience designing and integrating APIs, webhooks, asynchronous processing, queues, retries, logging, monitoring, rate-limit handling, and failure-recovery mechanisms. 
 - Strong experience with cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, observability, production deployments, QA processes, incident management, security, and launch readiness. 
 - Experience with complex SaaS, CRM, workflow automation, marketplace, fintech/payment, PropTech, field-service, or other multi-user operational platforms. 
 - Practical experience integrating AI/LLM functionality into production applications, including evaluation, monitoring, privacy, hallucination risk, human review, and cost management. 
 - Ability to move between high-level architecture and detailed technical investigation when necessary. 
 - Excellent English communication skills and the ability to explain complex technical issues, trade-offs, risks, and recommendations clearly to non-technical leadership. 

Nice to Have

- Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline. 
 - 15+ years of software engineering experience. 
 - Previous experience as a Principal Engineer, Senior Architect, Technical Architect, Engineering Lead, or similar senior technical authority. 
 - Experience taking an existing SaaS product through technical stabilization and commercial launch. 
 - Experience performing technical audits or taking ownership of software platforms originally developed by another engineering team. 
 - Experience in PropTech, real estate technology, property management software, CRM platforms, maintenance/field-service platforms, fintech, payments, compliance systems, or marketplace applications. 
 - Experience with complex platforms supporting multiple user types, including administrators, employees, vendors, customers, owners, tenants, professional users, and external partners. 
 - Experience building or modernizing high-volume workflow and transaction-processing systems. 
 - Relevant cloud, architecture, security, DevOps, or AI certifications. 

What Success Looks Like

You Will Be Expected To Develop a Deep Understanding Of Revun's Existing Technology And Give Leadership a Clear, Evidence-based View Of

- What is technically strong and should remain. 
 - What needs improvement or refactoring. 
 - What presents significant technical or launch risk. 
 - Whether existing engineering resources are performing at the required level. 
 - What engineering resources or expertise are missing. 
 - What must be completed before commercial launch. 
 - How the platform should evolve technically as it scales. 

You should be comfortable challenging existing decisions when necessary, but equally comfortable recommending that existing technology remain untouched when rebuilding it would provide little business or technical value. 

We are looking for someone who can make sound technical decisions and lead engineers through executing them, not simply produce architecture diagrams or recommendations. 

Compensation

C$54, 000-C$78, 000 annually, based on experience, qualifications, technical depth, and the scope of the role. 

Compensation will be discussed during the interview process. 

Schedule

Full-time, Monday to Friday

4: 00 AM-1: 00 PM Eastern Time

data.description:
Company: 

Qualcomm India Private Limited

Job Area: 

Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Systems Engineering

General Summary: 

Job Overview: 

You will be part of System Performance team that is responsible for profiling and optimizing the System Performance on Snapdragon chipsets. This role will require a strong knowledge of AI/ML performance using NPU cores. The knowledge of CPU, DDR, NoCs will be an added advantage. 

Skills Required: 

- A deep understanding of NPU, CPU and DDR architecture internals like
 - NPU: Understanding of NPU micro-architecture, including its specialized processing elements for operations like matrix multiplications and convolutions. 
 - A strong grasp of deep learning fundamentals, including neural network architectures like Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), transformers, GenAI etc. 
 - Understanding the distinction between the compute-intensive training of a model (often done on GPUs) and running inference (making predictions) on NPUs. 
 - Knowledge of Model optimization and compression techniques (Quantization, Pruning, Distillation etc. )
 - CPU caches (L1, L2, L3), instruction pipelines, branch prediction, memory hierarchy (including register, cache, and main memory) and multi-core/multi-threaded processing. You need to understand how memory access, instruction dependencies, and contention for shared resources can impact performance. 
 - DDR: Understanding of JEDEC specifications LPDDR4, LPDDR5, LPDDR6, including command and timing parameters (e. g. , tCL, tRCD, tRP), memory organization (rows, columns, banks), and basic view of training and initialization sequences, how a memory controller works and its specific features like command queue, port arbitration, and various control schemes. 
 - Familiarity with frameworks like TensorFlow Lite, PyTorch Mobile, and ONNX Runtime for preparing models for deployment. Experience with NPU-specific compilers, such as those from Qualcomm (QNN), Arm (Vela), Intel (OpenVINO), to optimize and orchestrate AI workloads. 
 - Evaluating hardware and software to determine the best fit for specific AI tasks and measure performance metrics like TOPS/W (trillions of operations per second per watt). 
 - Using tools like the Windows Performance Toolkit and Qualcomm's Snapdragon Profiler to analyze and optimize NPU and system-level performance
 - A core understanding of how to use parallel processing architectures for efficient AI computations. 
 - Expertise in how operating systems manage processes, threads, memory, MMU, and interrupt handling. This knowledge is crucial to understanding software for the kernel scheduler and system-level bottlenecks. 
 - Good understanding of Benchmarks CPU (like GeekBench, SpecInt, CoreMark etc) and DDR (like lat_mem, stream, bw_mem etc. ) and how they exercise the underlying CPU/GPU/DDR architecture. 
 - Experience with a variety of performance monitoring tools like Intel VTune, Linux perf, and Utilities like top, vmstat, iostat, and netstat to monitor system resources like CPU, memory, and I/O. Experience with software tools to monitor system hotspots, command bus utilization, and identify memory traffic patterns is critical. This includes validating that the traffic generated by software is as expected. 
 - Good understanding of memory allocation policies, prefetching, and caching to minimize latency and maximize bandwidth. Understanding how an application accesses memory is vital. Skills in profiling code to analyze memory access patterns and then optimizing the code for better data locality. 
 - Analyzing large datasets from performance tests requires strong statistical skills. This can involve creating histograms of transaction latencies and deriving performance metrics to understand a system's behavior. 

Responsibilities Include: 

- Drive Performance analysis on silicon using various System and Cores (i. e. NPU, AI/ML, CPU, Memory) benchmarks like Dhrystone, GeekBench, SPECInt, CNN/GenAI ML networks etc. 
 - Use of Performance tools to analyze the load patterns across IPs and identify any performance bottlenecks in system. 
 - Analyzing Perf KPIs of SoC subsystems like NPU, CPU, Memory, and corelate performance with projection
 - Evaluate and characterize performance at various junction temperatures and optimize running at high ambient temperatures. 
 - Analyze and optimize the System performance parameters of SoC infrastructure like NoC, LP5 DDR, etc. 
 - Collaborate with cross-functional global teams to plan and execute performance activities on chipsets as well as make recommendations for next generation chipsets. 

Minimum Qualifications: 

- 1 to 5 years of industry experience in the following: 
 - Experience working on any ARM/x86 based platforms, mobile/automotive/Data center operating systems and/or performance profiling tools. 
 - Experience in application or driver development in Linux\QNX and ability to create/customize make files with various compiler options is a plus. 
 - Must be quick learner and should be able to adapt to new technologies. 
 - Must have excellent communication skills. 

Preferred Qualifications: 

Additional skills in the following areas are preferred: 

- Knowledge of Computer architecture, LP5 DDR, Bus/NOC profiling is a big plus. 
 - Fundamentals on any operating system like Linux/QNX/Hypervisor & experience working on any Data center applications. 
 - Experience in creating professional quality reports and slides using MS Office or any advanced visualization tools. 
 - Experience in PoC development and competitive analysis Knowledge on Voltage/Power/ Thermal domain is plus.

- Required: Bachelor's, Computer Engineering, and/or Electrical Engineering

data.title: Staff Engineer
data.description:
This role is responsible for two things that are more connected than they first appear: (1) making production deployments safe enough that rollback is the default response to a problem, and (2) making configuration changes safe, audited, and AI-supervised so that bad configuration is caught before it reaches production. Both are fundamentally release-safety problems. 

GreyOrange operates a platform that multiple enterprise customers (DHL, XPO, Continental, others) run in production warehouses. A bad deployment or a bad configuration change is a customer-visible incident. The infrastructure you build is what stands between a code change and a customer outage. The company's ability to keep all customers on the same major platform version - rather than maintaining separate branches per customer - depends entirely on whether rollback is fast, trustworthy, and routine. 

After establishing the deployment and configuration management foundations, you expand into data and messaging engineering - specifically Kafka schema contracts and the Redis claim-check pattern for payload management. The overlap between distributed delivery systems (Kubernetes + Kafka both require schema and contract thinking) makes this a natural progression. 

What You Will Do

First Six Months - Deployment Safety & Configuration

- Take ownership of the deploy and release engineering domain. Audit the existing Spinnaker pipelines and ArgoCD application definitions to understand the starting point. 
 - Conduct a Consul configuration inventory - catalog every human-edited key, identify overlaps with the existing configuration management system, and publish a written boundary document clarifying which configs live where. 
 - Design and ship blue-green progressive delivery for the top three critical stateless services using ArgoCD Rollouts. Write a shared Rollout template that all subsequent services follow. 
 - Standardise Spinnaker pipeline templates for VM-deployed services. Define smoke-test requirements as a mandatory promotion gate. 
 - Ship the Java/Spring feature-flag SDK, piloted against one service. Then Erlang and React SDKs. 
 - Implement Consul-as-backend: bring human-edited Consul keys behind the configuration management UI. Remove direct write access for humans. 

Next Six Months - Configuration Intelligence & Messaging

- Ship AI-supervised configuration: train or fine-tune a model on historical incident data, surface risk warnings in the configuration UI. First version can be rule-based with an LLM layer on top. 
 - Wire the configuration audit log into the compliance evidence pipeline so configuration changes become part of the joined audit trail alongside access events and incident records. 
 - Own Kafka schema contract rollout: Schema Registry adoption and Avro migration for the highest-traffic topics. Partner with service teams through the migration. 
 - Build and ship the Redis claim-check SDK. Monitor payload-size distribution and consumer lag. Demonstrate measurable reduction in Kafka payload sizes on the pilot topics. 

Ongoing

- Run rollback drills on a regular cadence - each customer environment should execute at least one controlled rollback per half so the process is practised before it is needed under pressure. 
 - Maintain the deployment and configuration systems as production services - they are part of the platform team's on-call rotation. 
 - Contribute to cross-team architecture reviews with a deployment safety and release-engineering lens. 
 - Write and maintain design documents and runbooks for everything you build. 

Requirements

- 8+ years of backend or platform engineering with strong Kubernetes and GitOps depth
 - Production experience with ArgoCD, ArgoCD Rollouts, Flagger, or comparable progressive-delivery tooling - has configured traffic shifting, canary analysis, and automated rollback in a real production environment
 - Has built or substantially extended a feature-flag or runtime configuration management system - not just used a commercial tool, but understood or built the machinery underneath
 - Familiarity with Consul, Vault, or the broader HashiCorp ecosystem at an engineering level
 - Experience with Spinnaker or a comparable continuous delivery platform for VM-based deployments
 - Uses deployment frequency, change failure rate, and mean time to restore as engineering metrics - not just awareness of what DORA is, but a track record of using it to prioritise engineering investment
 - Comfortable with heterogeneous deployment environments - both Kubernetes and traditional VMs as first-class production targets in the same organisation

Nice to Have

- Experience with Apache Camel or Apache Flink - relevant for future work in integration and streaming engineering
 - Background with Kafka Connect, schema registries, or MQTT integration - the platform bridges Kafka and MQTT for robot communication
 - Multi-tenant SaaS background where customer-segmented feature rollouts are standard practice - GreyOrange deploys to multiple enterprise customers with different risk tolerances and release windows
 - Familiarity with LLM APIs (Vertex AI, OpenAI) and retrieval-augmented generation - the AI configuration risk-detection work uses an LLM layer on top of historical incident data
 - Erlang/OTP experience or genuine curiosity about it - the Erlang feature-flag SDK requires understanding how OTP applications load and manage configuration at runtime

data.title: [SLTKGEUJ] AI Tester
data.description:
Hello All, 

Greeting's from ZettaMine!!!

Job Role

AI Tester

Location: PAN India (Prefer Bangalore /Mumbai)

Notice Period: Immediate Joiners to 25 Days NP Serving Candidates

Job Description: 

AI Evaluation & Harness Engineer - Healthcare AI

We are looking for an AI Evaluation & Harness Engineer to design and operate both halves of this system: the evaluation infrastructure that proves our AI is trustworthy, and the production harness - prompts, tool contracts, guardrails, context management - that makes our agents perform reliably in the first place. This is a hands-on technical role for someone who has actually built and evaluated LLM or agentic systems in production, not only tested them from the outside. You will set technical direction for how AI quality is measured and gated, build reusable evaluation datasets and judges, and work directly with the engineers building our agents to close gaps between what ships and what's actually been proven safe. 

Responsibilities

- Design and build evaluation harnesses for LLM-powered and agentic workflows, covering prompt-level regression testing, structured-output/schema validation, retrieval quality (context precision/recall), faithfulness, and answer relevancy, using frameworks such as RAGAS and DeepEval to operationalize these metrics rather than building scoring logic from scratch each time. 
 - Build and maintain LLM-as-judge evaluation pipelines with rubric design, calibration against human review, and inter-rater reliability checks, distinguishing dimensions that require deterministic assertions from those that genuinely require semantic judgment. 
 - Own evaluation and testing for agentic systems built on frameworks such as Google's Agent Development Kit (ADK), LangChain/LangGraph, or comparable orchestration frameworks - including trajectory evaluation, tool-call accuracy (tool selection vs. parameter construction, evaluated independently), agent handoff accuracy in multi-agent workflows, and failure-recovery testing via deliberate failure injection. 
 - Design and maintain the regression-gated evaluation pipeline that runs on every prompt change, model version bump, or context update - functioning as the AI equivalent of a CI/CD quality gate - and isolate model changes from prompt changes when both occur together rather than validating only at the end-to-end layer. 
 - Own model lifecycle and drift management: treat prompts as versioned behavioral specifications, run continuous (not just release-time) regression suites against golden datasets, and detect silent model drift introduced by upstream provider updates before it surfaces as a user-facing quality problem. 
 - Build and evolve the production harness around our agent Lambdas/services: structured-output contracts, prompt/context versioning, guardrails against unsafe or out-of-scope input, escalation logic for low-confidence outputs, and the observability/tracing layer that captures every input → prompt → model response → downstream action as an inspectable record. 
 - Build a structured failure taxonomy specific to our systems - grounding/hallucination failures, reasoning and instruction-drift failures, safety/adversarial failures, coordination failures in multi-agent handoffs, and stochastic/consistency failures - and use it to drive systematic test coverage rather than ad hoc test-writing. 
 - Design human-in-the-loop review workflows for low-confidence or high-stakes outputs, including sampling strategy, escalation paths, and feedback loops that route confirmed failures back into evaluation datasets. 
 - Convert every significant production incident into permanent evaluation coverage: identify why existing evaluations didn't catch it, close the gap, and confirm the fix before redeployment. 
 - Establish evaluation datasets, judges, rubrics, and regression baselines as shared, versioned infrastructure usable by other project teams, rather than infrastructure rebuilt per project. 
 - Produce audit-ready documentation of evaluation methodology, results, and drift trends to support compliance and clinical-safety review. Qualifications

Required: 

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or related technical field, plus 3+ years of software engineering experience with 1+ years specifically building, evaluating, or productionizing LLM or agentic AI systems - or equivalent experience. 
 - Direct, hands-on experience integrating LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, or similar) into production systems - this must be applied AI/ML engineering experience, not testing AI features from a pure QA vantage point. 
 - Practical experience with evaluation frameworks or techniques such as RAGAS, DeepEval, LLM-as-judge scoring, or comparable evaluation tooling. 
 - Strong Python engineering skills, including experience with structured-output/function-calling patterns and prompt versioning. Preferred: 

- Experience with agent orchestration frameworks such as Google's Agent Development Kit (ADK), LangChain/LangGraph, or similar. 
 - Cloud platform experience - GCP (Vertex AI, Cloud Functions), AWS (Lambda, Bedrock), or Azure (AI Foundry) - is a strong plus, particularly for serverless AI workloads. 
 - Experience evaluating RAG pipelines or multi-agent systems in a regulated or safety-critical domain (healthcare, finance). 
 - Familiarity with HIPAA/PHI handling requirements and healthcare data governance. 
 - Experience designing failure taxonomies, trajectory/handoff test scenarios, and severity-tiered quality gates for agentic systems. 
 - Exposure to observability/tracing tooling for multi-step AI pipelines (e. g. , LangSmith, Datadog LLM Observability, or equivalent). Our AI Evaluation practice sits at the point where AI ambition meets AI accountability - every agent we ship, every model we adopt, and every prompt we change passes through the systems this role builds. If you've been in the room building and debugging LLM systems and want to make that discipline rigorous and repeatable at scale, this is that role

How to Apply:

- Full Name

That mindset shapes not only our solutions - but how we operate as a company. 

When you join Fuller, you're joining a team that supports your growth and values your contribution. Here, colleagues collaborate openly, leaders give you room to develop, and the environment is built on trust, inclusion, and continuous learning. You'll find the stability of a global organization and the agility of one that's actively expanding - a place where your career can accelerate alongside the business. 

If you want to move forward with a company that brings its people with it - Fuller is where that happens. 

About The Role

The Machine Control Specialist (PLC Engineer) is a senior technical field leader responsible for driving complex installation, commissioning, Aftermarket Service, and optimization activities across heavy industrial process systems, with a strong focus on the cement industry. 

Operating with a high degree of autonomy, this role serves as a trusted technical advisor to customers and internal stakeholders while directing multi-disciplinary field teams. The Machine Control Specialist combines deep Automation and Instrumentation expertise, specifically with Material Handling, heavy rotary and grinding equipment with site leadership, commercial awareness, and customer-facing problem-solving. This position plays a critical role in strengthening customer relationships, driving operational excellence during plant shutdowns, and generating service and spare parts business growth. 

This position will require Extensive travel to customer sites both planned and occasionally on short notice. 

About The Department

Fuller Technologies Professional Service department is responsible to provide onsite support for it's Projects / aftermarket business in India. The primary responsibilities will be related to Installation, troubleshooting, technical leadership for Projects & Aftermarket Services of Fuller Technologies proprietary equipment. The Professional Service department works closely with Projects / After Market sales team. 

Your Responsibilities: 

- Supervision of E&I installation/ testing/ commissioning activities at site. 
 - Coordination with customer, contractors. Vendor & HO. 
 - Maintain daily diary on site activities. 
 - Preparation of instruction sheets / advice notes to customer
 - Preparation of weekly schedules & punch list jobs. 
 - Inspection of FLS supplied equipment /parts & reporting back to HO. 
 - Advising customer on site storage, equipment protection of FLS supplied equipment. 
 - Adhering to Customer safety rules and regulations. 
 - Ensure quality of job done by customer and contractor
 - Preparation of MOMs with customer and vendors as and when required. 
 - Preparation of weekly reports, CAPA & Special reports and forward to HO
 - Participation in Cold and Hot commissioning and preparation of reports with customer and contractor. 
 - Plant start-up, load trials & optimization
 - Advice customer on plant operation & maintenance. 
 - Must have site experience on E&I installation and Commissioning activities
 - PLC/DCS programming /testing /Commissioning for Siemens / Rockwell / ABB / Schneider Systems. 
 - Programming / testing of Intelligent MCCs. 
 - SCADA / HMI Programming / Testing. 
 - Site supervision for C&I and Control system equipment installation / Commissioning in Cement / Material Handling / Mineral Processing Industries. 
 - Experience in FLS - Automation ECS (V7 /V8) will be an added advantage. 
 - Industrials Protocols like Modbus, Ethernet, Profibus, Profinet, Device Net etc. 
 - Strong Technical Knowledge about, Field instruments and LV Electrical Equipment (LV Motors, MCC and PDBs) and FLS Standard to respective area
 - Adequate expertise to trouble shooting. 
 - Focuses are both technical and leadership with execution targets (budgets). 
 - Interacts with technical personnel in the field and on the leadership level. 
 - Evaluates quality issues for the project, the machines and the system together. 
 - Manages support from headquarters to provide technical solutions. 
 - Identifies potential opportunities for Fuller Technologies products and services. 
 - Plans and organizes the job so that execution is on target (time). 
 - Advises customer and contractors on proper procedures and processes to guarantee technical specifications. 

You bring

- Bachelor's degree / Diploma in Electrical / Electronics / Instrumentation Engineering
 - 5 years of proven experience in cement / mining industry or other equipment / technology related. 
 - 3 years of proven experience in installation / commissioning / maintenance
 - Leadership experience in project / aftermarket services for the cement / mining industries

As an equal opportunity employer, Fuller Technologies embraces diversity and equality by promoting an environment of inclusion. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds to apply irrespective of sex, gender identity/expression, disability, sexual orientation, or age. The more diverse our employees are, the stronger our team is. 

What We Offer

- Competitive remuneration package & access to salary packaging options to allow you to maximize your after-tax income. 
 - Competitive benefits package including Health Insurance, Personal Accident / Disability, Group Term Life Insurance, Annual health check-up, and voluntary insurance options.

Application and contact

Please apply by clicking "apply" on this page. Kindly note that we will be reviewing applications and conducting interviews - also on a virtual setting as required - on an ongoing basis so please apply as soon as possible. 

No recruiters and unsolicited agency referrals, please. 

Build a better world

Fuller Technologies helps build societies all over the world by contributing to the infrastructure needed for global economic growth. It is a big responsibility, and we are committed to driving growth while minimising environmental impact. To achieve this, your skills, your curiosity, and your drive for change are important. data.description:
Vantive is a vital organ therapy company on a mission to extend lives and expand possibilities for patients and care teams everywhere. For 70 years, our team has driven meaningful innovations in kidney care. As we build on our legacy, we are deepening our commitment to elevating the dialysis experience through digital solutions and advanced services, while looking beyond kidney care and investing in transforming vital organ therapies. Greater flexibility and efficiency in therapy administration for care teams, and longer, fuller lives for patients- that is what Vantive aspires to deliver. 

We believe Vantive will not only build our leadership in the kidney care space, it will also offer meaningful work to those who join us. At Vantive, you will become part of a community of people who are focused, courageous and don't settle for the mediocre. Each of us is driven to help improve patients' lives worldwide. Join us in advancing our mission to extend lives and expand possibilities. 

Education And/or Experience

BS Degree (engineering, science or pharmaceutical related discipline) with 8 -10 years of experience in medical device industry

Experience in the design and development of electromechanical devices is required. 

Qualifications

- Demonstrated compliance knowledge in the areas of medical device and drug product development, change control, NCR CAPA, and risk management. 
 - Strong verbal and written communication skills
 - Strong interpersonal/communication/influencing/negotiation skills required. 
 - Demonstrated leadership, teaming, and communication skills accomplishing success with large teams. 
 - Device regulation (design control) experience required
 - Knowledge of FDA (21 CFR Part 210, 211, 820, 803, 806), ISO 13485, ISO 14971, IEC 60601, and standards for medical devices and therapeutics. 
 - Strong analytical and problems solving skills utilizing DMAIC tools, Six Sigma Engineering, ASQ or other certifications desirable. 
 - Proficient with Minitab or any equivalent statistical tool is required. 
 - Proficient in product and process change controls and risk management
 - Apply DMAIC and statistical techniques to address issues and investigations
 - Demonstrates ability to work independently

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Provides quality guidance and approval to product design and process change controls to ensure compliance to the required Product Development Process (PDP) deliverables, resulting in the development and sustaining of safe and effective medical devices

Responsible for Quality Assurance of the Product Development and Lifecycle Management process. 

Supports product verification testing to ensure product reliability and conformance to specifications

Organize and implement site support of corporate audits and Notified Body regulatory inspections. Act as front room lead for audits and inspections. 

Educates and trains on product body of knowledge and Vantive QMS principles

Analyzes data from various sources (Non-Conformances, Field Corrective Actions, Medical Device Reports, and Complaints) to drive decisions

Drive Quality culture mindset and provide input for code quality improvements. 

Identify and oversee specific process product improvement initiatives such as test case adequacy, requirement levelling and test automations. 

Reasonable Accommodation

Vantive is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities globally. If, because of a medical condition or disability, you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application or interview process, please click on the link here and let us know the nature of your request along with your contact information. Form Link

Recruitment Fraud Notice

Vantive has discovered incidents of employment scams, where fraudulent parties pose as Vantive employees, recruiters, or other agents, and engage with online job seekers in an attempt to steal personal and/or financial information. To learn how you can protect yourself, review our Recruitment Fraud Notice.

Company Description

FlocknGo is a community-first platform designed for organizers who run paid group activities and for professionals who join them. It replaces fragmented tools like messaging apps, forms, and spreadsheets with a single platform where organizers manage discovery, bookings, payments, and member engagement. 

Members can easily find communities that match their interests, book activities in one tap, and receive updates directly on their preferred messaging channels. The platform focuses on building long-term communities rather than just selling tickets, while maintaining strong privacy standards and never sharing phone numbers. 

FlocknGo is trusted by diverse groups including run clubs, farms, board game organizers, cultural clubs, and professional communities. 

Role Description

The CTO and Co Founder with Investment role at FlocknGo is location agnostic, but preferably based in the Pune. This role involves leading the technical vision, designing and evolving the platform architecture, and driving end-to-end product development from concept to deployment. 

The ideal candidate comes from startup ecosystem with any recent exits and looking for the next challenge of building a startup in the emerging Experience Economy. 

The individual will oversee software development processes, coordinate with product and business stakeholders, and ensure that technology decisions align with the company's community-first strategy. Day-to-day activities include hands-on coding, reviewing technical designs, managing technical roadmaps and sprints, and setting standards for security, scalability, and data privacy. 

As a co-founder with investment, the person will also participate in strategic planning, help build and mentor the engineering team, and contribute to fundraising and partner discussions. 

Qualifications

- Strong AI First Software Development skills, including experience with modern web technologies, APIs, and cloud-based platforms. 
 - Proven ability in Architecture and IT Strategy to design scalable, secure, and privacy-focused systems that support community-centric products. 
 - Experience in Product Development, from discovery and MVP design through iterations, launches, and user feedback integration. 
 - Project Management capabilities to plan roadmaps, manage sprints, coordinate cross-functional teams, and deliver on time. 
 - Background in building or scaling SaaS or marketplace products is highly beneficial. 
 - Comfort with data-driven decision-making, analytics, and experimentation to improve user experience and platform performance. 
 - Ability to work collaboratively in a startup environment, take ownership, and communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Relevant degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - Compensation is more of equity, so anyone looking for a regular job, please skip. This role is for entrepreneurs at heart looking for the next big challenge and opportunity. 

The Blueprint

Stack: Python/Django, Flutter, React. js, hosted on AWS. 

Team: Managing 5 developers. 

Location: Remote (Pune preferred for occasional in-person collaboration). 

Commitment: Full-time preferred, but open to part-time for the right architect. 

Upside: Competitive terms with significant equity participation. 

If you are a builder who wants technical autonomy and serious skin in the game.
