data.description:
Job Description

We're looking for a tech leader ready to focus on Data governance, authorization, and data-mesh architecture - with regional technical leadership across the India team

As a Senior Principal Software Engineer at JPMorgan Chase within the Commercial & Investment Bank's Markets - Markets Data Lake (MDL) team, you will be the technical authority for how data is governed, secured, and authorized across this mesh, and you will provide regional technical leadership across the India team - one of MDL's primary engineering hubs. You will set direction, grow senior talent locally, and act as the senior technical anchor in-region, while staying hands-on with the platform's most critical governance and authorization components. 

Job Responsibilities

- Serve as the senior technical leader in-region for the India-based MDL engineering team, setting technical direction and ensuring alignment with the global platform roadmap. Grow and mentor senior, staff, and up-and-coming engineers in India; establish a strong local engineering culture, review practices, and career-development pathways. 
 - Own regional delivery of major platform initiatives end-to-end, coordinating across time zones with global stakeholders and partner teams. Build in-region depth in governance, authorization, and data-mesh capabilities so the India team owns critical platform domains, not just execution. 
 - Represent MDL locally - interviewing and hiring, onboarding, and raising the engineering bar across the India hub. Bridge global and regional priorities, ensuring the India team's work is visible, influential, and tightly integrated with the broader organization. 
 - Architect the data-mesh platform: define what a "data product" is on MDL - its contracts, SLAs, schemas, ownership, lifecycle, and interoperability standards - and build the self-serve platform capabilities domain teams use to publish them. Establish federated computational governance: design the policies-as-code framework that lets central standards (security, quality, entitlements, retention) be enforced automatically across independently-owned domains. 
 - Build the data-product substrate: catalog, discovery, lineage, versioning, and distribution across the platform's query engines, so consumers can find and query products through the semantic layer and NL-query interfaces without bypassing controls. 
 - Keep the architecture engine-agnostic - design governance, entitlements, and data-product contracts to work uniformly across current and future storage and compute engines rather than being tied to any single technology. give domains freedom to model and evolve their products while guaranteeing platform-wide consistency and safety. 
 - Own the governance model end-to-end: data classification, metadata management, lineage, data quality, retention, and audit across every MDL data product. Codify governance as code - schema/contract validation, quality gates, and policy checks embedded in publishing and CI/CD pipelines so governance is enforced, not advisory. Drive lineage and auditability: every query and every distributed dataset must be traceable, correlated, and reproducible for regulatory and internal audit needs. 
 - Partner with data owners, risk, compliance, and privacy to translate regulatory and firm obligations into automated platform controls. Own the authorization architecture for MDL: fine-grained, row- and column-level entitlements enforced consistently across every query engine and the query/agent layer (nl_query/execute_query). 
 - Design a scalable entitlements model - attribute/role/policy-based access control, entitlement propagation from source systems, and least-privilege by default. Guarantee "no query bypasses entitlements": ensure NL-generated and raw SQL alike are planned and executed within the caller's entitlement scope, with credentials brokered securely. 
 - Harden identity and access: integration with enterprise IdP/OAuth2, token lifecycle, secrets handling, and full access audit trails. Set technical direction across multiple teams via design docs, RFCs, and architecture reviews focused on governance, security, and mesh interoperability. Stay hands-on - personally build reference implementations for the highest-risk governance/authorization components and set the pattern others follow. Mentor and grow senior and staff engineers globally and in-region; establish best practices for secure-by-design data engineering. 

Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills

- Formal training or certification on software engineering concepts and 10+ years applied experience 
 - Software engineering experience with significant time architecting large-scale data platforms. 
 - Demonstrated regional/site technical leadership - anchoring a distributed engineering team (ideally in India), growing senior talent, and delivering across time zones. 
 - Deep expertise in data governance and authorization at scale: fine-grained entitlements (row/column-level security), ABAC/RBAC/policy-based access control, data classification, lineage, and audit. 
 - Demonstrated experience designing and scaling agentic AI-enabled development patterns (using enterprise-authorized tools within the work environment) across teams/functions, including establishing governance for human-in-the-loop validation, traceability/auditability, and secure handling of sensitive inputs/outputs. 
 - Strong understanding of responsible AI use and control expectations at scale, including security/resiliency implications, data sensitivity, and risk-based governance; ability to advise senior leaders on safe adoption, reuse, and measurable outcomes. 
 - Strong experience designing secure, governed data platforms on the cloud, including identity/OAuth2 token-based authorization - applied in an engine-agnostic way rather than tied to a single warehouse or lake technology. 
 - Data-mesh or federated data-platform experience - designing data products, data contracts, and federated/computational governance. 
 - Strong SQL and data modeling; experience with a semantic/metrics layer. 
 - Proficiency in a primary backend language (Python, Java, Go, or similar) and policy-as-code tooling. 
 - Excellent cross-time-zone communication, design-doc, and stakeholder-management skills. 

Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills

- Capital markets / financial services data experience (FX, rates, credit, equities, reference data) and familiarity with the associated regulatory and data-privacy landscape. 
 - Experience building and scaling engineering teams within a global delivery / India hub model. 
 - Experience with data catalogs, lineage, and governance tooling (e. g. OpenLineage/DataHub, Collibra, Immuta/Okera-style policy engines). 
 - Experience securing natural-language / LLM-agent data access (MCP) - ensuring generated SQL is entitlement-safe and deterministic. 
 - Familiarity with a range of storage/compute engines and lakehouse formats (e. g. Iceberg, Delta, Hudi) and streaming/batch pipelines (Kafka, Spark, Flink), with the judgment to choose the right tool per use case. 
 - Infrastructure-as-code (Terraform) and mature CI/CD with embedded policy gates.

data.title: Global Marketing & Digital Wealth QA Engineer, Associate
data.description:
About This Role

The Team: 

The Global Marketing & Digital Wealth organization at BlackRock is a forward-looking, globally connected team at the center of the firm's most high-impact priorities. We are architects of growth, working across functions and markets to unlock opportunities and accelerate outcomes for the business. In collaboration with both internal and external partners, we design the conditions for success-delivering next-generation campaigns, brand platforms, communications, training, and client experiences. Our work is powered by world-class centers of excellence spanning content strategy, research & analytics, and digital platforms & experiences. 

Within Global Marketing & Digital Wealth, the Global Digital team owns and transforms BlackRock's client-facing digital properties-including BlackRock. com, iShares. com, and Advisor Center-as well as our email marketing channels. The team brings together product, design, engineering, and digital expertise to create connected, personalized experiences that help clients discover, understand, and engage with BlackRock. 

Role And Impact

As more clients hold iShares and engage with BlackRock digitally, the quality of our client experiences matters more than ever. We are looking for a QA Engineer to join our global Digital Experiences team and help ensure that the experiences we build-guiding users through the purchase funnel, personalizing to their needs, and encouraging ongoing engagement-are reliable, accurate, and release-ready. 

The successful candidate will own quality across the delivery lifecycle, from test planning and preparation through execution, automation, and CI/CD integration. They will bring a development-minded approach to testing and help evolve our QA practice toward an AI-assisted model that increases coverage and speed while reducing manual effort. 

Responsibilities

Planning

- Understand requirements and Jira stories; create test plans, assess test automation feasibility, and estimate, schedule, and plan testing activities. 
 - Use AI tools to analyze requirements and user stories, identify gaps or ambiguities early, and propose risk-based test coverage. 

Test Preparation

- Analyze and understand scenarios and application flows, and prepare test scenarios and test cases for new functionality. 
 - Prepare test data and manually execute test cases to understand application flows. 
 - Use AI-assisted tools to generate and refine test scenarios, test cases, and synthetic test data, applying human review to validate accuracy and completeness. 

Test Execution

- Execute new functional test cases for the current release, as well as manual and automated regression packs. 
 - Log defects and retest fixed defects. 
 - Apply AI to triage test failures, cluster related defects, and draft clear, reproducible defect reports. 
 - Leverage AI-enabled visual, accessibility, and content checks to catch regressions across pages, markets, and devices. 

Test Scripting & Integration

- Develop test scripts according to the BlackRock framework and perform dry runs of automation scripts. 
 - Integrate automation with the CI/CD pipeline and complete a full run of automated scripts. 
 - Use AI coding assistants (e. g. , GitHub Copilot) to accelerate test script development, refactoring, and maintenance, including self-healing of brittle locators. 
 - Help build reusable prompts, agent workflows, and standards that scale AI-assisted QA across the team, and measure their impact on coverage, cycle time, and defect leakage. 

User Documentation

- Create and update user manuals. 

Core Skills

- Quality mindset with a development background. 
 - Analytical mindset with the ability to grasp complex concepts easily. 
 - Comfortable working in an agile environment, fluent in English. 
 - Interested in continuously extending testing know-how. 
 - Curious and pragmatic about AI-applies it to improve quality and speed, while exercising sound judgment on AI-generated output. 

Qualifications

Essential Skills and Experience

- 3-7 years of working experience in software testing or QA. 
 - Technology-based university degree or equivalent experience. 
 - Proven ability to assure the quality of developed software and code. 
 - Experience with at least one of the following frameworks: Playwright, Cypress, or Puppeteer. 
 - Experience with CI/CD environments. 
 - Experience with Jira/Azure Boards, Confluence, and Git. 
 - Hands-on experience using AI tools (e. g. , GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, or similar) in testing or development workflows. 

Desirable Skills And Experience

- Practical knowledge of designing and developing test automation solutions. 
 - Experience with Azure DevOps. 
 - Strong hands-on knowledge of TypeScript and Python for test automation, scripting, and framework development. 
 - Familiarity with AI-native testing tools, Playwright MCP, or agent-based test generation and execution. 
 - Experience testing AI-powered features (e. g. , chatbots or generative content), including evaluation of output accuracy and consistency. 

Our Benefits

To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about. 

Our hybrid work model

BlackRock's hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person - aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock. 

Guidance on AI use for candidates

At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work - enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we've provided guidance on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self. 

About BlackRock

At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children's educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress. 

This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment - the one we make in our employees. It's why we're dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive. 

To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers. BlackRock. com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok. 

BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, family status, gender identity, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected attributes at law.

Service Delivery Manager - Performance & Continuous Improvement

Grade

ABOUT THE HUB

Bureau Veritas is building a greenfield HR Shared Services hub in Noida. The hub will bring HR operations that currently run separately in each country into one standardised, digitally enabled service centre. You will design your tower, move work into Noida in structured waves, and run it at scale to global standards. 

ROLE PURPOSE

You are the hub's performance and improvement engine. You will build the Intelligent Command Centre that gives leaders one real-time view of service health across every tower. You will also run the continuous improvement system that moves the hub from stable operations to best-in-class service. 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

- Transition and shared services set-up
 - Design the hub's performance framework: a KPI tree, SLA definitions, data sources and a reporting cadence shared by all towers. 
 - Capture and certify the pre-transition baselines for each country, so the hub can prove its value against the starting point. 
 - Support the transition PMO with readiness scorecards, go/no-go dashboards and hypercare tracking for every wave. 
 - Set up the Intelligent Command Centre, covering architecture, data pipelines, dashboards and alerting. 
 - Process ownership and service delivery
 - Run the ICC day to day, with real-time SLA, volume, backlog and escalation monitoring across R2P, R2H, Q2R and A2W. 
 - Lead the hub's governance rhythm: daily stand-ups, weekly tower reviews, monthly service reviews and quarterly business reviews with stakeholders. 
 - Own the hub-wide customer voice programme, including CSAT and NPS surveys, closing the loop with respondents, and reporting insight. 
 - Run hub-level capacity and productivity analytics to support resourcing decisions. 
 - Governance, risk and controls
 - Own the hub quality management system, covering process documentation standards, internal quality audits and control testing across towers. 
 - Maintain the hub risk register and the tracking of issues and actions. 
 - Build data governance for performance reporting so that there is one version of the truth. 
 - Continuous improvement and digital
 - Build and govern the hub-wide continuous improvement backlog. Prioritise by value and effort, and agree ownership with each GPO. 
 - Lead improvement projects using Lean, Six Sigma and process mining. Track benefits through to realised savings. 
 - Run the hub's automation and AI pipeline, from idea intake to business case, delivery and benefits tracking. 
 - Build a continuous improvement culture through training, recognition and a simple way for every employee to raise ideas. 
 - People leadership, performance and culture
 - Build the tower's team from the ground up. Define the structure, spans of control, role profiles and hiring plan for each transition wave. 
 - Recruit, onboard and develop team leads and specialists. Build succession cover for every critical role before the tower reaches steady state. 
 - Run a disciplined people-performance cycle covering goal setting, monthly one-to-ones, quarterly reviews and calibrated year-end ratings. 
 - Keep attrition, absence and engagement at or better than hub targets. Act early on hotspots. 
 - Model the hub culture of ownership, customer focus, speed with control and learning. Make it visible in how the team works every day. 
 - Build capability through skills matrices, cross-training and certification paths. Create career moves across towers. 

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

- First 90 days: hub KPI framework, baseline method and ICC design signed off. 
 - By go-live: ICC live with real-time dashboards for the first transition wave, and the governance rhythm running. 
 - Within 12-18 months: continuous improvement portfolio delivering measurable, validated benefits, with hub-wide dashboards trusted by global stakeholders. 

KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS

KPI

Indicative target

Hub-wide SLA adherence

≥ 95% across towers

Validated CI Benefits

Annual savings and hours released against target

Automation hours released

Increased year on year

Reporting timeliness and accuracy

100% on schedule

Hub CSAT / NPS

At or above target

Audit and quality findings

Closed within agreed timelines

CI participation

% of employees who submitted or delivered an improvement

Targets are indicative. They will be finalised in the hub SLA framework and country baselines. 

TECHNICAL SKILLS

- Performance management and command-centre design for multi-tower shared services. 
 - Lean Six Sigma methods, including DMAIC, value-stream mapping and root-cause analysis. 
 - Data analytics and visualisation (Power BI or Tableau). SQL or data-modelling skills are an advantage. 
 - Process mining (Celonis, Signavio or similar) and automation pipeline management (RPA, AI). 
 - ITIL service level management and quality management systems. 
 - Benefits realisation and business case development. 

LEADERSHIP COMPETENCIES

Customer-centric leadership

- Builds teams from zero
 - Drives change and adoption
 - Sound judgement under pressure
 - Influences without authority across countries
 - Data-led decision making
 - Coaches and develops talent
 - Holds a high bar on control

Essential

EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATIONS

- 15+ years of experience, including 7+ years in shared services performance, excellence or transformation roles. 
 - Has built and run an ICC, command centre or equivalent governance function. 
 - Has deployed continuous improvement frameworks across multi-tower shared services centres. 
 - Lean Six Sigma Black Belt. 
 - Master's degree in Business, HR, Engineering or a related field. 

Preferred

- Transition PMO experience
 - Process mining certification
 - Change management certification (Prosci or equivalent)

KEY STAKEHOLDERS

Hub Director, all tower GPOs, Global HR leadership, HR technology and data teams, Finance, Internal Audit, transformation partners.

data.title: Linux Kernel & Virtualization Manager — Memory Management, QA, Scheduler, Power Management
data.description:
WHAT YOU DO AT AMD CHANGES EVERYTHING

At AMD, our mission is to build great products that accelerate next-generation computing experiences-from AI and data centers, to PCs, gaming and embedded systems. Grounded in a culture of innovation and collaboration, we believe real progress comes from bold ideas, human ingenuity and a shared passion to create something extraordinary. When you join AMD, you'll discover the real differentiator is our culture. We push the limits of innovation to solve the world's most important challenges-striving for execution excellence, while being direct, humble, collaborative, and inclusive of diverse perspectives. Join us as we shape the future of AI and beyond. Together, we advance your career. 

The Role

We are looking for a passionate, dedicated, and technically strong first-line manager to lead a team of highly skilled Linux kernel engineers developing core CPU and SOC features for AMD EPYCTM processors in the data center. In this role you will guide and direct the technical activities of the team across key kernel subsystems - Memory Management, Scheduler, Power Management - and own the Quality Assurance practices that ensure this work is upstream-ready and production-quality. Your team's scope also includes pre-silicon validation of new AMD hardware, performance optimization, and both internal and customer debug. You will bring an understanding of computer architecture and operating system concepts for the x86-64 architecture, drive feature design and development in the Linux kernel and related open source projects, and help bring new generations of AMD hardware to market. This is a highly collaborative role: you will work closely with remote engineering staff across India, the U. S. , and Europe to set direction, remove obstacles, and grow the careers of the engineers you lead. 

The Person

An experienced kernel engineering leader with strong analysis and problem-solving skills, who delivers responsive and efficient solutions that bring new AMD processors to market. You combine technical credibility in Linux kernel development with the people-leadership skills to build, coach, and scale a high-performing team. You engage proven technical collaboration to guide AMD hardware enablement for new-generation CPUs, and you bring excellent written and verbal communication skills to work with local and remote teams, analyze system requirements, and coordinate feature design and development across groups. You thrive in a matrix-managed, fast-paced, quality-driven, and innovative engineering organization, working effectively with peer managers and experienced subject matter experts, and you take ownership of both your team's technical results and its members' growth. 

Key Responsibilities

Lead and develop a team of highly skilled Linux kernel engineers, including hiring, coaching, performance management, planning, task prioritization, and communication of status. Drive features and functionality across core kernel subsystems - Memory Management, Scheduler, and Power Management - while owning the Quality Assurance strategy that keeps the team's contributions robust, well-tested, and upstream-ready. Lead pre-silicon validation of new AMD hardware, drive performance optimization of the platform, and resolve internal and customer debug issues. Guide the team through code review, unit and integration test development, and detailed documentation. Work collaboratively with remote engineering staff across India, the U. S. , and Europe, partnering effectively with peer managers and experienced subject matter experts, and represent your team's work and priorities across the broader organization. 

Preferred Experience

- Proven record of technical and team leadership, including people management and collaboration with remote, geographically distributed teams
 - Ability to work collaboratively with remote engineering staff across India, the U. S. , and Europe
 - Ability to work effectively within a matrix-managed organization, partnering with peer managers and experienced subject matter experts
 - Solid understanding and experience with the Linux kernel and related upstream development workflow, including one or more of Memory Management, Scheduler, and Power Management subsystems
 - Experience defining and driving Quality Assurance practices for kernel or systems software (test development, CI, performance and regression testing)
 - Experience with pre-silicon validation and with internal and customer debug
 - Experience with performance optimization - running, analyzing, and tuning system performance benchmarks
 - Background in C programming for operating system kernel and systems development is useful; hands-on development is not a primary function of this role (experience with Rust is a plus)
 - Experience with open source software development - building and submitting patches on a mailing list, and working with external software partners and communities
 - Deep understanding of operating systems concepts, data structures, and x86-64 architecture
 - Exposure to KVM/QEMU (including x86-64 virtualization extensions) is a plus
 - Experience with the GNU toolchain and proficient use of git
 - Experience with low-level debug tools, emulators, and simulators
 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills
 - Ability to thrive in a matrix-managed, fast-paced, quality-driven, and innovative engineering organization

Academic Credentials

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or another relevant field

Benefits offered are described: AMD benefits at a glance. 

AMD does not accept unsolicited resumes from headhunters, recruitment agencies, or fee-based recruitment services. AMD and its subsidiaries are equal opportunity, inclusive employers and will consider all applicants without regard to age, ancestry, color, marital status, medical condition, mental or physical disability, national origin, race, religion, political and/or third-party affiliation, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We encourage applications from all qualified candidates and will accommodate applicants' needs under the respective laws throughout all stages of the recruitment and selection process. 

AMD may use Artificial Intelligence to help screen, assess or select applicants for this position. AMD's "Responsible AI Policy" is available here. 

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

data.title: Verification Engineer, DMTS/SMTS/MTS
data.description:
Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all. 

Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead verification strategy, architecture, and execution across RTL, AMS (Analog Mixed-Signal), and Transistor-Level Verification (TAV) domains, driving key technical decisions throughout the product lifecycle. 
 - Define and implement verification methodologies, test plans, coverage strategies, and debug flows to ensure first-pass silicon success and high product quality. 
 - Collaborate with global cross-functional teams including design, product engineering, validation, and CAD/EDA groups to establish and deploy best-known verification practices. 
 - Develop, maintain, and enhance verification environments using SystemVerilog, UVM, SPICE/HSPICE, FineSim, Verilog, and related industry-standard tools.

data.title: Director of Digital Design Engineering, Memory Interface IP
data.description:
Job Title

- Director of Digital Design Engineering, Memory Interface IP

We Are

Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow. 

You Are

You have spent years deep in the world of high-speed memory interfaces, where timing closure is measured in picoseconds and a single protocol violation can sink a tape-out. You know HBM, DDR, and LPDDR not as acronyms but as living systems with tradeoffs you have navigated across multiple generations. Leading a design team is not about holding status meetings. It is about knowing when to step into a critical path issue at 4 p. m. on a Friday and when to let your engineers own the solution. You have built teams that ship, and you know the difference between a group that executes and one that just stays busy. 

You do not manage from a distance. You review RTL, you ask the hard questions during design reviews, and you push back when a verification plan is too thin or a schedule is built on hope. At the same time, you trust your people, you clear obstacles, and you create space for them to do their best work. You have worked with executive stakeholders and you can translate a technical risk into a business decision without losing the engineering substance. At Synopsys, you will lead a team building memory interface IP that powers the next wave of AI and high-performance compute. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Lead a team of ASIC digital design and verification engineers working on HBM, DDR, and LPDDR memory interface IP
 - Own the technical direction and execution of RTL design and verification at both block and chip integration levels
 - Drive design reviews, architecture decisions, and quality checkpoints across the full development cycle from spec to silicon
 - Collaborate with cross-functional teams including analog design, DFT, physical design, and product management to align on specifications, schedules, and deliverables
 - Build and refine design and verification methodologies, incorporating AI-driven tools and automation to improve efficiency and quality
 - Manage project timelines, resource allocation, and risk mitigation to deliver on schedule and within scope
 - Mentor and develop engineers, providing technical guidance and career growth opportunities across the team

The Impact You Will Have

- Deliver memory interface IP that enables the next generation of AI accelerators, data center processors, and high-performance SoCs
 - Raise the bar for design quality and verification coverage across one of the most performance-critical IP domains in the industry
 - Shape the technical roadmap for high-speed memory controllers that will be integrated into products shipping at scale
 - Build a high-performing team culture where engineers grow, ship complex designs, and solve hard problems together
 - Accelerate time to market by driving adoption of advanced methodologies, automation, and AI-assisted design flows
 - Strengthen Synopsys' leadership position in memory interface IP by delivering differentiated, production-proven solutions
 - Influence product strategy and customer engagements through deep technical insight and execution credibility

What You'll Need

- 15 - 20+ years of experience in ASIC digital design and verification, with significant hands-on work in memory interface IP such as HBM, DDR, or LPDDR
 - Proven track record leading engineering teams through full product development cycles from architecture to silicon bring-up
 - Deep expertise in RTL design, verification methodologies, and design closure for high-speed digital interfaces
 - Strong understanding of memory protocols, PHY/controller architecture, signal integrity, and timing closure challenges
 - Experience managing cross-functional collaboration with analog, physical design, and product teams
 - Demonstrated ability to communicate technical risks, tradeoffs, and project status to executive leadership and stakeholders
 - Experience with AI-driven design tools or a strong interest in integrating AI into design and verification flows is a plus

Who You Are

- You can walk into a design review, spot the gap in a verification plan or a timing assumption, and ask the question that changes the outcome
 - You build teams that want to work for you because you clear the path, give honest feedback, and celebrate the wins that matter
 - You are comfortable making hard calls under uncertainty, whether it is a schedule tradeoff, a resource decision, or a technical pivot
 - You do not wait for perfect information to act, you gather what you need, align the right people, and move forward with clarity
 - You care about the details but you do not micromanage, you know when to zoom in and when to let your engineers own the problem

data.title: R&D Engineering, Sr Manager
data.description:
We Are

Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow. 

You Are

You have spent a decade building embedded memory IP that actually ships in production silicon, not just test chips that look good in papers. Managing teams through the full arc of SRAM, register file, and TCAM development has taught you that the hardest decisions happen early, at the architecture and bit cell level, and you have learned to guide engineers toward choices that hold up through tapeout and beyond. 

You think in tradeoffs. Power versus area, speed versus yield, custom circuit elegance versus compiler automation constraints. When a layout is failing timing or a bit cell is not meeting yield targets at 3nm, you do not panic or wait for more data. You pull the team together, dig into the SPICE decks, and find the path forward. 

Leading engineers across circuit design, physical implementation, and characterization means you speak multiple technical languages fluently. You can review a sense amplifier schematic in the morning, debug a Perl-based compiler flow after lunch, and walk a junior engineer through FinFET variation analysis before you leave. Your team trusts you because you have done the work and because you make them better at theirs. 

At Synopsys, you will lead memory IP development that powers the most advanced semiconductor designs in the world. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Lead a cross-functional team through the complete embedded memory development cycle, from bit cell analysis and architecture definition through circuit design, layout, verification, characterization, and model generation
 - Drive SRAM, register file, TCAM, and ROM compiler development, balancing performance, power, area, and yield across advanced FinFET technology nodes
 - Own schematic entry, transistor-level simulation, layout planning, and interface with CAD teams for full physical verification and timing model delivery
 - Design and implement low-power, area-efficient memory circuits and architectures optimized for deep submicron and FinFET process variations
 - Coordinate daily activities across your engineering team, prioritize workloads across multiple concurrent projects, and proactively address issues impacting schedule or quality
 - Collaborate with internal teams and external customers to resolve technical challenges, align on solutions, and ensure memory IP meets functional and performance requirements
 - Ramp quickly on existing flows, identify gaps or inefficiencies, and produce actionable work plans that drive projects to completion on aggressive timelines

The Impact You Will Have

- Your team will deliver production-ready memory compilers that enable customers to build complex SoCs at the most advanced process nodes
 - Architectural and circuit decisions you guide will directly affect power, performance, and area outcomes in chips used across AI, mobile, automotive, and data center applications
 - Memory IP you ship will be integrated into designs at scale, affecting yield, time-to-market, and product success for Synopsys customers globally
 - Process improvements and automation you implement will increase team productivity and reduce development cycle time across future memory platforms
 - Engineers you mentor will grow their skills in advanced circuit design, FinFET technology, and memory compiler automation, strengthening the team's long-term capability
 - Technical solutions you drive will resolve cross-discipline challenges spanning circuit design, physical implementation, characterization, and modeling
 - Your ability to deliver on schedule will enable downstream teams in verification, integration, and customer engagement to execute without delay

What You'll Need

- 10+ years of hands-on experience in embedded memory design, covering architecture, circuit design, physical implementation, compiler automation, characterization, and model generation
 - BE/B. Tech/ME/M. Tech/MS in Electrical and Electronics Engineering
 - Deep expertise in SRAM and register file architectures, including custom circuit techniques for sense amplifiers, write drivers, decoders, and bit cells
 - Direct experience designing memory IP in advanced FinFET technology nodes, with strong understanding of variation-aware design, leakage management, and yield optimization
 - Proficiency in scripting using Perl and Python for automation of design flows, characterization, and model generation
 - Solid grounding in CMOS fundamentals, RC circuit analysis, digital design, and analog circuit basics, with practical application in memory design contexts
 - Proven ability to lead engineering teams, manage multiple projects simultaneously, and deliver complex IP on schedule in a cross-site, multi-discipline environment

Who You Are

- You can walk into a design review, spot the issue in a timing path or a layout bottleneck, and guide the engineer toward a fix without taking over their work
 - When a project is behind schedule or facing a technical roadblock, you do not wait for escalation. You pull the right people together, frame the problem clearly, and drive to a decision
 - You are comfortable saying no when a proposed solution will not scale, will not meet yield, or will create problems six months downstream, and you can explain why in terms the team understands
 - Mentoring engineers is not a side task for you. You actively invest in growing your team's skills, whether that means reviewing their SPICE simulations in detail or walking them through FinFET device physics
 - You communicate technical tradeoffs effectively to senior internal stakeholders and external customers, translating circuit-level complexity into clear business and performance implications
 - You stay current with advances in memory design, process technology, and EDA tooling, and you bring that knowledge back to your team in practical, applicable ways

The Team You'll Be Part Of

Your recruiter will share more about the team structure and mission during the interview process. 

Rewards and Benefits

We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

data.title: Staff Streaming/Messaging Infra Engineer
data.description:
At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader - we're changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We're committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts. 

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work - every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet. 

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers - and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all. 

About the Team and the Role Join the infrastructure engineering team responsible for building, scaling, and operating eBay's core messaging and real-time streaming platforms. Our infrastructure powers mission-critical, high-throughput applications across eBay's global ecosystem. 

In this role, you will act as a core developer and architect, taking full ownership of both the control plane and data plane for our distributed streaming platforms-including Apache Flink and Apache Kafka-deployed across multiple private cloud Kubernetes clusters spanning various Availability Zones (AZs) and Data Centers (DCs). You will also play a key role in designing and evolving our next-generation streaming lakehouse storage systems. 

What You'll do

- Build a cloud-native distributed systems: Design and develop core Streaming components, supporting independent scaling, high availability, and fault tolerance. 
 - Solve distributed systems challenges: Design and implement replication, consistency, crash recovery, failover, and distributed coordination mechanisms. 
 - Build Streaming Lakehouses: Lead the design and development of our real-time streaming lakehouse storage architecture, enabling low-latency analytical workloads at massive scale. 
 - Ensure Operational Excellence: Drive high availability, automated fault recovery, and zero-downtime operations for large-scale production streaming topologies. 
 - Enhance System Observability: Advance enterprise monitoring, distributed tracing, automated alerting, and failure-diagnosis tooling to maximize platform uptime. 
 - Collaborate Globally: Partner with cross-functional architecture and platform teams worldwide to shape the future of eBay's real-time data ecosystem. 
 - Leverage AI-assisted engineering: Use modern AI coding agents to accelerate development, testing, debugging, and validation while maintaining high engineering standards. 

What We're Looking For

data.title: Senior Frontend Engineer (React + Chrome Extension)
data.description:
TTEC Digital seeks a Senior Frontend Engineer (React + Chrome Extension) to join our team. This role is a full-time and fully remote opportunity!

The work: 
We're an innovation group inside TTEC (NASDAQ: TTEC), building the next generation of AI CX tools - automated QA, conversational analytics, knowledge assist, and agentic automation - for the world's biggest brands and the millions of customers they serve. We move like an early-stage startup, backed by the scale, distribution, and enterprise client base of a company that's been obsessed with customer experience since 1982. 

This is the rare seat where getting in early actually matters at scale. TTEC is a public company at an AI inflection point. Ship the right products into thousands of live enterprise deployments and you don't just move a metric - you move the trajectory of the company and the value of the stock. The leverage is real, and the work compounds. 

Who we hire - the DNA: 

- Self-starters and do-ers with grit - hackers in the best sense, with a startup mentality and a show-me bias: working software over slides, prototypes over proposals. 
 - Want to learn, love new technology. This platform is built on the latest technology, and that technology changes and advances monthly. You adapt to change quickly - new tools, new models, new priorities - without drama. 
 - Master debuggers and problem solvers. You love solving complex problems, you think outside the box, and you multitask across domains without losing the thread. 
 - AI-native. You work with AI on all levels - you understand the technology around you (LLMs, SLMs, RAG, knowledge graphs, agents, training, eval) and you use AI tools daily to exponentially increase your velocity. 
 - Distributed-systems literate. High-efficiency, event-driven, low-latency systems are our world; you understand what that demands. 
 - Innovators who ship. You demonstrate ideas easily, fail fast, and move forward. You make committed timelines and hit them. 
 - You consider yourself exceptional - and you like winning. So do we. 
 - No one will have everything in this description. We're looking for well-rounded, smart people who move fast

What You Will Do: 
The role: 

- Build the Agent UI shell, the Chrome extension, the slide-out / pill workspace, the Control UI, and the per-module panels
 - This is the product wedge - what an evaluator demos in 5 minutes and decides "yes. "
 - Real-time UI over live voice, desktop, and AI event streams, in a startup environment: 1-week sprints, Friday demos, fail fast and move forward. 

What you'll own: 

- React app + Chrome extension (Manifest V3, content scripts, injected iframe, page-overlay pill)
 - WebSocket-driven real-time UI
 - plugin / module-federation patterns
 - Screen-real-estate management
 - The design system in code
 - Your committed timelines. 

Who you are: 

- A self-starter with a show-me mentality - you move from prototype to real-world product quickly and demonstrate ideas with working UI, not mockups
 - You love new technology and adapt fast when it changes
 - Consistent by discipline: you use shared libraries and established patterns instead of reinventing per feature - consistency is what keeps a small team fast
 - You use AI tools daily to multiply your velocity
 - You consider yourself exceptional, love solving hard problems, and like winning. 

What You Will Bring: 

- 7+ years frontend; senior-level React + TypeScript mandatory. HTML5, JavaScript, and graphics skills all ++++ - 
 - You're a master of the browser platform itself, not just a framework user (canvas/SVG/WebGL, animation, rendering). 
 - Strong design/UI skills a +++ - you have taste; your UIs look and feel professional without a designer holding your hand. 
 - Real Chrome Extension experience - Manifest V3, content scripts, the messaging model, injecting UI over a host page. This is core, not a footnote. 
 - Strong API skills - you design and consume clean APIs, and you understand the backend messaging systems behind them (pub/sub, event streams, WebSocket) well enough to reason about ordering, reconnects, and state sync. 
 - Heavy WebSocket / real-time UI; you've built interfaces that update from a live event stream. 
 - Plugin / module-federation or dynamic-component-loading experience. 
 - Performance as a habit - render profiling, virtualization for dense data, sub-frame updates under a firehose event stream; the UI must never be the latency bottleneck. 
 - State management under streaming data - optimistic updates, reconnect/replay handling, conflict resolution. 
 - Extension security fluency - CSP, sandboxing, isolated worlds; we inject UI into other companies' pages and can never break or leak. 
 - Automated UI testing (Playwright-class) as part of shipping, not a QA handoff. 
 - Accessibility and keyboard-first flows as defaults - agents live in this UI 8 hours a day. 
 - A master debugger in the browser - DevTools is an extension of your hands; you see the render bug, the leak, the layout thrash. 
 - Go literacy is a plus (you'll read it). 

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

data.title: Sr. Principal Engineer, Emulation & IP Verification
data.description:
We Are

Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow. 

You Are

You have spent 15 years learning that emulation is not just about running tests faster, it is about finding the bugs that matter before they cost millions in silicon respins. The difference between a verification plan that looks complete and one that actually catches corner cases is something you can spot in the first ten minutes of a review. You know PCIe, DDR, and Ethernet at the protocol level, not just the spec level, because you have debugged enough real failures to understand where theory and implementation diverge. 

Working with Zebu is second nature to you. You have built emulation environments that bridge the gap between what the platform can do and what your design team actually needs. When someone says "the emulation IP does not support that feature, " you do not stop there. You figure out the workaround, propose the enhancement, or find another path entirely. 

You operate comfortably across geographies and functions. Design teams, verification teams, IP teams, they all speak slightly different languages, and you translate between them without losing the technical thread. Matrixed organizations do not slow you down because you know how to build consensus without waiting for perfect alignment. At Synopsys, you will define how we validate the next generation of high-speed interfaces, and the IP you help verify will ship in products that power everything from data centers to autonomous systems. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Close the gap between Zebu emulation IP capabilities and what Design IP teams need to verify PCIe, DDR, and Ethernet controllers and PHYs across functional and performance domains
 - Define technical requirements for emulation IP, working directly with IP development teams to ensure correct implementation, deployment, and integration into verification flows
 - Track and report emulation IP quality metrics, identifying trends, gaps, and improvement opportunities that directly impact product schedules and silicon success
 - Stay ahead of evolving PCIe, DDR, and Ethernet standards, translating specification updates, ECNs, and errata into actionable requirements for both emulation and design teams
 - Review and validate test plans for emulation IP and design IP, ensuring coverage is complete, traceable, and aligned with real-world use cases and customer requirements
 - Drive cross-functional alignment on verification methodology, standardizing workflows and best practices across global teams to improve efficiency and reduce rework
 - Mentor engineers on emulation strategy, IP verification techniques, and how to think critically about coverage and quality in pre-silicon environments

The Impact You Will Have

- Accelerate time to market for high-speed interface IP by catching critical bugs in emulation before they reach silicon
 - Influence the roadmap and feature set of Synopsys emulation IP, shaping tools that thousands of engineers across the company depend on
 - Elevate verification quality across multiple product lines by defining and evangelizing best practices that become the standard
 - Reduce costly silicon respins by ensuring emulation environments accurately model real-world system behavior and corner cases
 - Build bridges between geographically distributed teams, turning fragmented verification efforts into cohesive, repeatable strategies
 - Position Synopsys as the industry leader in pre-silicon validation by driving adoption of cutting-edge emulation techniques
 - Enable the next generation of AI, automotive, and data center products by ensuring the IP that powers them is verified to the highest standard

What You'll Need

- 15+ years of hands-on experience in emulation, IP verification, or ASIC digital design
 - Deep expertise in PCIe and DDR protocols, including verification strategies, corner cases, and standards compliance
 - Extensive experience with Zebu or similar emulation platforms, particularly for IP-level verification and system-level integration
 - Proven track record leading or contributing to IP product development with a focus on emulation-based verification
 - Strong ability to work across global, matrixed teams and drive alignment between emulation IP and design IP organizations
 - Excellent communication skills, you can explain a complex tradeoff to a design lead in two sentences without losing the nuance
 - Experience interpreting and applying industry standards updates, ECNs, and errata in real verification contexts is a strong plus

Who You Are

- You can walk into a test plan review, spot the missing corner case that everyone else missed, and explain why it matters in two sentences
 - When something does not work in emulation, you do not wait for someone else to fix it. You dig in, reproduce it, and come back with a proposal
 - You are comfortable saying "this verification strategy will not catch that class of bugs" in a room full of senior engineers, and you can back it up with data
 - Ambiguity does not slow you down. You ask the right questions, make reasonable assumptions, document them, and keep moving
 - You have mentored engineers before and you know the difference between giving someone the answer and helping them learn how to find it
 - You treat verification like a product. You think about the user experience, the failure modes, and what happens six months from now when someone else has to maintain what you built

The Team You'll Be Part Of

You will join a dynamic, high-performing engineering team focused on IP development, emulation, and verification at the forefront of semiconductor innovation. Our team is collaborative, cross-functional, and globally distributed, working together to solve complex challenges and deliver industry-leading solutions. You will have the opportunity to collaborate with experts across multiple domains, drive impactful initiatives, and shape the future of digital design and verification at Synopsys. 

Rewards and Benefits

We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

data.title: SSD Firmware & Software Lead/Architect (10-15+)
data.description:
Company Description ChipSilica is a specialized technology company focused on PCIe and related high-speed interconnect protocols, including CXL, UALink, Ethernet, DDR and UCIe. The team supports customers in designing and developing switches, retimers, and SoCs that rely on advanced PCIe-based architectures. By combining deep protocol expertise with practical implementation experience, ChipSilica helps organizations build reliable, high-performance solutions. The company collaborates closely with clients to address complex design challenges and accelerate product development. 

Role: Lead / Architect - SSD Firmware & Software Engineering

Experience: 10-15+ years (relevant hands-on experience)

Location: Bangalore, India

Employment Type: Full-time

Role Description

We are looking for an experienced SSD Firmware & Software Architect to lead the complete firmware and software development of a next-generation SSD controller. 

The candidate will own the end-to-end software stack, covering device-side firmware, host-side drivers, low-level hardware interfaces, system software and software validation. 

The role involves close collaboration with our RTL Design, Design Verification, FPGA, Physical Design and DFT teams to develop and validate the SSD controller, starting from FPGA-based prototyping and progressing towards silicon bring-up and production. 

This is a hands-on technical leadership position. The candidate will be responsible for defining the software architecture, establishing development methodologies and eventually building and leading the firmware and software engineering team. 

Key Responsibilities

- SSD Controller Firmware Development: Architect, develop and lead device-side firmware for SSD controllers. Develop low-level firmware for controller initialization, hardware configuration, command processing and device management. 
 - Host-Side Software & Driver Development: Develop and integrate host-side software for SSD controller interfacing. Experience with PCIe-based host-controller communication and device enumeration. Develop, customize and debug Linux device drivers and kernel-level interfaces wherever required. 
 - Low-Level Software & Hardware Bring-up: Develop bare-metal firmware and/or RTOS-based embedded software. 
 - FPGA Prototyping & Validation: Lead firmware and software development for FPGA-based SSD controller prototypes
 - Silicon Bring-up & Productization: Lead firmware bring-up on first silicon in collaboration with RTL, PD and DFT teams. Develop initial boot firmware and hardware initialization sequences. Debug silicon-level issues involving PCIe, NAND interfaces, memory controllers, DMA and other controller subsystems. 
 - Architecture & Technical Leadership: Define the complete SSD software architecture and technology roadmap

Required Technical Skills

Strong experience in embedded firmware development using C and C++. 

Strong understanding of computer architecture, microcontrollers, SoCs and hardware-software interfaces. 

Hands-on experience with bare-metal firmware and/or RTOS-based development. 

Strong understanding of PCIe and NVMe protocols. 

Experience with SSD controller firmware or storage subsystem development. 

Understanding of NAND Flash architecture and flash management techniques. 

Experience with Linux kernel, device drivers and storage subsystems. 

Strong understanding of DMA, interrupts, memory-mapped I/O and low-level peripheral interfaces. 

Experience in firmware debugging, hardware bring-up and system-level integration. 

Ability to work with RTL, DV and FPGA teams during hardware-software co-development.

An Overview Of This Role

As a Staff Software Engineer, you'll help lead two important areas for GitLab Security: the data layer behind our vulnerability and dependency management capabilities, and our move toward services outside the GitLab monolith. You'll design and develop systems that ingest, store, index, and query security report data, including integrations with key third-party systems. With a strong focus on PostgreSQL and scalable backend design, your work will support security features delivered by teams across GitLab. 

You'll take ownership of large deliverables from early ideas through implementation, working directly with product, design, frontend, and engineering partners to shape the technical and product roadmap. You'll stay hands-on across GitLab's Ruby on Rails application and newer services, including greenfield projects, while helping the team build its expertise in modular service design. 

What You'll Do

- Lead large technical deliverables from initial problem definition through delivery, often across multiple months or quarters. 
 - Design and develop backend systems for vulnerability and dependency management, including security report ingestion, storage, indexing, querying, and integrations with key third-party systems. 
 - Build and improve systems using Ruby on Rails and PostgreSQL, and contribute to newer services using technologies such as Go or Rust where appropriate. 
 - Shape technical plans, break down complex work, and help other engineers deliver effectively. 
 - Work directly with product, design, frontend, and engineering partners to make clear decisions, resolve constraints, and deliver measurable progress. 
 - Influence the team's product and technical roadmap through hands-on investigation, clear proposals, and iterative delivery that demonstrates progress in each monthly release cycle. 
 - Apply a security mindset when designing systems, including considering how GitLab identifies and handles malicious or vulnerable software packages. 
 - Define patterns for modular services, provide technical leadership when vulnerability management work spans multiple GitLab areas, and share that expertise across GitLab Security. 

What You'll Bring

- Experience leading complex backend projects from idea through delivery while remaining hands-on with design and development. 
 - Strong PostgreSQL experience, including evidence of query optimization, table optimization, and write-ahead log management in data-intensive systems. 
 - Strong professional experience with Ruby on Rails or Go and comfort working in Ruby on Rails day to day. Experience with large monoliths is helpful, along with an interest in working across languages and services.

 - Experience with large-scale data systems or established software products. We welcome transferable experience from outside the security domain. 
 - Fluency in using artificial intelligence tools to improve delivery while applying sound engineering judgment. 

About The Team

The Vulnerability Management team contributes to GitLab's move toward modular services and will help other Security teams adopt these patterns over time. Today, we include two Staff Software Engineers, two Senior Software Engineers, and one Intermediate Software Engineer across the United Kingdom, Poland, the Netherlands, and India. You'll work closely with us, product partners, and engineering leaders across GitLab.

The selected SRE and DevOps professional will be responsible for maintaining highly available production systems, managing cloud infrastructure, improving observability, and supporting reliable deployment and operations practices. The role combines hands-on engineering with incident response, infrastructure automation, performance optimization, and continuous reliability improvement. 

The ideal candidate should have experience working in production-critical environments where system availability, quick incident resolution, effective monitoring, and preventive engineering are essential. 

Key Responsibilities1. Site Reliability and Production Operations

- Monitor production systems and maintain service availability, performance, and operational stability. 
 - Participate in production support and scheduled on-call rotations, including the resolution of critical incidents. 
 - Investigate system failures, perform root cause analysis, document post-incident findings, and implement preventive measures. 
 - Identify recurring operational issues and reduce manual intervention through automation. 
 - Improve service reliability using measurable indicators, service objectives, availability targets, and error-budget practices. 
 - Contribute to capacity planning, disaster recovery, high availability, redundancy, and failover strategies. 
 - Cloud Infrastructure and Platform Engineering
 - Manage and optimize cloud infrastructure across Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services (AWS), and/or Google Cloud Platform (GCP). 
 - Work with cloud compute, storage, networking, access management, monitoring, and cloud-native services. 
 - Support containerized applications and manage Kubernetes-based infrastructure, including AKS, EKS, GKE, or equivalent platforms. 
 - Troubleshoot cluster health, application workloads, resource utilization, scaling, networking, and deployment-related issues. 
 - Work with Helm and other relevant deployment tools to maintain consistent application releases. 
 - Infrastructure Automation and DevOps
 - Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform. 
 - Support automated infrastructure provisioning, configuration management, and repeatable deployment processes. 
 - Work with Git-based development workflows, including GitHub, GitLab, Azure Repos, or equivalent platforms. 
 - Contribute to CI/CD pipelines and improve deployment reliability through automation. 
 - Develop scripts using Python and/or Bash to simplify operational activities and eliminate repetitive tasks. 
 - Monitoring, Observability and Performance
 - Build and maintain monitoring, logging, metrics, tracing, and alerting solutions for production environments. 
 - Work with observability platforms such as OpenTelemetry, Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, Azure Monitor, Golden Signals(including Latency, errors, traffic, saturation), AWS CloudWatch, and GCP Cloud Monitoring. 
 - Apply the four Golden Signals-latency, traffic, errors, and saturation-to monitor service health and identify performance issues. 
 - Improve distributed tracing and establish meaningful alerts that reflect actual system health and user impact. 
 - Investigate performance bottlenecks across infrastructure, applications, networks, and distributed systems. 
 - Linux, Networking and Security
 - Troubleshoot Linux-based systems and production infrastructure issues. 
 - Apply networking fundamentals, including DNS, TCP/IP, load balancing, SSL/TLS, and connectivity troubleshooting. 
 - Follow cloud security best practices for identity and access management, network segmentation, and secrets management. 
 - Support vulnerability remediation, security improvements, and compliance-related activities in collaboration with relevant teams. 

Technical Environment

The role involves cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, Terraform, scripting, production support, monitoring, and modern reliability engineering practices. Experience with one major cloud platform is important, while exposure to multiple cloud environments can be beneficial. 

Additional exposure to Go (Golang), OpenSearch, ELK Stack, AI/ML production platforms, Azure AI services, AI Foundry, RAG-based workloads, and enterprise observability frameworks would be advantageous. 

Skills: github, sre, production engineering, incident management, troubleshooting, capacity planning, sla, sre & production operations, mttr, gitlab, aws, kubernetes & containerization, error budgets, opentelemetry, iac, terraform, toil reduction, ms azure, rca, cloud infrastructure, python, golang, 24/7 production support, sli, golden signals, slo, gcp, linux system, devops

data.description:
Work Schedule

Standard (Mon-Fri)

Environmental Conditions

Office

Staff Engineer, Software V&V At Thermo Fisher, our mission is to cure cancer with genomic data. It is a close-knit, collaborative, cross-functional setting where we believe none of us is as smart as all of us and we each have something valuable to contribute toward our goal. The software services team is tasked with applying industry best practices to the design, development, and deployment of world-class software products. We are looking to hire individuals with experience with software development and test engineering in clinical and research settings, and who can help us solve the next wave of technical challenges using the latest cloud-based, big-data, and rich analytics toolsets. We are seeking enthusiastic Leader in Software Verification and Validation who will define scope, design, for automated and manual tests for highly advanced bioinformatics software. We require strong coding skills as well as a solid understanding of Quality Assurance principles and Continuous Integration methods. You will drive writing positive and negative smoke and regression test scripts to test product functionality and integration with dependencies. You will drive strategies for test APIs, user interfaces, web services, and/or web apps and write performance, load, and stress tests. You are excited and passionate about participating in an Agile/SCRUM setting to meet and exceed customer expectations and continuously drive towards quality improvements. You like the idea of partnering with users and other team members to brainstorm the best possible approaches to validating systems. You welcome the challenge of working in a fast-paced, discovery-oriented environment and will be genuinely excited about the prospect of creatively exercising your problem-solving skills continuously to ultimately improve the human condition. Essential Functions: 

- Develop and implement software testing Strategy, Methods and Best Practices that allow high quality NGS analytics and instruments software products to be designed, developed, and released into the regulated in-vitro diagnostics/ medical device space. 
 - Lead and mentor a group of bioinformatics and software test engineers. 
 - Establish software quality standards and KPI metrics to actively measure software and bioinformatics product quality. Implement software quality tracking tools and methodologies to provide on-going visibility and action during software product development lifecycle. 
 - Single point of contact while working with external partners to deliver state of the art Software products in market. 
 - Partner with software and bioinformatics leadership, functional and project managers to identify appropriate scope of software testing, verification and validation required for a project and managing the overall testing activities for projects. 
 - Partner with internal and external stakeholders to drive the requirements for regulated assays and software. Help software development team to understand the complex informatics and visualization requirements leading into design implementation Minimum Qualifications (must have): 
 - Masters/PhD preferred or Bachelors with minimum 10+ years of work experience and strong track record of industry productivity
 - 10+ experience performing software verification and validation testing, preferably in the medical device/ biotech space
 - Strong understanding of NGS-based regulated software, IVD assay development practices and informatics data analysis pipelines. 
 - Strong leadership abilities and extensive experience managing the activities of software quality engineering and assurance teams. Experience leading cross-functional, multi-site teams preferred. 
 - Practical experience as a leader in the use of modern software development methodologies/ processes with an ability to direct the use of resources to meet department goals
 - Good understanding in design control for regulated products (e. g. US-IVD, IVD-D, IVD-R, China and Japan regulations) and knowledge of applicable regulations and standards used in IVD and medical device software development (e. g. ISO 13485, IEC 62304, and 21 CFR 820). 
 - Ability to work well with senior leadership. 
 - Experience working in a fast paced, dynamic environment.

 - Good understanding in design control for regulated products (e. g. US-IVD, IVD-D, IVD-R, China and Japan regulations) and knowledge of applicable regulations and standards used in IVD and medical device software development (e. g. ISO 13485, IEC 62304, and 21 CFR 820).
