data.title: Senior Software Engineer I
data.description:
Job Description

As a Senior Software Engineer I, you will help advance Mission Control's Automation First strategy by engineering scalable, reliable automation capabilities that reduce operational toil, accelerate incident remediation, and improve service availability. This role will focus on building and evolving automation solutions across the Mission Control ecosystem, including using automation framework Incident Pilot, AIOps integrations, event-driven remediation workflows, self-healing patterns, observability-driven triggers, and automation enablement during onboarding. You will partner closely with Operations Engineering, Tools Engineering, SRE, App Support, and onboarding teams to convert repeatable production support activities into governed, measurable, and resilient automations. 

Responsibilities

- Design, build, and support automation capabilities that enable Mission Control to detect, triage, repair, and validate incidents with minimal manual intervention. 
 - Engineer event-driven workflows that connect observability signals, incident data, runbooks, and automation execution platforms to deliver consistent remediation outcomes. 
 - Advance inhouse automation framework IncidentPilot and related automation platforms by improving configuration workflows, routing logic, automation triggering, failure handling, auditability, reporting, and self-service capabilities. 
 - Partner with Mission Control onboarding teams to identify automatable SOPs and runbooks before or during onboarding, ensuring automation is embedded as a standard part of service transition. 
 - Build reusable automation patterns for self-healing, job retriggers, pod scaling, component-based validations, health checks, reroutes, incident enrichment, and operational notifications. 
 - Integrate automation solutions with platforms such as ServiceNow, event and incident pipelines, Kafka, Dynatrace, Splunk/ELF, Ansible, APIs, and enterprise workflow tools where applicable. 
 - Use AI-assisted engineering and AIOps capabilities responsibly to accelerate troubleshooting, automate configuration support, attach relevant SOPs, and identify new automation opportunities. 
 - Develop highly available, observable, and supportable services with clear telemetry, dashboards, alerts, operational runbooks, and failure recovery patterns. 
 - Establish engineering practices that ensure automation is safe, governed, testable, auditable, and aligned with enterprise controls and production readiness expectations. 
 - Monitor automation performance, adoption, success rates, exception paths, and operational savings to demonstrate measurable value and guide continuous improvement. 
 - Provide technical leadership and mentorship to engineers by reinforcing coding standards, testing discipline, design reviews, and responsible AI-assisted development practices. 
 - Collaborate across Mission Control, SRE, App Support, Observability, and enterprise platform teams to remove friction, standardize repeatable processes, and scale automation across domains. 

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or comparable experience. 6+ years of software engineering experience in a professional environment, with hands-on experience building production-grade services, integrations, scripts, APIs, or automation workflows using Java, Python, or similar technologies. 

- Experience designing, developing, testing, and supporting automation solutions for production operations, incident management, observability, or reliability engineering use cases. 
 - Knowledge of distributed, multi-tiered systems, algorithms, NoSQL databases, relational databases, APIs, and event-driven integration patterns. 
 - Experience implementing large-scale automations such as self-healing, pod scaling, job retriggers, component-based testing, health checks, incident enrichment, or automated rerouting. 
 - Experience with CI/CD environments and frameworks, including GitHub, Jenkins, automated testing, build pipelines, and deployment pipelines. 
 - Practical experience implementing integration solutions, including REST APIs, batch and real-time processing, Kafka, messaging platforms, or workflow orchestration tools. 
 - Understanding of observability and cloud-native principles, including monitoring, alerting, service discovery, circuit breakers, distributed tracing, dashboards, and operational telemetry. 
 - Experience translating SOPs, runbooks, incident patterns, and production support activities into reliable, repeatable automation workflows. 
 - Working knowledge of AI-enabled development tools, AIOps concepts, and responsible use of AI-assisted engineering workflows. 
 - Understanding of governance, access controls, auditability, error handling, and production readiness considerations for automation platforms. 
 - Experience with automated, functional, integration, and performance testing to validate automation correctness and stability. 
 - Ability to communicate technical designs, risks, tradeoffs, and operational impact clearly with engineering and operations partners. 
 - Strong analytical thinking, ownership, curiosity, continuous learning, and continuous improvement mindset. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience building or supporting incident automation platforms, workflow engines, event-driven remediation tools, or self-healing operational capabilities. 
 - Experience with Mission Control-adjacent tooling or patterns such as IncidentPilot, ServiceNow integrations, Event and Incident Pipelines, Kafka-based event ingestion, AIOps workflows, or observability-driven automation. 
 - Experience working with automation platforms such as Ansible, EAP-style execution platforms, runbook automation, or enterprise orchestration tools. 
 - Experience building production APIs, operational dashboards, reporting views, automation audit trails, or self-service configuration capabilities. 
 - Experience using AI to identify automation opportunities, improve incident triage, support SOP discovery, assist with configuration creation, or accelerate engineering delivery. 
 - Experience partnering with SRE, App Support, Operations Engineering, Observability, or onboarding teams to standardize support activities and reduce manual operational effort at scale.

Auditors

data.title: Senior Software Engineer
data.description:
Job Overview

Join the Central Engineering - Software team as a Senior System QA Engineer, helping to validate complex Linux server and SoC platforms. You will develop automated tests and investigate system-level issues across hardware, firmware and software, contributing to reliable platform bring-up, performance and long-duration stability. This role offers the opportunity to work across processor, memory, I/O, networking, storage, power and thermal technologies, collaborating with engineering teams to turn challenging failures into clear, actionable findings. 

Responsibilities

- Develop and maintain functional, performance, stress and stability tests for Linux server and SoC platforms. 
 - Create test automation, log-analysis tools and regression coverage using C/C++, Python and shell scripting. 
 - Validate and debug interactions across firmware, Linux kernel and device drivers, system management, networking, storage and hardware bring-up. 
 - Investigate failures found during system-level workloads and long-duration testing; gather evidence, identify likely root causes and communicate findings clearly to partner engineering teams. 
 - Exercise platform reliability, availability and serviceability features, telemetry, power and thermal behaviour, and reset and boot flows. 
 - Contribute to validation of memory, high-speed I/O, PCIe, NVMe, Ethernet, RDMA and accelerator-related workloads where relevant to the platform. 

Required Skills and Experience

- Practical experience programming in C or C++ and using Python and shell scripting to develop test automation, analyse logs and support regression testing. 
 - Ability to validate and debug Linux-based server or SoC platforms across firmware, kernel, device drivers, system management and hardware bring-up; equivalent practical experience is welcome. 
 - Experience designing and running system-level functional, performance, stress or long-duration stability tests, with effective failure detection and root-cause analysis. 
 - Understanding of system architecture and behaviour across areas such as CPU and memory, cache coherency, DMA, NUMA, IOMMU/SMMU, PCIe, networking, storage, power or thermal management. 

Nice-to-Have Skills and Experience

- Experience with BMC-based server management, secure boot, firmware authentication, boot-stage sequencing, watchdogs, reset flows, inter-processor communication or mailbox mechanisms. 
 - Knowledge of RAS validation across memory, interconnect, PCIe or accelerator subsystems, including use of telemetry such as performance counters, sensors and activity monitors. 
 - Experience with PCIe or NVMe validation, including raw block-device testing, storage performance testing or long-duration storage stress testing. 
 - Knowledge of high-speed Ethernet, RDMA, RoCEv2, MPI/CCL-style communication stacks, collective operations, or scale-up and scale-out communication architectures. 
 - Familiarity with AI/ML or accelerator validation, including PyTorch workloads, model execution, numerical-result comparison, benchmarking, workload automation or concurrent compute, memory, networking and I/O testing. 

In Return

You will work on meaningful system validation challenges at the intersection of hardware and software, helping improve the reliability and performance of complex server and SoC platforms. The role provides broad technical exposure across Linux, firmware, platform management, networking, storage and accelerator technologies, alongside opportunities to deepen your debugging, automation and system-level validation expertise. You will collaborate with engineers across disciplines and see your work inform product quality and platform readiness. 

Our 10x Mindset

At Arm, we believe progress happens when people are empowered to think bigger and push beyond what seems possible. Our 10x mindset is about curiosity, ambition and creating impact that will be used by millions. We learn fast, prioritise collaboration and turn bold ideas into real technology. We look for people who are inspired by this way of working and want to grow in an environment where bold ideas are welcomed. Discover how the 10x mindset shapes life at Arm: https: //careers. arm. com/10x-mindset

Use of AI in Your Application

At Arm, we embrace the benefits AI can bring, including in recruitment. You may use AI to support your preparation, such as improving the clarity of written responses, practicing interview questions, or learning more about our industry. However, your application and interview responses must reflect your own thinking, experience, and abilities. We are seeking a QA Engineer with a strong automation-first mindset and hands-on experience testing web applications, APIs, and data/analytics systems. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working close to the code, understands distributed systems, and thinks holistically about quality across the application, data, and reporting layers. 

You will work closely with Engineering, Product, Analytics, and DevOps teams to ensure that features are delivered with high functional correctness, system reliability, and data integrity. 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES: 

Quality Ownership & Functional Testing

- Collaborate with Product Managers and Engineering teams to understand requirements, clarify acceptance criteria, and define test strategies early in the development lifecycle. 
 - Establish and maintain QA standards, processes, and best practices for consistent quality across teams. 
 - Validate that delivered features meet functional, non-functional, and business requirements with a strong focus on usability and reliability. 
 - Analyze test results to identify defects, behavioral risks, and edge cases, and recommend preventive solutions. 
 - Track and report quality metrics such as defect leakage, automation coverage, release readiness, and data accuracy. 
 - Proactively identify risks and challenges within a sprint and propose remediation or process improvements. 
 - Drive assigned initiatives independently, with a strong sense of ownership. 

Test Automation & Engineering

- Design, implement, execute, and maintain automated and manual test cases across backend systems. 
 - Build and maintain a robust automation suite that is used consistently across releases. 
 - Drive in-sprint automation, ensuring that new features are automated as part of development rather than post-release. 
 - Partner with developers to improve testability, observability, and environment stability. 
 - Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines to support continuous delivery

Data & Analytics Quality Assurance (Explicit Focus)

- Basic validation of data flows between source systems and reports or dashboards. 
 - Verify correctness of key data fields in reports and analytics views. 
 - Perform simple data checks by comparing source data with reporting outputs (OLTP databases, payment gateways, CRM systems like HubSpot) and downstream analytics platforms. 
 - Validate reports, dashboards and metrics for accuracy, completeness, and consistency. 
 - Identify and help prevent common analytics issues such as data drift, duplication, late-arriving data and broken joins. 
 - Collaborate with developers and analysts to clarify data-related test scenarios. 
 - Hands-on experience in writing SQL queries with joins for data validation and testing

Non-Functional Testing

- Execute and guide performance, reliability, and basic security testing. 
 - Validate system behavior under load, stress, and failure scenarios. 
 - Work with Engineering and DevOps teams to identify and mitigate production risks early. 

REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE: 

- 5-7 years of hands-on experience in software quality engineering
 - Strong experience testing modern web applications and APIs
 - Experience testing data-intensive or analytics-driven systems is required
 - Mobile application testing experience is a plus

Automation & Programming

 - Hands-on experience with automation frameworks: Selenium and Appium for Mobile automation
 - Strong understanding of automation design patterns and best practices
 - Hands-on use of AI-assisted tools (e. g. , ChatGPT, Claude) for test design, automation or analysis

Technical Stack Exposure (Preferred)

- RESTful APIs and microservices-based architectures
 - Relational databases and SQL (advanced querying for validation)
 - Cloud-based environments (AWS preferred)
 - AWS Redshift is an added advantage
 - CI/CD pipelines and version control systems

What Success Looks Like at Silvermine

- Defects are caught early, not in production
 - Automation is reliable, fast, and meaningful
 - Data and reports are trusted by business and leadership
 - QA is a partner in engineering, not a downstream function
 - You influence how quality is built, measured, and sustained

 - Opportunity to shape QA strategy across application and data platforms
 - Collaborative culture that values ownership, accountability, and continuous improvement

Job Description

JOB DESCRIPTION

Senior Firmware Developer - Thermal Application

Location - Pune Chakan

Position Summary

The Senior Firmware Developer - Thermal Application engineer will be responsible for leading the design, development, validation, and support of electrical and electronic systems for HVAC equipment, with strong hands‐on experience in screw chiller machines and thermal products. This role involves technical leadership, cross‐functional coordination, and end‐to‐end ownership of electrical, controls, and integration activities throughout the product lifecycle-from concept to commissioning. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead the design and development of electrical and electronic systems for HVAC machines, including screw chillers and thermal products. 
 - Prepare, review, and approve electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, control panel layouts, interlock logic, and BOMs. 
 - Select and integrate electrical and electronic components such as VFDs, controllers, PLCs, HMIs, sensors, protection devices, and safety components. 
 - Lead and support PLC and HMI programming activities, including control logic review, I/O allocation, tag mapping, alarm handling, and parameter optimization. 
 - Drive BMS integration (BACnet / Modbus or equivalent), including points list definition, signal mapping, validation, and coordination with site/BMS teams. 
 - Support control philosophy development and close integration of electrical systems with controls and embedded software. 
 - Drive design validation testing (DVT), dry testing, performance testing, and troubleshooting in lab and factory environments. 
 - Lead root cause analysis and corrective action implementation for electrical and controls‐related issues identified during testing or field operation. 
 - Support commissioning, field issues, and service escalations related to electrical, controls, and automation systems. 
 - Coordinate with Mechanical, Software, Product Management, QA, Sourcing, and Service teams to ensure successful product execution. 
 - Ensure compliance with applicable electrical standards, safety norms, cybersecurity guidelines (where applicable), and regulatory requirements. 
 - Support component localization, alternate sourcing, and cost optimization initiatives without compromising performance or reliability. 
 - Provide technical guidance, reviews, and mentoring to junior engineers and team members. 

Required Skills & Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical, Electronics, or Instrumentation Engineering (or equivalent). 
 - 4 to 6 years of relevant industry experience, preferably in HVAC, industrial machinery, or automation systems. 
 - Strong machine‐level experience with HVAC systems, particularly screw chiller machines and thermal products. 
 - Deep knowledge of industrial electrical systems, power distribution, control panels, safety circuits, and VFD applications. 
 - Solid working experience with PLC and HMI programming in industrial or HVAC applications. 
 - Proven exposure to BMS integration using standard industrial protocols such as BACnet and Modbus. 
 - Working knowledge of programming languages such as C, C++, Structured Text (ST), and Function Block Diagram (FBD); ability to review logic and coordinate with software teams. 
 - Hands‐on experience in testing, commissioning, and troubleshooting complex HVAC and automation systems. 
 - Proficient in reading and interpreting electrical drawings, control schematics, functional descriptions, and technical specifications. 
 - Strong analytical, problem‐solving, communication, and team‐leadership skills.

data.title: Software Development Manager III, Seller Fulfillment Technology (International FBA Team)
data.description:
Description

Own a core part of Fulfillment by Amazon (FBA) for Amazon's fastest-growing and most strategic marketplaces - from emerging international markets to the future of FBA in Europe. International FBA builds the software that lets third-party (3P) sellers send inventory into Amazon's network, keep it in stock, and fulfill orders, and we're hiring a Software Development Manager to lead a high-impact engineering charter end to end. 

Key job responsibilities

Own the vision, multi-year roadmap, and quarterly execution for the engineering charter, translating seller and business goals into a clear, prioritized delivery plan. 

Lead, coach, and grow a team of software engineers - owning hiring, performance management, and career development, and building a strong bench of technical leaders. 

Drive the architecture and design of high-scale, low-latency, highly available distributed systems, making sound technical and build-vs-adopt decisions. 

Build Generative AI (GenAI) solutions and conversational assistants that simplify complex, multi-step seller workflows into guided experiences. 

Own operational excellence - availability, latency, and correctness - for services with direct seller and business impact; strengthen on-call, reduce operational load, and drive issues to root-cause resolution. 

Manage region-specific complexity across diverse international marketplaces, including local compliance, tax, and capacity requirements. 

Partner across Product, Applied Science, Operations, Compliance, and worldwide (WW) FBA teams to align on shared roadmaps, resolve dependencies, and deliver end to end. 

Represent your area in leadership, business, and operational reviews; communicate crisply in writing (narrative style) and in person to both technical and business audiences. 

Set and uphold a high bar for engineering quality, security, and best practices across the software development lifecycle (SDLC). 

A day in the life

You start the morning by scanning your team's operational dashboards and any overnight on-call activity - checking the health of the seller-facing systems you own and making sure nothing is blocking sellers from getting inventory into Amazon. You join your team's daily standup, unblock engineers, and dive into a design review for a new Generative AI (GenAI) conversational assistant feature that will help sellers manage their inventory. 

Midday, you meet with your Product and Applied Science partners to align on the quarterly roadmap and prioritize the next set of deliverables - balancing near-term seller impact against longer-term bets like the Europe FBA transformation. You spend focused time writing or reviewing a technical narrative, and you have a career-development one-on-one with one of your engineers. 

In the afternoon, you make a key architecture decision on a high-scale service, review a peer's design document, and represent your area in a business review with leadership. You close the day by clearing code reviews, responding to your team, and jotting down priorities for tomorrow. Throughout, you're operating as both a builder and a leader - setting technical direction, growing your people, and delivering measurable impact for sellers across International FBA's marketplaces. 

About The Team

International FBA builds the seller-facing software behind Fulfillment by Amazon (FBA) across two strategic frontiers. In Emerging Markets - India, UAE, KSA (Kingdom of Saudi Arabia), Egypt, Mexico, Brazil, Turkey, Australia, and South Africa - we own the end-to-end seller journey, building region-specific architecture where local law and network economics demand it, and pioneering Generative AI (GenAI) assistants that make selling on Amazon radically simpler. 

In Europe, we're reinventing FBA itself: transforming a fragmented, country-by-country operation into a single, unified European supply chain (the "One EU" vision) - one shipment, one inventory pool, one set of controls - so sellers reach the whole continent effortlessly. 

We're a team of builders who care equally about seller experience and engineering excellence. We work across product, science, and operations, own our systems end to end, and take real ownership of outcomes that move Amazon's international business forward. 

Basic Qualifications

- 7+ years of engineering experience
 - 3+ years of engineering team management experience
 - 8+ years of leading the definition and development of multi tier web services experience
 - Experience partnering with product or program management teams
 - Bachelor's degree

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience in communicating with users, other technical teams, and senior leadership to collect requirements, describe software product features, technical designs, and product strategy
 - Experience in recruiting, hiring, mentoring/coaching and managing teams of Software Engineers to improve their skills, and make them more effective, product software engineers

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https: //amazon. jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you're applying in isn't listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

data.title: Director of Engineering
data.description:
About Delhivery

Delhivery is India's leading logistics and supply chain infrastructure company. We are a technology-first organization operating a massive physical network. Our proprietary platforms handle millions of shipments daily across 18, 000+ pin codes, generating vast volumes of multi-modal, spatial, operational, and conversational data. As we transition toward autonomous, self-healing supply chain workflows, this role will lead the engineering frontier that builds our central intelligence and agentic platforms. 

The Mandate: 

As a SEM/Director, you will hold the architectural blueprint and operational authority for Delhivery's ecosystem. Your mandate is to design the core platform infrastructure, establish engineering standards, and govern the deployment of autonomous agentic systems across all product lines (including Warehouse Management, Transportation, Last-Mile, and Merchant Platforms). 

You will act as the central technical authority, driving the adoption of open standards to securely and uniformly connect AI models to Delhivery's enterprise data sources and operational tools. You will enable product teams to build safe, deterministic, and highly optimized AI systems while reviewing and greenlighting all agents before they launch into production. 

Core Responsibilities

- Establish Enterprise AI Standards: Own the definition of technical blueprints, design patterns, and SDKs for agentic workflows across the organization. Establish organization-wide standards for Agentic implementations, covering orchestration, context management, structured outputs, tool invocation, security, identity, observability, evaluation, lifecycle management, and interoperability. 
 - Centralized Architecture & Launch Review: Serve as the final technical gateway for all AI agent deployments at Delhivery. Design automated governance frameworks that validate architecture compliance, tool permissions, security boundaries, model behavior, latency budgets, cost efficiency, reliability, structured output correctness, evaluation quality, and operational readiness before any AI system reaches production. 
 - Architect Production-Grade Agentic Workflows: Design and deploy core multi-agent systems optimized for large-scale enterprise problems involving planning, reasoning, workflow orchestration, long-running execution, memory, human-in-the-loop approvals, asynchronous execution, and real-time decision making across warehouse, transportation, customer experience, and operational platforms
 - Build the Central AI Control Plane & Catalog: Architect Delhivery's shared AI infrastructure layer. Develop central enterprise capabilities for unified model routing, automated prompt drift detection, vector database multi-tenancy, and a centralized catalog that allows secure, audited discovery of enterprise data and services by autonomous agents
 - Lead a High-Caliber Engineering Team: Mentor and scale a specialized engineering squad focused on foundational AI platform development. Cultivate a unified AI engineering community across Delhivery by hosting architectural reviews and upskilling product engineers on production-grade systems design and MCP-driven architectures. 

Core Capabilities & Architectural Focus

This role is centered on building the underlying infrastructure, standardized protocols, and evaluation frameworks required to scale intelligent workflows safely: 

- Platform & Gateways: Designing resilient LLM gateways, automated model failover mechanisms, and enterprise-wide token optimization telemetry, inference optimization to deliver low-latency AI services. 
 - Evaluation & Deployment Pipelines: Building continuous integration frameworks that programmatically test, benchmark, and audit the safety, retrieval accuracy, prompt regressions, safety, hallucination rates, policy compliance, and tool-calling reliability of agents developed across different business units before production deployment. 
 - State & Orchestration: Engineering custom graph architectures or leveraging advanced state-management systems optimized for high-throughput, asynchronous tool execution. 

What We Are Looking For

- Proven Engineering & Governance Leadership: 8+ years of core software engineering experience, with a significant track record of architecting, deploying, and establishing engineering standards for high-scale distributed systems or building production AI systems involving LLMs, agentic workflows, orchestration frameworks, evaluation systems, retrieval architectures, or model serving platforms. 
 - Platform Architecture & Protocol Expertise: Demonstrated success in building developer platforms, shared infrastructure SDKs, or building systems leveraging open interoperability protocols (such as gRPC, GraphQL, or Model Context Protocol). 
 - Systems-First Pragmatism: A deep commitment to engineering metrics-focusing heavily on system latency, API validation, compute cost-efficiency, secure tool execution boundaries, and predictable, deterministic software behavior. 
 - Cross-Functional Influence: The ability to effectively collaborate with, advise, and align diverse product engineering heads and business stakeholders toward a unified technical vision.

Job Title: Manager - Data Operations

Summary: 

We are looking for a skilled and experienced Manager - Data Operations to manage the day-to-day operation of enterprise data pipelines and platforms supporting corporate finance transformation. 

This role combines hands-on operational oversight, service management, and team leadership to ensure timely, accurate, and reliable data delivery. The ideal candidate will work closely with data engineering, platform, governance, and business teams to support finance processes across P2P, O2C, R2R, and FP&A. 

You will be accountable for operational performance, incident coordination, data quality monitoring, and continuous improvement within the assigned service scope, helping business users and clients access trusted data within agreed service levels. 

Responsibilities: 

Data Operations & Technical Oversight

- Manage daily operation of batch and streaming data pipelines, including ingestion, transformation, scheduling, and delivery to downstream systems and reporting platforms. 
 - Monitor job execution, data freshness, processing volumes, and dependencies; coordinate reruns, backfills, and recovery using approved procedures and reconciliation checks. 
 - Maintain operational runbooks, standard operating procedures, job inventories, dependency maps, and escalation paths for supported data services. 
 - Investigate pipeline failures, data discrepancies, and performance issues using logs, monitoring tools, and SQL; engage engineering teams where code or architecture changes are required. 
 - Coordinate production changes and releases with engineering and DevOps teams, validating operational readiness, support handover, rollback procedures, and post-release checks. 
 - Lead incident triage, business-impact assessment, escalation, and service restoration; coordinate root-cause analysis and track corrective actions to closure. 

Service Delivery & Operational Excellence

- Plan and prioritize operational workloads, support requests, and improvement activities to meet agreed SLAs and critical business processing deadlines. 
 - Implement incident, problem, change, and service request management practices; maintain effective shift handovers and on-call coverage where required by the service model. 
 - Track and report pipeline success rates, data freshness, SLA adherence, incident volumes, recovery times, and recurring failures; use trends to improve service performance. 
 - Automate repetitive checks, recovery steps, and reporting where appropriate; work with engineering teams to reduce manual effort, recurring incidents, and inefficient resource usage. 
 - Operate data quality checks and source-to-target reconciliations; route exceptions to accountable data owners and maintain evidence of resolution, access reviews, and approved controls. 

Team Leadership & Talent Management

- Manage a team of data operations analysts and support engineers, assigning responsibilities and ensuring appropriate coverage for supported services. 
 - Build a culture of accountability, collaboration, service ownership, and disciplined execution, with clear expectations for operational quality. 
 - Manage capacity planning, onboarding, performance feedback, and training; develop cross-skilling and backup coverage for critical processes. 
 - Coach team members on troubleshooting, data validation, incident handling, documentation, and stakeholder communication. 

Business & Stakeholder Management

- Partner with finance stakeholders, data owners, and reporting teams to understand data dependencies, business priorities, and critical reporting or period-close schedules. 
 - Coordinate with data engineering, platform, security, and governance teams to resolve operational issues and maintain clear ownership across service boundaries. 
 - Support onboarding of new data services by validating support requirements, monitoring coverage, runbooks, knowledge transfer, and acceptance criteria. 
 - Communicate service status, incidents, business impact, recovery estimates, and improvement progress clearly to stakeholders and management. 

Data Quality & Continuous Improvement

- Work with data owners to define and maintain operational checks for completeness, accuracy, validity, consistency, and timeliness of critical datasets. 
 - Identify recurring data and process issues; maintain a prioritized improvement backlog and standardize reusable monitoring, reconciliation, and support practices. 
 - Support backup and recovery validation, continuity exercises, and retention procedures with platform and governance teams; verify data integrity following restoration. 

Qualifications

Education & Experience

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - 7+ years of experience in data operations, data engineering support, production support, or analytics operations, including responsibility for enterprise data services. 
 - 2+ years of team leadership or people-management experience, with a track record of coordinating operational delivery and developing support teams. 

Technical Expertise

- Hands-on experience supporting data workloads on at least one major cloud platform (Azure, AWS, or GCP), including monitoring, troubleshooting, and access controls. 
 - Strong SQL skills and understanding of ETL/ELT processes, relational databases, data warehouses, and data lake or lakehouse environments. 
 - Experience with data orchestration and processing tools relevant to the environment (e. g. , Airflow, Azure Data Factory, Spark, dbt, or Kafka), including failure diagnosis and recovery. 
 - Working knowledge of Python or shell scripting, APIs, file-based integrations, logging, and monitoring tools to automate checks and investigate data flow issues.

Operational & Delivery Skills

Domain & Functional Knowledge

 - Partner with the Product Owner and cross-functional teams to maintain clear requirements and acceptance criteria.

 - Certifications if any- NA

- Java and Spring Boot application development. 
 - Spring Framework, JPA/Hibernate, RESTful APIs, and microservices.

 - AWS, containers, Kubernetes or OpenShift, and cloud-native deployment practices. 
 - PostgreSQL or Oracle, DynamoDB, Redis, and data-access optimization. 
 - CI/CD, automation, testing, observability, and DevOps practices.

 - Stakeholder collaboration, clear communication, and results orientation.

 - Knowledge of API testing tools such as Postman and automated test frameworks.

 - Relevant AWS, Java, Kubernetes, or DevOps certification.

data.title: Mgr., Product Compliance
data.description:
A Day in Your Life at MKS: (Summary & Objectives)

As a Mgr. , Product Compliance at MKS Inc. , you will: 

- Own the execution & the results of the Product Compliance audits and certification-surveillance programs across assigned MKS manufacturing locations. 
 - Work with corporate compliance, quality, Mfg. , Ops. , Eng. , supply chain, supplier quality, and external laboratories/certification bodies to establish clear action owners, due dates, escalation paths, and measurable deliverables. 

In this role, you will report to the Director of Product Compliance. 

You Will Make an Impact By: (Responsibilities)

Primary Objective - Product Compliance Audit Program Ownership

- Own the Product Compliance audits for assigned manufacturing sites and all certification activities. You will be accountable for 3rd-party audit readiness and execution, timely closure of findings, and the controls required to keep certified products aligned with approved constructions and regulatory requirements. 
 - Establish audit deliverables and hold Quality, Manufacturing, Operations, Engineering, Supply Chain/Supplier Quality, and suppliers accountable to committed dates; escalate missed commitments to site and business leadership, and ensure identified gaps are mitigated before the audits. 
 - Own compliance-critical manufacturing-control expectations, i. e. , receiving inspection, calibration, production test records, document control, and engineering/manufacturing change control, product transfers, etc. related to CCL (Components Critical to Compliance List). Evaluate changes for certification impact, and complete agency notifications and technical reviews before implementation. 
 - Manage working relationships with MKS compliance group, third-party laboratories, NRTLs/certification bodies, inspectors, and technical reviewers. 

Skills You Bring: (Required Skills)

- B. S. or M. S. in EE, ME, Quality Engineering, or a related technical discipline, with 7+ years of relevant experience in product compliance, certification, quality, manufacturing, or regulatory engineering. 
 - Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders and cross-functional teams, establish accountability without relying solely on direct authority, and drive deliverables to closure. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to represent MKS effectively internally and externally. 
 - Working knowledge of product safety and EMC/EMI compliance requirements and standards such as IEC/UL/EN 61010-1, IEC/EN 61326-1, IEC/EN 60825-1, applicable IEC 61000 series standards, SEMI S2. 
 - Working knowledge of global product compliance frameworks and regulations, including CE marking, LVD, EMC, FCC, NRTL certifications, UKCA, KC, RoHS, REACH, China RoHS, and other applicable regional requirements. 
 - Strong understanding of manufacturing and quality-system controls relevant to certification audits, including critical components, engineering and supplier change control, traceability, doc control, calibration, inspection, and testing. 
 - Working knowledge of ISO 9001 and internal auditing principles, with the ability to interpret requirements, assess objective evidence, classify risk, and ensure findings are effectively closed. 
 - Strong program-management discipline, including prioritization, action tracking, resource planning, risk management, escalation, executive reporting, and management of multiple concurrent audits and certification commitments. 

Preferred Skills

- Hands-on experience with UL, Intertek/ETL, CSA, TÜV, or similar NRTL/certification-body factory inspection 
 - Formal ISO 9001 internal auditor or lead auditor training; ASQ Certified Quality Auditor (CQA) is a plus. 
 - Experience managing supplier quality audits, supplier corrective actions, contract and global manufacturers 
 - Experience with ERP, PLM, and QMS systems used to manage BOMs, approved vendor lists, engineering changes, controlled documents, certifications, audit evidence, and CAPA records. 
 - Experience with semiconductor, vacuum, plasma, RF/power, laser/optical, precision motion, or other complex equipment. 
 - Experience managing third-party audit/certification budgets, service providers, or statements of work is a plus. 

Key Interfaces

- Internal: Product Compliance, Quality, Manufacturing, Operations, Engineering, Supply Chain, Supplier Quality, Service, site leadership, and business-unit leadership. 
 - External: Third-party test laboratories, NRTLs/certification bodies, auditors/inspectors, suppliers, contract manufacturers, and other regulatory or certification representatives. 

Supervisory Scope

- Reporting Relationships: Manager-level role with matrixed audit coordinators, as applicable to the organization structure. 
 - Financial Responsibilities: Responsible for planning and managing assigned third-party audit, certification, and related services. 

Physical Demands and Working Conditions

- Able to travel domestically and internationally (~30%) as needed to support manufacturing-site, supplier, laboratory, and certification audits. 
 - Able to work in manufacturing, laboratory, and supplier environments and comply with applicable site safety and personal protective equipment requirements.

Working at Bank of America will give you a great career with opportunities to learn, grow and make an impact, along with the power to make a difference. Join us!

Global Business Services

Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations. 

Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation. 

In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services. 

Process Overview*

Global Finance was set up in 2007 as a part of the CFO Global Delivery strategy to provide offshore delivery to Line of Business and Enterprise Finance functions. The capabilities hosted include Accounts Payable, General Accounting & Reconciliations, Management Reporting & Analysis, Research & Analytics, Financial Transaction Processing, Finance Systems Support & Regulatory reporting. Principal Engineer - Agentic AI for Network & Security Operations

Meet the Team

The Cisco CTO Organization is shaping the future of networking and security through AI-native, cloud-delivered and autonomous operations platforms. We are building intelligent systems that make network and security operations more observable, proactive, reliable and efficient at enterprise scale. 

Your Impact

As a Principal Engineer, you will define and build the architecture for agentic AI and autonomous operations across Cisco's networking and security portfolio. 

You will combine deep experience in network management, security platforms, distributed systems, cloud-native architecture and large-scale telemetry with emerging agentic AI technologies. Your work will help operators diagnose problems faster, understand complex operational conditions and safely automate remediation. 

You will provide technical direction across multiple engineering teams and turn new AI capabilities into scalable, reliable and customer-facing products. 

What You'll Do

- Define the architecture for agentic AI platforms supporting network troubleshooting, operational assistance, incident analysis and dynamic visualization. 
 - Build tool-using AI agents that reason over network telemetry, configurations, events, alerts, logs and operational knowledge. 
 - Establish evaluation frameworks, guardrails, correctness standards and gateway services for safely deploying agents in production. 
 - Design real-time fault-detection, alerting, suppression, analysis and automated-remediation systems.

data.description:
Company Description

Ubisoft is a global leader in gaming with teams across the world creating original and memorable gaming experiences, from Assassin's Creed, Rainbow Six to Just Dance and more. We believe diverse perspectives help both players and teams thrive. If you're passionate about innovation and pushing entertainment boundaries, join our journey and help us create the unknown!

Job Description

Job Summary

UBISOFT is seeking an Intermediate R&D Engineer to prototype and validate new technologies that improve game testing and quality control. This role focuses on building rapid prototypes and running experiments using GenAI, VLMs (Vision-Language Models), and AI/ML to explore automation opportunities across QC. You will work closely with the R&D Manager and cross-functional partners to translate ideas into measurable experiments, evaluate feasibility, and iterate toward proof-of-value prototypes. This role provides an excellent opportunity to gain hands-on experience in software development, automation, and quality control processes within the gaming industry. 

Core Responsibilities

Job Duties / Responsibilities

- Build rapid prototypes using GenAI/VLM/ML to address QC and testing pain points. 
 - Design and execute experiments: define hypotheses, datasets/inputs, evaluation criteria, baselines, and success metrics (accuracy, precision/recall, latency, cost, robustness). 
 - Implement data pipelines for experiments: data collection, cleaning, labeling support, and dataset versioning (as needed for proofs-of-concept). 
 - Explore and compare approaches and document trade-offs. 
 - Integrate prototypes with existing internal tools/test systems at a lightweight level (APIs, CLIs, plugins) to enable user trials and feedback. 
 - Analyze experiment results, identify failure modes, and iterate quickly based on findings and stakeholder input. 
 - Maintain reproducible research practices: experiment tracking, configuration management, and clear documentation of assumptions and limitations. 
 - Collaborate in agile workflows: estimate assigned tasks, provide status updates, and incorporate feedback iteratively. 

Learning Opportunities

- Gain hands-on experience with software development and automation tools. 
 - Develop a deeper understanding of software testing lifecycles. 
 - Enhance coding and debugging skills in a collaborative environment. 
 - Learn about CI/CD pipelines and version control systems. 

Core Competencies

- Eager to Learn: Highly motivated and quick to grasp new concepts. 
 - Experimental Mindset: Comfortable with ambiguity; able to form hypotheses and learn quickly through iteration. 
 - Pragmatic Engineering: Delivers prototypes that are usable and measurable, without over-engineering. 
 - Analytical Thinking: Interprets results critically; understands bias, variance, and common evaluation pitfalls. 
 - Collaboration: Works well with technical and non-technical stakeholders; communicates trade-offs clearly. 
 - Adaptability: Keeps pace with rapidly evolving AI/ML tooling and best practices. 

Behavioral Competencies

- Curiosity: Passion for exploring new technologies and their applications. 
 - Teamwork: Ability to collaborate effectively with diverse teams. 
 - Adaptability: Willingness to take on new challenges and adapt to changing priorities. 

Qualifications

Seniority: 

Having at least 5-8 years of coding experience in above languages, 

B. E/BTech/MTech/MS Computer Science in computer science or equivalent. 

Technical Competencies

- Hands on Knowledge of Python programming. 
 - Good understanding of AI/ML concepts. 
 - Familiarity with software development and testing processes. 
 - Exposure to CI/CD tools (e. g. , Jenkins, TeamCity) and version control systems (e. g. , Git). 
 - Solid understanding of debugging and troubleshooting techniques. 
 - Good to have understanding of other languages such as C++ and C#. 
 - Nice to have experience working with game engine

Title And Summary

Senior Software Integration Engineer(Quality Engineer)

Overview

The SME team is looking for a Senior Software Integration Engineer who can contribute independently in complex situations while supporting quality, engineering, and delivery goals. This role requires strong experience in agile work management, integration testing, quality assurance, requirements management, SDLC practices, systems integration, troubleshooting, web services, workflow management, and test automation. 

The ideal candidate will plan, prioritize, and manage work using agile practices to enable iterative delivery, collaboration, adaptability, and continuous improvement. They will partner with developers and engineering teams to review source code, identify issues, improve quality, and promote maintainability and coding standards. 

This position is responsible for designing, executing, and maintaining tests that validate interactions across integrated components, systems, services, APIs, data flows, interfaces, and dependencies. The candidate will help establish and maintain QA processes and standards that prevent defects, optimize performance, improve customer satisfaction, and support compliance. 

The role also requires strong understanding of requirements management, SDLC, systems integration, web services, troubleshooting, and workflow management. The candidate should be a key contributor who can guide others informally and help teams deliver reliable, maintainable solutions. 

Role

In This Role, You Will

- Perform QE activities across assigned projects, including test planning, strategy, validation, automation, and release readiness. 
 - Collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams to enhance testing processes and strengthen quality practices. 
 - Contribute to SME QE teams focused on test validation and automation within assigned projects. 
 - Design, execute, and maintain integration tests to validate interactions between systems, services, APIs, data flows, interfaces, and dependencies. 
 - Establish and maintain QA processes and standards that prevent defects, improve quality, optimize performance, and support customer expectations. 
 - Apply agile work management practices to plan, prioritize, and manage work effectively in iterative delivery environments. 
 - Partner with product owners, developers, and delivery teams to review requirements, clarify acceptance criteria, manage changes, identify risks, and ensure testability throughout the SDLC. 
 - Support SDLC activities including requirements, design, coding, testing, deployment, and maintenance to ensure solutions remain high quality and maintainable. 
 - Contribute to systems integration by validating communication, interoperability, and reliability across diverse technologies, processes, applications, and services. 
 - Implement and support UI, API, backend, and integration automation using tools such as Playwright, Cypress, and API automation frameworks. 
 - Support API performance testing and performance validation using tools such as Gatling and BlazeMeter. 
 - Troubleshoot complex issues across systems, applications, services, integrations, test environments, and networks using structured methods and tools. 
 - Evaluate source code written by developers to identify and address potential issues, support maintainability, improve quality, and ensure adherence to coding standards and best practices. 
 - Analyze workflows, identify bottlenecks, streamline procedures, monitor progress, allocate resources, and adapt processes to ensure work moves smoothly from one stage to the next. 
 - Contribute to CI/CD and DevOps practices by supporting automated test execution, version control, and integration of test automation into delivery pipelines. 
 - Provide technical guidance to team members, support proof-of-concepts, coach others informally, and help teams adopt scalable and maintainable test automation practices. 
 - Communicate status, risks, dependencies, and quality insights clearly to stakeholders and leadership. 
 - Promote agile ways of working, continuous learning, collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement across the team. 

All About You / Experience

The ideal candidate for this position should have: 

- Strong experience in quality engineering, test strategy, planning, automation, QA, and software validation across complex technology programs. 
 - Ability to apply skills independently and consistently in complex or nuanced situations while supporting broader business, delivery, and quality goals. 
 - Strong knowledge of agile principles and practices, including planning, prioritization, iterative delivery, collaboration, adaptability, and continuous improvement. 
 - Experience collaborating with developers and engineering teams to review source code, identify potential issues, improve maintainability, and promote coding standards and best practices. 
 - Hands-on experience with UI and API automation tools such as Playwright and Cypress. 
 - Strong experience in API integration testing and backend validation. 
 - Experience designing and maintaining integration tests that validate data flows, interfaces, dependencies, web services, and system interactions. 
 - Experience with API performance testing and exposure to performance testing tools such as Gatling and BlazeMeter. 
 - Strong understanding of requirements management, including documenting, analyzing, tracing, prioritizing, agreeing on, and communicating requirements and changes to stakeholders. 
 - Strong understanding of software development life cycle practices, including requirements gathering, design, coding, testing, deployment, and maintenance. 
 - Experience with systems integration, including validating communication and interoperability across applications, services, technologies, and processes. 
 - Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills, with the ability to systematically identify, diagnose, and resolve technical issues across systems, applications, services, test environments, and networks. 
 - Experience with web services and standardized protocols that enable communication, data exchange, interoperability, scalability, and integration across diverse systems. 
 - Ability to analyze workflows, identify bottlenecks, streamline procedures, monitor progress, allocate resources, and adapt processes to achieve outcomes. 
 - Working knowledge of version control tools such as Git. 
 - Experience with API testing tools such as Insomnia. 
 - Experience with test case management tools such as XRay. 
 - Experience with project management tools such as Jira. 
 - Exposure to cloud platforms, preferably Azure. 
 - Familiarity with AI-assisted engineering and quality practices, including GitHub Copilot, Playwright MCP servers, and automation accelerators. 
 - Ability to work on proof-of-concepts. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate across teams and present quality insights clearly. 
 - Self-driven, proactive, adaptable, and committed to continuous improvement. 

Corporate Security Responsibility

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must: 

- Abide by Mastercard's security policies and practices; 
 - Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed; 
 - Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
 - Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard's guidelines.

data.title: Senior Director, Engineering (AI Voice Agents)
data.description:
About Birdeye Inc. 

Birdeye builds AI coworkers for multi-location brands. Jay for marketing, Myna for operations, and Robin for customer experience orchestrate AI agents to win AI visibility, book appointments, and drive consistent CX at every location. They run on BirdAI, the Agent OS built on 13 years of multi-location data infrastructure and 3, 000+ integrations. BirdAI consolidates every signal, reasons with industry, brand and location context, and acts autonomously or with a human in the loop. 

Birdeye is trusted by the world's largest multi-location brands across healthcare, dental, restaurants, financial services, auto, retail, and property management. G2 ranks Birdeye #1 in Enterprise Multi-Location Marketing Platforms and named it to the 2026 Best Agentic AI Products list. Learn more at birdeye. com. 

About The Role

Every day, local businesses miss a large share of their inbound calls - and in appointment-driven industries, every missed call is a lost patient, a lost repair job, a lost service visit. Front desks are understaffed, phones ring after hours, and customers who don't get through simply call the next provider. Birdeye's AI Voice Agents group exists to fix this: AI agents that answer every call naturally, book and reschedule appointments directly into the systems businesses already run on, and give owners complete visibility into every conversation and outcome. 

As Senior Director of Engineering, you will lead this group end to end: the real-time voice agent platform, a CRM/PMS integrations and data-sync layer handling business-contact data at massive scale, and the conversation dashboard where customers see every call, booking, and insight. You inherit an existing engineering team - the mandate combines 0-to-1 product urgency with the leadership challenge of aligning that team around one architecture, raising the delivery bar, and shipping GA products across four verticals. 

The role is based in India, leading Birdeye's India-based Voice Agents engineering team with direct exposure to US product leadership and customers. You will report to senior R&D leadership and partner daily with Product, Design, and the partnerships team driving CRM/EHR/FSM/DMS alliances. You lead from the front: deeply technical, close to the code where it matters - architecture decisions, critical-path reviews, and agent-quality evals. 

What You Will Own

- Voice agent platform: real-time conversational pipeline (telephony, ASR, LLM orchestration, TTS), sub-second latency, barge-in handling, graceful human handoff, and per-vertical conversation design for appointment booking, rescheduling, and reminders. 
 - Integrations & data sync: bidirectional sync of business contacts, calendars, and appointments with EHR/PMS (e. g. , Epic, Dentrix, Eaglesoft), FSM (e. g. , ServiceTitan, Housecall Pro), DMS (e. g. , CDK, Reynolds, Tekion), and horizontal CRMs - reliable at tens of millions of records with conflict resolution, idempotency, and audit trails. 
 - Conversation dashboard & analytics: the customer-facing surface for full conversation history, transcripts, booking outcomes, containment/conversion metrics, and agent-quality analytics across locations. 
 - The team: lead the existing engineering team (voice/ML, backend/integrations, frontend, QA) through managers and senior ICs; shape team structure around the platform/integrations / dashboard pillars, develop and hire leaders, and establish on-call, quality bars, and eval-driven development for agent behavior. 
 - Execution & operating cadence: fast, predictable release cycles - planning, weekly reviews, and retrospectives that drive improvement; clear technical plans and milestones with trade-offs made explicit. 
 - Trust & compliance: HIPAA (BAAs), SOC 2, telephony/TCPA compliance, and safe-AI guardrails for autonomous customer-facing conversations. 

What success looks like: 

- GA voice agent live in at least two verticals with measurable booking-conversion and call-containment targets. 
 - Certified, bidirectional integrations with the top systems of record in each launch vertical. 
 - Conversation dashboard adopted as a daily surface by customers; analytics driving retention and upsell. 
 - The team operating as a high-performing unit: clear team charters, a strong manager bench, predictable delivery, and production-grade reliability (99. 9%+ voice uptime). 

What we're looking for: 

- 15+ years in software engineering, 6+ years leading large engineering teams through managers of managers, including inheriting and re-aligning an existing team. 
 - A blend of large-scale engineering rigor and startup speed - e. g. , senior tenure at a global-scale technology organization plus experience at a high-growth startup. 
 - Leadership at an AI-native product company (agents, enterprise search/RAG, conversational AI, or ML-heavy 
 - consumer platforms) - you have shipped AI products to demanding users, not just prototyped them. 
 - Shipped and operated real-time and/or high-scale distributed systems in production - voice/video, telephony, streaming, or large-scale data synchronization. 
 - Hands-on familiarity with the modern LLM/voice stack (ASR/TTS, agent orchestration, evals, prompt/tool design) and pragmatic judgment on build-vs-buy (e. g. , Retell/Vapi-class infra vs. in-house). 
 - Experience integrating with third-party systems of record (CRM, EHR/PMS, FSM, or DMS) and running partner-facing engineering relationships. 
 - 0-to-1 product instincts at scale: comfort with ambiguity, fast iteration against real customer calls, and shipping before everything is perfect - while keeping a large org focused. 
 - Strong cross-functional operator: partners tightly with Product, Design, GTM, and external partners; communicates crisply with executives. 

Nice to Have:

data.title: DevOps Engineer, Engineering Team Manager, Vice President
data.description:
About This Role

You can work with us at one of top FinTech companies. We sell our Aladdin platform to over 200 of the top global corporations, in total managing about quarter of all the world's money under management. 

BlackRock is global but close-knit team of individuals who share a common goal of providing the very best possible level of support to our business partners and customers. From the top of the firm down, we embrace the diversity of values, identities and ideas brought by our employees. We are serious about our people and offer Flexible Time Off, collaborative working spaces and several other benefits. 

An individual selected in this position will have the responsibility to cover business-critical computing workloads, real-time / interactive processing, data transfer services, application and new technology on-boarding and upgrades, and recovery procedures. The international team is split into 4 global regions to provide 24*7*365 support. 

This role is accountable for enterprise‐scale reliability, risk posture, and operational resilience through the adoption of AI‐enabled, autonomous infrastructure and service operations. 

The leader transitions the organization from human‐driven, reactive operations to AI‐supervised, self‐healing systems, ensuring technology platforms scale safely, predictably, and in alignment with business growth and regulatory expectations. 

The role owns strategy, outcomes, and governance, if any of these excites you, we want to talk to you. 

Team Overview

The Service Management Operations Group is responsible for monitoring, supporting, and administering production environments for all BlackRock businesses (including subsidiaries and BlackRock Solutions) acting as a first responder relative to troubleshooting, problem resolution, and escalation. 

Collaborating with skilled professionals across the globe and managing a broad range of technologies and applications, the Operations Group delivers service quality and excellence through teamwork, innovating operational processes, and being part of the One BlackRock culture. 

Key Responsibilities

- Own reliability outcomes
 - Deliver measurable improvements in availability, latency, recovery time, and incident recurrence for critical workloads. 
 - Establish and mature SRE practices: SLIs/SLOs, error budgets, and reliability governance. 
 - Build AI‐enabled, signal‐driven operations
 - Replace alert volume with AI‐correlated signals that prioritize true business impact and early risk indicators. 
 - Implement and improve detection, correlation, and routing workflows integrated into operational processes and tooling. 
 - Engineer self‐healing systems (automation-first)
 - Design, implement, and govern automated remediation for known failure patterns (with safe guardrails and audit trails). 
 - Maintain structured human oversight for novel scenarios and ensure continuous learning feeds back into automation. 
 - Embed reliability and operability into engineering lifecycle
 - Partner with Engineering/Architecture/Product to build operability, observability, resilience-by-design into services. 
 - Drive root-cause elimination and reduce recurrence through systemic fixes, not repetitive recovery. 
 - Change-aware resilience + risk posture
 - Own change-aware operations: use AI risk signals to anticipate failures based on historical data, dependency graphs, and weak points. 
 - Support production readiness: capacity planning, disaster recovery exercises, and disciplined change governance. 
 - Evidence, auditability, and resilience expectations
 - Ensure AI-driven systems are observable, explainable, and auditable, meeting operational and regulatory expectations. 
 - Develop and lead high performing global team, fostering strong ownership, technical depth, and a culture of accountability and continuous improvement. 

Qualifications / Competencies

- Bachelor's degree in computer science /engineering (or equivalent practical experience). 
 - 10+ years across Service Management, DevOps, SRE, Product Engineering, and/or large-scale production operations. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with observability/monitoring/telemetry platforms, focused on actionable insights and reliability outcomes. 
 - Proven experience transitioning environments from reactive support to proactive, signal-driven / AI-assisted operations. 
 - Designed/tuned/governed automation and AIOps workflows, enabling automated remediation while retaining structured human oversight for exceptions. 
 - Experience implementing change-aware operations, drift detection/correction, and data-driven reliability governance to reduce incident recurrence. 
 - AI-assisted capacity forecasting and proactive scaling for performance predictability and cost efficiency. 
 - End-to-end operational fluency: telemetry → ITSM integration → automated execution. 
 - Experience sponsoring or governing AI-assisted/autonomous operational platforms. 

Our Benefits

To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about. 

Our hybrid work model

BlackRock's hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person - aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock. 

Guidance on AI use for candidates

At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work - enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we've provided guidance on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self. 

About BlackRock

At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children's educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress. 

This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment - the one we make in our employees. It's why we're dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive. 

To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers. BlackRock. com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok. 

BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, family status, gender identity, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected attributes at law.

data.title: Engineering Manager, Managed Gateways Infrastructure
data.description:
Are you ready to unlock intelligence?

If you don't think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box - we're looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others. 

The Mission

Kong Cloud Gateways is Kong's foundational cloud-native SaaS platform, powering its managed API and AI Gateway offerings. It provides a multi-tenant control plane, automation, and platform services that let customers securely deploy, operate, and scale dedicated gateway infrastructure with the simplicity of a fully managed cloud service. Behind that experience sits a distributed platform responsible for provisioning, fleet management, software lifecycle, zero-downtime upgrades, observability, security, and multi-region operations across globally distributed cloud infrastructure - built to a target of 99. 99% availability, balancing reliability, performance, operational excellence, and infrastructure efficiency at global SaaS scale. 

As a Software Engineering Manager for Managed Gateways Infrastructure, you will own and grow Kong's Bangalore-based engineering team, taking full accountability for this multi-tenant SaaS platform. Kong Cloud Gateways is growing 100% YoY, and as enterprises increasingly adopt AI alongside traditional APIs, this platform becomes an increasingly important part of Kong's API and AI strategy - every improvement in automation, scalability, and operational excellence you drive accelerates new platform capabilities and lets product teams innovate faster. Beyond the technical charter, you play a key role in shaping a dynamic engineering culture - one built on urgency, ownership, and first-principles thinking - as the team scales to match the pace of the business. 

This is a highly technical, hands-on leadership role - you're expected to stay close to the systems, dig into hard problems alongside your team, and not hesitate to get into the trenches when it matters. 

What You'll Do

- Own and grow Kong's Managed Gateways Infrastructure engineering team in Bangalore - scaling the team's capability, raising the technical bar, and staying hands-on in critical implementations and incidents, not just directing from a distance. 
 - Own the reliability and scalability of a multi-tenant SaaS infrastructure platform serving customers across regions and clouds - every architectural decision has to hold up under multi-tenant load, isolation, and blast-radius considerations, not just single-tenant assumptions. 
 - Drive 4-9s (99. 99%+) availability across Kong's global infrastructure footprint - owning capacity, resilience, and failure-mode design across multi-region, multi-cloud deployments (AWS, Azure, GCP) so Cloud Gateways stays up for customers everywhere, at any scale. 
 - Act as a direct technical contributor when it counts - complex incidents, architecture reviews, and high-stakes implementations that materially move the needle on Managed Gateways' growth and reliability. 
 - Lead, mentor, and grow a high-performing engineering team building and operating Kong's SaaS infrastructure for Managed Gateways, in direct support of our critical enterprise customer base globally. 
 - Architect and implement robust, scalable, and fault-tolerant cloud-native systems using technologies like Kubernetes, Golang, and major cloud providers (AWS, Azure, GCP). 
 - Own the complete operational lifecycle end-to-end - infrastructure, reliability, on-call, incident response, and blameless post-mortems - as one integrated engineering charter, not a separate function. 
 - Drive developer delight and operational efficiency through automation, self-service tooling, and streamlined workflows for deploying and managing API gateways, while proactively preventing technical debt and reducing operational toil. 
 - Define, track, and report on key SLOs and SLIs, and advocate for architectural best practices that keep Managed Gateways performant and resilient as it scales. 
 - Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, engineering, and support teams to influence roadmap decisions and ensure operational readiness for new features. 

What You'll Bring

The Toolkit: 

- Proven experience leading and managing software engineering teams responsible for infrastructure and reliability in a fast-paced, high-growth environment, with a track record of staying technically hands-on rather than purely delegating. 
 - Deep, current expertise in designing, deploying, and operating highly available distributed systems on cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) - this role needs someone who can still open a terminal and debug production, not just review architecture diagrams. 
 - Extensive hands-on experience with Kubernetes (k8s) and container orchestration in production environments. 
 - Proficiency in Golang or similar modern programming languages for infrastructure automation and service development. 
 - Strong understanding of observability principles and experience with tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, or similar. 
 - Demonstrated ability to manage critical incidents personally when needed, perform root cause analysis, and implement effective preventative measures. 
 - Familiarity with API gateway technologies, service mesh, or network proxies is a significant plus. 

The Kong DNA

- Ownership: You take full responsibility for the reliability and performance of systems, driving initiatives from conception to completion. 
 - Urgency: You thrive in dynamic environments, prioritizing critical issues and delivering impactful solutions with speed and precision. 
 - Collaboration: You build strong relationships, foster open communication, and work effectively across global teams to achieve shared goals. 

Bonus Points

- Experience with open-source contributions or active participation in SRE/cloud-native communities. 
 - Certifications in cloud platforms (e. g. , AWS Certified DevOps Engineer) or Kubernetes (e. g. , CKA, CKAD). 
 - Background in companies focused on developer tools, infrastructure software, or API management. 

About Kong

Kong Inc. , the AI Connectivity Company, is building the connectivity layer of AI. Trusted by the Fortune 500® and AI-native startups alike, Kong's unified API and AI platform enables organizations to secure, manage, accelerate, govern, and monetize the flow of intelligence across APIs and AI traffic - on any model, any cloud. For more information, visit www. konghq. com.
