data.title: Manager, Network and Infrastructure Reliability
data.description:
Join us in bringing joy to customer experience. Five9 is a leading provider of cloud contact center software, bringing the power of cloud innovation to customers worldwide. 

Living our values everyday results in our team-first culture and enables us to innovate, grow, and thrive while enjoying the journey together. We celebrate diversity and foster an inclusive environment, empowering our employees to be their authentic selves. 

Five9 is rebuilding the operational leadership for its Network & Infrastructure team and needs a hands-on, senior technical manager to take direct ownership of the environment and the team executing the work. 

The right candidate will have directly managed production networks at scale, led teams of engineers who build and maintain those systems, and successfully transitioned frontline operations from manual "click-ops" into automated, code-driven execution. If you have not personally managed engineering teams through this specific transition, this is not the right role. 

Modernization is already underway, but the current engineering team is short-handed and lacks several critical skills. The person stepping into this role must stabilize daily operations quickly, assess the existing talent, and immediately begin rebuilding both the team and the operating workflows against clear, sprint-level, and measurable milestones. 

This is a true player-coach role. You must stay close enough to the technical work to keep your engineering judgment sharp, maintain credibility with senior engineers, and be willing to set the standard by example on the keyboard when needed. At the same time, you must focus on building automated validation gates and upskilling your team so that you can step out of the daily critical path. Carrying a portion of the senior technical load to stabilize the team at the outset is expected; still operating as the primary technical bottle-neck six months in is a failure. 

What Success Looks Like In Your First 120 Days

- A working map of the network and infrastructure estate across our DCs and our cloud footprint, plus a clear assessment of your team's capabilities and operational bottlenecks. 
 - A team skills assessment and a tactical execution plan that details how your team will transition from manual operations to infrastructure/network-as-code, automation, and drift control, balanced against current project deliverables. 
 - Key engineering hires onboarded successfully, with existing team members actively engaged in cross-training and upskilling programs. 
 - Early modernization wins visible in production, the on-call and incident load distributed fairly across the team, and you have successfully transitioned from tactical firefighting to guiding team execution. 

What You Bring To Five9

- A track record of building and leading cohesive teams, raising engineering standards, and shifting daily operations from reactive to proactive, engineering-led execution. 
 - Experience stabilizing operations and guiding engineering teams through periods of technical change and modernization. 
 - Strong communication skills backed by operational data, clear risk articulation, and the ability to report measurable outcomes to department leadership. 
 - Proven ability to build trust, accountability, and a high-performance culture within your engineering team. 
 - Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, with experience partnering closely with software engineering, security, SRE, and product teams. 
 - Ability to mentor and develop senior engineers and technical leads, driving accountability while establishing clear ownership, operational discipline, and career growth pathways. 
 - Strong decision-making and prioritization skills in high-pressure production environments with competing operational demands. 
 - Demonstrated ability to lead teams through ambiguity, align team goals with broader department objectives, and execute complex technical migrations. 
 - Effective conflict resolution and stakeholder management skills to align technical delivery with business needs. 
 - Strong operational judgment in network and infrastructure security, with the ability to partner effectively with Security Operations teams. 

What We Require

- 7+ years of experience in network/infrastructure engineering, with 3+ years directly managing engineering teams in mission-critical, multi-DC production environments. 
 - Deep technical background in modern DC networking, including OSPF, EVPN, VXLAN, Cisco Nexus, and NX-OS. 
 - Experience managing infrastructure in a hybrid cloud environment, with a strong focus on supporting GCP workloads. 
 - Proven success guiding teams to build and adopt network automation and IaC using tools such as Ansible, Terraform, Python, Git, and CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Hands-on experience modernizing legacy environments by introducing configuration management, drift detection, and policy-based operations where they didn't exist before. 
 - Strong understanding of network and infrastructure observability using tools such as ThousandEyes, Grafana, Loki, NetFlow, and Netscout to achieve a "single pane of glass" for system health. 
 - Experience supporting the underlying infrastructure needs of Kubernetes, AI, and GPU workloads. 
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience). 

Workplace location: This role is fully remote for candidates who reside further than a 30 kilometer driving distance from either our Bangalore or Chennai offices. Candidates who reside within a 30 kilometer driving distance of one of our office locations would be required to work in-office 3 days a week.

products, platforms, and services.

engineering, we create a better future for people and the planet. 

Our customer is a global pioneer in media technology, delivering industry-leading video and

audio editing solutions to premier entertainment brands and major hollywood studios. 

Recognized with accolades ranging from Oscars and Grammys to NAB's Product of the Year, 

they continue to set the standard for digital media innovation. 

For over 15 years, the strategic partnership with GlobalLogic has been instrumental for our

customer in driving product development across their core platforms in audiovideo editing and

media workflow management. Our customer is expanding its collaboration with GlobalLogic to

engineer next-generation, cloud-based, and AI-augmented media lifecycle management

solutions. This effort is supported by a growing team of specialized engineering

Requirements

Job Description

We are seeking a Principal Engineer II to lead the architecture and development of our SaaS

control plane for media products. This is a leadership role where you will set technical direction, 

mentor engineers, and ensure the platform scales securely and reliably across tenants, users, and

resources. 

You should have

- 12+ years building backend services for cloud-based multi-tenant SaaS products
 - Python or Golang expertise (must-have)
 - Solid AWS fundamentals: IAM, ECS/EKS, RDS/Aurora, SQS/SNS, Secrets Manager, 

CloudWatch

- Multi-tenant systems design and isolation patterns
 - Modern authentication, authorization, and access patterns (OAuth2, OIDC, SAML, 

SCIM)

- API Gateway expertise (Apache APISIX preferred; Apigee, Kong, AWS API Gateway

acceptable)

- Kubernetes/cloud-native architectures, like Istio/Envoy service mesh
 - SaaS analytics, metering, and billing (expected significant knowledge)
 - AWS Cognito for identity and access management
 - Familiarity with async/event-driven architectures and distributed control planes
 - Strong documentation habits: ADRs, runbooks, API contracts
 - Proven ability to instrument services for observability (structured logging, metrics, 

distributed tracing)

- AI Native Development: intimate familiarity with AI-driven development practices, 

tooling, and ability to guide teams in AI integration

Skill Category

- Cloud / SaaS Control Plane Engineering
 - Backend Development (Python/Golang)
 - Cloud-native Architecture & Kubernetes
 - Authentication & Authorization
 - API Gateway & Service Mesh
 - SaaS Analytics, Metering & Billing
 - AI-driven Development Leadership

Job responsibilities

Job Responsibilities

- Architect and lead control plane services: tenant provisioning, principal lifecycle (users, 

service accounts, API keys), entitlement/subscription enforcement

- Own onboarding flows end-to-end: account creation, identity setup, resource

provisioning, and readiness

- Design APIs and async workflows with resilience, failure handling, and graceful retries

operational automation

make on-call manageable

- Collaborate across teams (auth, database, platform) to deliver secure, consistent

features

- Operational excellence: contribute to runbooks, alerts, and iterative improvements to

reduce toil

data.title: Staff SRE for K8s Platform Team (AWS, Kubernetes, Platform Creation, Helm, Karpenter, Istio)
data.description:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence. 

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk. 

Workforce Identity Cloud
Okta Workforce Identity Cloud (WIC) provides easy, secure access for your workforce so you can focus on other strategic priorities, such as reducing costs and doing more for your customers. 
If you like to be challenged and have a passion for solving large-scale automation, testing, and tuning problems, we would love to hear from you. The ideal candidate is someone who exemplifies the ethics of, "If you have to do something more than once, automate it" and who can rapidly self-educate on new concepts and tools. 
Position Overview: 
The Staff Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) will play a key role in building and managing Kubernetes platforms that support cloud-native applications and services. This position focuses on architecting and managing reliable, scalable, and secure Kubernetes-based platforms on AWS, ensuring high availability and performance while optimising costs and automation. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with AWS infrastructure, Kubernetes platform creation, Helm charts, Karpenter scaling, and Istio service mesh. 
Key Responsibilities: 
 - Kubernetes Platform Creation: Design, implement, and maintain highly available, scalable, and fault-tolerant Kubernetes platforms. Ensure clusters are optimised for production workloads, providing high resilience and operational efficiency. 
 - AWS Infrastructure Management: Build, manage, and optimise AWS cloud infrastructure, including EKS, ECS, S3, VPCS, RDS, IAM, and more. Implement best practices for cost management, scaling, and security within AWS. 
 - Helm Management: Utilise Helm to automate and streamline the deployment of applications and services to Kubernetes clusters. Create, maintain, and manage Helm charts for production-ready deployments. 
 - Karpenter Implementation: Implement and manage Karpenter to dynamically scale Kubernetes clusters in response to workload demands.   
 - Istio Service Mesh Management: Configure and manage Istio to provide service-to-service communication, security, and observability within the Kubernetes clusters. Enable fine-grained traffic management, service discovery, and policy enforcement. 
 - Platform Automation & Scaling: Automate the deployment, scaling, and management of infrastructure and applications. Work with CI/CD pipelines to ensure a seamless flow from development to production with minimal downtime. 
 - Incident Management & Troubleshooting: Respond to incidents, troubleshoot, and resolve system issues related to performance, availability, and security in a timely and effective manner. 
 - Security & Compliance: Design and implement secure cloud infrastructure with appropriate access controls, network security, and compliance frameworks. 
 - Documentation & Knowledge Sharing: Create and maintain detailed documentation for Kubernetes platform setup, operational procedures, and best practices. Promote knowledge sharing across teams. Required Qualifications: 
 - 5+ years of experience with Kubernetes/ K8s, Helm, Karpenter, Istio; 
 - 8+ years of Experience with infrastructure-as-code tools like Terraform, Chef or  Ansible
 - 8+ years of Experience with serverless computing (AWS Lambda, API Gateway) and microservices architecture. 
 - Proven experience with AWS (EKS, ECS, RDS, S3, CloudFormation, IAM, etc. ) and solid understanding of cloud-native architectures. 
 - Strong expertise in Kubernetes platform creation, management, and optimisation (e. g. , setting up highly available clusters, networking, and storage). 
 - Hands-on experience with Helm for Kubernetes application deployment and management. 
 - Practical experience with Karpenter for dynamic scaling of Kubernetes clusters and optimising resource usage. 
 - Expertise in managing and securing Istio for service mesh, including traffic management, security, and observability features. 
 - Proficiency in CI/CD pipelines and automation tools (e. g. , Jenkins, GitLab, CircleCI, Terraform, Spinnaker, Ansible). 
 - Strong scripting and automation skills in Python or Go for infrastructure management and platform automation. 
 - Experience with monitoring, logging, and alerting tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, CloudWatch, and ELK Stack. Preferred Qualifications: 
 - Experience with multi-region cloud environments. 
 - Understanding of security best practices for cloud platforms and Kubernetes (e. g. , role-based access control (RBAC), encryption, and compliance frameworks). 
 - Familiarity with Docker and containerization principles. 
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent professional experience). 
 - Certifications (Preferred): CKA (Certified Kubernetes Administrator), CKAD (Certified Kubernetes Application Developer), or AWS Certified DevOps Engineer are highly desirable.

data.title: Application Developer-Google Cloud FullStack
data.description:
Introduction

A career in IBM Consulting is built on long-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You'll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you'll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You'll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences. 

Your Role And Responsibilities

As an Application Developer: Google Cloud FullStack, you will design and develop cloud-native solutions using microservices-based modular designs and API-driven microservices. You will work in an Agile environment, focusing on continuous release and improvement cycles, and collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver scalable and resilient applications. 

Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include

- Develop Rich UI Applications: Design and develop rich UI applications based on Single Page Applications (SPA) or microfrontends using frameworks such as ReactJS or Angular. 
 - Develop Scalable Backend Microservices: Develop scalable and resilient backend microservices based on 12-factor principles, bounded context of the business domain, and expose functionality via API and event interfaces using frameworks such as Springboot. 
 - Develop Data Models: Design and develop data models using modern SQL and No-SQL modeling techniques, and implement data storage solutions using databases such as DB2, PostgreSQL, or MongoDB. 
 - Implement Event-Driven Architectures: Develop event-driven applications using Kafka, Zookeeper, and other event-driven technologies, and implement cloud-native CI/CD pipelines for change release. 
 - Manage Cloud Services: Run and manage services on IBM Cloud, including PaaS, databases, event-driven services, observability, DevSecOps, storage, and networking. 

Preferred Education

Master's Degree

Required Technical And Professional Expertise

- Cloud-Native Solution Development: Experience with designing and developing cloud-native solutions using microservices-based modular designs and API-driven microservices, with a focus on continuous release and improvement cycles. 
 - Full Stack Development: Experience with developing rich UI applications based on Single Page Applications (SPA) or microfrontends using frameworks such as ReactJS or Angular, and developing scalable and resilient backend microservices using frameworks such as Springboot. 
 - Data Modeling and Storage: Experience with designing and developing data models using modern SQL and No-SQL modeling techniques, and implementing data storage solutions using databases such as DB2, PostgreSQL, or MongoDB. 
 - Event-Driven Architecture: Experience with developing event-driven applications using Kafka, Zookeeper, and other event-driven technologies, and implementing cloud-native CI/CD pipelines for change release. 
 - Cloud Service Management: Experience with running and managing services on IBM Cloud, including PaaS, databases, event-driven services, observability, DevSecOps, storage, and networking. 

Preferred Technical And Professional Experience

- Proficiency in Hyperscaler Cloud: Exposure to hyperscaler cloud services and frameworks, with ability to develop and deploy cloud-native applications. 
 - Knowledge of Test-Driven Development: Experience with test-driven development methodologies, with ability to write unit tests and integrate testing into CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Familiarity with IBM Cloud Services: Exposure to IBM Cloud services, including PaaS, databases, event-driven services, observability, DevSecOps, storage, and networking.

data.title: Engineer II, Software
data.description:
This is where  your work makes a difference. 

At Baxter, we believe every person-regardless of who they are or where they are from-deserves a chance to live a healthy life. It was our founding belief in 1931 and continues to be our guiding principle. We are redefining healthcare delivery to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond. 

Our Baxter colleagues are united by our Mission to Save and Sustain Lives. Together, our community is driven by a culture of courage, trust, and collaboration. Every individual is empowered to take ownership and make a meaningful impact. We strive for efficient and effective operations, and we hold each other accountable for delivering exceptional results. 

Here, you will find more than just a job-you will find purpose and pride.   

Your Role at Baxter: 

As Engineer II, Software of the Baxter's Specialty Monitoring group, you will be involved in design and development of software applications and features on embedded Linux for Patient Monitoring devices. This Software application uses Qt/QML as the user interface technology and C++ as the backend. 

  

What You'll be Doing: 

- Design and development of medical application and end-end feature development, unit testing, debugging, bug fixing. 
 - Technical risk identification and performance optimization on embedded platforms. 
 - Collaborate with scrum teams and ensure regular program planning and flow it down to PI and Sprint levels. 
 - Involve actively in project planning, scope changes and other nonstandard events throughout the life of the project. 
 - Manage stakeholder communication and progress reporting. 
 - Demonstrate superior knowledge of software development life cycles. 
 - Ensure that releases meet quality standards and functional requirements. 
 - Work with fellow team members and provide subject matter expertise to diagnose bugs and formulate solutions during testing cycles as well as during and after the project is deployed in production. 

  

What You'll Bring: 

- Degree in Bachelor of Engineering/ Computer Science. 
 - 4+ years in product development in Software with exposure to Technically Leading scrum teams. 
 - Strong Hands-on knowledge on C++ on embedded systems, Linux OS (Operating System), MVVM design Pattern. 
 - Knowledge of SDLC (Software Development Life Cycle) and Agile SW (Software) development methodologies. 
 - Knowledge and application of design patterns. 
 - Excellent teamwork and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively in a collaborative multinational environment. 
 - Outstanding communication skills. 
 - Demonstrated problem solving abilities and a proactive approach to addressing challenges. 

Equal Employment Opportunity

Baxter is an equal opportunity employer. Baxter evaluates qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, protected veteran status, disability/handicap status or any other legally protected characteristic.

data.title: Archt I-DevOps
data.description:
When you join Verizon

You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely - even if they're daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love - driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together - lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere & always. Want in? Join the #VTeamLife. 

What You'll Be Doing. . . 

Type of Work: Highly technical, code-driven, and execution-focused. The daily focus is on accelerating the pre-sales cycle by building automated demo labs, scripting repetitive sales engineering tasks (like BOM generation and RFP parsing), and showcasing network automation capabilities to enterprise customers. 

Expected Volumes: High volume of scripting, API integration, and lab management. You will maintain internal code repositories, write Infrastructure as Code (IaC) templates, manage automated demonstration portals, and execute high-speed Proof of Concepts (PoCs) concurrently. 

Risk & Criticality: Moderate commercial risk. You are the technical automation engine for the team. While senior architects design the overarching telecom solutions, your code directly dictates how fast and effectively those solutions can be demonstrated and quoted. Broken scripts or failed API calls during a live demo can derail customer confidence and stall the sales cycle. 

What We're Looking For. . . 

- Pre-Sales Workflow Automation: Write scripts to eliminate manual pre-sales bottlenecks. Automate the generation of Bill of Materials (BOMs) by querying CPQ APIs, automate network diagramming, and use data parsing to accelerate RFP/RFI responses. 
 - Zero-Touch Provisioning (ZTP) Demonstrations: Build and maintain the scripts used in live customer pitches. You will help senior architects show (not just tell) customers how easily our telecom network can be provisioned and managed via APIs. 
 - API & Systems Integration: Serve as the team's API expert. Connect disparate pre-sales tools (e. g. , Salesforce, CPQ, vendor portals, and internal lab hypervisors) to create a seamless, automated workflow for the Solutions Architecture team. 
 - NetDevOps Handoff: Revolutionize the pre-sales-to-delivery handoff. Instead of handing over Word documents, package your successful solution design as Git repositories, JSON payloads, and Ansible playbooks for the Implementation team to deploy instantly. 
 - Foundational Network Support: Understand the basics of the telecom and networking equipment you are automating (IP addressing, routing basics, firewalls) just enough to successfully write the code that provisions them. 

You'll Need To Have

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field. 
 - 2 to 4 years of hands-on experience in network automation, scripting, DevOps, or a heavily automated systems engineering role. 
 - Automation & Scripting: High proficiency in Python. Deep understanding of how to interact with RESTful APIs, manage authentication (OAuth, API keys), and parse data formats like JSON, YAML, and XML. 
 - Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Hands-on experience with configuration management and provisioning tools such as Ansible, Terraform, or Nornir. 
 - Version Control: Comfortable using Git and collaborative platforms like GitHub or GitLab to manage and document your code. 
 - Experience integrating or building with LLM APIs (Anthropic Claude, OpenAI) to automate internal workflows, such as parsing dense technical RFPs or auto-generating technical documentation. 

Even better if you have one or more of the following: 

- Industry certifications focused on automation, such as Cisco DevNet Associate, AWS Certified Developer, or HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate. 
 - Experience with CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitLab CI) applied to network infrastructure (NetDevOps). 
 - Basic Networking Context: Must understand foundational networking concepts (OSI model, IP Subnetting, basic routing, and what a firewall does) to know what your scripts are automating. 

Where you'll be working

In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes work from home and assigned office days set by your manager. 

Scheduled Weekly Hours

40

Equal Employment Opportunity

Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, gender, disability or any other legally protected characteristics.

data.description:
Company

Qualcomm India Private Limited

Job Area

Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Hardware Engineering

General Summary

As a leading technology innovator, Qualcomm pushes the boundaries of what's possible to enable next-generation experiences and drives digital transformation to help create a smarter, connected future for all. As a Qualcomm Hardware Engineer, you will plan, design, optimize, verify, and test electronic systems, bring-up yield, circuits, mechanical systems, Digital/Analog/RF/optical systems, equipment and packaging, test systems, FPGA, and/or DSP systems that launch cutting-edge, world class products. Qualcomm Hardware Engineers collaborate with cross-functional teams to develop solutions and meet performance requirements. 

Minimum Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Engineering, or related field and 6+ years of Hardware Engineering or related work experience. 

OR

Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Engineering, or related field and 5+ years of Hardware Engineering or related work experience. 

OR

PhD in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Engineering, or related field and 4+ years of Hardware Engineering or related work experience. 

We are looking for a Staff / Senior Staff CPU Tools, Platform & QA Engineer to drive the quality, validation, automation, and scalability of CPU engineering infrastructure across the complete product lifecycle - from testbench and emulation platforms through firmware and silicon. 

The role will have broad technical ownership across CPU tools, PnP (Power & Performance), telemetry, regression infrastructure, firmware, and platform QA (BareMetal and OS based Frameworks test execution etc. )

This is a senior technical leadership role requiring strong CPU fundamentals, software/firmware expertise, validation and automation experience, and the ability to debug complex issues spanning CPU hardware, tools, firmware, emulation, and silicon. 

Key Responsibilities

- Define and drive end-to-end QA and validation strategy for CPU tools and platforms across: 
 - Pre-silicon testbenches
 - Emulation platforms
 - Firmware / bare-metal environments
 - Silicon platforms
 - Post-silicon labs

- Own quality and validation of CPU infrastructure including: 
 - CPU firmware and low-level software
 - Platform testbenches
 - PnP infrastructure
 - Telemetry and data-collection frameworks
 - Regression and automation infrastructure

- Drive Power & Performance (PnP) framework validation, including automated execution, data collection, analysis, regression detection, and correlation across platforms. 
 - Develop and maintain telemetry regression frameworks to track CPU performance, power, functional, and system-level metrics across builds, platforms, and silicon generations. 
 - Establish automated nightly/weekly regression pipelines, including: 
 - Test execution
 - Telemetry collection
 - Golden-data comparison
 - Performance/power deviation analysis
 - Regression detection
 - Failure triage
 - Dashboards and reporting

- Build mechanisms to correlate emulation, testbench, and silicon results, enabling early identification of potential silicon issues. 
 - Define quality gates and release criteria for CPU tools, firmware, PnP infrastructure, telemetry, and platform releases. 
 - Drive root-cause analysis of failures spanning CPU architecture, firmware, tools, test infrastructure, emulation, and silicon. 
 - Identify systemic gaps in test coverage, telemetry, automation, and regression infrastructure and drive solutions across engineering organizations. 
 - Develop scalable frameworks that transition CPU validation from manual execution to automated, data-driven QA. 
 - Partner closely with CPU architecture, design, firmware, CAD, validation, performance, power, emulation, and post-silicon teams. 
 - Lead technical initiatives across multiple CPU programs and generations. 
 - Mentor engineers and provide technical direction to distributed engineering teams. 

PnP & Telemetry Responsibilities

- Define methodology for CPU power and performance characterization and regression. 
 - Build automated pipelines for collecting and analyzing: 
 - CPU performance metrics
 - Frequency / Fmax behavior
 - Power metrics
 - Performance counters / telemetry
 - Workload-level KPIs
 - Platform health metrics

- Establish golden baselines and deviation thresholds for automated regression detection. 
 - Develop correlation between pre-silicon models, emulation, and silicon telemetry. 
 - Detect performance/power regressions early and drive cross-functional debug to root cause. 
 - Build dashboards providing clear visibility into CPU quality, performance, power, and platform health. 
 - Enable scalable telemetry analysis across large regression datasets and multiple CPU programs. 

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or related field. 
 - 10+ years of relevant engineering experience, with demonstrated technical leadership at Staff/Senior Staff level. 
 - Strong understanding of CPU architecture, system architecture, and low-level software. 
 - Experience in CPU validation, post-silicon, emulation, firmware, performance, power, or system-level engineering. 
 - Strong programming skills in C/C++ and Python. 
 - Experience developing automation, regression, CI/CD, telemetry, and QA frameworks. 
 - Strong debugging skills across hardware/software boundaries. 
 - Experience analyzing large datasets and identifying performance, power, functional, or telemetry regressions. 
 - Ability to lead complex cross-functional debug and drive issues to closure. 
 - Strong written and verbal communication skills. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with ARM / ARM64 CPU architecture and ISA. 
 - Experience with CPU Power & Performance (PnP) validation. 
 - Experience with CPU performance counters, telemetry, profiling, and workload characterization. 
 - Experience with Veloce, Palladium, or equivalent emulation platforms. 
 - Experience with CPU firmware, bare-metal environments, Linux, and low-level debugging. 
 - Experience with post-silicon CPU validation and silicon debug. 
 - Experience developing large-scale regression infrastructure and data analytics. 
 - Experience establishing golden-data based regression and automated quality dashboards. 
 - Experience across multiple CPU generations or complex SoC programs. 

Staff / Senior Staff Leadership Expectations

At This Level, The Engineer Is Expected To

- Drive technical strategy and architecture, not just execute individual projects. 
 - Own quality across the Tools → Firmware → Testbench → Emulation → PnP/Telemetry → Silicon ecosystem. 
 - Identify systemic problems and develop solutions that scale across CPU programs. 
 - Influence architecture, infrastructure, and validation methodologies. 
 - Lead complex cross-functional technical investigations. 
 - Establish engineering standards for automation, regression, telemetry, and quality. 
 - Mentor engineers and raise the technical bar across the organization. 

Core Ownership Areas

CPU Tools | Firmware | Testbenches | Emulation | Silicon | PnP | Telemetry | Regression | QA | Automation

With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry‐first model which brings together the best of in‐house and third‐party capability. 

We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal. 

#VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture

About This Role

We are seeking a Performance Testing Lead to deliver high‐quality non‐functional testing services across VOIS in a telecommunications environment. The role is responsible for defining and executing performance testing strategies, leading performance test delivery across onshore and offshore teams, and ensuring platforms, services and components meet agreed quality, cost and timeline commitments. This role operates across cloud, CRM and middleware domains, with a strong focus on continuous improvement, reuse of test assets and adherence to global testing standards. 

What You'll Do

- Define and execute performance and non‐functional test strategies aligned to telecom platforms, delivery approaches and strategic initiatives
 - Plan, design and execute performance tests using appropriate tools, scripts and scenarios
 - Work closely with business stakeholders to gather requirements, define acceptance criteria and communicate performance outcomes
 - Analyse non‐functional requirements and perform volumetric analysis to ensure realistic test coverage
 - Execute and coordinate performance testing activities across multi‐vendor, global delivery environments
 - Analyse test results and communicate findings clearly to technical and non‐technical stakeholders
 - Drive improvements in test automation, reusability of test assets and overall testing efficiency
 - Develop and maintain non‐functional test strategies, ensuring alignment to project risk profiles and delivery schedules
 - Collaborate with application and development teams to resolve performance issues identified during testing
 - Promote reuse of scripts, data sets and frameworks across non‐functional testing initiatives
 - Apply performance testing tools such as LoadRunner, JMeter, SOAP UI and related technologies

data.title: Forward Deployed Architect { Mumbai}
data.description:
About DevRev

At DevRev, we're building the future of work with Computer - your AI teammate. Unlike traditional tools, Computer unifies all your data sources, tools, and workflows into a single AI-ready platform, giving employees real-time insights, proactive suggestions, and powerful agentic actions. It extends your existing software with AI-native apps and agents that work alongside your teams and customers - updating workflows, coordinating across teams, and eliminating repetitive work. We call this Team Intelligence: human-AI collaboration that breaks down silos, brings people back together, and frees you to solve bigger problems. Backed by Khosla Ventures and Mayfield with $150M+ raised, DevRev is trusted by global companies across industries. 

About The Role

As a Forward Deployment Architect, you will serve as a hands-on senior technical architect on the Applied AI Engineering team, owning the end-to-end design and delivery of AI-driven business transformation projects. 

You'll work closely with pre-sales teams to scope technical integration and implementation strategies, translating business requirements into architectural solutions. Once opportunities move to post-sales, you'll own the detailed technical designs from original scoping documents and drive execution including hands-on coding to build proofs-of-concept, custom integrations, and solution prototypes that validate technical feasibility. 

As the technical owner of the customer relationship, you'll partner cross-collaboratively to ensure successful delivery. Your role spans from understanding domain-specific customer needs to architecting scalable, agent-based AI solutions using DevRev's platform**, with direct involvement in implementing key technical components and debugging complex integration challenges. 

This position requires a unique blend of enterprise architecture expertise, AI solution design, hands-on development skills, customer empathy, and cross-functional collaboration. You'll act as the connective tissue between pre-sales, customer success, engineering, and product teams, bringing our AI capabilities to life for real-world business impact. 

What You'll Do

- Customer-facing: 80% working directly with customers 
 - Design & Deploy AI Agents: Build, configure, and launch intelligent agents using the DevRev platform to solve real customer problems. 
 - Integrate Systems: Connect AI agents with external platforms (e. g. , CRMs, APIs, databases) for seamless workflow automation. 
 - Optimize Performance: Tune prompts, logic, and agent configurations for accuracy, reliability, and scalability. 
 - Own Requirements: Partner with customers to deeply understand their needs and translate them into technical agent specifications. 
 - Prototype & Iterate: Lead live demos, build rapid proof-of-concepts, and refine solutions through customer feedback. 
 - Lead Execution: Define project plans, align internal teams, and ensure timely delivery of deployments. 
 - Advise Customers: Act as a trusted technical advisor on AI agent architecture, performance, and long-term scalability. 

What You Bring

- Experience: 7+ years in software development, AI/ML engineering, or technical consulting. Customer-facing experience is a plus. 
 - Background: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field. 
 - Coding Skills: Strong proficiency using TypeScript/JavaScript, Python, data structures and algorithms, (Nice to have: Go). 
 - Applied AI Knowledge: Large language models (LLMs), prompt engineering, frameworks like RAG and function calling, and building evals to validate agentic AI solutions. 
 - Cloud & DevOps: Hands-on experience with AWS, GCP, or Azure, and modern DevOps practices (CI/CD, containers, observability). 
 - System Integration: Comfortable integrating systems via APIs, webhooks, and event/data pipelines. 
 - Data-Driven Mindset: Use A/B testing, telemetry, and metrics to guide decisions and drive improvements. 
 - Communication: Strong written and verbal skills to articulate technical concepts to both engineers and business stakeholders. 
 - Customer Empathy: A bias for action and a relentless focus on solving problems for customers. 
 - Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related discipline. Advanced degrees or certifications in AI/architecture frameworks (e. g. , TOGAF, SAFe) are a plus. 

As part of our hiring process, shortlisted candidates will undergo a Background Verification (BGV). By applying, you consent to sharing personal information required for this process. Any offer made will be subject to successful completion of the BGV. 

How do we work?

Whatever your role, our values describe what we ask of each other. 

Be a bridger

Look beyond your own role. Ask questions, share context and help others get unstuck. That may mean bringing the right people together or picking up a problem that doesn't necessarily fit neatly into your job description. 

Care loudly

We want your perspective, not just your agreement. Speak up when something isn't working or someone needs support. Give honest feedback with respect for the person receiving it. Don't let an uncomfortable conversation become an unspoken problem. 

Own the outcome

Take responsibility for the result, not just your part in the process. Use AI to move the work forward, not to outsource your judgment. Make the call, check whether it worked and change course when it didn't. If something goes wrong, own it and help fix it. 

That's DevRev!

DevRev is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related condition, or any other basis protected by law.

After scaling rapidly into a best-in-class hub, we deliver the product innovation and enterprise capabilities that accelerate our global growth, profitability, and scale. As we expand Smartsheet India, we're searching for a Principal AI Engineer, who craves variety and ownership. You'll have the opportunity to work across multiple teams and disciplines, building a versatile skillset while solving the complex challenges of a global platform. 

You Will

- Own the target-state architecture for Smartsheet's AI platform, defining the standards that bind Data, Agents, Knowledge Graph, Context Graph into one coherent system. 
 - Set the architecture for the agent harness and sub-agent framework including orchestration, lifecycle, hand-off contracts, Evals (Offline and Online) and capability-tier classification used across all agent teams.

 - Build and maintain a reference agent framework that teams fork or extend, so no team re-solves orchestration, tracing, or deployment from scratch. 
 - Author and publish a shared skills and tools library with clear interface contracts and a versioning model any team can build on. 
 - Stand up fast, slim prototypes to de-risk architecture decisions (new sub-agent patterns, retrieval strategies, partner capabilities) before teams commit a roadmap to them, and own the criteria for promoting a prototype into a supported, shared capability. 
 - Define deployment, security, and governance patterns, including the standard path from prototype to production and the AI governance plane applied across platforms and agents. 
 - Serve as Smartsheet's primary technical lead for strategic technology partners - Databricks (Lakehouse, Unity Catalog, Unity AI Gateway), AWS (Bedrock, AgentCore), Anthropic (Claude, MCP, agent patterns), and others - running standing technical syncs and routing early-access programs through prototypes evaluated against real Smartsheet problems. 
 - Partner closely with Principal Engineers and team leads across Smartsheet, aligning to platform milestones through architecture authority in design and demonstrated prototypes. 
 - Engage with Forward Deployed Engineering (equipping the field team with reference frameworks and skills) and MCP/external parity (reviewing gate criteria before external commitments). 
 - Drive architecture decisions to close quickly and keep the escalation backlog near zero. 

You Have

- Deep, hands-on experience architecting production agentic systems on Databricks Platform, AWS Bedrock/AgentCore and MCPs
 - Experience in Agent harness/orchestration design, sub-agent boundaries, tracing and observability (e. g. , MLflow), Evals, Governance, Responsible AI and cost/latency instrumentation at platform scale. 
 - Strong background in Knowledge and Context graph based systems, including ontology design, ingestion pipelines, and retrieval/grounding evaluation. 
 - A builder's track record: you prototype rapidly, ship working software, and let adoption - not mandate - prove which patterns are right. 
 - Experience designing reusable, versioned software interfaces (skills, tools, libraries) that multiple teams adopt directly, with clear contracts and promotion criteria from prototype to production. 
 - Familiarity with modern LLM/agent tooling and standards, including Databricks, Bedrock, Strands SDK, and MCP (Model Context Protocol). 
 - Comfort operating as a technical DRI in strategic partner relationships (e. g. , Databricks, AWS, Anthropic), translating partner roadmaps and early-access capabilities into platform decisions. 
 - Proven ability to set cross-team technical standards and drive alignment without formal management authority - influencing through design quality, working prototypes, and clear documentation rather than positional control. 
 - Strong judgment on architectural tradeoffs spanning model selection, inference patterns, deployment, and governance, balanced with respect for team-level autonomy over delivery. 
 - Excellent cross-functional communication skills and translating ambiguity into documented, decisive architecture calls. 
 - Legally eligible to work in India on an ongoing basis

Get To Know Us

At Smartsheet, your ideas are heard, your potential is supported, and your contributions have real impact. You'll have the freedom to explore, push boundaries, and grow beyond your role. We welcome diverse perspectives and nontraditional paths-because we know that impact comes from individuals who care deeply and challenge thoughtfully. When you're doing work that stretches you, excites you, and connects you to something bigger, that's magic at work. Let's build what's next, together.

Job Title: Senior Backend Engineer - FastAPI & Python | HLD/LLD & AI Experience (Payments / FinTech / US Multinational)

Location: Bangalore / Hyderabad, India (Hybrid / On-site options)

Employment Type: Full-time

Experience Required: 2-5 Years

About The Opportunity

We are partnering with a prominent US-based payment transaction and financial technology enterprise that is scaling its state-of-the-art engineering hubs in Bangalore and Hyderabad. Our client processes high-volume global payment transactions, powers robust merchant solutions, and is aggressively integrating next-generation artificial intelligence and automated workflows into its core transaction security, fraud detection, and merchant intelligence platforms. 

They operate at high velocity-where production-grade reliability, ultra-low latency, and architectural excellence form the backbone of global financial operations. 

The Role

As a Senior Backend Engineer (FastAPI & Python), you will design, build, and scale high-throughput REST APIs and distributed microservices that power global payment transactions and intelligent AI-driven workflows. 

You will own both High-Level Design (HLD) and Low-Level Design (LLD) for critical backend systems, ensuring fault tolerance, low latency, and strict security compliance. Beyond traditional backend engineering, you will collaborate with AI teams to integrate LLM and RAG services seamlessly into payment rails, fraud detection pipelines, and merchant analytics. 

What You'll Own

System Architecture & Design: Own HLD and LLD for scalable, resilient, and high-performance backend microservices processing payment transactions. 

FastAPI & Python Development: Build production-grade, asynchronous REST APIs and backend services using Python, FastAPI, and modern concurrency frameworks. 

AI & LLM Integration: Architect backend pipelines that interface with Large Language Models, vector search databases, and automated decision engines. 

Database & Caching Management: Design efficient schemas, optimize queries, and manage high-throughput relational databases (e. g. , MySQL, PostgreSQL, MariaDB) and caching layers (Redis). 

Code Quality & Scalability: Establish rigorous coding standards, perform thorough code reviews, write comprehensive unit/integration tests, and ensure high system availability. 

Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with product managers, frontend teams, data engineers, and DevOps to deliver robust features from conception to production deployment. 

What We're Looking For

Experience: 2-5 years of professional backend software engineering experience, with deep expertise in Python and asynchronous frameworks (FastAPI/Flask). 

Architectural Mastery: Proven track record in designing robust HLD and LLD for distributed systems, microservices, and event-driven architectures. 

AI Familiarity: Hands-on experience integrating AI/ML models, LLM APIs, or vector search engines into backend applications. 

Data & Infrastructure: Strong proficiency with SQL databases, connection pooling, indexing strategies, and cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP/Azure, Docker, Kubernetes). 

FinTech / High-Scale Mindset: Understanding of transaction security, PCI-DSS compliance, API security best practices, and ultra-low latency requirements. 

High Agency: A proactive builder who thrives in fast-paced environments, takes end-to-end ownership of systems, and drives engineering excellence. 

Why Join?

High-Impact FinTech Scale: Build backend infrastructure that directly handles high-volume global payment transactions and merchant operations. 

Modern Technology Stack: Work with Python, FastAPI, advanced microservices, and applied AI without legacy baggage. 

Growth & Leadership: Play a pivotal role in shaping engineering standards and scaling technology hubs across Bangalore and Hyderabad. 

The Perks: Competitive compensation, flexible work culture, continuous learning budgets, and robust health benefits. 

Key Skills & Competencies Required

Python & FastAPI (Asynchronous Programming)

High-Level Design (HLD) & Low-Level Design (LLD)

Distributed Microservices Architecture

AI & LLM Backend Integration

Relational Databases & Query Optimization (MySQL/PostgreSQL)

Caching & Message Queues (Redis, RabbitMQ/Kafka)

RESTful API Design & Documentation

Cloud Infrastructure & Containerization (Docker, Kubernetes, AWS)

Unit Testing & CI/CD Pipelines

FinTech / Payment Domain Security & Scalability

Interested candidates may apply directly or reach out to learn more about this exciting mandate. 

Skills: microservices, level design, redis, sql, security, python, postgresql, fintech, databases, fastapi, rest apis, ci/cd, aws, mysql, gcp, azure, docker, integration, infrastructure, kubernetes, kafka

Preferred Qualifications That Set You Apart: 

- Experience with Azure Logic Apps, Azure Functions, and Azure API Management for extending Power Platform solutions.

 - Good to have experience in HTML5, CSS, Javascript, Asp. net, C#, jQuery

We foster an environment that encourages innovation, collaboration, and diverse perspectives-because we know that great ideas come from great teams. data.title: Quality and Reliability Manager – Memory Products
data.description:
Quality and Reliability Manager Memory Products

Location: Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India

Work Mode: Onsite

Employment Type: Full-Time

Experience: 12 - 18 Years

Industry: Semiconductor / ATMP / OSAT / Memory Products

Role Overview

We are looking for a Quality and Reliability Manager to lead product-quality, package-reliability and qualification activities for memory products in a high-volume semiconductor assembly and test environment. 

The role will own reliability strategy, qualification execution, product-health monitoring, failure analysis and corrective-action closure for DRAM, NAND and related memory products. The position requires strong semiconductor product-quality knowledge and experience working across packaging, assembly, test, product engineering, manufacturing and customer-quality functions. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead quality and reliability engineering for semiconductor memory products and package technologies. 
 - Develop product- and package-qualification strategies aligned with JEDEC and customer requirements. 
 - Define reliability test plans, qualification matrices, sample sizes, acceptance criteria and release requirements. 
 - Manage reliability testing, including HTOL, HAST/uHAST, temperature cycling, MSL and high-temperature storage. 
 - Review qualification results and approve products, packages, materials and process changes for manufacturing release. 
 - Monitor product-health, reliability, yield, defect and quality indicators during high-volume manufacturing. 
 - Lead investigation of reliability failures, manufacturing excursions, customer returns and field-quality issues. 
 - Coordinate electrical and physical failure analysis to identify package-, process-, material- and device-related causes. 
 - Drive root-cause analysis, containment, corrective action and recurrence-prevention activities. 
 - Partner with package, product, process, test and equipment engineers during NPI and production ramp-up. 
 - Assess reliability risks associated with material, equipment, supplier, process and package changes. 
 - Establish reliability-monitoring plans and early-warning mechanisms for abnormal product trends. 
 - Support supplier qualification and improvement programs for substrates, leadframes, mold compounds and other materials. 
 - Lead 8D, CAPA, FMEA and risk-assessment activities for product-quality and reliability issues. 
 - Prepare qualification reports, reliability summaries, risk assessments and customer-facing technical documentation. 
 - Support customer audits, quality reviews and technical discussions related to product and package reliability. 
 - Build and develop the quality and reliability engineering team. 
 - Ensure laboratory methods, equipment and records comply with internal and industry requirements. Required Qualifications

- Bachelor s or Master s degree in Electronics, Electrical, Materials, Physics, Mechanical, Microelectronics Engineering or a related discipline. 
 - 12 18 years of semiconductor quality, product reliability, package reliability or qualification experience. 
 - At least 4 6 years of experience managing quality, reliability or failure-analysis engineers. 
 - Strong experience with semiconductor assembly, packaging and test operations. 
 - Knowledge of DRAM, NAND, NOR or other memory-product reliability is strongly preferred. 
 - Demonstrated experience planning and executing product and package qualification programs. 
 - Hands-on knowledge of accelerated reliability testing and failure mechanisms. 
 - Experience investigating qualification failures, manufacturing excursions and customer complaints. 
 - Strong understanding of statistical data analysis, quality systems and risk-management methodologies. 
 - Ability to support global teams and manufacturing escalations in a 24 7 production environment. Technical Skills Memory Product Quality

- DRAM and NAND product quality
 - Non-volatile memory reliability
 - Memory-package qualification
 - Product-health monitoring
 - Yield and defect analysis
 - Product-change qualification
 - Customer-quality management
 - Manufacturing-quality controls
 - Field-return analysis
 - Product lifecycle qualityReliability Testing

- High-Temperature Operating Life
 - Highly Accelerated Stress Test
 - Unbiased HAST
 - Temperature Cycling
 - Thermal Shock
 - Moisture Sensitivity Level
 - Preconditioning
 - High-Temperature Storage Life
 - Low-Temperature Storage
 - Board-Level Reliability
 - Mechanical and environmental testingPackage Reliability

- Die-attach integrity
 - Wire-bond reliability
 - Intermetallic formation
 - Delamination
 - Package cracking
 - Mold-compound and substrate interaction
 - Solder-joint reliability
 - Package warpage
 - Electromigration and corrosion
 - Thermal and mechanical stress
 - Multi-die and stacked-die package reliabilityFailure Analysis

- Electrical failure analysis

- JEDEC reliability standards

Passionate about driving the validation of next-generation SoCs from pre-silicon to post-silicon stages? Join our Silicon Validation team and play a key role in bringing cutting-edge semiconductor products to life. You will work on ARM-based platforms, validate high-speed interfaces, debug complex system-level issues, and collaborate closely with design, architecture, and software teams to ensure product quality and performance. 

Your role

Key responsibilities in your new role

- Own and execute pre-silicon and post-silicon validation activities for ARM-based SoCs and platforms. 
 - Develop, automate, and maintain validation frameworks using Python and C/C++/Embedded C. 
 - Create validation plans, test cases, and regression suites based on product specifications. 
 - Validate and debug high-speed interfaces and protocols including PCIe, USB, AXI, I2C, SPI, and UART. 
 - Perform system-level bring-up, functional validation, performance characterization, and issue triaging. 
 - Use lab equipment such as high-speed oscilloscopes and logic analyzers for silicon debug and root-cause analysis. 
 - Work closely with Architecture, Design, Firmware, and Software teams to identify, debug, and resolve silicon and system-level issues. 
 - Analyze validation results, document findings, and drive issue resolution through product release. 
 - Contribute to improving validation methodologies, automation infrastructure, and test coverage. 

Your profile

Qualifications And Skills To Help You Succeed

- B. E. /B. Tech or M. E. /M. Tech in Electronics, Electrical, Computer Science, Embedded Systems, or a related discipline. 
 - 3-5 years of hands-on experience in Silicon Validation, System Validation, or Platform Validation. 
 - Strong programming and scripting skills in Python and C/C++ or Embedded C. 
 - Solid understanding of ARM SoC architecture and embedded systems concepts. 
 - Experience working with high-speed interfaces and protocols such as PCIe, USB, AXI, I2C, SPI, and UART. 
 - Hands-on expertise with laboratory debugging tools, including oscilloscopes and logic analyzers. 
 - Strong debugging, problem-solving, and analytical skills with a structured approach to root-cause analysis. 
 - Ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams within a fast-paced semiconductor development environment.

Automation Testing builds how developers test and automate their APIs, from local runs and CI pipelines to scheduled and large-scale runs in the cloud. 

About The Role

You'll work across Automation Testing, starting with performance testing: load-testing APIs at scale. The role leans toward the product experience: how users set up and run tests, and read and debug their results. 

What You'll Do

- Build features that help developers test their APIs and automate those tests, locally, in CI and in the cloud

Nice to have

- Experience with load-testing tools such as k6, JMeter, Gatling or Locust

What Else?

In addition to Postman's pay-on-performance philosophy, and a flexible schedule working with a fun, collaborative team, Postman offers a comprehensive set of benefits, including full medical coverage, flexible PTO, wellness reimbursement, and a monthly lunch stipend. Along with that, our wellness programs will help you stay in the best of your physical and mental health. Our frequent and fascinating team-building events will keep you connected, while our donation-matching program can support the causes you care about. We're building a long-term company with an inclusive culture where everyone can be the best version of themselves. 

At Postman we value in person collaboration. We are in office 5 days a week for all roles based out of our hubs in San Francisco Bay Area, Boston, Austin, New York City, Tokyo and London. In our work, we focus on specific goals that add up to a larger vision. Our inclusive work culture ensures that everyone is valued equally as important pieces of our final product. We are dedicated to delivering the best products we can. 

Equal Opportunity

Postman is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status. Headhunters and recruitment agencies may not submit resumes/CVs through this website or directly to managers. Postman does not accept unsolicited headhunter and agency resumes. data.title: Manager, Salesforce Development
data.description:
Business Systems | ECI Solutions Hyderabad | On-site

Job Title

Manager, Salesforce Development

Location

Hyderabad, India - On-site

Work Model

On-site, 5 days per week

Department

Business Systems / Enterprise Applications (Internal IT)

Reports To

Chief Information Officer

Direct Reports

3-6 Salesforce developers and admins (India-based)

Employment Type

Full-time, permanent

Experience

9-14 years total; 6+ years hands-on Salesforce development; 2+ years leading a development team

Working Hours

India business hours with 2-3 hours of overlap with US Central Time

About Eci Solutions

ECI Solutions builds cloud-based business management and ERP software for small and mid-sized companies in manufacturing, distribution, building and construction, and field service. Our Business Systems organisation runs the Salesforce platform that our global sales, revenue and customer support teams depend on every day - a single connected org that sits at the centre of our quote-to-cash and customer-support operations and integrates with our ERP, billing, CPQ, data, and telephony systems. 

THE ROLE

We are hiring a hands-on Manager, Salesforce Development to run ECI's Salesforce engineering team in India. This is a player-coach role: roughly 50-60% of your time is spent designing and writing code, and the remainder is spent leading people, setting technical standards, reviewing work, and partnering with stakeholders in the US and Europe. 

You will own the technical quality of everything the team ships across Service Cloud and Sales/Revenue Cloud, including the integrations that connect Salesforce to our ERP, billing, and support systems, and the Agentforce and Data Cloud capabilities we are rolling out across service and revenue operations. 

This role suits an engineer who is still energised by solving hard platform problems but has grown past wanting to be the only person who can solve them. 

Key Responsibilities

Technical Leadership

- Own the technical design of Salesforce solutions across Service Cloud, Sales Cloud and Revenue Cloud, balancing declarative configuration against custom code and documenting the reasoning behind each choice. 
 - Set and enforce coding standards, design patterns, naming conventions, test-coverage expectations, and a definition of done for the team. 
 - Run code reviews as a teaching exercise, not a gate - raise the team's ceiling, not just the pull request's. 
 - Guard against technical debt: governor limit risk, hard-coded IDs, uncontrolled triggers, duplicated automation, and sprawling unmanaged Flows. 
 - Partner with architects and the US platform team on org strategy, release planning, and Salesforce release readiness (three major releases per year). 

Hands-on Delivery

- Write and review production Apex, Lightning Web Components, SOQL, Flow, and integration code for the most complex and highest-risk work on the backlog. 
 - Design and build integrations between Salesforce and ERP, billing, CPQ, data warehouse, and telephony platforms using REST/SOAP APIs, Platform Events, Change Data Capture, and middleware such as MuleSoft. 
 - Lead the build-out of Agentforce agents, Prompt Builder templates, and Data Cloud grounding for internal service and revenue use cases, including the guardrails, testing and monitoring that make them safe to deploy. 
 - Troubleshoot production incidents, lead root-cause analysis, and drive permanent fixes rather than repeat workarounds. 

People and Delivery Management

- Line-manage a team of developers and admins: goal setting, one-to-ones, performance reviews, growth plans, and certification paths. 
 - Plan and sequence sprint work with product owners and business stakeholders; protect the team from thrash and make trade-offs visible early. 
 - Onboard and mentor junior developers, giving them real work with a safety net. 
 - Interview and help hire additional developers as the India team grows. 

DevOps and Governance

- Own the release process end to end: source control branching strategy, CI/CD pipeline, sandbox seeding, regression testing, and deployment. 
 - Maintain environment strategy and data management practices, including sandbox refresh planning and data masking for non-production orgs. 
 - Ensure solutions meet security, access control, audit, and data-privacy requirements, and participate in security and compliance reviews. 

Required Qualifications

- Experience: 9-14+ years in software engineering, with at least 6 years building on the Salesforce platform and at least 2 years leading or formally mentoring a development team. 
 - Apex and LWC: Expert-level Apex (asynchronous patterns, batch, queueable, trigger frameworks, bulkification, governor limits) and Lightning Web Components with modern JavaScript. 
 - Breadth across clouds: Production experience in both Service Cloud and Sales Cloud; working knowledge of CPQ or Revenue Cloud quote-to-cash processes. 
 - Integration: Proven experience integrating Salesforce with ERP or financial systems - REST/SOAP, authentication patterns (OAuth 2. 0, JWT, Named Credentials), error handling, retry and reconciliation design. 
 - Data model design: Ability to design a scalable Salesforce data model and reason about sharing, visibility and large data volumes. 
 - DevOps: Git-based source control, Salesforce DX, and a CI/CD toolchain (Copado, Gearset, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, or GitHub Actions). 
 - Testing: Disciplined about unit testing, test data factories, and meaningful assertions - not coverage padding. 
 - Communication: Able to explain a technical trade-off to a non-technical business stakeholder in writing, in English, without losing them or oversimplifying. 
 - Availability: Able to work on-site and to overlap with US-based stakeholders for part of the day. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with Agentforce, Einstein, Prompt Builder, Agent Builder, or Data Cloud in a production setting. 
 - Experience in an internal IT or business systems function, supporting a single large org rather than multiple client projects. 
 - MuleSoft Anypoint Platform or comparable enterprise middleware experience. 
 - Familiarity with MuleSoft IDP and Fabric a plus. 
 - Experience with Salesforce Field Service, Experience Cloud, or Marketing Cloud Account Engagement. 
 - Exposure to an ERP platform (SAP, NetSuite, Microsoft Dynamics, Infor, or a vertical ERP) and to order-to-cash processes. 
 - Experience migrating from Salesforce CPQ to Revenue Cloud Advanced. 
 - Background in a SaaS or software company. 

CERTIFICATIONS

- Required: Salesforce Certified Platform Developer I. 
 - Strongly preferred: Salesforce Certified Platform Developer II. 
 - Valued: Application Architect, Integration Architect, Service Cloud Consultant, Sales Cloud Consultant, Revenue Cloud Consultant, Agentforce Specialist, or JavaScript Developer I. 

What Success Looks Like

- By 60 days: You know the org, its automation, its integrations, and its sore spots; you have shipped production code; you have met every stakeholder who files work with the team. 
 - By 6 months: Coding standards and a review process are in place and used; release cadence is predictable; each team member has a written growth plan; the top two or three sources of recurring production issues have been permanently fixed.

Design calculations and reviews

Inter-discipline checks with Process, Electrical, Piping, Mechanical and Civil

Exposure to international clients and codes (US, Canada, Europe or Middle East)

SPEED & SPIRIT is what we look for in our candidates, defined by some simple values that inspire us to BE DRIVEN in our performance, BE VIBRANT in our sporting legacy, BE TOGETHER in our team spirit, and BE YOU to let our individual talent and experience shine. You will be part of the Core Commerce Platform organisation responsible for delivering the omnichannel commerce capabilities that power the purchase journey, inventory availability, delivery promise, order processing & fulfilment and post-purchase experiences across channels. Partner with Product Owners, Architects, Retail Technology, Supply Chain, and Business stakeholders to translate requirements into robust technical solutions.

 - Experience with enterprise order management platforms such as Fluent Commerce (preferred), IBM Sterling OMS, Manhattan Associates, Kibo Commerce, or Salesforce OMS is highly desirable. 
 - Hands-on software engineering experience with Java, Spring Boot, and modern microservices architectures, building scalable, resilient, and production-grade services. 
 - Deep understanding of the end-to-end order lifecycle, including order capture, sourcing, fulfilment, shipment, returns, exchanges, and post-purchase processes. 
 - Proven experience customizing and extending OMS capabilities to support evolving business requirements, omnichannel fulfilment models, and enterprise integrations. 
 - Strong knowledge of omnichannel commerce operations, including Ship-from-Store (SFS), Buy Online Pick Up In Store (BOPIS), Ship-to-Store, Curbside Pickup, Endless Aisle, and associated order routing strategies. 
 - Solid understanding of inventory management, sourcing optimization, fulfilment orchestration, and order allocation concepts across stores, DCs, and third-party fulfilment networks. 
 - Proven experience integrating OMS platforms with Commerce, WMS, ERP, POS, Payment, 3PL, Carrier, and Customer Service systems to enable end-to-end order visibility and orchestration. 
 - Experience designing OMS-centric microservice architectures with clear domain boundaries across Order Management, Inventory, Sourcing, Fulfilment, Returns, and Customer Service capabilities. 
 - Hands-on experience with Kafka or similar event-streaming platforms for event-driven architectures, asynchronous processing, and enterprise-scale system integrations. 
 - Experience with performance engineering, scalability testing, and optimization of high-throughput, business-critical commerce platforms. 
 - Experience defining and implementing capacity planning, resiliency, and scaling strategies to support peak trading events and global commerce operations. 
 - Experience driving technical architecture, establishing engineering standards, mentoring engineers, and influencing technical direction across cross-functional teams. 
 - Experience leveraging AI-assisted engineering tools, coding agents, and LLM-powered development workflows to improve engineering productivity, software quality, and delivery efficiency. 

PUMA provides equal opportunities for all job applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or disability. Because at PUMA, whoever wants to play, can play. 

PUMA is a global sports brand creating footwear, apparel, and accessories that inspire athletes and everyday movers. The PUMA Group owns PUMA, Cobra Golf, and stichd, operates in 120+ countries, and has around 22, 000 employees worldwide.

Working across the full stack, you will develop user interfaces, backend services, APIs, integrations, and data workflows. 

AI coding assistants and agents will be central to your engineering approach, helping accelerate development while you retain responsibility for quality and technical decisions. 

You will collaborate directly with product and business stakeholders in an international environment, helping shape solutions and raise engineering standards. 

Your impact will be measured by your ability to deliver secure, maintainable, and production-ready software with minimal coordination overhead. 

Accountabilities

Responsibilities

You will own the complete engineering lifecycle, from understanding business problems and evaluating technical options to shipping reliable software and continuously improving it. Your responsibilities will include: 

- Translate business needs and loosely defined product requirements into technical plans, prototypes, production features, and iterative improvements. 
 - Design pragmatic architectures that balance development speed, simplicity, security, reliability, scalability, and infrastructure costs. 
 - Build full-stack solutions, including user interfaces, backend services, APIs, integrations, data models, and background processing workflows. 
 - Own production delivery across automated testing, CI/CD, cloud deployment, observability, troubleshooting, and performance optimization. 
 - Evaluate unfamiliar technologies, validate assumptions through focused experiments, and select tools and frameworks based on practical requirements. 
 - Use AI coding assistants, agents, and automation to accelerate research, implementation, testing, debugging, and documentation. 
 - Review and validate all code, including AI-generated output, while maintaining appropriate testing standards, documentation, and operational safeguards. 
 - Collaborate directly with product and business stakeholders to clarify requirements, challenge assumptions, define scope, and deliver meaningful increments. 
 - Strengthen engineering practices through design discussions, code reviews, reusable components, and knowledge sharing. 
 - Identify technical risks and trade-offs early, take responsibility for resolving them, and ensure delivered systems remain maintainable and ready to evolve. 

Requirements

The ideal candidate is an independent and technically versatile engineer with a strong record of delivering production software. You should combine deep technical expertise with sound product judgment, strong ownership, and the ability to work effectively with limited supervision. 

- Proven experience independently building and shipping production software, with ownership across multiple stages of the product lifecycle. 
 - Deep expertise in at least one backend ecosystem and strong working knowledge of modern frontend development, databases, APIs, and cloud infrastructure. 
 - Broad understanding of development tools, frameworks, and architectural approaches, with the ability to explain trade-offs and choose the simplest effective solution. 
 - Ability to become productive quickly in unfamiliar codebases, technologies, and technical environments. 
 - Strong understanding of system design, data modeling, asynchronous processing, caching, queues, authentication, authorization, and application security. 
 - Hands-on experience with automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, containers, monitoring, and production incident diagnosis. 
 - Practical experience using AI development tools for substantial engineering tasks, including task decomposition, context preparation, code review, and result verification. 
 - Strong debugging and problem-solving skills across application code, infrastructure, data, and third-party integrations. 
 - Sound product judgment, including the ability to prioritize essential functionality, reduce unnecessary scope, and make effective build-versus-buy decisions. 
 - Clear communication skills, strong accountability, and the ability to make progress independently while seeking feedback when valuable. 

Additional Experience That Would Be An Advantage

- Experience as an early engineering hire, founding engineer, or technical owner of a product built from scratch. 
 - Background developing SaaS platforms, multi-tenant systems, data pipelines, or integration-heavy products. 
 - Experience building LLM-powered features, agent workflows, or internal automation. 
 - Experience optimizing cloud infrastructure costs, application performance, and production reliability. 
 - Familiarity with conversion APIs, server-side tracking, or advertising platform APIs. 

Benefits

- Opportunity to join a stable, bootstrapped, and profitable startup environment. 
 - Competitive compensation. 
 - Employee-friendly ESOP programme. 
 - Work-from-anywhere flexibility with the freedom to organize your own working hours. 
 - Access to coworking spaces when you want an alternative to working from home. 
 - Health coverage for you and your family. 
 - International exposure through collaboration with clients and partners across the Gulf, Europe, Africa, India, APAC, and the United States. 
 - Annual company offsite and a relaxed, informal working culture. 
 - Transparent compensation discussions, with no salary-history requirements.

Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team. 

We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!

This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). You may exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection) at any time.
