data.title: Platform Engineer - Datacenter Infrastructure
data.description:
At F5, we strive to bring a better digital world to life. Our teams empower organizations across the globe to create, secure, and run applications that enhance how we experience our evolving digital world. We are passionate about cybersecurity, from protecting consumers from fraud to enabling companies to focus on innovation. 

Everything we do centers around people. That means we obsess over how to make the lives of our customers, and their customers, better. And it means we prioritize a diverse F5 community where each individual can thrive. 

About Us

F5 is a leading technology company dedicated to securing and optimizing applications across diverse on-premises, edge, and multi-cloud environments. We are looking for passionate individuals who are ready to help us build and scale resilient infrastructure that supports our global operations and innovative product suite. 

The Role

We are seeking a Platform Engineer to modernize and automate our virtual machine and core infrastructure services that form the backbone of our data center and hybrid-cloud environments. This role is multifaceted, focused on increasing the reliability, scalability, and security of foundational services such as DNS, PKI, logging, and observability through Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and GitOps practices, as well as scaling and executing on our VM and hypervisor management ecosystems. You will also be responsible for automating the deployment and lifecycle management of critical COTS (Commercial Off-The-Shelf) management tools. The ideal candidate has a strong background in traditional data center technologies and system engineering, combined with a passion for modern automation and platform engineering principles. 

Key Responsibilities

- Support hypervisor operations across a global datacenter footprint and provide VM management services, such as patching, backups, and monitoring through automation and at scale. 
 - Create and manage reusable Terraform modules and Ansible playbooks to ensure consistent, repeatable, and version-controlled deployments of all core services. 
 - Apply GitOps principles for managing all infrastructure and service configurations, using pull requests for changes and enabling automated reconciliation. 
 - Lead the architecture, automation, and operational management of core infrastructure services, including enterprise DNS, Public Key Infrastructure (PKI), and NTP. 
 - Design, build, and maintain a centralized log aggregation to feed observability platform for infrastructure and applications. 
 - Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines to automate the testing, validation, and promotion of changes to core service configurations and infrastructure. 
 - Embed security and compliance into the entire sevice lifecycle, including secret management, certificate lifecycle automation, and vulnerability scanning. 
 - Implement monitoring, alerting, and dashboards for all managed services, and apply SRE principles to improve their reliability and performance. 
 - Collaborate with network, security, and application teams to ensure seamless integration and consumption of core services. 

Required Qualifications

- +5 year experience working as a systems engineer or site reliability engineer supporting on-premise datacenter infrastructure and core infrastructure services 
 - Proficient with hypervisor technologies that support operating systems and containers (e. g. , VMware, Nutanix, Openshift) 
 - Proficient with automation and management of Windows Server and Linux VMs (eg Ubuntu, Redhat, Debian, etc) 
 - Deep hands-on experience engineering and automating core infrastructure services within a large-scale data center environment (e. g. , DNS/BIND, Active Directory Certificate Services/PKI). 
 - Experience building container platform capabilities in an on-premise ecosystem. 
 - Strong proficiency with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and configuration management tools, particularly Terraform and Ansible. 
 - Proven experience building CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure automation (e. g. , using GitLab CI, Jenkins, or similar tools). 
 - Comfortable with Git-based workflows (PR reviews, branching strategies, versioning) and GitOps principles. 
 - Strong scripting and programming ability (e. g. , Python, Bash, PowerShell) to build automation, integrations, and tooling. 
 - Solid understanding of data center networking concepts (TCP/IP, routing, firewalls) and security principles (least privilege, encryption, network security zones). 
 - Experience with centralized logging and observability platforms (e. g. , Splunk, Elastic Stack, LogicMonitor). 

Preferred Qualifications

- Familiarity with security and control frameworks such as NIST CSF, SOX, and ISO 27002. 
 - Experience working in hybrid-cloud environments and connecting on-premises services to public cloud providers (AWS, Azure). 
 - Knowledge of containerization and Kubernetes. 
 - Experience with platform engineering concepts like building internal tools and APIs to improve the developer/operator experience. 

The Job Description is intended to be a general representation of the responsibilities and requirements of the job. However, the description may not be all-inclusive, and responsibilities and requirements are subject to change. 

Please note that F5 only contacts candidates through F5 email address (ending with @f5. com) or auto email notification from Workday (ending with f5. com or @myworkday. com). 

Equal Employment Opportunity

It is the policy of F5 to provide equal employment opportunities to all employees and employment applicants without regard to unlawful considerations of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, sensory, physical, or mental disability, marital status, veteran or military status, genetic information, or any other classification protected by applicable local, state, or federal laws. This policy applies to all aspects of employment, including, but not limited to, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, discipline, and termination. F5 offers a variety of reasonable accommodations for candidates. Requesting an accommodation is completely voluntary. F5 will assess the need for accommodations in the application process separately from those that may be needed to perform the job. Request by contacting accommodations@f5. com.

data.title: SW QA Engineer - Simcenter Flightstream
data.description:
We are Siemens

Siemens Digital Industries Software is a leading provider of solutions for the design, simulation, and manufacture of products across many different industries. Formula 1 cars, skyscrapers, ships, space exploration vehicles, and many of the objects we see in our daily lives are being conceived and manufactured using our software. 

Siemens Digital Industries Software is seeking a talented and driven Software Quality Assurance Engineer to join our Quality Assurance team and contribute to the continued growth and development of our industry-leading CAE/CFD solutions. 

In this role, you will contribute across the software development lifecycle of Simcenter Flightstream, helping ensure the quality, accuracy, reliability, and robustness of capabilities used for aerodynamic, hydrodynamic, and multidisciplinary analysis. 

As a key member of the Quality Assurance team, you will independently design, develop, and execute manual and automated test cases, validate software capabilities delivered by the Development team, and analyze complex technical results. You will combine strong engineering knowledge with a quality mindset to identify issues, assess risks, improve test coverage, and continuously enhance testing tools and processes. 

The ideal candidate has a strong foundation in aerodynamics, CFD, or aircraft design, combined with excellent analytical thinking, attention to detail, problem-solving skills, and programming ability. 

Key Responsibilities

- Validate complex engineering capabilities: Design and develop comprehensive test cases to evaluate aerodynamic, hydrodynamic, and multidisciplinary capabilities, ensuring software results are accurate, reliable, and consistent with expected engineering behavior. 
 - Develop automated regression testing: Create, maintain, and improve automated regression tests to identify unintended changes and ensure the stability of Simcenter Flightstream capabilities across software releases. 
 - Analyze and communicate technical results: Analyze test results, investigate unexpected behavior, and prepare clear technical reports using visualizations, key performance indicators, and other relevant data. 
 - Ensure release quality: Thoroughly test software releases, assess quality and technical risks, document test execution results, and communicate findings and recommendations to relevant stakeholders. 
 - Investigate and manage defects: Identify, reproduce, document, and track software defects; communicate risks effectively and collaborate with Development teams to support timely investigation and resolution. 
 - Improve quality engineering practices: Identify opportunities to improve test coverage, automation, tools, and processes, contributing to the continuous improvement of the overall QA approach. 
 - Collaborate globally: Work effectively with a globally distributed and cross-functional team, contributing technical expertise and participating in projects across Quality Assurance, Development, and other engineering functions. 

Qualifications

- Master's degree in Aeronautical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Ocean Engineering, or a related technical discipline. 
 - Strong academic background or professional experience in Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD), aerodynamics, hydrodynamics, aircraft design, or related engineering disciplines. 
 - Solid understanding of aerodynamics and CFD workflows, including the ability to analyze engineering results and identify unexpected or potentially incorrect behavior. 
 - Knowledge of panel methods, vortex-lattice methods, or other reduced-order aerodynamic methods. 
 - Experience designing, executing, or analyzing complex engineering test cases, simulations, or validation studies. 
 - Programming or scripting experience using Python, C++, Java, or similar languages, with the ability to develop or maintain automated testing and analysis solutions. 
 - Strong analytical, problem-solving, and attention-to-detail skills, combined with excellent verbal and written communication skills in English. 

Preferred Skills

- Hands-on experience with Simcenter Flightstream and/or Simcenter STAR-CCM+, including the ability to create, configure, analyze, and troubleshoot complex simulation cases. 
 - Experience with software quality assurance, validation, verification, or regression testing of engineering or scientific software. 
 - Experience managing or troubleshooting Windows and Linux test environments. 
 - Experience creating technical reports, visualizations, and engineering performance indicators. 
 - Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively in a globally distributed and matrix organization. 
 - Strong ownership mindset, self-motivation, and commitment to continuous learning and technical development. 

Why Us

At Siemens Software, flexibility is how we work - hybrid by default, built on trust and autonomy. Together, 30, 000 people across more than 200 countries build technology that shapes the real world. You'll grow through real projects, strong technical peers, and global mobility, backed by the scale and benefits of an industrial software leader. We're committed to equality and inclusion, and we hire based on merit, skills, and impact. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!

Diversity & Inclusion

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities. At Siemens, we believe people who've had real experiences dealing with being different will excel as leaders. Let's foster a culture of creativity and innovation. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

data.title: Mechanical Design Manager
data.description:
Job Description: Mechanical Design Lead - Data Centers

Department: Design & Engineering

Reporting to: Mechanical Head

Location: Hyderabad / Mumbai

Experience: 10-17 years, with significant experience in data centre buildings and campus infrastructure

Qualification: B. Arch /M. Arch Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering; 

Role Purpose

Lead mechanical design and engineering for data centre buildings and campus infrastructure, ensuring design quality, multidisciplinary coordination, code compliance, cost optimisation, and timely delivery. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead design and engineering of PHE (Plumbing Health Engineering) systems, including water supply, plumbing, and drainage. 
 - Oversee Fire Fighting (FF) systems, Fire Sprinkler systems, and Fire Detection systems. 
 - Review HSD (High-Speed Diesel) systems, including diesel storage, transfer, and distribution for DG installations. 
 - Lead Water Tank Design, including capacity calculations and sizing. 
 - Review STP & WTP design, sizing, and campus utility integration. 
 - Review Fire Extinguishers selection, placement, and compliance. 
 - Oversee Gas Suppression system design for data halls, UPS rooms, electrical rooms, and other critical spaces. 
 - Review design calculations, drawings, technical specifications, BOQs, and GFC packages. 
 - Ensure multidisciplinary coordination with civil, structural, electrical, HVAC, architectural, and BIM teams. 
 - Drive design reviews, value engineering, standardisation, and compliance with applicable NBC, NFPA, IS codes, and project specifications. 
 - Manage design consultants, review schedules, technical queries, and construction-stage design issues. 
 - Lead the mechanical design team, monitor SLAs and project milestones, and report progress and risks to the Mechanical Head. Required Skills and Competencies

- Proven experience in mechanical design for data centre buildings and/or campus infrastructure. 
 - Strong technical expertise across all the mechanical systems listed above. 
 - Knowledge of design calculations, engineering standards, BIM coordination, and construction documentation. 
 - Working knowledge of AutoCAD, Revit MEP, and Navisworks. 
 - Strong leadership, consultant management, stakeholder coordination, and problem-solving skills. Key Performance Indicators

- Timely delivery of design packages and adherence to SLAs. 
 - Design quality, first-time-right submissions, and reduction in rework. 
 - Compliance with applicable codes, specifications, and quality standards. 
 - Timely closure of design comments, technical queries, and site issues. 
 - Effective consultant management, team performance, and multidisciplinary coordination.

data.title: Global Sanctions and SWIFT Utility Delivery Lead
data.description:
If you're looking for further opportunities to develop your career, take the next step in fulfilling your potential right here at HSBC. 

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organizations in the world, with operations in 58 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realize their ambitions. 

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Global Sanctions Technology Executive, GPS

The Opportunity

Own the strategy, integrated delivery, modernisation and reliable operation of HSBC's global sanctions screening capabilities within the GPS value stream in Global Payments Solutions, with explicit end-to-end technology accountability for Name Screening and Transaction Screening. The role leads approximately 200 colleagues and strategic partners supporting around 68 million screened transactions each month across 48 markets, together with the global party and record populations subject to continuous Name Screening, and provides a single point of technology leadership for roadmap execution, production readiness, resilience uplift, service transition and safe change. 

Translate the Screening Future State Architecture into controlled, measurable platform outcomes, bringing Name Screening and Transaction Screening together within a coherent Screening-as-a-Service strategy. Move fragmented, duplicative and vendor-centric utilities toward standard interfaces, common reusable services, consolidated screening data, end-to-end observability, consistent adjudication and governed automation, while retaining the distinct risk, regulatory, criticality, latency, resilience, geography and data-residency requirements of each screening type. The strategic direction is to shift from high-volume alert processing to outcome-led risk protection: preventing access or transactions outside risk appetite, improving true-positive detection, reducing false positives and manual intervention, and minimising unnecessary customer friction. 

What You'll Do

- Strategy, roadmap and investment: Own the multi-year global sanctions technology strategy and integrated roadmap for Name Screening and Transaction Screening, aligned to Group strategy, financial-crime risk appetite, regulatory expectations and the CBCC Future State Architecture. Set priorities, funding and sequencing to create a coherent Screening-as-a-Service utility, standardise the global operating model and shared building blocks, and make explicit build, buy, partner and retire decisions based on risk effectiveness, resilience, customer outcomes, strategic control and total cost. 
 - Name Screening and Transaction Screening transformation: Lead progressive modernisation across both screening domains. For Name Screening, advance globally consistent, model-driven continuous screening triggered by onboarding, party change, list change and risk events, with local variation only where regulation or data and hosting residency require it. For Transaction Screening, deliver high-throughput, real-time and 24x7 capabilities with regional segregation, scalable capacity, graceful degradation and no uncontrolled bypass, while strengthening tuning, layered auto-discounting and rapid response to geopolitical or regulatory change. 
 - Architecture, engineering and release excellence: Establish secure, scalable patterns across cloud and hybrid deployment, Kubernetes, Java/Spring, APIs, event streaming, distributed databases, caching, CI/CD and infrastructure automation. Embed automated testing, configuration management, observability, performance engineering and evidence-based release readiness, while meeting data and hosting residency requirements and maximising global standards and reuse. 
 - Risk effectiveness and control governance: Maintain zero tolerance for sanctions breaches and strengthen the effectiveness of Name Screening and Transaction Screening in line with policy, regulatory expectations and risk appetite. Improve true-positive detection while evidencing reductions in false positives; govern lists, policies, models, algorithms, filters, thresholds, routing, tuning and discounting through validation, impact analysis, segregation of duties, maker-checker controls, reconciliation, auditability and global standards with local divergence by approved exception. 
 - Service readiness, resilience and production outcomes: Own availability, capacity, performance, recoverability and continuity for mission-critical sanctions services, including evolution toward 24x7 transaction and continuous name screening. Ensure every material change is supportable and recoverable, with production-like testing, viable back-out, clear handover, post-implementation verification and sustainable remediation of incident, service-review and control-assessment actions. 
 - Data, observability, automation and AI: Create a trusted, consolidated screening data asset spanning Name Screening and Transaction Screening, with strong quality, lineage, completeness, reconciliation and end-to-end tracking from screening event to risk outcome. Use real-time analytics and transparent management information to support assurance and regulatory evidence. Govern AI-assisted matching, entity resolution, triage, prioritisation, recommendations and layered auto-discounting with human accountability, explainability, validation, drift monitoring, feedback loops and safe fallback arrangements, progressively moving toward near-zero-touch operations where the control evidence supports it. 
 - Customer and operational outcomes: Embed Name Screening and Transaction Screening controls seamlessly into customer onboarding, servicing and payment journeys. Apply risk-based segmentation, improve data capture at source and provide predictable turnaround and proactive status information. Reduce duplicate screens, repeat alerts, manual adjudication and unnecessary requests for information, while ensuring Financial Crime and Operations have the data needed to make timely decisions to reject, block, freeze, escalate or exit in accordance with policy. 
 - Leadership, governance and stakeholder alignment: Lead and develop a globally distributed, inclusive engineering organisation; own workforce shape, investment priorities, standards, talent and succession plans. Establish transparent, decision-oriented governance across Financial Crime, Operations, Global Businesses, regions, Group Data, Foundations Technology, Architecture, Cybersecurity, Risk, Audit, Finance and Procurement; manage suppliers against measurable delivery, quality, security and service-readiness outcomes. 

Measures of success

- Predictable delivery of the Screening-as-a-Service roadmap for Name Screening and Transaction Screening against approved milestones, investment and benefit commitments, with greater reuse of common capabilities and less duplication across screening types, regions and products. 
 - Measurably improved risk effectiveness across Name Screening and Transaction Screening: stronger true-positive detection and designation-to-action outcomes, controlled reductions in false positives, duplicate alerts, manual adjudication and repeated customer outreach, and faster risk-led decisioning. 
 - Resilient, secure and scalable screening services, including continuous Name Screening and real-time 24x7 Transaction Screening, with improved availability, throughput, recovery performance and capacity for peak volumes, list events and regulatory change, and reduced change failure, high-severity incidents and customer disruption. 
 - Reliable data, observability and regulatory evidence, with demonstrable governance of lists, models, policies, filters, algorithms, AI and configuration changes. 
 - A sustainable, inclusive and high-performing global technology organisation and effective strategic supplier ecosystem. 

Role

What you will need to succeed in the role

- Significant senior technology, engineering and platform-delivery leadership experience in global payments, sanctions screening, financial crime technology or a comparable regulated, mission-critical domain. 
 - Proven delivery of complex, multi-year transformation across regions, business lines, platforms and suppliers, including legacy modernisation and product/platform operating models. 
 - Strong knowledge of transaction and name screening, list management, matching/filtering, adjudication, case management, discounting, customer outreach and associated regulatory controls. 
 - Deep understanding of cross-border payments, ISO 20022, payment messaging and payment-processing controls, together with the operation of high-volume, high-availability and preferably 24x7 services. 
 - Practical command of modern cloud/hybrid engineering, containerisation, APIs, event streaming, distributed data, CI/CD, observability, cybersecurity, data protection, resilience and disaster recovery. 
 - Experience leading controlled data, analytics, machine-learning or AI capabilities, and managing technology risk, audit, regulatory assurance, suppliers, utilities and build-versus-buy decisions. 
 - Evidence of building and developing large, globally distributed and culturally diverse teams, with exceptional executive, regulator and cross-functional stakeholder influence. 
 - Relevant degree, technology qualification or equivalent professional experience; cloud, architecture, engineering, resilience or security certification is desirable. 

You'll achieve more when you join HSBC. 

HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc. , We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role. 

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

data.title: Principal Software Engineer, Debug Tools
data.description:
Description

Invent the future with us. 

Ampere is a semiconductor design company for a new era, leading the future of computing with an innovative approach to CPU design focused on high-performance, energy efficient AI compute. 

As a pioneer in the new frontier of energy efficient high-performance computing, Ampere is part of the Softbank Group of companies driving sustainable computing for AI, Cloud, and edge applications. 

Join us at Ampere and work alongside a passionate and growing team - we'd love to have you apply!

About The Role

As a core member of the Ampere Debug Tools team, you will be responsible for the architecture, design, and development of Debug Tools solutions for the next generation of Ampere products. This role is distinguished by deep technical ownership, architecture leadership, and cross-team influence. 

The Debug Tools Team is part of the Ampere Software Team. Our mission is to develop a comprehensive debug strategy and roadmap for internal debug capabilities, as well as to develop and deploy debug solutions for all internal and external Ampere SoC users. 

- Internal users include Debug Tools software users from the Virtual Platform, Emulation, Platform, Design Validation (DV), Post-Silicon Validation, Design For Test (DFT), Firmware, Operating System, Software, Performance, and Application Engineering teams. 
 - External users include partners, ODMs, OEMs, datacenter, edge and embedded customers. 
 - Debug solutions include Arm Development Studio, TRACE32 PowerView, and OpenOCD debuggers, Arm Self-Hosted Trace for Linux, and utilities for invasive debug, bus trace, instruction trace, array dump, and scan dump. This role will be for the lead of the Arm Development Studio implementation. 

What You'll Achieve

- Architect, design, develop, and deploy software-based Debug Tools for custom 64-bit Armv9 SoC and other processors. 
 - Invent new debug tools and techniques for future products and technologies. 
 - Influence the architecture and design team decisions with knowledge of internal and external debug tools on Ampere SoCs. 
 - Contribute to software architecture and design documents, application notes, and other software product documentation. 
 - Develop tooling for advanced debugging techniques, such as instruction trace, bus trace, array dump, scan dump, and ATE bootstrapping. 
 - Develop open source JTAG and self-hosted trace and debugger software for internal and external use in debugging Ampere microprocessors. 
 - Develop Arm Development Studio, TRACE32, and OpenOCD utilities for internal and external use in debugging Ampere microprocessors. 
 - Perform pre-silicon bring-up of debug software on software simulators and hardware emulation platforms. 
 - Collaborate with hardware design, architecture, post-silicon validation, and platform AE teams, as necessary, to resolve critical customer issues. 

About You

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or Software Engineering or related technical field & 8 years of related experience; or MS degree & 5 years; or PhD & 3 years
 - Proficiency with Arm® architecture and ecosystem, including Armv8-a/v9-a and Armv7-m processor architectures, Arm Debug Interface Architecture, Arm CoreSightTM Architecture, Arm AMBA® APB, AXI, AHB, and CHI protocols. 
 - Proficiency in C/C++, Python, and Bash programming. 
 - Experience using Arm Development Studio, TRACE32 PowerView, OpenOCD, and GDB debuggers. 
 - Experience with instruction trace, bus trace, scan dumps, array dumps, and crash capture. 
 - Experience with version control tools such as git, and software best practices. 
 - Strong analytical, debugging, and testing methodology skills. 
 - Proven ability to own problems and drive them to a resolution. 
 - Experience with system software debugging, tracing, and analysis tools, such as perf, ftrace, etc, is recommended. 

What We'll Offer

At Ampere we believe in taking care of our employees and providing a competitive total rewards package that includes base pay, cash long-term incentive, and comprehensive benefits. 

Benefits Highlights Include

- Premium medical, dental, vision insurance, parental benefits including creche reimbursement, as well as a retirement plan, so that you can feel secure in your health, financial future and child care during work. 
 - Generous paid time off policy so that you can embrace a healthy work-life balance 
 - Fully catered lunch in our office along with a variety of healthy snacks, energizing coffee or tea, and refreshing drinks to keep you fueled and focused throughout the day. 

And there is much more than compensation and benefits. At Ampere, we foster an inclusive culture that empowers our employees to do more and grow more. We are excited to share more about our career opportunities with you through the interview process. 

DR

Ampere is an inclusive and equal opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from all backgrounds. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, citizenship, religion, age, veteran and/or military status, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, physical or mental disability, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law.

data.description:
Some careers shine brighter than others. 

If you're looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC and fulfil your potential. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further. 

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions. 

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Consultant Specialist

The Opportunity

This role focuses on test management for the components and systems owned by a single delivery line within our Private Core Banking Platform - Avaloq. You'll help build an Automation Centre of Excellence and shape how automated testing is delivered across change and run activities. The role plays a direct part in improving automation levels to reduce manual intervention across testing and operational lifecycles including decisions on tooling and performance. You'll also help ensure products and services meet mandatory and regulatory requirements and that group controls are maintained with swift remediation when needed. Success means a robust and extensible Avaloq Test Suite, improved operational stability and automation that consistently meets customer needs. 

What you'll be doing

- Build an Automation Centre of Excellence for the Private Core Banking Platform - Avaloq 
 - Create and extend an Avaloq Test Suite with high levels of automation and ongoing optimisation 
 - Optimise automation levels across the team to reduce human intervention in testing and operational lifecycles 
 - Decide on testing tools and approaches to achieve optimal performance for automated testing 
 - Ensure products and services maintain compliance with mandatory and regulatory requirements 
 - Maintain group controls within pod activities and resolve remediation actions swiftly 
 - Own operational stability, integrity and availability for the banking platform 
 - Manage the team's delivery and operation of the automation suite to meet customer needs

What we're looking for

- Bring a strong testing background with automation using TestMaster 
 - Demonstrate deep hands-on experience working on the Avaloq platform 
 - Apply strong knowledge of test automation using the TestMaster tool 
 - Use Avaloq scripting and DDIC confidently to build and maintain automated tests 
 - Bring experience in the Private Banking domain 
 - Communicate clearly with senior stakeholders across systems and functions 
 - Develop IT solutions aligned to solution design and support continuous improvement including unit and integration testing 
 - Document solutions and changes with structured analysis and comprehensive written outputs

Building automation that protects stability

This is a chance to shape how automated testing supports a core private banking platform and the services built on top of it. You'll strengthen automation capability while supporting operational stability, controls and regulatory expectations. If you want your work to have clear impact across both change delivery and day-to-day platform reliability this role offers a strong platform to do it. Apply to help set the direction for Avaloq test automation at scale. 

You'll achieve more when you join HSBC.

data.title: IN_Associate_Automation Engineer with AI_GCC_Advisory
Lead Control Engineer
data.description:
Job Description Summary

Job Description

Roles and Responsibilities

- As part of controls team responsible for project deliverables, controls software validation, project specific software creation, FAT, SAT, HIL, commissioning support for Solar & Battery energy storage system (BESS) projects. 
 - Support on-site startup and integration of various systems to our hardware and software. 
 - Track overall status of controls deliverables and complete on time with quality for the assigned projects to meet goals of the control team. 
 - Have close interaction with project managers, various internal teams and customers to finalize engineering requirements with respect to contract scope and deliver the same to ensure customer satisfaction. 
 - Possess excellent communication skills and the ability to collaborate with customers with confidence and clarity. 
 - Develop, improve, and administer customer overview and operational training material for the control system. 
 - Work across the Hybrid engineering and services organizations to prepare documentation for installation, commissioning, and operations for use by internal GE employees and our customers. 
 - Work on design, develop and deploy the control hardware configuration for each project and design the communication network, including but not limited to DI/DO, Ethernet, FO and other industrial communication etc. 
 - Support problem identification and resolution of new and installed products. 
 - Drive performance and reliability enhancements back to the product
 - Participate actively in controls design, Software code reviews, testing and software validation. 
 - Work on standardization of controls project execution, software validation, implementation. 

Required Qualification & Experience

- Bachelor/master's degree in electrical /electronic/instrumentation/controls engineering or equivalent. 
 - Minimum 10+ years of experience in developing and implementing control software. 
 - Experience in GE's MarkVIe product & tools like GE's Toolbox ST, Workstation ST, Cimplicity software (SCADA), P80i software is preferable. 
 - Demonstrated Software expertise in Solar, Battery Energy storage, Plant level controls, validation and verification, formal methods, systems integration, advanced controls, or related technologies. 
 - Familiarity with standard industrial protocols such as OPC-UA, Modbus, EGD, Profibus, CAN bus, IEC 61850 and IEC 104 etc. 
 - Experience in PLC, DCS, SCADA, SQL and Matlab Simulink software. 
 - Experience in various countries grid code compliance particularly Australian grid code, PLQ & AEMO requirements, UK, USA, European, Germany, Itali, Turkey & India grid codes. 
 - Familiar with AS/NZS safety standards. 
 - Worked in any power generation industry like BESS, solar. renewable, thermal, nuclear etc. 
 - Experience in communication networks equipment's functionality, Selection, Software features, Hardware & Cyber security. 
 - Demonstrated implementation of controls or systems integration in products and field engineering experience. 

Desired Characteristics

- Ability to summarize and communicate complex technical information
 - Strong problem analysis and resolution skills
 - Curiosity, passion for excellence, drive to deliver on time
 - Knowledge of power conversion systems and controls. 
 - Present technical plans in voice of customer
 - Experience in working cross-functionally between Engineering, Sourcing, Manufacturing, Logistics, Product Management, etc. 
 - Self-started attitude is strongly requested
 - Demonstrate excellent verbal and written communication skills
 - Mentor & Guide team
 - Self-Starter, demonstrate ability to work effectively within and between teams and as Individual
 - Ability to energize teams and perceives change as an opportunity
 - Ability to work effectively in a culturally diverse and highly matrix environment. 

Additional Information

Relocation Assistance Provided: Yes

- Develop comprehensive and detailed test plans for ETL pipelines.

 - Create and manage UAT test plans and test cases based on existing dashboards, in close collaboration with the client's analytics team.

Testing skills:

 - User Acceptance Testing (UAT) Support

 - Visualizations Testing (Charts, Tables, Maps, Cards)

We are seeking a motivated Test Engineer with experience in network security testing and automation to validate and enhance the quality of our security products. data.title: Global Sanctions and SWIFT Utility Delivery Lead
data.description:
Location: Hyderabad/ Pune/ Bangalore

If you're looking for further opportunities to develop your career, take the next step in fulfilling your potential right here at HSBC. 

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organizations in the world, with operations in 58 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realize their ambitions. 

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Global Sanctions Technology Executive, GPS

The Opportunity

Own the strategy, integrated delivery, modernisation and reliable operation of HSBC's global sanctions screening capabilities within the GPS value stream in Global Payments Solutions, with explicit end-to-end technology accountability for Name Screening and Transaction Screening. The role leads approximately 200 colleagues and strategic partners supporting around 68 million screened transactions each month across 48 markets, together with the global party and record populations subject to continuous Name Screening, and provides a single point of technology leadership for roadmap execution, production readiness, resilience uplift, service transition and safe change. 

Translate the Screening Future State Architecture into controlled, measurable platform outcomes, bringing Name Screening and Transaction Screening together within a coherent Screening-as-a-Service strategy. Move fragmented, duplicative and vendor-centric utilities toward standard interfaces, common reusable services, consolidated screening data, end-to-end observability, consistent adjudication and governed automation, while retaining the distinct risk, regulatory, criticality, latency, resilience, geography and data-residency requirements of each screening type. The strategic direction is to shift from high-volume alert processing to outcome-led risk protection: preventing access or transactions outside risk appetite, improving true-positive detection, reducing false positives and manual intervention, and minimising unnecessary customer friction. 

What You'll Do

- Strategy, roadmap and investment: Own the multi-year global sanctions technology strategy and integrated roadmap for Name Screening and Transaction Screening, aligned to Group strategy, financial-crime risk appetite, regulatory expectations and the CBCC Future State Architecture. Set priorities, funding and sequencing to create a coherent Screening-as-a-Service utility, standardise the global operating model and shared building blocks, and make explicit build, buy, partner and retire decisions based on risk effectiveness, resilience, customer outcomes, strategic control and total cost. 
 - Name Screening and Transaction Screening transformation: Lead progressive modernisation across both screening domains. For Name Screening, advance globally consistent, model-driven continuous screening triggered by onboarding, party change, list change and risk events, with local variation only where regulation or data and hosting residency require it. For Transaction Screening, deliver high-throughput, real-time and 24x7 capabilities with regional segregation, scalable capacity, graceful degradation and no uncontrolled bypass, while strengthening tuning, layered auto-discounting and rapid response to geopolitical or regulatory change. 
 - Architecture, engineering and release excellence: Establish secure, scalable patterns across cloud and hybrid deployment, Kubernetes, Java/Spring, APIs, event streaming, distributed databases, caching, CI/CD and infrastructure automation. Embed automated testing, configuration management, observability, performance engineering and evidence-based release readiness, while meeting data and hosting residency requirements and maximising global standards and reuse. 
 - Risk effectiveness and control governance: Maintain zero tolerance for sanctions breaches and strengthen the effectiveness of Name Screening and Transaction Screening in line with policy, regulatory expectations and risk appetite. Improve true-positive detection while evidencing reductions in false positives; govern lists, policies, models, algorithms, filters, thresholds, routing, tuning and discounting through validation, impact analysis, segregation of duties, maker-checker controls, reconciliation, auditability and global standards with local divergence by approved exception. 
 - Service readiness, resilience and production outcomes: Own availability, capacity, performance, recoverability and continuity for mission-critical sanctions services, including evolution toward 24x7 transaction and continuous name screening. Ensure every material change is supportable and recoverable, with production-like testing, viable back-out, clear handover, post-implementation verification and sustainable remediation of incident, service-review and control-assessment actions. 
 - Data, observability, automation and AI: Create a trusted, consolidated screening data asset spanning Name Screening and Transaction Screening, with strong quality, lineage, completeness, reconciliation and end-to-end tracking from screening event to risk outcome. Use real-time analytics and transparent management information to support assurance and regulatory evidence. Govern AI-assisted matching, entity resolution, triage, prioritisation, recommendations and layered auto-discounting with human accountability, explainability, validation, drift monitoring, feedback loops and safe fallback arrangements, progressively moving toward near-zero-touch operations where the control evidence supports it. 
 - Customer and operational outcomes: Embed Name Screening and Transaction Screening controls seamlessly into customer onboarding, servicing and payment journeys. Apply risk-based segmentation, improve data capture at source and provide predictable turnaround and proactive status information. Reduce duplicate screens, repeat alerts, manual adjudication and unnecessary requests for information, while ensuring Financial Crime and Operations have the data needed to make timely decisions to reject, block, freeze, escalate or exit in accordance with policy. 
 - Leadership, governance and stakeholder alignment: Lead and develop a globally distributed, inclusive engineering organisation; own workforce shape, investment priorities, standards, talent and succession plans. Establish transparent, decision-oriented governance across Financial Crime, Operations, Global Businesses, regions, Group Data, Foundations Technology, Architecture, Cybersecurity, Risk, Audit, Finance and Procurement; manage suppliers against measurable delivery, quality, security and service-readiness outcomes. 

Measures of success

- Predictable delivery of the Screening-as-a-Service roadmap for Name Screening and Transaction Screening against approved milestones, investment and benefit commitments, with greater reuse of common capabilities and less duplication across screening types, regions and products. 
 - Measurably improved risk effectiveness across Name Screening and Transaction Screening: stronger true-positive detection and designation-to-action outcomes, controlled reductions in false positives, duplicate alerts, manual adjudication and repeated customer outreach, and faster risk-led decisioning. 
 - Resilient, secure and scalable screening services, including continuous Name Screening and real-time 24x7 Transaction Screening, with improved availability, throughput, recovery performance and capacity for peak volumes, list events and regulatory change, and reduced change failure, high-severity incidents and customer disruption. 
 - Reliable data, observability and regulatory evidence, with demonstrable governance of lists, models, policies, filters, algorithms, AI and configuration changes. 
 - A sustainable, inclusive and high-performing global technology organisation and effective strategic supplier ecosystem. 

Role

What you will need to succeed in the role

- Significant senior technology, engineering and platform-delivery leadership experience in global payments, sanctions screening, financial crime technology or a comparable regulated, mission-critical domain. 
 - Proven delivery of complex, multi-year transformation across regions, business lines, platforms and suppliers, including legacy modernisation and product/platform operating models. 
 - Strong knowledge of transaction and name screening, list management, matching/filtering, adjudication, case management, discounting, customer outreach and associated regulatory controls. 
 - Deep understanding of cross-border payments, ISO 20022, payment messaging and payment-processing controls, together with the operation of high-volume, high-availability and preferably 24x7 services. 
 - Practical command of modern cloud/hybrid engineering, containerisation, APIs, event streaming, distributed data, CI/CD, observability, cybersecurity, data protection, resilience and disaster recovery. 
 - Experience leading controlled data, analytics, machine-learning or AI capabilities, and managing technology risk, audit, regulatory assurance, suppliers, utilities and build-versus-buy decisions. 
 - Evidence of building and developing large, globally distributed and culturally diverse teams, with exceptional executive, regulator and cross-functional stakeholder influence. 
 - Relevant degree, technology qualification or equivalent professional experience; cloud, architecture, engineering, resilience or security certification is desirable. 

You'll achieve more when you join HSBC. 

HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc. , We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role. 

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website. 

- Issued By HSBC Software Development (India) Limited***

data.title: Senior Trading System Support Engineer
data.description:
Who are we?

FalconX is a pioneering team of operators, investors, and builders committed to revolutionizing institutional access to the crypto markets. Operating at the intersection of traditional finance and cutting-edge technology, FalconX addresses the industry's foremost challenges: Navigating the digital asset market can be complex and fragmented, with limited products and services that support trading strategies, structures, and liquidity found in conventional financial markets. As a comprehensive solution for all digital asset strategies from start to scale, FalconX operates as the connective tissue empowering clients with seamless navigation through the ever-evolving cryptocurrency landscape. 

Responsibilities

- Be part of a trading systems engineering team, dedicated to building out the core trading platforms. 
 - Work closely with cross functional teams to improve the system reliability, scalability and security. 
 - Engage in and improve the quality supporting the platform. 
 - Build and manage systems, infrastructure and applications through automation. 
 - Provide operational support to internal teams working on the platform. 
 - Work on improvements to bring in high efficiency, reduce latency, deploy systems faster. 
 - Practice sustainable incident response and blameless postmortems. 
 - Together with your engineering team, you will share an on-call rotation and be an escalation contact for service incidents. 
 - Implement and maintain rigorous security best practices across all infrastructure, with a focus on minimizing attack surface and ensuring data integrity. 
 - Monitor system health and performance with a keen eye for identifying and resolving issues before they affect trading activity. 
 - Manage user queries and service requests (often requiring in depth analysis of the technical and/or business logic of our systems). 
 - Proactive approach to problem analysis and resolution of production incidents. 
 - Manage Issue tracking and prioritisation of day to day production incidents. 
 - Manage platform trading support initiatives (e. g. platform monitoring, reporting, release automation). 

Minimum Qualification

- Bachelors with 5+ years of working experience as Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) / Devops Engineer
 - Strong knowledge of Linux system internals (kernels, memory management, file systems & network I/O optimization) as well as bash scripting. 
 - Minimum 5+ years experience in a Front Office Trading Floor or related application support experience. 
 - Need to be available to work in US (Night) Shift
 - Good product knowledge in financial instruments including experience in managing front to back trading lifecycle and familiar with order life cycle (Equities, FX, Crypto etc). 
 - Experience with electronic trading platforms and OMS/EMS systems. 
 - Knowledge of ITIL practices including Incident, Problem and Change management. 
 - Experience with system monitoring platforms. 
 - Proven expertise optimizing systems for lowest latency performance and productionizing trading systems, from initial concept to full deployment, including on-prem and colocation. 
 - Strong working knowledge of network communications fundamentals TCP/IP and UDP
 - Knowledge of FIX protocol, as well as familiarity with low latency multicast with Aeron. 
 - Strong skills around observability, debugging and performance tuning, with a willingness to dive-deep to determine the root cause, 
 - Effective communicator, with the ability to explain root causes in plain language, then outline plans and recommendations to remediate and ultimately to execute plans that systematically resolve issues. 
 - Demonstrated ability to build tools that enable rapid operational triage; leveraging logs, performance telemetry metrics and traces to make Grafana dashboards (or similar) 
 - Strong experience deploying and managing Cloud infrastructure with providers like AWS, Azure and/or GCP (accounts, profiles, IAM roles, Policies, service classes, instance types, etc. )
 - Strong experience adapting workloads to use Cloud Native technologies, like kubernetes and docker etc. (Dockerfile, docker-compose, helm charts, deploy manifest, ingress wiring, service mesh, etc. )
 - Expertise using devops deployment tooling, like Github Actions, Jenkins, ArgoCD and Ansible. 
 - Hands-on experience developing in one or more programming languages: C, C++, Java, Python, or Go. 
 - Proficient in utilizing C++ build systems such as CMake and building CI/CD pipelines for trading systems. 
 - Working knowledge of key backing services like mysql, PostgresDB, Redis, MongoDB, DynamoDB, Kafka, RabbitMQ, etc. 

Key attributes critical to success: 

- Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to communicate confidently and clearly with internal teams and external counterparts. . 
 - Ability to analyse complex scenarios from both a technical and business perspective and deliver solutions. 
 - A sense of urgency, and an ability to deliver to deadlines in an environment where multiple competing requirements are a part of the job. 
 - Proactivity and a strong ownership ethos, ensuring that queries are resolved through to completion. 
 - Desire and ability to deliver improvements to the platform. 

Preferred Qualification

- Extensive experience with DevOps for Deployment automation and App level support, as well as SRE and/or Linux systems Administrator for systems and infrastructure level support. 
 - Extensive experience in a Low Latency Electronic trading environment, where high performance is critical at all stages of the infrastructure, network and application design and implementation. 
 - Expertise in developing advanced observability capabilities (USE-RED signals, Tracing, front end observability etc)

Bonus Points: 

- Experience with hardware acceleration technologies (FPGAs, GPUs, LPU, TPU).

data.description:
Job Description Summary

As a Senior Staff Software Architect, you will define and evolve the architecture of Cardiology platform based on embedded software used across multiple products. This role requires strong architectural ownership beyond individual component development, with experience scaling design systems. 

The ideal candidate should combine strong architecture, governance, performance engineering, quality strategy, technical leadership, and practical AI-assisted engineering experience. 

GE HealthCare is a leading global medical technology and digital solutions innovator. Our purpose is to create a world where healthcare has no limits. Unlock your ambition, turn ideas into world-changing realities, and join an organization where every voice makes a difference, and every difference builds a healthier world. 

Job Description

We are in a phase of growth, designing next generation Cardiology devices. This requires an architect who thinks like a platform owner, not just a component builder. You must look beyond individual implementation details to think about scale, governance, and empowerment. You will define the architectural foundations and self-service patterns that let teams move fast without breaking the consistency, compatibility, and accessibility standards required for patient safety. 

Core Responsibilities

- Architecture & Platform Design 
 - Platform Architecture: Define and evolve scalable architecture for embedded system. 
 - Quality, Performance & Technical Debt 
 - Quality Strategy: Define quality strategy across unit, component, regression, integration, and E2E testing. Establish release-blocking quality gates and compatibility expectations. 
 - Performance Engineering: Diagnose and improve rendering, memory, bundle-size, and framework-integration performance. Define measurable performance baselines, and engineering health metrics rather than subjective assessments. 
 - Debt Prioritization: Prioritize technical and QA debt based on customer impact, adoption, risk, and maintainability. 
 - Roadmap
 - Architecture Roadmap: Create architecture roadmaps and guide long-term evolution without unnecessary rewrites, aligning with product priorities. 
 - Cross-Functional Partnership: Partner with Leadership, Product, UX, QA, DevOps, and engineering teams to drive architecture decisions across organizational boundaries. 

Core Competencies

- Communicating Trade-offs & Alignment: Exceptional ability to communicate complex architectural concepts by clearly explaining options, technical trade-offs, risks, and long-term implications. Works closely with cross-functional engineering, UX, and product teams to ensure alignment and secure buy-in. 
 - Architectural Ownership: Acts as the clear architectural owner for Embedded System platform. Demonstrates cross-team architectural ownership rather than experience limited to individual contributor delivery. 
 - Applied AI for Development: Uses AI-assisted engineering for refactoring, testing, migrations, documentation, debugging, and code review. Understands model selection and context/token management. Can define safe team-level AI development practices (validation, security, human-review controls) and demonstrate measurable improvements in productivity. 
 - Evidence-Based Direction: Challenges existing architecture when required and can demonstrate examples where technical direction was corrected based on evidence. 
 - Mentorship: Mentors senior engineers and Tech Leads, raising architectural capability across the team. Balances scalability, compatibility, performance, developer experience, security, and delivery needs. 

Required Skills

- Proven experience architecting platforms or large design systems used by multiple applications. 
 - Hands on Linux based embedded software development; able to own, create and deliver platform components, application development and analyze and resolve technical issues
 - Strong knowledge of Object-Oriented Analysis and Design, Software Design Patterns and C++ coding principles. 
 - Conduct technical design reviews of software to ensure reliability and performance
 - Interacting with global teams to promote consistency and maximize synergies across common software platforms
 - Ensuring SDLC process compliance during requirements gathering, architecture design, implementation, and verification. 
 - Aware of and comply with the GEHC Quality Manual, Quality Management System, Quality Management Policy, Quality Goals, and applicable laws and regulations as they apply to this job type/position
 - Complete all planned Quality & Compliance training within the defined deadlines. Identify and report any quality or compliance concerns and take immediate corrective action as required
 - Ensure compliance/closure of Regulatory and Quality requirements before approving Design Outputs/Program Deliverables
 - Lead continuous improvement activities by driving the implementation of process and product quality improvement initiatives

Qualifications & Essential Skills

- Bachelor's Degree / Masters in a relevant Engineering discipline (Electronics or Software is preferred)
 - 15+ years of experience in developing embedded Linux platform application with at least 3 years in a lead architect role specifically focused on Embedded software
 - Strong C, C++ language skills. 
 - Should have hands on experience in Shell / perl/ python scripting
 - Expertise in using Source control tools
 - Experience in Build automation and continuous integration
 - Excellent communication, leadership, and interpersonal skills to collaborate with architects, product managers, and executive stakeholders. 

Desired Skills

- Master's degree in engineering Compute Science or Electronics and Communication. 
 - Hardware Expertise: Knowledge on ARM based processor architecture, knowledge on USB/Flash/LAN/WLAN/Bluetooth technologies. 
 - Creative problem solver and solution developer when presented with conflicting requirements, business demands and technical risks/issues
 - Experience in Eclipse, GITLAB
 - Hands-on experience with UI development using QML
 - Working Knowledge in Python and ability to Automate Integration Testing using Test frameworks like Squish. 

This Job Description is intended to provide a high-level guide to the role. However, it is not intended to amend or otherwise restrict/expand the duties required by each individual employee as set out in their respective employment contract and/or as otherwise agreed between an employee and their manager. 

Inclusion And Diversity

GE Healthcare is an Equal Opportunity Employer where inclusion matters. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, colour, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law. 

We expect all employees to live and breathe our behaviours: to act with humility and build trust; lead with transparency; deliver with focus, and drive ownership - always with unyielding integrity. 

Our total rewards are designed to unlock your ambition by giving you the boost and flexibility you need to turn your ideas into world-changing realities. Our salary and benefits are everything you'd expect from an organization with global strength and scale, and you'll be surrounded by career opportunities in a culture that fosters care, collaboration, and support.

data.title: Quality Assurance Technical Lead
data.description:
About The Role

The Technical Lead - Quality Assurance is a senior technical leader responsible for driving end-to-end quality strategy, governance, and execution across assigned products or programs. This role combines deep hands-on expertise with leadership capabilities to ensure high-quality software delivery, strong automation adoption, and alignment with business and customer expectations. 

Operating across the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), the QA Technical Lead partners closely with Product, Engineering, and Client Delivery teams to define testing strategies, improve efficiency, and ensure robust validation of complex business workflows. The role plays a critical part in strengthening quality practices, reducing risk, and enabling predictable, high-quality releases. 

This position also focuses on building team capability, mentoring QA engineers, and driving innovation through automation, AI-driven testing, and continuous improvement initiatives. 

Deliverables and Performance Measures

- Define and execute end-to-end QA strategy aligned with product, business, and customer requirements
 - Lead test planning, execution, regression cycles, and defect triage across projects and releases
 - Ensure validation of complex, end-to-end business workflows including underwriting, policy servicing, and rule-based calculations
 - Drive risk-based testing approaches to prioritize critical functionalities and reduce production defects
 - Establish and enforce QA standards, frameworks, and best practices across teams
 - Monitor and analyze quality metrics such as defect leakage, test coverage, and execution efficiency
 - Lead root cause analysis (RCA) and implement corrective actions to improve product quality
 - Provide technical oversight for test automation across UI, API, and integration layers
 - Drive automation-first strategy, increasing coverage and reducing manual effort
 - Integrate QA processes with CI/CD pipelines to enable faster and more reliable release cycles
 - Collaborate with Engineering, DevOps, and Product teams to ensure environment readiness, data setup, and release validation
 - Act as a subject matter expert (SME) for system architecture, integrations, and configuration-driven implementations
 - Present quality metrics, release readiness status, and risk assessments to stakeholders
 - Mentor and develop QA team members, improving technical and domain capabilities
 - Foster cross-functional collaboration to ensure alignment between QA, Development, Product, and Client Delivery
 - Drive adoption of AI-driven testing practices, including intelligent automation and efficient regression strategies

What Will Make You Successful

- 5-8 years of experience in Quality Assurance / Quality Engineering roles
 - Strong experience in leading QA teams and managing end-to-end quality delivery
 - Deep expertise in QA methodologies, test strategy, and automation frameworks
 - Strong domain knowledge in Life Insurance and Annuities
 - Experience with tools such as Selenium, Katalon, Jira, TestRail, Jenkins, and API testing tools
 - Hands-on experience integrating QA with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices
 - Strong understanding of system architecture, integrations, and complex workflows
 - Experience in risk-based testing, defect management, and root cause analysis
 - Proven ability to analyze quality metrics and drive continuous improvement initiatives
 - Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills with attention to detail
 - Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
 - Demonstrated ability to mentor and develop high-performing QA teams
 - Experience leveraging AI tools for testing, automation, and productivity improvements is a plus
 - High ownership mindset with the ability to operate in a fast-paced, delivery-driven environment

We are committed to being a driving force in the innovation of the insurance market and that means that we help our employees stay on top of current trends and technologies, and progress within our company. This position can move into the following roles.

data.title: Engineer - Controls Engineering
data.description:
Job Description Summary

Systems Engineering ist eine funktionsübergreifende technische Disziplin, die sich auf einen Ansatz, eine Denkweise und einen Prozess konzentriert. Alle Tätigkeiten, die sowohl die geschäftlichen als auch die technischen Anforderungen der Kunden berücksichtigen, mit dem Ziel, ein Qualitätsprodukt bereitzustellen, das die Anforderungen der Benutzer erfüllt. Die Disziplin zur Umsetzung eines soliden Prozesses zum Entwerfen, Erstellen und Optimieren von Systemen, der aus der Identifizierung und Quantifizierung von Systemanforderungen, der Erstellung alternativer Systementwurfskonzepte, der Durchführung von Design-Trade-off-Studien, der Auswahl und Implementierung der besten Entwürfe und der Überprüfung der Tatsache besteht, dass das Design ordnungsgemäß integriert ist und ausgeführt wird. Prozess, der vom Konzept über die Produktion bis zum Betrieb verläuft. 

Beeinflusst die Qualität der eigenen Arbeit und der Arbeit anderer im Team. Führt betriebliche/technische Standardaufgaben aus, die in der Regel Anweisungen und Arbeitsabläufen unterliegen. Möglicherweise besteht Spielraum, um die Reihenfolge zu ändern und Aufgaben/Pflichten basierend auf sich ändernden Arbeitssituationen zu erledigen. 

Job Description

Rollen und Verantwortlichkeiten

- Identifizieren, entwickeln, bewerten, führen ein und verwalten Engineering-Lösungen für die Anforderungen der Produkt- und Steuerungssystemtechnologie. Wenden die Steuerungstheorie und mathematische Modellierung auf Entwurfs- und Steuerungssysteme mit dem gewünschten Verhalten an. Beinhaltet Bedienbarkeit, Festlegen von Grenzen, Zyklusoptimierung, Steuerlogik, steuerungsbezogene Software, Sensoren, Hardware- und Softwarealgorithmen sowie Feedback zur Steuerung der Leistung von Geräten, Subsystemen und Systemen. 
 - Erweiterung der Kenntnisse der eigenen technischen Disziplin zur Umsetzung von Richtlinien/Strategien. Kann Support-Rollen mit spezialisiertem technischem Wissensgebiet beinhalten; laufender Erwerb von Kenntnissen und Fähigkeiten auf höherem Niveau. 
 - Grundlegendes Verständnis der wichtigsten Geschäftstreiber; nutzt dieses Verständnis, um eigene Arbeit zu leisten. Gute Kenntnisse darüber, wie sich die Arbeit des eigenen Teams in andere Teams integriert und zum Bereich beiträgt. 
 - Kann eine gewisse Autonomie besitzen, um Entscheidungen innerhalb eines definierten Rahmens zu treffen. Löst Probleme in Situationen, in denen gute technische Kenntnisse und Urteilsvermögen im Rahmen festgelegter Verfahren erforderlich sind. Konsultiert hochrangigere Teammitglieder zu Problemen außerhalb definierter Anweisungen/Parameter. 
 - Eine Stelle auf diesem Niveau erfordert gute zwischenmenschliche Fähigkeiten und kann notwendig sein, um ein Junior-Team zu führen. Entwickelt für kundenorientierte Rollen starke Kundenbeziehungen und dient als Schnittstelle zwischen Kunden und GE Vernova. Erklärt anderen technische Informationen. 

Grundqualifikationen

- Diese Rolle erfordert grundlegende Erfahrung . Der Wissensstand ist vergleichbar mit einem Bachelor-Abschluss einer akkreditierten Universität oder Hochschule (oder einem Abitur mit entsprechender Erfahrung). 

Gewünschte Eigenschaften

- Sehr gute mündliche und schriftliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten. Ausgeprägte Sozialkompetenz und Führungsqualitäten. Fähigkeit, selbständig zu arbeiten. Starke Fähigkeiten zur Problemlösung. Hinweis: Um die Einwanderungsbestimmungen der USA und andere gesetzliche Anforderungen zu erfüllen, muss die Mindestanzahl der Jahre an Erfahrung angegeben werden, die für eine Tätigkeit in den USA erforderlich sind. Für Rollen außerhalb der USA sollten sich die JDs auf das für die Rolle erforderliche inhaltliche Erfahrungsniveau konzentrieren, um die Einhaltung der geltenden Rechtsvorschriften zu gewährleisten, und eine Mindestanzahl von Jahren sollte NICHT verwendet werden. Diese Stellenbeschreibung soll einen allgemeinen Leitfaden für die Rolle liefern. Sie soll jedoch nicht die von jedem Mitarbeiter gemäß dem jeweiligen Arbeitsvertrag und/oder gemäß einer anderweitigen Vereinbarung zwischen einem Mitarbeiter und seinem Vorgesetzten geforderten Pflichten ändern oder anderweitig einzuschränken/erweitern. 

Additional Information

Relocation Assistance Provided: Yes

data.title: Team Lead MEP - Stadiums, Sports Complexes & Arenas
data.description:
ROLE PURPOSE: 

Provide technical, operational, and people leadership for the MEP engineering function supporting US-based stadiums, sports complexes, arenas, and large-venue construction projects from Turner Technical Services offices in Mumbai or Bengaluru. Lead multidisciplinary engineering coordination, technical reviews, constructability, procurement support, testing and commissioning, quality, safety, schedule, risk, event-readiness, and system turnover. 

The Team Lead will coordinate with US project teams, owners, architects, design consultants, commissioning agents, trade partners, manufacturers, venue operators, technology providers, and internal teams. The role may be calibrated based on project complexity, technical accountability, team leadership, and demonstrated proficiency against the Engineering Career Development Qualifications. 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

- Technical & team leadership: Lead, mentor, and develop MEP engineering professionals; establish technical priorities, quality expectations, and delivery commitments. 
 - Project delivery: Lead engineering coordination for stadiums, arenas, sports complexes, training facilities, and other large public-assembly venues. 
 - MEP systems: Oversee HVAC, ventilation, plumbing, drainage, fire protection, controls, electrical distribution, emergency power, lighting, sports lighting, and life-safety systems. 
 - Venue-specific systems: Coordinate field/turf systems, retractable roofs and seating, scoreboards, LED displays, broadcast infrastructure, AV/ICT, security, access control, public-address, and venue technology. 
 - Crowd & life safety: Support engineering solutions for egress, emergency communication, mass notification, fire protection, crowd movement, accessibility, and event-day safety. 
 - Hospitality & athlete facilities: Coordinate MEP requirements for suites, premium clubs, concessions, kitchens, locker rooms, training areas, medical facilities, and athlete-support spaces. 
 - Design & constructability: Review drawings, specifications, RFIs, submittals, shop drawings, calculations, equipment selections, and installation sequencing; identify and resolve coordination issues. 
 - Testing & commissioning: Coordinate TAB, equipment start-up, controls verification, functional testing, emergency-power testing, life-safety testing, integrated systems testing, and event simulations. 
 - Project controls: Track engineering deliverables, RFIs, submittals, procurement, long-lead equipment, schedule constraints, commissioning activities, and event-readiness milestones. 
 - Risk management: Identify and mitigate technical, schedule, quality, safety, life-safety, operational, and event-readiness risks. 
 - Stakeholder management: Maintain effective relationships with project teams, clients, designers, contractors, venue operators, commissioning agents, and technology providers. 
 - Closeout & turnover: Coordinate record documents, O&M manuals, warranties, test reports, commissioning documentation, training, and final system acceptance. 
 - Continuous improvement: Promote Lean practices, standardization, knowledge sharing, digital tools, and lessons learned across projects. 

QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE

- Relevant experience of 12+ years, at least 5 years in sports complex/stadium projects
 - Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related engineering discipline. 
 - Progressive experience in MEP engineering, construction engineering, design coordination, commissioning, or complex building-project delivery. 
 - Stadium, arena, sports complex, entertainment, hospitality, or large public-assembly experience strongly preferred. 
 - Strong knowledge of HVAC, electrical distribution, emergency power, plumbing, fire protection, controls, lighting, life safety, ICT, AV, and building systems. 
 - Understanding of US building, electrical, mechanical, fire/life-safety, accessibility, and public-assembly codes and standards. 
 - Demonstrated ability to lead multidisciplinary teams and mentor engineers. 
 - Strong technical problem-solving, communication, coordination, and stakeholder-management skills. 
 - Experience project platforms such as Procore, Autodesk Construction Cloud, Bluebeam, or similar tools preferred. 
 - Ability to manage multiple priorities and provide working-hour overlap with US-based project teams. 
 - Flexibility to support critical project and event milestones, including sporting events, concerts, opening events, and commissioning activities.
