With leadership positions in LNG, hydrogen, ethylene, sustainable chemistry, and CO2 management, we are contributing to the development of critical markets such as energy, energy derivatives, decarbonization, and circularity. Our complementary business segments, Technology, Products and Services (TPS) and Project Delivery, turn innovation into scalable and industrial reality. 

Through collaboration and excellence in execution, our 17, 000+ employees across 34 countries are fully committed to bridging prosperity with sustainability for a world designed to last. 

About the mission we offer you: 

As a Lead Full Stack Developer, the candidate will be responsible for leading the design, development, and delivery of a scalable and high-performance application. They will work in collaboration with a team of full-stack developers in a Scrum-based environment, under the guidance of a Business Application Owner. 

The Lead Developer will play a critical role in ensuring the technical quality of the application by promoting best practices, ensuring secure coding standards, and optimizing performance. The candidate is expected to mentor team members, provide technical leadership, and act as the primary point of contact for technical challenges. A deep understanding of the business domain and the ability to translate complex functional requirements into scalable technical solutions are essential for success in this role. 

This role also requires hands-on technical expertise to address challenges in system design, database architecture, integration with microservices, and cloud deployment. The ideal candidate will be proactive, detail-oriented, and committed to delivering high-quality software solutions that align with business needs. 

Qualifications / Skills: 

- Software Development: 8 to 12 years of experience in web software development with demonstrated leadership capabilities. 
 - Database Expertise: 6+ years of hands-on experience with SQL Server, database optimization, and writing complex queries. 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. 
 - Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. 
 - Ability to work independently. 

Starting Date: Immediately

About you: 

We love to hear from you and how you match with this position. To be successful in this mission you should consider the following requirements: 

Assignment, Context, Job Main Challenges & Key Expectations: 

- Learning Curve: The candidate is expected to quickly acquire deep knowledge of the application's technical and business context. 
 - Team Leadership: The candidate will mentor and guide the development team, ensuring they follow best practices in coding, design, and testing. 
 - Stakeholder Collaboration: Close collaboration with Product Owners (POs), test leads, and business stakeholders to refine user stories, resolve ambiguities, and ensure technical feasibility. 
 - Technical Ownership: The candidate will own the design, development, and delivery of complex modules, ensuring the application is secure, maintainable, and scalable. 
 - Code Quality and Security: The candidate is expected to champion DevSecOps practices, embedding security throughout the CI/CD pipeline and software development lifecycle. This 
 - includes advocating secure coding practices and leveraging tools such as SonarQube and Snyk to improve code quality and detect vulnerabilities. 
 - Continuous Improvement: Staying updated with emerging technologies and proactively identifying opportunities to enhance the application and development processes. 

Job Scope: 

- Analyze user stories and oversee the translation of functional requirements into technical tasks. 
 - Design and implement scalable, secure, and maintainable architecture solutions. 
 - Optimize database schema design, queries, and application performance. 
 - Ensure robust documentation, comprehensive unit testing, and effective resolution of issues. 
 - Act as a mentor and guide to the development team, ensuring adherence to coding standards and promoting a culture of technical excellence. 

Responsibilities: 

- Actively participate in and lead all Agile ceremonies daily standups, sprint planning, reviews, demos, and refinements. 
 - Collaborate with Product Owners (POs), developers, and other stakeholders to refine user stories and provide technical insights. 
 - Estimate user stories, allocate tasks, and guide team members during refinement and sprint planning. 
 - Implement user stories with clean, maintainable, and secure code. 
 - Design scalable and reliable architecture while ensuring adherence to security and performance benchmarks. 
 - Utilize tools such as SonarQube and Snyk to identify and resolve code vulnerabilities, technical debt, and code smells. 
 - Conduct and oversee thorough code reviews to maintain quality and enforce secure coding practices. 
 - Integrate DevSecOps practices into the CI/CD pipeline, including automated security scanning using SonarQube (SAST) and Snyk (dependency/container vulnerability checks), secrets management, DAST, and compliance-as-code, ensuring security is a shared responsibility across the development lifecycle. 
 - Leverage AI-assisted development tools (e. g. , GitHub Copilot, Claude) to accelerate coding, automate code review feedback, enforce code quality standards, and generate documentation; evaluate and responsibly adopt AI/ML capabilities within the application where they deliver measurable business value. 
 - Ensure responsible use of AI tools in line with company AI policy: review all AI-generated code before merge and never share confidential or client data in prompts. 
 - Manage Azure cloud resources, Azure API Management, Azure Key Vault, Azure Monitor, and Application Insights. 
 - Design and write comprehensive unit test cases to ensure high reliability and code coverage. 
 - Debug and resolve complex issues identified in QA, UAT, pre-production, and production environments. 
 - Provide production support, troubleshoot issues, and ensure system reliability during hyper-care and beyond. 
 - Mentor team members, facilitate knowledge-sharing sessions, and foster team development. 
 - Stay updated on emerging technologies and propose their adoption when relevant. 
 - Lead strategies for code cleanup, performance optimization, and process improvements. 
 - Maintain Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) and own the technical roadmap for the application. 
 - Track and manage technical debt as a prioritized backlog item, agreed with the Product Owner. 
 - Lead incident management for production issues, including root cause analysis (RCA) and preventive actions. 
 - Coordinate with other application teams, vendors, and infrastructure and cyber security teams, including support for architecture and security reviews. 
 - Participate in technical interviews and contribute to hiring and onboarding developers. 

Success Measures (KPIs): 

- Sprint predictability: committed versus delivered story points. 
 - Defect leakage to UAT and production. 
 - Unit test code coverage meeting the agreed target. 
 - SonarQube quality gate pass rate on all pipelines. 
 - Closure of security vulnerabilities (SonarQube, Snyk) within the agreed SLA. 
 - Timely resolution of production incidents with completed RCA. 
 - Growth in team capability through mentoring and knowledge sharing. 

Preferred Certifications: 

- Microsoft Certified: Azure Developer Associate (AZ-204) 
 - Microsoft Certified: DevOps Engineer Expert (AZ-400) 
 - Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305) 
 - Certified ScrumMaster (CSM) or Professional Scrum Master (PSM)

Your career with us

Working at Technip Energies is an inspiring journey, filled with groundbreaking projects and dynamic collaborations. Surrounded by diverse and talented individuals, you will feel welcomed, respected, and engaged. Enjoy a safe, caring environment where you can spark new ideas, reimagine the future, and lead change. As your career grows, you will benefit from learning opportunities at T. EN University, such as The Future Ready Program, Graduate Program, and from the support of your manager through check-in moments like the Mid-Year Development Review, fostering continuous growth and development. 

What's Next?

Once receiving your system application, our recruiting team will screen and match your skills, experience, and potential team fit against the role requirements. We ask for your patience as the team completes the volume of applications with reasonable timeframe. Check your application progress periodically via personal account from created candidate profile during your application.

data.title: DevOps Engineer Lead
data.description:
DevOps Lead - Data Platforms

Corporate Engineering, AI and DataEngineering

Role Overview

We build and operate the platforms colleagues use to create, share, discover, govern, and consume trusted data across the organisation. Our services support analytics, automation, machine learning, and AI-enabled capabilities through secure, resilient, and reusable platform foundations. 

Reporting to the Senior Manager, Corporate Data Cloud, you will lead DevOps, platform automation, and operational reliability across our Data Platform services. You will work closely with Platform Engineers, Architects, Product Owners, Central Cloud Engineering, Cyber Security, and delivery teams to improve delivery, strengthen controls, and simplify platform operations. 

This role succeeds when teams can release changes safely, recover quickly from issues, meet cloud engineering standards, and spend more time delivering value than managing infrastructure. 

What You will Do

Build and Improve Platform Engineering

We are investing in modern engineering practices that make our platforms easier to build, operate, and support. 

You will: 

- Define and promote DevOps, DevSecOps, and Platform Engineering practices across the Data Platform capability. 
 - Develop reusable automation, CI/CD pipelines, engineering templates, and self-service tooling that help teams move faster. 
 - Improve platform onboarding and delivery through Infrastructure as Code, automation, and standard patterns. 
 - Reduce operational complexity by replacing manual processes with repeatable engineering practices. 

Strengthen Reliability, Security, and Compliance

We believe reliable and secure platforms are built into the engineering

process, not added afterwards. 

You will: 

- Improve monitoring, observability, alerting, operational visibility, and service health across platform services. 
 - Ensure AWS services and platform components align with standards and controls defined by Central Cloud Engineering and Cyber Security teams. 
 - Identify, prioritise, and coordinate remediation of vulnerabilities, cloud configuration findings, compliance gaps, and operational risks. 
 - Lead incident response, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement activities that strengthen platform resilience. 
 - Maintain operational documentation, controls, and evidence required for audit and compliance reviews. 

Enable Faster Delivery

We want teams to spend less time managing environments and more time delivering solutions. 

You will: 

- Work with Architects and Engineering teams to implement approved designs using standardised tooling and deployment practices. 
 - Coordinate release readiness, environments, and operational support for new platform capabilities. 
 - Support onboarding of services and data integrations into Corporate Data Cloud. 
 - Use operational metrics and engineering insights to reduce deployment risk, lead time, recurring incidents, and technical debt. 
 - Explore AI-assisted operations, automation, and operational intelligence capabilities that improve service health and engineer productivity. 

Lead and Partner

We work collaboratively across engineering, architecture, security, and operations teams. 

You will: 

- Coach and support engineers across DevOps and Platform Engineering disciplines. 
 - Partner with Product Owners, Architects, Central Cloud Engineering, Cyber Security, and delivery teams to resolve dependencies and achieve shared outcomes. 
 - Represent Data Platforms within operational governance, cloud compliance reviews, and engineering forums. 
 - Communicate platform health, risks, vulnerabilities, and delivery progress clearly to stakeholders. 
 - Promote knowledge sharing, continuous improvement, and practical engineering standards across the team. 

About You

You are an experienced DevOps or Platform Engineering professional who enjoys improving reliability, simplifying operations, and helping teams deliver technology more effectively. 

You combine strong technical skills with practical judgement, collaboration, and a continuous improvement mindset. You are comfortable working across engineering, architecture, operations, and security teams while balancing delivery speed, platform stability, and compliance requirements. 

You Will Bring

- 6+ years of experience in DevOps, Platform Engineering, Cloud Engineering, Site Reliability Engineering, or related technology disciplines. 
 - Experience supporting enterprise Data, Analytics, or Cloud platforms in production environments. 
 - Strong knowledge of CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, automation, configuration management, and release engineering practices. 
 - Practical experience with AWS and modern Data Platform technologies such as Snowflake, Microsoft Fabric, or equivalent cloud-based solutions. 
 - Experience implementing cloud engineering standards and remediating security vulnerabilities, compliance findings, and operational risks. 
 - Knowledge of monitoring, observability, incident management, problem management, and service reliability practices. 
 - Understanding of cloud security controls, operational risk management, audit requirements, and IT service management principles. 
 - Experience leading technical work and collaborating across matrixed delivery teams. 
 - Strong communication, stakeholder management, problem-solving, and decision-making skills. 
 - Experience working within regulated or operationally complex environments is advantageous. 
 - A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 

How We Work

- We automate wherever it improves safety, speed, reliability, or consistency. 
 - We build platforms that are secure, resilient, scalable, and easy to operate. 
 - We favour reusable tooling, common patterns, and self-service capabilities over one-off solutions. 
 - We learn from production, measure outcomes, and continuously improve. 
 - We work closely with engineering and control functions to ensure the compliant path is also the simplest path. 
 - We believe the best solutions are created through collaboration, ownership, and shared learning. 

Why This Role Matters

Every analytics, automation, machine learning, and AI initiative depends on reliable platform services and strong engineering foundations. 

As DevOps Lead, you will influence how Data Platform capabilities are built, secured, deployed, and operated. Your work will help teams deliver changes faster, improve service reliability, strengthen cloud compliance, and create a better engineering experience across Corporate Data Cloud. 

This is a role with visible impact, broad technical exposure, and the opportunity to shape the future of Platform Engineering within Data Platforms. 

Inclusion and Accessibility

We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work. 

We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe diverse teams build better solutions and stronger products. 

If you require an adjustment or accommodation during the recruitment process or while performing the role, we will work with you to provide the support you need

We're proud to have been recognised as a Great Place to Work® in India '25

Career Stage: 

Senior Associate

London Stock Exchange Group (LSEG) Information: 

Join us and be part of a team that values innovation, quality, and continuous improvement. If you're ready to take your career to the next level and make a significant impact, we'd love to hear from you. 

LSEG is a leading global financial markets infrastructure and data provider. Our purpose is driving financial stability, empowering economies and enabling customers to create sustainable growth. 

Our purpose is the foundation on which our culture is built. Our values of Integrity, Partnership, Excellence and Change underpin our purpose and set the standard for everything we do, every day. They go to the heart of who we are and guide our decision making and everyday actions. 

Working with us means that you will be part of a dynamic organisation of 25, 000 people across 65 countries. However, we will value your individuality and enable you to bring your true self to work so you can help enrich our diverse workforce.

This means that we do not discriminate on the basis of anyone's race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital status, veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. Conforming with applicable law, we can reasonably accommodate applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs.

We are committed to sustainability across our global business and we are proud to partner with our customers to help them meet their sustainability objectives. At Bristol Myers Squibb, our employees often ask, "Who are you working for?"-a question that fuels collaboration, accountability, and urgency in our work. Our purpose-driven culture inspires us to discover, develop, and deliver innovative medicines to prevail over serious diseases. We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it. 

Role Overview

We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer (Full Stack Developer) to design, build, and maintain scalable web applications across the front end, back end, and cloud infrastructure. This role requires a strong foundation in modern JavaScript/TypeScript frameworks, Python and Node. js backend development, containerized microservices, and hands-on experience deploying and operating applications on AWS. The ideal candidate is comfortable owning features end-to-end - from UI implementation to API design to cloud deployment - and collaborates effectively within an Agile team. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design, build, and maintain full stack web applications spanning front-end, back-end, and cloud environments
 - Develop and integrate REST/SOAP APIs and microservices to support business applications and AI-driven workflows
 - Enhance, troubleshoot, and support existing production applications, ensuring reliability, performance, and scalability
 - Deploy and manage applications on AWS using containerized (Docker/ECS Fargate) and serverless (Lambda/API Gateway) architectures
 - Collaborate with product managers, designers, and fellow engineers within an Agile development process
 - Participate in code reviews and apply static code analysis and security scanning tools to maintain code quality
 - Collaborate with IT partners, business teams, and the broader IT matrix organization to understand requirements and use cases, support solution design and delivery of new digital capabilities, and contribute to the enablement and simplification of existing ones - translating requirements into user stories, epics, and sprint-ready tasks using Agile/Scrum methodologies
 - Gather requirements, propose solution options, and communicate technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders

Desired Experience

Front End

- Strong hands-on experience building production applications with ReactJS (with TypeScript); working knowledge of Next. js
 - Experience with React Native for mobile development
 - Exposure to an additional front-end framework such as Vue. js is a plus
 - Strong proficiency in JavaScript (ES6+), HTML, and CSS
 - Experience with modern CSS frameworks/libraries such as Tailwind CSS, Bootstrap, and component libraries like shadcn/ui

Back End

- Solid experience with Python and Node. js for building server-side applications and services
 - Experience designing and building REST APIs; familiarity with SOAP APIs
 - Hands-on experience with microservices architecture and Docker containerization
 - Experience with backend frameworks such as FastAPI, Flask, Django, and Express. js
 - Understanding of ORM concepts and implementation

Database

- Experience with PostgreSQL and DynamoDB (or similar relational and NoSQL databases)
 - Familiarity with SQLite for lightweight/local data storage use cases
 - Practical experience with data modeling for both relational and NoSQL systems

Cloud (AWS)

- Hands-on experience with core AWS services: API Gateway, Lambda, S3, CloudFront, Route 53, EC2, ECR, ECS Fargate, ALB, NLB, and IAM
 - Understanding of serverless and containerized deployment patterns on AWS
 - Working knowledge of AWS security and access management (IAM roles/policies)

DevOps

- Proficient with Git for version control and collaborative development workflows
 - Experience with Infrastructure as Code using CloudFormation
 - Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions and/or AWS CodePipeline, CodeBuild, and CodeDeploy
 - Familiarity with static code analysis and linting tools such as PyLint and ESLint

Tools & Collaboration

- Experience using AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code and GitHub Copilot within VS Code
 - Experience working with JIRA and Confluence in an Agile development environment
 - Strong track record of participating in code reviews and applying static code analysis tools such as SonarQube and Snyk Code

Good to Have

- Exposure to Generative AI and Agentic AI concepts and application development
 - Experience with LangChain and/or LangGraph for building AI-driven workflows and agents
 - Familiarity with Azure OpenAI and/or AWS Bedrock
 - Understanding of Model Context Protocol (MCP) and its use in AI tool integrations

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience)
 - 4-7 years of professional software development experience, with demonstrated full stack project delivery
 - Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within a cross-functional Agile team
 - Solid understanding of software engineering best practices, including version control, code review, testing, and secure coding standards
 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills
 - Demonstrated experience deploying and supporting applications in a cloud environment (AWS preferred)

data.title: POWER PLATFORM & COPILOT DEVELOPER
data.description:
Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world's manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28, 000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers - amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility - our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better. 

We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that's you we would love to have you join us!

Job Description

The Power Platform & Copilot Developer leads the design, delivery, and scaling of enterprise AI agents, chatbots, and low-code solutions using Microsoft Copilot Studio, Microsoft Power Platform, Agent OS, Azure AI Foundry, and Azure AI Search to support LCS strategic business use cases. 

This role serves as a technical and functional lead, providing architectural guidance, governance oversight, and mentorship while ensuring measurable business outcomes from AI investments. 

The role partners closely with business leaders, AI governance teams, and platform stakeholders to establish a scalable, governed low-code and agentic AI operating model, build Copilot Studio SME capability, and drive adoption across LCS. 

We are hiring for Pune and Noida locations. 

Key Responsibilities

AI & Copilot Technical Leadership

- Lead the end-to-end architecture, design, and delivery of Copilot Studio solutions, AI agents, and chatbots. 
 - Define conversational and agentic AI patterns, standards, and reusable frameworks for enterprise adoption. 
 - Leverage Agent OS and Azure AI Foundry for agent orchestration and advanced AI use cases. 
 - Design enterprise knowledge and RAG solutions using Azure AI Search where applicable. 
 - Review solution designs to ensure scalability, security, performance, and maintainability. 
 - Drive continuous improvement of AI agents based on usage analytics, feedback, and business outcomes. 

Power Platform Solution Architecture

- Lead development of complex Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse, and Copilot Studio solutions. 
 - Establish best practices for low-code/pro-code extensibility, integrations, APIs, and AI services. 
 - Enable integration across Power Platform, Agent OS, Azure AI Foundry, Azure AI Search, and enterprise systems. 
 - Ensure alignment with enterprise application architecture and data strategies. 

Governance, Security & Compliance

- Own and enforce governance standards for Copilot, Power Platform, and enterprise AI solutions. 
 - Partner with security and compliance teams to ensure Responsible AI, data protection, and audit readiness. 
 - Guide environment strategy, DLP policies, access controls, and solution lifecycle management. 

Capability Building & Team Enablement

- Act as a Copilot Studio SME and mentor, cross-training Power Platform developers into AI solution builders. 
 - Build team capability across Copilot Studio, Agent OS, Azure AI Foundry, Azure AI Search, and RAG. 
 - Support hiring, onboarding, and enablement of incremental Copilot development capacity. 
 - Contribute to a Center of Excellence / RCC delivery model, defining intake, prioritization, KPIs, and capacity planning. 

Stakeholder & Program Leadership

- Partner with business owners and AI leadership to identify, prioritize, and roadmap high-value AI use cases. 
 - Provide executive-level updates on progress, risks, ROI, and adoption metrics. 
 - Represent the Copilot and low-code AI capability in enterprise forums such as AI2. 

Required Skills & Experience

- Advanced hands-on experience with Microsoft Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse). 
 - Strong experience designing and delivering solutions using Microsoft Copilot Studio. 
 - Experience with AI agents, agentic workflows, and enterprise AI integration patterns. 
 - Working knowledge of Agent OS and Azure AI Foundry. 
 - Understanding of Azure AI Search, RAG, and enterprise knowledge grounding. 
 - Proven experience leading enterprise-scale low-code or AI initiatives. 
 - Strong understanding of conversational AI design, UX, and performance optimization. 
 - Experience with governance, security, Responsible AI, and compliance in enterprise environments. 
 - Strong leadership, mentoring, and stakeholder-management skills. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Microsoft certifications in Power Platform, Copilot Studio, or Azure AI. 
 - Hands-on exposure to Azure AI Foundry, Azure AI Search, Azure OpenAI, and RAG architectures. 
 - Experience with agent orchestration and multi-agent architectures. 
 - Experience operating within a Center of Excellence (CoE) or shared services model. 
 - Experience defining and tracking KPIs, ROI, and adoption metrics for AI solutions. 
 - Familiarity with change management and enterprise adoption strategies. 

Success Measures

- Successful delivery of high-impact AI agent and chatbot use cases. 
 - Adoption and reuse of standardized Copilot and agentic AI solutions across teams. 
 - Establishment and growth of Copilot Studio and AI SME capability. 
 - Compliance with enterprise governance and Responsible AI standards. 
 - Demonstrated ROI and measurable business value from AI initiatives. 

The Preferred - You Might Also Have

- 3 to 8 years of relevant work experience in a fast-paced business environment. 
 - Strong troubleshooting and technical support skills. 
 - Experience maintaining project documentation and managing system updates. 
 - Excellent stakeholder communication and relationship-building abilities. 
 - Familiarity with data governance and compliance standards. 
 - Skilled in creating engaging content and presentations. 
 - Comfortable with multi-channel communication platforms. 

What We Offer

Our benefits package includes . . . 

- Comprehensive mindfulness programs with a premium membership to Calm
 - Volunteer Paid Time off available after 6 months of employment for eligible employees
 - Company volunteer and donation matching program - Your volunteer hours or personal cash donations to an eligible charity can be matched with a charitable donation. 
 - Employee Assistance Program
 - Personalized wellbeing programs through our OnTrack program
 - On-demand digital course library for professional development
 - and other local benefits!

At Rockwell Automation we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right person for this or other roles. 

Rockwell Automation's hybrid policy aligns that employees are expected to work at a Rockwell location at least Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays unless they have a business obligation out of the office.

data.title: Supplier Quality Manager - Configured Systems
data.description:
Job Description Summary

Lead the supplier quality engineers to meet KPI and comply to GE Vernova procedure. Drive quality for assigned suppliers, including quality plan implementation. Select suppliers through qualification processes. Own supplier results, drive improvements utilizing supplier scorecards. Own supplier audits, ensuring compliance, and driving improvement plans where needed. Has in-depth knowledge of best practices and how own area integrates with others; has working knowledge of competition and the factors that differentiate them in the market

Job Description

There dual role as below

Team Leader Role

- Deploy Supplier quality policy. Manage activities and execute action plan to drive supplier quality team to meet KPI team or department
 - Typically a 1st line manager of assigned team or department. Developing specialized depth and/or breadth of expertise in own job discipline or field. Serves as best practice/quality resource. Has awareness of latest functional developments in own area. Contributes towards strategy and policy development, and ensures delivery within area of responsibility
 - Be resource for team on technical, problem solving , project management
 - Lead execution of qualification, inspection , audit and resolve quality issue for team
 - To be main contact point on assigned commodity and align with regional quality, project, sourcing 
 - Lead Medium to complex projects with moderate risks and resource requirements. Explains difficult or sensitive information
 - Works to build consensus. Developing persuasion skills required to influence others on topics within field

SQE Role

- Develop and monitor supplier quality on assigned equipment/product from supplier qualification phase to final inspections to verify compliance with technical and quality requirements before shipment release
 - New Supplier Evaluation / on boarding - Rigorously execute the supplier evaluation process, including quality & compliance audits / assessments to ensure that only appropriately qualified suppliers are taken through the process. Work with sourcing/commodity team to meet business objectives of new supplier addition and provide input to technical tender analysis
 - Lead Supplier Qualification with partnership with procurement, engineering, project quality
 - Prepare Supplier Quality Documents for project such Quality Control Plan (QCP), ITPL (Inspection Testing Plan) Product Testing procedure
 - Perform FAT (Factory Acceptance Test) and PSI (Pre-Shipment inspection)
 - Organizing / performing inspections at suppliers and ensuring the product quality compliance
 - Develop surveillance audits plan and execute to assure that suppliers have effective process control, rigorous product acceptance standards, and robust quality systems
 - Own SRG (Safety/Health/Environment Supplier Responsibility Guidelines) metrics for the assigned suppliers and conduct SRG audits per the region audit plan
 - Manage Supplier Deviation Request (SDR) Non-Conformance Report (NCR) & Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for nonconformities caused by suppliers and lead resolution of complex, cross-functional quality issues for severe NCR/RCA
 - Review and approve supplier End of Manufacturing Reports and give release for shipment

Qualifications / Requirements

- Bachelor's degree in Mechanical or Electrical or Metallurgy Engineering
 - Minimum 12 years of experience with 5 years of leadership experience/familiar power, oil & gas
 - Proven Skilled influencer, able to communicate complex messages to others. 
 - Proven ability to lead project and project management skill and responsible for the overall implementation of quality control related to specification and international code & standard. 
 - Proven ability to work efficiently without direct supervision. Self-motivated with demonstrated ability to motivate others to achieve results. 
 - Strong oral and written communication skills
 - Strong ability to use Word, Excel, PowerPoint
 - English languages proficiency
 - Demonstrated ability to analyze and resolve problems
 - Ability and willingness to travel domestically and internationally at short notice

Desired Characteristics

- Working knowledge on manufacturing processes such as Casting, forging, Welding, Heat treatment, Coating process

 - Welding technical knowledge and NDT knowledge
 - CWI (Certified Welding Inspector) certificate

data.description:
Job Title

Senior Manager - Quality & Regulatory

Job Description

Role Overview

The SQR Lead will serve as the Quality and Regulatory leader for Oral Healthcare sustaining, lifecycle-management and product-development activities supported from Pune. The role will partner with global OHC R&D, Procurement, Operations and Quality & Regulatory teams to strengthen product quality, regulatory compliance, supplier quality performance and effective portfolio execution, ensuring the delivery of safe, effective, and compliant OHC products throughout the product lifecycle. The leader will support quality strategy, regulatory deployment, risk management, governance and continuous improvement while building a capable, high-performing SQR team. 

The Product Safety Quality Manager 70 is responsible for conducting seamless, in-depth safety assessments and compliance evaluations of product designs, overseeing the analysis of test data and root cause analysis to effectively resolve complex safety issues. The role acts as a principal advisor and subject matter expert on product safety and compliance matters, provides authoritative guidance to internal teams and external stakeholders. The role reviews and enhances product safety processes and procedures, optimizes operational efficiency and resource allocation to achieve departmental objectives effectively. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead the OHC Quality and Regulatory function in Pune as a site leadership-team member, fostering a culture of quality, compliance, accountability and continuous improvement across the site. 
 - Provide oversight of the Quality Management System and ensure alignment with applicable global requirements, including FDA QMSR, ISO 13485, EU MDR and other relevant regulatory and quality standards. 
 - Serve as the primary site Quality representative for leading and supporting the regulatory inspections, notified-body assessments and external audits, while maintaining organizational audit readiness and ensuring timely, effective responses. 
 - Establish, maintain and continuously improve quality processes, systems, procedures and controls that support safe, effective, reliable and compliant products throughout their lifecycle. 
 - Lead design assurance and design control activities, including design inputs, quality planning, verification, validation, usability, reliability, manufacturability, safety, design transfer and process validation across hardware, software and system development. 
 - Ensure quality engineering documentation, including product and system quality plans, is accurate, current, risk-based and compliant with internal and external requirements. 
 - Guide product and process risk-management activities across development, manufacturing and post-market phases, ensuring risks are identified, assessed, controlled and monitored throughout the lifecycle. 
 - Lead & support investigations, root-cause analysis, CAPA, nonconformance management and corrective actions, ensuring sustainable resolution of product, process and quality-system issues. 
 - Integrate customer feedback, reliability information, complaint trends and post-market surveillance data into product-development and lifecycle decisions, providing actionable feedback to design and manufacturing teams. 
 - Monitor quality-system, product and process performance metrics, using data-based insights to identify trends, manage emerging risks and drive strategic improvement priorities. 
 - Partner with R&D, Operations, Regulatory Affairs, Procurement and other functions to resolve quality issues, support business objectives and ensure effective execution of quality strategies and project milestones. 
 - Lead supplier-quality governance, including supplier qualification and development, audits, quality agreements, supplier changes, performance monitoring and corrective actions. 
 - Drive quality and operational-excellence initiatives using quality engineering, Lean, Six Sigma and other appropriate continuous-improvement methodologies. 
 - Lead and develop a high-performing quality organization through talent acquisition, objective setting, performance management, coaching, succession planning and employee development. 
 - Establish and manage departmental objectives, budgets, resource plans and performance goals, and communicate quality risks, priorities and recommendations effectively to senior leadership and key stakeholders. 
 - Oversee the deployment of applicable global regulatory requirements and internal regulatory policies across OHC development and lifecycle-management activities, covering medical, non-medical. 
 - Provide governance for global product certification and conformity-assessment strategies, including coordination with certification bodies and test houses such as UL and DEKRA when required. 
 - Ensure regulatory requirements are translated into development plans and product requirements, and that verification and validation evidence is adequate to demonstrate product safety and compliance. 
 - Oversee regulatory submission planning, product licensing, maintenance of existing registrations and licenses, and regulatory change-control activities in partnership with Regulatory Affairs and market teams. 
 - Provide oversight for product labeling plans and the review and approval of product labeling and product-related marketing communications for regulatory and safety compliance. 

You're The Right Fit If

- You have a minimum of a Bachelor's Degree (Required), in Quality, Engineering or similar disciplines. 
 - You have a minimum of 15+ years' overall experience in Product development lifecycle and 10+ years' experience in FDA regulated Class 2 or Class 3 medical device environments, with a focus on Quality Management System (QMS) Compliance, and Design Assurance functions. 
 - You have proven experience in functional management of quality teams, including budgeting, workforce planning, Performance Management, Employee Engagement/ Retention, Succession Planning, coaching, training, etc. 
 - You have strong understanding of Medical Device regulations/standards including ISO 13485/14971, 21CFR (803, 806, 820, etc. ), MDD/ EU MDR, GMP, and GDP. 
 - You have extensive experience managing design assurance activities throughout the product lifecycle, including design controls, Risk Management (ISO 14971, DFMEA/PFMEA) V&V, design transfer, and process validation. 
 - You have extensive experience in leading audit readiness, serving as the primary quality representative for regulatory inspections, external audits, and interactions with regulatory authorities and notified bodies and ensuring timely, effective responses to internal audits, regulatory inspections, and external assessments. 
 - You have proven experience utilizing Quality KPI's/Data Analysis to assess project/team performance and identify process and continuous improvement opportunities. 
 - You have extensive experience leading CAPA/Nonconformance activities, including problem identification, root cause analysis, implementation of solutions to prevent recurrence and drive continuous improvement. 
 - You have a minimum of a Bachelor's Degree (Required), in Quality, Engineering or similar disciplines. 
 - You have working knowledge of product safety and compliance standards relevant to OHC products, including IEC 60335, IEC 60601, electromagnetic compatibility and radio requirements. 
 - You have working knowledge of RoHS, REACH, global environmental requirements and biocompatibility principles under ISO 10993. 
 - You have experience working with certification bodies and supporting global product certifications, regulatory submissions and product-license maintenance. 

How We Work Together

We believe that we are better together than apart. For our office-based teams, this means working in-person at least 3 days per week. Onsite roles require full-time presence in the company's facilities. Field roles are most effectively done outside of the company's main facilities, generally at the customers' or suppliers' locations. 

About Philips

Are you ready to do the work of your life to help the lives of others? Learn more about our business, discover our rich and exciting history and learn more about our purpose. 

If you're interested in this role and have many, but not all, of the experiences needed, we encourage you to apply. You may still be the right candidate for this or other opportunities at Philips. Learn more about our culture of impact with care.

Job Description

- This role is a Site Engineering position within Nokia's Product Validation & Test (PV&T) R&D organization, where you will operate as a full member of the PV&T engineering team. Your primary purpose is to serve as PV&T's direct presence and working arm at manufacturing sites, focusing on Test Station Development (TSD). You will be actively involved on the factory floor, responsible for the setup, debugging, and continuous improvement of test stations. A key aspect of the role is driving the implementation of R&D-developed hardware, software, fixture, and procedural changes directly into manufacturing operations. This is distinctly an R&D engineering role situated within the production environment, not a CM test technician, supply chain, operations, or pure program management function. The position specifically covers TSD for either coherent pluggable and/or TROSA stations, requiring deep expertise in at least one of these station families. 

NILightpath

How You Will Contribute And What You Will Learn

- Design, bring up, debug, and improve optical test stations for performance, reliability, and production readiness in PV&T manufacturing. 
 - Work on-site with manufacturing and Contract Manufacturer (CM) teams to integrate stations into the factory test flow, including fixtures, instruments, automation, and measurement procedures. 
 - Analyze station data and provide feedback for station design, test protocols, and Test Station Development (TSD)/R&D. 
 - Manage the transition of R&D changes to factory reality, including software/firmware/fixture updates, procedure changes, and confirmation of line capability. 
 - Develop and maintain test protocols to ensure accurate and repeatable results, proactively addressing compliance, safety, and measurement-integrity issues. 
 - Represent PV&T at the manufacturing site, mentoring others and ensuring visibility and resolution of station-related issues. 

Key Skills And Experience

- Bachelor's or master's in engineering, Physics, or a related field (equivalent industry experience considered). 
 - Typically, 3+ years developing test stations or automated test equipment (ATE) in optical and/or electrical test. 
 - Working knowledge of optical measurement principles and how test hardware/software produces results. 
 - Comfort working in a manufacturing environment and willingness to travel regularly to Nokia/CM sites in Thailand and Malaysia. 
 - Ability to work effectively across hardware, software, and manufacturing teams to resolve issues. 
 - Coherent pluggable / PIC test-station or ATE development, OR TROSA / photonic-assembly test-station or ATE development. 
 - Electrical design, simulation, or schematic/layout support for test hardware; fixture, thermal, or PCB work, including RF and low-frequency analog/digital signals. 
 - Source control and software-driven test infrastructure (e. g. , Git, Azure DevOps, Bitbucket), with Continuous Integration (CI) for hardware test being a plus.

Job Description: 

Analyst - Performance Engineering

What will you do?

The Analyst - Performance Engineering will execute performance testing activities for assigned applications, working with the Performance Engineering Lead and cross-functional teams. Responsibilities include understanding non-functional requirements (NFRs), contributing to the test approach and workload model, developing and maintaining scripts, executing tests, analyzing application and infrastructure metrics, and reporting findings against agreed performance criteria. The role will support bottleneck investigation, remediation validation, and continuous improvement through reusable assets and automation. Overall strategy and release approval remain with the designated leads and decisionmakers. 

Your scope of work / key responsibilities: 

- Collaborate with stakeholders to understand business-critical journeys, application architecture, expected volumes, and agreed NFRs. 
 - Contribute to performance test plans and workload models, including transaction mix, concurrency, throughput, pacing, think time, and test duration. 
 - Develop, debug, and maintain reusable performance test scripts with correlation, parameterization, assertions, and appropriate transaction definitions. 
 - Prepare and validate test data, application access, environment readiness, and monitoring prerequisites before execution, following approved test-data and security practices. 
 - Execute baseline, load, stress, spike, and endurance tests as required by the agreed test approach. 
 - Analyze response-time percentiles, throughput, error rates, and resource utilization, compare steady-state results with agreed thresholds and previous baselines to identify regressions and trends. 
 - Produce clear test reports covering workload, environment, results, limitations, risks, and recommendations; communicate progress and blockers promptly to stakeholders. 
 - Document performance defects with supporting evidence, track remediation with the relevant teams, and validate fixes through retesting. 
 - Use application performance monitoring (APM), infrastructure metrics, and logs to investigate bottlenecks with developers, system engineers, database administrators, architects, and application owners; contribute evidence-based improvement recommendations. 
 - Maintain reusable test assets and contribute to scripting, reporting, and process automation; recommend and implement agreed improvements to testing quality and efficiency. 

Key Qualifications and experience: 

- Bachelor's degree or diploma in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - 3-5 years of relevant hands-on experience in performance testing or performance engineering, including scripting, execution, monitoring, and results analysis. 

Essential Technical Skills

- Hands-on experience with LoadRunner Enterprise or LoadRunner Professional, including VuGen scripting, scenario configuration, test execution, and results analysis. 
 - Practical knowledge of correlation, parameterization, pacing, think time, assertions, transaction definitions, and script troubleshooting. 
 - Understanding of HTTP/HTTPS, REST APIs, and three-tier or multi-tier application architecture. 
 - Experience with at least one relevant APM tool, such as CA APM, AppDynamics, or Dynatrace, or a log-analysis and monitoring tool such as Splunk; proficiency in every listed product is not required. 
 - Ability to interpret response-time percentiles, throughput, error rates, concurrency, and resource utilization, and relate test results to agreed NFRs. 
 - Working knowledge of a relevant scripting language and basic operating-system, network, and database performance concepts. 
 - Strong analytical problem-solving, documentation, and stakeholder communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across teams. 

Preferred Skills

- Exposure to Java-based application diagnostics, cloud-based applications, or distributed services. 
 - Experience with additional load-testing tools relevant to the application landscape. 
 - Exposure to Git, continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD), and performance-testing or reporting automation. 
 - Familiarity with project lifecycles, incident, change, and problem-management processes, and service-level agreements (SLAs), in support of testing and defect investigation. 
 - Experience using approved AI-assisted development tools, such as GitHub Copilot, with human validation and adherence to security and confidentiality requirements.

As a Senior SQA Analyst, you will play a critical role in ensuring the quality, reliability, and usability of our documentation tools. Your primary responsibility will be to design, execute, and maintain testing strategies and test cases to validate the functionality and performance of our software applications. 

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

Quality Ownership & Technical Leadership

- Own end-to-end quality of releases through comprehensive test planning, execution, and risk assessment. 
 - Define and drive test strategies, quality standards, risk-based testing approaches, and release readiness criteria across multiple product areas. 
 - Act as a technical escalation point; mentor colleagues on test case design, automation frameworks, and QA best practices. 
 - Collaborate with Product Management, Engineering, and Professional Services teams to influence product quality decisions. 
 - Conduct root cause analysis, track defect metrics, and drive continuous process improvements. 
 - Participate in release retrospectives, providing actionable testing insights to improve product quality. 
 - Champion quality advocacy across teams, ensuring adherence to standards and compliance requirements. 

Test Strategy & Coverage

- Analyze requirements and user stories to identify gaps, ambiguities, and risks; design targeted test plans accordingly. 
 - Execute manual and automated tests across web, Windows desktop, mobile (iOS/Android), APIs, databases, and XML content. 
 - Validate XML against schemas/DTDs (e. g. , S1000D, DITA, custom) to ensure product compliance. 
 - Perform accessibility testing (WCAG & EAA), performance testing (JMeter), functional, regression, and exploratory testing. 
 - Ensure test coverage across integration, system, and user acceptance testing phases. 

Automation & CI/CD Excellence

- Architect and optimize scalable automation frameworks like Playwright and Selenium. 
 - Implement Power Automate flows to streamline testing workflows. 
 - Integrate and maintain automation within Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines for continuous quality validation. 
 - Maintain test data management strategies to support automation and regression testing. 
 - Assist in expanding automated coverage across UI, API, workflow, and data validation layers. 
 - Develop automation approaches for XML validation, publishing verification, and content quality checks. 
 - Analyze automation effectiveness and continuously improve test coverage. 

Functional & Workflow Testing

- Design and execute comprehensive test plans, test cases, and test strategies for enterprise content management solutions. 
 - Validate complex XML based structured authoring, review, approval, and publishing workflows. 
 - Test automated workflows, including content creation, reuse, versioning, branching, localization, metadata management, and publication processes. 
 - Validate workflow orchestration across multiple integrated systems and services. 
 - Ensure content integrity throughout the content lifecycle. 

XML and Publishing Validation

- Perform validation of XML-based content processing pipelines. 
 - Verify XML structures (e. g. , DITA maps, topics, etc. ), metadata, key references, conrefs, and content reuse mechanisms. 
 - Validate XML transformations and publishing workflows. 
 - Conduct output fidelity testing by validating that rendered outputs accurately reflect source XML structure, metadata, conditional processing rules, content reuse mechanisms, and publishing business rules. 
 - Verify content accuracy across PDF, HTML, WebHelp, and other publishing formats. 
 - Troubleshoot content rendering issues and identify root causes across transformation pipelines. 

Data Layer Testing

- Test both relational and NoSQL data architectures. 
 - Validate data persistence, retrieval, indexing, and content storage processes. 
 - Perform scale and performance testing against our content databases . 
 - Develop and execute XQuery-based validation scripts to verify content integrity and business rules. 
 - Validate database indexing, search relevance, faceted search behavior, metadata retrieval, taxonomy relationships, and content discoverability across large repositories. 
 - Ensure data consistency across systems and environments. 

API and Integration Testing

- Design and execute API testing for REST, GraphML, MCP and SOAP services. 
 - Validate API and Application integrations with authoring tools, publishing engines, translation management systems, identity providers, content delivery platforms, and downstream applications. 
 - Test webhook-based integrations and event-driven workflows. 
 - Verify message processing, asynchronous workflows, and system-to-system communication. 
 - Perform end-to-end validation across integrated platforms. 
 - Ensure reliability, scalability, and fault tolerance of integration points. 

Performance and Reliability Testing

- Validate system performance under realistic content processing workloads. 
 - Test scalability of publishing pipelines and content repositories. 
 - Identify bottlenecks across application, database, and integration layers. 
 - Collaborate with engineering teams to improve system reliability and performance. 

Collaboration & Execution

- Partner closely with global developers, technical writers, product managers, and QA teams. 
 - Document results and issues in Jira with detailed repro steps, severity levels, and acceptance criteria. 
 - Support multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining sprint velocity and meeting deadlines. 
 - Contribute to cross-functional initiatives such as DevOps, release management, and quality governance. 

Experience And Skills

Mandatory Requirements & Qualifications: 

- Excellent English language (written and spoken) skills. 
 - Strong experience with enterprise XML based Component Content Management Systems (CCMS), including structured content authoring, workflow management, content reuse, localization, and publishing processes. 
 - Solid understanding of XML content architectures and structured content management. 
 - Strong understanding of XML technologies and XML-based publishing pipelines. 
 - Experience validating publishing outputs against source XML content. 
 - Hands-on experience testing XML/NoSQL database platforms, with the ability to develop and execute XQuery-based validation scripts. 
 - Experience testing modern APIs. 
 - Experience testing asynchronous, event-driven, and webhook-based workflows. 
 - Strong SQL skills and experience validating relational database systems. 
 - Expertise in Playwright (JS/TS), JMeter, Azure DevOps, and Jira. 
 - Minimum of 10 years' experience in SQA, specifically testing XML based systems. . 
 - Proven experience defining enterprise QA strategy, establishing testing standards, and driving quality initiatives across multiple teams. 
 - Demonstrated ability to influence product, engineering, and architectural decisions through quality leadership. 
 - Experience mentoring QA engineers and leading quality efforts without direct supervision. 
 - Track record of improving release quality, automation maturity, and testing efficiency at an organizational level. 
 - Deep understanding of SDLC/STLC with proven Agile/Scrum experience. 
 - Strong skills in test data creation, maintenance, and management. 
 - Ability to manage multiple projects independently in a fast-paced environment. 
 - Education: MCA / Bachelor's in Engineering (Computer Science or equivalent). 
 - Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills. 

Preferred Skills & Qualifications

- Experience with Power Automate for workflow automation. 
 - Strong API and database testing expertise (REST, SOAP, SQL, MarkLogic, NoSQL). 
 - Accessibility testing knowledge (WCAG & EAA compliance). 
 - Proficiency with Git and version control systems. 
 - Experience working with structured content publishing ecosystems, including localization, translation management, or content delivery platforms.

Meet the Team / Who You'll Work With

The Cisco IOS XR Routing Test Team ensures the reliability, scalability, performance, and resiliency of Cisco's carrier-grade routing platforms. We work closely with software developers, architects, product managers, and customer-facing teams to deliver comprehensive, end-to-end validation across platforms, Optics, Layer 0, Layer 1 optical, routing, subscriber-management, and network-service technologies for service providers, hyperscalers, Optical and web-scale customers operating some of the world's largest and most demanding networks. Exciting career opportunities open for enthusiastic and experienced Software professionals in India

Our team values technical depth, automation-first engineering, continuous learning, collaborative problem-solving, and responsible adoption of AI-assisted development practices. 

Your Impact

Cisco provides you an excellent opportunity to take your career aspirations forward. You will bring your unique talents to the group that works on Cisco's routing technology, which large enterprises now consider to be the transport medium of choice for mission-critical networks. In your role as a Software Test Engineer, you will own the quality validation of IOS XR routing - Platform infra, Optics, Layer 0, Layer 1 capabilities. You will design test strategies, develop automation, validate complex customer scenarios, investigate system-level failures, and provide data-driven release recommendations. 

Your work will help ensure that Cisco delivers stable, scalable, and production-ready networking solutions. You will also mentor junior engineers, improve test frameworks, and use modern AI-assisted tools to accelerate engineering and troubleshooting workflows. 

What You Will Do

- Design and execute functional, system, regression, scale, performance, interoperability, resiliency, and high-availability tests for IOS XR routing - Platform Infra/Optics, L0/L1 test features.

 - Troubleshoot complex issues using IOS XR logs, protocol traces, packet captures, telemetry, RADIUS transactions, crash information, and system-resource data. 
 - Validate model-driven interfaces and telemetry using YANG, NETCONF, RESTCONF, gNMI, gRPC, OpenConfig, and native IOS XR models. 
 - Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines, code reviews, version control, and regression testing. 
 - Use approved AI coding assistants and engineering agents for test generation, automation development, log analysis, defect triage, and documentation. 
 - Apply foundational knowledge of generative AI, AI agents, MCPs, reusable AI skills, prompt and context management, and responsible validation of AI-generated output. 
 - Collaborate across engineering teams, review test designs and automation code, mentor junior engineers, and communicate product-quality risks and release readiness. 
 - Work on Network automation, algorithmic thinking and Analytics applications derived from customer use cases
 - Strong in Software engineering test methodology and process knowledge

Minimum Qualifications

- Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Telecommunications, or a related technical field. 
 - Five or more years of experience in software engineering, network product testing, test automation, or quality engineering. 
 - Experience configuring and troubleshooting Cisco IOS XR or another carrier-grade network operating system. 
 - Advanced Python programming skills for test automation, scripting, API interaction, data analysis, and troubleshooting. 
 - Experience developing system, scale, performance, resiliency, and high-availability test scenarios. 
 - Working knowledge of cloud, containerization, virtualization, and clustering technologies, including Docker, Kubernetes, VMware, and OpenStack. 
 - Familiarity with AI coding assistants such as GitHub Copilot or equivalent tools. 
 - Basic understanding of generative AI, AI agents, MCP, reusable skills, and responsible AI practices. 
 - Strong knowledge of software development life cycle. 
 - Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills. 
 - Deep understanding of customer deployments, operations and the ability to translate brown field/green field deployments into test strategy with high efficacy
 - Experience in test engineering concepts and methodologies including test planning, test case design, test execution and test automation
 - Excellent experience in Layer-0, Layer-1 traffic generators and analyzers (e. g. Viavi, Agilent, Spirent, IXIA, etc. )
 - Strong written, verbal communication, and interpersonal skills
 - Results oriented with a high degree of accountability, dedication and responsibility

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience testing Optical and routing capabilities on Cisco IOS XR platforms such as Cisco 8000, ASR 9000, NCS 5500/5700 and NCS1K
 - Experience with traffic generators and subscriber-simulation tools such as IXIA or Spirent or Viavi or JDSU. 
 - Knowledge of Layer 0 , Layer 1 testing along with platform & optics test skills. 
 - Experience with Datapath, model-driven telemetry, and network programmability. 
 - Familiarity with scale and performance characterization. 

Expectations

The successful candidate will operate as an experienced individual contributor who can independently own a significant routing or BNG feature area, develop production-quality automation, lead complex technical investigations, identify product and test risks, and provide evidence-based release recommendations. 

The engineer is also expected to influence test strategy, improve engineering practices, mentor junior team members, and use AI-assisted tools responsibly while maintaining security, accuracy, and engineering accountability. 

Why Cisco

At Cisco, you will work on technologies that power some of the world's largest networks. You will collaborate with experienced engineers, solve complex technical problems, and contribute to products with global impact. 

Cisco provides an inclusive environment, opportunities for continuous learning, and the ability to grow across networking, cloud, automation, and AI technologies. 

#WeAreCisco

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we're revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era - and beyond. We've been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint. 

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you'll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. 

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

Job Title

Location

Delhi , India

Full-time

The job

We are looking for a technically strong and customer-focused Service Team Lead - AMC & Customer Support to strengthen our Service & Execution organization. The role will own post-commissioning service delivery for Power SCADA, EMS and Automation projects, including AMC, warranty, technical support and customer coordination. The position will work closely with Project, Engineering, Product Development and customer teams to ensure reliable system operation, timely issue resolution and long-term customer satisfaction.

- Manage end-to-end post-commissioning support for Power SCADA, EMS and Automation projects, including remote and onsite service activities.

 - Act as the key point of contact for customer service requests, technical escalations, service updates and resolution plans. 
 - Lead troubleshooting and coordinate resolution of SCADA servers, HMI, databases, RTUs/PLCs, communication networks and system integration issues. 
 - Plan and allocate service resources, maintain service documentation, monitor SLA commitments and drive recurring-issue improvements. 

Essential Requirements

- 5-7 years of experience in Power SCADA, Electrical Automation, EMS or related control systems. 
 - Practical experience in post-commissioning support, AMC execution, warranty management and customer-facing technical service. 
 - Good understanding of SCADA architecture, HMI, real-time databases, RTUs/PLCs and system integration.

- Impact: Strong troubleshooting and service coordination skills, with focus on timely resolution and reliable customer outcomes.

 - Trust: Clear customer communication, accurate documentation and effective collaboration with Project, Engineering, Product Development, QA and supplier teams.

data.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Piping Lead

FMCG / Food & Beverage Manufacturing Projects

1. Role Purpose

The Piping Lead is responsible for planning, coordinating, reviewing and delivering piping engineering and design for greenfield and brownfield FMCG, food, dairy and beverage projects. The role covers piping scope from concept and basic engineering through detailed design, procurement support, construction, commissioning and start-up, ensuring safe, hygienic, compliant, constructible and cost-effective solutions. 

2. Key Responsibilities

- Define the piping scope, design basis, deliverable list, execution plan, schedule, resource requirement and progress measurement method. 
 - Lead and coordinate piping engineers and designers; allocate work, provide technical guidance, review outputs and ensure timely completion. 
 - Review client requirements, tender documents, process inputs, P&IDs, equipment data, site information and applicable project specifications. 
 - Prepare and review piping layouts, equipment layouts, routing studies, nozzle orientations, isometrics, support requirements and typical details. 
 - Prepare and review piping material specifications, valve specifications, line lists, tie-in lists, MTO / BOQ, material requisitions and technical bid evaluations. 
 - Identify critical lines and define the flexibility / stress-analysis requirement; review stress reports, support philosophy and equipment nozzle loads. 
 - Lead 30%, 60% and 90% 3D model reviews covering safety, hygiene, access, operability, maintainability, clash-free routing and constructability. 
 - Coordinate piping interfaces with process, mechanical, civil / structural, electrical, automation, HSE, quality, procurement, construction and commissioning teams. 
 - Conduct site surveys, verify existing conditions, manage brownfield tie-ins and provide engineering support during construction and commissioning. 
 - Monitor engineering quality, schedule, man-hours, technical risks, changes, deviations and interdisciplinary actions; report concerns with recommended solutions. 
 - Support bids and proposals through scope assessment, assumptions, exclusions, deliverable estimation, man-hour estimates and technical clarifications. 
 - Interface with clients, vendors and contractors and review vendor drawings and documents affecting piping design. 3. Piping Design Requirements for Food Industry

- Apply service-based piping material selection considering product contact, water quality, corrosion, pressure, temperature, installation environment, cleanability and lifecycle cost. 
 - Ensure hygienic design of product and CIP piping, including drainability, suitable slopes, minimum dead legs, cleanable routing, hygienic connections and avoidance of contamination traps. 
 - Provide appropriate segregation between product, cleaning chemicals, utilities, drains and incompatible services. 
 - Consider thermal expansion, condensation control, insulation, vapour sealing, personnel protection, corrosion protection and external environment in the piping design. 
 - Ensure safe access for operation, valve handling, instrument maintenance, cleaning, inspection and future replacement. 
 - Use approved piping classes, standard details and components and document any project-specific deviation for review and approval. 
 - For brownfield work, use verified survey information and laser-scan / point-cloud data where available; plan tie-ins around safe isolation and production constraints. 4. Key Piping Deliverables

- Piping design basis, design criteria, piping material specifications and piping classes
 - Equipment layouts, piping layouts, routing studies and nozzle-orientation inputs
 - Piping GAs, isometrics, line list, tie-in list, valve list and specialty-item list
 - Piping MTO / BOQ, material requisitions, technical bid evaluations and vendor-document reviews
 - Critical-line list, pipe stress-analysis reports and piping-support requirements
 - 3D model, model-review reports, clash-resolution records and interdisciplinary check comments
 - Site survey reports, construction-query responses, field-change inputs and as-built documentation5. Required Technical Knowledge

- 12-15 years of piping engineering and design experience, preferably with significant exposure to FMCG, food, dairy, beverage or consumer-product facilities. 
 - Strong knowledge of piping layout, material selection, valves, supports, insulation, stress analysis and constructability. 
 - Experience with product / hygienic piping and plant utilities such as water systems, chilled water, glycol, steam, condensate, compressed air, gases, drainage and chemical piping. 
 - Working knowledge of applicable project standards such as ASME B31. 3, ASME BPE, EN 13480, relevant ISO / EN standards, EHEDG / 3-A hygienic principles, NFPA requirements and local statutory codes, as applicable. 
 - Experience in concept, basic engineering / FEED, detailed engineering, procurement support, construction and commissioning.
