data.title: Staff Engineer
data.description:
Life at Plume

At Plume, we believe that technology isn't about moving faster, it's about making life's moments better. Which is why we've built the world's first, and only, open and hardware-independent service delivery platform for smart homes, small businesses, enterprises, and beyond. Our SaaS platform uses WiFi, advanced AI, and machine learning to create the future of connected spaces-and human experiences-at massive scale. 

We now deliver services to over 60 million locations globally and have managed over 3 billion devices on our platform. We're expanding rapidly, pioneering a new category, and we achieved our Series F funding in just four years. Our customers include many of the world's largest Internet Service Providers (ISPs) who look to Plume to help them evolve their smart home offerings while gleaning insights from their own data. 

With a bias for action and a love for being trailblazers, the team at Plume embodies a combination of relentless curiosity and imaginative innovation. We challenge ourselves to think in ways that other companies don't, work to do what should be done (rather than what can), and if we can't do it exceptionally well, we don't do it. It's how we've assembled a team of world-class builders, thinkers, and doers. And it's how we're reinventing what's possible every day. 

This is a work-from-office / In-Office role based in our Hyderabad, India location. 

Plume's Core Engineering team builds the open-standards firmware foundation of our platform across RDK-B, prplOS and OpenWRT and OpenSync. We are looking for a Staff Engineer to own the controller based broadband router firmware stack end to end: architecture, design, implementation, upstreaming

You will be the technical lead for various features like device management, network management, Wi-Fi and multi-AP mesh features such as backhaul management and steering, onboarding and metrics etc. 

What You'll Do

- Own architecture and design for various CPE features like EasyMesh, Wi-Fi Optimization, remote and local controller over standard SDK platforms like RDK-B, PrplOS, OpenWRT and OpenSync. This includes deep Wi-Fi sub-system management like backhaul link tracking, standard and hitless (make-before-break) backhaul steering, backhaul STA policies, and AP/STA metrics. 
 - Break large features into sequenced, reviewable work. Write design documents, feature matrices and validation reports that both engineers and program stakeholders can use. 
 - Maintain Plume's RDK-B Yocto layer and patch framework. Lead quarterly rebases onto new RDK-B releases and keep reference builds healthy on gateway and extender targets. 
 - Close gaps in TR-181 data models exposed through USP (obuspa) and UBus, RBus, including Wi-Fi DataElements, DHCP and DNS. 
 - Deliver onboarding flows: WPS, Wi-Fi EasyConnect (DPP) and backhaul onboarding, with WPA3/SAE, 6 GHz and Wi-Fi 7 MLO support. 
 - Triage and fix Alpha, Beta and GA blockers: mesh instability, IPv6 dual-stack and RA behavior, routing, firmware upgrade failures, and CPU and memory regressions. Back each fix with measured before/after data. 
 - Upstream fixes to opensource community like RDK Central, PrplOS, OpenWRT and evaluate competing community contributions against our own implementation. 
 - Contribute to cross-platform work on prplOS/prplMesh and OpenSync, including porting spikes and architecture comparisons. 
 - Review code and mentor engineers. Work closely with QA, program management and architects in other regions. 

What You'll Bring

- 10+ years building embedded Linux or networking firmware, with 4+ years on Wi-Fi or broadband CPE software. 
 - Strong C and C++ on Linux user space, plus shell scripting. Comfortable debugging on target with gdb, core dumps, /proc and packet captures. 
 - Hands-on RDK-B (e. g. CCSP components, RBus, OneWifi, WebConfig, and Yocto/BitBake builds) and PrplOS experiences
 - Deep 802. 11 knowledge: hostapd and wpa_supplicant, 802. 11k/v/r and BTM, WPA3/SAE, 6 GHz, MLO. 
 - Working knowledge of EasyMesh and IEEE 1905. 1: topology discovery, TLVs, controller/agent state machines and backhaul. 
 - TR-181 and USP/TR-369. TR-069 experience is a plus. 
 - Solid IP networking: IPv4/IPv6 dual stack, DHCPv4/v6, router advertisements, routing, netfilter/iptables and QoS. 
 - A track record of taking features from spike to GA, with written designs that others build from. 
 - Fluent in Git and GitHub pull-request workflows, quilt-style patch management and Jenkins CI. 

About Plume

As the creator of the only open, hardware-independent, cloud-controlled experience platform for ISPs and their subscribers, Plume partners with over 400 ISP customers, including some of the world's largest such as Charter, Liberty Global, and J: COM. 

Using OpenSync, the most widely supported open-source, silicon-to-cloud framework for smart spaces, Plume's software-defined network allows ISPs to decouple their service offerings from hardware and rapidly curate and deliver new services over a multi-vendor, open-platform architecture. 

Plume is an equal opportunity workplace that maintains a continuing policy of nondiscrimination in all employment practices and decisions, ensuring equal employment opportunities for all qualified individuals without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, national origin, age, physical or mental disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, pregnancy, childbirth or related individual conditions, medical conditions (as defined by state law), military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local law.

data.title: Staff Software Engineer
data.description:
Harness is the AI Software Delivery Platform company, led by technologist and entrepreneur Jyoti Bansal (founder of AppDynamics, acquired by Cisco for $3. 7B). Harness has raised approximately $570M in funding and is valued at $5. 5B, backed by leading investors including Goldman Sachs, Menlo Ventures, IVP, Unusual Ventures, Citi Ventures, and more. As AI accelerates code creation, the real bottleneck has shifted to everything after the code - testing, deployments, application security, reliability, compliance, and cost optimization. Harness brings AI and automation to this "outer loop, " helping teams ship software faster while maintaining security and governance throughout the entire software delivery lifecycle. 

Powered by Harness AI and the Software Delivery Knowledge Graph, the Harness Platform applies deep context and intelligent automation across the software delivery lifecycle with governance and policy-driven controls embedded throughout the platform. 

Over the past year, Harness powered over 185M deployments, 82M builds, 18T flag evaluations, 8M security scans, 9. 1B optimized tests, 3T protected API calls, and helped manage $2. 8B in cloud spend - enabling customers like United Airlines, Morningstar, and Choice Hotels to accelerate releases by up to 75%, reduce cloud costs by up to 60%, and achieve 10x DevOps efficiency. 

With a global team across 26 offices and 27 countries, Harness is shaping the future of AI software delivery - and we're looking for exceptional talent to help us move even faster. 

Position Summary

Build Distributed Systems at Global Scale - Join Harness Feature Management & Experimentation (FME)

Last year, the Harness FME platform evaluated 4 trillion feature flags. For most people, that's just an impressive number. For a scale-minded builder and engineering leader, it represents one of the most demanding challenges in distributed systems. 

To Power This Scale, We've Built

- Massive global concurrency supporting millions of real-time decisions. 
 - Millisecond-level latency through a globally distributed feature flag delivery network. 
 - Tier-one enterprise reliability trusted by the world's most sophisticated companies. 

About The Role

- Design and develop scalable backend services using Java/Golang
 - Architect and maintain distributed microservices-based systems. 
 - Build reliable APIs and internal platform services using REST(gorilla. mux, alice. chains) and gRPC. 
 - Optimize system performance across compute, memory, storage, and networking layers. 
 - Work with PostgreSQL, Redis, S3, and AWS cloud infrastructure. 
 - Deploy and manage cloud-native applications using Docker and Kubernetes. 
 - Troubleshoot complex production and infrastructure-level issues. 
 - Drive engineering best practices, code quality, and system reliability. 
 - Mentor engineers and contribute to technical leadership across teams. 
 - Collaborate cross-functionally to deliver scalable and resilient solutions. 

About You

- 8-11 years of software engineering experience with strong proficiency in Go, C++ and Java. 
 - Deep understanding of computer science fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, concurrency, memory management, CPU/process architecture, containers, cgroups, and filesystems. 
 - Strong experience designing and building scalable distributed systems and microservices architectures. 
 - Hands-on expertise with PostgreSQL (including pgx driver), Redis, and object storage systems such as S3. 
 - Solid experience working within AWS environments and familiarity with core cloud infrastructure concepts including VPCs, load balancers, auto scaling, and compute instances. Exposure to Azure or GCP is a plus. 
 - Experience building and operating cloud-native applications using Docker, Docker Compose, Kubernetes, and related orchestration tooling. 
 - Strong understanding of API design and backend communication patterns, including
 - REST APIs, gRPC, and middleware frameworks such as gorilla/mux and alice. 
 - Proficient with Git-based development workflows and modern software delivery practices. 
 - Excellent debugging and problem-solving skills, including the ability to diagnose infrastructure, networking, and system-level issues beyond application code. 
 - Strong communication and collaboration skills with the ability to operate independently in fast-paced engineering environments. 
 - Proven experience mentoring engineers, driving technical discussions, and leading initiatives across teams

Nice-to-have

- Prior experience writing security policies for API gateways or load balancers. 
 - Contributions to open-source projects. 

What You Will Have At Harness

- Experience building a transformative product
 - End-to-end ownership of your projects
 - Competitive salary
 - Comprehensive healthcare benefit
 - Flexible work schedule
 - Paid Time Off and Parental Leave
 - Monthly, quarterly, and annual social and team building events
 - Monthly internet reimbursement

Harness In The News

- Accelerating Our Mission to Bring AI to Everything After Code
 - Goldman Sachs leads investment in software delivery startup Harness at $5. 5 billion valuation
 - How Harness runs 16 "startups within a startup" at scale | Jyoti Bansal
 - Harness Research Shows AI Visibility Crisis Fueling Security Nightmare
 - Harness has been named to the Inc. Power Partner list for software delivery success

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex or national origin. 

At Harness, we care about your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data. For additional information on this topic, you can visit our privacy Portal: https: //harness-privacy. relyance. ai/

Note on Fraudulent Recruiting/Offers

We have become aware that there may be fraudulent recruiting attempts being made by people posing as representatives of Harness. These scams may involve fake job postings, unsolicited emails, or messages claiming to be from our recruiters or hiring managers. 

Please note, we do not ask for sensitive or financial information via chat, text, or social media, and any email communications will come from the domain @harness. io. Additionally, Harness will never ask for any payment, fee to be paid, or purchases to be made by a job applicant. All applicants are encouraged to apply directly to our open jobs via our website. Interviews are generally conducted via Zoom video conference unless the candidate requests other accommodations. 

If you believe that you have been the target of an interview/offer scam by someone posing as a representative of Harness, please do not provide any personal or financial information and contact us immediately at security@harness. io. You can also find additional information about this type of scam and report any fraudulent employment offers via the Federal Trade Commission's website (https: //consumer. ftc. gov/articles/job-scams), or you can contact your local law enforcement agency.

data.title: Senior Software Engineer - Rust
data.description:
Senior Rust Software Engineer (Desktop Native)

Bitwarden promotes better internet security and safety with the leading open source password management solution for individuals, teams, and business organizations. Our philosophy on security is that "we are all in this together" - we continue to offer a full-featured free version of Bitwarden so that everyone can be protected with strong password management. We also provide enterprise-grade solutions to some of the largest companies in the world, and will continue to innovate in the identity and authentication market as the world starts to grow beyond passwords. Read more on the Bitwarden blog. 

As a Senior Rust Engineer on the Desktop Native team, you will own desktop autofill and native OS integrations, including the SSH agent, Autotype, native passkeys, and the DuckDuckGo integration, built on the same cross-platform Rust SDK that also powers browser autofill. This role is primarily for someone strong in Rust, FFI and language bindings, and native OS-level integration on Windows, macOS, and Linux, with the unusual challenge of delivering secure, reliable native experiences on top of a zero-knowledge, end-to-end encrypted product. This is not primarily a front-end or UI role. 

WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Design, build, and maintain native desktop integrations including the SSH agent, Autotype, native passkeys, and the DuckDuckGo integration
 - Participate in the hands-on design, development, and evolution of the shared Rust SDK, including language bindings and FFI, consumed across desktop and browser clients
 - Interface directly with OS-level APIs on Windows, macOS, and Linux to deliver reliable native behavior. 
 - Improve performance, reliability, security, and maintainability of native integrations handling sensitive credential data. 
 - Partner with product, design, QA, and the Autofill team to deliver high-quality experiences end to end. 
 - Review pull requests and help raise the quality of native/systems engineering, including community contributions in GitHub. 
 - Identify technical debt and contribute to pragmatic refactoring and architecture improvements to the Desktop Native roadmap
 - Participate in code reviews, learning, and spreading technical knowledge
 - Independently plan, estimate, and deliver new feature work and bug fixes
 - Occasionally review & approve bug fixes submitted by the user community

WHAT YOU BRING TO BITWARDEN

- Strong production Rust experience - 4-6+ years overall backend/systems experience, including FFI and language bindings
 - Native desktop application experience, interfacing directly with OS-level APIs on Windows, macOS, or Linux
 - Experience designing and versioning cross-platform SDKs or shared libraries consumed by multiple client surfaces
 - Experience using AI tooling in your development and testing workflow (Anthropic Claude preferred)
 - Experience with Electron, TypeScript, and other web tech for cross-platform desktop applications and web clients is a plus
 - Collaborative and adaptable mindset
 - Openness and authenticity combined with excellent communication skills
 - Excitement and enthusiasm for open source and for better internet security 
 - Excellent problem-solving skills - you might not know all the answers, but you know how to find and communicate the solution

WHY WORK WITH US

- Our user community loves us and we love them. Come to work each day with a sense of purpose as we bring a more secure internet experience to everyone from our friends and family to the world's largest organizations. 
 - Become an expert. You'll get immersed in the prominent technology markets of security and open source software. 
 - We are dedicated to building a diverse and talented team. Work remotely with motivated and supportive team members across the world. 
 - Learn and grow. Take on new challenges with the support of your team, and join our #growth-club to continue personal and professional development. 
 - At Bitwarden, we are passionate about what we do, but not necessarily everything we do. Our engineering team makes it a policy to carve out some time for personal growth, learning, skill building and pursuing personal passions that positively impact the team and company. To ensure that everyone has time to reaffirm their purpose and grow, you are encouraged to self-direct up to 15% of your week to what you feel is important for the company and for yourself. 

Equal Opportunity Employer

We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone can do their best work. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and make employment decisions based on skills, experience, qualifications, and business needs.

data.description:
Who are we?

Whatfix is an AI platform advancing the "userization" of enterprise applications, empowering companies to maximize the ROI of their digital investments. Technology needs adoption. It's no different for AI. As AI reshapes roles, workflows, and human-machine interactions, it also introduces new layers of complexity and user friction. This is where Whatfix plays a pivotal role. A decade old DNA of empowering people to succeed with technology and not replacing them. We call this philosophy Userization: the belief that technology must adapt to the user, not the other way around. 

At the heart of userization philosophy is ScreenSense, our proprietary AI engine, which continuously interprets both the context of what users are doing in an application or an AI tool and the intent behind their actions. By combining these signals, Whatfix delivers real-time guidance, nudges, knowledge, and automation directly in the flow of work. 

This intelligence powers our entire product suite. 

- Digital Adoption helps users get productive faster. 
 - Product Analytics uncovers friction and closes adoption gaps. 
 - Mirror allows employees to train in safe, simulated environments. 

These are embedded with Whatfix AI Agents which supercharge creation, insights, and user guidance. 

Our upcoming AI-first products are already creating a buzz in the market. 

- Seek is an AI-native assistant that not only knows your business context but can also act across applications to get work done on your behalf. 
 - Whatfix Mirror 2. 0 is the world's only System plus Role simulation with a complete assessment to lead the Gen AI simulation category. 

Together, these products reflect Whatfix's commitment to building enterprise-ready AI teammates that maximize productivity and ROI. It gives users a unified, intelligent way to find answers across systems, apps, and knowledge silos and helps anyone looking to deliver fast and contextual answers. 

Whatfix is bridging the gap between rapid technological change and human enablement-ensuring AI is not only embedded but also usable, trusted, and outcome-driven for every employee. 

At Whatfix, we're not just making software easier-we're making AI work for people. 

The company has seven offices across the US, India, UK, Germany, Singapore, and Australia and a presence across 40+ countries. 

Customers: 700+ enterprise customers, including 80+ Fortune 500 companies such as Shell, Schneider Electric, and UPS Supply Chain Solutions. 

Investors: A total of ~$270 million USD has been raised as yet. Most recently Series E round of $125 Million USD led by Warburg Pincus, with participation from existing investor SoftBank Vision Fund 2. Other investors include Cisco Investments, Eight Roads Ventures (A division of Fidelity Investments), Dragoneer, Peak XV Partners, and Stellaris Venture Partners. 

Whatfix's leadership is consistently recognized across top industry analysts and business rankings: 

- Won the 2025 AI Breakthrough Award for the Overall AI-based Analytics Solution of the Year
 - Only DAP to be recognized as a "Leader" across various DAP reports for the past 5+ years by leading analyst firms like Gartner, Forrester, IDC, and Everest Group. 
 - With over 45% YoY sustainable annual recurring revenue (ARR) growth, Whatfix is among the "Top 50 Indian Software Companies" as per G2 Best Software Awards. 
 - Named a Gartner Customers' Choice for DAP for the second year in a row (2024 and 2025)-the only vendor in the market to earn this distinction consecutively. 
 - We also boast a star rating of 4. 6 on G2 Crowd, 4. 5 on Gartner Peer Insights, and a super-high CSAT of 99. 8%
 - Stevie Award winner in the category (Bronze): Customer Service Department of the Year - Computer Software - 100 or More Employees. 
 - Winner of the ISG Paragon Innovation Award in partnership with Sophos (customer) for the EMEA region and finalist in the Transformation Award category. 
 - RemoteTech Breakthrough Awards winner for "Software Asset Management Solution of the Year"These recognitions are matched by business performance: 

- Highest-Ranking DAP on 2023 Deloitte Technology Fast 500TM North America for Fifth Consecutive Year
 - Listed on the Financial Times & Statista's High-Growth Companies Asia-Pacific 2025 list. 
 - Won the Silver for Stevie's Employer of the Year 2023 - Computer Software category and also recognized as Great Place to Work 2022-2023
 - Only DAP to be among the top 35% companies worldwide in sustainability excellence with EcoVadis Bronze Medal

What you'll own

- Complex initiatives, end to end. The technical outcome, risks, dependencies and delivery of initiatives that cross system and team boundaries. 
 - Technical direction. You write and review specs and designs, challenge assumptions, and catch architectural, scalability, reliability, security and operational risks early. You take major designs to our Architecture Review Board (ARB). 
 - Clarity for others. You break large initiatives into outcomes that can be delivered on their own, so several engineers and coding agents can execute in parallel without waiting on you. 
 - AI in the product. You design and ship AI-powered capabilities, such as LLM integration, agents and tool calling, retrieval and evaluation, held to the same bar as any production system: latency, cost, safety and tenant isolation. 
 - Production quality. You use production and customer issues to find systemic weaknesses, and fix them so whole classes of problems don't come back. 
 - A stronger team. You mentor several engineers, share reusable specs, patterns and tooling, and help hire across Engineering. 
 - Customer and product impact. You work with Product, customers and customer-facing teams, and help shape the roadmap with a clear technical point of view. 

How you'll build

- Spec first. Every meaningful change starts with a written spec: the problem, expected outcome, constraints and acceptance criteria. 
 - Delegate real work to agents. You hand substantial implementation to coding agents and give them what they need to succeed: repository context, instruction files, and tests written before delegation. 
 - Review like it matters. Agent output isn't correct because it compiles or passes its own tests. You catch the race condition, the missing index, the cache that never invalidates and the weak assumption before they reach production. 
 - Own what you merge. Whether you or an agent wrote it, you can explain, debug and change it without leaning on the agent. 
 - One discipline. Frontend, backend, data, testing, deployment and monitoring are all part of solving the problem. Technology is a tool, not a boundary. 
 - Safe use of AI. Approved tools only, with security, privacy, data and licensing requirements intact.

 - Real experience with coding agents such as Claude Code, Cursor or Copilot on meaningful work. You've delegated substantial work, seen where agents go wrong, and changed how you scope and verify as a result. 
 - Hands-on experience building AI features: LLM APIs, prompt and context design, retrieval, agents and tool use, and evaluation. You understand the cost, latency and failure modes of probabilistic systems.

 - Customer-first thinking, and clear written communication. Your specs and design docs are easy for people and agents to act on. 
 - Good to have: multi-tenant B2B SaaS experience, or frontend work embedded inside other applications, such as browser extensions or in-app overlays. 

Nice-to-Have: 

- Exposure to mobile product ecosystems and architecture considerations. 
 - Familiarity with front-end technologies like JavaScript/React JS
 - Prior experience in SaaS, B2B, or large-scale platform development. 

Why Join Us?

- Be part of a fast-growing team driving critical backend infrastructure for Whatfix products. 
 - Opportunity to work on modern technology stacks and contribute to systems at scale. 
 - Transparent growth path with clear expectations and regular reviews. 
 - Flexible work environment with high ownership and impactful challenges. 

Perks & Benefits (India)

 - Education sponsorship
 - Internal job transfer & global mobility programs
 - Scope to represent Whatfix at global events
 - We also provide uncapped incentives, bonus plans and opportunities to employees (especially those in GTM teams) to travel to meet our global customers. 

Note: 

- We strive to live and breathe our Cultural Principles and encourage employees to demonstrate some of these core values - Customer First; Empathy; Transparency; Fail Fast and scale Fast; No Hierarchies for Communication; Deep Dive and innovate; Trust, Do it as you own it; 
 - We are an equal opportunity employer and value diverse people because of and not in spite of the differences. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status
 - At Whatfix, we deeply value collaboration, innovation, and human connection. We believe that being together in the office five days a week fosters open communication, strengthens our sense of community, and accelerates innovation-ultimately helping us achieve our goals more effectively. At the same time, we recognize the importance of flexibility in balancing personal and professional priorities. To support this, we offer the option to work from home up to two days per month.

data.title: Senior Staff Digital Methodology Engineer - Design for Testability (DFT)
data.description:
We Are

Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow. 

You Are

You have spent over a decade architecting test solutions for chips that power everything from autonomous vehicles to data centers, and you understand that DFT is not an afterthought, it is the difference between a design that ships on time and one that bleeds money in yield loss. You know the nuances of scan compression versus hierarchical DFT, not from a textbook, but from making the call on a 10-billion-gate SoC where the wrong decision costs months. 

You are the person design teams call when ATPG coverage is stuck at 97% and manufacturing is demanding 99. 5%. You have debugged IJTAG networks that span multiple chiplets, written the Tcl that automated what used to take three engineers a week, and sat in rooms with VPs explaining why their test access strategy needs to change before tapeout. You do not just know the IEEE standards, you have deployed them in production silicon and lived with the consequences. 

At Synopsys, you will work on methodologies that define how the world's most complex chips get tested. The problems are hard, the customers are sophisticated, and what you build will matter. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Define and drive DFT methodologies for next-generation ASIC and SoC designs across strategic customer programs, translating architecture decisions into deployable best practices
 - Lead deployment of advanced test solutions including scan compression, hierarchical DFT, IEEE 1500 wrappers, IJTAG instrumentation networks, and embedded test IP across multi-billion-gate designs
 - Architect scalable test access infrastructures using IEEE 1149. 1, IEEE 1149. 6, IEEE 1687, and IEEE 1500 standards for complex multi-die and chiplet-based systems
 - Develop automation frameworks, signoff criteria, and reusable methodology packages using Tcl, Python, and Perl that accelerate adoption across business units
 - Serve as technical leader and subject matter expert for Synopsys TestMAX DFT, TestMAX ATPG, diagnosis, and silicon lifecycle solutions in customer engagements and internal escalations
 - Collaborate directly with R&D teams to influence TestMAX product roadmap based on real deployment challenges and customer requirements
 - Provide technical leadership for strategic customer engagements, methodology reviews, and complex DFT architecture decisions that impact tapeout schedules and silicon success

The Impact You Will Have

- Enable successful deployment of industry-leading DFT methodologies across the world's most advanced semiconductor programs in AI, automotive, and hyperscale computing
 - Drive measurable improvements in test coverage, pattern count reduction, and manufacturing yield through methodology standardization and best-practice development
 - Influence next-generation TestMAX capabilities by translating customer deployment challenges into product requirements that shape future releases
 - Accelerate adoption of standards-based test architectures across strategic accounts, reducing time-to-market and improving silicon reliability
 - Improve engineering productivity across multiple programs through automation frameworks and reusable methodology packages that eliminate redundant work
 - Establish Synopsys as the trusted technical advisor in DFT and manufacturing test, strengthening customer relationships and competitive positioning
 - Contribute to breakthrough technologies powering autonomous vehicles, AI accelerators, and next-generation networking infrastructure

What You'll Need

- Bachelor's or Master's in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field
 - 10+ years in semiconductor or EDA industry with at least 5 years focused on DFT architecture, ATPG, and manufacturing test methodologies
 - Demonstrated expertise architecting and implementing DFT solutions for large-scale ASIC and SoC designs, including successful tapeouts
 - Hands-on experience with Synopsys TestMAX DFT and TestMAX ATPG solutions in production design environments
 - Deep technical knowledge of scan insertion, scan compression, hierarchical DFT, ATPG and diagnosis, stuck-at/transition/path-delay/bridge/cell-aware fault models, and coverage optimization techniques
 - Expertise deploying IEEE 1149. 1 (JTAG), IEEE 1149. 6 (AC JTAG), IEEE 1687 (IJTAG), and IEEE 1500 standards in complex test access architectures
 - Experience integrating DFT IP including Codec/embedded compression, OCC, LBIST, TAP controllers, JTAG and IJTAG infrastructure, TDR networks, and IEEE 1500 wrappers
 - Strong understanding of RTL-to-GDSII flows and how DFT interacts with synthesis, physical design, timing closure, and signoff
 - Proficiency with Tcl, Python, Perl, or Shell scripting for methodology automation and deployment
 - Experience defining enterprise-wide DFT standards and signoff methodologies is a strong plus
 - Background supporting advanced-node ASICs, multi-billion-gate SoCs, silicon bring-up, diagnosis, or yield improvement is highly valued
 - Knowledge of functional safety standards and automotive test requirements is a plus
 - Contributions to industry test standards, technical publications, patents, or conference presentations strengthen your candidacy

Who You Are

- You can walk into a room with a customer's design team, diagnose a coverage gap in their hierarchical DFT strategy, and sketch a solution on the whiteboard that they trust enough to implement before tapeout
 - You mentor engineers not by telling them what to do, but by asking the questions that help them see the tradeoff they missed between test time and pattern count
 - You are comfortable presenting a methodology roadmap to a VP in two slides and then diving three levels deep with an engineer debugging an IJTAG network the same afternoon
 - You push back when a proposed DFT architecture does not align with manufacturing realities, and you do it in a way that builds trust rather than friction
 - You treat automation as a first-class deliverable, not an afterthought, because you know the methodology only scales if the Tcl actually works
 - You stay current with industry trends, standards evolution, and emerging test challenges because you know that what worked on 7nm will not necessarily work on 3nm

The Team You'll Be Part Of

You will join the Digital Methodology Center of Excellence, a highly visible organization responsible for defining and advancing Synopsys' DFT methodologies, best practices, and customer deployment strategies. Working closely with R&D, product engineering, customer success, and strategic accounts, you will help shape the future of Design-for-Test and drive successful adoption of the industry's most advanced test solutions worldwide. 

Rewards and Benefits

We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

 - Define and own firmware/System validation strategy for UCIe front-end subsystems, including resets, interrupts, Logging and error handling. 
 - Define, plan, and execute system-level validation strategies for front-end (PHY + controller) IP, back end(Controller +NAND) IP and SoC-level integration. 
 - Integrate tests into scalable automation frameworks supporting simulation, emulation, and silicon validation. 
 - Debug firmware issues, perform front-end error injection, and expose design or integration defects. 
 - Validate UCIe compliance, robustness of fault detection and recovery mechanisms. 
 - Review and verify firmware trace logs and debug telemetry for correctness and completeness. 
 - Drive validation readiness across pre‐silicon and post‐silicon platforms, ensuring alignment of firmware specs, drivers, and test collateral. 
 - Interface with cross‐functional stakeholders to ensure validation coverage meets product and customer requirements. 
 - Drive compliance and interoperability testing with various endpoints 
 - Proven expertise in defining and driving end-to-end validation strategies across simulation, emulation/FPGA, and post-silicon platforms for complex SoCs and storage systems. 
 - Strong experience validating hardware IPs in pre-silicon environments (RTL simulation, SystemC/VDK, emulation, FPGA prototyping) and post-silicon environments. 
 - Possess deep understanding of Host SoC integration, firmware-hardware interactions, subsystem interoperability, and system-level debug across the complete product stack. 
 - Proficiency in high-performance/AI compute architectures, accelerator data paths, workload scheduling, and system-level performance validation

Qualifications

Required Qualifications & Skills: 

- BE/B. Tech/ME/M. Tech degree in CSE/ ECE/ EEE/ IS or related field
 - In-depth knowledge of UCIe/AXI, flow control, ordering rules, error handling, power management
 - Proficiency with protocol analyzers/exercisers (Teledyne LeCroy, Keysight) etc. 
 - Experience with high‐performance storage, networking, or compute SoCs. 
 - Strong expertise in UCIe protocol, DMA, and ASIC front-end architecture. 
 - Strong scripting skills in Python/C/C++ based scripting API's. 
 - Hands-on experience with error injection, fault modeling, and silicon debug tools. 
 - Familiarity with pre‐silicon (simulation/emulation) and post‐silicon lab validation flows. 
 - Solid understanding of firmware-hardware interaction and system-level debugging. 
 - Demonstrated leadership in test strategy definition, technical reviews, and mentoring. 
 - Strong problem-solving skills and ability to drive issues to closure under schedule pressure. 
 - Excellent communication skills with the ability to collaborate across teams and influence technical decisions. 
 - Proficiency in scripting and automation using Python, C/C++, or Bash. 
 - Minimum 6 - 8 years of related experience in firmware verification or system level testing along with Gen5/Gen6 PCI-SIG protocol testing
 - Knowledge on Git, CI & source code management flow and agile development practices. 

Soft Skills

- Strong problem-solving skills with a focus on root cause analysis. 
 - Collaborative and proactive communication style. 
 - Attention to detail and quality assurance mindset. 
 - Ability to work effectively in a global, cross-functional team.

data.description:

You will contribute to building a robust quality engineering ecosystem by integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines and supporting continuous delivery. 

In this role, you will translate requirements into effective test strategies, combining automation with manual, exploratory, and integration testing to ensure comprehensive quality coverage across all application layers. 

This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys hands-on coding, solving complex validation challenges, and improving system quality at scale, while taking ownership of end-to-end quality outcomes and collaborating closely with cross-functional teams. 

Responsibilities

Automation Development & Framework Ownership

- Design, develop, and own scalable test automation frameworks and reusable components

Test Strategy & Implementation

Delivery & Execution Excellence

 - Validate end-to-end workflows and business scenarios
 - Identify edge cases and usability issues through exploratory testing
 - Ensure test coverage for areas not suitable for automation

Quality, Standards & Engineering Practices

 - Participate in code reviews and continuous improvement of automation frameworks
 - Ensure adherence to Definition of Ready (DoR) and Definition of Done (DoD)
 - Take ownership of end-to-end quality outcomes across assigned areas
 - Follow established DevOps, security, and quality engineering practices

CI/CD & DevOps Integration

- Integrate automation into CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps preferred)
 - Enable continuous testing and shift-left quality practices
 - Monitor and improve pipeline stability, execution time, and reliability
 - Validate and troubleshoot system integrations, data flows, and error handling based on defined architectural designs and interfaces

Non-Functional Testing

- Contribute to performance, reliability, and resilience testing
 - Validate system behavior under load, stress, and failure scenarios

Observability & Debuggability

- Leverage logs, metrics, and traces to improve test reliability
 - Support root cause analysis of failures and improve system observability

Test Data & Environment Management

- Design and manage test data strategies and datasets
 - Ensure availability of stable, production-like test environments

Incident & Operational Support

- Assist in troubleshooting defects across environments
 - Support maintenance and continuous improvement of automation suites
 - Analyze and reduce flaky tests and unstable scenarios

Collaboration & Growth

- Collaborate with developers, QA, Product Owners, and Tech Leads
 - Actively learn and adopt new tools, frameworks, and best practices
 - Contribute to team knowledge sharing and a strong quality culture

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, IT, or related field
 - 5+ years of experience in software testing with strong automation focus
 - Experience in designing and implementing test automation frameworks
 - Strong understanding of testing principles, SDLC, STLC, and Agile practices

Technical Skills

Assets

 - Exposure to: 
 - Cloud platforms (Azure preferred)

 - Experience using AI-assisted tools responsibly (e. g. , GitHub Copilot)
Key Expectations

 - Ensure high reliability, scalability, and stability of automation pipelines
 - Take accountability for quality outcomes, not just test execution

 - Test and validate Bluetooth protocol stack implementations, including interoperability between different Bluetooth versions, chipsets, and operating systems. 
 - Analyze and troubleshoot complex issues related to Bluetooth communication, signal interference, range, and performance.

 - Utilize specialized Bluetooth test tools and protocol analyzers (e. g. , Ellisys, Teledyne LeCroy) to capture, decode, and analyze Bluetooth traffic.

- Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Telecommunications, or a related field.

 - Expertise in Python, Gen AI tool and Linux environment is expected

Benefits & Perks

data.description:
Job Description Summary

We are looking for a visionary, hands-on software leader to head our CT Software Engineering organization in Bangalore. In this role, you will shape how our CT software turns clinical and operational challenges into innovative, reliable solutions that help radiologists and technologists scan faster, see more clearly, reduce patient dose, and deliver better patient outcomes. 

You will lead a team of approximately 120 engineers, setting the technical vision, building world-class software engineering practices, and accelerating the speed at which we move from idea to validated product, all within the rigor required of a regulated medical device environment. As a key part of the global CT Software organization, you will bring a global mindset, working seamlessly with CT teams and partners around the world while establishing Bangalore as a center of excellence for CT software innovation. 

GE Healthcare is a leading global medical technology and digital solutions innovator. Our mission is to create a world where healthcare has no limits. Unlock your ambition, turn ideas into world-changing realities, and join an organization where every voice makes a difference, and every difference builds a healthier world. 

Job Description

Senior Director of Software Engineering - Computed Tomography (CT)

Location: Bangalore, India

Reports to: VP of Software Engineering - CT

Team size: ~120 software engineers

Travel: ~20-25% international travel to global CT R&D sites, customer sites, and leadership forums

Role Summary

We are looking for a visionary, hands-on software leader to head our CT Software Engineering organization in Bangalore. In this role, you will shape how our CT software turns clinical and operational challenges into innovative, reliable solutions that help radiologists and technologists scan faster, see more clearly, reduce patient dose, and deliver better patient outcomes. 

You will lead a team of approximately 120 engineers, setting the technical vision, building world-class software engineering practices, and accelerating the speed at which we move from idea to validated product, all within the rigor required of a regulated medical device environment. As a key part of the global CT Software organization, you will bring a global mindset, working seamlessly with CT teams and partners around the world while establishing Bangalore as a center of excellence for CT software innovation. 

Key Responsibilities

- Strategic Leadership and Vision
 - Define and communicate a multi-year software vision and strategy for the Bangalore CT organization, aligned with global CT business priorities, product roadmaps, and customer needs. 
 - Translate business objectives into clear engineering goals, measurable outcomes, and investment priorities. 
 - Develop and drive strategic initiatives that improve engineering productivity, product quality, and time-to-market. 
 - Anticipate technology and industry trends in CT and position the organization to take advantage of them. 
 - Customer-Centric Innovation
 - Champion a deep understanding of customer pain points by engaging directly with radiologists, CT technologists, service teams, and hospital IT and operations stakeholders. 
 - Partner with Product Management, Clinical, Applications, and UX teams to turn unmet customer needs into differentiated software solutions, for example simpler scan workflows, faster and more consistent exams, lower dose, better image quality, higher system uptime, and smarter automation. 
 - Build an innovation pipeline that balances near-term customer improvements with longer-term breakthrough capabilities. 
 - Encourage rapid experimentation through prototypes, proofs of concept, hackathons, and customer pilots to validate ideas early and often. 
 - Innovation Speed and R&D Execution
 - Oversee end-to-end delivery of CT software programs, including innovation projects, new product introductions (NPIs), design changes, sustaining engineering, and field actions. 
 - Ensure programs are delivered with high quality, on schedule, and within budget, with predictable and transparent execution. 
 - Increase innovation velocity by shortening feedback loops, reducing cycle time, and removing organizational and technical bottlenecks, without compromising safety or compliance. 
 - Use metrics such as DORA metrics, lead time, defect escape rate, and customer-reported issues to drive data-informed decisions and continuous improvement. 
 - Identify and manage key delivery risks and cross-site dependencies proactively. 
 - World-Class Software Engineering Practices
 - Establish and continuously raise the bar on engineering excellence, including code quality, design reviews, automated testing, CI/CD, DevSecOps, and release management. 
 - Lead the adoption of modern engineering practices and tools, including test automation, simulation and virtual scanner environments, infrastructure as code, observability, and AI-assisted development, adapted for a regulated environment. 
 - Provide leadership on Lean and Agile principles at scale; coach teams on estimation, work sizing, backlog health, and flow efficiency. 
 - Benchmark the organization against industry leaders and drive a roadmap toward best-in-class engineering maturity. 
 - Quality, Safety, and Regulatory Compliance
 - Ensure all software activities comply with applicable medical device regulations and standards, and relevant cybersecurity requirements. 
 - Build quality and compliance into everyday engineering workflows so that they support speed rather than slow it down. 
 - Partner with Quality, Regulatory, and Systems Engineering leaders to ensure CT products meet compliance, controllership, radiation safety, and patient safety standards. 
 - Ensure audit readiness and lead the organization's response to software-related CAPAs, field issues, and regulatory inquiries. 
 - Technical Standards, Architecture, and Platforms
 - Partner with global system architects and cross-functional leaders to define future CT technology platforms that are scalable, secure, interoperable, and reusable across product lines. 
 - Drive platform thinking and modular design to reduce duplication, speed up new feature delivery, and lower total cost of ownership. 
 - Global Leadership and Collaboration
 - Lead the Bangalore CT software organization as an integral part of the global CT software team, with a "one team" mindset built on trust, shared goals, and seamless collaboration across geographies, cultures, and time zones. 
 - Represent the Bangalore CT organization in global leadership forums and strengthen its visibility and impact across the business. 
 - Work closely with global partners in Product Management, Systems Engineering, Hardware, Detector and Physics, Clinical, Service, Manufacturing, Quality, and Regulatory. 
 - Talent Management and Culture
 - Attract, develop, and retain top engineering talent in a highly competitive market. 
 - Build strong technical and functional leadership benches, organizational models, and succession plans. 
 - Create an inclusive, high-performance culture built on ownership, curiosity, psychological safety, and continuous learning. 
 - Develop clear technical and managerial career paths, and mentor emerging leaders and senior technical experts. 
 - Engineering Operations and Finances
 - Own and manage the Bangalore CT software engineering budget, headcount, and resource allocation. 
 - Explore and implement alternative resourcing models, such as partners, vendors, and centers of excellence, to scale capacity and accelerate innovation. 
 - Use portfolio and project management tools to track progress, report status, and highlight key risks. 
 - Drive cost efficiency and productivity improvements while protecting investment in innovation. 
 - Stakeholder Engagement and Communication
 - Present regular updates on strategy, progress, and risks to executive sponsors, global CT leadership, and customers. 
 - Align stakeholders on priorities, timelines, and trade-offs; resolve conflicting priorities through proactive and transparent communication. 
 - Ensure data, process, and system changes are implemented in line with project objectives and timelines. 
 - Thought Leadership and Knowledge Sharing
 - Act as a recognized technical and leadership voice inside the company and in the wider industry, including conferences, publications, and industry and academic partnerships. 
 - Share technical, procedural, and business knowledge to raise the capability of the broader organization. 
 - Encourage the creation of learning content, internal tech talks, communities of practice, and patents and invention disclosures. 

Education Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. A Master's degree or other advanced degree is preferred. 

Required Skills

- 15+ years of experience in software engineering, including the design and development of complex, scalable software systems. 
 - 5+ years leading large software organizations (100+ engineers), including leaders of leaders. 
 - Proven experience working in and with globally distributed teams across multiple countries and cultures. 
 - Demonstrated track record of delivering innovative products that solved real customer problems and created measurable business impact. 
 - Experience working with regulatory compliance in the medical devices industry or another highly regulated industry. 

Skills And Competencies

- Strategic thinking with the ability to connect technology choices to customer value and business outcomes. 
 - Customer focus, with a habit of grounding decisions in direct customer insight. 
 - Global mindset, with cultural agility and a proven ability to build cohesive teams across borders. 
 - Bias for speed and action, balanced with sound judgment on quality, safety, and risk. 
 - Deep knowledge of modern software development methodologies, architecture, and tools. 
 - Strong program and portfolio management, organizational, and financial skills. 
 - Excellent communication, influencing, and executive presence, with the ability to explain complex technical topics to diverse audiences. 
 - Ability to inspire, coach, and build high-performing teams and future leaders. lex problems. 

Inclusion And Diversity

Employment decisions are made without regard to race, colour, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

 - Experience in Agile, Scrum, and DevOps-driven environments.

You will manage a team of engineers, including senior engineers and leads, with responsibility for performance, career growth, and team effectiveness. You will shape the roadmap for your area with business leadership and product managers, and own planning, estimation, capacity planning, and scope management while navigating delivery risks, trade-offs, and escalations independently. You will remain close to design and development, guiding the team on engineering best practices and providing technical leadership on complex, high-impact problems. You will mentor engineers on both technology and domain aspects to support their growth and development. 

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR: 

The ideal candidate should hold-

Basic Qualifications: 

- A bachelor's or master's degree in computer science or a related field, with 8 to 11 years of relevant experience
 - Robust software design and architecture experience, with sound judgment on trade-offs involving scalability, availability, security, and maintainability
 - Experience managing and developing engineers, including providing feedback, coaching, and supporting career growth
 - Proven ability to work with senior stakeholders, shape requirements and technical direction, build alignment, and handle escalations independently
 - Solid software engineering background across web applications, backend services, or data-intensive systems, with experience building and operating production systems at scale
 - Proven experience delivering complex projects end to end, including planning, estimation, execution, and course correction
 - Robust problem-solving and analytical skills, with a focus on engineering quality and sound technical judgment
 - Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with both technical and business stakeholders

Preferred Qualifications:

data.description:
Organization OverviewCompany Description

QAD is a leading provider of ERP solutions purpose-built for manufacturing industries - automotive, life sciences, food & beverage, high tech, and industrial. Serving thousands of global manufacturers, QAD's Adaptive Manufacturing Cloud helps companies operate with greater precision, agility, and intelligence. 

Enterprise software is entering a third era. The first gave manufacturers a System of Record - ERP that answered 'what do we have and what did we commit to?' The second gave them Data Infrastructure - the ability to move, analyse, and query that data at scale. The third era is domain-specific intelligence: AI agents that can act autonomously on manufacturing data, but only if that data has been given the context, relationships, and governed rules that allow an agent to reason correctly. 

Job Description

The ERP Platform Architect owns the architecture of the foundation underneath Adaptive ERP: the frameworks, shared services, data layer, and runtime that every functional area builds on. This architect is the technical partner to the Director, ERP Platform: one engineering head paired with one architect. 

Open: final scope and level to be confirmed. 

Responsibilities

- Develop the platform architecture and technical roadmap with the Director, ERP Platform and the Lead Architect. 
 - Define clear contracts and standards for shared platform services: application interfaces, integrations, identity, data access, and extensibility. 
 - Assess legacy dependencies and technical debt, and design incremental modernization paths that preserve compatibility for customers. 
 - Set requirements for performance, security, resilience, observability, and testability. 
 - Review designs and critical implementation choices, using prototypes to resolve hard platform risks. 
 - Coach engineers and provide technical input into development plans and promotion assessments. 

Qualifications

Required Skills: 

- Senior architecture and hands-on engineering experience on a complex enterprise software platform. 
 - Deep knowledge of frameworks, data layers, APIs, integration patterns, extensibility, and multi-environment deployment. 
 - A record of modernizing established software incrementally, balancing long-term architecture with delivery. 
 - Influence across engineering teams, turning architectural decisions into implemented outcomes. 

Preferred

- Enterprise ERP or manufacturing software experience. 
 - Experience with Progress/OpenEdge environments and Java services. 
 - AI-assisted modernization or development. 

What Success Looks Like

One coherent target architecture that every workstream builds toward, cross-team technical decisions made quickly, and visible progress in modernizing the product. 

The benchmark is a chief-architect-calibre leader early in that arc: broad, credible with executives, and able to drive change rather than only advise on it. 

Why QAD?

You'll be shaping the future of intelligent manufacturing platforms at global scale-working with ambitious leaders, modern cloud technologies, and AI‐driven innovation that delivers real‐world impact. 

Additional Information

- Your health and well being are important to us at QAD. We provide programs that help you strike a healthy work-life balance. 
 - Opportunity to join a growing business, launching into its next phase of expansion and transformation. 
 - Collaborative culture of smart and hard-working people who support one another to get the job done. 
 - An atmosphere of growth and opportunity, where idea-sharing is always prioritized over level or hierarchy. 
 - Compensation packages based on experience and desired skill set

In our 12 countries (Europe, Middle East, Asia) of operation, we are working on the production and distribution of low-carbon electricity, through the development of nuclear and renewable energies. The Assystem Safety & Risk business unit has over 20 years' experience, delivering bespoke, high-quality safety, risk, and reliability consultancy services to high-hazard industries. data.title: Director, Engineering (Lynx + Extensions Platform)
data.description:
Organization OverviewCompany Description

QAD is a leading provider of ERP solutions purpose-built for manufacturing industries - automotive, life sciences, food & beverage, high tech, and industrial. Serving thousands of global manufacturers, QAD's Adaptive Manufacturing Cloud helps companies operate with greater precision, agility, and intelligence. 

Enterprise software is entering a third era. The first gave manufacturers a System of Record - ERP that answered 'what do we have and what did we commit to?' The second gave them Data Infrastructure - the ability to move, analyse, and query that data at scale. The third era is domain-specific intelligence: AI agents that can act autonomously on manufacturing data, but only if that data has been given the context, relationships, and governed rules that allow an agent to reason correctly. 

Job Description

This director owns the engineering that moves customers onto Adaptive streamlined. Many customers carry years of custom code. Lynx is QAD's tooling, built on AWS' ATX, that analyzes existing customizations and supports their conversion to approaches compatible with Adaptive streamlined. The Extensions Platform is where customers build and run those extensions. This leader owns both, plus the engineering side of the pre-engagement assessment every customer goes through before migrating. It is the most customer-facing engineering leadership role in the transformation. 

Responsibilities

- Own the engineering capabilities and technical support model that enable Services and partners to assess, plan, and execute customer transitions: assess their environment, customizations, integrations, and business processes; convert what can be converted; resolve what cannot. 
 - Lead the engineering side of the pre-engagement gate with Services, Sales, and Product, so customers are qualified and planned before migration starts. 
 - Own the combined roadmap, delivery commitments, budget, and results for Lynx and the Extensions Platform. 
 - Lead and develop both managers and their teams, with clear ownership, performance expectations, and succession. 
 - Turn findings from every migration into backlog: missed customizations become Lynx work, platform gaps become Extensions Platform work. 
 - Build an Extensions Platform that lets customers create their own extensions, replacing what they give up in custom code. 
 - Manage internal and vendor delivery, and measure the process: conversion effort, cycle time, and customers reaching Adaptive streamlined. 

Qualifications

Required

- Engineering leadership across multiple teams through managers, accountable for people, technology, execution, and results. 
 - Experience delivering migration tooling, developer tooling, customization frameworks, or low-code/no-code platforms for enterprise software. 
 - Comfort working directly with customers, Services, and partners, turning complex needs into repeatable product capabilities. 
 - Strong technical judgment and credibility in design decisions alongside architects. 

Preferred

- ERP or manufacturing software experience. 
 - Leadership of large legacy modernization or customer conversion programs. 
 - Practical experience using AI for code analysis, transformation, or developer productivity. 

What Success Looks Like

A repeatable, measurable path to Adaptive streamlined, fewer recurring conversion blockers, and steadily less effort per customer migration. 

Additional Information

- Your health and well being are important to us at QAD. We provide programs that help you strike a healthy work-life balance. 
 - Opportunity to join a growing business, launching into its next phase of expansion and transformation. 
 - Collaborative culture of smart and hard-working people who support one another to get the job done. 
 - An atmosphere of growth and opportunity, where idea-sharing is always prioritized over level or hierarchy. 
 - Compensation packages based on experience and desired skill set

About QAD

QAD | Redzone is redefining manufacturing and supply chains through its intelligent, adaptive platform that connects people, processes, and data into a single System of Action. With three core pillars - Redzone (frontline empowerment), Adaptive Applications (the intelligent backbone), and Champion AI (Agentic AI for manufacturing) - QAD | Redzone helps manufacturers operate with Champion Pace, achieving measurable productivity, resilience, and growth in just 90 days.

data.description:
Job Description

At NI IP Routing SW, we believe in fostering a flat and non-hierarchical work environment. We are obsessed about delivering high-quality products and ensure the utmost level of excellence in everything we do. We are a passionate bunch and strive to be technological leaders in our industry. You will be integral to a close-knit team to engineer best-in-class products for the most critical networks - data centers for web/hyper-scalers, telcos and enterprises (including AI fabrics), and communication service provider networks. 

We are looking for SW engineers who wish to be a part of developing and evolving the current and next generation of routers that form the core of anything internet. These routers are at the heart of Nokia's IP product offerings, from data centers (including AI fabrics) to providing strong, resilient low latency and dependable IP backhaul for service providers and mission critical networks. In this role, you will have the opportunity to work with one of the best engineering teams in the industry. We value your expertise and offer an environment where you can thrive both professionally and personally. There are more customers we want to win, more networks to penetrate, more technologies to enable and more applications to support. We want to make smaller products, and we want to make bigger products. We want to build products based on newer standards and newer ASICS in the market. 

You will play a critical role in designing and implementing high-performance data path solutions on both custom and merchant silicon. You will be responsible for writing efficient and modular code that is well-tested and robust, ensuring that it meets the high standards required for the most critical networks. Your role will involve working on advanced packet forwarding techniques in IP, MPLS, Segment Routing, VxLANs. You will also contribute into Traffic Management technologies - QoS (Policers, Schedulers, Shapers), ACLs, TCAM Management, and Packet Extractions to CPU. DCN2026. 

How You Will Contribute And What You Will Learn

- Design and implementation: You will gain deep expertise in designing and implementing datapath solutions on both custom and merchant silicon. 
 - Advanced packet forwarding: Develop your skills in IP, MPLS, Segment Routing, VXLANs, and QoS technologies such as Policers, Schedulers, and ACLs. DPDK and performance optimization: You'll be working with DPDK and similar technologies to maximize performance for high-throughput systems. 
 - Virtualized environments: Expand your knowledge in working with virtualized Linux environments such as KVM and Dockers. 
 - Team collaboration: Work closely with cross-functional teams, including product management and software testers, to deliver customer-driven solutions. 
 - Robust and modular code: Focus on writing modular, maintainable code that is well unit-tested, improving your coding skills and best practices. 

Key Skills And Experience

- Bachelor's degree with 3-10 years of Experience. 
 - Proven experience in packet forwarding technologies (IP, MPLS, Segment Routing, VXLANs). 
 - Experience with QoS technologies (Policers, Schedulers, ACLs) and TCAM management. 
 - Hands-on experience with DPDK for high-performance packet processing. 
 - Proficiency in C/C++ programming, with a focus on networking solutions. 
 - Contributions to SONiC or other open-source networking projects (desirable). 
 - Methodical problem-solving skills and attention to detail. 
 - Experience working in virtualized Linux environments (e. g. , KVM, Docker, etc. ). 
 - Passion for networking technologies and high-performance systems. 

About Us

Advancing connectivity to secure a brighter world. 

Nokia is a global leader in connectivity for the AI era. With expertise across fixed, mobile and transport networks, powered by the innovation of Nokia Bell Labs, we're advancing connectivity to secure a brighter world.

data.description:

Whirlpool of India Limited, headquartered in Gurugram, is a leading home appliances company dedicated to enhancing life at home and inspiring generations through its trusted brands. The team you will be a part of

The Service Quality team is responsible for setting up of the Service Quality standards for Whirlpool India along with addressing consumer complaints by effectively managing service call center. Also responsible for leading cost saving projects and service strategy consolidation along with managing the serviceability of the assigned categories. 

This Role In Summary

The Service Quality Lead will be responsible for driving end-to-end service quality, customer experience, technical capability, and product/service performance for the Air Conditioner and Microwave categories. The role will identify quality gaps and convert customer, field and data insights into effective corrective and preventive actions. It will drive sustainable improvement in key service KPIs, including repeat rate, First Time Fix, NPS and complaint resolution. The role will also lead P4G and Total Cost of Quality (TCQ) initiatives focused on reducing Cost of Poor Quality, warranty costs, repeat repairs and service inefficiencies. Partnering with cross-functional teams, the role will identify, quantify and deliver impactful cost-saving opportunities without compromising customer experience or service quality. 

Your Responsibilities Will Include

- Ensure service readiness for new product launches, including SOPs, technical training, tools, spares, troubleshooting and field support. 
 - Analyse customer VOC, field data, product failures and service trends to identify quality gaps, recurring issues and improvement opportunities. 
 - Lead RCA, CAPA and corrective actions for critical and recurring product/service quality issues in collaboration with Engineering, Plant Quality, Manufacturing, Marketing and Service Operations. 
 - Drive Field Fix implementation for identified product and technical issues, ensuring effective execution, compliance and closure across the service network
 - Drive P4G and TCQ initiatives to reduce Cost of Poor Quality, warranty costs, repeat repairs, material consumption, avoidable visits and other service-related costs. 
 - Establish effective control over customer machine replacements and Under-Warranty (UW) costs, ensuring appropriate validation, approvals and cost governance. 
 - Manage coordination with FPS vendors for technical interventions, product quality issues, field actions and resolution of critical cases. 
 - Drive technical capability development of Service Engineers, Master Engineers and Service Partners through targeted training, certification and technical interventions. 
 - Own LMS platform management for the categories, ensuring training content, curriculum, certification, completion and capability tracking are effectively managed. 
 - Drive SBOM readiness and MSL review for new and existing products, ensuring adequate parts availability based on failure trends, installed base and service requirements. 
 - Monitor and improve Service Partner quality performance through audits, scorecards, governance reviews and structured improvement plans. 
 - Establish early-warning mechanisms and quality dashboards to proactively identify product, process and service quality risks. 
 - Benchmark best practices and lead continuous improvement and quality transformation projects across the service network. 

Minimum Requirements

Education: Bachelor's degree in Engineering, preferably Mechanical, Electrical, Electronics, Production or a related discipline. 

Preferred Skills And Experiences

8+ years in Consumer Durables, HVAC, Refrigeration or related industries, with strong service and field operations exposure. 

Strong expertise in spare parts planning, SBOM readiness, MSL optimisation and parts availability. 

Proven experience in Service Partner quality, technical capability and FPS/vendor coordination. 

Strong cross-functional leadership across Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Marketing and Service. 

Data-driven problem-solving, stakeholder management and ability to convert VOC/field insights into improvements. 

Experience in new product launch readiness, including SOPs, training, tools, spares and field support. 

Excellent communication and presentation skills with senior leadership and field teams.

QAD is a leading provider of ERP solutions purpose-built for manufacturing industries - automotive, life sciences, food & beverage, high tech, and industrial. Serving thousands of global manufacturers, QAD's Adaptive Manufacturing Cloud helps companies operate with greater precision, agility, and intelligence. 

Enterprise software is entering a third era. The first gave manufacturers a System of Record - ERP that answered 'what do we have and what did we commit to?' The second gave them Data Infrastructure - the ability to move, analyse, and query that data at scale. The third era is domain-specific intelligence: AI agents that can act autonomously on manufacturing data, but only if that data has been given the context, relationships, and governed rules that allow an agent to reason correctly.

The SRM Architect owns the technical direction of QAD's SaaS products outside the core ERP: Supplier Relationship Management (SRM), Enterprise Quality Management (EQMS), and Demand & Delivery. Responsibilities

- Define the target architecture and a practical modernization roadmap for SRM, EQMS, and Demand & Delivery, with engineering and product leaders. 
 - Make and document architecture decisions on application design, AWS deployment, multi-tenancy, integrations, data, security, and performance.
