data.title: Pre-Silicon SoC Validation - Technical Lead
data.description:
Job Details

Job Description: 

Role Summary

Seeking an experienced SoC Validation Engineer to define, drive, and execute validation strategies across the full silicon lifecycle, from architecture definition and pre-silicon planning through silicon power-on, post-silicon debug, stepping readiness, and PRQ quality convergence. 

The role requires deep expertise in complex SoC validation, security validation, coherency flows, firmware and hardware interaction, disaggregated architecture, and cross-functional technical leadership. 

The engineer will be responsible for ensuring early risk identification, high-quality milestone readiness, predictable silicon bring-up, rapid sighting debug, and continuous feedback from post-silicon learnings into earlier validation phases. 

Key Responsibilities

Define and drive end-to-end SoC validation strategy across the full lifecycle, including architecture definition, pre-silicon validation planning, RTL milestone readiness, silicon power-on preparation, post-silicon debug, stepping readiness, and PRQ quality convergence. 

Develop comprehensive validation plans, execution strategies, coverage goals, debug plans, and sign-off criteria aligned to program milestones and product quality targets. 

Drive validation of critical SoC flows across security, coherency, memory, fabric, IO, and cross-die interactions in disaggregated architectures. 

Validate complex hardware, firmware, and software interactions with specific focus on security handshakes, coherency protocols, cache and fabric ordering, access control, isolation, attestation, fuse/security policy behavior, and multi-die/domain interactions. 

Review architecture and microarchitecture specifications to identify validation gaps in security, coherency, shared-resource behavior, cross-die communication, firmware sequencing, and lifecycle readiness from pre-silicon through post-silicon execution. 

Drive debug of complex pre-silicon and post-silicon failures, identify root cause across RTL, firmware, microcode, platform software, validation content, security policy, coherency behavior, and system-level configuration. 

Partner with architecture, design, verification, firmware, post-silicon, security, coherency, platform, manufacturing, and program teams to ensure high-quality validation readiness, silicon bring-up efficiency, and timely closure of issues across product milestones. 

Use post-silicon sightings, customer issues, stepping feedback, defect trends, security observations, and coherency escapes to strengthen earlier validation strategies, improve coverage, and prevent repeated escapes across programs. 

Define validation quality metrics, execution dashboards, risk indicators, milestone readiness reports, and sign-off recommendations for leadership reviews. 

Drive innovation in validation efficiency, including automation, test grading, coverage-driven execution, AI/ML-assisted bug hunting, regression optimization, and shift-left methodologies. 

Mentor senior and mid-level engineers, build technical depth in the team, and contribute to reusable validation methodologies, collateral, and best practices across programs. 

Qualifications

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electronics Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, VLSI, Embedded Systems, Computer Science, or a related discipline. 

12-20 years of relevant industry experience in pre-silicon validation, SoC validation, design verification, silicon validation, firmware validation, or hardware/software co-validation. 

Strong understanding of SoC architecture, microarchitecture, CPU/core integration, fabrics, memory subsystem, security, coherency, cache hierarchy, firmware-driven security flows, and disaggregated/multi-die architectures. 

Hands-on experience defining and executing validation strategies across the product lifecycle, including architecture review, pre-silicon planning, RTL milestone readiness, silicon power-on preparation, post-silicon sighting debug, stepping feedback, and PRQ quality convergence. 

Proven experience in developing validation plans, test strategies, debug methodologies, coverage closure plans, post-silicon feedback loops, and milestone sign-off criteria for complex SoCs and disaggregated silicon products. 

Required Technical Skills

Deep knowledge of SoC architecture, system architecture, disaggregated and multi-die architecture, microarchitecture fundamentals, IP/subsystem integration, fabrics, memory hierarchy, and cross-die communication. 

Strong expertise in validation methodologies across the pre-silicon to post-silicon continuum, including test planning, content development, coverage closure, milestone readiness, silicon bring-up support, sighting reproduction, and lifecycle feedback loops. 

Strong technical depth in security validation, coherency validation, cache/fabric ordering, access-control flows, isolation mechanisms, firmware-authenticated flows, fuse/security policy behavior, and multi-domain system interactions. 

Strong debug skills using waveform analysis, logs, traces, checkers, assertions, firmware instrumentation, and platform-level debug tools. 

Experience with one or more programming or scripting languages such as C, C++, Python, Perl, SystemVerilog, UVM, or similar validation automation languages. 

Knowledge of firmware and microcode flows, manageability firmware, or other SoC firmware interactions. 

Understanding of validation quality metrics, functional coverage, test effectiveness, regression health, bug trends, and milestone readiness indicators. 

Leadership and Collaboration Expectations

Operate as a senior technical leader who can independently define technical direction, influence stakeholders, and drive convergence across multiple teams. 

Lead cross-functional discussions with architecture, design, verification, firmware, post-silicon, platform, manufacturing, and program management teams. 

Identify program risks early, propose mitigation plans, and drive technical decision-making to protect milestone predictability and product quality. 

Communicate complex technical issues clearly through reviews, dashboards, status reports, debug summaries, and leadership updates. 

Mentor engineers, build validation capability within the organization, and help establish scalable processes for future SoC programs. 

Preferred Qualifications

Prior Intel Xeon product validation experience across one or more server SoC generations, including pre-silicon planning, silicon power-on, post-silicon debug, stepping readiness, or PRQ quality convergence. 

Exposure to Cheetah-based validation methodologies, including validation environment integration, filelist/dependency setup, methodology quality checks, simulation build/run readiness, or SoC/IP integration collateral checks. 

Exposure to security, coherency, cache hierarchy, fabric, memory validation. 

Experience with lifecycle-driven validation improvements, including shift-left strategies, post-silicon sighting reproduction in pre-silicon environments, reusable validation content, formal-assisted validation, collateral consistency checks, and AI/ML-driven validation efficiency improvements. 

Prior experience driving A0/TI readiness, milestone sign-off, or post-silicon sighting reproduction in pre-silicon environments. 

Demonstrated ability to deliver results through ambiguity, influence without authority, and enable technical convergence across distributed teams.

data.description:
Organization OverviewCompany Description

QAD is a leading provider of ERP solutions purpose-built for manufacturing industries - automotive, life sciences, food & beverage, high tech, and industrial. Serving thousands of global manufacturers, QAD's Adaptive Manufacturing Cloud helps companies operate with greater precision, agility, and intelligence. 

Enterprise software is entering a third era. The first gave manufacturers a System of Record - ERP that answered 'what do we have and what did we commit to?' The second gave them Data Infrastructure - the ability to move, analyse, and query that data at scale. The third era is domain-specific intelligence: AI agents that can act autonomously on manufacturing data, but only if that data has been given the context, relationships, and governed rules that allow an agent to reason correctly. 

Job Description

This director changes how QAD builds and proves quality in Adaptive ERP. The goal is continuous, automated evidence that every release, patch, and update works in environments that look like customers' own, not a QA stage at the end. This leader owns quality standards, regression automation, and release gates, and has the authority to stop a release that does not meet them. We are not looking for a QA manager. We need a leader who will reshape how the organization thinks about quality. 

Responsibilities

- Build and lead the central Quality Engineering organization: strategy, staffing, capability, and results. 
 - Define quality standards and evidence-based release gates covering installation, configuration, upgrades, patches, integrations, and end-to-end business flows. 
 - Hold the authority to block a release that fails those gates. 
 - Lead regression automation: one framework, a suite covering the defined test surface, and a measurable coverage ramp, integrated into development and deployment pipelines. 
 - Qualify releases in customer-representative environments and configurations. 
 - Apply AI across the quality lifecycle, including test generation, maintenance, and defect analysis. 
 - Make quality visible with data: coverage, escaped defects, regression results, and release readiness. 
 - Own the quality assessment against agreed release gates and escalate unmet criteria through the release decision process. 

Qualifications

Required

- Senior quality engineering leadership on large enterprise SaaS products, including organizational and process transformation. ERP experience is not required. 
 - Expertise in automation architecture, continuous testing, CI/CD, branch strategy, and risk-based qualification. 
 - Practical experience applying AI to testing or software engineering, with evidence it worked. 
 - Data-driven judgment and the confidence to push back on senior leaders, including the SVP, when quality standards are not met. 

Preferred

- Experience testing ERP or similarly complex enterprise applications. 
 - Experience qualifying repeatable upgrades and patches in controlled configurations. 

What Success Looks Like

Release decisions made on evidence, continuous regression running on every change, rising coverage of critical customer flows, and a sustained drop in escaped defects. 

Additional Information

- Your health and well being are important to us at QAD. We provide programs that help you strike a healthy work-life balance. 
 - Opportunity to join a growing business, launching into its next phase of expansion and transformation. 
 - Collaborative culture of smart and hard-working people who support one another to get the job done.

Qualifications

- Strong grounding in security, privacy, and enterprise engineering practices, including authentication, 

authorization, data protection, and secure API design. 

- Proven ability to translate ambiguous technical/business problems into clear execution plans, 

particularly within a newly formed team without fully established process. 

- Strong ownership mindset and technical judgment; comfortable operating with high autonomy in a

One of India's largest private FM radio networks, active since 2006. The company reaches over 40 million listeners weekly across 49 cities, 1, 000+ towns, and 50, 000 villages.

The company is building a media super-app that unifies video, audio, radio, micro-drama, news, and commerce on a single platform. What We Offer

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced and result-oriented EPC Quality Head to lead and manage quality assurance and quality control activities across our solar EPC projects. The candidate will be responsible for ensuring that all project activities comply with approved engineering specifications, quality standards, statutory requirements, and project execution guidelines. 

The ideal candidate should have strong experience in solar EPC projects, quality management systems, site inspections, audits, and project quality control. 

Key Responsibilities

1. Develop, implement, and monitor Quality Assurance and Quality Control (QA/QC) plans for solar EPC projects. 

2. Ensure compliance with project specifications, approved drawings, technical standards, and applicable quality norms. 

3. Lead and supervise the quality team at project sites. 

4. Monitor quality activities related to solar module installation, mounting structures, DC/AC electrical works, cabling, earthing, and commissioning. 

5. Conduct regular site inspections, quality audits, and process evaluations. 

6. Review and approve Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs), Method Statements, and Quality Control Procedures. 

7. Coordinate with project execution, engineering, procurement, and subcontractor teams to resolve quality-related issues. 

8. Identify non-conformities, implement corrective and preventive actions (CAPA), and ensure timely closure. 

9. Maintain quality documentation, inspection reports, test records, and project quality reports. 

10. Ensure material quality inspections and verification of incoming materials as per approved specifications.

Role - Quality Assurance Engineer 3

About Us

We are surrounded by the world's leading consumer companies led by technology - Amazon for retail, Airbnb for hospitality, Uber for mobility, Netflix and Spotify for entertainment, etc. Food & Beverage is the only consumer sector where large players are still traditional restaurant companies. At Rebel Foods, we are challenging this status quo as we are building the world's most valuable restaurant company on the internet, superfast. 

The opportunity for us is immense due to the exponential growth in the food delivery business worldwide which has helped us build 'The World's Largest Internet Restaurant Company' in the last few years. Rebel Foods' current presence in India & UAE with close to 50 brands and 4500+ internet restaurants has been built on The Rebel Operating System. 

While for us it is still Day 1, we know we are in the middle of a revolution towards creating never seen before customer-first experiences. We bring you a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to disrupt the 500-year-old industry with technology at its core. 

We urge you to refer to the below to understand how we are changing the restaurant industry before applying at Rebel Foods.

Software Engineering @ Rebel

Software Engineering @ Rebel comprises of most of the components of a customer-centric internet commerce company and problem statements of scalable and distributed systems. We believe in applying engineering excellence and operational excellence in all the areas of compute, storage, network to build & operate efficient systems. While we work on open-source, cloud-managed and enterprise tech stacks in Frontend (web/mobile), Backend (API layers), Caching, Async Processing/Queuing, Databases (SQL, NoSQL), ERP, CRM, Analytics, Big Data (Hadoop, Spark, MongoDB etc), Data Science (ML) etc, we also work/evaluate on many emerging tech stacks like NLP, AI/IOT, Robotics + Automations, Bots, Voice, Vision computing, Blockchain etc to solve many use cases around different verticals of FoodTech. The teams have built more than 30 different systems in-house to tackle the massive complexity of a multi-brand operation while keeping business metrics supremely efficient and optimized. 

Future of Software Engineering @ Rebel

Rebel Engineering function is working on Software + Robotics + Automation to solve the toughest problems in an integrated fashion for our customers and to make their food experiences unique, memorable and delightful & sure. We believe in continuous adoption of emerging technologies to solve customer problems in fast and innovative fashion. Technology and data are the backbone for us to disrupt this industry and build the most loved experiences for customers. 

The Role

We are on the lookout for a Lead QA who is passionate about using technology to solve known and unknown business and customer use cases. We want someone who can look at a business problem from the end user's perspective, believes in building and delivering quality products, and can lead others to do the same. 

In this role, you will own end-to-end quality for backend and integration services that have no user interface. Around 60-70% of the work involves validating system behaviour through logs and monitoring tools. You will analyse application logs in ELK to confirm that the correct API calls are happening with the right payloads and sequencing, trace requests across microservices using Datadog APM, and debug issues in services hosted on AWS. You will be responsible for test strategy, planning and release sign-off. You will also test third-party integrations for contract correctness, data consistency, retries, timeouts and failure scenarios, prepare regression and sanity suites, and run Linux commands and write SQL queries to verify logs, production issues and data. 

On the automation side, you will contribute to, scale and improve our existing API automation frameworks (Java, RestAssured), and design new frameworks from scratch when needed. You should have hands-on knowledge of Jenkins and Docker to integrate automation into CI/CD pipelines, and be able to plan and run performance tests using JMeter or similar tools. As a lead, you will mentor and guide QA engineers, review their test plans and automation code, define and report quality metrics, and drive adoption of AI-assisted testing practices. We expect you to be a strong problem solver and an out-of-the-box thinker. 

Exposure to common technologies such as web technologies, caching, queuing, databases (SQL), storage systems, monitoring tools and cloud technologies is also helpful. 

You will work closely with the Product and Engineering teams and will report to the Engineering Manager - QA. 

The Rebel Culture

We believe in empowering and growing people to perform the best at their job functions. data.description:
Company Description

It started with a simple idea: what if surgery could be less invasive and recovery less painful? Nearly 30 years later, that question still fuels everything we do at Intuitive. As a global leader in robotic-assisted surgery and minimally invasive care, our technologies-like the da Vinci surgical system and Ion-have transformed how care is delivered for millions of patients worldwide. 

We're a team of engineers, clinicians, and innovators united by one purpose: to make surgery smarter, safer, and more human. Every day, our work helps care teams perform with greater precision and patients recover faster, improving outcomes around the world. 

The problems we solve demand creativity, rigor, and collaboration. The work is challenging, but deeply meaningful-because every improvement we make has the potential to change a life. 

If you're ready to contribute to something bigger than yourself and help transform the future of healthcare, you'll find your purpose here. 

Job Description

Primary Function: 

In this role, a Sr. Supplier Engineer is responsible for ensuring suppliers meet ISI requirements for quality, service, delivery, and cost. Drive suppliers to continuously improve business and manufacturing processes. Evaluate and select suppliers. Guide Engineering in choosing suppliers for new products and provide DFM input to new designs to support NPI projects. Executes detailed projects with suppliers to ensure excellence across quality, cost, capacity, risk management, and sub-supplier management. 

Roles And Responsibilities

- Drive PCBA manufacturing qualification at contract manufacturers, including readiness requirements and milestone reviews. 
 - Provide PCB/PCBA DFM feedback and escalate manufacturability risks early in product development. 
 - Complete project/ part qualification deliverables including: Supplier pFMEA, Process Validations (IQ/OQ/PQ), Inspection Reports, Gage R&R, and Process Capability Analysis
 - Develop and implement manufacturing technologies and process improvements to enhance quality, reliability, throughput, and cost. 
 - Work with suppliers to execute cost reductions, capacity improvements, and risk mitigation
 - Select the right process and supplier for the part, considering long term fit and total ownership cost
 - Manage supplier changes including manufacturing process changes, production optimization, facility changes, new equipment qualification, and new line validations
 - Drive changes to ISI requirements as necessary by initiating and managing changes to specifications and drawings through the engineering change order process
 - Own and drive to closure supplier variances from symptom through root cause analysis to corrective action, including careful CAPA documentation
 - Effectively prioritize and advance multiple concurrent projects and tasks
 - Clearly communicate project status to key stakeholders
 - Build, own, and relentlessly pursue a vision for developing suppliers
 - Understand proper level of documentation detail for tracking of actions and justification of decisions
 - Generate key metrics for the team and suppliers, and continually drive for timely achievement of those metrics
 - Drive suppliers to continually improve their business and manufacturing process performance to meet Intuitive's requirements for supplier excellence using a collection of best practices in project management, Six Sigma, Lean, SPC and negotiation. Lead these efforts without managerial guidance at several suppliers simultaneously
 - Implement corrective and preventive actions for supplier process by driving supplier's investigations and root cause analysis
 - Provide effective and timely supply base health information and recommendation to management by creating and delivering data-driven supply base information to any level of management at ISI with little or no guidance
 - Prepare and deliver supplier communications as required by independently working with suppliers on scorecard creation
 - Work with suppliers and ISI design engineering for the new product introduction to: 
 - Create product supplier landscapes to determine launch readiness and report to management
 - Develop supplier ramp readiness plans by judging business risk based on forecast, supplier capacity, quality performance, and process capability. 
 - DFM by engaging suppliers early in development cycle to feedback manufacturability improvements in the designs prior to production
 - Influence and guide Design Engineering in choosing suppliers by determining selection criteria for preferred suppliers and leading the team effort to evaluate preferred suppliers
 - Review, analyze and close customer complaints, manufacturing variance requests, and first article inspections by judging risk analyses and justifications
 - Evaluate corrective and preventive actions at suppliers, looks for opportunities with suppliers to eliminate recurrence

Qualifications

Skills/Job Requirements: 

- Minimum 7 yrs related experience in engineering/manufacturing of Electronics (PCBA, PCA, cable assemblies, wiring harnesses, etc. ) preferred. 
 - Experience with board assembly processes and equipment, including stencil, paste print, SPI, pick and place, SMT reflow, AOI, AXI, selective solder, flying probe, wash, and conformal coating. 
 - PCBA DFM experience
 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills including presentations to executive level management
 - Excellent Interpersonal, team building and project management skills
 - Demonstrable knowledge in evaluating and challenging supplier technical, quality, and business capabilities
 - Demonstrable knowledge of a wide range of manufacturing processes including understanding of key input variables for quality, cost, and capacity
 - Excellent knowledge of 21 CFR part 820 and ISO 13485
 - Significant computer experience using Windows, Word, Excel, Project, Access, and ERP Information Systems, preferably SAP or Agile

Required Education And Training

- Minimum Education: BS degree in Engineering or equivalent experience, advanced degree preferred
 - Experience with SMT/PCBA manufacturing and process development
 - Experience in a high-volume medical device company is a plus

Working Conditions

- Ability to travel to suppliers on an as-needed basis - domestic and international. 

Preferred Skills And Experience

 - Advanced degree preferred
 - DFM tools experience, such as Valor or Allegro, is a plus. 
 - Experience with statistical analysis software such as Minitab is a plus
 - Experience in a high-volume medical device company is a plus

Additional Information

Intuitive is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. We provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants and employees, and prohibit discrimination and harassment of any type, without regard to race, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, color, age, religion, protected veteran or disability status, genetic information or any other status protected under federal, state, or local applicable laws.

data.description:
About The Opportunity

A dynamic technology consulting firm operating at the intersection of enterprise software and digital transformation, we partner with global clients to optimize application performance, scalability, and reliability under real-world load conditions. Our Performance Testing practice is central to ensuring seamless user experiences for mission-critical platforms across finance, e-commerce, and SaaS sectors. 

Role & Responsibilities

- Design, develop, and execute performance test scripts using industry-standard tools to simulate real user traffic and stress scenarios. 
 - Identify performance bottlenecks across application tiers-network, server, API, database-and collaborate with dev/ops teams to resolve them. 
 - Configure and manage test environments, including cloud and on-prem setups, to mirror production architecture accurately. 
 - Generate detailed performance test reports with actionable insights, including response times, throughput, error rates, and resource utilization. 
 - Integrate performance testing into CI/CD pipelines to enable shift-left testing and continuous performance validation. 
 - Advocate performance best practices across engineering teams and mentor junior testers on tooling and methodology.

- Must-Have
 - JMeter
 - LoadRunner
 - Gatling
 - Apache Bench
 - API Testing (REST/SOAP)
 - Performance Monitoring Tools (New Relic, Dynatrace, AppDynamics)
 - CI/CD Integration (Jenkins, GitLab CI)
 - Cloud Platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP)
 - Preferred
 - K6
 - Python Scripting for Test Automation
 - Knowledge of Kubernetes & Containerized Environments

Benefits & Culture Highlights

- On-site collaborative workspace in prime Indian tech hubs with modern infrastructure. 
 - Continuous learning budget and certification sponsorship for performance engineering domains. 
 - Cross-functional exposure to DevOps, SRE, and cloud architecture teams. 

Skills: loadrunner, api testing, jenkins, new relic, jmeter, aws

data.title: Senior Staff QA
data.description:
About JazzX AI

Vision: Enterprises operating on institutional intelligence-governed, self-improving, and scalable beyond individual expertise. 

JazzX AI is defining the future of enterprise work-by building AI-native digital workers that actually get the job done. 

We believe enterprises don't scale expertise-they lose it. Knowledge stays trapped in individuals, judgment gets applied inconsistently, and the best talent spends time on work that should run itself. We're changing that. 

JazzX AI transforms messy enterprise reality into institutional intelligence: governed digital workers that capture expert judgment, make every decision explainable, and continuously improve through real-world execution. The result is faster decisions, higher-quality outcomes, and reliable execution at scale-in domains where getting it wrong isn't an option. 

We're starting with lending and due-diligence workflows-complex, regulated, high-stakes. From here, we're building the backbone for enterprise intelligence across industries. 

This is early-stage, hard, and consequential work. If you want to be part of bringing AI systems to market that actually run in production, handle real complexity, and deliver real outcomes-not demos, not chatbots-JazzX AI is the place. 

About SAIGroup

SAIGroup a private investment firm that has committed $1B to build and scale next-generation, AI-powered enterprise software companies. SAIGroup's portfolio serves 2, 000+ global enterprise customers, generates nearly $800M in annual revenue, and employs 4, 000+ people worldwide - providing JazzX AI with long-term capital, deep operating expertise, and access to real-world enterprise scale from day one. 

Role Overview

We are looking for a QA Lead who can architect the overall quality strategy for JazzX AI's platforms and AI-powered products. This role requires a blend of traditional QA expertise, AI/ML awareness, and strong leadership capabilities. 

You will lead the quality roadmap for agent workflows, LLM outputs, APIs, and cloud services while managing a high-performing QA team. 

Key Responsibilities

- Quality Strategy & Leadership
 - Build and own JazzX AI's end-to-end QA strategy across AI copilots, workflows, and enterprise deployments. 
 - Lead, mentor, and scale a team of QA engineers and automation specialists. 
 - Partner closely with Product, ML Engineering, and Platform Engineering to embed quality in early design phases. 
 - Define and enforce quality gates and release-readiness standards. 
 - AI/LLM-Specific Quality Assurance
 - Develop evaluation systems for LLM accuracy, hallucination detection, factuality, safety, and bias mitigation. 
 - Design scalable tests for agent reasoning, tool-use correctness, and multi-step workflow validation. 
 - Create synthetic datasets and scenario-based tests for edge-case prediction and regression testing. 
 - Validate model performance across fine-tuning, RAG, knowledge-grounding, and inference scenarios. 
 - Automation Engineering
 - Architect and manage automation frameworks using Python/Java/JS, Playwright, Selenium, PyTest, Postman, etc. 
 - Ensure seamless integration of automated suites into CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions/GitLab/Jenkins). 
 - Automated API, microservices, and backend testing for JazzX AI's cloud architecture running on AWS/GCP. 
 - Performance Testing
 - Load Testing, Stress Testing, Spike Testing, Endurance/Soak Testing using industry-standard tools like JMeter, LoadRunner, Gatling, k6, or Locust. 
 - Release, Monitoring & Reliability
 - Own the release sign-off process for all AI software components and platform features. 
 - Conduct RCA, maintain issues of dashboards, and drive continuous improvement in QA lifecycle. 
 - Collaborate with DevOps/ML Ops to monitor model drift, performance anomalies, and post-production behaviors. 
 - Documentation & Communication
 - Prepare detailed QA documents: strategies, test plans, evaluation reports, and execution metrics. 
 - Provide clear communication of risks, quality insights, and impact analysis to leadership. 

Required Qualifications

- 12+ years of experience in Software QA. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with test automation frameworks and scripting (Python/Java/JavaScript). 
 - Experienced in working with microservice-based architecture 
 - Working knowledge of AI/ML systems, including datasets, model evaluation, vector stores, RAG, and LLM operations. 
 - Architect and manage automation frameworks using Python/Java/JS, Playwright, Selenium, PyTest, Postman, etc. 
 - Automated API, microservices, and backend testing for JazzX AI's cloud architecture running on Azure /AWS. 
 - Experience testing distributed cloud systems, APIs, and high-performance backend services. 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to drive organization-wide quality initiatives. 

Preferred Skills

- Experience testing LLMs, RAG pipelines, or autonomous AI agents. 
 - Familiarity with AI observability tools, logging/monitoring stacks (ELK, Prometheus, Datadog). 
 - Exposure security testing, performance/load testing, and compliance (SOC2, GDPR). 
 - Ability to operate in a fast-paced, zero-to-one startup environment. 

Why Join JazzX AI

What draws people to JazzX AI is the opportunity to build something truly foundational. 

We are at the beginning of a new era - one where enterprise systems will no longer be static tools, but dynamic collaborators that learn, reason, and evolve alongside the people who use them. At JazzX AI, you'll help build a platform that redefines how work happens in the AGI era. 

JazzX AI brings together vision, deep technology, and purpose. This is not about experimenting with AI features; it's about turning the promise of AGI into practical, auditable, and human-aligned systems that enterprises can trust and rely on at scale. The work here directly impacts productivity, efficiency, and decision-making in complex, real-world environments. 

If you're motivated by building systems that matter - systems that combine intelligence with responsibility - JazzX AI offers the chance to do that work at a deeper level, with real ownership and lasting impact. 

Headquartered in Los Altos, CA. Backed by SAIGroup. 

Learn More About JazzX AI

LinkedIn: https: //www. linkedin. com/company/jazzx-ai

data.title: Principal Engineer - Full Stack
data.description:
A different kind of organization

- High trust, transparency, and autonomy
 - Small teams, high ownership, flat structures
 - Radical compensation transparency
 - Sense of ownership in collective success
 - Work with exceptional people who deeply care about their craft

The role

As a Principal Consultant, you're often the first person a customer meets to brainstorm a business problem. You should be at home debating distributed systems with engineers and framing decisions with leadership. You'll frame the problem with customers, shape the approach with the team, provide technical direction, and stay hands-on through delivery. You will work in self-managing, experienced, small, and high-impact teams, solving hard problems. This is a consulting & tech delivery role and while you will not have direct reports, you will regularly influence teams, mentor practitioners, manage stakeholders, and guide organisations through complex technology and business decisions. 

What the work looks like

We can't promise which problem you'll pick up, but the menu right now looks something like this: 

- Redesign a ClickHouse schema so an ad buyer can query 85 billion rows in under two seconds, and discover that pre-exploding the rows 168x is actually the right answer. 
 - Keep a vehicle telemetry platform moving billions of messages a day without the Kafka consumers falling over. 
 - Build the engineering spine of a mobile wallet used by more than two billion people across four continents. 
 - Ship the data product behind peer-review submissions for one of the world's largest scientific publishers. 

The list changes every quarter. The pattern doesn't: data-heavy, distributed, and often sitting on top of something that already exists and isn't perfect. 

What you'll do

Frame Problems & Propose Solutions

- Help customers find the right problem before jumping to a solution. 
 - Facilitate discovery sessions, architecture reviews, and technical workshops. 
 - Translate business goals into a technology strategy and an execution plan. 

Lead Through Technical Excellence

- Stay hands-on; contribute directly to design, architecture, implementation, and review. 
 - Make pragmatic calls balancing business needs, engineering quality, and delivery timelines. 
 - Guide teams to build scalable, resilient, secure systems and the practices that keep them that way. 

Influence, Advise, and align

- Act as a trusted advisor on technology and investment decisions; assessments, due diligence, advisory. 
 - Build trust and alignment across Sahaj and customer teams
 - Converge competing priorities into a path forward. 
 - Communicate complex ideas clearly to technical and non-technical audiences. 
 - Shape new work through discovery and proposals; mentor others and raise the bar as you go. 

Operate Across Technology Domains

Distributed systems, data engineering, AI & agentic systems, DevOps/SRE. Depth in few areas; breadth across, and appreciation for trade-offs in context. 

You'll thrive here if

- You reach for the simplest solution that gets the job done and distrust accidental complexity. 
 - You think in systems, not isolated parts. 
 - You stay calm when the path is unclear and build clarity for those around you. 
 - You move easily between the org-level picture and the technical detail. 
 - You're curious by default and pick up new domains fast. 
 - You'd rather be in the room with a customer solving a real problem. 

What we're looking for

- 12+ years building software systems in complex environments. 
 - Strong engineering fundamentals; expert in at least one language, ideally polyglot. 
 - Hands-on experience designing and delivering distributed systems at scale. 
 - Deep grasp of architecture, system design, and engineering trade-offs. 
 - Direct experience working with customers and business stakeholders.

data.title: Senior Backend Engineer
data.description:
About the Role

TeraRecon, part of ConcertAI, is building a next-generation radiology platform for healthcare systems. The platform brings together AI model development, agentic AI systems, and an advanced medical image viewer. 

We are looking for an experienced Backend Engineer to design, build, and operate the services behind our cloud-native, AI-assisted medical imaging platform. You will own backend systems end to end, from API design to production operations, in an environment where reliability, security, and data integrity matter. 

You will work closely with product, frontend, ML, and DevOps teams, and help set engineering standards for the team. This role is open at both Senior and Staff/Lead levels. Scope and expectations are calibrated to your experience

What You'll Do

- Design and build scalable, secure, and highly available backend services and APIs (REST/gRPC) in Python or Go. 
 - Own services through the full lifecycle: design, development, testing, deployment, monitoring, and incident response. 
 - Architect data pipelines and asynchronous workflows for high-volume, large-payload data. 
 - Design and optimize data models and queries across relational and NoSQL stores. 
 - Improve the performance, reliability, and observability of production systems, including profiling, capacity planning, and cost optimization. 
 - Write design documents, run architecture reviews, and make well-reasoned trade-offs. 
 - Mentor engineers through code reviews, pairing, and technical guidance. 
 - Collaborate with DevOps on CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, and container orchestration. 
 - Contribute to security, privacy, and compliance practices, including audit logging, access control, and data protection. 
 - Work with teammates across India and the US, with some overlap hours for cross-timezone collaboration. 

What We're Looking For

Required Qualifications

- 6+ years of professional backend software engineering experience. 
 - Strong proficiency in Python or Go, with idiomatic, production-quality code. 
 - Proven experience building and running large-scale distributed systems in production, with a track record of handling high throughput, large data volumes, or high concurrency. 
 - Solid grasp of system design: microservices, event-driven architecture, caching, queues, idempotency, consistency trade-offs, and failure handling. 
 - Hands-on experience with PostgreSQL (or similar RDBMS), including schema design, indexing, query tuning, and migrations. 
 - Experience designing and consuming REST and/or gRPC APIs, including versioning, auth (OAuth2/OIDC, JWT), and rate limiting. 
 - Experience with AWS (or another major cloud): compute, object storage (S3), networking, IAM, and managed databases. 
 - Proficiency with Docker and Kubernetes. 
 - Strong testing discipline: unit, integration, and contract tests. 
 - Experience with observability: structured logging, metrics, tracing, and alerting (e. g. , Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Datadog). 
 - Strong written and verbal communication, and comfort working with distributed teams across time zones. 

Good to Have

- Experience with workflow/orchestration engines (Temporal, Airflow, Celery, Step Functions). 
 - Experience with message brokers and streaming (Kafka, RabbitMQ, SQS/SNS). 
 - Familiarity with Redis, Elasticsearch/OpenSearch, or other specialized data stores. 
 - Python frameworks (FastAPI, Django, Flask, asyncio) or Go ecosystem tools (gRPC, Gin/Echo/Chi, goroutine-based concurrency patterns). 
 - Infrastructure-as-code (Terraform) and CI/CD (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins). 
 - Experience in healthcare, medical imaging, or other regulated domains (HIPAA, FDA, ISO 13485, IEC 62304). 
 - Familiarity with DICOM/DICOMweb, PACS, FHIR, or HL7. 
 - Experience serving ML models or integrating AI/LLM-based services into production backends. 
 - Security best practices (OWASP, secrets management, encryption at rest and in transit). 
 - Contributions to open source or technical writing. 

Level Expectations

- Senior Engineer (approximately 6-9 years)
 - Independently design, build, and ship complex features and services. 
 - Own one or more services in production, including on-call and incident follow-up. 
 - Mentor junior and mid-level engineers. 
 - Contribute actively to design reviews. 

Education

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 

What We Offer

- Work on technology that directly affects patient care and clinical workflows. 
 - Ownership and real influence over architecture decisions. 
 - A collaborative, distributed team across India and the US. 
 - A hybrid work model based in Bengaluru. 
 - Compensation as per industry standards. 
 - Learning and growth opportunities

data.title: ServiceNow QA Automation Engineer
data.description:
BETSOL is a cloud-first digital transformation and data management company offering products and IT services to enterprises in over 40 countries. BETSOL team holds several engineering patents, is recognized with industry awards, and BETSOL maintains a net promoter score that is 2x the industry average. 

BETSOL's open source backup and recovery product line, Zmanda (Zmanda. com), delivers up to 50% savings in total cost of ownership (TCO) and best-in-class performance. 

BETSOL Global IT Services (BETSOL. com) builds and supports end-to-end enterprise solutions, reducing time-to-market for its customers. 

BETSOL offices are set against the vibrant backdrops of Broomfield, Colorado and Bangalore, India. 

We take pride in being an employee-centric organization, offering comprehensive health insurance, competitive salaries, volunteer programs, and scholarship opportunities. Office amenities include a fitness center, cafe, and recreational facilities. 

Learn more at betsol. com

Job Description

BETSOL's team designs and runs software license tracking on ServiceNow SAM Professional. For each software publisher brought into scope, the team analyses contracts, models entitlements and consumption, and delivers a custom publisher view and dashboard that shows licenses owned, licenses consumed and the resulting compliance position. The publishers we work with span SaaS and enterprise software, each with its own license metrics, SKUs and data sources. 

We are looking for a QA engineer who can test ServiceNow SAM implementation end to end and keep growing the test automation. You will validate the calculations behind every license number, to prove that dashboards match the underlying report data, and turn repeatable checks into automated scripts so that releases move from development to UAT to production quickly. You will work closely with ServiceNow developers, business analysts and project managers, and with business stakeholders during UAT. 

Key responsibilities

Testing SAM publisher implementations

- Review publisher analysis and stories, then write test scenarios and test cases that trace back to the agreed requirements and expected dashboard output. 
 - Validate entitlement and consumption logic: rights owned, rights consumed, rights available and rights needed, license metrics (for example User Subscription versus Resource Consumption) and custom SKUs created for usage that standard SKUs do not cover. 
 - Verify calculation rules such as contract term calculation with date tolerance, unit price by billing frequency, weighted average price across entitlements and ratchet behaviour where increases are applied and decreases are not. 
 - Test server-side components on the custom SAM report table, including business rules, script includes, scheduled jobs that run by product group, and audit and data-fix scripts. 
 - Reconcile dashboard values against report and source records for each product group, and validate data built from vendor exports and admin API extracts (deduplication, scoping by site and contract line). 
 - Run functional, regression and UAT support cycles across the development, test and production instances. 

Building and running test automation

- Extend the existing SAM automation framework and test scripts, and deliver items on the SAM test automation roadmap against agreed timelines. 
 - Automate regression suites for recurring publisher patterns so developers can run them when QA capacity is tight. 
 - Use the ServiceNow Automated Test Framework (ATF) and server-side scripts to automate data and calculation checks. 
 - Keep scripts maintainable, documented and reusable across publishers. 

Quality process and reporting

- Log, track and retest defects; record evidence and keep test case documents current. 
 - Produce a QA sign-off document for each release with test case counts, pass results, defects raised and fixes verified, before promotion to UAT. 
 - Support stakeholder reviews of dashboards before production, and fold their feedback into validation before deployment. 
 - Take part in sprint ceremonies, estimate QA effort and raise risks to delivery early. 

Qualifications

Required qualifications

- Minimum 2 years of hands-on QA experience on the ServiceNow platform, within at least 3 years of overall software testing experience. 
 - Working knowledge of ServiceNow SAM Professional or Software Asset Management concepts: entitlements, license metrics, software models, reconciliation and compliance. 
 - Practical test automation experience, ideally with ServiceNow ATF, and enough JavaScript to read and write server-side scripts and GlideRecord queries. 
 - Strong data validation skills: comfortable reconciling numbers across tables, reports and spreadsheets, and explaining where a figure comes from. 
 - Experience writing structured test cases and sign-off reports, and using Jira and a test management tool such as Zephyr. 
 - Clear written and spoken English, with the confidence to walk stakeholders through test results and to discuss your own past work in depth. 

Preferred Qualifications

- ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA); a Certified Implementation Specialist in Software Asset Management (CIS-SAM) is a strong plus. 
 - Exposure to software licensing models for SaaS and enterprise publishers (named user, subscription, resource or consumption based). 
 - Experience testing REST API integrations and vendor usage exports. 
 - Familiarity with Agile delivery and ALM tools such as Jira.

data.title: Technical Co-Founder – Multi-Tenant Logistics SaaS
data.description:
About PicUpMe TechnologiesOur shared pickup and drop service provides an economical, convenient, reliable solution and eco-friendly solution for your daily commute. Enjoy a hassle-free experience with timely pickups, comfortable rides, safe drop-offs with fellow commuters, ensuring you arrive at your destination refreshed on time and a reliable journey. With our service, you can save on travel costs while contributing to a greener environment, making your daily commute smooth, stress-free, efficient, cost effective and sustainable.   

We are currently building a multi-tenant SaaS platform that lets logistics and transport businesses run their operations on one system: fleet and driver management, load and trip planning, real-time tracking, billing, and customer portals. Fleet owners, 3PLs, freight forwarders and transporters each get their own secure, configurable workspace on a shared platform. 

      The logistics market is large, fragmented and still run on spreadsheets, WhatsApp groups and legacy software. We are an early-stage team with a validated problem, and a clear plan to scale. We are looking for a technical co-founder to build the product and the engineering organisation with us from day one. 

Role overviewTitle: Technical Co-Founder  Reports to: CEO / Co-founder (peer relationship, shared decision-making) Location: [ Bangalore / Hybrid] Type:   Equity-led founding role

You will own the technology vision and architecture of the platform, ship the first production version, and grow the engineering team. You are a founder first: you share accountability for product, customers, fundraising and culture, not just code. 

Key responsibilitiesProduct and architecture

- Design and own a scalable multi-tenant architecture: tenant isolation, per-tenant configuration, role-based access control, white-labelling and usage-based billing hooks. 
 - Choose the tech stack, data model and tenancy strategy (shared schema, schema-per-tenant or database-per-tenant) based on cost, security and scale. 
 - Build core modules: order and shipment management, trip and route planning, fleet and driver management, GPS and telematics tracking, e-POD, invoicing and settlement. 
 - Design APIs and integrations with GPS/IoT devices, e-way bill and GST systems, payment gateways, ERPs, maps and routing services, and WhatsApp/SMS notifications. Engineering and delivery

- Ship an MVP in [2-3 months], then iterate quickly with customer feedback. 
 - Set up CI/CD, cloud infrastructure, monitoring, logging, backups and disaster recovery. 
 - Own security, data privacy and compliance, including tenant data separation, audit trails and applicable Indian data-protection requirements. 
 - Plan for real-time, high-volume workloads such as location pings, event streams and notifications. Leadership and company building

- Hire, mentor and lead the first engineers, designers and QA; define engineering culture and standards. 
 - Partner with the CEO on roadmap, pricing, go-to-market and customer discovery; join sales calls and pilots. 
 - Represent technology to investors, partners and enterprise customers during due diligence and fundraising. Required qualifications
 - 7+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 3 years building and shipping SaaS products end to end. 
 - Proven experience designing multi-tenant systems: tenant isolation, RBAC, configuration per tenant, and scaling data stores. 
 - Strong full-stack skills, for example Node. js, Python, Go or Java on the backend and React, Next. js or similar on the frontend. 
 - Solid with relational databases (PostgreSQL preferred) and comfortable with caching, queues and event-driven design (Redis, Kafka, RabbitMQ or SQS). 
 - Hands-on cloud experience (AWS, GCP or Azure), containers, Kubernetes or equivalent, and infrastructure as code. 
 - Experience with REST and GraphQL APIs, webhooks and third-party integrations. 
 - Working knowledge of application security: authentication (OAuth2, SSO), encryption, OWASP risks, audit logging. 
 - Has led or mentored engineers, or been an early engineer or tech lead at a startup. 
 - Able to make pragmatic trade-offs between speed and quality, and to write production code yourself in the first year. Nice to have
 - Prior work in logistics, supply chain, fleet management, TMS/WMS, mobility or marketplaces. 
 - Experience with GPS/telematics data, route optimisation, geospatial databases (PostGIS) or map APIs. 
 - Mobile app experience (React Native or Flutter) for driver and field apps, including offline-first design. 
 - Experience with AI/ML for ETA prediction, load matching or demand forecasting. 
 - Previous startup exit, founding experience, or fundraising exposure. 
 - Industry network among transporters, 3PLs, shippers or logistics tech companies. Co-founder fit
 - Ownership mindset: treats the company's outcomes as personal, and stays through uncertainty. 
 - Customer-obsessed: willing to visit transport yards and talk to dispatchers and drivers to understand real workflows. 
 - Builder and leader: can write the first version and also hire the team that replaces your own code. 
 - Clear communicator: explains technical choices to non-technical founders, customers and investors. 
 - Comfortable with ambiguity: thrives with limited resources and changing priorities. 
 - Aligned values: transparent, direct and committed to a long-term build, with a full-time commitment from [start date]. What we offerEquity - [15-20]% founder equity, based on contribution and stage

Role - Co-founder with a board seat and full authority over technology

Decision rights - Joint decisions on strategy and fundraising;   owns technical decisions

Legal - Founders' agreement, IP assignment and good/bad-leaver terms signed before start

You will also get the chance to define the product and engineering culture of a company from its first line of code. 

First 12 months and how to applyMonths 0-3 : Finalise architecture and tenancy model; build MVP core (orders, trips, tracking, invoicing); onboard first pilot customer

Months 4-6 : Launch to 3-5 paying tenants; add driver mobile app and integrations; set up monitoring and security baseline

Months 7-9 : Hire first 3-4 engineers; ship self-serve tenant onboarding, configurable workflows and billing

Months 10-12 : Scale to [20+] tenants; complete security review; support seed fundraising with tech due diligence

Hiring process: intro call with the founder, technical deep dive on architecture and past work, d working session on a real platform problem, meetings with advisors, then a founders' agreement discussion. 

To apply: send your CV or LinkedIn, links to products you have built, and a short note on why logistics and why now to picupme75@gmail. com .

data.title: Engineering Manager- Linux & Kernel
data.description:
Hungry, Humble, Honest, with Heart. 

The Opportunity

Nutanix AHV builds on top of the open-source x86-KVM stack, with an emphasis on performance, scale, and reliability. The hyperconverged nature of our stack provides the phenomenal potential for optimizations cutting across various parts of our stack -- right from the kernel and ranging up to, but not limited by, the management layer. 

We are looking for original thinkers who won't hesitate to demand conventional thought in arriving at out-of-the-box solutions. 

We aim to work as closely aligned with the open-source community as possible. Our engineers are highly encouraged to participate in open-source community development. Any work you do will be preserved as open-source commit(s) for posterity!

A day in the life of an AHV hypervisor engineer: 

- Problems you'll solve: 
 - We've always believed in demanding the status quo and disrupting ourselves to provide the best in-class customer experience. A case in point: Nutanix is well known for providing a zero-touch upgrade experience for our customers. Within the hypervisor team, we are focussing on various ways to make this faster and more reliable -- by pushing the limits of VM live migrations towards speed and predictability, or rethinking why a hypervisor upgrade should need a reboot at all. 
About The Team

At Nutanix, you will have the opportunity to be part of the Hypervisor team, a dynamic group that is spread out geographically. Despite being in different locations, the team collaborates effectively and maintains a strong sense of camaraderie. Working with the Hypervisor team means being surrounded by talented people who are supportive, making it a great team to work with. This setup also provides exciting exposure to diverse perspectives and opportunities for personal and professional growth. 

You will report to a Senior Manager who is committed to supporting your development and ensuring your success within the organization. This role operates in a hybrid capacity, blending the benefits of remote work with the advantages of in-person collaboration. In locations where our workplace policy applies (i. e. San Jose, Durham, Mexico City, Bangalore, Pune, Hoofddorp, Belgrade, Barcelona, Singapore, Sydney and Tokyo), employees are expected to work onsite a minimum of 3 days per week to foster collaboration, team alignment, and access to in-office resources. Workplace type may vary based on location and team requirements. Please speak with your recruiter for details. Additional team-specific guidance and norms will be provided by your manager. As for travel requirements, there are none, allowing you to focus on your projects without the need for frequent travel. 

Your Role

Role

You'll be managing a team of extremely talented engineers across a spectrum of geographies and experience. The most successful candidate for this role will be someone who can: 

- Constantly look for ways to improve the product, learning from customer questions and not limited to existing technologies. 
 - Devise solutions and back them up with solid research and numbers to prove their efficacy. 
 - Have the ability to convey ideas to a geographically diverse audience using excellent communication/writing skills. 
 - Participate in design discussions, often outside one's known comfort zone -- learning on the go. 
 - Proactively mentor junior members of the team, finding ways to fuel their intelligent curiosity and leverage their unique strengths. 
 - Not hesitate to help out with occasional customer escalations: Nutanix believes in putting customers first. While we have a huge, dedicated team to assist customers with any issues, there might be situations where engineering help might be sought to bail out a rare, unfortunate outage. 
 - Take pride in working with open-source communities to fold product improvements back into community projects. 

What You Will Bring

- The must-haves: 
 - Rock-solid OS/systems fundamentals drive design and implementation. 
 - Low-level coding and debugging experience with at least one hardware architecture, preferably x86. 
 - The ability to write and maintain enterprise-quality code. 
 - Deep reasoning and detailed skills, which provide top-down thinking to break down abstract concepts into actionable pieces. 
 - Proven feature delivery experience: should have 8+ years of hands-on experience of what it means to ship enterprise-quality code to customers. 
 - The good-to-haves: 
 - Knowledge of x86 virtualization and the KVM stack. 
 - Code contributions to the Linux kernel/virtualization stack is an added plus. 
Desired Qualification & Experience

- Bachelor's/Master's degree in computer science or equivalent. 
 - 12+ years of experience building enterprise-grade software, preferably some with guide experience.

Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software. 

- Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab. 

As a Staff Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) at GitLab, you'll help keep all user-facing services and production systems reliable, scalable, and efficient. Our SREs combine a pragmatic operations mindset with strong software engineering practices to drive automation, reduce toil, and improve resilience across our platform. 

In the Environment Automation specialization, your focus is on operating and automating hundreds of GitLab environments-from initial provisioning to day-to-day maintenance tasks. 

Unlike other SRE roles, this position centers on automating the lifecycle of many tenant environments, ensuring they remain secure, consistent, and reliable at scale. 

Some Examples Of The Projects You Could Work On

- Designing infrastructure automation that provisions and operates GitLab environments using Terraform, Ansible, and Kubernetes
 - Creating and maintaining deployment packages for GitLab, such as Helm Charts and omnibus-gitlab
 - Building and operating Dedicated GitLab instances integrated with cloud-native services (e. g. , GCP, AWS)
 - Developing tools to orchestrate infrastructure-as-code workflows across multiple tenants
 - Deploying and managing microservices on Kubernetes clusters at scale
 - Enhancing GitLab's observability stack (e. g. , Prometheus, ELK) to support proactive monitoring and incident response
 - Integrating with and operating infrastructure in cloud provider ecosystems (e. g. , IAM, networking, storage)
 - Championing and implementing cloud security best practices across automated infrastructure

What You'll Do

- Build & Scale Multi-Tenant Infrastructure: Design and implement automation that provisions and manages hundreds of isolated GitLab environments using Terraform, Ansible, and Kubernetes. Manage complex state strategies and workspace configurations to support scale and maintainability. 
 - Debug & Resolve Production Issues: Troubleshoot issues across Kubernetes clusters, cloud services, and GitLab apps-identifying root causes of failed deployments, crash loops, and scheduling conflicts to ensure service continuity. 
 - Automate Operations at Scale: Replace manual workflows with infrastructure-as-code solutions, including automated version upgrades, configuration rollouts, and provisioning pipelines that operate reliably across all tenants. 
 - Monitor & Predict Capacity: Build observability systems that detect bottlenecks, predict usage trends, and optimize resource consumption using tools like Prometheus, ELK, and Grafana. 
 - Respond & Lead During Incidents: Lead incident response and postmortem efforts, applying technical depth to resolve issues and establish operational standards that reduce future risk. 
 - Architect & Collaborate: Influence architectural decisions around automation, scalability, and operational excellence. Partner with engineering teams to improve automation, platform resilience, and production-readiness. 

What You'll Bring

- Production-Scale Experience: Proven ability to operate and troubleshoot production workloads across multiple tenants or environments. Deep understanding of how distributed systems fail at scale and how to build in resilience. Terraform & IaC Mastery: Strong hands-on experience with Terraform, including workspace strategies, state management, and automation patterns that scale. Comfortable solving state isolation issues and building reliable, reusable infrastructure code. Experience with Ansible and templating tools like Jsonnet is a plus. Kubernetes in Production: Skilled at diagnosing deployment failures, interpreting pod logs, and debugging scheduling issues and rollback scenarios in live environments. Understands how pods, ReplicaSets, and controllers interact in production. Programming & Code Analysis: Ability to read and debug code in Go and/or Ruby. Familiar with identifying performance issues, scalability concerns, and contributing to infrastructure tooling through thoughtful code analysis. Large Scale Operations Background: Experience supporting infrastructure for many customers or environments simultaneously. Comfortable managing isolation, scaling, monitoring, and incident response across diverse workloads. Architecture & Incident Response: Able to reason through complex systems and operational challenges. Brings on-call experience and can lead technical discussions and incident resolution efforts under pressure. Customer-Focused Collaboration: Proven ability to work across teams and with internal or external customers to solve technical problems while maintaining service commitments and clear communication. data.title: Team Lead, Product Operations,  Climate
data.description:
Job Purpose

ICE Climate Operations supports ICE's Climate Risk Data business, covering physical climate risk, transition risk, nature-related risk, and avoided emissions across public and private companies, sovereigns, and structured finance assets such as mortgage-backed and municipal securities. The Physical Risk team runs the geospatial research and quality assurance function behind this coverage, identifying and validating corporate and sovereign asset locations against wildfire, flood, hurricane, and extreme-temperature exposure for ICE's global geospatial risk platform. 

Lead the operational delivery and continuous improvement of Physical Risk data projects within ICE Climate Operations. The role manages and develops a team of analysts responsible for asset-location research, geospatial validation, structured quality assurance, and project delivery. It combines people leadership with hands-on oversight of complex research and QA, ensuring data is accurate, complete, traceable, and delivered in line with product and client priorities. 

The team leader is the primary operational contact for Physical Risk workstreams and coordinates closely with Product, R&D, Engineering, Analytics, and Data Quality teams. The role is expected to translate evolving requirements into clear work plans, maintain visibility of progress and risks, and build the team's ability to support product improvements and respond to data-related queries with increasing independence. 

Responsibilities

- Team leadership and delivery management
 - Lead, coach, and develop a team of associates and senior associates, setting clear expectations for delivery, quality, accountability, and professional growth. 
 - Convert business and project priorities into practical work plans, allocate resources across concurrent workstreams, and adjust assignments as priorities change. 
 - Monitor milestones, productivity, quality, and turnaround times; identify delivery risks early and implement recovery actions. 
 - Conduct regular one-to-one discussions, goal setting, performance reviews, and development planning; support recruitment, onboarding, and succession readiness. 
 - Act as the first point of escalation for operational blockers, quality concerns, scope ambiguity, and resourcing conflicts. 
 - Physical risk project and product support
 - Lead operational support for Physical Risk initiatives, including industrial and mine location QA, high-materiality asset review, corporate mapping, location weighting, and damage-function research across corporate, sovereign, and private-company asset classes. 
 - Coordinate delivery with Product and R&D stakeholders, clarify objectives and acceptance criteria, maintain project status and dependencies, and ensure outputs are usable for downstream product or model development. 
 - Keep the team focused on work that improves the quality and coverage of Physical Risk products, including continuous QA of critical asset data and on-demand QA or updates for client-driven requirements spanning wildfire, flood, hurricane, and extreme-temperature exposure. 
 - Build sufficient product and methodology knowledge within the team to support data samples, stakeholder queries, and issue investigation with reduced dependency on Product teams. 
 - Research, geospatial data, and quality assurance
 - Oversee research to identify, classify, map, and validate corporate asset locations, ownership relationships, operational status, facility type, coordinates, and materiality indicators. 
 - Ensure consistent use of authoritative internal data, third-party datasets, company disclosures, mapping platforms, satellite imagery, and documented public sources. 
 - Review complex or high-risk discrepancies, confirm source traceability, approve final outputs, and direct root-cause analysis and corrective actions. 
 - Oversee QA controls for completeness, coordinate accuracy, classification, duplication, status, source evidence, and conformity with approved methodologies and due-diligence standards. 
 - Ensure project outputs are documented, reproducible, and ready for ingestion, analytics, model research, or client delivery as applicable. 
 - Data, reporting, and operational governance
 - Use SQL and BigQuery to retrieve, join, analyze, and validate entity and location datasets; use advanced Excel and reporting tools to manage and communicate delivery performance. 
 - Maintain concise dashboards and status reporting covering scope, milestones, quality, throughput, risks, dependencies, and decisions required. 
 - Establish clear operating procedures, research playbooks, source hierarchies, QA checklists, and hand-off criteria; keep documentation current as requirements evolve. 
 - Support audits, internal reviews, release validation, production issue analysis, and governance activities relevant to Physical Risk data operations. 
 - Process improvement, automation, and capability building
 - Identify recurring data and workflow issues and implement scalable improvements that reduce manual effort, rework, and turnaround time without weakening control quality. 
 - Promote responsible use of AI-assisted research, automated validation, and smart workflows, with human verification and clear evidence retained for material decisions. 
 - Develop team capability in Physical Risk methodology, corporate structures and identifiers, GIS and mapping, asset materiality, SQL/BigQuery, QA, and relevant internal platforms. 
 - Create a collaborative learning environment through structured training, calibration sessions, knowledge sharing, and review of complex cases. 
Knowledge And Experience

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Geography, Geospatial Science, Environmental Science or Planning, Data Science, Engineering, or a related discipline. 
 - 6+ years of relevant experience in data operations related to geospatial or location data, GIS research, including experience leading people or project delivery. 
 - Demonstrated ability to manage priorities, resources, quality, and stakeholder expectations in a data-intensive operational environment. 
 - Working knowledge of corporate entity structures, asset-location data, geospatial concepts, mapping tools, and research-based verification. 
 - Proficiency in SQL, Python, and advanced Excel; practical experience querying and analyzing large datasets. Experience with BigQuery is strongly preferred. 
 - Strong analytical judgment, attention to detail, documentation discipline, and ability to resolve ambiguous or conflicting evidence. 
 - Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to present status, risks, recommendations, and decisions to technical and non-technical stakeholders. 

Preferred Knowledge And Experience

- Experience supporting Physical Risk, climate risk, catastrophe modelling, asset-level analytics, or commercial geospatial data products. 
 - Exposure to facility materiality, industrial assets, mines, utilities, damage-function or historical-loss research, and third-party location datasets. 
 - Experience with Power BI or similar reporting tools, workflow automation, and AI-assisted research or validation processes. 
 - Familiarity with data governance, audit controls, client data samples, and cross-functional product delivery.
