data.title: Head of Payments Platform(Singapore)
data.description:
Job Summary

This role could be based in Singapore and India. When you start the application process you will be presented with a drop down menu showing all countries, Please ensure that you select a country where the role is based. 

Head of Payments Platforms will be the chief engineer and leader for Standard Chartered's core payment engines. He/she will lead an engineering division of engineers responsible for building, modernising, and scaling high-availability, high-throughput payment execution engines across our global footprint, ensuring uninterrupted operations within strict regulatory resilience frameworks. This end-to-end responsibility includes core engines, direct debits, clearing gateways, adaptors, global routers, and integration services. 

- Core Execution Architecture: Drive the technical vision, scale, and performance for core clearing engines, high-concurrency payment gateways, real-time transaction processing systems, and automated ledger entries. 
 - Corridor Scale & Latency: Engineer resilient, idempotent, low-latency execution engines capable of processing millions of cross-border and domestic payments daily across complex G-SIB corridors within critical cut off schedules and payment windows. 
 - Resilience, SRE & Telemetry: Guarantee maximum operational stability, near-zero downtime, and fault tolerance across execution pipelines. Own global transaction telemetry, and adherence to regulatory resilience standards (e. g. , DORA, CPS 230) and strict RTO targets. 
 - Legacy Modernisation: Lead the architectural evolution from legacy transaction engines to modern, distributed engines without impacting live payment corridors. 
 - People Management: Direct, mentor, and scale an engineering organisation of engineers. 

Key Responsibilities

Strategy

- Execute the Payments technology strategy defined by the CIO Payments and translate it into an actionable platform engineering roadmap. 
 - Define and continuously evolve the target-state architecture for core payment execution capabilities, including transaction processing, clearing, settlement, payment gateways and ledger platforms. 
 - Drive modernization of payment transaction engines, messaging layers, workflow orchestration and execution services while ensuring uninterrupted client and business operations. 
 - Lead engineering decisions that improve scalability, resilience, performance, security and maintainability of the Payments platform estate. 
 - Partner with Architecture, Engineering and Product stakeholders to ensure platform designs align with the broader Payments and enterprise technology strategy. 
 - Develop technology roadmaps for platform simplification, technical debt reduction, observability, automation and resilience improvements. 
 - Identify emerging technology opportunities and engineering innovations that support future payment volumes, new payment schemes and evolving client requirements. 

Business

- Deliver and operate the strategic payment platform capabilities required to support the Bank's domestic, cross-border and real-time payments business. 
 - Partner with Transaction Banking, Cash Operations, Product, Architecture and Engineering teams to ensure platform capabilities support business growth and client outcomes. 
 - Own platform performance, transaction throughput, latency, availability and service quality across critical payment corridors. 
 - Support delivery of new payment products, market initiatives, regulatory changes and payment network requirements. 
 - Lead engineering execution for strategic payments programmes, market migrations and platform consolidation initiatives. 
 - Ensure platform capabilities support operational efficiency, straight-through-processing, resiliency and improved client experience. 
 - Provide technology leadership and subject matter expertise across payment execution, processing and settlement capabilities. 

Processes

- Lead engineering, development, platform operations and service management processes across the Payments Platform estate. 
 - Establish engineering excellence standards covering software development lifecycle, DevSecOps, Site Reliability Engineering, testing, release management and platform operations. 
 - Ensure payment platforms are engineered for high throughput, low latency, idempotency and resilience across critical domestic and international payment corridors. 
 - Implement automated deployment, testing, monitoring, recovery and support processes to improve operational efficiency and reduce risk. 
 - Drive continuous improvement of payment execution, reconciliation, settlement and exception management processes. 
 - Lead management of platform dependencies, technology lifecycle activities and vendor-supported services. 
 - Support the Bank's product operating model through effective alignment of Build and Run teams across the platform lifecycle. 

People & Talent

- Build and lead a high-performing global engineering, platform and site reliability organisation supporting the Payments Platform estate. 
 - Create a culture of engineering excellence, accountability, innovation, ownership and continuous improvement. 
 - Develop organisational capability across distributed systems engineering, cloud technologies, payments processing, resilience engineering and platform operations. 
 - Attract, retain and develop world-class engineering talent through effective succession planning, career development and capability-building initiatives. 
 - Coach and mentor engineering leaders and senior technical contributors. 
 - Establish clear performance expectations, engineering standards and measurable delivery outcomes. 
 - Promote agile ways of working, inclusion, collaboration and continuous learning across global teams. 

Risk Management

- Own technology and operational risk management for the Payments Platform estate. 
 - Ensure payment platforms comply with regulatory resilience and operational risk requirements, including DORA, CPS 230 and applicable payment scheme obligations. 
 - Maintain strong controls around platform availability, recoverability, cyber resilience, secure development and technology lifecycle management. 
 - Lead identification, remediation and escalation of platform risks, vulnerabilities and control weaknesses. 
 - Ensure recovery strategies, disaster recovery capabilities and business continuity arrangements meet agreed recovery objectives. 
 - Drive proactive incident prevention through observability, telemetry, capacity management and resilience engineering practices. 
 - Partner with Risk, Compliance, Cyber Security and Audit stakeholders to maintain an effective control environment across the platform estate. 

Governance

- Operate governance frameworks that ensure the Payments Platform estate meets enterprise architecture, engineering, security and operational standards. 
 - Provide regular reporting on platform health, resilience, transformation progress, risks, technical debt and investment outcomes to the CIO Payments and governance forums. 
 - Ensure platform decisions comply with approved architecture standards, engineering controls, technology policies and regulatory requirements. 
 - Lead platform review forums covering resilience, service performance, operational risk, capacity management and modernization initiatives. 
 - Maintain effective oversight of third-party technology partners and platform service providers. 
 - Support internal and external audits, regulatory reviews and remediation activities. 
 - Promote the Group's values, Code of Conduct and risk culture across the Payments Platform organisation. 

Regulatory & Business Conduct

- Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group's Values and Code of Conduct. 
 - Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct. 
 - Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters. 

Key stakeholders

- Business Leaders (TB Cash and Payments)
 - Country CIOs / CTOs, T&O Leadership
 - Payments Product Management
 - Engineering, Infrastructure & Platform Teams
 - Enterprise Architecture
 - Cyber Security / ICS
 - Programme & Change Delivery Teams
 - Operations & Service Resilience Teams

Other Responsibilities

- Embed Here for good and Group's brand and values in Payments Platform. Perform other responsibilities assigned under Group, Country, Business or Functional policies and procedures. 

Skills And Experience

- Operational Risk Control
 - Software Engineering
 - Distributed Systems
 - Transaction Banking Processes
 - Payment Gateways
 - Clearing Engine
 - Message Transformation

Our Ideal Candidate

- Deep expertise in software engineering, distributed systems, and low-latency transaction processing in transaction banking. 
 - Mastery of high-throughput payment gateways, clearing engine design, message transformation, and ledger integration. 
 - Proven track record of maintaining high-availability SLAs, payment resilience, and regulatory operational risk controls within strict operational schedules. 
 - Experience leading engineering organizations of ~80+ headcount in a global bank or high-scale fintech. 

About Standard Chartered

We're a global bank connecting clients to our differentiated network, offering growth opportunities in the world's most dynamic markets. Our strategy, which combines cross-border capabilities and leading wealth management expertise, helps us deliver our purpose - to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity. 

Over our 170-year history, and across a unique geographical footprint connecting Asia, Africa and the Middle East to each other and the world, we've built a bank like no other, with diverse capabilities and partnerships that set us apart. 

What We Offer

- Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions, and geographies. 
 - In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing. 
 - Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations. 
 - Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum. 
 - Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns. 
 - Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global employee assistance programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and self-help toolkits. 
 - A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual, and digital learning. 

Visit our careers website to learn more about us: www. sc. com/careers. 

Recruitment Assessments

Some of our roles use assessments to help us understand how suitable you are for the role you've applied to. If you are invited to take an assessment, this is great news. It means your application has progressed to an important stage of our recruitment process.

data.title: Solution Architect - AWS Integration & API Gateway
data.description:
Job Description

We are seeking a Solution Architect to design and lead a central email gateway. It will sit between the client's commerce platform, its middleware (enterprise service bus) and a new email service provider, and will carry all business-critical transactional email, such as order, shipping, refund and account notifications. The gateway offers two integration models: 

- a pass-through API for systems that are ready to use the new provider directly
 - a backward-compatible API that mimics the legacy provider, so existing systems only need to change an endpoint

The Architect will own the AWS target architecture, the versioned API contracts, a configuration-driven mapping model, and the resilience design needed to make sure no email is lost or sent twice. The role leads a small cross-functional team on a short build window, drives technical decisions with the client's architects, and owns cutover readiness and early-life support. 

Responsibilities

Architecture & Design

- Own the AWS target architecture across edge, API Gateway, private networking, load-balancing and ECS Fargate integration, containerized compute, eventing, audit and data flows
 - Define versioned OpenAPI contracts for the pass-through and backward-compatible APIs
 - Design a configuration-driven mapping engine for campaign, field and error-code translation
 - Design resilience patterns: timeouts, retries with backoff, circuit breaker, idempotency and dead-letter queue (DLQ) handling
 - Design the Security & Observability Framework

Technical Leadership

- Lead discovery and capture existing integration contracts from live traffic
 - Set engineering standards and review all code, including AI-generated code
 - Guide developers, DevOps and QA on design, testability and performance
 - Establish AI-assisted application-building workflows using AI approved

Stakeholder & Delivery

- Present options and recommendations to the client's architecture and platform teams
 - Coordinate the ecommerce, middleware and email provider teams through integration and SIT
 - Own cutover planning, go/no-go criteria and early-life support

Security & Compliance

- Ensure OAuth2 machine-to-machine authentication, encryption, least-privilege IAM and PII masking
 - Align audit retention and the data purge approach with GDPR/CCPA requirements

Qualifications

Required Skills & Competencies

- Strong solution architecture experience on AWS: API Gateway, ECS/Fargate, SQS, EventBridge, Secrets Manager, IAM and KMS 
 - Configuration management using AppConfig or DynamoDB; observability with CloudWatch and OpenTelemetry/ADOT or X-Ray; CI/CD and infrastructure-as-code design. 
 - Proven design of API gateways or enterprise integration layers for high-volume transactional systems
 - Hands-on with Node. js/TypeScript or Java/Spring Boot microservices
 - Strong grasp of resilience patterns, idempotency and event-driven design
 - OpenAPI-first design and contract testing practices
 - Excellent stakeholder communication and technical leadership

Good-to-Have

- Exposure to email service provider platforms; retail transactional email, ESB/middleware platforms
 - Fastify; Akamai WAF; Terraform or AWS CDK; OpenSearch/ELK-based operational search. 
 - AWS Solutions Architect - Professional certification

Qualifications

- 12+ years of relevant software engineering experience with solution architecture and hands-on technical leadership. 
 - B. E. /B. Tech/MCA or equivalent
 - AWS architecture certification is desirable.

At the heart of our culture is ONE with Client - a set of four core values that reflect who we are and how we work: One Zensar, Nurturing, Empowering, and Client Focus. 

Part of the $4. 8 billion RPG Group, we're a community of 10, 000+ innovators across 30+ global locations, including Milpitas, Seattle, Princeton, Cape Town, London, Zurich, Singapore, and Mexico City. data.title: Senior Software Architect
data.description:
About SBS

SBS is a global financial technology company and an independently operated portfolio company of 74Software, an enterprise software group focused on mission-critical products and durable customer outcomes. SBS provides composable, cloud-based software across banking, lending, compliance, payments, consumer and asset finance. This role sits within the SBS India engineering team in Noida and contributes directly to the evolution of Digital Core and Payments. 

Role Summary

We are seeking a highly experienced, hands-on Senior Software Architect to shape SBS Digital Core, a strategic product AI Native Core Banking System spanning account and deposit management, product and pricing, payment processing and financial-crime controls. This is a senior technical leadership role, but not a hands-off advisory role: you will be expected to guide architecture, reduce technical debt, coach engineers and still personally produce deliverable engineering outcomes using modern tools, including approved AI coding assistants such as Claude, Codex and comparable enterprise-approved models. You will combine banking-domain depth, product architecture and hands-on engineering to turn complex banking, payments, regulatory and operational requirements into reusable, cloud-native capabilities incl. AI Use cases. The mandate is to build differentiated software that can scale across customers, markets and deployment models while enabling banks to modernise progressively. 

AI is part of the engineering method: use approved frontier and code-generation models such as Claude, Codex and comparable enterprise tools to accelerate architecture exploration, solution design, coding, testing and documentation. The expectation is not only to recommend direction, but to convert that direction into reviewed code, reference implementations, tests, migration patterns and working technical assets, while retaining human accountability, security controls and rigorous review. 

Why This Role Matters

Build a strategic growth platform. Digital Core sit at the centre of SBS's move towards AI native modular products, SaaS expansion and a more recurring, scalable software model. Your work will help protect trusted customer relationships while creating reusable capabilities for new growth. 

Engineer mission-critical banking. Shape the systems that manage accounts, deposits, product and pricing rules, real-time transactions and the full payment lifecycle, where availability, correctness, security and auditability are non-negotiable while providing AI capabilities to our customers

Create reusable product value. Design capabilities once and make them reusable across markets, deployment models and SBS products, reducing duplication while accelerating customer outcomes. 

Turn the digital core into an intelligent core. Embed governed AI, real-time data and automation into core operations so banks can improve decisions, service and operational efficiency without sacrificing deterministic controls. 

Influence a visible transformation. Work where product strategy, R&D focus, early-adopter delivery and engineering execution meet. Your architectural decisions will shape a flagship platform within SBS . 

Key Responsibilities

Architect distributed platforms. Design high-availability, cloud-native SaaS solutions using microservices, event-driven architecture and well-defined domain boundaries. 

Lead hands-on engineering. Write and review production code, reference implementations and reusable components for secure, resilient and maintainable services. 

Apply AI-assisted engineering. Use the latest approved AI models and coding assistants to produce and compare design options, draft architecture decision records, generate and refactor code, create tests, explain legacy code and improve technical documentation. 

Engineer responsibly with AI. Define prompts, context, evaluation criteria and review gates. Validate generated outputs for correctness, security, performance, licensing, privacy, bias and maintainability. Never expose confidential data to unapproved services. 

Convert architecture into deliverables. Personally produce hands-on outputs such as prototype services, reference implementations, proof points, migration utilities, test suites, performance experiments, code reviews and technical documentation that teams can adopt directly. 

Own banking-domain architecture. Translate the semantics and controls of deposits, account management, product and pricing, payment processing, into clear domain models, APIs, events and invariants

Enable progressive modernisation. Design coexistence and migration patterns that allow banks to introduce modular capabilities, run new and legacy services side by side and move products and customers at a controlled pace. 

Own non-functional architecture. Drive performance, scalability, availability, observability, recoverability, maintainability and security from design through production. 

Shape cloud-native delivery. Leverage Kubernetes and AWS services; guide containerisation, deployment topology, configuration, secrets and release patterns. 

Embed quality and DevSecOps. Promote TDD, contract testing, automated quality controls, threat modelling and efficient CI/CD practices. 

Influence technical direction. Define and challenge application design strategies, standards, guardrails and effective development workflows. 

Collaborate and communicate. Work with product, business, security, architecture and engineering stakeholders, and present complex decisions clearly. 

Lead technical change management. Help teams adapt to AI-assisted engineering and modern delivery practices by setting examples, creating guardrails, running enablement sessions and building confidence in new ways of working. 

Build a strong technical bench. Raise the engineering bar through hiring input, interviewing, coaching, mentoring and succession planning, creating a team of strong technical people around the role rather than becoming a single point of dependency. 

Core Technical Skills

Backend engineering: Expert-level Java, including modern Java versions and strong Spring Boot experience; reactive programming and Spring WebFlux are advantageous. 

Architecture: Distributed systems, Domain-Driven Design, Event-Driven Architecture, microservices, APIs and SaaS product architecture. 

Data and messaging: SQL and NoSQL technologies such as PostgreSQL, MongoDB and Redis; event streaming with Kafka. 

Cloud and platform: AWS, Kubernetes, Docker and Helm; GitLab CI and Argo CD experience is valuable. 

Quality engineering: JUnit, TDD, Spring Cloud Contract, automated integration and performance testing; K6 experience is advantageous. 

Front end and data processing: Working knowledge of TypeScript and Angular; Apache Spark exposure is beneficial. 

Security and compliance: Secure-by-design architecture, threat modelling, identity, data protection and financial-services regulatory expectations. 

AI engineering: Practical experience with enterprise-approved generative AI and coding assistants for architecture, code and test generation; ability to evaluate model outputs and design safe human-in-the-loop workflows. 

Hands-on delivery credibility: Proven record of remaining close to code and delivery while operating at senior architect level; comfortable producing tangible engineering assets rather than limiting contribution to strategy, reviews or governance. 

Qualifications

Experience: 10+ years in software engineering within large product teams, including 5+ years of hands-on design responsibility for complex distributed solutions. 

Education: Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience. 

Leadership: Demonstrated ability to lead technical teams, influence decisions, resolve complex architectural challenges and communicate with senior stakeholders while staying close enough to implementation to unblock delivery and model excellent engineering practice. 

Domain: Experience in fintech, banking or payments, with an understanding of financial-sector security and compliance. 

AI fluency: Evidence of using modern AI models to improve architecture and engineering outcomes, combined with disciplined verification, secure data handling and measurable quality controls. 

Change agent: Experience helping engineering teams adopt new tools, AI-assisted workflows, modern development practices and higher standards through coaching, hands-on examples and pragmatic guardrails. 

Mindset: Curiosity, sound judgement, continuous learning and a track record of introducing valuable technology without compromising product quality. 

What Drives Our Teams

We build mission-critical software with a long-term product mindset. Digital Core combines the scale and rigour of core banking with the pace of a modern software platform: modular architecture, API-first integration, real-time processing, cloud-native delivery, deep regulatory awareness and responsible AI. Architects are expected to contribute directly to code and design, simplify complexity, create reusable capabilities, coach others into stronger engineering habits and lead the change towards AI-enabled ways of working that improve customer outcomes across markets.

data.title: Builder QA II
data.description:
Job Description

You are an engineer who specialises in proving things work. The distinction between "dev" and "QA" work is not one we maintain: you read the application code, you write production-grade Python, and you build agents. The difference is what you point them at. 

- Core DNA
 - AI-Native Workflow. You use AI to accelerate everything you do as a default, not an experiment. You have opinions about which tools earn their place. 
 - Agentic Implementation. You build, debug and deploy autonomous agents - LLM-driven test generation, Playwright browser-use agents, self-healing locator strategies - against complex ERP screens and workflows. 
 - Legacy-to-Modern Bridge. Some of what you'll test is a modern web rewrite. Some is a desktop application older than your career. Both are puzzles. 
 - Evidence Over Confidence. A generated test that has never been executed is not a test. You know your own false-positive and flake rates rather than claiming there aren't any. 
 - What You Own

The ticket-to-test pipeline. An agent that reads a requirement or defect, understands the affected area, and produces a real test - grounded in the actual application, not in what the model imagines the application looks like. Hallucinated locators are the failure mode that kills these systems; preventing them is your problem. 

Execution and stabilization. Generation is the easy half. Your pipeline isn't done when a test file exists or a ticket gets created - it's done when the test has run against a real build, passed repeatedly, and earned its place in the suite. Flake is the enemy, because a suite nobody trusts is worse than no suite. 

Coverage that means something. You can tell the difference between a suite that covers the code and a suite that covers the risk. You use mutation testing and real defect history rather than counting tests, and you argue for the edge cases that actually bite: fiscal calendars, multi-currency, partial shipments, period-end adjustments. 

- Where You Might Lean In
 - Test Generation & Grounding - the retrieval and context problem. How does an agent know what the screen really contains, what the business rule really is, and what changed in this release? 
 - Adversarial & Red-Team - you build agents whose job is to break things. Programmatic prompt optimization (DSPy), fuzzing business logic, hunting the input nobody thought of. 
 - Test Infrastructure & Agent-Ops - the factory the test agents run in: parallel execution, environment and data management, tracing, and the observability to know why a run went sideways. 
 - Legacy Surface Automation - desktop and thick-client applications where modern tooling doesn't reach and the automation has to be built rather than installed. 

What You'll Actually Do

- Build test-generation agents that take a ticket and produce an executable test grounded in the live application. 
 - Close the loop. Make generation, execution, stabilization and reporting one pipeline rather than four disconnected steps with a human carrying work between them. 
 - Automate the untestable. Wrap legacy business logic - the modules everyone has avoided because there's no spec - in characterization tests that capture what the system actually does today. 
 - Kill flake. Find the root cause rather than adding a retry. Retries are how suites die. 
 - Red-team the financial logic. Build the agents that go looking for the case where the ledger doesn't balance. 
 - Fix your own agents in production. Read the traces, find why it went sideways, make it not happen again. 

What Good Looks Like

(Illustrative - real targets agreed with the hiring manager. )

- 30 days: Shipped your first agent-generated test into a running suite - generated, executed, stable. 
 - 90 days: Owning the ticket-to-test pipeline for a product area end to end, with a measured flake rate and a real coverage picture. 
 - 6 months: Other Builders reuse what you built. Escaped defects in your area are measurably down, and you can show why. 

The Stack

Python, pytest, Playwright, SQL (Postgres/SQL Server), TypeScript, OpenAI/Anthropic, LangChain/LangGraph, DSPy, pgvector/Qdrant, Docker, CI/CD pipelines, OpenTelemetry, eval and tracing platforms (LangSmith / Langfuse / Braintrust or equivalent), desktop automation frameworks where the application demands it. And any other tool that helps us achieve greatness. 

Who You Are

- You've shipped one. You have built at least one autonomous agent or complex LLM workflow that real people used for real work - not a weekend demo. You know how it failed, because it did. 
 - You write real code. Python that goes to production and gets reviewed like anyone else's. If your automation experience stops at a record-and-playback tool, this isn't the role. 
 - The manual-task hater. You have a physical reaction to repetitive work. If you do it twice, you've already started drafting the automation. 
 - Technically fearless. A 500-table undocumented legacy schema isn't complexity, it's a puzzle about to get solved. You aren't intimidated by spaghetti code - you're the one who brings the sauce. 
 - Rigor over hype. You love the new models and you still ask for the numbers. You know the difference between a cool demo and a pipeline people rely on every release. 
 - Suspicious by instinct. Your first question about any green build is what it didn't check. 

Why Join Us

- Quality is engineering here, not a stage gate. You are a Builder on the same ladder, with the same levels and the same expectations as everyone else in the squad. You build; you don't sign off on other people's work. 
 - The Final Boss of complexity. ERPs are the ultimate challenge for AI. If you can build agents that validate a General Ledger, you've solved the hardest version of this problem. 
 - Agentic autonomy. We don't do tickets. We do missions. You'll have real freedom over the models, frameworks and agent architectures you think will win. 
 - No red tape. If the agent works and the evals pass, we ship. No Change Management Committee - a "Does It Work?" policy. 
 - The Builder Tribe. You won't be the only AI person in the room. You'll be part of a small squad equally obsessed with moving faster, where your automation hacks are your biggest contribution rather than a hidden side project.

Project Description: 

UI path Developer for Testing Automation for thick clients will design, build and execute automated test solutions for the application platform using UiPath Test Suite, covering functional, regression, integration and upgrade testing. The role is responsible for converting the existing manual regression pack into a reusable, maintainable automation suite, integrating it into CI/CD pipelines, and providing reliable, repeatable test coverage across Loan IQ releases, enhancements and interfacing applications. 

Responsibilities: 

Test Automation Design & Development: 

- Design, develop and maintain automated test scripts and reusable components using UiPath Studio / UiPath Test Suite. 
 - Build and maintain an object repository and data-driven automation framework covering thick client and web-based screens (thick client automation). 
 - Automate the regression pack across core modules - Customer, Deal, Facility, Outstanding, Drawdowns, Payments, Fees, Interest, Accruals, Notices and Batch processing. 
 - Parameterise test data and manage test data set-up to enable repeatable execution across SIT, UAT and pre-production environments

Test Execution & Defect Management: 

- Plan and execute automated regression, smoke and sanity cycles for Loan IQ patches, hot fixes, version upgrades and enhancement releases. 
 - Analyse execution results, triage failures, distinguish genuine defects from script/environment issues and publish execution reports to stakeholders. 
 - Log, track and re-test defects in JIRA / Zephyr / ALM through to closure, working with development and vendor teams. 
 - Support integration testing of thick client interfacing systems (e. g. payment hub, messaging, reporting and downstream applications). 

Framework, CI/CD & Maintenance: 

- Integrate automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, GitLab or Azure DevOps to enable continuous testing. 
 - Maintain and refactor automation assets in response to thick clients version upgrades, configuration changes and screen changes. 
 - Manage version control of automation code and maintain scheduled unattended execution through UiPath Orchestrator. 
 - Identify and implement automation opportunities that reduce manual regression effort and shorten release cycles. 

Documentation & Collaboration: 

- Prepare and maintain test strategy, automation approach, test plans, test scenarios, scripts and requirement traceability matrices. 
 - Participate in Agile ceremonies and work closely with business analysts, developers, product owners, operations and vendor teams. 
 - Provide knowledge transfer and support to manual testers and business UAT users on automated test assets and results. 

Mandatory Skills Description: 

- 5 to 8 years in software testing, with a minimum of 3 years in test automation and hands-on experience testing with any thick client test cases automation experience and with computer vision of uipath. 
 - Thick client automation experience is a must. 
 - Hands-on experience with UiPath Studio, UiPath Test Suite and UiPath Orchestrator for automated functional and regression testing. 
 - Strong functional knowledge Deal Booking, Facility Booking, Drawdowns, Payments, Fees, Interest, Servicing, Notices and Batch processing. 
 - Experience in corporate and syndicated lending processes is a must. 
 - Proven experience in test design, test case authoring, regression testing, system integration testing and UAT support. 
 - Strong SQL skills with Oracle / PostgreSQL / MS SQL Server for back-end validation and test data preparation. 
 - Experience with test management and defect tracking tools such as JIRA, Zephyr, HP ALM or qTest. 
 - Experience working in Agile / Scrum delivery with DevOps practices
 - Exposure to other automation tools such as Selenium, UFT or Tosca, and scripting in VB Script, Java or Python. 
 - Experience integrating automation suites into CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitLab, Azure DevOps). 
 - API testing experience - XML API, REST / SOAP services, Postman or REST Assured. 
 - Good understanding of Cloud concepts (Azure and AWS). 
 - UiPath certification (e. g. UiPath Certified Professional - Automation Developer / Test Automation Engineer).

Job Description

As a Test Automation Engineer, you will design and implement automation solutions that validate system behavior across UI, APIs, and integrations. You will contribute to building a robust quality engineering ecosystem by integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines and supporting continuous delivery. 

In this role, you will translate requirements into effective test strategies, combining automation with manual, exploratory, and integration testing to ensure comprehensive quality coverage across all application layers. 

This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys hands-on coding, solving complex validation challenges, and improving system quality at scale, while taking ownership of end-to-end quality outcomes and collaborating closely with cross-functional teams. 

Responsibilities

Automation Development & Framework Ownership

- Design, develop, and own scalable test automation frameworks and reusable components
 - Build automated test suites across: 
 - UI (Web/Mobile)
 - API and integration layers
 - Ensure automation solutions are maintainable, reliable, and extensible across teams

Test Strategy & Implementation

- Translate requirements into automation-ready test scenarios, test data, and validation strategies
 - Contribute to test strategy, coverage planning, and quality goals
 - Identify test gaps and proactively mitigate risks

To lead the design, implementation, and governance of enterprise-grade ML Ops frameworks that enable scalable, secure, and efficient deployment of AI and Generative AI models, while driving best practices in automation, monitoring, and AWS architecture. 

Accountabilities Are Given Below

data.description:
About Us

Mercari is a Japan-based C2C marketplace company founded in 2013 with the mission to "Create value in a global marketplace where anyone can buy & sell. " From being the first tech unicorn from Japan before its IPO in 2018, we have come a long way towards becoming a global player and continuously and diligently work towards our transformation journey with a strong focus on our mission. 

Since its inception, Mercari Group has worked to grow its services, investing in both our people and technology. Over time Mercari has expanded from being the top player in the C2C marketplace in Japan to new geographies like the U. S. We have also successfully launched new businesses such as Merpay, a mobile payment service platform with a vision to create a society where anyone can realize their dreams through a new ecosystem centered not only on payment service but also on credit. Today, Mercari Group is made up of multiple subsidiary businesses including logistics, B2C platform, blockchain, and sports team management. 

For our services to be utilized by people worldwide, there is still a mountain of work ahead of us. This endeavor naturally requires the capability of the best talent and minds, and that is exactly the reason for us to launch the India Center of Excellence. With your help, we will continue to take on the world stage and strive to grow into a successful global tech company. 

Our Culture

To achieve our mission at Mercari, our organization and each of our employees share the same values and perspectives. Our individual guidelines for action are defined by our four values: Go Bold, All for One, Be a Pro and Move Fast. Our organization is also shaped by our four foundations: Sustainability, Diversity & Inclusion, Trust & Openness, and Well-being for Performance. Regardless of how big Mercari gets, the culture will remain essential to achieving our mission and something we want to preserve throughout our organization. We invite you to read the Mercari Culture Doc which summarizes the behaviors and mindset shared by Mercari and its employees. We continue to build an environment where all of our members of diverse backgrounds are accepted and recognized, and where they can thrive while holding dear to Mercari's culture. 

Organization/Team Mission

Mercari Engineering Principles

Mercari Engineering Principles are a shared understanding that serves as the foundation of engineering beliefs and behavior at Mercari. The Engineering Principles are designed to complement the organizational identity (Mercari's mission, values, and culture) from an engineering viewpoint. 

These principles ultimately help us achieve Mercari's mission by defining the ideal state we seek to realize in the long term. 

- Passion For The Product
 - Grow Together
 - Solve Through Mechanisms
 - Collaborate Openly

Role

We're looking for a Tech Lead with a strong computer science background and proven experience building and operating platform or infrastructure systems. You'll provide technical leadership for platform initiatives while remaining hands-on, improving developer productivity and ensuring the reliability, security, scalability, and observability of Mercari services. 

You'll work with engineers and stakeholders across teams to identify problems, set technical direction, and deliver platform capabilities that support large-scale systems. You'll also guide the release, migration, adoption, and operation of those capabilities. 

What You'll Do

- Lead the design, development, and operation of platform features and tools that support the full software development lifecycle, from build and test through deployment and operation
 - Set technical direction for platform initiatives, make pragmatic architectural decisions, and communicate trade-offs clearly
 - Write and review production code, design documents, and infrastructure changes while maintaining high engineering standards
 - Plan and lead migrations and adoption of platform features and tools, working with internal developers to minimize disruption
 - Improve platform stability, scalability, availability, and security in collaboration with the SRE and Security teams
 - Improve observability of services and the platform to reduce incidents and control costs
 - Improve and automate daily platform operations, reducing toil, and guide incident response and follow-up improvements
 - Mentor engineers, share knowledge, and foster engineering best practices through technical guidance and collaboration
 - Work with internal developers and stakeholders to understand their needs, prioritize problems, and deliver practical solutions

You may be a good fit if you

- Are passionate about improving developer productivity and experience
 - Enjoy building, operating, and maintaining scalable infrastructure through operational automation
 - Lead by example and enjoy mentoring engineers and helping teams make sound technical decisions
 - Take a pragmatic approach to problems and are neutral about technology choices
 - Avoid reinventing the wheel and make effective use of existing tools and ecosystems
 - Have strong communication and interpersonal skills and can align stakeholders across teams

Platform areas

- ETI
 - Network
 - Platform Infra
 - Observability

Bold challenges

The platform and its tools are used across the Japan marketplace, Japan fintech, and the Mercari US marketplace. Changes and improvements can affect organizational performance-from development agility to system reliability-and your work can have a significant impact. 

The team needs to understand developers' challenges and the needs of Mercari Group product development. As a lead engineer, you'll help gather requirements, prioritize problems, and guide practical solutions that draw on your knowledge and experience. 

Requirements

Minimum requirements

- At least 8 years of experience developing, operating, and maintaining complex, scalable production systems, including cloud-based platforms
 - Experience leading the technical design and delivery of platform or infrastructure initiatives across teams
 - Strong computer science background and in-depth knowledge of a major cloud platform such as AWS, Azure, or GCP
 - Strong written communication skills for documenting designs, explaining technical trade-offs, and collaborating with stakeholders
 - Proficiency with container platforms such as Kubernetes or Docker in production environments
 - Hands-on experience building tools and automation with languages such as Bash, Go, or Python
 - Strong experience implementing and managing infrastructure as code (IaC), such as Terraform
 - Experience mentoring engineers and providing technical guidance through design and code reviews
 - Ability to collaborate with a team and adapt to a dynamic environment

Preferred requirements

- Experience with distributed systems or microservices architecture
 - Understanding of service-level agreements (SLAs) and objectives for maintaining system performance and reliability
 - Familiarity with monitoring and observability technologies such as Datadog, Prometheus, Graphite, Grafana, Kibana, or Elasticsearch
 - Previous open-source software development experience or active participation in open-source communities
 - Production experience with service meshes such as Istio, Kong, or Linkerd

Benefits

Employment Status : Full-time

Office location: Bengaluru

Hybrid workstyle : 2 Days Work From Office

(We believe in high performance and professionalism. We work from office for 2 days/week and work from home 3 days/week

To build a strong & highly-engaged organization in India, we highly encourage everyone to work from our Bangalore office, especially during the initial office setup phase

We will continue to review and update the policy to address future organizational needs)

Working Conditions

This is where your work makes a difference. 

At Baxter, we believe every person-regardless of who they are or where they are from-deserves a chance to live a healthy life. It was our founding belief in 1931 and continues to be our guiding principle. We are redefining healthcare delivery to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.

Every individual is empowered to take ownership and make a meaningful impact. We strive for efficient and effective operations, and we hold each other accountable for delivering exceptional results. 

Here, you will find more than just a job-you will find purpose and pride. 

Job Summary

We are seeking a Development and Test Manager with 12+ years of experience leading software development, verification, and quality engineering for connected healthcare and regulated medical software. The manager will provide technical and people leadership across the complete product lifecycle-from requirements, architecture, design, and implementation through functional, automation, performance, reliability, and release-readiness testing. This role owns delivery of cloud-native applications, REST and GraphQL APIs, user interfaces, microservices, medical-device integrations, and EMR/EHR workflows within agreed quality, schedule, and budget commitments. The role combines engineering leadership, development and test governance, technical direction, stakeholder management, design-control compliance, and audit-ready delivery. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Define and continuously improve the integrated software development and test strategy in alignment with product roadmaps, business priorities, regulatory commitments, architecture direction, and release plans. 
 - Lead software developers, automation engineers, performance engineers, and functional verification engineers; manage capacity, hiring, onboarding, objectives, coaching, technical development, succession planning, and delivery accountability. 
 - Plan and lead engineering assignments involving the evaluation, selection, and adaptation of software designs, technologies, development methods, test approaches, tools, and engineering practices. 
 - Provide technical direction from product conception through requirements, architecture, detailed design, implementation, integration, verification, release, and sustaining activities. 
 - Establish software engineering governance covering estimation, design and code reviews, coding standards, branching and configuration management, unit and component testing, static analysis, code coverage, technical debt, defect management, and quality metrics. 
 - Ensure software architecture and implementation meet requirements for maintainability, security, scalability, performance, reliability, interoperability, observability, and supportability. 
 - Own delivery of cloud-native applications, microservices, REST and GraphQL APIs, web user interfaces, integration services, and data processing capabilities using appropriate C#/. NET and related technologies. 
 - Establish test governance, risk-based planning, entry and exit criteria, requirements traceability, defect management, quality dashboards, and release-readiness assessments. 
 - Own the roadmap and governance for reusable C#-based REST API and UI automation frameworks, including coding standards, test-data management, parallel execution, logging, reporting, and environment configuration. 
 - Ensure unit, component, integration, smoke, regression, performance, scalability, reliability, security, and release-level testing is incorporated into CI/CD pipelines with appropriate automated quality gates. 
 - Guide design, development, integration, and verification of HL7 ADT, FHIR resources, clinical workflows, EMR/EHR interfaces, connected medical devices, real-time communications, notifications, and downstream clinical systems. 
 - Implement configuration and change management throughout the complete product lifecycle, including design, development, verification, release, and sustaining phases. 
 - Partner with product, clinical, systems, architecture, DevOps, cybersecurity, quality, regulatory, service, manufacturing, and external integration teams to resolve dependencies, technical issues, and product risks. 
 - Drive root-cause analysis by correlating application behavior, source code, automated and performance results, logs, API traces, network data, database records, queues, container metrics, and infrastructure telemetry. 
 - Incorporate field issues, customer feedback, post-market learnings, and production trends into product design improvements, corrective actions, regression coverage, reliability testing, and performance validation. 
 - Ensure compliance with the product development process, design controls, Quality System requirements, software lifecycle procedures, cybersecurity expectations, and applicable regulatory standards. 
 - Maintain audit-ready requirements, architecture and design records, code and review evidence, plans, test cases, objective evidence, reports, approvals, and traceability in approved tools such as Jira, Jama, source-control platforms, and validated test-management systems. 
 - Develop project plans, engineering milestones, resource strategies, budgets, and delivery forecasts; identify and mitigate issues that could affect quality, cost, scope, or schedule. 
 - Manage external development partners, contractors, vendors, and third-party service providers, including technical direction, deliverable acceptance, and performance monitoring. 
 - Communicate development progress, quality status, technical risks, mitigation plans, resource needs, architecture decisions, test findings, and go/no-go recommendations to program and leadership forums. 

What You'll Bring

- 12-18 years of software engineering, software development, testing, verification, quality engineering, or performance engineering experience, including at least 5 years leading multidisciplinary technical teams in a regulated or safety-critical environment. 
 - B. E/B. Tech in Computer Science / Electronics & Communication / Electrical or related field 
 - Demonstrated experience managing the complete software development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, architecture, design, implementation, code review, unit testing, integration, verification, release, and sustaining engineering. 
 - Strong hands-on or technical leadership experience with C#/. NET, object-oriented design, design patterns, REST and GraphQL APIs, microservices, web applications, and distributed systems. 
 - Demonstrated ownership of functional and automation test strategy for REST APIs, web user interfaces, integration workflows, and end-to-end regression using Playwright, Selenium, NUnit, xUnit, MSTest, or comparable technologies. 
 - Experience with software architecture and engineering practices such as clean architecture, secure coding, static analysis, code quality, code coverage, configuration management, branching strategies, dependency management, and technical-debt reduction. 
 - Experience validating distributed microservices, event-driven systems, JSON/XML, SQL/PostgreSQL, authentication, authorization, RabbitMQ, Azure Service Bus, MQTT, or comparable technologies. 
 - Working knowledge of Azure, Docker, Kubernetes, autoscaling, service discovery, role-based access control, secrets management, service mesh, resilience, and cloud observability. 
 - Experience with CI/CD architecture, Git, build automation, automated quality gates, pipeline troubleshooting, artifact management, deployment practices, test reporting, and engineering dashboards. 
 - Healthcare domain expertise covering HL7 v2, ADT messages and acknowledgements, FHIR REST resources, EMR/EHR workflows, connected medical devices, data integrity, patient safety, privacy, and clinical risk. 
 - Knowledge of regulated healthcare software practices and standards such as IEC 62304, ISO 13485, ISO 14971, design controls, cybersecurity expectations, and formal verification evidence. 
 - Ability to manage complex projects and engineering programs within boundaries of quality, time, scope, and budget while balancing development and verification priorities. 
 - Strong people leadership, stakeholder influencing, conflict resolution, planning, prioritization, vendor coordination, risk management, and executive communication skills. 

Preferred Skills

- Experience with SIP, RTP, WebSocket, WebRTC, audio/video communication, Kamailio, FreeSWITCH, RTPEngine, or comparable real-time communication technologies. 
 - Experience with Grafana, Prometheus, Application Insights, APM platforms, centralized logging, packet analysis, database diagnostics, and automated performance-threshold evaluation.

 - Experience supporting regulatory audits, formal submissions, post-market investigations, and enterprise-scale healthcare product releases. 
 - Familiarity with IEC 62304, ISO 13485, risk management, cybersecurity expectations, and quality systems for regulated healthcare software. 
 - Experience with Jira, Jama, validated toolchains, Agile/Scrum delivery, and formal release-readiness reviews.

data.title: Guidewire QA Engineer
data.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Guidewire QA Engineer based in India. 

We are looking for a detail-oriented Guidewire QA Engineer to ensure the quality, reliability, and performance of enterprise insurance applications. In this fully remote role, you will be responsible for testing Guidewire InsuranceSuite solutions, including PolicyCenter, ClaimCenter, and BillingCenter, across various business processes and application workflows. You will design and execute comprehensive test strategies covering functional, integration, regression, system, and user acceptance testing. Working closely with developers, business analysts, and business stakeholders, you will identify defects, validate fixes, and ensure applications meet business and technical requirements. You will also contribute to API testing, test automation initiatives, and continuous quality improvement throughout the software development lifecycle. This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced QA professional to contribute to reliable insurance technology solutions within a collaborative Agile environment. 

Accountabilities

- Test Planning and Execution: Develop, maintain, and execute comprehensive test plans, test cases, and test scripts for Guidewire applications. Perform functional, integration, regression, system, and User Acceptance Testing (UAT) to ensure solutions meet business and technical requirements. 
 - Guidewire Application Testing: Validate configurations, business rules, workflows, and application functionality across Guidewire InsuranceSuite modules, including PolicyCenter, ClaimCenter, and BillingCenter. Test end-to-end business processes and verify application behaviour against defined requirements. 
 - Requirements Analysis and Test Coverage: Analyze business and technical specifications to identify testing requirements and design effective test scenarios. Ensure adequate test coverage and document execution results to validate application functionality and reliability. 
 - Data Validation and Consistency: Verify the accuracy, completeness, and consistency of data across Guidewire components and integrated enterprise systems. Use SQL queries to support database testing and investigate data-related discrepancies. 
 - API and Integration Testing: Perform API testing using tools such as Postman and SOAP UI. Validate REST APIs and SOAP web services, ensuring reliable communication and accurate data exchange between Guidewire applications and external systems. Investigate integration failures and collaborate with developers to verify corrective solutions.

data.title: DevOps Automation Engineer
data.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a DevOps Automation Engineer based in India. 

We are seeking an experienced, automation-focused DevOps Engineer to optimize engineering operations and drive automation across a cloud-native SaaS environment. In this hands-on senior individual contributor role, you will design and implement scalable solutions that reduce manual work, improve infrastructure management, and enhance software delivery reliability. You will work extensively with AWS, Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD pipelines, and production systems while leveraging AI coding agents and intelligent automation workflows. You will play a key role in strengthening infrastructure security, system performance, and developer productivity through reusable tools and standardized engineering practices. Working closely with distributed teams across India and the United States, you will collaborate with engineering, security, product, and operations stakeholders. This is an exciting opportunity for a technically strong professional who combines DevOps expertise, problem-solving capabilities, and an innovative approach to AI-assisted engineering. 

Accountabilities

- DevOps Automation and Process Optimization: Identify manual, repetitive, and error-prone activities across infrastructure, development, deployment, and security operations. Design and implement automated and AI-assisted workflows to improve efficiency, reduce operational overhead, and increase engineering productivity. Measure automation outcomes, including time saved, reduced manual effort, and improved delivery reliability. 
 - Infrastructure as Code and Cloud Management: Design, implement, and maintain cloud infrastructure using Terraform and other Infrastructure as Code technologies. Develop reusable infrastructure modules and establish effective practices for state management, environment promotion, infrastructure drift detection, and remediation. Manage and troubleshoot AWS services across computing, networking, storage, identity management, and databases while ensuring scalability, security, and resilience. 
 - CI/CD Pipeline Development and Optimization: Own, maintain, and improve CI/CD pipelines covering builds, automated testing, security scanning, artifact management, and deployments. Develop reusable pipeline patterns and shared libraries to standardize software delivery. Integrate automated quality checks and security controls, configure SonarQube quality gates, and troubleshoot pipeline failures to improve deployment consistency and reliability. 
 - AI-Assisted Engineering and Agentic Automation: Leverage AI coding agents, such as Claude Code, as key tools for engineering and automation implementation. Translate complex requirements into clear specifications, provide appropriate context and guardrails, and guide AI agents through development tasks. Review AI-generated code for functional correctness, security vulnerabilities, hallucinations, and architectural consistency. Design multi-step agentic workflows with human-in-the-loop validation and develop reusable AI skills, templates, configurations, and automation processes. 
 - Responsible AI Implementation: Integrate generative AI tools with internal data sources, APIs, and enterprise systems where appropriate. Apply responsible AI practices, including prompt injection awareness, data sensitivity controls, sandboxed execution, and output validation to ensure secure and reliable implementation.

Conduct root cause investigations, implement preventive measures, and develop operational runbooks and troubleshooting documentation. Improve monitoring, observability, alerting, and overall system reliability.

Integrate security scanning, code quality checks, and compliance controls into CI/CD pipelines.  - Strong experience managing production CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, CircleCI, Azure DevOps, or similar tools. 
 - Solid understanding of public cloud architecture, containerization, serverless computing, event-driven architecture, and RESTful API design. 
 - Proficiency in Python, Go, or another comparable programming language. 
 - Strong knowledge of system design and distributed systems, including failure handling, state management, idempotency, and infrastructure reliability. 
 - Demonstrated experience using AI coding agents for meaningful engineering and implementation tasks, with the ability to critically assess and validate generated outputs. 
 - Practical knowledge of generative AI tools, prompt engineering, agentic workflows, and AI-assisted engineering productivity. 
 - Understanding of AI limitations and risks, including hallucinations, context constraints, sensitive data exposure, and security vulnerabilities.

data.description:
Description

The Experience

Salesforce is hiring a Portfolio Leader to directly manage and grow a team of technical AI specialists deploying Agentforce solutions inside complex customer environments. This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who can drive engineering excellence while operating at the executive level. This is not a traditional people manager, but a mission-critical multiplier on the agentic frontier. You will lead a blended delivery team made up of two specialist functions: Forward Deployed Engineers (Technical Builders - who design, build, and deploy AI Agents directly in customer environments) and Deployment Strategists (Strategic Builders - customer-facing advisors who shape AI strategy, define use cases, and drive adoption). Together, these teams work alongside customers to co-build and deliver agentic AI solutions on a single large enterprise account or across multiple engagements simultaneously. You'll set the engineering standards, unblock complex customer deployments, and scale the talent that's shipping production AI today. 

Production leadership required. Builder mindset non-negotiable. 

The Builder Leadership Experience

- Delivery Team Coordination: You own the capacity planning, talent acquisition, and staffing that ensures your cross-functional squads have the horsepower to deploy Agentforce at enterprise scale. 
 - AI-Augmented Leadership: Your team ships solutions using a best-in-class suite of AI tools (Cursor, Claude, and Salesforce coding products like Vibes). You will foster an inclusive, high-energy, and psychologically safe engineering culture where builders iterate fast and continuously level up. 
 - Direct Product Influence: You stand at the center of the product feedback loop. Partner directly with the Product and Engineering organizations on pilot programs and beta rollouts, turning raw field insights from high-stakes deployments into features on the Agentforce core roadmap. 

What You'll Actually Be Doing

- Scale Elite Talent: Recruit, mentor, and develop the next wave of Technical and Strategic Builders. Drive technical excellence, structure career growth, and foster an environment where shipping high-quality, production-ready systems is the norm. 
 - Maintain Operational Velocity: Monitor key delivery metrics, coach your teams on optimization, and run hard on complex customer escalations. You ensure your teams move from sketch to deployable in weeks, not months. 
 - Ultimate Technical Authority: Serve as the final technical escalation point for your portfolio. Maintain deep architectural judgment across the Salesforce platform, advanced LLM techniques, data pipelines, and agentic orchestration. 
 - Guide Enterprise Implementations: Unblock complex data readiness, tool integration, and multi-agent orchestration challenges. Step in directly to help your teams assess customer technical readiness, remove deployment barriers, and codify standardized, repeatable delivery methodologies. 
 - Drive Agentic Adoption: Build and anchor strong executive-level relationships within your customer portfolio, ensuring flawless Agentforce activation, rollout, and sustained production value. 
 - Accelerate Portfolio Performance: Operationally run your account portfolio with engineering rigor - monitoring health, delivery velocity, and core consumption metrics to accelerate progress toward customer business outcomes. 
 - Cross-Functional Alignment: Partner lock-step with Services, Account Success, and Product teams to help enterprises activate and consume Agentforce quickly, moving customers from pilot to production at hyper-speed. 

You're Our Person If. . . 

- Advanced Technical Depth: 15+years of Technical background with recent deep architectural understanding of AI, LLMs, and the Salesforce ecosystem. You have hands-on experience with enterprise software implementation, data modeling, API integration, and AI deployments. 
 - You Have Proven Leadership: 3+ years of direct people management or high-impact technical leadership steering cross-functional engineering or technical teams. You have a track record of hiring, mentoring, and scaling technical talent. 
 - You Own the Agentforce & Data Cloud Blueprint: You possess direct, hands-on experience architecting or deploying Salesforce Data Cloud and the Agentforce platform. You don't just understand the tech stack - you know how to orchestrate it to unblock enterprise scale and drive immediate production value. 
 - You Lead with an Enterprise Customer Focus: Strong background navigating high-touch customer strategies at a Global level, paired with exceptional executive-level communication and influence skills. You can hold your own in a room with customer CTOs and enterprise architects. 
 - You Have a Ship-It Mindset: Exceptional problem-solving instincts, extreme resourcefulness, and a "get-things-done" demeanor. You thrive at the technical helm where code is being actively shipped, not just talking about it. 

Even Better If. . . 

- Hands-on experience building multi-agent systems, prompt engineering pipelines, or deterministic AI guardrails. 
 - Familiarity with cloud data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery) and enterprise data pipelines. 
 - Relevant Salesforce certifications (Advanced Admin, Service Cloud, Data Cloud, Sales Cloud, or Agentforce Specialist).

data.title: Senior Application Software Engineer
data.description:
Job Description

As a Senior Application Software Engineer, you will work with Product/Design during the design phase, author a technical approach to building the features, and breakdown, refine, and deliver the work with your team. The ideal candidate will be passionate, self-motivated, able to multitask effectively, and have strong communication skills. Daily tasks include microservices development, testing, CI/CD, participating in scrum activities, and collaboration with Support, Product Management, and other Service Teams. Performs deep debugging across a bounded set of distributed services, driving fixes that protect downstream consumers and upgrade paths. 

Technical Qualifications: 

- BS degree in Computer Science or related fields or equivalent experience
 - 5+ years of experience in software development
 - Expert in Java programming language
 - Experience building interfaces, including JSON REST APIs. 
 - Experience with test frameworks like Junit, Enzym, Jest
 - Knowledge of database technologies (e. g. , MongoDB, PostgreSQL, MySQL). 
 - Experience with distributed source control, including GIT
 - Experience with continuous deployment tools like Jenkins
 - Familiarity with log analysis tools and debugging tools
 - Excellent problem-solving and communication skills
 - Proficient is using AI coding tools to accelerate the development
 - Experience in frontend development is a plus

Functional Qualifications: 

- Experience with Agile Methodologies, specifically Scrum
 - Experience using ticket tracking systems such as JIRA
 - Ability to quickly pick up new languages and technologies
 - Self-driven, able to work independently on a project
 - Strong desire to stay on top of new technologies and services
 - Passionate about learning
 - Strong communication skills, including cross-team collaboration
 - Ability to deliver basic functionality and iterate
 - Experience working with geographically distributed teams
 - Experience in the healthcare industry and clinical applications is a plus

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Software Development and Coding - Design, Testing, and Optimization: 

- Designs software solutions and analyzes and helps identify requirements to achieve business and operational goals, independently. 
 - Adheres to and suggests improvements to all phases of the software development lifecycle. 
 - Utilizes working knowledge to develop new software features and enhancements following design specifications and develops documents to clarify software design and code. 
 - Leads code reviews in designated areas to help drive improvements. 
 - Conducts debugging and troubleshooting to identify and fix moderately complex software issues. Develops fixes for identified issues. 
 - Implements software testing (e. g. , functional and non-functional testing), quality assurance processes, software error logging, monitoring, and observability for effective debugging, ensuring review by manager and/or lead throughout the process. 
 - Exercises judgment and discretion to conduct performance profiling and optimization of coding. 
 - Troubleshoots and resolves moderately complex issues related to application programming interface (API) functionality and integration. 
 - Implements moderately complex API versioning, lifecycle, and interoperability strategies. 

Software Architecture - Software System Structural Design: 

- Designs and develops software, systems, and services aligned to pre-defined system architecture. 
 - Develops working knowledge of software architecture decisions and best practices. 
 - Collaborates with team leads to review work to ensure alignment with software architecture. 
 - Implements moderately complex performance optimization and scalability strategies in software design. 

Issue/Defect Collaboration - Software Products Support: 

- Collaborates within and beyond immediate team to understand customer issues and align solutions. 
 - May provide technical guidance and support to customers regarding customer-reported issues, independently. 
 - Coaches, mentors, and guides others to advocate for customers' interests and suggests product enhancements based on feedback. 
 - Influences team to ensure customer satisfaction through timely resolution of issues and effective communication. 
 - Implements customer issue and/or defect handling and training processes, independently. 
 - Investigates and troubleshoots complex product maintenance issues to ensure customer agreement on short- and long-term solutions (e. g. , future enhancements). 

Practices and Standards Compliance - Security and Compliance: 

- Collaborates with the team to establish and follow development practices and coding standards. 
 - Exercises judgment and discretion to ensure code quality and adherence to broad acceptance criteria during development. 
 - Keeps up to date with industry best practices and applies them to software development processes. 
 - Implements secure coding practices to prevent security vulnerabilities. 

Development Operations - System Maintenance: 

- Performs periodic maintenance and testing operations for systems that require upgrading or patching (e. g. , for critical vulnerabilities). 
 - Exercises judgment and discretion to drive improvements, ensure automation, testing, and debugging of systems to ensure service/product availability, health, support, and reliability. 

Core Responsibilities

Planning & Execution: 

- Independently manages work, monitoring timelines and deliverables to ensure projects or initiatives stay on track and meet requirements. Proactively prioritizes work and adapts to resource or timeline shifts, suggesting adjustments to maintain project efficiency. 

Collaboration & Partnership: 

- Collaborates across teams to align on expectations and achieve shared objectives. Builds and maintains a comprehensive understanding of business, stakeholder, and/or customer needs to build and support effective partnerships. Actively listens to diverse perspectives and asks questions to ensure understanding of others. 

Problem Solving: 

- Independently identifies and addresses standard and non-standard issues in accordance with standard practices, escalating more complex issues as appropriate. Analyzes data and/or information from multiple sources to troubleshoot standard and non-standard errors. Contributes to knowledge sharing and best practices. 

Continuous Learning: 

- Embraces continuous learning by actively seeking to build knowledge and new skills and/or tools and staying current with industry trends and best practices. Seeks out and leverages feedback and training to improve skills. Contributes to a culture of continuous learning and knowledge sharing with team members. 

Continuous Improvement: 

- Develops ideas and recommends updates to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows within a team. Seeks input from team members on alternative approaches and methods for improving work. 

About Us

Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives. 

True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That's why we're committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We're committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation-request_mb@oracle. com or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States.
