data.title: Lead Platform Engineer - Cloud Infrastructure
data.description:
About The Job

Introduction : 

Our solutions hosted on our Iris Smart Manufacturing platform combine equipment and process domain expertise in Mining & Metals, Oil & Gas, Chemicals & Petrochemicals with the state-of-the-art in data sciences, machine learning, and process optimization. 

The IRIS platform can work in hybrid mode and is built using microservices architecture. 

The applications are containerised and run on Azure Kubernetes service and use Azure blob storage, Data Lake, IoT Hub, Event Hub, Event Grid, and Queues. 

The development team embraces DevOps culture and delivers products using Continuous Delivery principles. 

You will be key in managing multiple installations of the platform across Cloud and on-premise environments, fixing security vulnerabilities on a monthly basis, conducting audits, and contributing to automation of installations. 

You will have a great opportunity to work with a world-class team and latest technologies and be able to learn and contribute. 

Responsibilities

- Contribute to the IRIS Platform operations roadmap and execute planned research and development
 - Deploy and manage cloud infrastructure on Azure and AWS using best practices and governance standards
 - Lead production operations, including incident management, troubleshooting, and root cause analysis
 - Automate so that IRIS Platform is deployable easily across multiple Cloud providers such as Azure and AWS, and on-premise such as K3s and RKE2
 - Work with customers and Services team to support multiple installations of the IRIS platform
 - Conduct monthly audits including vulnerabilities, DAST tests, and review of backups, cost and access reviews
 - Develop CICD pipelines for projects built microservices that would be deployable across multiple environments
 - Implement security best practices in cloud and on-premise environments to address vulnerabilities and compliance requirements
 - Develop and maintain Helm charts for packaging and deploying Kubernetes applications
 - Manage operations of the databases and messaging systems Postgres, Elastic, Redis, and Kafka including configuration, scalability, and backups
 - Implement auto-scaling of various platform services within the Kubernetes environment
 - Automate infrastructure provisioning with Terraform, Ansible, or similar IaC tools
 - Operate Kubernetes clusters, ensuring scalability, reliability, and security
 - Implement monitoring, logging, and alerting to maintain SLAs and availability targets
 - Apply security best practices and enforce compliance standards across cloud and deployment pipelines
 - Be the operations contact point for multiple product teams

Required Skills & Qualifications

- 4+ years of hands-on experience with AWS and/or Azure
 - 3+ years of experience working with Linux systems
 - 4+ years of commercial experience with Kubernetes
 - 2+ years of experience working with Docker
 - 4+ years of experience setting up CICD pipelines (AzureDevOps or similar)
 - 2+ years of experience with automation tools such as Terraform and Ansible
 - 2+ years of experience with Cloud such as Azure, AWS or GCP
 - Good knowledge of best security practices, vulnerability management, and testing tools such as Acunetix, Snyk, CheckMarx or Trivy
 - Troubleshooting problems in Production and comfortable doing root cause analysis
 - Able to work in an Agile environment

Preferred Skills & Qualifications

- Good working or operational knowledge of databases (Postgres, Elastic search, Redis or similar)
 - Exposure to configuring web servers such as Nginx
 - Working knowledge of monitoring tools such as Grafana and Prometheus
 - Working knowledge of a messaging framework such as Event Hub, Kafka, RabbitMQ or similar

Compensation & Benefits

- Competitive salary and benefits package
 - Flexible hybrid working model
 - Opportunities for professional growth and development
 - Collaborative and inclusive work environment
 - Access to the latest technologies and tools
 - Opportunity to make a tangible impact on cutting-edge Retail/CPG AI solutions

Diversity & Inclusion Statement

We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team and encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply. 

About Us

SymphonyAI is building the leading enterprise AI SaaS company for digital transformation across the most critical and resilient growth industries, including retail, consumer packaged goods, financial crime prevention, manufacturing, media, and IT service management. 

Since its founding in 2017, SymphonyAI today serves 1500+ Enterprise customers globally and has grown to 3, 000 talented leaders, data scientists, and other professionals across over 30 countries

data.title: Gammastack - Site Reliability Engineer - Google Cloud Platform
data.description:
Responsibilities

- Own the reliability, availability, and performance of microservices and production workloads. 
 - Design and improve resilient infrastructure on GCP, with strong emphasis on Cloud Run, Kubernetes, and containerized services. 
 - Build and maintain observability across logs, metrics, tracing, alerting, and service health so issues are detected early and resolved quickly. 
 - Improve deployment safety through stronger CI/CD pipelines, release controls, rollback strategies, and environment consistency. 
 - Lead incident response and production readiness practices, including runbooks, postmortems, on-call hygiene, capacity planning, and resilience testing. 
 - Reduce operational toil by automating repetitive work and improving tooling for engineers supporting distributed services. 
 - Partner with development teams to improve the operability, scalability, and fault tolerance of microservices early in the design lifecycle. 
 - Strengthen cloud security and infrastructure hygiene across IAM, secrets management, workload hardening, and production safeguards. 
 - Improve service performance, resource efficiency, and cloud cost management without compromising reliability. 
 - Support architecture and reliability reviews for critical services and high-traffic business events. 

Qualifications

- 5+ years of experience in Site Reliability Engineering or closely related DevOps roles with meaningful production ownership. 
 - Strong experience running production systems on Google Cloud Platform. 
 - Hands-on experience with Cloud Run, Kubernetes, and container-based microservices in production. 
 - Strong experience with infrastructure as code, particularly Terraform and Terragrunt. 
 - Strong understanding of observability using tools such as OpenTelemetry, Cloud Monitoring, New Relic, or equivalent systems. 
 - Strong understanding of distributed systems, microservice failure modes, reliability engineering, and production debugging. 
 - Experience building or improving CI/CD pipelines and release workflows in modern engineering environments, including GitHub Actions. 
 - Ability to write code and automation in one or more languages such as Python or Java. 
 - Good judgment during incidents and a practical mindset around reliability, recovery, and risk tradeoffs. 
 - Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across engineering teams. 
 - Experience working with AI tooling and agentic workflows in engineering or operational environments. 
 - Experience in retail, e-commerce, or other customer-facing environments is a plus.

data.title: QA/QC Manager
data.description:
- Role Summary

The Lead of QA/QC is a senior technical and governance authority responsible for establishing, implementing, and overseeing quality assurance and quality control (QA/QC) frameworks across the delivery of data center and missions. 

The role represents the client's quality, compliance, and risk interests, ensuring that all design, procurement, construction, and handover activities meet approved standards, specifications, regulatory requirements, and operational reliability expectations. The QA/QC Head supports projects from early design through construction, commissioning, and handover, with a strong focus on quality governance, compliance monitoring, defect prevention, and continuous improvement in fast‐track environments. 

- Key Responsibilities

QA/QC Leadership & Project Delivery

- Provide end‐to‐end QA/QC leadership across data center projects from design development through construction, commissioning, and handover. 
 - Act as the QA/QC Lead, advising the client on quality strategies, risks, compliance gaps, and corrective actions. 
 - Develop, implement, and maintain the Project Quality Management Plan (PQMP) in alignment with Employer's Requirements (ERs), contractual obligations, and client standards. 
 - Establish quality objectives, inspection regimes, and acceptance criteria aligned with program, phasing, and operational readiness requirements. 
 - Design Quality Review & Technical Governance
 - Oversee quality assurance of design deliverables across all disciplines, including: 
 - CSA, MEP, ELV, IT, and specialist systems
 - Specifications, drawings, calculations, and schedules
 - Ensure design deliverables comply with: 
 - Local codes, regulations, and authority requirements
 - International standards (e. g. , ISO, NFPA, ASHRAE, IEC)
 - Client data center design standards and quality benchmarks
 - Verify incorporation of constructability, maintainability, and commissioning requirements into design documentation. 
 - Participate in design reviews, technical workshops, value engineering, and constructability sessions with a quality focus. 
 - Construction Quality Oversight, Audits & Compliance
 - Provide QA/QC oversight during construction to ensure works comply with approved designs, specifications, and quality plans. 
 - Review and approve contractor Quality Plans, Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs), method statements, and material submittals. 
 - Conduct regular site inspections, quality audits, and compliance reviews. 
 - Monitor and track non‐conformances (NCRs), observations, and corrective/preventive actions. 
 - Ensure workmanship quality, testing compliance, and traceability of materials and installations. 
 - Oversee defect management, punch lists, and quality close‐out processes. 
 - Interface Management & Coordination
 - Coordinate closely with: 
 - CSA, MEP, ELV, IT, and commissioning teams to ensure consistent quality standards
 - Contractors, subcontractors, and vendors to enforce quality requirements
 - Commissioning teams to ensure quality readiness prior to testing and IST
 - Ensure quality requirements are embedded in procurement, construction, and commissioning workflows. 
 - Support cross‐discipline coordination to prevent quality gaps and interface failures. 
 - Risk Management, Continuous Improvement & Change Control
 - Identify quality‐related risks impacting safety, performance, durability, and operational reliability. 
 - Implement preventive quality measures to reduce rework, delays, and defects. 
 - Support phased delivery, fast‐track, and live environment projects while maintaining quality standards. 
 - Provide QA/QC input to change management, variations, and claims. 
 - Support schedule and cost impact assessments related to quality issues and corrective actions. 
 - Promote continuous improvement through lessons learned and quality trend analysis. 
 - Data Center-Specific QA/QC Expertise
 - Quality oversight of mission‐critical systems including: 
 - Structural and architectural works
 - Electrical power and grounding systems
 - Mechanical cooling and containment systems
 - ELV, controls, BMS, EPMS, and DCIM systems
 - Ensure quality alignment with redundancy, resilience, and Tier‐level requirements. 
 - Monitor quality readiness for commissioning, IST, and operational handover. 
 - Ensure quality documentation supports long‐term operations and maintenance. 
 - Client & Stakeholder Management
 - Act as the primary QA/QC representative to the client. 
 - Support senior leadership in managing client expectations related to quality and compliance. 
 - Present quality status, risks, trends, and corrective actions to stakeholders. 
 - Coordinate with authorities, designers, contractors, and vendors on quality matters. 
 - Maintain complete and auditable quality records and reports. 
 - Qualifications & Experience

Education

- Bachelor's degree in engineering, Construction Management, or a related technical discipline. 

Professional Certifications (Preferred)

- ISO 9001 Lead Auditor or equivalent. 
 - Chartered Engineer / Professional Engineer (CEng, PE, or equivalent). 
 - Data center or mission‐critical certifications (e. g. , Uptime Institute ATD, CDCP) are advantageous. 

Experience

- 15-20 years of experience in QA/QC, construction quality management, or technical governance roles. 
 - Proven experience delivering data center or mission‐critical infrastructure projects. 
 - Technical Skills & Tools
 - Advanced understanding of QA/QC systems, inspection regimes, and audit methodologies. 
 - Strong knowledge of construction standards, codes, and authority requirements. 
 - Familiarity with quality management systems, NCR tracking, and reporting tools. 
 - BIM and digital tools for quality inspections and issue tracking. 
 - Strong technical reporting, documentation, and governance capabilities. 
 - Core Competencies
 - Strong leadership and independent professional judgment. 
 - High attention to detail with a systematic, risk‐based approach. 
 - Effective communication and stakeholder engagement skills. 
 - Ability to enforce standards while maintaining collaborative relationships. 

Proactive mindset focused on prevention rather than correction.

data.title: Principal Systems Software Engineer
data.description:
Job Description

Firmware connects hardware capability to cloud reliability. At OCI, you will work where those layers meet-investigating challenging failures, developing lasting fixes, and improving how firmware is tested, deployed, and operated across our infrastructure. 

As a Principal Systems Firmware Engineer, you will design, develop, and improve BMC firmware or BIOS/UEFI and the tools that support its deployment across OCI's server and GPU infrastructure. You will own complex engineering problems across firmware, hardware, and operating systems, delivering changes that improve platform reliability, diagnosability, security, and recovery. 

Your initial focus will be engineering improvements for platforms already operating in our fleet. You will use production findings to identify design weaknesses, develop and validate firmware fixes, extend automated testing, and eliminate recurring failure modes. Success means delivering durable improvements that reduce failures and the need for manual intervention. 

You will also participate in an India daytime on-call rotation, complementing US engineering teams. This responsibility connects your engineering work directly to how platforms behave in production and includes incident investigation, mitigation, and coordinated handoffs. 

As the team grows, its scope is expected to expand into new server and GPU platform development, with opportunities to work alongside silicon suppliers and ODM/JDM partners on firmware integration, platform bring-up, and validation. 

This role offers the opportunity to help shape a new team's engineering practices while remaining deeply involved in design, code, and complex technical investigations. 

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Own firmware development and integration. Design, develop, debug, and maintain BMC or BIOS/UEFI components and supporting systems software. Define clear interfaces across firmware, hardware, operating systems, and fleet management services. 

- Resolve complex fleet issues. Lead investigations into boot failures, management controller faults, firmware update problems, hardware initialization failures, and other platform reliability issues. Develop mitigations, establish root cause, and deliver durable fixes. 
 - Provide operational support. Participate in the India daytime on-call rotation, coordinate investigations and handoffs with US teams, and communicate impact, progress, and resolution clearly. 
 - Build automation and preventive controls. Develop tools for firmware provisioning, updates, diagnostics, recovery, and validation. Improve telemetry, logging, and failure analysis to reduce recurring incidents and manual intervention. 
 - Drive software quality and security. Write maintainable code, lead design and code reviews, and develop functional, regression, negative, and recovery tests. Apply secure development practices and support firmware vulnerability remediation. 
 - Contribute to platform bring-up. Diagnose interactions across firmware, hardware, bootloaders, and operating systems. Use platform logs and appropriate hardware debugging tools to isolate faults and validate end-to-end behavior. 
 - Collaborate with engineering and vendor partners. Work with hardware, silicon, operating system, validation, and fleet operations teams. As product development scope grows, work with ODM/JDM partners on requirements, defect resolution, firmware releases, and platform readiness. 
 - Provide technical leadership. Own delivery of complex engineering work, identify dependencies and risks, document designs and debugging methods, mentor engineers, and contribute to hiring and continuous improvement. 

Required Qualifications

- Meet one of the following education and software development experience combinations: 
 - 11 years of software development experience; or 
 - A bachelor's degree/B. Tech in a relevant engineering, computing, information technology, mathematics, physics, or related field, with 7 years of software development experience; or 
 - A master's degree/M. Tech in one of these fields, with 5 years of software development experience; or 
 - A doctorate in one of these fields, with 3 years of software development experience. 
 - At least 6 years of experience using programming and scripting languages, with strong C/C++ skills and the ability to build diagnostic and automation tools. 
 - Substantial hands-on development and debugging experience in BMC firmware or BIOS/UEFI, with the ability to investigate interactions across the broader server platform. 
 - Strong understanding of server architecture, embedded systems, hardware/software interfaces, and Linux fundamentals. 
 - Demonstrated ability to diagnose complex issues across firmware, hardware, and operating systems, using evidence to distinguish symptoms from root causes. 
 - Experience owning software components through design, implementation, code review, testing, release, and ongoing support. 
 - Experience developing automated tests, diagnostics, or operational tooling and improving reliability, observability, or performance. 
 - Ability to lead technical investigations, mentor colleagues, and communicate effectively across engineering teams and external partners. 
 - Willingness to participate in the India daytime on-call rotation. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with OpenBMC or other server BMC stacks, or with server BIOS/UEFI implementations such as EDK II or commercial firmware platforms. 
 - Familiarity with relevant platform interfaces and protocols, such as Redfish, IPMI, PLDM/MCTP, SMBus/I2C, SPI, PCIe, or ACPI. 
 - Experience with server or GPU platform bring-up, hardware initialization, power and thermal management, or reliability, availability, and serviceability (RAS) features. 
 - Experience using JTAG, logic analyzers, protocol analyzers, or emulators, and interpreting schematics and board documentation. 
 - Experience with secure boot, firmware signing, update and recovery mechanisms, or firmware security remediation. 
 - Experience supporting production infrastructure at cloud or hyperscale environments, including controlled firmware rollouts and incident response. 
 - Experience collaborating with silicon suppliers, BIOS/BMC vendors, or ODM/JDM engineering teams.

data.title: Manager/Senior Manager, Engineering - Observability and Monitoring
data.description:
We are looking for a senior Manager, Engineering for our Observability and Monitoring teams. Someone who can take ownership of two high-visibility teams building the operational backbone of SimCorp One, and who is ready to help define how we see, detect, and resolve issues across the company before clients feel them. 

What Makes Us, Us

Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!

At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values - Caring, Customer success-driven, Collaborative, Curious, and Courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered. 

If you like what we're saying, keep reading!

WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US

The AI & Insights area is building the foundation for reliable, intelligent operations of SimCorp's offerings. When something breaks in our systems, we need to know immediately, and our teams need to quickly be able to understand the root cause. Ideally, we see the signals in advance, initiate self-healing, and avoid interruptions for our clients. Observability and Monitoring are how we enable that. 

The Observability team owns the data foundation: a standard, Open Telemetry-based way for every SimCorp system to emit logs, traces, and metrics, collected on a central Operational Data Platform that SREs, monitoring, and AI agents can all use. The Monitoring team owns what we do with that data: one governed monitoring standard with a single alert funnel, a standard alert payload, and one Grafana instance for dashboards and alert rules. Together, the two teams are the data and signal layer for AIOps: AI-assisted root-cause analysis, proactive resolution, and self-healing workflows. 

You will partner closely with the Product Managers for Observability and Monitoring and with the architect to turn the roadmap into delivery, and you will report directly to the Senior Director of Engineering. You will also be part of the AI & Insights leadership team, contributing to the broader deliveries and growth of the area. 

What Will You Be Responsible For

Team leadership and development

- Lead and grow the Observability and Monitoring teams, distributed across multiple locations, creating clear priorities and a supportive, engaged culture 
 - Develop individual engineers through regular 1: 1s, coaching, and honest feedbac 
 - Build one coherent engineering group across two domains, with the right composition, skills, and no single-person dependencies 
 - Hire and onboard new engineers into fast-moving workstreams as scope grows

Delivery and operations

- Own delivery of the Observability and Monitoring roadmaps 
 - Hold a high bar on quality, security, and operational readiness 
 - Manage day-to-day prioritisation, capacity, and engineering health across both teams, keeping delivery and engagement strong 
 - Remove blockers before they slow the team down, including the ones involving other teams

Stakeholder and cross-team collaboration

- Partner with the Product Managers to translate product strategy into an executable delivery plan 
 - Work with the architect on technology direction, from the OpenTelemetry data plane to the alerting and visualisation stack 
 - Collaborate with SREs, Operations, SaaS reliability, and the product development teams who instrument their code and consume the data, and translate technical work into clear updates for non-technical stakeholders 
 - Align with the Senior Director of Engineering on priorities and risks

Strategy and growth

- Help shape SimCorp's observability, monitoring, and AIOps strategy as scope expands from collecting data to automated root-cause analysis and self-healing 
 - Anticipate where the teams need to grow in skills, headcount, and tooling, and advocate for it 
 - Bring an informed point of view on measuring what matters, such as monitoring maturity, SLOs, and incident detection and resolution times, rather than coverage alone 
 - Make AI agents part of how the teams work and how SimCorp operates, with people orchestrating, reviewing, and holding the bar. 

What We Value

Ownership and independence You take responsibility without being told to, dig in when things are unclear, and are comfortable deciding with incomplete information and following through. 

Management experience You have led engineering teams before, ideally in a platform context, with a genuine track record of accountability for team outcomes and engagement. 

Technical grounding in observability and monitoring engineering You have a background in software or platform engineering and engage comfortably with telemetry (logs, traces, and metrics), instrumentation standards such as Open Telemetry, alerting, SLOs, and incident response. You are curious about how AI can speed up root-cause analysis and operations. You will not write production code, but you understand what your engineers build, ask the right questions, and spot when something is off. 

Communication clarity You write and speak in plain, precise English, can explain a complex platform decision to a non-technical stakeholder, and represent your team with confidence in senior forums. 

Benefits

- Global hybrid work policy - We ask you to work 2 days a week from the office. If you choose you can work remotely the other days. Of course, you are welcome at the office if that is your preference. 
 - Culture - Inclusive and diverse company culture. 
 - Work-life balance - We believe that an equilibrium between professional responsibilities makes us all the best version of ourselves, both in private life and as colleagues in the workplace. 
 - Empowerment - We believe that all voices are valuable and must be heard. You will be involved in shaping our work processes. 
 - Career & Growth - Simcorp does offer opportunities for professional development: there is never just only one route - we offer an individual approach to professional development to support the direction you want to take. 

NEXT STEPS

Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed. At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photos, age, or any non-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process. 

If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to assist you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks. 

We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone's experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated. 

WHO WE ARE?

For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world's leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 3, 000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, education, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds. 

SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full, front-to-back offering for our clients. 

SimCorp is an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, without regard to race, gender, age, disability, or any other protected status under applicable law. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best-in-class solutions to our clients.

Description

Have you ever wondered how Amazon delivers millions of customer orders with exceptional speed and reliability? Behind every fast and on-time delivery is a complex network of software, infrastructure, robotics, and operational processes engineered to work seamlessly at scale. 

Amazon Fulfillment Technologies (AFT) builds the software and infrastructure that power Amazon's world-class fulfillment centers. Our systems integrate with warehouse automation, machines, and human associates to orchestrate critical fulfillment processes across a global network. These technologies enable the movement of millions of inventory units and support billions of transactions, ensuring that customers receive the products they want, when they expect them. 

About The Mansort Team

The Mansort team owns the manual sortation layer of Amazon's fulfillment network. Our systems determine where packages should be routed after packing and before reaching the outbound dock, enabling accurate and efficient movement of shipments through fulfillment centers. 

We build and operate software responsible for sort plan generation, chute and destination assignment, and scan-and-sort workflows used by warehouse associates. Our systems operate on the fulfillment center floor across hundreds of buildings worldwide, where reliability, performance, and correctness directly influence operational efficiency and customer delivery promises. 

Mansort operates in a technically demanding environment characterized by high transaction volumes, stringent low-latency requirements, and the need for continuous availability despite connectivity disruptions or upstream dependency failures. Correctness is equally critical: every sortation decision must accurately direct a package to its intended destination to prevent operational errors and missed transportation cutoffs. 

Manual sortation complements Amazon's automated sortation capabilities by providing the flexibility and scalability needed to handle peak demand, support new geographies and fulfillment center formats, and accommodate diverse operational requirements that cannot always be addressed through fixed automation. 

As Amazon continues to expand its global fulfillment network and introduce new supply chain capabilities, delivery models, and customer experiences, the Mansort team has an opportunity to solve challenging engineering problems, modernize existing systems, and build scalable, resilient solutions that support the future of fulfillment operations. 

Key job responsibilities

Design and develop scalable systems by owning the architecture, design, implementation, testing, and deployment of distributed software systems operating in live fulfillment center environments. 

Build high-throughput, low-latency services that meet stringent performance, scalability, and availability requirements. 

Ensure operational reliability and correctness through robust sortation workflows, data integrity, routing accuracy, fault tolerance, and graceful degradation. 

Solve complex business and technical problems using pragmatic engineering decisions, innovative solutions, and modern technologies. 

Drive operational excellence by improving observability, monitoring, troubleshooting, and recovery mechanisms to minimize disruptions. 

Collaborate with product managers, operations teams, process engineers, and partner engineering teams to improve fulfillment efficiency and customer experience. 

Influence technical direction by contributing to architecture, engineering standards, and technical strategy within the team and broader organization. 

Maintain high engineering standards by writing clean, maintainable, well-tested code and ensuring software quality, performance, security, and reliability. 

Mentor engineers through knowledge sharing, design discussions, code reviews, and technical guidance to strengthen team capabilities.

data.title: Sr Lead - Software Quality Engineering/Bangalore
data.description:
About Northern Trust

As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world's most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions. 

Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide. 

With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24, 000 partners, we serve the world's most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service. 

Northern Trust is looking for a Senior Lead to join its Technology Development Centre in Pune/Bangalore, India. 

Job Overview

The Automation QA Lead holds distinct accountability for quality delivery across Trade, Securities, Accounting , Corporate Actions application changes and initiatives. 

The role is responsible for defining test architecture, embedding quality into delivery execution, and ensuring stable, compliant, and audit‐ready releases. 

The role partners closely with Product, Business, Development, Operations, and vendor teams and serves as a functional quality escalation point. 

Application Domain: Asset Servicing, Reconciliation , Asset Pricing, Trade life cycle, Corporate actions

Required Technical Skills

- Deep expertise in designing automation frameworks for Web, API, MQ, DB and mainframe systems
 - Strong programming ability in Typescripts/ JavaScript Java, Python or similar languages with CI CD integration
 - Experience with containers, observability, test data, environment lifecycle, performance and reliability testing
 - Strong exposure to latest AI tools / technologies with exposure to agentic workflows

Roles & Responsibilities

- Accountable for functional test delivery across Securities platforms including Post‐Trade, Settlements, Custody, Reconciliation, and Payments. 
 - Responsible for defining Test architecture, including scope, approach, entry/exit criteria, regression strategy, and quality gates. 
 - Lead planning, execution, monitoring, and closure of functional and integration testing activities. 
 - Analyze business requirements, workflows, and dependencies to identify functional risks and coverage gaps. 
 - Accountable for functional defect triage, severity assessment, business impact articulation, and driving defects to resolution. 
 - Provide functional quality sign‐off for releases, including clearly documented risks, constraints, and mitigation plans. 
 - Oversee end‐to‐end business flow validation across upstream and downstream systems. 
 - Act as an escalation point for functional quality risks, delivery issues, and readiness concerns. 
 - Drive consistent status reporting, RAID management, readiness reviews, and stakeholder communications. 
 - Mentor and guide QA team members, ensuring adherence to functional testing standards, practices, and delivery discipline. 
 - Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives focused on test effectiveness, consistency, and functional coverage maturity. 

Required Knowledge

- Strong understanding of Asset Servicing domains, particularly Post‐Trade processing like settlements. 
 - In‐depth knowledge of functional testing, integration testing, regression strategy, and release readiness practices. 
 - Familiarity with complex enterprise platforms supporting Capital Markets processing (BaNCS or similar). 
 - Understanding of interface concepts including APIs, file‐based integrations, and messaging (SWIFT preferred). 
 - Knowledge of QA governance, audit readiness, and risk‐based testing methodologies. 

Required Skills

- Proven experience owning functional QA delivery for complex, multi‐system platforms. 
 - Strong analytical and problem‐solving skills to assess functional impacts and testing risks. 
 - Excellent defect management, stakeholder communication, and influence skills. 
 - Ability to manage multiple priorities, risks, and delivery timelines concurrently. 
 - Exposure to hybrid QA models and automation impact analysis (hands‐on automation not mandatory). 

Qualifications & Skills

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience. 
 - 13+ years of experience in QA / Testing, preferably within Asset Servicing. 
 - Demonstrated leadership through ownership, accountability, and decision‐making (Lead IC role). 
 - Ability to communicate effectively with senior stakeholders, product owners, and delivery teams. 
 - Proactive, detail‐oriented, and quality‐driven mindset with strong execution focus. 

Shift: EMEA: 12: 30PM to 9: 30PM IST

Working with Us

As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve. 

Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust's history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities. 

Reasonable Accommodation

Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs. com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with. 

About Our Bangalore Office

The Northern Trust Bangalore office, established in 2005, is home to over 5, 600 employees. In this stunning office space, we offer fantastic amenities which include our Arrival Hub - Jungle, the GameZone, and the Employee Experience Zone that appeal to both clients and employees. Learn more.

Job Description

About Datahash

Datahash is a privacy-centric first-party data platform. Our core product, Datahash Signals, gives marketers low-code, no-code integrations between web, app, e-commerce, CRM, marketing automation and data warehouses on one side and the major ad channels on the other: Meta, Google, TikTok, Snap, Amazon and more. We are one of a handful of badged integration partners across these channels and work with them directly on first-party data adoption programmes, where advertisers are moving to server-side integrations, conversions APIs and privacy-safe measurement. We are bootstrapped, profitable, and run across Dubai, Bangalore, Mumbai and London with clients in EMEA, India, Africa, APAC and the US. 

The role

We are looking for an experienced, hands-on engineer who can take a product from an initial idea to a reliable production system, owning technical discovery, architecture, implementation, deployment, and continuous improvement. 

Think of this as operating with the independence and breadth of a small product engineering team. You should be comfortable turning ambiguous requirements into working software, making pragmatic architectural decisions, and moving across the stack to deliver complete product capabilities. 

This is a senior individual contributor role with substantial technical ownership. You will write code, solve difficult engineering problems, and remain accountable for what you ship. Strong use of AI coding tools and agents is central to the role, backed by the engineering judgment to validate their output. 

What You Will Own

- End-to-end product development. Translate business problems into technical plans, working prototypes, production features, and subsequent improvements. 
 - Architecture and technical decisions. Design systems that balance speed, simplicity, security, reliability, scalability, and cost. 
 - Full-stack implementation. Build user interfaces, backend services, APIs, integrations, data models, and background processing workflows. 
 - Production delivery. Own testing, CI/CD, cloud deployment, observability, troubleshooting, and performance optimization. 
 - Technology evaluation. Quickly learn unfamiliar technologies, test assumptions through focused experiments, and choose tools based on the problem. 
 - AI-assisted engineering. Use coding assistants, agents, and automation to accelerate research, implementation, testing, debugging, and documentation. 
 - Quality and maintainability. Review and validate all code, including AI-generated code, and establish appropriate tests, documentation, and operational safeguards. 
 - Product collaboration. Work directly with product and business stakeholders to clarify requirements, challenge assumptions, define scope, and deliver useful increments. 
 - Technical influence. Raise engineering standards through design discussions, code reviews, reusable components, and knowledge sharing. 

What Success Looks Like

You can take a loosely defined product need, propose a sensible approach, and deliver a complete, usable solution with minimal coordination overhead. You use AI effectively to shorten delivery cycles, make sound technical decisions, and leave behind software that is secure, observable, maintainable, and ready to evolve. 

How We Hire

We move fast and we are transparent about how we decide. Every decision about a person is made by a person. 

Step 1: a short structured screen within two working days of applying. Step 2: a 50-minute conversation with the hiring manager. Step 3: a small exercise close to the real work, which you present to two or three of us. Step 4: fit and terms, including the founder for this role. We aim to give you a decision within five working days of the final conversation. 

We evaluate evidence rather than claims, the quality of your questions, how you handle ambiguity, and how naturally you already use AI in your own work. 

What To Share When Applying

Share one or two products or substantial features you personally took from concept to production. Explain what you owned, the key architectural trade-offs, how you used AI or automation, and the outcomes achieved. Links to working products, code samples, or architecture walkthroughs are welcome. 

Requirements

What we are looking for

- A strong track record of independently building and shipping production software with ownership across multiple stages of the product lifecycle. 
 - Deep expertise in at least one backend ecosystem and strong working capability across modern frontend development, databases, APIs, and cloud infrastructure. 
 - Broad understanding of tools, frameworks, and architectural approaches, with the ability to explain their trade-offs and select the simplest effective solution. 
 - Demonstrated ability to become productive quickly in unfamiliar codebases and technologies. 
 - Sound understanding of system design, data modeling, asynchronous processing, caching, queues, authentication, authorization, and application security. 
 - Hands-on experience with automated testing, CI/CD, containers, monitoring, and production incident diagnosis. 
 - Practical experience using AI development tools for meaningful engineering work, including breaking work into tasks, providing context, reviewing changes, and verifying results. 
 - Strong debugging skills and the ability to reason across application code, infrastructure, data, and third-party integrations. 
 - Product judgment: the ability to identify what matters, reduce unnecessary scope, and make sensible build-versus-buy decisions. 
 - Clear communication, strong ownership, and the ability to make progress with limited supervision. 

How You Approach The Work

- You turn an unclear problem into a concrete plan and start delivering. 
 - You know when a prototype is sufficient and what must change before it reaches production. 
 - You use AI to increase your capacity while retaining a clear understanding of the systems you build. 
 - You can distinguish a useful abstraction from unnecessary complexity. 
 - You surface risks and trade-offs early and take responsibility for resolving them. 
 - You work independently while seeking feedback and specialist input when it improves the outcome. 

Good to have

- Experience as an early engineering hire, founding engineer, or owner of a product built from scratch. 
 - Experience with SaaS platforms, multi-tenant systems, data pipelines, or integration-heavy products. 
 - Experience building LLM-powered features, agent workflows, or internal automation. 
 - Experience improving cloud costs, application performance, and production reliability. 
 - Exposure to conversions APIs, server-side tracking or ad-platform APIs. 

Benefits

- A startup environment backed by a stable, bootstrapped, profitable business. 
 - Competitive compensation and one of the most employee-friendly ESOP programmes in the industry. 
 - Work from anywhere, on your hours; coworking access when you want a change from home. 
 - Health cover for you and your family. 
 - Real international exposure: clients and partners across the Gulf, Europe, Africa, India, APAC and the US. 
 - A yearly offsite that we take seriously, and a culture that does not. 

Datahash is an equal-opportunity employer. We hire on evidence and fit for the work and do not ask for salary history. Compensation is discussed at the fit-and-terms stage.

data.title: Systems Engineer

We are seeking a Systems Engineer to support and enhance our internal healthcare application platform. You will handle Kubernetes-based application deployments, CI/CD pipeline support, infrastructure automation, platform reliability, and cost optimization. You will work within established standards and security practices. 

Key Responsibilities

- Deploy, upgrade, and maintain healthcare applications on Kubernetes using standardized patterns and Helm charts. 
 - Implement, maintain, and troubleshoot CI/CD pipelines using modern DevOps practices. 
 - Automate infrastructure provisioning and routine operational tasks using Infrastructure as Code (IaC). 
 - Monitor platform health, respond to alerts, troubleshoot issues, and contribute to root cause analysis. 
 - Identify manual processes and automate them to improve operational efficiency. 
 - Identify and implement cost-saving opportunities such as rightsizing, cleaning up unused resources, and tuning autoscaling. 
 - Follow security and compliance practices (HIPAA, access controls, secrets management) in all platform work. 
 - Maintain runbooks and technical documentation. 
 - Collaborate with development, operations, and support teams to improve application delivery. 

Required Skills

- 3+ years of experience in Systems Engineering, DevOps, or Platform Engineering. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with Kubernetes, Docker, and containerized applications. 
 - Experience with Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, or Jenkins. 
 - Proficiency in Terraform, Ansible, or other IaC tools. 
 - Scripting experience with PowerShell, Python, or Bash. 
 - Experience with Azure or another cloud platform. 
 - Strong troubleshooting, automation, and problem-solving skills. 

Preferred Skills

- Experience with AKS, EKS, or OpenShift. 
 - Helm charts and Kubernetes administration. 
 - Monitoring tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, Azure Monitor, or ELK. 
 - Experience in healthcare or other regulated environments. 
 - Certifications such as CKA/CKAD, Azure Administrator, or Terraform Associate. 

What Success Looks Like

- Applications are deployed consistently using standardized Kubernetes patterns. 
 - Automation has measurably reduced manual work.

data.title: Sr. Manager, Engineering
data.description:
Join Us as a Sr. Manager, Engineering!

Are you ready to make a significant impact in an innovative environment? At ORBCOMM, we're looking for an experienced and technically strong Sr. Manager, Engineering to lead high-performing software engineering teams responsible for building and operating our cloud-based IoT and asset intelligence solutions. 

If you're passionate about developing engineering talent, building scalable cloud platforms, and translating complex business requirements into reliable technology solutions that create meaningful customer value, we'd love to hear from you. 

Why You'll Love Working Here

As a Sr. Manager, Engineering, you'll lead software engineering teams responsible for the design, development, delivery, and operation of ORBCOMM's cloud-based products and platforms. 

You'll partner closely with Product Management, Program Management, Architecture, Quality Assurance, DevOps, and Customer Success to deliver scalable, secure, and reliable solutions that support ORBCOMM's global customers. 

This role combines technical leadership, people leadership, and delivery execution. You'll help establish engineering standards, guide technical decision-making, develop engineering talent, and ensure teams have the structure, priorities, and resources needed to deliver high-quality products. You'll also collaborate with globally distributed engineering teams, helping create consistent engineering practices and a culture of accountability, innovation, continuous improvement, and customer focus. 

This role is based out of our Hyderabad office. We operate in an onsite work environment. 

What You'll Do

Engineering Leadership & Delivery

- Lead software engineering teams responsible for the development and operation of ORBCOMM's cloud-based IoT, asset intelligence solutions and AI First offerings. 
 - Drive execution of cloud platform initiatives, ensuring timely delivery of high-quality, scalable, and reliable software. 
 - Manage engineering capacity, prioritization, and resource allocation across multiple projects and initiatives. 
 - Partner with Product Management to translate business requirements into technical solutions and executable delivery plans. 
 - Drive Agile development practices, including sprint planning, release management, and continuous delivery. 
 - Monitor engineering productivity, software quality, system reliability, and customer satisfaction to identify opportunities for improvement. 

Technical & Operational Excellence

- Establish and champion engineering best practices across software development, architecture, code quality, testing, security, and operational excellence. 
 - Guide teams in the development and operation of cloud-native applications, microservices, APIs, and distributed systems. 
 - Promote effective CI/CD, DevOps, automation, monitoring, and production support practices. 
 - Drive improvements in application scalability, performance, reliability, and security. 
 - Support customer escalations and critical production issues when required, ensuring appropriate technical resources and stakeholders are engaged. 

People & Organizational Leadership

- Lead, coach, and mentor engineering teams while fostering a culture of accountability, innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement. 
 - Develop engineering talent through ongoing coaching, feedback, career development, and succession planning. 
 - Build and scale high-performing engineering teams capable of supporting evolving product and business priorities. 
 - Create an environment that encourages technical excellence, ownership, problem-solving, and knowledge sharing. 

Cross-Functional & Global Collaboration

- Partner closely with Product Management, Program Management, Architecture, QA, DevOps, Customer Success, and other business stakeholders. 
 - Collaborate effectively with engineering teams across multiple locations and time zones. 
 - Communicate engineering priorities, risks, dependencies, and progress clearly to technical and business stakeholders. 
 - Apply data-driven decision-making to engineering priorities, resource planning, and continuous improvement initiatives. 

Who You Are

You're an experienced engineering leader who combines strong technical knowledge with exceptional people leadership and execution capabilities. You understand how to build high-performing teams while maintaining a strong focus on software quality, operational reliability, and customer outcomes. 

If You Have

- 15+ years of progressive software engineering experience, including 5+ years of engineering management experience. 
 - Demonstrated experience leading globally distributed software engineering teams. 
 - Strong experience building and operating cloud-native applications and enterprise software platforms. 
 - Hands-on knowledge of public cloud platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud. 
 - Hands on experience with microservices architecture and distributed systems. 
 - Knowledge of containerization and orchestration technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes. 
 - Experience with CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, and modern software delivery methodologies. 
 - Strong understanding of SaaS platforms, API development, and system integrations. 
 - Experience with cloud security, scalability, performance optimization, monitoring, and system reliability. 
 - Familiarity with databases, messaging systems, and event-driven architectures. 
 - Experience managing cloud-based enterprise software products and platforms. 
 - Experience within IoT, transportation, logistics, telematics, supply chain, industrial automation, connected products, or a related technology environment. 
 - Knowledge of IoT platforms, connected devices, telemetry, and asset tracking solutions is highly desirable. 
 - Strong people leadership, coaching, and talent development capabilities. 
 - Excellent stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration skills. 
 - Strong analytical and data-driven decision-making capabilities. 
 - Excellent communication skills with the ability to effectively communicate with technical teams, business stakeholders, and executive leadership. 
 - A customer-focused mindset with a passion for delivering measurable business outcomes. 
 - Leverage AI-enabled tools and automation to support daily tasks and productivity. 
 - Commitment to continuous learning in digital and AI literacy. 

Then we want to meet you!

The Benefits Of Working Here

A career with ORBCOMM offers a unique opportunity to grow your skills and expand your expertise in a collaborative, innovative environment. Beyond being part of an exceptional team, we provide a competitive, locally relevant benefits package designed to support our employees around the world. Benefits vary by location and include health and wellness coverage, paid time off, retirement or savings programs, flexible work arrangements, insurance coverage, lifestyle perks, and access to employee discounts-helping you thrive both professionally and personally. 

How We Hire

ORBCOMM uses technology-enabled tools, including artificial intelligence (AI), to support parts of the recruitment process. All hiring decisions are made by people, as part of our human-led, tech-enabled culture. 

About Us

At ORBCOMM, we're pioneers in IoT technology that drives innovation and empowers our clients to make data-driven decisions. Our industry-leading solutions enable customers to boost productivity, streamline operations, and increase their bottom line. With over 30 years of experience and the most comprehensive solution portfolio in the industry, we enable the management of millions of assets worldwide across diverse sectors, including transportation, heavy industries, satellite, and maritime. Discover how ORBCOMM is transforming industries and unlocking the potential of data to drive meaningful change at www. orbcomm. com !

Ready to Join Us?

We believe that our people are our greatest asset. Your skills and passion can help us achieve remarkable things! If you're seeking a thrilling career opportunity in a vibrant, growth-oriented environment, ORBCOMM is the perfect fit for you. 

We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace and appreciate all applicants for their interest in joining our team. Only candidates selected for an interview will be contacted. 

At ORBCOMM, we are also dedicated to ensuring accessibility and are pleased to offer accommodations for individuals with disabilities upon request throughout all aspects of the selection process.

Senior Systems Engineer

We are seeking a Senior Systems Engineer to lead the design, scalability, and reliability of our internal healthcare application platform. This role owns Kubernetes platform standards, CI/CD and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) strategy, operational excellence, and cost optimization. The role also mentors engineers and partners with development and leadership teams. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design, own, and evolve the Kubernetes platform architecture for healthcare applications, including cluster strategy, upgrades, and multi-environment standards. 
 - Define and enforce standardized deployment patterns using Helm, Kustomize, and GitOps (e. g. , Argo CD or Flux). 
 - Architect enterprise CI/CD pipelines with built-in security scanning, quality gates, and release governance. 
 - Lead IaC strategy with reusable Terraform modules, configuration management, and policy-as-code. 
 - Establish observability standards, SLOs/SLIs, and alerting. Lead incident response, root cause analysis, and post-incident reviews. 
 - Drive platform security and compliance (HIPAA, audit readiness, secrets management, RBAC, network policies, image hardening). 
 - Own cloud cost governance (FinOps): rightsizing, autoscaling, reserved capacity, and cost reporting, with measurable savings. 
 - Plan and test disaster recovery, backup, and high availability. 
 - Mentor engineers, conduct design and code reviews, and author technical documentation and runbooks. 
 - Partner with development, security, and leadership teams on the platform roadmap and technical decisions. 

Required Skills

- 5+ years in Systems Engineering, DevOps, SRE, or Platform Engineering, including 3+ years running Kubernetes in production. 
 - Expert-level Kubernetes administration (AKS, EKS, or OpenShift), Docker, Kustomize and Helm. 
 - Proven experience designing CI/CD at scale with Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, or Jenkins. 
 - Advanced Terraform skills (module design, state management) plus Ansible or similar tools. 
 - Strong scripting and automation in PowerShell, Python, or Bash. 
 - Deep Azure experience (networking, identity, security, cost management); multi-cloud is a plus. 
 - Hands-on observability experience with Prometheus, Grafana, Azure Monitor, or ELK. 
 - Track record of leading production incidents and delivering reliability improvements. 

Preferred Skills

- Experience in healthcare or other regulated environments (HIPAA, HITRUST, SOC 2). 
 - GitOps, service mesh (Istio or Linkerd), and policy engines (OPA/Gatekeeper or Kyverno).

- Hands on experience and expert on working with core Java, Spring Boot, Spring (MVC, IOC, AOP, Security), SQL, RDBMS (Oracle and PostGRES), NoSQL (Cassandra), Web-services (JSON and SOAP), Kafka, Zookeeper
 - Hands on experience of developing microservice application & deploying them on any one of the public cloud like Google, AWS, Azure
 - Hands on experience of using Eclipse/My Eclipse IDE, UML tools (MS Visio, PlantUML)
 - Hands on experience of writing Junit test cases, working with Maven/Ant/Gradle, GIT
 - Experience of working with Agile methodologies. 
 - Personal attributes are strong logical and Analytical Skills, design skills, should be able to articulate and present his/her thoughts very clearly and precisely in English (written and verbal)

Additional/Desirable Capabilities

- Experience of working in Payments application Domain
 - Hands on experience of working with tools like Mockito, JBehave, Jenkins, Bamboo, Confluence, Rally
 - AI exposure. Experience of using AI tools like Github CoPilot, Claude or Cursor. 
 - Experience of reviewing the AI output with the functional aspects and coding standards

Corporate Security Responsibility

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must: 

- Abide by Mastercard's security policies and practices; 
 - Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed; 
 - Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
 - Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard's guidelines.

data.title: Engineering Manager – Firmware Engineering
data.description:
A Day in Your Life at MKS

The Engineering Manager - Firmware Engineering will lead a team delivering firmware across sustaining engineering, product enhancements, production support, qualification, and new product development. 

This hands-on leader will own technical execution, delivery, quality, and team development for an assigned portfolio while increasing team accountability from individual tasks toward complete deliverables and workstreams. 

You Will Make an Impact By

- Lead firmware execution across sustaining, enhancements, qualification, production support, and product development. 
 - Provide hands-on technical leadership in embedded firmware, real-time systems, controls, communications, and diagnostics. 
 - Own team priorities, resources, commitments, risks, and delivery. 
 - Drive architecture, design and code reviews, troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, and technical decisions. 
 - Strengthen requirements, code quality, verification, configuration, release, and defect-prevention practices. 
 - Expand CI/CD, test automation, regression automation, and approved AI-assisted development. 
 - Partner with global teams on execution, qualification, production issues, and product delivery. 
 - Coach engineers, develop technical leads, and build capability, ownership, and succession. 

Key Result Areas

Delivery: On-time delivery, commitment reliability, backlog health, and responsiveness. 

Quality: Defect leakage, repeat defects, verification effectiveness, and corrective-action closure. 

Productivity and Automation: Development cycle time, automated test coverage, CI/CD maturity, and measurable benefits from automation and approved AI tools. 

Talent and Ownership: Skill growth, time to productivity, retention, technical-lead development, and progression toward deliverable and workstream ownership. 

Skills You Bring: 

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electronics, Electrical, Computer Engineering, Embedded Systems, Computer Science, or a related discipline. 
 - 10+ years of firmware or embedded-systems experience, including 3+ years of engineering leadership. 
 - Strong technical depth in embedded C/C++, real-time systems, processors, communications, diagnostics, and embedded architecture. 
 - Experience delivering firmware through design, integration, verification, release, sustaining, and production support. 
 - Hands-on experience with design and code reviews, debugging, root-cause analysis, and technical problem solving. 
 - Experience with automated testing, CI/CD, configuration management, and modern firmware-development practices. 
 - Strong execution, people leadership, global collaboration, and stakeholder-management skills. 

Preferred Skills: 

- Experience in semiconductor equipment, instrumentation, controls, power systems, industrial automation, or similar complex products. 
 - Experience with RTOS-based systems, embedded Linux, industrial communications, high-reliability products, or hardware-in-the-loop testing. 
 - Experience using automation and AI-assisted engineering tools to improve development productivity and quality.

data.title: Software Engineer
data.description:
At Bristol Myers Squibb, our employees often ask, "Who are you working for?"-a question that fuels collaboration, accountability, and urgency in our work. Our purpose-driven culture inspires us to discover, develop, and deliver innovative medicines to prevail over serious diseases. We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it. 

Summary

The position requires an experienced Developer with a strong focus on cloud native services, DevOps, Automation and creating reusable platforms. The ideal candidate should have expertise in designing complex systems, self-service user and admin portals and cloud-based services, with expert-level experience in AWS and additional experience in GCP or Azure being a plus. 

The candidate must be able to develop, analyze and design end to end Cloud-Native solutions that automate complex tasks and simplify user experience. The candidate should have a deep understanding of DevOps/Infrastructure-As-Code (IaC) delivery models, Cloud: Network, Security, Application architecture, and usage models. The candidate must be experienced with Agile, DevOps and test-oriented system design philosophies, as well as ability to interface with other teams that may need education on cloud and DevOps best practices. 

Skills - Must Have

- The ideal candidate must be a strong developer and have experience using AWS services beyond just EC2s and Databases. Expertise in serverless, managed services, API-Governance, Basic Networking is required. 
 - Strong understanding of basic cloud networking is required to assist in troubleshooting and designing optimized solutions. 
 - The candidate must have hands-on experience with cloud projects and will be expected to demonstrate the ability to deliver quality script, code and test suites. 
 - Must have working experience with deep-dive HTTPS troubleshooting, 
 - Must have lots of experience with REST API and design, GraphQL and React/CSS front end. 
 - Skilled with JavaScript, NodeJS and Python, especially in Lambda and Beanstalk environment. 
 - Coach and develop other employees and be a technology leader and resolve difficult technical roadblocks. 
 - The candidate should have demonstrated knowledge or experience with CloudFormation at scale and reuse, and the ability to influence multiple workstreams with reusable IaC components. 
 - The candidate should also have experience in developing multi-region, serverless solutions on AWS and addressing all non-functional and AWS Well-Architected concerns in the design. 
 - Must be able to design for end-user simplicity while ensuring the system can handle complexity and exceptions internally. 
 - The candidate should have experience in breaking down projects into MVP and Agile deliverables, delivering complex end systems incrementally. 
 - Must be able to design for disaster recovery in IaaS Cloud platform and possess strong scripting skills, such as Python, Bash, Ruby, Perl, PowerShell, SSM, etc. 
 - Must have experience with managing substantial numbers of cloud accounts consistently using automation. Cloud SDK, CLI and scripting hands-on knowledge is necessary. 
 - Good listener and communicator. Strong verbal, non-verbal diagramming, and written communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across internal and external organizations
 - Experience with working and building an automated build-pipeline, continuous integration, and continuous deployment. Experience with source code control repositories
 - In-depth understanding of Interface-Contracts, Loosely Coupled designs and simplifying solutions and reducing TCO for the end-to-end picture. 

Skills - Preferred

- Experience creating and maintaining an Enterprise Internal Development Platform or equivalent highly reusable components or services. 
 - Prior success in automating a real-world problem from manual parts
 - Expertise in Cloud security and access models
 - Management of continuous integration servers like AWS Code Pipeline, Code Build. 
 - Familiarity with monitoring tools
 - Strong practical Linux and Windows-based server configuration, CLI, Script and automation skills, particularly in a Cloud environment. 
 - Skilled with producing well-designed UX with self-service solutions using Reacts GUI using REST/GraphQL API securely is a big plus. 
 - Experience with seamless/automated build scripts used for release management across environments. 
 - AWS Service Catalog experience is a big plus. 
 - Experience with automated testing and unit test tools and processes is a big plus 
 - Experience building and supporting serverless automation in AWS
 - Expertise in PaaS, and SaaS methodologies, network integration and controls
 - Experience architecting micro-service based cloud solutions

Responsibilities

- Be Developer & Engineer that the team depends on tackle difficult problems, produce automation, and prove out abstract solutions. 
 - Create and provide long-term technical leadership and vision for teams by guiding other internal development teams on cloud architecture, engineering, and operational standards. 
 - Troubleshoot difficult cases, especially those involving full range of cloud, system, network problems, including helping other teams with systems that we did not build. 
 - Architect, build, and support systems in collaboration with other departments and colleagues
 - Consider designs for long term, scale, resiliency, Cost, Security, and maintainability. 
 - Quickly learn new services as they come out of AWS, Azure and GCP. 
 - Work on a wide range of innovative Cloud uses cases. 
 - Create code-assets and tools to accelerate cloud projects. 
 - Will be an automation advocate - you genuinely believe in removing operation load with software. Ability to automate manual processes and write code to expediate detection and mitigation of issues in the environment. 
 - Work with other app-dev teams to develop new cloud hosted services
 - Partner with service providers both internal and external to design and implement cloud data systems in the BMS cloud environment. 
 - Education and training of teams
 - Document, Design/Build automation tools and APIs

Educational, Professional, And Technical Expertise

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, or commensurate experience. 
 - At least 5+ years of experience in cloud computing, software development and/or Cloud Center of Excellence (COE) as a hands-on coding role. 
 - At least 3+ years of experience working with AWS as a senior developer
 - Strong knowledge of cloud computing platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud
 - Willingness to occasionally work in a 24x7 on-call cycle to manage escalations. 
 - Strong verbal and written communication skills (content creation such as whitepapers, system diagrams, etc. ). 
 - Ability to explain complex technology concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences at all levels in the organization. 

Preferred Certifications

- AWS Certified Developer
 - AWS Certified DevOps Engineer; Associate or Professional
 - AWS Certified SysOps Administrator Associate a plus
 - Any Azure or Google Cloud certification a plus

We hire for skills and capabilities, not just credentials - if this role excites you, but doesn't perfectly match your resume, we encourage you to apply anyway.

- JMeterLocustGatlingk6OWASP ZAPBurp SuiteNessus / QualysAzure DevOpsAzure Load TestingApplication InsightsDatadogDynatracePlaywrightPythonDocker / Kubernetes

Preferred Qualifications

- Certifications in performance testing (ISTQB Performance Testing Specialist) or security testing (CEH, OSCP, or relevant Azure security certifications).
