data.description:
Job Summary

Content Automation Architect role for a global organization responsible for designing optimizing and maintaining scalable automation solutions using Ansible for hybrid work model operations. The architect will collaborate across technology and business teams to streamline content delivery workflows improve operational efficiency and support domain initiatives in Air Time Inventory while working standard day shifts without travel requirements. 

Responsibilities

- Design and implement robust automation architectures using Ansible to streamline content deployment workflows across hybrid work model environments ensuring reliable and repeatable operations that enhance overall platform stability and scalability. 
 - Develop reusable Ansible playbooks and roles that standardize configuration management for content platforms reducing manual effort and operational risk while improving consistency and compliance across environments. 
 - Optimize existing automation pipelines by analyzing performance bottlenecks and implementing improvements that reduce deployment time minimize errors and increase throughput for complex content automation scenarios. 
 - Collaborate with product engineering and operations teams to translate business requirements into well defined automation solutions that support day shift operations and align with enterprise standards and regulatory expectations. 
 - Oversee environment readiness for content automation by coordinating with infrastructure and application stakeholders to ensure compatible configurations proper access controls and stable integration points for Ansible based workflows. 
 - Provide guidance on best practices for Ansible usage including inventory management module selection error handling and testing strategies so teams can confidently maintain and extend automation assets over time. 
 - Configure monitoring and alerting for automated processes to promptly identify failures or anomalies enabling rapid incident response that protects service availability and improves end user experience. 
 - Integrate automation solutions with Air Time Inventory processes when applicable enabling more accurate scheduling faster content updates and improved utilization of inventory resources that support business growth and audience satisfaction. 
 - Document automation designs operational procedures and troubleshooting guides in clear and accessible formats so cross functional teams can effectively support and evolve the content automation ecosystem. 
 - Conduct periodic reviews of automation security posture including credential handling and access controls to align with enterprise security policies and protect sensitive content and configuration data. 
 - Coordinate and execute controlled rollouts of new or enhanced automation capabilities during day shifts ensuring minimal business disruption and transparent communication with impacted stakeholders. 
 - Mentor peers on automation concepts and Ansible techniques through demonstrations and knowledge sharing sessions fostering a culture of continuous improvement and innovation in content operations. 
 - Evaluate emerging tools and practices related to content automation and inventory management proposing enhancements that advance organizational efficiency reduce operational cost and deliver greater value to audiences and clients. 

Qualifications

- Demonstrate five to eight years of experience designing and implementing automation solutions with substantial hands on expertise in Ansible for configuration management and orchestration in enterprise environments. 
 - Possess strong understanding of content lifecycle management and operational processes for digital delivery platforms with the ability to translate workflow requirements into scalable automation patterns. 
 - Bring experience or familiarity with Air Time Inventory concepts such as scheduling allocation and utilization enabling effective collaboration with domain experts and smoother integration of automation outcomes. 
 - Exhibit proficiency in scripting and automation adjacent tools that complement Ansible capabilities supporting complex orchestration scenarios and advanced configuration routines. 
 - Show capability to work in a hybrid model with effective communication and coordination across remote and onsite teams during day shifts while managing priorities and deadlines responsibly. 
 - Apply solid analytical and problem solving skills to diagnose automation issues design corrective actions and prevent recurrence through improved patterns and resilient configurations. 

Certifications Required

Preferred certifications include Red Hat Certified Specialist in Ansible Automation or equivalent automation and DevOps certification.

data.title: Associate Manager - C&I Maintenance
data.description:
About Business

JOB DESCRIPTION

Adani Group: Adani Group is a diversified organisation in India comprising 10 publicly traded companies. It has created a world-class logistics and utility infrastructure portfolio that has a pan-India presence. Adani Group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, in the state of Gujarat, India. Over the years, Adani Group has positioned itself to be the market leader in its logistics and energy businesses focusing on large-scale infrastructure development in India with O & M practices benchmarked to global standards. With four IG-rated businesses, it is the only Infrastructure Investment Grade issuer in India. 

Adani Power Limited (APL): Adani Power Limited (APL), a part of the diversified Adani Group, is the largest private thermal power producer in India. We have a power generation capacity of 15, 250 MW comprising thermal power plants in Gujarat, Maharashtra, Karnataka, Rajasthan, Chhattisgarh, Madhya Pradesh, and Jharkhand, and a 40 MW solar power project in Gujarat. 

Job Purpose: This role is responsible to manage the continuous availability, reliability, and functionality of DCS and PLC systems. This includes scheduling and performing regular system backups, maintenance, and troubleshooting, as well as coordinating with OEMs for system upgrades. The role also involves managing hardware and software resources, network integrity, and cybersecurity measures to prevent data loss and system vulnerabilities. 

Responsibilities

Lead - DCS_PLC (Distributed Control System_ Programmable Logic Control)

System Reliability And Maintenance

Ensure the availability and functioning of all control loops in auto mode, maintaining reliability of equipment protection under BTG. 

Schedule and execute regular backups of DCS and PLC systems to prevent data loss. 

Perform routine maintenance and troubleshooting of DCS and PLC hardware to minimize downtime. 

Monitor system alarms daily and ensure the healthiness and redundancy of systems. 

Coordinate with Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs) for annual maintenance activities and system upgrades. 

Manage the proper functioning of Operator Workstations (OWS) and Engineering Workstations (EWS). 

Maintain periodical backups and availability of historian systems for data integrity and recovery. 

Hardware And Software Management

Manage the availability of DCS and PLC hardware and software, including necessary spares for emergency replacements. 

Maintain up-to-date DCS and PLC licenses and manage renewals to avoid operational disruptions. 

Conduct patch updates of DCS and PLC software to address vulnerabilities and enhance system performance. 

Upgrade DCS and PLC systems proactively to prevent obsolescence and maintain compatibility with new technologies. 

Network And Cybersecurity

Manage the storage, backup, and restoration of systems in compliance with cybersecurity policies. 

Ensure the healthiness and redundancy of the DCS and PLC network, preventing single points of failure. 

Oversee the transfer of data to third-party systems, such as Pi servers, ensuring secure and reliable communication. 

Review and strengthen network security measures to protect against cyber threats and unauthorized access. 

Business Sustainability

Implement and Follow IMS, AWMS, DISHA and CHETNA guidelines within the department. 

Promote the safety of personnel and equipment through rigorous training and strict adherence to safety protocols. 

Implement risk management practices to mitigate potential hazards and ensure operational continuity. 

Develop and maintain emergency response plans to address potential incidents swiftly and effectively. 

Ensure adherence to statutory compliances and regulations. 

Implement MoC (Management of Change) protocols to ensure safe and compliant modifications to equipment and processes. 

Provide support for Root Cause Analysis (RCA), Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA), Zero Forced Outage (ZFO) to enhance system reliability. 

Implement field related ZFO action items and AWMS for continuous improvement in maintenance practices. 

Digitization And Automation

Execute comprehensive digitization strategies and automation solutions to optimize operational efficiency. 

Implement process and system improvements, adopting newer technologies and innovative ideas. 

Drive the implementation of digital transformation initiatives. 

Analyse data trends and system performance to identify opportunities for automation and digitization enhancements.

Environment & Sustainability

Techno Commercial

Operations & Maintenance

Security

Stores

Support Functions

ENDORSE

ENOC

Key Stakeholders - External

Vendor

Educational Qualification: 

Bachelor's degree in C&I or Electronics & Communication or equivalent degree. 

Work Experience (Range Of Years)

6+ years of experience in industrial automation, specifically with DCS and PLC systems. 

Preferred Industry

Experience in the power generation, petrochemical, oil and gas, or heavy industrial sectors.

Meet the Team

Come join us and be part of the Cisco SiliconOne team and take part in crafting Cisco's groundbreaking Enterprise and Service Provider solutions by crafting some of the most complex chips being developed in the industry with the opportunity to get full exposure to all aspects of the systems and applications we build (Silicon, Hardware, Software, telemetry, security, etc). Cisco SiliconOne team is looking for an expert and talented ASIC Engineering Leader. - Leads ASIC engineering teams to deliver high-performance, high quality and reliable ASICs for Cisco's diverse product platforms. 
 - Leads teams in defining and verifying ASICs and ASIC subsystems to ensure alignment with stringent quality requirements for deployment across Cisco's platforms.

 - Defining new DV methodologies or enhancing the existing methodologies
 - In-depth understanding of the architecture, and identification of problems and solutions. 
 - End-to-end verification of one or more design blocks simultaneously while helping full chip team with integration and support. 
 - Test plan generation, review, planning and execution, meeting all criteria of ASIC group. 
 - Help in developing Emulation infrastructure using C/C++, that has to work with UVM based verification environment. 
 - Gate level simulation and SDF back annotation for blocks as part of pre-silicon verification. 
 - Code and Functional coverage-based simulation run, coverage collection, merging and working with designers to fill coverage holes. 
 - Participating in all phases during ASIC development - RTL Verification, Emulation and post-silicon validation

data.title: Senior Developer, Agentic AI
data.description:
Overview

ABOUT JAGGAER

JAGGAER provides an intelligent Source-to-Pay and Supplier Collaboration Platform that empowers organizations to manage and automate complex processes while enabling a highly resilient, responsible, and integrated supplier base. With 30 years of expertise, we specialize in solving complex procurement and supply chain challenges across various industries. 

Our 1, 300+ global employees are obsessed with ensuring customers get full value from our products - ultimately enhancing and transforming their businesses. 

For more information, visit www. jaggaer. com

JAGGAER is an AI-powered procure to pay and source to pay software solutions platform for manufacturing, public sector and higher education. 

We are seeking a hands-on Senior Engineer to lead the architecture and evolution of our enterprise agentic AI platform. 

You will work across AI agents, multi-agent orchestration, workflows, tools, enterprise integrations, retrieval, model providers, micro-frontends, observability, security, and governance. Your responsibility will be to create a coherent, reusable platform that enables multiple product teams to build and operate secure, reliable AI capabilities at scale. 

This is not a documentation-only architecture role. You will be expected to design systems, review and write production code, resolve complex technical issues, guide platform migrations, and mentor senior engineers. 

Principal Responsibilities

- Define the target architecture for enterprise AI agents, workflows, orchestration runtimes, tools, retrieval, model integrations, and embedded user experiences. 
 - Establish clear platform contracts for agent definitions, versions, advertised capabilities, tools, workflows, sessions, memory, and runtime execution. 
 - Design and evolve multi-agent and Supervisor Agent architectures that can safely coordinate worker agents, child supervisors, tools, and long-running workflows. 
 - Define shared runtime operations such as invoke, stream, resume, approve, cancel, status, events, and trace. 
 - Ensure secure propagation of tenant, user, authorization, run, and delegation context across distributed agent and workflow calls. 
 - Build deterministic security, policy, approval, budget, retry, and lifecycle controls around probabilistic model decisions. 
 - Guide micro-frontend and embedded AI architecture, including streaming, orchestration progress, tool activity, evidence, approvals, and error handling. 
 - Define provider-independent model integrations and model-selection strategies based on quality, latency, reliability, and cost. 
 - Establish agent evaluation systems covering capability selection, plan quality, grounding, hallucination, safety, latency, cost, and user experience. 
 - Drive observability across model calls, agents, tools, workflows, retrieval, evaluation, and final synthesis. 
 - Design for retries, idempotency, partial failures, cancellation, long-running execution, human pauses, and process recovery. 
 - Lead technical reviews, critical refactors, production debugging, and platform-hardening initiatives. 
 - Mentor engineers and influence architecture across multiple product and platform teams. 

Position Requirements

- 7+ years of software engineering experience, with experience operating at Principal Engineer, Architect, Staff+ Engineer, or equivalent scope. 
 - Strong hands-on programming and production-debugging ability. 
 - Deep experience designing and operating distributed, multi-tenant enterprise platforms. 
 - Strong expertise in several of the following: 
 - Python 
 - TypeScript and React 
 - API and event-driven architectures 
 - PostgreSQL and Redis 
 - Workflow or queue-based systems 
 - Containers and Kubernetes 
 - Public cloud platforms 
 - Production experience with LLM applications, AI agents, or enterprise AI platforms. 
 - Understanding of tool calling, structured model output, retrieval-augmented generation, model evaluation, and human-in-the-loop workflows. 
 - Strong knowledge of authentication, authorization, tenant isolation, API versioning, observability, reliability, and data governance. 
 - Ability to distinguish model-driven decisions from deterministic security, policy, and transactional controls. 
 - Excellent communication skills and a proven ability to influence technical direction across teams. 
Preferred Qualifications

- Experience designing multi-agent, Supervisor Agent, or research-oriented AI systems. 
 - Experience with graph-based orchestration frameworks and cloud-hosted generative AI services. 
 - Experience with multiple commercial LLM providers. 
 - Experience building shared platforms used by several product teams. 
 - Experience with micro-frontends and AI functionality embedded across a product portfolio. 
 - Familiarity with AI governance, model risk management, audit, safety controls, and regulatory requirements. 
 - Experience with distributed tracing and AI observability platforms. 
 - Experience defining internal developer platforms, reference architectures, and migration programs. 

Ideal Leadership Profile

You Are

- Hands-on and comfortable moving from architecture to implementation 
 - Opinionated but evidence-driven 
 - Focused on simplifying complex systems without forcing unnecessary rewrites 
 - Experienced in balancing delivery speed with security and platform quality 
 - Comfortable making trade-offs across model quality, latency, cost, and reliability 
 - Able to communicate effectively with engineers, product leaders, security teams, and executives 
 - Passionate about mentoring engineers and building strong technical leadership across the organization

What We Offer

At JAGGAER, we are committed to supporting you and your family's well-being. Your health is a priority, and we offer a range of programs to help you stay well and thrive. Our benefits include Health, Accidental Insurance, and Term Life. 

Our Values - T. E. A. M

At JAGGAER, our business is about people. Our products are built on intellectual property, but the real differentiator is the teams behind them-the way we collaborate, innovate, solve problems and deliver for customers. TEAM gives us a common set of expectations for how we work together across products, cultures, and geographies. 

- Transparency - Openness Builds Trust: Candor strengthens relationships, speeds decision-making, and ensures problems are solved together-with customers, teammates, and partners. 
 - Entrepreneurial Spirit - Own It, Drive It, Make It: A scrappy, customer obsessed, problem-solving mindset is at the cornerstone of both organizational and personal growth 
 - Accountability - Thumbs In, Not Fingers Out: We take responsibility ourselves before pointing elsewhere 
 - Metrics-Driven Results - Outcomes Over Activities: Data and evidence guide our decisions, help us course-correct quickly, and ensure we're delivering real impact. 

Eeo

JAGGAER is a proud equal opportunity/affirmative action employer supporting workforce diversity. We do not discriminate based upon race, ethnicity, ancestry, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, caregiver status, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, genetic information, military, or veteran status, mental or physical disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. 

Great Place to Work® Certified 2026 - JAGGAER

Join a workplace where innovation, collaboration, and people come first. 

We are proud to announce that JAGGAER has been certified as a Great Place to Work® for 2026, recognizing our commitment to creating an inclusive, empowering, and high-performing culture.

data.description:
Bring more to life. 

Are you ready to accelerate your potential and make a real difference within life sciences, diagnostics, and biotechnology?

At Radiometer, one of Danaher's operating companies, our work saves lives, and we're all united by a shared commitment to innovate for tangible impact. You'll thrive in a culture of belonging where your unique viewpoint matters, and where continuous improvement helps turn ideas into real-world impact. 

At Radiometer, life comes first. Our vision is to improve global healthcare with reliable, fast, and easy patient diagnoses-and cybersecurity plays a critical role in ensuring safe and secure products for patients and customers worldwide. 

About The Role

In this role, you will provide technical leadership and architectural direction for the development of diagnostic instrumentation. You will be responsible for defining, evolving, and governing embedded software and system architectures that enable scalable, reliable, secure, and maintainable products. 

In this role, you will collaborate closely with Product Management, Systems Engineering, Hardware Engineering, Software/Firmware Engineering, Verification & Validation, Quality, and other cross-functional stakeholders to translate product and platform strategies into robust technical solutions that enable confident diagnostic decisions, and improve patient outcomes. You will drive architectural decisions, establish engineering standards, resolve complex technical challenges, and guide teams through the successful delivery of high-quality products. 

In This Role, You Will Have The Opportunity To

- Define and drive the architecture, design, and evolution of embedded software systems and platforms for medical diagnostic instruments. 
 - Lead the development of secure, scalable, reliable, and maintainable software architectures spanning firmware, real-time processing, device control, communication, diagnostics, and system integration. 
 - Translate product requirements into well-defined architectural solutions, including component decomposition, interface definitions, technology selection, and dependency management. 
 - Lead architecture, design, and code reviews to ensure technical quality, consistency, and compliance with organizational and product objectives. 
 - Collaborate with Hardware, Firmware, Systems, Mechanical, Verification & Validation, Quality, Regulatory, and Product teams to deliver integrated instrument solutions. 
 - Collaborate with global R&D teams and stakeholders to influence technical direction, align architectural roadmaps, and support long-term product and platform strategies. 

The Essential Requirements Of The Job Include

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electronics Engineering, Embedded Systems, or a related field, with 14+ years of experience in embedded software development, firmware engineering, systems architecture, or related technical roles. 
 - Proven expertise in architecting and developing complex embedded systems using C/C++, with strong knowledge of software architecture, object-oriented design, design patterns, system-level engineering, interface design, and architectural trade-off analysis. 
 - Deep understanding of embedded and real-time systems, including RTOS, multithreading, synchronization, interrupt handling, memory management, performance optimization, and deterministic system behavior. 
 - Hands-on experience with embedded communication and networking technologies, including UART, SPI, I2C, CAN, USB, Ethernet, TCP/IP, and similar protocols. 
 - Demonstrated technical leadership in cross-functional product development teams, including mentoring engineers, driving architectural decisions, influencing technical direction, and exhibiting strong analytical, communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills. 

It would be a plus if you also possess experience in: 

- Experience architecting embedded systems for medical devices, IVD platforms, laboratory automation, scientific instrumentation, or other regulated industries, with knowledge of applicable compliance and quality requirements. 
 - Expertise in designing high-reliability, safety-critical instrument control systems involving sensors, motors, pumps, valves, measurement systems, diagnostics, fault-tolerant architectures, risk controls, and recovery mechanisms. 
 - Experience with medical device standards and cybersecurity requirements (e. g. , IEC 62304, ISO 14971), as well as modernization of legacy embedded systems and migration to next-generation architectures and platforms. 

Why Join Us

Radiometer, a Danaher operating company, offers a collaborative and purpose-driven environment where your work contributes directly to improving patient outcomes globally. 

Join our winning team today. Together, we'll accelerate the real-life impact of tomorrow's science and technology, shaping the architecture and innovation behind next-generation healthcare solutions that advance patient care around the world. 

Join our winning team today. Together, we'll accelerate the real-life impact of tomorrow's science and technology. We partner with customers across the globe to help them solve their most complex challenges, architecting solutions that bring the power of science to life. 

For more information, visit www. danaher. com.

data.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. 

The Position

External Job Ad Text

Job Description
We are seeking a highly skilled AI Quality Engineer specializing in testing Generative (and non-Generative) AI applications and agentic systems to join our team. The ideal candidate will have expertise in both traditional software testing and specialized testing methodologies for Large Language Models (LLMs)-based and AI-based systems. 

As a fullstack Quality Engineer within a lean, agentic software team, you will cover the entire spectrum of quality assurance. You will span manual exploratory testing, traditional automated UI/API/MCP testing (across our Python and TypeScript stack), classical machine learning validation, and cutting-edge generative and agentic AI evaluation. This role requires a deep understanding of LLM, agentic and ML systems behaviors, and testing frameworks to ensure the reliability, fairness, and effectiveness of our AI-powered solutions. 

Description Of The Area
At Roche Digital Technology, we are advancing the boundaries of Applied AI. The Applied AI Engineering Team focuses on architecting, building, and operating high-value AI solutions and services to solve complex business challenges in healthcare. 

In the 2026 tech landscape, we operate in small, highly autonomous agile teams (e. g. , ~9 members) powered by advanced coding agents (like Claude Code) to develop and ship solutions faster than ever before. In this highly regulated environment, quality cannot be an afterthought. You will be the foundational pillar ensuring our rapidly developed agentic workflows and AI, GenAI, and agentic applications are safe, compliant, and robust before they reach the clinical or enterprise user. 

Job Responsibilities

- Generative & Agentic AI Testing Strategy: Design and implement comprehensive testing strategies specifically tailored for LLM-based applications and agentic systems, including evaluation of model responses, RAG pipelines accuracy, and overall system reliability. You will expand this to evaluate autonomous multi-agent behaviors and tool-use accuracy
 - Full-Stack Test Automation: Design and implement automated testing solutions for continuous evaluation of LLM applications, including integration tests, performance tests, and specialized AI behavior tests. This spans both our Python backend services and modern TypeScript/React/Angular frontends
 - Quality Assurance Framework & Compliance: Utilize Roche's testing frameworks that address both traditional software quality aspects and AI-specific concerns such as output consistency, contextual accuracy, and ethical compliance; co-create and maintain such frameworks when required. Create and maintain comprehensive test documentation testing strategy, test cases, and testing guidelines specific to AI applications and compliant with Roche practices
 - Edge Case, Bias, and Fairness Testing: Identify and develop test scenarios for edge cases in LLM behavior, including handling of ambiguous inputs, potential biases, and unexpected response patterns. Design and execute tests to identify potential biases in model outputs and ensure fair treatment across different user groups and use cases
 - Security & Performance Testing: Collaborate within development teams to test for potential vulnerabilities specific to LLM applications, including prompt injection, data leakage, and other AI-specific security concerns. Collaborate with other engineers to conduct thorough performance testing of GenAI applications, including response time analysis, load testing, and resource utilization monitoring

Qualifications

- Hold B. Sc. , B. Eng. , M. Sc. , M. Eng. in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent degree with strong background in testing methodologies
 - Be passionate about quality assurance and testing, particularly in the context of AI and GenAI applications and agents
 - Have strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail
 - Utilize critical thinking and problem-solving when using AI prompts (in e. g. NLP, data distributions and edge cases)
 - Be proactive in identifying potential issues and suggesting improvements

Education / Experience

- Experience: 7+ years of experience in software testing, with at least 1 year focused on genAI and/or agentic applications
 - Regulated Environments: Be ready to work in a regulated environment with qualified infrastructure and validated applications, understand the difference between GxP and non-GxP products and the importance of CSV and ITSM processes in the delivery
 - Agile Integration: Be experienced in working with Agile development teams

Skills
Must-have: 

- Comprehensive Full-Stack Testing Mastery
 - Core Languages & Testing Frameworks: Advanced command of Python and standard testing frameworks (e. g. , pytest, allure), alongside practical familiarity with specialized AI evaluation tools. High competence in TypeScript-driven test frameworks (such as Playwright, Jest, and Cypress) for thoroughly verifying dynamic generative user interfaces
 - End-to-End Automation & CI/CD: Proven expertise in architecting and maintaining end-to-end automated testing suites that bridge traditional UI/API validation with complex, asynchronous AI/LLM evaluation pipelines
 - Pipeline Integration: Hands-on experience integrating these comprehensive suites within GitHub Actions or modern CI/CD pipelines to ensure continuous, reliable quality checks throughout the entire development lifecycle
 - Advanced AI Quality & Evaluation Mastery
 - AI Evaluation Frameworks: Expertise in implementing evaluation harnesses (e. g. , RAGAS, DeepEval, Promptfoo) to quantify LLM performance, hallucination rates, and answer relevancy
 - Agentic Workflow Validation: Ability to test autonomous agentic loops, including tool-use accuracy, step-by-step reasoning verification, and goal-directed performance metrics
 - Evaluation Datasets: Experience in curating, managing, and versioning 'Golden Datasets' for benchmarking model responses against ground truth in both development and production environments
 - Observability & Feedback Loops: Leveraging tracing (e. g. , LangSmith, Arize Phoenix) to monitor production inputs/outputs, identify drift, and capture user feedback for continuous improvement
 - Basic broad AI knowledge: Understanding of LLM architectures, RAG systems, agents, and common failure modes in AI applications
 - Python Expertise: Advanced proficiency in writing robust, maintainable Python code for test automation (e. g. , pytest). Experience using Python to orchestrate complex AI evaluation workflows, process large datasets for benchmarking, and automate interactions with LLM/AI services. Ability to integrate Python scripts into CI/CD pipelines for automated quality checks and performance observability in agentic systems

Should-have: 

- Cloud: Practical experience with testing applications on cloud platforms (AWS) and working with cloud-based AI services
 - Observability & ALM: Experience with monitoring and observability tools, log analysis, and performance metrics tracking (Grafana). Experienced in Roche mandatory ALM tools (Jira, GitHub)
 - Agentic SDLC & Engineering Excellence: Leverage AI coding assistants and autonomous agents (e. g. , Claude Code, Ona) daily to accelerate full-stack development and testing cycles. Conduct rigorous code reviews for both human-written and AI-generated code
 - Security: Understanding of security testing methodologies, particularly in the context of AI applications

Could-have: 

- Regulatory Compliance: Proven understanding of AI quality assurance and testing standards within highly regulated industries

Additional Qualifications

- Stay current with the latest developments in AI and GenAI testing methodologies and best practices
 - Have excellent communication skills and the ability to clearly document findings and recommendations
 - Be able to communicate in English at the level of C1+
 - Located in Hyderabad, India, with working hours structured to capture the 'golden hours' of overlap with Central European Time (typically running through the IST evening)

Renesas is a global semiconductor company providing hardware and software solutions for advanced automotive, industrial, infrastructure, data-centre and smart-home applications. Job Description

Position Summary: 

The Embedded Processing organization is seeking a Senior Test Engineer to define and deliver robust, cost-effective production test solutions for new semiconductor products from concept through mass production and sustaining support. In this senior role, the Senior test engineer owns the test strategy, ATE test development, test hardware, test validation, qualification and production release, test-cost optimization and industrial activities. 

Key Responsibilities: 

- Define the production test strategy and manufacturing test flow for assigned products including tester selection
 - Own the test planning
 - Provide testability input to DFT, DFM and design reviews before tapeout
 - Define detailed test plan covering ATE implementation
 - Lead test hardware requirements and development, including loadboards, probe cards, sockets, interface hardware and related fixtures. 
 - Develop and review ATE test programs, test methods, production patterns and supporting software. 
 - Lead first-silicon ATE bring-up, test program debug and sample generation. 
 - Execute ATE characterization across process, voltage and temperature conditions in alignment with the product characterization plan. 
 - Support qualification and customer sample generation by developing dedicated test programs
 - Identify test coverage gaps and potential escapes, then implement containment and permanent corrective actions
 - Release qualified test software and hardware into production and support OSAT manufacturing start-up. 
 - Review and sign off test deliverables
 - Drive production ramp readiness reviews and close test-related release risks. 
 - Reduce test time through method optimization, improved sequencing, multisite efficiency and instrumentation utilization. 
 - Support customer-return and RMA investigations by reproducing failures and assessing production test coverage. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electronics Engineering, Electrical Engineering or a related discipline. 
 - At least 6 years of relevant semiconductor test engineering experience spanning NPI, characterization, qualification, production release and sustaining support. 
 - Strong knowledge of semiconductor production test methodologies and practical experience developing ATE test solutions. 
 - Experience with Advantest V93000 or equivalent ATE platforms. 
 - Experience developing production test solutions for RF-SOC devices
 - Experience with test hardware development, including loadboards, probe cards, sockets and handler/prober interfaces. 
 - Strong programming skills
 - Experience driving manufacturing release at OSATs
 - Experience with data-analysis and yield-management tools such as JMP, Spotfire or equivalent platforms. 
 - Strong analytical, technical leadership, planning, communication and problem-solving skills.

data.title: Supervisor, Customer Service
data.description:
Description

The U. S. Pharmacopeial Convention (USP) is an independent scientific organization that collaborates with the world's leading health and science experts to develop rigorous quality standards for medicines, dietary supplements, and food ingredients. At USP, we believe that scientific excellence is driven by a commitment to fairness, integrity, and global collaboration. This belief is embedded in our core value of Passion for Quality and is demonstrated through the contributions of more than 1, 300 professionals across twenty global locations, working to strengthen the supply of safe, high-quality medicines worldwide. 

At USP, we value inclusive scientific collaboration and recognize that attracting diverse expertise strengthens our ability to develop trusted public health standards. We foster an organizational culture that supports equitable access to mentorship, professional development, and leadership opportunities. Our partnerships, standards, and research reflect our belief that ensuring broad participation in scientific leadership results in stronger, more impactful outcomes for global health. 

USP is proud to be an equal employment opportunity employer (EEOE) and is committed to ensuring fair, merit-based selection processes that enable the best scientific minds-regardless of background-to contribute to advancing public health solutions worldwide. We provide reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities and uphold policies that create an inclusive and collaborative work environment. 

Brief Job Overview

The Supervisor, Customer Success provides operational leadership for the India-based Customer Success team within a global, matrixed Customer Success & Operations organization, with primary responsibility for day-to-day execution and resolution of customer requests related to quotes, orders, order changes, order status, fulfillment, pricing, and other transactional activities across the customer journey. Working closely with the US-based Senior Manager, Customer Success, the Supervisor translates global strategy and Success standards into effective local execution, while leading team performance, workforce management, escalations, process adherence, and continuous improvement to drive timely, accurate, and consistent customer outcomes. 

How will YOU create impact here at USP?

As part of our mission to advance scientific rigor and public health standards, you will play a vital role in increasing global access to high-quality medicines through public standards and related programs. USP prioritizes scientific integrity, regulatory excellence, and evidence-based decision-making to ensure health systems worldwide can rely on strong, tested, and globally relevant quality standards. 

Additionally, USP's People and Culture division, in partnership with the Equity Office, invests in leadership and workforce development to equip all employees with the skills to create high-performing, inclusive teams. This includes training in equitable management practices and tools to promote engaged, collaborative, and results-driven work environments. 

Leadership And Operational Direction

The Supervisor, Customer Success has the following responsibilities: 

- Provide visible, inclusive leadership and set clear direction, Success standards, priorities, and accountability for the Customer Success function in India within the global operating model. 
 - Align routinely with the Senior Manager, Customer Success on functional priorities, performance expectations, customer and business risks, and execution plans for the India Customer Success team. 
 - Translate Customer Success Operations strategy into executable team plans, goals, measures, and routines aligned with customer, revenue, quality, and operational objectives. 
 - Lead through change by communicating business context, preparing the team for new processes and technologies, and reinforcing adoption and sustained execution. 
 - Promote a culture of customer focus, quality, integrity, collaboration, continuous improvement, and equitable employee engagement. 
 - Exercise sound financial stewardship, manage resources responsibly, and support business priorities within approved budgets. 

Team Management And Capability Building

- Direct daily team operations and equitably allocate omni-channel work, including orders, quotes, cases, calls, and correspondence, based on volume, skills, priorities, and Success commitments. 
 - Recruit, onboard, train, coach, and develop Customer Success Representatives, Specialists, and Supervisors to build capability, engagement, and succession readiness. 
 - Establish clear job expectations and manage performance through regular feedback, recognition, mentoring, development planning, counseling, and corrective action when required. 
 - Monitor workload, productivity, quality, data accuracy, and Success results; identify gaps and implement targeted coaching, training, and process improvements. 
 - Ensure employees have the tools, knowledge, procedures, and cross-training needed to deliver consistent, high-quality Success and maintain business continuity. 

Customer Escalation And Resolution Management

- Own and coordinate the timely investigation, documentation, communication, and resolution of complex, sensitive, or high-impact customer complaints and escalations. 
 - Assess business and customer impact, establish the appropriate urgency, engage accountable partners, and maintain clear ownership through resolution and follow-up. 
 - Identify recurring complaint and escalation themes, determine root causes with relevant partners, and convert customer feedback into corrective and preventive actions. 
 - Provide hands-on support across the full order cycle when needed, including quotations, registration, ordering, payment, fulfillment, access, shipment, and post-order concerns. 
 - Ensure escalation handling follows applicable SOPs, operating manuals, complaint requirements, and customer communication standards. 
 - Support the Customer Service Manager in reviewing, maintaining, and updating Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) to ensure Customer Service processes remain accurate, current, and aligned with operational requirements. Conduct periodic reviews of SOPs and identify opportunities for process clarification and improvement. 

Operational Governance, Compliance, And Continuous Improvement

- Develop, maintain, and improve Customer Success policies, SOPs, operating procedures, knowledge resources, and controls to support consistent and compliant execution. 
 - Ensure adherence to applicable requirements for controlled substances, permits, customs, foreign licensing, shipments, and order documentation. 
 - Monitor reporting and database accuracy; analyze service, quality, volume, productivity, and complaint data to identify trends, risks, and opportunities. 
 - Lead or support improvements that strengthen customer experience, service quality, efficiency, productivity, cost effectiveness, and organizational readiness. 
 - Maintain current knowledge of USP products, service, systems, and Customer Success practices, and perform other related duties or special projects as assigned. 
 - The Supervisor supports for ISO audits within the India Customer Success department, coordinating audit activities, maintaining compliance documentation, driving corrective actions, and ensuring adherence to established quality management standards. 

Who is USP Looking For?

Education & Experience

The successful candidate will have a demonstrated understanding of our mission, commitment to excellence through inclusive and equitable behaviors and practices, ability to quickly build credibility with stakeholders, along with the following competencies and experience: 

- Bachelor's degree required in a business, sales or related field. 
 - Minimum of seven (7) years of experience in Customer Success, Sales, or related field in a multi-cultural environment, preferably for a global organization. 
 - Experience with artificial intelligence (AI), automation, or other emerging technologies in a customer service or business environment is highly desirable. Relevant AI-related training or certifications are considered a strong plus. 
 - Previous experience in an Order to Cash environment required. 

Skills & Competencies

- Fluency in English required, and a second language strongly preferred. 
 - Willingness to work in rotational shifts. 
 - Customer Success focused and ability to provide a high degree of customer Success. 
 - Must possess ability to handle multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment with a high level for stress tolerance while maintaining composure and enthusiasm. 
 - Excellent organization, problem analysis, problem solving and decision-making skills, and attention to details required. 
 - Excellent communication skills (written and oral) and presentation skills are a must. 
 - Individuals must possess the ability to influence without direct authority. 
 - Results driven with demonstrated successful outcomes. 
 - Excellent supervisory skills with a history of building high performing and motivated teams. 
 - Strong team builder and people leader with the ability and desire to work well with diverse employees and customers in a cooperative and friendly manner. 
 - Must be able to work independently and in a team environment. 
 - Must be highly proficient in the use of Microsoft software (word processing, email, spreadsheet, database, and Internet). 
 - Proficiency in Oracle and CRM systems desired. 
 - Familiarity with automated order entry systems, Ariba or other EDI processes a plus. 
 - Good understanding of complaint handling and resolution management. 
 - Familiarity with imports, exports, customs, and business with other countries strongly preferred. 
 - Familiarity with the culture(s) in the applicable geography(s) is strongly preferred. 
 - Candidates must be able to work flexible hours, when needed. 

Supervisory Responsibilities

Yes

Benefits

USP provides the benefits to protect yourself and your family today and tomorrow. From company-paid time off and comprehensive healthcare options to retirement savings, you can have peace of mind that your personal and financial well-being is protected.

data.title: Staff Software Engineer, Backend
data.description:
The world still has coverage blind spots. You could help eliminate them at Skylo. 

Skylo has pioneered a standards-based approach to satellite connectivity. We connect smartphones and IoT devices directly to satellites. No special hardware, no entirely new networks. Just billions of existing devices, suddenly reachable anywhere on Earth. We're not building toward this future. We're already in it. 

Our direct-to-device service is live on millions of activated devices across five continents, covering more than 72 million square kilometers, in partnership with leading satellite operators, mobile network operators, Tier-1 chipset makers, and OEMs worldwide. And we're just getting started. 

At the heart of it all is Skylo's commercial NTN vRAN: a 3GPP standards-based, cloud-native platform that seamlessly bridges terrestrial and satellite networks. It's the infrastructure that makes true anywhere, anytime connectivity possible. 

When you join Skylo, you'll work at the intersection of three markets reshaping how the world stays connected: mass-market consumer devices, automotive, and industrial IoT. Enabling people outdoors and critical workflows in the world's most remote places. 

This is a rare chance to work on technology that matters, at a company that's already proving it works

This role is located in Bangalore, India where we are onsite 3 days a week in office. 

Summary Of How You Will Impact Skylo

Skylo is hiring a Staff Software Engineer - Backend to help fulfill our mission of making satellite connectivity available to all. In this role, you will be a key contributor to the design, architecture, and implementation of the Skylo Data Mobility Platform or/and Subscriber & Provisioning Platform. You will be instrumental in creating best-in-class software infrastructure solutions, combining your deep technical knowledge with a passion for excellence. Your work will directly support the development of cloud services and the deployment of a highly scalable and resilient cloud-based software platform. You will also contribute to building cloud systems that are resilient, secure, and address data privacy. 

How You Will Contribute

- Lead the design, implementation, and testing of larger features and components. 
 - Work closely with junior engineers, implementing best practices and actively engaging in design and code reviews. 
 - Design and develop distributed application services, microservices, and scalable database systems. 
 - Define, design, and implement REST APIs, building out Swagger UI and Postman collections. 
 - Develop applications using Java/GoLang, GCP Pub/Sub, SQL DB, and Web hook integration. 
 - Implement unit testing using JUnit for Java and standard testing frameworks for Go. 
 - Integrate with third-party application systems using REST APIs and/or messaging queues. 
 - Define and execute component test scenarios and test cases, including unit testing, code coverage, and API test automation. 
 - Participate in build and deployment processes using tools like Jira, Jenkins, GCR/GKE. 
 - Enforce security best practices in both software development and deployment. 
 - Drive observability using Prometheus and log/data collectors for monitoring and diagnostics. 
 - Evaluate and adopt new technologies to improve system performance and developer productivity. 

What We Look For

- 8+ years of experience in professional software development with a focus on object-oriented programming (OOP) and distributed microservices. 
 - A Master's or Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. 
 - Wide-ranging experience with cloud technologies and tech stacks, with the ability to resolve complex issues creatively and effectively. 
 - Proficiency in Java and Go programming languages. 
 - Experience developing microservices using the Spring-Boot framework or Go language frameworks. 
 - Expertise in query optimization, partitioning, and performance tuning in SQL and big data query engines. 
 - Prior working experience with messaging brokers like Kafka or GCP Pub/Sub to build event-driven microservices architectures. 
 - Experience with REST API and gRPC design. 
 - Strong understanding of distributed systems for massive horizontal scaling. 
 - Working experience with Kubernetes, Docker, Jenkins, and GCP. 
 - Solid understanding of database technologies, including Redis, SQL (e. g. , PostgreSQL, MySQL), and NoSQL (e. g. , MongoDB, DynamoDB). 
 - Strong problem-solving and communication skills, with the ability to lead technical discussions.

Skylo is an equal-opportunity employer and we celebrate diversity. data.description:
Date Posted: 

2026-10-29

Country: 

India

Location: 

IN-KA-BENGALURU-BLDG 3 ~ Plot No 132 to 167 ~ BLDG 3, Hi-Tech Defence & Aerospace Park

Position Role Type: 

Onsite

At RTX, the world's largest aerospace and defense company, 185, 000 great minds are united by purpose and inspired to make a difference solving the world's most complex problems. With our three market leading businesses, world-class operations and investments in research and development, we offer capabilities and opportunity no one else can. Together, we push the boundaries of known science and find new ways to connect and protect our world. 

Collins Aerospace is a leader in technologically advanced, intelligent solutions that help redefine the aerospace and defense industry. With a comprehensive portfolio and deep technical expertise, we help customers meet the demands of the global market. Join us and help shape the future of aerospace and defense. 

About RTX

RTX is a global aerospace and defense company with more than 185, 000 employees worldwide. We push the boundaries of technology and innovation to help create a safer, more connected world. Through our industry-leading businesses-Collins Aerospace, Pratt & Whitney, and Raytheon-we deliver advanced solutions for commercial aviation, defense, and connected technologies. 

About Collins Aerospace

Collins Aerospace, an RTX business, is a leader in aerospace and defense technologies, delivering intelligent solutions that redefine the future of aviation. Our Digital Technology (DT) organization enables business transformation by providing secure, scalable, and innovative digital solutions that support our global operations, customers, and suppliers. 

Join our Digital Technology team and play a key role in driving digital transformation across our global Supply Chain organization while collaborating with talented professionals around the world. 

Job Overview

As a Senior Associate Manager - Quality for Lighting Value stream at Collins Aerospace, you are responsible for leading incoming inspection of buy parts, assemblies, and COTS parts to ensure compliance with engineering drawings, specifications, and quality requirements. 

Manage and develop the inspection team, including workload allocation, competency development, and daily Tier 1/2 meetings. Drive quality performance through QN management, block stock disposition, QIP updates, supplier corrective actions, and continuous improvement initiatives. 

Ensure documentation, traceability, and compliance with AS9100 and Collins ASQR requirements while coordinating with Supplier Quality, SCM, Engineering, Manufacturing, and Warehouse teams. 

What You Will Do: 

Key Responsibilities: 

- Incoming Buy Parts Inspection
 - Supervise inspection of Buy parts, assemblies, COTs parts and other supplier-delivered products. 
 - Verify suppliers' parts against engineering drawings, specifications, purchase orders, and other applicable quality requirements. 
 - Ensure proper sampling plans and inspection methods are followed at inspection process. 
 - Review inspection records on regular basis for effectiveness. 
 - QN creation and communication to SQE focal with 5 working days from NC identified. 
 - Monitor the block stock for SLT1 and MRB1 & MRB3 disposition in same month or 30 days. 
 - Team Leadership
 - Lead, train, coach, and evaluate receiving inspection personnel. 
 - Assign daily workloads and prioritize inspection activities. 
 - Ensure adherence to quality procedures and safety requirements. 
 - Support employee development and competency assessments. 
 - Tier 1 meeting board should be maintain and updation on daily basis. 
 - Conduct tier1 meeting on daily basis. 
 - Quality Management
 - Develop and maintain receiving inspection procedures and work instructions . 
 - Monitor inspection cycle times, and incoming quality levels. Ammendment QIP as applicable. 
 - Drive continuous improvement initiatives to reduce defects and improve efficiency at inspection process and block stock. 
 - Participate in audits and support compliance with quality management systems. 
 - Supplier Quality Coordination
 - Investigate incoming material nonconformances. 
 - Coordinate corrective and preventive actions (CAPA) with suppliers. 
 - Work with Supplier Quality focal and SCM Focal to resolve recurring quality issues. 
 - Review supplier performance data and support supplier qualification activities. 
 - Documentation & Compliance
 - Maintain inspection reports, nonconformance reports (NCRs), and quality records. 
 - Ensure compliance with standards such as: 
 - AS9100 (Aerospace)
 - COL-ASQR-PRO-0003 COLLINS follow down requirements. 
 - Regulatory requirements applicable to the industry. 
 - Support internal, customer, and regulatory audits. 
 - All inspection records /documents scanned copy shall be maintain on weekly basis. 
 - Cross-Functional Collaboration
 - Collaborate with Manufacturing, Engineering, Supply Chain, and Warehouse teams. 
 - Participate in Material Review Board (MRB) activities. 
 - Assist in root cause analysis and problem-solving efforts

What You Will Learn

- Gain hands-on experience in Incoming inspection , nonconformance management, QN creation, block stock monitoring, and MRB disposition processes. 
 - Strengthen team leadership, workload planning, daily Tier 1 management, employee coaching, and competency development skills. 
 - Learn to monitor inspection performance metrics, improve cycle times, update QIPs, and drive continuous improvement initiatives. 
 - Develop knowledge of supplier quality management, CAPA coordination, root cause analysis, and supplier performance improvement. 
 - Gain expertise in aerospace quality standards, including AS9100 and Collins ASQR requirements, documentation control, and audit compliance. 
 - Enhance cross-functional collaboration with Supplier Quality, Supply Chain Management, Engineering, Manufacturing, and Warehouse teams. 
 - Strengthen problem-solving, decision-making, stakeholder management, and quality process improvement skills. 
 - Strengthen your leadership, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills. 

Qualifications You Must Have

- Bachelor's degree in Engineering -Mechanical / Electronics, or a related field with 7-10 years of experience. 

Working knowledge of: 

- Quality Function - Aerospace / Automotive

Experience in: 

- Six sigma
 - SAP - Quality Function T-Codes
 - FAI as per AS9102
 - Strong communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills. 
 - Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively in a global team environment. 

Qualifications We Prefer

- B. E (Mechanical / Electronics) with 7-10 years of experience. 
 - Strong on GD&T Measurements
 - CMM operation Skill benefit - Additional advantage

WE ARE REDEFINING AEROSPACE. 

- Please consider the following role type definitions as you apply for this role. 

Onsite: Employees who are working in Onsite roles will work primarily onsite. This includes all production and maintenance employees, as they are essential to the development of our products. 

Benefits package includes: 

- Meal coupons
 - Group Term Life Insurance. 
 - Group Health Insurance. 
 - Group Personal Accident Insurance. 
 - Entitled for 18 days of vacation and 12 days of contingency leave annually. 
 - Employee scholar programme. 
 - Work life balance. 
 - Car lease programme. 
 - National Pension Scheme
 - LTA
 - Fuel & Maintenance /Driver wages
 - Meal vouchers

Nothing matters more to Collins Aerospace than our strong ethical and safety commitments. As such, all India positions require a background check, which may include a drug screen. 

Note: 

- Background check and drug screen required (every external new hire in the India)

At Collins, the paths we pave together lead to limitless possibility. And the bonds we form - with our customers and with each other -- propel us all higher, again and again. 

Apply now and be part of the team that's redefining

data.description:
Project Role : Custom Software Engineer

Project Role Description : Develop custom software solutions to design, code, and enhance components across systems or applications. Use modern frameworks and agile practices to deliver scalable, high-performing solutions tailored to specific business needs. 

Must have skills : Embedded Product Verification & Validation

Good to have skills : NA

Minimum 5 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required

Educational Qualification : Bachelor or Master of Engineering in Electronics or Electrical or Instrumentation

Summary: 

As a test lead you will act as an interface in the areas of testing, validation, integration, and requirements management. You will coordinate with team members across global locations. You will actively participate in building and developing the testing team in the areas of test development, test execution, test environment development and maintenance, guidance and technical mentorship. 

Roles & Responsibilities: 

You will be responsible for developing test strategies, specifying new test cases and implementing automated test suites. 

You will analyze and interpret the obtained test results, discuss them with technical experts, and support in optimizing the testing processes. 

You will be responsible for testing the infotainment systems Features such as Media, BT, Wi-Fi, Navigation etc. , in close cooperation with our customers and process partners. 

Professional & Technical Skills: 

Overall, 9 years of experience in testing and Validation in the automotive domain. 

You have gained practical experience on test automation with programming language such as Python or C#. 

You have hands-on experience in assembling a test bench (HIL) and are comfortable working with hardware and electrical components. 

Very good knowledge in Vector tools like CANoe, CANape. 

Experience with Confluence, Jira, DOORs

Good experience of Ethernet, CAN and LIN protocols. 

System and Sub system Knowledge of Automotive ECUs. 

Experience on Requirement Understanding, Configuration Management, Bug Tracking Tool, Change management Tool

You have experience in test strategy creation, test planning, and tooling enablement. 

You offer guidance and mentoring to teams in regard to technology usage

You are an excellent team player with very good communication skills. 

You have a strong ability to think analytically you have a well-established professional network and have an independent and structured way of working. 

You are excellent at solving problems and debugging. 

You are a confident communicator and have highly developed interpersonal skills

Additional Information: 

- The candidate should have minimum 9 years of experience in Embedded Product Verification & Validation. 
 - This position is based at our Bengaluru office. 
 - A Bachelor or Master of Engineering in Electronics or Electrical or Instrumentation is required.

data.title: MCCB Product Engineer
data.description:
At Capgemini Engineering, the world leader in engineering services, we bring together a global team of engineers, scientists, and architects to help the world's most innovative companies unleash their potential. From autonomous cars to life-saving robots, our digital and software technology experts think outside the box as they provide unique R&D and engineering services across all industries. Join us for a career full of opportunities. Where you can make a difference. Where no two days are the same. 

Job Description

MCCB Product Engineering Lead

Location: Bangalore

Experience: 13+ Years

About The Role

We are seeking an experienced MCCB Product Engineering Lead with expertise in product development, industrialization, manufacturing processes, validation, and quality engineering for low-voltage switchgear products. The role requires strong technical leadership to drive new product introduction, supplier development, testing, and manufacturing excellence. 

Your Role

As an MCCB Product Engineering Lead, you will be responsible for leading product engineering and industrialization activities for MCCB products, ensuring successful product launches, quality compliance, and continuous improvement across the product lifecycle. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead MCCB product engineering activities from design support through industrialization and production ramp-up. 
 - Drive New Product Introduction (NPI) programs including pilot builds, process qualification, and manufacturing readiness. 
 - Provide technical expertise on MCCB architecture, protection systems, operating mechanisms, and critical components. 
 - Collaborate with design, manufacturing, quality, testing, and supplier teams to ensure robust product performance. 
 - Support manufacturing processes including moulding, stamping, forming, plating, joining, assembly, calibration, and testing. 
 - Review and validate plastic, rubber, and sheet-metal components for manufacturability, quality, and reliability. 
 - Execute APQP activities including PFMEA, Process Flow, Control Plan, MSA, Cp/Cpk studies, and PPAP deliverables. 
 - Lead validation and compliance testing as per IEC 60947-2 standards. 
 - Perform root cause analysis for product, process, supplier, and field failures and drive corrective actions. 
 - Support supplier qualification, component development, process audits, and continuous improvement initiatives. 
 - Mentor junior engineers and provide technical leadership across cross-functional teams. 

Required Skills & Experience

- 13+ years of experience in MCCB product engineering, manufacturing engineering, or industrialization. 
 - Strong hands-on knowledge of MCCB architecture, protection mechanisms, and components. 
 - Proven experience executing NPI, pilot production, process release, and ramp-up activities. 
 - Extensive knowledge of manufacturing processes including injection moulding, stamping, sheet-metal fabrication, assembly, and testing. 
 - Strong understanding of engineering plastics, copper alloys, steels, contact materials, bimetals, elastomers, and coatings. 
 - Hands-on experience with APQP, PPAP, PFMEA, MSA, Control Plans, and process capability analysis. 
 - Knowledge of IEC 60947-2 testing including temperature rise, dielectric, overload, endurance, and trip testing. 
 - Expertise in failure analysis, problem-solving methodologies, and corrective/preventive actions. 
 - Experience in supplier development, supplier qualification, and technical leadership. 
 - Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and collaboration skills. 

What You'll Love About Working Here

We value flexibility and support our employees with remote work options and adaptable schedules to maintain a healthy work-life balance. 

Our inclusive culture brings together diverse professionals committed to growth, innovation, and excellence. 

You'll have access to continuous learning opportunities and certifications in emerging technologies like cloud and AI. 

At Capgemini Engineering, the world leader in engineering services, we bring together a global team of engineers, scientists, and architects to help the world's most innovative companies unleash their potential. From autonomous cars to life-saving robots, our digital and software technology experts think outside the box as they provide unique R&D and engineering services across all industries. Join us for a career full of opportunities. Where you can make a difference. Where no two days are the same.

data.title: Principal Software Developer (software installation and deployment solutions)
data.description:
The driving force behind our success has always been the people of AspenTech. What drives us, is our aspiration, our desire and ambition to keep pushing the envelope, overcoming any hurdle, challenging the status quo to continually find a better way. You will experience these qualities of passion, pride and aspiration in many ways - from a rich set of career development programs to support of community service projects to social events that foster fun and relationship building across our global community. 

The Role

We are seeking an experienced Installation Developer with 7-12 years of software development experience and strong expertise in Windows and/or Linux environments to design, develop, and maintain reliable software installation and deployment solutions. 

The ideal candidate will have strong knowledge of installation technologies, demonstrated programming and scripting skills, and experience working collaboratively in an Agile development environment. The candidate should also be able to effectively leverage AI-assisted development tools to improve productivity, accelerate troubleshooting and development, enhance testing and documentation, and deliver high-quality software solutions while applying appropriate engineering judgment to validate AI-generated code and recommendations. 

Your Impact

- Design, develop, test, and maintain installation packages and deployment solutions for Windows and Linux platforms. 
 - Utilize Windows Installer and other installation technologies to deliver reliable, maintainable, and scalable installation solutions. 
 - Develop and maintain installation tools, automation, and scripts using C#, PowerShell, Bash, and C++. 
 - Leverage InstallShield for advanced installation packaging, configuration, and deployment requirements. 
 - Effectively utilize AI-assisted development tools to accelerate coding, scripting, debugging, troubleshooting, testing, code review, and technical documentation. 
 - Apply engineering judgment to review and validate AI-generated code and recommendations, ensuring solutions meet established standards for correctness, security, performance, and maintainability. 
 - Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define installation requirements, deployment strategies, and technical solutions. 
 - Work with container technologies, such as Docker and Kubernetes, to support modern deployment environments. 
 - Integrate installation and deployment processes with version control systems such as Git and Perforce and automated CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Support database configuration and connectivity requirements for SQL and NoSQL database systems as part of installation and deployment workflows. 
 - Troubleshoot, debug, perform root-cause analysis, and resolve complex installation and deployment issues. 
 - Develop automated tests and validation processes to improve the quality and reliability of installation solutions. 
 - Follow Agile development practices and established software engineering standards to deliver high-quality solutions in a timely manner. 
 - Identify opportunities to improve installation processes through automation, AI-assisted development, and adoption of modern engineering practices. 

What You'll Need

- 7-12 years of software development experience, preferably involving software installation, deployment, build, release, or related technologies. 
 - Strong knowledge of Windows and/or Linux operating systems, including software installation, configuration, and deployment concepts. 
 - Strong experience with Windows Installer technology and InstallShield, or comparable enterprise installation technologies. 
 - Strong proficiency in one or more relevant programming and scripting languages, including C#, C++, PowerShell, and Bash. 
 - Experience with container technologies, such as Docker and Kubernetes, and an understanding of containerized software deployment. 
 - Demonstrated ability to effectively use or rapidly adopt AI-assisted software development tools to improve coding, debugging, testing, troubleshooting, documentation, and overall engineering productivity. 
 - Ability to critically evaluate and validate AI-generated code and technical recommendations, applying sound software engineering principles and appropriate human oversight. 
 - Solid understanding of software installation and deployment processes, CI/CD, automation, and software engineering best practices. 
 - Experience working in an Agile software development environment. 
 - Familiarity with SQL and NoSQL database technologies and their installation and configuration requirements. 
 - Experience with version control systems such as Git and Perforce. 
 - Strong problem-solving, debugging, and analytical skills, with the ability to investigate complex technical issues and develop sustainable solutions.

Job Title: Lead - Performance Tester

Experience: 8+ years of experience in Performance Testing

Job Location: Bangalore / Chennai

Position ID: J1026-2520

Work Type: Hybrid

Employment Type: Full Time / Permanent

Qualification: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. 

Practice / Domain: Digital Experience, API Integration & Retail/Lubricants Ecosystem

Role Summary & Context: The Lead Performance Engineer / Performance Tester will design, script, execute, and analyze high volume load, stress, scalability, and endurance testing across the entire unified experience stack. You will partner with Frontend, Integration, and Core ERP Engineering teams to define nonfunctional requirements (NFRs), map user journeys to realistic volumetric load models, configure specialized performance testing tools, and diagnose critical bottlenecks in multi tier, distributed cloud environments. 

This role requires a proactive professional who does not simply report metrics but actively isolates performance failures (such as memory leaks, thread contention, and slow database queries) and collaborates with development teams to implement architectural, code, and database optimizations. 

Key Responsibilities: 

Performance Strategy & Volumetric Modeling: 

- Define, document, and refine Non Functional Requirements (NFRs) (e. g. , Response Time, Throughput, Concurrent Users, Resource Utilization) for the unified digital front door. 
 - Formulate robust, data driven Performance Test Plans based on production telemetry and realistic regional workload patterns across distributors and workshop centers. 
 - Model comprehensive test scenarios encompassing Load, Stress, Endurance/Soak, Spike, and Failover/Resilience testing. 

Test Automation, Scripting & Execution

- Develop, maintain, and execute highly parameterized performance test scripts utilizing industry standard tools (e. g. , JMeter, Gatling, or HP LoadRunner/Performance Center). 
 - Simulate complex multi step APIs, event driven integrations (Kafka/Azure Event Grid), and distributed state machine operations (Camunda workflows) under varying load conditions. 
 - Design and execute performance testing pipelines integrated seamlessly with CI/CD practices (Azure DevOps / GitHub Actions) for automated regression level performance checks. 

Deep Dive Bottleneck Analysis & Profiling

- Utilize modern Application Performance Monitoring (APM) and observability tools (e. g. , Dynatrace, AppDynamics, New Relic, or Datadog) to gain end to end transaction visibility. 
 - Investigate latency across the entire user journey: from React/Next. js frontend rendering, API Gateway forwarding (Azure APIM/Kong), BFF processing, Java Spring Boot microservices execution, and Camunda state engine hops, down to target SAP ERP connector calls. 
 - Perform log analysis, database query profiling, JVM heap dump analysis, and thread contention investigations to isolate the root cause of high response times and error rates. 

Collaboration, Reporting & Optimization

- Collaborate closely with Infrastructure, Database Administration, and Cloud Operations teams to tune systems (e. g. , JVM sizing, database connection pools, Kubernetes container scaling parameters, Redis caching strategies). 
 - Publish detailed performance execution reports with actionable recommendations for senior engineering leadership and program stakeholders. 

Required Qualifications & Technical Stack

- Professional Experience: 8+ years of experience in Performance Testing / Performance Engineering, with a proven track record of testing high scale, distributed B2B or B2B2C cloud applications. 
 - Testing Toolsets: Mastery of Apache JMeter or Gatling (Scala/Java based writing) is required. Experience with commercial suites (LoadRunner/NeoLoad) is a strong plus. 
 - Observability & APM: Hands on experience using modern APM platforms (specifically Dynatrace, Datadog, or AppDynamics) to analyze transaction traces and isolate resource bottlenecks. 
 - API & Integration Testing: Deep expertise in load testing REST/SOAP APIs, microservices architectures, and asynchronous event brokers (specifically Apache Kafka). 
 - Environment & Infrastructure: Solid understanding of cloud native infrastructure concepts (Kubernetes, AWS/Azure configurations, and container scaling policies). 

Database & Caching Profiling: Experience identifying slow SQL/NoSQL queries and evaluating the effectiveness of caching layers (such as Redis).
