data.title: Software Engineer - Cloud Native BNG Solution Testing, Scale & Performance, Python | 4-8 years
data.description:
Meet the Team

The Cisco cnBNG Solution Testing team validates carrier-grade broadband solutions running on IOS-XR routing platforms, including Cisco 8000, ASR 9000, and NCS 5500/5700. Our focus is ensuring that cnBNG solutions meet demanding service-provider requirements for functionality, scale, performance, resiliency, interoperability, and operational readiness. We validate the cnBNG solution end-to-end across Control Plane and User Plane functions, subscriber protocols, forwarding, high availability, and platform infrastructure. We operate at the intersection of software, hardware, networking, and customer deployments, with an automation-first approach and responsible adoption of AI-assisted engineering practices. 

Your Impact

As a Software Engineer in the cnBNG Solution Testing team, you will own end-to-end solution, scale, performance, and resiliency validation of cnBNG deployments. 

You will design sophisticated service-provider network topologies, develop comprehensive test strategies, automate large-scale subscriber and traffic scenarios, and validate the system under realistic customer workloads. You will work extensively with traffic-generation platforms such as Keysight IXIA and Spirent, analyze system and forwarding performance, identify bottlenecks, and collaborate with development teams to drive defects to resolution. 

- You will play a critical role in assessing product quality and providing evidence-based recommendations for release readiness. 
 - Design and implement end-to-end cnBNG solution testing across Control Plane, User Plane, subscriber management, forwarding, platform infrastructure, and external network elements. 
 - Own scale and performance qualification, including subscriber scale, session setup/teardown rates, throughput, latency, packet loss, convergence, CPU/memory utilization, and system behavior under sustained load. 
 - Develop realistic service-provider test topologies covering PPPoE, IPoE, DHCPv4/v6, PPP, RADIUS/CoA, L2TP, subscriber policies, accounting, QoS, and subscriber lifecycle scenarios. 
 - Build and validate large-scale cnBNG deployments with multiple Control Plane and User Plane nodes. Develop strong proficiency with Keysight IXIA and Spirent traffic generators, including subscriber emulation, protocol emulation, traffic generation, traffic analysis, performance benchmarking, and large-scale test execution. 
 - Create traffic profiles that model real-world broadband deployments, including mixed IPv4/IPv6 traffic, multiple packet sizes, bidirectional traffic, QoS classes, and subscriber service profiles. 
 - Validate CUPS / CP-UP separation, including session programming, state synchronization, state replay, reconciliation, Control Plane and User Plane failures, and recovery scenarios. 
 - Perform comprehensive high-availability and resiliency testing, including SRG geo/warm standby, process restart, node failures, link failures, ISSU, NSR/NSF, control-plane failures, and subscriber session continuity. 
 - Validate IOS-XR forwarding functionality including L2/L3 forwarding, FIB/adjacency, MPLS/L3VPN, H-QoS/policing, ACLs, mirroring, OAM/BFD, slowpath, and NPU forwarding behavior. 
 - Develop and maintain scalable Python-based test automation using pyATS/Genie or equivalent frameworks, integrating tests into CI/CD pipelines and regression suites. 
 - Build reusable automation libraries for topology setup, subscriber provisioning, traffic generation, fault injection, statistics collection, verification, and automated result analysis. 
 - Analyze performance trends and identify bottlenecks across software, forwarding hardware, NPU resources, CPU, memory, and control-plane interactions. 
 - Perform soak, longevity, stress, negative, boundary, and capacity testing to uncover issues that may only appear under sustained or extreme workloads. 
 - Validate subscriber QoS, accounting, lawful intercept, policy enforcement, and other service-provider features under functional and scale conditions. 
 - Validate CLI, YANG models, model-driven telemetry, gRPC/NETCONF/gNMI, and operational data required for managing and troubleshooting large cnBNG deployments. 
 - Debug sophisticated solution-level issues using IOS-XR logs, traces, telemetry, packet captures, core dumps, IXIA/Spirent statistics, and platform/NPU diagnostics. 
 - Perform detailed root-cause isolation, determining whether failures originate in the Control Plane, User Plane, forwarding infrastructure, Silicon One NPU, automation environment, traffic generator, or external network components. 
 - Partner closely with development, platform, system architecture, and customer-facing engineering teams to reproduce defects and drive them to closure. 
 - Define measurable test exit criteria and provide data-driven release-quality and readiness recommendations based on functional, scale, performance, and resiliency results. 
 - Use Git and modern software-development practices for automation code, test reviews, defect management, and CI/CD integration. 
 - Actively use approved AI coding assistants and engineering agents for automation development, test generation, log analysis, failure clustering, defect analysis, and troubleshooting while responsibly validating AI-generated output. 
 - Mentor junior engineers and help improve solution-testing methodology, automation architecture, scale infrastructure, and overall engineering quality. 

Minimum Qualifications (Must-Have)

- Bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Computer Engineering, 
 - Telecommunications, or a related field. Strong experience in system, solution, scale, performance, and resiliency testing of networking products or carrier-grade networking solutions. 
 - Strong understanding of test methodologies covering functional, integration, system, regression, scale, performance, stress, longevity, failover, and high-availability testing. 
 - Hands-on expertise with Keysight IXIA and/or Spirent traffic-generation platforms, including
 - protocol emulation, subscriber emulation, traffic generation, scale testing, and performance analysis. 
 - Strong Python programming and experience developing scalable test automation using pyATS/
 - Genie or equivalent frameworks. 
 - Experience integrating automated test suites into CI/CD and continuous regression pipelines. 
 - Strong IP networking fundamentals, including L2/L3 forwarding, IPv4/IPv6, routing, MPLS/L3VPN, and QoS. Knowledge of broadband/subscriber technologies and protocols including PPPoE, IPoE, DHCPv4/v6, PPP, RADIUS/CoA, and L2TP. 
 - Experience configuring, validating, and solving IOS-XR or another carrier-grade network operating system. 
 - Ability to design and implement large-scale network topologies and systematically characterize capacity, throughput, latency, convergence, resource utilization, and failure recovery. 
 - Strong understanding of high availability, duplication, subscriber-state management, and fault- recovery mechanisms. 
 - Strong Linux skills and experience with Git, debugging tools, packet collections, logs, telemetry, and defect-management systems. 
 - Strong solving and analytical skills with the ability to isolate sophisticated issues across traffic generators, network protocols, software, hardware, and forwarding layers. 
 - AI-assisted engineering is a must: use of AI coding assistants such as GitHub Copilot and a working understanding of generative AI, AI agents, MCP (Model Context Protocol), reusable AI skills, prompt/context management, and responsible validation of AI-generated output, including AI-assisted log and defect analysis. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience validating cnBNG, BNG, or broadband subscriber solutions. 
 - Experience with CUPS / Control Plane-User Plane separation and large-scale distributed User
 - Plane deployments. 
 - Sophisticated experience with IXIA BreakingPoint/IxNetwork and/or Spirent Test Center, including automation APIs and large-scale subscriber/traffic emulation. 
 - Experience with Cisco 8000, ASR 9000, NCS 5500/5700, Silicon One, or comparable carrier-grade routing platforms and NPUs. Experience validating subscriber scale, session churn, traffic performance, convergence, and long-duration stability. 
 - Experience with SRG geo/warm excess, ISSU, NSR/NSF, and service continuity testing. 
 - Knowledge of SRv6/Segment Routing, MPLS, EVPN/VPLS, TE/GRE tunnels, BFD, BGP Flowspec, and ACLs. Experience with YANG, gRPC, NETCONF, gNMI, OpenConfig, and telemetry. Experience building automated performance dashboards, test-result analytics, failure classification, and regression trend analysis. 
 - Familiarity with Aha/Jira APIs engineering and defect-management integrations. 

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we're revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era - and beyond. We've been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint. 

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you'll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. 

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you. 

Disclaimer

About

To ensure that we hire the best talent in the right way, we follow a strict hiring process and recently, Cisco has been made aware of fraudulent recruiters claiming to be from the company. Please be advised that any communication from Cisco about careers will: 

- be in direct response to an application you have submitted through the company career site

Cisco will never make a job offer without conducting an interview process or ask you for money in any way. If you have been requested to apply for a role or have received an offer from a site other than https: //careers. cisco. com or cisco. wd5. myworkday. com, do not provide any personal identifying information, including your Aadhaar or other personal identifying number, birth certificate, banking information, driver's license, or passport. 

If you are the target of a recruiting scam, consider filing a report with your local law enforcement authorities. Cisco bears no responsibility, and cannot be held liable, for any claims, damages, expenses, or other inconvenience resulting from or in any way connected to recruiting scams.

In this role at PwC Acceleration Center Bangalore, you will shape solution architecture, support client discussions, and help translate data science and AI concepts into practical business outcomes across AI-Driven Automation & Cognitive Solutions and Data, Analytics & AI. 

Responsibilities

data.title: Staff Software Engineer - CTV (Ad Server)
data.description:
About The Role

PubMatic is looking for a Staff Software Engineer to help architect and evolve our next-generation, highly scalable, low-latency AdServer for Connected TV (CTV) - operating at a scale of 1 trillion+ requests per day and managing millions of requests per second. This is a technical leadership role for an engineer who wants to shape the architectural direction of the CTV AdServer platform, not just one team's roadmap, in one of the fastest-growing areas of programmatic advertising. If you thrive on solving distributed-systems problems at extreme scale, enjoy influencing engineering direction across multiple teams, and want to be one of the most senior technical voices in the organization, we'd love to talk to you. 

What You'll Do

- Product & Architecture Influence: Influence multiple teams across the AdServer organization by defining and reviewing product and platform architecture and implementations. Identify architectural risks early and propose alternatives and solutions that hold up at trillion-scale. 
 - Architectural Oversight: Oversee the design and implementation of critical platform components by maintaining in-depth knowledge of best practices, technologies, architectures, and emerging technologies, and by setting the technical bar for the AdServer engineering organization. 
 - Standards & Decisions: Document and communicate exceptions to architectural standards by capturing significant architectural decisions (ADRs), ensuring decisions and their rationale are visible, durable, and reusable across teams. 
 - Own end-to-end technical direction for the AdServer platform - partnering with Principal and Senior Principal Engineers, Engineering Leads, and Product Leads to translate business needs into a coherent, multi-quarter technical roadmap. 
 - Lead the design and evolution of highly reliable, scalable, low-latency distributed backend platforms and services, and set the technical direction that other teams build on. 
 - Drive research into emerging technologies, sponsor proof-of-concepts, and make build/adopt decisions that materially move the platform forward. 
 - Act as a technical escalation point across teams - auditing designs for platform stability, reviewing major architecture changes across the AdServer Development Team, and unblocking the hardest cross-cutting problems. 
 - Partner with Data Center and DevOps teams on long-range technical planning - new technology adoption, software optimization strategy, and stability roadmaps for the overall platform. 
 - Mentor and raise the technical bar of Principal and Senior Principal Engineers, and other senior ICs, through design reviews, architecture forums, and hands-on technical guidance. 
 - Champion engineering best practices and documentation standards across teams; ensure designs meet requirements and that platform-wide work meets a consistently high quality bar. 
 - Drive the application of GenAI across the software development lifecycle - design, coding, testing, and documentation - and help set the standard for AI-enabled engineering across the org. 

We'd Love for You to Have

- 14+ years of hands-on development experience in C/C++ in a Linux/UNIX environment, with a track record of shipping and evolving large-scale distributed systems. Experience with Go is a strong plus. 
 - Demonstrated experience defining architecture and technical direction across multiple teams or a full platform, not just a single service or team. 
 - Deep proficiency in algorithms and advanced data structures, with a strong foundation in core computer science principles. 
 - Extensive experience in software design and architecture for complex, scalable, low-latency, high-throughput systems. 
 - A track record of identifying architectural risk ahead of time and driving alternatives that are adopted broadly. 
 - Ability to write and review architectural decision records, and to communicate trade-offs clearly to both engineering and product stakeholders. 
 - Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to find optimal, innovative solutions to open-ended technical problems. 
 - Strong working knowledge of generative AI-based tools and IDEs to accelerate development; comfort with prompt engineering fundamentals and an understanding of different model types at a working level. 
 - Deep knowledge of OS internals and systems programming - multi-threading, multi-processing, and memory management - and the ability to troubleshoot the hardest production issues. 
 - Ability to write clean, modular, loosely coupled code, and to hold others to that same bar through review. 
 - Strong end-to-end understanding of product functionality across the platform, not just an individual component. 
 - Working knowledge of scripting (Perl/Python/Shell) and databases (preferably MySQL). 
 - Excellent interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills, with experience influencing senior stakeholders and driving alignment across teams without direct authority. 

Good To Have - CTV Domain Experience

- Prior hands-on experience building or scaling ad serving, ad decisioning, or real-time bidding systems specifically for Connected TV (CTV) / OTT. 
 - Working knowledge of CTV-specific technical protocols and standards - e. g. VAST/VPAID/VMAP, SSAI (server-side ad insertion) and CSAI, HLS/DASH manifest manipulation, and IAB CTV/OTT specifications. 
 - Understanding of the CTV supply chain and its unique constraints - device- and app-level identifiers (e. g. IFA, RIDA), frequency capping and pod/ad-break management, content-level targeting, and the latency/quality bar required for a living-room viewing experience. 
 - Familiarity with SSAI stitching architectures and the trade-offs between client-side and server-side ad insertion at scale. 
 - Exposure to OTT/streaming platforms, smart TV operating systems (e. g. Roku, Fire TV, Android TV, tvOS, Samsung Tizen, LG webOS), or set-top box environments, and the constraints they place on ad delivery. 
 - Understanding of CTV measurement, viewability, and completion-rate reporting requirements, and how they differ from traditional display/video. 
 - Awareness of the evolving CTV privacy and identity landscape (e. g. data clean rooms, alternative identifiers, cross-device graphs) and its implications for ad server architecture. 

AI-Enabled Engineering Mindset

We value engineers who actively leverage Generative AI tools and IDEs (e. g. GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, Windsurf etc. ) to accelerate development, improve code quality, automate repetitive tasks, and enhance documentation and debugging workflows. Engineers who demonstrate AI-first thinking using these tools to drive faster experimentation, ideation, and technical execution will thrive in our high-scale, performance-critical environment. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Engineering (CS/IT) or an equivalent degree from a well-known institute or university; advanced degree is a plus but not required given depth of experience. 

Additional Information

Return to Office: PubMatic employees throughout the global have returned to our offices via a hybrid work schedule (3 days "in office" and 2 days "working remotely") that is intended to maximize collaboration, innovation, and productivity among teams and across functions. 

Benefits: Our benefits package includes the best of what leading organizations provide, such as paternity/maternity leave, healthcare insurance, broadband reimbursement. As well, when we're back in the office, we all benefit from a kitchen loaded with healthy snacks and drinks and catered lunches and much more!

Diversity and Inclusion: PubMatic is proud to be an equal opportunity employer; we don't just value diversity, we promote and celebrate it. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. 

About PubMatic

PubMatic is one of the world's leading scaled digital advertising platforms, offering more transparent advertising solutions to publishers, media buyers, commerce companies and data owners, allowing them to harness the power and potential of the open internet to drive better business outcomes. 

Founded in 2006 with the vision that data-driven decisioning would be the future of digital advertising, we enable content creators to run a more profitable advertising business, which in turn allows them to invest back into the multi-screen and multi-format content that consumers demand.

Required Skills & Experience

Mandatory Skills

Engineering Manager

Woolworths Group India is partnering exclusively with Zinnov Group to recruit for this position. 

About the role

The Engineering Manager, Data Products is a pivotal operational and people leadership role within the Global Capability Centre (GCC), responsible for the coordination, planning, and resource management of the data products engineering squads. This role provides direct line management and coaching to approximately seven Lead Engineers, each of whom runs a dedicated squad engineering data pipelines, products, and solutions (utilizing Google Cloud Platform/BigQuery, Apache Airflow, Dataform, Python, SQL, Cloud Functions, etc. ) to establish and maintain a single source of enterprise truth for various business data domains. 

The primary focus of this role is to drive on-time, orchestrated delivery, manage engineering resource allocations, track delivery risks and issues, and build compelling career pathways and training plans for engineers across the squads. While not directly responsible for setting technical or coding standards, the Engineering Manager ensures consistent execution and operational excellence in the GCC by closely collaborating with onshore and offshore leadership, as well as operations and support teams. 

What you'll do

Delivery & Operational Orchestration

- Coordinate and Plan Engineering Delivery: Direct the planning, scheduling, and resource allocation of data engineers across multiple data product squads to ensure on-time delivery of business-critical data changes and solutions. 
 - Orchestrate Delivery Across Squads: Manage delivery execution across all seven squads, ensuring consistent execution, minimizing team friction, and standardizing agile pipeline delivery processes. 
 - Track Risks, Issues & Dependencies: Proactively identify, monitor, and mitigate delivery risks, roadblocks, and cross-team dependencies. Act as the primary escalation point for delivery and team constraints. 
 - Support Operational Excellence: Consult and collaborate with operational and support teams to prioritize problem management, resolve technical debt, and ensure stable, resilient production operations. People & Capability Management

- Lead and Develop Lead Engineers: Provide direct management, mentorship, and leadership coaching to your ~7 Lead Engineers, enabling them to lead their respective squads effectively. 
 - Design Career & Learning Pathways: Partner with HR and technical leads to build compelling career development plans, training frameworks, and structured skill-progression pathways for engineers within the GCC. 
 - Manage Capacity & Talent Pipeline: Forecast future resource demands, manage squad capacity, and oversee recruitment, onboarding, and capability retention strategies in India. 
 - Cultivate an Excellence Culture: Foster an inclusive, high-performing culture centered on curiosity, continuous learning, accountability, and psychological safety. Strategic Collaboration & Alignment

- Partner with Leadership Teams: Work in lockstep with the Head of Data Engineering, Head of Data Products, Head of Data Platform, and Senior Manager of Operations to align engineering capacity with overall business priorities and strategic roadmaps. 
 - Champion GCC Value: Showcase the technical capabilities and delivery achievements of the India-based squads, facilitating close collaboration and seamless integration with onshore teams.

Description

Amazon built world-class finance and accounting machinery to run its own business at scale. Finance as a Service (FaaS) is turning that machinery into a product: end-to-end back-office finance and accounting, delivered to sellers and partners as a service. Customers get Amazon-grade accuracy, controllership, and compliance without building it themselves. We run accounts payable, accounts receivable, record-to-report, and tax operations for a growing roster customers today. 

The systems that power FaaS today are highly specialized, built to run Amazon's own books and in many ways add odds what other businesses really want and need. FaaS as a product will benefit from an operations stack built with multi-tenancy, data isolation, multi-auditor control support built into its foundation from the start. FaaS must scale from large multinationals down to small local business, and its technology must be similarly geared. Scaling FaaS into a durable business requires a deliberate long-term strategy, and this includes the technology that powers it. 

Key job responsibilities

- Work collaboratively, shape the vision and strategy in building the product and solving business problems. 
 - Design scalable and secure systems that handle sensitive financial data. 
 - Mentor and grow the team while delivering with quality. 
 - Deep dive, develop and deliver systems that are highly maintainable. Technical leader for the team with the ability to deliver against all odds. 
 - Data driven approach for making right architecture decisions while managing business priorities. 
 - Drive adoption of emerging technologies including agentic AI and LLMs.

data.description:
‒ Design and build AI solutions across a range of business problems, choosing the right approach for each: document and image extraction or classification, predictive models, workflow automation, LLM-based agents and more. 

‒ Apply AI engineering best practices across every project: prompt design, retrieval strategies, evaluation frameworks, regression testing and version control for models and prompts. 

‒ Set and enforce model governance standards: approval workflows, risk and bias assessment, and documentation for every model promoted to production. 

‒ Build observability into every AI system: logging, tracing and monitoring for inputs, outputs, latency and failure modes, so issues surface before they reach the business. 

‒ Own token economics and compute cost across LLM-based and other AI systems: track cost per request, choose the right model size for each task, and balance accuracy against spend. 

‒ Build and maintain a dashboard that tracks the metrics that matter, such as accuracy, latency, cost, throughput, drift and error rate, across every AI system in production. 

‒ Evaluate and select the right AI approach for each problem, whether that is an LLM, a classical machine learning model, computer vision or a mix, based on what the problem actually needs rather than what is fashionable. 

‒ Mentor engineers on AI engineering practices, and build a shared standard for how the team designs, tests and ships AI systems. 

‒ Explain what an AI system can and cannot do, in plain terms, to non-technical stakeholders and leadership, so expectations stay realistic. 

‒ Track new AI and machine learning techniques, and test them against real business needs rather than adopting them for their own sake. 

What You Bring

‒ 8+ years of software engineering experience, including 3+ years focused on applied AI or machine learning in production. 

‒ Hands-on experience building and deploying a range of AI solutions, such as document or image extraction and classification, predictive models, recommendation systems, or LLM-based agents and assistants. 

‒ Strong programming skills in Python or a comparable language, and fluency with standard AI and ML tooling: model frameworks, orchestration frameworks and vector databases. 

‒ Experience building observability into AI systems: logging, tracing, monitoring and alerting for model behavior in production. 

‒ Experience with model governance: approval workflows, risk and bias assessment, and documentation standards for models moving into production. 

‒ Working knowledge of token economics and compute cost management for AI systems at scale. 

‒ Experience building dashboards or metrics systems that track model and system performance over time. 

‒ A track record of leading or mentoring engineers and setting technical direction, not only contributing as an individual. 

‒ Strong business acumen: you translate an AI capability into a concrete business outcome, and you know when a simpler, non-AI solution is the right call. 

‒ Clear communication skills. You explain technical trade-offs to engineers and non-technical stakeholders alike, without losing precision. 

Nice to Have

‒ Experience with document or image classification and extraction, as one of several AI domains you have worked in. 

‒ Experience with a dashboarding tool such as Power BI, Tableau or Grafana, used for tracking model and system metrics. 

‒ Familiarity with prompt versioning or evaluation frameworks used for regression testing model outputs. 

‒ Exposure to a data-intensive industry, such as real estate, financial services or health care.

 - Strong understanding of how backend systems, admin tools, and content pipelines work together to power live events, gameplay tuning, and player-facing experiences
 - Experience with A/B testing, segmentation, rollout controls, or live configuration systems is strongly preferred
 - Comfortable partnering across technical and non-technical functions to translate product and operational needs into durable engineering solutions
 - Experience in mobile games, live-service games, or game-adjacent backend/platform environments is highly preferred
 - Soft Skills & Education
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
 - Strong communication skills, with the ability to align engineers, stakeholders, and leadership around priorities, tradeoffs, and outcomes

At Aristocrat, excellence isn't just a goal; it's our way of life. Our dedication to innovation and creativity propels us to deliver flawless gaming experiences every day. As a Tech Lead - Python Developer, you will play a pivotal role in driving transformation and crafting the future of our enterprise through modern automation. This role is uniquely positioned to offer you the opportunity to work with advanced technologies and collaborate with a team of highly skilled professionals. Join us in crafting world-class automation solutions that set industry standards!

What You'll Do
 - Develop the entire automation solution life cycle, from intake through development, debugging, testing, and implementation into production. 
 - Write documentation that follows the Reporting Center of Excellence's standards and governance. 
 - Review and ensure all developed automated solutions meet objectives and guidelines by collaborating with the lead engineer. 
 - Build and review sustainability documentation for automated processes and contribute to team training and professional development. 
 - Maintain and debug over 500 existing automation processes to ensure consistent, accurate, and up-to-date operational rhythms. 
 - Lead recurring meetings with business collaborators, sharing functional and technical expertise, identifying automation opportunities, and guiding participants in setting up successful automation processes. 
 - Research and develop code to improve existing automations, focusing on faster run times and innovative solutions. 
 - Support the Reporting Center of Excellence in driving forward strategic and tactical implementation of automation solutions. 
 - Direct the development of automation solutions using Python, Blue Prism, Power Automate, Co Pilot Studio, and other platforms to simplify repetitive tasks. 
 - Conduct detailed reviews of automation code developed by team members, providing constructive feedback and ensuring alignment with organizational standards. 
 - Mentor and train junior engineers, encouraging skill development in Python, Blue Prism, Power Automate, and problem-solving techniques. 
 - Find opportunities for process improvements and implement solutions to optimize automations. 
 - Incorporate AI/ML capabilities into automation workflows where applicable. 
 - Support proof-of-concept developments to evaluate new tools and frameworks for automation efficiency. 

What We're Looking For
 - High-level Python skills
 - Proven experience in Blue Prism automation
 - Experience using Power Automate
 - Experience working with AI Tools such as Gemini, Co Pilot Studio, OpenAI, Snowflake Cortex
 - Strong communication skills and the ability to work independently and collaboratively
 - Capable of handling a variety of data sources, including several ERP systems and legacy environments
 - Ability to set and accomplish goals
 - Excellent organizational skills
 - Strong interpersonal skills
 - Demonstrates a strong sense of personal and professional responsibility
 - Ability to meet changing demands and adapt to frequently changing priorities

Qualifications
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Mathematics, Statistics, or similar
 - Minimum 3+ years experience in Automation Development
 - Proficient skills in Python, Blue Prism, Power Automate, Agentic Automation, Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Teams)
 - Preferred experience in R, SQL, Java, C++, C#, HTML, Selenium, CoPilot Studio, Snowflake or another Data Warehouse Solution, PowerBI or any other Data Visualization Tool, IPA, Anaplan, Microsoft Dynamics 365 (D365), Concur

This job description may have been reviewed and enhanced using AI-assisted tools to improve clarity, consistency, and inclusivity. All final content, role requirements and hiring decisions remain subject to human review and approval by Aristocrat. 

Compensation Philosophy

We offer a comprehensive pay and benefits package designed to stay competitive in the market, support your wellbeing, and recognise your contribution to our success. Our approach is underpinned by a pay-for-performance belief in rewarding individual impact. Your specific compensation package will be determined by factors such as your skills, experience, qualifications, and location. 

Depending on your role and location, you may be eligible for annual bonuses and incentives, health and wellbeing benefits, paid time off, retirement plans, insurance coverage, and other local or statutory benefits. 

Specific details about compensation and benefits for this position will be discussed during the recruitment process.

data.title: Director, Technology (Data Engineering)
data.description:
The Technical Director, Data Engineering will own the vision, architecture, and delivery of our data platform and the engineering organization behind it. You will set the technical direction for how Code and Theory collects, models, and activates data, powering analytics, predictive models, and generative AI across the agency and its clients. You will work closely with agency leadership, client stakeholders, Engineering, Strategy, and the Machine Learning team to translate business strategy into data and platform development. 

You will have broad authority over technical strategy, standards, and staffing, and input into budget and roadmap decisions. You will anchor the architecture of major platform initiatives, define how we prioritize and fund competing investments, and build the team as deliberately as the systems. You will collaborate with some of the best talent globally and define the culture and craft of a world-class data organization. 

Our engineers are AI native and advance the state of the art in the practice of software development with AI. 

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Own the vision, architecture, and delivery of the Code and Theory data platform and the engineering organization behind it
 - Set technical strategy and tie it to measurable business outcomes, prioritizing and funding competing initiatives
 - Design and scale data platforms from the ground up, covering how data is collected, modeled, and activated
 - Activate latent company and client data lakes into data-driven product backends
 - Evaluate and select cloud data platforms, making and defending architectural trade-offs
 - Write and review Python and SQL, staying hands-on in architecture, design reviews, and critical builds
 - Partner with the Machine Learning team to power analytics, predictive models, and generative AI across the agency and its clients
 - Use AI tools like Claude Code and Cursor in daily engineering, and build agentic tools and AI-enabled workflows that automate and optimize quality, processes, and delivery
 - Lead adoption of AI-powered coding and agentic engineering across the team, establishing best practices for AI-enhanced processes
 - Hire, mentor, and develop engineers and leads, and establish engineering standards, best practices, and team culture
 - Have input into budget and roadmap decisions and represent the data organization to senior leadership and clients
 - Recommend data governance, privacy, and security policies that fit client and regulatory constraints
 - Communicate effectively across the full range of technical levels in an organization that is 50/50 Tech/Creative
 - Create internal and external knowledge sharing in the form of blog posts, whitepapers, best practices, and methodologies

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

- 10+ years in data engineering or adjacent disciplines
 - 3+ years leading teams or technical organizations
 - Record of designing and scaling data platforms from the ground up
 - Demonstrated ability to set technical strategy and tie it to measurable business outcomes, including prioritizing and funding competing initiatives
 - Substantial work experience activating latent company data lakes into data-driven product backends
 - Deep expertise in cloud data platforms and the judgment to choose among them. Bring your opinions on which you love and which you hate!
 - Strong technical fluency in Python and SQL
 - Substantial experience with AI-powered coding, agentic engineering, and AI-enabled workflows, ideally having led their adoption across a team
 - Proven track record of hiring, mentoring, and growing engineers and leads, and of establishing standards and best practices
 - Exceptional communication and influence across the full range of technical levels
 - Ability to represent the data organization to senior leadership and clients

NICE TO HAVE

- Experience owning data governance, privacy compliance, and security programs
 - Working knowledge of marketing data ecosystems (GA4, advertising platforms, CRMs, CDPs)
 - Experience integrating AI/ML capabilities into data pipelines and shipping GenAI applications to production
 - Experience in an agency or consultancy environment, balancing client-facing delivery with internal platform investment

ABOUT US

Born in 2001, Code and Theory is a digital-first creative agency that sits at the center of creativity and technology. We pride ourselves on not only solving consumer and business problems, but also helping to establish new capabilities for our clients. With a global client roster of Fortune 100s and start-ups alike, we crave the hardest problems to solve. We have teams distributed across North America, South America, Europe, and Asia. The Code and Theory global network of agencies is growing and includes Kettle, Instrument, Left Field Labs, Create Group, Current, and TrueLogic. 

Striving never to be pigeonholed, we work across every major category: from tech to CPG, financial services to travel & hospitality, government and education to media and publishing. We value the collaboration with our client partners, including but not limited to Adidas, Amazon, Con Edison, Diageo, EY, J. P. Morgan Chase, Lenovo, Marriott, Mars, Microsoft, Thomson Reuters, and TikTok. 

The Code and Theory network is comprised of nearly 2, 000 people with 50% engineers and 50% creative talent. We're always on the lookout for smart, driven, and forward-thinking people to join our team.

data.title: Forward Deployed Engineer IRC300057
data.description:
Description

About the Role & Team

We are seeking a Forward-Deployed AI Architect to help our enterprise customers radically accelerate and modernize their software delivery lifecycle. In this elite, high-impact role, you will embed directly with customer engineering teams to prove the value of AI-led engineering through hands-on architecture, agentic workflows, and measurable delivery outcomes. 

This role is designed for senior architects and builders who sit at the intersection of core enterprise software architecture and cutting-edge AI engineering. You will help customers transition from traditional, ticket-bound Scrum cycles toward intent-driven, increasingly autonomous delivery models where AI tools, agents, and human governance seamlessly turn business intent into production-ready software. 

Requirements

Candidate Profile: Qualifications & Experience

Must-Have Attributes

Experience: 12+ years of proven experience across software engineering, architecture, product/platform engineering, or solution architecture, backed by a strong track record of product-side delivery. 

SDLC Mastery: Deep, foundational understanding of enterprise software architecture, DevSecOps pipelines, Agile/Scrum frameworks, and the broader product lifecycle. 

Hands-on AI Fluency: Direct, practical fluency with AI development tools, IDE-based AI assistants, agentic workflows, and AI-enabled software delivery. You must possess the ability to build, evaluate, and deeply explain working AI solutions. 

Modern AI Tech Stack: Experience leveraging tools and frameworks such as Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, GitHub Copilot, LangChain, AutoGen, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, MCP (Model Context Protocol), RAG, and vector databases. 

Hands on in Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG), Vector Databases, Evaluation Frameworks, Prompt Engineering, Tool Calling, Function Calling, Multi-agent orchestration, AI Observability

Good-to-Have Skills

Customer-Facing Excellence: Prior experience in high-touch, customer-facing technical roles (e. g. , Forward-Deployed Engineer, Principal Solutions Architect, Field Engineer, or Pre-Sales Engineering Leader). 

AI Governance & Security: A strong grasp of AI governance models, human-in-the-loop controls, responsible AI frameworks, observability, and production readiness for AI-enabled enterprise systems. 

Job responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

- Client Engagement & Strategic Architecture

Identify AI Opportunities: Work directly with customer engineering, product, architecture, and executive teams to diagnose SDLC bottlenecks and map out high-value areas for AI-led acceleration. 

Design & Build Proofs of Concept: Act as a hands-on builder to design, develop, and deliver working proofs utilizing modern AI engineering tools, agentic workflows, and automation frameworks. 

Lead the Intent-Driven Transition: Guide clients away from rigid, manual sprint mechanics toward fluid, intent-driven delivery loops capable of autonomously generating plans, code, tests, documentation, and validation artifacts. 

- Value Measurement & Executive Alignment

Quantify AI Impact: Define, measure, and report on hard engineering acceleration outcomes, including reduced cycle times, faster story-to-code conversion, improved automated testing, and accelerated code reviews. 

Technical & Executive Presentation: Communicate complex technical approaches, agentic architectures, proof results, and long-term adoption strategies to both engineering teams and C-level stakeholders. 

What we offer

Exciting Projects: We focus on industries like High-Tech, communication, media, healthcare, retail and telecom. Our customer list is full of fantastic global brands and leaders who love what we build for them. 

Collaborative Environment: You Can expand your skills by collaborating with a diverse team of highly talented people in an open, laidback environment - or even abroad in one of our global centers or client facilities!

Work-Life Balance: GlobalLogic prioritizes work-life balance, which is why we offer flexible work schedules, opportunities to work from home, and paid time off and holidays. 

Professional Development: Our dedicated Learning & Development team regularly organizes Communication skills training(GL Vantage, Toast Master), Stress Management program, professional certifications, and technical and soft skill trainings. 

Excellent Benefits: We provide our employees with competitive salaries, family medical insurance, Group Term Life Insurance, Group Personal Accident Insurance , NPS(National Pension Scheme ), Periodic health awareness program, extended maternity leave, annual performance bonuses, and referral bonuses. 

Fun Perks: We want you to love where you work, which is why we host sports events, cultural activities, offer food on subsidies rates, Corporate parties. Our vibrant offices also include dedicated GL Zones, rooftop decks and GL Club where you can drink coffee or tea with your colleagues over a game of table and offer discounts for popular stores and restaurants!

About GlobalLogic

GlobalLogic, a Hitachi Group Company, is a trusted digital engineering partner to the world's largest and most forward-thinking companies. Since 2000, we've been at the forefront of the digital revolution - helping create some of the most innovative and widely used digital products and experiences. Today we continue to collaborate with clients in transforming businesses and redefining industries through intelligent products, platforms, and services.

data.description:
Position Type

Full time

Type Of Hire

Experienced (relevant combo of work and education)

Our team is responsible for designing, developing, and supporting highly scalable, resilient, and performance-driven applications that serve our global customer base. We leverage modern engineering practices, cloud technologies, microservices architecture, and distributed messaging platforms to build secure and reliable solutions. As a Lead Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in driving technical excellence, mentoring engineering teams, collaborating with Product Owners and Architects, and ensuring successful end-to-end delivery of business-critical initiatives.

- Lead the design, development, and delivery of scalable, high-performance Java-based microservices and backend applications using Spring Boot and related technologies. 
 - Own end-to-end feature delivery, including requirements analysis, solution design, development, testing, deployment, production support, and continuous improvement. 
 - Collaborate with Product Owners, Architects, Business Analysts, and stakeholders to translate business requirements into robust, scalable technical solutions. 
 - Provide technical leadership through architecture discussions, code reviews, mentoring, and the adoption of software engineering best practices. 
 - Design and implement REST APIs, event-driven solutions, and system integrations using technologies such as Kafka, relational databases, SQL, and Hibernate. 
 - Drive DevOps and cloud-native practices, including CI/CD automation, containerization (Docker), Kubernetes, cloud deployments (AWS preferred), release management, and operational excellence. 
 - Ensure application reliability, performance, and quality through automated testing, monitoring, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and proactive optimization. 

What You Bring

- 10+ years of software development experience with strong expertise in Java 8+, Enterprise Java technologies, and modern development practices. 
 - Proven experience designing and developing microservices and RESTful APIs using Spring Framework, Spring Boot, and related technologies. 
 - Strong understanding of object-oriented design, software architecture, design patterns, and scalable application development. 
 - Hands-on experience with relational databases, SQL optimization, Hibernate/ORM frameworks, and automated unit/integration testing practices. 
 - Experience with distributed systems and event-driven architectures using Kafka or similar messaging technologies. 
 - Knowledge of DevOps and cloud-native technologies, including CI/CD, application lifecycle management, Docker, Kubernetes, container orchestration, and cloud platforms (AWS preferred). 
 - Strong troubleshooting, performance tuning, monitoring, and observability skills, with familiarity in workflow scheduling tools (e. g. , Apache Airflow) and basic front-end technologies. 
 - Strong communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to understand business needs and articulate technical solutions in business-friendly language while effectively working with internal and external customers. 
 - Self-motivated and adaptable team player with strong problem-solving, research, multitasking, time management, and presentation skills, demonstrating a positive attitude and willingness to take on challenging tasks while embracing feedback and continuous learning. 

Added Bonus If You Have

- Experience working within the FinTech, Banking, Payments, or Financial Services domain
 - Experience with Kubernetes and container orchestration in large-scale production environments
 - Exposure to DevOps practices and CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or similar platforms
 - Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform
 - Knowledge of event-driven architecture and large-scale distributed systems
 - Familiarity with performance engineering and high-throughput transaction processing systems

What We Offer You

- An exciting opportunity to be part of the world's leading FinTech product organization. 
 - A vibrant team environment and the opportunity to build a career in the core banking/payments domain. 
 - Competitive salary and attractive benefits including GHMI/Hospitalization coverage for employees and dependents. 
 - A multifaceted role with a high degree of responsibility and a wide range of opportunities. 
 - A broad range of professional education and personal development possibilities - FIS is your final career step

Privacy Statement

FIS is committed to protecting the privacy and security of all personal information that we process in order to provide services to our clients. For specific information on how FIS protects personal information online, please see the Online Privacy Notice. 

Sourcing Model

Recruitment at FIS works primarily on a direct sourcing model; a relatively small portion of our hiring is through recruitment agencies. FIS does not accept resumes from recruitment agencies which are not on the preferred supplier list and is not responsible for any related fees for resumes submitted to job postings, our employees, or any other part of our company.

data.description:
Job Title: Staff Software Engineer, Database Engineering

Location: India, Hybrid

This is a hybrid position, which will require the ability to be onsite in our Bengaluru, India office as needed. Candidates must be based in India. 

ABOUT THE COMPANY: 

Salesloft is building the next era of enterprise revenue - one where teams make confident decisions powered by AI and real signals. By combining our scale, insights, and AI innovation, we're building the industry's first Predictive Revenue System, enabling humans and AI to work together to make smarter decisions and drive consistent growth. 

With thousands of customers using our platforms every day, we have an unmatched view into how revenue is actually won - the Revenue Context that reveals what happens, when, and with what outcome. This gives us a unique opportunity to transform an entire category and set a new benchmark for how modern revenue teams operate. 

Join us to help transform how companies around the world run revenue - and build the platform that will guide leading revenue teams into the future. 

THE OPPORTUNITY: 

At Salesloft, our Staff Software Engineer, DBE will be pivotal to our company's success. You will be a key member of our fast-growing and high-performing team in India. We are looking for an experienced technical leader who can help realize the Salesloft vision of a "Data Platform as a Service. " We are looking for engineers who are passionate about database reliability, cloud automation, and data integrity, and who thrive working on leading-edge technologies to scale our DataHub to Petabyte Scale. 

On a day-to-day basis, you will be responsible to: 

- Design, build, and scale our RDBMS (Postgres, MySQL, Amazon Aurora) and NoSQL systems (Cassandra, MongoDB) to meet massive ingestion and analytical demands. 
 - Lead large, cross-functional projects that identify and overcome friction points in data persistence, migration, and scaling. 
 - Architect scale-out strategies, including the evaluation and implementation of sharding technologies to distribute workloads effectively across clusters. 
 - Build automation and tooling (Infrastructure as Code) to improve engineering efficiency, reduce toil, and empower product teams to operate in a reliable and secure manner. 
 - Collaborate synchronously and asynchronously with Architects, Product Development, and Data Science teams to gather requirements and design scalable, distributed systems. 
 - Maintain, protect, and grow our data resources by owning the "backbone" of our production environment, including high-availability (HA) solutions, backups, and disaster recovery. 

As a technical leader within the Platform Operations Infrastructure Team, you are a resilient problem solver. You have a deep understanding of the engineering lifecycle and how teams work in Agile. You hold strong opinions, loosely held, and welcome new perspectives supported by thoughtful reasoning and data. You thrive in a collaborative environment where cross-team impact and a diversity of ideas are valued. 

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR: 

We are seeking a Staff Software Engineer, DBE to provide an experienced backbone to our team in the form of automation, capacity planning, and overall database platform management. If you're looking for an opportunity to learn more, do more, and become more, then this is the career path for you!

THE TEAM: 

Salesloft's Platform Operations Infrastructure organization builds systems and tools to enable engineering velocity in a reliable manner. We partner with engineering teams to establish standards, improve reliability, and increase cost-efficiency. This is a great opportunity to make a massive impact on scaling cloud infrastructure to meet the high demand and rapid growth of both users and workload per user. 

Our Database Engineering Team consists of people passionate about solving customer problems, both internal and external. 

THE SKILL SET: 

- 8+ years of experience building and managing large-scale, business-critical, high-throughput stateful applications in the cloud (AWS/GCP). 
 - Expertise in RDBMS and NoSQL: Deep knowledge in optimizing and tuning PostgreSQL, MySQL Amazon Aurora, MongoDB, and Cassandra. 
 - Automation & IaC: Expert-level experience with Infrastructure as Code and Configuration Management (e. g. , Terraform, Ansible). 
 - Coding Proficiency: Ability to code in Python or Java, with a solid grasp of shell scripting. 
 - Reliability & HA: Demonstrated experience with high-availability databases and failover clustering (experience with Patroni is a plus). 
 - Scaling & Sharding (Plus): Experience with database sharding technologies and extensions (e. g. , Citus for PostgreSQL) is highly preferred but not required. 
 - Query Optimization: Expert-level SQL skills and the ability to aid product teams in complex performance tuning and problem resolution. 
 - Distributed Systems: Strong understanding of data processing, analytics, and how databases fit into a microservices architecture. 
 - Communication: Excellent written and verbal skills, with a love for collaborating across multiple timezones in a remote-first environment. 

At Salesloft, we are committed to creating an inclusive and supportive workplace where everyone belongs and can thrive. We focus on culture add, not culture fit, and believe our teams are made stronger by the unique perspectives, experiences, and identities each person brings. 

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and provide employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, pregnancy, or any other characteristic protected by law. 

If you're excited about this role even though your experience may not perfectly match every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We are actively hiring across multiple geographies and would love to welcome passionate, curious, and mission-driven individuals to our growing team. Explore our open roles and consider joining us!

Please note that all official communication regarding job opportunities at Salesloft will come from an @salesloft. com email address. If you receive messages on LinkedIn or other job platforms claiming to be from Salesloft, they may not be legitimate. To verify the authenticity of any job-related communication, please visit our official Careers Page. 

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, notetaking, or summarizing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment - all hiring decisions are made by people. If you would like more information about how your data is processed or prefer to opt out of any AI-assisted tools, please let your recruiter know. Opting out will not impact your experience or consideration.

Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic and labelling is accurate. 

The Eurofins network of companies believes that it is a global leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing and in discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and AgroScience contract research services. It is also one of the market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, and in the support of clinical studies, as well as in biopharma contract development and manufacturing. It also has a rapidly developing presence in highly specialised and molecular clinical diagnostic testing and in-vitro diagnostic products. 

In over 37 years, Eurofins has grown from one laboratory in Nantes, France to over 65, 000 staff across a decentralised and entrepreneurial network of more than 950 laboratories in over 1, 000 companies across 59 countries. Eurofins companies offer a portfolio of over 200, 000 analytical methods to evaluate the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin, traceability and purity of biological substances and products.

data.description:
Job Description Summary

As a Lead Control Automation System Engineer, you will be responsible to lead the requirement, design, implementation, and development of digital control system of the HVDC Control & Protection system. As part of this role, you will be working closely across various engineering disciplines within HVDC business. Solution and engineering centre (NPI, ITO, OTR and Product Care) in all aspects of HVDC Control & Protection system, this includes developing organizational talent and Engineering process management, provide technical guidance, mentoring, drive consistent design practices, common global processes for projects implementation and also provide technical solution that meets the NPI, project delivery and Tender objectives. 

Job Description

Roles and Responsibilities

Overseeing the overall technical solution that meets customer Requirement based on reference Solution. 

This Includes The Following Actives

- Responsible for leading overall requirement, design, implementation, and testing of digital control system of the HVDC Control & Protection system this includes network & Cybersecurity design
 - Lead the configuration of IEC61850 IED's via vendor specific tools and System Configuration Tools for complete system integration. 
 - Lead the generation of Substation Configuration description Language (SCL) files for system integration. 
 - Knowledge of Sequencing & interlocking principles used in substation automation systems and their implementation on IEC61850 IED's. 
 - Lead the design, configuration and testing required to deliver on time and within defined budgets the HVDC Control System hardware. 
 - Lead the testing and debugging of complex IEC61850 communication systems using industry standard tools such as IEDSCout, Wireshark etc. 
 - Good experience with HMI/SCADA technologies, implementation, testing and installation. 
 - Coordinate and interface the HVDC Control System with Balance of Plant equipment and SCADA systems. 
 - Define the main IO Lists of the control system. 
 - Analyze signal interfaces and ensure compatibility with the control system. 
 - Lead in collaboration with NPI teams, the configuration of Remote Terminal Units (RTU), Bay Controllers (BCU) and Merging Units for signal acquisition in digital substation environments. 
 - Lead the design of LAN networks/Communication Architectures and configuration of industrial ethernet switches/routers and satellite clocks
 - Follow the departments standard design practices, engineering reviews and guidelines. 
 - Define Control Panel requirements and produce detailed design documentation for the control system using standard design blocks under the guidance of lead engineers. 
 - Panel Electrical Schematics (using Engineering Base tool)
 - Wire/Cable Schedules
 - Routine Test specification
 - General Assembly drawings
 - Bill of Materials
 - Oversee the testing and FAT witnessing of the Control System. 
 - Prepare and present technical information for Substation Control Systems to internal and external customers. 
 - Assist site activities relevant to the installation and commissioning of the control system. 
 - Share engineering information and promote open dialogue. 
 - Assure proper documentation of technical data generated for the assigned projects and/or tasks consistent with engineering policies and procedures. 
 - Responsible for coaching and developing department talent. 
 - Continuously improving the product in terms of delivery speed, stability and reliability
 - Review and approve design documents, implement, and ensures quality deliverables on time and within targeted cost

Required Qualifications

- Degree in Electronics/Electrical engineering or related field. 
 - Strong background in configuring Substation Bay Controllers/Merging Units/ IEC61850 IED's/HMI/SCADA technologies. 
 - Minimum of 8 -10 years' experience in control and protection system design
 - Knowledge of industrial communication networks such as IEC61850 and Ethernet based protocols. 
 - Control & Protection Relay logics Design techniques
 - Experienced in developing electrical designs for industrial control systems
 - Knowledge of communication networks Security/Hardening and Cybersecurity best practices
 - Excellent knowledge of commonly used Layer2&3 protocols such as Ipv4, OSPF, LACP, DMZ, VPN/ DMS/ADMS/ DNP, IEC, Modbus
 - Experience relevant to electrical power systems and Substation automation engineering
 - Working knowledge of industrial and utility electrical control and protection systems and Digital Control Systems, Substation Automation and SCADA

Desired Characteristics

- Strong oral and written communication skills. Strong interpersonal and leadership skills. Demonstrated ability to analyze and resolve problems. Demonstrated ability to lead programs / projects. Ability to document, plan, market, and execute programs. Established project management skills. 
 - Proven technical leadership in a complex system engineering development environment

Additional Information

The role of Control engineer is to perform DCS activity related to substation automation projects within India and abroad. Engineer should be capable to handle & perform the design activity, database configuration, relay integration, system validation and commissioning activity. The delivery of project should be with high quality standard. 

Job Description

Roles and Responsibilities

- Perform DCS database configuration with GE system. 
 - Preparation of Design document, engineering document for projects
 - Perform FAT and SAT activity with worldwide units. 
 - Perform design activity for various project. 
 - Perform system & database validation before the project delivery. 
 - Should have a good knowledge of GE relays. 
 - Work with the team for achieving a high level of automation in testing by promoting different innovations from the team. 
 - Reviewing detailed functional and technical specifications. 
 - Reviewing GE Grid Automation products, applications and system instruction manuals, technical presentations, and end-user training material. 
 - Work with Customer Support personnel to resolve customer issues
 - Provide technical consultation to cross-functional teams throughout the business to improve or resolve manufacturing, products, applications, or field issues
 - Assist in preparing training material and deliver training courses, where required

Education Qualification/Requirement

- Bachelor's Degree in Electrical, Electronics & Communication, with a minimum of 4+ years of professional experience
 - Hands on experience in validating and testing of substation automation products and solutions
 - Hands on experience of various relay integration. 
 - Knowledge of GE system (e. g. DS Agile system, D25, D400 etc. ) is added advantage. 
 - Knowledge of serial SCADA protocols (e. g. DNP3, IEC 60870-5-101, 103, Modbus)
 - Knowledge of LAN-based SCADA protocols (e. g. IEC 61850-8-1, DNP3/TCP, IEC 60870-5-104, Modbus TCP)
 - Thorough knowledge of all parts of IEC 61850 standard for communication networks and systems in power substations. Familiarity with communications practices and procedures of electrical utilities. 
 - Detailed knowledge of Ethernet networking; wired / wireless and Switch technologies
 - Strong organizational, communication skills and a proactive / open approach to conflict resolution
 - Flexible and adaptable; open to change and modification of tasks, display initiative
 - Able to share ideas and work well in a team environment. 

Desired Characteristics

- Working Knowledge of DS Agile Software is preferred
 - Good analytical skills with ability to identify and explain critical issues. 
 - Ability to work effectively with minimum supervision
 - Strong customer service mindset
 - Prior engineering experience is preferred
 - Strong oral and written communication skills
 - Strong interpersonal skills
 - Strong operational effectiveness and accountability. 

Note: GE is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law. *Disclosure of your Gender or Sexual orientation is completely Voluntary and not mandatory.

Relocation Assistance Provided: Yes

data.description:
About MISUMI Americas

MISUMI Americas, a division of MISUMI Group, is a leading provider of standard, configurable, and custom manufacturing solutions. By integrating a vast catalog of components with a world-class digital manufacturing platform, MISUMI Americas empowers engineers and procurement teams to accelerate innovation across the entire product lifecycle. With operations in the San Francisco Bay Area and Chicago, the company serves as a vital partner for the most innovative companies in the Americas. 

What's in it for you?

List at least two comparative wins for this role over another that someone might consider. Example follows. 

Opportunity To Unlock Your Creativity

Think of all the times you were held back from trying new ideas because you were boxed in by bureaucratic legacy processes or old school tactics. Having a growth mindset is deeply ingrained into our company culture since day 1 so Fictiv is an environment where you have the creative liberty and support of the team to try big bold ideas to achieve our sales and customer goals. 

Opportunity To Grow Your Career

There are plenty of jobs out there. The question is whether any of them will help you grow in your career? Will you be challenged by teammates to achieve your potential? Or are they roles that will ask you to do more of what you've already mastered. At Fictiv, you'll be surrounded by supportive teammates who will push you to be your best through their curiosity and passion. 

Impact In This Role

As a Salesforce engineering leader at Fictiv, you will build and manage high-performing teams by making strategic, culture-aligned hiring decisions and using data to optimize capacity. You'll foster an environment of ownership and continuous learning, coaching Scrum teams in Agile excellence to ensure consistent, high-quality delivery. 

By bridging the gap between business goals and technical execution, you will define a clear technical vision, manage complex integrations, and partner with Architects to modernize the roadmap while reducing tech debt. Ultimately, you take full accountability for engineering deliverables, ensuring they are scalable, on schedule, and held to the highest standards of quality and excellence. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Build and take ownership of the Salesforce engineering team and drive excellence.

 - Set clear expectations and goals for team members and create opportunities for team members to showcase their work
 - Facilitate team-building activities
 - Build an in-depth understanding of the code owned by the team. 
 - Encouraging knowledge sharing and collaboration
 - Identify and address recurring issues in development cycles and improve speed of development. 
 - Ensure code quality and best practices
 - Collaborate with Product Owners and stakeholders in understanding the requirements and translating them into technical designs. 
 - Provide high-level technical recommendations, approaches, and feedback. 
 - Create and maintain project timelines
 - Identify dependencies between different systems and facilitate communication between cross-functional teams. 
 - Drive the execution and delivery of features by collaborating with many multi-functional teams, architects, product owners and engineers. 
 - Conduct risk assessments throughout the project's lifecycle and provide updates to the stakeholder's progress of each project you manage. 
 - Resolve cross-team coordination issues that may impact progress. 
 - Manage expectations and negotiate scope changes. 
 - Facilitate decision-making processes when trade-offs are necessary
 - Ensure smooth handoff between development, QA, and plan for the software releases. 
 - Identify repetitive tasks that can be automated
 - Encourage the development of internal tools to boost productivity
 - Allocate time for refactoring and system improvements
 - Encourage experimentation with new tools or methodologies

Desired Traits

- 12+ years of overall experience in engineering
 - 7+ years of hands-on experience working in Salesforce
 - Proven experience in developing Salesforce solutions with a deep understanding of Apex, Visualforce, Lightning Web Components, and Salesforce APIs. 
 - Have worked in Salesforce CPQ, Sales, Manufacturing, Service, Data Cloud. 
 - Experienced in designing and implementing custom solutions that align with business needs. 
 - Strong knowledge of Salesforce data modeling, reporting, and database design. 
 - Has played the role of an Architect
 - Demonstrated experience in building and maintaining integrations between Salesforce and external applications. 
 - 3+ years of leading software engineering teams in an agile environment
 - Experience in hiring, mentoring, and leading engineers
 - Bachelor's Degree in computer science, computer science engineering, or related experience required; advanced degree preferred
 - Strong knowledge of Salesforce product and platform features, capabilities, and best use of it
 - A good understanding of enterprise architecture principles is strongly preferred
 - Active Salesforce Certifications are desirable (preferably Development Lifecycle & Deployment Architect, Application Architect, 
 - Experience in Mulesoft is a plus
 - Ability to quickly grasp and distinctly explain technological and business concepts
 - Experience in CI/CD
 - Experience with agile software development methodologies and practices
 - Prior experience leading teams in an agile environment. 
 - Strong oral and written communication skills, organizational and time management skills
 - Ability to set priorities and multi-task in a fast-paced environment. 
 - Demonstrates analytical thinking, problem-solving
 - Experience in communicating with users, other technical teams, and product management to understand requirements, describe software product features, and technical designs. 

Interested in learning more? We look forward to hearing from you soon. 

We're actively seeking teammates who: 

- Bring diverse perspectives and experience to our culture and company. 
 - Excel at being part of a strong, empathetic team. 
 - Thrive in an environment emphasizing respect, honesty, collaboration, and growth. 
 - Have an 'always learning' mindset that celebrates learning, not just wins.

 - 3 years of experience in people management, including mentoring analytical and technical teams (e. g. , data scientists, engineering analysts) in applied AI.

Preferred qualifications:

 - Excellent communication skills, able to explain complex technical issues clearly to stakeholders at different levels and to influence decision-making across roles. 
 - Excellent problem-solving and critical thinking skills with attention to detail in an ever-changing environment. 

About The Job

Trust and Safety team members are tasked with identifying and taking on the biggest problems that challenge the safety and integrity of the products. They use technical know-how, excellent problem-solving skills, user insights, and proactive communication to protect users and the partners from abuse across Google Ads products. On this team, you are a big-picture thinker and strategic team-player with a passion for doing what's right. You work globally and cross-functionally with Google engineers and product managers to identify and fight abuse and fraud cases at Google speed - with urgency. And you take pride in knowing that every day you are working hard to promote users' trust in Google and ensuring the highest levels of user safety. 

In this role, you will lead a high-performing team fighting adversarial actors in Google Ads. You will apply your data science and fraud detection leadership to drive AI transformation, developing scaled solutions to protect users from complex threats like malware and cloaking. Work closely with cross-functional partners in Ads Safety, AP Engineering, and gTech, architect defense-in-depth strategies that balance user safety with a streamlined advertiser experience. Lead the development of advanced AI-driven clustering models, establish robust evaluation frameworks for Agentic AI, and pioneer rigorous false-negative measurement methodologies. 

You will work with sensitive content or situations and may be exposed to graphic, controversial, or upsetting topics or content. 

Responsibilities

- Direct and mentor a high-performing team of Engineering Analysts, fostering AI transformation, operational excellence and strategic execution against adversarial fraud. 
 - Partner with PM, Engineering, and Legal to build Defense in Depth strategies that enhance user safety and fortify the Google Ads ecosystem against emerging threats. 
 - Lead the development of AI-driven enforcement capabilities, to proactively combat abuse at scale. Establish robust evaluation frameworks for the AI era, pioneering rigorous measurement methodologies and overseeing programs to train next-generation AI agents/ML Models for fraud detection. 
 - Lead investigations into complex TTPs (Tactics, Techniques, and Procedures) to perform actor tracking and disrupt organized fraud rings targeting Google Ads. 
 - Partner closely with sales leadership to architect and implement streamlined recovery experiences for advertisers impacted by policy enforcement, balancing user harm with advertiser experience.
