data.title: Systems Architect (Staff Architect II), TSG Software Engineering
data.description:
COMPANY PROFILE

Bain & Company is one of the top management consulting firms in the world that helps the world's most ambitious changemakers define the future. 

Across 65 cities in 40 countries, we work alongside our clients as one team with a shared ambition to achieve extraordinary results, outperforming the competition, and redefine industries. We complement our tailored, integrated expertise with a vibrant ecosystem of digital innovators to deliver better, faster, and more enduring outcomes. 

The firm established several functions in the Indian market early 2000s and its remit across functions has expanded over time. Since 2019, these functions have become part of Global Business Services (GBS). Global Business Services (GBS) is a network of five interconnected business functions hubs across India, Poland, Malaysia, Mexico and Portugal, serving Bain globally to run our business, support other functions, and help drive innovation internally. We are over 1000 business professionals - serving functions in operations, HR, finance, legal, tech, marketing, research, and data analytics - who support our offices globally. Our mantra of "shared innovation, seamless execution, " underpinned by a passion for results, teamwork, and creativity, helps Bain stay at the top of our game operationally. 

WHAT MAKES US A GREAT PLACE TO WORK

We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world's best places to work. We are currently the top-ranked consulting firm on Glassdoor's Best Places to Work list and have earned the #1 overall spot a record seven times. 

Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don't happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally. 

WHO YOU'LL WORK WITH

You'll work across all of Bain's TSG software engineering teams working with Engineering Managers, Developers, and vendor delivery partners. These teams build and support Bain's most strategic internal software systems, primarily enterprise-scale, browser-based or mobile applications with a global user base. 

Teams combine internal developers with vendor-augmented developers, work in an Agile/kanban model, and increasingly use AI-assisted and agent-assisted development. You will also work closely with Information Security, infrastructure and cloud teams, and procurement. 

WHAT YOU'LL DO

The Systems Architect is a senior technical leadership role. The role is the technical authority across all engineering teams for software architecture, non-functional requirements (NFRs), secure development, testing, deployment, and the use of AI in engineering. The role sets standards, builds guardrails, makes tooling decisions, and acts as a technical evangelist, working through Engineering Managers and developers to create consistency across teams. 

Where capacity allows, the role also takes on end-to-end delivery of selected projects. Percentages below are indicative and will flex with project delivery commitments. 

Architecture and engineering standards (20%)

- Define and maintain a unified software architecture approach across all teams, including reference architectures, design patterns, integration and API standards, and architecture decision records. 

- Act as design authority for significant new systems and major upgrades, reviewing solution designs for fit with standards, scalability, resilience, security, and cost. 

- Define NFRs such as performance, availability, scalability, security, observability, and maintainability, and make sure they are built into designs, estimates, and development practices. 

- Guide data architecture choices across SQL, NoSQL, and vector databases so teams make consistent, well-reasoned decisions. 

- Advise on the modernization, rationalization, or retirement of legacy applications, working with AMS leads and Engineering Managers on technical roadmaps and technical debt. 

- Ensure vendor-augmented teams follow the same architecture and engineering standards as internal teams. 

NFR and system inventory (10%)

- Own the NFR system, templates, and process by which NFRs are captured, validated, tracked, and verified for every product. 

- Own the inventory of all applications and legacy systems, and keep it current and complete, covering technology stack, ownership, dependencies, hosting, and lifecycle status. 

- Drive up-to-date documentation of software systems and processes, and set documentation standards for teams. 

Secure software development , AI-enabled engineering and agent guardrails (25%)

- Define and own secure software development practices across teams, including threat modeling, secure design review, dependency and supply chain security, secrets management, and code scanning. 

- Work with InfoSec to turn policy into practical engineering controls and serve as the technical escalation point for security questions. 

- Set controls for the secure use of AI-generated code and AI agents, including protection of data and prompts. 

- Review vulnerability and remediation trends across teams and drive corrective action. 

- Define standards for the use of code assistants and AI coding agents, including approved tools, usage practices, review of AI-generated code, and how impact is measured. 

- Design and maintain guardrails for AI agents, including permissions, handling of data and prompts, human review checkpoints, auditability, and failure handling. 

- Promote AI-driven development lifecycle (AIDLC) practices and their adoption across teams. 

- Define architecture patterns for LLM-based applications, including retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), vectorization and embeddings, vector databases, evaluation, cost, and latency. 

- Track emerging AI risks and ensure approaches align with Bain's governance and responsible AI expectations. 

Cloud, deployment, and DevOps (15%)

- Finalize and govern deployment approaches across Azure, GCP, and AWS, including criteria for workload placement, environment strategy, and infrastructure as code. 

- Standardize CI/CD pipelines, release strategies, and observability practices across teams. 

- Partner with infrastructure and cloud teams on cost, resilience, and disaster recovery. 

- Verify that NFRs are met in deployed environments. 

Tooling, licensing, procurement, and proofs of concept (10%)

- Make and recommend tool choices across IDEs, code assistants, testing, CI/CD, security, and observability, with clear evaluation criteria and rationale as and when there is a decision point. 

- Manage tool licenses for all teams, internal and vendor-augmented, and optimize usage and cost. 

- Lead procurement of tools, including requirements, vendor evaluation, commercial input, and onboarding, with procurement and reporting to the TS leadership. 

- Lead or sponsor proof of concept on emerging technologies for different teams, with clear success criteria and a recommendation to adopt, defer, or drop. Present findings to the wider engineering group. 

Technical mentoring (15%)

- Act as technical evangelist across teams through communities of practice, tech talks, and architecture forums, building shared understanding of standards and the reasons behind them. 

- Communicate architecture decisions clearly to technical and non-technical audiences, including senior stakeholders. 

- Coach and mentor developers and Engineering Managers on design, architecture, and technical decision-making to build architecture capability across the group. 

- Report to the TS leadership and give Engineering Managers regular feedback on the technical health of teams. 

- Role model assertive communication in crucial conversations, and listen to understand the needs of teams. 

Project delivery (5%)

- Take end-to-end ownership of selected delivery projects when availability permits, from architecture through build, testing, release, and handover. 

- Report to the TS leadership on project selection, and make sure standards and governance responsibilities are not compromised. 

- Build hands-on prototypes and technical spikes to validate approaches before wider adoption. 

What success looks like

- Teams share consistent architecture, NFR, testing, security, and deployment approaches, and Engineering Managers and developers treat the Systems Architect as the reference point. 

- AI coding tools and agents are used safely and productively, within clear guardrails. 

- NFRs are captured and verified for every product, and App Stack AI is complete and trusted. 

- Tool licenses and procurement are managed with clear ownership, and proofs of concept lead to timely adoption decisions. 

About you

- 15+ years in software engineering, including 5+ years in architecture or senior technical leadership roles spanning multiple systems and teams. 

- Demonstrated record as architect or design authority for enterprise-scale applications, setting standards that were adopted across several teams. 

- Experience working with distributed teams that combine internal and vendor-augmented developers. 

- Hands-on experience with AI-assisted development and LLM-based applications, and the ability to define practical guardrails for AI agents. 

- Strong grounding in secure software development practices. 

- Experience designing and deploying on at least one major cloud platform (Azure, GCP, or AWS), with working knowledge of the others. 

- Experience evaluating tools, managing licenses, supporting procurement, and running proofs of concept. 

- Ability to influence and lead without direct authority, and to earn credibility with engineers and senior stakeholders alike. 

- Strong communication, listening, and customer service skills. 

- Strong analytic and problem-solving skills. 

- Bachelor's or equivalent degree. 

Software engineering: technical skills

- Architecture: scalable, secure, and maintainable system design, including microservices, event-driven patterns, API design, integration patterns, and NFR definition. 

- Backend languages and frameworks: Python, C#, . NET, and . NET Core. 

- Web frameworks and libraries: Angular, React, Next. js, and TypeScript. 

- AI and Gen AI: LLMs, ML, MLOps/ AIOps, prompt design, RAG, AI agents, AI coding assistants, agent guardrails, and evaluation. 

- Vector databases and vectorization: embedding models, vector stores, indexing, and retrieval tuning. 

- SQL databases: Microsoft SQL Server, Databricks, PostgreSQL, or equivalent. 

- NoSQL databases: MongoDB, Cosmos DB, or equivalent. 

- Cloud: Azure, GCP, and AWS, including infrastructure as code and workload placement. 

- DevOps: CI/CD pipelines, release management, containers, and observability. 

- Testing: Exposure to unit testing, API and end-to-end testing, and performance testing tools. 

- Secure development: threat modeling, SAST and DAST, dependency scanning, and secrets management. 

- Architecture documentation: C4 or UML modeling and architecture decision records.

data.description:
InnoPhase Inc. , DBA GreenWave RadiosTM, is at the forefront of innovation in Open RAN digital radios. Our cutting-edge solutions, powered by the Hermes64 RF SoC, are designed to enhance network energy efficiency while dramatically reducing operational expenses, with purpose-built silicon that is the heart of ORAN-based active antenna arrays. 

Headquartered in San Diego, California, GreenWave RadiosTM has established itself as a pioneer in delivering power-efficient digital-to-RF solutions. The company is supported by a talented team of over 100 engineers spread across four global R&D facilities. With an extensive portfolio of more than 120 global patents, GreenWave RadiosTM continues to push the boundaries of radio technology and innovation. 

To learn more about GreenWave RadiosTM and hear what our employees have to say, visit the GreenWaveTM certification profile at GreatPlacetoWork. com or explore our Home - GreenWave Radios website. 

InnoPhase Inc. , DBA GreenWaveTM Radios and Synergic Emergence have a co-employment relationship. For over three years, GreenWave Radios has partnered with Synergic Emergence, a professional employment organization provider, to offer our employees the best benefits and services. This arrangement means that Synergic Emergence provides employee pay checks and benefits, and GreenWave Radios will provide employment, evaluation, and advancement. By outsourcing some HR functions, GreenWave Radios can focus on what we do best - developing and implementing highly innovative SOC cellular radio integrated circuit products. 

Job Description

InnoPhase Inc. , DBA GreenWaveTM Radios Bangalore is looking for a Senior Engineer - Design Verification to join our fast-paced and motivated team to drive excellence in our 5G products. This role is an excellent opportunity for someone that enjoys driving the critical path and making a significant impact in launching products into the market and winning!

Key Responsibilities

- You will be working within DV team on verifying HW wireless DSP blocks using internal developed reference MATLAB/Python Model. 
 - Develop UVM testbench environment and execute verification cases to verify RTL design in bit true and cycle accurate. 
 - Construct SoC level testbench re-using verification components developed at the IP/ Subsystem level. Test bench architecture for random/directed testing, stimulus generation, and integration of custom and off the shelf VIP/UVCs. 
 - Develop and execute verification plans based on design specifications and collaboration with architects and designers. 
 - Construct HW/SW Co-Verification environment - test-benches, use-cases, APIs, sequences. Execute and Debug use-cases. 
 - Be part of a dynamic and functionally diverse team with opportunities for gaining exposure to modelling (TLM), HW emulation/acceleration, and SW driven verification. 
 - Debug test cases and report verification result to achieve expected code/functional coverage metrics. Utilize constrained random verification, functional coverage, code coverage and assertions to achieve goals. 
 - Assist in emulation, FPGA, prototyping efforts. 
 - Implement and maintain automated verification flows in languages such as Python, Perl/ Shell scripts. 

Job Requirements

- Master's and/or bachelor's degree in engineering (or equivalent) in EC/ EE/ CS. 
 - 5 or more years of experience in DSP blocks(FFT, FIR, IIR, AGC, Interpolation/Decimation Filters, Up/Down Converter) design verification using reference models. 
 - Hands-on experiences in integrating MATLAB/Python models to UVM environment and create Agents, Scoreboards components for DSP blocks. 
 - Knowledge of wireless communication theories (SNR, IQ constellations, FFT, OFDM, MIMO)

Company Description

Cint is a pioneer in research technology (ResTech). Our customers use the Cint platform to post questions and get answers from real people to build business strategies, confidently publish research, accurately measure the impact of digital advertising, and more. The Cint platform is built on a programmatic marketplace, which is the world's largest, with nearly 300 million respondents in over 150 countries who consent to sharing their opinions, motivations, and behaviours. 

We are feeding the world's curiosity!

Job Description

Job Opportunity

We are seeking a highly skilled, detail-driven Data Scrubbing Senior Analyst to join our growing Global Programming & Hosting (P&H) team. In this hands-on role, you will be responsible for safeguarding the quality and integrity of our clients' survey data through rigorous cleaning, validation, and scrubbing processes. 

As a senior level analyst, you will own the technical execution of the data quality lifecycle, from live fieldwork monitoring and response validation to final scrubbing, anonymisation, and data delivery. You will work closely with Project Managers and client stakeholders to ensure our datasets are clean, compliant, and ready for confident analysis. 

What You'll Do

- Data Scrubbing & Cleaning: Lead the cleaning and scrubbing of survey data, identifying and removing duplicate, fraudulent, or low-quality responses without compromising dataset integrity. 
 - Technical Consulting: Review client requirements and quality thresholds, advising on best practices for data validation, quota management, and respondent quality control. 
 - Quality Assurance & Testing: Conduct rigorous QA checks on incoming data to catch straight-lining, speeding, and other fraud patterns before delivery. 
 - Data Validation & Compliance: Ensure data structures are clean, properly formatted, and privacy-compliant for delivery (SPSS, Excel, CSV, etc. ), scrubbing or anonymizing PII in line with regulations such as GDPR. 
 - Troubleshooting & Support: Quickly diagnose and resolve data quality issues, flagging anomalies or respondent flow bottlenecks during live fieldwork. 
 - Stakeholder Collaboration: Partner directly with internal Project Managers and client-side researchers to clarify quality standards and provide updates on data delivery timelines. 

Qualifications

What We're Looking For

- Experience: 3+ years of hands-on full service project management or survey programming experience within a market research, panel, or data collection environment. 
 - Platform Expertise: Advanced proficiency in major survey programming platforms (such as Decipher, Qualtrics, Alchemer or similar ResTech tools). 
 - Technical Skills: Strong working knowledge of web technologies including HTML, CSS, and JavaScript to customize survey interfaces and design. Experience with Python or XML is a strong plus. 
 - Eye for Detail: Exceptional analytical and QA skills with a track record of delivering clean, error-free survey logic and data files.

data.title: SOA Architect / Technical Lead
data.description:
Job Role : SOA Architect / Technical Lead

Location : Remote

Experience : 12+years

Role overview : 

An SOA Architect or Technical Lead will play a key role in ensuring that the Oracle upgrade does not disrupt integrations, business processes, application availability, or downstream systems. 

The role is broader than simply upgrading the database. It involves assessing the impact on the SOA platform, validating compatibility, coordinating technical teams, managing risks, and ensuring a controlled cutover with a reliable rollback strategy. 

SOA Architect will be responsible for target-state design and technical direction, Defines the cross-platform compatibility assessment, Recommends the upgrade approach and key design decisions, owns architectural risks and mitigation, ensuring the target architecture, compatibility approach, migration patterns and technical controls support a safe, phased transition of business-critical integrations. 

Skills : 

- Architecture designing and Middleware experience. 
 - Oracle SOA Suite 12c and 14c; Oracle WebLogic; Oracle Service Bus; BPEL; Mediator; BPM Suite; Oracle Enterprise Manager
 - Handson experience in Integration Development. 
 - BPEL; XSD/XSLT; XML/XPath; SOAP web services; REST APIs; Java/J2EE
 - DevOps and Automation : Jenkins; Git; Maven; Ansible; deployment scripting; Docker where applicable
 - Database : Oracle Database; PL/SQL; SQL performance tuning
 - Quality Engineering : SoapUI; Postman; Selenium; JMeter; regression automation; test data and defect management
 - Infrastructure and Operations : Linux; load balancers; monitoring and alerting; Kubernetes where applicable
 - Delivery and Governance : Project management; migration factory management; architecture governance; release management; ITIL-aligned transition

Key responsibilities

- Assess the current SOA estate, including composites, BPEL processes, OSB services, adapters, shared components, custom code and external dependencies. 
 - Define target architecture, upgrade strategy, technical standards, migration patterns and design decisions. 
 - Lead compatibility and impact assessments for integrations, libraries, adapters, security, certificates and runtime configurations. 
 - Produce technical designs, interface dependency maps, migration-wave recommendations and implementation guidance. 
 - Review code and configuration changes, resolve complex technical issues and conduct peer/design reviews. 
 - Work with QA and operations to define technical regression coverage, observability, rollback criteria and production-readiness checks. 
 - Support cutover, defect triage, performance tuning and stabilization. 
 - Required skills and experience

- Strong hands-on Oracle SOA Suite and Oracle Fusion Middleware experience. 
 - Expertise in BPEL, Oracle Service Bus (OSB), Mediator, SCA composites, adapters and integration patterns, as applicable to the estate. 
 - Working knowledge of Oracle WebLogic Server, JDeveloper, XML, XSD, XSLT, WSDL, SOAP and REST. 
 - Experience with middleware upgrades, platform migration, compatibility assessment and production troubleshooting. 
 - Ability to produce clear architecture/design documentation and guide offshore engineering teams. 

we are looking for someone with 30-45days of availability to start.

data.title: Hardware Architect/Engineering Manager for Electronic Solutions
data.description:
Location: Bangalore, India

Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we're driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust. 

Present in India since 1953, Thales is headquartered in Noida and has other operational offices and sites spread across Delhi, Gurugram, Bengaluru and Mumbai, among others. Over 2200 employees are working with Thales and its joint ventures in India. Since the beginning, Thales has been playing an essential role in India's growth story by sharing its technologies and expertise in Defence, Aerospace and Cyber & Digital sectors. Thales has two engineering competence centres in India - one in Noida focused on Cyber & Digital business, while the one in Bengaluru focuses on hardware, software and systems engineering capabilities for both the civil and defence sectors, serving global needs. The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair & Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry. 

Hardware Architect/Engineering Manager for Electronic Solutions

Thales India Engineering Competency Center (ECC) in Bangalore is looking to drive a Hardware engineering team. In this role, you will be responsible for Hardware subsystems architectural decisions, trade-off analysis, feasibility studies, Proposal preparation, Project scheduling/costing, Project monitoring and managing and IVVQ for various Thales products (Defense and aerospace applications). You will be coordinating with the Solution/System Architect and the Project Design Authority (PDA) to ensure consistency with the Solution/System architecture and with the hardware, industry and procurement strategies. Necessary to technically and functionally co-ordinate with engineers of hardware disciplines such as Board design (digital, analog, RF and power supplies), FPGA design (FPGA, ASIC), low-level software (in agreement with the software architect), mechanical design, testability and means of tests, industrial design (in agreement with the Head of Industry). This position requires having good level of expertise in its hardware product design, development and qualification. 

Qualifications: B. Tech/B. E in Electronics, Instrumentation engineering or equivalent with 12 to 15 years of relevant experience. Higher qualifications of Masters or Post-graduation is desirable. Domain experience in Avionics systems or defense system is desirable. 

Responsibilities: 

- Develop, stabilize and maintain hardware architecture for all phases of the life cycle from design to delivery to customer. 
 - Perform trade-off analysis of different technologies and feasibility studies to propose the best architecture design
 - Implement architecture choices based on trade-offs between cost, supply chain, customer requirements and technology possibilities
 - Lead and coordinate the architectural studies of Hardware under his responsibility
 - Perform trade-off analysis of different technologies and feasibility studies to propose the best architecture design
 - Identify risks and opportunities related to the hardware architecture
 - Propose and implement risk reduction plans and opportunities for validation
 - Preparing project proposal including schedule and efforts
 - Preparation of the associated project documentation and reviews
 - Coordinating with different stakeholders like Industrialization, IPO, suppliers, engineering, WPM, customer to prepare the optimal project proposals
 - Integration of Hardware, Software and Firmware and performs IVVQ
 - Collaborative work applying quality standards and internal processes
 - Ensure compliance with standards, product development plans (reuse policy), material, industrial and purchasing strategies

Skills & experience: 

- Must have strong experience in complete Hardware certified development life cycle (Technical feasibility, requirements writing, preliminary and detailed design, prototype manufacturing, test and evaluation, qualification and certification)
 - Must have gained experience in piloting a lot of development work, involving in product testing in external labs for hardware products
 - Must have experience in the IVVQ (Integration, Verification, Validation and Qualification) including requirements management
 - Must have strong experience of integration of Hardware, FPGA firmware, mechanical packaging, low-level software and application software on Hardware unit. 
 - Must have good experience in bench test set-up, functional testing and performance evaluation
 - Must have experience in developing IVV Test procedures (PVP/ATP), Test Reports (PVR/ATR), Qualification by similarity reports (QBSR) and other documents required by certification authorities for airborne products. 
 - Must have strong experience to troubleshoot on electronics and embedded hardware systems to find the root cause and to fix with a suitable solution. 
 - Must have experience to ensure the reporting progress of the project along with KPI. 
 - Must have experience to manage risks and opportunities at Hardware solution architecture. 
 - Must be rigorous, organized, autonomous and proactive, and motivated by a position within a multidisciplinary team. 
 - Must have demonstrated leadership skills on complex topics. 
 - Must have experience of working with multi-disciplinary team (extended business line engineering team, Lab technicians, external labs, Purchase team, Engineering teams and manufacturing teams)
 - Must have experience in interfacing with external test facilities for environmental and EMI/EMC and other electrical tests as per MIL-STD/IEC61000/DO-160 standards. 
 - Should be familiar with Knowledge of production trades: procurement, manufacturing, delivery
 - Knowledge of Certification DO254/DO160, Safety of aeronautical systems (ARP4761), and Knowledge of ARP4754B will be helpful. 
 - Product knowledge in avionics fields: civil and military calculators, displays, inertia, GNSS, probes will be helpful. 
 - Excellent communication and collaboration skills in an international multi-cultural environment (France, Canada, India, UK). Ability to work across different departments and establish effective relationships. 

At Thales, we're committed to fostering a workplace where respect, trust, collaboration, and passion drive everything we do. Here, you'll feel empowered to bring your best self, thrive in a supportive culture, and love the work you do. Join us, and be part of a team reimagining technology to create solutions that truly make a difference - for a safer, greener, and more inclusive world.

Technology, Digital and Data

Job Description

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc. 

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do - but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here - we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it. 

Cat Digital seeks a seasoned Senior Software Engineering Manager to lead the Helios Platform Services India Team, building and scaling core platform capabilities that power Caterpillar's digital ecosystem. 

This senior leadership role combines people leadership, technical direction, and product strategy. You will drive delivery and evolution of enterprise-grade capabilities that help product teams move faster through reusable, secure, and scalable services. 

You will partner with global engineering, product, architecture, and business leaders to accelerate Helios adoption and strengthen a reusable, API-driven engineering culture. 

Key Responsibilities

Engineering Leadership and Delivery

- Lead multiple teams delivering domain and core services on Helios, Caterpillar's largest data platform. 
 - Drive end-to-end delivery across design, development, deployment, and operations. 
 - Ensure platform services meet enterprise-grade standards for scalability, reliability, and performance. 
 - Own delivery commitments, roadmaps, and execution for the India-based teams. 

Platform Strategy and Architecture

- Partner with product, architecture, and principal engineering leaders to define the Helios roadmap. 
 - Drive adoption of cloud-native architecture patterns, including microservices, APIs, and event-driven systems. 
 - Ensure services are built as reusable, standardized components aligned with design principles. 
 - Align platform services with enterprise architecture, security, and compliance requirements. 

People Leadership and Organization Building

- Build, mentor, and scale high-performing teams, including engineering managers and senior engineers. 
 - Build a strong leadership bench and succession pipeline. 
 - Lead hiring, talent development, and performance management in line with Cat Digital standards. 
 - Foster a culture of ownership, accountability, and engineering excellence. 

Operational Excellence and Quality

- Own platform reliability, availability, and operational health, including SLA/SLO adherence, observability, and incident management. 
 - Drive adoption of DevOps, CI/CD, and automated quality practices, including TDD and BDD. 
 - Institutionalize metrics-driven engineering across quality, velocity, stability, and customer impact. 

Platform Adoption and Stakeholder Management

- Partner with product teams to accelerate onboarding and adoption. 
 - Partner with global stakeholders to prioritize platform investments and resolve cross-team dependencies. 
 - Act as a key bridge between India engineering teams and global Helios leadership. 

Innovation and Continuous Improvement

- Drive innovation in platform capabilities, including automation, AI enablement, and developer experience improvements. 
 - Identify opportunities to modernize legacy systems and improve operational efficiency. 
 - Champion a product mindset, with APIs treated as products and services owned across their lifecycle. 

Required Qualifications

- 18+ years of experience in software engineering with significant exposure to platform or enterprise-scale systems
 - 8+ years in engineering leadership roles managing multiple teams and managers
 - Strong experience building and operating cloud-native platforms (AWS)
 - Proven track record delivering shared services and platform services used by multiple products
 - Deep understanding of Java, Spring Boot, microservices, APIs, distributed systems, DevOps, CI/CD, and automation. 
 - Experience leading large-scale, globally distributed teams. 
 - Strong understanding of AI models and their use in improving developer and business outcomes. 
 - Ability to normalize and contextualize data from diverse sources for real-time decision-making. 
 - Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to drive cross-functional alignment. 
 - Demonstrated ability to define platform strategy, guide architectural decisions, and align engineering execution with business goals. 
 - Strong organizational design and talent development skills, including hiring, mentoring, and performance management. 

What You Will Bring

- Strong strategic thinking with a bias for execution. 
 - Ability to operate at both the system and organizational levels. 
 - A platform-first mindset centered on reuse, consistency, and developer experience. 
 - Executive presence and the ability to influence across functions. 
 - Passion for building teams, leaders, and long-term engineering capability in India

Success Measures

- Increase adoption and usage across products. 
 - Improve platform reliability, scalability, and developer experience. 
 - Build a strong engineering culture and leadership pipeline. 
 - Deliver the platform roadmap and business outcomes predictably. 

Why This Role Matters

Helios is the foundation of Caterpillar's digital ecosystem, enabling reusable services, cross-product integration, and enterprise-scale innovation. This role is central to scaling the India team into a strategic execution engine for global priorities. 

This position requires working onsite five days a week. 

Visa Sponsorship is not available for this position. 

Posting Dates

October 29, 2026 - November 8, 2026

Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply

Not ready to apply? Join our Talent Community.

Qualcomm India Private Limited

Job Area

Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Software Engineering

General Summary

Lead the architecture, development, optimization, and productization of low-power Wi-Fi MAC firmware and Datapath. Drive technical innovation, system performance and execution across multiple wireless connectivity products. 

Key Responsibilities

- Define and drive Wi-Fi MAC firmware and datapath architecture. 
 - Design and implement Wi-Fi MAC features for 802. 11ax/ac/n platforms. 
 - Develop and optimize TX/RX datapaths, packet scheduling, buffer management, and DMA flows. 
 - Drive power optimization initiatives including TWT, U-APSD, DCVS, and sleep-state management. 
 - Lead root-cause analysis and resolution of connectivity, throughput, latency, coexistence, and power issues. 
 - Strong experience in debugging FW issues due to MAC HW configurations
 - Establish debugging frameworks, performance instrumentation, and engineering best practices. 
 - Mentor engineers and provide technical leadership across projects.

- BS/MS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related field.

data.title: IND Staff Software Engineer
data.description:
IND Staff Software Engineer - GCC122

We're determined to make a difference and are proud to be an insurance company that goes well beyond coverages and policies. Working here means having every opportunity to achieve your goals - and to help others accomplish theirs, too. Join our team as we help shape the future. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design & Deliver AI Solutions: Build statistical, ML, and generative/agentic AI solutions spanning RAG pipelines, chat/assistants, classification, forecasting, and recommendation systems using a fit‐for‐purpose toolkit from traditional predictive modeling to agentic workflows. 
 - Regulatory Intelligence & Filing Automation: Design and deploy GenAI capabilities to automate regulatory filing support, including DOI objection response generation and ingestion of legacy filings into searchable knowledge bases. Partner with Legal and Compliance to ensure outputs meet evolving standards and enable direct API integrations with regulatory bodies. 
 - Knowledge Base Engineering for Strategic Domains: Engineer and maintain domain‐specific knowledge bases (regulatory intelligence, competitive insights, customer sentiment) to power generative applications across underwriting, pricing, and service. 
 - Domain & Compliance Integration: Develop deep understanding of The Hartford's business structures, processes, and data sources. Embed domain taxonomies, regulatory constraints, access controls, and security into the solution design. Ensure adherence to responsible AI practices-fairness, bias mitigation, transparency, and observability with compliance‐by‐design. 
 - Stakeholder Collaboration: Partner with leaders and SMEs across Product, Operations, Claims, Underwriting, and Risk to align initiatives to business goals. Define success criteria that balance accuracy, reusability, cost, and performance. Translate model behavior into actionable strategies with clear ROI. 
 - End‐to‐End Solution Development: Own the AI lifecycle from problem framing through deployment: data prep, modeling, evaluation, CI/CD, orchestration, observability, safety filters/guardrails, and rollback plans. Collaborate closely with AI engineers, data engineers, platform, security, and IT for seamless integration. 
 - Unstructured Data & Retrieval Design: Prepare multi‐format content (PDF, Office, HTML, images, audio) with normalization, metadata/lineage management, and PII detection/redaction. Design retrieval strategies (chunking, embeddings, hybrid search) and tune for cost, latency, and domain fit; leverage rerankers where appropriate. 
 - Prompt & Agent Design: Author robust system prompts, few‐shot patterns, and structured outputs (e. g. , JSON schemas). Define safe tool‐use policies and function/structured calling for reliable agent behavior. 
 - Evaluation & Monitoring: Define metrics across use cases for classification, information retrieval, RAG/chat, forecasting, plus customer/ops KPIs. Build gold/synthetic test sets, support A/B testing, and monitor drift. Provide economic, qualitative, and statistical analysis supporting thresholds and decisions. 
 - Synthetic Data Generation & Augmentation: Develop and validate synthetic data pipelines to alleviate sparsity and accelerate convergence, especially for low‐frequency perils and emerging segments, while preserving privacy and distributional fidelity. 
 - Customer Experience Optimization: Apply GenAI to elevate self‐service, virtual assistants, and inspection automation, driving personalization, speed, and operational efficiency. 
 - Architectural Collaboration & MLOps Integration: Partner with enterprise architects and platform teams to ensure scalable, secure deployments via unified systems. Standardize experiment tracking, registries, evaluation gates, and CI/CD patterns across clouds and services. 
 - Innovation & Continuous Learning: Identify and pilot emerging methods (OCR, rerankers, PEFT/LoRA, distillation). Build reusable accelerators (chunking templates, prompt registries, evaluation harnesses). Stay current on AI/ML, LLMOps, NLP, RAG, and responsible AI. 

Required Skills & Experience

- Experience Range - 6 to 9 Years
 - Experience in statistical modeling and machine learning using Python, including extensive use of pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, and strong SQL for data exploration, feature development, and knowledge preparation; familiarity with PyTorch and/or TensorFlow preferred. 
 - Experience across the end-to-end modeling lifecycle, including problem framing and requirements gathering, experiment design, offline evaluation, and ongoing production validation and monitoring. 
 - Solid understanding and practical application of core machine learning methods, with 3+ years of experience applying deep learning architectures in real-world use cases. 
 - Experience designing and operationalizing model evaluation and monitoring approaches, including test set creation (gold and/or synthetic), metric definition and tracking (e. g. , classification, forecasting, ranking/IR, and business KPIs), and supporting A/B testing, drift detection, and performance regression monitoring. 
 - Experience working with unstructured data, including document parsing and OCR fundamentals, text normalization, metadata and lineage awareness, and PII detection or redaction considerations. 
 - Experience using Git and Unix-based development environments, with experience building reproducible notebooks or pipelines and ensuring repeatable analytical workflows; 3+ years of exposure to basic container and cloud fundamentals supporting deployment workflows
 - Experience communicating modeling decisions, design tradeoffs, evaluation results, and risks to both technical and non-technical audiences, and translating analytical outcomes into measurable business impact. 
 - Experience working with cloud-based AI platforms such as Google Vertex AI, AWS SageMaker or Bedrock, or Azure AI Services, supporting experimentation, model training, and deployment. 
 - Experience deploying models and integrating scoring logic into production systems, including operation within complex enterprise or packaged application environments (e. g. , Duck Creek, Ratabase). 
 - Experience with NLP and Generative AI capabilities, including embeddings, retrieval strategies (dense and hybrid), chunking approaches, prompt engineering, structured outputs, and contributing to Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions and evaluations. 
 - Experience or exposure to advanced GenAI applications and extensions, such as agent or tool-use concepts, domain-specific knowledge graph integration, synthetic data generation, sentiment modeling, and GenAI use cases in filing or compliance contexts. 
 - Experience working within enterprise AI governance expectations, including aligning model development with compliance, privacy, documentation, and ethical standards. 

Nice to Have

- RAG Expertise: Handson with vector databases and search (e. g. , Vertex AI RAG Engine, OpenSearch, pgvector/Postgres), ANN indexing (HNSW), rerankers (crossencoders), and evaluation frameworks (RAGAS, TruLens, DeepEval). 
 - Document AI Tooling: PyMuPDF/pdfplumber, Apache Tika; OCR (Tesseract); layoutaware models (LayoutLM); table extraction (Camelot/Tabula). 
 - Embedding Model Selection: Experience comparing OpenAI/Cohere/Voyage vs. opensource (bge/e5/gte) for domain corpora; understanding dimension/quality/cost/latency tradeoffs and multilingual needs. 
 - Orchestration Frameworks: Familiarity with LangChain, LangGraph, or LlamaIndex; structured tool/function calling and guardrails for AI agents. 
 - CloudNative ML: Handson with Vertex AI, SageMaker, or Azure ML; experiment tracking (MLflow/W&B), registries, and CI evaluation gates. 
 - Responsible AI & Safety: Bias/fairness testing, hallucination mitigation, grounding checks, safety filters; basic model risk documentation. 
 - Broader Modalities (Nice to Have): Timeseries forecasting, recommenders, anomaly/fraud detection, speech/vision/multimodal. 
 - Fine tuning LLMs and Diffusion models using PEFT/LoRA, experience with distillation

data.title: OpenShift Virtualization & Linux Platform Team Lead
data.description:
Location: Hyderabad, India

Function: (DEAI HV) IT

Requisition ID: R0149102

Our Company

We're Hitachi Vantara, the data foundation trusted by the world's innovators. Our resilient, high-performance data infrastructure means that customers - from banks to theme parks - can focus on achieving the incredible with data. If you've seen the Las Vegas Sphere, you've seen just one example of how we empower businesses to automate, optimize, innovate - and wow their customers. Right now, we're laying the foundation for our next wave of growth. We're looking for people who love being part of a diverse, global team - and who get excited about making a real-world impact with data. 

The Role

Lead the architecture, deployment, and operation of enterprise OpenShift Virtualization and Linux platforms. This hands-on role owns platform reliability, security, automation, patching, monitoring, recovery, and lifecycle management across OpenShift, RHEL, Red Hat Satellite, Ansible, NFS, and virtual machines. The position also leads complex troubleshooting, supports critical workloads, mentors engineers, and coordinates with infrastructure, cloud, security, application, database, and vendor teams. 

Design, deploy, administer, and support OpenShift Container Platform and OpenShift Virtualization in production. 

- Define standards for cluster architecture, virtualization worker nodes, VM placement, capacity, security, availability, and lifecycle management. 
 - Manage VM provisioning, templates, images, DataVolumes, persistent storage, snapshots, cloning, live migration, backup, recovery, and maintenance. 
 - Plan platform upgrades; perform health, compatibility, capacity, and post-change validation; maintain architecture and operating documentation. 
 - Provide expert-level RHEL administration and troubleshooting across system services, boot, kernel, networking, storage, filesystems, LVM, logging, SELinux, certificates, and performance. 
 - Own Red Hat Satellite for content, subscriptions, host lifecycle, provisioning, patching, compliance, and reporting. 
 - Plan and execute OS patching, lifecycle upgrades, hardening, and vulnerability remediation for on-premises and AWS-hosted Linux VMs. 
 - Design and maintain Ansible Automation Platform playbooks, roles, inventories, templates, and workflows for provisioning, configuration, patching, validation, compliance, and reporting. 
 - Support production Linux VMs and business-critical applications, including Oracle E-Business Suite (EBS), in partnership with application and database teams. 
 - Lead complex incident troubleshooting and root-cause analysis across OpenShift, Linux, applications, and dependent infrastructure services. 
 - Remain hands-on while leading design reviews, operational-readiness reviews, troubleshooting sessions, and major incident resolution. 
 - Mentor engineers and communicate technical risks, dependencies, options, and recommendations clearly to stakeholders. 
 - Coordinate with application, database, cloud, security, network, storage, backup, identity, datacenter, and vendor teams. 

What you'll Bring

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - Minimum of 8 years of experience in IT infrastructure, with at least 4 years in a senior technical role focused on Linux and/or virtualization. 
 - Proven expertise with Red Hat OpenShift, including OpenShift Virtualization (KubeVirt). 
 - Strong proficiency in Linux operating systems (e. g. , RHEL, CentOS, Ubuntu) and system administration. 
 - Extensive experience with containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes) and orchestration. 
 - Solid understanding of networking concepts (TCP/IP, DNS, Load Balancing) and storage solutions in a cloud-native environment. 
 - Experience with automation tools and scripting (e. g. , Ansible, Python, Bash). 
 - Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps methodologies. 
 - Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills. 
 - Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment. 
 - Relevant certifications (e. g. , Red Hat Certified Engineer, Kubernetes Administrator) are a plus. 

About Us

We're a global team of innovators. Together, we harness engineering excellence and passion for insight to co-create meaningful solutions to complex challenges. We turn organizations into data-driven leaders that can make a positive impact on their industries and society. If you believe that innovation can inspire the future, this is the place to fulfil your purpose and achieve your potential. 

Fostering innovation through diverse perspectives

Hitachi is a global company operating across a wide range of industries and regions. One of the things that sets Hitachi apart is the diversity of our business and people, which drives our innovation and growth. 

We are committed to building an inclusive culture based on mutual respect and merit-based systems. We believe that when people feel valued, heard, and safe to express themselves, they do their best work. 

How We Look After You

We help take care of your today and tomorrow with industry-leading benefits, support, and services that look after your holistic health and wellbeing. We're also champions of life balance and offer flexible arrangements that work for you (role and location dependent). We're always looking for new ways of working that bring out our best, which leads to unexpected ideas. So here, you'll experience a sense of belonging, and discover autonomy, freedom, and ownership as you work alongside talented people you enjoy sharing knowledge with. 

We're proud to say we're an equal opportunity employer and welcome all applicants for employment without attention to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran, age, disability status or any other protected characteristic. Should you need reasonable accommodations during the recruitment process, please let us know so that we can do our best to set you up for success.

data.title: Sr. Assoc, Devops Engineer
data.description:
About Revantage

Revantage, a Blackstone Real Estate portfolio company, is a global provider of corporate services. 

With a corporate purpose of 'In Pursuit of Better, ' Revantage delivers value-added services and world-class talent for Blackstone Real Estate portfolio companies, spanning diverse asset classes, including residential, logistics, office, hospitality and retail sectors. The company's footprint extends across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific. 

Creating a culture that inspires impact and momentum requires the right team. We know what it takes to lead an industry, and are looking for leaders who seek constant growth, want to excel, and continuously improve upon themselves and the industry. 

In addition to supporting Revantage, we also recruit for Blackstone Real Estate portfolio companies, giving you the unique opportunity to work within a network of best-in-class professionals across a broad real estate platform. 

India

With offices in Bengaluru and Gurugram, our teams in India deliver expertise, innovation and operational excellence that support thousands of assets across logistics, data centers, residential, commercial and hospitality. 

Whether you're building new capabilities, driving critical initiatives or strengthening partnerships, you'll have the opportunity to truly Build What Matters. 

Summary / Position Objective

The DevOps Engineer is responsible for building, automating, securing, and operating cloud infrastructure and delivery pipelines in Microsoft Azure, with a significant focus on infrastructure as code using Terraform and on the operation of the Databricks data platform. This position codifies infrastructure rather than clicking through portals, treats pipelines and environments as products, and is measured by the reliability, repeatability, security, and cost efficiency of what it builds. 

Working as an integrated member of the Security and IT Operations organization alongside software developers, data engineers, cybersecurity engineers, and systems administrators, the DevOps Engineer partners early in the delivery lifecycle to make the secure path the easy path. This role also participates in on-call rotation, release and maintenance windows, and incident response for the platforms it owns. This position reports to the Director of IT Operations. 

Critical Duties

Infrastructure as Code and Azure Platform Engineering

- Design, write, review, and maintain Terraform code to provision and manage Azure infrastructure, including reusable modules, consistent naming and tagging standards, and version pinning of providers and modules. 
 - Own Terraform state management, including remote backends, state locking, workspace and environment separation, drift detection, and safe remediation of drift without destructive changes. 
 - Build and maintain Azure foundational infrastructure, including subscriptions and resource groups, virtual networks, subnets, network security groups, private endpoints, DNS, load balancing, and storage. 
 - Implement guardrails as code, including Azure Policy, role assignments, resource locks, and budget and tagging enforcement, so environments are compliant by construction rather than by audit. 
 - Manage environment promotion across development, test, and production with identical code paths and environment-specific configuration held outside of code. 
 - Eliminate manual and portal-based infrastructure changes by bringing existing resources under Terraform management and documenting the exceptions that cannot be. 

CI/CD and Release Engineering

- Build, maintain, and optimize CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps Pipelines and/or GitHub Actions), including build, test, artifact publication, and multi-stage deployment with approvals. 
 - Implement automated quality and security gates in pipelines, including linting, unit and integration test execution, Terraform plan review, static analysis, dependency scanning, and container image scanning. 
 - Establish and enforce source control practices, including branching strategy, pull request review requirements, protected branches, and traceability from commit to deployed change. 
 - Automate deployment and rollback so that releases are low-drama and reversible, and reduce lead time from merge to production. 
 - Manage build agents, runners, service connections, and workload identity federation, eliminating long-lived credentials wherever possible. 

Databricks and Data Platform Operations

- Provision and manage Databricks workspaces and workspace configuration through Terraform rather than manual setup. 
 - Administer Databricks platform operations, including cluster policies, instance pools, compute sizing, autoscaling, auto-termination, runtime version management, and job and workflow orchestration. 
 - Implement and maintain Unity Catalog structure and governance, including metastore configuration, catalogs and schemas, external locations, storage credentials, and grants aligned to least privilege. 
 - Integrate Databricks identity with Microsoft Entra ID, including SCIM provisioning of users and groups, and coordinate entitlement design with the Identity and Access Management team. 
 - Secure the data platform, including secret scopes backed by Azure Key Vault, private connectivity to Azure Data Lake Storage, network isolation, and elimination of embedded credentials in notebooks and jobs. 
 - Build CI/CD for data assets, including Databricks Repos or Git folders, notebook and job deployment automation, and environment-specific configuration for data pipelines. 
 - Monitor platform health, job reliability, and cost; implement chargeback tagging, cluster cost controls, and alerting on runaway compute. 
 - Partner with data engineering to troubleshoot job failures, performance problems, and Delta Lake and storage layer issues. 

Observability, Reliability, and Automation

- Implement and maintain monitoring, logging, and alerting using Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, and Application Insights, with alerts that are actionable and tuned to reduce noise. 
 - Define and track service level indicators and objectives for owned platforms, and drive down recurring failure modes rather than repeatedly remediating them. 
 - Write and maintain automation and tooling in PowerShell, Python, and/or Bash to eliminate repeatable operational work. 
 - Build and operate containerized workloads where applicable, including Docker images, Azure Kubernetes Service, and container registry lifecycle and image hygiene. 
 - Author and maintain runbooks, architecture diagrams, and operational documentation sufficient for another engineer to operate the platform unaided. 
 - Participate in incident response for owned platforms, including triage, mitigation, restoration, and blameless post-incident review with corrective actions tracked to closure. 
 - Design and validate backup, recovery, and business continuity capability for infrastructure and platform configuration, including periodic restore testing. 

Security, Governance, and Cost

- Apply DevSecOps practices throughout the pipeline, shifting security checks left and treating security findings as build-blocking defects rather than backlog items. 
 - Implement least-privilege access using Azure role-based access control, managed identities, and workload identity federation; route all human entitlement and privileged access requests through the Identity and Access Management team in accordance with company policy. 
 - Manage secrets and certificates in Azure Key Vault, including rotation, and remediate any secrets found in code, pipelines, or configuration. 
 - Partner with Information Security on vulnerability remediation, cloud security posture findings (including Microsoft Defender for Cloud), hardening standards such as CIS benchmarks, and evidence for control reviews. 
 - Follow change management for all production changes, including documented change records, tested rollback plans, and adherence to approved change windows. 
 - Monitor and optimize cloud spend, including rightsizing, reservation and savings plan recommendations, orphaned resource cleanup, and cost visibility reporting to leadership. 

Coverage, On-Call, and Business Continuity

- Maintain overlap with U. S. Central Time business hours for collaboration with U. S. -based engineering, data, and security teams. 
 - Participate in a rotating holiday coverage schedule, including Indian holidays, to ensure uninterrupted support for a U. S. -based enterprise. 
 - Provide support outside normal business hours as operational needs dictate, including incident response and critical production events. 
 - Support a 24×7 operational environment through scheduled rotation, on-call responsibilities, and business continuity requirements. 
 - Execute planned deployments, patching, and maintenance during approved windows, which may fall on U. S. nights or weekends. 

Essential Duties

- Partner with software developers and data engineers early in design to make infrastructure, pipeline, and platform decisions that hold up in production. 
 - Review peers' infrastructure and pipeline code, and accept review on your own, treating code review as a quality control rather than a formality. 
 - Document and continuously improve platform standards, reference architectures, and repeatable patterns to create consistency and increase efficiency. 
 - Identify and retire technical debt, including unmanaged resources, deprecated runtimes, unsupported provider versions, and one-off snowflake environments. 
 - Evaluate new Azure and Databricks capabilities against real needs, pilot deliberately, and recommend adoption with a clear cost, risk, and operational impact assessment. 
 - Provide knowledge transfer and enablement to IT Operations and application teams so platform ownership is not concentrated in a single person. 
 - Contribute to capacity planning, platform roadmap input, and cloud budget forecasting. 
 - Maintain ongoing working knowledge of cloud platform engineering, infrastructure as code, and data platform best practices, and proactively bring applicable improvements to the team and leadership. 

Qualifications

OTHER DUTIES MAY BE ASSIGNED

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each critical duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed are representative of the minimum knowledge, skills, and/or abilities required. data.title: Principal Emulation IP Engineer
data.description:
We Are

Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow. 

You Are

You have spent years in the trenches of ASIC verification, and somewhere along the way you realized that emulation is not just another tool in the flow, it is the thing that makes or breaks your ability to ship complex IP on time. You know PCIe or DDR inside and out, not just the spec but the weird corner cases, the errata that nobody talks about, and the places where emulation models fall short of what the design team actually needs. 

You have worked on Zebu or similar platforms long enough to know what good emulation IP looks like and what happens when it is not quite right. You have closed that gap before, probably more than once, and you know how to do it without creating chaos for the teams depending on your work. Sitting with a design team in Bangalore, a verification lead in California, and an IP product manager in Europe does not faze you. You walk out with a plan that everyone believes in. 

You do not wait for perfect alignment. Ask the right questions, push back when something does not make sense, and move. At Synopsys, you will work on IP that powers the next generation of silicon, and the emulation strategies you define will directly affect how fast we get there. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Bridge the gap between Emulation IP capabilities and Design IP verification needs across both Controller and PHY domains for high-speed interfaces like PCIe and DDR
 - Define technical requirements for Emulation IP, working directly with IP development and verification teams to ensure correct implementation and deployment on Zebu platforms
 - Track and report key metrics on Emulation IP quality, performance, and coverage, driving continuous improvement across verification workflows
 - Stay ahead of evolving PCIe and DDR standards, interpret specification updates, ECNs, and errata, and translate those into actionable changes for both Emulation and Design IP teams
 - Review and validate test plans for Emulation IP and Design IP, ensuring completeness, traceability, and alignment with product quality goals
 - Collaborate cross-functionally with verification, design, product, and platform teams to optimize emulation methodologies and standardize best practices
 - Mentor engineers on emulation strategies, verification techniques, and IP development workflows

The Impact You Will Have

- Accelerate time to market for high-performance IP by defining emulation strategies that catch issues earlier and reduce silicon respins
 - Elevate product quality across Synopsys IP portfolios by ensuring Emulation IP meets the real needs of design and verification teams
 - Drive adoption of best-in-class emulation and verification methodologies that become standard practice across the organization
 - Influence the next generation of emulation solutions and workflows, positioning Synopsys as a leader in pre-silicon validation
 - Improve cross-functional collaboration and alignment between geographically distributed teams, reducing friction and rework
 - Standardize verification workflows and metrics, making it easier for teams to track progress, identify gaps, and deliver with confidence
 - Shape how Synopsys develops and deploys Emulation IP for cutting-edge digital designs and system architectures

What You'll Need

- 8+ years of hands-on experience in emulation, pre-silicon verification, or IP product development
 - Expert-level knowledge of PCIe or DDR interfaces, including protocol details, verification strategies, and real-world implementation challenges
 - Extensive experience with Zebu or similar emulation platforms, specifically for IP verification and system-level validation
 - Proven track record leading IP product development initiatives with a strong focus on emulation and verification
 - Demonstrated ability to work cross-functionally in matrixed, global teams and drive consensus across diverse stakeholders
 - Strong communication skills with the ability to influence technical direction and inspire change across engineering teams
 - Comfort working in dynamic, ambiguous environments where requirements evolve and priorities shift

Who You Are

- You can walk into a room where the Emulation IP does not quite match what the design team needs and walk out with a concrete plan to close the gap without derailing either team's schedule
 - You do not need someone to tell you what the next version of the PCIe or DDR spec means for your work. You read it, figure out the implications, and start the conversation with your team
 - You are the person people come to when emulation results do not make sense, and you know how to debug across the boundary between emulation models, RTL, and test environments
 - You push back when a test plan looks complete on paper but is missing coverage for the cases that actually matter in production
 - Mentoring engineers who are newer to emulation or IP verification comes naturally to you, and you do it in a way that builds their confidence and capability
 - You stay organized across multiple workstreams, stakeholders, and time zones without losing track of what matters most

The Team You'll Be Part Of

You will join a dynamic, high-performing engineering team focused on IP development, emulation, and verification at the forefront of semiconductor innovation. Our team is collaborative, cross-functional, and globally distributed, working together to solve complex challenges and deliver industry-leading solutions. You will have the opportunity to collaborate with experts across multiple domains, drive impactful initiatives, and shape the future of digital design and verification at Synopsys. 

Rewards and Benefits

We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

data.title: Manager Product Development
data.description:
Itron is innovating new ways for utilities and cities to manage energy and water. We create a more resourceful world to protect essential resources for today and tomorrow. Join us. 

Itron Resiliency Solutions is an innovative business unit within Itron focused on solving mission critical problems for utilities through software and AI. Resiliency Solutions offers unique, market leading solutions for front-line worker safety, storm response, excavation damage prevention, construction management, and many more. These software and AI solutions solve end-to-end challenges for the utilities that power our society and are used by the largest and most complex organizations in the world such as National Grid, Southern Company, and Exelon. 

Itron Resiliency Solutions is a global, diverse team of builders and innovators who tackle previously impossible challenges for our customers. If you have a desire to challenge yourself, solve impactful problems, and work with a passionate and talented team, this is the place. 

Position Summary

We're hiring a hands-on Engineering Manager in Bengaluru to lead a team that owns production software end to end - from what customers need, to how it's built, to how it runs. This is not a coordination role: you will still design systems, review code and get into incidents, while growing the people around you. 

Our India engineering team is taking full ownership of core products and growing quickly, including a ground-up rebuild of a customer-critical service. Y ou'll help shape how this team works, who joins it, and what it ships. Y ou'll report to the Director of Engineering and work closely with Product, Program Management, Customer Support and business stakeholders. 

What You'll Own In Your First Year

- A team and its outcomes. Lead a team of engineers (growing as we hire) and own what it delivers - measured by what changed for customers, not by tickets closed. 
 - Hiring. Help build the team: define what good looks like, interview, and close candidates. 
 - Quality as a first-class priority. Set the bar for testing, release and on-call so the team ships often without breaking customers. 
 - Technical direction. Make and document the architecture tradeoffs for your area, and stay close enough to the code to know when a design is wrong. 
 - People growth. Run 1: 1s, give direct feedback, and create stretch paths so strong engineers grow faster than a standard promotion cycle. 
 - Own: Own it end to end with Speed, quality, depth and long term vision. 

What You Must Bring

- You have led engineers. At least 2 years directly managing a team - hiring, feedback, 

performance conversations, growing people. 

- Tech-lead: A tech-lead role for at least 4 years. 
 - You are still hands-on. Y ou've designed and built production systems in the recent

past, and you can review a pull request or a design doc and find the real problem in it. 

- You've owned multiple systems in production end to end. A system or product where

you were accountable for it working for customers - releases, incidents, and the

follow-through after. 

- You've delivered under ambiguity. You've taken a problem nobody had fully defined - a new product, an inherited system, a team in transition - and turned it into something

shipped. 

We care how you engineer more than which language you did it in. 

Technical background

- You've built and run production systems with a modern stack, such as: Cloud: AWS - you've designed, deployed and operated services on it, not just consumed them. 
 - Languages: one or more modern languages such as Python, Java or JavaScript/TypeScript. 
 - Frameworks: modern service frameworks such as FastAPI, Node. js or equivalents. 
 - Databases, in depth: data modeling, query and index optimization, and scaling (replication, partitioning, caching). Y ou can walk us through a data model you designed and a performance problem you fixed, with the before and after. 

Exact tools matter less than depth. Strong experience on an equivalent stack is welcome. 

What Sets Great Candidates Apart

- Impact you can explain. You can name a result, the baseline it moved from, and how your team got there. You've also stopped or cut something that wasn't working. Teams you've grown. People you hired or coached who went on to bigger roles, and a team that got measurably better at shipping under you. 
 - Scale and complexity. Y ou've handled real load, real data volume or a genuinely hard domain - and can tell the story of one hard technical problem in detail. 
 - Inherited systems. You've taken over a codebase or product from another team or location and made it better without stopping delivery. 
 - Quality discipline. Y ou've raised a team's bar on testing, releases or incident response, and can show what changed. 
 - Cross-functional range. You've worked directly with product, support and business partners, and made scoping calls rather than just executing them. 
 - Framework mindset: You have a framework mindset and find opportunities to covert a custom implementation into a framework. 

What We Look For In Everyone We Hire

Whatever the role, we hire for six things. For a manager, each one also shows up in the team you build. 

- Customer obsession. Y ou know who uses what your team builds and what changed for them. Y ou treat support escalations and on-call as signal, not chores. 
 - Impact over activity. Y ou measure success by outcomes, not sprints delivered or meetings run. Y ou'll choose the boring solution if it ships sooner. 
 - Honesty. You give credit to your team and are specific about your own part. You tell leadership bad news early, and you say what didn't work. 
 - Independence. Y ou don't need a roadmap handed to you. Y ou find the problem worth solving and get it done with little hand-holding - and you build a team that works the same way. Y ou will work with leaders who will partner with you in the journey. 
 - Passion. Not the word on a resume - the evidence: something you kept going back to, a craft you kept deepening, people you kept teaching. 
 - Depth. At least one system or domain you could talk about for an hour, down to the internals and the tradeoffs. Y ears in a role aren't depth; complexity handled is. 

Itron is committed to building an inclusive and diverse workforce and providing an authentic workplace experience for all employees. If you are excited about this role but your past experiences don't perfectly align with every requirement, we encourage you to apply anyway. In the end, you may be just who we are looking for!

The successful candidate's starting wage will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills and experience. 

Itron is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. If you require an accommodation to apply, please contact a recruiting representative at 1-800-635-5461 or email Accessibility@itron. com. 

Itron is transforming how the world manages energy, water and city services. Our trusted intelligent infrastructure solutions help utilities and cities improve efficiency, build resilience and deliver safe, reliable and affordable service. With edge intelligence, we connect people, data insights and devices so communities can better manage the essential resources they rely on to live. Join us as we create a more resourceful world: www. itron. com

data.description:
Position Summary

JOB DESCRIPTION

Vertiv is seeking a AME Manufacturing Development & Deployment Engineer. This role is the critical architect of our "Connected Factory, " responsible for the physical and digital realization of manufacturing processes on the plant floor. You will lead the deployment of advanced production lines for Power and Thermal products, ensuring that Discrete Event Simulation (DES) and Yamazumi models are executed with precision. This role requires a leader who can manage the convergence of physical equipment-such as Automation cells and DC Torque tools-with our OT digital stack, including Inductive Automation's Ignition, Power Apps, and mobile tablet integration, to ensure a seamless "Vertical Startup" with real-time data visibility

Responsibilities

- On-Site Process & OT Deployment: Lead the physical installation of manufacturing lines, integrating OT devices and Automation into a unified factory ecosystem. Orchestrate the rollout of Ignition Perspective HMI and Microsoft Power Apps to provide shop-floor operators with real-time digital work instructions and performance dashboards. 
 - Smart Tooling & IoT Integration: Direct the deployment and calibration of DC Torque tools and smart sensors. Ensure these devices are networked to capture granular assembly data (e. g. , torque curves, cycle times) to feed directly into the Digital Twin and Quality Management Systems. 
 - Factory-Level Yamazumi Execution: Validate and refine Yamazumi modeling on the shop floor. Utilize Tablets and mobile devices to conduct live work content graphing, ensuring the synchronization of manual labor with automated machine cycles to meet Takt time targets. 
 - Digital-to-Physical Validation: Use Discrete Event Simulation (DES) data to guide the layout of automation cells and material handling. Verify that the physical throughput and data latency of networked OT devices match simulation predictions, neutralizing bottlenecks during the deployment phase. 
 - Full Line Balancing & Tablet-Based SOPs: Synchronize all factory processes, deploying Tablets at each workstation to replace paper-based systems. Ensure a seamless data flow between automated cells and manual enclosure integration through integrated Power Automate workflows. 
 - Equipment & Automation Commissioning: Oversee the validation (IQ/OQ/PQ) of manufacturing equipment, including robotics, conveyors, and testing protocols. Ensure all OT infrastructure is robust, secure, and fully communicative with the broader MES/ERP environment. 
 - Digital Handoff & Hyper-care: Lead the creation of digital Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs). Act as the primary technical lead during the launch "hyper-care" period, troubleshooting both physical mechanical issues and digital logic gaps in the Ignition/Power App interface. 
 - Cross-Functional Factory Alignment: Collaborate with IT, Plant Managers, and Supply Chain to ensure the factory's network infrastructure supports high-density IoT and mobile tablet connectivity required for new deployments. 

Skills

- Deployment & Automation Expertise: Proven ability to manage large-scale equipment installations and PLC/Automation startups in an international environment. 
 - OT Stack Proficiency: Hands-on experience deploying Inductive Automation (Ignition), Microsoft Power Apps, and Power Automate within a manufacturing context. 
 - Smart Hardware Integration: Expert knowledge of integrating DC Torque tools, OT gateways, and Industrial Tablets into a production line. 
 - Operational Line Balancing: Advanced proficiency in Takt time optimization and Work Content Graphing using digital data collection tools. 
 - Simulation Application: Ability to use Discrete Event Simulation outputs to optimize the placement of automation and the configuration of digital workflows. 
 - Bilingual Proficiency: Professional fluency in English and Spanish to facilitate communication with regional engineering teams and local factory staff

EDUCATION AND CERTIFICATIONS

- Degrees: Bachelor's degree in Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Systems Engineering, or Mechanical/Electrical Engineering. 
 - Experience: Minimum of 15+ years of hands-on experience in manufacturing deployment or plant engineering, specifically with power products or high-complexity electronics. 
 - Proven Launch Track Record: Demonstrated success in "Vertical Startups" and the physical implementation of DFM/DFA principles on the factory floor. 
 - Software Proficiency: Experience with Advanced Simulation tools (e. g. , FlexSim, Arena) and CAD (SolidWorks/AutoCAD) for factory footprint and layout design. 
 - Certification: Six Sigma Black Belt or Lean Certification is highly desirable. 

Physical Requirements

No Special Physical Requirements

ENVIRONMENTAL DEMANDS

No Special Requirements

Travel Time Required

- 25%

No calls or agencies please. Vertiv will only employ those who are legally authorized to work in the United States. This is not a position for which sponsorship will be provided. Individuals with temporary visas such as E, F-1, H-1, H-2, L, B, J, or TN or who need sponsorship for work authorization now or in the future, are not eligible for hire.
