data.title: Software Design Assurance Engineer Advanced
data.description:
Overview

At Zebra, we are a community of innovators who come together to create new ways of working. United by curiosity and a culture of caring, we develop smart solutions that anticipate our customer's and partner's needs and solve their challenges. 

Being part of Zebra Nation means you are seen, heard, valued, and respected. Drawing from our unique perspectives, we collaborate to deliver on our purpose. Here you are part of a team pushing boundaries today to redefine the work of tomorrow for organizations, their employees, and those they serve. 

You'll have opportunities to learn and lead in a forward-thinking environment, defining your path to a fulfilling career while channeling your skills toward causes you care about-locally and globally. 

Come make an impact every day at Zebra. 

What We're Looking For

The Software Design Assurance Team is responsible for ensuring our software products meet quality, reliability, and release-readiness standards throughout the development lifecycle. The design assurance team supports Zebra's promise of quality to our customers and is responsible for participating in design reviews, sprint refinement, build/release operations, and post-mortems, and process gap analysis to conduct release readiness assessment. This position works with a minimum level of supervision. 

This position is hybrid based in Bengaluru, India. 

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Perform an analysis of SW Design Assurance for cloud-native SaaS Technology products and provide feedback for all the key Quality Metrics and deliverables executed by the functional teams, including: 

- Responsible for SW Quality assessment of SWS & cloud solutions. Identify deviations from stated product goals, standards, and processes. 
 - Perform Software Quality Reviews, measure and monitor progress of programs under development. 
 - Lead and conduct Product Release readiness reviews ensuring release criteria for software & device solutions are met and communicate all quality issues, risks, requirements gap prior to product approval. 
 - Recommend latest technologies and new approaches to design and implementation of new technology
 - Should have strong knowledge of cause-and-effect relation between SW defects and potential customer impact use cases. 
 - Instrument the product CI/CD pipeline and surface build-stage quality signal - code coverage trends, flaky-test detection, build stability, deployment frequency, and rollback rate - as a living engineering dashboard rather than a downstream report. 
 - Experience with Software-as-a-Service development processes, release automation, observability tooling, and quality metrics for distributed cloud systems. 
 - Knowledge of the SDLC, testing concepts, methodologies, metrics, automated SW testing frameworks
 - Experience in delivery and manage multi release projects in AGILE (Scrum, Scaled Agile) and knowledge of SW tools like JIRA, Confluence and Power BI
 - Guidance of the process, test methodologies, test strategy used in production of Zebra's NSI SW products and solutions including Software Stability, Stress, and performance strategies
 - Experience communicating cross-functionally and across management levels in formal and informal settings
 - Actively participate in SW Product and applications Risk Assessment and mitigation activities

Job Requirements

- Bachelor's degree in an Engineering field (Software Engineering, Computer Science, or related). 
 - Minimum of 10 years' experience in Software Engineering, with at least 5 years in site reliability, release engineering, or senior quality engineering roles on SaaS / cloud-native systems. 
 - Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines (e. g. , Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps), observability stacks (e. g. , Datadog, New Relic, Splunk, Prometheus/Grafana), and release-automation tooling - able to instrument systems directly, not only interpret dashboards. 
 - Demonstrated experience with modern test architecture across unit, integration, contract, and end-to-end layers; flaky-test triage; regression-suite design; and test-pyramid discipline applied to refactor-heavy codebases. 
 - Software QA automation experience with technologies such as Java, Python, JavaScript / TypeScript, or comparable. 
 - Knowledge of productivity and analytics tools such as issue trackers, knowledge-base / documentation systems, BI / dashboarding tools, and CRM platforms. 
 - Effective verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to deliver an independent quality recommendation to an engineering team in which the engineer is embedded - without compromising the working relationship. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Production-incident and release-health fluency - comfortable leading post-mortems, building escape-defect feedback loops, and translating field signal into engineering priorities; credibility built from on-call experience. 
 - Experience with multi-tenant enterprise SaaS domains and complex customer-facing platforms. 
 - Experience working as an embedded quality / SRE partner inside a product engineering team, with demonstrated ability to maintain independent judgment while operating inside the team's day-to-day rituals. 
 - Experience communicating cross-functionally and across management levels - including engineering leadership, customer success, and quality leadership - in formal and informal settings. 
 - Ability to actively engage business and technology partners; present, defend, and challenge technical recommendations. 
 - Ability to deal with ambiguity effectively and exercise sound judgment when evidence is incomplete. 
 - Advocate for the customer and drive the highest standard of quality at every stage of the product lifecycle. 
 - Instill best practices for software development, testing, and observability documentation. 
 - Demonstrated ability to deliver high-quality work on tight schedules. 
 - Strong analytical skills and a methodical, objective approach to problem-solving. 

Benefits

We understand the importance of work-life balance and wellbeing, which is why we offer flexibility for our teams including: hybrid work, adaptable hours, Summer Flex Fridays, Focus Fridays, and an annual companywide well-being day to promote revitalization and success. 

Job Posting Statement

To protect candidates from falling victim to online fraudulent activity involving fake job postings and employment offers, please be aware our recruiters will always connect with you via @zebra. com email accounts. Applications are only accepted through our applicant tracking system and only accept personal identifying information through that system. Our Talent Acquisition team will not ask for you to provide personal identifying information via e-mail or outside of the system. If you are a victim of identity theft contact your local police department. 

AI Technology Statement

Zebra Technologies leverages AI technology to evaluate job applications using objective, job-relevant criteria. This approach enhances efficiency and promotes fairness in the hiring process. However, every decision regarding interviews and hiring is made by our dedicated team, because we believe people make the best decisions about people. For more on how we use technology in hiring and how we process applicant data, see our Zebra Privacy Policy.

data.title: Senior Automation Engineer

data.description:
Job Title

Senior Automation Engineer

Division

Engineering

Location: 

Pune

Job Summary

The Lead Automation Engineer is responsible for delivery of engineering Automation design outputs for projects and, where requested, bid proposals. They will be responsible for the technical scope of the project/proposal (or, in some cases, a sub-area of the scope). For the scope area for which they are responsible, the Lead Automation Engineer must: 

- Provide leadership to engineers working on that area. 
 - Function as the interface point for customers and, also, the SPX internal organization. 
 - Propose / update the execution strategy within the project life to get the most relevant & efficient team. 
 - Ensure adherence with relevant SPX Flow procedures and practices (e. g. IDEFs)
 - Manage the engineering process to ensure outputs meet schedule, budgetary and quality requirements. 
 - Ensure that the scope delivered from engineering is aligned with contract or proposal requirements (KPIs)

Depending on the scope of the project, the Lead Automation Engineer may be required to undertake engineering design tasks corresponding to their own core discipline and, as such, reference should be made to relevant job descriptions such as Process Engineer, Mechanical Engineer, Automation Engineer, etc. 

Principal Duties And Responsibilities

Lead Automation Engineers are expected to possess relevant experience of engineering design and execution from within the industries which we serve. Duties include, but are not limited to, the following: 

Lead Engineer

The primary role will be to perform the "lead engineer" tasks on projects and proposals: 

- Safety & Environment
 - Ensuring that plant designs are safe. 
 - Ensuring that environmental impacts of designs have been considered appropriately. 
 - Ensuring that relevant reviews, as defined in SPX Flow procedures and, additionally, customer contracts, have been undertaken fully and that resultant actions have been completed. (Example reviews include: Design Reviews, Risk Assessments)
 - Ensuring compliance with local legislation and regulations (for the locality of the plant/process) which apply to engineering design (e. g. EU Machinery Directive)
 - Promoting a safety culture amongst staff, particularly when operating outside of the known office environment (e. g. on customer and supplier sites)

- Management of Engineering Design Process
 - Owning the engineering execution model throughout the project lifecycle, including adapting approach as required to suit changing requirements. 
 - Interpreting contractual requirements, defining design deliverable, and devising an appropriate plan for the design phase of the project
 - Generating and maintaining the time schedule for engineering phase, including consulting with Project Manager to ensure alignment with overall project schedule
 - Identifying resource needs and ensuring that resource managers are kept informed about ongoing changes to requirements. 
 - Establishing and leading engineering team meetings/discussions as required to achieving the project or proposal's engineering design deliverables. Ask for approval to our customers when contractually required or just deliver documentation for information. 
 - Managing team members to meet schedule demands and target on-budget execution (in terms of hours), whilst still ensuring delivery of a thoroughly engineered, complete design. (In other words, the Lead Engineer is required to manage the balance between cost, timescale, and quality). Keep close relationship with Project Manager & Costs Controller to provide updated EAC (Estimation at Completion)

- Design Ownership
 - Ensuring that the design is executed in line with: 
 - Applicable legislation and regulation
 - Customer contractual requirements (or, in case of proposal, RFQ/URS requirements) 
 - SPX references, standards, and best practices, where applicable
 - Ensuring that the output of design team is complete and of a consistent standard. Examples include ensuring that: 
 - Documentation (e. g. P&IDs, FDS, Operating Manuals etc. ) uses the same standards and that these are delivered to a consistent level in terms of content and quality. 
 - A suitable "project equipment catalogue" is established to support item selection. 
 - Consistent approaches are applied for electrical build. 
 - Ensuring all scope elements/sub-systems integrate coherently and that external interfaces are clearly understood and defined. 
 - Ensuring that all design information is captured, stored, and maintained in a suitable structured and accessible location (in line with SPX Flow procedures and practices)
 - Engaging with Supply Chain to support purchasing process (initial specification, review of supplier quotes, etc)
 - Consulting with installation teams to ensure output designs reflect transportation and assembly requirements. 
 - Leading resolution of design issues identified during the installation and commissioning phases. 
 - Coordinate customer automation training when applicable 
 - Communication
 - Ensuring appropriate engineering attendance at customer meetings (as agreed with Project Manager or Bid Process Owner) e. g. : 
 - Pre-contract sales meetings
 - Customer launch/ "kick-off" meetings (for project or proposal)

data.title: Technical Architect – Application Design & AI Engineering
data.description:
Job Description

Location: Hyderabad

Employment Type: Full-time

Experience: 12-15 years

Primary Areas: Application Architecture, Enterprise & Cloud Architecture, AI-Assisted Software Engineering, Quality Engineering

Primary Stack: Python/Django, Go/Gin, Angular/TypeScript, MySQL, PostgreSQL, Redis, Azure, Docker, Terraform, Playwright

Role Summary

We are looking for a hands-on Technical Architect to define and evolve the application architecture of Nextpower's engineering and business platforms. 

The role will focus on designing scalable, maintainable, and secure applications across the full technology stack, including domain models, APIs, services, user interfaces, data stores, integrations, and deployment environments. 

The architect will also establish practical guidelines for AI-assisted software development, helping teams use AI tools to improve productivity while maintaining strong standards for design quality, security, testing, maintainability, and responsible use. 

This is a senior individual-contributor role that works closely with product management, engineering, QA, DevOps, security, and subject-matter experts. The role remains hands-on in complex or high-risk areas through design reviews, prototypes, reference implementations, and critical code reviews. 

Key Responsibilities

Application Architecture and Design

- Define target application architectures, reference architectures, and reusable design patterns. 
 - Design end-to-end solutions covering domain models, business services, APIs, user interfaces, persistence, integrations, security, and deployment. 
 - Establish standards for modular application design, service boundaries, API contracts, error handling, configuration, and versioning. 
 - Review major application designs for functional suitability, scalability, reliability, security, maintainability, and operational supportability. 
 - Guide teams in selecting appropriate architectural styles, including modular monoliths, microservices, event-driven components, and workflow-based solutions. 
 - Identify architectural risks, design inconsistencies, and technical debt, and drive practical remediation plans. 
 - Remain hands-on through prototypes, proof-of-concepts, reference implementations, and targeted development in uncertain or high-risk areas. 

AI-Assisted Software Engineering

- Define guidelines for the responsible and effective use of AI coding assistants and generative AI tools across the software development lifecycle. 
 - Establish recommended practices for AI-assisted requirements analysis, architecture, coding, testing, documentation, code review, and troubleshooting. 
 - Define quality gates and review expectations for AI-generated or AI-assisted code. 
 - Develop reusable prompts, templates, coding patterns, architectural context, and development workflows that improve consistency and engineering productivity. 
 - Guide teams in using AI to generate and maintain unit tests, API tests, UI tests, documentation, migration scripts, and technical designs. 
 - Define guardrails for security, privacy, intellectual property, licensing, data handling, and human oversight when using AI tools. 
 - Evaluate emerging AI development tools and recommend their adoption where they provide measurable engineering value. 
 - Measure the impact of AI-assisted development on delivery speed, quality, test coverage, maintainability, and developer experience. 

Engineering and Quality Standards

- Set standards for architecture, APIs, authentication and authorization, observability, testing, CI/CD, configuration, and deployment. 
 - Establish expectations for automated unit, integration, API, contract, and end-to-end testing. 
 - Partner with QA and engineering teams to improve testability, regression coverage, and production confidence. 
 - Promote design-for-quality practices, including validation, resilience, diagnosability, performance, and backward compatibility. 
 - Run architecture reviews, critical code reviews, and technical design discussions. 
 - Define and promote engineering practices that reduce defects and prevent the accumulation of technical debt. 

Technical Leadership

- Drive technical alignment across teams and resolve cross-team dependencies. 
 - Communicate architectural decisions, trade-offs, constraints, and risks to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Mentor engineers and technical leads in application design, cloud architecture, software quality, and AI-assisted development. 
 - Collaborate with product management to assess technical feasibility, delivery risks, and sequencing of major initiatives. 
 - Escalate significant technical, security, reliability, and operational risks. 
 - Maintain practical architecture documentation, decision records, standards, and reference implementations. 

Required Skills And Experience

- 12-15 years of experience in enterprise software engineering, with significant experience in application architecture and technical leadership. 
 - Strong experience designing end-to-end business applications and platforms. 
 - Strong understanding of domain modeling, modular design, service boundaries, API-first development, integration patterns, and distributed systems. 
 - Hands-on backend development experience with Python/Django/DRF and/or Go/Gin. 
 - Strong frontend architecture experience with Angular and TypeScript; working knowledge of React is a plus. 
 - Experience designing relational data models, indexes, queries, and persistence strategies using MySQL and PostgreSQL. 
 - Experience with Redis for caching, distributed coordination, or queue-based processing.

data.description:
The D. E. Shaw group is a global investment and technology development firm with more than $100 billion in investment capital as of June 1, 2026, and offices in North America, Europe, and Asia. Since our founding in 1988, our firm has earned an international reputation for successful investing based on innovation, careful risk management, and the quality and depth of our staff. We have a significant presence in the world's capital markets, investing in a wide range of companies and financial instruments in both developed and developing economies. 

We are looking for an experienced software developer to join the GAI Tech team at the D. E. Shaw India office based in Hyderabad, Bengaluru, or Gurugram. The GAI Tech team is responsible for building infrastructure and applications of Generative AI (GAI) within the firm. The team's objectives consist of identifying the most productive GAI models, providing tools for sophisticated GAI-based applications, creating initial iterations of GAI tools, and offering support for technical staff involved with GAI projects. The focus of GAI Tech will be on improving areas such as developer productivity, process efficiency, making DESCO data easy to use with LLMs, and promoting generative AI for BU-specific adoption. Additionally, a significant aspect of GAI Tech's role focuses on user education and promoting interdepartmental collaboration. The mission of GAI Tech is to serve as a catalyst for the research, development, and integration of GAI technologies, emphasizing user education and support for other technical teams within the organization. The team focuses on developing and integrating AI tools to enhance productivity and development. This includes AI-powered assistants for writing and coding, tools for AI infrastructure, and custom AI components. GAI Tech is also dedicated to simplifying GAI utilization across the firm through optimized developer tooling, easier programmatic ways to integrate LLMs, and fostering ready-to-use applications for developers. Embracing open-ended experimentation and ongoing evaluation is another critical aspect of GAI Tech's objectives, supporting the team's continuous quest to advance GAI models and techniques. 

WHAT YOU'LL DO DAY-TO-DAY: 

You will be working as a part of a team that is focused on providing core AI infrastructure for the firm. You will be working on improving areas including developer productivity and process efficiency and making DESCO data easy to use with LLMs, promoting generative AI for BU-specific adoption, etc. You will be expected to comprehend the technical requirements of diverse groups using AI, explore opensource tech options beneficial for us, and integrate the chosen tech within our teams to enhance efficiency and construct supportive systems. You will also be overseeing the end-to-end development of generative AI tools and infrastructure. You will be expected to solve complex technical challenges, ensure project specifications are met efficiently, and facilitate the rapid learning and implementation of new technologies within the team. You will be expected to mentor team members from day one, and over time take on people management responsibilities, including leading and managing a team to drive effective execution and delivery. 

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR: 

The ideal candidate should hold-

Basic qualifications: 

- A bachelor's or master's degree in computer science or a related field with 6 to 9 years of relevant experience
 - Exposure to GAI projects
 - Exceptional problem-solving abilities and the capacity to acquire and apply new technologies quickly

 - At least 1 year of people and team management experience, leading a team of at least 2 members

Preferred qualification: 

- Experience in managing and working in a global and diverse team

data.title: Senior Engineering Leader
data.description:
Job Summary

Senior Engineering Leader responsible for driving scalable technology solutions across cards and payments platforms using containerization messaging data integration and modern Java services. The role oversees hybrid model engineering delivery across Helm Docker Kafka Tanzu K8s and MSB ensuring resilient systems that support secure transactions operational efficiency and continuous improvement in a collaborative environment. 

Responsibilities

- Drive end to end engineering execution for cards and payments platforms by planning coordinating and delivering robust solutions using Helm Docker Kafka Tanzu K8s MSB and Java to meet complex business transaction needs. 
 - Oversee design of microservices and integration patterns in Java that support high throughput card processing and payment workflows while optimizing performance reliability and maintainability for hybrid deployment environments. 
 - Provide architectural guidance for container based applications using Helm and Docker on Tanzu K8s to ensure consistent configuration efficient resource usage and standardized deployment practices across environments. 
 - Coordinate implementation of Kafka based event streaming and messaging for payment authorization clearing and settlement processes to improve resilience observability and real time transaction tracking. 
 - Manage MSBI SSIS admin activities for data extraction transformation and loading from card transaction systems into analytical and reporting platforms ensuring data quality security and timely availability. 
 - Collaborate with product operations and compliance stakeholders in cards and payments to translate regulatory risk and customer experience requirements into actionable engineering solutions and technical roadmaps. 
 - Guide teams in implementing observability monitoring and alerting for Java services Kubernetes workloads Kafka clusters and MSBI packages to proactively detect issues and minimize impact on payment processing. 
 - Ensure secure engineering practices for cardholder data and payment information by driving encryption secure configuration controlled access and adherence to relevant internal standards and industry regulations. 
 - Optimize hybrid work model collaboration by establishing clear communication routines documentation practices and engineering workflows that maintain productivity across onsite and remote team members. 
 - Coordinate continuous improvement initiatives such as refactoring performance tuning and platform upgrades across Helm charts Docker images Kafka topics Tanzu K8s clusters and MSBI SSIS solutions to reduce technical debt. 
 - Mentor senior engineers and architects in applying best practices for distributed systems container orchestration and data integration within the cards and payments domain to strengthen overall engineering capability. 
 - Align engineering outcomes with company purpose by enabling secure efficient and reliable payments experiences that support customers merchants and financial partners while contributing to broader economic activity. 
 - Evaluate new tools and patterns related to Kubernetes platforms event streaming and data integration that can enhance scalability resiliency and innovation in the cards and payments technology landscape. 

Qualifications

- Demonstrate extensive experience of fifteen to eighteen years in engineering roles delivering complex enterprise systems with significant exposure to transaction intensive financial platforms. 
 - Possess strong hands on expertise using Helm for configuration management and release orchestration of containerized services deployed on Kubernetes based infrastructure. 
 - Apply deep practical skills in Docker for building packaging and running secure and efficient application images that support modular and repeatable deployments across environments. 
 - Show advanced experience implementing and operating Kafka clusters for high volume event streaming and messaging in payment processing authorization and settlement flows. 
 - Utilize comprehensive knowledge of Tanzu K8s or similar Kubernetes platforms to manage workloads namespaces scaling strategies and cluster configurations for mission critical services. 
 - Bring proven proficiency in MSBI admin including job scheduling package management performance optimization and troubleshooting for data pipelines related to cards and payments. 
 - Exhibit strong Java development experience in designing and implementing secure performant and maintainable services that integrate with payment gateways card networks and internal systems. 
 - Demonstrate deep domain expertise in cards and payments covering transaction lifecycles clearing and settlement fraud and risk considerations and customer experience impacts to guide technical decisions. 
 - Work effectively in a hybrid model by managing time communication and collaboration tools to maintain productivity and alignment within distributed engineering and stakeholder teams. 
 - Communicate clearly with cross functional partners including business operations risk and compliance to ensure engineering solutions meet regulatory expectations and service level objectives. 
 - Adapt to evolving technology and regulatory landscapes in payments by continuously updating skills exploring new approaches and applying learning to improve platforms and processes.

data.description:
Job Description

At Infoblox, every breakthrough begins with a bold "what if. "

What if your ideas could ignite global innovation?

What if your curiosity could redefine the future?

We invite you to step into the next exciting chapter of your career journey. Bring your creativity, drive, your daring spirit, and feel what it's like to thrive on a team big enough to make an impact, yet small enough to make a difference. Our cloud-first networking and security solutions already protect 70% of the Fortune 500, and we're looking for creative thinkers ready to push that influence even further. Join us and discover how far your bold "what if" can take the world, your community, and your career. 

How we empower our people is extraordinary: we're recognized as a Glassdoor Best Place to Work 2025, Great Place to Work-Certified in five countries, and honored by Cigna as a Healthy Workforce honors for three consecutive years; and what we build is world class: named CybersecAsia's Best in Critical Infrastructure 2024 - clear evidence that when first-class technology meets empowered talent, remarkable careers take shape. So, what if the next big idea, and the next great career story, comes from you? Become the force that turns every "what if" into "what's next. "

In a world where you can be anything, Be Infoblox. 

Director, Cloud Delivery Assurance

The Opportunity

We have an opportunity for a Director, Cloud Delivery Assurance to build and lead our new Cloud Delivery Assurance team within SaaS Platform Engineering in Pune or Bangalore, India, reporting to the VP, Engineering. 

In this pivotal role, you will make release readiness a defensible, engineering-owned decision. You will establish a team of automation and delivery-assurance engineers, define the roadmap from manual and inconsistent release checks to an automated artifact-promotion pipeline, and own the quality gates that govern promotion of SaaS software from development clusters through integration and staging environments into production. 

Collaborating closely with Solutions QA, Site Reliability Engineering, DevOps, CloudOps, application, and platform teams, you will create the integration-quality, automation, and production-readiness operating model that validates the combined system before customers experience it. You will establish trusted environments, shared tooling, and evidence-based release-readiness gates while complementing-not duplicating-the charters of Solutions QA, DevOps, and SRE. 

You are the ideal candidate if you have built quality or delivery-assurance organizations from the ground up, are fluent in Kubernetes-based cloud platforms and CI/CD, and are comfortable making clear, data-backed decisions when the evidence does not support a release. 

Be a Contributor - What You'll Do

- Build the CDA strategy, roadmap, operating model, and staffing plan; align scope, milestones, investment, and success measures with the SVP, Platform Engineering and peer engineering leaders
 - Hire, lead, coach, and develop a team of one technical project manager and eight software development engineers in test; establish the team charter, operating cadence, engineering standards, and inclusive culture
 - Own the automated artifact-promotion pipeline from CI build and security-scan validation through development-cluster smoke testing, integration and certification runs, staging certification, and production promotion
 - Define, implement, and enforce quality gates for each promotion decision, including entry and exit criteria, required evidence, hold-and-return behavior, risk acceptance, and rollback expectations
 - Serve as the accountable approver for promotion of SaaS software across development, integration, staging, and production environments; make go/no-go recommendations defensible with data
 - Establish a common test-automation framework, shared libraries, and fit-for-purpose test environments for API, integration, end-to-end, regression, performance, and deployment-verification testing
 - Apply AI-assisted engineering tools, including code assistants, test-generation capabilities, and intelligent analytics, to improve productivity, expand meaningful test coverage, identify risk patterns, and support-not replace-engineering judgment
 - Govern responsible use of AI-generated code and test assets through human review, security and privacy controls, traceability, and measurable quality outcomes
 - Deliver readiness scorecards, quality and risk heatmaps, coverage and escape-rate metrics, defect trends, mean-time-to-detect measures, and environment and release status for engineering leadership
 - Partner with Solutions QA on end-to-end functional coverage and release sign-off, and with SRE on stress, scale, high availability, disaster recovery, and chaos testing

Be Prepared - What You Bring

- Fifteen or more years of experience in software engineering, quality engineering, test automation, platform engineering, DevOps, SRE, or delivery assurance, including five or more years leading and growing engineering or QA teams
 - Proven success defining and delivering quality, automation, and release-readiness strategies for cloud-native SaaS platforms
 - Deep understanding of Kubernetes, Linux, containers, public cloud environments such as AWS or GCP, distributed systems, and microservices
 - Strong command of CI/CD practices, including pipeline design, artifact promotion, progressive delivery, canary releases, deployment verification, and automated quality gates using tools such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Argo, or Spinnaker
 - Expertise in test-automation architecture across API, integration, end-to-end, regression, performance, and production-readiness testing, with the technical depth to review designs and code
 - Experience building metrics-driven programs using measures such as coverage, escape rate, defect trends, mean time to detect, release risk, and environment stability
 - Practical experience using AI-assisted development, test-generation, analytics, automation, content-generation, or decision-support tools, with an understanding of responsible AI practices and appropriate human oversight
 - Demonstrated ability to influence without authority across QA, SRE, DevOps, product, application, and platform teams while maintaining a consistent quality bar under delivery pressure
 - Experience hiring and scaling engineering teams in India, preferably across distributed or multi-site environments, and building an inclusive, high-accountability culture
 - Bachelor's degree in computer science, computer engineering, electrical engineering, or a related technical field; a master's degree is a plus

Be Successful - Your Path

First 90 Days: Immerse in our culture, connect with mentors through Blox Buddies, and map the systems and meet with key stakeholders that rely on your work. Discuss and create short/long-term goals. 

Six Months: 

- Operate automated build and development-cluster validation gates for every release candidate, with promotion decisions recorded and evidence collected automatically
 - Establish the common test-automation framework and shared libraries, with regression suites running on a predictable schedule against a protected certification baseline
 - Launch readiness scorecards and quality-risk reporting, including AI-assisted aggregation and analysis of release evidence with human review and clear auditability
 - Complete staffing and onboarding for the CDA team, with the technical project manager driving milestones, dependencies, and stakeholder communications
 - Define baseline measures for coverage, escape rate, defect trends, environment stability, and release-cycle efficiency; use the data to prioritize improvements

One Year: 

- Establish CDA as the mandatory release-readiness gate for the SaaS platform, with staging certification and production-promotion decisions consistently supported by objective evidence
 - Automate critical regression coverage for release candidates and demonstrate measurable improvement in customer-found defects and release-time Sev 1 and Sev 2 incidents
 - Validate Tier 1 services for high availability, scale, performance, recovery, and deployment safety in partnership with SRE
 - Integrate AI-assisted test development and release analytics into the operating model with appropriate security, privacy, governance, and human-review controls
 - Establish a smooth interlock among CDA, Solutions QA, SRE, DevOps, CloudOps, application, and platform teams, with remediation routed and closed through a single visible workflow

Belong - Your Community

Our culture thrives on inclusion, rewarding the bold ideas, curiosity, and creativity that move us forward. In a community where every voice counts, continuous learning is the norm. So, whether you code, create, sell, or care for customers, you'll grow and belong here. 

Be Rewarded - Benefits That Help You Grow, Thrive, Belong

- Comprehensive health coverage, generous PTO, and flexible work options
 - Learning opportunities, career-mobility programs, and leadership workshops
 - Sixteen paid volunteer hours each year, global employee resource groups, and a "No Jerks" policy that keeps collaboration healthy
 - Modern offices with EV charging, healthy snacks, plus hackathons, game nights, and culture celebrations
 - Charitable Giving Program supported by Company Match

Ready to Be the Difference?

Infoblox is an Affirmative Action and Equal Opportunity Employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, genetic information, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected basis.

Amdocs helps the world's leading communications and media companies deliver exceptional customer experiences through reliable, efficient, and secure operations at scale. We provide software products and services that embed intelligence into how work runs across business, IT, and network domains, delivering measurable outcomes in customer experience, network performance, cloud modernization, and revenue growth. 

With our talented people and more than 40 years of experience running mission-critical systems around the globe, Amdocs runs billions of transactions daily. Our technology is relied on every day, connecting people worldwide and advancing a more inclusive, connected world. Together, we help those who shape the future to make it amazing. 

Amdocs is listed on the NASDAQ Global Select Market under the symbol DOX and reported revenue of $4. 53 billion in fiscal 2025. For more information, visit https: //www. amdocs. com/. 

At Amdocs, our mission is to empower our employees to"Live Amazing, Do Amazing" every day. We believe in creating a workplace where you can excel professionally and thrive personally. Through our culture of making a real impact, fostering growth, embracing flexibility, and building connections, we enable our people to live meaningful lives while making a difference in the world. 

Team Introduction

The team supports three products deployed on-premises in mobile operators' data centers and in the cloud, with installations around the world: 

- Product 1: Handles mobile calls, including call forwarding, rejection, and charging. 
 - Product 2: Handles mobile data sessions, including protocol conversion, session correlation, and network-topology protection. 
 - Product 3: Sends notifications to subscribers through SMS, email, push notifications, and other protocols based on incoming requests and remote-server availability. 

These products are designed for network-intensive communication. They are based on event-driven application servers and handle tens of thousands of operations per second

What will your job look like?

As the Non-Functional Testing Lead, you will own the quality and reliability of the products under real-world telecom workloads. You will design, drive, and continuously evolve the non-functional testing strategy across performance, scalability, resilience, stability, and resource efficiency. 

Define and Lead the NFT Strategy

- Develop comprehensive strategies for performance, load, soak, and failover testing across all products. 
 - Ensure coverage for telecom-specific behaviors, including session surges, protocol latency, message bursts, and failover scenarios. 

Design and Execute NFT Scenarios

- Create realistic, high-load test scenarios for mobile calls, data sessions, and notification-delivery workflows. 
 - Simulate complex operator environments, including network latency, bandwidth constraints, and protocol interactions. 

Identify and Analyze Performance Issues

- Detect bottlenecks in production and staging environments. 
 - Localize issues such as high CPU load, memory leaks, locked threads, database-related problems, and network-related problems. 
 - Reproduce identified issues in controlled test environments. 
 - Collaborate with developers to resolve performance and reliability issues. 

Measure and Optimize System Behavior

- Track key performance indicators, including: 
 - Throughput
 - Latency
 - CPU and memory utilization
 - Garbage-collection performance
 - Database-query performance
 - Network I/O efficiency
 - Provide tuning recommendations across Java, databases, operating systems, hardware, and configuration layers. 
Own and Improve NFT Tooling and Automation

- Maintain and optimize the non-functional regression suite. 
 - Reduce execution time and improve the stability of test runs. 
 - Enhance observability through metrics, logs, dumps, and monitoring dashboards. 

Collaborate Across Teams

- Work closely with development teams to ensure that new features meet performance expectations. 
 - Support pre-production certification activities with operators and cloud deployments. 

All you need is. . . 

Must-Have Qualifications

- Strong expertise in performance engineering, particularly for high-load, network-intensive systems. 
 - Hands-on experience with performance tuning and bottleneck identification in distributed or telecom-grade systems. 
 - Solid understanding of the OSI model and practical networking fundamentals. 
 - Experience with relational databases, including: 
 - Indexing strategies
 - SQL tuning
 - Query optimization under load
 - Strong Linux knowledge, including an understanding of how Linux uses: 
 - CPU
 - Network resources
 - I/O and storage
 - Experience with diagnostic tools and techniques, including: 
 - tcpdump for packet capture
 - Thread dumps
 - Heap dumps
 - Java class histograms
Preferred Qualifications

- Familiarity with telecom and messaging protocols, including: 
 - Diameter
 - SMTP
 - SMPP
 - CAP
 - MAP
Why You Will Love This Job

- You will be part of a talented team working on challenging projects. 
 - You will have opportunities to learn about the latest industry trends. 
 - You will develop non-standard solutions for continuously evolving environments and standards. 
 - You will have opportunities for personal and professional growth. 
 - You will work with advanced technologies used across the industry. 

Core Competencies

- Builds valuable customer relationships

Functional Competencies

- Analytical thinking and problem-solving

Because becoming the undisputed leader in food means surrounding ourselves with people who are hungry for what's next. 

Overview

As a Controls and Information Systems (CIS) Senior Consultant, you will lead development and implementation of General Mills Controls Engineering standards, applications, and tools that reduce operational losses, improve system performance, and strengthen product quality. You will lead the global rollout of plant control infrastructure and provide ongoing virtual consulting to manufacturing sites around the world. Drawing on expertise in plant engineering, preferably within the food industry and strong project management skills, you will assess challenges, solve complex controls and systems problems, improve productivity, and optimize manufacturing costs. 

Key Accountabilities

80% OF TIME - BUSINESS RESULTS

- Drive productivity and system utilization while reducing manual effort, production waste, and manufacturing costs through the strategic application of controls technology. 
 - Develop and deploy global General Mills controls and systems solutions using plant process automation platforms, including AVEVA System Platform/Wonderware Archestra, Siemens, Ignition and Rockwell. 
 - Lead CIS OU engagements with plants and Identify operational, quality, and system-performance opportunities; recommend and execute standardized controls solutions that improve plant performance. 
 - Identify, pilot, and scale emerging controls, OT, and digital technologies (advanced visualization, IIoT, edge computing, remote diagnostics) and partner with OEMs and integrators to capture innovation. 
 - Lead tactical operations support through technical root-cause analysis, control-system problem resolution, diagnostic-tool development, and creation of documentation and training materials. 
 - Lead controls architecture and infrastructure, optimize reliability and performance, and develop plans to address system obsolescence. 
 - Provide strategic operations support by developing solutions to chronic problems, planning and supporting disaster-recovery activities, contributing to the long-term Controls and Information Systems vision, and strengthening partnerships with Research and Development, the Process Technology Group, and Systems Engineering. 
 - Lead OT technologies and provide strategic direction and Serve as a subject-matter expert, applying engineering expertise and knowledge of electrical systems, control platforms, regulatory requirements, and manufacturing plant operations. 
 - Work effectively in cross-cultural virtual teams; coach and mentor engineers and develop foundational Controls and Information Systems onboarding plans. 

20% OF TIME - LEADERSHIP, DEVELOPMENT, AND COMMUNITY CONTRIBUTION

- Continue professional development through the individual development plan process and participation in relevant training, seminars, and technical fairs. 
 - Collaborate with functional partners, build internal and external networks, identify capability and training needs, and coordinate development opportunities. 
 - Share technical learnings, standards, and best practices across the Controls Engineering and Controls and Information Systems community. 
 - Support the One Technical Community strategy by embracing and incorporating broad performance programs, including Continuous Improvement, Safety by Design, and value-added tools and technologies. 

Minimum Qualifications

Education: Bachelor's degree in Instrumentation, Electronics, Electrical, or IT Engineering from an accredited university; full-time graduation required. 

Experience: 12+ years of relevant experience in Controls Engineering and controls/instrumentation systems, including plant-floor commissioning, troubleshooting, line integration, and end-to-end automation delivery from design through operational handover. 

Technical Skills: Hands-on proficiency with AVEVA System Platform and OMI and/or Ignition SCADA, including graphics, alarms, dashboards, historian functions, and data logging; PLC programming with Rockwell ControlLogix/Studio 5000 and/or Siemens; industrial networks and operational technology cybersecurity (VLANs, managed switches, firewalls, IP addressing, access control, patching, segmentation, and threat response); SQL and scripting/application development using Python, Visual Basic, or . NET; VMware or Hyper-V; instrumentation, field devices, Ethernet/IP, Modbus, Profibus, electrical panels, motor control centers, and single-line diagrams.

Preferred Qualifications

- Master's degree in Engineering (Electronics / Instrumentation) or an MBA.

 - Experience integrating manufacturing execution systems with supervisory control, programmable controller, or plant data systems

data.title: ASIC Digital Design Manager
data.description:
We Are

Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow. 

You Are

You have spent a decade building IP that ships, not just passes verification. You know that the best microarchitecture is the one that survives contact with timing closure, power constraints, and the realities of a 5nm process node. You have been the person in the room who catches the CDC issue before it becomes a silicon respin, and you have learned that the hardest part of leading a design team is not writing the cleanest RTL, it is teaching five engineers to think three steps ahead without micromanaging their every line of code. 

You are equally comfortable reviewing a timing report at 9 a. m. and having a career conversation with a junior engineer at 3 p. m. You do not just manage projects, you grow people. When someone on your team hits a wall on a complex AXI bridge implementation, you know when to step in with technical guidance and when to let them work through it. You have strong opinions about what makes good SystemVerilog and you are not afraid to push back when an architecture decision does not make sense for the product or the schedule. 

At Synopsys, you will lead a team building Ethernet MAC and PCS controllers that power networking silicon across the industry. The work is technically hard, the team is real, and what you build will matter. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Lead a team of digital design engineers developing Ethernet MAC and PCS IP from microarchitecture specification through customer release
 - Drive architectural and microarchitectural decisions for next-generation Ethernet controllers, translating customer requirements into robust, scalable RTL implementations in SystemVerilog
 - Oversee design reviews, timing closure strategy, CDC/RDC sign-off, and synthesis quality across multiple concurrent IP development projects
 - Manage resource allocation, project execution, and cross-functional collaboration with verification, physical design, and product teams to meet schedule and quality commitments
 - Conduct technical interviews, assess candidate capabilities in RTL design and microarchitecture, and build a high-performing team through hiring and onboarding
 - Mentor engineers on complex implementation challenges including high-speed interface design, multi-voltage domain architectures, and UPF-based low-power methodologies
 - Own performance reviews, career development planning, and succession planning for your team while fostering a culture of technical excellence and continuous learning

The Impact You Will Have

- Deliver Ethernet IP that powers networking products across the semiconductor industry, enabling high-speed connectivity in data centers, automotive, and AI systems
 - Build and scale a digital design team capable of executing complex IP development projects with quality, predictability, and technical rigor
 - Strengthen Synopsys IP portfolio by driving architectural innovation and design reuse across Ethernet MAC, PCS, and related high-speed interface technologies
 - Reduce time-to-market for customers by ensuring IP releases meet timing, power, and area targets without late-stage surprises or silicon respins
 - Grow the next generation of RTL design talent through mentorship, technical coaching, and hands-on leadership in real product development
 - Influence cross-functional execution by providing clear technical direction, risk assessment, and tradeoff analysis that keeps projects on track
 - Shape the technical culture of the Ethernet IP group by setting standards for design quality, code reviews, and engineering discipline

What You'll Need

- 10+ years of hands-on ASIC digital design experience with deep expertise in RTL development, microarchitecture, and IP design
 - 3+ years in a technical leadership or engineering management role, with demonstrated ability to lead, mentor, and grow design teams
 - Expert-level proficiency in SystemVerilog and Verilog for synthesis, with a strong track record of delivering production-quality RTL
 - Deep knowledge of high-speed interfaces and protocols such as Ethernet, PCIe, DDR, or AMBA AXI/AHB/APB
 - Strong understanding of Static Timing Analysis, synthesis, timing closure, and the ability to make microarchitectural tradeoffs that meet timing and power goals
 - Hands-on experience with CDC and RDC verification flows, linting, and static sign-off methodologies
 - Experience with low-power design techniques, UPF-based power intent definition, and multi-voltage domain architectures is a strong plus
 - Familiarity with advanced process nodes (7nm, 5nm, or below) or hardware/software co-verification using emulation platforms like Palladium or Zebu is a plus

Who You Are

- You can look at a timing report, identify the critical path, and explain to your team why the fix is not just about adding pipeline stages but rethinking the datapath architecture
 - You know the difference between mentoring someone through a tough technical problem and solving it for them, and you default to the former unless the schedule truly demands the latter
 - You ask the right questions in design reviews, the ones that uncover assumptions, expose risks, and make the team think harder about corner cases before they become bugs
 - You are comfortable having hard conversations about performance, technical gaps, or missed commitments, and you do it in a way that builds trust rather than defensiveness
 - You can explain a complex microarchitectural tradeoff to a product manager in two sentences without losing the technical nuance that matters
 - You treat hiring as seriously as you treat design reviews because you know that the quality of your team determines the quality of the IP you ship

The Team You'll Be Part Of

You will join the Synopsys Ethernet IP Group in Bengaluru, a team focused on designing and developing Ethernet MAC and PCS controllers that power networking solutions across the industry. This is a core IP design team, not an SoC integration group. The work centers on complex ASIC and IP development requiring deep RTL expertise, microarchitecture skills, and a strong understanding of high-speed interface technologies. You will collaborate closely with verification, physical design, and product teams to deliver IP that meets rigorous customer requirements for performance, power, and quality. 

Rewards and Benefits

We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

data.title: Software Development Manager - Derivatives
data.description:
We are looking for a Software Development Manager to serve as the overall engineering leader for Derivatives. This is a senior, hands-on technical leadership role - responsible for driving the engineering architecture, technical direction, and delivery of derivatives capabilities across the platform. This role sits at the intersection of software engineering and derivatives domain expertise, covering trade lifecycle management, valuation/pricing, and downstream processing across FX, Interest Rate, Credit, Equity, and Commodity derivatives. You will architect and build systems that are correct, auditable, and performant at scale, working closely with quants, traders, operations, and risk teams. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design and build scalable, resilient systems for derivatives trade capture, lifecycle event processing (resets, fixings, exercises, novations, terminations, amendments), and downstream settlement/confirmation workflows. 
 - Own architecture decisions for pricing and valuation services, including integration with pricing libraries/models and market data feeds for FX, IR, Credit, Equity, and Commodity derivatives. 
 - Build and maintain data models and event-driven pipelines that support accurate position keeping, P&L, and risk reporting across the trade lifecycle. 
 - Partner with quant and risk teams to translate valuation and pricing logic into robust, testable, production-grade code. 
 - Drive engineering best practices: system design reviews, code quality, test automation, observability, and performance tuning for high-throughput, low-latency workflows. 
 - Collaborate with operations and business stakeholders to understand STP requirements, exception handling, and reconciliation needs across the trade lifecycle. 
 - Mentor engineers, contribute to technical roadmap decisions, and raise the bar on engineering rigor across the team. 
 - Contribute to hedge accounting workflows where applicable, including effectiveness testing support. 

Qualifications

Technical

- 12+ years of software engineering experience, with a strong track record of designing and building complex, distributed, data-intensive systems. 
 - Deep proficiency in at least one modern backend language (Java, Python, or similar) and strong system design fundamentals (scalability, data modeling, API design, event-driven architecture). 
 - Experience with relational and/or time-series databases, messaging systems (Kafka or similar), and building services that operate under strict accuracy and auditability requirements. 
 - Comfort working across the full stack of a trading platform: trade capture, lifecycle processing, valuation integration, and reporting/reconciliation. 

Domain

- Solid understanding of derivatives lifecycle management across FX, Interest Rate, Credit, Equity, and Commodity products - including trade events such as fixings, resets, exercises, novations, and terminations. 
 - Working knowledge of valuation and pricing concepts for these asset classes (e. g. , discounting curves, forward/NPV calculations, sensitivities) - you don't need to build pricing models yourself, but you must understand how they plug into the systems you build. 
 - Familiarity with middle/back office processes: confirmations, settlements, reconciliation, and regulatory/reporting considerations for derivatives. 

Nice to Have

- Understanding of hedge accounting concepts (e. g. , fair value/cash flow hedges) and hedge effectiveness testing methodologies. 
 - Experience with regulatory reporting frameworks for derivatives (e. g. , Dodd-Frank, EMIR, MiFID II). 
 - Exposure to cloud infrastructure and modern DevOps practices in a regulated financial environment.

data.description:
About The Team

Seller Order Life Cycle (SOLC) and Ship with Walmart are key charters of Walmart Marketplace, focused on enabling great seller experiences, and scalable platform capabilities to manage seller fulfilled orders. Ship with Walmart requires complex, cross-functional initiatives that require deep partnership across product, engineering, operations, and business teams. To ensure the success of these initiatives, it is critical to have a senior technical leader who can provide end-to-end engineering leadership across the full lifecycle of the program. 

About Walmart Marketplace

At Walmart Global Tech, the Marketplace Engineering team is at the forefront of redefining global commerce at scale. We are the backbone of one of the fastest-growing e Commerce platforms Walmart Marketplace, where third-party sellers meet millions of customers every day. Our mission is bold: to deliver unmatched selection, competitive pricing, and a world-class pre-order, post-order experience, all powered by intelligent platforms and resilient systems. 

We empower thousands of sellers to thrive by offering tools to manage every aspect of their digital storefront from listing products to optimizing prices and inventory, while ensuring exceptional customer experiences. Our systems monitor the entire seller lifecycle, leverage real-time data for insights, and seamlessly integrate with partner platforms across the Walmart ecosystem. 

Architecture & Technology Strategy

Define and champion architectural blueprints, engineering standards, and best practices across initiatives. 

Set the vision for cross-domain and cross-platform integration, ensuring solutions are reusable, scalable, and built for long-term growth. 

Partner with product and business leaders to shape technical strategy as part of new capability launches. 

Evaluate emerging technologies and frameworks, providing recommendations for adoption where they can accelerate innovation and execution. 

Guide the evolution of technology stacks and platform capabilities to support diverse logistic carriers and seller needs. 

Technical Leadership & Innovation

Mentor and guide senior engineers and engineering leaders on system design, coding standards, operational excellence, and modern architectural patterns. 

Lead the design and implementation of complex, large-scale distributed systems with a focus on performance, resiliency, security, and maintainability. 

Drive engineering excellence through strong observability, automation, CI/CD, and operational best practices at scale. 

Champion secure coding practices and ensure solutions are designed with reliability, privacy, and compliance in mind. 

Remain hands-on in critical technical areas, helping teams solve ambiguous, high-complexity engineering problems. 

Strategic Requirement Analysis & Solution Design

Lead deep technical discovery and requirement analysis for complex, cross-functional Marketplace initiatives. 

Translate business goals into scalable technical solutions and platform investments. 

Mediate and resolve conflicting requirements across stakeholders, balancing speed, flexibility, and long-term maintainability. 

Shape roadmaps for foundational capabilities and engineering investments that unlock business value. 

Guide the creation of technical design artifacts, epics, and implementation plans for large cross-functional programs. 

Platform Scalability, Security & Compliance

Drive the design of secure, scalable, and highly available systems that support Marketplace growth. 

Ensure strong engineering discipline around data protection, service reliability, access controls, and platform security. 

Oversee system health, vulnerability management, and architectural risk mitigation across SOLC-owned capabilities. 

Partner with security and compliance teams to ensure adherence to legal, regulatory, and industry standards as applicable. 

Stakeholder Influence & Executive Leadership

Serve as a trusted technical advisor to senior leadership, influencing platform investments and engineering strategy. 

Lead cross-functional technical discussions, build alignment across teams, and drive decisions using data and sound engineering judgment. 

Communicate complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. 

Represent Marketplace engineering in broader organizational conversations and help raise the bar for technical excellence across Walmart. 

Talent Development & Culture

Attract, develop, and mentor top technical talent through coaching, technical leadership, and a strong culture of engineering excellence. 

Foster a culture of innovation, inclusion, ownership, and continuous learning across the organization. 

Model Walmart's values and ethical standards in all interactions. 

Continuous Improvement & Transformation

Drive continuous improvement in architecture, developer productivity, system quality, and operational maturity. 

Champion modern engineering practices and pragmatic innovation to accelerate delivery of strategic Marketplace capabilities. 

Encourage experimentation and thoughtful risk-taking while maintaining strong technical judgment and accountability. 

What You'll Bring

Deep working knowledge of cloud-native distributed system development; Azure / GCP / WCNP preferred. 

Strong experience building full-stack, multi-platform, large-scale, low-latency systems using microservices and distributed architectures. 

Proven experience mentoring engineers, technical leaders, and architects, and leading large engineering efforts with strong engineering excellence and system design rigor. 

Strong hands-on coding experience with the ability to go deep on architecture and implementation details when needed. 

Experience partnering cross-functionally with product, program management, QA, release management, operations, and other engineering teams. 

Proven experience designing, developing, and scaling software platforms for large user bases, with a focus on modularity, extensibility, and long-term maintainability. 

Strong platform-oriented decision-making, balancing technical and business needs in fast-paced, complex environments. 

Experience working with geographically distributed teams and aligning diverse stakeholders around shared technical goals. 

Strong business acumen, with the ability to connect technical strategy to business outcomes. 

Exceptional and concise verbal and written communication skills. 

Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, growing environment with ambiguity and high ownership. 

Knowledge of current AI tools for engineering

Preferred Experience

BS in Computer Science or similar plus 15 years or more in the field OR a MS in Computer Science and 12 years or more of experience. 

About Walmart Global Tech

Imagine working in an environment where one line of code can make life easier for hundreds of millions of people. That's what we do at Walmart Global Tech. We're a team of software engineers, data scientists, cybersecurity expert's and service professionals within the world's leading retailer who make an epic impact and are at the forefront of the next retail disruption. People are why we innovate, and people power our innovations. We are people-led and tech-empowered. 

We train our team in the skillsets of the future and bring in experts like you to help us grow. We have roles for those chasing their first opportunity as well as those looking for the opportunity that will define their career. Here, you can kickstart a great career in tech, gain new skills and experience for virtually every industry, or leverage your expertise to innovate at scale, impact millions and reimagine the future of retail. 

Mode of Work

Walmart's culture sets us apart, and we know being together helps us innovate, learn and grow great careers. This role is based in our Bangalore office for daily work, with the flexibility for associates to manage their personal lives. 

Benefits

Beyond our great compensation package, you can receive incentive awards for your performance. Other great perks include a host of best-in-class benefits maternity and parental leave, PTO, health benefits, and much more. 

Belonging

We aim to create a culture where every associate feels valued for who they are, rooted in respect for the individual. Our goal is to foster a sense of belonging, to create opportunities for all our associates, customers and suppliers, and to be a Walmart for everyone. 

At Walmart, our vision is "everyone included. " By fostering a workplace culture where everyone is-and feels-included, everyone wins. Our associates and customers reflect the makeup of all 19 countries where we operate. By making Walmart a welcoming place where all people feel like they belong, we're able to engage associates, strengthen our business, improve our ability to serve customers, and support the communities where we operate.

data.title: SAP Build Process Automation Developer
data.description:
About the company: 

Our client is a technology-driven company specializing in Artificial Intelligence (AI) and automation solutions. The organization helps businesses streamline operations, optimize processes, and improve performance through intelligent, scalable, and customized technology solutions. 

With strong technical expertise and a client-focused approach, the company develops practical solutions that enhance efficiency, accelerate business growth, and deliver measurable results. Its focus is on helping organizations embrace digital transformation and unlock new opportunities through AI and intelligent automation. 

The Role: 

One of our enterprise customers is standardizing its automation estate on SAP Build Process Automation. They currently run a portfolio of production bots on Automation Anywhere - bots that our team supports today and knows well. There is no direct, tool-to-tool conversion path from Automation Anywhere to SAP Build. Every automation has to be understood at the process level and rebuilt natively on SAP Build using the right mix of workflows, business rules, forms, and RPA agents. 

We are hiring a developer who can do both halves of that work: assess the existing bots and produce credible migration estimates and timelines, then build the replacement automations on SAP Build. You will work alongside the existing support team, who can walk you through the current bots and the business processes behind them. 

What You'll Do: 

Assessment and estimation: 

- Review existing Automation Anywhere bots and supporting documentation to understand what each automation actually does - systems touched, triggers, business rules, exception paths, and data dependencies. 
 - Work with our support team and the customer's process owners to separate what the bot does from what the business process requires, so the rebuild targets the process rather than replicating bot specific workarounds. 
 - Assess each automation for SAP Build fit and complexity, and identify where a workflow, a business rule, a form, an API call, or an RPA agent is the right construct. 
 - Produce effort estimates, migration sequencing recommendations, and realistic timelines at both 
 - the individual-automation and portfolio level, with assumptions and risks stated clearly. 
 - Flag automations that should be redesigned, consolidated, or retired rather than migrated as-is. Design and build: 

- Build and unit-test automations in SAP Build Process Automation - process workflows, decisions and business rules, forms, approvals, and attended/unattended RPA agents. 
 - Integrate with SAP S/4HANA, SAP BTP services, and non-SAP applications via OData, RESTAPIs, destinations, and connectors. 
 - Configure environments, agents, destinations, and transports across development, QA, and production. 
 - Implement error handling, logging, retry logic, and process visibility so automations are supportable in production. 
 - Support UAT, deployment, hypercare, and knowledge transfer to the support team. 
 - Documentation and collaboration: 
 - Maintain process design documents, solution design documents, test scripts, and runbooks. 
 - Report progress, risks, and dependencies to the OnTrac delivery lead and participate in customer facing working sessions as needed. 
 - Contribute to reusable patterns and standards that speed up subsequent migrations. 

What You Need: 

- 4+ years in RPA, process automation, or SAP application development, including 2+ years hands-on with SAP Build Process Automation (or SAP Intelligent RPA with demonstrated transition to SAP Build). 
 - Proven delivery of SAP Build automations in production - not just training exercises or proofs of concept. 
 - Working knowledge of SAP BTP: cockpit, subaccounts, destinations, connectivity, authorizations, and the Cloud Connector. 
 - Practical experience integrating with SAP S/4HANA or SAP ECC, and comfort working with OData services, RESTAPIs, and SAP Fiori applications. 
 - Ability to read and interpret Automation Anywhere bots (A360 or v11) well enough to reverse engineer process logic. 
 - Deep Automation Anywhere development experience is a plus but not required. 
 - Demonstrated ability to estimate effort and build timelines for automation work, and to defend those estimates with clear reasoning. 
 - Scripting proficiency in JavaScript; comfort with JSON and data transformation. 
 - Strong written and spoken English, and the confidence to ask business users the right questions about a process. 
 - Ability to work with meaningful overlap with US business hours for design sessions and stand-ups. 

Nice to Have: 

- SAP Certified Associate - SAP Build Process Automation. 
 - Experience migrating automations between platforms (any direction). 
 - SAP Build Apps, SAP Build Work Zone, or SAP Integration Suite exposure. 
 - Intelligent document processing experience (SAP Document Information Extraction or comparable). 
 - ABAP reading ability for tracing logic in custom SAP objects. 
 - Background in a consulting or client-services environment.

data.title: Senior Engineering Manager- NKP
data.description:
About The Team

The NKP (Nutanix Kubertenes Platform) team is building an enterprise-grade management platform for the containerized world. We are developing a fully cloud-native architecture designed to securely deploy, run, and manage Kubernetes clusters seamlessly across any hybrid or multi-cloud environment. 

NKP offers Container Attached Storage using Kubernetes pods to run AOS distributed storage fabric (Cloud Native AOS), enabling seamless integration with cloud native stateful workloads. The platform offers scale out, resilient and tiered storage. Supports storage features such as dynamic provisioning, thin provisioning, data efficiency, and application-centric snapshots. Cloud Native AOS can be used in both hyperconverged and disaggregated storage environments in a hybrid cloud environment. The stateful application Pods use the Nutanix CSI driver to consume storage entities that the AOS Pods present as Persistent Volumes. Much Like an on-premise HCI setup, Cloud Native AOS too provides all core Nutanix data management and copy data management functionalities. 

The Role

We are seeking a Senior Engineering Manager who is a "builder" at heart-someone who can architect complex storage software and, more importantly, architect the careers of the engineers who write it. 

In this role, you will lead a team of talented junior and mid-level engineers. You will serve as the technical anchor and mentor, guiding the team through the challenges of containerizing our services while ensuring our storage control path remains the gold standard for performance and reliability. 

You will design secure-by-default architectures, develop Kubernetes Custom Resource Definitions (CRDs) and operators, and ensure our Container Storage Interface (CSI) implementations are hardened against modern attack vectors while effortlessly serving enterprise and AI workloads. 

Key Responsibilities.

data.title: Senior AI Product Tester
data.description:
About The Opportunity

Venxr is hiring a Senior AI Product Tester to ensure zero broken AI products reach clients, especially those managing real ad budgets for major Indian brands like Haier, Orient Electric, and Suzuki. The role centers on QA automation powered by Claude, testing products that act on data - launching campaigns, moving budgets, and conversing with customers via WhatsApp. 

Role & Responsibilities

- Own quality across AdsGPT, and the WhatsApp bot - not as a gate at sprint end, but as a daily habit starting at 10am and embedded in every story shipped. 
 - Write test cases for every user story from acceptance criteria, and review them with the PM before development finishes. 
 - Run a 30-minute morning sanity check daily across all products - logins, key flows, ad-platform syncs, bot replies - and flag red issues before stand-up. 
 - Build and own QA automation using Claude Code for UI, API, and conversational flows, wired into CI to run on every deploy. 
 - Log 5-10 actionable bugs daily: clear repro steps, expected vs actual, severity, and evidence - so developers can fix without follow-up. 
 - Build evaluation sets for AI features - golden prompts, edge cases, adversarial inputs - to measure if new prompts or models improve outcomes. 
 - Validate numbers against source systems - dashboards must match Google Ads and Meta down to the rupee. 
 - Maintain the regression suite: fix flaky tests, delete useless ones, and identify coverage gaps. 
 - Test non-deterministic AI outputs using structural/intent assertions, LLM-as-judge with rubrics, and human validation when needed. 
 - Ensure bulk uploads (e. g. , Excel-based ad campaigns) fail safely and report precise errors for malformed inputs. 
 - Verify automated rules (e. g. , spend alerts) fire correctly and stay silent when they shouldn't. 
 - Test WhatsApp bot conversations - Hinglish, one-word replies, angry customers, off-topic questions, prompt injection. 
 - Validate live, self-updating client reports to ensure data accuracy against ad platforms. 

Skills & Qualifications

Must-Have

- 3-5 years in software QA, with at least 2 years building CI-integrated automation. 
 - Hands-on experience using Claude Code (or similar coding agent) to write, debug, and maintain test suites - must show a working suite built this way. 
 - Proficient with Playwright, Cypress, or Selenium for UI testing, and Postman, pytest, or REST Assured for API testing. 
 - Comfortable reading and testing code in Python or JavaScript/TypeScript. 
 - Skilled at testing non-deterministic outputs - assertions on structure/intent, LLM-as-judge with rubrics, and knowing when human judgment is needed. 
 - Ability to write clear, concise, and actionable bug reports and test cases - no padding, just specifics. 
 - Working knowledge of SQL to validate data directly in the database, not just UI. 

Preferred

- Experience testing chatbots or WhatsApp Business API flows. 
 - Exposure to Google Ads, Meta Ads, or ad-tech platforms. 
 - Familiarity with MCP servers (e. g. , Playwright MCP), GitHub Actions, or Docker. 
 - Basic load testing experience with k6, Locust, or JMeter. 

Benefits & Culture Highlights

- Small, fast team - bugs you find get fixed in days, not quarters. 
 - Build QA automation from the ground up - you choose tools, structure, and what to automate first. 
 - Flat hierarchy - no layers between you and release decisions. 
 - Direct client exposure - see how brands use your work and learn the ad industry. 
 - Work at the edge of AI testing - help write the playbook as you go. 
 - Offsites, learning budget, and an open culture for asking questions. 

Skills: typescript, rest assured, k6, claude code, python, selenium, sql, github actions, pytest, javascript, cypress, playwright
