If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution - then we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team!

Job Description

As a Test Automation Engineer, you will design and implement automation solutions that validate system behavior across UI, APIs, and integrations. You will contribute to building a robust quality engineering ecosystem by integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines and supporting continuous delivery. 

In this role, you will translate requirements into effective test strategies, combining automation with manual, exploratory, and integration testing to ensure comprehensive quality coverage across all application layers. 

This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys hands-on coding, solving complex validation challenges, and improving system quality at scale, while taking ownership of end-to-end quality outcomes and collaborating closely with cross-functional teams. 

Responsibilities

Automation Development & Framework Ownership

- Design, develop, and own scalable test automation frameworks and reusable components
 - Build automated test suites across: 
 - UI (Web/Mobile)
 - API and integration layers
 - Ensure automation solutions are maintainable, reliable, and extensible across teams

Test Strategy & Implementation

- Translate requirements into automation-ready test scenarios, test data, and validation strategies
 - Contribute to test strategy, coverage planning, and quality goals
 - Identify test gaps and proactively mitigate risks
 - Perform automation feasibility analysis to determine optimal test approach (manual vs automated)

Delivery & Execution Excellence

- Execute a balanced mix of automated and manual tests aligned with sprint goals, ensuring comprehensive validation across functional, integration, and edge-case scenarios.

Perforce is looking for a Principal Software Engineer responsible for managing the backend architecture of our internal AI platform, Perforce Prism on our Enterprise AI team. 

This role will own translating complex AI capabilities into developing scalable, production-grade solutions that drive real business impact. You'll work across technical teams and the business to embed AI into existing workflows and infrastructure, building solutions with measurable, lasting impact. 

This role sits at the intersection of engineering and the business. If you thrive on taking emerging AI capability and making it work in practice, this is the role for you.

data.description:
At PDI Technologies, we empower some of the world's leading convenience retail and petroleum brands with cutting-edge technology solutions that drive growth and operational efficiency. 

By "Connecting Convenience" across the globe, we empower businesses to increase productivity, make more informed decisions, and engage faster with customers through loyalty programs, shopper insights, and unmatched real-time market intelligence via mobile applications, such as GasBuddy.   We're a global team committed to excellence, collaboration, and driving real impact. Explore our opportunities and become part of a company that values diversity, integrity, and growth. 

Role Overview: 

Do you love building software that thrills your customers using AIDLC? Do you insist on high standards for the systems you and your teams design and build? Are you a progressive, hands-on software engineer with an architect's mindset, an advocate of agile development practices, and a proponent of continuous improvement? Well if this is you, then join an energetic team of engineers building next generation applications for PDI!  Software Engineer 4 is our senior-most engineering level and operates at the scope of a Software Architect. You will own the technical architecture and solution design for your product area as we drive to continuously increase our cloud maturity and mobility, defining how services are structured, integrated, secured, and scaled, and making the key design decisions for new and existing applications. You will lead medium and large sized projects, set technical direction and engineering standards across teams, and guide, train, and mentor engineers at all levels. You will partner with Product Management, Software Architects, and DevOps on solution feasibility, estimation, and the technical roadmap, and serve as the evangelist and custodian of our technology, architecture, and product.   With the variety of environments, platforms, technologies & languages, you must be comfortable working in both Windows & Linux environments and learning a variety of programming languages. 

This is a hands-on architect-level position (: 60% hands-on design and coding, : 40% architecture, technical leadership, and mentoring) requiring expert proficiency in . NET Core, React, SQL Server, and cloud-native architecture on Azure, with ownership of system design, architectural decisions, and engineering quality across teams. 

Key Responsibilities

- Own the architecture and solution design for your product area, and be accountable for design decisions for new and existing applications, proactively escalating issues and seeking assistance to overcome obstacles

- Define and document target-state architecture, system designs, and architecture decision records (ADRs); run design reviews and ensure implementations stay consistent with the agreed architecture

- Design for non-functional requirements (scalability, availability, performance, security, and compliance such as PCI DSS) and make the trade-offs between them explicit

- Define service boundaries, API contracts, integration patterns (REST, messaging and event-driven), and data models across services and third-party systems

- Lead medium and large sized projects end-to-end, from architecture and design through production deployment

- Set technical direction, coding standards, and engineering best practices across teams; guide, train, and mentor engineers at all levels, including through code and design reviews

- Actively design, develop, and maintain critical services and enterprise applications using . NET Framework, . NET Core, and React, building reference implementations and proofs of concept

- Partner with Product Management to consult on solution feasibility, high-level effort estimation, and the technical roadmap

- Prepare and provide project status and risk assessments, including technical and architectural risks, to management with appropriate levels of detail to ensure programs stay on schedule

- Collaborate with Software Architects and DevOps teams to evaluate tools, processes, technologies, and cloud infrastructure, including build-versus-buy decisions

- Make recommendations for technology adoption and framework improvement, analyzing trends, patterns, and best practices for software, including AI-assisted development (AIDLC)

- Serve as the evangelist and custodian of technology, architecture, and product

- Identify systemic performance, reliability, and scalability risks; drive root-cause analysis of production incidents and the architectural fixes that follow

- Use a disciplined approach in an Agile environment to assist in analysis and determination of preferred solutions to technical challenges

- Troubleshoot, test, and validate software issues; resolve issues with due urgency and maintain thorough documentation of all software solutions

- Work with Product Owner to clarify and estimate feature work, and with QA Engineers to develop optimal product test plans and resolve issues found during release stabilization

- Own the technical debt roadmap: identify, prioritize, and drive modernization and improvements across teams

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science or related field plus 9+ years' experience designing, developing, and maintaining software applications in a software product development environment, OR equivalent experience

- 4+ years of experience serving as a technical team lead or in an architecture role

- Proven track record of designing and delivering distributed, cloud-native systems end-to-end, including microservices, event-driven architecture, and API design

- Expert in: . NET Framework, . Net/. NET Core, C#, SQL, ASP. NET, ASP. NET Core, MVC, REST API, React

- Strong knowledge of architecture and design principles: design patterns, domain-driven design, SOLID, scalability, resiliency patterns, caching, and messaging (for example, Azure Service Bus)

- Strong experience with SQL Server and NoSQL data stores (for example, Cosmos DB): data modeling, stored procedures, and query performance tuning

- Deep knowledge of C# development including: multi-threading, memory management, async programming, microservices, dependency injection

- 3+ years of experience designing and running cloud native applications on Azure (or AWS/GCP): Infrastructure as a Service, Docker/containers, CI/CD, and observability

- Understanding of application security and compliance (OWASP, PCI DSS), with experience in payments or other regulated domains preferred

- Hands-on experience with AI-assisted development tools (AI-based agents) and the ability to drive their adoption across teams

- Proficiency with Microsoft Visual Studio IDE and the use of Azure DevOps or Jira

- 2+ years of practical experience with Agile development methodologies

- Highly motivated self-starter with a desire to help others and take action

- Requires strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to translate technical concepts into non-technical terms and present architecture to technical and business audiences

- Ability to socialize ideas and influence decisions without direct authority

- Ability to multi-task and prioritize tasks with competing deadlines

- Strong problem-solving and analytical skills with the ability to work under pressure

- Considers 'best-practice' standards, as well as departmental policies and procedures

- Experience working in retail or payments solution is preferred

Behavioral Competencies

Ensures Accountability

Manages Complexity

- 
Communicates Effectively

- 
Balances Stakeholders

- 
Collaborates Effectively

data.title: Senior Engineer - Supplier Quality
data.description:
Company Overview

Nikkiso Clean Energy & Industrial Gases (CE&IG) is a leading provider of cryogenic pumps, heat exchangers, process systems, turboexpanders, services, and solutions for the LH2, LNG and industrial gases industries. We are a subsidiary of Nikkiso Company Ltd, a leading industrial manufacturer headquartered in Tokyo, Japan, with over USD 1. 2B in annual revenue, 8, 000 + employees worldwide, and publicly traded on the Tokyo Stock Exchange. 

Job Overview

Summary/Objective: 

We are looking for an experienced engineer with 8-12 years of experience, who can work with supplier and ensure their deliverables and develop them to our expectation to meet the growing business volume and help to deliver good quality products withing stipulated delivery time. 

The candidate will be responsible for developing new suppliers, improving existing supplier capabilities, localizing components for group companies, ensuring supplier quality and delivery performance, and coordinating with global teams for technical and localization requirements. 

The ideal candidate should have strong technical knowledge of raw material, P&ID components, ASME code and have excellent communication and presentation skills, and the ability to independently drive supplier development projects from identification through successful production

Responsibilities

Responsibilities

- Identify, evaluate, and develop new suppliers based on technical, quality, capacity, cost, and delivery requirements. 
 - Conduct supplier capability assessments and evaluate manufacturing infrastructure, processes, quality systems, and capacity. 
 - Develop suppliers for P& ID parts, machined, cast, fabricated, forged, and other engineering components. 
 - Identify suitable local suppliers and develop them to meet global quality and technical standards. 
 - Drive improvement projects from supplier identification → feasibility → sample development → validation → PPAP/approval → production stabilization. 
 - Resolve technical and quality issues during development in coordination with global teams. 
 - Ensure consistent quality of components received from suppliers. 
 - Monitor supplier quality performance through PPM, rejection, rework, customer complaints, and other quality KPIs. 
 - Drive root-cause analysis and corrective actions for supplier quality issues. 
 - Work closely with suppliers to implement CAPA, RCA, and continuous improvement initiatives. 
 - Establish process controls and inspection standards at supplier locations. 
 - Conduct regular supplier visits and process audits. 
 - Development & qualification of supplier product / process of newly purchased parts through the process working with Sourcing, Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing. 
 - Support to Supplier process to develop suppliers and products to the point of successful/on-time Production Part Approval Process and Customer needs. 
 - Coordinates with engineering, manufacturing engineering, procurement and supplier quality on component quality / delivery issues and supplier initiatives to minimize the waste and control the cost, prepare monthly reports (MER). 
 - Provide support role to Quality to ensure supplier on-time product part approval process, Run at Rate and Delivery. 
 - Interfaces with the suppliers' engineering, manufacturing and procurement departments the respective internal departments to drive cost effective manufacturing process improvements that optimize throughput and minimize waste. 
 - Perform in-depth quality system assessments across commodities to confirm supplier structure, level of lean implementation, and effectiveness of the quality management system. 
 - Perform annual supplier audits as required. 

Authorities

- Work with vendor and improve their performance, help in material clearance while working closely with internal quality team, periodic vendor audits

Supervisory Responsibility

- Establish and monitor supplier performance metrics covering Quality, Cost, Delivery, Development, and Service. 
 - Prepare supplier performance reviews and development plans 
 - Coordinate effectively with procurement, quality, Manufacturing, logistics teams. 
 - Prepare and deliver professional management presentations, supplier review presentations, project updates, and performance reports. 
 - Responsibility of improving the performance and effectiveness of the IMS. 
 - Responsibility to Provide support of implementation of supplier related Engineering Changes involving major product design, process, supplier changes, as needed 
 - Assist company to perform cost reduction programs with suppliers, eliminate cost of rework 
 - Supplier assessment - Plans and conducts or ensure, supplier assessment including reporting and findings for major and minor opportunities for improvements and verifies effective closure of assessment findings by the supplier. 
 - Facilitate supplier design reviews encompassing supplier design simulation, testing, and validation activities to ensure delivered quality at both the proto-type and product launch phase 
 - Project management, Review & reporting of pending RFQ, PO, Delivery

Work Environment

This job operates in a professional office environment. This role routinely uses standard office equipment such as laptop computers, photocopiers, and smartphones. 

Physical Demands

- While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk or listen. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision and ability to adjust focus. This would require the ability to lift files, open filing cabinets and bend or stand on a stool as necessary. 

Qualifications

Education, Experience and Skills: 

- 8-12 years of relevant experience in Supplier Quality, Supplier Development, Vendor Development, Sourcing, or Manufacturing Engineering. 
 - B. E. /B. Tech. - Mechanical Engineering, master's degree in management will be an added advantage 
 - Strong hands-on knowledge of machining and casting processes. 
 - Proven experience in new supplier development and supplier qualification. 
 - Demonstrated experience in localization of components/parts, preferably for multinational or group companies. 
 - Experience in coordinating with global teams and international stakeholders. 
 - Strong knowledge of engineering drawings, GD&T, inspection methods, process capability, and manufacturing processes. 
 - Knowledge of PPAP, FMEA, RCA, and CAPA. 
 - Good understanding of supplier audits and quality management systems. 
 - Strong communication, negotiation, presentation, and interpersonal skills. 
 - Ability to lead suppliers and cross-functional teams toward defined project objectives. 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities. 
 - Willingness to travel to supplier locations as required. 
 - Strong negotiation and influential skills 
 - Understanding and interpretation of engineering drawings 
 - Good communication and interpersonal skills 
 - Experience as Auditor will be an added benefit 
 - Experience of IMS / ISO quality system 
 - Willing to work with people in an international environment 
 - Experience in machining and component manufacturing industry

Other Duties

This is where your work makes a difference. 

At Baxter, we believe every person-regardless of who they are or where they are from-deserves a chance to live a healthy life. It was our founding belief in 1931 and continues to be our guiding principle. We are redefining healthcare delivery to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond. 

Our Baxter colleagues are united by our Mission to Save and Sustain Lives. Together, our community is driven by a culture of courage, trust, and collaboration. Every individual is empowered to take ownership and make a meaningful impact. We strive for efficient and effective operations, and we hold each other accountable for delivering exceptional results. 

Here, you will find more than just a job-you will find purpose and pride. 

We are seeking a Senior Automation Engineer to design, implement, execute, and maintain reliable automated tests for distributed applications and connected-service workflows. The engineer will build C#-based REST API and UI automation, integrate test suites into CI/CD pipelines, analyze failures, and collaborate with verification, development, DevOps, and product teams to improve release quality. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Analyze product, system, interface, and software requirements and translate them into maintainable automated test scenarios.

 - Validate JSON/XML payloads, authentication and authorization, database records, event-driven integrations, negative paths, and boundary conditions. 
 - Integrate automated smoke and regression suites with Azure DevOps or equivalent CI/CD pipelines and maintain stable daily execution. 
 - Investigate failed tests using application logs, API traces, network diagnostics, database queries, and pipeline artifacts. 
 - Maintain requirements-to-test traceability, objective evidence, defect records, and release verification reports. 
 - Review automation code, improve coverage, support root-cause analysis, and mentor less-experienced engineers. 

What You'll Bring

- B. E/B. Tech in Computer Science / Electronics & Communication / Electrical or related field 
 - 8+ years of relevant experience in test automation, including C#/. NET-based API and UI automation, framework development, and CI/CD integration.

 - Proven REST API automation experience using suitable . NET libraries and test frameworks such as NUnit, xUnit, or MSTest.

Baxter is an equal opportunity employer. data.description:
Description

Do you thrive on solving complex problems? Do you enjoy diving under the surface to uncover how massively scalable systems with multiple dependencies work? We are creating a world class Center of Excellence and we need world class QAEs to deliver on this vision. As a QA Engineer, you will provide both coding and testing expertise for our team, as well as be a constant advocate for our customers. Our preferred candidate possesses a high level of OO coding experience, combined with a demonstrated passion for software quality. As a QAE, you will work closely with product and engineering teams to create test strategies and drive initiatives that ultimately ensure our customers get what they want, when they want. You'll understand the big picture of how our features and products interact as you navigate through complex designs and code. You will work with software development engineers to ensure soundness of design, testability of their code, and determine the best testing and automation approaches. You will contribute to automation frameworks and automate test cases both at the API and UI levels, using Java and other languages. You'll be responsible for driving the software development process toward quality-centric methodologies. 

- Demonstrated track record of delivering test automation, quality requirements, designing functional and performance test suites and producing deliverables that exceed commitments.

 - Generation of metrics and information that improve development practices on the team. 
 - Review and critique of technical requirements and software design specifications and software implementation. 
 - Instilling best practices for test suite automation and frameworks and documentation, making sure designs meet requirements, and delivering high quality software on tight schedules.

▪ Experience partnering with enterprise architecture, infrastructure, security, performance engineering, and other technology organizations

What's in it for you

At Schwab India, you're empowered to shape your future. We support your growth through meaningful work, continuous learning, and a culture rooted in trust and collaboration - so you can build the skills to make a lasting impact. Our benefits are designed to care for your wellbeing, your family, and your long-term financial security.

data.title: Senior Platform Software Engineer
data.description:
Job Description

Owns moderately complex components within platform services or SDKs; leads team-level improvements to integration frameworks and developer tooling. Performs deep debugging across a bounded set of distributed services, driving fixes that protect downstream consumers and upgrade paths. Analyzes usage, performance, and error budgets for specific platform surfaces; implements targeted resilience and capacity optimizations. Authors and curates team-scoped documentation, samples, and adoption guidance. 

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Platform Software Development: 

- Own a bounded platform component (service module, SDK area) and evolve its contracts for multi-tenant use. 
 - Perform deep debugging across a limited-service graph; drive compatibility-safe remediation plans. 
 - Implement targeted resilience/capacity patterns and document adoption guidance for team consumers. 

Software Development and Coding - Design, Testing, and Optimization: 

- Designs software solutions and analyzes and helps identify requirements to achieve business and operational goals, independently. 
 - Adheres to and suggests improvements to all phases of the software development lifecycle. 
 - Utilizes working knowledge to develop new software features and enhancements following design specifications and develops documents to clarify software design and code. 
 - Leads code reviews in designated areas to help drive improvements. 
 - Conducts debugging and troubleshooting to identify and fix moderately complex software issues. Develops fixes for identified issues. 
 - Implements software testing (e. g. , functional and non-functional testing), quality assurance processes, software error logging, monitoring, and observability for effective debugging, ensuring review by manager and/or lead throughout the process. 
 - Exercises judgment and discretion to conduct performance profiling and optimization of coding. 
 - Troubleshoots and resolves moderately complex issues related to application programming interface (API) functionality and integration. 
 - Implements moderately complex API versioning, lifecycle, and interoperability strategies. 

Software Architecture - Software System Structural Design: 

- Designs and develops software, systems, and services aligned to pre-defined system architecture. 
 - Develops working knowledge of software architecture decisions and best practices. 
 - Collaborates with team leads to review work to ensure alignment with software architecture. 
 - Implements moderately complex performance optimization and scalability strategies in software design. 

Issue/Defect Collaboration - Software Products Support: 

- Collaborates within and beyond immediate team to understand customer issues and align solutions. 
 - May provide technical guidance and support to customers regarding customer-reported issues, independently. 
 - Coaches, mentors, and guides others to advocate for customers' interests and suggests product enhancements based on feedback. 
 - Influences team to ensure customer satisfaction through timely resolution of issues and effective communication. 
 - Implements customer issue and/or defect handling and training processes, independently. 
 - Investigates and troubleshoots complex product maintenance issues to ensure customer agreement on short- and long-term solutions (e. g. , future enhancements). 

Practices and Standards Compliance - Security and Compliance: 

- Collaborates with the team to establish and follow development practices and coding standards. 
 - Exercises judgment and discretion to ensure code quality and adherence to broad acceptance criteria during development. 
 - Keeps up to date with industry best practices and applies them to software development processes. 
 - Implements secure coding practices to prevent security vulnerabilities. 

Development Operations - System Maintenance: 

- Performs periodic maintenance and testing operations for systems that require upgrading or patching (e. g. , for critical vulnerabilities). 
 - Exercises judgment and discretion to drive improvements, ensure automation, testing, and debugging of systems to ensure service/product availability, health, support, and reliability. 

Core Responsibilities

Planning & Execution: 

- Independently manages work, monitoring timelines and deliverables to ensure projects or initiatives stay on track and meet requirements. Proactively prioritizes work and adapts to resource or timeline shifts, suggesting adjustments to maintain project efficiency. 

Collaboration & Partnership: 

- Collaborates across teams to align on expectations and achieve shared objectives. Builds and maintains a comprehensive understanding of business, stakeholder, and/or customer needs to build and support effective partnerships. Actively listens to diverse perspectives and asks questions to ensure understanding of others. 

Problem Solving: 

- Independently identifies and addresses standard and non-standard issues in accordance with standard practices, escalating more complex issues as appropriate. Analyzes data and/or information from multiple sources to troubleshoot standard and non-standard errors. Contributes to knowledge sharing and best practices. 

Continuous Learning: 

- Embraces continuous learning by actively seeking to build knowledge and new skills and/or tools and staying current with industry trends and best practices. Seeks out and leverages feedback and training to improve skills. Contributes to a culture of continuous learning and knowledge sharing with team members. 

Continuous Improvement: 

- Develops ideas and recommends updates to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows within a team. Seeks input from team members on alternative approaches and methods for improving work. 

About Us

Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives. 

True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That's why we're committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs. 

We're committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation-request_mb@oracle. com or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States. 

Oracle is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans' status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Oracle will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.

This is a unique opportunity to be part of our early growth phase and shape something new, backed by the stability and strength of a Fortune 500 company. Your impact begins on day one, and your contributions will help define our future in the region. 

What you have

Key Responsibilities

At Schwab, you are empowered to make an impact on your career. Innovative thinking meets disciplined engineering as we challenge the status quo and strengthen the quality of digital experiences that serve our clients. 

This Senior Manager role will lead quality engineering and SDET practices for business-critical enterprise applications. The role combines hands-on automation architecture with technical leadership, partnering across product, development, architecture, operations, and risk teams to build quality into every stage of delivery. 

The ideal candidate is a pragmatic quality leader who can independently drive large-scale initiatives, modernize automation frameworks, coach engineers, and improve release confidence through measurable, risk-based testing. 

AI-enabled quality engineering is a core expectation of this position. The leader will establish practical, governed use of AI agents and coding assistants to accelerate test design, framework development, end-to-end regression automation, failure analysis, and continuous quality improvement while maintaining human review, security, privacy, traceability, and reliability controls. 

- Drive quality strategy and successful execution for complex, business-critical programs, aligning test coverage, automation, release readiness, and quality outcomes with organizational objectives. 
 - Architect, develop, and evolve scalable UI and API automation frameworks using Playwright with JavaScript/TypeScript and Selenium with Java, applying reusable design patterns, reliable synchronization, test-data management, and actionable failure diagnostics. 
 - Establish an effective quality-engineering approach across functional, integration, regression, end-to-end, API, database, accessibility, compatibility, and non-functional testing, with appropriate use of exploratory and risk-based testing. 
 - Validate data integrity and backend processing through advanced SQL across Microsoft SQL Server and PostgreSQL, including source-to-target reconciliation, stored procedure validation, and troubleshooting of complex application workflows. 
 - Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and GitHub-based workflows; improve execution speed, stability, reporting, environment readiness, and defect traceability using modern test and quality-management tooling. 
 - Lead test planning, estimation, quality metrics, defect triage, root-cause analysis, release risk assessments, and production-quality reviews, distinguishing product defects from automation or environment instability. 
 - Guide and mentor SDETs and QA engineers, set coding and automation standards, conduct design and code reviews, and foster accountability, collaboration, continuous learning, and engineering excellence. 
 - Partner with geographically distributed product, engineering, architecture, DevOps, operations, compliance, and vendor teams to manage dependencies, resolve blockers, and deliver secure, resilient, and maintainable solutions. 

Required Qualifications

Preffered Qualification

- Contribute to long-term quality-engineering roadmaps, platform modernization, tooling decisions, and responsible adoption of AI-assisted testing while following data privacy and company-policy guardrails. 
 - Define and lead an AI-enabled quality-engineering strategy, including the creation and governed use of specialized testing agents for requirement analysis, test-case generation, automation development, test-data preparation, code review, regression-suite maintenance, defect reproduction, and failure triage. 
 - Build and maintain enterprise end-to-end regression suites and reusable test frameworks using Playwright, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, Selenium, mabl, API automation, and AI-assisted engineering tools such as GitHub Copilot and Claude, with mandatory human validation of generated code, tests, assertions, and conclusions. 
 - Create agent instructions, reusable prompts, repository context, tool integrations, and evaluation criteria that enable AI agents to consistently follow application architecture, coding standards, testing patterns, security controls, and quality gates. 
 - Own GitHub engineering administration and governance for quality repositories, including repository structure, branching strategy, pull-request controls, access management, protected branches, secrets usage, dependency management, release tagging, reusable workflows, auditability, and quality dashboards. 
 - Design, manage, and continuously improve CI/CD and test-execution pipelines across GitHub Actions, Jenkins, and Bamboo, including pipeline-as-code, parallel and distributed execution, environment orchestration, test selection, artifact retention, reporting, failure notifications, and release gates. 
 - Lead adoption and governance of mabl for agentic and low-code test automation, including browser and API coverage, reusable flows, test plans, environment configurations, CI/CD integration, intelligent test maintenance, and alignment with the broader Playwright and Selenium automation strategy. 
 - Establish controls for responsible AI use in quality engineering, including approved-tool usage, data classification and privacy protection, restricted handling of credentials and production data, prompt and output review, model-risk awareness, reproducibility, evidence retention, and monitoring for inaccurate or unsafe AI-generated results. 
 - Define measurable AI and automation outcomes such as regression coverage, execution duration, flaky-test rate, escaped defects, failure-triage time, maintainability, adoption, and productivity, using metrics to guide investment and continuous improvement. 
 - 
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - 12+ years of experience in software quality engineering, QA automation, SET, or SDET roles, including 5+ years leading engineers or major quality-engineering initiatives for enterprise applications. 
 - Advanced hands-on experience designing and maintaining automation frameworks with Playwright and JavaScript/TypeScript, plus strong experience with Java and Selenium WebDriver. 
 - Strong experience testing web applications, REST APIs, microservices, and distributed systems using appropriate automation libraries and API tools such as REST Assured, Postman, or equivalent. 
 - Proficiency in SQL and database validation across Microsoft SQL Server and PostgreSQL, including complex queries, data reconciliation, backend troubleshooting, and performance-aware test design. 
 - Experience integrating automated suites with CI/CD and source-control workflows using GitHub, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, AWS DevOps, or comparable platforms; practical knowledge of containers and cloud-based test execution. 
 - Demonstrated knowledge of Page Object or Screenplay patterns, test pyramids, contract testing, mocking or service virtualization, TDD/BDD, parallel execution, cross-browser testing, and dependable test-data strategies. 
 - Experience with Jira, Confluence, Xray, Zephyr, TestRail, qTest, or equivalent, along with clear quality metrics and executive-ready reporting. 
 - Working knowledge of accessibility, security, performance, and observability testing, JMeter or k6, Splunk, and application-log analysis. 
 - Proven ability to work independently, lead multiple large-scale efforts, influence technical decisions, communicate risks clearly, and collaborate effectively in Agile environments. 
 - Mandatory hands-on experience applying generative AI and agentic AI to software quality engineering, including the creation or configuration of testing agents and the use of AI-assisted tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude, or comparable enterprise-approved platforms to design tests, generate and review automation code, create end-to-end regression suites, maintain frameworks, and analyze failures. 
 - Demonstrated ability to evaluate AI-generated tests and code for functional correctness, determinism, security, privacy, maintainability, coverage, bias, hallucination risk, and compliance with enterprise engineering standards; candidates must be able to keep a human-in-the-loop for material quality and release decisions. 
 - Advanced ownership of GitHub repository management and governance, including permissions, branching, pull requests, protected branches, secrets, reusable workflows, dependency controls, release management, auditability, and integration with enterprise CI/CD and quality tooling. 
 - Strong experience designing and operating production-grade automation pipelines with GitHub Actions, Jenkins, and Bamboo, including pipeline-as-code, parallel execution, environment and test-data orchestration, reports and artifacts, notifications, quality gates, failure recovery, and troubleshooting. 
 - Hands-on experience with mabl or a comparable intelligent test-automation platform, including authoring and maintaining browser and API tests, reusable flows, execution plans, environment configuration, CI/CD integration, result analysis, and governed use of AI-assisted capabilities. 
 - Experience integrating AI agents with test-management, observability, source-control, CI/CD, and engineering workflows through APIs, webhooks, or Model Context Protocol (MCP). 
 - Experience establishing reusable AI prompts, agent instructions, contextual grounding, evaluation datasets or benchmark scenarios, and acceptance criteria for AI-assisted testing workflows, with clear versioning and traceability in source control. 
 - Experience in financial services, brokerage, wealth management, or another highly regulated industry. 
 - Experience modernizing legacy Selenium suites to Playwright and improving flaky-test detection, execution time, coverage, and maintainability. 
 - Knowledge of AWS, GCP, or Azure; Kubernetes/Docker; mobile automation with Appium; event-driven systems; and data-pipeline testing. 
 - Practical use of AI-assisted engineering tools to accelerate test design, automation development, code review, and failure triage, with human validation and appropriate privacy controls. 
 - Relevant quality, Agile, cloud, security, or testing certifications. 
 - Experience defining an enterprise adoption roadmap for AI-enabled testing, including proof-of-value criteria, tool evaluation, licensing and usage controls, training, reusable assets, governance, and scaled rollout across multiple teams. 
 - Knowledge of testing AI-enabled application features, including validation of model responses, grounding, prompt behavior, safety controls, non-deterministic outcomes, latency, reliability, and regression evaluation. 

What's in it for you

At Schwab India, you're empowered to shape your future. We support your growth through meaningful work, continuous learning, and a culture rooted in trust and collaboration - so you can build the skills to make a lasting impact. Our benefits are designed to care for your wellbeing, your family, and your long-term financial security.

data.title: Senior Platform Software Engineer
data.description:
Job Description

Owns moderately complex components within platform services or SDKs; leads team-level improvements to integration frameworks and developer tooling. Performs deep debugging across a bounded set of distributed services, driving fixes that protect downstream consumers and upgrade paths. Analyzes usage, performance, and error budgets for specific platform surfaces; implements targeted resilience and capacity optimizations. Authors and curates team-scoped documentation, samples, and adoption guidance. 

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Platform Software Development: 

- Own a bounded platform component (service module, SDK area) and evolve its contracts for multi-tenant use. 
 - Perform deep debugging across a limited-service graph; drive compatibility-safe remediation plans. 
 - Implement targeted resilience/capacity patterns and document adoption guidance for team consumers. 

Software Development and Coding - Design, Testing, and Optimization: 

- Designs software solutions and analyzes and helps identify requirements to achieve business and operational goals, independently. 
 - Adheres to and suggests improvements to all phases of the software development lifecycle. 
 - Utilizes working knowledge to develop new software features and enhancements following design specifications and develops documents to clarify software design and code. 
 - Leads code reviews in designated areas to help drive improvements. 
 - Conducts debugging and troubleshooting to identify and fix moderately complex software issues. Develops fixes for identified issues. 
 - Implements software testing (e. g. , functional and non-functional testing), quality assurance processes, software error logging, monitoring, and observability for effective debugging, ensuring review by manager and/or lead throughout the process. 
 - Exercises judgment and discretion to conduct performance profiling and optimization of coding. 
 - Troubleshoots and resolves moderately complex issues related to application programming interface (API) functionality and integration. 
 - Implements moderately complex API versioning, lifecycle, and interoperability strategies.

- Designs and develops software, systems, and services aligned to pre-defined system architecture. 
 - Develops working knowledge of software architecture decisions and best practices. 
 - Collaborates with team leads to review work to ensure alignment with software architecture. 
 - Implements moderately complex performance optimization and scalability strategies in software design.

 - Influences team to ensure customer satisfaction through timely resolution of issues and effective communication. 
 - Implements customer issue and/or defect handling and training processes, independently. 
 - Investigates and troubleshoots complex product maintenance issues to ensure customer agreement on short- and long-term solutions (e. g. , future enhancements). 

Practices and Standards Compliance - Security and Compliance: 

- Collaborates with the team to establish and follow development practices and coding standards. 
 - Exercises judgment and discretion to ensure code quality and adherence to broad acceptance criteria during development. 
 - Keeps up to date with industry best practices and applies them to software development processes. 
 - Implements secure coding practices to prevent security vulnerabilities. 

Development Operations - System Maintenance: 

- Performs periodic maintenance and testing operations for systems that require upgrading or patching (e. g. , for critical vulnerabilities). 
 - Exercises judgment and discretion to drive improvements, ensure automation, testing, and debugging of systems to ensure service/product availability, health, support, and reliability. 

Core Responsibilities

Planning & Execution: 

- Independently manages work, monitoring timelines and deliverables to ensure projects or initiatives stay on track and meet requirements. Proactively prioritizes work and adapts to resource or timeline shifts, suggesting adjustments to maintain project efficiency. 

Collaboration & Partnership: 

- Collaborates across teams to align on expectations and achieve shared objectives. Builds and maintains a comprehensive understanding of business, stakeholder, and/or customer needs to build and support effective partnerships. Actively listens to diverse perspectives and asks questions to ensure understanding of others. 

Problem Solving: 

- Independently identifies and addresses standard and non-standard issues in accordance with standard practices, escalating more complex issues as appropriate. Analyzes data and/or information from multiple sources to troubleshoot standard and non-standard errors. Contributes to knowledge sharing and best practices. 

Continuous Learning: 

- Embraces continuous learning by actively seeking to build knowledge and new skills and/or tools and staying current with industry trends and best practices. Seeks out and leverages feedback and training to improve skills. Contributes to a culture of continuous learning and knowledge sharing with team members. 

Continuous Improvement: 

- Develops ideas and recommends updates to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows within a team. Seeks input from team members on alternative approaches and methods for improving work.

data.title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer
data.description:
Job Description

Are you looking to apply your skills contributing to a next generation of Database cloud services? Are you calm and collected when others panic under pressure? Do you get a thrill from solving really tough problems? Do you light up in conversations about uptime, horizontal scalability, performance, security, and DevOps?

The Autonomous AI Database Team is responsible for building the cloud service framework powering various Oracle Autonomous AI Database cloud services, including Autonomous Data Warehouse (ADW) and Autonomous Transaction Processing (ATP). The framework automates deployment, scaling and management of databases in the cloud. It is built on top of Oracle's Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) Layer. 

The autonomous AI database cloud service framework features APIs to handle all lifecycle management operations of databases. It also performs operations autonomously based on internal and external events. The team has the unique opportunity to make significant contributions to the full stack of Oracle technology, from database kernel to cloud service platform and to customer-facing portals. 

As a Site reliability Engineer, you will be responsible for defining and deploying autonomous database services with deep focus on architecture, production operations, capacity planning, performance management, deployment, and release engineering. You will work with multiple cross-functional teams helping deliver new and outstanding experiences to our stakeholders while ensuring reliability and performance. 

We are a dynamic and enthusiastic team with great emphasis on go-getters and proactive individuals. 

Overview from oracle. com with links to other collateral: 

https: //cloud. oracle. com/en_US/datawarehouse

https: //www. oracle. com/database/autonomous-database/feature. html

Career Level - IC3

Responsibilities

In this role you will need to: 

Take ownership of the implementation and production operations of a wide array of core system platform solutions

React to production deficiencies by continuously implementing automation, self-healing, and real-time monitoring to production systems

Be a strong contributor to development of platform services including architecture, provisioning, configuration, deployment, and support

Partner with the distributed team in prototyping new database platform services

Stay informed of cloud infrastructure stacks

Innovate

Preferred Qualifications: 

Degree level : BE/BS/MS

Programming languages like Python, Java

Expert knowledge and in-depth experience of the Oracle Engineered systems and subsystems. 

Ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex hardware/software issues, restore environments to an operational state, perform root cause analysis and provide forward thinking mitigation strategies

Expert level understanding, implementation experience and troubleshooting of Oracle Database technology including RAC, Dataguard, ASM, RMAN etc

Demonstrated operations experience with Linux platform (i. e. RHEL, OEL) including administration, management, and troubleshooting

Strong communication and analytical skills

Familiarity with security practices in web application delivery and General knowledge of network topology

Experience with configuration management tools

*Core Competencies: *

- Extensive expertise in Oracle Engineered Systems and subsystems with hands-on experience in deployment, optimization, and maintenance. 
 - Proven ability to diagnose and resolve complex hardware/software issues, restore system functionality, conduct root cause analysis, and implement proactive mitigation strategies. 
 - Advanced proficiency in Oracle Database technologies, including RAC, Data Guard, ASM, RMAN, and performance tuning, with a focus on implementation and troubleshooting. 
 - Operational mastery of Linux platforms (e. g. , RHEL, OEL), including system administration, maintenance, and issue resolution. 
 - Strong experience in automation using Python and shell scripting to develop custom solutions, streamline processes, and improve system efficiency. 
 - Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (OCI, AWS, Azure, GCP) is a plus. 
 - Excellent communication skills paired with strong analytical and problem-solving abilities. 
 - Working knowledge of security best practices for web application delivery and familiarity with network infrastructure concepts.

Position: Lead Developer- AI-Native Product Development

Location: Hyderabad ( 8 PM to 5 AM IST)

Work Type: Full-Time

Experience: 8+ Years

PETADATA is looking for a Lead Developer to lead the design, development, and delivery of AI-native, full-stack applications. The ideal candidate will have strong experience in software architecture, AI-assisted development, CRM/data integrations, and modern web technologies, with the ability to drive projects from concept to production. 

Roles & Responsibilities

Product Development

- Design, develop, and deliver production-ready software products using modern AI-assisted development workflows.

data.title: Senior Controls Automation Engineer
data.description:
Johnson Controls is seeking a Senior Controls & Automation Engineer to support the development, testing, commissioning and troubleshooting of PLC/HMI control systems for Hydraulic Power Units (HPU) and CAFS / INERT Fire Suppression Systems. 

This is a hands-on role focused on PLC software development, HMI configuration, FAT/iFAT/SAT execution, commissioning and operational support across supplier facilities, JCI sites and project locations. 

Key Responsibilities

- Develop, modify and troubleshoot PLC software using Siemens TIA Portal & Rockwell Studio 5000 and FactoryTalk experience. 
 - Configure and support HMI/SCADA applications such as WinCC, WinCC Unified, FactoryTalk or similar platforms. 
 - Execute and support Pre-FAT, FAT, iFAT, SAT and commissioning activities. 
 - Implement and verify Cause & Effect Matrices, interlocks, alarms, shutdowns and control sequences. 
 - Troubleshoot PLC, HMI, I/O, instrumentation and communication issues. 
 - Support controlled software updates, testing and issue resolution. 
 - Work closely with engineering teams, suppliers and client representatives to achieve project milestones. 

Essential Requirements

- Degree in Electrical, Automation, Control or Instrumentation Engineering. 
 - Minimum 5 years' hands-on PLC programming experience. 
 - Strong experience with Siemens TIA Portal and Studio 5000 (mandatory). 
 - HMI development experience with WinCC, WinCC Unified, FactoryTalk or equivalent. 
 - Proven experience delivering FAT, iFAT, SAT and commissioning activities. 
 - Knowledge of industrial communications including Profinet, Modbus TCP/IP and Ethernet/IP. 
 - Experience implementing control philosophies, Cause & Effect requirements, interlocks and permissives. 

Desirable Experience

- Oil & Gas, Marine or Offshore projects. 
 - Fire Suppression Systems, HPU packages or safety-related control systems. 
 - Functional Safety awareness (IEC 61508 / IEC 61511). 
 - OT Cyber Security awareness (IEC 62443). 
 - Rockwell Studio 5000 and FactoryTalk experience. 

What We're Looking For

A practical, hands-on Controls Engineer who can quickly understand control systems, solve automation problems, support project delivery, and work effectively with suppliers, clients and multidisciplinary engineering teams. 

Travel within the UK, Turkey and Vietnam will be required for FAT, commissioning and project support activities.

Job Purpose

Supervise the production of New Products (Textura, Kool n Seal & other products) and testing of all raw materials, in process & finished product so as to achieve targeted production as per specified quality norms to fulfill market demands. 

Job Context & Major Challenges

Job Context

Birla White is White Cement division of UltraTech Cement Limited and is a P&L centre. In India, BW is leader in White Cement as well as main Value Added Product Wall Care Putty with WC installed capacity of 680, 000 MT per annum and Wall Care Putty capacity of 8, 50, 000 MT per annum. Business has plans to increase White Cement capacity by another 7, 20, 000 MT and Wall Care Putty capacity by another 4, 50, 000 MT per annum. Birla White plant is fully integrated and automated processing. The plant is accredited with ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 50001, SA 8000, and OHSAS 18001. BW sells WC & WCP in multipack variants of 1 KG, 5KG, 20 KG, 25 KG, 40 KG and 50 KG. 

In White Cement category, there is only one major competitor M/s JK White Cement with BW commanding a Market Share of 52. 3% whereas in cement based putty, there are multiple competitors across organized and unorganized sector with BW commanding a market share of over 45. 5%. Over the years, WCP has grown to become major contributor to White Cement Industry and is contributing 60%-65% of the total revenues. However with Paint majors (Asian, Berger, Nerolac etc. ) becoming a potent force in WCP market, it is becoming extremely difficult to maintain the high margins the industry has achieved in the past.

Director - AI Engineering

At Capital One, we are creating responsible and reliable AI systems, changing banking for good. For years, Capital One has been an industry leader in using machine learning to create real-time, personalized customer experiences. Our investments in technology infrastructure and world-class talent along with our deep experience in machine learning, position us to be at the forefront of enterprises leveraging AI. From informing customers about unusual charges to answering their questions in real time, our applications of AI & ML are bringing humanity and simplicity to banking. We are committed to continuing to build world-class applied science and engineering teams to deliver our industry leading capabilities with breakthrough product experiences and scalable, high-performance AI infrastructure. At Capital One, you will help bring the transformative power of emerging AI capabilities to reimagine how we serve our customers and businesses who have come to love the products and services we build. 

Team Description: 

The Intelligent Foundations and Experiences (IFX) team is at the center of bringing our vision for AI at Capital One to life. Our Generative AI models and platforms empower teams across Capital One to enhance their products by composing powerful, safe and explainable AI capabilities such as agentic workflows, and shared services such as guardrails, observability and evals coupled with foundational model power of open-weight and proprietary frontier models. The team is also delivering capabilities on top of the platform to optimize the software development life-cycle to dramatically enhance developer productivity and model-development life cycle to improve time-to-market of machine learning models. 

In this role, you will: 

- Partner with a cross-functional team of engineers, research scientists, technical program managers, and product managers to deliver AI-powered products that change how our associates work and how our customers interact with Capital One. 
 - Oversee the design, development, testing, deployment, and support AI software components including foundation model training, large language model inference, similarity search, guardrails, model evaluation, experimentation, governance, and observability, etc. 
 - Make high judgment build-vs-buy decisions across a broad stack of Open Source and SaaS AI technologies such as AWS Ultraclusters, Huggingface, VectorDBs, Nemo Guardrails, PyTorch and more. 
 - Invent and introduce state-of-the-art LLM optimization techniques to improve the performance. scalability, cost, latency, throughput of large scale production AI systems. 
 - Contribute to the technical vision and the long term roadmap of foundational AI systems at Capital One. 
 - Attract and retain top talent in the AI industry and nurture personal and professional development for your team. Foster a culture of learning and staying abreast of the state-of-the-art in AI. 

The Ideal Candidate: 

- You love to build systems, take pride in the quality of your work, and also share our passion to do the right thing. You want to work on problems that will help change banking for good. 
 - Passion for staying abreast of the latest research, and an ability to intuitively understand scientific publications and judiciously apply novel techniques in production. 
 - You get fulfillment from empowering others to achieve their potential and you actively drive professional development through mentoring and coaching. You are hands-on when necessary and lead by example. 
 - You adapt quickly and thrive on bringing clarity to big, undefined problems. You love asking questions and digging deep to uncover the root of problems and can articulate your findings concisely with clarity. You have the courage to share new ideas even when they are unproven. 
 - You are deeply Technical. You possess a strong foundation in engineering and mathematics, and your expertise in hardware, software, and AI enable you to see and exploit optimization opportunities that others miss. 
 - You are a resilient trail blazer who can forge new paths to achieve business goals when the route is unknown. 

Basic Qualifications: 

- Bachelor's Degree or higher in Computer Science, Machine Learning or a related quantitative field such as Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics or Engineering
 - At least 3 years of people leadership experience
 - At least 6 years of experience developing AI and ML algorithms or technologies
 - At least 6 years of experience deploying scalable and responsible AI solutions on cloud platforms including AWS, Google Cloud or Azure

Preferred Qualifications: 

- Master's or Doctoral Degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mathematics or related field
 - 5+ years of experience managing and leading an engineering team
 - 8+ years of experience deploying scalable and responsible AI solutions on cloud platforms including AWS, Google Cloud or Azure
 - 8+ years of experience developing AI and ML algorithms or technologies, such as LLM Inference, Similarity Search and VectorDBs, Guardrails, and Memory. 
 - Passion for staying abreast of the latest AI research and AI systems and judiciously apply novel techniques in production
 - Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to articulate complex AI concepts to peers

Business Intelligence & Semantic Modeling

- Lead and grow multiple engineering teams responsible for Personalization and Recommendation platforms across FOX's Digital Product ecosystem.

 - Partner closely with Product Management, Data Science, Machine Learning, Analytics, Platform Engineering, and DevOps teams to deliver strategic business initiatives.

 - Balance feature delivery with long-term platform scalability, modernization, and technical debt reduction. 
 - Lead the development of experimentation platforms including A/B testing capabilities to support data-driven product decisions. 
 - Ensure recommendation services deliver high availability, scalability, performance, and measurable business impact. 
 - Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate recommendation services across Web, Mobile, and Connected TV applications. 
 - Communicate engineering strategy, delivery status, risks, trade-offs, and business outcomes to executive leadership. 
 - Foster an inclusive engineering culture focused on ownership, innovation, customer experience, and continuous learning.

 - 12+ years of software engineering experience, including 5+ years leading multiple engineering teams or organizations. 
 - Proven experience building scalable backend platforms and distributed systems serving millions of users.

Role Summary

We are seeking an experienced Lead Performance Engineer with strong expertise in Performance Engineering, Capacity Planning, Scalability Assessment, Performance Architecture, and Technical Leadership across UI applications, APIs, MQ-based messaging systems, and Batch Processing workloads. 

The ideal candidate will lead performance engineering initiatives, define enterprise-wide performance strategies, mentor performance teams, and drive performance governance across multiple programs. The role requires strong hands-on expertise in LoadRunner Enterprise (LRE), Apache JMeter, AutoSys, Capacity Engineering, Bottleneck Analysis, Infrastructure Sizing, and Performance Optimization. 

The candidate will work closely with Enterprise Architects, Application Development Teams, Infrastructure Teams, Middleware Teams, Database Administrators, DevOps Teams, and Business Stakeholders to ensure scalable, resilient, and high-performing enterprise platforms. 

Day to Day Job Duties

 - Lead performance testing and engineering activities across UI, API, MQ, Batch, and distributed application architectures. 
 - Design performance test approaches, workload models, test scenarios, success criteria, and capacity strategies. 
 - Provide technical leadership and guidance to performance engineers across multiple projects and programs. 
 - Design, review, and govern performance test scripts developed using LoadRunner Enterprise (LRE) and Apache JMeter. 
 - Lead load, stress, endurance, scalability, volume, and peak-load testing initiatives. 
 - Oversee API and MQ performance testing for synchronous, asynchronous, and event-driven systems. 
 - Lead analysis of AutoSys-managed batch workloads and identify optimization opportunities across batch processing landscapes.

 - Correlate application performance metrics with monitoring, observability, and infrastructure utilization data. 
 - Provide performance architecture recommendations for application modernization and cloud transformation initiatives. 
 - Establish performance baselines, SLAs, KPIs, and performance governance frameworks.

 - Present performance findings and solution recommendations to leadership teams, architects, and senior stakeholders.

Basic Qualifications

 - Strong expertise in LoadRunner Enterprise (LRE) and Apache JMeter. 
 - Experience leading performance engineering teams and enterprise-scale performance programs. 
 - Strong experience in UI, API, MQ, and Batch Performance Testing. 
 - Expertise in capacity assessment, infrastructure sizing, performance architecture, and workload modeling. 
 - Experience working with enterprise monitoring and observability platforms. 
 - Strong knowledge of distributed systems, microservices, middleware technologies, and enterprise application architectures. 
 - Experience presenting technical recommendations to senior leadership and business stakeholders. 
 - Strong leadership, stakeholder management, communication, and mentoring skills. 

Core Technical Skills

 - DevOps & Automation: CI/CD Integration, Performance Automation, Release Validation
 - Methodologies: Agile, Scrum, SDLC

Nice to Have

- Experience in Banking, Payments, Financial Services, or High-Volume Transaction Processing Environments.

 - Experience with SQL Optimization and Database Performance Engineering. 
 - Experience with Linux/Unix administration, Shell Scripting, and Log Analysis. 
 - Exposure to Cloud Performance Engineering across Azure, AWS, or GCP platforms. 
 - Experience working with SRE, Observability, and Reliability Engineering practices. 
 - Knowledge of Containerized and Kubernetes-based application performance testing. 
 - Experience supporting Digital Transformation and Cloud Migration programs. 
 - Ability to define enterprise performance governance and standards. 
 - Strong executive communication and stakeholder engagement skills. 

Preferred Experience Profile

- 10-15+ years of Performance Engineering experience. 
 - Proven experience leading enterprise-scale performance programs and teams. 
 - Strong expertise in LoadRunner Enterprise (LRE) and Apache JMeter. 
 - Experience in performance strategy, architecture reviews, and governance frameworks. 
 - Strong experience in UI, API, MQ, and Batch workload performance analysis. 
 - Expertise in capacity assessment, forecasting, scalability planning, and infrastructure optimization.

 - Experience presenting performance findings and recommendations to senior stakeholders.

Expected Deliverables

 - Bottleneck Analysis & Optimization Recommendations

 - Performance Dashboards & Executive Reporting

data.title: Senior SDET ID85590
data.description:
We are looking for a Senior SDET to build and maintain Web and API automation frameworks from scratch and define the automation strategy within the squads. 

The mandatory requirements are 4+ years of SDET experience, strong Java programming skills, REST Assured, and Playwright. 

RECRUITMENT PROCESS

- Application - Share a few details about your experience and background. 
 - Coding Challenge - If applicable, complete it in the coding language you are most comfortable with. 
 - Video Interview - Record a short video introduction in English. 
 - Technical Interview or Hiring Manager Interview - Discuss your experience and fit for the role. 
 - Offer - If it's a match, you'll receive an offer. 

What You'll Gain

- Remote work - Work from where you feel most productive. 
 - Local presence in India - Work in a structured and compliant environment aligned with Indian regulations. 
 - Competitive compensation in INR - Receive compensation in INR, plus support for learning, education, and wellness. 
 - Exciting projects - Work with modern technologies for global clients and fast-growing companies. 

MUST HAVES

- 4+ years of experience as an SDET Engineer 
 - Technical Solvency: Strong programming skills in Java (a "developer-first" approach to QA). 
 - API Automation: Extensive experience using REST Assured for backend testing. 
 - Frontend Automation: Proven hands-on experience with Playwright. 
 - Testing Philosophy: Deep understanding of the "shift-left" approach and integrating automation into CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Ability to work independently and provide technical direction on quality initiatives. 
 - Upper-intermediate English level. 

NICE TO HAVES

- Domain Experience: Previous experience in the Loyalty or Fintech sectors. 
 - Experience with Performance or Load testing (e. g. , JMeter or Gatling). 
 - Familiarity with Cloud infrastructure and SQL for data validation within test scripts. 
 - Experience working with Mocking frameworks. 

What You Will Do

- Framework Design: Build and maintain scalable, robust automation frameworks from the ground up for both Web and API layers. 
 - Strategy & Leadership: Define the automation strategy, ensuring high test coverage and reliable release cycles within your squads. 
 - Backend Validation: Create comprehensive API automation suites to ensure the integrity of microservices. 
 - Frontend Validation: Implement and manage frontend automation scripts to ensure a top-tier user experience. 
 - Coaching: Mentor other engineers on testing best practices and foster a "quality-first" culture.

data.description:
India T&M Special Bonus: 

Req ID: 396166

NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now. 

We are currently seeking a Technology Consultant - Senior Automation & AI Engineer to join our team in Noida, Uttar Pradesh (IN-UP), India (IN). 

Job Title: Technology Consultant - Senior Automation & AI Engineer

Location: Noida/Bengaluru

Overall Experience: 7-12+ Years

Role Summary

We are seeking an experienced Senior Automation & AI Engineer with strong expertise in Intelligent Automation, Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, Process Automation, and Enterprise Solution Development. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, and implementing automation and AI-driven solutions that improve operational efficiency, productivity, and business outcomes. 

The candidate should possess hands-on experience with Python, AI/ML frameworks, Generative AI platforms, workflow automation, APIs, cloud services, and integration technologies. The role will work closely with Business Stakeholders, Product Owners, Architects, Developers, Data Engineers, and Operations teams to identify automation opportunities and deliver scalable AI-powered solutions. 

Day to Day Job Duties

- Design, develop, and deploy AI-powered automation solutions across business and technology functions. 
 - Identify business processes suitable for automation and recommend appropriate AI and automation approaches. 
 - Develop intelligent workflows using AI, Machine Learning, Generative AI, and automation platforms. 
 - Build and integrate AI services utilizing Large Language Models (LLMs), NLP, and AI-driven decision-making capabilities. 
 - Develop Python-based automation frameworks, utilities, APIs, and reusable components. 
 - Integrate enterprise systems using REST APIs, web services, databases, and middleware technologies. 
 - Design and implement AI assistants, copilots, chatbots, and workflow automation solutions. 
 - Work with structured and unstructured data for AI model training, inference, and process automation. 
 - Collaborate with business teams to gather requirements and translate them into technical solutions. 
 - Develop prompt engineering strategies and optimize AI model responses for business use cases. 
 - Monitor AI solution performance, accuracy, reliability, and operational effectiveness. 
 - Implement security, governance, compliance, and responsible AI best practices. 
 - Conduct troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and performance optimization activities. 
 - Support SIT, UAT, deployment, production rollout, and post-production support activities. 
 - Participate in Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, backlog grooming, design reviews, and retrospectives. 
 - Mentor junior engineers and provide technical guidance on AI and automation best practices. 

Basic Qualifications

- 7-12+ years of experience in Software Engineering, Automation Engineering, AI Engineering, or related fields. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with Python development and automation frameworks. 
 - Experience delivering AI, Machine Learning, or Generative AI solutions in enterprise environments. 
 - Experience integrating applications using APIs, databases, and cloud services. 
 - Strong understanding of automation architectures and workflow orchestration concepts. 
 - Experience working with cloud-native applications and modern development practices. 
 - Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills. 
 - Experience working in Agile/Scrum delivery environments. 

Core Technical Skills

- Programming: Python, SQL, JavaScript
 - Generative AI: OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, LLM Integration
 - AI/ML: Machine Learning, NLP, Model Evaluation, AI Workflows
 - Prompt Engineering: Prompt Design, Optimization, AI Response Tuning
 - Automation Development: Workflow Automation, Business Process Automation, Intelligent Automation
 - Frameworks & Libraries: LangChain, Semantic Kernel, Hugging Face, AI SDKs
 - Integration Technologies: REST APIs, Web Services, API Integrations
 - Data Technologies: SQL, Vector Databases, Data Processing, Data Validation
 - Cloud Platforms: Azure, AWS, GCP
 - DevOps & CI/CD: Git, Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins
 - Security & Governance: Responsible AI, Data Privacy, Access Controls
 - Methodologies: Agile, Scrum, SDLC

Nice to Have

- Experience with Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio, Power Platform, or Power Automate. 
 - Experience building AI Agents, AI Assistants, and Autonomous Workflows. 
 - Knowledge of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures. 
 - Experience with Vector Databases such as Pinecone, Chroma, or Azure AI Search. 
 - Experience with document intelligence, OCR, and intelligent document processing solutions. 
 - Exposure to Data Engineering, Analytics, and Data Science projects. 
 - Experience implementing AI governance and compliance frameworks. 
 - Knowledge of MLOps, model deployment, and monitoring frameworks. 
 - Experience working on enterprise digital transformation initiatives. 
 - Strong stakeholder management and consulting skills.
