data.title: Senior Testing Lead - Automation, Performance, Security & Functional QA
data.description:
Position: Senior Testing Lead - Automation, Performance, Security & Functional QA

Location: Hyderabad ( 8 PM to 5 AM IST)

Work Type: Full-Time/Onsite

Experience: 8+ Years

PETADATA is looking for a highly experienced Senior Testing Lead with 8+ years of experience to own the overall quality strategy, build and scale test automation, and lead functional, performance, security, API, and data-validation testing for a data migration platform operating across cloud and on-premise environments. 

Roles & Responsibilities Quality Strategy & Leadership

- Own and define the overall QA and testing strategy across functional, automation, performance, security, and data-integrity testing. 
 - Establish quality gates, release criteria, testing standards, metrics, and reporting. 
 - Identify and prioritize testing efforts based on business and technical risk, especially data-correctness risks. 
 - Build and manage the quality function with minimal supervision. 
 - Mentor developers and QA engineers and promote a quality-first engineering culture. 
 - Partner closely with Engineering, DevOps, Architecture, Security, and Implementation teams. 

Test Automation

- Design and build test automation frameworks from scratch. 
 - Develop automated UI, API, integration, and regression testing solutions. 
 - Use tools such as Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, and REST/API automation frameworks. 
 - Integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Build scalable regression suites that improve release velocity and confidence. 
 - Use programming languages such as Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or Java for automation. 

Functional & Migration Testing

- Own end-to-end functional testing across supported CRM platforms and migration scenarios. 
 - Test standard and custom objects, relationships, transformations, mappings, and edge cases. 
 - Design test scenarios based on real-world customer data migration use cases. 
 - Validate migration correctness from source to destination. 
 - Test multi-tenant behavior, configuration, and tenant data isolation. 
 - Identify defects and ensure issues are properly investigated, resolved, and prevented from recurring. 

Data Validation & Integrity

- Build automated source-to-target data validation frameworks. 
 - Validate: 
 - Record counts 
 - Field-level accuracy 
 - Data mappings 
 - Relationships and associations 
 - Transformations 
 - Deduplication 
 - Overall data integrity 
 - Use SQL and programmatic validation techniques to verify migration results. 
 - Ensure migrated customer data remains complete, accurate, and consistent. Performance Testing

- Design and execute load, stress, scalability, and performance testing. 
 - Test large data volumes and high numbers of concurrent migrations. 
 - Establish performance baselines, benchmarks, and SLAs. 
 - Identify performance bottlenecks and work with Engineering and Architecture teams to resolve them. 
 - Use tools such as k6, JMeter, Gatling, or Locust. 
 - Integrate appropriate performance testing into the CI/CD pipeline. 

Security Testing

- Perform and coordinate security testing across the application and platform. 
 - Test tenant isolation and ensure no cross-tenant data access is possible. 
 - Validate authentication and authorization controls. 
 - Perform input validation and abuse-case testing. 
 - Integrate SAST, DAST, and vulnerability scanning into CI/CD. 
 - Coordinate penetration testing with internal security teams and external security vendors. 
 - Support security and compliance requirements such as SOC 2 and ISO 27001 through appropriate testing evidence. 

Technical Quality & Delivery

- Ensure software is secure, scalable, reliable, and production-ready. 
 - Establish automated quality checks throughout the development lifecycle. 
 - Collaborate with developers to identify defects early. 
 - Review testing approaches and improve overall engineering quality. 
 - Support both cloud and on-premise deployments. 
 - Help establish reliable test environments using cloud, containers, and infrastructure automation. 

Note: Should be highly self-directed, comfortable building the QA function from the ground up, and able to work effectively with distributed engineering teams across required time zones. 

Note: Should be able to work independently and work in USA time zones

Required Skills

- 8+ years of professional QA / Test Engineering experience. 
 - Strong experience leading QA strategy and quality engineering for software products. 
 - Strong hands-on experience building test automation frameworks from scratch. 
 - Proficiency with Playwright, Cypress, and/or Selenium. 
 - Strong API and REST testing experience. 
 - Strong programming experience with Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or Java. 
 - Hands-on experience integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Experience with functional, integration, regression, and end-to-end testing. 
 - Strong experience with performance/load testing using JMeter, k6, Gatling, Locust, or similar tools. 
 - Working knowledge of security testing, including OWASP, authentication, authorization, tenant isolation, SAST, DAST, and vulnerability scanning. 
 - Strong SQL and data-validation experience. 
 - Experience validating source-to-target data integrity across multiple systems. 
 - Strong understanding of data migration, ETL, integration, or data-intensive applications. 
 - Experience testing multi-tenant SaaS applications. 
 - Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP. 
 - Experience with on-premise/customer-deployed software is preferred. 
 - Experience with Salesforce, HubSpot, Zoho, or similar CRM platforms is a plus. 
 - Familiarity with Docker, containers, and IaC is a plus. 
 - Exposure to chaos/resilience testing or contract testing is a plus. 
 - Experience supporting SOC 2 / ISO 27001 or other compliance audits is preferred. 
 - Strong problem-solving, communication, leadership, ownership, and decision-making skills. 
 - Ability to independently establish testing processes, frameworks, quality standards, and release criteria. 

Education

Bachelor s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field is preferred. 

Candidates must attend phone/video calls and in-person interviews as required. After selection, candidates will undergo background checks on Education and Experience. 

Please email your resume to divyam@petadata. ai

After carefully reviewing your experience and skills, one of our HR team members will contact you about the next steps.

data.title: Senior Principal DFT Engineer
data.description:
Description

Invent the future with us. 

Ampere is a semiconductor design company for a new era, leading the future of computing with an innovative approach to CPU design focused on high-performance, energy efficient AIcompute. 

As a pioneer in the new frontier of energy efficient high-performance computing, Ampere is part of the Softbank Group of companies driving sustainable computing for AI, Cloud, and edge applications. 

Join us at Ampere and work alongside a passionate and growing team - we'd love to have you apply!

About the role: 

The ideal candidate will work with multi-functional global teams to design, implement and verify Boundary Scan, ATPG (Stuck-AT/AT-Speed) SCAN, MBIST, IO BIST and JTAG/IJTAG DFT features on our next generation highly complex server class processor products. Will work in close collaboration with test engineering team to deliver ATE patterns and post silicon bring-up and debug. 

What you'll achieve: 

- DFT features like EDT, SSN, shared bus based MBIST insertion, ijtag, simulation and debug on RTL and gates netlist for automotive applications. 
 - Verification of jtag/ijtag, MBIST features in RTL and GLS. 
 - Boundary Scan insertion, simulation and verification. 
 - Hands on knowledge in state-of-the-art EDA tools for DFT, design and verification (Mentor, Cadence, Synopsys)
 - STA DFT Test mode timing constraint development and analysis
 - In-depth knowledge of Verilog HDL and experience with simulators and waveform debugging tools 
 - ATE silicon debug and utilize scripting with perl/Tcl for efficient handling of ATE data

About you: 

- M. Tech in Electronics Engineering or Computer Engineering with 8+ years of semiconductor experience or B. Tech in Electronics Engineering or Computer Engineering with 12+ years of semiconductor experience
 - Expert with methods and techniques to design, implement and verify regular and shared bus based Memory BIST on repairable and non-repairable memories using Electrical fuses. 
 - Expert knowledge and practical work experience partnering with designers to implement highly customized and tools-driven MBIST solutions. 
 - Solid understanding of MBIST algorithms needed for 5nm and lower technology nodes and ability to code new algorithms, operation sets supporting tool driven solutions for functional safety applications. 
 - Experience in implementing EDT, SSN, IST, boundary scan, jtag/ijtag features. 
 - Work independently to generate test plans, run simulations and debug failures on RTL and Gate Level
 - Hands on experience in the usage of industry standard tools, like Siemens Tessent Shell flow, or Synopsys SMS/SHS flow
 - Experience in Multimedia subsystems DFT (Image, display, video etc. )
 - Expert understanding tradeoffs to optimize coverage and test time reduction with the ability to foresee physical implementation and timing challenges during early development. 
 - Experience in working with physical design teams to support STA constraints, reviewing timing reports. 
 - Expert in using silicon debug/diagnosis tools to root cause silicon bringup and production test issue. 
 - Experience in setting up and running Scan DRC flows in RTL. 
 - Experience with industry standard simulation tools, including Verilog, and scripting languages like Perl, Python, Shell or Tcl. 
 - Experience in revision control systems like GIT, perforce etc. . 
 - Needs in depth experience in stuck at, transition delay, path delay, etc. coverage loss analysis and identifying solutions to improve test coverage
 - Experience in leading the effort to derive cell aware fault models and develop necessary flows to generate ATPG and to support silicon debug. 
 - Good knowledge of functional safety, clock domain crossing analysis, logic synthesis and scan insertion

What we'll offer: 

At Ampere we believe in taking care of our employees and providing a competitive total rewards package that includes base pay, cash long-term incentive, and comprehensive benefits. 

Benefits highlights include: 

- Premium medical, dental, vision insurance, parental benefits includingcrechereimbursement, as well as a retirement plan, so thatyou can feel secure in your health, financial futureand child care during work. 
 - Generous paid time off policy so that you can embrace a healthy work-life balance
 - Fully catered lunch in our office along with a variety of healthy snacks, energizing coffee or tea, and refreshing drinks to keep you fueled and focused throughout the day. 

And thereismuch more than compensation and benefits. At Ampere, we foster an inclusive culture that empowers our employees to do more and grow more. We are excited to share more about our career opportunities with you through the interview process. 

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us. 

Ampere is an inclusive and equal opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from all backgrounds. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, citizenship, religion, age, veteran and/or military status, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, physical or mental disability, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law.

data.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
data.description:
Who We Are: 

CrashPlan® provides cyber-ready data resilience and governance in a single platform for organizations whose ideas power their revenue. With its comprehensive backup and recovery capabilities for data stored on servers, on endpoint devices, and in SaaS applications, CrashPlan's solutions are trusted by entrepreneurs, professionals, and businesses of all sizes worldwide. From ransomware recovery and breaches to migrations and legal holds, CrashPlan's suite of products ensures the safety and compliance of your data without disruption. 

What You Will Be Doing

We are seeking an experienced Senior DevOps Engineer to drive the automation, deployment, reliability, and operational excellence of CrashPlan's cloud platform. This role requires deep expertise in cloud infrastructure, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, system reliability, and operational automation. 

The ideal candidate will have extensive experience working in large-scale cloud environments, leading DevOps initiatives, mentoring engineers, and ensuring highly available, secure, and scalable systems in a 24x7 production environment. 

This role will primarily support Microsoft Azure technologies, although strong experience with AWS and other cloud platforms is highly valued. 

Key Responsibilities

Cloud Infrastructure & Operations

- Design, implement, and manage scalable, secure, and highly available cloud infrastructure
 - Automate provisioning, deployment, monitoring, and operational processes across cloud environments
 - Ensure platform reliability, performance, and availability in a 24x7 production environment
 - Lead incident response, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and preventive actions

DevOps & Automation

data.title: Senior SDET – Automation Framework Architect (Playwright, Selenium, API, CI/CD)
data.description:
Senior SDET - Automation Framework Architect (Playwright, Selenium, API, CI/CD)THE ROLEOwn test strategy, quality architecture, and the automated regression infrastructure for Securly Flex - the flex period scheduling and attendance platform that 1, 000+ schools use every school day to place students into intervention, enrichment, and support sessions. 

Flex decides where students are supposed to be. A defect in Autoassign placement, capacity limits, separation rules, roster sync, or attendance recording does not just break a feature - it can put a student in the wrong room, leave a must-attend intervention empty, place students together who are required to be kept apart, or send inaccurate attendance into a district's student information system. The test infrastructure you build is the last line of defense before production. 

This is an engineering leadership role, not a QA role. You will define what "production-ready" means for Flex, build the automation platform that enforces it through CI/CD quality gates, and write production-quality code for that platform yourself. You will also serve as the team's expert on rules-engine correctness and edge-case testing - your understanding of how Flex's rules interact (priorities, capacity limits, restricted sessions, sign-up cutoffs, and check-in controls) directly shapes both the test suite and the implementation team's design decisions. 

Location: Pune, India (Hybrid - 2 days onsite)
Experience: 6-10+ years
Reports to: Director of Quality Engineering

WHAT YOU'LL DO
 - Own the quality bar. Define what "passing" means for Flex: establish written quality criteria covering scheduling correctness, data integrity, access control, and performance that gate production releases. 
 - Test the rules engine. Design and implement automated test suites covering Autoassign placement logic - student choice, teacher priority, must-attend assignments, rostered and restricted sessions, at-risk designations, seat and room capacity, separation (contact control) rules, conflict detection, and the guarantee that manual registrations are never overwritten - plus the edge cases around them: conflicting rules, boundary conditions, concurrent registrations at capacity limits and sign-up cutoffs, API calls that skip UI validation, and permission boundaries. 
 - Gate every release. Build CI/CD quality gates that prevent regressions from reaching production; own the pipeline configuration and ensure the quality bar is enforced, not advisory. 
 - Set performance baselines. Measure and establish written performance baselines for peak-load moments: sign-up windows opening and closing, Autoassign runs before each flex period, and attendance taking across thousands of concurrent users; define the thresholds that constitute a performance regression. 
 - Cover web, mobile, and integrations. Own end-to-end coverage across web, mobile, and integrations: student, teacher, and admin workflows; the student mobile app; email, in-product, and push notifications; roster imports and attendance exports to the SIS; and the shared rostering and single sign-on Flex runs on with Securly Pass. 
 - Build the framework. Architect and build the Flex automation framework: reusable libraries, test data utilities for roster and attendance files, parallel execution, and reporting that the whole team extends - and contribute fixes to product code where it improves testability. 
 - Mentor and scale. Mentor engineers on test architecture as a first-class discipline, and bring AI-assisted tooling into how the team generates scenarios, triages failures, and scales coverage. 
 - Shape architecture. Partner with your technical lead and the Distinguished Engineer on architecture and testability decisions, and influence testing standards across teams beyond your own squad. 
 - Own incidents. Join the on-call rotation and own the full incident lifecycle for quality regressions: detection, diagnosis, resolution, and retrospective. 

SKILLS & REQUIREMENTSMust-Have
 - Test framework architecture - designing automation frameworks from scratch (page object or screenplay patterns, BDD where it fits, parallel execution, reporting) that other engineers extend. You build the platform, not just the scripts. 
 - Test automation (SDET-level) - Playwright, Cypress, or Selenium for UI plus API-level automation (REST, contract testing). Must automate business-rule behavior - placement decisions, capacity and eligibility rules, state transitions - not just UI interaction tests. 
 - CI/CD quality gates - integrating test suites into pipelines; defining and enforcing regression gates for a multi-tenant product used daily by 1, 000+ schools. At this level you own the definition of the bar, not just the tests that check it. 
 - Rules-engine and data-integrity testing - designing deterministic test data and fixtures for scheduling, allocation, or eligibility logic; building data utilities that validate rosters, registrations, and attendance across CSV/XML imports, exports, and concurrent edits. 
 - Strong programming - JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, or Python at production quality (TypeScript strongly preferred). Your test code is held to the same review standard as product code. 
 - Technical communication - ability to produce written quality criteria, test strategy and edge-case documentation, and performance baseline documents that the implementation team, engineering manager, PM, Support, and leadership can act on. 
 - Education & experience - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field, with 6 to 10+ years of hands-on SDET / test automation experience. Strongly Preferred
 - Performance & concurrency testing - k6, JMeter, Gatling, or Locust; modeling burst traffic (thousands of users acting in the same minute) and catching race conditions at capacity limits and sign-up cutoffs. 
 - AI-assisted test engineering - using AI tools to generate test scenarios, triage failures, or scale framework adoption across teams. 
 - Security & access-control testing - role-based permissions (student / teacher / admin), multi-tenant data isolation between districts, and student data privacy expectations. Nice to Have
 - Mobile test automation - Appium, Maestro, Detox, or similar for iOS and Android; push notification and device-fragmentation coverage. 
 - Integration testing - SIS data import/export, rostering sync, single sign-on, and notification delivery (email, in-product, push). 
 - K-12 EdTech domain - understanding of bell schedules, flex and advisory periods, MTSS intervention tiers, and how districts manage SIS data helps design realistic test scenarios. WHO YOU ARE
 - You test the edge cases, not just the happy path. You test the ways the system should fail and doesn't, and you document those cases so the implementation team designs against them. 
 - You have built automation frameworks from the ground up - not just inherited them - and other engineers have built on what you designed. 
 - You treat test architecture as a first-class engineering discipline. A feature without a regression suite is not finished - and you enforce that standard through CI/CD gates, not just code review comments. 
 - You define what "quality" means on a product that decides where students are supposed to be, and produce written criteria that hold the codebase to that standard across every engineer and every release. 
 - You are hands-on at a senior level - you still write the framework code, and you raise the bar for everyone who writes tests after you. Experience shipping product feature code is a bonus, not a requirement. 
 - Your edge-case documentation and performance baselines are used by the implementation team to make better architecture decisions. Your influence extends past your own work. 
 - You own your area end to end with minimal oversight, and you resolve ambiguity in requirements and design tradeoffs instead of waiting for a fully formed spec. ABOUT SECURLYTech Giant Scale. EdTech Innovation. Unmatched Student Impact. 

Securly processes over 1. 1 billion requests per day and 54 TB of data daily, protecting more than 20 million students across 20, 000+ schools globally. Since pioneering the first cloud-based web filter for K-12 in 2013, Securly has built one of the most trusted, high-scale platforms for student safety, wellness, and engagement. 

By turning data into meaningful, actionable intelligence, Securly enables schools to identify risk earlier, reduce harmful incidents, and strengthen student support - driving measurable improvements in student safety and wellbeing at scale. 

We are proud to be consistently recognized as a Top Place to Work, named a Top 40 Most Used EdTech platform, and included on the GSV 150 list as one of the most transformational growth companies in digital learning and workforce skills.

- Lead technical design for ISV engagements by understanding partner architecture and delivery models, then defining MongoDB data models, access patterns, indexing, and integration approaches for products serving different industries

 - Design coexistence architectures and migration paths, including data flows, synchronization, consistency, application refactoring, dual-run strategies, validation, and controlled cutover
 - Lead design reviews, provide technical direction, and review schemas, queries, indexes, MongoDB-related code, and performance against realistic partner workloads

 - Experience with regulated or data-intensive industries and their security, compliance, and data-governance requirements
 - MongoDB certification, MongoDB Atlas experience, or experience with MongoDB's broader product portfolio

What you will learn

- Deepen your expertise across MongoDB Atlas, Enterprise Advanced, application development, data modeling, search, vector workloads, and the broader MongoDB ecosystem
 - Develop advanced experience in multi-database application architecture, database coexistence, migrations, cloud-native deployment, and the operational considerations of partner products
 - Work across ISV products, technology stacks, industries, and deployment environments while building reusable architecture patterns and developing your technical influence and leadership

With offices worldwide and over 67, 000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we're powering the next era of software.

To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we're committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. data.title: DE - AE- AI Architect-SM-GDS04
data.description:
At EY, you'll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we're counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all. 

Senior AI Architect

Experience

- 15+ years overall; 8+ years in Java/J2EE; 2+ years in AI/GenAI delivery

Role focus

- AI-led modernization of enterprise Java platforms and creation of scalable, secure AI solutions

The opportunity

We are seeking a Senior AI Architect who combines deep Java/J2EE architecture expertise with hands-on AI and Generative AI delivery experience. The role will shape AI-first enterprise solutions, embed intelligent capabilities into existing Java estates, and guide clients from experimentation through secure, production-scale adoption. 

The successful candidate will operate at the intersection of enterprise architecture, product engineering, cloud-native modernization and applied AI. They will define target architectures, make technology decisions, lead engineering teams, and advise senior stakeholders on how AI can create measurable business and engineering outcomes. 

Key Responsibilities

AI and solution architecture

- Define end-to-end architectures for AI-enabled enterprise applications, from data ingestion and retrieval through model orchestration, inference, APIs, user experience and production operations. 
 - Architect Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), semantic search, knowledge graph, multimodal and agentic AI solutions aligned to business workflows. 
 - Design multi-agent systems / skills, tool-use patterns and orchestration approaches, including Model Context Protocol (MCP) where relevant. 
 - Establish architecture blueprints, reusable patterns, non-functional requirements and technology guardrails for scalable, secure and responsible AI adoption. 
 - Evaluate models, frameworks, data stores and cloud AI services based on quality, latency, security, portability, operability and cost. 

Java/J2EE engineering and modernization

- Architect enterprise solutions using Java/J2EE, Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Security and RESTful APIs. 
 - Integrate LLM-powered services, copilots and AI agents into existing Java applications and business workflows through well-governed APIs and event-driven patterns. 
 - Decompose monolithic applications into modular services and define modernization pathways that introduce AI without compromising business continuity. 
 - Design microservices, event-driven and distributed architectures using technologies such as Kafka or RabbitMQ, container platforms and API management. 
 - Guide engineering teams on code quality, design patterns, performance, resilience, observability, security and maintainability. 

Cloud, LLMOps and production engineering

- Design and deploy AI solutions on Azure, AWS or GCP using appropriate managed AI services and cloud-native components. 
 - Establish CI/CD, DevSecOps, MLOps and LLMOps practices covering prompt, model and configuration versioning; automated testing; deployment; monitoring; evaluation and rollback. 
 - Define AI quality and evaluation frameworks for relevance, groundedness, safety, latency, reliability and cost. 
 - Implement observability across application, model and agent layers, and drive continuous improvement using telemetry and user feedback. 
 - Lead the transition from proof of concept to hardened, scalable production deployment. 

Governance, security and responsible AI

- Embed privacy, data governance, access control, content safety, model security, auditability and Responsible AI requirements into solution design. 
 - Define controls for prompt injection, sensitive-data exposure, unsafe outputs, model misuse and third-party model risk. 
 - Partner with security, risk, legal and compliance stakeholders to align AI solutions with enterprise policies and applicable regulatory obligations. 
 - Drive cost transparency and FinOps practices for model usage, infrastructure and multi-cloud AI workloads. 

Consulting, leadership and capability building

- Lead discovery workshops, architecture assessments and design sessions with business and technology stakeholders. 
 - Translate business goals into AI roadmaps, solution options, implementation plans and clear value cases. 
 - Act as a trusted advisor to client leadership and communicate architecture choices, trade-offs, risks and outcomes in executive-ready language. 
 - Provide technical leadership for pursuits, proposals, solutioning and estimation, including architecture narratives and delivery models. 
 - Lead and mentor cross-functional teams of architects, Java engineers, AI engineers, data scientists and platform specialists. 
 - Create reusable accelerators, reference implementations, knowledge assets and engineering standards for the EAT competency. 

Qualifications And Experience

- Education: BE/BTech/MCA or equivalent degree in computer science, engineering or a related discipline. 
 - Overall experience: 15+ years in software architecture, engineering and enterprise solution delivery. 
 - Java/J2EE depth: 8+ years designing and delivering enterprise-grade Java/J2EE applications, with strong Spring ecosystem experience. 
 - Architecture depth: 5+ years in microservices, distributed systems, API-led and event-driven architecture. 
 - AI delivery: 2+ years of hands-on architecture and implementation experience in AI/ML/GenAI initiatives, with evidence of production or enterprise-scale delivery. 
 - Leadership: Experience leading multidisciplinary engineering teams and owning architecture and delivery outcomes. 
 - Consulting: Strong client engagement, workshop facilitation, presales, storytelling and senior stakeholder communication skills. 

Mandatory Technical Skills

Capability & Expected proficiency

- Enterprise engineering - Java 8/11/17+, J2EE, Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Security, REST APIs, microservices, design patterns, distributed systems
 - Integration and platforms - API management, Kafka/RabbitMQ, event-driven architecture, Docker, Kubernetes, service observability
 - GenAI and agentic AI - LLMs, prompt engineering, embeddings, RAG, semantic and hybrid search, AI agents, multi-agent orchestration, context engineering
 - AI frameworks - Hands-on exposure to relevant frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, CrewAI or Haystack
 - Data and retrieval - SQL/NoSQL, vector databases such as Azure AI Search, Pinecone, Weaviate, FAISS or equivalent; knowledge graphs such as Neo4j
 - Cloud AI - At least one of Azure OpenAI / Azure AI, AWS Bedrock / SageMaker, or Google Vertex AI, with working awareness of the other major clouds
 - Operationalization - CI/CD, DevSecOps, MLOps/LLMOps, model and prompt lifecycle, evaluation, monitoring, tracing and production support
 - Security and governance - Identity and access, OAuth/OIDC or SAML, data protection, AI safety, Responsible AI, model risk and secure AI service integration

Preferred Skills And Experience

- Python and AI service development using FastAPI or Flask, alongside the primary Java/J2EE engineering background. 
 - Fine-tuning concepts, model optimization, quantization, open-source models and multimodal AI. 
 - GraphRAG, Knowledge-Augmented Generation, enterprise knowledge platforms and advanced retrieval/evaluation patterns. 
 - Workflow orchestration or BPM platforms such as Camunda, Airflow or Prefect. 
 - Infrastructure as Code and platform engineering using tools such as Terraform and GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps. 
 - Experience across regulated industries and familiarity with enterprise privacy, security and compliance expectations. 
 - Relevant cloud, architecture, Java or AI certifications; contributions to internal accelerators, open-source projects or technical communities. 

EY | Building a better working world

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets. 

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate. 

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

 - Demonstrated experience troubleshooting complex infrastructure issues, deployment failures, distributed systems, and performance bottlenecks. 
 - Strong awareness of cloud governance, compliance frameworks (ISO 27001, SOC 2, CIS Benchmarks), cost optimization, and operational best practices. 
 - Strong analytical, problem-solving, documentation, collaboration, and stakeholder communication skills. 

Qualification and Certifications

- B. E. / B. Tech in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline. 
 - One or more relevant certifications strongly preferred - Microsoft Azure (AZ-104 / AZ-305 / AZ-400), CKA / CKAD / CKS, HashiCorp Terraform Associate, AWS Solutions Architect / DevOps Engineer, or recognized security certifications (CCSK, CompTIA Security+). 
 - Strong commitment to continuous learning and staying current with cloud, DevSecOps, Kubernetes, and platform engineering practices. 

Good-to-Have Skills

- Exposure to GCP and broader multi-cloud operating models. 
 - Experience with policy-as-code and guardrails (OPA / Gatekeeper, Kyverno, Azure Policy, Sentinel). 
 - Experience with service mesh, GitOps tooling (ArgoCD, Flux), and progressive delivery patterns. 
 - Experience with monitoring and observability stacks such as Prometheus, Grafana, Azure Monitor, CloudWatch, ELK, Datadog, or Dynatrace. 
 - Experience with Azure Cost Management, AWS Cost Explorer, tagging strategies, and FinOps practices. 
 - Exposure to platform engineering, internal developer platforms (IDP), release management, and SRE practices. 

Working Expectations

- Collaborate effectively with architecture, engineering, security, application, and operations teams across geographies. 
 - Maintain clear, version-controlled documentation for infrastructure design, deployment steps, SOPs, runbooks, and automation scripts. 
 - Demonstrate strong ownership in resolving issues, improving reliability, hardening security posture, and enhancing automation across cloud platforms. 
 - Follow enterprise delivery standards, security controls, change and operational procedures, and quality expectations.

data.title: Senior Performance Test Specialist
data.description:
Esko | Veralto Corporation

Location: Bangalore, India | Hybrid

Reports To: Senior Team Leader

Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced Senior Performance Test Specialist to independently design realistic workload simulations and own performance, scalability, stability, and capacity testing for WebCenter Enterprise, a Java/J2EE web application. The role requires strong hands-on expertise in JMeter and complementary performance-testing tools, test scripting, workload modelling, statistical analysis of results, and evidence-based root-cause analysis across application, JVM, database, search, and infrastructure layers. You will partner with development and infrastructure colleagues to translate findings into prioritized recommendations and verified improvements. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design realistic load, stress, spike, endurance, scalability, and capacity simulations based on user behaviour, transaction flows, concurrency, data volumes, pacing, and production-like workload distributions. 
 - Develop and maintain reusable JMeter frameworks and scripts for web applications and APIs, including correlation, parameterization, dynamic test data, assertions, distributed execution, and automated result collection. Use LoadRunner, Gatling, k6, or other tools where appropriate. 
 - Define workload models, baselines, SLAs, and acceptance criteria with stakeholders. 
 - Analyze response-time distributions and percentiles, throughput, errors, variability, saturation points, and resource trends; distinguish repeatable patterns from noise, outliers, and environmental variation. 
 - Diagnose Java/JVM issues using JFR, heap and thread dumps, GC logs, Eclipse MAT, jcmd, and related tools, including memory leaks, OOM errors, high CPU, thread contention, and connection-pool bottlenecks. 
 - Analyze and tune performance across JBoss/WildFly, Tomcat, SQL Server, REST APIs, and OpenSearch/Elasticsearch in collaboration with development and infrastructure teams. 
 - Correlate transaction timings, logs, traces, diagnostics, database behaviour, and cloud/infrastructure metrics to identify and quantify root causes. 
 - Form and test hypotheses, recommend prioritized improvements, and rerun controlled tests to verify benefits and prevent regressions. 
 - Integrate repeatable performance checks into CI/CD pipelines and maintain controlled environments, baselines, and versioned test assets. 
 - Plan investigations independently, estimate effort, manage dependencies and risks, validate test-environment and load-generator constraints, and document reproducible findings. 
 - Use approved AI tools where appropriate for scripting, diagnostics, and reporting; validate outputs and protect proprietary and customer data. 

Required Skills

- 8+ years of testing experience, including at least 5 years of hands-on performance testing and engineering, with independent delivery of complex investigations. 
 - Advanced JMeter experience designing, scripting, debugging, executing, and maintaining realistic simulations for enterprise web applications and APIs, including distributed load generation, correlation, parameterization, dynamic test data, workload modelling, and automated result collection. 
 - Demonstrated ability to interpret percentiles, distributions, throughput, errors, variability, saturation behaviour, and resource correlations; distinguish meaningful findings from noise; and communicate evidence-based root causes, capacity limits, and recommendations. 
 - Hands-on Java/JVM performance diagnosis using profiling data, JFR, heap and thread dumps, GC logs, Eclipse MAT, jcmd, or comparable tools. 
 - Performance-analysis experience across JBoss/WildFly or Tomcat, SQL Server, and REST APIs. 
 - Experience with monitoring and APM tools such as Grafana, Prometheus, Dynatrace, AppDynamics, or Datadog for cross-layer correlation and root-cause analysis. 
 - Experience with AWS or comparable cloud infrastructure, Linux and Windows, Git, and CI/CD pipelines for repeatable performance-test execution. 
 - Ability to use Python, PowerShell, Bash, Java, or similar languages for test-data generation, execution automation, result processing, statistical analysis, and repeatable reporting. 

Preferred Skills

- Experience with OpenSearch/Elasticsearch performance analysis. 
 - Experience with LoadRunner, Gatling, or k6 in addition to JMeter. 
 - Effective use of AI-assisted tools for performance scripting, analysis, or diagnostics, with critical validation of outputs.

About The Role

The Opportunity

We're seeking a self-driven Senior QA Specialist to strengthen quality engineering for WebCenter Enterprise, a Java/J2EE web application. In this hands-on role, you'll independently own quality for assigned features and product areas, combining thoughtful manual testing with the creation and maintenance of reliable automated test scripts. You'll work with the current SAHI-based automation suite and help evolve the framework, including evaluating Playwright or Selenium where appropriate. 

You'll work closely with software engineers, product managers, and the Senior Team Leader to translate product and technical risks into an effective test approach. You'll execute tests, interpret results, distinguish product defects from automation or environment failures, and communicate evidence-based quality risks. Success means meaningful automation coverage, effective exploratory testing, earlier defect detection, and dependable test results for WebCenter Enterprise. 

What You'll Do

In this role, you will: 

- Independently own the test approach for assigned features and product areas: assess customer and technical risk, clarify acceptance criteria, estimate effort, prioritize coverage, and raise dependencies or quality concerns early. 
 - Design and execute a balanced set of manual and automated tests, including exploratory, functional, regression, integration, API, and end-to-end testing; select the test layer and technique that best addresses the risk. 
 - Create, maintain, and improve reliable SAHI-based automated test scripts using established design patterns and reusable code; contribute to framework design and evaluate Playwright or Selenium where appropriate. 
 - Interpret test and CI/CD results, investigate failures systematically, and distinguish product defects from automation, test-data, or environment issues using logs, browser developer tools, and reproducible evidence. 
 - Reduce flaky tests through root-cause analysis; maintain representative test data, repeatable setup and cleanup, dependable environments, and clear, actionable failure reporting. 
 - Collaborate with developers and product managers throughout the development lifecycle to improve testability, find defects earlier, and align testing with delivery timelines and product quality goals. 
 - Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and improve QA processes, tooling, and feedback loops while protecting the stability of existing coverage. 
 - Produce concise, accurate test cases, automation code, defect reports, traceability, and quality summaries; communicate coverage, evidence, blockers, and release risks clearly to stakeholders. 
 - Share domain knowledge and practical QA and automation techniques with colleagues, and use approved AI tools responsibly where useful while independently validating outputs and protecting proprietary and customer data. 

Minimum Qualifications

What We're Looking For

These are the must-have requirements for the role: 

- 8+ years of professional experience in software quality assurance, test automation, software development, or a combination thereof, including ownership of quality for complex web-product features. 
 - Strong hands-on ability in automated and manual testing, including writing, debugging, reviewing, and maintaining reusable automation code with established design patterns; practical programming or scripting skills in JavaScript, Java, or a comparable language; proficiency with Git, code review, and maintainable coding practices; and sound judgment in applying exploratory, functional, regression, and automated testing. 
 - Hands-on experience creating and maintaining web test automation with SAHI, Selenium, Playwright, or a comparable framework, together with the ability to become productive in SAHI. SAHI is the current automation tool; prior expertise in SAHI is not required. 
 - Hands-on experience designing, organizing, and implementing automated unit, integration, and API tests with Java frameworks such as TestNG, JUnit, or equivalent solutions, including parameterized or data-driven testing; API coverage should include HTTP/REST, authentication, response and schema validation, and negative scenarios using RestAssured or comparable code-based tools, with Postman or similar tools for exploratory testing. 
 - Experience integrating, maintaining, and diagnosing automated test execution in CI/CD pipelines using tools such as Jenkins, GitLab CI, or Azure DevOps, including analysis of failures and reliable reporting of results. 
 - Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, including interpreting test results and investigating failures with logs, browser developer tools, and reproducible evidence. 
 - Experience testing web and client/server products, preferably Java/J2EE enterprise applications, with a good understanding of browser behavior, sessions, authentication, authorization, and integrations. 
 - Strong risk-based test-design skills, including equivalence partitioning, boundary-value analysis, and state-transition testing. 
 - Ability to design representative test data, maintain repeatable setup and cleanup, and validate results and data integrity, including practical use of basic SQL queries where appropriate. 
 - Experience working in Agile or Scrum teams and contributing quality engineering and automation activities throughout iterative, sprint-based delivery. 
 - Clear, proactive communication and a collaborative working style, with the ability to explain quality risks, ask relevant questions, build consensus, and support less-experienced colleagues. 

Preferred Qualifications

The following qualifications will help distinguish stronger candidates; relevant experience in one or more of these areas is valued: 

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical field. 
 - Relevant professional testing certification, such as ISTQB Certified Tester Foundation Level (CTFL); advanced or specialist credentials-particularly ISTQB Advanced Level Test Automation Engineering (CTAL-TAE), Technical Test Analyst (CTAL-TTA), Quality in DevOps (CT-QDO), or an equivalent recognized certification are a differentiator for this senior automation-focused role. 
 - Practical experience using approved AI tools to accelerate test design, automation-code development, test-data generation, or failure analysis, with independent review and validation of outputs and appropriate protection of proprietary and customer data. 
 - Direct experience maintaining or evolving SAHI-based automation suites. 
 - Familiarity with Behavior-Driven Development (BDD) practices and experience using Cucumber to translate expected user behaviors and acceptance criteria into clear, executable test scenarios and maintainable automated test scripts. 
 - Experience with performance testing and tools such as JMeter. 
 - Experience testing AI-assisted features with non-deterministic outputs, including correctness, consistency, reliability, and safe fallback behavior. 
 - Working knowledge of Jira and Atlassian Wiki, or comparable platforms, for defect management, test documentation, and collaboration.

Job Description Summary

As a Senior Quality Assurance Engineer, you will play a critical role in ensuring the quality, reliability, performance, and scalability of GE Vernova Grid Software solutions that support transmission, distribution, and energy management operations across utilities worldwide. Leveraging deep expertise in power systems, utility operations, EMS/SCADA applications, and Grid Engineering products, you will lead quality engineering initiatives across complex enterprise software platforms. 

The ideal candidate combines strong software testing and quality engineering capabilities with a Master's degree in Electrical Engineering (Power Systems preferred) and hands-on experience validating mission-critical grid applications. You will work closely with product management, development teams, system architects, and domain experts to develop comprehensive test strategies, drive automation adoption, identify product risks early, and ensure high-quality releases for customers operating critical grid infrastructure. 

This role requires strong domain expertise in power systems and utility operations, exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills, and a passion for delivering world-class Grid Software products that are transforming the future of energy. 

Responsibilities

Job Description

- Lead quality assurance activities across Grid Software products, ensuring functional, integration, system, performance, and regression testing coverage. 
 - Develop and execute comprehensive test strategies, test plans, and validation approaches for complex EMS, SCADA, DMS, ADMS, GridOS, and power system applications. 
 - Collaborate with product managers, developers, solution architects, and power system engineers to understand business requirements and grid operational workflows. 
 - Apply strong power system domain expertise to validate network modeling, topology processing, state estimation, contingency analysis, outage management, interoperability, and other grid applications. 
 - Drive automation initiatives using modern test frameworks and CI/CD pipelines to improve test coverage, release quality, and execution efficiency. 
 - Design and implement automated functional, API, integration, and end-to-end test suites for enterprise-grade Grid Software products. 
 - Analyze customer-reported issues, reproduce field defects, perform root-cause analysis, and partner with engineering teams to drive resolution. 
 - Validate software performance, scalability, cybersecurity, reliability, and resiliency requirements for utility-grade deployments. 
 - Participate in architecture reviews, requirement reviews, and design discussions to ensure quality is built into products from inception. 
 - Champion quality engineering best practices, shift-left testing methodologies, risk-based testing, and continuous improvement initiatives. 
 - Mentor junior QA engineers and contribute to establishing testing standards, frameworks, and quality processes across teams. 
 - Support customer deployments, interoperability testing, factory acceptance testing (FAT), and system validation activities for utility customers globally. 

Desired Characteristics

- Strong understanding of Power Systems Engineering, utility operations, transmission systems, distribution systems, and control center applications. 
 - Proven experience working with Grid Engineering products, including EMS, DMS, ADMS, SCADA, GridOS, Network Applications, Market Systems, or related utility software platforms. 
 - Deep knowledge of software testing methodologies, validation processes, defect lifecycle management, and quality assurance best practices. 
 - Experience developing automation frameworks and automated test suites using modern tools and programming languages. 
 - Understanding of utility communication standards and interoperability concepts. 
 - Strong analytical thinking and ability to evaluate complex power system behaviors and operational scenarios. 
 - Experience with enterprise software products deployed in mission-critical environments. 
 - Ability to collaborate effectively with developers, product managers, customers, and power system subject matter experts. 
 - Excellent root-cause analysis, troubleshooting, debugging, and problem-solving skills. 
 - Strong communication, stakeholder management, and leadership capabilities. 

Qualifications

- Master's Degree in Electrical Engineering (Power Systems preferred). 
 - Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related STEM discipline. 
 - 5-10+ years of experience in Quality Assurance, Software Testing, Quality Engineering, or related product engineering roles. 
 - Strong experience validating enterprise software products used in utility, energy, transmission, distribution, or industrial control environments. 
 - Demonstrated experience working with power system applications, grid operations, EMS, SCADA, DMS, ADMS, GridOS, or similar utility software platforms. 
 - Experience with test automation tools, scripting, and quality engineering methodologies. 

Preferred Experience

- Experience supporting development and testing of Grid Engineering and Energy Management System (EMS) applications. 
 - Knowledge of transmission network operations, distribution management systems, contingency analysis, state estimation, load flow, network modeling, and grid reliability functions. 
 - Experience with utility deployment validation, customer acceptance testing, and interoperability testing. 
 - Familiarity with Agile development methodologies, CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, and test automation frameworks. 
 - Experience with databases, APIs, messaging systems, and enterprise software architectures. 
 - Working knowledge of cloud technologies, microservices, containerized applications, and modern software delivery practices. 
 - Exposure to cybersecurity testing and validation practices for critical infrastructure applications. 
 - Ability to lead cross-functional quality initiatives and influence product quality across distributed global teams.

The Challenge

As an Engineering Manager, you will direct technical implementation, support people development, and advance strategic engineering initiatives. Key areas of responsibility include:

data.title: Lead Cloud Developer
data.description:
At Basware, we deliver mission-critical cloud solutions that empower organizations to unlock their full potential. Our products are designed to bring clear and compelling value to our customers, and we're looking for a talented and forward-thinking developer who can help us shape the future of our technology. 

We are seeking a Lead Cloud Developer - Country Compliance, an experienced software engineer, who will contribute to the solutions that keep our customers compliant with country e-invoicing and tax reporting mandates. Your role will be focused on building the country-specific capabilities that connect invoices, credit notes and purchase orders to government tax portals and clearance networks, using the latest technologies and AI-assisted ways of working to deliver large-scale, high-performance, enterprise-grade solutions. You will also provide technical leadership and mentoring to the team, helping to shape engineering practices and raise the bar on code quality and architectural decisions. 

This is a hands-on technology role, ideal for candidates seeking opportunities to both build on their existing experience and research new knowledge areas, with a significant share of design and exploratory elements to their day-to-day tasks. Every country mandate brings a different set of rules, formats and deadlines, so no two modules look the same. 

You will be working alongside engineers and developers from the Invoice Lifecycle Management (ILM) Teams, assisted by our AI Engineering team, and in integration with other Basware solutions. The product you will be contributing to is targeted at large, well-known enterprises. 

Key Responsibilities

- Own system design and software architecture decisions for country compliance modules, from new mandate onboarding through to production. 
 - Drive non-functional requirements: throughput and latency under load, secure handling of certificates, tokens and secrets, fault tolerance and graceful degradation against unreliable third-party government APIs. 
 - Lead code and design reviews and set the architectural conventions the team builds against. 
 - Mentor senior and mid-level engineers on design thinking, technical depth and code quality. 
 - Champion CI/CD, TDD and AI-assisted engineering practices across the team. 
 - Participate in incident response and drive root cause fixes for production issues. 

, 

- 10+ years of commercial software engineering experience, including prior technical leadership of a team or major module. 
 - Strong Java (17+) and Spring Boot expertise, with deep understanding of REST API design and implementation. 
 - Proven hands-on experience in the application of AI-assisted coding techniques, including structuring context and prompts, and critically reviewing AI-generated code for correctness and security. 
 - Experience with XML and XSD processing at scale, including secure parsing and schema validation frameworks. 
 - Hands-on experience with MongoDB (document design, indexing, performance tuning) or comparable NoSQL databases. 
 - Solid grasp of authentication and authorization patterns: OAuth2, JWT, API security, secrets management. 
 - Practical AWS cloud architecture experience across compute, storage, networking, IAM and observability, and designing for cloud-native deployment. 
 - Demonstrated system design and software architecture skills, able to design for scale, extensibility, and multi-tenant and multi-region variation. 
 - Strong CI/CD pipeline experience and Test-Driven Development as a working practice. 
 - Proven ability to mentor engineers on both technical depth and non-functional thinking across performance, security and resilience. 
 - Excellent communication skills, able to explain architectural trade-offs to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Collaborative mindset, strong sense of ownership, comfortable adapting to shifting regulatory and business requirements. 

Considered as a strong plus

- Familiarity with e-invoicing standards and networks such as Peppol and EN 16931, or with national clearance models such as Italy's SDI, Poland's KSeF or the French PPF and PDP model. 
 - Experience with digital signatures and certificates (X. 509, XAdES) or secure token and credential handling. 
 - Microservices architecture design experience: service decomposition, inter-service contracts, resilience patterns such as circuit breakers and bulkheads. 
 - Experience with spec-driven AI development, where a written specification drives implementation and tests, and with AI agents and agent skills. 
 - Working knowledge of JavaScript for adjacent integration touchpoints. 
 - We highly value candidates who demonstrate curiosity, a proactive mindset and a willingness to explore and incorporate AI-driven technologies into their work. We encourage growth in this area and provide opportunities for experimentation and learning. 

Why Basware?

We're a purpose-driven company with a global footprint and a collaborative culture. At Basware, you'll work with passionate professionals, cutting-edge technology, and a shared commitment to innovation and excellence. 

Ready to make an impact?

If you're excited by the challenge, apply now and help shape the future of Basware. 

Please submit your resume and cover letter by clicking the 'I'm interested' link. 

Our recruitment process will include pre-employment actions such as enhanced background screening and reference check. 

Basware. Now it all just happens.

data.description:
FactSet creates flexible, open data and software solutions for over 200, 000 investment professionals worldwide, providing instant access to financial data and analytics that investors use to make crucial decisions. 

At FactSet, our values are the foundation of everything we do. They express how we act and operate, serve as a compass in our decision-making, and play a big role in how we treat each other, our clients, and our communities. We believe that the best ideas can come from anyone, anywhere, at any time, and that curiosity is the key to anticipating our clients' needs and exceeding their expectations.

FactSet's product suite of smart analytics and unique data empower the world's leading financial service professionals to make more informed decisions every day. At our heart is an inclusive community unified by the spirit of going above and beyond. Our philosophy is to embrace diversity, and that our best ideas can come from anyone, anywhere, at any time. We continuously look ahead to advance the future and technology of our industry, by rolling up our sleeves to solve tough problems together, and by learning from our successes, as well as our failures. 

In this role, you will work with team of engineers who are responsible for the design, development and maintenance of our API Gateway. This team powers centralized routing, service discovery, rate limiting, and policy enforcement for MCP traffic and other internal APIs. You will design, implement, and operate dual‐authentication and token‐exchange capabilities, evolve gateway policies, drive multi‐region reliability, and automate delivery on AWS. This role spans design through operations with a strong focus on performance, security, and developer experience. 

What We're Looking For

- Bachelor's degree, or higher, in Computer Science or a related technical field 
 - 7+ years' experience of building backend/platform systems, with substantial experience in traffic management or API platforms. 
 - Strong GO development and Lua experience on NGINXX/OpenResty
 - Deep hands‐on experience with Docker/Kubernetes and AWS (EKS, EC2, ALB/NLB, Route 53, VPC/private networking; CloudWatch/CloudTrail). 
 - Infrastructure‐as‐code and CI/CD pipelines
 - Strong Linux fundamentals and scripting (Bash/Python); excellent debugging and performance tuning skills. 
 - Clear communication, ownership mindset, and a security‐first approach. 
 - Address production issues in a timely manner 
 -

What You'll Do

- Design, implement, and operate gateway capabilities: routing, service discovery, rate limiting/quotas, and policy enforcement. 
 - Build gateway extensions and filters in Lua (NGINX/OpenResty) and GO for authN/Z, token exchange, request shaping, and telemetry. 
 - Implement dual‐auth support and seamless token exchange (OAuth2/OIDC, RFC 8693), including validation, caching, replay protection, and robust trust store management. 
 - Establish mTLS to backends and standardize API registration and onboarding patterns; integrate with discovery (Kubernetes/EKS, Consul). 
 - Automate deployments with IaC and CI/CD (Terraform/CloudFormation, Helm, GitHub Actions/Jenkins); use blue/green and canary releases with signed artifacts. 
 - Plan and run hybrid/multi‐region topologies on AWS (active‐active or active‐standby), including global routing (Route 53/GLB), health checks, failover, and DR/chaos drills. 
 - Lead patching and upgrades with minimal downtime; define autoscaling policies, capacity plans, and incident response playbooks. 
 - Create onboarding guides, example configurations, and self‐service workflows to accelerate adoption by MCP servers/agents and other internal services. 
 - Participate in code-reviews and proactively take ownership of PR's and make sure to catch all security vulnerabilities
 - Proper collaboration and interaction with multiple teams across FactSet and respond to stakeholder queries in a timely manner

Nice To Have

- Kong Gateway experience (configuration, plugin development) - a strong plus. 
 - Envoy or NGINX expertise 
 - Multi‐region traffic management (Global Accelerator/CloudFront), resilience patterns, and DR playbooks. 
 - Data stores for counters and policies (Redis/KeyDB, DynamoDB including Global Tables). 
 - Observability stacks (OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, Loki/ELK) and SLO/error budget practices.

FactSet (NYSE: FDS | NASDAQ: FDS) helps the financial community to see more, think bigger, and work better. Our digital platform and enterprise solutions deliver financial data, analytics, and open technology to more than 8, 200 global clients, including over 200, 000 individual users. Clients across the buy-side and sell-side, as well as wealth managers, private equity firms, and corporations, achieve more every day with our comprehensive and connected content, flexible next-generation workflow solutions, and client-centric specialized support. As a member of the S&P 500, we are committed to sustainable growth and have been recognized among the Best Places to Work in 2023 by Glassdoor as a Glassdoor Employees' Choice Award winner. Learn more at www. factset. com and follow us on X and LinkedIn. 

At FactSet, we celebrate difference of thought, experience, and perspective. Qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to characteristics protected by law.

data.title: Senior Staff Emulation Engineer
data.description:
We Are

Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow. 

You Are

You have spent years in the trenches of ASIC verification, and somewhere along the way you realized that emulation is not just another tool in the flow, it is the thing that makes or breaks your ability to ship complex IP on time. You know PCIe or DDR inside and out, not just the spec but the weird corner cases, the errata that nobody talks about, and the places where emulation models fall short of what the design team actually needs. 

You have worked on Zebu or similar platforms long enough to know what good emulation IP looks like and what happens when it is not quite right. You have closed that gap before, probably more than once, and you know how to do it without creating chaos for the teams depending on your work. You are comfortable sitting with a design team in Bangalore, a verification lead in California, and an IP product manager in Europe, and walking out with a plan that everyone believes in. 

You do not wait for perfect alignment. You ask the right questions, you push back when something does not make sense, and you move. At Synopsys, you will work on IP that powers the next generation of silicon, and the emulation strategies you define will directly affect how fast we get there. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Bridge the gap between Emulation IP capabilities and Design IP verification needs across both Controller and PHY domains for high speed interfaces like PCIe and DDR
 - Define technical requirements for Emulation IP, working directly with IP development and verification teams to ensure correct implementation and deployment on Zebu platforms
 - Track and report key metrics on Emulation IP quality, performance, and coverage, driving continuous improvement across verification workflows
 - Stay ahead of evolving PCIe and DDR standards, interpret specification updates, ECNs, and errata, and translate those into actionable changes for both Emulation and Design IP teams
 - Review and validate test plans for Emulation IP and Design IP, ensuring completeness, traceability, and alignment with product quality goals
 - Collaborate cross-functionally with verification, design, product, and platform teams to optimize emulation methodologies and standardize best practices
 - Mentor engineers on emulation strategies, verification techniques, and IP development workflows

The Impact You Will Have

- Accelerate time to market for high performance IP by defining emulation strategies that catch issues earlier and reduce silicon respins
 - Elevate product quality across Synopsys IP portfolios by ensuring Emulation IP meets the real needs of design and verification teams
 - Drive adoption of best in class emulation and verification methodologies that become standard practice across the organization
 - Influence the next generation of emulation solutions and workflows, positioning Synopsys as a leader in pre-silicon validation
 - Improve cross-functional collaboration and alignment between geographically distributed teams, reducing friction and rework
 - Standardize verification workflows and metrics, making it easier for teams to track progress, identify gaps, and deliver with confidence
 - Shape how Synopsys develops and deploys Emulation IP for cutting edge digital designs and system architectures

What You'll Need

- 8+ years of hands-on experience in emulation, pre-silicon verification, or IP product development
 - Expert-level knowledge of PCIe or DDR interfaces, including protocol details, verification strategies, and real-world implementation challenges
 - Extensive experience with Zebu or similar emulation platforms, specifically for IP verification and system-level validation
 - Proven track record leading IP product development initiatives with a strong focus on emulation and verification
 - Demonstrated ability to work cross-functionally in matrixed, global teams and drive consensus across diverse stakeholders
 - Strong communication skills with the ability to influence technical direction and inspire change across engineering teams
 - Comfort working in dynamic, ambiguous environments where requirements evolve and priorities shift

Who You Are

- You can walk into a room where the Emulation IP does not quite match what the design team needs and walk out with a concrete plan to close the gap without derailing either team's schedule
 - You do not need someone to tell you what the next version of the PCIe or DDR spec means for your work, you read it, figure out the implications, and start the conversation with your team
 - You are the person people come to when emulation results do not make sense, and you know how to debug across the boundary between emulation models, RTL, and test environments
 - You push back when a test plan looks complete on paper but is missing coverage for the cases that actually matter in production
 - You are comfortable mentoring engineers who are newer to emulation or IP verification, and you do it in a way that builds their confidence and capability
 - You stay organized across multiple workstreams, stakeholders, and time zones without losing track of what matters most

The Team You'll Be Part Of

Your recruiter will share more about the team structure and mission during the interview process. 

Rewards and Benefits

We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

 - Knowledge of Physical Verification flows, including DRC, LVS, and sign-off checks, and collaboration with PD and layout teams. 
 - Understanding of RTL Design concepts, interfaces, and constraints to support effective implementation and debug.

As a Manager of Software Engineering at JPMorgan Chase within the Commercial & Investment Bank, Payments Technology, you lead multiple teams and manage day-to-day implementation activities by identifying and escalating issues and ensuring your team's work adheres to compliance standards, business requirements, and tactical best practices.

 - Leverage AI to multi fold team productivity

data.title: Staff Software Engineer – Kubernetes & Golang
data.description:
Scope

Design, build, and evolve cloud-native platform capabilities leveraging Kubernetes, Golang, and Azure. Develop platform automation and reusable services while driving scalability, reliability, security, and operational excellence across engineering teams. 

About The Role

We are looking for an experienced Staff Software Engineer - Platform Engineering to design, build, and evolve the next generation of cloud-native platform capabilities. This role requires deep technical expertise in Kubernetes, Networking, and Go (Golang) to develop scalable, secure, and high-performance platform solutions that empower engineering teams. 

As a Staff Engineer, you will provide technical leadership across multiple initiatives, drive architecture and design decisions, mentor engineers, and be accountable for the successful delivery of critical platform engineering projects. You will work closely with Product Management, Engineering, Infrastructure, Security, and SRE teams to build reusable frameworks, automation, and platform services that improve developer productivity, reliability, and operational excellence. 

Required Skills & Qualifications

- Experience: 10+ years of software engineering experience with a strong focus on cloud-native platform engineering. 
 - Kubernetes (Expert): Deep expertise in Kubernetes architecture, controllers, CRDs, Operators, networking, storage, security, RBAC, Helm, and production-scale cluster operations. 
 - Networking (Expert): Strong understanding of TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, TLS, Load Balancing, Ingress, CNI, Network Policies, routing, firewalls, and troubleshooting distributed networking. 
 - Go (Golang): Extensive experience building scalable backend services, Kubernetes Operators, controllers, and automation frameworks. 
 - Azure & AKS: Extensive experience designing, deploying, and operating production workloads on Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), including managing and operating hundreds of AKS clusters at scale. 
 - Kubernetes Operators: Proven experience developing and maintaining Kubernetes Operators using Operator SDK or Kubebuilder. 
 - CI/CD & GitOps: Strong experience with GitHub workflows, CI/CD pipeline design and implementation, and GitOps practices using Argo CD. 
 - Platform Engineering: Experience designing and building scalable, high-performance platform frameworks, internal developer platforms, and reusable engineering services. 
 - Technical Leadership: Demonstrated ownership of architecture and technical decisions, accountability for team deliverables, and experience conducting code reviews and mentoring engineers. 

Good To Have

- Experience with Cloudflare CDN, edge networking, WAF, DNS, and traffic management. 
 - Experience with MongoDB, including high availability, replication, sharding, and performance tuning. 
 - Knowledge of cloud security best practices, including IAM, Managed Identities, Azure Key Vault/Secrets Management, RBAC, network security, and Zero Trust principles. 
 - Hands-on experience with GitOps workflows and deployment automation. 
 - Experience implementing observability solutions using Elastic Stack, Logstash, OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, or similar monitoring and logging platforms. 
 - Familiarity with service mesh technologies such as Istio. 
 - Exposure to multi-cluster Kubernetes, disaster recovery, backup and restore strategies, and platform resilience. 
 - Experience with performance optimization, capacity planning, scalability, and cost optimization for cloud-native platforms. 
 - Knowledge of container security, image scanning, vulnerability management, policy enforcement, and software supply chain security. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead the architecture, design, and development of scalable platform engineering solutions. 
 - Design and build reusable platform frameworks, services, and automation to improve developer experience and operational efficiency. 
 - Develop cloud-native applications, Kubernetes Operators, controllers, and platform services using Go (Golang). 
 - Design, develop, and maintain Kubernetes Operators using Operator SDK or Kubebuilder. 
 - Drive technical decisions and establish engineering best practices across platform teams. 
 - Own the technical roadmap for platform initiatives and be accountable for architecture, code quality, and successful delivery. 
 - Collaborate with Engineering, Product Management, Infrastructure, Security, and SRE teams to deliver secure, scalable, and resilient platform capabilities. 
 - Perform architecture reviews, design reviews, and code reviews to maintain high engineering standards. 
 - Mentor and coach junior engineers through technical guidance, design discussions, and code reviews. 
 - Troubleshoot complex production issues involving Kubernetes, networking, distributed systems, and cloud infrastructure. 
 - Continuously improve platform scalability, performance, reliability, security, and observability through automation and engineering excellence. 

What We're Looking For

- A platform-first mindset with a passion for building scalable, reliable, secure, and automated engineering platforms that enhance developer productivity. 
 - Self-driven, proactive, and comfortable leading technical initiatives in a fast-paced, collaborative engineering environment. 
 - Strong ownership mindset with accountability for technical decisions, architecture, and delivery outcomes. 
 - Ability to solve complex engineering challenges with pragmatic, scalable, and maintainable solutions. 
 - Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and cross-functional collaboration skills. 
 - Passion for mentoring engineers, driving engineering excellence, and raising the technical bar across the organization. 

Our Values

If you want to know the heart of a company, take a look at their values. Ours unite us. They are what drive our success - and the success of our customers. Does your heart beat like ours? Find out here: Core Values

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status.
