data.title: Staff Software Engineer - Backend
data.description:
DeepIntent is the leading healthcare marketing platform, purpose-built to help marketers plan, activate, and optimize data-driven campaigns with speed and precision. Trusted by the world's top healthcare brands and their agencies, DeepIntent uniquely unites media, identity, and real-world clinical data to power privacy-safe, omnichannel marketing across every screen. Backed by patented technology and proven outcomes, DeepIntent's platform delivers measurable audience quality and script lift at scale. Learn more at www. deepintent. com. 

What You'll Do

- Provide technical leadership across multiple teams and backend systems, owning the architecture of high-throughput, low-latency services built primarily on Java and Spring Boot. 
 - Drive architecture decisions for distributed systems, including service boundaries, data modelling, storage choices, and scalability, so the platform stays future-proof as volume and complexity grow. 
 - Tackle the most complex architectural challenges in your area, and partner with Tech Leads and Engineering Managers to shape the technical vision and roadmap. 
 - Lead critical cross-team technical initiatives end to end, from design through rollout, aligning engineering work with product and business goals. 
 - Act as the technical lead for your product line, breaking down complex problems into well-defined work, providing clear technical guidance, and unblocking engineers. 
 - Mentor senior and junior engineers through design reviews, code reviews, and pair programming, raising the technical bar and fostering a culture of ownership and continuous learning. 
 - Design and build systems that make effective use of Redis across a range of patterns, such as caching, real-time counters, rate limiting, distributed locking, pub/sub, and streams, alongside other datastores. 
 - Build and evolve event-driven and asynchronous systems using messaging and streaming platforms such as Kafka. 
 - Lead the integration of AI into our products and engineering workflows, including LLM-powered features, agentic workflows, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and tool integrations via the Model Context Protocol (MCP). 
 - Champion AI-assisted software development across the team, setting standards for how engineers use coding agents and AI tools responsibly to improve speed and quality. 
 - Establish and enforce engineering best practices around API design, code quality, testing, security, and data privacy, with healthcare compliance expectations in mind. 
 - Design observability strategies (metrics, logging, tracing, alerting) using tools such as Grafana and Prometheus to proactively identify bottlenecks and ensure production stability. 
 - Lead deep-dive investigations into complex production issues and drive root-cause fixes and blameless postmortems. 
 - Drive knowledge sharing across engineering through technical documentation, design forums, and internal talks. 

Who You Are

- 8+ years of backend engineering experience, with a track record of designing and delivering large-scale distributed systems in production. 
 - Deep expertise in Java (17+) and the Spring ecosystem (Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, Spring Data), including a solid understanding of JVM internals, concurrency, and performance tuning. 
 - Strong working knowledge of Redis, including its data structures, persistence and clustering models, and how to apply it to problems beyond caching, with a clear understanding of its trade-offs at scale. 
 - Solid experience with relational and NoSQL databases (e. g. , MySQL, PostgreSQL, Aerospike, Cassandra or similar), including query optimisation and schema design. 
 - Experience with messaging and streaming systems such as Kafka, and with designing resilient, idempotent, event-driven architectures. 
 - Strong grounding in microservices, REST/gRPC API design, and distributed systems fundamentals (consistency, partitioning, fault tolerance). 
 - Experience with cloud platforms (GCP or AWS), containerisation (Docker, Kubernetes), and owning CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Working knowledge of current AI trends and their practical engineering application: LLM APIs, prompt and context engineering, agentic systems, RAG and vector databases, MCP, and evaluation of AI system quality and reliability. 
 - Hands-on experience using AI coding tools (such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or Cursor) in day-to-day development, with a clear view of where they help and where human judgment is essential. 
 - Proven ability to lead technical work across multiple teams, influence architectural decisions without direct authority, and mentor senior engineers. 
 - Clear communicator who can explain complex technical trade-offs to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Experience in ad tech (programmatic advertising, RTB, DSP/SSP systems) or healthcare data platforms is a plus.

data.title: Senior Software Engineer - Trusted Data Platform
data.description:
Overview

Working at Atlassian

Atlassians can choose where they work - whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity. Interviews and onboarding are conducted virtually, a part of being a distributed-first company. 

This role can be based remotely or from an Atlassian office where eligible. Whatever your preference - working from home, an office, or in between - you can choose the place that's best for your work and your lifestyle. We call this TEAM anywhere . 

Responsibilities

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will play a critical role in designing, building, and optimizing high-performance, scalable, and resilient backend storage solutions on AWS cloud infrastructure. You will be responsible for developing distributed storage systems, APIs, and backend services that power mission-critical applications, ensuring low-latency, high-throughput, and fault-tolerant data storage. Your work will directly impact system reliability, scalability, and cost efficiency. 

You will collaborate closely with principal engineers, architects, SREs, and product teams to define technical roadmaps, improve storage efficiency, and optimize access patterns. You will drive performance tuning, data modeling, caching strategies, and cost optimization across AWS storage services like S3, DynamoDB, EBS, EFS, FSx, and Glacier. Additionally, you will contribute to infrastructure automation, security best practices, and monitoring strategies using tools like Terraform, CloudWatch, Prometheus, and OpenTelemetry. 

In this role, you will also be responsible for troubleshooting and resolving production incidents related to data integrity, latency spikes, and storage failures, ensuring high availability and disaster recovery preparedness. You will mentor junior engineers, participate in design reviews and architectural discussions, and advocate for engineering best practices such as CI/CD automation, infrastructure as code, and observability-driven development. Your contributions will directly impact the organization's ability to scale its storage infrastructure efficiently while maintaining security, reliability, and compliance with industry standards. 

Qualifications

Strong Backend Development Skills

- 8+ years of experience in backend software development
 - Proficiency in Kotlin or Java for backend development
 - Experience building high-performance, scalable microservices and APIs
 - Strong understanding of RESTful APIs, gRPC, and event-driven architectures

Experience With AWS Storage Technologies

- Hands-on experience with AWS S3, DynamoDB, EBS, EFS, FSx, and Glacier
 - Knowledge of AWS IAM, KMS, and data access policies for secure storage solutions
 - Understanding of AWS networking (VPC, PrivateLink, Route 53) for optimizing storage performance

Distributed Systems & Scalability

- Solid understanding of distributed databases, storage consistency models, and caching mechanisms
 - Experience with sharding, partitioning, and load balancing to scale storage-heavy applications
 - Familiarity with event-driven architectures using AWS SNS, SQS, Kinesis, or Kafka

Performance Optimization & Cost Efficiency

- Ability to profile and optimize storage performance, indexing strategies, and data retrieval latencies
 - Experience with cost-efficient storage solutions by implementing tiering, lifecycle policies, and data deduplication
 - Knowledge of benchmarking and monitoring tools (CloudWatch, OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana)

Security & Reliability

- Experience implementing data encryption at rest and in transit using AWS KMS or TLS
 - Understanding of access control mechanisms (IAM roles, STS, fine-grained permissions)
 - Experience ensuring high availability and disaster recovery using AWS backup strategies and multi-region replication

Hands-On with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) & DevOps

- Experience using Terraform, AWS CloudFormation, or CDK to manage infrastructure
 - Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines for backend deployments using GitHub Actions, CodePipeline, or Jenkins
 - Experience with containerized deployments using Docker, Kubernetes (EKS), and serverless solutions (Lambda, Fargate)

Troubleshooting & Production Support

- Strong debugging skills for investigating storage failures, high-latency issues, and API bottlenecks
 - Experience using observability and tracing tools to monitor storage workloads
 - Ability to triage and resolve production incidents in large-scale backend systems

Collaboration & Engineering Best Practices

- Strong experience in code reviews, unit testing, and API contract enforcement
 - Ability to work cross-functionally with SREs, data engineers, and infrastructure teams
 - Good documentation habits for ensuring architecture decisions and design patterns are well-documented

Benefits & Perks

Atlassian offers a wide range of perks and benefits designed to support you, your family and to help you engage with your local community. Our offerings include health and wellbeing resources, paid volunteer days, and so much more. To learn more, visit go. atlassian. com/perksandbenefits . 

About Atlassian

At Atlassian, we're motivated by a common goal: to unleash the potential of every team. Our software products help teams all over the planet and our solutions are designed for all types of work. Team collaboration through our tools makes what may be impossible alone, possible together. 

We believe that the unique contributions of all Atlassians create our success. To ensure that our products and culture continue to incorporate everyone's perspectives and experience, we never discriminate based on race, religion, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. 

To provide you the best experience, we can support with accommodations or adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process. Simply inform our Recruitment team during your conversation with them. 

To learn more about our culture and hiring process, visit go. atlassian. com/crh .

data.description:
Location: Bangalore - Indraprastha, India

Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we're driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust. 

Present in India since 1953, Thales is headquartered in Noida and has other operational offices and sites spread across Delhi, Gurugram, Bengaluru and Mumbai, among others. Over 2200 employees are working with Thales and its joint ventures in India. Since the beginning, Thales has been playing an essential role in India's growth story by sharing its technologies and expertise in Defence, Aerospace and Cyber & Digital sectors. Thales has two engineering competence centres in India - one in Noida focused on Cyber & Digital business, while the one in Bengaluru focuses on hardware, software and systems engineering capabilities for both the civil and defence sectors, serving global needs. The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair & Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry. 

Responsibilities

- Apply SRE core tenets of measurement (SLI/SLO/SLA), eliminate toil, and reliability modeling
 - Enable and educate development teams on industry best practice design patterns, ways of working and operational knowledge to ensure platform continuity
 - Develop and architect solutions to infrastructure and operational aspects of new products and feature sets
 - Assist with go/no go preplanning, verification/validation, and review of existing and new product/services
 - Proactively analyze data and test the integrity of network/systems to ensure production applications and services are operating optimally
 - Work within development teams to troubleshoot and resolve business affecting issues
 - Escalations, incident response, RCA, and blameless postmortem
 - Participate in on-call rotation

Qualifications

- At least 7+ years of professional experience within a cloud/web/CDN scale infrastructure
 - Expert Linux troubleshooting in production: isolate CPU vs memory vs IO vs network bottlenecks quickly; hands-on with top/htop, vmstat, iostat, sar, pidstat, ss, lsof, dmesg, and journald/systemd. 
 - Strong networking fundamentals + practical debugging: deep understanding of TCP/UDP and routing basics; can prove issues using curl, dig, mtr/traceroute, nc, and tcpdump. 
 - DNS & HTTP(S) clarity: understands resolver vs authoritative, TTL/caching, SERVFAIL/NXDOMAIN patterns; knows HTTP 502/503/504 meaning and common LB/proxy failure modes. 
 - TLS/SSL proficiency: understands certificate chain, expiry, SNI mismatch, handshake failures; can validate quickly using openssl s_client and interpret output. 
 - Production mindset: prioritizes mitigation first (rollback/disable/route around), then RCA; writes clear runbooks and automates repeat fixes to reduce toil. 
 - Expert knowledge of Linux systems, network programming and protocols TCP, UDP, DNS, TLS/SSL, HTTP
 - Experience with BGP and Anycast routing is a plus
 - Experience with DevOps principles and concepts such as Infrastructure as Code (Ansible/Saltstack), CI/CD (Gitlab, Jenkins, Git), monitoring and visualization (Prometheus, Grafana)
 - Experience with big data technologies such as NoSQL/RDBMS, Redis, ElasticSearch, Kafka
 - Experience with containers and container management (Docker, Kubernetes)
 - Experience analyzing and building data telemetry, modeling, pipelines, UI visualization
 - Experience in developing software, troubleshooting, and monitoring large scale distributed systems
 - Implement software engineering best practices/standards and software development life cycle
 - Working knowledge and experience of Agile software development methodologies
 - A strong team player who is accountable towards business urgency
 - Ability to stay organized in a multi-tasking environment
 - Self-starter personality

At Thales, we're committed to fostering a workplace where respect, trust, collaboration, and passion drive everything we do. Here, you'll feel empowered to bring your best self, thrive in a supportive culture, and love the work you do. Join us, and be part of a team reimagining technology to create solutions that truly make a difference - for a safer, greener, and more inclusive world.

That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity. Interviews and onboarding are conducted virtually, a part of being a distributed-first company. 

This role can be based remotely or from an Atlassian office where eligible. Whatever your preference - working from home, an office, or in between - you can choose the place that's best for your work and your lifestyle. We call this TEAM anywhere . 

Responsibilities

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will play a critical role in designing, building, and optimizing high-performance, scalable, and resilient backend storage solutions on AWS cloud infrastructure. You will be responsible for developing distributed storage systems, APIs, and backend services that power mission-critical applications, ensuring low-latency, high-throughput, and fault-tolerant data storage. Your work will directly impact system reliability, scalability, and cost efficiency. 

You will collaborate closely with principal engineers, architects, SREs, and product teams to define technical roadmaps, improve storage efficiency, and optimize access patterns. You will drive performance tuning, data modeling, caching strategies, and cost optimization across AWS storage services like S3, DynamoDB, EBS, EFS, FSx, and Glacier. Additionally, you will contribute to infrastructure automation, security best practices, and monitoring strategies using tools like Terraform, CloudWatch, Prometheus, and OpenTelemetry. 

In this role, you will also be responsible for troubleshooting and resolving production incidents related to data integrity, latency spikes, and storage failures, ensuring high availability and disaster recovery preparedness. You will mentor junior engineers, participate in design reviews and architectural discussions, and advocate for engineering best practices such as CI/CD automation, infrastructure as code, and observability-driven development. Your contributions will directly impact the organization's ability to scale its storage infrastructure efficiently while maintaining security, reliability, and compliance with industry standards. 

Qualifications

Strong Backend Development Skills

- 8+ years of experience in backend software development
 - Proficiency in Kotlin or Java for backend development
 - Experience building high-performance, scalable microservices and APIs
 - Strong understanding of RESTful APIs, gRPC, and event-driven architectures

Experience With AWS Storage Technologies

- Hands-on experience with AWS S3, DynamoDB, EBS, EFS, FSx, and Glacier
 - Knowledge of AWS IAM, KMS, and data access policies for secure storage solutions
 - Understanding of AWS networking (VPC, PrivateLink, Route 53) for optimizing storage performance

Distributed Systems & Scalability

- Solid understanding of distributed databases, storage consistency models, and caching mechanisms
 - Experience with sharding, partitioning, and load balancing to scale storage-heavy applications
 - Familiarity with event-driven architectures using AWS SNS, SQS, Kinesis, or Kafka

Performance Optimization & Cost Efficiency

- Ability to profile and optimize storage performance, indexing strategies, and data retrieval latencies
 - Experience with cost-efficient storage solutions by implementing tiering, lifecycle policies, and data deduplication
 - Knowledge of benchmarking and monitoring tools (CloudWatch, OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana)

Security & Reliability

- Experience implementing data encryption at rest and in transit using AWS KMS or TLS
 - Understanding of access control mechanisms (IAM roles, STS, fine-grained permissions)
 - Experience ensuring high availability and disaster recovery using AWS backup strategies and multi-region replication

Hands-On with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) & DevOps

- Experience using Terraform, AWS CloudFormation, or CDK to manage infrastructure
 - Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines for backend deployments using GitHub Actions, CodePipeline, or Jenkins
 - Experience with containerized deployments using Docker, Kubernetes (EKS), and serverless solutions (Lambda, Fargate)

Troubleshooting & Production Support

- Strong debugging skills for investigating storage failures, high-latency issues, and API bottlenecks
 - Experience using observability and tracing tools to monitor storage workloads
 - Ability to triage and resolve production incidents in large-scale backend systems

Collaboration & Engineering Best Practices

- Strong experience in code reviews, unit testing, and API contract enforcement
 - Ability to work cross-functionally with SREs, data engineers, and infrastructure teams
 - Good documentation habits for ensuring architecture decisions and design patterns are well-documented

Benefits & Perks

Atlassian offers a wide range of perks and benefits designed to support you, your family and to help you engage with your local community. Our offerings include health and wellbeing resources, paid volunteer days, and so much more. To learn more, visit go. atlassian. com/perksandbenefits . 

About Atlassian

At Atlassian, we're motivated by a common goal: to unleash the potential of every team. Our software products help teams all over the planet and our solutions are designed for all types of work. Team collaboration through our tools makes what may be impossible alone, possible together. 

We believe that the unique contributions of all Atlassians create our success. To ensure that our products and culture continue to incorporate everyone's perspectives and experience, we never discriminate based on race, religion, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. 

To provide you the best experience, we can support with accommodations or adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process. Simply inform our Recruitment team during your conversation with them. 

To learn more about our culture and hiring process, visit go. atlassian. com/crh .

data.title: Financial Crime Agile Testing Team Lead
data.description:
Join us as a Financial Crime Agile Testing Team Lead at Barclays, where you'll shape how the bank assures, tests, and strengthens its financial crime controls. This is a high-visibility opportunity to build and evolve an agile testing capability from the ground up, driving testing strategy, influencing senior stakeholders, and applying a consultancy-style mindset to delivery, communication, and continuous improvement. You'll play a meaningful role in helping Barclays manage financial crime risk, protect customers, and strengthen the bank's control environment. 

You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking, digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills including assurance testing, financial crime investigations, agile delivery, stakeholder management, and written and verbal communication. 

To be successful as a Financial Crime Agile Testing Team Lead you should have experience with: 

Basic/ Essential Qualifications

- Experience in Financial Crime Assurance or Control Testing within a 2nd line function including understanding of investigative processes and control or hypothesis testing. 
 - Strong risk and control mindset, with the ability to identify, assess, test, and challenge compliance and financial crime risks across business activities, processes, systems, and controls. 
 - Line management and project management experience, including leading teams, managing day-to-day delivery, developing colleagues, and driving performance against priorities. 

Desirable Skillsets/ Good To Have

- Stakeholder management experience, with the ability to engage, influence, and provide check and challenge to senior stakeholders across Compliance, 1LOD, and risk management functions. 
 - Strong written and verbal communication skills to produce clear testing outputs, senior-level materials, memos, and communications that support the insights, observations or outcomes. 
 - Experience in advisory or consulting roles, agile delivery, and use of case management systems (like Salesforce) to support testing, oversight, and continuous improvement. 

This role will be based out of Pune, India. 

Purpose of the role

To provide data-led expert oversight and check and challenge on business and compliance matters to evidence that the organisation is operating in a compliance with Barclays legal, regulatory and ethical responsibilities. 

Accountabilities

- Identification and assessment of compliance risks through thorough reviews of business activities, changes, processes, testing and systems to. 
 - Identification and investigation of potential market abuse, including but not limited to, Insider Dealing, Unlawful Disclosure, Market Manipulation or Anti-Competitive Conduct. 
 - Conduct investigation of compliance risk events or breaches. Oversight and check and challenge of corrective actions and preventative measures to avoid future occurrences. 
 - Implementation of compliance policies and procedures in line with regulatory requirements and ensuring that the bank's internal policies are aligned with international standards, including jurisdictional requirements. 
 - Collaboration with 1LOD, other relevant Compliance teams and legal, and relevant risk management functions to facilitate a comprehensive approach to compliance and risk management. 
 - Identification, investigation and oversight of potential money laundering, terrorist financing or other financial crime. 

Vice President Expectations

- To contribute or set strategy, drive requirements and make recommendations for change. Plan resources, budgets, and policies; manage and maintain policies/ processes; deliver continuous improvements and escalate breaches of policies/procedures. . 
 - If managing a team, they define jobs and responsibilities, planning for the department's future needs and operations, counselling employees on performance and contributing to employee pay decisions/changes. They may also lead a number of specialists to influence the operations of a department, in alignment with strategic as well as tactical priorities, while balancing short and long term goals and ensuring that budgets and schedules meet corporate requirements. . 
 - If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L - Listen and be authentic, E - Energise and inspire, A - Align across the enterprise, D - Develop others. . 
 - OR for an individual contributor, they will be a subject matter expert within own discipline and will guide technical direction. They will lead collaborative, multi-year assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will train, guide and coach less experienced specialists and provide information affecting long term profits, organisational risks and strategic decisions. . 
 - Advise key stakeholders, including functional leadership teams and senior management on functional and cross functional areas of impact and alignment. 
 - Manage and mitigate risks through assessment, in support of the control and governance agenda. 
 - Demonstrate leadership and accountability for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work your team does. 
 - Demonstrate comprehensive understanding of the organisation functions to contribute to achieving the goals of the business. 
 - Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategies. 
 - Create solutions based on sophisticated analytical thought comparing and selecting complex alternatives. In-depth analysis with interpretative thinking will be required to define problems and develop innovative solutions. 
 - Adopt and include the outcomes of extensive research in problem solving processes. 
 - Seek out, build and maintain trusting relationships and partnerships with internal and external stakeholders in order to accomplish key business objectives, using influencing and negotiating skills to achieve outcomes. 

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship - our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset - to Empower, Challenge and Drive - the operating manual for how we behave.

Ubisoft is a global leader in gaming, with teams around the world creating original and memorable gaming experiences through franchises such as Assassin's Creed, Rainbow Six, Just Dance, and more.

Job Description

About Our Team

At Ubisoft, our technology teams operate within Production Services, part of the broader Core Services organization, which brings together specialized teams delivering technology, solutions, and expertise to production studios worldwide. 

Within this structure, our team goes well beyond traditional Quality Control. We focus on Test Automation, Quality Engineering, AI/GenAI, Data Analytics, Engineering Tools, and R&D, developing intelligent systems and scalable engineering solutions that address real challenges across game production. 

Our work includes everything from advanced automation frameworks and AI-powered autonomous agents to data-driven intelligence platforms. We actively explore emerging technologies and turn promising ideas into practical solutions that improve how AAA games are developed, tested, and delivered. 

Why Join Us?

As a Technical Architect within Ubisoft's Production Services organization, you will have the opportunity to: 

- Build technology beyond traditional testing: Work on automation platforms, engineering tools, AI-driven solutions, and R&D initiatives that support game production. 
 - Influence technology at a global scale: Design solutions with the potential to benefit multiple AAA projects and Ubisoft studios worldwide. 
 - Work with emerging technologies: Explore practical applications of Generative AI, autonomous agents, and intelligent engineering systems. 
 - Own meaningful technical challenges: Shape architectural decisions, guide implementations, and see the impact of your work. 
 - Collaborate across disciplines: Work alongside engineers, technical leaders, and production teams solving diverse challenges. 
 - Help shape future capabilities: Contribute to how Ubisoft evolves its engineering solutions and production technology. 

If you enjoy solving complex technical problems, building scalable systems, and exploring how emerging technologies can improve real-world production workflows, we'd love to hear from you. 

Job Summary : 

We are looking for an experienced Technical Architect to join our technology team at Ubisoft Pune. 

In this role, you will shape the technical architecture of solutions spanning Automation, Engineering Tools, and R&D initiatives. You will work closely with Programming Leads, engineers, project teams, and global technical stakeholders to design and deliver scalable, reliable, and maintainable technology solutions. 

As a senior individual contributor, you will take ownership of key architectural decisions, evaluate emerging technologies, guide engineering teams, and help transform innovative concepts into production-ready solutions. 

This is an opportunity to work across multiple technical domains, solve complex engineering problems, and influence technology decisions that can benefit multiple Ubisoft projects and studios worldwide. 

Key Responsibilities

- Technical Architecture & Solution Design
 - Design scalable, reliable, and maintainable architectures for automation frameworks, engineering tools, and intelligent systems. 
 - Translate complex production and engineering challenges into practical technical solutions. 
 - Define architectural standards, design principles, system interfaces, and integration approaches. 
 - Ensure solutions meet performance, security, scalability, and maintainability requirements.

 - Automation & Engineering Solutions

 - Identify opportunities to improve development, testing, and production workflows through technology. 
 - Design reusable solutions that can support multiple projects, teams, and production environments. 
 - Collaborate with engineers to optimize system performance, reliability, and integration. 
 - Promote engineering best practices, including code quality, modularity, documentation, and maintainability. 
 - Emerging Technologies & R&D
 - Explore and evaluate emerging technologies, including AI, Generative AI, machine learning, and intelligent automation. 
 - Work with R&D teams to assess technical feasibility and develop proofs of concept. 
 - Guide the technical transition of promising prototypes into scalable, production-ready solutions. 
 - Evaluate new frameworks, tools, and architectural approaches based on their practical value and long-term potential. 
 - Encourage experimentation while maintaining sound engineering and architectural practices. 
 - Technical Leadership & Engineering Excellence
 - Provide technical guidance and architectural direction to Programming Leads and engineering teams. 
 - Conduct architecture reviews, design discussions, and code reviews to maintain engineering standards. 
 - Help resolve complex technical challenges and guide teams toward effective solutions. 
 - Support technical planning, effort estimation, and implementation strategies. 
 - Contribute to the technical growth of teams through mentoring, knowledge sharing, and capability development. 
 - Global Collaboration & Technology Strategy
 - Act as a key technical point of contact for the team in discussions with global technical stakeholders. 
 - Collaborate with engineering, production, and technology teams across Ubisoft studios. 
 - Identify opportunities to share, reuse, and scale technology solutions across projects. 
 - Contribute to long-term technology roadmaps and architectural direction. 
 - Ensure local engineering initiatives align with broader organizational technology objectives. 

Core Competencies

- Architectural Thinking: Ability to design solutions that balance immediate requirements with long-term scalability and maintainability. 
 - Problem-Solving: Strong analytical skills and a practical approach to solving complex engineering challenges. 
 - Technical Curiosity: Interest in exploring emerging technologies and identifying opportunities for their application. 
 - Technical Leadership: Ability to influence engineering decisions, guide technical teams, and establish strong engineering practices. 
 - Collaboration: Confidence working with multidisciplinary teams and global stakeholders. 
 - Ownership: Ability to drive technical initiatives from problem definition and architectural design through implementation and adoption. 
 - Communication: Ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences. 

Qualifications

- 12+ years of experience in software engineering, technical architecture, or solution development. 
 - Strong programming expertise in one or more languages such as C++, C#, and Python, with the ability to work across different technology stacks. 
 - Proven experience designing and implementing scalable software architectures, frameworks, or engineering platforms. 
 - Strong understanding of software design principles, design patterns, APIs, system integration, and application architecture. 
 - Experience developing automation frameworks, developer tools, or complex engineering solutions. 
 - Hands-on experience evaluating technologies, building prototypes, and converting technical concepts into working solutions. 
 - Strong understanding of performance optimization, reliability, maintainability, and scalable system design. 
 - Experience defining technical standards and guiding engineering teams through implementation. 
 - Ability to assess engineering challenges, evaluate technical trade-offs, and recommend sustainable solutions. 

Good to Have

- Experience working with AI/ML, Generative AI, LLMs, or AI-powered automation solutions. 
 - Familiarity with agentic systems, computer vision, or autonomous workflows. 
 - Experience with cloud technologies, distributed systems, containerization, or CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Understanding of data engineering, analytics platforms, or intelligent decision-support systems. 
 - Experience developing tools or technology solutions for game development, game engines, or interactive applications. 
 - Experience working with globally distributed engineering teams. 

Previous experience in the gaming industry is an advantage, but not a requirement. We welcome experienced architects from other technology domains who can bring new perspectives and engineering approaches.

You will guide technical strategy, develop engineering talent, and drive the delivery and operation of scalable backend services, telemetry systems, data pipelines, metrics, and diagnostic workflows used to understand and improve Windows health at scale.

data.title: Software Dev Manager III,  Pharmacy
data.description:
Description

Lead a pioneering team at Amazon Pharmacy as we build our next-generation Pharmacy Warehouse Management System (WMS) from the ground up in Bangalore. As a development manager, you'll establish and scale a high-performing engineering team focused on mission-critical fulfillment technology that ensures medication safety for millions of customers across America. 

You'll drive the technical vision and execution of complex distributed systems handling inventory management, order orchestration, and compliance-critical workflows, while integrating with cutting-edge robotics and AI/ML capabilities. This role requires a strong technical leader who can balance rapid innovation with unwavering quality standards in a highly regulated healthcare environment. 

Amazon Pharmacy is transforming healthcare delivery by combining Amazon's customer obsession and operational excellence with pharmacy services. You'll partner closely with senior leadership to shape the technical strategy of this rapidly growing business, while building and mentoring a team of talented engineers. Your organization will be instrumental in scaling Amazon's pharmacy operations nationwide, working with teams across the globe to deliver solutions that could fundamentally change how Americans access their medications. . 

The ideal candidate is a tenured engineering leader ready to tackle next level challenges, in an ambiguous, high-stakes scope. You bring experience leading complex technical programs, building highly available services at scale, and developing engineering talent. You also think strategically beyond your own team, connecting technical decisions to long-term business outcomes and ready to own charter-level problems with org-wide impact. 

Key job responsibilities

- Building, leading and growing diverse, inclusive and high-performing engineering product teams, including recruiting, mentoring, motivating, promoting and performance management. 
 - Collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams including customers, product managers, stakeholders and leaders to ensure the successful delivery of product capabilities. 
 - Timely execution and prioritization of goals for the team and effectively mitigating risks. 

Strategic leadership to create product roadmaps, set the vision for the team and collaboratively partner with other stakeholder teams. 

- Technical leadership including architecture and design discussions for science and engineering problems and technical deep dives to ensure resolution of root causes of complex issues. 

About The Team

This team owns the technology that moves every medication from dock to patient - the warehouse management systems, the real-time inventory system of record, and the dispensing workflows across every form factor, from standard vials to cold chain to adherence packets. We control billions a year in pharmaceutical inventory across a fast-growing network of regional automated facilities, small-format pharmacies, and kiosks, scaling for 40%+ annual volume growth. Our work sits at the intersection of hard problems: real-time distributed systems, warehouse robotics and automation, write-time regulatory compliance, and ML-driven autonomy - all under a bar where correctness is non-negotiable because a patient is on the other end. We're building a single, platform-native architecture that tracks every drug in real time, automates the majority of fulfillment, and makes operations predictive and self-healing. For engineers, that means owning systems end to end and solving problems that don't have off-the-shelf answers. 

Basic Qualifications

- 8+ years of engineering experience
 - 3+ years of engineering team management experience
 - 8+ years of leading the definition and development of multi tier web services experience
 - Knowledge of engineering practices and patterns for the full software/hardware/networks development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, certification, and livesite operations
 - Experience partnering with product or program management teams
 - Excellent communication and articulation skills. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience in communicating with users, other technical teams, and senior leadership to collect requirements, describe software product features, technical designs, and product strategy

data.description:
Job Title: AI Platform Engineer

Department: CEFS IT (CRM&S - CRM)

About Business line/Function: CIB

Experience Required: 7+ years in software engineering, AI engineering or related fields (or equivalent proven experience)

Product: AI‐Native CRM Platforms

Position Purpose

Looking for a highly skilled candidate with 7+ years of experience to join our dynamic development team as an AI Platform Engineer. In this role, the candidate will architect and deploy autonomous and semi-autonomous AI agentic systems designed to automate complex CRM+ application features and orchestrate multi-step processes across enterprise data. This is an exceptional opportunity for a candidate to drive innovation in Agentic AI, RAG pipelines, and LLMOps within a high-scale, regulated corporate and institutional banking environment. 

Responsibilities

Direct Responsibilities

- Design, develop, and deploy autonomous and semi‐autonomous AI agents that automate CRM workflows (sales assistance, support automation, lead qualification) and orchestrate multi‐step processes across enterprise data. Implement permission‐aware tool adapters, bounded autonomy, guard‐rails, escalation mechanisms and full audit‐logging to satisfy AML and security compliance
 - Build production‐grade Retrieval‐Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines that ingest structured and unstructured data, perform chunking, embedding, hybrid search, semantic retrieval, metadata filtering and re‐ranking using vector databases (pgvector, Qdrant, Pinecone, Weaviate). Create reusable LLM abstraction layers that support multiple model providers and open‐weight models, with model routing, fall‐backs, rate‐limiting, cost‐tracking and token‐consumption optimization (caching, context‐window management)
 - Design and implement robust state & memory management for autonomous agents-handle checkpointing, persistent context storage, efficient serialization/retrieval, and scalable memory‐access patterns to support long‐running, multi‐turn interactions while maintaining consistency and compliance. 
 - Develop AI‐powered CRM capabilities such as customer profiling, lead qualification, meeting preparation, interaction summarization, follow‐up generation and next‐best‐action recommendation. Build natural‐language interfaces that let users query customer information, generate insights and trigger workflows conversationally. Enable agents to retrieve context, update CRM records and execute authorized actions while integrating LLM reasoning with business‐rule engines and existing CRM processes
 - Engineer scalable backend services and APIs (Python, FastAPI, async) that expose agent functionality, integrate with CRM systems, databases, email/calendar services, document repositories and external APIs. Implement reliable execution patterns - background jobs, message queues, retries, timeouts, idempotency and fault tolerance - and construct event‐driven architectures with Kafka or RabbitMQ. 

Design and operate AI‐infrastructure and LLMOps pipelines: containerize services (Docker), orchestrate on‐prem or cloud‐native Kubernetes clusters (Helm, Argo CD GitOps), manage CI/CD (GitHub Actions, Jenkins), and implement observability (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK) together with model‐lifecycle tooling (MLflow, experiment tracking, model registry). Optimize latency, throughput, concurrency, resource utilization and inference cost; enforce access controls, tenant isolation, secrets management and audit trails. 

- Provide technical leadership across product, engineering and compliance teams: own end‐to‐end architecture, prototype, productionise and maintain AI solutions; develop reusable frameworks and standards for agentic AI; conduct code and architecture reviews; mentor junior engineers; and continuously evaluate emerging agentic‐AI frameworks, models and deployment technologies for product relevance. 

Contributing Responsibilities

- Proficiency in tools (e. g. , JIRA, Confluence, MS Visio)
 - Familiarity with software development methodologies (Agile, Scrum, Waterfall). 
 - Familiarity with Oracle databases, Understanding schema, SQL
 - Strong analytical, communication, and interpersonal skills
 - Ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams and manage multiple priorities. 
 - Quick to learn and adapt
 - Good Team player
 - Someone who could have long-term commitment with the team and organization

Technical & Behavioral Competencies

- Agentic AI & Multi‐Agent Systems - Mastery of LangGraph / LangChain, tool‐calling, function‐calling, planning, task decomposition, state management, checkpointing, retries, human‐in‐the‐loop approval and performance metrics (completion rate, accuracy, latency, cost). 
 - LLM & RAG Engineering - End‐to‐end RAG pipeline design, context‐engineering, prompt optimization, grounding, hallucination mitigation, token‐window management, caching strategies and multi‐provider model routing. 
 - AI‐Powered CRM Capability Design - Ability to translate CRM domain expertise into intelligent features (profiling, scoring, summarization, recommendation) and embed LLM‐driven reasoning with rule‐engine and workflow automation. 
 - Backend & Integration Engineering - Delivery of high‐availability micro‐services (FastAPI/Node. js), event‐driven pipelines (Kafka, RabbitMQ, Avro/Schema Registry), secure API‐gateway configuration (Kong) and robust integration adapters that enforce permission models and idempotent behavior. 
 - Cloud‐Native & DevOps Practices - Deep experience with Docker, Kubernetes (multi‐namespace, Helm, Argo CD), CI/CD automation, Infrastructure‐as‐Code (Terraform, Pulumi) and observability stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/Loki). 
 - Data & Retrieval Engineering - Proficiency with SQL/relational databases, vector‐search technologies, document processing, feature‐store patterns (Feast, Redis), data‐quality governance, schema evolution and caching. 
 - Machine‐Learning Foundations - Practical knowledge of scikit‐learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow, model training/evaluation, hyper‐parameter tuning and lifecycle management with MLflow. 
 - Security, Governance & Compliance - Implementation of permission‐aware tool execution, audit logging, model governance and adherence to AML, GDPR and internal risk‐management policies. 
 - Performance Measurement & Optimization - Definition and monitoring of agent/LLM metrics (accuracy, latency, cost), systematic A/B testing and optimization techniques (semantic caching, prompt caching, context compression). 

Nice to have

- Experience with vLLM, LoRA/QLoRA fine‐tuning, quantization and GPU‐based model serving behind firewalls. 
 - Hands‐on work with LLM evaluation and tracing platforms such as LangSmith, Langfuse, Phoenix, OpenTelemetry or comparable tools. 
 - Advanced agentic‐AI patterns: durable execution, Model‐Context Protocol (MCP), persistent agent memory and sophisticated human‐in‐the‐loop workflows. 
 - Proficiency with common ML libraries (scikit‐learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow) for rapid prototyping and model development. 
 - Knowledge‐graph expertise (Neo4j, Memgraph, TigerGraph, Amazon Neptune, JanusGraph) for large‐scale network analytics and entity resolution. 
 - Experience with large‐scale streaming and batch processing frameworks (Kafka, Spark, Flink, Delta Lake) and data‐pipeline orchestration tools (dbt, Airflow). 
 - Familiarity with multi‐tenant SaaS architecture, OAuth2/OpenID Connect, SSO and enterprise identity‐management solutions. 
 - Background in recommendation, ranking, lead‐scoring, customer segmentation, forecasting or churn‐prediction models for CRM intelligence. 
 - Infrastructure‐automation expertise (Terraform, Pulumi, GitOps, Helm, Argo CD) and sandbox quota management for GPU nodes. 

Specific Qualifications: NA

Technical Skills

Skills Referential (Required knowledge, skills and abilities)

- Core Programming & Software Engineering - Python, FastAPI/Flask, asynchronous development, REST/GraphQL APIs, SQL/relational databases, Git version control, automated testing, CI/CD best practices. 
 - Agentic AI & LLM Engineering - LangGraph/LangChain, tool/function calling, state & memory management, planning, task decomposition, multi‐agent orchestration, RAG pipelines, vector‐DB integration, prompt engineering, cost & rate‐limit controls, model routing. 
 - Backend & Integration Engineering - High‐availability micro‐services (FastAPI/Node. js), event‐driven pipelines (Kafka, RabbitMQ, Avro/Schema Registry), API‐gateway configuration (Kong), rule‐engine integration (Drools or custom), secure credential handling, idempotent design. 
 - Cloud‐Native & DevOps - Docker, Kubernetes (multi‐namespace, Helm, Argo CD GitOps), CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI), IaC (Terraform, Pulumi), observability (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/Loki), secrets management, tenant isolation. 
 - Data & Retrieval Engineering - Structured and semi‐structured data handling, document ingestion & processing, embedding generation, vector‐search (pgvector, Qdrant, Pinecone, Weaviate), feature‐store patterns (Feast, Redis), data lineage, quality and governance. 
 - Machine‐Learning Foundations - Scikit‐learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow, model training, evaluation, hyper‐parameter optimization, MLflow experiment tracking, model registry and artifact versioning. 
 - Collaboration & Problem‐Solving - Cross‐functional communication, stakeholder alignment, comprehensive documentation, mentorship, systematic troubleshooting and adaptability to regulated environments. 

Behavioral Skills

- Collaboration & Communication - Proven ability to work in globally distributed, cross‐functional teams; translate complex AI concepts into actionable specifications; produce clear technical documentation (OpenAPI/Swagger, design specs); mentor junior engineers. 
 - Problem‐Solving Mindset & Adaptability - Systematic, data‐driven approach to ambiguous CRM/financial‐crime typologies; rapid learning of new domains, regulations and technologies while maintaining high‐quality, secure solutions. 
 - Professional Background - bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, Engineering, AI or related discipline (or equivalent experience); ≥ 7 years of demonstrable experience delivering production‐grade software and AI systems; documented ownership of end‐to‐end AI product features. 

Education Level: Bachelor's degree or equivalent

Location: Mumbai

data.description:
About the Team: 

Enterprise Systems is the backbone of GSK's internal operations in Digital & Tech, enabling GSK Global Functions teams such as Finance, Procurement, HR, Legal, Compliance, WREF, CGA and Corporate Secretariat to run seamlessly. This team designs and delivers cutting-edge digital platforms that power critical processes, ensuring efficiency, compliance, and scalability across the enterprise. 

Enterprise Systems Management & Business Operations delivers digital solutions that support Enterprise Systems running as a high-performing organisation. This team drives financial discipline, operational rigour and strategic alignment across the ES portfolio that safeguard GSK's integrity and reputation globally. By joining this team, you'll help shape systems that support thousands of employees worldwide, driving innovation and reliability in the tools that keep GSK moving forward. 

Job Purpose: 

Integration Engineer provides technical leadership for the design, implementation and lifecycle management of data integrations connecting shop-floor and laboratory systems with site, enterprise and R&D data platforms. The role focuses on ISA-95 (International Society of Automation standard 95) Levels 2, 3 and 5, enabling governed and contextualized data flow from automation and equipment through manufacturing operations systems to enterprise, analytics and scientific environments. 

The role leads integration across Manufacturing, MSAT (Manufacturing Science and Technology), Quality, Laboratory, CMC and R&D use cases, including Factory Integration Layer (FIL) capabilities, industrial connectivity, event-driven integration, canonical data models, Unified Namespace patterns, APIs and secure cloud or edge interfaces. The job holder ensures solutions preserve manufacturing context, genealogy, data integrity and semantic meaning while aligning with approved architecture, cyber security, validation and engineering standards. 

The role coordinates automation, OT, IT, data, cloud, application and scientific teams and acts as the technical lead for complex cross-layer delivery and operational issues. It develops reusable interface patterns, engineering standards, test strategies, monitoring and support documentation, and strengthens capability through coaching and knowledge transfer. 

Key Responsibilities: 

- Lead end-to-end integration design across ISA-95 Level 2 control and equipment systems, Level 3 manufacturing operations systems, and Level 5 enterprise, cloud, analytics and R&D platforms. 
 - Use approved AI tools in your day-to-day work to improve your own productivity and your team's ways of working, sharing what works and applying sound judgement, including validating outputs and following GSK's Responsible AI, privacy and security requirements 
 - Own technical quality for FIL and related integration services, including interface specifications, data contracts, mappings, configuration records, deployment artefacts, test evidence and operational acceptance criteria. 
 - Perform troubleshooting and root-cause analysis, with timely escalation where manufacturing batches, product quality, patient supply or data integrity may be affected. 
 - Design and configure secure interfaces, data pipelines, event streams, APIs and data models that integrate automation, historians, MES (Manufacturing Execution System) / Electronic Batch Record. (Manufacturing Operations Management), LIMS ( Laboratory Information Management System), LES (Laboratory Execution System), PAT (Process Analytical Technology), laboratory instruments, asset systems and enterprise or scientific data platforms. 
 - Analyse message flows, logs, traces, metrics, data-quality controls and system behaviour across edge, site and cloud components to identify defects, latency, data loss, schema drift, performance constraints and opportunities for improvement. 
 - Coach site engineers and super users and contribute to training, runbooks and knowledge articles. 
 - Lead technical design and implementation across multiple projects, releases or sites. 
 - Review and approve key technical specifications, design documents, configurations, test scripts and validation evidence. 
 - Provide technical direction during complex incidents, releases and stabilisation and coordinate internal and supplier engineering resources. 
 - Assess technical risks and ensure mitigation addresses security, compliance, resilience, data integrity and supportability. 
 - Maintain reusable integration patterns, canonical models, namespace and topic conventions, API standards, connector templates, deployment automation and engineering guardrails for manufacturing and R&D data integration. 
 - Define and implement connectivity patterns for industrial protocols and interfaces such as OPC UA(Open Platform Communications Unified Architecture) MQTT, Sparkplug B, REST APIs (Representational State Transfer Application Programming Interface), message queues, file-based exchange and database integration, selecting patterns according to criticality, latency, security and supportability requirements. 
 - Develop contextualization and semantic mapping from equipment tags and process signals to assets, materials, batches, process steps, samples, methods and products using governed metadata, master data, ontologies and knowledge-graph-ready relationships. 
 - Enable reliable movement of manufacturing and laboratory data to enterprise and R&D consumers while retaining source, timestamp, unit of measure, quality status, lineage, batch and equipment context. 
 - Partner with CMC, MSAT, Data Science and R&D teams to translate scientific and process-analysis needs into scalable integration services and consumable, well-described data products. 
 - Design for store-and-forward, buffering, retry, idempotency, ordering, reconciliation, observability and disaster recovery where connectivity or downstream services may be interrupted. 
 - Apply OT/IT security principles including network segmentation, least privilege, certificate and secrets management, encrypted transport, secure remote access and controlled change across edge, site and cloud boundaries. 
 - Lead interface risk assessments, commissioning, qualification and validation activities using a risk-based approach appropriate to GxP and data-integrity requirements. 
 - Coordinate integration cutover, data reconciliation, hypercare and transition to service, including service-level measures, alerting, runbooks, ownership boundaries and escalation paths. 
 - Support formal technical assurance, audits and inspections and ensure corrective actions are evidence based. 
 - Drive engineering lessons learned and cross-team continuous improvement. 

Key Relationships / Customers

Business and Site Stakeholders

- Manufacturing, Quality, Laboratory, Supply Chain and MSAT stakeholders 
 - Site engineers, automation teams, super users and key users 
 - Business Process Owners and operational risk owners

Digital & Technology Stakeholders

- Product Managers and Product Owners 
 - Solution and Enterprise Architects 
 - Engineering, DevOps, Data and Integration teams 
 - Service Managers, Cyber Security and Infrastructure teams 
 - Validation, Quality and technical assurance teams

Other

- Technology vendors 
 - System integrators and specialist engineering partners 
 - Managed service and support providers

Area of Specialization: 

- Technical solution implementation and configuration 
 - Interfaces, workflows, recipes, data models and environment design 
 - Technical specifications, design documentation and validation evidence 
 - Testing, release, deployment and configuration management 
 - Logs, metrics, monitoring and root-cause analysis 
 - Security, data integrity, resilience and supportability 
 - Regulated manufacturing, quality or laboratory technology environments 
 - Technical leadership across products, sites or programmes 
 - Design assurance and complex technical decision making 
 - ISA-95 Levels 2, 3 and 5 integration architecture and data flows 
 - Factory Integration Layer and industrial edge integration patterns 
 - OT protocols and connectivity, including OPC UA, MQTT/Sparkplug B and industrial historians 
 - MES/MOM, LIMS/LES, PAT, laboratory, asset and automation system integration 
 - API-led, event-driven and message-based integration using governed data contracts 
 - Unified Namespace, canonical information models and semantic interoperability 
 - Manufacturing data contextualization, genealogy, lineage, time-series and event data 
 - R&D and CMC data integration, including scientific metadata, ontologies and knowledge graphs 
 - Cloud and edge integration, containerized services, CI/CD (Continuous Integration / Continuous Delivery ) and infrastructure/configuration automation 
 - Integration observability, reconciliation, resilience, performance and operational support

Basic Qualifications: 

- Bachelor's or master's degree in engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Automation, Data, Life Sciences, or a relevant technical discipline, or any related technical discipline
 - Minimum 7+ years of hands-on technical engineering experience involving enterprise IT, manufacturing OT, automation, data, or integration environments. 
 - Experience leading the technical design and implementation of solutions across a product family, platform, programme, or multiple sites. 
 - Experience reviewing or approving technical specifications, design documents, system configurations, test scripts, and technical validation evidence. 
 - Experience in integrating ISA-95 Level 2 systems such as PLC(Programmable Logic Controller), SCADA(Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition) , DCS (Distributed Control System), equipment, instruments, PAT, or historians with Level 3 systems such as MES/MOM, LIMS/LES, EBR (Electronic Batch Record), scheduling, quality, or maintenance systems. 
 - Experience integrating Level 3 manufacturing systems and data with Level 5 enterprise, cloud, analytics, data lakehouse, ontology, or knowledge graph platforms supporting Manufacturing, MSAT, CMC, or R&D (Research and Development). 
 - Experience designing, configuring, or supporting integrations using OPC UA, MQTT(Message Queuing Telemetry Transport) or Sparkplug B, REST APIs, message brokers/event streaming, SQL(Structured Query Language), time-series data, and secure file or database integration. 
 - Experience creating or implementing canonical data models, Unified Namespace structures, topic/naming conventions, schema evolution approaches, metadata, and master-data mappings. 
 - Experience designing integrations that maintain batch, material, asset, process, sample, method, timestamp, unit, quality, lineage/provenance, and equipment context between source and consuming systems. 
 - Experience performing integration and performance testing, data reconciliation and monitoring, and implementing store-and-forward, retry, recovery, or resilience mechanisms in business-critical environments. 
 - Experience using or supporting cloud and edge platforms, containers, version control, CI/CD, automated deployment, or configuration management. 
 - Experience developing or maintaining integration components using at least one programming or scripting language, such as Python, Java, C#, or JavaScript/TypeScript. 
 - Experience performing troubleshooting and root-cause analysis across systems, interfaces, workflows, data, or infrastructure. 
 - Experience coordinating engineers, site teams, vendors, or specialist partners during design, deployment, cutover, and stabilisation activities. 
 - Experience conducting technical risk assessments and implementing controls or mitigations covering security, data integrity, resilience, compliance, or supportability. 
 - Experience coaching engineers or creating reusable engineering materials, such as integration standards, patterns, runbooks, or technical knowledge articles. 
 - Experience providing technical documentation or evidence for audits, inspections, validation, or formal technical assurance activities. 
 - Experience applying OT (Operational Technology)/IT security controls to integrations, including network segmentation, least-privilege access, certificate or secrets management, encrypted communication, or secure service-to-service communication. 

Preferred Qualifications: 

- Experience delivering integrations within regulated pharmaceutical, biopharmaceutical, medical-device, or similarly controlled manufacturing and laboratory environments. 
 - Relevant technical, cloud, integration, automation, data, validation, cybersecurity, or engineering certifications. 
 - Deep understanding of ISA-95 Levels 2, 3, and 5, including responsibilities, system boundaries, and integration patterns between these layers. 
 - Experience with Factory Integration Layer (FIL) and industrial edge integration patterns. 
 - Experience implementing Unified Namespace (UNS) and semantic interoperability patterns. 
 - Knowledge of data modelling, ontology mapping, knowledge graphs, master data, metadata, data lineage, and data-product principles. 
 - Experience contextualizing manufacturing and laboratory data from equipment tags and process signals into assets, materials, batches, process steps, samples, methods, and products. 
 - Experience supporting Manufacturing, MSAT, Quality, Laboratory, CMC(Chemistry, Manufacturing and Controls), and R&D integration use cases. 
 - Knowledge of API (Application Programming Interface) management, event streaming, message brokering, schema registries, and interface versioning. 
 - Experience with industrial historians, MES/MOM, LIMS/LES, PAT, laboratory instruments, asset systems, and automation systems. 
 - Ability to define non-functional requirements covering latency, throughput, availability, recoverability, scalability, data retention, performance, and supportability. 
 - Experience with cloud/edge integration, containerized services, deployment automation, and infrastructure/configuration automation. 
 - Ability to interpret automation/process-control information, tag structures, and historian data and translate them into governed manufacturing and scientific information models. 
 - Experience bridging manufacturing engineering, automation, data engineering, cloud/IT, and scientific/R&D teams for complex cross-layer integration.

Engineering Leadership & Delivery

data.title: Lead Data Scientist - AI Delivery
data.description:
About The Role

The FCC DnA team is seeking an experienced Lead Data Scientist to provide technical and delivery leadership across multiple AI and Data Science initiatives. This role will serve as a key India delivery partner to the U. S. AI leadership team and will be responsible for independently driving execution across products and use cases such as Data Integrity, intelligent document processing, Broker Statement processing, workflow automation and other Applied AI initiatives. 

The role requires a strong technical leader who can manage a small team, translate business priorities into executable plans, remove delivery blockers and work effectively across Data Science, Product, Engineering and Platform teams. Since these solutions are deployed on the Digital Twin platform, the successful candidate should be comfortable working with platform engineering teams on APIs, environments, deployments, integrations, monitoring and production issues. 

This is not intended to be a pure people-management role or a pure modeling role. The person should maintain strong technical depth across Data Science, Machine Learning and Applied AI, while also understanding enough software and platform engineering to move solutions from development through production. Experience with Statistical Modeling and model lifecycle management is a strong plus, as the role will also support and collaborate with the broader AI Modeling team. 

The successful candidate should be able to work independently with limited day-to-day supervision, take ownership of delivery outcomes, communicate risks and decisions clearly, and present technical progress and recommendations confidently to senior leaders. 

Key Responsibilities

- Own end-to-end delivery of multiple AI and Data Science initiatives from requirements and solution design through development, testing, deployment and production stabilization. 
 - Act as the primary India delivery lead for assigned initiatives and independently manage priorities, milestones, dependencies, risks and execution. 
 - Lead and mentor a small team of Data Scientists, AI Engineers and technical resources, providing clear direction, technical guidance and accountability. 
 - Translate ambiguous business problems into practical AI, analytics and engineering solutions aligned to business outcomes. 
 - Partner closely with the Digital Twin platform team to resolve environment, integration, deployment, performance and production issues. 
 - Provide sufficient technical depth to distinguish whether issues originate in the model, application, integration, data or platform layer and coordinate the appropriate resolution. 
 - Participate in solution architecture and design discussions and ensure solutions are scalable, reliable, secure and maintainable. 
 - Guide teams on API integrations, data pipelines, authentication, cloud environments, CI/CD, logging, monitoring and other production dependencies. 
 - Provide technical oversight for Machine Learning, NLP, document intelligence, Generative AI, RAG and Agentic AI solutions. 
 - Review model and AI approaches, evaluation methodology, error analysis, performance metrics and implementation trade-offs. 
 - Partner with the AI Modeling team on model development, validation, monitoring, drift detection and productionization when required. 
 - Drive root-cause analysis and corrective actions when solution accuracy, reliability or production performance is below expectations. 
 - Promote reusable frameworks, components and delivery patterns that can support multiple products and customers. 
 - Partner with Product, Business, Advisory, Engineering and Content teams to ensure technical delivery remains aligned to customer and business needs. 
 - Provide concise status updates covering progress, risks, dependencies and decisions required, and escalate issues early with recommended actions. 
 - Present technical solutions, delivery updates and recommendations clearly to senior leaders and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Support hiring, interviewing, mentoring and capability development as the AI/Data Science team grows. 

Experience

Required Qualifications

- 8+ years of progressive experience in Data Science, Machine Learning, Applied AI, AI Engineering or related technical roles. 
 - Demonstrated experience leading end-to-end delivery of production AI, Machine Learning or analytics solutions. 
 - At least 2-3 years of experience leading technical teams, workstreams or complex cross-functional initiatives. 
 - Proven ability to independently manage multiple projects or workstreams with limited supervision. 
 - Experience working with Engineering, Platform, DevOps or Cloud teams to move AI solutions into production. 
 - Experience troubleshooting production issues and coordinating resolution across multiple technical teams. 
 - Experience managing, mentoring or providing technical direction to Data Scientists and/or AI Engineers. 
 - Experience communicating technical decisions, risks and outcomes to senior stakeholders. 
 - Experience working in distributed or global teams is strongly preferred. 
 - Experience in Financial Services, Banking, Insurance, Risk, Regulatory or Compliance environments is desirable. 

Data Science & Modeling Expertise

- Strong understanding of Statistics, Machine Learning and predictive modeling concepts. 
 - Experience with regression, classification, tree-based models, ensemble methods, clustering and other common Machine Learning techniques. 
 - Strong understanding of model evaluation, validation, feature engineering, overfitting, class imbalance, data leakage and model monitoring. 
 - Ability to challenge model selection and evaluation approaches and assess trade-offs across accuracy, explainability, stability and maintainability. 
 - Understanding of model lifecycle management including development, validation, deployment, monitoring, drift detection and retraining. 
 - Experience with document intelligence, NLP or unstructured data processing is highly desirable. 
 - Experience with Generative AI, LLMs, embeddings, RAG and Agentic AI is highly desirable. 
 - Ability to determine when traditional Machine Learning, Generative AI or a hybrid approach is most appropriate. 

AI, Engineering & Platform Skills

- Strong Python skills and good SQL and data engineering fundamentals. 
 - Strong understanding of REST APIs and enterprise system integrations. 
 - Experience with Azure and/or AWS cloud environments. 
 - Good understanding of Docker, Git, CI/CD and modern software delivery practices. 
 - Working knowledge of application architecture, microservices and scalable system design. 
 - Understanding of authentication, secrets management, API security and enterprise networking concepts. 
 - Experience with logging, monitoring, troubleshooting and production support. 
 - Understanding of MLOps and/or LLMOps practices including versioning, deployment, monitoring and evaluation. 
 - Ability to work effectively with platform engineers without needing to be a dedicated platform engineer. 

Leadership Mindset

- Takes ownership of outcomes rather than limiting responsibility to assigned tasks. 
 - Works independently and moves initiatives forward even when requirements or dependencies are ambiguous. 
 - Balances business priorities, technical quality, delivery speed and long-term maintainability. 
 - Identifies risks early, performs root-cause analysis and brings solution-oriented recommendations. 
 - Challenges technical assumptions constructively and raises the quality of decisions across the team. 
 - Develops team members through technical coaching, clear expectations and meaningful feedback. 
 - Communicates confidently with Data Scientists, Engineers, Product leaders and senior business stakeholders. 
 - Can present complex technical topics in clear business language and influence decisions across teams. 
 - Remains hands-on enough to provide meaningful technical guidance while successfully leading delivery across multiple initiatives. 
 - Demonstrates strong judgment, accountability and a collaborative leadership style. 

Education

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Data Science, Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Engineering or another quantitative/technical discipline. 

Our Interview Practices

To maintain a fair and genuine hiring process, we kindly ask that all candidates participate in interviews without the assistance of AI tools or external prompts. Our interview process is designed to assess your individual skills, experiences, and communication style. We value authenticity and want to ensure we're getting to know you-not a digital assistant. To help maintain this integrity, we ask to remove virtual backgrounds and include in-person interviews in our hiring process. Please note that use of AI-generated responses or third-party support during interviews will be grounds for disqualification from the recruitment process. 

Applicants may be required to appear onsite at a Wolters Kluwer office as part of the recruitment process.

Technical Leadership

data.title: Associate Manager - Instock
data.description:
Job Description

ASSOCIATE MANAGER, IN-STOCK OPERATIONS Role Summary

The Associate Manager, In-Stock Operations leads a team of In-Stock Specialists, translating individual execution into consistent team-wide performance. You own the team's output quality, capacity, and development - setting priorities, unblocking your team, and driving the projects that move inventory health metrics forward. You are accountable for your team's results, not just your own. 

What You'll Do

- Manage a team of In-Stock Specialists (I, II, and Senior) - setting goals, assigning work, and monitoring performance against SLAs and inventory health metrics (DIO, in-stock rate). 
 - Own hiring, onboarding, performance reviews, coaching, and career development for direct reports. 
 - Run team rituals (1: 1s, stand-ups, retros) and maintain a clear view of team capacity, workload distribution, and coverage. 
 - Lead cross-functional projects end-to-end (e. g. , WBR, new brand onboarding, expiration-date programme) - defining scope, timelines, and success metrics, and coordinating across brand management, the US team, and leadership. 
 - Identify and prioritize automation and process-improvement opportunities across the team, and hold owners accountable for shipping them. 
 - Own and present WBR-level reporting and inventory health metrics to leadership, translating data into a clear narrative and action plan. 
 - Serve as the escalation point for complex vendor, catalogue, or marketplace issues that require cross-team coordination or leadership visibility. 
 - Partner with brand management and marketplace leads to align on inventory strategy and proactively manage risk. 
 - Build and maintain team documentation, training materials, and onboarding processes so the team scales without you as a bottleneck. 

What Success Looks Like

- Team consistently meets or exceeds SLAs 
 - Your team's capacity and skills grow over time - specialists are promoted, and the team absorbs more scope without proportional headcount growth. 
 - Cross-functional projects you own land on time and deliver measurable results. 
 - You spend meaningfully more time on planning, coaching, and problem-solving than on individual task execution. 

Qualifications

- 2+ years of experience in inventory operations, supply chain, or e-commerce operations, including direct ownership of core inventory processes. 
 - Prior experience managing or leading a team - formally or informally - including hiring, coaching, and performance management. 
 - Strong project management skills - able to scope, sequence, and drive cross-functional projects to completion. 
 - Deep fluency in inventory health metrics (DIO, in-stock rate) and the forecasting/ordering mechanics that drive them. 
 - Comfortable pulling and synthesizing data from multiple systems (e. g. , Snowflake, brand selling accounts) to build a narrative for leadership. 
 - Track record of identifying and shipping process or automation improvements using AI tools, scripts, or workflow automation. 
 - Experience with e-commerce marketplaces (Amazon, Chewy, Australia marketplace, or equivalent) strongly preferred. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication; able to build trust with stakeholders across functions and time zones.

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.
