data.title: Senior Associate-Front Office QA Engineer
data.description:
Job Purpose

Looking for a Data QA Engineer to lead data validation and regression testing across capital-markets data pipelines spanning legacy and modern platforms. The role will focus on ensuring data accuracy, completeness, consistency, integrity, and adherence to business rules through source-to-target validation, schema checks, reconciliation, lineage review, and automation-led regression testing. 

The candidate will build reusable Python/SQL-based validation frameworks, support batch and cloud execution, validate post-trade data flows, identify data anomalies, and partner with engineering and business teams to embed strong data-quality controls. The ideal candidate combines data QA expertise, capital-markets domain understanding, automation-first thinking, and strong ownership of data quality across environments. 

Key Responsibilities

- Perform source-to-target data validation across legacy and modern systems, including SQL Server and cloud-based data environments. 
 - Validate data accuracy, completeness, consistency, timeliness, duplication handling, referential integrity, schema structures, metadata, lineage, and business-rule conformance. 
 - Build and maintain automation-first regression testing frameworks using Python, PySpark, SQL, and reusable validation utilities. 
 - Execute field-level, dataset-level, transformation-level, and aggregate-level data checks across source, staging, warehouse, data lake, and downstream systems. 
 - Validate ETL/ELT pipelines, post-trade data flows, stored procedures, batch jobs, and cloud-based execution workflows. 
 - Perform testing of derivative products and workflows including Options, Swaps, Futures, and Forwards. 
 - Validate business workflows covering bonds, treasuries, corporate debt, and other fixed income instruments
 - Verify trade booking, valuations, cashflows, margin processing, lifecycle events, and settlement workflows across asset classes. 
 - Design reusable test cases, validation scenarios, reconciliation checks, automated scripts, and regression packs for repeatable data-quality assurance. 
 - Write, optimize, and troubleshoot complex SQL queries and stored procedures across SQL Server, Oracle, PostgreSQL, or similar platforms. 
 - Translate business rules, stored procedure logic, and post-trade process flows into automated validation scripts and assertions. 
 - Build Python-based utilities, APIs, CLI tools, and reusable frameworks to support data validation, orchestration, API integrations, and reporting workflows. 
 - Integrate regression tests, data validation checks, SQL deployables, and quality gates into CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, Jenkins, GitLab, or equivalent tools. 
 - Automate execution of AutoSys jobs, batch processes, stored procedures, and validation scripts across development, UAT, and production environments. 
 - Work with engineering teams to embed data quality controls into pipelines, releases, and operational workflows. 
 - Identify data anomalies, schema mismatches, duplicate records, null-handling issues, transformation failures, reconciliation breaks, and integrity violations. 
 - Log defects with clear evidence, impact analysis, root-cause observations, and business context. 
 - Support capital markets and post-trade validation across allocations, clearing, settlement, confirmations, reconciliations, market data, reference data, and downstream reporting. 

Key competencies

- 5-7 years of hands-on experience in Data QA, Data Engineering QA, or Python-based automation roles. 
 - Atleast basic domain knowledge of Capital Markets with expertise in Fixed Income products and workflows
 - Strong Python skills for data validation, automation framework development, regression testing, and pipeline verification. 
 - Working knowledge of PySpark for validating large-scale data pipelines and distributed datasets. 
 - Solid SQL skills for source-to-target validation, reconciliation, complex queries, stored procedures, schema checks, and defect analysis. 
 - Experience in data QA, ETL/ELT testing, data pipeline testing, and regression testing across legacy and modern platforms. 
 - Proven experience building automation-first regression frameworks, reusable validation scripts, test cases, and data verification utilities. 
 - Strong understanding of data quality dimensions including accuracy, completeness, consistency, timeliness, uniqueness, referential integrity, and business-rule conformance. 
 - Experience validating metadata, schema structures, data types, constraints, lineage, transformation logic, and downstream outputs. 
 - Exposure to CI/CD tools such as Azure DevOps, Jenkins, or GitLab, with the ability to integrate automated tests and quality gates into deployment pipelines. 
 - Familiarity with batch orchestration tools such as AutoSys, Control-M, or Airflow. 
 - Good analytical skills to understand post-trade, financial, market data, or reference data and translate them into repeatable validation scenarios. 
 - Experience with JIRA, XRay, agile delivery practices, defect management, and QA process governance. 
 - Proficiency in leveraging AI-assisted tools such as Claude or GitHub Copilot to accelerate test case generation, SQL development, data validation, defect analysis, documentation, and test data creation. 
 - Strong communication, problem-solving, attention to detail, and cross-functional collaboration skills. 

Nice to Have

- Exposure to Azure, AWS, ADF, containers, Kubernetes, or cloud-based data platforms. 
 - Experience with relational and NoSQL databases such as SQL Server, MongoDB, Cassandra, DynamoDB, or similar platforms. 
 - Exposure to Hadoop, Spark, Databricks, cloud data lakes, and Big Data validation. 
 - Experience validating batch, streaming, real-time, and Kafka-based ingestion pipelines. 
 - Capital markets domain exposure, especially post-trade, market data, reference data, trade data, or ION/blotter platform integrations. 
 - Exposure to DevSecOps, infrastructure as code, and code quality tools such as Terraform, Bicep, Sonar, Mend, or ZAP.

We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that's you we would love to have you join us!

Job Description

Position Summary

Job Summary

As the Intelligent Packaged Power (IPP) SW/FW Engineering Team Lead, you will lead the IPP software and firmware engineering resources based in Pune. Your scope will include the LVMCC Software Engineering Team and the MVB Firmware Engineering Team. You will combine people leadership, technical direction, and execution leadership to allow secure, reliable, and high-quality embedded firmware and industrial software solutions. You will work in partnership with the designated Scrum Masters. You will collaborate with global teams, including engineering, product management, quality, cybersecurity, test, and operations teams. These collaborations will align priorities, manage dependencies, and deliver integrated solutions for IPP products and platforms. 

You will report to the Global Engineering Director - IPP and will work in hybrid schedule based in Pune, Hinjewadi. 

Your Responsibilities

- Lead the Pune-based IPP software and firmware engineering teams, creating clear priorities, engagement, accountability, and understanding of IPP goals. 
 - Provide daily leadership for the LVMCC Software Engineering Team and MVB Firmware Engineering Team, balancing people leadership with hands-on technical guidance and delivery ownership. 
 - Coach engineers in technical capability, career development, and professional growth while building a culture of inclusion, learning, collaboration, and engineering excellence. 
 - Partner with global engineering leaders and product team members to translate product roadmaps and customer needs into executable software and firmware plans, staffing priorities, and delivery commitments. 
 - Support planning and execution, remove organisational impediments, manage cross-team dependencies, and lead predictable delivery and continuous improvement. 
 - Promote disciplined engineering practices across architecture, requirements, design, coding, peer review, configuration management, verification, validation, release, and lifecycle support. 
 - Champion quality, functional safety, product security, DevOps, automated testing, and CI/CD practices appropriate for industrial software and embedded firmware development. 
 - Coordinate across distributed teams, including hardware, systems, test, quality, cybersecurity, product management, and manufacturing engineering. 
 - Monitor project health, capacity, technical risks, defects, and delivery performance; communicate clear status, decisions, trade-offs, and escalations to stakeholders. 
 - Support hiring, onboarding, resource planning, succession planning, and capability development for the Pune SW/FW organization. 
 - Guide reuse, common architectures, tools, and engineering methods across LVMCC and MVB while respecting product-specific technical and regulatory requirements. 
 - Foster customer-focused innovation and identify opportunities to improve product value, engineering efficiency, maintainability, and speed to market. 

The Essentials - You Will Have

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Electronic & Communication, Embedded Systems, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - Minimum 7 years of relevant software or firmware engineering experience, including at least 2 years in a team leadership, people leadership, technical leadership, or engineering management role. 
 - Experience leading, coaching, software and/or firmware engineers in a product development environment. 
 - Experience delivering industrial software, embedded firmware, controls, automation, power electronics, motor control, or other complex engineered products. 
 - Working knowledge of modern software and firmware development lifecycles, requirements management, architecture, coding practices, testing, defect management, and release processes. 
 - Experience working in Agile development environments with product owners and cross-functional engineering stakeholders. 
 - Legal authorization to work in India. 

The Preferred - You Might Also Have

- Master's degree in a relevant engineering or technical field. 
 - Experience leading both application software and embedded firmware teams. 
 - Knowledge of low-voltage motor control centers, medium-voltage products, drives, motor control, power distribution, or industrial automation systems. 
 - Experience with Rockwell Automation platforms, IntelliCENTER solutions, FactoryTalk software, Logix-based systems, or connected industrial products. 
 - Experience with embedded C/C++, real-time operating systems, industrial communications, desktop or web application development, and software integration. 
 - Familiarity with DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, automated build and test environments, source control, static analysis, and engineering metrics. 
 - Knowledge of product cybersecurity, secure development lifecycle practices, functional safety, or relevant industrial standards. 
 - Experience managing external partners, contractors, or globally distributed development teams. 
 - Agile, project management, or engineering leadership certification. 

What We Offer

Our benefits package includes . . . 

- Comprehensive mindfulness programs with a premium membership to Calm
 - Volunteer Paid Time off available after 6 months of employment for eligible employees. 
 - Company volunteer and donation matching programme - Your volunteer hours or personal cash donations to an eligible charity can be matched with a charitable donation. 
 - Employee Assistance Program
 - Personalised wellbeing programmes through our OnTrack programme
 - On-demand digital course library for professional development
 - and other local benefits!

At Rockwell Automation we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right person for this or other roles. 

Rockwell Automation's hybrid policy aligns that employees are expected to work at a Rockwell location at least Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays unless they have a business obligation out of the office.

data.title: Associate Director, Software Engineering Specialist
data.description:
Some careers shine brighter than others. 

If you're looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC and fulfil your potential. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further. 

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions. 

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Associate Director, Software Engineering Specialist

Why HSBC

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world. Guided by our purpose of opening up a world of opportunity, our ambition is to become the world's most trusted bank globally, putting customers at the heart of everything we do. 

The Opportunity

This role shapes the end-to-end design and delivery of resilient cloud-native data platforms and microservices. You'll set technical direction across modernisation of legacy estates while staying close enough to the code to unblock teams and strengthen engineering quality in Java and distributed system design. The focus spans high-performance data pipelines, event-driven integration and production-ready operational standards in a regulated environment. Success means services that are scalable, observable and secure with clear roadmaps that reduce risk and disruption to live operations. You'll influence senior stakeholders by translating business outcomes into pragmatic technical plans and measurable milestones. 

What you'll be doing

- Own solution architecture for high-performance data pipelines and microservices including resilience, scalability, latency, observability and security
 - Define modernisation roadmaps across re-platforming, refactoring and microservices decomposition with minimal disruption to live services
 - Establish engineering standards for API design, event-driven integration, data modelling, testing strategy, CI/CD and operational readiness
 - Manage technical debt through clear prioritisation and measurable outcomes
 - Architect, design and build core services using Java (8+), Spring Boot 3, JPA and PostgreSQL (or other RDBMS) using event streaming patterns
 - Deliver real-time processing implementations using Apache Flink and/or Apache Beam where appropriate
 - Partner with engineers on code reviews, pair debugging, performance tuning and production incident resolution
 - Own operational excellence on GCP across monitoring, alerting, capacity planning, reliability improvements and cost optimisation

What we're looking for

- Bring substantial software engineering experience designing and delivering distributed systems and data-intensive applications
 - Demonstrate recent hands-on Java engineering expertise using Spring Boot with REST and event-driven services
 - Apply proven system design across microservices patterns, asynchronous messaging, idempotency, consistency models, caching, rate limiting and failure handling
 - Show strong SQL capability including performance tuning and working effectively with ORM frameworks such as JPA/Hibernate
 - Deliver cloud-native solutions on GCP or an equivalent cloud platform with the ability to translate patterns and services
 - Troubleshoot across application, data, infrastructure and performance layers to restore service quickly and prevent recurrence
 - Communicate architecture decisions clearly and connect them to business priorities and operational constraints
 - Coach and mentor engineers across levels to strengthen craftsmanship, accountability and continuous improvement

Building resilient data services

If you want to shape modern cloud-native platforms while staying hands-on with Java engineering this role offers real scope to make a visible difference. You'll set direction for microservices and data pipelines that need to perform under demanding production conditions. The work spans architecture, delivery and operational excellence so improvements show up in reliability, scalability and engineering efficiency. If this aligns with the kind of platform work you want to own we'd welcome your application. 

You'll achieve more when you join HSBC. 

www. hsbc. com/careers

HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc. , We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role. "

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website. 

Issued by - HSBC Software Development India

data.title: Software Development Engineer - 3
data.description:
AssetPlus is redefining the future of wealth management. We're a fast-scaling SaaS fintech platform powering mutual fund distributors (MFDs) and financial advisors with tools that modernise how investments are managed. Our mission is to build India's best assisted wealth management platform, helping millions of households achieve their financial goals. 

Engineering at AssetPlus is a growth led, high-velocity team of ~18 engineers organized into three product pods. We ship on a modern, AI-enabled Node. js + TypeScript + MongoDB stack, own our systems in production, and hold a high technical and cultural bar. If you want to solve meaningful problems at scale with real ownership, this is the place. 

The Role

We are looking for a deeply hands-on SDE-3 who owns features end-to-end and raises the quality bar within a pod. You bring strong technical judgment, speed, clarity and simplicity to everything you build. You will be a core builder inside one product pod: designing services, writing production Node. js + TypeScript, shaping MongoDB schemas, debugging across backend, React and Flutter, and keeping the systems you own reliable. You will use AI as a cognitive partner to move faster without lowering the bar. 

Key Responsibilities

Architecture & Systems

- Design and build scalable, resilient services within your pod's domain. 
 - Contribute to system design reviews and argue trade-offs with first-principles reasoning. 
 - Decide what to build vs reuse vs adopt open-source, and explain the call. 
 - Follow and strengthen the architecture patterns the team has agreed on. 

Hands-On Engineering

- Write high-quality Node. js + TypeScript code - readable, tested, production-grade. 
 - Design efficient MongoDB schemas and build complex aggregations. 
 - Debug issues across React, Flutter and Backend, down to the infra and DB layer. 
 - Leverage AI capabilities and develop at a high pace with good taste. 

AI Driven Engineering

- Use AI as a cognitive partner to accelerate coding, debugging, design and decision-making. 
 - Orchestrate models, tools, context and workflows into a productive AI-powered engineering loop. 
 - Continuously adopt new AI capabilities to compound speed and improve system quality. 
 - Bring AI native practices into your pod's day-to-day workflow. 

Reliability & Support

- Monitor the systems you own and catch issues early. 
 - Respond to critical incidents with urgency - including off-hours when it matters. 
 - Drive root-cause analysis, performance improvements and observability. 

Developer Experience & Quality

- Contribute to improving developer workflows, tooling and automation. 
 - Maintain high standards around clarity, testing, security and simplicity. 
 - Advocate for minimal, robust and maintainable engineering. 

Leadership & Collaboration

- Mentor junior and mid-level engineers and review their work closely. 
 - Communicate decisions clearly and confidently. 
 - Be approachable, energetic and easy to build with. 

What we are looking for; 

Must have

- 6-8 years of full stack experience with a backend-heavy core (experience range is indicative - we hire for ownership, not tenure)
 - Strong Node. js + TypeScript in production; you have owned services end-to-end, not just contributed
 - Solid MongoDB - schema design, indexing, complex aggregations
 - Built and operated systems under real load; comfortable being on the hook when they break
 - Strong debugging across backend, frontend and DB layer
 - Pragmatic engineering judgment - simple > clever; sound build vs reuse vs open-source calls
 - Strong communicator - can clearly explain a system you owned and the decisions behind it

Strongly Preferred

- Hands-on AWS - CloudWatch, ECS, Amplify, Lambda, SQS, SES
 - React and/or Flutter exposure - enough to debug across the stack
 - Fintech, wealth-tech or SEBI-regulated product experience
 - Daily use of AI coding tools as a real productivity multiplier, not a novelty
 - Experience mentoring juniors and running meaningful code reviews
 - CI/CD, Docker and GitHub-based workflows in a fast-shipping team

data.title: Senior Engineer - Full Stack
data.description:
Why Ryan?

- Global Award-Winning Culture
 - Flexible Work Environment
 - Generous Paid Time Off
 - World-Class Benefits and Compensation
 - Rapid Growth Opportunities
 - Company Sponsored Two-Way Transportation
 - Exponential Career Growth

As a Senior Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in designing, developing, and delivering robust, scalable, and secure artificial intelligence (AI)-driven software systems. You will own complex components, lead critical feature implementation, and promote engineering best practices within your squad. You will help connect high-level design with detailed implementation through active participation in solution design, system integration, evaluation, and continuous improvement. 

You will collaborate with cross-functional teams, contribute to architectural discussions, and help ensure AI solutions align with user needs, business goals, safety expectations, and performance constraints. Success in this position requires hands-on engineering expertise, strong ownership, and the ability to work independently and collaboratively. 

Duties And Responsibilities

Software Design and Development

- Translate business needs into agentic workflows and production-ready full-stack components, including application programming interfaces (APIs), services, and user interfaces (UIs). 
 - Design and document functional and technical specifications for mid-sized to large components. 
 - Implement agent orchestration, tool use, and integrations with a strong focus on correctness, safety, and reliability. 
 - Implement and review high-quality code using modern software development practices. 
 - Conduct design and code reviews with an emphasis on performance, scalability, and maintainability. 

Applications Integration and Middleware

- Integrate enterprise applications and services using APIs and middleware solutions. 
 - Conduct feasibility assessments and support application interoperability testing. 
 - Troubleshoot integration issues and support the optimization of connected systems. 

Cloud, DevOps, and Configuration

- Develop software and participate in deployments within Microsoft Azure cloud environments. 
 - Configure platform-specific deployment scripts and troubleshoot build and release issues. 
 - Participate in infrastructure-as-code practices and cloud performance tuning. 

Testing and Automation

- Define evaluation strategies for agent behavior, including golden datasets, regression suites, scenario coverage, and reliability checks. 
 - Instrument and monitor agent behavior, including tool-call traces, latency and cost metrics, and failure modes, and drive iterative improvements. 
 - Design and execute complex unit, integration, and automated test cases. 
 - Analyze and resolve test failures, propose code fixes, and contribute to automation frameworks. 
 - Collaborate with quality assurance and DevOps teams to enhance continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines. 

Architecture Support

- Assist in translating high-level architecture into low-level designs. 
 - Develop and maintain design artifacts under the guidance of architects and staff engineers. 
 - Understand existing system architecture and communicate trade-offs during design sessions. 

Collaboration and Execution

- Work closely with product managers, user experience (UX) designers, and business stakeholders. 
 - Contribute to project planning and estimation for features and enhancements. 
 - Lead technical discussions, mentor junior engineers, and support knowledge sharing. 

Required Competencies

Technical Strength

- Demonstrates a deep understanding of core programming concepts, system design principles, and application performance optimization. 
 - Has hands-on experience building agentic systems with large language models (LLMs), including tool use, orchestration, multistep flows, and verification and validation patterns. 
 - Is proficient in one or more agentic frameworks, such as LangChain/LangGraph, the OpenAI Agents Software Development Kit (SDK), Microsoft Semantic Kernel, Microsoft AutoGen, or CrewAI. 
 - Is proficient in writing clean, efficient, and maintainable code using at least one modern full-stack technology stack. Experience with frameworks in the . NET ecosystem and ReactJS is a plus. 
 - Can debug complex issues and propose effective solutions with minimal guidance. 

Solution Ownership

- Demonstrates end-to-end ownership of features or components from design through deployment. 
 - Proactively anticipates risks, raises concerns early, and takes accountability for resolving them. 
 - Breaks down complex problems into actionable technical work. 
 - Reviews code to confirm functionality, identify potential solutions and unexpected side effects, and ensure conformance with documented standards. 

Collaboration and Influence

- Communicates technical ideas clearly across teams and stakeholder groups. 
 - Builds strong partnerships with quality assurance, DevOps, Product, and other engineering teams. 
 - Provides constructive feedback during code and design reviews and effectively mentors junior engineers. 

Execution Excellence

- Consistently delivers high-quality, tested, and secure code. 
 - Prioritizes work effectively and executes in alignment with sprint goals and timelines. 
 - Manages competing tasks and changing priorities with discipline. 

Continuous Improvement

- Actively contributes to improving team processes, standards, and tools. 
 - Stays current on new technologies and applies relevant practices when appropriate. 
 - Seeks feedback and adapts to strengthen performance and technical expertise. 

What You Bring

- Six to nine years of software engineering experience, with a strong record of building production-grade systems. 
 - Demonstrated experience delivering AI- and LLM-powered features, including agents, agentic frameworks, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), tool calling, and workflow automation, within real user workflows. 
 - Proficiency in at least one modern full-stack technology stack, data stores such as Structured Query Language (SQL) and NoSQL databases, Redis, containerization, Kubernetes, and Azure cloud-native services. 
 - Strong knowledge of data structures, design patterns, and system integration techniques. 
 - Hands-on experience with CI/CD, containers such as Docker, and cloud services such as Amazon Web Services (AWS) and Microsoft Azure. 
 - Demonstrated ability to design, test, and debug complex systems in a collaborative environment. 
 - Strong attention to detail and the ability to work with a large codebase. 
 - A proactive mindset and the ability to work independently while managing competing priorities. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to document and present technical concepts clearly. 
 - Recognizes when progress has stalled and asks for help or confirmation when appropriate. 

Why Join Us?

You will join a company where innovation creates real-world impact. We are building meaningful solutions, and your expertise will help shape the future of our platform. You can expect a collaborative environment, knowledgeable colleagues, and opportunities to influence technical and business decisions that matter.

6-10 years in application development, with strong hands-on experience building intuitive Power Apps canvas apps, designing scalable Power Automate workflows, and implementing Dataverse solutions including the security model - plus working knowledge of integrating AI agents and Copilot capabilities into Power Platform solutions

Role Summary

Avanade India's Business Applications practice is seeking a Power Apps Tech Lead to lead the design and delivery of enterprise-grade solutions across Power Apps, Power Automate and Dataverse. This is a hands-on build role for someone who takes a business process and turns it into a canvas app people find easy and fast to use, backed by a properly designed Dataverse model and automation that holds up in production. 

You will own features end to end - data model, app, automation, integration and security - on delivery teams alongside architects, business analysts and client stakeholders. We also expect you to bring AI into the solution where it earns its place: embedding Copilot and agent capabilities in canvas apps and the wider Power Platform estate, rather than treating AI as a separate project. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design and build intuitive, user-friendly Power Apps canvas apps - screen and navigation design, responsive layouts, reusable components, delegation-aware data access and performance tuning. 
 - Turn business requirements and user journeys into working applications, taking ownership of usability and of how the app performs with real data volumes. 
 - Design and implement scalable Power Automate workflows - cloud flows, child flows, error handling and retry patterns, approvals, scheduled and event-driven processing, and concurrency and throughput considerations. 
 - Design and implement Dataverse solutions: tables, columns and relationships, alternate keys, calculated and rollup fields, and business rules. 
 - Design and implement the Dataverse security model - security roles, teams, business units, and row-level and column-level security - and validate that users see only what they should. 
 - Integrate AI agents and Copilot capabilities into canvas apps and related Power Platform solutions, including Copilot Studio agents, AI Builder models and prompt-based actions, with attention to grounding, accuracy and appropriate use. 
 - Integrate solutions with external systems and Microsoft 365 services using standard and custom connectors, Power Automate and APIs. 
 - Apply Power Platform ALM properly - solutions, managed and unmanaged layers, environment variables, connection references, and deployment through pipelines or Azure DevOps. 
 - Troubleshoot, tune and resolve defects across apps, flows and Dataverse, including performance and delegation issues. 
 - Follow Power Platform governance, licensing, data loss prevention and security best practice, and design within the client's environment strategy. 
 - Produce technical documentation, solution designs and handover material, and support testing, UAT, deployment and release activities. 
 - Work with business stakeholders, architects and developers to shape practical solutions, and guide junior developers on the team. 

Required Skills & Experience

- 6-10 years of overall application development experience, with a substantial recent focus on the Microsoft Power Platform. 
 - Strong hands-on experience building Power Apps canvas apps that users find intuitive - component reuse, responsive design, Power Fx, collections and variables, delegation and performance optimisation. 
 - Strong experience designing and implementing scalable Power Automate workflows, including error handling, child flows, approvals and long-running or high-volume patterns. 
 - Proven Dataverse implementation experience: tables, columns and relationships, alternate keys, calculated and rollup fields, and business rules. 
 - Practical command of the Dataverse security model - security roles, teams, business units, and row-level and column-level security - and the ability to design it for a real organizational structure. 
 - Working knowledge of integrating AI agents and Copilot capabilities with canvas apps and Power Platform solutions (Copilot Studio, AI Builder or equivalent). 
 - Experience integrating with external systems and Microsoft 365 services through standard and custom connectors and APIs. 
 - Understanding of Power Platform ALM - solutions, environment variables, connection references and automated deployment. 
 - Awareness of Power Platform governance, licensing implications and DLP policies. 
 - Ability to debug and performance-tune apps and flows, and to resolve defects through to closure. 
 - Good client-facing communication - running requirement discussions and demos, and explaining design decisions clearly. 

Qualifications

Preferred / Good to Have

- Experience with model-driven apps, Power Pages or Power BI alongside canvas apps. 
 - Experience building Copilot Studio agents in depth - topics, actions, knowledge sources and channel deployment. 
 - Custom code extension skills: PCF components, JavaScript, C# plug-ins or Azure Functions.

data.title: Lead AI Architect nterprise Transformation
data.description:
Organization OverviewCompany Description

QAD | Redzone is building an enterprise AI platform to support AI-enabled and agentic workflows across the organisation. The AI Centre of Excellence (CoE) is accountable for turning that ambition into deployed, measured, production workflows across priority business functions. 

The CoE is small, senior and high-leverage. It combines architecture and engineering with a set of functional AI Engagement Specialists who own the demand side: what gets built, why it is worth building, whether anyone uses it, and whether it actually works once live. 

Job Description

We are looking for a Lead AI Architect to own the technical architecture underpinning this transformation - from translating business and product requirements into implementable system designs, to defining the reusable platform capabilities, technology choices and engineering standards required to build and operate AI solutions at scale. 

This is a hands-on architecture leadership role. You will work across the AI CoE, enterprise architecture, engineering teams, business functions and implementation partners to ensure individual AI solutions are built on a coherent, scalable and maintainable foundation rather than as disconnected point solutions. 

The distinguishing challenge here is not building one impressive AI workflow. It is building the second, fifth and twentieth at a fraction of the cost of the first, on infrastructure that survives contact with real enterprise identity, real permissions, real data quality and real production incidents. 

Where this role sits

Reports to: Head of the AI Centre of Excellence

Alignment: Dotted line to QAD engineering architecture; close partnership with Enterprise Architecture, Security & GRC, Data & Platform Engineering, and Product

Technical leadership of: The CoE engineering team (Senior AI Engineer and subsequent hires) and the engineering capacity provided by system integrators and cloud partners

Primary internal customers: The functional AI Engagement Specialists who own the workflow pipeline and PRDs for the business functions in scope

Team size: No direct reports at hire; technical authority across an internal and partner engineering group. Line management may follow as the CoE scales. 

What You Will Own

Architecture and platform direction

- Own the enterprise AI reference architecture, defining the target-state architecture and the MVP or "golden path" required to begin delivering priority AI workflows while the broader platform evolves. 
 - Translate workflow requirements and PRDs into build-ready technical architecture - system boundaries, source systems, APIs and integrations, data requirements, identity and access, user and consumption layers, orchestration, and non-functional requirements. Closing the gap between a high-level PRD and a design detailed enough to generate development stories is an explicit, named responsibility of this role. 
 - Make and govern key architecture decisions across infrastructure, data, integration, semantic layer, AI and LLM services, agent orchestration, state and memory, application layers and deployment architecture - and record them, with rationale and revisit triggers, as durable decision records. 
 - Define what is reusable enterprise capability versus workflow-specific build, and where capability should be centralised versus federated, balancing scalability against speed to value. 
 - Lead platform and technology selection, evaluating options on functional fit, existing enterprise capability, build and migration effort, total cost of ownership, operating complexity, the skills required to sustain the platform, security, regulatory requirements and vendor lock-in. 
 - Draw the boundary between internal enterprise workflow and productisable capability. In a software company, some of what the CoE builds will be a candidate for the product. Design so that boundary remains crossable rather than discovering later that an internal tool cannot be productised without a rewrite. 
 - Continuously evolve the architecture as new use cases, products and capabilities emerge - avoiding premature complexity while ensuring near-term decisions do not constrain the longer-term platform. 

Delivery and production readiness

- Drive the foundational platform build in parallel with workflow delivery, identifying the minimum non-negotiable capabilities required before solutions can safely reach production rather than waiting for the complete target platform. 
 - Establish production architecture and engineering standards covering development, test and production environments, CI/CD, logging, monitoring, AI and application observability, tracing, state and memory, human-agent handoffs, and operational support. 
 - Own the technical approach to AI operations - model and agent lifecycle management, evaluation, drift, reliability, observability, and cost and usage management. 
 - Own evaluation as an architectural concern. Define how quality and correctness are specified, measured, regression-tested and monitored, and make evaluation infrastructure a first-class platform capability rather than something each workflow reinvents. 
 - Design the human-in-the-loop and escalation model at the architecture level: where a human must approve, where an agent may act autonomously, how handoffs preserve context, and how reversal or remediation works when an agent gets it wrong. 
 - Own the cost architecture. Establish unit economics per workflow, model routing and tiering, caching strategy, token budgets, and the telemetry required for the business to see what each workflow costs to run. 

Data, identity and integration

- Architect the data and integration foundations required by AI workflows - APIs, semantic and translation layers, metadata, data access patterns, and appropriate reuse of existing enterprise platforms. 
 - Solve identity, delegated authority and traceability for agents. Design how an agent acts on behalf of a user across multiple systems under least privilege, how roles and permissions propagate into retrieval and tool invocation, and how every action is attributable to a human or an agent in an auditable trail. This is among the hardest problems in the architecture and is squarely owned by this role. 
 - Design for multi-tenancy and data isolation where AI capability touches customer data or customer-facing surfaces. 

Governance and technical leadership

- Set architecture guardrails for security and responsible AI, partnering with existing Security, GRC and enterprise architecture functions rather than recreating them inside the AI team. 
 - Provide technical leadership to the AI engineering team and implementation partners - reviewing designs, resolving trade-offs, and ensuring builds conform to the reference architecture. You remain the internal technical authority even where significant engineering capacity is supplied by SIs or cloud partners. 
 - Run architecture conformance review for partner-delivered work, with the standing and the willingness to reject a design that will not survive production. 

Qualifications

What we are looking for

Essential

- 10+ years across software, platform, cloud, data or enterprise architecture, including meaningful experience architecting production AI/ML or GenAI systems - systems with real users, real failure modes and real operating cost, not pilots. 
 - Deep understanding of modern AI and agentic architectures: LLM platforms and model selection, agent orchestration, tool and API invocation, RAG and context architecture (chunking, hybrid retrieval, reranking, grounding, freshness), semantic layers, state and memory, evaluation and observability. 
 - Strong experience with at least one major cloud ecosystem - AWS and/or GCP - with the ability to evaluate services across platforms objectively rather than defending a favourite. 
 - Strong foundation in distributed systems and enterprise system engineering: APIs, integration patterns, authentication and authorisation, data architecture, application architecture, DevOps and CI/CD, and production operations. 
 - Experience designing architectures that span multiple enterprise applications and heterogeneous data sources, including systems you do not control. 
 - Ability to reason rigorously through build versus buy, reuse versus new capability, cost versus performance, and MVP versus target state - and to explain the reasoning to people who will be affected by it. 
 - Experience taking ambiguous business requirements through technical discovery into implementable designs. 
 - Non-functional design judgement: latency, availability, cost, failure modes, graceful degradation, and what happens when the model provider has an outage. 
 - Comfortable operating cross-functionally across engineering teams, vendors and stakeholders to hold alignment across design and delivery. 
 - Strong communication, with the ability to make complex architecture choices understandable to both technical and business leaders - and to say no to a bad idea without losing the relationship. 
 - Hands-on technical depth: able to inspect designs, APIs, data structures, prototypes and code, and credibly guide engineers. 

Strongly Preferred

- Enterprise SaaS products, multi-tenant platforms, or customer-facing AI applications. 
 - ERP, manufacturing, supply chain or industrial software domain exposure. 
 - Semantic and metadata platforms; building shared AI capability consumed by multiple products or business functions. 
 - Experience delivering through system integrators and cloud partners while retaining architectural control. 
 - Having taken an organisation through the second wave - the transition from a successful pilot to a repeatable production pattern, which is where most enterprise AI programmes stall. 
 - Familiarity with emerging interoperability standards for tools and agents (for example MCP and equivalent protocols), and a considered view of what to adopt and what to wait out. 
 - Experience in a security-sensitive or regulated environment. 

The technical environment

You will work in a predominantly AWS estate with a meaningful GCP footprint, alongside multi-tenant SaaS products, ERP and manufacturing data, and a heterogeneous set of enterprise systems across CRM, support, services delivery, marketing and data platforms. Engineering capacity is a mix of internal team and external implementation partners. 

We are deliberately not prescribing a fixed AI toolchain in this job description. Selecting it - defensibly, with the operating model and skills required to sustain it - is part of the mandate. 

What This Role Is Not

- Not an advisory or strategy role. You will produce designs that engineers build from, not decks that recommend that someone else produce them. 
 - Not a people-management-first role. Leadership here is technical authority earned through design quality and judgement. 
 - Not a role that delegates the thinking to a partner. SIs will provide capacity; the architecture stays in-house. 
 - Not a research role. The bar is production systems, operating cost and reliability - not novelty. 

What Success Looks Like

First 3-6 months

- A clear enterprise AI reference architecture and MVP architecture, with documented design principles and decision guardrails. 
 - Priority AI workflows converted into implementable system designs, enabling engineering to move from PRD into build without a translation gap. 
 - The foundational capabilities required to support the first production AI workflows delivered, alongside a repeatable architecture for subsequent waves. 
 - Common patterns established for integration, identity and access, data and semantic services, orchestration, observability, evaluation and operations. 
 - A sustainable model for operating, monitoring, maintaining and evolving AI applications after launch. 
 - Recognition as the internal technical authority for the AI transformation, with internal engineers and external partners building against one coherent architecture. 

First 12 months

- A golden path that measurably shortens the build time and cost of each successive workflow, with evidence from at least two subsequent waves. 
 - Known and improving unit economics - the business can see what each workflow costs to run, and that number is trending in the right direction. 
 - Architecture conformance functioning as a real gate, with partner-delivered work reviewed against the standard. 
 - No critical production incident attributable to a foreseeable architectural gap in identity, data access, evaluation or operational readiness. 
 - A credible, sequenced view of the next twelve months of platform evolution, endorsed by enterprise architecture and security. 

How We Assess

- Portfolio conversation - walk us through an AI or platform architecture you owned end to end, including what you got wrong. 
 - Working session - a live architecture discussion on one of our actual prioritised workflows. We are interested in how you interrogate the problem, not in a polished answer. 
 - Depth probe - detailed technical examination of one system you designed, down to data flow, identity model and failure handling. 
 - Stakeholder interview - how you communicate trade-offs and hold a position with senior non-technical leaders. 

Additional Information

Qualification

- Your health and well being are important to us at QAD. We provide programs that help you strike a healthy work-life balance. 
 - Opportunity to join a growing business, launching into its next phase of expansion and transformation. 
 - Collaborative culture of smart and hard-working people who support one another to get the job done. 
 - An atmosphere of growth and opportunity, where idea-sharing is always prioritized over level or hierarchy. 
 - Compensation packages based on experience and desired skill set

About QAD

QAD | Redzone is redefining manufacturing and supply chains through its intelligent, adaptive platform that connects people, processes, and data into a single System of Action. With three core pillars - Redzone (frontline empowerment), Adaptive Applications (the intelligent backbone), and Champion AI (Agentic AI for manufacturing) - QAD | Redzone helps manufacturers operate with Champion Pace, achieving measurable productivity, resilience, and growth in just 90 days. 

QAD is committed to ensuring that every employee feels they work in an environment that values their contributions, respects their unique perspectives and provides opportunities for growth regardless of background. QAD's DEI program is driving higher levels of diversity, equity and inclusion so that employees can bring their whole self to work. 

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, sex, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, status as a veteran, and basis of disability or any other federal, state or local protected class.

Title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer- I : FinOps

Location: Noida, Hybrid

Sumo Logic's FinOps team makes every dollar of cloud and AI spend visible, attributable and optimizable. That means building, running and improving the tooling behind our cost decisions, from cost data pipelines and dashboards to unit-economics and allocation reporting. data.title: Inside Sales Team Lead
data.description:
About the job

Inside Sales Team Lead - International B2B Sales

Company: Beverage Trade NetworkLocation: Vadodara, Gujarat, IndiaJob Type: Full-Time |

On-SiteDepartment: International Sales

Company DescriptionBeverage Trade Network (BTN) is a global B2B media, events, and business

services company connecting beverage, wine, spirits, beer, and non-alcoholic drink producers with

buyers, importers, distributors, and industry professionals worldwide. BTN organizes international

trade shows, industry events, and competitions in the USA, UK, and other global markets, helping

businesses build connections, gain market exposure, and grow their sales. 

Role DescriptionWe are looking for an experienced and hands-on Inside Sales Team Lead to manage, 

train, and develop a team of international B2B telesales executives. 

This is a sales leadership role focused on driving revenue through outbound calling, lead generation, 

pipeline management, and sales conversions. The team will primarily sell exhibition stands, trade

show participation packages, and other B2B services to international businesses. 

The ideal candidate must have strong personal telesales experience, proven experience leading a

telesales team, and the ability to train representatives, monitor sales calls, improve conversion rates, 

and consistently achieve team revenue targets. We are looking for someone who understands how to

run a structured, KPI-driven telesales operation and can actively work with representatives to

improve their sales performance. 

Key Responsibilities

Team Management & Sales Performance

● Manage a team of 5-10 inside sales executives handling international B2B sales. 

● Set and monitor daily, weekly, and monthly calling, lead generation, conversion, and revenue

targets. 

● Conduct daily sales huddles, review individual performance, and ensure accountability. 

● Monitor sales pipelines, follow-ups, and closing opportunities to ensure revenue targets are

achieved. 

● Identify underperforming representatives and implement structured performance

improvement plans. 

Sales Training & Call Monitoring

● Train new and existing sales representatives on outbound calling, prospecting, qualification, 

objection handling, follow-ups, and closing techniques. 

● Regularly listen to live and recorded sales calls to evaluate sales quality and effectiveness. 

● Provide individual coaching and actionable feedback to improve call quality and conversion

rates. ● Develop and improve sales scripts, opening pitches, objection-handling techniques, and

closing approaches. 

● Conduct mock calls, role-playing exercises, and regular sales training sessions. 

● Lead by example by making sales calls and demonstrating effective sales techniques when

required. 

International Outbound Sales

● Guide the team in prospecting and selling to international customers, particularly in the USA, 

UK, Europe, and other markets. 

● Ensure representatives effectively connect with business owners, founders, sales directors, 

and other decision-makers. 

● Oversee outbound sales campaigns through phone, email, LinkedIn, and other approved

channels. 

● Help representatives handle difficult conversations, negotiations, and high-value sales

opportunities. 

● Support the team in closing exhibition stand bookings and other B2B service sales. 

CRM, Reporting & Sales Operations

● Ensure accurate and timely CRM updates, lead tracking, and follow-up management. 

● Monitor key telesales metrics, including calls made, conversations, qualified leads, 

proposals, conversion rates, and revenue. 

● Prepare daily sales performance reports and weekly revenue forecasts. 

● Coordinate with marketing and data teams to improve lead quality and campaign

effectiveness. 

● Identify opportunities to improve sales processes, team productivity, and overall revenue

performance. 

Minimum Qualifications - Mandatory

Candidates must meet all of the following requirements: 

● Minimum 3 years of hands-on telesales experience, including outbound calling, lead

generation, customer follow-ups, and closing sales over the phone. 

● Minimum 1 year of experience leading a telesales team, with direct responsibility for

managing sales representatives, monitoring performance, and achieving team targets. 

● Minimum 1 year of international outbound telesales experience, personally making sales

calls to customers in markets such as the USA, UK, Europe, or Australia. 

● Proven experience training and coaching telesales representatives, including onboarding, 

sales pitch development, objection handling, and closing techniques. 

● Hands-on experience listening to and monitoring sales calls, evaluating call quality, 

identifying improvement areas, and providing regular coaching. 

● Strong understanding of telesales KPIs, including daily call targets, connection rates, lead

qualification, conversion rates, pipeline management, and revenue performance. 

● Experience working with CRM systems, sales dashboards, and daily performance reporting. 

● Excellent spoken and written English, with the confidence to communicate with international

customers and train team members. Preferred Qualifications

● Experience managing an international outbound BPO, inside sales, or telesales process. 

● Experience selling B2B services, trade shows, exhibitions, advertising, sponsorships, or

similar products. 

● Experience building sales teams, onboarding new representatives, and developing sales

training processes. 

● Proven ability to improve team productivity, conversion rates, and revenue through structured

coaching. 

● Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field preferred. 

Who We Are Looking ForWe want a hands-on sales leader who: 

● Has personally succeeded in international outbound telesales. 

● Enjoys training, coaching, and developing salespeople. 

● Knows how to listen to a sales call and identify exactly what a representative needs to

improve. 

● Is comfortable setting targets and holding team members accountable. 

● Can motivate a sales team while maintaining discipline and consistent execution. 

● Understands that sales performance depends on prospecting quality, effective

conversations, consistent follow-ups, and strong closing skills. 

● Is confident working in a fast-paced, target-driven sales environment. 

● Takes ownership of team revenue rather than only monitoring activities. 

This is not an administrative or purely supervisory role. We are looking for someone who can actively

manage a telesales floor, coach representatives, improve sales conversions, and lead the team to

achieve revenue targets. 

How To ApplyPlease email your resume to jobs@beveragetradenetwork. com and include: 

● Your current CTC. 

● Your expected CTC. 

● Your total years of hands-on telesales experience. 

● Your total years of international outbound telesales experience and the countries you have

called. 

● Your experience leading telesales teams, including team size and duration. 

● A brief, personalised note explaining your experience training sales representatives, 

monitoring calls, and improving team sales performance. 

Our team will review your application and contact you by email if you are shortlisted for an

interview. Please note: We will not consider LinkedIn Quick Apply submissions, generic AI-generated

responses, or incomplete and non-serious applications. Candidates who do not meet the mandatory

minimum experience requirements should not apply. Please follow the instructions above and apply

by email.

JD for Development Team Lead (. NET)

Position Overview

The Development Team Lead (. NET) is responsible for providing hands‐on technical leadership, mentoring, and delivery oversight for a team building enterprise applications on the Microsoft . NET platform. This role blends deep . NET expertise with people leadership, Agile delivery, and cross‐functional collaboration. The Team Lead works closely with Product, QA, DevOps, Architecture, and Delivery to ensure consistent, predictable, and high‐quality delivery. 

This role will play a key leadership role in the modernization of legacy . NET and WCF-based platforms, helping drive the transition to cloud-ready ASP. NET Core APIs, microservices, and Azure-native architectures. 

Key Responsibilities

Technical Leadership

- Lead the design and development of applications using C#, VB. NET, ASP. NET Core, ASP. NET MVC, Web API, LINQ, and related . NET technologies. 
 - Guide modernization of legacy VB. NET, WCF, and . NET Framework applications and services into modern C#, ASP. NET Core, and . NET 8+ API architectures where appropriate. 
 - Define and lead migration strategies for legacy WCF/SOAP services, including service decomposition, API design, security modernization, backward compatibility, and transition to RESTful and event-driven architectures. 
 - Provide technical leadership for both the ongoing enhancement of existing WCF-based applications and the strategic modernization of those platforms to ASP. NET Core and cloud-ready architectures. 
 - Evaluate and implement modern integration patterns using REST APIs, microservices, Azure Service Bus, and cloud-native services as part of application modernization initiatives. 
 - Perform and enforce high‐quality code reviews, ensuring adherence to coding standards, clean architecture, and SOLID principles. 
 - Break down complex technical requirements into well‐scoped stories and tasks. 
 - Work with Architects to align on technical patterns, integration approaches, and long‐term platform direction. 

People Leadership & Coaching

- Provide day‐to‐day support, mentorship, and coaching to developers across varying experience levels. 
 - Foster a positive, inclusive culture centered on learning, ownership, and accountability. 
 - Conduct regular 1: 1s and support career development, skills progression, and performance management. 

Agile Delivery & Planning

- Lead sprint planning, backlog readiness, estimation, and throughput optimization. 
 - Facilitate daily stand‐ups, reviews, and retrospectives; remove team impediments rapidly. 
 - Coordinate dependencies with QA, DevOps, and other teams; ensure release readiness and change control. 
 - Partner with the Delivery Manager (or act in that capacity where needed) to maintain predictable sprint throughput and reliable release timelines. 

Quality & Reliability

- Ensure strong testing practices: unit testing (xUnit/NUnit/MSTest), integration testing, API testing, and automation support and high code coverage targets. 
 - Collaborate with QA to embed quality in the workflow; drive shift‐left testing practices. 
 - Validate that applications meet non‐functional requirements such as performance, resilience, and security. 
 - Collaborate with DevOps to improve CI/CD pipelines, environment stability, and release automation. 

System & Application Ownership

- Provide technical leadership for legacy service modernization initiatives, including assessment, refactoring, migration planning, risk management, and production rollout of WCF-to-. NET Core API transformations. 
 - Troubleshoot and resolve complex issues across environments (DEV/QA/UAT/PROD). 
 - Lead root cause analysis for production incidents and identify long‐term fixes. 
 - Monitor application health using Application Insights, logging frameworks, and dashboards. 

Cross‐Functional Collaboration

- Partner with Product Owners to refine user stories, clarify requirements, and provide estimates. 
 - Work closely with DevOps for CI/CD enhancements and infrastructure needs (Azure preferred). 
 - Collaborate with QA Lead, Architecture, and Security teams to ensure compliance with standards. 

Qualifications

Required

- 8+ years of professional software development experience with . NET Framework, . NET Core, and enterprise application development. 
 - 2+ years in a people leader role. 
 - Strong expertise in C#, with hands-on experience developing, enhancing, supporting, and modernizing applications built on VB. NET, WCF, and the . NET Framework. Experience migrating legacy services to ASP. NET Core and modern API architectures is required. 
 - Hands-on experience designing, developing, supporting, and modernizing WCF/SOAP services, including execution of WCF-to-ASP. NET Core Web API migration initiatives, service contract analysis, authentication modernization, API versioning, and integration modernization. 
 - Strong understanding of enterprise integration patterns, including SOAP, REST, messaging, service-oriented architecture (SOA), and microservices. 
 - Experience maintaining and enhancing enterprise applications built on WCF, SOAP, and . NET Framework, including troubleshooting, performance tuning, and delivery of new business functionality. 
 - Experience building REST APIs, microservices, or modular applications using ASP. NET Core/Web API. 
 - Proficiency with Git, CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps/GitHub Actions), unit testing frameworks, and design patterns. 
 - Experience working in Agile environments (Scrum/Kanban) with strong facilitation skills. 
 - Demonstrated ability to lead teams, influence architecture, and deliver complex initiatives. 
 - Excellent communication, facilitation, and problem‐solving skills. 

Preferred

- Experience in a multi‐team environment with shared services (QA, DevOps, Architecture). 
 - Experience with Microsoft Azure services including API Management, App Services, Azure Functions, Service Bus, Key Vault, and Application Insights. 
 - Experience modernizing monolithic or service-oriented applications into microservices or cloud-native architectures. 
 - Experience using modernization tools and frameworks such as . NET Upgrade Assistant, migration assessment tools, and automated code conversion utilities. 
 - Familiarity with observability (logs, metrics, tracing) and performance tuning. 
 - Exposure to relational and NoSQL data stores, messaging, and event‐driven patterns.

data.title: Staff Software Engineer
data.description:
Position Overview

We are looking for a Staff Software Engineer, RCM AI Automation & Platform to provide technical leadership and help shape the next generation of Experity's RCM technology. 

In this role, you will lead the design and evolution of platform capabilities spanning multiple RCM workflows, including backend services, APIs, integrations, event-driven and long-running workflows, configurable business rules, data, and AI-enabled automation supporting charge entry, claims processing, claim submission, rejection and denial resolution, payments, and other parts of the revenue cycle. 

You will work closely with Product Managers, RCM Operations, Software Engineers, Architects, Data teams, and QA to translate complex healthcare business workflows into scalable, maintainable software solutions. 

As a Staff Engineer, your impact will extend beyond the software you personally build. You will provide technical direction across initiatives, establish reusable architecture and engineering patterns, solve high-ambiguity and cross-system problems, mentor engineers, and help teams make sound technical tradeoffs as the RCM platform evolves. 

Success means more than delivering features. You will help increase automation, reduce unnecessary manual work, improve claim outcomes, shorten processing time, and build an RCM platform that can continue to evolve. 

You will be expected to understand the business workflow behind the software, identify opportunities for automation, and determine when deterministic software, configurable rules, data, machine learning, or AI agents are most appropriate for the problem. 

What You'll Do

Architecture & Technical Leadership

- Define and evolve the technical architecture for RCM automation capabilities spanning multiple products, services, workflows, and integrations. 
 - Lead technical design for complex, high-impact initiatives where requirements, system boundaries, or implementation approaches may initially be ambiguous. 
 - Establish reusable patterns for workflow orchestration, state management, business rules, integrations, event processing, AI-enabled automation, observability, and failure recovery. 
 - Identify where capabilities should become reusable platform services versus remaining workflow- or product-specific implementations. 
 - Drive technical decisions across service boundaries and work with architects and engineering teams to ensure solutions fit Experity's broader platform architecture. 
 - Evaluate architectural tradeoffs involving scalability, reliability, maintainability, security, cost, speed of delivery, and operational complexity. 
 - Reduce unnecessary technical complexity and prevent one-off solutions from becoming long-term platform liabilities. 

RCM Platform Engineering

- Design, develop, test, deploy, and operate scalable production software supporting Experity's Revenue Cycle Management workflows. 
 - Build backend services and REST APIs using TypeScript, Node. js, and cloud-native technologies. 
 - Contribute to modern web applications when needed using technologies such as React, Next. js, and TypeScript. 
 - Design and implement event-driven, queue-based, and asynchronous workflows with explicit state management, retries, redrive, exception handling, idempotency, and auditability. 
 - Design long-running RCM workflows that support state transitions, human-in-the-loop processing, exception handling, replay/recovery, workflow versioning, and compensation or reversal when appropriate. 
 - Ensure workflow designs can evolve across multiple RCM use cases without creating tightly coupled or duplicated implementations. 
 - Build integrations with Experity applications, healthcare clearinghouses, payer systems, and third-party RCM services. 
 - Design reliable interfaces for claims, payment, eligibility, rejection, denial, and other healthcare transaction workflows. 
 - Define integration patterns and contracts that improve consistency, resilience, traceability, and reuse across RCM systems. 

Rules, Data & Automation

- Develop configurable business rules and workflow capabilities that replace logic currently distributed across application code, spreadsheets, and operational processes. 
 - Build rules and workflow capabilities that are configurable, versioned, explainable, auditable, and safe to change without introducing unnecessary application dependencies. 
 - Guide the architecture of reusable rules, workflow, and exception-management capabilities rather than embedding business logic independently within individual services. 
 - Work with claims, financial, and operational data to improve automation, identify exceptions, and measure business outcomes. 

AI & Agentic Engineering

- Integrate Generative AI, LLMs, agents, retrieval, and machine learning capabilities where they provide measurable value, while using deterministic software and business rules where those approaches are more appropriate. 
 - Build AI-enabled capabilities using clearly defined tools, APIs, contracts, permissions, validation, evaluation, observability, and fallback paths rather than treating LLMs as standalone solutions. 
 - Define architectural patterns for safely incorporating AI agents into production RCM workflows, including tool boundaries, authorization, human-in-the-loop controls, deterministic guardrails, evaluation, fallback behavior, and auditability. 
 - Help teams determine where AI adds measurable value and where conventional software, workflow orchestration, rules, or machine learning are more appropriate. 
 - Drive reusable AI integration patterns so individual teams do not independently create incompatible agent, tool, retrieval, or evaluation architectures. 
 - Use modern AI-assisted software development practices for codebase exploration, development, testing, debugging, documentation, and engineering productivity while maintaining appropriate engineering review and quality standards. 

Reliability, Security & Operations

- Build observability, automated testing, security, operational controls, and failure recovery into software from the beginning. 
 - Design systems with healthcare security, PHI protection, least-privilege access, auditability, and safe operational logging in mind. 
 - Define reliability and observability standards across RCM services and workflows, including traceability across asynchronous and distributed processing. 
 - Lead technical investigation of complex production issues that cross application, integration, data, infrastructure, or workflow boundaries. 
 - Identify systemic causes behind recurring incidents and drive platform-level improvements rather than repeatedly addressing symptoms. 

Engineering Leadership & Influence

- Serve as a technical leader and trusted engineering partner across RCM initiatives without requiring direct people-management responsibility. 
 - Mentor engineers through architecture reviews, design discussions, code reviews, debugging, and complex technical decisions. 
 - Raise engineering quality by establishing practical standards, reusable patterns, reference implementations, and technical guidance. 
 - Influence engineering roadmaps by identifying foundational technical investments, architectural risks, scalability constraints, and modernization opportunities. 
 - Partner with Product and RCM Operations to challenge assumptions, simplify workflows, and ensure technology decisions address the underlying business problem rather than simply automating existing processes. 
 - Own critical software through production and continuously improve it based on system behavior, operational feedback, and business results. 
 - Measure the impact of engineering improvements through outcomes such as automation rate, exception rate, manual touches, processing time, rejection/denial resolution time, successful resubmission, payment outcomes, and system reliability. 

Qualifications

Required

- 8+ years of professional software engineering experience, with significant experience designing and operating complex production systems. 
 - Demonstrated experience operating at a senior technical leadership level-leading architecture and technical direction across multiple engineers, services, or initiatives. 
 - Strong software engineering fundamentals, including application design, testing, debugging, code review, and maintainability. 
 - Deep experience building backend services, REST APIs, distributed applications, and transaction-processing systems. 
 - Proficiency with TypeScript, Node. js, or comparable modern backend technologies. 
 - Experience with relational databases, SQL, data modeling, and transactional systems. 
 - Strong experience developing and operating cloud-hosted applications, preferably on AWS. 
 - Deep understanding of asynchronous processing, queues, events, distributed-system failure modes, retries, idempotency, consistency, and resilient system design. 
 - Experience architecting long-running workflow or orchestration systems involving state management, exceptions, retries, recovery, and human intervention. 
 - Experience with automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, observability, and secure software development practices. 
 - Ability to design systems and technical contracts that remain maintainable as teams, workflows, integrations, and transaction volumes grow. 
 - Ability to reason across application, platform, integration, data, security, and operational boundaries rather than optimizing a single service in isolation. 
 - Ability to investigate highly ambiguous problems using production behavior, data, logs, architecture, and user workflows. 
 - Demonstrated ability to influence technical decisions across teams through technical credibility, communication, design artifacts, and collaboration rather than organizational authority. 
 - Experience mentoring engineers and raising the technical capability of a broader engineering team. 
 - Strong collaboration and communication skills with the ability to work across engineering, product, operations, architecture, data, and executive stakeholders. 
 - Experience using modern AI-assisted software development tools and workflows while maintaining engineering quality, security, and accountability. 

Preferred

Experience in one or more of the following areas is valuable: 

- Healthcare Revenue Cycle Management, medical billing, claims, rejections, denials, eligibility, remittance, payment processing, or claim remediation. 
 - Healthcare claims transactions and standards such as 837, 835, CARC/RARC, or related payer/clearinghouse workflows. 
 - Waystar or other healthcare clearinghouse integrations. 
 - Healthcare, HealthTech, FinTech, insurance, payments, or other high-volume transactional environments. 
 - Architecture of workflow orchestration, rules engines, state machines, or exception-management platforms used across multiple products or business processes. 
 - Event-driven architectures and large-scale distributed systems. 
 - Incremental modernization of legacy platforms while maintaining production continuity and avoiding high-risk rewrites. 
 - Production use of Generative AI, LLMs, AI agents, retrieval-augmented generation, or machine learning. 
 - AI orchestration frameworks, structured tool use, MCP or similar tool protocols, and agentic workflows. 
 - Human-in-the-loop automation where AI or software recommendations require review, approval, correction, or escalation. 
 - Architecture and governance of production AI/agent systems, including evaluation, guardrails, tool authorization, observability, and fallback strategies. 
 - Snowflake or other cloud-native data platforms. 
 - Docker, Kubernetes, and containerized application deployment. 
 - Data-intensive application development and distributed data processing. 
 - Experience working with HIPAA-regulated systems, PHI, audit requirements, or other highly regulated environments. 

Technology Environment

Our RCM Engineering Environment Includes

- Backend: TypeScript, Node. js, Python
 - Frontend: React, Next. js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS
 - Cloud & Platform: AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD
 - Architecture: REST APIs, queues, events, asynchronous workflows, distributed services
 - Data: SQL, Snowflake
 - AI: AWS Bedrock, LLM APIs, retrieval, structured tool use, Generative AI, and agentic workflows
 - Integrations: Waystar, Experity EMR and Practice Management, payer systems, and third-party RCM services

Candidates are not expected to have experience with every technology listed above. At the Staff level, depth of engineering judgment, experience solving complex cross-system problems, and ability to establish scalable technical patterns are more important than matching every technology in the stack. 

How We Work

We want engineers who understand the problem they are solving, not just the ticket they are implementing. 

At the Staff level, we expect you to look beyond an individual feature or service and understand how technical decisions affect the broader RCM platform. 

You should be comfortable learning a complex healthcare domain, questioning existing processes, working through ambiguity, making practical technical tradeoffs, and taking ownership of difficult problems. 

Our engineers collaborate closely with business and operational teams because understanding the real workflow is essential to building the right solution. We value pragmatic engineering, measurable outcomes, incremental modernization, and choosing the right technology for the problem rather than applying technology for its own sake. 

Staff Engineers help turn repeated solutions into platform capabilities, repeated problems into engineering standards, and ambiguous business challenges into clear technical direction. 

We expect engineers to understand the end-to-end RCM workflow, identify where AI and automation can eliminate unnecessary work, design for exceptions and failure from the beginning, and measure whether the software actually improves operational and financial outcomes. 

We are building an AI-native engineering culture. Engineers are expected to use modern AI development tools thoughtfully to accelerate delivery and improve quality while retaining ownership of architecture, code quality, testing, security, and production outcomes.

We are building a high-impact team at the intersection of CPU architecture, machine learning workloads, and system-level performance optimization.  - Instruction utilization

 - ML kernel development (GEMM, convolution, attention)

- Knowledge of: 
 - CPU architecture (pipelines, caching, SIMD/vector extensions such as NEON, SVE, QMX)

- Familiarity with: 
 - ML frameworks and inference stacks

- Experience with low-level optimization: 
 - Intrinsics, assembly, memory and cache tuning

 - Directly influence hardware design through real workload insights

 - Collaborate with top architecture, systems, and AI teams

What You'll Do

Alert, Monitoring, Log analysis: Detect and analyze monitoring graphs and alerts to identify systems causing production impacts with various tools like Grafana, Prometheus, MMS, Service Now, JIRA, Dynatrace, Splunk etc [Reduce MTTD Mean Time to Detect].
