data.title: Site Reliability Engineer II
data.description:
Job Description

The Enterprise Technology Services organization partners with every part of the American Express business to power the company's growth and innovation with trust and efficiency, and drive competitive differentiation with speed. We support the delivery and operations of technology, digital, and data capabilities, platforms, and services globally. Specifically, our team is responsible for the company's technology engineering, architecture, and infrastructure, providing 24x7 support to ensure an uninterrupted, high-quality experience for customers and colleagues. 

We are looking for a talented Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) with strong Java/Kotlin software engineering skills to join our team in Bengaluru, India. In this role, you will help enhance the reliability, resiliency, and operational excellence of mission-critical systems through software engineering, automation, observability, and proactive failure prevention. You will leverage modern engineering practices and emerging AI capabilities to improve incident diagnostics, accelerate recovery, automate operational workflows, and reduce service disruptions. Working alongside experienced engineers, you will contribute to building scalable, highly available systems that deliver exceptional experiences for our customers. 

Responsibilities

- Function as a member of an Agile engineering team, contributing to the design, development, deployment, and operational reliability of highly available, scalable, and resilient applications. 
 - Develop high-quality, maintainable software and automation solutions using Java, Kotlin, or Python, leveraging AI-assisted coding and Spec-Driven Development (SDD) practices to improve engineering productivity and code quality. 
 - Contribute to Non-Abstract Large System Design (NALSD), supporting the design and implementation of scalable, fault-tolerant distributed systems for mission-critical payment processing and customer-facing applications. 
 - Participate in Failure Mode Analysis to identify potential system vulnerabilities, assess failure scenarios, and implement mitigation strategies to improve system resilience. 
 - Design and execute controlled chaos engineering experiments to validate system resilience, identify weaknesses, and improve fault tolerance and recovery capabilities. 
 - Design and enhance application observability using OpenTelemetry (OTEL), distributed tracing, metrics, logging, and monitoring frameworks to improve visibility into system health and operational reliability. 
 - Contribute to defining, monitoring, and improving Service Level Indicators (SLIs), Service Level Objectives (SLOs), and error budgets to drive data-informed reliability improvements. 
 - Develop and maintain automation for application deployments, infrastructure operations, incident response, and system recovery, leveraging resilient workflow orchestration technologies such as Temporal where appropriate. 
 - Explore and apply Generative AI capabilities, including RAG, context engineering, and agentic workflows using frameworks such as LangGraph, to improve operational automation, incident investigation, troubleshooting, and engineering efficiency. 
 - Support the reliability and observability of AI-enabled workflows, including automated evaluation using Promptfoo, safety controls using NeMo Guardrails, and AI observability practices. 
 - Troubleshoot application and infrastructure issues, participate in incident response and root cause analysis, and implement corrective and preventive actions to reduce recurring failures. 
 - Develop and maintain operational runbooks, troubleshooting guides, and automated remediation procedures to improve operational readiness. 
 - Implement and enhance CI/CD pipelines, application scaling, automated testing, and infrastructure automation across development, testing, and production environments. 
 - Participate in code reviews, performance optimization, and continuous improvement initiatives while collaborating with software engineering, infrastructure, security, and platform teams. 

Qualifications

- 4+ years of professional experience in software engineering, Site Reliability Engineering, DevOps, or related technical disciplines, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - Strong programming skills in Java, Kotlin, or Python, with experience developing production-quality applications, automation tools, and distributed services. 
 - Strong understanding of data structures, algorithms, object-oriented programming, system design, and software engineering principles. 
 - Experience designing, developing, testing, and supporting RESTful APIs, microservices, and distributed applications using technologies such as Java/J2EE, Spring Boot, Kotlin, or Python. 
 - Working knowledge of multithreading, concurrency, application performance tuning, and troubleshooting. 
 - Experience with CI/CD tools and workflows such as Jenkins, Maven, Git, or similar technologies. 
 - Experience with relational or NoSQL databases such as DB2, PostgreSQL, Redis, or Couchbase. 
 - Hands-on experience with application observability, including OpenTelemetry, metrics, logs, distributed tracing, and monitoring platforms such as Prometheus, Grafana, or Splunk. 
 - Familiarity with resilience engineering practices such as NALSD, failure mode analysis, chaos engineering, SLOs, SLIs, and error budgets. 
 - Experience investigating production issues, performing root cause analysis, and implementing corrective actions. 
 - Familiarity with AI-assisted software development, including SDD, prompt engineering, and AI-supported coding, testing, and debugging. 
 - Understanding of Generative AI concepts such as LLMs, RAG, context engineering, and agentic orchestration using LangGraph or similar frameworks. 
 - Awareness of AI evaluation, safety, and observability concepts, including tools such as Promptfoo, NeMo Guardrails, and AI tracing frameworks. 
 - Ability to independently deliver moderately complex engineering tasks and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams. 
 - Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills. 

About Us

At American Express, our culture is built on a 175-year history of innovation, shared values and Leadership Behaviors, and an unwavering commitment to back our customers, communities, and colleagues. From delivering differentiated products to providing world-class customer service, we operate with a strong risk mindset, ensuring we continue to uphold our brand promise of trust, security, and service. 

As part of Team Amex, you'll experience our powerful backing with comprehensive support for your holistic well-being and many opportunities to learn new skills, develop as a leader, and grow your career. Here, your voice and ideas matter, your work makes an impact, and together, you will help us define the future of American Express. 

About The Team

We back you with benefits that support your holistic well-being so you can be and deliver your best. This means caring for you and your loved ones' physical, financial, and mental health, as well as providing the flexibility you need to thrive personally and professionally: 

- Competitive base salaries
 - Bonus incentives
 - Support for financial-well-being and retirement
 - Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life insurance, and disability benefits (depending on location)
 - Flexible working model with hybrid, onsite or virtual arrangements depending on role and business need
 - Generous paid parental leave policies (depending on your location)
 - Free access to global on-site wellness centers staffed with nurses and doctors (depending on location)
 - Free and confidential counseling support through our Healthy Minds program
 - Career development and training opportunities

American Express is an equal opportunity employer and makes employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, disability status, age, or any other status protected by law. 

Offer of employment with American Express is conditioned upon the successful completion of a background verification check, subject to applicable laws and regulations.

data.description:
About Revantage

Revantage, a Blackstone Real Estate portfolio company, is a global provider of corporate services. 

With a corporate purpose of 'In Pursuit of Better, ' Revantage delivers value-added services and world-class talent for Blackstone Real Estate portfolio companies, spanning diverse asset classes, including residential, logistics, office, hospitality and retail sectors. The company's footprint extends across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific. 

Creating a culture that inspires impact and momentum requires the right team. We know what it takes to lead an industry, and are looking for leaders who seek constant growth, want to excel, and continuously improve upon themselves and the industry. 

In addition to supporting Revantage, we also recruit for Blackstone Real Estate portfolio companies, giving you the unique opportunity to work within a network of best-in-class professionals across a broad real estate platform. 

India

With offices in Bengaluru and Gurugram, our teams in India deliver expertise, innovation and operational excellence that support thousands of assets across logistics, data centers, residential, commercial and hospitality. 

Whether you're building new capabilities, driving critical initiatives or strengthening partnerships, you'll have the opportunity to truly Build What Matters. 

Role Summary

We are seeking a Quality Assurance (QA) Tester for American Campus Communities (ACC), a Blackstone Real Estate portfolio company and the largest owner, manager and developer of high-quality student housing communities in the United States. This role is based in Bengaluru, India and is hired through Revantage India. 

The QA Tester is responsible for the design, execution and documentation of testing across ACC's Oracle Fusion Cloud environment and the integrations, interfaces, reports and business processes that surround it. The role supports both the in-flight Oracle implementation - including system integration testing, user acceptance testing support, data conversion validation and cutover readiness - and the ongoing steady-state testing that follows go-live, including enhancement testing, defect regression and validation of Oracle's quarterly release updates. The QA Tester partners closely with US-based IT leadership, functional and technical analysts, system integration partners and business process owners to ensure that changes to the Oracle ecosystem are delivered accurately, are thoroughly documented and do not disrupt downstream finance and operations processes. 

Primary Role - Quality Assurance Testing: Oracle Fusion and Integrated Systems

- Own the overall test strategy, test plans and testing approach for the Oracle Fusion Cloud program, covering Financials modules including General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Fixed Assets, Cash Management and Procurement
 - Develop, maintain and execute test cases, test scripts and test scenarios for Oracle Fusion Cloud Financials modules, including General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Fixed Assets, Cash Management and Procurement, based on functional design documents, configuration workbooks and business requirements. 
 - Execute system integration testing, regression testing and end-to-end process testing across Oracle and the surrounding application landscape, validating that business processes function correctly from source system, through Oracle, and out to downstream consumers. 
 - Test inbound and outbound integrations between Oracle Fusion and property management, banking, treasury, payroll, procurement and reporting systems, including file-based interfaces, APIs and Oracle Integration Cloud flows; validate payload accuracy, error handling, reprocessing and exception reporting. 
 - Validate data conversion and migration activities, including reconciliation of converted balances, master data and historical transactions between legacy systems and Oracle. 
 - Test reports, dashboards and analytics developed in OTBI, BI Publisher, Financial Reporting Studio and Fusion Data Intelligence, reconciling output to source data and confirming correct parameters, security and formatting. 
 - Support user acceptance testing, including preparation of business-facing test scripts, coordination of tester schedules, hands-on support to business users during execution, and tracking of UAT results through to closure. 
 - Plan and execute regression testing for Oracle's quarterly release updates, assessing the impact of new features and patches on existing configurations, integrations, reports and extensions. 
 - Log, triage, document and track defects through resolution in the program's defect management tool, including clear reproduction steps, supporting evidence and appropriate severity and priority classification, and partner with functional and technical teams on root cause analysis and retest. 
 - Maintain the test case repository, requirements traceability matrices and test evidence to ensure complete coverage of requirements and to satisfy internal control, audit and SOX documentation standards. 
 - Build and maintain automated test scripts and regression suites where automation adds value, and maintain those assets as configurations and business processes change. 
 - Prepare and maintain test data sets across development, test and staging environments, coordinating environment readiness and refreshes with the technical team. 
 - Produce clear and timely test status reporting, including execution progress, pass and fail rates, open defects by severity, and risks to the delivery schedule, for project leadership and stakeholders. 
 - Participate in requirements and design reviews to identify testability gaps, ambiguous requirements and delivery risks early in the lifecycle
 - Lead, mentor and coordinate a team of QA engineers, including work allocation, estimation, daily prioritization and review of test cases, scripts and evidence for quality and completeness. 
 - Validate security roles, user provisioning and segregation of duties configurations as part of testing cycles. 
 - Support cutover and post-go-live validation activities, including production smoke testing, hypercare defect triage and verification of fixes in the production environment. 
 - Contribute to the continuous improvement of QA standards, templates, testing methodology and automation coverage across the Oracle program. 
 - Must be able to work from the Bengaluru office under the hybrid working model, with a shift aligned to US Central Time and available until 11: 00 AM CT Flexibility is expected during testing cycles, cutover events, quarterly update windows and other peak periods. daily. Perform other projects and responsibilities as assigned. 

Qualifications & Skills

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, information systems, engineering, accounting or a related field is required. 
 - undefined
 - Minimum of eight years of software quality assurance and testing experience, including at least four years testing enterprise ERP applications and at least two years leading a QA team, is required. 
 - undefinedLead and manage a small to mid-sized QA team (2-5 engineers), including task allocation, daily progress tracking, deliverable reviews, mentoring and onboarding of new team members. Must have hands-on testing experience with Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP is required; coverage across General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Fixed Assets, Cash Management or Procurement is preferred. Experience supporting at least one full-lifecycle ERP implementation, including system integration testing, user acceptance testing and cutover, is strongly preferred. Demonstrated experience testing system integrations and interfaces, including file-based feeds, web services and APIs, and middleware such as Oracle Integration Cloud, is required. Experience validating reports and data in OTBI, BI Publisher, Financial Reporting Studio or Fusion Data Intelligence is preferred. Working knowledge of SQL sufficient to independently query and reconcile data between source systems and Oracle is preferred. Experience with test automation tools and frameworks, such as Oracle Test Automation, Tricentis Tosca, Selenium or similar, is preferred; a willingness to develop and expand automation capability is required. 
 - Experience with test management and defect tracking tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, qTest or similar is required. 
 - Familiarity with Oracle's quarterly update cycle and the associated regression testing approach is preferred. 
 - Working understanding of core finance and accounting processes, including record to report, procure to pay and order to cash, sufficient to test business scenarios meaningfully; real estate, property management or student housing experience is an advantage. 
 - Familiarity with SOX and IT general control requirements as they relate to testing documentation and evidence retention is preferred. 
 - ISTQB certification or an equivalent quality assurance credential would be a plus . 
 - Proficient in Microsoft Office applications, with emphasis on Excel. 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with meticulous attention to detail and the discipline to document findings clearly and completely. 
 - Strong written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to explain defects, test results and risks clearly to onshore technical and business stakeholders. 
 - Ability to manage multiple concurrent testing priorities against fixed delivery deadlines and to work independently with limited onshore supervision. 
 - Demonstrates a positive attitude and maintains a high level of professionalism when working with onshore stakeholders and leadership across time zones.

Key Responsibilities

 - Develop Packaging supplier quality management systems through Self - Assessment & Periodic Audits as per periodic schedule.

 - Drive Alternate Supplier development by supporting with Qualification & Followup Audits.

 - Conduct vendor visits for investigation and resolution of Packaging Material quality issues.

 - Ensure compliance to change management process for all specification changes, new supplier/material,

data.title: Fullstack AI Quality Engineer – Applied & Agentic AI Systems
data.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. 

The Position

Job Description
We are seeking a highly skilled AI Quality Engineer specializing in testing Generative (and non-Generative) AI applications and agentic systems to join our team. The ideal candidate will have expertise in both traditional software testing and specialized testing methodologies for Large Language Models (LLMs)-based and AI-based systems. 

As a fullstack Quality Engineer within a lean, agentic software team, you will cover the entire spectrum of quality assurance. You will span manual exploratory testing, traditional automated UI/API/MCP testing (across our Python and TypeScript stack), classical machine learning validation, and cutting-edge generative and agentic AI evaluation. This role requires a deep understanding of LLM, agentic and ML systems behaviors, and testing frameworks to ensure the reliability, fairness, and effectiveness of our AI-powered solutions. 

Description of the area

At Roche Digital Technology, we are advancing the boundaries of Applied AI. The Applied AI Engineering Team focuses on architecting, building, and operating high-value AI solutions and services to solve complex business challenges in healthcare. 

In the 2026 tech landscape, we operate in small, highly autonomous agile teams (e. g. , ~9 members) powered by advanced coding agents (like Claude Code) to develop and ship solutions faster than ever before. In this highly regulated environment, quality cannot be an afterthought. You will be the foundational pillar ensuring our rapidly developed agentic workflows and AI, GenAI, and agentic applications are safe, compliant, and robust before they reach the clinical or enterprise user. 

Job Responsibilities

- Generative & Agentic AI Testing Strategy: Design and implement comprehensive testing strategies specifically tailored for LLM-based applications and agentic systems, including evaluation of model responses, RAG pipelines accuracy, and overall system reliability. You will expand this to evaluate autonomous multi-agent behaviors and tool-use accuracy
 - Full-Stack Test Automation: Design and implement automated testing solutions for continuous evaluation of LLM applications, including integration tests, performance tests, and specialized AI behavior tests. This spans both our Python backend services and modern TypeScript/React/Angular frontends
 - Quality Assurance Framework & Compliance: Utilize Roche's testing frameworks that address both traditional software quality aspects and AI-specific concerns such as output consistency, contextual accuracy, and ethical compliance; co-create and maintain such frameworks when required. Create and maintain comprehensive test documentation testing strategy, test cases, and testing guidelines specific to AI applications and compliant with Roche practices
 - Edge Case, Bias, and Fairness Testing: Identify and develop test scenarios for edge cases in LLM behavior, including handling of ambiguous inputs, potential biases, and unexpected response patterns. Design and execute tests to identify potential biases in model outputs and ensure fair treatment across different user groups and use cases
 - Security & Performance Testing: Collaborate within development teams to test for potential vulnerabilities specific to LLM applications, including prompt injection, data leakage, and other AI-specific security concerns. Collaborate with other engineers to conduct thorough performance testing of GenAI applications, including response time analysis, load testing, and resource utilization monitoring

The QA Tester is responsible for the design, execution and documentation of testing across Oracle Fusion Cloud environment and the integrations, interfaces, reports and business processes that surround it.  - Validate data conversion and migration activities, including reconciliation of converted balances, master data and historical transactions between legacy systems and Oracle.

data.title: R&D Engineering, Sr Manager
data.description:
We Are

Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow. 

You Are

You have spent years in the trenches of ASIC verification, and somewhere along the way you realized that emulation is not just another tool in the flow, it is the thing that makes or breaks your ability to ship complex IP on time. You know PCIe or DDR inside and out, not just the spec but the weird corner cases, the errata that nobody talks about, and the places where emulation models fall short of what the design team actually needs. 

You have worked on Zebu or similar platforms long enough to know what good emulation IP looks like and what happens when it is not quite right. You have closed that gap before, probably more than once, and you know how to do it without creating chaos for the teams depending on your work. You are comfortable sitting with a design team in Bangalore, a verification lead in California, and an IP product manager in Europe, and walking out with a plan that everyone believes in. 

You do not wait for perfect alignment. You ask the right questions, you push back when something does not make sense, and you move. At Synopsys, you will work on IP that powers the next generation of silicon, and the emulation strategies you define will directly affect how fast we get there. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Bridge the gap between Emulation IP capabilities and Design IP verification needs across both Controller and PHY domains for high speed interfaces like PCIe and DDR
 - Define technical requirements for Emulation IP, working directly with IP development and verification teams to ensure correct implementation and deployment on Zebu platforms
 - Track and report key metrics on Emulation IP quality, performance, and coverage, driving continuous improvement across verification workflows
 - Stay ahead of evolving PCIe and DDR standards, interpret specification updates, ECNs, and errata, and translate those into actionable changes for both Emulation and Design IP teams
 - Review and validate test plans for Emulation IP and Design IP, ensuring completeness, traceability, and alignment with product quality goals
 - Collaborate cross-functionally with verification, design, product, and platform teams to optimize emulation methodologies and standardize best practices
 - Mentor engineers on emulation strategies, verification techniques, and IP development workflows

The Impact You Will Have

- Accelerate time to market for high performance IP by defining emulation strategies that catch issues earlier and reduce silicon respins
 - Elevate product quality across Synopsys IP portfolios by ensuring Emulation IP meets the real needs of design and verification teams
 - Drive adoption of best in class emulation and verification methodologies that become standard practice across the organization
 - Influence the next generation of emulation solutions and workflows, positioning Synopsys as a leader in pre-silicon validation
 - Improve cross-functional collaboration and alignment between geographically distributed teams, reducing friction and rework
 - Standardize verification workflows and metrics, making it easier for teams to track progress, identify gaps, and deliver with confidence
 - Shape how Synopsys develops and deploys Emulation IP for cutting edge digital designs and system architectures

What You'll Need

- 15+ years of hands-on experience in emulation, pre-silicon verification, or IP product development
 - Expert-level knowledge of PCIe or DDR interfaces, including protocol details, verification strategies, and real-world implementation challenges
 - Extensive experience with Zebu or similar emulation platforms, specifically for IP verification and system-level validation
 - Proven track record leading IP product development initiatives with a strong focus on emulation and verification
 - Demonstrated ability to work cross-functionally in matrixed, global teams and drive consensus across diverse stakeholders
 - Strong communication skills with the ability to influence technical direction and inspire change across engineering teams
 - Comfort working in dynamic, ambiguous environments where requirements evolve and priorities shift

Who You Are

- You can walk into a room where the Emulation IP does not quite match what the design team needs and walk out with a concrete plan to close the gap without derailing either team's schedule
 - You do not need someone to tell you what the next version of the PCIe or DDR spec means for your work, you read it, figure out the implications, and start the conversation with your team
 - You are the person people come to when emulation results do not make sense, and you know how to debug across the boundary between emulation models, RTL, and test environments
 - You push back when a test plan looks complete on paper but is missing coverage for the cases that actually matter in production
 - You are comfortable mentoring engineers who are newer to emulation or IP verification, and you do it in a way that builds their confidence and capability
 - You stay organized across multiple workstreams, stakeholders, and time zones without losing track of what matters most

The Team You'll Be Part Of

Your recruiter will share more about the team structure and mission during the interview process. 

Rewards and Benefits

We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

Job Responsibilities

The Lead Engineer - Hard Automation & Special Purpose Machines role recognizes expanded responsibility in translating customer requirements into concept development, leading the design and validation of complex welding automation systems, and ensuring manufacturing-ready execution with delivery accountability. The position extends beyond individual contribution to include technical leadership, cross-functional coordination, project ownership, and team capability development for special purpose welding automation systems. This role places strong emphasis on mentoring and developing junior engineers, providing day-to-day technical guidance, design direction, and best-practice coaching. 

Scope

- Lead hard automation projects by setting technical direction from customer requirements through concept and execution, applying welding system expertise, and mentoring engineers to deliver consistent, high‐quality designs and owing project execution. 
 - Ensure designs emphasize manufacturability, assembly accessibility, and long‐term serviceability by applying DFMA principles, while working closely with manufacturing engineers to resolve fabrication challenges and mentor junior engineers on shop‐floor best practices. 
 - Perform and review structural and static finite element analysis (FEA) to validate safety, stiffness, and load capacity, and mentor junior engineers on analytical methods and interpretation of results. 
 - Own engineering deliverables with accountability for technical quality, cost targets, and on-time delivery, setting execution standards for the team. 
 - Perform detailed mechanical calculations and system sizing to support welding automation equipment design, including selection and specification of gearboxes, electric motors, servo systems, pneumatics, and hydraulics. This includes load and torque calculations, duty cycle assessment, inertia matching, safety factors, thermal considerations, and validation of selections against performance, reliability, and cost targets, while coordinating with controls, electrical, and manufacturing teams to ensure robust machinery execution. 

Job Requirements

- Builds engineering capability through mentoring, technical leadership, and strong design-manufacturing integration. 
 - Reduces rework and late-stage changes through early manufacturability and serviceability focus, reinforced via design reviews. 
 - Improves schedule adherence and execution quality by combining technical ownership with proactive guidance of junior engineers. 
 - Develops creative and robust mechanical design solutions and performs engineering calculations to support equipment sizing, component selection, and overall system performance. 
 - Bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering with 10-12 years of experience in hard automation and/or welding automation equipment design. 
 - Strong experience in manufacturing-driven design, including conducting DFMA reviews, with a proven ability to design manufacturable and serviceable mechanical systems with an on time and on quality focus. 
 - Working knowledge of submerged arc welding applications, particularly for pipes, pressure vessels, and growing lines, with the ability to translate application understanding into design concepts.

data.title: Manager, Data Science
data.description:
Job Description

Thomson Reuters is expanding its Data Science and AI organization and is looking for a Manager to lead a team building intelligent products and automation. You will own the full lifecycle of ML and GenAI solutions, from problem framing to production deployment and operation. The work spans traditional machine learning and modern GenAI systems, including LLM applications, RAG, agents, and multi-agent platforms. You will set technical direction, develop your team, and partner with business stakeholders to deliver measurable impact. 

Key Responsibilities

Problem framing and solution design

- Translate business problems into well-scoped data science and AI use cases with clear hypotheses, success metrics, and value estimates. 
 - Lead the design and development of ML and GenAI solutions, including predictive models, LLM applications, RAG, and agents, from exploration through validated prototype. 
 - Partner with engineering to move solutions into production by defining model requirements, performance thresholds, and monitoring and retraining needs. 

Evaluation and impact measurement

- Define evaluation frameworks for classical models and LLM and agent solutions, covering accuracy, groundedness, safety, and regression. 
 - Design experiments and pilots, including A/B tests, to measure business impact and adoption, and use results to guide iteration and prioritization. 
 - Analyze post-launch model and agent performance, including quality, drift, and cost signals, and recommend improvements. 

AI roadmap and portfolio prioritization

- Shape the data science and AI roadmap for the team's use case portfolio, prioritizing by business value, feasibility, and risk. 
 - Identify reusable agentic patterns such as prompts, skills, workflow templates, and evaluation sets, and partner with engineering to make them available across teams. 
 - Provide data science input into build-versus-buy decisions, including evaluation of model and vendor quality. 

Coaching and mentoring

- Lead, coach, and grow data scientists and AI engineers through feedback, code and design reviews, and career development. 
 - Build a culture of rigor, experimentation, and ownership. 
 - Hire, onboard, and retain strong talent. 

Stakeholder partnership

- Partner with Sales, Marketing, Product, and Operations to prioritize use cases and design solutions. 
 - Apply AI and data science to business problems such as workflow automation, customer retention, cross-sell, segmentation, pricing, and recommendations. 
 - Communicate results and trade-offs clearly to audiences from engineers to senior leadership. 

Required Qualifications

- 8-10 years of experience in data science and machine learning, with models deployed in production. 
 - Experience leading, mentoring, or managing data scientists or ML engineers. 
 - Hands-on experience building LLM applications, including prompt engineering, RAG, embeddings, and vector search. 
 - Experience designing and shipping agentic systems, including tool use, orchestration, and agent evaluation. 
 - Strong foundation in statistics, machine learning, and hypothesis testing. 
 - Expert Python and strong SQL skills. 
 - Experience with scikit-learn, PyTorch, or TensorFlow. 
 - Experience with cloud platforms (preferably AWS), containerization, and CI/CD for model deployment. 
 - Experience applying ML to business problems such as predictive analytics, segmentation, pricing, or recommendations. 
 - Strong communication and stakeholder management skills. 
 - Bachelor's degree or higher; a quantitative field is preferred. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience building multi-agent platforms with frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, or AutoGen. 
 - Experience with MCP and building reusable tools and skills for agents. 
 - Experience with LLMOps tooling, including tracing, evaluation, guardrails, and prompt management. 
 - Experience with advanced RAG techniques such as hybrid search, re-ranking, and retrieval evaluation. 
 - Familiarity with responsible AI practices, including hallucination mitigation, privacy, and governance. 
 - Experience on sales, marketing, or revenue-operations data, or automating business workflows with AI. 
 - Experience owning an AI platform used by multiple teams. 

What's in it For You?

- Hybrid Work Model: We've adopted a flexible hybrid working environment for our office-based roles while delivering a seamless experience that is digitally and physically connected. 
 - Flexibility & Work-Life Balance: Flex My Way is a set of supportive workplace policies designed to help manage personal and professional responsibilities, whether caring for family, giving back to the community, or finding time to refresh and reset. This builds upon our flexible work arrangements, including work from anywhere for up to 8 weeks per year, empowering employees to achieve a better work-life balance. 
 - Career Development and Growth: By fostering a culture of continuous learning and skill development, we prepare our talent to tackle tomorrow's challenges and deliver real-world solutions. Our Grow My Way programming and skills-first approach ensures you have the tools and knowledge to grow, lead, and thrive in an AI-enabled future. 
 - Industry Competitive Benefits: We offer comprehensive benefit plans to include flexible vacation, two company-wide Mental Health Days off, access to the Headspace app, retirement savings, tuition reimbursement, employee incentive programs, and resources for mental, physical, and financial wellbeing. 
 - Culture: Globally recognized, award-winning reputation for inclusion and belonging, flexibility, work-life balance, and more. We live by our values: Obsess over our Customers, Compete to Win, Challenge (Y)our Thinking, Act Fast / Learn Fast, and Stronger Together. 
 - Social Impact: Make an impact in your community with our Social Impact Institute. We offer employees two paid volunteer days off annually and opportunities to get involved with pro-bono consulting projects and Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) initiatives. 
 - Making a Real-World Impact: We are one of the few companies globally that helps its customers pursue justice, truth, and transparency. Together, with the professionals and institutions we serve, we help uphold the rule of law, turn the wheels of commerce, catch bad actors, report the facts, and provide trusted, unbiased information to people all over the world. 

About Us

Thomson Reuters informs the way forward by bringing together the trusted content and technology that people and organizations need to make the right decisions. We serve professionals across legal, tax, accounting, compliance, government, and media. Our products combine highly specialized software and insights to empower professionals with the data, intelligence, and solutions needed to make informed decisions, and to help institutions in their pursuit of justice, truth, and transparency. Reuters, part of Thomson Reuters, is a world leading provider of trusted journalism and news. 

We are powered by the talents of 26, 000 employees across more than 70 countries, where everyone has a chance to contribute and grow professionally in flexible work environments. At a time when objectivity, accuracy, fairness, and transparency are under attack, we consider it our duty to pursue them. Sound exciting? Join us and help shape the industries that move society forward. 

As a global business, we rely on the unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences of all employees to deliver on our business goals. To ensure we can do that, we seek talented, qualified employees in all our operations around the world regardless of race, color, sex/gender, including pregnancy, gender identity and expression, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, disability, age, marital status, citizen status, veteran status, or any other protected classification under applicable law. Thomson Reuters is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer providing a drug-free workplace. 

We also make reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and for sincerely held religious beliefs in accordance with applicable law. More information on requesting an accommodation here. 

Learn more on how to protect yourself from fraudulent job postings here. 

More information about Thomson Reuters can be found on thomsonreuters. com.

Solution Architecture & Design

 - Act as the CMS technology SME, helping clients navigate platform capabilities and recommending the most effective solutions. 
 - Evaluate and design integrations with surrounding systems including CRM, DAM, marketing automation, and analytics. 
 - Assess when to use traditional AEM Sites, headless/composable delivery, document-based authoring, or Edge Delivery Services depending on client needs, migration complexity, performance goals, and operating model. 
 - Define modernization roadmaps for AEM 6. 5, AMS, and AEM as a Cloud Service estates, including phased adoption of Universal Editor, Edge Delivery Services, content modeling, and API-first delivery.

Client Engagement & Innovation

- Act as the primary technical point of contact for clients on CMS solutions, providing trusted guidance and making proactive recommendations-not just reacting to requests. 
 - Drive innovation by staying informed on AEM as a Cloud Service releases, Edge Delivery Services, Universal Editor, Adobe Experience Cloud integrations, content supply chain evolution, and broader CMS/DXP trends.

Integration & Performance

- Design and implement integrations using REST, GraphQL, SOAP where required, event-driven patterns, Adobe I/O, middleware, cloud-native services, and composable enterprise APIs.

Governance, Security & Compliance

Team Enablement & Collaboration

 - Drive a culture of continuous improvement and shared accountability.

Deep knowledge of AEM architecture, including Sites, Assets, Content Fragments, Experience Fragments, Headless CMS, GraphQL, Universal Editor, Edge Delivery Services, and AEM as a Cloud Service operating models. Strong expertise in Java, Sling, OSGi, HTL, JCR, Dispatcher configuration, and CI/CD pipelines. Frontend expertise in modern frameworks such as React, Angular, Vue, or similar technologies, with solid understanding of web performance, accessibility, Core Web Vitals, and framework-agnostic authoring patterns. Proficient in backend integrations using REST/SOAP, middleware tools, and message brokers. Strong understanding of database technologies, cloud platforms, Adobe Cloud Manager, CI/CD automation, observability, DevOps practices, and deployment governance across AWS, Azure, or equivalent cloud environments. Experience working in Agile delivery models with a focus on rapid value delivery and iterative design. Experience with migration or modernization programs, including AEM 6. 5 to AEM as a Cloud Service, component refactoring, content model redesign, performance remediation, and platform rationalization. 
 - Nice to Have
 - Awareness or hands-on experience with Content Supply Chain tools such as Adobe Workfront, Adobe Express, DAM workflows, asset lifecycle management, review/approval automation, and content velocity optimization. Familiarity with Adobe Experience Cloud products beyond AEM. Experience with Adobe I/O, App Builder, GraphQL, OpenAPI, personalization, experimentation, analytics integration, and AI-assisted content or development workflows. Exposure to agentic AEM concepts, AI-supported pipeline troubleshooting, developer agents, content modernization agents, or automated migration accelerators. Strong communication and storytelling skills - capable of translating complex technical concepts into business-friendly language. Team player with leadership presence and the ability to influence across teams and stakeholders.

- Pattern Setting: Define reusable integration adapters, async strategies, error handling, and component architecture standards. Review critical PRs as final technical checkpoint. 

- Team Leadership & Global Coordination: Lead engineers across a globally distributed practice. Own delivery cadence, align priorities across time zones. Responsible for team performance, career development, and technical growth.

- Good to Have: TypeScript. Test automation. AWS (Lambda, S3, API Gateway). Education & Experience: 

- Bachelor's degree in computer science or related field or equivalent demonstrated experience. 
 - 15+ years of relevant experience, with at least 3 years of owing platform level technical decisions. 
 - Financial Services background
 - Salesforce Certified Platform Developer II
 - Salesforce Certified Application Architect or System Architect (strongly preferred).

data.description:
Project Role : AI Native Software Engineer

Project Role Description : Build and ship production-ready software using AI as a core part of the engineering lifecycle. Apply AI-native practices to develop and validate solutions, maintain quality and compliance, and continuously improve how software is built and operated. 

Must have skills : Java Full Stack Development

Good to have skills : NA

Minimum 3 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required

Educational Qualification : 15 years full time education

Summary: 

The Principal Engineer is a key leadership role within the engineering team, responsible for overseeing and guiding complex technical projects, driving innovation, and ensuring the successful delivery of high-quality software products. This role involves a combination of hands-on technical work, strategic planning, and team mentorship. If you have drive to lead and mentor engineering teams, ability to set technical direction for greenfield SaaS products and excellent communication skills to work with cross-functional teams, including product management and other stakeholders, this position is for you

Roles & Responsibilities: 

Prepare technical design specifications based on functional requirements and analysis documents. Provide written knowledge transfer material. 

Review functional requirements, analysis, and design documents and provide feedback. 

Implement, test, maintain and support software, based on technical design specifications. 

Improve system quality by identifying issues and common patterns and developing standard operating procedures. 

Enhance applications by identifying opportunities for improvement, making recommendations, and designing and implementing systems. 

Maintain and improve existing codebases and peer review code changes. 

Liason with colleagues to implement technical designs. 

Investigate and use new technologies where relevant. 

Assist customer support with technical problems and questions. 

Ability to work independently with wide latitude for independent decision making. 

Experience in leading the work of others and mentor less experienced developers in the context of a project is a plus. 

Ability to listen and understand information and communicate the same. 

Participate in architecture and code reviews. 

Lead or participate in other projects or duties as need arises. 

Technical experience & Professional attributes: 

- The Winning Way behaviors that all employees need in order to meet the expectations of each other, our customers, and our partners. 
 - Communicate with Clarity - Be clear, concise and actionable. Be relentlessly constructive. Seek and provide meaningful feedback. 
 - Act with Urgency - Adopt an agile mentality - frequent iterations, improved speed, resilience. 80/20 rule - better is the enemy of done. Don t spend hours when minutes are enough. 
 - Work with Purpose - Exhibit a We Can mindset. Results outweigh effort. Everyone understands how their role contributes. Set aside personal objectives for team results. 
 - Drive to Decision - Cut the swirl with defined deadlines and decision points. Be clear on individual accountability and decision authority. Guided by a commitment to and accountability for customer outcomes. 
 - Own the Outcome - Defined milestones, commitments and intended results. Assess your work in context, if you re unsure, ask. Demonstrate unwavering support for decisions. 
 - (MUST HAVE) 2+ years of experience developing systems/software for large business environments
 - (MUST HAVE) Strong OOD and SOA principles, with ability to implement them in a language of choice (Java preferable)
 - (MUST HAVE) Strong experience leading architecture, design and implementation of robust and highly scalable web services. 
 - (MUST HAVE) Experience working with AWS and/or Azure SaaS infrastructure and CI/CD DevOps technologies, and extensive debugging experience. 
 - (MUST HAVE) An understanding of unit testing, test driven development, functional testing, and performance testing. 
 - Experience building front end with React is a big plus. 
 - Knowledge of database systems (SQL, NoSQL) and data architecture. 
 - Experience working and integrating with Event Bus like Pulsar is a big plus. 
 - Experience working and integrating with cloud based big data solutions like Snowflake is a big plus. 
 - Working experience with software security-enhancing tools and best practices. 
 - Knowledge of at least one shell scripting language. 
 - Understanding of industry-leading technology/solutions in big data and machine learning. 
 - Ability to operate at highly varying levels of abstraction, from business strategy to product strategy to high-level technical design to detailed technical design to implementation. 
 - Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, complex technical environment. 
 - Experience driving for results across cross-functional teams while maintaining effective working relationships. 
 - Must possess strong interpersonal, organizational, presentation and facilitation skills. 
 - Must be results oriented and customer focused with an ability to make successful trade-offs that balance short- and long-term product goals. 
 - High-energy, self-starter with a positive mindset and with a can do attitude. 
 - Proven experience in cloud, DevOps, or AI modernization initiatives. 
 - Strong understanding of LLMs, automation, and engineering toolchains. 
 - Ability to translate AI innovation into business and productivity impact. 

Education qualifications: 

- The candidate should have minimum 2 years of experience in Java Enterprise Edition. 
 - Bachelor s degree in computer science, Information Systems, or related field or equivalent combination of education/experience. Master s degree is a plus. 
 - 3 years or more of extensive experience developing mission critical and low latency solutions for large business environments. 
 - At least 3 years of experience with developing and debugging distributed systems and working with big data systems in the cloud. 

Additional Information: 

- The candidate should have minimum 5 years of experience in Java Full Stack Development. 
 - A 15 years full time education is required.

data.description:

Lead GCC UK Building Structures team , delivering high-quality analysis, design, and documentation for building structures projects across UK region. Drive technical excellence, team development, project delivery, and stakeholder engagement while supporting the growth of GCC capabilities.

data.description:
Senior Product Engineering Lead (Java, Fintech)

Location: Hyderabad, India

About Olea: 

Olea is a digital infrastructure platform that connects global liquidity with trade and supply chain opportunities, fueling growth and unlocking potential worldwide. Olea has diverse liquidity pools with varying appetite and focuses. Olea's vision is to connect capital to opportunity. It has a strong conviction in the role of trade to support sustainable economic development across countries, particularly emerging markets, particularly Asia where many smaller suppliers are based. Olea supports suppliers and buyers in over 70 corridors. 

Role summary: 

We are looking for a Senior Product Engineering Lead for our Client Journey & Solutioning engineering team, based in our Hyderabad office, to bridge the gap between complex business product lines and highly scalable technology. In this role, you will lead and guide a high-performing engineering team focused on crafting seamless, friction-free client onboarding and transaction workflows for trade finance products, including invoice financing, factoring, and supply chain finance. You will be a hands-on Java technical lead with a product manager's mindset, closely collaborating with Business teams and the SDET Architect to champion agile methodologies. You will also promote the adoption of AI-assisted engineering workflows, while ensuring that all code, whether human-written or AI-generated, adheres to strict structural guardrails and automated testing standards. 

Responsibilities: 

· Team Leadership & Product Collaboration: Partner closely with Business Product teams to translate complex invoice financing, factoring, and supply chain finance requirements into intuitive, reliable client journeys and technical solutions. 

· Technical Leadership: Act as the technical lead for the team: set architecture and design direction, own design and code reviews, and stay hands-on in the Java codebase to unblock engineers and raise the engineering bar. 

· End-to-End Delivery Management: Manage the full software development lifecycle (SDLC) for both existing client-facing and product applications, balancing the ongoing enhancement and stability of the existing production platform with the delivery of new greenfield capabilities. Own backend scalability, automated testing, 

and production stability, and provide technical direction for the client-facing frontend experience. 

· AI-Native Engineering Leadership: Establish and scale AI-native engineering workflows, leveraging AI coding assistants, automated testing, and structured development guardrails to accelerate delivery velocity while enforcing rigorous engineering discipline, and encourage the team to adopt them. 

· Guardrails & Code Integration: Establish and oversee robust code merge gates; ensure that whether code is generated by AI and reviewed by a developer, or written directly by a developer, it strictly passes the automated test suite, security linting, and compliance checks before being merged into the main codebase. 

· Technical Mentorship & Culture: Guide, mentor, and pair-program with engineers to uplift the team's technical capabilities, foster an agile DevOps culture, and continuously optimize CI/CD pipelines. 

· Proactive Problem Solving: Take ownership of resolving systemic technical debts, operational bottlenecks, or misalignments between business requirements and technical execution. 

· Product & Business Ownership: Draw on your product management experience to guide engineering decisions: understand the business model, client needs and commercial outcomes of each product line, contribute to roadmap and prioritisation, and make trade-offs between scope, value and technical risk. 

Role specific technical competencies: 

· Product & Solution Architecture: Ability to translate complex business processes into scalable technical architectures, customer journeys, APIs, and platform capabilities. 

· Core Tech Stack (Java): Strong, hands-on background in the Java stack, including Java 11/17+, Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, Hibernate/JPA, microservices, REST APIs, event-driven messaging (e. g. Kafka) and relational databases. NodeJS / TypeScript experience is a nice-to-have, not a requirement. 

· Backend & Platform Leadership: Proven experience designing and delivering secure, high-throughput, and scalable backend architectures, with the ability to guide the team on client-facing user interfaces and their integration with backend APIs. 

· Fintech & Trade Finance Domain Expertise: Mandatory domain experience in Fintech (e. g. payments, lending, transaction banking or trade finance). Hands-on domain knowledge and engineering experience within supply chain finance frameworks, notably Invoice Financing, Factoring, and Supply Chain Finance workflows, is strongly preferred. 

· Client Journey Solutioning: Demonstrated ability to map out complex financial workflows into highly performant, intuitive, and secure client solutions and API integrations. 

· Product Management & Business Acumen: Product manager or product owner experience, or equivalent hands-on ownership of a product, with a clear understanding of product strategy, requirements definition, prioritisation and how technology decisions drive business outcomes. 

· AI-Native Engineering Proficiency: Solid hands-on experience using AI coding platforms or enterprise AI assistants in day-to-day engineering, and the ability to use them effectively to boost team velocity without compromising architectural integrity, code security, or regulatory compliance. 

· Core Software Engineering: Strong systems design patterns, data structures, algorithms, and advanced test automation practices. 

Qualifications (training, licenses, memberships and certifications): 

· Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a similar quantitative/engineering discipline. 

· 6+ years of Java software engineering experience, within Fintech, transactional banking, or Trade Finance platforms. 

· 3-5+ years leading engineering teams, with a proven track record of managing technical teams in these domains. 

· Strong background in Java-based product engineering, with the ability to lead technically while remaining hands-on. 

· Mandatory domain experience in Fintech. 

· Product manager or product owner experience (or equivalent hands-on product ownership), with a clear understanding of product and business. 

· Hands-on experience using AI coding assistants in software delivery. 

Note: 

Olea is committed to diversity and inclusion. By providing equal opportunities we foster a work environment which embraces diversity and gets the best out of the broadest spectrum of people to sustain business performance and competitive advantage. We build an inclusive culture by demonstrating respect for each other's unique strengths and perspectives to enable every employee to develop a sense of belonging and have the opportunity to maximise their potential.

Guided by modern engineering practices and a commitment to domain excellence, technical rigor, and collaboration, the Technology team ensures our platforms remain resilient, adaptable, and aligned with evolving business needs making it a core driver of Envestnet's long‐term success. 

How You'll Contribute

Provides leadership and oversight to the Software Development Engineering group. Oversees team efforts to build scalable, secure platforms in support of Envestnet business operations, including wealth management, financial data aggregation and advisor-driven technology solutions. Works across cloud-based architectures, integrating complex data sources and APIs to deliver reliable, high-performance systems. Collaborates with product managers, data scientists and compliance stakeholders to meet both business and regulatory requirements. 

- Define engineering strategy and the execution model for the enterprise CRM integration domain across Tamarac, Envestnet UMP, and MoneyGuide. 
 - Own end-to-end delivery across multiple teams, including the phased rollout: Tamarac engagement inbound, MoneyGuide relationship read, and UMP relationship plus control. 
 - Set domain architecture direction with senior technical leaders: the canonical data model, per-field direction and write authority, echo suppression, entity crosswalk and resolution, and the versioned API and event contract. 
 - Consolidate overlapping canonical-modeling efforts across separate backlogs into one owned contract, and take a stated position on the Envestnet-wide party/Holders framework. 
 - Own Envestnet's data-plane relationship with customer CRM orgs (Salesforce, Dynamics, Redtail, Wealthbox, Advyzon). That means one integration identity and one change-capture subscription per org, schema versioning under Envestnet's control, and per-tenant mapping and entitlement configuration. 
 - Drive compliance and data governance: SOX-relevant audit of reads and writes with dual actor identity, per-firm ingestion scope, redaction of unstructured advisor content, tenant isolation, and advisor-level entitlement extended to delegated agent access. 
 - Manage budget, headcount, and org design, including build-versus-buy decisions on CRM adapters, mapping layers, and per-org licensing. 
 - Implement KPIs: per-object sync freshness, availability, latency, write success and rejection rates, cost efficiency, and quality trends. 
 - Influence prioritization across engineering, product, AI/agent engineering, and partners, including repositioning partner overlays from independent extractors to consumers of the service. 
 - Lead the transformation: retire point-to-point integrations and migrate onto shared streaming, canonical, and observability infrastructure. 
 - Build leadership bench strength through structured succession planning. 
 - Drive adoption of agentic coding practices across the SDLC to increase productivity and cut time-to-delivery. 

What You'll Need To Bring

- 10+ years of software engineering experience, including leading managers, technical leads, or multiple teams across a major domain. 
 - Proven ability to define engineering strategy, translate business objectives into multi-quarter plans, and deliver measurable customer and business outcomes. 
 - Experience setting domain-level architecture direction, including platform consolidation, integration modernization, and replacing point-to-point integrations with a canonical shared service. 
 - Deep enterprise CRM integration experience: 
 - Salesforce: managed packages, Change Data Capture, Pub/Sub API and platform events, replay and gap/overflow handling, field-level security, and Financial Services Cloud. 
 - Microsoft Dynamics 365/Dataverse: change tracking and delta tokens, service endpoints, Entra ID service principals, and least-privilege Graph scopes. 
 - Experience designing canonical or master data models and persistent entity crosswalks: per-field direction control, write authority, echo suppression in bi-directional sync, conflict policy, and pre-write constraint validation. 
 - Event-driven architecture background: Kafka/Amazon MSK, the transactional outbox pattern, Debezium CDC, and Kafka Connect sinks. 
 - PostgreSQL at scale (row-level security, partitioning, logical replication) with Flyway migrations. 
 - . NET, xUnit, Reqnroll, RESTful API design and versioning, and consumer-driven contract testing. 
 - AWS (EC2, S3, API Gateway, Lambda, RDS, EKS, CloudWatch, SQS), Kubernetes, Docker, and IaC (CloudFormation, CDK, Terraform). 
 - Identity and access management: OAuth 2. 0, OIDC, Keycloak, RFC 8693 token exchange for delegated and agent identities, and entitlement models finer than tenant scope. 
 - Experience driving compliance, data governance, and security: SOX audit trails, PII and tax-ID tokenization, data classification, redaction of unstructured content, and retention policy. 
 - Experience with engineering KPIs, OKRs, MBRs, budgeting, headcount planning, org design, hiring, performance management, and succession planning. 
 - Experience with vendor evaluation and build-versus-buy decisions, including security review of vendors needing write access to customer systems of record. 
 - Strong stakeholder management across engineering, product, AI/agent engineering, partners, and business leaders, including commercially sensitive partner conversations. 
 - Experience building leadership bench strength and inspiring high-performing teams through coaching, development, and accountability. 
 - Experience with DevOps, automation, agile/Scrum, and test-driven development.

data.description:
About Ema

Ema builds AI Employees for HR, IT and Finance. Our AI Employees take on the busy work across the employee experience, from recruiting, onboarding and benefits to IT support, invoice processing and payroll, so people can spend their time on work that needs them. Founded by former executives from Google, Coinbase, Flipkart, and Okta, our team includes engineers from premier tech companies and graduates of Stanford, MIT, UC Berkeley, CMU, and IITs. 

We are backed by industry leading investors including Accel, Naspers/Prosus, Creaegis, Section32, and angels like Sheryl Sandberg and Dustin Moskovitz. Headquartered in Silicon Valley and with offices in London, Bangalore and Vancouver, Ema is at the frontier of what Agentic AI can do in production. We ship real systems that run real business processes at scale. 

Role Overview & Key Responsibilities

This is a high-leverage leadership role that spans architecture, execution, and org-building, and will shape the direction of our AI / ML initiatives at Ema. We are seeking an AI / ML technical leader who can take a vision and build it. As a Principal ML Engineer at Ema, you will be a senior technical leader responsible for shaping the machine learning roadmap, architecting large-scale ML systems, driving innovation, and ensuring our mixture of expert models (LLM + SLM + Custom Model) is accurate and performant at scale. You will collaborate across teams (research, product, infra, data, etc. ), mentor senior engineers, and influence strategy and execution at company-wide levels. 

Responsibilities

- Lead the technical direction of GenAI and agentic ML systems that power enterprise-grade AI agents - spanning reasoning, retrieval, tool use, and integrations across various SaaS products. 
 - Architect, design, and implement scalable production pipelines for model training, fine-tuning, retrieval (RAG), agent orchestration, and evaluation - ensuring robustness, latency efficiency, and continuous learning. 
 - Define and own the multi-year ML roadmap for GenAI infrastructure - including agent frameworks, RAG systems, world-class evaluation loops, and integration with MCP, browser, and vision pipelines. 
 - Identify and integrate cutting-edge ML methods / research (deep learning, large models, recommender systems, LLMs, etc. ) into Ema's products or infrastructure. 
 - Research, prototype, and integrate cutting-edge ML and LLM advancements (reasoning, memory architectures, multi-modal perception, long-context models, autonomous agents) into the platform. 
 - Optimize trade-offs between accuracy, latency, cost, interpretability, and real-world reliability across the agent lifecycle - from prompt design to orchestration and execution. 
 - Champion engineering excellence - drive observability, reproducibility, versioning, testing, and bias-aware development across ML and agentic systems. 
 - Mentor and elevate senior engineers and researchers, fostering a culture of scientific rigor, experimentation, and system-level thinking. 
 - Collaborate cross-functionally with product, infra, and research teams to align ML innovation with enterprise needs - enabling secure integrations, privacy-aware deployments, and scalable use cases. 
 - Influence data strategy - guide how retrieval indices, embeddings, structured/unstructured corpora, and feedback loops evolve to improve grounding, factuality, and reasoning depth. 
 - Drive system scalability and performance - ensuring ML agents and RAG pipelines can operate across billions of knowledge objects, diverse APIs, and real-time enterprise contexts. 

Required Skills & Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's (or PhD) degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, or a related field. 
 - A strong track record (usually 10-12+ years) of applied experience with ML techniques, especially in large-scale settings. 
 - Experience building production ML systems that operate at scale (latency / throughput / cost constraints). 
 - Experience in Knowledge retrieval and Search space. 
 - Exposure in building Agentic Systems and Frameworks. 
 - Proficiency in relevant programming languages (e. g. Python, C++, Java) and ML frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch, etc. ). 
 - Strong understanding of the full ML lifecycle: data pipelines, feature engineering, model training, serving, monitoring, maintenance. 
 - Experience designing systems for monitoring, diagnostics, logging, model versioning, etc. 
 - Deep knowledge of computational trade-offs: distributed training, inference, optimizations (e. g. quantization, pruning, batching). 
 - Excellent communication skills; ability to present complex systems / trade-offs to technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Experience mentoring senior engineers; ability to lead technical discussions and influence across orgs. 

Why Join Ema?

- Work at the forefront of agentic AI systems-driving real enterprise transformation. 
 - Own mission-critical platforms that make or break Ema's capabilities. 
 - Join an elite team of engineers, product thinkers, and AI researchers who value deep execution. 
 - Help define the architectural, cultural, and operational DNA of a company set to define a new category. 

Our culture & Values

- High Bar on Quality - We value excellence and expect world-class execution. 
 - Ownership & Accountability - We take full responsibility for our work and outcomes. 
 - Impact-Driven Approach - We set ambitious goals and measure success through real-world impact. 
 - Team Collaboration & Growth - We believe in continuous learning, knowledge sharing, and supporting each other. 
 - No Hierarchy, Just Execution - Everyone is an individual contributor, focused on delivering results. 

Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for variable compensation, equity, and benefits. 

Ema Unlimited is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, or genetics.

Integrate LLMs and generative AI capabilities into real-world products and business workflows. 

Build AI-powered features using techniques such as structured outputs, tool calling, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and agentic workflows where appropriate. 

Evaluate models, prompts, and architectures to balance quality, latency, reliability, and cost. 

Design workflows that combine AI with business rules, databases, and external APIs. 

Implement appropriate validation, error handling, observability, and human review for AI outputs. 

3. Develop Scalable Full-Stack Applications

Build responsive, user-friendly frontend experiences and reliable backend services. 

Design APIs, data models, and database schemas that support product requirements and future growth. 

Write maintainable, testable code and follow sound engineering practices. 

Integrate third-party services, authentication systems, background jobs, and other infrastructure as needed. 

Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks, bugs, and production issues. 

4. Ship, Measure, and Improve

Prototype promising ideas quickly and validate them with actual users. 

Deploy applications and manage releases, monitoring, and ongoing maintenance. 

Use user feedback, product usage, and business outcomes to guide improvements. 

Leverage AI coding tools to accelerate development while maintaining code quality, security, and reliability. 

Document key technical decisions and share learnings with the team. 

What We're Looking For

Essential Skills

- 2-4 years of experience building and shipping full-stack software applications. 
 - Strong programming fundamentals and hands-on experience developing frontend and backend applications. 
 - Practical experience integrating LLMs or generative AI into applications, workflows, or developer tooling. 
 - Experience designing and working with REST APIs, databases, and third-party integrations. 
 - Familiarity with deploying applications to production and troubleshooting real-world issues. 
 - Ability to break down ambiguous requirements into practical, well-scoped solutions. 
 - A strong sense of ownership, with a focus on usability, reliability, and business outcomes. 
 - We are particularly interested in candidates who have gone beyond basic chatbot implementations. 
 - Working with LLM APIs and structured model outputs. 
 - Building RAG pipelines, semantic search, or document-processing workflows. 
 - Implementing AI agents, tool calling, or multi-step AI workflows where appropriate. 
 - Evaluating AI output quality and handling hallucinations, failures, and edge cases. 
 - Using AI coding assistants to improve development speed and productivity. 
 - Experience building consumer-facing applications or SaaS products with active users. 
 - Experience with cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, automated testing, and application monitoring. 
 - Experience with background processing, queues, caching, or event-driven systems. 
 - Experience in marketing technology, creator platforms, analytics, or workflow automation. 
 - A strong portfolio, GitHub repository, live product, or technical case study demonstrating your work. 
 - You don't need experience with every technique listed. We value practical implementation experience and sound technical judgment over familiarity with buzzwords. 

How You Work Matters

- You can communicate technical trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders. 
 - You are comfortable making decisions when requirements are incomplete. 
 - You know when to use AI, when traditional software is more reliable, and when a simpler solution is better. 
 - You can move fast, accept feedback, and iterate without losing sight of code quality. 
 - You take responsibility for what happens after deployment, not just for writing the code. 

Our Technology Environment

We care more about your ability to choose the right tools and build reliable products than about matching every item on a checklist. 

Depending on the product, our engineering environment may involve modern frontend frameworks, backend services, relational or NoSQL databases, cloud infrastructure, LLM APIs, and AI development tools. 

You'll have the opportunity to evaluate technologies, experiment with new approaches, and make informed architectural decisions. 

How We'll Measure Success

In this role, success means: 

- Turning business problems into working solutions that users can actually use. 
 - Shipping useful prototypes and production features with appropriate speed and quality. 
 - Building AI capabilities that deliver measurable improvements in accuracy, productivity, or user experience. 
 - Maintaining reliable applications through testing, monitoring, and continuous improvement. 

Why Work With Us

Flexible Work Culture

We focus on outcomes, not rigid rules. You'll have the autonomy to manage your work, with a culture built on trust and accountability. 

Health & Accident Insurance

Your wellbeing matters to us. We provide comprehensive health and accident coverage to support you when it counts. 

Complimentary Meals

Breakfast, lunch, and snacks are on us-so you can stay focused and energized throughout the day. 

Sports & Outdoor Activities

From cricket matches to badminton games and monthly hikes, we keep things active with at least two sports events every month. 

Upskill with Us

Get access to learning platforms like Udemy and mentorship to continuously build your marketing and growth skillset. 

Performance Gets Rewarded

We recognize and reward great work through regular incentives, quarterly and annual awards, and ongoing appreciation.
