data.description:
Two Circles | Audience Intelligence Platform

About us

Two Circles is a Sports & Entertainment Marketing business. We grow audiences and revenues by knowing fans best. We help clients understand and influence how fans spend, which events they attend, which channels they respond to and what content they watch. 

Our platforms and services are trusted by 1, 000+ clients globally, including the English Premier League,   Red Bull, UEFA, VISA, the NFL and the Board of Control for Cricket India (BCCI). [RB1]    We're 1, 000+ people across 15 offices. 

The role

Join our global squad of software and data engineers building the Audience Intelligence Platform, the leading data management and analytics platform for the sports industry. You'll build the React frontend and . NET services that let teams, leagues and rights holders explore fan data, build audiences and act on insight, increasingly through AI-powered experiences. 

You'll work in an AI-augmented way: using tools like Claude Code and GitHub Copilot to ship faster, and building AI features directly into the product. 

What you'll do

- Design, build and test scalable React/TypeScript applications and . NET APIs (C#, ASP. NET Web API/MVC). 
 - Build AI-powered UI features such as natural-language audience building, conversational analytics, AI-generated insights and summaries, and smart recommendations. 
 - Design interfaces for AI interactions: streaming responses, loading and error states, citations and confidence cues, and human-in-the-loop controls. 
 - Build APIs that expose fan behaviour analytics to the UI and to AI services. 
 - Use AI coding assistants in your daily workflow, and help the team shape good practice: prompting, code review of AI-generated code, testing and guardrails. 
 - Work closely with product and marketing to turn data into high-value features. 
 - Write clean, tested, maintainable code with accessibility and performance in mind. 

Requirements

- Strong React and TypeScript experience, including component architecture, state management, and performance. 
 - Strong HTML5 (semantic, accessible) and CSS3/SCSS (responsive, themeable). 
 - Hands-on experience using AI coding tools (Claude Code, Copilot or similar) in day-to-day development, with a clear view of their strengths and limits. 
 - CI/CD experience with Azure DevOps pipelines or GitHub Actions. 
 - Familiarity with LLM APIs (Anthropic, OpenAI, Azure OpenAI), prompt design, tool/function calling, or MCP. 
 - Experience implementing AI features in a UI: LLM-backed chat or copilots, generative UI, or AI-assisted search and filtering. 
 - Experience testing and evaluating non-deterministic features, and handling latency, cost, privacy and safety. 
 - Clear communication, including explaining blockers and timelines to non-technical stakeholders. Preferred

- Strong C# and experience building APIs in modern . NET (Core/6/8/10); awareness of . NET Framework migration considerations. What matters most

Skills can be learned. Attitude and the ability to learn quickly matter most in this team, especially as AI changes how we build software. 

Benefits

What can we offer you?

We offer a benefits package to suit you and your lifestyle! Out of a core monthly budget, you can choose your own comprehensive benefit package

- 15 standard days of PTO (+1 Birthday, 1 Admin Day, +1 Big Life Event Day, + 1 Wellbeing Day)
 - Medical Insurance (Self +5 Dependents) & Group Term Insurance
 - Performance reviews every 6 months with discretionary salary increases
 - Hybrid work set-up
 - Gym membership contribution/ Sport challenge contribution
 - WFH set-up equipment allowance(Valid upto 1st  six months of joining)
 - Renowned team days often throughout the year
 - Discretionary bonus on company performance
 - Manager, team & individual training-Lunch & Learns, Brunch clubs, Global Huddles
 - Mobile & Internet Reimbursement  Though these are the basics written down, we will principally be recruiting for energy, values and commitment - both to Two Circles and to your career. Even if you feel you don't tick 100% of the boxes but feel you could bring value to the role, we'd still love to hear from you!  Our recruitment process will be honest & thorough, and so will our roles. In return, we can offer honesty, integrity, and the chance to progress in the organisation as quickly as you develop within it. 

Two Circles is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunities employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

Amgen harnesses the best of biology and technology to fight the world's toughest diseases and make people's lives easier, fuller, and longer. We are seeking an Associate IS Engineer to support the delivery, operation, maintenance, and continuous improvement of enterprise applications and digital solutions.

Working under the guidance of senior engineers, the Associate IS Engineer will investigate and resolve application and integration issues, support application releases and upgrades, participate in incident and problem management, maintain application documentation and configurations, and work with business, infrastructure, platform, security, and vendor teams.

Job Description

Job Description - Production Supervisor

XDU/CDU End-of-Line Testing Production Supervisor

Company: Vertiv Location: Chakan Plant, Pune, India Department: Production / Manufacturing Reports To: Production Manager Employment Type: Full-Time

Position Summary

We are seeking an experienced and technically proficient CDU (Coolant Distribution Unit) End-of-Line Testing Supervisor to lead and manage the end-of-line testing operations for our CDU production line. The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in liquid cooling systems, chilled water systems, and automated testing equipment, combined with strong supervisory and production management skills. This role is critical to ensuring every CDU leaving the production line meets stringent quality, performance, and safety standards. 

Key Responsibilities Technical & Testing

- Supervise and execute end-of-line testing of Coolant Distribution Units (CDUs) used in data centre liquid cooling applications
 - Operate, program, and troubleshoot automated test equipment (auto testers) designed for CDU functional and performance validation
 - Conduct and oversee water pressure testing including hydrostatic testing, leak testing, and pressure decay testing as per established procedures and standards
 - Read, interpret, and validate readings from instrumentation including pressure transducers, temperature sensors (RTDs, thermocouples), flow meters, differential pressure gauges, and other water system instruments
 - Ensure proper functioning and calibration of all test instruments and equipment
 - Validate CDU components and sub-assemblies including butterfly valves, ball valves, control valves, coupling joints (Victaulic/grooved couplings), heat exchangers, pumps, manifolds, and piping assemblies
 - Understand and apply knowledge of chilled water system principles - flow dynamics, pressure drops, heat rejection, temperature differentials, and coolant loop operations
 - Diagnose and resolve test failures by analyzing root causes related to hydraulic, mechanical, or electrical sub-systems of the CDU
 - Maintain and update test procedures, checklists, and acceptance criteria documentation

Safety & Compliance

- Enforce and ensure strict adherence to electrical safety protocols during CDU testing (lockout/tagout, grounding, insulation resistance testing, high-voltage precautions)
 - Enforce and ensure strict adherence to mechanical safety protocols (pressurized system handling, PPE compliance, safe coupling/decoupling of water lines, spill containment)
 - Conduct risk assessments and ensure all testing activities comply with EHS (Environment, Health & Safety) standards
 - Maintain safety records, incident reports, and ensure corrective actions are implemented promptly
 - Ensure compliance with relevant industry standards and regulatory requirements for pressure vessel and water system testing

Supervision & People Management

- Supervise, mentor, and train a team of testing technicians and operators on CDU testing procedures, instrument handling, and safety practices
 - Develop and maintain operator certification and skill matrix programs for the testing team
 - Conduct regular performance reviews, provide feedback, and identify skill development needs
 - Plan and manage shift schedules, manpower allocation, and workload distribution to meet production targets

Production & Operations Management

- Coordinate with production planning to align testing schedules with production targets and delivery timelines
 - Monitor and report key metrics - first pass yield (FPY), test cycle time, defect rates, and throughput
 - Drive continuous improvement initiatives to reduce test cycle times, improve yield, and enhance testing reliability
 - Maintain 5S standards on the testing shop floor - Sort, Set in Order, Shine, Standardize, Sustain
 - Adhere to and promote standard manufacturing practices including lean manufacturing, Kaizen, and visual management
 - Coordinate with cross-functional teams including Design Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing Engineering (ME), Advanced Manufacturing Engineering (AME), Supply Chain, and Service for issue resolution and process improvements
 - Participate in new product introduction (NPI) activities by supporting test procedure development and validation for new CDU models
 - Manage test equipment maintenance schedules and coordinate with vendors for calibration and servicing

Required Qualifications Education

- Bachelor's Degree in Engineering - Mechanical, Electrical, Mechatronics, or a related discipline

Experience

- Minimum 5 years of hands-on experience in testing, quality, or production supervision roles in a manufacturing environment
 - Demonstrated experience with liquid cooling systems, chilled water systems, or HVAC systems
 - Proven experience with pressure testing procedures (hydrostatic, pneumatic, leak detection)
 - Experience working with automated test systems/auto testers in a production environment

Technical Skills

- Strong working knowledge of chilled water system components - valves (butterfly, ball, control), coupling joints, heat exchangers, pumps, expansion tanks, and piping systems
 - Proficiency in reading and interpreting P&ID (Piping & Instrumentation Diagrams) and engineering drawings
 - Ability to read, calibrate, and troubleshoot instruments - pressure transducers, temperature sensors (RTDs/thermocouples), flow meters, differential pressure gauges, and data loggers
 - Understanding of electrical systems in CDUs - control panels, VFDs, sensors, and wiring
 - Familiarity with test automation software/platforms and data acquisition systems
 - Knowledge of relevant standards (ASME, ASHRAE, ISO) related to pressure testing and water systems

Supervisory & Management Skills

- Proven ability to lead, train, and develop a team of technicians and operators
 - Strong understanding of production scheduling, manpower planning, and resource optimization
 - Experience in maintaining quality standards in a production/testing environment (ISO 9001 awareness preferred)
 - Hands-on experience with 5S implementation and shop floor discipline
 - Familiarity with lean manufacturing principles, Kaizen, and continuous improvement methodologies
 - Excellent coordination and communication skills for cross-functional collaboration
 - Proficiency in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) and familiarity with ERP/MES systems

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience specifically in data centre cooling equipment manufacturing or testing
 - Exposure to CDU, in-row cooling, or precision cooling product lines
 - Knowledge of data centre infrastructure and liquid cooling architectures (direct-to-chip, rear-door heat exchangers, immersion cooling)
 - Certification in Six Sigma (Green/Black Belt) or equivalent quality methodology
 - Experience with SPC (Statistical Process Control) and test data analytics
 - Familiarity with PLC-based test automation and SCADA systems

Key Competencies

- Attention to detail and commitment to quality
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
 - Safety-first mindset
 - Ability to work under pressure and meet tight production deadlines
 - Proactive and self-driven with a continuous improvement orientation
 - Effective team leadership and people development skills
 - Adaptability to a fast-paced, evolving manufacturing environment

data.description:
Job Title: 

- Director - SoC Verification

We Are

Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow. 

You Are

You have built a career at the intersection of deep SoC verification expertise and organizational leadership. You have closed coverage on complex multi-protocol designs and know that scaling verification across a services organization requires clear structure, strong leaders, and a strategy that holds when customer scope, timelines, and design complexity move at once. The difference between a verification plan that delivers and one that collapses three months before tapeout is usually visible early, and you are the kind of leader who sees it and acts before it becomes an escalation. You operate at two levels simultaneously. One day you are reviewing a coverage closure strategy for an automotive SoC with safety requirements your team has never seen before. The next you are restructuring team assignments because two customer engagements just expanded scope and you need to rebalance without dropping quality. You build leaders, not just projects. You know how to develop a senior engineer into someone who can own customer signoff, and you know when to step into a room yourself because the technical or relationship stakes require it. At Synopsys, you will lead verification for the System Solutions Group and shape how we deliver complex SoC services to customers who depend on us to get it right. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Lead and grow a multi-team SoC verification organization delivering customer-facing services across automotive, aerospace, defense, and high-performance computing
 - Define and drive SSG verification strategy, including methodology standards, signoff criteria, VIP and tool deployment, and reusable testbench patterns adopted across projects
 - Own organizational planning including headcount, hiring, succession, performance management, and skill development to build scalable verification capability
 - Partner with sales and account teams to scope opportunities, assess technical and resource risk, prioritize work against capacity, and align delivery with customer and business objectives
 - Serve as executive-level technical authority on complex SoC verification challenges, escalations, and convergence across multi-protocol, multi-domain, and advanced-node designs
 - Establish clear accountability across verification managers and technical leads, and drive adoption of Synopsys VCS, Verdi, and VIP based on customer project learnings
 - Build and maintain executive customer relationships that enable long-term engagement growth and position Synopsys as the verification partner of choice for complex SoC programs

The Impact You Will Have

- Your organization will enable customers to tape out complex SoCs on schedule, affecting product launches in AI, automotive, aerospace, and high-performance computing
 - The verification strategy and standards you define will scale across SSG projects, improving coverage quality, reducing cycle time, and compressing ramp time on new engagements
 - The leaders you develop will strengthen Synopsys capability to win and execute larger, more complex verification service engagements
 - Your capacity planning and executive customer engagement will shape how leading semiconductor companies adopt Synopsys EDA tools, VIP, and verification services
 - What you build will directly influence how SSG scales verification delivery, wins competitive pursuits, and expands into new customer segments and protocol domains
 - The organizational structure and accountability model you establish will become the foundation for how SSG verification grows over the next three to five years

What You'll Need

- Bachelor's or Master's in Electronics Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field with 20+ years of hands-on SoC, subsystem, or IP verification experience, including significant leadership scope
 - Expert-level knowledge of UVM-based verification, coverage-driven closure, verification planning, and complex multi-domain debug across processor-based SoC architectures
 - Proven experience leading large verification organizations or multi-project teams through planning, delivery, and customer signoff in a services or product development environment
 - Deep working knowledge of protocols such as PCIe, Ethernet, USB, DDR, and AMBA interconnects, and hands-on proficiency with Synopsys VCS, Verdi, and VIP
 - Demonstrated ability to build organizational structures with clear accountability, develop managers and technical leads, and partner with sales and senior customer stakeholders on scoping and escalations
 - Experience with ARM-based SoC architectures, automotive functional safety verification, or emulation flows is a strong plus

Who You Are

- You translate vague customer requests into scoped plans, staffed organizations, and delivery models your teams can execute without losing quality
 - You see both the technical gap and the organizational failure behind a coverage miss or escalation, and you know how to fix both
 - You build leaders, not just projects, and you invest time developing managers and senior engineers into people who can own customer outcomes independently
 - You communicate effectively to engineers debugging a testbench, customer architects reviewing signoff criteria, sales executives scoping a new opportunity, and Synopsys senior leadership reviewing quarterly business performance
 - You make hard calls on resource allocation, project prioritization, and team structure when the right answer is not the easy one, and you explain the tradeoff clearly enough that people understand why
 - You know when to delegate and when to step in yourself, whether that means reviewing a verification plan before it goes to a customer or sitting in an escalation call with an executive stakeholder

The Team You'll Be Part Of

You will lead verification within the System Solutions Group (SSG), which delivers end-to-end SoC design and verification services to Synopsys customers across high-performance computing, automotive, aerospace, and defense. You will build and lead the verification organization and collaborate with SSG design and architecture peers, sales, application engineering, IP, and EDA teams to deliver customer engagements and scale Synopsys verification capability. 

Rewards And Benefits

We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

data.title: USB Lead Engineer
data.description:
USB Lead Engineer - Linux Enablement & AVV (Pre/Post-Silicon) - RISC‐V MPU Platform

Location: Pune / Bangalore, India

Own USB enablement on Linux - driver bring-up, compliance, and AVV from FPGA to first silicon. 

About GlobalFoundries

GlobalFoundries is a leading full-service semiconductor foundry providing a unique combination of design, development, and fabrication services to some of the world's most inspired technology companies. With a global manufacturing footprint spanning three continents, GlobalFoundries make possible the technologies and systems that transform industries and give customers the power to shape their markets. For more information, visit www. gf. com. 

About The Role

We're building a next-generation, application-class RISC‐V MPU SoC platform for Linux systems - bringing together multimedia, industrial connectivity, security, and high-speed I/O. 

In the Platform Software team, you will be the technical owner for USB across the stack: boot-to-user-space enablement, kernel/driver integration, and automated validation (AVV) on virtual platforms/FPGA and first silicon. You'll partner closely with architects and hardware teams to de-risk the USB subsystem, drive bring-up readiness and deliver a production-quality SDK experience. 

Key Responsibilities

- USB Linux enablement & integration: enable and maintain USB host/device/dual-role functionality on a 64-bit RISC‐V MPU Linux platform. 
 - Bring up USB controllers (e. g. , xHCI/EHCI for host, UDC for device/gadget), PHY integration, clocks/resets, and interrupts. 
 - Drive kernel/BSP enablement: Device Tree bindings, power management (runtime/PM QoS), suspend/resume, and performance tuning. 
 - Develop/debug USB drivers and related subsystems: USB core interactions, hub behavior, gadget framework, and class drivers as needed. 
 - Enable and validate user-space workflows: enumeration, throughput/latency, storage/networking classes, and reliability over hot-plug scenarios. 
 - Deliver USB-ready SDK releases: integration, regression validation, and developer-facing documentation/debug guides. 
 - AVV & silicon validation (pre/post-silicon): create test plans and automation to validate USB functionality, performance, and compliance on FPGA/emulation and first silicon. 
 - Contribute to shift-left validation using virtual platforms/emulation/FPGA; build reusable USB validation apps/tests to exercise data paths and corner cases. 
 - Debug and root-cause USB issues across HW/FW/kernel using logs, traces, and lab equipment (e. g. , JTAG, logic/protocol analyzers); drive fixes to closure. 
 - Cross-functional ownership: partner with architects, RTL/PHY, board, and platform teams to define requirements, de-risk schedules, and land USB features. 
 - Own USB feature planning: role/port matrix, power & charging considerations, compliance goals, and bring-up milestones. 
 - Provide bring-up and validation feedback that influences USB architecture decisions (controller/PHY selection, debug hooks, observability, testability). 
 - Align with internal and external stakeholders on deliverables, bug triage, and release readiness for USB enablement. 
 - Customer & ecosystem engagement: support early adopters and upstream fixes when appropriate (kernel, Device Tree, test collateral). 
 - Work with OEMs/Tier‐1s during bring-up and USB interoperability; contribute patches upstream when it improves maintainability. 
Required Qualifications

- B. E. /B. Tech or M. E. /M. Tech in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field. 
 - Strong experience with minimum 8-15 years in Embedded Linux platform/BSP and device-driver development. 
 - Expert-level C programming; comfortable reading and modifying kernel, driver, and low-level firmware code. 
 - Strong Linux internals knowledge: boot flow, memory/interrupt subsystems, concurrency, and performance debugging. 
 - Hands-on SoC/platform bring-up experience, including high-speed I/O enablement and ownership mindset for subsystem quality. 
 - Hands-on with U‐Boot, Linux kernel, Device Tree, and Yocto/OpenEmbedded; experience integrating and validating USB in BSP/SDK releases. 
 - Strong debugging skills with GDB and at least one OpenOCD/JTAG, Lauterbach, or similar tools; able to debug complex HW/SW interactions. 
 - Experience working on FPGA, emulation, or early-silicon platforms for bring-up/validation. 

Good to Have

- Deep USB knowledge (USB2/USB3) and familiarity with Linux USB architecture (usbcore, HCD, gadget framework). 
 - Experience with USB compliance/interoperability testing and post-silicon triage (throughput, link stability, suspend/resume, hot-plug). 
 - Exposure to USB Type‐C/PD, retimers, and/or Alt Modes (e. g. , DisplayPort) is a plus. 
 - Familiarity with platform security boundaries relevant to USB (secure boot, firmware/OS boundaries, attack surface considerations). 
 - Experience with QEMU, virtual platforms, or emulation workflows used for early driver/test development. 
 - Exposure to CI/CD and automated validation (Python/shell test frameworks, dashboards, regressions) for continuous USB quality. 

What We Offer

- Build a RISC‐V MPU platform from the ground up and see it shipped in real products. 
 - End-to-end ownership across pre-silicon → FPGA → first silicon → production SDK releases. 
 - Work closely with CPU architects and SoC teams, your data drives decisions. 
 - Deep technical work, strong peer group, and long-term growth on a strategic platform

MIPS - GlobalFoundries company is an equal opportunity employer, cultivating a diverse and inclusive workforce. We believe having a multicultural workplace enhances productivity, efficiency and innovation whilst our employees feel truly respected, valued and heard. 

As an affirmative employer, all qualified applicants are considered for employment regardless of age, ethnicity, marital status, citizenship, race, religion, political affiliation, gender, sexual orientation and medical and/or physical abilities. 

All offers of employment with GlobalFoundries are conditioned upon the successful completion of background checks, medical screenings as applicable and subject to the respective local laws and regulations. 

Information about our benefits you can find here: https: //gf. com/about-us/careers/opportunities-asia

data.title: Principal Expert, US Insurance Industry
data.description:
Life at UiPath

The people at UiPath believe in the transformative power of automation to change how the world works. We're committed to creating category-leading enterprise software that unleashes that power. 

To make that happen, we need people who are curious, self-propelled, generous, and genuine. People who love being part of a fast-moving, fast-thinking growth company. And people who care-about each other, about UiPath, and about our larger purpose. 

Could that be you?

Your Mission

UiPath is building a new way to design and deliver enterprise processes. UiPath cartographer draws on a curated library of industry process knowledge, interviews the business, and produces process maps and design documents. AI coding agents then turn those designs into working, orchestrated solutions, in days rather than months. 

In insurance, "almost right" isn't good enough. The best AI companies in regulated industries have learned the same lesson: quality comes from making a senior practitioner part of the team to building the benchmarks, evaluations and feedback loops around their experience and judgment. 

That's this role. As our Principal Expert for insurance, you will own the quality of everything our AI produces for US insurers. You'll set the bar, build the tests that hold the AI to it, and work in the field with customers and partners to make sure what we ship works in a real carrier. 

This role does not carry a sales quota and is not a product management role. Success is measured by the quality of the insurance solutions we deliver and how confidently customers build on them. 

Why This Role Is Exciting

- Your work sets the standard. What you define as good will be used by insurance customers, partners and AI agents across the platform. 
 - You see the impact. Take a process from discovery to a working solution in days, then keep improving it. 
 - You're building something new. Help decide which lines of business we go after next and how we measure the success of AI-designed processes. 

What You'll Do At UiPath

Own insurance AI quality

- Own the quality of insurance process knowledge, designs and solutions across Property & Casualty and Life & Annuity. 
 - Decide what needs fixing first, review changes before they go to customers, and sign off when a process is ready. 
 - Work with industry experts, partners and reviewers to maintain and improve quality. 

Build the insurance benchmark

- Build a library of real insurance use cases covering claims, FNOL and triage, total loss, endorsements, life claims, medical records, disability claims and new business NIGO. 
 - Define test cases, scoring criteria and expected answers to evaluate every new AI model and product release before it reaches customers. 

Turn expert judgment into evaluations

- Evaluate AI outputs at every stage, from process knowledge and process maps to design documents and working solutions. 
 - Work with applied scientists and engineers to make sure automated AI evaluations match expert judgment, so we can scale quality checks without relying on manual reviews for everything. 

Find failures and make sure they get fixed

- Review actual outputs, identify common failure types across regulation, coverage, workflows, data and terminology, and prioritise them based on customer impact. 
 - Turn recurring failures into reusable test cases and make sure fixes work before they go live. 
 - Share clear updates on quality, key issues and progress with leadership, product teams and customers. 

How You'll Work

You'll work in a small, senior team of automation consultants, engineers and applied scientists, working directly with customers. 

- Work with insurance carriers, MGAs and consulting partners to understand how their claims and underwriting teams operate, and test our designs against real processes. 
 - Join consultants and engineers on customer deployments and use what you learn to improve our benchmarks and evaluations. 
 - Run a regular review cycle, roughly every two weeks, to assess outputs, prioritise fixes and track improvements. 
 - Join customer and partner meetings. 

What You'll Bring To The Team

- Extensive experience (typically 12+ years) in US insurance, ideally starting hands-on in claims and moving into claims operations senior or mid level roles. 
 - Deep P&C or Life & Annuity knowledge across the lifecycle
 - Working knowledge of US claims regulation: unfair claims settlement practices, state acknowledgment and payment deadlines, total-loss and salvage rules, and market conduct exams. 
 - Experience mapping or redesigning claims or policy servicing operations: queues, handoffs, SLAs, exceptions, fraud referral and QA. 
 - The confidence to review complex documents quickly, spot what's plausible but wrong, and explain exactly why. 

Nice To Have

- Life & Annuity or disability expertise: contestability, beneficiary determination, unclaimed property, suitability, and underwriting evidence such as medical records. 
 - Experience evaluating AI or automation output: writing test cases, rubrics or reference answers, or running QA or validation programs. 
 - Experience with insurance AI, claims automation or document intake programs. 
 - Comfort with data and light technical work, such as spreadsheets, data analysis or prompting AI tools. 
 - Experience leading or calibrating a team of reviewers, auditors or claims QA specialists. 
 - Commercial lines, workers' compensation, employee benefits or broker/MGA experience. 

Maybe you don't tick all the boxes above-but still think you'd be great for the job? Go ahead, apply anyway. Please. Because we know that experience comes in all shapes and sizes-and passion can't be learned. 

Many of our roles allow for flexibility in when and where work gets done. Depending on the needs of the business and the role, the number of hybrid, office-based, and remote workers will vary from team to team. Applications are assessed on a rolling basis and there is no fixed deadline for this requisition. The application window may change depending on the volume of applications received or may close immediately if a qualified candidate is selected. 

We value a range of diverse backgrounds, experiences and ideas. We pride ourselves on our diversity and inclusive workplace that provides equal opportunities to all persons regardless of age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, and expression, national origin, disability, neurodiversity, military and/or veteran status, or any other protected classes. Additionally, UiPath provides reasonable accommodations for candidates on request and respects applicants' privacy rights. To review these and other legal disclosures, visit our privacy policy.

Join a high-impact Customer Quality & Failure Analysis team where you'll investigate complex customer-reported failures in cutting-edge IoT Wi-Fi and Bluetooth products. This role offers the opportunity to work closely with product, design, manufacturing, and customer engineering teams to drive root cause analysis, improve product quality, and directly influence customer satisfaction. 

Your role

Key responsibilities in your new role

- Own customer-reported Failure Analysis (FA) cases from initiation through customer closure. 
 - Perform electrical failure analysis on IoT Wi-Fi and Bluetooth semiconductor devices. 
 - Conduct lot trace analysis and manufacturing data reviews to identify potential process or product anomalies. 
 - Execute DC/bench testing and electrical characterization as part of failure investigations. 
 - Perform ATE testing on UltraFlex platforms and analyze test logs to determine failure mechanisms. 
 - Conduct Wi-Fi and Bluetooth system-level validation to isolate and reproduce issues. 
 - Drive root cause identification and corrective actions using structured problem-solving methodologies. 
 - Collaborate with Product Engineering, Design, Manufacturing, Applications Engineering, and Quality teams to resolve customer issues. 
 - Interface directly with internal and external customers, providing technical updates and investigation findings. 
 - Author detailed failure analysis reports and customer-facing technical summaries. 
 - Manage FA case communications and documentation within Salesforce. com. 
 - Support sustaining engineering activities for microprocessors and IoT product portfolios. 
 - Present technical findings and corrective action recommendations to customers and cross-functional stakeholders. 

Your profile

Qualifications And Skills To Help You Succeed

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Microelectronics, Semiconductor Physics, or a related field. 
 - 8+ years of experience in Customer Quality, Failure Analysis, Product Engineering, or Semiconductor Quality roles. 
 - Strong expertise in electrical failure analysis and semiconductor device characterization. 
 - Hands-on experience with UltraFlex test systems; experience with Advantest, Verigy, Maverick, or Magnum platforms is highly desirable. 
 - Sound understanding of semiconductor physics, device failure mechanisms, and manufacturing processes. 
 - Proven experience using quality and problem-solving tools such as 8D, DOE, FMEA, FTA, Fishbone Analysis, Why-Why, Statistical Yield Analysis, and Is/Is-Not methodology. 
 - Strong data analysis skills with proficiency in Excel (Pivot Tables, data interpretation, trend analysis). 
 - Experience creating professional customer-facing FA reports, presentations, and technical documentation. 
 - Excellent communication and customer-facing presentation skills. 
 - Knowledge of scripting, automation, data science, or analytics tools is an added advantage. 
 - Ability to work effectively across global, cross-functional teams and manage multiple complex investigations simultaneously. 

#WeAreIn for driving decarbonization and digitalization. 

As a global leader in semiconductor solutions in power systems and IoT, Infineon enables game-changing solutions for green and efficient energy, clean and safe mobility, as well as smart and secure IoT. Together, we drive innovation and customer success, while caring for our people and empowering them to reach ambitious goals. Be a part of making life easier, safer and greener. 

Are you in?

We are on a journey to create the best Infineon for everyone. 

We strive to create the best Infineon for everyone by embracing diversity and inclusion. We welcome applicants for who they are and offer a workplace built on trust, openness, respect and equal opportunity. 

Our hiring decisions are based on skills and experience. Even if you don't meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. 

Please let your recruiter know if you need any accommodations during the interview process. 

Learn more about our various contact channels and about Diversity & Inclusion at Infineon.

data.title: AWS DevOps Lead
data.description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they are doing!

We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business. 

About The Role

We are looking for a AWS DevOps Lead with strong hands-on experience in AWS cloud infrastructure, automation, CI/CD and production engineering. This role is suited for an engineer with a strong builder mindset who enjoys solving complex infrastructure problems and creating scalable, reliable and automated platforms. 

What You'll Do

- Design, build and maintain highly available, scalable and secure infrastructure on AWS. 
 - Build automation to reduce manual operational effort and improve engineering productivity. 
 - Design, develop and manage robust CI/CD pipelines for application and infrastructure deployments. 
 - Drive Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and automation-first engineering practices. 
 - Troubleshoot complex production issues across AWS infrastructure, Linux, networking, applications and deployment pipelines. 
 - Participate in production support and on-call activities, taking end-to-end ownership of incidents and root-cause analysis. 
 - Partner closely with software engineering teams to design and enable cloud-native solutions. 
 - Continuously improve platform reliability, scalability, security, performance and developer experience. 
 - Build reusable automation and self-service capabilities for engineering teams. 
 - Evaluate AI-powered engineering solutions that can improve operational efficiency and developer productivity. 
 - Create and maintain architecture documentation, operational runbooks and engineering best practices. 

What We're Looking For

- 8-12 years of hands-on experience in DevOps, AWS Cloud Engineering, Platform Engineering, SRE or similar engineering roles. 
 - Strong hands-on experience designing and operating infrastructure on Amazon Web Services (AWS). 
 - Experience with AWS services and capabilities such as: EC2 EBS S3 VPC and VPC Endpoints Transit Gateway Security Groups and NACLs AWS CodePipeline AWS CodeBuild
 - Strong Linux administration and troubleshooting skills, including process management, memory, file systems, system performance and shell scripting. 
 - Solid understanding of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, routing, load balancing, firewalls and VPN concepts. 
 - Strong scripting or programming skills in at least one of Python, Go, Java or Bash. 
 - Hands-on experience building and managing CI/CD pipelines and a good understanding of modern software delivery practices. 
 - Experience with GitHub Actions for build and deployment automation. 
 - Strong production troubleshooting, debugging and root-cause analysis capabilities. 
 - Experience building reusable automation or self-service tooling. 
 - Strong communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across engineering teams. 

Good to Have

- Hands-on experience with Terraform and/or AWS CloudFormation. 
 - Experience with containers and orchestration technologies such as Docker, Kubernetes and Amazon EKS. 
 - Experience with monitoring and observability platforms such as AWS CloudWatch, Grafana, Prometheus or Datadog. 
 - Experience with configuration management tools such as Ansible. 
 - Understanding of AWS cloud security and infrastructure security best practices. 
 - AWS certification(s). 

What Will Make You Successful in This Role

You Are Someone Who

- Thinks automation first and looks for opportunities to engineer manual work out of the system. 
 - Has a strong builder mindset and enjoys solving difficult infrastructure problems. 
 - Takes ownership of production systems rather than simply operating them. 
 - Has strong debugging instincts and enjoys getting to the root cause of complex problems. 
 - Balances reliability, scalability, security and developer experience. 
 - Is curious about emerging engineering technologies, including AI-assisted engineering tools. 
 - Continuously learns and helps raise the engineering standards of the wider team. 

Why Fractal?

At Fractal, you'll have the opportunity to work at the intersection of AI, cloud and modern engineering, solving challenging problems at scale alongside multidisciplinary engineering and technology teams. 

If you enjoy building rather than just maintaining, automating rather than manually operating and solving complex cloud infrastructure problems, we'd love to hear from you. 

If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!

Not the right fit? Let us know you're interested in a future opportunity by clicking Introduce Yourself in the top-right corner of the page or create an account to set up email alerts as new job postings become available that meet your interest!

data.title: Principal Enterprise Software Test Engineer
data.description:
Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95, 000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first - developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact. 

A Day in the Life

The Acute Care Monitoring (ACM) Research & Development organization develops software and technology solutions that support patient monitoring and respiratory interventions across the continuum of care. The software verification and validation function is responsible for ensuring product quality, reliability, safety, and regulatory compliance through comprehensive test strategy development, test automation, verification and validation activities, and continuous quality improvements for medical device software products. 

This position is based in Hyderabad, India and follows a Flex work arrangement. No travel is required. 

As a senior software verification and validation professional, you will lead verification and validation activities for medical device software products across multiple programs. The role focuses on test strategy development, test automation, software quality assurance, regulatory compliance, and cross-functional collaboration to ensure safe, effective, and high-quality software releases for Acute Care Monitoring products. 

Primary Responsibilities

- Lead software verification and validation activities across multiple medical device software programs and serve as test lead for RPE initiatives. 
 - Design, develop, and execute verification and validation strategies using manual and automated testing methodologies. 
 - Develop and enhance test automation frameworks for desktop, web, mobile, and embedded software applications. 
 - Review software requirements, test designs, and test scripts to ensure comprehensive verification of product functionality and quality requirements. 
 - Collaborate with global cross-functional Agile teams throughout requirements, design, implementation, verification, and release activities. 
 - Support non-product tool validation (NPTV), defect analysis, risk assessments, static code analysis, and quality assurance activities. 
 - Mentor verification and validation engineers, promote testing best practices, and support continuous process improvements. 
 - Ensure compliance with medical device software standards, quality requirements, and project performance objectives. 

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree OR Master's degree in Computer Science, Biomedical Engineering, Biotechnology, Electronics Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related technical discipline with 15+ years of experience in software verification and validation, including 2+ years in medical device, medical IT, or other regulated industries. 
 - Experience in software verification and validation for desktop, web, mobile, and embedded software applications using manual and automated testing methodologies. 
 - Proficiency in Python, LabVIEW, TestStand, and C# with experience developing automated test solutions and test frameworks. 
 - Experience with UI test automation tools, Selenium, Appium, debugging techniques, and both white-box and black-box testing methodologies. 
 - Experience with Agile software development, JIRA, Polarion, GitLab, continuous integration environments, and hardware-software integration testing. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience designing, developing, or testing regulated medical device software products. 
 - Knowledge of IEC 62304, IEC 60601-1, ISO 13485, ISO 14971, FDA regulations, and medical device quality system requirements. 
 - Experience with networking and embedded communication protocols including UART, USB, Bluetooth, Wi-Fi, and related technologies. 
 - Experience with software version control systems, automated testing frameworks, and quality engineering best practices. 
 - Experience serving as a technical mentor or test lead within cross-functional global development teams. 

Physical Job Requirements

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees assigned to this position, but they are not an exhaustive list of all the required responsibilities and skills of this position. 





Recruitment Fraud Alert

We are aware of phishing scams targeting job seekers. Please keep the following in mind: 

Apply only through official Medtronic channels. All legitimate Medtronic recruiting communications come from approved Medtronic platforms and official @medtronic. com email addresses. 

Medtronic will never ask for payment or sensitive personal information (such as bank account or Social Security details) during early stages of the hiring process. Any such requests are not legitimate. 

If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from Medtronic, do not respond, click links, or open attachments. 

If you have any questions, concerns regarding the authenticity of a communication alleged to have been made by or on behalf of Medtronic, please contact us immediately at AskHR@medtronic. com. 

Benefits & Compensation

Medtronic offers a competitive Salary and flexible Benefits Package

A commitment to our employees lives at the core of our values. We recognize their contributions. They share in the success they help to create. We offer a wide range of benefits, resources, and competitive compensation plans designed to support you at every career and life stage. 



This position is eligible for a short-term incentive called the Medtronic Incentive Plan (MIP).

data.title: Staff Performance Engineer
data.description:
Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced Staff Performance Engineer to lead and scale performance engineering practices for our cloud-native SaaS platform. This role is responsible for driving performance, scalability, reliability, and cost efficiency at an organizational level, with a strong focus on serverless and distributed architectures. 

You will define performance engineering strategy, build scalable and AI-driven performance platforms, and influence architectural decisions across teams. The role requires deep expertise in modern cloud environments and a strong focus on embedding performance into the entire software lifecycle, from development to production. 

Key Responsibilities

- Define and drive organization-wide performance engineering strategy aligned with business KPIs, customer experience, and cost efficiency
 - Architect and build scalable, self-service performance engineering platforms enabling teams to run performance tests and analysis independently
 - Design and implement AI-driven performance engineering solutions including anomaly detection, predictive performance insights, adaptive load testing, and automated optimization recommendations
 - Lead the design and execution of advanced performance testing strategies for serverless, distributed, and event-driven systems
 - Establish and standardize performance benchmarks, SLAs, SLOs, and KPIs across services
 - Drive integration of performance testing and validation into CI/CD pipelines to enable continuous performance engineering (shift-left approach)
 - Analyze system-wide performance bottlenecks including latency, cold starts, concurrency limits, and resource utilization across distributed systems
 - Collaborate with engineering, SRE, and architecture teams to influence system design for scalability, resilience, and performance optimization
 - Own performance in production environments by leveraging observability tools, distributed tracing, and real-time monitoring systems
 - Implement intelligent observability solutions using tools such as CloudWatch, Datadog, New Relic, and AI-based monitoring platforms
 - Lead capacity planning and scalability initiatives for high-throughput and globally distributed systems
 - Drive cost-performance optimization strategies in cloud-native environments (FinOps alignment)
 - Mentor and guide engineers across teams, promoting a performance-first culture and best practices
 - Stay updated with emerging trends in performance engineering, including AI/ML-driven optimization and cloud-native innovations

Desired Skill and Requirements

Must Have

- 8+ years of experience in performance engineering within large-scale SaaS or cloud-native environments
 - Performance testing tools - JMeter, Gatling, Locust, or similar
 - Serverless architectures - AWS Lambda, API Gateway, event-driven systems
 - Performance monitoring and observability tools - CloudWatch, Datadog, New Relic, distributed tracing systems
 - Building performance engineering frameworks or platforms at scale
 - Performance optimization in distributed and serverless systems - latency, cold starts, concurrency, and scaling behavior
 - Integration of performance engineering into CI/CD pipelines
 - Programming/scripting - Python (preferred), Java, or similar
 - AI/ML-based performance optimization techniques - anomaly detection, predictive analysis, adaptive load modeling
 - Cloud platforms (AWS preferred) and performance optimization techniques
 - Ability to identify and resolve complex performance bottlenecks
 - Large-scale load testing and capacity planning
 - Cost-performance optimization in cloud environments

Good To Have

- Kubernetes, containerized, and serverless architectures
 - Chaos engineering and resilience testing
 - Internal developer platforms and self-service tooling
 - FinOps and cloud cost optimization strategies
 - Globally distributed and multi-region architectures
 - API performance optimization
 - Modern distributed data stores - DynamoDB, Aurora Serverless, NoSQL systems
 - AIOps platforms and intelligent observability systems

Soft Skills

- Strong problem-solving and analytical thinking
 - Ability to influence architectural and technical decisions across teams
 - Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
 - Ownership mindset with the ability to drive cross-functional initiatives
 - Mentorship and leadership capabilities
 - Ability to operate in a fast-paced, high-growth SaaS environment

Experience

- 8+ years of experience in performance engineering in large-scale SaaS or cloud-native environments
 - 3+ years of experience in Senior, Lead, or Staff-level performance engineering roles
 - 4+ years of experience performance testing large-scale SaaS or distributed systems
 - 5+ years of hands-on experience with performance testing tools such as JMeter, Gatling, k6, or Locust
 - Experience designing and executing large-scale performance tests in production-like environments
 - Experience identifying and resolving performance bottlenecks across application, database, network, and infrastructure layers
 - Experience tuning databases for performance at scale
 - Experience defining and implementing performance benchmarks, KPIs, and capacity planning strategies
 - Experience working with observability and monitoring platforms for performance analysis
 - Experience optimizing event-driven and serverless architectures
 - Experience influencing architecture and engineering decisions across teams and domains
 - Experience operating in fast-paced, high-growth SaaS environments

Education

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field
 - Equivalent practical experience in performance engineering or cloud-native systems

data.title: Senior QA Engineer (Performance Testing)
data.description:
We're looking for a Senior QA Engineer (Performance Testing) to join Procore's Product & Technology QA Engineering Team in India. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, executing, and scaling performance and load tests for critical systems to ensure our platform delivers reliable and high-performing experiences to millions of users worldwide. 

You should be detail-oriented, analytical, and self-driven, with the ability to work in a fast-paced environment with cross-functional teams across various domains and locations. This role will focus on performance testing of web applications, APIs, and backend services, and will play a key part in performance tuning and capacity planning. 

Procore software solutions aim to improve the lives of everyone in construction, and our Product & Technology team is the driving force behind our innovative, top-rated global platform. We're a customer-centric group encompassing engineering, product, design, data, and business systems. 

This position reports into the QA Manager and will be based in our Bengaluru offices. We're looking for someone to join us immediately. 

What You'll Do: 

- Design and develop robust performance test plans and strategies for backend services, APIs, and web applications. 
 - Execute load, stress, endurance, scalability, and capacity tests to validate system performance. 
 - Analyze test results, identify bottlenecks, and work closely with development and infrastructure teams to resolve performance issues. 
 - Establish performance benchmarks and monitor performance regressions across releases. 
 - Integrate performance testing into CI/CD pipelines to enable shift-left performance validation. 
 - Collaborate with cross-functional teams including developers, DevOps, product managers, and business stakeholders to define non-functional requirements and acceptance criteria. 
 - Contribute to performance optimization and tuning initiatives, and support root cause analysis for production performance incidents. 

What We're Looking For: 

- 5+ years of experience in performance engineering or software quality assurance with a strong focus on performance testing. 
 - Strong experience with performance testing tools such as JMeter, Gatling, Locust, or k6. 
 - Solid understanding of system architecture, distributed systems, and cloud-native applications (preferably AWS or GCP). 
 - Strong analytical and debugging skills to diagnose performance issues at different layers (app, database, network). 
 - Experience with APM tools like New Relic, Datadog, or Grafana for monitoring and profiling. 
 - Proficiency in scripting languages such as Python, JavaScript, or Groovy to automate test workflows. 
 - Working knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and integrating performance tests into Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or similar systems. 
 - Familiarity with Kubernetes, Docker, and microservices architecture is a plus. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to articulate technical details to both technical and non-technical audiences.

data.title: Senior Member Technical Staff - Senior QA Engineer
data.description:
Company Description

At Nielsen, we are passionate about our work to power a better media future for all people by providing powerful insights that drive client decisions and deliver extraordinary results. Our talented, global workforce is dedicated to capturing audience engagement with content - wherever and whenever it's consumed. Together, we are proudly rooted in our deep legacy as we stand at the forefront of the media revolution. When you join Nielsen, you will join a dynamic team committed to excellence, perseverance, and the ambition to make an impact together. We champion you, because when you succeed, we do too. We enable your best to power our future. 

Job Description

We are looking for a strong Quality Engineering candidate who can flex across MTS-2 and MTS-3 expectations depending on depth of experience, ownership, and technical maturity. This role is ideal for someone who brings deep hands-on automation skills with solid manual testing foundations, and who is excited to work on products spanning mobile, TV/CTV, web, backend services, and large-scale data pipelines. 

This person will work across Nielsen Pulse / Streaming+, EMM / panel applications, and adjacent digital measurement platforms. The role requires end-to-end quality ownership across user journeys, platform integrations, data collection flows, and backend validation in a domain where correctness, scale, and platform diversity matter. 

The ideal candidate is comfortable testing not just UI behavior, but also events, telemetry, APIs, databases, data pipelines, and platform-specific edge cases across Android, iOS, web, and TV environments. They should be able to design robust automation, perform deep debugging, and partner closely with engineering, product, data, and operations teams to ship high-quality releases. 

Qualifications

- Own test strategy, planning, execution, and sign-off for features spanning manual and automation coverage
 - Build and maintain scalable automation frameworks for UI, API, integration, and regression testing
 - Validate complex end-to-end flows across mobile, TV/CTV, web, backend services, and data pipelines
 - Perform deep validation of data correctness across logs, APIs, databases, batch jobs, event streams, and downstream reports
 - Design test cases for large-volume, high-variability, real-world datasets and platform combinations
 - Investigate production issues, reproduce complex defects, and drive root-cause analysis with engineering teams
 - Validate streaming/data donation flows, permissions, onboarding, telemetry, reward logic, and panel-related workflows
 - Partner with developers, product managers, designers, data engineers, and stakeholders to ensure quality from requirements through release
 - Improve CI/CD quality gates, regression coverage, release confidence, and defect prevention practices
 - Contribute to test planning for new devices, OS upgrades, beta releases, and cross-platform compatibility validation
 - Create and maintain test documentation, test evidence, dashboards, and release-quality communication
 - Mentor junior QA engineers or peers in test design, debugging, automation, and quality best practices

Required Skills & Qualifications

- 6+ years of experience in software testing / quality engineering
 - Strong hands-on experience in test automation, with good grounding in manual exploratory and functional testing
 - Experience testing across some combination of Android, iOS, web, CTV/TV, and backend systems
 - Strong understanding of API testing, service validation, and backend workflow testing
 - Experience validating large datasets, event pipelines, reporting outputs, or analytics systems
 - Strong SQL and data validation skills, including comparison of source vs processed outputs
 - Experience debugging issues using logs, network traces, device logs, browser tools, and backend evidence
 - Strong understanding of test design, regression planning, edge-case identification, and defect lifecycle management
 - Experience working in Agile teams with cross-functional collaboration
 - Ability to independently own features, drive clarity in ambiguous situations, and balance speed with quality

Additional Information

- Experience in panel, measurement, attribution, or data donation ecosystems
 - Experience working with CTV platforms such as Android TV, Apple TV/tvOS, Fire TV, Roku, or similar
 - Experience testing OS transitions, device-specific behaviors, and platform permission models
 - Exposure to analytics instrumentation, event schemas, or certification-style validation workflows

Please be aware that job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by scammers seeking personal data or money. Nielsen recruiters will only contact you through official job boards, LinkedIn, or email with a nielsen. com domain. Be cautious of any outreach claiming to be from Nielsen via other messaging platforms or personal email addresses. Always verify that email communications come from an @nielsen. com address. If you're unsure about the authenticity of a job offer or communication, please contact Nielsen directly through our official website or verified social media channels.

Job Description

As a Test Automation Engineer, you will design and implement automation solutions that validate system behavior across UI, APIs, and integrations. You will contribute to building a robust quality engineering ecosystem by integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines and supporting continuous delivery. 

In this role, you will translate requirements into effective test strategies, combining automation with manual, exploratory, and integration testing to ensure comprehensive quality coverage across all application layers. 

This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys hands-on coding, solving complex validation challenges, and improving system quality at scale, while taking ownership of end-to-end quality outcomes and collaborating closely with cross-functional teams. 

Responsibilities

Automation Development & Framework Ownership

- Design, develop, and own scalable test automation frameworks and reusable components

 - UI (Web/Mobile)

Test Strategy & Implementation

Delivery & Execution Excellence

Manual & Functional Testing

 - Validate end-to-end workflows and business scenarios
 - Identify edge cases and usability issues through exploratory testing
 - Ensure test coverage for areas not suitable for automation

Quality, Standards & Engineering Practices

- Write clean, testable, and maintainable automation code
 - Participate in code reviews and continuous improvement of automation frameworks
 - Ensure adherence to Definition of Ready (DoR) and Definition of Done (DoD)
 - Take ownership of end-to-end quality outcomes across assigned areas

CI/CD & DevOps Integration

 - Enable continuous testing and shift-left quality practices
 - Monitor and improve pipeline stability, execution time, and reliability
 - Validate and troubleshoot system integrations, data flows, and error handling based on defined architectural designs and interfaces

Non-Functional Testing

- Contribute to performance, reliability, and resilience testing
 - Validate system behavior under load, stress, and failure scenarios

Observability & Debuggability

- Leverage logs, metrics, and traces to improve test reliability
 - Support root cause analysis of failures and improve system observability

Test Data & Environment Management

- Design and manage test data strategies and datasets
 - Ensure availability of stable, production-like test environments

Incident & Operational Support

- Assist in troubleshooting defects across environments
 - Support maintenance and continuous improvement of automation suites
 - Analyze and reduce flaky tests and unstable scenarios

Collaboration & Growth

- Collaborate with developers, QA, Product Owners, and Tech Leads
 - Actively learn and adopt new tools, frameworks, and best practices
 - Contribute to team knowledge sharing and a strong quality culture

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, IT, or related field
 - 5+ years of experience in software testing with strong automation focus
 - Experience in designing and implementing test automation frameworks
 - Strong understanding of testing principles, SDLC, STLC, and Agile practices

Technical Skills

- Programming experience in one or more: C#, Java, Python, JavaScript, Swift

 - Familiarity with:

Assets

 - Exposure to:

Key Expectations

- Craft and articulate a vision for Applied AI engineering across the firm's enterprise solutions-mapping business capabilities to the enterprise technology landscape and defining how GenAI and agentic capabilities are built directly into the products we deliver-in alignment with the Business Strategy and US Deloitte Technology strategy. Collaborate with diverse stakeholders across product, engineering, experience, delivery, security, and infrastructure at all organizational levels.

Remain hands-on with design, architecture, and code-contributing to team and product group velocity and staying engaged with engineers across the SSDLC-while reviewing code, driving tech-debt reduction, and experimenting with new technology.

Lead by example through thought leadership-showcasing experiments internally, speaking at conferences, publishing whitepapers or blogs, and leading R&D collaborations, including with academia.  - Engage stakeholders at all levels-from team members to middle management to executives-building collaborative, constructive relationships and co-creating momentum and value across multiple organizational levels.

As Deloitte's primary internal development team, Product Engineering delivers innovative digital solutions to businesses, service lines, and internal operations with proven bottom-line results and outcomes. It helps power Deloitte's success. It is the engine that drives Deloitte, serving many of the world's largest, most respected companies. Our reputation is built on a tradition of delivering with excellence. 

The successful candidate will possess: 

- Excellent interpersonal and organizational skills, with the ability to handle diverse situations, complex projects, and changing priorities, behaving with passion, empathy, and care. 

Required Qualifications: 

- A bachelor's degree in computer science, software engineering, data science, machine learning, or related discipline. Experience is the most relevant factor. 
 - 10+ years of full-stack software engineering experience with most of the following: Angular, React, NodeJS, Python, C#, . NET, Java, SQL/NoSQL, REST/SOAP/GraphQL, SSO/MFA, PyTorch, TensorFlow, LangChain, LangGraph, as well as unit and integration testing frameworks. 
 - 7+ years of experience architecting and delivering enterprise solutions on modern technology stacks (e. g. , API Gateways, Message Brokers, Queuing Services, Workflow Automation & Orchestration, ETL/ELT, Event Streaming, Real-Time Data Processing, Service Mesh) and cloud-native engineering, using FaaS, PaaS, and micro-services on any of the cloud hyperscalers such as Azure, AWS, or GCP, including leveraging their AI/ML services such as Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, or Vertex AI, plus application-level infrastructure-as-code and cost-aware engineering (FinOps accountability).

 - 2+ years of experience in establishing engineering standards, including actively leading, mentoring, and guiding team members in the adoption and continuous improvement of these standards.

Our Purpose

At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. As AI reshapes how organizations build, operate, and innovate, the responsibility to protect them becomes more critical than ever. When you join SentinelOne, your work helps protect global enterprises, critical infrastructure, and the technologies shaping tomorrow. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here. 

About Us

SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters. 

Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity. 

What Are We Looking For?

We're looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes. 

As a Staff Software Engineer, you will be tasked with taking ownership and acting on it, without being tied to a single team or codebase. As company priorities shift, you will move to where your skills make the biggest difference, whether that is a new product area, a scaling challenge, or an ambiguous problem nobody has framed yet. You should be excited about setting technical direction for large-scale distributed systems, comfortable diving into complexity, and eager to own the architecture, reliability, and operability of what you build, while influencing technical strategy across multiple teams and mentoring engineers at all levels. 

What Will You Do?

Primary responsibilities include: 

- Set technical direction by defining the architecture and technical roadmap for the systems you work on, aligning multiple squads of backend and frontend engineers around a coherent long-term vision. 
 - Drive complex initiatives end-to-end, leading the most ambiguous, cross-cutting projects from problem framing through production and delivering under uncertainty. 
 - Own the architecture by making foundational design decisions, choosing patterns and technologies for scale, reliability, performance, and maintainability, and establishing the standards others build on. 
 - Own operability and lifecycle at scale, shaping deployment, observability, patching, and upgrade strategy so that our systems stay secure, reliable, and current. 
 - Own outcomes, not just tasks, taking accountability from design through production and incident resolution. 
 - Multiply the team by mentoring and growing engineers, raising the engineering bar through design and code reviews, and serving as a force multiplier across the organization. 
 - Influence without authority, driving alignment and technical decisions across teams through clear communication and sound judgment. 
 - See your impact, as your work directly improves how customers deploy, operate, and trust SentinelOne, and is a visible part of key company initiatives. 

What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?

Ideal candidates will have: 

- 8 or more years of backend development experience, including a track record of technical leadership on large-scale systems. 
 - Proficiency in at least one of Go or Python, with a strong foundation in data structures, algorithms, and system design. 
 - Solid experience with unit and integration testing, and with both relational and NoSQL databases, including database design and sharding. 
 - Proven experience designing distributed systems, including partitioning, consistency, and availability trade-offs, and architecting high-performance, microservices-based backend systems at scale. 
 - Hands-on experience with event-driven architecture and messaging platforms such as Kafka; experience with high-scale API design and resilience patterns such as circuit breakers; and a deep understanding of operating systems and networking fundamentals. 
 - Hands-on experience with at least one public cloud (AWS, GCP, or Azure), and with Docker and Docker Compose. 
 - A strong ownership mindset and the agency to act without waiting to be told; comfort with ambiguity, breaking down unclear problems and delivering under uncertainty; and adaptability, learning new domains quickly and being happy to move between teams. 
 - Proven cross-team influence, driving alignment and technical decisions without formal authority, and a track record of mentoring engineers and contributing to their career growth. 
 - Excellent communication skills, including translating technical complexity into business context and leading projects in a hybrid or remote team. 
 - Open-source contributions, experience with AI coding agents and agentic development workflows, experience architecting software for on-prem, self-hosted, or air-gapped deployments, and hands-on experience with the Kafka ecosystem (Kafka Pub/Sub, Kafka Connect, etc. ) are preferred. 

Why SentinelOne?

AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. If you want to build where innovation and impact move together, this is that place.

Wellness & Lifestyle
