With our global scale and deep expertise, you'll have the opportunity to do meaningful work, grow your career and make a real impact on people's health around the world. Together, we're improving health and improving lives. 

Labcorp is a global leader in diagnostic testing and drug development solutions, helping healthcare providers, researchers, and patients make informed decisions that advance care. Join us in our mission to improve health and improve lives. 

Labcorp is seeking a QA Engineer - Salesforce & Enterprise Applications to support quality assurance across Salesforce and integrated enterprise applications to join our team!

Work Schedule: This is an initial one-year contract position, and the role is assigned to a second-shift schedule. with standard business hours of Monday through Friday, 12. 30 PM IST - 9. 30 PM IST in your local time zone. Business needs may occasionally require flexibility in work hours, including earlier, later, or additional hours, with reasonable notice provided when possible. 

Job Responsibilities

- Analyze user stories, business requirements, solution designs, and acceptance criteria from a QA perspective to ensure requirements are complete, consistent, and testable. 
 - Identify requirement gaps, edge cases, dependencies, and quality risks early in the software development lifecycle and work with Business Analysts, Product Owners, and Developers to clarify expected behavior. 

Technical Oversight

- Develop and maintain test plans, test scenarios, test cases, test data, and test execution documentation. 
 - Perform rigorous functional, integration, end-to-end, regression, and negative testing for Salesforce applications and related enterprise systems. 
 - Test Salesforce functionality including business processes, Flows, validation rules, objects, fields, permissions, profiles, record types, and other configuration and customization. 
 - Design, develop, execute, and maintain automated test cases using Copado Robotic Testing, with a focus on reusable and maintainable regression automation. 
 - Evaluate existing and new test cases to identify opportunities to improve automation coverage, regression coverage, and overall testing effectiveness. 
 - Test integrations between Salesforce and other enterprise applications, including APIs, middleware, scheduled processes, and inbound/outbound interfaces. 
 - Perform data migration and data validation testing, including field mapping, record counts, data completeness, accuracy, transformation, synchronization, and exception handling. 
 - Identify, document, and track defects with clear reproduction steps, severity, supporting evidence, and business impact; retest fixes and perform appropriate regression testing. 
 - Participate in Agile ceremonies including backlog refinement, sprint planning, daily stand-ups, demonstrations, and retrospectives, and provide QA estimates, status updates, and quality risks. 
 - Collaborate with cross-functional teams to continuously improve QA processes, test automation, regression coverage, defect prevention, and overall software quality. 

Minimum Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field. 
 - 8 years or more experience as a Software Quality Assurance Engineer. 
 - 3 years or more experience testing Salesforce platform applications on Sales Cloud or Service Cloud. 
 - 2 years or more experience in Salesforce, Copado, or related QA/test automation certifications. 
 - 2 years or more experience performing functional, integration, end-to-end, regression, and negative testing. 
 - 2 years or more experience with test automation, preferably Copado Robotic Testing, or similar enterprise test automation tools. 
 - 2 years or more experience with data migration, data conversion, or large-scale data validation testing. 
 - 2 years or more experience working in Agile/Scrum delivery environments. 

Preferred Qualifications

- 1 year or more experience testing REST/SOAP APIs and integration platforms
 - 1 year or more experience with Jira, Salesforce DevOps processes, and version-control practices. 

Certifications

- Salesforce certifications. Professional certifications such as ISTQB, ASTQB, CSTE, CSQA, CQSE

Additional Job Standards

- Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills with attention to detail. 
 - Strong experience analyzing user stories, requirements, and acceptance criteria and translating them into comprehensive test scenarios and test cases. 
 - Strong analytical, troubleshooting, defect-management, and communication skills. 
 - Strong command of the English language. Fluent in speaking and writing English. 
 - Ability to independently analyze requirements and identify quality risks before testing begins. 
 - Strong ownership of testing outcomes and commitment to delivering high-quality solutions. 
 - Ability to effectively balance comprehensive testing with Agile delivery timelines. 
 - Strong collaboration and communication skills across business and technical teams. 
 - Ability to continuously identify opportunities to improve testing efficiency, automation coverage, and quality processes. 

About The Role

- The QA Engineer will be responsible for analyzing requirements from a quality perspective, developing and executing comprehensive test scenarios, and building and maintaining automated tests using Copado Robotic Testing. The role requires strong Salesforce testing experience and the ability to test complex business processes involving integrations, data migration, and multiple enterprise systems.

data.description:
WHAT YOU DO AT AMD CHANGES EVERYTHING

At AMD, our mission is to build great products that accelerate next-generation computing experiences-from AI and data centers, to PCs, gaming and embedded systems. Grounded in a culture of innovation and collaboration, we believe real progress comes from bold ideas, human ingenuity and a shared passion to create something extraordinary. When you join AMD, you'll discover the real differentiator is our culture. We push the limits of innovation to solve the world's most important challenges-striving for execution excellence, while being direct, humble, collaborative, and inclusive of diverse perspectives. Join us as we shape the future of AI and beyond. Together, we advance your career. 

Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced SMTS Software Quality Engineer to join the HIP Runtime Quality Engineering team within the ROCm ecosystem. In this role, you will focus on defect triage, root‐cause analysis, and scalable test automation for the HIP runtime, ensuring robustness, portability, and performance across AMD and NVIDIA GPU backends. 

The role sits at the intersection of runtime systems, GPU APIs, and CI-driven quality assurance, working closely with HIP runtime developers, compiler teams, and system software engineers to improve test coverage and accelerate issue resolution across a fast-evolving open‐source stack. 

HIP is a C++ runtime API and kernel language designed for CUDA portability and heterogeneous GPU programming in the ROCm platform. 

Key Responsibilities

Defect Triage & Root Cause Analysis

- Own end-to-end triage of HIP runtime failures observed in CI, nightly, and release testing pipelines. 
 - Analyze failures across HIP runtime APIs, including memory management, streams, events, kernels, graphs, and device management. 
 - Perform log analysis, repro reduction, and backtrace debugging across Linux and Windows environments. 
 - Correlate failures across: 
 - ROCr system runtime
 - HIP runtime
 - Driver / firmware interfaces
 - Compiler (hipcc / clang) interactions
 - File high‐quality bug reports with clear reproduction steps, root cause hypotheses, and impact assessment. 

Test Automation & Framework Development

- Design, enhance, and maintain automated test frameworks for HIP runtime validation using existing HIP test infrastructure (Catch2-based and custom harnesses). 
 - Expand functional, negative, stress, and regression coverage for: 
 - HIP Runtime APIs
 - Graph APIs
 - Memory copy variants (1D/2D/3D, async/sync)
 - Multi-GPU and peer-to-peer use cases
 - Integrate tests into CI/CD pipelines with actionable failure reporting. 
 - Develop Python, C++, and shell-based automation for test execution, result aggregation, and trend analysis. 
 - Drive test flakiness reduction and improve signal-to-noise ratio in large-scale CI. 

Cross-Team Collaboration

- Partner with HIP runtime developers to: 
 - Review test gaps for new features and APIs
 - Validate bug fixes and performance-sensitive code paths
 - Collaborate with: 
 - Compiler and language runtime teams
 - ROCr system runtime teams
 - Release engineering and CI infrastructure teams
 - Contribute test fixes and enhancements upstream in open-source HIP/ROCm repositories. 

Quality Metrics & Continuous Improvement

- Define and track quality metrics such as failure escape rate, test coverage, and mean-time-to-resolution (MTTR). 
 - Identify systemic issues and propose data-driven quality improvements. 
 - Participate in release readiness assessments for HIP runtime drops. 

Required Qualifications

Technical Skills

- Strong experience in software quality engineering, test automation, or SDET roles. 
 - Solid proficiency in C++ with debugging experience (gdb/lldb). 
 - Working knowledge of HIP or CUDA runtime concepts, including kernels, streams, memory models, and device execution. 
 - Experience with Linux-based development and debugging. 
 - Familiarity with CI systems (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or similar). 
 - Experience writing and maintaining automated tests for low-level systems or runtime libraries. 

Debugging & Analysis Skills

- Ability to reason about runtime abstractions, concurrency, and asynchronous execution. 
 - Strong skills in failure reproduction, minimization, and log-driven debugging. 
 - Experience triaging issues across hardware-software boundaries is a plus. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with GPU programming models (HIP, CUDA, OpenCL). 
 - Familiarity with ROCm stack components (HIP, ROCr, compilers, drivers). 
 - Experience testing graph APIs, async execution models, or multi-GPU systems. 
 - Prior contributions to open-source system software or test frameworks. 
 - Knowledge of Python-based test orchestration and reporting tools. 
 - Knowledge and application of AI tools in validation and testing. 

What Success Looks Like

- Faster, higher-quality issue triage with actionable root cause insights. 
 - Improved automation coverage for HIP runtime APIs and edge cases. 
 - Reduced CI noise and faster feedback for developers. 
 - Strong collaboration with runtime and compiler engineers to ship stable, high-quality HIP releases.

data.description:

Description: 

Senior Database Performance & Benchmark Engineer, the responsible for designing and executing rigorous testing strategies across a complex hybrid environment consisting of large-scale on-premises SQL Server instances and public cloud managed database services. You will act as the bridge between infrastructure engineering, database administration, and application development to ensure our systems are resilient, highly scalable, and optimized for peak

production workloads. 

Your responsibilities

- Hybrid Benchmarking & Load Testing: Design, script, and execute comprehensive load, stress, and endurance tests utilizing synthetic tools (e. g. , HammerDB, OStress, Apache JMeter) and production replay tools (e. g. , WorkloadTools, DEA). 
 - Performance Telemetry & Monitoring: Establish performance baselines and build continuous monitoring dashboards utilizing OS-level metrics (PerfMon/Linux Sysstat) and SQL Server Dynamic Management Views (DMVs). 
 - Cloud Migration & Scaling Validation: Benchmark on-premises workloads and simulate equivalent performance in public cloud environments (such as AWS RDS/EC2, Azure SQL, or GCP Cloud SQL) to accurately size cloud infrastructure and control costs. 
 - Bottleneck Isolation & Optimization: Analyze execution plans, identify plan regressions, and isolate resource contention bottlenecks (CPU, Memory, Disk I/O, TempDB, and network latency). 
 - Concurrency & Lock Management: Diagnose and resolve complex locking, blocking, and deadlock scenarios discovered during high-concurrency simulation cycles. 
 - Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Performance QA, DevOps, Infrastructure, and Application teams to establish quality gates and provide actionable code/indexing optimization recommendations. 

Your skills and experience

Must-Have: 

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, information technology, engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent with 7+ years of experience in dedicated database administration (DBA), database engineering, or specialized database performance testing experience. 
 - Hybrid Environment Mastery: Proven track record managing or benchmarking both traditional on-premises enterprise hardware and public cloud architectures (AWS, Azure, or GCP). 
 - Deep SQL Server Internals: Expert-level knowledge of SQL Server query optimization, execution plan analysis, Query Store, Extended Events (XEvents), and system DMVs and Extensive experience setting up and operating database benchmarking suites such as HammerDB, SQLQueryStress, OStress, or similar automated simulation frameworks. 
 - Solid understanding of underlying storage configurations (SAN, NVMe, Cloud IOPS allocations), virtualization layers, and network latency mechanics in hybrid setups and Scripting & Automation: Proficiency in PowerShell, T-SQL, or Python to automate test deployments, data generation, and telemetry collection. 
 - Experience with cloud native infrastructure-as-code tools (e. g. , Terraform) to spin up and tear down transient performance testing sandboxes and Experience with production workload masking and synchronization methodologies to generate high-fidelity, non-sensitive testing datasets. 

Nice-To-Have: 

- Relevant certifications such as Azure Database Administrator Associate or historical Microsoft SQL Server certifications.

Skills And Attributes

 - Strong knowledge in SharePoint Architecture Design (Extranet & Intranet). 
 - Must have good experience in SharePoint Framework (SPFx) & Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate) solutions. 
 - Good experience in JavaScript, TypeScript, React JS, AngularJS, Fluent UI, Knockout JS, HTML5, CSS, Ajax, JSON, jQuery etc
 - Core Skills:

 - Power Platform: Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI, Power Virtual Agents
 - Dataverse: Data modeling, APIs, integration with Power Platform
 - Web API Integration: REST, SOAP, authentication (OAuth, OpenID Connect)
 - PCF Controls: React, TypeScript, PCF control framework
 - Desirable Skills: 
 - Microsoft Purview: Data governance, DLP, information protection
 - Microsoft Syntex: AI-driven content processing, document understanding, classification, and generation
 - AI Builder: Custom AI models, integration with Power Platform
 - Microsoft 365 Copilot: Integration with M365 apps
 - Azure DevOps: CI/CD, source control
 - Microsoft Teams: App development, integration
 - Passion for the web, open source development, and for helping us build meaningful experiences. 
 - Experience in consulting strongly preferred. 
 - Strong problem-solving abilities, taking initiative, and the ability to thrive under pressure. 
 - Maintain a positive and constructive outlook, focus on driving results, finding solutions / breakthroughs to solve problems and challenges; has a positive influence on peers. 
 - Interpersonal and communication skills. 
 - Respond positively to opportunities to be involved in brainstorming and iterative work. Handle times of change in a way that drives innovation and iteration. 
 - Work in collaborative and supportive manner. 
 - Listen carefully to provided information and ask clarifying questions. Actively listen as a learner rather than a passive recipient of information. 
 - Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or related discipline preferred. 

Soft Skills

- Excellent Communication Skills
 - Team Player
 - Self-starter and highly motivated
 - Ability to handle high pressure and fast paced situations
 - Excellent presentation skills
 - Ability to work with globally distributed teams

To qualify for the role, you must have

- A bachelor's or master's degree
 - A minimum of 8+ years of experience, preferably background in a professional services firm. 
 - Strong knowledge of SharePoint 2013/2016/2019/o365
 - Strong knowledge of SharePoint Framework (SPFx), Power Apps & Power Automate. 
 - Strong knowledge of TypeScript, React JS, AngularJS & Fluent UI. 
 - Strong knowledge of PowerShell & PnP. 
 - Excellent communication skills with consulting experience preferred

Ideally, you'll also have

- Analytical ability to manage multiple projects and prioritize tasks into manageable work products. 
 - Can operate independently or with minimum supervision

What Working At EY Offers

At EY, we're dedicated to helping our clients, from start-ups to Fortune 500 companies - and the work we do with them is as varied as they are. 

You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer: 

- Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
 - Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
 - The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that's right for you

EY | Building a better working world

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets. 

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate. 

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

data.title: Vice President of Software Engineering
data.description:
Job Summary

The Vice President - Software Engineering is responsible for leading the design, development, delivery, and continuous evolution of the MADTECH. AI platform. This role provides strategic and technical leadership to multiple engineering teams responsible for building scalable, secure, cloud-native B2B SaaS products. 

The ideal candidate is an accomplished engineering leader with deep expertise in software architecture, cloud platforms, AI-enabled applications, data engineering, DevOps, and modern engineering practices. This individual will build high-performing engineering teams, establish engineering excellence, drive innovation, and ensure timely delivery of high-quality products while working closely with Product Management, AI/ML, Data Engineering, QA, Customer Success, and Business leadership. 

Key Responsibilities

Engineering Strategy & Technology Leadership

- Define and execute the engineering strategy aligned with the organization's business and product objectives. 
 - Establish engineering standards, architectural principles, coding best practices, and software development governance. 
 - Drive technology modernization and adoption of emerging technologies including AI, Generative AI, cloud-native platforms, and automation. 
 - Develop long-term technology roadmaps to ensure scalability, maintainability, and security. 

Software Engineering Leadership

- Lead multiple engineering teams responsible for backend, frontend, platform engineering, integrations, and DevOps. 
 - Ensure successful delivery of high-quality software products within timelines and budget. 
 - Oversee software architecture, technical design, implementation, testing, deployment, and production support. 
 - Drive engineering productivity through Agile delivery methodologies and engineering metrics. 

Architecture & Platform Engineering

- Provide technical leadership for scalable microservices architecture and distributed systems. 
 - Guide architectural decisions across cloud infrastructure, APIs, data platforms, AI services, and integrations. 
 - Ensure platform scalability, performance, availability, reliability, and security. 
 - Lead architecture reviews and technology evaluations. 

Engineering Operations & Delivery Excellence

- Improve engineering processes, SDLC, CI/CD pipelines, release management, and deployment automation. 
 - Implement DevSecOps best practices. 
 - Monitor engineering KPIs including
 - Velocity
 - Quality
 - Reliability
 - Deployment frequency
 - MTTR
 - Engineering efficiency
 - Ensure operational excellence through observability, monitoring, incident management, and root cause analysis. 

AI & Data Engineering Enablement

- Collaborate with AI/ML teams to integrate intelligent capabilities into the platform. 
 - Enable scalable data pipelines, APIs, AI agents, RAG architectures, and GenAI applications. 
 - Promote engineering practices that support analytics, automation, and customer intelligence. 

Cross-functional Collaboration

- Partner closely with Product Management to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions. 
 - Collaborate with QA, Security, DevOps, Customer Success, Sales Engineering, and Product teams throughout the product lifecycle. 
 - Support customer escalations requiring engineering leadership. 

People Leadership

- Recruit, mentor, coach, and retain world-class engineering talent. 
 - Build a culture of ownership, innovation, collaboration, accountability, and continuous learning. 
 - Develop engineering managers and technical leads. 
 - Drive performance management, succession planning, and career development. 

Technical Expertise

- Strong expertise in designing and developing scalable, secure, cloud-native B2B SaaS applications using modern software engineering principles and best practices. 
 - Deep understanding of software architecture, including microservices, distributed systems, event-driven architecture, API-first design, and multi-tenant platforms. 
 - Proficiency in cloud platforms, with hands-on experience in AWS (mandatory); exposure to Azure and GCP is preferred. Strong knowledge of containerization technologies such as Docker, Kubernetes, Amazon EKS, and modern CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Extensive experience with modern software development technologies and frameworks such as Java, Python, Node. js, React, Angular, TypeScript, and related technologies. 
 - Strong understanding of AI/ML and Generative AI technologies, including AI Agents, LangChain, LangGraph, RAG architectures, MCP (Model Context Protocol), TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn, and LLM integrations. 
 - Experience with data engineering, including SQL, data warehousing, ETL/ELT, reverse ETL, data modeling, data lakes, and large-scale data processing frameworks. 
 - Strong knowledge of RESTful APIs, GraphQL, event-driven architectures, Kafka, webhooks, third-party integrations, and modern integration frameworks. 
 - Experience implementing DevSecOps practices, Infrastructure as Code (Terraform/CloudFormation), automated testing, release management, monitoring, logging, observability, and production support. 
 - Expertise in Agile software development methodologies, including Scrum, Kanban, Jira, engineering planning, sprint execution, and continuous delivery. 
 - Strong understanding of software quality engineering, secure coding practices, performance optimization, scalability, reliability engineering, and engineering governance. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline. Master's degree preferred. 
 - 15+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 8 years leading large engineering teams. 
 - Proven experience delivering enterprise-scale B2B SaaS products. 
 - Strong hands-on background in software architecture, cloud platforms, distributed systems, APIs, and modern application development. 
 - Experience leading engineering organizations of 30+ engineers across multiple functional teams. 
 - Strong understanding of AI/ML technologies, cloud-native applications, and modern software engineering practices. 
 - Experience working with global customers across the US, UK, Australia, and MENA markets. 
 - Demonstrated success in building high-performing engineering organizations. 
 - Excellent leadership, communication, stakeholder management, and decision-making skills. 
 - Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth technology environment. 
 - Willing to work from Mysuru or Bengaluru. 

Why MADTECH. AI?

Join us in building the future of AI-powered Marketing Decision Intelligence. 

At MADTECH. AI, we're developing a next-generation B2B SaaS platform that brings together AI, advanced analytics, cloud technologies, and intelligent automation to help organizations make faster, smarter, and data-driven business decisions. 

As the VP - Software Engineering, you will have the opportunity to shape the technical vision of our platform, lead high-performing engineering teams, and influence the architecture of products used by global customers. You'll work on cutting-edge technologies, solve complex engineering challenges, and foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and engineering excellence. 

If you're passionate about building scalable SaaS products, mentoring exceptional engineering talent, and making a meaningful impact in a fast-growing AI company, MADTECH. AI offers the opportunity to innovate, lead, and grow with us.

data.title: Performance Test Engineering Senior Associate
data.description:
Are you ready to make an impact at DTCC?

Do you want to work on innovative projects, collaborate with a dynamic and supportive team, and receive investment in your professional development? At DTCC, we are at the forefront of innovation in the financial markets. We are committed to helping our employees grow and succeed. We believe that you have the skills and drive to make a real impact. We foster a thriving internal community and are committed to creating a workplace that looks like the world that we serve. 

The Information Technology group delivers secure, reliable technology solutions that enable DTCC to be the trusted infrastructure of the global capital markets. The team delivers high-quality information through activities that include development of essential, building infrastructure capabilities to meet client needs and implementing data standards and governance. 

Pay And Benefits

- Competitive compensation, including base pay and annual incentive
 - Comprehensive health and life insurance and well-being benefits, based on location
 - Pension / Retirement benefits
 - Paid Time Off and Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well-being. 
 - DTCC offers a flexible/hybrid model of 3 days onsite and 2 days remote (onsite Tuesdays, Wednesdays and a third day unique to each team or employee). 

The Impact You Will Have In This Role

The Enterprise Test Engineering ("ETE") family is responsible for ensuring that all applications and systems meet defined quality standards. The ETE family encompasses three major areas including (a) functional testing, (b) non-functional testing, and (c) test architecture and enablement. Other key focuses include: regression testing, browser testing, performance testing, capacity and stress testing, resiliency testing, environment management services, and infrastructure testing. Develops, conducts, and evaluates testing processes, working closely with developers to remediate identified system defects. In-depth knowledge of automated testing tools, and quality control and assurance approaches including the creation of reusable foundational test automation framework for the entire organization. The Performance Test Engineering role is responsible for the validation of non-functional requirements for performance testing. 

Your Primary Responsibilities

- Develop proven grasp of the DTCC Software Delivery process, Performance Test Engineering framework, CoE (Center of Excellence) Engagement process as well as understanding of tech-stack (tools and technologies) to perform day-to-day job
 - Prepare, maintain, and implement performance test scenarios based on non-functional requirements and follow standard DTCC testing guidelines
 - Automate performance test scenarios by using current automated performance test scripts in compliance with the non-functional framework
 - Maintain traceability across Non-Functional Requirements, Performance Test Scenarios and Defects
 - Review of performance test scenarios from both a technical and business perspective with collaborators, such as development teams and business
 - Track defects to closure, report test results, continuously supervise execution achievements and call out as required
 - Contribute to the technical aspects of Delivery Pipeline adoption for performance testing and improve adoption
 - Identify environmental and data requirements; collaborate with Development and Testing teams to manage and maintain environment and data
 - Provide mentorship to team members related to performance test coverage, performance test scenarios, and non-functional requirements
 - Develop a basic understanding of the product being delivered including architecture considerations and technical design of the supported applications in relations to the performance and scalability. 
 - Work with Development and Architecture teams and find opportunities to improve the test coverage. Share suggestions for performance improvements
 - Aligns risk and control processes into day-to-day responsibilities to supervise and mitigate risk; raises appropriately
 - Note: Responsibilities of this role are not limited to the details above

Qualifications

- Minimum of 6 years of related experience
 - Bachelor's degree preferred or equivalent experience

Talents Needed For Success

- Expertise in LINUX/UNIX, shell scripting
 - Hands-on experience coding and scripting complex business logic and scenarios. 
 - Experience using JMS/IBM-MQ messaging system and Administering the MQ systems
 - Experience with understanding multi-technology end-to-end testing (distributed and mainframe systems)
 - Experience in performance engineering (analysis, testing, and tuning)
 - Experience developing n-tier, J2EE software applications
 - Experience working in Unix or Linux environments
 - Expertise in performance analysis of distributed platforms including Linux, Windows, AWS, Containers and VMware (tools: Dynatrace, Grafana, AppDynamics, Splunk, CloudWatch, TeamQuest)
 - Extensive knowledge of the functionality and performance aspects of the above computing platforms
 - Experience in sophisticated statistical and analytical modeling
 - Excellent analytical skills including: Data exploration, analysis and presentation applying descriptive statistics and graphical techniques
 - Key Performance and volume metrics relationship modeling
 - Understanding of queuing networks modeling and simulation modeling concepts and experience with one of the industry standard analytic modeling tools - TeamQuest, Metron-Athenee, HyPerformix, and BMC
 - Understanding of RESTful web service, JSON, and XML
 - Experience in Relational Databases, preferably Oracle
 - Communicates openly keeping everyone across the organization informed. 

Actual salary is determined based on the role, location, individual experience, skills, and other considerations. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

data.title: DevOps Lead
data.description:
iRage is one of India's leading high-frequency trading firms. We build and own everything in-house, from ultra-low-latency execution to full trading infrastructure. Our systems deliver some of the lowest latencies in the market, with order-send speeds under 100 nanoseconds. Our stack is fully in-house: custom FPGA pipelines, kernel-bypass networking, in-house exchange gateways, and a C++ codebase we own end-to-end from market data ingestion to order entry and risk. But great technology alone doesn't move markets. Our quant and tech teams work in lockstep, and the results speak for themselves. Millions of trades. Every day. At lightning speed. iRage is where that tech expertise meets real market impact, at scale, in one of the world's fastest-growing trading ecosystems. 

Role Summary: 

We are seeking an experienced DevOps Lead/ Operations Tech Lead to drive operational excellence and lead a dynamic team in our fast-paced environment. The ideal candidate will combine strong technical expertise in Python with proven leadership capabilities to optimize processes, ensure system reliability, and deliver results. 

Roles & Responsibilities: 

- Team & stakeholder leadership - Lead an operations team and work cross-functionally with developers, system administrators, quants, and traders. 
 - DevOps automation & deployment - Develop deployment pipelines, automate configuration management, and build Python-based tools for operational processes and system optimization.

data.description:
Renesas is a global semiconductor leader shaping the backbone of next‐generation automotive, industrial, cloud, and IoT innovation. With over $9. 3 billion in annual revenue (2024) and a world‐class team of 22, 700+ employees, Renesas operates at scale while retaining the agility to drive category‐defining breakthroughs. The company's footprint spans more than 30 countries, enabling deep customer proximity and a uniquely global innovative engine. As Japan's semiconductor powerhouse and a top global player in microcontrollers, analog, and power technologies, Renesas delivers real‐world impact across EVs, smart factories, renewable energy infrastructure, and edge intelligence. For ambitious problem‐solvers who want to work on meaningful, systems‐level challenges with huge industry leverage, Renesas offers the scale, stability, and strategic clarity of a market leader-paired with the transformative momentum of a company reinventing how the world computes, connects, and electrifies. 

Renesas has a growing presence in India with HC approaching 1000+ and significant presence with active government and university collaboration as well as OSAT footprint (JV with CG India). With the growing importance of India as a market (Growing semiconductor market and government goals / mandates of localization needs) and talent hub, our division's (India for India) mission is to grow India market. We aspire to create products (SoCs, Software, Power and Analog chips etc) which serve needs for local market. Renesas is a leading electronics supplier globally, and this is a unique opportunity to directly influence the future products which will be offered to our customers in a new, fast growing and large Indian market with specific needs and applications. 

Job Description

Renesas is looking for a Principal SoC Validation Engineer, to redefine how SoCs are built and validated-driving first‐time‐right silicon, eliminating customer escapes, and setting a new industry benchmark for validation excellence

Key Responsibilities

- Define and own the end‐to‐end silicon validation strategy for automotive and Embedded SoCs, from pre‐silicon enablement through post‐silicon production release. 
 - Ensure first‐time‐right silicon, robust validation coverage, and zero customer escapes across all assigned programs. 
 - Lead global validation teams responsible for silicon bring‐up, characterization, and system‐level validation across multiple concurrent programs. 
 - Establish and drive a System Use Case Validation Program, harvesting real customer/OEM and system scenarios and converting them into automated, traceable validation suites. 
 - Influence SoC architecture, design, and program decisions through early validation insights, risk identification, and data‐backed recommendations. 
 - Drive shift‐left validation as a measurable engineering program, increasing reuse across simulation, emulation/FPGA, and silicon to reduce late surprises. 
 - Own escape‐prevention strategy, including robustness testing, fault scenarios, coverage models, and disciplined validation signoff criteria. 
 - Build and scale high‐performing validation organizations, developing strong technical leadership (Staff/Principal pipeline) and execution ownership. 
 - Lead automation, standardization, and infrastructure modernization across validation labs, board farms, and CI systems. 
 - Establish validation methodologies, quality benchmarks, metrics, and dashboards aligned with Renesas standards and automotive expectations. 
 - Identify technical, execution, and program risks early; drive data‐driven mitigation and executive decision‐making. 
 - Provide clear executive‐level reporting on validation status, risks, readiness, and outcomes. 
 - Act as a trusted partner to Design, DV, Test, Firmware, Software, Product Engineering, Quality, and BU leadership. 
 - Adoption of industry best practices as a measurable program

Qualifications

Required Skills & Experience

- B. E. /B. Tech or M. E. /M. Tech in Electronics, Electrical, or Computer Engineering, or equivalent industry experience. 
 - 15+ years of experience in semiconductor validation, characterization, or silicon engineering, with demonstrated ownership of silicon quality outcomes. 
 - 3+ years in senior technical leadership roles 
 - Strong domain expertise in SoC validation, system‐level use‐case testing, and robustness validation. 
 - Proven experience delivering complex SoC programs from first silicon through production release. 
 - Deep understanding of silicon validation flows, lab environments, and post‐silicon debug ecosystems. 
 - Demonstrated success building and scaling automation‐first validation frameworks using Python, C++, or similar technologies. 
 - Strong experience driving cross‐functional execution in a matrixed, global environment. 
 - Excellent executive communication, stakeholder management, and decision‐making skills. 
 - Experience with AI frameworks for SoC Validation efficiency and quality gain- eg validation specific AI agents, Cody AI for content development etc. Preferred

- Experience with ISO 26262 / ASIL‐B development and validation environments. 
 - Exposure to emulation/FPGA‐based shift‐left validation and pre↔post silicon continuity models. 
 - Strong foundation in mixed‐signal and digital silicon validation, including pattern‐based and system‐level methodologies. 
 - Track record of institutionalizing industry best practices across multiple programs and organizations. 
 - Experience leading culture change toward proactive risk ownership, evidence‐based closure, and challenge‐ready execution. 
 - Automotive OEM or Tier‐1 customer engagement experience. 

Additional Information

Renesas is an embedded semiconductor solution provider driven by its Purpose, To Make Our Lives Easier. With a global team of over 21, 000 engineers and problem solvers in more than 30 countries, we offer the opportunity to work on world‐leading technology for Automotive, Industrial, Infrastructure, and IoT, shaping a safer, healthier, greener, and smarter future. 

At Renesas, TAGIE is our culture, grounded in being Transparent, Agile, Global, Innovative, and Entrepreneurial. It shapes how we work, grow and deliver on our purpose together. This collaborative spirit and mindset drive our semiconductor technology to transform industries and impact millions of lives. 

We believe in rewarding our employees with a competitive benefits package alongside their salary. More information will be provided during the hiring process.

data.title: Validation Engineer – Post Silicon Functional Validation, Compute Subsystem (CSS)
data.description:
About The Team

The Compute Subsystem (CSS) team at Arm designs and delivers integrated, validated compute subsystems that serve as reference platforms for Arm-based SoCs. The team collaborates across CPU, interconnect, memory, and IO IP teams to build efficient, high-performance solutions targeting client, infrastructure, and automotive markets. 

The Functional Validation Team ensures that Arm's compute subsystems meet quality, performance, and functionality expectations through comprehensive pre-silicon and post-silicon validation across the product lifecycle. 

Role Overview

As a Validation Engineer, you will be responsible for developing, executing, and improving validation methodologies for Arm's compute subsystems IPs both before and after silicon bring-up. You will work closely with design, verification, emulation and customer enablement teams to ensure robust validation coverage and early detection of complex system-level issues. 

or

As a Validation Engineer in the Compute Sub-System (CSS) team, you will be responsible for validating key subsystem IPs and platform functionality across the pre-silicon and post-silicon lifecycle. You will develop validation solutions, execute comprehensive test plans, debug complex hardware/software issues, and collaborate closely with Architecture, Design, DV, Firmware, and Software teams to ensure high-quality silicon delivery. 

Key Responsibilities

- Develop and execute pre-silicon and post-silicon validation plans for Arm's compute subsystems. 
 - Build and enhance test environments, automation frameworks, and validation infrastructure using emulation and silicon platforms. 
 - Perform system-level functional validation, focusing on CPU clusters, coherent interconnects, memory controllers, and peripheral integration. 
 - Drive root-cause analysis of hardware, firmware, and software issues, collaborating with cross-functional teams. 
 - Develop diagnostic, stress, and performance workloads to validate system functionality, power, and performance. 
 - Support silicon bring-up and debug activities, including board-level testing and post-silicon lab validation. 
 - Analyse coverage gaps and contribute to improving validation efficiency and quality metrics. 
 - Contribute to automation and continuous integration for validation workflows. 

Required Skills And Experience

 - Experience testing contact center / telephony applications (voice, IVR, chat) and familiarity with tools such as Hammer and Cyara. 
 - Experience with AWS cloud services and Amazon Connect (or comparable cloud contact center platform). 
 - Proficient in at least one object-oriented programming language and SQL; ability to write and debug test automation code. 
 - Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines (e. g. , Jenkins) and using version control (Git/Bitbucket).

Responsibilities

The Bengaluru-based engineering opportunity supports its work in wireless testing and validation within the telecommunications domain, contributing to the development and assessment of WLAN technologies. Rohde & Schwarz operates under its own name and brings together its divisions to address complex connectivity needs across the sectors it serves. 

About the Role

As a full-time, on-site WLAN Test Engineer in Bengaluru, you will lead wireless test strategy and validation in a telecommunications engineering environment. You will develop test plans, build Python-based automation, and assess Wi-Fi performance and RF behavior against relevant 802. 11 standards. The role combines hands-on network and protocol testing with analysis, troubleshooting, and clear documentation of test procedures and findings. You will work with engineering teams to investigate defects and resolve wireless connectivity issues, while mentoring junior test engineers and strengthening test execution. This position suits an experienced engineer with a background in WLAN testing, wireless communications, or RF testing who can take ownership of test quality and help deliver reliable wireless systems. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead WLAN test strategy development and translate product and validation needs into effective test coverage. Align test priorities with engineering objectives and relevant wireless standards. 
 - Design wireless test plans covering Wi-Fi performance, network behavior, protocols, and RF system validation. Define test scenarios and procedures that support consistent, repeatable execution. 
 - Build and maintain Python test automation frameworks for WLAN validation. Use automation to improve test execution and support reliable assessment of wireless system behavior. 
 - Execute Wi-Fi performance, network, protocol, and RF tests against applicable 802. 11 standards. Record outcomes and identify defects or unexpected system behavior. 
 - Analyze test results and defects, troubleshoot wireless connectivity issues, and support engineering teams in investigating root causes. Communicate findings clearly to enable resolution. 
 - Document test procedures, execution details, and findings to maintain useful validation records. Share relevant results and technical observations with engineering stakeholders. 
 - Collaborate with engineering teams throughout test planning and execution, and mentor junior test engineers. Support effective knowledge sharing and consistent testing practices. 

Essential Skills & Technologies

- Strong WLAN and Wi-Fi testing capability, including practical wireless validation experience. Apply relevant 802. 11 standards when planning and assessing test coverage. 
 - Experience with radio frequency testing and RF system behavior. Evaluate wireless performance and interpret results in the context of system validation. 
 - Python programming skills for building test automation frameworks. Develop automation that supports structured, repeatable WLAN test execution. 
 - Knowledge of network testing and protocol testing for wireless systems. Design and execute test scenarios that assess connectivity and protocol behavior. 
 - Test planning and test execution skills, including designing wireless test plans and carrying them through to documented results. Maintain clarity and consistency across validation activities. 
 - Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills for investigating wireless connectivity issues, reviewing test results, and assessing defects. Explain findings to support engineering resolution. 
 - Bachelor of Technology in Electronics and Communication Engineering, Computer Science, or Electrical and Electronics Engineering. Relevant specialization in WLAN testing, wireless communications, or RF testing. 

Additional Plus

- Experience across telecommunications, telecom or ISP environments, or computers and electronics manufacturing can provide useful context for wireless product validation. 
 - Background in mentoring junior test engineers and collaborating with engineering teams can support effective knowledge sharing and coordinated defect investigation. 

What You'll Bring

- Eight to twelve years of relevant experience in WLAN, wireless communications, or RF testing, with the ability to take ownership of test strategy and validation outcomes. 
 - A Bachelor of Technology in Electronics and Communication Engineering, Computer Science, or Electrical and Electronics Engineering, complemented by relevant wireless or RF specialization. 
 - Practical strength in Python automation, 802. 11 standards, network and protocol testing, test planning, execution, and defect analysis. 
 - Professional English communication skills, sound documentation habits, and the ability to work on-site in Bengaluru while collaborating with engineering teams and mentoring junior colleagues. 

Why Join Us

Join Rohde & Schwarz and contribute to work that supports a safer, connected world. The company operates across Test & Measurement, Aerospace & Defense, and Critical Infrastructure & Networks, developing solutions for industrial, regulatory, and government customers with technology and connectivity challenges. In this engineering role, your work will focus on WLAN strategy, Wi-Fi performance testing, RF validation, and Python test automation. You will help turn test requirements into structured plans, investigate connectivity issues, and communicate findings that engineering teams can act on. The opportunity brings together hands-on wireless testing and technical leadership through collaboration and mentorship. Rohde & Schwarz identifies independence, stability, and long-term relationships with customers and partners as company values. You can apply your experience in a telecommunications environment where connectivity and dependable technical systems are central to the work. The position is full-time and on-site in Bengaluru, with scope to contribute directly to wireless validation and improve the quality and consistency of testing practices. 

What We Offer

- A full-time, on-site engineering opportunity in Bengaluru, focused on WLAN validation, Wi-Fi performance, RF behavior, and test automation. 
 - Ownership of WLAN test strategy and plans, with practical scope to execute testing, analyze defects, and collaborate with engineering teams. 
 - The opportunity to contribute to telecommunications work supporting Rohde & Schwarz's broader focus on connectivity and technology challenges.

of fire prevention and emergency response systems across units.

* Lead the Head of QC in establishing and maintaining quality standards for incoming materials, 

in-process production and finished goods in accordance with approved specifications and

sampling procedures. 

* Monitor rejection rates, rework, customer complaints, quality deviations and product

consistency for timely investigation of non-conformities and implementation of corrective

and preventive actions. 

G. Laboratory Management

* Oversee the Laboratory team to ensure reliable and timely testing of raw materials, 

fragrances, binders, bamboo sticks, packaging materials and finished products, as applicable. 

H. Inbound Material Control

* Oversee the GRN function to ensure that all incoming materials are received, verified, 

documented and recorded accurately as per SOP's. 

* Ensure reconciliation of purchase orders, supplier invoices, delivery challans, physical

quantities and accepted quantities.

* Mentor the Purchase dept to ensure timely, cost-effective, and reliable availability of raw

materials, packaging materials, consumables, spare parts month on month. 

* Ensure competitive sourcing, appropriate commercial terms, quality compliance, and

adherence to approved procurement policies. 

J. Dispatch and Finished Goods Movement

* Ensure timely, accurate, and cost-effective movement of finished goods to depots and

distribution points for efficient delivery performance. 

K. Cost Control and Resource Optimisation

* Develop and monitor operational budgets covering manufacturing, labour, maintenance, quality, procurement, safety, and dispatch. 

* Identify cost-saving opportunities, and review operational variances, and establish

accountability for corrective actions. 

L. Reporting Systems

* Ensure compliance with applicable factory, labour, safety, environmental, quality, and other

statutory requirements, in coordination with designated functional owners. 

* Have regular performance reviews on all business KPI's with the Management. 

Knowledge, Skills, & Abilities

1. Industry and Business orientation

2. Entrepreneurial approach

3. Strategic Leadership

4. Collaborative approach

5. Analytical thinking and structured problem-solving

6. Communication skills. 

7. Negotiation skills and stakeholder management

8. Team leadership and capability development. 

9. Functional expertise

Educational Qualifications & Work Experience

* Post Graduate/ Graduate degree in any discipline

* Certifications Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, TPM, EHS, quality systems or operational

excellence will be an advantage. 

* 12 -16 years of experience in a relevant manufacturing set-up. 

* Experience in manufacturing cost optimisation, plant productivity improvement, and

operational transformation. 

About the company -

MDPH is a leading FMCG company in India that owns household Brands like Zed Black, Manthan, DinDin, Coach, Orva & more. 

MDPH provides direct employment to over 4, 000 people, has a range of 1200+ SKUs, a network of over 3, 500 distributors, and has invested in 4 manufacturing plants, 39 distribution centers, and an overseas office in New York. MDPH exports to 40+ countries. 

Zed Black Agarbatti is endorsed by MS Dhoni, Manthan Dhoop is endorsed by Hrithik Roshan, and DinDin Confectionery is endorsed by Doraemon.

 - Support quality strategy: help with product testing when needed as well help determine where automation provides the greatest value, while retaining sound test design and appropriate exploration or manual testing where needed. 

Essential Skills

- Strong, hands-on Python programming skills. You should be comfortable designing, implementing, debugging, profiling and refactoring non-trivial code-not just writing test scripts. 
 - Typically, 8+ years of relevant software engineering, test automation or framework-development experience, including substantial ownership of automation frameworks. 
 - Demonstrated experience designing and evolving reusable automation frameworks, test libraries or developer tooling used by multiple engineers or teams. 
 - Strong software engineering fundamentals: data structures, algorithms, object-oriented design, modularity, error handling, testing, debugging and clean-code practices. 
 - Experience building and maintaining integration-level, API or backend automated tests. 
 - Practical experience with Playwright and TypeScript for front end-end end-to-end automation, or the ability to demonstrate equivalent depth and quickly contribute to this stack. 
 - Experience with Git, code reviews, CI/CD pipelines and collaborative Agile software development. 
 - Ability to investigate complex failures across application code, test code, test data, environments and infrastructure. 
 - Strong communication and mentoring skills, with the ability to explain design trade-offs and raise engineering quality across a team. 

Desired Skills

- Experience testing financial technology, electronic trading, capital markets, market data, order management or other complex, high-throughput systems. 
 - Experience with development and maintenance of Python-based automation frameworks. 
 - Experience improving large regression suites through parallelization, smarter test selection, test-data management, code coverage, performance profiling and flakiness reduction. 
 - Experience with distributed systems, asynchronous programming, service integrations, messaging or event-driven architectures. 
 - Experience with Linux-based test environments, containers and troubleshooting environment-dependent failures. 
 - Experience using AI-assisted engineering tools effectively, with appropriate review and validation of generated code. 

What We Bring to the Table

Compensation

Competitive Benefits & Perks in India We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. 

- Health & Financial Security: 
 - Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage
 - Time Off & Flexibility: 
 - Enjoy the best of both worlds: the energy and collaboration of in-person work, combined with the convenience and focus of remote days. This is a hybrid position requiring three days of in-office collaboration per week, with the flexibility to work remotely for the remaining two days. Our hybrid model is designed to balance individual flexibility with the benefits of in-person collaboration, enhanced team cohesion, spontaneous innovation, hands-on mentorship opportunities and strengthens our company culture. 
 - 21 days of Paid Time Off (PTO) per year, with the option to roll over unused days. 
 - One dedicated day per year for volunteering. 
 - Two professional development days per year to allow uninterrupted professional development. 
 - An additional PTO day is added during milestone anniversary years. 
 - Robust paid holiday schedule with early dismissal. 
 - Generous parental leave for all parents (including adoptive parents).

 - Budget for tech accessories, including monitors, headphones, keyboards, and other office equipment. 
 - Milestone anniversary bonuses. 
 - Wellness & Lifestyle Perks: 
 - Subsidy contributions toward gym memberships and health/wellness initiatives. 
 - Our Culture: 
 - Forward-thinking, culture-based organization with collaborative teams that promote diversity and inclusion.

With its roots in listed derivatives, the Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) company delivers "multi-X" solutions, with "X" representing asset classes, functions, workflows, and geographies. Job Description Join Wipro Technologies as a Techno Functional Consultant L1, where you will play a pivotal role in driving technological innovations and delivering impactful solutions in dynamic multi-cloud and hybrid cloud environments. This role is designed for professionals with substantial expertise in AIOPS implementation, leveraging cutting-edge cloud-native architectures and advanced monitoring and automation tools to enhance system performance and reliability. 

As a key contributor within the Technology Services sector and the TTMS - AMS (EA) practice, you will collaborate closely across teams to design, implement, and optimize scalable systems that meet evolving client needs. Your responsibilities will encompass developing strategic solutions integrating Datadog's stack, Kubernetes orchestration, and cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, and Azure, while fostering robust incident response and alerting mechanisms. 

This role offers an opportunity to be part of an innovative digital transformation journey at Wipro. You will work within an environment that champions agility, collaboration, and continuous learning, empowering you to advance your career and skillset while contributing to inspiring business growth and client success. 

͏ 
 - 6-9 years of comprehensive hands-on experience working with Datadog's monitoring and analytics suite across diverse multi-cloud and hybrid cloud infrastructures. 
 - Strong foundation in systems engineering principles or software development methodologies, enabling holistic understanding of complex system interactions. 
 - Proven expertise with container orchestration using Kubernetes and practical experience with major public cloud platforms including AWS, Google Cloud Platform, and Microsoft Azure. 
 - Advanced proficiency in programming and scripting languages such as Go, Python, and Java to develop automation scripts and customize monitoring solutions. 
 - Deep understanding of monitoring strategies, alert configurations, and incident management procedures to ensure system reliability and quick remediation. 
 - Solid grasp of cloud-native application architectures and microservices design, facilitating efficient deployment and scaling of distributed applications. 
 - Experience designing and managing high-throughput, low-latency systems ensuring optimal performance under demanding conditions, complemented by strong communication and teamwork skills. 
 - Familiarity with Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) pipelines and leveraging monitoring tools for automated feedback and system health tracking. 
 - Comprehensive knowledge of both Windows and Linux operating systems internals, networking concepts, and system-level troubleshooting. 
 - Experience building and maintaining distributed systems with high availability requirements and disaster recovery strategies. 
 - Expertise in containerization using Docker, advanced Kubernetes features, and integration with service mesh technologies to enhance security and traffic management. 
 - Knowledge of infrastructure-as-code and automation tools such as Terraform, Ansible, or Pulumi adds valuable advantages; competency in building dashboards, designing monitors, and configuring alert systems enhances operational visibility and proactive issue resolution. 
 - Familiar with automation frameworks and workflow orchestration tools like Jenkins, GitHub Actions, and CircleCI to streamline deployment, rollback, and testing processes efficiently. ͏ At Wipro, we seek individuals who bring not only technical expertise but also a strong set of professional competencies that foster effective teamwork and successful project delivery: 

- Effective Communication: Ability to convey complex technical concepts clearly and collaborate with diverse teams and stakeholders. 
 - Collaborative Working: Embrace teamwork and collective problem-solving to achieve shared goals. 
 - Passion for Results: Demonstrating commitment and dedication to delivering high-quality outcomes. 
 - Client Centricity: Focusing on understanding and fulfilling client requirements to drive satisfaction and value. 
 - Learning Agility: Proactively acquiring new knowledge and skills to adapt to the fast-changing technology landscape. 
 - Problem Solving & Decision Making: Applying analytical thinking to resolve challenges efficiently and make informed decisions. 
 - Execution Excellence: Delivering on commitments with precision, consistency, and attention to quality. ͏ Candidates are expected to have mandatory skills in AIOPS implementation, showcasing practical experience in deploying AI-driven operational solutions that automate monitoring, alerting, and incident response workflows. This expertise is critical in modern cloud environments for enhancing system resilience and operational efficiency. 

The position requires a minimum of 5 to 8 years of professional experience in relevant fields such as cloud infrastructure, systems engineering, or software development, reflecting a deep understanding of both functional and technical aspects of the role. 

Applicants passionate about innovation and continuous improvement will find this opportunity fulfilling, supported by Wipro's commitment to empowering employees to design their own career reinvention within a forward-thinking and evolving digital ecosystem. 

͏ Wipro Technologies stands at the forefront of digital transformation as a comprehensive partner committed to innovation and excellence. We are reshaping industries by embracing change and nurturing talent that thrives on reinvention. 

By joining Wipro, you become part of a dynamic culture that values diversity, inclusivity, and continuous learning. Our mission is rooted in purpose-driven business practices that strive to empower clients and employees alike to adapt and excel in a rapidly evolving world. 

We offer a collaborative, supportive environment where your contributions directly impact enterprise success, backed by cutting-edge technologies and global opportunities to elevate your professional journey. 

Reinvent your future with Wipro - where your career growth aligns with bold ambitions and transformative innovation. 

  

Mandatory Skills: AIOPS - Implementation
. 

  

Experience: 5-8 Years
. 

  

Reinvent your world. We are building a modern Wipro. We are an end-to-end digital transformation partner with the boldest ambitions. To realize them, we need people inspired by reinvention. Of yourself, your career, and your skills. We want to see the constant evolution of our business and our industry. It has always been in our DNA - as the world around us changes, so do we. Join a business powered by purpose and a place that empowers you to design your own reinvention.

Desired Skills

data.title: Material+ - Technical Lead - DevOps & Security
data.description:
About The Role

Srijan, a Material company, is a global digital engineering firm specialising in solving complex technology challenges. We are seeking a Technical Lead DevOps & Security with strong expertise in Azure platform security, identity and access management, API security, cloud networking, observability, and DevOps Design and implement Azure platform security controls using Microsoft Entra ID, Azure API Management (APIM), Azure networking, and native Azure monitoring and security services. 

- Configure Microsoft Entra ID app registrations, service principals, OAuth 2. 0 scopes, delegated and application permissions, OBO token flows, and consent models. 
 - Implement resource-scoped permissions, including Exchange Application RBAC and resource-specific consent (RSC)-style scoping. 
 - Develop and stage APIM policies, including client-specific policies, correlation-ID propagation, content-safety controls, and token-limit enforcement. 
 - Configure network security groups, firewall and egress rules, private endpoints, private connectivity, and subnet segmentation. 
 - Implement observability and audit logging using Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Microsoft Sentinel, OpenTelemetry, and KQL. 
 - Review application source code and agent workflows to determine minimum permissions for MCP servers, tools, and Microsoft Graph resources. 
 - Build shared instrumentation libraries or SDKs that enforce structured event emission, schema compliance, and consistent logging. 
 - Implement CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure-as-code practices to promote controls through DEV and UAT environments. 
 - Follow a native-first, GA-only approach, prioritising existing Azure security capabilities. 
 - Apply default-deny, least-privilege, and fail-closed principles to prevent unauthorised access. 
 - Design and execute positive and negative security tests to verify permitted operations and block unauthorised access. 
 - Produce audit-ready evidence, including permission exports, allow/deny matrices, tamper tests, and control designs. 
 - Coordinate with client platform, cloud networking, and SecOps teams to implement network segmentation and security dashboards. 
 - Manage control implementation through two-week sprint cycles, ensuring staged promotion and validation. 
 - Collaborate with architecture and governance stakeholders to support ARB, TRC, and security/compliance sign-offs. 
 - Drive continuous hardening of platform controls, ensuring they are operationally effective and verifiable. 

Requirements

- 6 - 10 years of experience in DevOps engineering, cloud security, platform engineering, or security engineering, with strong hands-on expertise in Microsoft Azure. 
 - Strong knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID, including app registrations, service principals, OAuth 2. 0, and consent management. 
 - Hands-on experience with Azure API Management, policy authoring, and security policy enforcement. 
 - Strong understanding of Azure networking (NSGs, firewalls, egress controls, private endpoints, subnet segmentation). 
 - Experience with Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Microsoft Sentinel, OpenTelemetry, and KQL. 
 - Ability to analyse source code and derive least-privilege permissions for AI agents, MCP servers, and Microsoft Graph resources. 
 - Experience developing shared instrumentation libraries, structured logging, and telemetry controls. 
 - Strong understanding of CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code, and controlled promotion across environments. 
 - Practical experience with default-deny access, fail-closed controls, and security bypass validation. 
 - Ability to produce clear technical documentation, control designs, and audit-grade evidence. 
 - Strong collaboration and stakeholder management skills. 
 - Ability to work in an Agile environment and deliver security controls within defined timelines. 
 - Experience with PlainID, AI agent platforms, LLM gateways, MCP hubs, LangSmith, PostgreSQL, and Azure AI security (Content Safety, Prompt Shields) would be an advantage. 

Working Conditions

- The role follows a native-first, GA-only approach with staged DEV-to-UAT promotion, positive and negative testing, and documented sign-off before client handover. Production changes are managed by the client through its own change-control process.

data.description:
Position: Senior Backend Platform Developer (CE80ST RM 4556)

Role Overview -

The developer will work with C#, ASP. NET Core, ASP. NET Zero, ABP. io, SQL Server, RabbitMQ, C++, Boost, IIS, SignalR, RTSP and WebRTC. The role owns platform components from technical design and implementation through testing, deployment, monitoring, maintenance, and production support. A key responsibility is modernizing existing components from ASP. NET Zero to ABP. io while preserving security, reliability, performance, scalability, and maintainability. 

Education : Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, software engineering, electronics engineering, or a related discipline. 

Key Responsibilities

- Backend Development
 - Design and develop scalable backend services, REST APIs, business logic, data-access components and integration modules. 
 - Develop and maintain enterprise applications using C#, ASP. NET Core, ASP. NET Zero, ABP. io and SQL Server. 
 - Contribute to ASP. NET Zero-to-ABP. io modernization and migration activities. 
 - Apply object-oriented design, modular architecture, design patterns, and clean coding practices. 
 - Messaging and Real-Time Integration
 - Design RabbitMQ-based asynchronous messaging, event-driven workflows, and distributed processing mechanisms. 
 - Develop SignalR-based services for alarms, notifications, events, status updates, and operational monitoring. 
 - Optimize message delivery, event processing, resiliency, fault handling, and system responsiveness. 
 - Platform and Infrastructure Services
 - Deploy, configure, and support ASP. NET applications and backend services hosted on IIS. 
 - Manage security settings, certificates, performance tuning, logging, monitoring, diagnostics, and recovery. 
 - Support CI/CD pipelines, automated builds, release management, and production deployments. 
 - Troubleshoot application, server, network, database, and deployment issues. 
 - Device and Protocol Integration
 - Develop and maintain C++ services, native libraries, communication modules, and protocol-handling components. 
 - Use Boost for networking, threading, asynchronous processing, messaging, and system-level operations. 
 - Integrate controllers, panels, security devices, cameras, and field hardware. 
 - Resolve protocol, communication, synchronization, performance, and stability issues. 
 - Video and Streaming Services
 - Integrate video-management and surveillance systems using RTSP-based streams. 
 - Develop and support WebRTC services for secure, low-latency browser video delivery. 
 - Support video monitoring, event correlation, alarm verification, and associated-camera workflows. 
 - Troubleshoot stream connectivity, conversion, latency, and browser-delivery issues. 
 - Application Support and Collaboration
 - Monitor system health, availability, performance, reliability, and scalability; maintain logging, auditing, tracing, and alerts. 
 - Apply secure coding practices and protect credentials, certificates, tokens, keys, and configuration secrets. 
 - Perform root-cause analysis and drive corrective actions, technical-debt reduction, and continuous improvement. 
 - Collaborate with Product Management, Architecture, QA, DevOps, UI/UX, and global engineering teams. 
 - Participate in design reviews, code reviews, technical planning, testing, releases, and documentation. 

Required Skills

- Core Backend Development
 - 8-12 years of software development experience. 
 - Strong experience in C#, ASP. NET Core, and REST API development. 
 - Experience with ASP. NET Zero and/or ABP. io. 
 - Good knowledge of SQL Server and Entity Framework Core. 
 - Strong understanding of software design principles and clean coding practices. 
 - Messaging & Platform Technologies
 - Experience with RabbitMQ or similar messaging platforms. 
 - Experience with SignalR, WebSockets, or real-time communication technologies. 
 - Strong experience in C++ development. 
 - Experience using Boost libraries. 
 - Understanding of TCP/IP, networking, multithreading, and asynchronous programming. 
 - Infrastructure & Engineering Practices
 - Experience deploying and supporting applications on IIS. 
 - Experience with Git, Bitbucket, SVN, and Jira. 
 - Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments. 
 - Familiarity with CI/CD, automated testing, and code quality practices. 
 - Preferred Skills
 - Experience migrating applications from ASP. NET Zero to ABP. io. 
 - Experience with RTSP and WebRTC technologies. 
 - Experience integrating controllers, alarm panels, cameras and field devices. 
 - Exposure to Angular and TypeScript. 
 - Knowledge of OAuth 2. 0, OpenID Connect and secure API design. 
 - Experience with Windows Services and distributed systems. 
 - Experience in access control, intrusion, video surveillance, or physical security platforms.
