data.title: Senior Manager, Core Infrastructure Engineering
data.description:
Job Description

The Engineering Manager will lead a team building and operating scalable OCI metering services that collect, validate, and aggregate cloud resource usage for downstream pricing, rating, and billing. They will own roadmap delivery over a 2-4 quarter horizon, hire and develop engineers, and guide architecture for high-throughput distributed systems with strong data correctness, fault tolerance, and availability. The role includes overseeing batch and streaming data pipelines using managed distributed processing platforms such as Data Flow. Responsibilities include setting engineering standards and SLOs; driving performance optimization, observability, reconciliation, and recovery; ensuring operational readiness and effective on-call coverage; and overseeing security, automation, and safe deployments and rollbacks. The manager will partner with compute, networking, storage, and commercial platform teams to deliver reliable metering capabilities and support new consumption models. Experience with Java, Python, Spark, and cloud data processing platforms is preferred. 

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

System Design & Architecture - System Scalability: 

- Manages the development and implementation of scalable distributed systems and components across multiple teams, including the effective use of distributed state management tools. 
 - Oversees code and/or system optimization efforts for large-scale data processing and high-throughput requirements within and across teams to support hyper-scale systems. 
 - Guides teams to define scalability requirements for owned components and ensures design and implementation requirements are met. 
 - Manages the use of data plane platforms to effectively handle large-scale data retrieval, storage, and processing. 
 - Ensures team accurately designs performance and load testing. 

System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Design: 

- Manages the strategy for building fault-tolerant components and systems capable of withstanding in-service updates by guiding the implementation of redundancy, replication, and automatic failover mechanisms. 
 - Develops design strategies for systems to effectively handle service disruptions (e. g. , network partitions) by prioritizing consistency, availability, or partition tolerance. 
 - Leads implementation and optimization initiatives across teams for approaches to handle network unreliability, including load-shedding, throttling, and rate-limiting. 
 - Guides teams to design components and systems that are durable and adhere to service level objectives (SLOs), setting expectations for availability and durability of other computing services within the department. 

System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Performance: 

- Provides oversight in defining key performance indicators (KPIs) and telemetry to identify gaps or issues in running systems. 
 - Oversees the building and customization of moderately complex dashboards, telemetry systems, and alerting mechanisms to proactively monitor components and system health. 

System Design & Architecture - Correctness / Availability: 

- Oversees the design and implementation of functional and correctness requirements for feature sets and/or systems in new or existing systems. 
 - Guides teams to design complex test scenarios (e. g. , fault-injection, brown-out) to evaluate system correctness. 
 - Directs implementation strategies for data replication and synchronization techniques to maintain data integrity and availability. 

Operational Troubleshooting & Incident Management: 

- Guides teams to be proactive when diagnosing, debugging, and resolving issues in active components and systems to support ongoing operation. 
 - Ensures teams leverage expertise to prevent interruptions, ensuring no maintenance windows are required for customers and users when resolving issues. 
 - Oversees operational readiness protocol and ensures teams remain knowledgeable of owned components and systems to support effective troubleshooting and performance. 
 - Oversees and approves schedules for operational support rotations. 

Compliance & Security: 

- Oversees implementation of robust security measures to protect data and applications in multi-tenant environments, ensuring team strategies incorporate encryption techniques and access controls. 
 - Directs execution of remediation plans to address identified security gaps, promoting continuous improvement of security measures. 
 - Ensures comprehensive documentation and cloud infrastructure compliance with industry standards and regulations. 

Automation & Change Management: 

- Oversees the development and maintenance of automation scripts and tools (e. g. , Infrastructure as Code (IaC)) to manage cloud infrastructure. 
 - Works with teams to create and adhere to change management plans for patching, updating, and rolling back applications, and guides development of components to allow for automation of these processes. 

Core Responsibilities

Planning & Execution: 

- Manages multiple medium- to large-scale projects or initiatives across teams, ensuring timelines, deliverables, and budgets (when applicable) are monitored and met. 
 - Provides direction to teams on project work, setting priorities, and aligning with business needs. 
 - Guides teams on adjusting plans to accommodate resource or timeline changes. 

Collaboration & Partnership: 

- Drives cross-functional partnerships to align on expectations and shared objectives across multiple teams. 
 - Coaches team members to develop strategic relationships with business leaders, stakeholders, and external partners to foster collaboration and long-term success. 
 - Promotes inclusivity by actively seeking and listening to diverse perspectives, ensuring others feel heard and respected. 

Problem Solving: 

- Provides direction to multiple teams on addressing complex operational and/or technical issues, as well as guidance on analyzing complex data and/or information to identify solutions. 
 - Reviews and provides insights into unresolved or critical issues, helping teams to identify potential solutions. 

Continuous Learning: 

- Models engaging in continuous learning to deepen expertise and stay ahead of industry trends, integrating best practices into strategic planning.

The purpose of this role is to ensure compliance and quality of the process within an account.   
  

͏ Do

- Track and review the process quality through audits

 - Monitor to ensure that the audits are being conducted as per plan
 - Review the audit data across the account to review the account performance on quality parameters, identify the error trends  
 - Prepare reports for review for the internal leadership as well as client

 - Ensure compliance part of the process by front-ending with the external auditors CMMIE or any onsite audits, coordinating with the internal teams and working with SDH and AH to develop SOPs and compliance registers as required for the audits.

data.title: Build and Release Methodology Engineer
data.description:
NVIDIA has continuously reinvented itself. Our invention of the GPU sparked the growth of the PC gaming market, redefined modern computer graphics, and revolutionized parallel computing. Today, research in artificial intelligence is booming worldwide, which calls for highly scalable and massively parallel computation horsepower that NVIDIA GPUs excel. NVIDIA is a "learning machine" that constantly evolves by adapting to new opportunities that are hard to solve, that only we can address, and that matter to the world. This is our life's work , to amplify human creativity and intelligence. As an NVIDIAN, you'll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join our diverse team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world!

We are looking for a Senior Engineer for our Build and Release Methodology Group catering to our pioneering SOCs. As the SOC development becomes more complex requiring packing of more and more IPs and the need for doing more SOCs increase, we need to have a scalable infrastructure to be able to complete SOC development in fastest as well as most efficient way possible. This requires an SOC Build and IP Release infrastructure that caters to and keeps up with these ever-increasing complexities. In this position, you will work first-hand on architecting and developing this methodology. If you have real passion for methodologies and automation solutions, you will fit in great!

What You'll Be Doing

- Define and develop system-level methodologies and tools to build SOCs in an efficient and scalable manner. 
 - Architect and implement core build flows so as to optimize build and make it simpler and efficient. 
 - Improve build, release, and integration tools and procedures. 
 - Identify and develop Checks to enforce the best practices for the Build and Release guidelines. 
 - Develop solutions to enable abstraction and compartmentalization for customer IPs. 
 - Identify difficulties and inefficiencies in the SOC implementation process and propose ideas to solve them. 
 - Support IP teams with Build and Release related issues. 

What We Need To See

- BS or MS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or Computer Science, or equivalent experience. 
 - 2+ years of industry experience as Build and Release Engineer, Build Automation, IP integration and related areas. 
 - Strong coding skills in Perl, Python, Makefile, Shell script, or other industry-standard scripting languages. 
 - Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills. 
 - Excellent interpersonal skills to work with multi-functional teams and collaborate with team members across sites and cultures to build consensus. 
 - Background in RTL (Verilog), Verification (UVM, System Verilog) and C/C++ is a plus - Not must. 
 - Experience in synthesis and physical design is a plus - Not must.

Arista Networks is an industry leader in data-driven, client-to-cloud networking for large data center, campus and routing environments. Arista's award-winning platforms, ranging in Ethernet speeds up to 800G bits per second, redefine scalability, agility, and resilience. Arista is a founding member of the Ultra Ethernet consortium. We have shipped over 20 million cloud networking ports worldwide with CloudVision and EOS, an advanced network operating system. Arista is committed to open standards, and its products are available worldwide directly and through partners. 

At Arista, we value the diversity of thought and perspectives each employee brings. We believe fostering an inclusive environment where individuals from various backgrounds and experiences feel welcome is essential for driving creativity and innovation.

Who You'll Work With

You will work with the Platform team who work closest to the hardware and programming chips.

As a Software Engineer your core responsibility is to deliver new cutting edge product features. A major part of this is writing and owning design/implementation of the code that drives our products. However, the role of a Software Engineer is much bigger than 'simply' writing code. Software engineers work on the whole development process, including: 

- Suggesting and deciding what features to build
 - Driving the design and architecture
 - Pushing, testing, documenting the feature
 - Working alongside customers in the field if needed

This Is An Interesting And Exciting Opportunity To Be a Part Of The Software Development Team That Is Redefining Data Center Switching. For Success At Arista All You Need Is

- Strong industry experience of 5+ years
 - Extensive background in algorithms and strong software architecture skills
 - Fluency in C/C++ programming
 - Hands-on experience with designs and implementations in a strong product-engineering environment.

Arista stands out as an engineering-centric company. Our leadership, including founders and engineering managers, are all engineers who understand sound software engineering principles and the importance of doing things right.

Enterprise Systems is the backbone of GSK's internal operations in Digital & Tech, enabling GSK Global Functions teams such as Finance, Procurement, HR, Legal, Compliance, WREF, CGA and Corporate Secretariat to run seamlessly. This team designs and delivers cutting-edge digital platforms that power critical processes, ensuring efficiency, compliance, and scalability across the enterprise.

This team drives financial discipline, operational rigour and strategic alignment across the ES portfolio that safeguard GSK's integrity and reputation globally. By joining this team, you'll help shape systems that support thousands of employees worldwide, driving innovation and reliability in the tools that keep GSK moving forward. 

Job Purpose: 

The Senior Technical SME for QA Systems provides technical leadership across the Quality Assurance product family and technology platforms, including Veeva, SAP, Mendix and AI-enabled automation solutions. The role leads solution design, implementation, validation and troubleshooting, ensuring technical outputs align with approved architecture, product strategy and engineering standards. The role coordinates engineers, site teams, architects, Product Owners, Service Managers and suppliers, acting as the technical lead for complex delivery and operational issues. The job holder reviews technical specifications, configurations and test evidence, and leads root-cause analysis were operational, batch or data-integrity impact may exist. The role also combines hands-on AI-enabled & automation and software engineering with technical leadership to deliver reusable agents, automation components, integrations and engineering tools. Working closely with the Automation Manager from the Enterprise AI team, the role translates the Quality Assurance AI and automation strategy into practical solutions and drives the technical adoption of AI within the team. 

Key Responsibilities: 

- Design, develop, test and implement AI-enabled automation and agents capabilities supporting the Quality Assurance platform development team, implementing technical solution designs and configurations in accordance with approved architecture and product strategy. 
 - Perform troubleshooting and root-cause analysis, with timely escalation where manufacturing batches, product quality, patient supply or data integrity may be affected. 
 - Own technical quality for the assigned scope, including specifications, design documentation, configuration records and technical validation evidence, and design or configure interfaces, workflows, recipes, data models and environments, writing or reviewing related specifications and test scripts. 
 - Analyze logs, metrics, monitoring and system behavior to identify defects, performance issues and opportunities for improvement, and lead technical design and implementation across multiple projects, releases or sites. 
 - Review and approve key technical specifications, design documents, configurations, test scripts and validation evidence, and assess technical risks to ensure mitigation addresses security, compliance, resilience, data integrity and supportability. 
 - Provide technical direction during complex incidents, releases and stabilization and coordinate internal and supplier engineering resources. 
 - Maintain technical standards and reusable engineering assets for the assigned product family or platform, and establish reusable artificial intelligence engineering standards, reference architectures and design patterns, while coaching engineers and suppliers. 
 - Drive engineering lessons learned and cross-team continuous improvement, defining artificial intelligence evaluation strategies, acceptance criteria, test evidence and production-readiness decisions. 
 - Ensure appropriate controls for responsible artificial intelligence, data privacy, cybersecurity, human oversight, traceability and regulated change, and lead complex investigations into artificial intelligence quality, retrieval, data, integration and operational issues. 

Basic Qualifications: 

- Bachelor's or master's degree in engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Automation, Data, Life Sciences or another technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

- Lead the architecture and development of enterprise virtual data products using Denodo virtualization and semantic modeling.

What You Will Bring

- 10+ years of experience in Data Engineering, Data Architecture, or Analytics Engineering. 
 - 5+ years of Denodo implementation experience, including enterprise semantic layers and virtualized data products. 
 - Strong knowledge of Denodo, AWS services such as Lambda and Glue, ETL, APIs, data modeling, ontologies, data governance, and API design. 
 - Experience with Generative AI, agentic AI frameworks, and LLMOps.

- Experience designing AI-ready data platforms.

data.title: Mobility Technology OBT Functional Testing Specialist
data.description:
About The Role

Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced Functional Testing Specialist to join the Mobility Technology / Digital Enablement team. The role will focus on manual testing of internal travel applications, particularly Online Booking Tools (OBTs) and integrated travel-technology platforms. 

Primary Objective

Own end-to-end quality assurance for reservation platforms and help ensure reliable operation of corporate travel policy engines, air and hotel booking workflows, GDS/NDC integrations, payment gateways, and downstream systems. 

Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate will bring strong experience in functional, regression, integration, and end-to-end testing. They will combine analytical thinking and attention to detail with effective cross-functional collaboration and a sound understanding of travel-domain processes. Prior travel-industry experience is preferred. 

Key Responsibilities

- Test Planning and Design: Create, document, and maintain detailed manual test cases for internal travel applications, with particular emphasis on Online Booking Tools. 
 - Requirements Analysis: Understand travel business processes and translate business and technical requirements into clear, practical, and testable scenarios. 
 - Test Execution: Perform functional, regression, smoke, exploratory, integration, and end-to-end testing across releases and sprint cycles. 
 - Booking-Path Validation: Test complex, multi-tier booking journeys across air, hotel, rail, and car rental, including corporate travel policies, approval workflows, and profile synchronization. 
 - API and Integration Testing: Validate XML/JSON RESTful and SOAP integrations between the OBT and GDS platforms such as Sabre, Amadeus, and Travelport, as well as NDC aggregators and direct supplier connections. 
 - Payment and Downstream-System Validation: Verify corporate, virtual, and ghost-card processing and confirm accurate data transmission to mid-office, back-office, and expense-management systems, including SAP Concur and Chrome River. 
 - Defect Management: Identify, isolate, document, prioritize, and track defects in Azure DevOps or Jira, providing clear reproduction steps, appropriate severity levels, and supporting evidence. 
 - Retesting and Resolution: Collaborate with development teams to resolve defects and complete retesting to confirm that fixes work as expected. 
 - Delivery Planning: Estimate testing effort, identify risks, and support mitigation planning to enable timely, high-quality releases. 
 - Agile Delivery: Participate in daily stand-ups, sprint planning, requirement discussions, development cycles, and retrospectives, providing timely quality-assurance input. 
 - Stakeholder Communication: Keep Product, Technology, and business stakeholders informed about testing progress, risks, blockers, quality concerns, and release readiness. 
 - Data Validation: Query databases to verify backend transaction states, profile-data mapping, and Passenger Name Record (PNR) generation. 
 - AI-Enabled Testing: Use AI tools where appropriate to support test-case creation, test-data preparation, defect analysis, and defect summarization. 
 - Continuous Improvement: Analyse user feedback and improve testing processes, documentation, test coverage, and overall quality-assurance practices. 

Must have

- 6-8+ years of overall software testing experience. 
 - Strong hands-on experience in manual testing. 
 - 15 years of formal education. 
 - Strong stakeholder management and communication skills. 
 - Proactive, curious and continuous-improvement mindset. 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. 
 - Experience with AI, data analytics and digital technologies. 
 - Experience in UAT and working with cross-functional teams. 
 - Excellent attention to detail
 - Ability to simplify complex themes
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. 
 - Excellent verbal and written communication skills. 
 - Basic understanding of the product development lifecycle. 
 - Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodology is a plus. 
 - Knowledge of tools such as Jira, Trello, Notion, Excel, or Google Sheets is preferred. 
 - Ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced environment. 
 - Eagerness to learn and take ownership of tasks. 
 - Basic understanding of UI/UX principles. 
 - Familiarity with SQL, analytics tools, or wireframing tools is an added advantage. 

Required Skills: The person in this role will need strong skills and experience in: 

- 6 to 8 years of core software testing experience, with at least 5+ years dedicated to online tech platforms B2B and B2C
 - Experience in a cross-border global role, successfully managing multiple complex projects at a global level
 - Outstanding communication skills

Optional/Preferred skills: 

- 3 to 6 years of core software testing experience, with at least 2+ years dedicated to travel-tech platforms, corporate travel booking engines, or OTA (Online Travel Agency) ecosystems. 
 - Experience or working knowledge of the travel domain, especially online booking applications and travel business processes. 
 - Understanding of the travel lifecycle, including PNR creation, ticketing, modifications, cancellations, refunds, void windows, and corporate travel policy configurations. 
 - proficiency with API testing tools (e. g. , Postman, SoapUI). Solid hands-on experience using test management software (e. g. , Jira/Zephyr, ALM, Azure DevOps). 
 - Intermediate proficiency in SQL for backend database verification (joins, indexing, basic data manipulation). 
 - Familiarity with web debugging tools (Chrome DevTools) to analyse network traffic, errors, and payloads. 
 - Conceptual understanding or basic exposure to automation testing frameworks (Selenium, Playwright, or RestAssured) to help transition manual workflows to automation. 

Certifications: ISTQB or equivalent software testing certification Preferred Not mandatory

Work Experience: 8-10 Years of end-to-end functional testing of any online B2C/B2B product preferably travel booking systems

 - Proven verbal and written communication skills, with ability to engage across business, technical, and vendor teams
 - Strong attention to detail, and analytical and problem-solving skills
 - Ability to operate in a fast-paced environment, managing multiple priorities and dependencies simultaneously

data.description:
This is where your work makes a difference. 

At Baxter, we believe every person-regardless of who they are or where they are from-deserves a chance to live a healthy life. It was our founding belief in 1931 and continues to be our guiding principle. We are redefining healthcare delivery to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond. 

Our Baxter colleagues are united by our Mission to Save and Sustain Lives. Together, our community is driven by a culture of courage, trust, and collaboration. Every individual is empowered to take ownership and make a meaningful impact. We strive for efficient and effective operations, and we hold each other accountable for delivering exceptional results. 

Here, you will find more than just a job-you will find purpose and pride. 

We are seeking a Senior Automation Engineer to design, implement, execute, and maintain reliable automated tests for distributed applications and connected-service workflows. The engineer will build C#-based REST API and UI automation, integrate test suites into CI/CD pipelines, analyze failures, and collaborate with verification, development, DevOps, and product teams to improve release quality. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Analyze product, system, interface, and software requirements and translate them into maintainable automated test scenarios. 
 - Develop and maintain C# automation for REST APIs, web user interfaces, integration workflows, and regression scenarios. 
 - Create reusable test utilities, data builders, service clients, page objects, assertions, and reporting components. 
 - Validate JSON/XML payloads, authentication and authorization, database records, event-driven integrations, negative paths, and boundary conditions. 
 - Integrate automated smoke and regression suites with Azure DevOps or equivalent CI/CD pipelines and maintain stable daily execution. 
 - Investigate failed tests using application logs, API traces, network diagnostics, database queries, and pipeline artifacts. 
 - Maintain requirements-to-test traceability, objective evidence, defect records, and release verification reports. 
 - Review automation code, improve coverage, support root-cause analysis, and mentor less-experienced engineers. 

What You'll Bring

- B. E/B. Tech in Computer Science / Electronics & Communication / Electrical or related field 
 - 8+ years of relevant experience in test automation, including C#/. NET-based API and UI automation, framework development, and CI/CD integration. 
 - Mandatory: Strong hands-on C# and . NET programming skills, including object-oriented design, asynchronous programming, exception handling, and debugging. 
 - Proven REST API automation experience using suitable . NET libraries and test frameworks such as NUnit, xUnit, or MSTest. 
 - Mandatory: Hands-on UI test automation experience using Selenium WebDriver and/or Playwright. 
 - Mandatory: Understanding of GraphQL (GQL), including queries, mutations, schemas, and API validation. 
 - Experience with API contracts, HTTP methods and status codes, JSON/XML, SQL, authentication, authorization, and test-data management. 
 - Working knowledge of Git, code reviews, CI/CD pipelines, test reporting, and troubleshooting unstable automation. 
 - Understanding of risk-based testing, requirements traceability, defect management, and formal verification evidence. 
 - Experience in mobile application automation is a plus. 

Preferred Skills

- Experience testing microservices, Azure-hosted applications, Docker or Kubernetes deployments, message brokers, and distributed workflows. 
 - Knowledge of healthcare interoperability, HL7, FHIR, medical-device integrations, or regulated software verification. 
 - Experience with observability tools, centralized logging, API mocking, service virtualization, and automated quality gates.

data.title: Senior Director, Software Engineering
data.description:
Job Description Summary

Heartbeat is GE HealthCare's proprietary business system, our standard way of working together to deliver on commitments to people, patients, and customers. The Innovation Management System (IMS) strengthens the processes that power our innovation roadmap. 

The Senior Director, Software Engineering is the enterprise technical leader for modern software engineering. This role works in close partnership with the Senior Director, Software Development Practices Transformation and the Enterprise AI R&D Product Director to unify engineering, practices, and AI-enablement into a consistent, scalable, and compliant approach. 

This leader combines deep hands-on engineering expertise with strong influence and credibility, constructively challenging norms and inspiring engineers and leaders to adopt common, modern, high-performing ways of developing SaMD, SiMD, platforms, and shared components. 

Our mission is to improve lives in the moments that matter. Unlock your ambition, turn ideas into world-changing realities, and join an organization where every voice makes a difference, and every difference builds a healthier world. 

Job Description

Roles Responsibilities: 

- Define and maintain enterprise software engineering patterns and reference approaches
 - Shape consistent engineering approaches for services, data, UI, and platform components that embed security, quality, and compliance. Enables faster starts, reduced variability, and improved interoperability across teams. 
 - Advance software reliability engineering (SRE) practices
 - Guide adoption of reliability-focused engineering including service-level indicators, incident learning, and modern operational practices. Improves availability, reduces field defects, and lowers operational burden. 
 - Translate regulatory expectations into practical team-level engineering methods
 - Ensure engineering teams can apply standards such as IEC 62304, ISO 14971, IEC 82304-1, and AAMI TIR45 in a lightweight, iterative way. Improves audit readiness while maintaining development velocity. 
 - Lead the software engineering standardization roadmap
 - Develop and sequence a multi-quarter roadmap of engineering capabilities, tools, and skills. Ensures predictable adoption and compounding improvement across segments. 
 - Bridge AI R&D and Quality & Development Acceleration technical execution
 - Align AI-enabled engineering tools with DevSecOps, validation, and QMS expectations. Accelerates safe adoption of AI that improves engineering throughput and reduces non-value-add effort. 
 - Establish enterprise engineering performance measures
 - Define and deploy metrics for flow, quality, security, and reliability, enabling clear visibility from engineering work to business outcomes such as cycle time and EBIT impact. 
 - Modernize development environments and CI/CD systems
 - Advance consistent development, build, test, and release workflows with secure dependency management and automated evidence generation. Shortens cycle time and reduces integration failures. 
 - Uplevel engineering talent and technical decision-making
 - Provide coaching, design reviews, and technical guidance that raise engineering maturity and consistency. Builds durable skills and strengthens technical leadership across segments. 
 - Strengthen platform reuse and integration quality
 - Promote consistent interface patterns, API standards, and shared services that minimize duplication. Improves integration speed and reliability across product lines. 
 - Foster a learning-oriented, improvement-driven engineering culture
 - Model constructive challenge, data-driven experimentation, and transparent communication. Accelerates organizational learning and sustained improvement. 

Educational Qualifications

- Bachelor' s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related field; advanced degree preferred. 

Technical Skills

- Deep software engineering background across cloud, data, embedded, or platform systems. 
 - Fluency with CI/CD, infrastructure automation, observability, and secure development practices. 
 - Strong understanding of applying IEC, ISO, and AAMI standards in regulated environments. 
 - Ability to simplify complex technical concepts and influence cross-functional engineering decisions. 
 - 12+ years of software engineering experience with significant time in regulated health software. 
 - Proven technical leadership experience at scale in architecture, reliability, or platform engineering. 
 - Strong ability to influence outcomes across engineering, quality, regulatory, and product teams. 

Desired Characteristics

- Recognized technical expert with a reputation for pragmatic, scalable engineering solutions. 
 - Constructively challenges assumptions and drives clarity without friction. 
 - Experienced mentor of engineering talent and technical leaders. 
 - Strong business acumen linking engineering choices to customer and financial outcomes. 

Inclusion and Diversity

GE Healthcare is an Equal Opportunity Employer where inclusion matters. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law. 

We expect all employees to live and breathe our behaviors: to act with humility and build trust; lead with transparency; deliver with focus, and drive ownership - always with unyielding integrity. 

Our total rewards are designed to unlock your ambition by giving you the boost and flexibility you need to turn your ideas into world-changing realities. Our salary and benefits are everything you'd expect from an organization with global strength and scale, and you'll be surrounded by career opportunities in a culture that fosters care, collaboration and support.

data.title: Senior Software Development Engineer
data.description:
How You'll Help Us Keep Climbing (Overview & Key Responsibilities)

As a Senior Software Development Engineer, you will join a team of highly adaptable engineers responsible for rapidly learning new business domains, understanding complex technology ecosystems, and delivering high-priority business outcomes. Engineers in this organization are expected to engage across multiple domains, become productive quickly, execute prioritized initiatives, and transition seamlessly to new opportunities as business priorities evolve. 

Success in this role requires strong technical depth, systems thinking, business curiosity, and the ability to navigate complex enterprise environments with numerous upstream and downstream dependencies. Candidates must be comfortable working across modern cloud-native platforms, enterprise integrations, legacy systems, APIs, and emerging AI-enabled solutions. 

Responsibilities Include, But Are Not Limited To

- Design, develop, and maintain scalable cloud-based applications using AWS services. 
 - Develop and maintain APIs, microservices, and integration services that enable critical business capabilities. 
 - Establish trusted partnerships with domain engineering teams and deliver solutions that align with existing engineering standards, delivery processes, and operational models. 
 - Apply AI-assisted development tools to accelerate software delivery, automate repetitive tasks, and improve code quality. 
 - Apply cloud engineering best practices, including security, observability, and cost optimization. 
 - Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines to support continuous delivery. 
 - Develop and deploy containerized applications using Kubernetes and OpenShift. 
 - Leverage Infrastructure-as-Code and automation practices. 
 - Implement monitoring, logging, tracing, and observability capabilities. 
 - Contribute to experimentation and adoption of Generative and Agentic AI capabilities and intelligent automation solutions. 
 - Mentor and guide junior engineers, fostering a culture of continuous improvement. 
 - Stay up to date with the latest AWS technologies and industry trends. 

What You Need To Succeed (Minimum Qualifications)

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field. 
 - 4-7 years of experience in software development with Java 11+/J2EE in Spring boot, with a focus on cloud technologies. 
 - Experience with AWS services such as EC2, S3, Lambda, RDS, and services such as Amazon SageMaker, Bedrock, and Agent Core. 
 - Experience building scalable cloud-native, distributed, and event-driven applications. 
 - Strong understanding of microservices architecture and API design. 
 - Demonstrated experience using AI-assisted development tools (e. g. , GitHub Copilot, Claude, Kiro) to accomplish tasks such as generating and reviewing code, writing and maintaining tests, creating documentation, and debugging, with the judgment to validate and own AI-generated output. 
 - Understanding of prompt engineering, AI workflows, or model integration patterns. 
 - Experience working with generative AI or LLM-based solutions is highly desirable. 
 - Rapidly learn new business domains, alliance partner ecosystems, and integrated travel experiences to support evolving business priorities. 
 - Analyze system dependencies, data flows, APIs, and integration patterns to identify risks, bottlenecks, and opportunities that accelerate delivery. 
 - Collaborate across application, architecture, and business teams to drive cross-functional solutions, ensure operational readiness, and maintain delivery momentum across initiatives. 
 - Lead technical design sessions and architecture discussions. 

Behavioral Competencies

- Ability to produce high quality results, work in a collaborative environment by embracing diverse perspectives and with a solution-based approach. 
 - Adapt communication clearly and concisely based on team dynamics and expresses thoughts & ideas effectively. 
 - Ability to engage effectively with peers and stakeholders to build trust and reliable working relationships. 
 - Ability to understand business processes, implement innovative solutions, guide juniors on continuous improvement by constantly updating oneself on current technology & trends. 
 - Inquisitive to understand customer and business expectations while creating value addition on technical solutions. 

What Will Give You a Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications)

- Strong programming skills in languages such as Python or Node. js. 
 - Strong hands-on experience in observability via tools like DynaTrace, Datadog, etc. 
 - Experience working in an airline technology environment is preferred. 
 - AWS Certified Solutions Architect or Developer certification. 
 - Familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP) for connecting AI models to external tools and data sources. 
 - Ability to quickly develop expertise in new business domains, customer journeys, interconnected enterprise systems, and partner ecosystems to drive rapid delivery of business priorities. 
 - Proven analytical, problem-solving, troubleshooting, and communication skills, with the ability to effectively collaborate across technical and business teams. 
 - Experience operating within large-scale enterprise environments, including cloud transformation and legacy modernization initiatives. 
 - Delivers complex engineering solutions from design through implementation with minimal oversight. 
 - Leverage systems thinking to navigate dependencies, solve complex business and technology challenges, and deliver scalable, secure, and resilient solutions. 

About The Company

What started as a humble, little aerial crop-dusting operation called Huff Daland Dusters in 1924 has now grown into the U. S. global airline leader in safety, innovation, reliability, and customer experience. Headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, Delta Air Lines is known for its operational excellence and award-winning customer service. 

Powered by our employees worldwide, Delta has led the airline industry in operational excellence for a decade while maintaining our reputation for award-winning customer service. With our mission of connecting the people and cultures of the globe, Delta strives to foster understanding across a diverse world and serve as a force for social good. 

In 2026, Delta Air Lines continued to earn global recognition for its performance, culture and operational excellence. Delta was named to Glassdoor's 2026 Top 100 Best Places to Work list for the ninth time, standing as the only airline recognized. Delta also secured the 11th spot on Fortune's World's Most Admired Companies list, marking its 13th consecutive year earning this distinction. Delta was also recognized by Cirium as the top on-time airline in North America for the fifth consecutive year, underscoring its unwavering commitment to reliability and customer experience. 

About The Delta Technology Hub (DTH), Bangalore

The DTH is one of Delta Air Lines' investments in world-class business capabilities and technology aimed at transforming how Delta Air Lines operates and provides world-class travel experiences to its customers through innovation and cutting-edge methodologies. By continuously reimagining processes and driving technology-led transformation, the Delta Technology Hub plays a pivotal role in Scripting The Future Of Aviation. The organization is certified by the Great Place to Work Institute (India). The Delta Technology Hub was a finalist for the iVolunteer Awards 2024/2025 in the "Leader in Employee Volunteering" category. This nomination highlights our remarkable volunteering initiatives and the outstanding practices we implement to encourage and support our employee volunteering program. 

For more information, please visit www. deltatechhub. com

Why join?

- Technology is a key enabler of the differentiated services that Delta provides. At the DTH, you get the opportunity to work on projects with a significant impact on business outcomes and customer experience. 
 - Deepen your knowledge by taking part in multifaceted learning and development programs -exposure to extensive internal and partner repositories, institutional affiliations, and industry SIG (Special Interest Groups) partnerships. 
 - Immerse yourself in an employee-centric culture. 
 - Develop deep and broad business acumen on airline operations while retaining focus on cutting-edge technology driven solutions. 
 - Avail a full range of benefits that support you and your family: Medical Insurance, Transportation to and from the DTH office, Complementary Cafeteria Meals, Special Travel opportunities and Travel Privileges, Car Lease Program, Paid time off, Parental Benefits and National Pension Scheme.

data.description:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts. 

Job Category

Software Engineering

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn't a buzzword - it's a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all. 

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You're in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce. 

About Salesforce

We're Salesforce, the Customer Company, inspiring the future of business with AI+ Data +CRM. Leading with our core values, we help companies across every industry blaze new trails and connect with customers in a whole new way. And, we empower you to be a Trailblazer, too - driving your performance and career growth, charting new paths, and improving the state of the world. If you believe in business as the greatest platform for change and in companies doing well and doing good - you've come to the right place. 

Organization Overview: 

Information Technology blazes the trail of enterprise IT. Built on the foundation of our core values - Trust, Ohana, Innovation - we own more than the traditional IT components with a heavy focus on working closely with our business partners for amazing outcomes. Our goal is to deliver technology that is centered around our business and our collective success. We oversee technology strategy supporting HR and Finance systems in Hire to Retire, Source to Pay, Record to Report and Plan to Perform business areas with applications engineering, infrastructure, collaboration, enterprise operations, architecture, and program enablement. 

Role Description: 

Salesforce seeks a talented, self-directed, technical leader to manage software engineers on the Information Technology Application Engineering and Operations team. In this role, you will be responsible for end-to-end management of tools, systems, and applications that support the Salesforce Finance and HR (Employee Success) systems. You will collaborate with many teams across Information Technology, Finance and Employee Success (HR) to scale and enhance systems for the unparalleled growth of Salesforce. 

Responsibilities

- Hire and retain top engineering talent
 - Lead and mentor a team of software engineers, providing guidance and support to ensure the successful delivery of projects. 
 - Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define project scopes, timelines, and resource requirements. 
 - Drive the implementation and adoption of best practices in software engineering, including Agile methodologies and continuous integration/delivery. 
 - Champion the utilization of MuleSoft and Workday integration solutions for Workday Financials or Workday HCM, leveraging its capabilities to streamline business processes and enhance efficiency. 
 - Oversee end-to-end support, operations and enhancements for Workday Financials or Workday HCM and their integrations, ensuring the delivery of high-quality software products. 
 - Manage stakeholder expectations and communicate project status updates effectively. 
 - Occasional travel is involved

Experience/Skills Required

- 12+ years of experience in software engineering & operations, with a proven track record of leadership and project delivery in Finance and HR Systems such as Workday / Peoplesoft / Oracle EBS in end to end Hire to Retire cycle or Finance business processes. 
 - Strong understanding of engineering management principles, including team leadership, performance management, and talent development. 
 - Experience managing vendor partners and teams extended with contractors
 - A keen eye for Innovation, Engineering / Operational Excellence, and Test Automation
 - Worked on project delivery in Workday Human Capital Management and/or Financial Transformation
 - Experience in HR domain (Hire to Retire, Talent Foundations, Total Rewards, Global Time & Absence, Payroll) OR in Finance (Record to Report, Source to Pay, Plan to Perform)
 - Experience in multiple Integration technologies like MuleSoft and Workday integrations (Studio, Orchestrations, etc. )
 - Experience managing global team working out of multiple time zones
 - Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent preferred
 - Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Experience with agile/scrum methodology

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you'll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we'll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future - but to redefine what's possible - for yourself, for AI, and the world. 

Accommodations

If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form. 

Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates' resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options. 

Posting Statement

Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that's inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. About Clinvvo

Clinvvo is a fast-growing, profitable Swedish health-tech company built by clinicians and technologists, trusted by 200+ hospitals and clinics across Sweden and Germany, and newly backed by a $1. 5M USD seed round from European institutional investors as we expand across Europe and beyond. Joining now means shaping the product, the technical roadmap, and the future of the company as we scale. 

Role

Clinvvo is hiring a senior engineer to help build a production MCP server that connects the Clinvvo platform to AI assistants such as Claude, ChatGPT and GitHub Copilot. You will work alongside our engineering lead and own significant parts of the build. 

About the project

Clinvvo is the modern healthcare OS, live in 300+ hospitals and clinics across Europe, the UK, India and the US. The MCP server exposes Clinvvo's APIs as tools, helps users build integrations from plain-language requests, and keeps patient data and credentials protected throughout. It runs on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore. 

Key responsibilities

- Build and deploy the MCP server and its AWS infrastructure
 - Turn Clinvvo's internal APIs into MCP tools, with guardrails and per-user permissions
 - Implement sign-in through Clinvvo's existing login (OAuth)
 - Build data protection: PII masking, credential scanning, secure logging
 - Build pipelines that keep the tools current as the platform changes
 - Set up automated evaluations and monitoring
 - Write documentation and support handover to the wider Clinvvo engineering team

Must-have skills and experience

- 3-5 years building backend services in production, strong in Python or TypeScript/Node. js

 - OAuth 2. x and OIDC in practice, ideally with Amazon Cognito (authorization code flow, PKCE, token exchange)
 - Code generation from API specs or source (OpenAPI, AST parsing or similar)
 - LLM application experience: tool calling, prompt design, structured outputs, and evaluating model output with test sets
 - Security mindset: least privilege, PII and patient-data handling, secret scanning, audit logging
 - CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI or similar)
 - Ships fast, works independently and communicates clearly across product, engineering and clinical teams

Nice to have

data.title: Lead AI Ops Engineer
data.description:
Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we're helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential. 

Title And Summary

Lead AI Ops Engineer

AI Ops

Overview

Mastercard's Operational Intelligence team is building the next generation of data products and AI solutions that help customers access and use operational insights in new ways. As AI agents move from POC to production, their behavior keeps changing in real time: the context they retrieve, the skills they select, how they resolve exceptions. These agents are never really "finished. " They keep learning from production outcomes, so their reliability, safety, and trustworthiness need to be actively operated, not just monitored. That is the job of AI Ops: making sure each agent's reasoning stays correct, its context stays current, and its behavior stays governed as it learns. 

Role

- Own end to end production monitoring for one or more AI agents, tracking key metrics, KPIs, accuracy, latency, SLA breaches, guardrail triggers, and out of scope rates through dedicated observability dashboards
 - Serve as L1/L2 production support, providing first response monitoring, triage, and escalation to tech teams as new agentic services go live
 - Identify and diagnose issues by monitoring eval scores and drift alerts, inspecting failing traces and patterns, and classifying root causes such as intent, tool, parameter, or hallucination errors
 - Evaluate whether the agent's reasoning remains correct in production, checking whether context retrieval stays current, whether resolutions match ground truth, and whether the learning loop is drifting
 - Monitor and manage post production reliability, including API and authentication failures and issues originating from external AI endpoints, to protect revenue generating, client facing agents
 - Partner with AI Engineering to prioritize fixes, run experiments on prompts, context, and routing in Dev, and validate improvements via evals before handing off proven changes for deployment
 - Embed governance within the agent's learning loop so that approval workflows and audit logging travel with every production change, rather than being added after the fact

All About You

- Experience monitoring or operating production AI/ML or agentic systems, including observability, evaluation, and drift detection practices
 - Strong analytical skills to diagnose root causes across intent classification, tool selection, parameter errors, and hallucination patterns
 - Understanding of AI/LLM observability concepts such as tracing, telemetry, guardrails, and evaluation engineering including benchmarks, automated evals, human review, and regression testing
 - Familiarity with governance, compliance, and responsible AI practices such as PII detection, access control, audit logging, and policy enforcement is a plus
 - Ability to work independently alongside existing Tech teams while owning a dedicated agent's post launch health
 - Excellent communication skills to translate production signals into clear, prioritized asks for AI Product and AI Engineering teams
 - Comfort working in a fast evolving environment where the process itself, not just the throughput, is what is being continuously operated on and improved

Corporate Security Responsibility

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must: 

- Abide by Mastercard's security policies and practices; 
 - Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed; 
 - Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
 - Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard's guidelines.

data.title: Architect - GPU Performance
data.description:
NVIDIA has continuously reinvented itself over two decades. Our invention of the GPU in 1999 sparked the growth of the PC gaming market, redefined modern computer graphics, and revolutionized parallel computing. More recently, GPU deep learning ignited modern AI - the next era of computing. NVIDIA is a "learning machine" that constantly evolves by adapting to new opportunities which are hard to seek, which only we can pursue, and which matter to the world. This is our life's work: to amplify human inventiveness and intelligence. 

NVIDIA is now driving innovation at the intersection of visual processing, high performance computing and artificial intelligence. We are looking for passionate, highly motivated, creative engineers to be part of our HW architecture team. As part of this team, you would be working on projects that will help make our next generation visual computing, automotive, GPU, HPC systems better. You will get to work on high performance CPU and Memory sub-systems, Next-Gen GPUs , NOC based Interconnect Fabric etc. Make the choice to join us today. 

What You'll Be Doing

- System level performance analysis/ bottleneck analysis of complex, high performance GPUs and System-on-Chips (SoCs). 
 - Work on hardware models of different levels of abstraction, including performance models, RTL test benches , emulators and silicon to analyze performance and find performance bottlenecks in the system. 
 - Understand key performance use-cases of the product. Develop workloads and test suits targeting graphics, machine learning, automotive, video, compute vision applications running on these products. 
 - Work closely with the architecture and design teams to explore architecture trade-offs related to system performance, area, and power consumption. 
 - Develop required infrastructure including performance models, testbench components, performance analysis and visualization tools.

What We Need To See

- BE/BTech, or MS/MTech in relevant area, PhD is a plus, or equivalent experience. 
 - 3+ years of experience with exposure to performance analysis and complex system on chip and/or GPU architectures. 
 - Strong understanding of System-on-Chip (SoC) architecture, graphics pipeline, memory subsystem architecture and Network-on-Chip (NoC)/Interconnect architecture. 
 - Expert hands on competence in programming (C/C++) and scripting (Perl/Python). Exposure to Verilog/System Verilog, SystemC/TLM is a strong plus. 
 - Strong debugging and analysis (including data and statistical analysis) skills, including use for RTL dumps to debug failures. 
 - Hands on experience developing performance simulators, cycle accurate/approximate models for pre-silicon performance analysis is a strong plus.

data.title: Senior Software Engineer - Syncade Developer
data.description:
At Bristol Myers Squibb, our employees often ask, "Who are you working for?"-a question that fuels collaboration, accountability, and urgency in our work. Our purpose-driven culture inspires us to discover, develop, and deliver innovative medicines to prevail over serious diseases. We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it. 

Position: Sr. Software Engineer - AI Engineer

At Bristol Myers Squibb, we are inspired by a single vision - transforming patients' lives through science. Each of our colleagues contribute to innovations that drive meaningful change. 

Scope

The EMES Core Platform, Its Components, Interfaces, Data Layer And Tools - Material And Inventory, Order Management, Equipment And Instrument Integration, Sample Management, Patient Scheduling System Integration, Label Printing, Recipe Authoring And Execution, Electronic Batch Records, And Batch Reporting And Analytics - Together With

- AI and GenAI services embedded in manufacturing workflows: assistants, retrieval over controlled documents, anomaly detection and decision support. 
 - Web applications and operator-facing interfaces across shop-floor, quality and supply-chain personas. 
 - Enterprise data models, databases, audit-trail architecture and reporting data flows; cloud migration and adoption of next-generation manufacturing systems. 

Key Responsibilities

AI Engineering

- Design, build and operate production-grade AI services - not prototypes - including retrieval-augmented generation over SOPs, batch records, deviations and equipment documentation, and agentic workflows that act against MES systems under human oversight. 
 - Own the retrieval architecture (chunking, embedding selection, vector storage such as pgvector or OpenSearch, hybrid search, re-ranking, citation fidelity) and LLM application patterns: structured output and tool calling, MCP servers over enterprise systems, orchestration, cost controls and guardrails. 
 - Establish AI evaluation and observability: golden datasets, offline and online evals, regression gates in CI, hallucination and drift detection, tracing and human-in-the-loop review. 
 - Apply classical ML where it is the better tool (anomaly detection, forecasting, predictive quality) and ensure responsible, compliant AI: data classification, IP and PII protection, model and prompt versioning, reproducibility and validation evidence for GxP-relevant use. 

Web Application Development

- Deliver full-stack applications: React with TypeScript front ends, component libraries and design systems, and responsive, accessible (WCAG) interfaces built for gloved, time-pressured shop-floor use as well as office users. 
 - Build backend services in Python (FastAPI) and/or Java (Spring Boot) exposing REST and GraphQL APIs with OpenAPI-first contracts, secured with OAuth 2. 0/OIDC, JWT, SSO and fine-grained RBAC, and write the data access layer with the same rigour as the API (deliberate query design, sound ORM boundaries, pagination, no N+1 access, idempotent writes). 
 - Implement real-time and AI-assisted experiences - WebSockets/SSE for live batch and equipment status, token streaming with inline citations - alongside validation-rich workflows including e-signature interaction patterns. 
 - Own quality and performance end to end: automated tests across the stack (pytest, Jest/Vitest, Playwright), load testing, and CI/CD (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, ArgoCD) with GitOps delivery of application and database changes together against measured p95 targets. 

System and Data Architecture

- Lead the design of distributed, multi-tenant systems: bounded contexts and Domain-Driven Design, service decomposition, API and event contracts, and evolution strategy. Own the data model end to end - conceptual, logical and physical design, deliberate normalization, and referential integrity, constraints and domain invariants enforced in the database rather than only in application code. 
 - Demonstrate advanced relational expertise: complex SQL, window functions, CTEs, stored procedures (PL/pgSQL, PL/SQL), partitioning, deliberate indexing strategy, and performance diagnosis from execution plans, statistics, lock contention and pool exhaustion. 
 - Apply correct transaction design (isolation levels, concurrency control, idempotency, retry semantics) and migration discipline (Flyway/Liquibase/Alembic, expand-contract zero-downtime rollout, tested rollback), and run databases as production assets on AWS: RDS/Aurora PostgreSQL, Multi-AZ, read replicas, pooling, PITR and DR. 
 - Design regulated-grade data integrity - immutable, append-only audit trails (including hash-chained designs), e-signature records, ALCOA+, retention and archival - satisfying GxP, 21 CFR Part 11 and GAMP 5 (2nd edition, incl. AI/ML guidance) by design, not documentation alone. 
 - Design event-driven systems with Kafka (partitioning and ordering guarantees, transactional outbox, CQRS and event sourcing, sagas) and enable analytics without burdening the transactional system through change data capture (Debezium) and dimensional models for batch reporting. 
 - Reason rigorously about non-functional requirements - capacity, scalability, SLOs, failure modes, circuit breakers, backpressure, graceful degradation when a site link is down - and define caching, queuing and throttling strategy (Redis, SQS/SNS, idempotency keys). 
 - Architect for hybrid deployment (on-premise and near-line where shop-floor latency demands it, AWS for scale) using Docker, Kubernetes (EKS/ECS) and IaC; instrument for observability (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry); and apply security by design, mitigating the OWASP Top 10 and OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications. 

Collaboration and Leadership

- Partner with Manufacturing, MS&T, Quality, Automation and site IT to translate process needs into system and data design; produce and defend the artifacts of real architecture work (ADRs, design documents, data models, sequence and data-flow diagrams, threat models) and run design reviews; and communicate integration contracts to technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Mentor engineers, review code and designs, and raise the bar on clean code, TDD/BDD and craftsmanship - including governed AI-assisted development that improves throughput without weakening review rigour or compliance - while driving continuous improvement through Agile/Scrum across global teams. 

Required Qualifications & Skills

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field, with 10-12 years of software engineering experience, including 5+ years building and operating web applications and 2+ years delivering AI/ML or GenAI capabilities into production (prototypes alone will not qualify). 
 - Expert-level SQL and relational data modeling with deep hands-on PostgreSQL (or Oracle/SQL Server): schema design, indexing, query tuning, transactions and migrations. 
 - Demonstrable system design capability at the level of a multi-service, multi-tenant platform - bounded contexts, API and event contracts, consistency and failure modes, capacity and scaling - with Docker, Kubernetes (EKS/ECS), cloud-native architecture on AWS, infrastructure as code and Kafka-based event streaming. 
 - Strong hands-on Python 3. x with FastAPI and TypeScript with React; Java/Spring Boot experience is a strong advantage. 
 - Practical experience with the LLM application stack: model APIs, embeddings and vector search, RAG, tool calling, prompt and context engineering, and evaluation. Agent frameworks (LangChain/LangGraph) and MCP server development are an advantage. 
 - Working knowledge of MES/EMES platforms, pharmaceutical manufacturing and regulatory compliance - ISA-88 and ISA-95, electronic batch records, recipe execution - or demonstrated ability to ramp quickly in a regulated domain. 
 - Solid grounding in application and data security (OAuth 2. 0/OIDC, JWT, SSO, RBAC, TLS, secrets management), automated testing, CI/CD and observability tooling. 
 - Clear written communication (design documents, ADRs, API documentation) and strong collaboration across global teams. 

We hire for skills and capabilities, not just credentials - if this role excites you, but doesn't perfectly match your resume, we encourage you to apply anyway. 

How We Work

Where you work matters - because collaboration, innovation and patient impact happen in many settings. Our roles are structured across four work models: site-essential, site-by-design, field-based and remote-by-design. The model assigned to this role is based on its core responsibilities. Learn more at https: //careers. bms. com/ways-of-working. 

Supporting People With Disabilities

BMS is dedicated to ensuring that people with disabilities can excel through a transparent recruitment process, reasonable workplace accommodations/adjustments and ongoing support in their roles. Applicants can request a reasonable workplace accommodation/adjustment prior to accepting a job offer. If you require reasonable accommodations/adjustments in completing this application, or in any part of the recruitment process, direct your inquiries to adastaffingsupport@bms. com. Visit careers. bms. com/eeo-accessibility to access our complete Equal Employment Opportunity statement. 

Candidate Rights

For roles based in Los Angeles County only: If you live in or expect to work from Los Angeles County if hired for this position, please visit this page for important additional information: https: //careers. bms. com/california-residents/

For roles based in Washington state only: If you live in or expect to work from Washington State if hired for this position, please visit this page for important information about the Washington Fair Chance Act. 

Data Protection

We will never request payments, financial information, or social security numbers during our application or recruitment process. Learn more about protecting yourself at https: //careers. bms. com/fraud-protection.

Title And Summary

Principal Data Engineer - Data Quality

Overview

We are seeking a visionary and technically strong engineering leader to drive the evolution of our Enterprise Data Quality capabilities and platforms. The Principal Data Engineer, Data Quality will lead the design, development, and adoption of scalable data quality frameworks, services, and engineering practices that improve trust, reliability, observability, and governance of data across the organization. 

This role requires a strategic thinker with deep expertise in data engineering, data quality, metadata management, and platform architecture, capable of influencing enterprise-wide technology decisions and partnering closely with engineering, governance, analytics, AI, and business teams to deliver innovative and scalable solutions. The successful candidate will lead the development of reusable capabilities that enable consistent, automated, and measurable data quality controls across diverse data ecosystems, including batch, streaming, cloud, on-premises, and SaaS environments. 

The ideal candidate combines strong technical depth with business acumen, executive presence, and organizational leadership. They will be responsible for balancing immediate business needs with long-term platform strategy, promoting Data Quality as a Product and Data Quality as Code mindset, while leveraging automation, observability, and emerging AI technologies to improve data trust, operational efficiency, and enterprise-wide adoption. 

Role

- Define and drive the enterprise Data Quality strategy, roadmap, architecture, standards, and best practices. 
 - Lead the design, development, and evolution of scalable data quality platforms, frameworks, and shared services supporting batch, streaming, cloud, on-premises, and SaaS environments. 
 - Architect and govern metadata-driven, reusable, and configurable data quality capabilities, including rule management, observability, profiling, anomaly detection, and remediation workflows.

 - Design and implement Data Quality observability solutions, including trust scores, quality metrics, SLAs, dashboards, alerts, and executive reporting. 
 - Partner with Data Governance, Data Management, Security, Compliance, and business stakeholders to operationalize quality controls and stewardship processes. 
 - Drive adoption of data quality practices across the data product lifecycle, promoting shift-left quality engineering and Data Quality as Code principles. 
 - Ensure quality frameworks are integrated with metadata management, lineage, catalog, governance, MDM, and data contract capabilities. 
 - Provide technical leadership, architecture guidance, and mentoring to engineering teams across multiple programs and domains. 
 - Lead evaluation, selection, and implementation of data quality tools, platforms, and emerging technologies. 
 - Collaborate with Analytics, Data Science, and AI teams to ensure trusted, high-quality, AI-ready datasets and data products. 
 - Identify opportunities to leverage AI, machine learning, and automation to improve data quality monitoring, root cause analysis, remediation, and engineering productivity. 
 - Establish engineering standards, operational controls, and CI/CD practices to improve platform reliability, scalability, security, and maintainability. 
 - Define and measure key performance indicators to track quality improvements, platform adoption, operational efficiency, and business outcomes. 
 - Influence enterprise-wide technology strategy and champion a culture of data quality, ownership, accountability, and continuous improvement. 

All About You

 - 10+ years of experience in Data Engineering, Data Platforms, or Data Architecture.

 - Excellent stakeholder management and executive communication skills. 

________________________________________

- Experience leveraging AI, Machine Learning, or Generative AI technologies to enhance data quality, observability, engineering productivity, and operational efficiency.

Job Information

Job Code: 00194001

Job Family: Research and Development

Job Function: Software Engineering

About The Job

We are seeking a Performance Architect - QA to join our R&D team as a senior individual contributor. The ideal candidate is a hands-on performance engineering expert with a deep architectural pedigree in core products, platforms, or large-scale enterprise software. You will shape our overarching performance strategy and partner closely with Product Engineering, Architecture, SRE, DevOps, and R&D teams to deliver highly scalable, resilient, and low-latency products. 

In this role, you will own the performance engineering domain from an architectural perspective-driving strategies that build performance into the core system design. While performance remains your primary focus, you will also bring critical insights into end-to-end, system-level Quality Assurance. By bridging the gap between functional automation and non-functional engineering, you will ensure a holistic approach to system reliability, helping elevate our entire QA framework. This role involves technical ownership and cross-functional influence, with no people-management responsibilities. 

About You

- Experience: 15+ years in QA, software/performance engineering, and automation, with 10+ years of hands-on SaaS experience. Mandatory background in a Core Product or R&D organization. 
 - Architecture & Systems: Expertise in distributed systems, microservices, cloud-native patterns, multi-tenant platforms, and load balancing (e. g. , Istio service mesh). 
 - Performance & Reliability: Experience establishing data-driven SLOs/SLIs and error budgets. Proven ability to lead chaos engineering initiatives (fault injection, failovers) and capacity planning using real-time SRE/APM telemetry. 
 - Testing & Tooling: Expert in performance testing frameworks (K6, JMeter, Gatling, or custom simulators) and stateful/protocol-level fuzzing (HTTP/2, gRPC, WebSocket). Advanced proficiency in functional automation (Playwright, Cypress, Selenium). 
 - Cloud & Infrastructure: Hands-on with Docker, Terraform, and Kubernetes (AKS preferred) for autoscaling and high availability. 
 - Development & CI/CD: Strong programming skills in Java, Python, C#, or Go. Seamless integration of continuous verification into CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Observability: Mastery of APM tools, distributed tracing, database tuning, Prometheus, and Grafana. 
 - Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field. 

Why Join & Who Should Apply

This is a high-impact role focused heavily on technical depth, engineering judgment, and cross-functional mentorship. You are a strong fit if you: 

- Have scaled complex, distributed products in an R&D environment and deeply understand the entire product lifecycle. 
 - Can authoritatively influence architectural decisions using data-driven performance insights. 
 - Possess a big-picture vision for end-to-end QA, optimizing both functional boundaries and non-functional baselines. 
 - Can perfectly balance hands-on coding, debugging, and production analysis with strategic architecture ownership. 

Education

Bachelor degree or equivalent experience

Advance Degree preferred

Preferred Certifications

Footer

data.title: Software Development Manager, Sports Data Platform - Prime Video Sports
data.description:
Description

Ever wondered how millions of sports fans worldwide get the right notification at the perfect moment during a live game, or how a match result instantly updates across every screen? Come build the systems that make it happen. 

We're Looking For a Software Development Manager To Lead a Team In Bangalore, India, That Sits At The Intersection Of Real Time Sports Data And Customer Experience For One Of The World's Largest Streaming Platforms. You'll Own And Drive The Technical Vision For Three Critical Areas

You'll lead the team building intelligent, real time notification systems that reach fans during the moments that matter most, think close game alerts, score updates, and live activity feeds across devices. Your systems will process live sports signals and make split second decisions about what to send, when, and to whom, at global scale. 

What You'll Do

You will hire and grow a high performing engineering team, define the technical roadmap, and deliver systems that directly shape how customers experience live sports. You'll work closely with product, design, and partner teams across multiple time zones to solve ambiguous, high impact problems. Your decisions will be visible at the highest levels of the organization and felt by millions of customers on game day. 

Why This Role

This is a rare opportunity to build from the ground up in a fast growing, high visibility space. Sports on streaming is still early innings, and the problems here are genuinely hard: real time data at scale, intelligent automation, and matching across thousands of global sports entities. You'll have the autonomy to define and drive innovative features. 

If you love building systems that delight customers in real time and want to be a part of shaping the future of live sports experiences, we'd love to talk. 

Key job responsibilities

A Manager III (SDM III) is a hybrid of system designer, people manager, roadmap/customer satisfaction driver, and project manager. They own the full technology lifecycle of their systems, including development, operations, and deprecation, and are responsible for both the technology vision and business vision of their team. 

- Ambiguity: Leads a team where the business problem or strategy may not yet be defined, with limited guidance
 - Team Management: Manages a two pizza team of SDEs, potentially across locations
 - Technical Leadership: Drives the team to invent, evolve, and deprecate data solutions; scopes projects and evaluates releases against business needs
 - Delivery: Establishes structures for delivering large systems; drives schedules, reprioritizes, and mitigates risks proactively
 - Engineering Excellence: Demonstrates technical breadth and depth; solves problems at root cause; builds flexible systems without over engineering
 - People Development: Hires the right mix of SDEs, manages performance, develops and promotes engineers
 - Communication: Writes narratives and strategic docs, fosters constructive dialogue, escalates risks proactively

Basic Qualifications

- 7+ years of engineering experience
 - 3+ years of engineering team management experience
 - 8+ years of leading the definition and development of multi tier web services experience
 - Knowledge of engineering practices and patterns for the full software/hardware/networks development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, certification, and livesite operations
 - Experience partnering with product or program management teams
 - Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience in communicating with users, other technical teams, and senior leadership to collect requirements, describe software product features, technical designs, and product strategy
 - Experience in recruiting, hiring, mentoring/coaching and managing teams of Software Engineers to improve their skills, and make them more effective, product software engineers
