Turvo provides a collaborative Transportation Management System (TMS) application designed specifically for the supply chain. Turvo Collaboration Cloud connects freight brokers, 3PLs, shippers, and carriers to unite supply chain ecosystems, delivering outstanding customer experiences, real-time collaboration, and accelerated growth. The technology unifies internal and external systems, providing one end-to-end solution that streamlines operations, enhances analytics, and automates business processes while eliminating redundant manual tasks. data.title: Copy of Lead, QA
data.description:
Ayr designs and manufactures critical power grid equipment including power transformers, distribution transformers, special-purpose transformers, high-voltage circuit breakers, and medium-voltage switchgear. They serve markets such as renewables, data centers, utilities, oil & gas, and industrial sectors. They position themselves as partners in power projects, offering lifecycle support and working to deliver faster than average industry timelines. 

Website: https: //ayr. energy

Role Purpose

Own in-process quality for medium and power transformers (33-400 kV), ensuring products meet applicable standards, customer specifications, and Ayr Energy's Quality Management System (QMS). Lead stage-wise quality controls across core, coil, tanking, assembly, oil processing, and final tests to achieve first-time-right builds, reduce rework, and elevate

customer satisfaction. 

Key Responsibilities

- Quality System & Documentation
 - Create and maintain Control Plans, Inspection & Test Plans (ITP), stage checklists, work instructions, and traveler/route cards; enforce hold/witness points. 
 - Own NCR/CAPA-facilitate structured root cause analysis (5-Why, Fishbone), implement fixes, and verify effectiveness; drive defect prevention. 
 - Maintain device history records, test certificates, as-built dossiers, and customer documentation packs for shipment and FAT. 
 - Supplier & Customer Interface
 - Qualify and develop suppliers for critical items (CRGO, copper, bushings, OLTC, radiators, tanks); conduct audits and PPAP/FAI where applicable. 
 - Lead customer stage and final inspections (FAT), coordinate third-party inspections/test labs, and close observations promptly. 
 - Data, Metrics & Continuous Improvement
 - Track FPY, rework/repair hours, supplier PPM, test bay failures, and COPQ; publish weekly/monthly dashboards. 
 - Apply 7 QC tools, MSA (GR&R), process capability (Cp/Cpk/Pp/Ppk), and SPC to stabilize and improve processes. 
 - Run kaizens to reduce defects (e. g. , oil leaks, winding shorts, paint defects) and cycle time at critical stages. 

Compliance & Standards

- ISO 9001: 2015 QMS; ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 (EHS) - adhere to procedures and participate in audits. 

Qualifications & Experience

- Education: BE/B. Tech or Diploma in Electrical/Mechanical Engineering (Electrical preferred). 
 - Experience: 8-15 years in transformer manufacturing quality; at least 5 years hands-on in-process/stage inspection and test bay exposure for 66 kV+ class. 
 - Certifications (preferred): Six Sigma Green Belt/Black Belt, ASQ CQA/CQE, NDT Level II (VT/PT), Lead Auditor (ISO 9001). 

Skills & Competencies

- Strong knowledge of transformer construction, drawings (GA, core/coil, schematic), tolerances, and insulation systems. 
 - Proficiency with electrical tests (TTR, WR, IR/PI, tan δ/PF, SFRA, AC withstand) and interpretation of results. 
 - Hands-on with metrology and torque tools; ability to set up gauges/fixtures and verify special processes. 
 - QMS documentation, RCA/CAPA, statistical analysis (MSA, Cp/Cpk), and SPC; working knowledge of ERP/MES and Minitab/Excel. 
 - Clear written/verbal communication; ability to coach operators, manage audits, and interface with customers and TPI bodies. 

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

- First-pass yield at critical stages and final test
 - Supplier PPM and on-time NCR closure
 - Defect/rework reduction (%), COPQ trend
 - Calibration compliance and audit scores
 - On-time documentation pack readiness and shipment clearance

Why Join Ayr Energy

Be part of a fast-growing grid hardware company building mission-critical products. You will shape world-class manufacturing systems, work with global suppliers and utilities, and grow into leadership roles with clear impact on reliability and safety of power networks. 

Work Conditions

- Primarily shop-floor based role with regular presence in test bay and oil processing areas. 
 - Shift and weekend support during critical builds or customer inspections as needed. 
 - Travel up to 60% for supplier audits, customer FATs, or type test witnessing.

data.title: Senior Platform Software Engineer
data.description:
Job Description

Owns application development lifecycle, suggesting improvements and following best practices. Develops features, enhancements, and fixes based on design specs, documenting design and code. Leads code reviews, debugging, and troubleshooting for complex issues. Designs software aligned with architecture, collaborating on customer solutions. Provides technical guidance and support, driving code quality and security standards. Performs maintenance, testing, and upgrades for application systems. 

Responsibilities

Responsibilities: 

- Drives medium features and quality improvements with measurable performance and reliability outcomes. 
 - Provides global production support for critical issues with minimal guidance; improves playbooks/alerts. 
 - Troubleshoots and debugs non-routine issues spanning application layers and common OCI services; proposes fixes. 
 - Define test strategy (unit/integration) for features; ensures consistency across modules. 
 - Considers trade-offs in existing architecture; proposes moderate design improvements. 
 - Translates ambiguous requirements into scalable designs and implementation plans. 
 - Defines and stabilizes API contracts and dependencies for the application area. 
 - Recommends build priorities within the team using data from incidents, telemetry, and customer feedback. 
 - Systematically incorporates external feedback (forums, live-site reports) into backlog refinement. 
 - Mentors junior engineers; coordinates cross-functionally on feature delivery. 

Software Development and Coding - Design, Testing, and Optimization: 

- Designs software solutions and analyzes and helps identify requirements to achieve business and operational goals, independently. 
 - Adheres to and suggests improvements to all phases of the software development lifecycle. 
 - Utilizes working knowledge to develop new software features and enhancements following design specifications and develops documents to clarify software design and code. 
 - Leads code reviews in designated areas to help drive improvements. 
 - Conducts debugging and troubleshooting to identify and fix moderately complex software issues. 
 - Develops fixes for identified issues. 
 - Implements software testing (e. g. , functional and non-functional testing), quality assurance processes, software error logging, monitoring, and observability for effective debugging, ensuring review by manager and/or lead throughout the process. 
 - Exercises judgment and discretion to conduct performance profiling and optimization of coding. 
 - Troubleshoots and resolves moderately complex issues related to application programming interface (API) functionality and integration. 
 - Implements moderately complex API versioning, lifecycle, and interoperability strategies. 

Software Architecture - Software System Structural Design: 

- Designs and develops software, systems, and services aligned to pre-defined system architecture. 
 - Develops working knowledge of software architecture decisions and best practices. 
 - Collaborates with team leads to review work to ensure alignment with software architecture. 
 - Implements moderately complex performance optimization and scalability strategies in software design. 

Issue/Defect Collaboration - Software Products Support: 

- Collaborates within and beyond immediate team to understand customer issues and align solutions. 
 - May provide technical guidance and support to customers regarding customer-reported issues, independently. 
 - Coaches, mentors, and guides others to advocate for customers' interests and suggests product enhancements based on feedback. 
 - Influences team to ensure customer satisfaction through timely resolution of issues and effective communication. 
 - Implements customer issue and/or defect handling and training processes, independently. 
 - Investigates and troubleshoots complex product maintenance issues to ensure customer agreement on short- and long-term solutions (e. g. , future enhancements). 

Practices and Standards Compliance - Security and Compliance: 

- Collaborates with the team to establish and follow development practices and coding standards. 
 - Exercises judgment and discretion to ensure code quality and adherence to broad acceptance criteria during development. 
 - Keeps up-to-date with industry best practices and applies them to software development processes. 
 - Implements secure coding practices to prevent security vulnerabilities. 

Development Operations - System Maintenance: 

- Performs periodic maintenance and testing operations for systems that require upgrading or patching (e. g. , for critical vulnerabilities). 
 - Exercises judgment and discretion to drive improvements, ensure automation, testing, and debugging of systems to ensure service/product availability, health, support, and reliability. 

Core Responsibilities

Planning & Execution: 

- Independently manages work, monitoring timelines and deliverables to ensure projects or initiatives stay on track and meet requirements. 
 - Proactively prioritizes work and adapts to resource or timeline shifts, suggesting adjustments to maintain project efficiency. 

Collaboration & Partnership: 

- Collaborates across teams to align on expectations and achieve shared objectives. 
 - Builds and maintains a comprehensive understanding of business, stakeholder, and/or customer needs to build and support effective partnerships. 
 - Actively listens to diverse perspectives and asks questions to ensure understanding of others. 

Problem Solving: 

- Independently identifies and addresses standard and non-standard issues in accordance with standard practices, escalating more complex issues as appropriate. 
 - Analyzes data and/or information from multiple sources to troubleshoot standard and non-standard errors. 
 - Contributes to knowledge sharing and best practices. 

Continuous Learning: 

- Embraces continuous learning by actively seeking to build knowledge and new skills and/or tools and staying current with industry trends and best practices. 
 - Seeks out and leverages feedback and training to improve skills. 
 - Contributes to a culture of continuous learning and knowledge sharing with team members. 

Continuous Improvement: 

- Develops ideas and recommends updates to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows within a team. 
 - Seeks input from team members on alternative approaches and methods for improving work.

data.title: Senior Software Engineer, SaaS Control Plane IRC303076
data.description:
Description

GlobalLogic, a Hitachi Group Company, is a trusted digital engineering partner to the world's largest and most

forward-thinking companies. We promise a people-first culture of caring, flexibility, and personal and professional growth. 

GlobalLogic, a Hitachi Group Company and trusted digital engineering partner, promises a people-first culture of caring, 

flexibility, and growth. GlobalLogic invites passionate problem solvers to join us in engineering impact through intelligent

products, platforms, and services. 

GlobalLogic is the digital engineering company that promises a people-first culture of professional and personal growth. We seek

passionate problem solvers who are energized by meaningful challenges. Using the power of design and complex software

engineering, we create a better future for people and the planet. 

Our customer is a global pioneer in media technology, delivering industry-leading video and audio editing solutions to premier entertainment brands and major hollywood studios. Recognized with accolades ranging from Oscars and Grammys to NAB's Product of the Year, they continue to set the standard for digital media innovation. 

For over 15 years, the strategic partnership with GlobalLogic has been instrumental for our customer in driving product development across their core platforms in audiovideo editing and media workflow management. Our customer is expanding its collaboration with GlobalLogic to engineer next-generation, cloud-based, and AI-augmented media lifecycle management solutions. This effort is supported by a growing team of specialized engineering talent in India dedicated to accelerating Client's cloud and AI roadmap. 

Requirements

We are looking for a talented CloudPython Developer to be a member of the Media Products development team, which creates and maintains several products in our Media product portfolio on audiovideo editing, media workflow management areas. 

You should have

8+ years building backend services for cloud-based SaaS products. 

Solid AWS fundamentals: IAM, ECS/EKS, RDS/Aurora, SQS/SNS, Secrets Manager, and CloudWatch. 

Experience with multi-tenant systems and the patterns that keep tenants isolated and operations manageable. 

Comfort working in Python or Go (or both) and writing well-tested service code. 

Familiarity with async/event-driven patterns and why they matter in a distributed control plane. 

A habits of writing things down - ADRs, runbooks, API contracts. 

ice to have: Kubernetes operator patterns, ArgoCD or similar GitOps tooling, Temporal or Step Functions for workflow orchestration, or experience onboarding enterprise customers with SSO and SCIM. 

Job responsibilities

Software Engineer, SaaS Control Plane

We're building the control plane that manages every tenant, user, and resource across our SaaS platform. You'll work on the core services that handle customer onboarding, principal lifecycle, entitlements, and the operational workflows that keep the platform running reliably at scale. 

What you'll do

- Build and maintain control plane services: tenant provisioning, principal management (users, service accounts, API keys), and entitlement/subscription enforcement. 

- Own the onboarding flow end to end - from account creation and identity setup through resource provisioning and first-use readiness. 

- Design APIs and async workflows that coordinate across services reliably, handling failure and retries gracefully. 

- Instrument services for observability: structured logging, metrics, and distributed tracing so on-call is tractable. 

- Partner with the auth, database, and platform teams to deliver features that are consistent and secure across the full stack. 

- Contribute to operational health: runbooks, alerts, and iterative improvements to reduce toil. 

What we offer

Exciting Projects: We focus on industries like High-Tech, communication, media, healthcare, retail and telecom. Our customer list is full of fantastic global brands and leaders who love what we build for them. 

Collaborative Environment: You Can expand your skills by collaborating with a diverse team of highly talented people in an open, laidback environment - or even abroad in one of our global centers or client facilities!

Work-Life Balance: GlobalLogic prioritizes work-life balance, which is why we offer flexible work schedules, opportunities to work from home, and paid time off and holidays. 

Professional Development: Our dedicated Learning & Development team regularly organizes Communication skills training(GL Vantage, Toast Master), Stress Management program, professional certifications, and technical and soft skill trainings. 

Excellent Benefits: We provide our employees with competitive salaries, family medical insurance, Group Term Life Insurance, Group Personal Accident Insurance , NPS(National Pension Scheme ), Periodic health awareness program, extended maternity leave, annual performance bonuses, and referral bonuses. 

Fun Perks: We want you to love where you work, which is why we host sports events, cultural activities, offer food on subsidies rates, Corporate parties. data.description:
Business Unit:

When you join Cubic, you become part of a company that creates and delivers technology solutions in transportation to make people's lives easier by simplifying their daily journeys, and defense capabilities to help promote mission success and safety for those who serve their nation. Job Details: 

Principal Technical Operations Engineer

Position Summary

The Principal Technical Operations Engineer is a hands-on senior technical leader responsible for the stability, reliability, performance, and supportability of Cubic's production systems. The role involves leading the diagnosis and resolution of the most complex software defects, customer-reported issues, configuration problems, data anomalies related challenges across live, interconnected environments. 

As a technical authority across assigned programs, this engineer influences architecture, design, configuration, production readiness, and lifecycle decisions. The role converts production insights into sustainable engineering improvements, drives the elimination of recurring failure patterns, strengthens observability and automation, and guides cross-functional teams in maintaining operational excellence across mission-critical transportation systems. 

Key Responsibilities

Production Support & Issue Resolution

- Understand the enterprise architecture end to end and own troubleshooting across multiple interconnected and complex software systems. 
 - Lead the investigation and resolution of high-impact software defects, configuration issues, integration failures, data anomalies for complex issues. 
 - Provide technical direction during the most complex cross-system production incidents, coordinating diagnosis across application, integration, database, messaging, and external interface layers. 
 - Perform deep-dive root cause and pattern analysis, converting findings into permanent corrective actions, preventive controls, and prioritized engineering improvements. 
 - Maintain system stability through proactive monitoring, configuration management, capacity awareness, and early identification of operational risks. 
 - Define reusable diagnostic approaches and troubleshooting standards that improve resolution quality, reduce mean time to restore, and strengthen support-team effectiveness. 

Technical Leadership

- Own the technical baseline for system architecture, design, configuration, and operational supportability across the full system lifecycle. 
 - Demonstrate strong cross-functional collaboration and advanced expertise in diagnosing, troubleshooting, and resolving complex technical issues. 
 - Demonstrated experience working in a Technical Business Analyst function, with exposure to analyzing end-to-end business processes and their underlying applications, system components, integrations, and data flows to identify gaps, dependencies, risks, and opportunities for operational and technical improvement. 
 - Drive root cause and pattern analysis for recurring production issues, translating findings into scalable engineering improvements and preventive actions. 
 - Champion automation and observability improvements that reduce manual intervention, strengthen reliability, and improve operational efficiency. 
 - Mentor Senior Engineers and support teams, establishing engineering standards, reusable practices, and consistent approaches to complex troubleshooting and technical decision-making. 
 - Bridge Production Operations, Systems Engineering, Development, and business or program teams by translating operational challenges into clear engineering priorities and scalable technical solutions. 

Operational Excellence

- Own the technical relationship with program teams and ensure systems meet agreed performance, availability, reliability, and supportability targets in accordance with service-level commitments. 
 - Drive cross-program operational maturity through standardization, automation, observability, reliability engineering, and measurable continuous-improvement initiatives. 
 - Develop, review, and maintain high-quality operational documentation, including runbooks, configuration guides, architectural support views, known-error records, and incident-response procedures. 
 - Lead post-incident reviews and ensure corrective actions address both immediate causes and broader systemic risks. 
 - Use incident trends, recurring failure patterns, service metrics, and operational data to prioritize engineering investments and reduce technical and operational risk. 
 - Influence production-readiness criteria and operational acceptance for new solutions, releases, architectural changes, and major configuration updates. 
 - Interface with customers, partners, and vendors to resolve escalated issues, communicate technical risk, and align on sustainable solutions. 
 - Promote knowledge reuse and operational readiness by strengthening technical documentation, knowledge transfer, and support-team capability. 

Required Qualifications: 

- Bachelor's degree in engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent relevant experience. 
 - 10+ years of experience in systems engineering, production engineering, site reliability, or technical operations, with demonstrated ownership of complex, business-critical production environments. 
 - Demonstrated experience working in a Technical Business Analyst function, with exposure to analyzing end-to-end business processes and their underlying applications, system components, integrations, and data flows to identify gaps, dependencies, risks, and opportunities for operational and technical improvement. 
 - Advanced expertise in diagnosing and resolving complex software, infrastructure, integration, configuration, messaging, data, and performance issues in live environments. 
 - Hands-on experience with incidents, problem, change, and release management processes in a 24x7 production environment. 
 - Experience with enterprise monitoring, observability, log analysis, alerting, performance tuning, and service-health analysis. 
 - Working knowledge of configuration management practices and distributed messaging technologies such as Kafka. 
 - Strong hands-on capability with SQL for production diagnostics, data validation, and issue analysis. 
 - Ability to navigate ambiguity, assess technical risk, establish priorities, and create clarity for technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Experience participating in rotational on-call or shift-based support for mission-critical production services. 
 - Proven ability to lead customer or client technical discussions, incident reviews, risk conversations, and solution-alignment sessions. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical topics to engineering, program, operational, and leadership audiences. 

Preferred Qualifications: 

- Experience in transportation, finance, smart mobility, or another regulated and mission-critical industry. 
 - Experience with high-availability, fault-tolerance, distributed, and event-driven architectures. 
 - Experience leading reliability engineering, observability, automation, production modernization, or operational maturity initiatives across large-scale systems. 
 - Experience working across technology ecosystems in which applications, infrastructure, integrations, field devices, back-office platforms, and operational processes collectively affect customer-facing services. 
 - Knowledge of security, resilience, disaster recovery, capacity planning, and production-readiness practices for enterprise systems. 
 - Relevant professional certifications in cloud technologies, IT service management, database technologies, systems engineering.

data.title: Platform & Solution Engineering Lead
data.description:
Role Summary

The Platform and Solution Engineering Lead owns the technical foundation on which the entire Digital Quality (DQ) portfolio is built, delivered and operated. Digital Quality delivers the solutions that transform Quality, Safety and Environmental Operations (QSEO) across Pfizer, and this role is accountable for the platforms, engineering capability and delivery pipelines that allow that portfolio to move at pace while remaining compliant, secure and supportable. 

The incumbent leads a global engineering organisation covering platform engineering, solution architecture and design, integration and data engineering, DevSecOps, environment and release management, and vendor delivery oversight. Accountability spans the full technology mix - Software as a Service (SaaS), commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) and in-house developed solutions - ensuring each is engineered, integrated, validated and operated to a consistent standard rather than as isolated stacks. 

The role is the engineering counterpart to the DQ Solution Leads, who own product strategy and business outcomes, and to the Scaled AI and Solution Architect, who sets cross-portfolio architecture direction and standards; this role is accountable for making those standards real in code, configuration, pipelines and operations. It is also the principal point of alignment between Digital Quality and the wider enterprise technology landscape, including Enterprise Architecture, Cyber Security, the enterprise AI and Data organisation, and central platform and infrastructure teams. The role is global in scope, spanning the PGS network, R&D, commercial markets and corporate locations. 

Role Responsibilities

Platform Engineering and Technical Foundation

- Own the strategy, engineering and lifecycle of the shared technical foundation for Digital Quality, including cloud footprint, runtime platforms, shared services, reusable components, developer tooling and non-production environments. 
 - Build the foundation as a product used by delivery teams across the portfolio, with defined service levels, roadmaps, adoption measures and a managed path for retiring legacy and duplicated technology. 

Solution Engineering Across SaaS, COTS and Custom Build

- Provide engineering leadership and design accountability across the full technology mix, establishing how SaaS platforms are configured and extended, how COTS products are deployed and integrated, and how in-house applications are designed, built and maintained. 
 - Ensure engineering rigour, supportability and consistent quality regardless of delivery model, and prevent unmanaged customisation that undermines upgradability and cost of ownership. 

Integration and Data Engineering

- Own the integration and data engineering layer connecting Digital Quality solutions to each other and to the wider Pfizer landscape, including manufacturing, laboratory, enterprise resource planning and enterprise data platforms. 
 - Establish reusable integration patterns, interfaces and data contracts, and ensure integrations are resilient, monitored, documented and compliant with data integrity requirements. 

DevSecOps, Release and Environment Management

- Define and run the engineering operating model for Digital Quality, covering source control, continuous integration and delivery pipelines, automated testing, security scanning, infrastructure as code, and environment and release management. 
 - Drive automation of validation and compliance evidence so that release frequency, deployment reliability and lead time improve without weakening GxP control. 
 - Own the release calendar and change governance across the portfolio, including coordination of platform vendor release cycles. 

Vendor and Managed Service Delivery

- Hold strategic technology vendors, systems integrators and managed service partners to account for engineering quality, delivery commitments, security posture and service performance. 
 - Shape sourcing strategy and the internal-versus-partner capability mix, define technical standards and acceptance criteria in statements of work, and manage capacity and demand across internal and external engineering teams. 

Enterprise Technology Alignment

- Act as the principal interface between Digital Quality and enterprise technology functions, ensuring DQ solutions adopt enterprise platforms, standards and services rather than building parallel capability. 
 - Influence enterprise roadmaps, standards and investment decisions on behalf of the QSEO domain, and represent Digital Quality in enterprise architecture, cyber security and technology governance forums. 

Organisational Leadership

- Lead, develop and grow a global engineering team of approximately 8-10 direct reports, spanning platform engineers, solution architects, integration and data engineers, DevSecOps and release specialists, alongside matrixed and contract resources. 
 - Build engineering capability, talent pipelines and succession plans; set technical performance expectations and career pathways; and foster a culture of engineering excellence, automation, innovation, accountability and continuous improvement across Digital Quality. 

Compliance, Risk and Governance

- Ensure the technical foundation and all solutions built on it are maintained in a validated and compliant state in accordance with GRC (Governance, Risk and Compliance) guidelines, computerised system validation expectations, data integrity, data privacy and cyber security requirements. 
 - Maintain audit and inspection readiness for engineering processes and evidence, support internal audits and regulatory inspections, and balance pace of innovation with regulatory compliance through effective governance and risk management. 

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree required in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology or a related discipline. 
 - 10+ years of relevant experience in software or platform engineering, technical delivery leadership or engineering management (9+ years with an MS/MBA; 7+ years with a PhD), including accountability for engineering across a portfolio rather than a single application. 
 - Demonstrated experience leading, hiring and developing engineering teams at scale, including matrix leadership of vendor and contract resources across multiple geographies. 
 - Deep hands-on grounding in cloud platform engineering, integration architecture and modern software engineering practice, with practical experience of CI/CD, infrastructure as code, automated testing and security-in-the-pipeline. 
 - Experience delivering and operating across SaaS, COTS and custom-developed solutions, including vendor platform configuration, extension and upgrade management. 
 - Strong experience with Agile ways of working; SAFe preferred. 
 - Knowledge of financial management and procurement activities, with the ability to manage complex budgets, vendor contracts and internal-versus-partner capacity decisions. 
 - Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence senior technical and non-technical stakeholders. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience in the pharmaceutical industry or another highly regulated manufacturing environment, including GxP computerised system validation, data integrity and inspection readiness
 - Experience automating validation and compliance evidence within CI/CD pipelines in a regulated context. 
 - Working knowledge of quality, or EHS platforms and their integration landscape (for example Veeva, LIMS, Cority, Enablon). 
 - Experience engineering or operating AI and data capability in production, in partnership with architecture and data functions. 
 - Demonstrated success leading technology rationalisation, platform consolidation or large-scale migration programmes. 
 - Recognised cloud or architecture certification. 

Physical/Mental Requirements

Typical desk job; no specific physical or mental requirements beyond standard office work. 

Non-standard Work Schedule, Travel Or Environment Requirements

Occasional travel up to 20%

Ability to meet with colleagues virtually across different regions and time zones, including occasional out-of-hours working to support deployment go-lives and hypercare. 

ORGANIZATIONAL RELATIONSHIPS

Reports into Pfizer Digital, PGS, Enabling Functions & Enterprise Platforms - Quality Solutions Lead. 

Key business stakeholders include Enterprise Architecture, Cyber Security, the enterprise AI and Data organization, central cloud, infrastructure and platform teams, Digital Compliance and Computerized System Validation. 

External: strategic software and cloud vendors, systems integrators and managed service partners. 

RESOURCES MANAGED

Financial Accountability

Annual accountability of approximately $10M across platform, cloud consumption, engineering services and managed service investment, including business case development and investment recommendations for the Digital Quality technical foundation

Supervision

Direct leadership of approximately 8 colleagues, including platform engineers, solution architects, integration and data engineers, and DevSecOps and release specialists. Accountability for external partner and managed service relationships, including contract and systems integrator resources working across the Digital Quality portfolio under the colleague's leadership. 

Work Location Assignment: Hybrid

Pfizer is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable equal employment opportunity legislation in each jurisdiction in which it operates. 

To learn more about acceptable and prohibited uses of AI during the recruitment process, please review our candidate AI-use guidelines available on Pfizer Careers.

By deeply integrating with existing security infrastructure, ITP relentlessly analyzes user behavior and system data to proactively hunt down and neutralize risks before they impact our customers. 
 - Identity Threat Detection & Response (ITDR): Detecting sophisticated credential compromise, privilege escalation, and lateral movement with speed and automated response capabilities. As we expand our engineering footprint in India, you will be a foundational member of a high-impact team driving architectural scale, technical innovation, and product synergy across this critical pillar. 

What You'll Be DoingAs a Staff Software Engineer on the team, you will play a pivotal, hands-on role in scaling our foundational platforms and web applications, with a primary emphasis on backend architecture and distributed services. Technical Leadership

People Leadership

Quality & Compliance

Operational Excellence

Job Description: 

About Us

At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. We do this by driving Responsible Growth and delivering for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day. 

Being a Great Place to Work and providing a culture of caring is core to how we drive Responsible Growth. We are intentional about fostering an inclusive workplace where every teammate has the opportunity to succeed, build a career and contribute to our shared success. This includes attracting and developing exceptional talent, recognizing and rewarding performance, and supporting our teammates' physical, emotional, and financial wellness through affordable, competitive and flexible benefits. 

We value the unique perspectives individuals bring from all backgrounds and career paths - whether shaped by military service, community college education, or a wide range of work and life experiences. These journeys foster resilience, leadership and innovation, strengthening our workforce and positively impact the communities we serve. 

Bank of America is committed to an in-office culture that supports collaboration, engagement, and career development. Our approach includes clear in-office expectations, while providing an appropriate level of flexibility based on role-specific responsibilities and business needs. 

At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!

Global Business Services

Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations. 

Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation. 

In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services. 

Process Overview: 

Equity group span across various offering like prime brokerage, Equities trading. This includes physical and synthetic financing solutions for clients who desire to gain market exposure and financing to securities in the Equity, Fixed Income and FX marketplaces. BAML's offering spans multiple areas within GBAM, each of which provide specific offerings to our clients. we implement innovative software solutions to provide our clients with a seamless trading experience. Solutions includes low touch trading, FIX connectivity, low latency market connectivity, smart order routing, algorithmic trading, and internal crossing. 

Job Description

The individual will be a senior member of the Equity Swaps Technology Development team and will be responsible for designing, developing, enhancing and delivering business-critical applications supporting the Equity Swaps business. He/She will be expected to have strong hands-on Python development experience, sound software engineering fundamentals, and the ability to work on complex enterprise applications and technology platforms. 

The individual should be well versed with Global Markets concepts, preferably Equities/Equity Derivatives, and should be a self-starter with the ability to understand complex business requirements and translate them into robust technical solutions. 

The individual should be self-motivated, creative and proactive, with the ability to operate successfully in a fast-paced environment comprising multiple applications, platforms and technologies. The individual will work closely with developers, business analysts, product owners, production support teams and other global technology partners throughout the SDLC. The role will involve solution design, hands-on development, code reviews, unit and integration testing, troubleshooting, performance optimization, deployment and production stability. 

The role requires the candidate to be passionate and hands-on with technology, with strong analytical, programming, debugging and problem-solving skills. The individual will actively participate in system design and architecture discussions in addition to implementation, testing and deployment. The ideal candidate will be a fast learner with strong programming acumen, the ability to develop a good understanding of the Equity Swaps domain, and sufficient experience to deliver complex projects with minimal supervision and end-to-end ownership. 

Responsibilities: 

- Interact with Business Partners, Product Owners and Technology teams to understand requirements and develop appropriate technical solutions. 
 - Understand business and technology priorities and collaborate with global teams on technical solutions and future development initiatives. 
 - Participate actively and provide recommendations in global technical design and architecture discussions. 
 - Design, develop, enhance and maintain high-quality Python applications and services supporting the Equity Swaps business. 
 - Develop clean, reusable, maintainable and well-tested code in accordance with established software engineering standards. 
 - Contribute to development and enhancement of applications leveraging the Quartz framework. 
 - Design and integrate application components using APIs, messaging, databases and other appropriate integration patterns. 
 - Perform hands-on troubleshooting, debugging, root-cause analysis and resolution of complex application issues. 
 - Develop appropriate unit and integration tests and ensure solutions meet functional and non-functional requirements. 
 - Identify opportunities to improve application performance, scalability, resiliency, maintainability and observability. 
 - Participate in code reviews and ensure adherence to development standards, engineering best practices and application controls. 
 - Contribute to CI/CD, DevOps and automated software delivery practices. 
 - Be capable of independently driving development initiatives and delivering projects with end-to-end ownership and accountability. 
 - Ensure high-quality standards across all technical deliverables. 
 - Participate and contribute to Agile ceremonies, project compliance reviews and audit activities. 
 - Learn and adopt new technologies as future development may involve diverse platforms, software, frameworks and tools. 
 - Effectively communicate technical concepts and solutions through both written and verbal discussions. 
 - Adhere to the team's governing principles, development standards and policies. 
 - Participate in mandatory training and cross-functional initiatives across the team. 
 - Demonstrate enthusiasm and willingness to build strong Equity Swaps and Global Markets domain knowledge. 

Requirements: 

Education: B. E. /B. Tech/M. S. /M. Tech or equivalent qualification in Computer Science, Engineering or a related technical discipline. 

Certifications (if any): Relevant Python, Cloud or software engineering certifications are not mandatory but will be an added advantage. 

Experience Range: 6- 9 years

Foundational Skills: 

- Strong hands-on Python development experience with excellent programming and software engineering fundamentals. 
 - Strong understanding of object-oriented programming, data structures, algorithms and design patterns. 
 - Experience designing, developing and supporting complex enterprise-scale applications. 
 - Strong knowledge of application architecture and ability to translate functional requirements into effective technical designs. 
 - Experience with Quartz framework would be a strong advantage. 
 - Confident working in Linux environments, including shell scripting. 
 - Strong experience with SQL, relational databases and data management concepts. 
 - Experience developing and integrating applications using APIs and service-based interfaces. 
 - Strong understanding of unit testing, integration testing and automated testing practices. 
 - Strong analytical, debugging, troubleshooting and root-cause analysis skills. 
 - Experience with source control, build processes and CI/CD practices. 
 - Understanding of application performance, resiliency, scalability and production stability considerations. 
 - Demonstrable experience developing or supporting applications in complex technology environments. 
 - Business knowledge or exposure to Equities, Equity Derivatives, Equity Swaps or Global Markets is preferred. 
 - Knowledge of FIX protocol and financial markets integration would be advantageous. 
 - Ability to participate effectively in technical design and architecture discussions. 
 - Ability to face off to senior management, business stakeholders and technology partners globally. 
 - Ability and expertise working in an Agile development methodology. 
 - Ability to take ownership of complex development deliverables and work with minimal supervision. 
 - Must be a self-starter with excellent communication, collaboration and interpersonal skills. 

Desired Skills: 

- Possess strong analytical, programming, problem-solving and creative thinking skills. Hands-on experience developing solutions using the Quartz framework. 
 - Work experience in Global Markets / Equities / Equity Swaps / Prime Brokerage technology. 
 - Understanding of Equity Swaps products and trade lifecycle would be an advantage. 
 - Experience developing high-volume, scalable or performance-sensitive applications. 
 - Exposure to distributed application architecture, APIs and messaging technologies. 
 - Experience implementing and improving application resiliency and production stability. 
 - Experience with application performance monitoring, profiling and optimization. 
 - Exposure to observability and monitoring technologies, such as Prometheus, Splunk, Dynatrace and OpenTelemetry (OTEL). 
 - Exposure to architecture and design practices across Python, Java and/or Scala technology stacks. 
 - Hands-on experience with Cloud and Containerization technologies, including Kubernetes/OpenShift. 
 - Hands-on experience with DevOps and CI/CD tools, such as Ansible and Jenkins. 
 - Exposure to automated testing frameworks and engineering practices that improve software quality and delivery efficiency. 

Possess strong analytical, programming, problem-solving and creative thinking skills.

Job Location: Mumbai/Chennai

data.title: Senior SCADA Engineer F/M
data.description:
The Company

ALSTEF GROUP is a global leader in the design, integration and maintenance of turnkey automated solutions for airports, intralogistics and parcel handling. With over 1, 000 employees across 18 countries and 5 continents, we deliver innovative and scalable solutions that improve operational efficiency and meet our customers' needs. Join a diverse, international team shaping the future of automated systems. 

Description

Post description

Department: Engineering / Automation

Location: Pune, India

Experience: 5-10 Years

Employment Type: Full-Time

Industry: Airport Baggage Handling / Intralogistics / Industrial Automation

About The Role

We are looking for a Senior SCADA Engineer with strong hands-on experience in SCADA development, configuration, commissioning and troubleshooting, preferably with ICONICS and WinCC. 

The candidate will be responsible for developing and implementing SCADA/HMI solutions for Airport Baggage Handling Systems (BHS), material handling and automated intralogistics systems. The role involves close collaboration with PLC, controls, software and project teams throughout the project lifecycle. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design, develop, configure and maintain SCADA/HMI applications for automation and material handling systems. 
 - Develop and configure SCADA applications using ICONICS and Siemens WinCC. 
 - Integrate SCADA systems with PLC/automation systems, databases and other control-system components. 
 - Configure alarms, events, trends, graphics, tags, recipes, reports and user management. 
 - Develop operator-friendly SCADA screens and graphical interfaces. 
 - Perform SCADA system testing, FAT, SAT, commissioning and site troubleshooting. 
 - Interface with PLCs and control systems for real-time monitoring and control. 
 - Troubleshoot communication issues between SCADA, PLCs, servers, networks and field devices. 
 - Work with protocols/interfaces such as OPC/OPC UA, TCP/IP and industrial communication protocols. 
 - Support SCADA server/client architecture, redundancy and system configuration. 
 - Analyse system issues and provide effective technical solutions during commissioning and operation. 
 - Coordinate with PLC/Controls, Electrical, Software and Project teams to ensure smooth system integration. 
 - Prepare and maintain technical documentation, SCADA standards and project-related documents. 
 - Support remote and on-site commissioning activities whenever required. 
 - Provide technical guidance to junior engineers and support knowledge sharing within the team. 

Mandatory Technical Skills

- Strong hands-on experience in SCADA development and configuration. 
 - Experience with ICONICS SCADA is highly preferred. 
 - Experience with Siemens WinCC is required/preferred. 
 - Good understanding of PLC-SCADA communication and integration. 
 - Experience in SCADA graphics, alarms, trends, tags and database integration. 
 - Knowledge of OPC / OPC UA and industrial communication. 
 - Good understanding of industrial automation systems and control architecture. 
 - Experience in FAT, SAT, commissioning and troubleshooting. 
 - Ability to analyse and resolve SCADA and communication-related issues independently. 

Key Competencies

- Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills
 - Good understanding of automation and control systems
 - Ability to work independently on SCADA projects
 - Good communication and coordination skills
 - Willingness to travel to customer/project sites for commissioning
 - Ability to work effectively with multidisciplinary project teams

What You Will Work On

You will work on automation solutions supporting airport baggage handling and intelligent intralogistics systems, collaborating with engineering and project teams to deliver reliable and high-performance SCADA solutions from development through commissioning. 

Keywords: SCADA Engineer, Senior SCADA Engineer, ICONICS, WinCC, Siemens WinCC, SCADA Development, HMI, PLC, OPC, OPC UA, Automation, BHS, Airport Baggage Handling, Material Handling, Intralogistics, Conveyor, Commissioning, FAT, SAT

Preferred Required

Profile required Preferred Experience

Candidates with experience in any of the following industries will be preferred: 

- Airport Baggage Handling Systems (BHS)
 - Material Handling Systems
 - Intralogistics / Warehouse Automation
 - Conveyor Systems
 - Parcel Sortation
 - Automated Storage & Retrieval Systems (ASRS)
 - Industrial Automation
 - Manufacturing Automation

Experience with BHS/intralogistics projects involving PLC, SCADA and HMI integration will be an added advantage. 

Education

- Bachelor's Degree / Diploma in Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation, Automation or related Engineering discipline. 

Réf: beadd130-f3c0-4744-8de4-a0c2693e28e9

As part of your application on the career site of ALSTEF Group , the information you provide is processed for the review of your profile, on the basis of pre-contractual measures and the legitimate interest of the company in building a CV database. 

Some data may be automatically analysed (parsing and pre-screening) via an Artificial Intelligence system. No decision is made solely by AI, as every application is reviewed by a recruiter. 

Regarding The Use Of AI

- Your data is not retained by our AI solution. 
 - It is not used to train an AI model. 
 - Processing is carried out exclusively on servers located within the European Union. 
 - No transfer outside the EU is carried out. 

Regarding Your Data

Unless otherwise requested, your data is retained for a maximum of 2 years. 

In accordance with our internal security policies (PSSI) and current best practices, robust technical and organisational measures are implemented to protect the access and integrity of your information: secure access, rights management, encryption, security protocols, access monitoring, employee awareness, etc. 

Regarding Your Rights

In accordance with the GDPR, you have the right to access, rectify, object to and delete your data. You may exercise these rights by contacting [email protected] .

data.title: Senior Cloud Developer
data.description:
At Basware, we deliver mission-critical cloud solutions that empower organizations to unlock their full potential. Our products are designed to bring clear and compelling value to our customers, and we're looking for a talented and forward-thinking developer who can help us shape the future of our technology. 

We are seeking a Senior Cloud Developer - Country Compliance, an experienced software engineer, who will contribute to the solutions that keep our customers compliant with country e-invoicing and tax reporting mandates. Your role will be focused on building the country-specific capabilities that connect invoices, credit notes and purchase orders to government tax portals and clearance networks, using the latest technologies and AI-assisted ways of working to deliver large-scale, high-performance, enterprise-grade solutions. 

This is a hands-on technology role, ideal for candidates seeking opportunities to both build on their existing experience and research new knowledge areas, with a significant share of design and exploratory elements to their day-to-day tasks. Every country mandate brings a different set of rules, formats and deadlines, so no two modules look the same. 

You will be working alongside engineers and developers from the Invoice Lifecycle Management (ILM) Teams, assisted by our AI Engineering team, and in integration with other Basware solutions. The product you will be contributing to is targeted at large, well-known enterprises. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design and implement country extension modules against the platform's shared frameworks and architectural conventions. 
 - Build and maintain REST APIs and service layers that carry compliance traffic to and from government portals. 
 - Implement compliance logic: XML and JSON schema validation, digital signature handling, submission to and status polling from government portals. 
 - Write automated tests as part of a TDD workflow, covering both unit and integration levels. 
 - Participate actively in code and design reviews, and help hold the quality bar across the team. 
 - Work with the Lead Developer and QA to harden the performance, security and resilience of compliance flows. 
 - Contribute to CI/CD pipeline improvements and help diagnose and fix production issues. 
 - Use AI coding assistants as part of the daily workflow, critically reviewing and validating what they generate. 

, 

- 5+ years of professional software engineering experience. 
 - Strong Java (17+) and Spring Boot experience building production REST services. 
 - Practical experience using AI coding assistants in a professional workflow, understanding their limitations and validating their output. 
 - Familiarity with XML processing, XSD schema validation and secure XML parsing practices. 
 - Practical experience with MongoDB or another NoSQL document database. 
 - Working knowledge of authentication and authorization mechanisms in web APIs. 
 - Experience deploying and operating applications on AWS cloud infrastructure. 
 - Solid understanding of software design principles and the ability to apply them in day-to-day coding. 
 - Experience with CI/CD pipelines and Test-Driven Development as a working practice. 
 - Good communication skills and the ability to collaborate cross-functionally with product, QA and compliance stakeholders. 
 - Strong sense of ownership, collaborative attitude, and willingness to learn new domains and regulations quickly. 
 - Familiarity with e-invoicing standards and networks such as Peppol and EN 16931, or with national clearance models such as Italy's SDI, Poland's KSeF or the French PPF and PDP model. 
 - Experience with digital signatures and certificates (X. 509, XAdES) or secure token and credential handling. 
 - Exposure to microservices architecture and distributed systems concepts. 
 - Experience with spec-driven AI development, where a written specification drives implementation and tests, and with AI agents and agent skills. 
 - Working knowledge of JavaScript for adjacent integration touchpoints. 
 - We highly value candidates who demonstrate curiosity, a proactive mindset and a willingness to explore and incorporate AI-driven technologies into their work. We encourage growth in this area and provide opportunities for experimentation and learning. 

Why Basware?

We're a purpose-driven company with a global footprint and a collaborative culture. At Basware, you'll work with passionate professionals, cutting-edge technology, and a shared commitment to innovation and excellence. 

Ready to make an impact?

If you're excited by the challenge, apply now and help shape the future of Basware. 

Please submit your resume and cover letter by clicking the 'I'm interested' link. 

Our recruitment process will include pre-employment actions such as enhanced background screening and reference check. 

Basware. Now it all just happens.

data.title: Senior Staff Product Engineer
data.description:
Renesas is one of the top global semiconductor companies in the world. We strive to develop a safer, healthier, greener, and smarter world, and our goal is to make every endpoint intelligent by offering product solutions in the automotive, industrial, infrastructure and IoT markets. Our robust product portfolio includes world leading MCUs, SoCs, Analog and power products, plus Winning Combination solutions that curate these complementary products. We are a key supplier to the world's leading manufacturers of electronics you rely on every day; you may not see our products, but they are all around you. 

Renesas employs roughly 21, 000 people in more than 30 countries worldwide. As a global team, our employees actively embody the Renesas Culture, our guiding principles based on five key elements: Transparent, Agile, Global, Innovative, and Entrepreneurial. Renesas believes in, and has a commitment to, diversity and inclusion, with initiatives and a leadership team dedicated to its resources and values. At Renesas, we want to build a sustainable future where technology helps make our lives easier. Join us and build your future by being part of what's next in electronics and the world. 

Job Description

Position Summary

Renesas Electronics is seeking an experienced Product Engineer ( Senior Staff level) to lead the development, qualification, release, and sustaining of advanced semiconductor power products. This role is responsible for driving product engineering execution across the full lifecycle, from silicon bring-up through high-volume production, with a strong focus on product quality, yield optimization, reliability, and customer success. The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in power semiconductor technologies (e. g. , Point of loads (POL), Hotswap/Efuse, Drivers solutions) and demonstrate strong ownership of complex technical challenges while influencing cross-functional teams. 

Key Responsibilities

- Own product engineering activities across the full lifecycle, including silicon bring-up, characterization, qualification, production release, and sustaining

- Define and execute comprehensive product qualification strategies aligned to JEDEC and industry standards

- Drive reliability stress planning and interpretation, including HTOL, HAST/uHAST, TC, ELFR, and associated qualification methodologies. 

- Lead ESD and latch-up qualification strategy, data analysis, and failure resolution in alignment with product requirements. 

- Lead root cause analysis and resolution of complex product, test, and manufacturing issues

- Drive improvements in yield, test efficiency, product performance, and cost of quality

- Define and execute characterization and qualification strategies to ensure robust product release

- Partner with design and test engineering teams to optimize DFT, test coverage, and correlation (bench vs ATE vs system)

- Lead cross-functional efforts to resolve customer issues and field escalations

- Analyse yield, parametric, and reliability data to identify trends and drive corrective actions

- Influence product, test, and manufacturing decisions through strong technical judgment and data-driven insights

- Serve as a recognized subject matter expert in product engineering, statistical analysis, reliability, and failure analysis. 

- Lead cross-functional efforts across design, applications, reliability, and test teams to resolve highly complex technical challenges. 

- Provide leadership in defining characterization plans, qualification strategies, and analysis methodologies. 

- Communicate complex analytical findings, qualification results, and failure analysis conclusions to diverse stakeholders, including senior leadership. 

- Influence product release decisions through data-driven insight, technical expertise, and sound engineering judgment. 

- Act as a key authority on product readiness, with accountability for decisions impacting product quality and business outcomes. 

- Work on complex, ambiguous problems requiring evaluation of incomplete or conflicting data, applying conceptual and statistical thinking to determine optimal solutions. 

- Anticipate technical risks in product performance, qualification adequacy, and reliability margins, and proactively drive improvements. 

- Contribute to development of best practices in qualification methodology, data analysis, and engineering decision frameworks. 

- Mentor junior engineers in advanced statistical techniques, reliability interpretation, and structured problem solving and contribute to development of best practices

Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering or Microelectronics Engineering

- 10+ years of experience in semiconductor product engineering, test engineering, or related roles

- Strong experience in semiconductor industry, with preference for power / analog / mixed-signal products

- Deep understanding of product lifecycle (NPI through sustaining)

- Strong working knowledge of JEDEC standards (e. g. , JESD47, JESD22 series) and industry qualification practices. 

- Hands-on experience with ESD qualification (HBM, CDM) and latch-up testing/analysis. 

- Experience with reliability stress planning and interpretation (HTOL, HAST, TC, ELFR, etc. ). 

- Proven track record solving complex technical and yield-related issues

- Strong data analysis skills (JMP, Python, MATLAB or similar)

- Demonstrated success driving efficiency improvements in characterization, qualification, and yield analysis workflows. 

- Experience with ATE, silicon characterization, and production environments

- Deep expertise in statistical analysis, including distribution analysis, correlation analysis, and limit optimization. 

- Strong background in product characterization and electrical performance evaluation. 

- Extensive experience in reliability qualification, ESD, and latch-up methodologies. 

- Demonstrated expertise in failure analysis and root cause investigation across multiple failure modes. 

- Proven leadership in solving highly complex technical problems using data-driven approaches. 

- Experience influencing engineering decisions and leading cross-functional technical initiatives. 

- Strong communication and cross-functional collaboration skills

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

- Successfully lead on-time product releases with robust characterization and qualification coverage

- Drive measurable improvements in yield, test cost, and product quality

- Achieve timely resolution of critical product and customer issues

- Establish strong correlation between bench, ATE, and system-level performance

- Influence key product and test decisions to improve competitiveness

- Contribute to team capability growth through mentorship and technical leadership

Additional Information

Renesas is an embedded semiconductor solution provider driven by its Purpose, To Make Our Lives Easier. With a global team of over 21, 000 engineers and problem solvers in more than 30 countries, we offer the opportunity to work on world‐leading technology for Automotive, Industrial, Infrastructure, and IoT, shaping a safer, healthier, greener, and smarter future. 

At Renesas, TAGIE is our culture, grounded in being Transparent, Agile, Global, Innovative, and Entrepreneurial. It shapes how we work, grow and deliver on our purpose together. This collaborative spirit and mindset drive our semiconductor technology to transform industries and impact millions of lives. 

We believe in rewarding our employees with a competitive benefits package alongside their salary. More information will be provided during the hiring process. 

Are you ready to join our team and shape the future with us?

Job Description

Plan, organize and lead a design team for new product development with adherence to Product Development Process, Husky Standards and Stage Gate. Implementation of continuous improvement activities including metrics, root cause analysis and implementation of improvement.

 - Concept development, evaluation and recommendation
 - Risk mitigation through past service issue research, risk identification and formal DFMEA

 - Engineering analysis using hand calculation, spreadsheet and CAE formats
 - Design execution with high attention to detail in engineering quality
 - Validation plan development
 - Design document discipline
 - Preparation for Product Release Process

 - Proactive management of project budgets, status, execution timeline and mitigation as required
 - Proactive communication of team status to management
 - Continuous development of team output to a high quality standard
 - Weekly facilitation of team design reviews and team planning whiteboards
 - Technical support for Sales and Service

Qualifications: 

- Strong knowledge of Product Development Process, Stage Gate, Husky Standards

 - Strong knowledge of specific supporting discipline
 - Strong knowledge of Husky products and customer base
 - Strong project, time management skills and ability to delegate tasks and projects
 - Strong leadership skills with the ability to motivate and develop/mentor a team
 - Strong decision-making and judgment
 - Excellent communication skills (verbal, written, interpersonal and presentation)
 - Strong sense of integrity
 - Demonstrates high degree of flexibility and embraces changing priorities
 - Previous hands on design experience
 - Education: Bachelor's degree in Engineering preferred, or 5 to 10 years of equivalent professional experience.

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a competitive compensation and benefits package and excellent opportunities for growth and advancement. We are committed to equal employment opportunity and respect, value and welcome diversity in our workplace.
