Job Description

This strategy is key to the WSP in India Buildings Mechanical Electrical Public Health (MEP) business as we position ourselves to address the challenges of a changing global economy. The role is the cornerstone of the establishment of a MEP Design Capacity in Noida working and adhering to WSP Global standards and promoting technical excellence, in addition to creating and building a team. This will involve recruiting, leading, developing a team of Engineers over a relatively short period of time. The successful candidate will stimulate and manage significant growth in a technically demanding environment to time, cost and quality targets. Cultural awareness, an open mind and excellent communication skills are essential requirements for the role. 

Responsibilities

A major element of this role is to liaise with the WSP in India design teams to ensure that the following essential elements of the role are satisfactorily completed: -

- Agree and confirm the project brief to anticipate and identify needs and expectations in conjunction with others. 
 - Agree the project deliverables and programme. 
 - Agree the resource in India that will be required to undertake the designs to complete the project brief in time and cost. 
 - Agree the project fees according to brief, resource required and programme. 
 - Be responsible for the quality of detailed design to WSP in India and Global Building Regulations standards ensuring technical reviews and sign off including complex calculations and co-ordination issues. 
 - Ensure design are co-ordinated and due consideration of Health & Safety, Construction Design Management and Quality Assurance standards. 
 - Regularly communicate and update the local Indian and wider Global project teams on programme delivery and quality issues through use of staff utilisation charts and Key Performance Indicator (KPI) reporting etc. 
 - Review outputs of Computer Aided Design analysis, and determine additional levels of checking needed. 
 - Where necessary, development of energy strategies incorporating renewable technologies and low energy designs to satisfy local authority planning requirements and compliance with Building Regulations Part L. 
 - Inform the Commercial Director of Professional Indemnity issues in line with WSP in India policy. 
 - Ensure all company standards & efficient working practices are adopted. 
 - Maintain an overview & understanding of the team workload & associated resource requirements, and work with other team leaders to ensure resources are fully utilised, identify & address effectively any surplus or shortfall in available staff
 - The successful candidate will be a dynamic self-motivated individual who will take on a Leadership role in project work, focused on delivery to the client and technical excellence. 
 - The role requires management of a number of projects and becoming involved in design at an early stage. 
 - The role includes management of fees, invoicing, project-resource management, mentoring and coaching junior members of the team. The ability to plan and design deliverables against British Engineering standards for each stage of a project is a pre-requisite. 
 - The role will include a short term secondment to the to visit some of the key WSP in India offices and WSP in India personnel to better understand WSP in India as a business and to assist with acclimatisation to the WSP in India methods of working. 
 - Lead the design process, set clear goals and monitor their progress closely and encourage the rest of the team to deliver appropriate and cost effective solutions to the agreed programme; support those more inexperienced by technical review, mentoring and advice. 
 - Lead from the front accepting design challenges and giving them due consideration with the support of others to achieve resolution. 

Establishment and growth of GCC

- Responsible for the recruitment of the design team, in liaison with the Head of GCC
 - Contribute to the design of operational processes, systems and measures
 - Working with Support Services, the local resources and the other disciplines to ensure that all hardware, software, workspace and IT infrastructure is in place
 - Provide the technical training, mentoring and support to members of the new team, ensuring that the team is capable in the use of the required standards, processes and software tools at the earliest opportunity. 
 - Provide highly visible, inspirational leadership and direction for the emerging Buildings team, ensuring the Noida based team feel part of the wider team
 - Liaise with the established leadership of the GCC facility across the globe. 
 - Promote WSP in India Vision and Values - see below. 
 - Support and promote team work within the team, and the wider business

Technical and Project Management

- Raise the level of technical competence within the teams
 - Implement delivery and quality measurement processes
 - Agree Key Performance Indicators (KPI s) with the Head of GCC monitoring and regularly reporting. Identify and implement improvements to increase KPIs accordingly
 - Promote technical excellence in all our projects
 - Undertake technical reviews and contribute to the concept design
 - Provide continuous feedback to the Head of GCC on the effectiveness of the protocols and processes in place with a view to continuous improvement

Commercial

- Implement the project delivery systems and structures
 - Support management of resource requirements versus project requirements
 - Support liaison with UK business to drive up utilisation of GCC team
 - Support and advise UK on implementation of GCC within fee bid

Qualifications

- The applicant will have proven experience in the design of Building Services with significant experience in a similar role or demonstration of a good track record. 
 - The applicant will have proven experience in the design of Engineering Building Services. 
 - Must be conversant with technical mechanical or electrical software, such as IES, Amtech, Hevacomp, Relux and Dialux. 
 - A sound understanding of Microsoft Outlook, Word, Excel, Project is essential. 
 - Must be fluent in English with an excellent understanding of technical terminology. 
 - A sound understanding of Microsoft Outlook, Word, Excel, and project is essential. 
 - Must be fluent in English with an excellent understanding of technical terminology. 
 - The applicant should ideally have obtained British Chartered Engineer status or equivalent, possess a degree in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering and possess membership to an accredited engineering body. 

BGV: 

- Employment with WSP India is subject to the successful completion of a background verification ("BGV") check conducted by a third-party agency appointed by WSP India. 
 - Candidates are advised to ensure that all information provided during the recruitment process - including documents uploaded - is accurate and complete, both to WSP India and its BGV partner". 

About Us

WSP is one of the world's leading professional services consulting firms. We are dedicated to our local communities and propelled by international brainpower. We are technical experts and strategic advisors including engineers, technicians, scientists, architects, planners, surveyors and environmental specialists, as well as other design, program and construction management professionals. We design lasting solutions in the Transportation & Infrastructure, Property & Buildings, Earth & Environment, Power & Energy, Resources and Industry sectors, as well as offering strategic advisory services. Our talented people around the globe engineer projects that will help societies grow for lifetimes to come. 

With approximately 4, 000 talented people across 3 locations (Noida, Bengaluru & Mumbai offices) in India and more than 73, 000 globally, in 550 offices across 40 countries, we engineer projects that will help societies grow for lifetimes to come. 

At "WSP" we draw on the diverse skills and capabilities of our employees globally to compete for the most exciting and complex projects across the world and bring the same level of expertise to our local communities. We are proud to be an international collective of innovative thinkers who work on the most complex problems. Unified under one strong brand, we use our local expertise, international reach and global scale to prepare our cities and environments for the future, connect communities and help societies thrive in built and natural ecosystems. True to our guiding principles, our business is built on four cornerstones: Our People, Our Clients, Our Operational Excellence and Our Expertise. 

www. wsp. com

We are

- Passionate people doing purposeful and sustainable work that helps shape our communities and the future. 
 - A collaborative team that thrives on challenges and unconventional thinking. 
 - A network of experts channeling our curiosity into creating solutions for complex issues. 

Inspired by diversity, driven by inclusion, we work with passion and purpose. 

Working with Us

At WSP, you can access our global scale, contribute to landmark projects and connect with the brightest minds in your field to do the best work of your life. You can embrace your curiosity in a culture that celebrates new ideas and diverse perspectives. You can experience a world of opportunity and the chance to shape a career as unique as you. 

Our Hybrid Working Module

With us, you can operate in a flexible, agile, yet structured work environment and follow a Hybrid Work Model. 

- Maximize collaboration. 
 - Maintain product quality and cultural integrity. 
 - Balance community, collaboration, opportunity, productivity, and efficiency. 

Health, Safety and Wellbeing

Our people are our greatest asset, and we prioritize a safe work environment. Health, safety, and wellbeing are integral to our culture, with each of us accountable for fostering a safe workplace through our "Making Health and Safety Personal" initiative. Our Zero Harm Vision drives us to reduce risks through innovative solutions, earning recognition for our global health and safety practices with the prestigious RoSPA Health and Safety Awards for six consecutive years. 

Inclusivity and Diversity

WSP India is dedicated to fostering a sustainable and inclusive work environment where our greatest strength - Our People -feel valued, respected, and supported. We ensure an unbiased approach in hiring, promotion, and performance evaluation, regardless of age, gender identity, race, religion, sexual orientation, marital status, physical ability, education, social status, or cultural background. 

Imagine a better future for you and a better future for us all. 

Join our close-knit community of over 73, 300 talented global professionals dedicated to making a positive impact. Together, we can make a difference in communities both near and far. 

With us, you can. 

Apply today. 

NOTICE TO THIRD PARTY AGENCIES: 

WSP does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters, employment agencies, or other staffing services. Unsolicited resumes include any resume or hiring document sent to WSP in the absence of a signed Service Agreement where WSP has expressly requested recruitment/staffing services specific to the position at hand. Any unsolicited resumes, including those submitted to hiring managers or other business leaders, will become the property of WSP and WSP will have the right to hire that candidate without reservation - no fee or other compensation will be owed or paid to the recruiter, employment agency, or other staffing service.

data.title: Silicon Networking Lead,  Cloud
data.description:
In most instances, this position requires in-person interviews as part of the hiring process. 

Minimum qualifications: 

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - 15 years of experience in ASIC design and development. 
 - Experience leading multi-disciplinary silicon engineering teams through the full development life-cycle from architecture definition to tape-out. 
 - Experience in high-performance or low-power design techniques, ASIC standard interfaces, and memory system architectures. 

Preferred qualifications: 

- Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering or Computer Science, with an emphasis on computer architecture. 
 - Experience with ASIC standard interfaces and memory system architecture. 
 - Knowledge of high-performance and low power design techniques. 
 - Knowledge of FPGA, emulation platforms, and SOC architecture. 
 - Knowledge of one of the following areas: arithmetic units, bus architectures, processor design, accelerators, or memory hierarchies. 

About The Job

Be part of a team that pushes boundaries, developing custom silicon solutions that power the future of Google's direct-to-consumer products. You'll contribute to the innovation behind products loved by millions worldwide. Your expertise will shape the next generation of hardware experiences, delivering unparalleled performance, efficiency, and integration. 

In this role, you will serve as the overall Silicon Networking Lead for our Bengaluru organization. You will contribute in all phases of complex application-specific integrated circuit (ASIC) designs from design specification to production. You will collaborate with members of architecture, software, verification, power, timing, synthesis etc. to specify and deliver high quality SoC/RTL. You'll solve technical problems with innovative micro-architecture and practical logic solutions, and evaluate design options with complexity, performance, power and area in mind. 

The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what's possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide. 

We're the driving force behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more. 

Responsibilities

- Own the Silicon Networking organization in Bengaluru, including definition, implementation and deployment of Networking IPs. Define IP development methodologies and drive deep technical involvement across the IP's development cycle, including seamless integration to SoC. 
 - Lead project planning from architecture and micro-architecture decisions to scoping effort, collaborating across teams to represent project status. Lead and manage a multi-disciplinary team of chip engineers, plan tasks, allocate people, and hold technical design/code reviews. 
 - Guide and participate across the entire ASIC lifecycle, spanning architecture definition, RTL development, synthesis, timing/power, FPGA/silicon bring-up, and verification strategy. 
 - Drive the full development life-cycle of chips from initial definition to a high-quality tape-out. Ensure developed IPs contribute effectively across multiple key projects. 
 - Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams and other sites around the globe. 

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

data.title: Head of Mechanical Engineering
data.description:
Head - Mechanical Engineering

Location: Nashik | Department: Engineering

NIDO is looking for a senior Mechanical Engineering leader to build and lead the mechanical engineering function for our warehouse automation, material handling, robotics and intralogistics products and systems. 

This is not a pure project-design or engineering coordination role. The person will own mechanical product architecture, engineering standards, design quality, product reliability, team capability and release discipline across NIDO's automation portfolio. 

We are looking for someone who can combine strong engineering fundamentals with practical product development experience and build a function that delivers reliable, standardised, manufacturable and cost-competitive products. 

What you will own

You will be responsible for the complete mechanical engineering function across product development and customer projects, including: 

- Mechanical architecture and design for conveyors, sorters, lifts, ASRS/material handling systems, robotic equipment and other automation products. 
 - Product design and development, from concept engineering, calculations and detailed design to prototyping, validation and production release. 
 - Mechanical systems involving structures, frames, mechanisms, drives, transmissions, bearings, shafts, rollers, belts, chains, linear motion systems and precision assemblies. 
 - Engineering calculations covering loads, stresses, deflections, torque, power transmission, fatigue, vibration and other relevant design parameters. 
 - 3D modelling, assemblies, manufacturing drawings, GD&T, tolerance stack-ups and mechanical BOMs. 
 - Mechanical design standards, component standardisation, modular architecture and approved design libraries. 
 - SolidWorks / equivalent 3D CAD design standards, PDM/PLM practices and engineering documentation discipline. 
 - Mechanical product design for standard NIDO products as well as project/application engineering. 
 - Design reviews, technical approvals, controlled design releases and engineering-change management. 
 - Design for Manufacturing and Assembly (DFM/DFA), value engineering, cost reduction, localisation and component optimisation. 
 - Product reliability, durability, maintainability, serviceability and lifecycle engineering. 
 - Prototype development, design verification, testing, validation and engineering improvements before product release. 
 - Mechanical safety, guarding, ergonomics and compliance with applicable machinery safety and customer standards. 
 - Technical support to Manufacturing, Procurement, Quality, Installation & Commissioning and Service teams. 
 - Resolution of recurring product and field issues through structured root-cause analysis, corrective actions and design improvements. 
 - Building engineering capability, reviewing technical work and developing the Mechanical Engineering team. Leadership responsibility

The Head - Mechanical Engineering will lead the mechanical engineering organisation and work closely with: 

Electrical Engineering · Systems Engineering · Controls & Automation · Product Management · Reliability & Validation · Procurement · Factory Operations · Quality · Installation & Commissioning

You will be expected to create a function that is increasingly based on standard product platforms, modular designs, reusable assemblies, controlled releases and strong engineering governance, rather than repeated project-by-project redesign. 

An important part of the role will be developing a technically capable team, strengthening engineering review practices and ensuring that mechanical engineering decisions are made with a clear understanding of performance, reliability, manufacturing cost and long-term product competitiveness. 

Important role boundary

At NIDO: 

- Mechanical Engineering owns the mechanical product architecture - structures, mechanisms, mechanical drives, assemblies, mechanical BOMs, manufacturing drawings and mechanical design integrity. 
 - Electrical Engineering owns the electrical hardware architecture - power distribution, panels, electrical devices, safety hardware and wiring. 
 - Controls & Automation owns PLC/software logic, motion programming and controls software architecture. 
 - Systems Engineering coordinates system-level requirements, interfaces and integration across mechanical, electrical, controls and software disciplines. The Mechanical Head must therefore be technically strong enough to work across disciplines while maintaining clear ownership of mechanical design decisions, engineering quality and product performance. 

What we are looking for

We would ideally like someone with: 

- 15+ years of relevant mechanical engineering experience, including substantial product development and engineering leadership responsibility. 
 - Strong experience in industrial automation, material handling, warehouse automation, conveyors, sortation systems, ASRS, industrial machinery, robotics or similar engineered equipment. 
 - Hands-on mechanical design experience, including complex assemblies, mechanisms, drive systems and industrial equipment. 
 - Strong proficiency in SolidWorks and/or equivalent 3D mechanical CAD platforms, with exposure to PDM/PLM systems. 
 - Sound knowledge of engineering calculations, material selection, machine elements, structural design, tolerances and manufacturing processes. 
 - Experience taking products through the complete development lifecycle - concept, design, prototype, testing, validation and production. 
 - Strong understanding of sheet metal fabrication, machining, welding, assembly processes, bought-out components and manufacturing constraints. 
 - Experience with mechanical BOMs, engineering documentation, design releases, revision control and engineering-change processes. 
 - Proven ability to improve product reliability, reduce recurring design issues and implement sustainable engineering improvements. 
 - Strong understanding of DFM/DFA, value engineering, standardisation, modularisation and cost optimisation. 
 - Ability to critically review complex mechanical designs and challenge engineering assumptions rather than only manage a team administratively. 
 - Experience working across Product, Electrical, Controls, Production, Procurement, Quality and customer-site teams. 
 - Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving and structured root-cause-analysis capability. 
 - Demonstrated ability to recruit, mentor and develop engineers while establishing strong technical standards and accountability. We are particularly interested in candidates who have built and improved repeatable industrial products, rather than having worked exclusively on one-off project engineering. 

Preferred background

Experience in one or more of the following would be particularly relevant: 

Warehouse Automation · Material Handling Equipment · Conveyor Systems · Sortation Systems · ASRS · Industrial Robotics · Industrial Machinery · Special Purpose Machines · Factory Automation · High-Speed Mechanical Systems

Experience in product-oriented engineering organisations, especially those developing and manufacturing their own machinery, would be an advantage. 

Education

B. E. / B. Tech in Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics or a closely related engineering discipline. 

A postgraduate qualification in Mechanical Design, Machine Design or a related specialisation would be an advantage. 

What success in this role looks like

Over time, we expect this person to build a Mechanical Engineering function where: 

- mechanical designs are standardised, modular and reusable; 
 - new products move through structured design, prototyping, testing and validation stages; 
 - product reliability, durability and maintainability improve measurably; 
 - design releases happen on time and with high first-pass quality; 
 - project-specific engineering variation reduces; 
 - manufacturing and assembly become simpler and more consistent; 
 - product costs improve through intelligent design and component standardisation; 
 - recurring field failures are eliminated through permanent engineering solutions; 
 - mechanical BOMs, drawings and revisions remain accurate and controlled; 
 - engineering decisions are supported by calculations, testing and technical evidence; 
 - junior engineers become stronger technically and develop independent problem-solving capability; 
 - Mechanical, Electrical, Controls and Systems Engineering work as one integrated engineering organisation. About NIDO

NIDO builds industrial technology for intelligent material flow, including automation, mechanisation, robotics and software solutions for warehouses, distribution centres and industrial operations. 

We are in a phase of strengthening and scaling our engineering capabilities, with a focus on developing reliable, innovative, standardised and globally competitive products engineered in India. 

We are looking for senior engineering leaders who want to help build not only projects, but strong products, scalable engineering platforms and high-performing engineering organisations. 

This role offers the opportunity to shape NIDO's mechanical engineering capabilities and contribute directly to the development of our next generation of products. 

Interested candidates can apply through LinkedIn or share their profile with the NIDO recruitment team.

data.description:
Job Description

If you are a software engineering leader ready to take the reins and drive impact, we've got an opportunity just for you. 

As a Director of Software Engineering at JPMorganChase within the Consumer & Community Banking, you lead a technical area and drive impact within teams, technologies, and projects across departments. Utilize your in-depth knowledge of software, applications, technical processes, and product management to drive multiple complex projects and initiatives, while serving as a primary decision maker for your teams and be a driver of innovation and solution delivery. 

Job Responsibilities

- Leads technology and process implementations to achieve functional technology objectives
 - Accountable for decisions that influence teams' resources, budget, tactical operations, and the execution and implementation of processes and procedures
 - Sets direction and governance for agentic AI-enabled engineering and SDLC/TLM automation within a technical area to drive measurable improvements in speed, quality, and operational outcomes (e. g. , AI-orchestrated delivery workflows, release readiness controls, automated test modernization, and incident triage acceleration), while establishing guardrails for validation, security, resiliency, traceability, and reuse across teams. 
 - Applies knowledge of tools within the Software Development Life Cycle toolchain, including enterprise-authorized AI-assisted development and automation capabilities, to improve the value realized by automation and support capacity unlock initiatives at scale.

 - Delivers technical solutions that can be leveraged across multiple businesses and domains
 - Influences peer leaders and senior stakeholders across the business, product, and technology teams

Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills

- Formal training or certification on software engineering concepts and 10+ years applied experience. In addition, 5+ years of experience leading technologists to manage, anticipate and solve complex technical items within your domain of expertise
 - Experience developing or leading cross-functional teams of technologists
 - Experience with hiring, developing, and recognizing talent
 - Experience leading adoption of agentic AI-enabled engineering practices (using enterprise-authorized tools within the work environment) across teams, including defining operating expectations (human-in-the-loop validation, quality gates), measuring outcomes, and ensuring secure handling of sensitive inputs/outputs. 
 - Strong understanding of responsible AI use and control expectations in engineering workflows, including data sensitivity, resiliency/security implications, and governance; ability to influence leaders on safe scaling patterns and reuse. 
 - Practical cloud native experience
 - Expertise in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Mathematics, or a related technical field

data.title: Manager, Account Management (Mid-Market)
data.description:
When you join Accurate Background, you're an integral part of making every hire the start of a success story. Your contributions will help us fulfill our mission of advancing the background screening experience through visibility and insights, empowering our clients to make smarter, unbiased decisions. 

Job Description

Position Summary

The Manager, Account Management (Mid-Market) leads a team of Account Managers responsible for retaining, growing, and strengthening a portfolio of mid-market clients generating >$150, 000 in annual revenue. The role establishes account strategy, coaches the team on consultative client engagement, and ensures consistent execution against revenue, retention, product adoption, and client experience goals. 

Using client health indicators, engagement data, business intelligence, and market insights, the manager guides portfolio prioritizatAion, opportunity development, risk mitigation, and executive-level client conversations. The role partners with cross functional partners and leadership to deliver measurable business outcomes and seamless client experience. 

Key Responsibilities

Team Leadership & Performance Management

- Lead, coach, and develop a team of Account Managers through regular one-on-ones, deal and account reviews, call coaching, and actionable performance feedback. 
 - Set clear expectations, goals, and operating rhythms aligned with retention, growth, adoption, pipeline, and client experience priorities. 
 - Monitor individual and team performance, identify capability gaps, and implement focused development or performance-improvement plans. 
 - Promote accountability, collaboration, professional communication, and consistent execution of account management standards. 

Portfolio Growth & Client Value

- Own team performance across a defined mid-market portfolio and ensure Account Managers maintain effective account plans, stakeholder maps, client health assessments, and growth strategies. 
 - Coach the team to identify and advance upsell, cross-sell, and expansion opportunities based on client needs, usage patterns, and business objectives. 
 - Review pipeline quality, forecast accuracy, whitespace analysis, and next steps removing blockers to success. 
 - Guide proactive risk identification and recovery planning for accounts with service, adoption, relationship, or renewal concerns. 

Client Governance & Business Reviews

- Establish a consistent client governance cadence for priority and strategic mid-market accounts. 
 - Ensure Account Managers prepare for and lead Business Reviews that demonstrate value, review service and adoption trends, align on client priorities, address risks, and identify actionable growth opportunities. 
 - Participate in executive-level client meetings and escalations when leadership sponsorship is required. 
 - Maintain clear executive visibility into portfolio health, material risks, achievements, and recommended actions.

data.description:
Description

Selling Partner Identity Verification (SPIV) ensures that Amazon is a safe and trustworthy place to shop and an amazing place to build a successful business selling products. Our mission is to build trust with our Customers and Selling Partners as we scale through technology, analytics, and science. We're committed to service as a center of excellence for Amazon. 

As part of SPIV, Seller Verification owns variety of products which enables us to collect data from WW Sellers in order to let them sell on Amazon marketplace. Our mission is to: (a) make it simple and fast for Sellers to register globally, (b) verify the identity of every person and business selling on Amazon through the Seller lifecycle, and (c) use automation to achieve accuracy, speed, and scale. When we are successful, we enable Marketplace growth and build trust with our Customers. Registration Systems receive ~1. 5M hits per week and strive towards providing a seamless experience that cannot be exploited by bad actors. As of today, sellers who intend to go global on Amazon need to register in each region and thus, go through the tedious registration process multiple times, which leads to friction for potential global sellers. 

We are looking for a Software Development Manager with a strong sense of ownership and a passion for delivering creative solutions for complex problems on an unprecedented scale. As part of leading a team of engineers, you will have the opportunity to create significant impact on our systems, our business and most importantly, our customers as we take on challenges that can reshape the e-commerce industry.

Success in this role requires close collaboration with platform, data, security, middleware, and application teams to deliver reliable, secure, and scalable solutions while modernizing legacy capabilities. 

Responsibilities

API Engineering & Application Development

 - Create Glue Job for data sync.

Security & Access Management

Automation & Infrastructure Engineering

 - Lambda
 - IAM roles and policies
 - CloudWatch logging and monitoring

CI/CD & Operational Excellence

 - Support automated testing, packaging, versioning, and release management. 
 - Implement observability through logging, metrics, alerts, and tracing.

Cross‐Team Collaboration

- Collaborate closely with application teams, platform engineering, cloud, and security teams. 
 - Align API design and implementation with enterprise architectural standards. 
 - Actively contribute to code reviews, design discussions, and technical documentation. 
 - Promote best practices and a culture of engineering excellence. 

Strategic Influence

- Influence API engineering standards, patterns, and best practices across the organization. 
 - Contribute to architectural reviews and modernization efforts. 
 - Help drive consistent, scalable, and maintainable cloud‐native API solutions. 

What Are We Looking For?

We're looking for strong collaborators who deliver exceptional client experiences and thrive in fast-paced, team-oriented environments. Our ideal candidates pursue greatness, act with integrity, and are driven to help our clients succeed. We value those who embrace creativity, continuous improvement, and contribute to a culture where we win together and create and share joy in our work. 

Requirements

- Minimum of 7 years of experience in software engineering, cloud application engineering, API engineering, platform engineering, or related technical roles. 
 - Hands-on experience with Python development, REST APIs, AWS services (Lambda, API Gateway, CloudWatch, IAM, S3), and Terraform for Infrastructure as Code. 
 - Experience developing, validating, supporting, or operating APIs and cloud-native applications in large-scale production environments. 
 - Experience with CI/CD pipelines, Git-based workflows, automated testing, and deployment automation tools such as Jenkins or GitHub Actions.

Core Competencies

- API Design Mindset - builds clean, consistent, and consumer‐friendly APIs.

 - Collaboration - works effectively across engineering, security, and platform teams.

Preferences

- Strong understanding of application monitoring, observability, logging, alerting, resiliency, and operational support.

data.description:
Our team members are at the heart of everything we do. At Cencora, we are united in our responsibility to create healthier futures, and every person here is essential to us being able to deliver on that purpose. If you want to make a difference at the center of health, come join our innovative company and help us improve the lives of people and animals everywhere. Apply today!

Job Details

Role Overview

We are looking for Lead DevOps-Network Automation Engineer to shape and deliver network automation, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), and platform engineering across our network environments. You will work with the Network Engineering and Product teams to turn network services into reliable, self-service, software-defined capabilities. You will be a technical authority and mentor, and a key driver of our infrastructure modernization strategy. 

What You'll Do

Architecture & Strategy

- Define and own IaC and network automation architecture, standards and reusable module libraries for the Network Engineering team. 
 - Design and build platform capabilities (APIs, self-service workflows, golden templates) that let Product and application teams consume network services faster. 
 - Drive adoption of SDN and cloud-native networking patterns across Core, Edge and SME environments. 
 - Evaluate emerging tools and recommend improvements, with a clear business case. 
 - Partner with Cloud, Platform Engineering, Security and DevOps teams to integrate network infrastructure into the wider technology ecosystem. 

Delivery & Engineering Excellence

- Lead end-to-end delivery of IaC and automation projects, from requirements through production deployment. 
 - Design CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure with automated testing, validation, drift detection and safe rollback. 
 - Implement policy-as-code and compliance-as-code to enforce governance at scale. 
 - Establish GitOps practices so every change is version-controlled, peer-reviewed and auditable. 
 - Integrate automation workflows with our sources of truth
 - Set coding standards, review processes and documentation practices for infrastructure code. 

Leadership

- Act as the technical point of contact for IaC and automation in Network Engineering. 
 - Mentor junior and mid-level engineers on IaC, software engineering practices and tooling. 
 - Translate business and product requirements into scalable technical solutions and contribute to the modernization roadmap. 

Required Qualifications

- 8+ years in systems, network or infrastructure engineering, with at least 3 years focused on IaC and network automation. 
 - Strong, hands-on Terraform (modules, state management, multi-environment) and Ansible (roles, inventories, AWX/Tower or equivalent). 
 - Strong Python for automation and tooling, plus working Bash/Shell skills. 
 - Expert-level Git and Git-based workflows, with CI/CD experience (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI or Azure Pipelines). 
 - Able to understand, troubleshoot and automate routing (BGP/OSPF), switching, VLANs, DNS/DHCP, firewalls and load balancers; deep design expertise is a plus
 - Working knowledge of at least one major cloud (AWS, Azure or GCP) and its networking services (VPC/VNet, Transit Gateway, DNS). 
 - Policy-as-code; GitOps tooling (ArgoCD, Flux). 
 - Experience mentoring engineers and leading delivery in a team setting. 
 - Strong understanding and experience with REST APIs and web streams. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Network source of truth experience YANG/NETCONF/RESTCONF. 
 - Cisco automation (DNA Center, NSO, NX-OS programmability); SD-WAN/SDN exposure. 
 - Experience with network automation libraries (NAPALM, Netmiko) and automated testing of infrastructure code. 
 - Docker, Kubernetes, Helm; Go or another programming language. 
 - Monitoring and observability include SLO/SLA tracking and Open Telemetry. Tools like New Relic and SolarWinds. 
 - ITIL or similar service management knowledge; large enterprise or global IT experience. 
 - Certifications such as Terraform Associate/Professional, AWS/Azure/GCP networking or architect certifications, CKA, CCNP/CCIE (automation track), RHCE. 

Bachelor's degree in computer science, software engineering, systems engineering, information technology, or a related field, or equivalent experience required. 

Master's degree in computer science, software engineering, systems engineering, information technology, or a related field, or equivalent experience preferred. 

Network source of truth experience YANG/NETCONF/RESTCONF.

We are seeking a Technical Manager to lead Bluetooth validation and test automation for Qualcomm connectivity solutions. Job Title: Senior Manager - Custom Analytics(FullStack)

GCL: E

Introduction To Role

Are you ready to lead the shift from low-code to scalable pro-code analytics that power critical decisions and, ultimately, better patient outcomes? As the lead in Custom Analytics management, you will be the hands-on engineering and change leader crafting a high-performance, enterprise-grade analytics application used across our global operations. 

You will champion AI-assisted development with a human-in-control ethos-accelerating delivery while safeguarding design quality, security, and compliance. Working closely with technical partners and multi-functional collaborators, you will translate complex requirements into well-structured implementations. These will involve working with React, TypeScript, Python alongside FastAPI, APIs, quality assurance, and continuous integration and delivery. Can you picture guiding teams through this transformation while leaving behind reusable patterns, frameworks, and guides that improve efficiency and quality across the board?

We are in a period of rapid growth and digital reinvention, where smarter engineering frees scientists and business colleagues to focus on discovery, insight, and decisions. Your work will streamline the process through which we develop analytics, reduce cycle time across the SDLC, and drive consistent, standards-aligned delivery that scales. 

Accountabilities

Front-End Engineering: Develop reusable UI components using React + TypeScript + Ant Design to create a consistent, maintainable user experience that accelerates feature delivery. 

Backend Services: Build and maintain backend services using FastAPI (Python) to deliver reliable, secure, and scalable business capabilities. 

API Build and Integration: Implement RESTful APIs following defined standards and guidelines, enabling interoperability and performance across services. 

Data Engineering: Handle data transformation, aggregation, and integration tasks to ensure accurate, timely insights for analytics use cases. 

Engineering Standards: Follow established system architecture and coding standards to ensure maintainability, compliance, and consistency with organizational frameworks. 

Quality and Validation: Ensure code quality through testing, validation, and alignment with standards, growing confidence in releases and reducing defects. 

Performance and Debugging: Support performance optimization and debugging across the application to improve user experience and system resilience. 

DevOps and Delivery: Collaborate using Docker and continuous integration and delivery pipelines to ensure smooth deployment processes and faster, reliable releases. 

Risk and Issue Management: Advance and communicate technical risks or blockers effectively to reduce delivery friction and protect timelines. 

AI-Assisted Delivery: Use approved AI coding assistants such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, or equivalent tools to accelerate coding, refactoring, documentation, testing, debugging, and solution analysis while maintaining human oversight. 

Coaching and Capability Building: Coach low-code/no-code developers into pro-code practices through upskilling, paired development, reusable templates, coding standards, and guided AI-assisted workflows. 

Responsible AI Guardrails: Apply guardrails for AI-generated code, including human review, testing, security validation, documentation, and alignment with enterprise architecture standards. 

Pro-Code Translation: Translate low-code/no-code prototypes into scalable pro-code solutions, balancing rapid prototyping with maintainability, extensibility, performance, and governance. 

Patterns and Templates: Create reusable patterns, repository guidance, starter templates, and playbooks that help AI tools produce consistent, standards-aligned outputs. 

Change Management: Support AI-assisted development change management through awareness, enablement, office hours, quick-start guides, feedback loops, adoption tracking, and reinforcement. 

Cross-Functional Partnership: Partner with leads, BAs, solution teams, and developers to reduce SDLC effort through AI across requirements, design, build, test, deployment, and support. 

Measurement and Reporting: Track adoption, productivity, quality outcomes, and risks from AI-assisted practices, and share progress, blockers, and lessons learned with stakeholders. 

Essential Skills/Experience

Strong experience with: 

React (v18+) + TypeScript

Python (FastAPI or similar frameworks)

Solid Understanding Of

REST API design and integration

Asynchronous programming

Component-based architecture

Experience with Redux Toolkit or similar state management tools

Strong SQL Skills And Experience With Relational Databases

Ability to work with data structures involving aggregation and hierarchy

Understanding Of

Clean code practices

Scalable application design

Strong debugging and problem-solving skills

Hands-on experience or strong knowledge of AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, ChatGPT Enterprise, or approved equivalents. 

Ability to use AI across the SDLC for code generation/explanation, refactoring, unit tests, test cases, debugging, documentation, and implementation planning. 

Strong understanding of responsible AI-generated code use, including review, hallucination checks, dependency validation, privacy, and security vulnerability checks. 

Experience moving teams from low-code/no-code to pro-code through capability building, coaching, standards adoption, and change management. 

Ability to create developer guidance, reusable prompts, coding patterns, repository instructions, and documentation for consistent AI-assisted outputs. 

Strong engineering mindset to balance rapid AI-assisted delivery with maintainability, scalability, quality, compliance, and production readiness. 

Comfortable mentoring developers moving from Power Platform, workflow automation, or other low-code/no-code tools into React, TypeScript, Python, APIs, Git, testing, and CI/CD. 

Desirable Skills/Experience

Experience with data visualisation tools (Chart. js, Ant Design Charts)

Exposure to microservices architecture

Experience working in enterprise or large-scale environments

Familiarity with Docker and CI/CD workflow

Experience adopting new engineering tools, AI coding assistants, or developer productivity platforms in team or enterprise settings. 

Familiarity with ADKAR or similar change frameworks covering awareness, desire, knowledge, ability, and reinforcement. 

Experience defining criteria to keep, enhance, or rebuild low-code/no-code prototypes as scalable pro-code solutions. 

Exposure to agentic workflows, AI-assisted planning, coding/testing agents, or repository-level AI guidance patterns. 

Ability to track and communicate adoption/value metrics such as usage, time saved, manual steps reduced, quality gains, and cycle-time improvements. 

When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we unleash bold thinking with the power to inspire life-changing medicines. In-person working gives us the platform we need to connect, work at pace and challenge perceptions. That's why we work, on average, a minimum of three days per week from the office. But that doesn't mean we're not flexible. We balance the expectation of being in the office while respecting individual flexibility. Join us in our unique and ambitious world. 

Why AstraZeneca

Join a mission-led enterprise where engineering excellence directly supports medicines that change lives and where your craft is amplified by a global, collaborative network. You will work with modern stacks, apply AI responsibly, and shape how we build products at scale-while partnering with diverse experts who move quickly, share openly, and value kindness alongside ambition. Here, your decisions travel from streamlined internal operations to faster insights and better outcomes for patients with unmet needs, and your curiosity is rewarded with real investment in tools, learning, and growth. 

Call To Action

Own this transformation and elevate your impact-send your CV today to lead scalable analytics that matter for our teams and for patients.

data.description:
Job Description

Lead Software Engineer Job Location - Pune (Hybrid) About the Team

The Logistics Technology team at Williams-Sonoma, Inc. builds and supports the platforms that move product across our supply chain - from distribution center operations and warehouse management to material handling automation, labeling, and sortation for brands including Williams Sonoma, Pottery Barn, West Elm, and Rejuvenation. We partner closely with Supply Chain, Distribution Center operations, and third-party automation vendors to keep fulfillment fast, accurate, and cost-effective. It is a hands-on, high-ownership team where engineers work end to end - designing systems, integrating with WMS, PLCs, and material handling equipment, and applying automation and AI to improve how our distribution network runs every day. 

About The Role

The Lead Software Engineer will lead the design, development, and delivery of a Windows-based sortation and labeling platform that integrates with PKMS/WMS systems, PLCs, and material handling equipment (MHE) across our distribution network. The system processes TCP socket messages for carton lifecycle events, persists data to enterprise databases, and coordinates downstream services, subject-matter depth in warehouse automation and MHE, and close collaboration with cross-functional business, DC operations, WCS and WES system integrations, and coordination with third-party vendor teams such as Savoye, Opex, Honeywell Intelligrated, Boxer, and bagger/print-and-apply solution providers. 

Responsibilities

- Provide technical leadership for the sortation and labeling domain - designing, developing, and leading delivery of high-throughput, low-latency Windows services and desktop applications. 
 - Design and maintain TCP socket server/client components for high-volume carton lifecycle messaging with PKMS/WMS and MHE controllers. 
 - Implement multithreading and asynchronous programming patterns for performance, responsiveness, and predictable throughput under peak volumes. 
 - Build and maintain desktop UI using WPF and coordinate with Windows Service hosts for end-to-end operational workflows. 
 - Lead integrations with PLCs, serial devices, scanners, print-and-apply, and material handling equipment, ensuring robust error handling, retry logic, and consistent state across data stores. 
 - Own ZPL label workflows and print pipelines, including label design, throughput tuning, and printer/applicator fault recovery. 
 - Define and enforce engineering standards for secure coding, unit testing, Git branching strategy, and code quality. 
 - Lead deployments, IIS configuration, and CI/CD automation, including automated testing and release readiness. 
 - Own application health in production - monitoring, alerting, incident triage, and root-cause resolution during peak fulfillment periods. 
 - Partner with Distribution Center operations, Supply Chain, and third-party MHE vendors to translate operational requirements into scalable technical solutions. 
 - Identify and deliver AI and automation opportunities that improve DC operations, production support, and business-user productivity. 
 - Drive Agile delivery - sprint planning, estimation, and delivery tracking - adhere to IT change management, and mentor engineers to raise the bar across the team. 

CriteriaExperience

- 10-15 years of software engineering experience, including at least 3 years in a technical lead or staff-level role. 
 - Proven track record delivering enterprise-scale . NET applications in a retail, supply chain, or logistics environment. 
 - Demonstrated experience as an individual contributor with strong ownership, self-direction, and vendor coordination. 
 - Experience delivering in Agile environments using Jira for sprint planning, estimation, and delivery tracking. 

Functional Expertise

- Strong knowledge of warehouse management, sortation, labeling, and Distribution Center operations. 
 - Hands-on experience integrating with PKMS, Manhattan WMOS, or comparable WMS platforms. 
 - Experience leading third-party vendor integrations, integration platforms, and enterprise web services. 
 - Strong business acumen with the ability to align technology solutions to throughput, accuracy, and cost goals. 

Material Handling Equipment (MHE) Subject-Matter Expertise

- Subject-matter expertise in material handling equipment and warehouse automation, with hands-on integration experience across one or more OEM solution sets: such as Savoye, Opex, Honeywell Intelligrated, Boxer, and bagger / print-and-apply systems. 
 - Deep understanding of MHE process flows - induction, singulation, scanning, sortation, diverts, put walls, unit sortation, carton and bag creation, weigh-in-motion, and label print-and-apply. 
 - Experience defining and supporting MHE interface specifications and message contracts between WMS/WCS/WES and equipment controllers, including carton lifecycle events, divert confirmations, no-reads, exceptions, and recirculation handling. 
 - Hands-on integration with PLCs, barcode scanners, scales, dimensioners, printers, and applicators over TCP/IP, serial, and OPC-style interfaces. 
 - Ability to troubleshoot live MHE issues on the floor - jams, mis-sorts, label misapplication, throughput degradation, and equipment/host message desynchronization - and drive root-cause resolution with vendors. 
 - Experience participating in MHE implementations: interface testing, dry runs, integration and acceptance testing, commissioning, go-live support, and post-go-live hypercare. 
 - Familiarity with MHE performance metrics - units per hour, sort accuracy, divert rates, read rates, and equipment uptime - and using them to tune application behavior. 
 - Ability to act as the technical point of contact and SME for MHE vendors, translating operational requirements into interface and application changes. 

Technical Expertise

- Extensive hands-on experience with multithreading, async/await, and TCP/IP sockets. 
 - Experience with message parsing, custom protocols, and high-volume event processing. 
 - Strong relational database skills and SQL data access patterns across SQL Server, Oracle, and DB2. 
 - Knowledge of ZPL label workflows, logging, diagnostics, and performance tuning. 
 - Experience with CI/CD pipelines, and automated testing. 
 - Working knowledge of secure coding standards, GitHub repository and branching strategies, and code quality tools such as Sonar. 
 - Proficiency with monitoring and observability tools such as AppDynamics, Splunk, ELK, and Grafana, including alert and notification setup. 
 - Familiarity with publisher/subscriber message brokers (Kafka, RabbitMQ) and an understanding of message acknowledgment and idempotent operations. 

AI Skills

- Strong AI-first mindset. 
 - Experience using AI tools, AI agents, and automation platforms to improve operations, production support, data validation, reporting, testing, and documentation. 
 - Ability to design AI-agent led solutions for use cases such as issue triage, exception monitoring, MHE fault pattern detection, report generation, knowledge retrieval, regression testing support, and operational analytics. 
 - Understanding of responsible AI practices, including data privacy, security, auditability, compliance, and validation of AI-generated outputs. 

Leadership

- Demonstrated situational leadership - guiding teams, driving execution, and delivering measurable business value. 
 - Self-driven with strong ownership; comfortable operating as a hands-on individual contributor. 
 - Ability to facilitate productive discussions across DC operations, business, and vendor stakeholder groups and drive alignment. 
 - Experience mentoring engineers and raising engineering standards across a team. 

Education

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent work experience. 

Work Location

- This role is based in Pune, India and follows a hybrid working model. 

Environment

- Socket-based services and Windows Service hosts. 
 - Integration with sortation devices, PLCs, MHE controllers, and WMS/PKMS via TCP. 
 - ZPL label print pipelines and event-forwarding mechanisms. 

About Us - ( https: //www. williams-sonoma. com/ )

Founded in 1956, Williams-Sonoma Inc. is the premier specialty retailer of high-quality products for the kitchen and home in the United States. Today, Williams-Sonoma, Inc. is one of the United States' largest e-commerce retailers with some of the best known and most beloved brands in home furnishings. Our family of brands are Williams-Sonoma, Pottery Barn, Pottery Barn Kids, Pottery Barn Teens, West Elm, Williams-Sonoma Home, Rejuvenation, GreenRow and Mark and Graham. We currently operate retail stores globally. Our products are also available to customers through our catalogs and online worldwide. 

Williams-Sonoma has established a technology center in Pune, India to enhance its global operations. The India Technology Center serves as a critical hub for innovation and focuses on developing cutting-edge solutions in areas such as e-commerce, supply chain optimization, and customer experience management. By integrating advanced technologies like artificial intelligence, data analytics, and machine learning, the India Technology Center plays a crucial role in accelerating Williams-Sonoma's growth and maintaining its competitive edge in the global market.

Your Role at Baxter

As System Verification Test engineer for Infusion pumps team within Medication delivery business, the incumbent will have an independent responsibility of following instructions clearly in executing Test procedures for supporting all activities related to Design Verification of the medical devices. Candidate will also assist in maintaining Lab equipment, work with Design engineers to help build Test fixtures/assemblies and assisting with Lab logistics.

Lead/Execute, perform, summarize and report out verification test activities Medical devices: Which includes but not limited to:

 - Support compliance/ closure of Regulatory and Quality requirements
 - Follow Test instructions and Test protocols. 
 - Follow instructions clearly from Design engineers during Test execution.

data.description:
Overview

The Azure App Testing team in Core AI provide cloud-scale testing capabilities that help developers validate the reliability, performance, and quality of modern applications. This includes Azure Load Testing for performance testing and Playwright Workspaces for end-to-end functional testing, enabling teams to test at scale without managing their own testing infrastructure. As applications increasingly incorporate AI and autonomous agents, testing is evolving and we are extending the platform to various agentic workloads. Playwright Workspaces provides fully managed, cloud-hosted browsers for developers, automation clients and AI agents can connect to remotely for high-scale secure and performant browser automation workloads. 

We are looking for a Principal Software Engineer who can provide deep technical leadership to shape the direction of Azure App Testing and deliver secure, reliable, scalable developer services. In this hands-on individual contributor role, you will lead architecture and implementation across service boundaries, turn ambiguous customer needs into durable platform capabilities, and raise engineering standards through technical leadership and mentorship. 

Responsibilities

- Define and evolve the architecture of distributed, multi-tenant testing services, balancing reliability, performance, security, operability, and cost. 
 - Lead complex initiatives from design and prototyping through implementation, rollout, and sustained operation, while remaining hands-on in coding and deeply engaged in design and code reviews. 
 - Build scalable execution and orchestration capabilities for load testing and managed browser automation, including scheduling, concurrency, isolation, and resilient failure handling. 
 - Shape developer-friendly APIs, tooling, and CI/CD integrations that make testing a natural part of development and release workflows. 
 - Advance AI-assisted testing with rigorous evaluation, observable behaviour, appropriate safeguards, and meaningful measures of quality and customer value. 
 - Drive live-site excellence through actionable telemetry, service-level objectives, incident response, root-cause analysis, and prevention of recurring issues; participate in the team's on-call rotation. 
 - Embed security, privacy, accessibility, and responsible AI into design and delivery, including identity, access control, and protection of customer test data. 
 - Partner with product managers, engineers, architects, security teams, and customers to set priorities, align architecture, resolve dependencies, and deliver cohesive platform capabilities. 
 - Mentor engineers, foster inclusive technical discussions, and improve engineering practices for testing, deployment safety, serviceability, and developer productivity. 

Qualifications

Required qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - 10+ years of extensive experience designing, building, and operating production software, with demonstrated technical leadership on complex initiatives spanning multiple components or teams. 
 - Strong software engineering skills in one or more languages such as C#, Java, C++, Go, Python, or TypeScript, including maintainable design, automated testing, and effective code review. 
 - Deep understanding of distributed systems, service architecture, API design, concurrency, fault tolerance, and performance engineering. 
 - Experience operating cloud services and diagnosing complex production issues using telemetry, debugging, and structured root-cause analysis. 
 - Ability to lead through influence, explain architectural trade-offs, collaborate across disciplines, and mentor engineers. 
 - A customer-focused approach and commitment to secure, reliable, inclusive engineering. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with Azure or comparable cloud platforms, containerised workloads, Kubernetes, and multi-tenant service infrastructure. 
 - Experience with browser automation or end-to-end testing using Playwright, and performance testing using JMeter, Locust, or comparable frameworks. 
 - Experience building developer platforms, SDKs, command-line tools, or integrations with GitHub, Azure DevOps, and CI/CD systems. 
 - Experience improving cloud resource efficiency, execution scheduling, service scalability, and infrastructure cost. 
 - Experience with AI-assisted developer tools or agentic workflows, including evaluation, reliability, and responsible AI practices. 
 - Experience collaborating with open-source communities or building services on open-source technologies.

data.title: Senior QA Test Engineer
data.description:
Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic and labelling is accurate. 

The Eurofins network of companies believes that it is a global leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing and in discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and AgroScience contract research services. It is also one of the market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, and in the support of clinical studies, as well as in biopharma contract development and manufacturing. It also has a rapidly developing presence in highly specialised and molecular clinical diagnostic testing and in-vitro diagnostic products. 

In over 37 years, Eurofins has grown from one laboratory in Nantes, France to over 65, 000 staff across a decentralised and entrepreneurial network of more than 950 laboratories in over 1, 000 companies across 59 countries. Eurofins companies offer a portfolio of over 200, 000 analytical methods to evaluate the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin, traceability and purity of biological substances and products. 

In 2024, Eurofins generated total revenues of EUR 6. 95 billion; and has been among the best performing stocks in Europe over the past 20 years. 

Job Description

Role: Senior QA Test Engineer

Location: Bengaluru, India

Department: Eurofins IT Solutions - eQMS

BPT is enabled by global engineering teams working on next-generation applications and Laboratory Information Management Systems (LIMS). As Senior Automation Engineer, you will be a crucial part of our delivery team, ensuring the product features are completely automated and reducing the idea to live time to Business. As a technology leader, BPT wants to give you the opportunity not just to accept new challenges and opportunities but to impress with your ingenuity, focus, attention to detail and collaboration with a global team of professionals.

Experience: 

- Experience between 5 to 8 yrs. 
 - Expertise in Automation Testing of Web based applications
 - Good experience in building and using automation frameworks using technologies: Java/ C#. 
 - Experience in doing in-sprint automation. 
 - Strong Automation background with experience in identifying and reviewing test cases and testing results.

 - Proficient in creating Test Reports. 
 - Should know about analyzing the Risks. 
 - Prior experience in testing LIMS would be an added advantage. Specific skills required

- Expertise in Automation Testing using Selenium/Specflow/BDD/Protractor/WebDriver IO. 
 - Hands-on experience in programming languages (C#, Java, Python, JavaScript). 
 - Experienced in Creating VM for Automation and setting up the configuration in the test suite and runners. 
 - Hands-on experience in SQL to write medium complex queries (e. g. Joins/sub-queries etc. ). 
 - Good understanding of JSON, XML, REST and experience in testing web services using POSTMAN, REST Assured, JSON Lint, SOAP UI. 
 - Experience with any defect tracking tool like Jira, TFS/MTM, Bugzilla, etc. 
 - Experience on any test management tools like TFS/MTM, ALM, etcDesirable Experience

Additional Information

- Customer-service oriented with a problem-solving attitude; 
 - Strong attention to detail and accuracy is essential; 
 - Entrepreneurial thinking and flexibility to change; 
 - Very good English communication skills (concise writing and orally convincing); 
 - Structured and clear writing skills; 
 - Proven ability to solve complex business problems using analytical reasoning; 
 - Demonstrated positive attitude, self-motivated, team player. PERFORMANCE APPRAISAL CRITERIA: Eurofins has a strong focus on Performance Management system. This includes quarterly calibrations, half-yearly reviews and annual reviews. The KPIs shall be set and may vary slightly between projects. NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.

 - Data integrity and consistency of patch artifacts

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organizations in the world. Guided by our purpose of opening up a world of opportunity, our ambition is to become the world's most trusted bank globally, putting customers at the heart of everything we do. 

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our Chief Technology Office team in the role of CTOi CIB Cloud lead. 

The Opportunity

Head of Corporate and Institutional Banking Cloud is accountable for the strategy, governance, engineering standards, adoption and operational management of cloud services across all Corporate and Institutional Banking functions globally. 

The role holder will lead the development of a consistent, resilient and cost-effective cloud capability across Corporate and Institutional Banking, working in close partnership with the central Chief Technology Office Cloud team to support platform build, adoption and standardization. The role will provide senior leadership across FinOps, infrastructure management, risk and controls, regulatory requirements, cloud architecture, solution design and engineering practices. 

What You Will Do

- Define the target state for cloud adoption, platforms, operating models and engineering capability, aligned with wider Chief Technology Office, Corporate and Institutional Banking and Group technology strategies. 
 - Provide senior leadership across cloud engineering, architecture, infrastructure and governance communities, setting measurable objectives and developing skills, succession and delivery capability. 
 - Establish governance for budgeting, forecasting, cost allocation, chargeback or show back, optimization and variance management. Drive transparent reporting, value assessments and cost-conscious engineering without compromising resilience, security or regulatory obligations. 
 - Ensure cloud platforms and workloads meet required standards for availability, capacity, performance, resilience, recoverability and operational support across their full lifecycle. 
 - Own the cloud risk and control agenda, ensuring effective assessments, evidence, testing, issue remediation, dependency mapping, recovery planning, scenario testing and tolerance compliance. 
 - Act as a credible senior technology representative in regulatory reviews, audits and assurance activities, explaining cloud arrangements clearly and ensuring findings, commitments and obligations are addressed within agreed timescales. 
 - Serve as the primary cloud face-off for Corporate and Institutional Banking business and technology leaders, Chief Operating Office team by translating business needs into secure, scalable and practical solutions while clearly communicating costs, risks, trade-offs, performance and priorities. 
 - Oversee solutions from initial demand through implementation and operational adoption, ensuring alignment with approved architectures, security requirements, data protection, identity, resilience, monitoring, recovery and regulatory expectations. 
 - Define and embed reusable cloud patterns, guardrails and practices covering infrastructure as code, automation, CI/CD, observability, security, resilience and self-service. Partner with the central Chief Technology Office Cloud team to shape platforms, roadmaps, service catalogues and adoption plans. 
 - Lead cloud adoption, infrastructure modernization, application migration, data platform and engineering productivity initiatives, ensuring dependencies, risks, costs, operational impacts and benefits are managed through to sustainable adoption and measurable outcomes. 
 - Working alongside Chief Technology Office central team to set enterprise cloud architecture direction, govern solution design and establish technology standards. 

To be successful in this role, you should meet the following requirements: 

- Leadership experience across cloud, infrastructure, platform engineering or technology transformation in a large, regulated organization. 
 - Extensive expertise in public and hybrid cloud, including networking, compute, storage, databases, identity, security, monitoring and automation. 
 - Proven ability to set enterprise cloud architecture direction, govern solution design and establish technology standards. 
 - Experience in Google Cloud Platform is required

 - Experience building or operating FinOps capabilities covering cost governance, optimization, forecasting and accountability. 
 - Strong understanding of technology risk, control frameworks, operational resilience, audit requirements and regulatory expectations, including representing 
 - technology in formal reviews and assurance engagements. 
 - Experience partnering with central cloud platform teams to build, adopt, govern and standardize enterprise cloud services. 
 - Proven success leading geographically distributed direct and virtual teams to deliver major cloud migration or modernization programmes. 
 - Excellent communication skills with an ability to translate complex technical matters into concise, decision-ready advice for executives, engineers, risk partners, auditors and regulators. 

You'll achieve more at HSBC. 

HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. And we're on a mission to push the boundaries of subscription revenue operations. Not just ours, but every customer and prospective business on a recurring revenue model. 

Our team builds high-quality and innovative software to enable our customers to grow their revenues powered by the state-of-the-art subscription management platform. 

Overview of the Role

We are looking for a Technical Lead - Backend Engineering who thrives in fast-paced environments and believes in getting things done. You will drive initiatives that scale our core systems, balance existing business logic with new innovations, and ensure high reliability and performance across mission-critical components. 

This role requires taking ownership of complex problems, collaborating effectively with peers, and comfortably engaging in both technical and customer-facing discussions. If you're ready to solve challenges at scale and directly impact the revenue engines of our partners, this is the opportunity for you. 

What You'll Work On

Execute with precision: Own technical execution for backend and frontend modules and lead delivery across the team. 

Scale smartly: Enhance and evolve existing backend systems with scalable architecture patterns and thoughtful refactoring-not rewrites for the sake of it. 

Drive backend excellence: Architect high-performance services using Java and Spring Boot, built for scale and uptime. 

Enable observability: Work closely with DevOps to ensure production readiness with robust monitoring and alerting practices on AWS. 

Collaborate cross-functionally: Partner with technical peers, product managers, and occasionally with customer-facing teams to ensure alignment of business and tech priorities. 

Mentor and lead: Grow backend engineering capabilities by providing clear guidance, thoughtful code reviews, and proactive problem-solving. 

What We're Looking For

Technical Expertise

7+ years of backend experience, with recent hands-on development in Java and Spring Boot. 

Proven experience building and scaling systems to handle high throughput, low latency, and event-driven architecture. 

Solid understanding of AWS infrastructure components: EC2, S3, RDS, SQS, VPC, and more. 

Familiarity with DevOps best practices, CI/CD pipelines, and performance tuning. 

Leadership & Execution

Ability to own end-to-end delivery of backend and frontend features with high accountability. 

Pragmatic decision-maker who focuses on value and execution over over-engineering. 

Experience leading and mentoring engineers, conducting design reviews, and managing technical debt effectively. 

Collaboration & Communication

Strong communication skills to influence technical decisions and align with business objectives. 

Comfortable in customer-facing discussions, when needed, to represent technical perspectives. 

Proven ability to collaborate with peers and cross-functional teams in remote/hybrid setups. 

Bonus Points

Prior experience in subscription billing, e-commerce, or high-scale fintech systems. 

Exposure to high-scale event-driven systems

Familiarity with observability tools like Prometheus, Grafana, or DataDog. 

Why Join Chargebee's Engineering Team?

Build features for a platform that processes billions of dollars in revenue annually. 

Work on real challenges of scale, resiliency, and complexity, with ownership from day one. 

Thrive in a hybrid work environment with flexibility and autonomy. 

Recharge with an uncapped leave policy, because sustainable pace matters. 

Benefits

Want to know what it means to work for a company that genuinely cares about you? Check out just a few of the benefits we give our employees: 

We are Globally Local

With a diverse team across four continents, and customers in over 60 countries, you get to work closely with a global perspective right from your own neighborhood. 

We value Curiosity

We believe the next great idea might just be around the corner. Perhaps it's that random thought you had ten minutes ago. We believe in creating an ecosystem that fosters a desire to seek out hard questions, and then figure out answers to them. 

Customer! Customer! Customer!

Everything we do is driven towards enabling our customers' growth. This means no matter what you do, you will always be adding real value to a real business problem. It's a lot of responsibility, but also a lot of fun. 

Ready to build the future of recurring revenue at scale?

Join the Chargebee tribe.

data.title: Principal Engineer - Driver Development
data.description:
Job Description

Primary Duties & Responsibilities

- Design, develop, and maintain C#/. NET-based device drivers and control software for hardware modules used in automated test systems. 
 - Architect scalable driver frameworks to support multiple hardware revisions and device configurations. 
 - Implement robust communication layers (USB, UART, SPI, I2C, Ethernet, or custom interfaces) between host applications and embedded hardware. 
 - Ensure drivers support high reliability, deterministic behavior, and safe hardware interaction in production test environments. 
 - Develop reusable driver libraries and APIs for integration with test automation frameworks and system software. 
 - Work closely with STM32 microcontroller-based boards to develop and validate host-side control drivers. 
 - Interface with embedded firmware teams to define communication protocols, command structures, and data exchange mechanisms. 
 - Support firmware bring-up activities by validating register-level communication and device control sequences. 
 - Understand microcontroller peripherals such as ADC, DAC, GPIO, PWM, SPI, I2C, and UART for driver integration. 
 - Utilize laboratory instrumentation to support debugging and validation activities, including and not limited to Oscilloscopes, Digital Communication Analyzers (DCA), Power supplies, Power meters, Network analyzers. 
 - Perform signal integrity checks, timing measurements, and power characterization during system validation. 
 - Correlate hardware measurements with software logs to identify system issues.
