data.title: Sr. Application Architect
data.description:
Description

The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using the AWS Cloud. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries. 

We are looking for a Senior Application Architect to design and deliver modern, cloud-native applications for AWS Professional Services (ProServe) India customers. In this role, you will own the technical architecture of complex customer engagements, from application assessment and modernization strategy through design, build, and production go-live. You will advise senior customer engineering leaders on how to re-architect, migrate, and modernize their application portfolios on AWS. 

The ideal candidate is a hands-on architect with deep software engineering and IT consulting experience and a proven track record of delivering large-scale distributed applications for enterprise customers. You can work through ambiguous problems with limited guidance and make sound architectural trade-offs across cost, performance, security, and resilience. You thrive in a fast-paced, growth environment, insist on the highest standards, and enjoy mentoring engineers and turning proven patterns into reusable assets for the wider team. 

You will lead technical workstreams made up of AWS consultants, partners, and customer developers, and set the architecture direction across microservices, containers, serverless, APIs, data integration, and DevOps practices. You are expected to write and review code, produce architecture artifacts, run design reviews, and resolve technical risks before they affect delivery. You will also support pre-sales by shaping solution designs and estimates, earn customer trust through technical credibility, and use AI/GenAI (including AI-assisted development tools) to speed up how applications are designed and built. 

In this capacity you will be based in India and are expected to travel occasionally (30-40%). You will report into the India ProServe Application Architecture Delivery Practice Manager. 

Key job responsibilities

We are looking for hands-on architects/developers who are passionate about: 

- Help internal customers make decisions on their cloud and AI journey, define scalable architecture, highly available solutions that leverage AWS services and AI capabilities
 - Assisting internal customers to architect and develop applications that are cloud-optimized and AI-integrated, including Generative AI and Agentic AI solutions
 - Working as a technical leader alongside customer business, development, and infrastructure teams
 - Guiding customers through the AI Development Life Cycle (AI-DLC)/ AI-assisted software engineering, from problem framing, data readiness, and model selection to deployment, evaluation, and continuous improvement. 
 - Sharing deep software development knowledge with respect to cloud architecture, AI design patterns, and programming
 - Advising and implementing AWS best practices for both cloud-native and AI-powered workloads
 - Assisting internal customers in infrastructure, application development, and AI solution integration
 - Assisting internal customers in agile software development and Implementation of DevOps practices
 - Independently leading a team that delivers applications including AI-enabled features spanning the full software lifecycle: design, implementation, testing, deployment, and maintenance strategy
 - Scoping development efforts, identifying risks, and prioritizing deliverables to meet organizational goals; providing guidance so your team designs solutions making the right trade-offs between innovation, speed, and operational excellence

About The Team

Diverse Experiences

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying. 

Why AWS

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating - that's why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses. 

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there's nothing we can't achieve in the cloud. 

Inclusive Team Culture

Here at AWS, it's in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness. 

Mentorship and Career Growth

We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional. 

Basic Qualifications

- 10+ years of technical specialist, design and architecture experience
 - 10+ years of consulting, design and implementation of serverless distributed solutions experience
 - 10+ years of software development with object oriented language experience
 - 10+ years of external or internal customer facing, complex and large scale project management experience
 - Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or equivalent
 - Travel up to 30% of the time

Preferred Qualifications

- 6+ years of leading development of applications backed by AWS services or using other cloud based technologies and services experience
 - Experience with designing and building application using AWS services such as Lambda, AWS Elastic Beanstalk, Kubernetes
 - Experience in one of the following programming languages: Java, Python, Ruby, Node. js, C#, or C
 - Experience in professional, non-internship software development, or experience in machine learning, data mining, information retrieval, statistics or natural language processing
 - Experience with CloudFormation, Chef, Puppet, Salt, or Ansible in production environments
 - Familiarity with AI-DLC / AI-assisted software engineering, data preparation, prompt engineering, model evaluation, and deploying Generative/Agentic AI solutions

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https: //amazon. jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you're applying in isn't listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

data.title: Turbine DCS engineer
data.description:
Company Description Power Plant is a power generation facility focused on delivering reliable, efficient, and safe energy to industrial and domestic consumers. The organization emphasizes high operational standards and adherence to industry regulations, with a strong commitment to preventive maintenance and continuous improvement. Teams work with advanced turbine technologies and digital control systems to optimize performance and minimize downtime. The work environment supports collaboration among engineering, operations, and maintenance personnel, offering opportunities to work on complex technical challenges and large-scale infrastructure projects. 
Role Description The Turbine DCS Engineer is responsible for the operation, monitoring, and optimization of turbine Distributed Control Systems (DCS) at the power plant. This full-time, on-site role in Hyderabad involves configuring control logic, tuning process parameters, and ensuring reliable integration of turbine and auxiliary systems. Day-to-day tasks include diagnosing and resolving control system issues, coordinating with operations and maintenance teams during startups, shutdowns, and planned outages, and implementing modifications to improve performance, safety, and compliance. The engineer will prepare technical documentation, support root-cause analyses, participate in safety and reliability reviews, and collaborate with vendors or contractors as needed for system upgrades and maintenance. 
Qualifications

- Candidates should possess strong skills in Process Control and Control Systems Design, including configuration, logic development, and performance tuning for turbine DCS systems. 
 - Candidates should possess solid Troubleshooting and Instrumentation skills to diagnose control-related issues and work with field devices such as sensors, transmitters, and actuators. 
 - Candidates should possess a foundation in Electrical Engineering, particularly as it applies to power plant systems, protection schemes, and integration of electrical and control equipment. 
 - Relevant experience with turbine control systems (e. g. , OEM DCS platforms), PLCs, SCADA, or similar industrial automation environments is beneficial. 
 - Familiarity with power plant operations, safety standards, and industry regulations, along with the ability to interpret P&IDs, wiring diagrams, and control narratives, is preferred. 
 - Strong analytical, communication, and teamwork skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively in a multi-disciplinary engineering and operations environment. 
 - Bachelor's degree in Electrical, Instrumentation, Control Engineering, or a related technical field; equivalent experience in power generation or industrial control systems may also be considered.

data.title: CAT Modeling (for one of Lloyd’s largest syndicates)
data.description:
Company Description

WNS, part of Capgemini, is an Agentic AI-powered leader in intelligent operations and transformation, serving more than 700 clients across 10 industries, including Banking and Financial Services, Healthcare, Insurance, Shipping and Logistics, and Travel and Hospitality. We bring together deep domain excellence - WNS' core differentiator - with AI-powered platforms and analytics to help businesses innovate, scale, adapt and build resilience in a world defined by disruption. 

Our purpose is clear: to enable lasting business value by designing intelligent, human-led solutions that deliver sustainable outcomes and a differentiated impact. With three global headquarters across four continents, operations in 13 countries, 65 delivery centers and more than 66, 000 employees, WNS combines scale, expertise and execution to create meaningful, measurable impact. 

Job Description

The Role

An exciting opportunity for a Catastrophe Risk Analyst to join a leading Exposure Management team at one of Lloyd's largest syndicates. The successful candidate will be delivering cutting edge analytics to stakeholders across the business for the D&F Property class, which has seen significant growth over the last 12 months. This is an excellent opportunity for a candidate looking to have a material impact at a top Lloyds' syndicate and global (re)insurer. 

As an analyst, you will have a real ability to meaningfully influence the risk selection process. The successful candidate will look to work collaboratively with various internal stakeholders to ensure timely modelling analytics to support risk pricing and wider Catastrophe Management goals. 

Skill mix: Account Modeling + Data Cleansing

CAT Modelers/ Sr. CAT Modelers: 

Responsibilities: 

- Confident and timely delivery of analytics and the ability to explain how these analytics can help drive risk selection. 
 - Use RMS and various other tools to deliver market leading analysis both on individual account and portfolio basis. 
 - Work closely with the Natural Catastrophe Management team, across different regions, to ensure close communication across the team, consistent application of view of risk and contribute to cross-region analytics. 
 - Create a narrative based on the modelling data and other sources to effectively provide a valuable summary of a certain risk and give advice to Underwriters on the strengths and weaknesses of both the data and the model's ability to provide meaningful results. This includes communicating the concept of uncertainty. 
 - Communicate risk metrics to key stakeholders. 
 - Coordinate with the Analytics and Reporting team to ensure timely delivery of data required for internal and external reporting. 

Skills and Experience: 

- Experience in a Cat Modelling role - RMS experience is highly desirable and D&F Property class experience is advantageous. 
 - Highly numerate and logical - strong mathematical/statistical knowledge is advantageous. 
 - Excellent business communication skills - ability to influence, negotiate, and listen. 
 - Ability to manipulate large data sets with strong Excel and SQL skills. 
 - Experience using Microsoft Power BI for analytics is desirable. 
 - Intermediate/Advanced Experience with MS SQL is a strong advantage. Ability to build/design and manipulate queries to improve process. 
 - Familiarity with another programming language such as VBA, . NET, R, Python is an advantage. 

Asst. Manager - CAT Modeling

Responsibilities: 

- Lead and manage catastrophe modeling projects, ensuring timely and high-quality delivery of client and business requirements. 
 - Review, validate, and approve exposure data, data scrubbing activities, quality checks, and model-ready datasets. 
 - Manage and mentor a team of catastrophe modeling analysts, providing technical guidance, training, and performance coaching. 
 - Oversee workload planning, resource allocation, and project prioritization to meet business objectives and service-level expectations. 
 - Drive data quality initiatives by identifying process gaps, implementing controls, and ensuring adherence to quality standards. 
 - Perform complex account, portfolio, and reinsurance analysis using catastrophe modeling platforms and internal tools. 
 - Collaborate with onshore stakeholders, underwriters, brokers, actuaries, and client teams to resolve data and modeling-related queries. 
 - Monitor project risks, track deliverables, and proactively communicate status, issues, and mitigation plans to management. 
 - Develop and enhance standard operating procedures, best practices, and process improvement initiatives. 
 - Review catastrophe model outputs, perform reasonability checks, and provide analytical insights to support business decisions. 
 - Ensure compliance with organizational policies, audit requirements, and data governance standards. 
 - Support transition activities, process documentation, knowledge management, and capability-building initiatives within the team. 

Skills and Experience: 

- 10+ years of experience in Catastrophe Modeling, exposure management, and insurance analytics. 
 - Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Finance, Computer Science, Data Analytics, or a related quantitative discipline. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with catastrophe modeling platforms such as RMS, AIR/Verisk, or equivalent industry-standard tools. 
 - Proven expertise in exposure data review, data cleansing, financial validation, geo-coding, and portfolio quality assurance. 
 - Demonstrated experience in leading teams, managing performance, and developing junior analysts. 
 - Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple deliverables, stakeholders, and competing priorities. 
 - Excellent understanding of insurance and reinsurance concepts, policy structures, CAT modeling methodologies, and financial terms. 
 - Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including complex formulas, Pivot Tables, Power Query, and data analysis techniques. 
 - Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making capabilities. 
 - Excellent verbal and written communication skills with experience interacting with global stakeholders and senior leadership. 
 - Experience driving process improvements, automation initiatives, and operational excellence programs. 
 - Ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment while maintaining high levels of accuracy and quality. 
 - Strong stakeholder management, collaboration, and client-facing skills. 

Qualifications

Bachelor's Degree in Mathematics/ Applied Mathematics/ Statistics/ Operations Research/ Actuarial Science

data.title: Lead Solution Architect - ADMS Presales | Bespoke Applications, Azure & Digital Modernization
data.description:
Job Location: Pune, Noida, Chennai, Bangalore

Location Flexibility: Multiple Locations in Country

Req Id: 12807

Posting Start Date: 10/13/26

At Fujitsu, we've been driven to create a sustainable world through innovation since 1935. Today, we lead in digital transformation globally with our 130, 000 employees across 50+ countries. We empower our diverse community to achieve greatness through career development and opportunities. Explore our internal positions and join us in shaping a brighter future. Thank you for being a part of Fujitsu. We look forward to growing together toward a brighter future. 

Lead Solution Architect- Bespoke Applications, Azure & Digital Modernization

Role family: Business Consulting / Solution Architecture

Technology focus: Azure, web, mobile, APIs, microservices and integration

Ideal Candidate

A customer-oriented Lead Solution Architect who combines broad architectural thinking with hands-on engineering credibility. The candidate should be able to navigate from business problem to solution strategy, defend choices with senior stakeholders, and guide multidisciplinary teams toward a secure, scalable, supportable and commercially viable outcome. 

Role Purpose

Own end-to-end architecture and presales solutioning for bespoke application engagements, translating business needs into secure, scalable and delivery-ready solutions across modern user experiences, cloud-native platforms, integration and application modernization. 

Role Summary

The Lead Solution Architect will provide technical and consulting leadership across complex bespoke application opportunities and transformation programs. The role combines customer-facing presales, application architecture, business and technical analysis, cloud-native engineering, estimation, migration planning and delivery governance. The successful candidate will shape pragmatic solutions that balance business outcomes, user experience, security, operability, cost, risk and delivery feasibility. 

Application Solution Architect

- Lead customer discovery, architecture workshops, and solution definition from opportunity qualification through proposal, solution defence, and transition to delivery. 
 - Own end-to-end architecture across user experience, applications, APIs, integration, data, security, Azure cloud, DevSecOps, observability, and service management. 
 - Translate business and technical requirements into target architectures, modernization roadmaps, estimates, assumptions, dependencies, and delivery-ready artefacts. 
 - Assess legacy applications, technical debt, cloud readiness, and non-functional requirements; define rationalisation and migration strategies using the 6R approach. 
 - Design scalable web, mobile, microservices, event-driven, and cloud-native solutions, selecting technologies based on fit, maintainability, and delivery context. 
 - Lead RFI/RFP/RFQ solutioning, including technical proposals, effort and cost estimates, delivery models, presentations, proofs of concept, solution defence, and commercial clarifications. 
 - Guide design, development, migration, code reviews, testing, CI/CD, security, and resolution of complex engineering risks. 
 - Partner with sales, bid management, delivery, security, cloud, data, service, and commercial teams to ensure solutions are competitive, executable, and supportable. 
 - Establish architecture standards, reusable patterns, governance, and quality gates, and provide leadership through mobilisation and early delivery. 
 - Coach architects and engineering teams and contribute to reference architectures, accelerators, playbooks, and knowledge assets. 

Core Technical Capabilities

- Application architecture: Layered and modular design, domain-driven principles, microservices, event-driven patterns, APIs, integration, and cloud-native design. 
 - Modernisation and migration: Application rationalisation, 6R assessments, technical-debt analysis, monolith decomposition, containerisation, migration sequencing, and roadmap development. 
 - Cloud and engineering: Azure hosting, serverless and container patterns, identity, data services, Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD, DevSecOps, automated testing, observability, SRE-aligned operability, and FinOps-aware decisions. 
 - Design and development: Responsive web and mobile solutions, accessibility, usability, design systems, coding practices, code reviews, testing strategy, and engineering-quality controls. 
 - Programming and frameworks: TypeScript, JavaScript, NativeScript, Angular, React, Flutter, Spring Boot, and Node. js. 
 - Analysis and delivery: Requirements elicitation, process and capability analysis, functional decomposition, NFR definition, dependency analysis, solution option assessment, backlog shaping, sprint planning, and Agile architecture governance. 
 - Architecture governance: Context, component, deployment, integration, data, security, and NFR views; decision records; traceability; architecture reviews; standards compliance; risk management; and handover criteria. 

Leadership and Consulting Skills

- Excellent executive communication, presentation, facilitation, and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to explain complex technical decisions in business terms. 
 - Strong analytical, estimation, troubleshooting, and structured problem-solving capability, with clear articulation of trade-offs. 
 - Customer-focused and commercially aware, with an understanding of how architecture choices affect cost, risk, schedule, scalability, serviceability, and competitive positioning. 
 - Collaborative and credible across matrix teams, cultures, and time zones, with the ability to influence without authority and manage competing priorities. 
 - Strong ownership, adaptability, resilience, quality orientation, and the ability to coach architects and engineers. 

Experience And Qualifications

- Significant experience in application solution architecture, bespoke software engineering, technology consulting, or an equivalent customer-facing role. 
 - Demonstrated experience designing and modernising enterprise applications across web, mobile, API, integration, and cloud platforms. 
 - Experience leading architecture and solutioning across presales and delivery, including estimation, proposal development, and transition to implementation. 
 - Practical understanding of Azure solution patterns, security, resilience, integration, DevSecOps, operational readiness, and Agile delivery. 
 - Bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience. 
 - Relevant cloud, architecture, Agile, project-management, or engineering certifications are desirable. 

Technology and Platform Exposure

Front end and mobile: Angular, React, Flutter, NativeScript, TypeScript, JavaScript, responsive design and accessibility. 

Back end and APIs: Spring Boot, Node. js, REST/GraphQL APIs, microservices, event-driven services and API management. 

Cloud and containers: Microsoft Azure, containers, Kubernetes, serverless services, platform services, hybrid integration and cloud governance. 

Integration and Middleware: API gateways, messaging, event streaming, enterprise integration patterns and service-to-service security. 

Engineering and delivery: Git-based engineering, CI/CD, automated testing, code quality, DevSecOps, Infrastructure as Code and environment strategy. 

Operations: Monitoring, logging, tracing, alerting, resilience, backup/recovery, service readiness and support transition. 

Relocation Supported: Yes

Visa Sponsorship Approved: No

We believe that hiring people from a wide variety of backgrounds makes us stronger, not because it's the right thing to do, but because it allows us to draw on a wider range of perspectives and life experiences.

Role Title - Staff Software Engineer

Business Unit- Group Security

Location- Bangalore- Manyata tech Park

Impact and Contributions: As a Staff Software Engineer - Identity Graph & Signals, you will be one of the senior individual contributors responsible for the technical direction and engineering quality of a strategic identity platform. 

The platform will build a connected representation of identities across people, privileged identities, service accounts, workloads, applications, devices, credentials, entitlements and resources. It will combine that graph with near-real-time identity and security signals to enable stronger identity intelligence, risk detection and dynamic security decisions. 

You will work on problems spanning distributed systems, graph modelling, event-driven architectures, identity security and large-scale data processing. 

This is a hands-on Staff engineering role. You will design systems, write production software, make consequential architecture decisions and raise engineering capability across the team. You will influence engineers and teams beyond your immediate delivery scope without relying on organisational authority. 

Key Responsibilities

You will: 

- Provide technical leadership for the architecture, design and evolution of the Identity Graph & Signals platform. 
 - Design and build highly available, secure and scalable distributed services that ingest, normalise, correlate and serve identity relationships and security signals. 
 - Define graph models capable of representing complex relationships between human identities, non-human identities, applications, workloads, accounts, credentials, entitlements, devices and resources. 
 - Engineer high-volume ingestion and event-processing pipelines for identity, authentication, authorisation, entitlement, device, workload and security telemetry. 
 - Develop APIs and services that allow identity relationships and signals to be consumed by authentication, authorisation, access governance, privileged access, detection and response, and other security capabilities. 
 - Solve difficult problems involving entity resolution, identity correlation, temporal relationships, graph traversal, event ordering, data quality, consistency, scale and low-latency access. 
 - Establish clear architectural boundaries, domain models, APIs, engineering patterns and technical standards that allow the platform to evolve safely. 
 - Make pragmatic engineering trade-offs across performance, reliability, security, maintainability, cost and speed of delivery. 
 - Remain deeply hands-on with production code, prototypes, design reviews and complex engineering problems. 
 - Lead technical design and code reviews, particularly for changes that affect platform architecture, security boundaries, reliability or long-term maintainability. 
 - Build security into the platform by design, including strong workload identity, authentication and authorisation, least privilege, encryption, secrets management and auditable access patterns. 
 - Design for operability from the beginning, using observability, SLOs, automated testing, deployment automation and production telemetry to continuously improve reliability. 
 - Work closely with identity architects, security engineers, product teams, data engineers and application teams across India and Australia. 
 - Identify architectural risks and systemic engineering issues early and drive them through to resolution. 
 - Mentor senior engineers and strengthen engineering capability through technical leadership, design thinking and high engineering standards. 
 - Contribute reusable patterns and engineering practices to the broader CommBank engineering community. 

Requirement-

We are looking for an engineer with substantial experience designing and building complex production systems. 

You will bring: 

- Typically 12+ years of software engineering experience, or equivalent depth of experience building and operating complex production systems. 
 - Demonstrated Staff-level technical leadership across systems or initiatives spanning multiple engineers, teams or domains. 
 - Exceptional software engineering capability in at least one modern backend language such as Java, Kotlin, Go, C#, Python or equivalent, with the ability to work effectively across a broader technology stack. 
 - Strong experience designing distributed, highly available and horizontally scalable systems. 
 - Deep understanding of API design, asynchronous processing, event-driven architectures, concurrency, failure handling and distributed-system trade-offs. 
 - Experience building platforms that process large volumes of data or events with demanding requirements for reliability, latency and correctness. 
 - Strong data-modelling capability across one or more of relational, document, key-value, search or graph data stores. 
 - Experience with cloud-native engineering on AWS, Azure or comparable cloud platforms. 
 - Strong engineering practices across automated testing, CI/CD, infrastructure automation, observability, production support and secure software development. 
 - A record of simplifying complex technical problems and turning ambiguous requirements into coherent architectures and working software. 
 - The ability to influence architecture and engineering decisions across teams while remaining collaborative and open to challenge. 
 - Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex technical decisions and trade-offs clearly. 

Highly Desirable

Direct experience in every area below is not required. Strong engineers with adjacent experience are encouraged to apply. 

Experience in one or more of the following would be highly regarded: 

- Graph databases and graph processing, including Amazon Neptune, Neo4j, JanusGraph or equivalent technologies. 
 - Graph modelling, graph traversal languages such as Gremlin or openCypher, entity resolution or relationship analytics. 
 - Large-scale streaming and event platforms such as Kafka, Kinesis, Event Hubs or equivalent. 
 - Identity and Access Management architectures involving OAuth 2. 0, OpenID Connect, SAML, SCIM, authentication, authorisation, identity governance or privileged access management. 
 - Modern workload and non-human identity patterns, including service identities, workload identities, certificates, secrets and machine credentials. 
 - Identity-security or cybersecurity telemetry, detection engineering, risk signals or continuous access evaluation. 
 - Technologies and patterns such as SPIFFE/SPIRE, Microsoft Entra, CyberArk, SailPoint, Ping Identity, HashiCorp Vault or equivalent platforms. 
 - Large-scale security, fraud, observability, recommendation, knowledge-graph or other systems where relationships and real-time signals are central to decision-making. 

What Success Looks Like

Within this role, success means more than delivering individual features. 

You will have helped create a platform where: 

- identity relationships can be understood across previously disconnected systems; 
 - identity and security signals can be processed and acted upon quickly; 
 - downstream teams can consume reliable identity intelligence through well-designed platform interfaces; 
 - architectural decisions enable rather than constrain future use cases; 
 - reliability, security and operability are intrinsic to the design; 
 - engineers around you make better technical decisions because of your influence; and
 - the platform becomes a reusable strategic capability rather than another isolated identity system. 

The Engineering Opportunity

Identity is changing. 

The traditional model of managing users, accounts and entitlements in separate systems is increasingly insufficient for cloud, APIs, workloads, AI agents and other non-human identities. Security decisions increasingly depend on understanding the relationships between identities, resources, privileges and behaviour, and on being able to respond to signals as circumstances change. 

The Identity Graph & Signals team is building that foundation at CommBank scale. 

For the right engineer, this is an opportunity to solve technically difficult problems, shape a new platform rather than inherit a finished one, and have material influence over how identity security evolves across one of Australia's largest technology environments. 

Education Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience. 

If you're already part of the Commonwealth Bank Group (including Bankwest, x15ventures), you'll need to apply through Sidekick to submit a valid application. We're keen to support you with the next step in your career. 

We're aware of some accessibility issues on this site, particularly for screen reader users. We want to make finding your dream job as easy as possible, so if you require additional support please contact HR Direct on 1800 989 696.

data.title: AIOps Platform Engineer Senior Associate Director, Software Engineering
data.description:
Some careers shine brighter than others. 

If you're looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC and fulfil your potential. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further. 

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions. 

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Senior Associate Director, Software Engineering

We are seeking an experienced Senior AIOps Engineer to design, build, and operate the autonomous agents that turn observability data into safe, closed-loop operational action. You will sit at the intersection of service observability and agentic AI: connecting agents to metrics, logs, traces, events, change data, and service topology so they can detect, diagnose, and remediate production issues with minimal human intervention. You will define how agents reason over telemetry, which tools and runbooks they can call, the guardrails and approval gates that keep their actions safe, and the feedback loops that make them smarter after every incident. This role moves us from dashboards people have to watch to a self-healing production estate where AI observes, decides, and acts - and humans stay in control. 

In This Role, You Will

- Design and build autonomous AIOps agents (LLM-based and multi-agent) that run the full operational loop - observe, correlate, diagnose, decide, act, and verify - across incident triage, root-cause analysis, and auto-remediation 
 - Connect agents to the observability estate (OpenTelemetry, Grafana, Tempo/Jaeger, APM, CMDB, change and deployment events) through well-defined tools/APIs and MCP servers, giving agents real-time, topology-aware context to reason over 
 - Turn observability signals into autonomous action: build event-driven triggers on SLO burn-rate, anomaly, and correlated alert patterns that launch agent workflows such as rollback, restart, scale-out, failover, traffic shift, config fix, or ticket enrichment 
 - Build the agent action layer: convert runbooks into machine-executable, idempotent actions (runbook-as-code), with pre-checks, blast-radius limits, dry-run modes, automatic rollback, and post-action health verification against SLIs 
 - Implement guardrails and human-in-the-loop controls: risk-tiered autonomy levels, policy-as-code, approval gates for high-risk changes, full audit trails, and explainable reasoning for every decision an agent makes 
 - Apply AI to observability data: anomaly detection, forecasting, alert noise reduction, event correlation, and retrieval-augmented reasoning over past incidents, runbooks, and post-mortems to speed up RCA and cut MTTD/MTTR 
 - Build evaluation and observability for the agents themselves: trace agent reasoning and tool calls, measure accuracy, action success rate, false-action rate, latency, and cost; run replay/simulation and chaos tests before increasing autonomy in production 
 - Partner with SRE, platform, and application teams to onboard services to autonomous operations, set standards and reusable patterns, and coach engineers on using AI + observability to automate their own operational workflows

To be successful in this role, you should meet the following requirements: 

- 10+ years overall experience with 5+ years in SRE, AIOps, observability, or platform engineering. 
 - Proven hands-on development of autonomous agents using frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, AutoGen, Semantic Kernel, or equivalent; strong grasp of tool/function calling, MCP, planning, memory, and multi-agent orchestration 
 - Deep service observability expertise: OpenTelemetry, , Grafana, , Jaeger/Tempo, or enterprise APM (Splunk, AppDynamics); strong PromQL/LogQL/SQL and SLO/SLI/error-budget design 
 - Track record of delivering closed-loop auto-remediation in production that measurably reduced MTTR, alert noise, or manual toil, with clear safety controls and rollback 
 - Strong Python (Go a plus) with experience building event-driven services and integrations across Kubernetes, CI/CD, ITSM (ServiceNow), and automation tools. 
 - Practical knowledge of applied ML and LLM techniques for operations: anomaly detection, time-series forecasting, event correlation, RAG, prompt engineering, and evaluation of LLM outputs 
 - Understanding of responsible and secure AI in regulated environments: least-privilege agent access, PII redaction, auditability, model risk management, and change-control compliance 
 - Demonstrated technical leadership, with experience mentoring and leading engineers, setting engineering direction, reviewing designs, and developing team capability while influencing risk partners and senior stakeholders

You'll achieve more when you join HSBC. 

www. hsbc. com/careers

HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc. , We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

data.title: Quality Assurance Manager
data.description:
About the Role: 

We are looking for an experienced and technically sound Quality Manager - Solar Ground Mount (C&I) to lead and manage Quality Assurance and Quality Control (QA/QC) activities for our Solar Ground-Mounted Commercial & Industrial projects. 

The ideal candidate should have strong experience in solar EPC project execution, quality management systems, site inspections, material quality assessments, testing and commissioning. The incumbent will be responsible for ensuring that project execution and installation activities comply with approved engineering designs, client specifications, applicable quality standards and regulatory requirements. 

Key Roles & Responsibilities: 

1. Quality Planning & Management

- Prepare and implement Project Quality Plans (PQP), Inspection & Test Plans (ITPs) and method statements for solar projects. 
 - Establish and maintain quality management systems in accordance with ISO 9001 requirements and project specifications. 

2. Civil, Mechanical & Electrical Quality

- Develop and implement quality inspection checklists for civil, mechanical and electrical activities. 
 - Monitor piling, pull-out and lateral load tests, foundation inspections, concrete cube testing, MMS erection, structural alignment and torque checks. 
 - Ensure quality compliance throughout project execution. 

3. Material & Vendor Quality

- Plan and witness Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT) and pre-dispatch inspections for PV modules, inverters, transformers, MMS structures, cables and switchgear. 
 - Verify incoming materials against approved technical specifications, test certificates and applicable BIS/IEC requirements. 
 - Evaluate vendor and subcontractor quality performance. 

4. Solar Module Quality & Electrical Testing

- Ensure proper handling and installation of solar modules as per OEM guidelines. 
 - Coordinate Electroluminescence (EL) and IV-curve testing wherever specified. 
 - Supervise insulation resistance, polarity, string Voc/Isc, earthing resistance, transformer and switchgear testing. 

5. Testing, Commissioning & Compliance

- Support pre-commissioning and commissioning activities. 
 - Coordinate CEIG/CEA inspections and ensure compliance with applicable regulatory requirements. 
 - Coordinate with clients, consultants and third-party inspection agencies. 

6. Non-Conformance & Corrective Actions

- Identify, raise, track and close Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs). 
 - Conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and implement Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA). 
 - Drive continuous improvement to reduce recurring defects, rework and quality deviations. 

7. Audits, Documentation & MIS

- Conduct internal quality audits and coordinate client, consultant and third-party quality audits. 
 - Maintain inspection records, testing reports, calibration records, quality registers and project quality dossiers. 
 - Prepare and monitor quality KPIs, including NCR status, inspection progress, first-pass yield and audit findings. 

8. Team Management & Continuous Improvement

- Lead and guide QA/QC engineers and inspectors across project sites. 
 - Train site engineers, supervisors and subcontractors on quality requirements. 
 - Share project learnings and implement measures to improve overall quality performance. 

Required Qualifications & Experience

- B. E. / B. Tech in Electrical, Mechanical or Civil Engineering from a recognised institute. 
 - 5-10 years of overall professional experience. 
 - Minimum 3-5 years of relevant QA/QC experience, preferably in Solar EPC project execution. 
 - Strong exposure to utility-scale and ground-mounted solar power projects. 
 - Hands-on experience in site inspections, material quality, testing and commissioning. 
 - Experience in managing QA/QC teams, vendors and subcontractors. 

Technical Skills & Competencies

- Strong understanding of QA/QC processes, Project Quality Plans, ITPs and ISO 9001. 
 - Knowledge of IEC 61215, IEC 61730, IEC 62446, relevant IS codes and CEA regulations. 
 - Experience in civil, mechanical and electrical quality inspections. 
 - Knowledge of RCA, 5-Why Analysis, Fishbone Diagram, CAPA and Pareto Analysis. 
 - Working knowledge of solar PV modules, inverters, MMS structures and solar plant installation. 
 - Proficiency in MS Excel for inspection trackers, NCR logs and KPI dashboards. 
 - Ability to prepare quality reports, audit documentation and management presentations. 
 - Strong communication, coordination and team leadership skills. 

Preferred / Additional Exposure

- ISO 9001: 2015 Lead Auditor / Internal Auditor certification. 
 - Six Sigma Green Belt or higher. 
 - Solar PV quality and inspection certifications. 
 - NDT Level II or Welding Quality / Civil QA/QC certifications. 
 - Experience working with large Independent Power Producers (IPPs). 
 - Exposure to PSU/Government solar tenders, including SECI, NTPC and State Renewable Energy Agencies. 
 - Experience handling Owner's Engineer audits and third-party inspections. 
 - Exposure to pooling substations and Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) projects. 

Key Performance Parameters

- Compliance with approved Project Quality Plans and inspection standards. 
 - Timely completion of material, civil, mechanical and electrical inspections. 
 - Reduction in quality defects, rework and recurring non-conformities. 
 - Timely closure of NCRs and implementation of CAPA. 
 - Successful completion of internal, client and third-party quality audits. 
 - Accurate and timely submission of quality documentation and project handover dossiers. 
 - Vendor and subcontractor quality performance. 

Why Join Sadbhav Futuretech Limited?

- Opportunity to work on large-scale renewable energy projects. 
 - Professional development and career growth opportunities. 
 - Employee medical insurance as per company policy. 
 - ESOP benefits as per company policy and eligibility. 
 - Opportunity to contribute to India's growing renewable energy sector. 

Interested in Joining Us?

If you have strong experience in Solar EPC Quality Management and are passionate about maintaining high-quality standards across solar projects, we would be happy to connect with you. 

Share your updated CV at: sanjay. dhami@sadbhavfuturetech. com

data.title: Senior Solutions Automation Engineer
data.description:
Description

Hungry, Humble, Honest, with a Heart. 

The Opportunity

Nutanix Validated Designs (NVDs) certify Nutanix Solutions cross-product interoperability at scale. Solutions Automation Engineers build the software behind that certification: the programmatic environment builds and validation workflows that Solutions Architects and Quality Engineering rely on. 

We are changing how that work gets done. Standing up infrastructure is already a solved problem for us, because our Python infrastructure-as-code tooling builds the same environment the same way every time. Judgment is the harder part, and it covers reading a validated design, catching the contradictions buried in it, and justifying every design decision before anything gets built. That is the work we are handing to agents. 

In this role you will write the deterministic Python that has to be correct on every run, and you will build the agentic workflows around it: the prompts, the skills, the guardrails, and the evaluations that decide when an agent can act on its own and when control belongs to a pipeline or to a person. 

You will work on hard problems at scale, with the freedom to deliver, alongside engineers who care about getting it right. 

Your Role

- Design, build, and maintain Python software that deploys, configures, and validates Nutanix private and hybrid cloud environments. 
 - Build agentic workflows around that software, including prompt engineering, agent skill and tool development, and the evaluation harnesses that show a workflow works before we rely on it. 
 - Decide what belongs in deterministic code and what belongs to an agent, and be able to defend that decision. Most of what you deliver should be deterministic and repeatable, with agents used where the problem involves ambiguity, synthesis, or design judgment. 
 - Use agentic coding tools in your daily work, and help raise the team's practice as the tooling changes. 
 - Build and operate cloud native, automated pipelines, covering containerized workloads, CI/CD, and infrastructure as code, so that builds and validations run without manual intervention. 
 - Automate validation as part of building the feature, and catch regressions before a release reaches a customer. 
 - Analyze failures, determine root cause, and drive fixes to closure. 
 - Demo your work to Solutions Architects, product teams, and customers, and write documentation that other people can actually use. 
 - Engage with customers and support when needed to solve production issues. 

What You'll Bring

- Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or a related field. 
 - 6+ years building production software, with real depth in at least one role. 
 - Python is required. We are looking for production-grade depth and the ability to own a Python codebase that other people depend on. 
 - Hands-on experience building with LLMs and agentic tooling: prompt engineering, agent skills or tool definitions, and testing and evaluating non-deterministic systems. 
 - Good judgment about where automation should be deterministic and where an agent adds value, and the discipline to keep the trusted path in code. 
 - Strong fundamentals in Object-Oriented Programming, algorithms, data structures, and problem solving. 
 - Cloud native delivery experience: containerized applications (Docker, Kubernetes) and automated CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Experience working against REST APIs and building infrastructure as code. 
 - Experience with a "systems" product such as storage, virtualization, networking, databases, or operating systems. 
 - Skill in debugging complex distributed applications. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication, and the confidence to present technical work to customers and senior stakeholders. 
 - A self-starter who can work independently, juggle competing priorities, respect differences, and maintain professionalism under pressure. 

Nice to Have

- Additional languages beyond Python: Golang, JavaScript, TypeScript, Node. js, React, Angular, etc. 
 - Experience with Terraform, Ansible, or comparable infrastructure as code tooling. 
 - Background as a platform engineer, SRE, or solutions architect who writes production code. 
 - Experience with Jira, GitHub, Artifactory, and modern CI systems. 
 - Public evidence of your work: GitHub projects, open source contributions, or published technical writing. 

--

data.title: Shift Manager
data.description:
Business Unit: 

Cubic Transportation Systems

Company Details: 

When you join Cubic, you become part of a company that creates and delivers technology solutions in transportation to make people's lives easier by simplifying their daily journeys, and defense capabilities to help promote mission success and safety for those who serve their nation. Led by our talented teams around the world, Cubic is committed to solving global issues through innovation and service to our customers and partners. 

We have a top-tier portfolio of businesses, including Cubic Transportation Systems (CTS) and Cubic Defense (CD). Explore more on Cubic. com. 

Job Details: 

Job Summary

As a Shift Coordinator on the CTS 24x7 Service Operations team, you will provide direct supervision to Tier 1 and Tier 2 staff across the Network Operations Center (NOC), Security Operations Center (SOC), and Service Desk during your assigned shift. You act as the technical and operational command authority during the shift. You are responsible for ensuring that events across all three functions are correctly triaged, tickets are properly assigned and tracked, incidents are escalated per defined protocols, and shift handovers preserve full situational awareness for the incoming shift. 

You are responsible for confirming shift staffing coverage in real time and for adjusting assignments to accommodate last-minute absences. You are the immediate escalation path for issues that exceed the authority of the Tier 1 and Tier 2 analysts on the shift, and you escalate to the Director of Technical Service Operations for issues that exceed shift authority. 

Work is conducted under the compliance frameworks that govern CTS operations, in particular ITIL 4 (Monitoring and Event Management, Incident Management, Continual Improvement), ISO/IEC 27001: 2022 (Annex A logging, monitoring, and incident management controls), and PCI DSS v4. 0. 1 (Requirements 10 and 12. 10). You will be recognized inside CTS as the shift-level owner for cross-function coordination and evidence continuity. 

Responsibilities

Essential Job Duties and Responsibilities

Shift Command and Team Coordination

- Provide direct supervision to Tier 1 and Tier 2 NOC, SOC, and Service Desk analysts during the assigned shift. 
 - Assign work at shift start and re-balance workload throughout the shift based on ticket volume, incident severity, and individual analyst capacity. 
 - Confirm complete shift coverage across NOC, SOC, and Service Desk queues at shift start; adjust in real time when staff are unavailable because of sick calls, unplanned PTO, or emergency absence. 
 - Serve as the initial escalation point for any Tier 1 or Tier 2 analyst who needs additional authority, judgment, or cross-functional coordination. 
 - Track and report shift-level metrics (ticket volume, SLA adherence, incident count by severity) at shift close. 

Shift Handover Discipline

- Execute a formal shift handover at the start and end of every shift, per the protocols defined in the NOC Scope Definition and the CTS SOC Scope of Operations. 
 - Ensure the handover record captures, at minimum: open incidents with owner and next action; active containment actions in progress; watchlist items; active maintenance windows; tooling or coverage gaps. 
 - Retain handover records as ISMS evidence supporting ISO/IEC 27001: 2022 A. 5. 10 and ITIL 4 Monitoring and Event Management practice. 

Incident Management Coordination

- Apply ITIL 4 Incident Management practice throughout the shift: validate alerts, classify severity, assign ownership, coordinate escalation, and track resolution against SLA. 
 - Coordinate the first 15 to 30 minutes of any SEV 0 or SEV 1 incident: declare the incident, engage the appropriate tiers, initiate stakeholder communications, and hand off to the Incident Commander or on-call Tier 3 engineer. 
 - Enforce severity special rules from the NOC Scope Definition (for example, loss of logging or monitoring is never a SEV 4 event; SEV 0 or SEV 1 with a recent production change requires a change correlation step). 
 - Ensure joint NOC-SOC coordination during Major Incidents: NOC leads operational recovery; SOC leads security investigation and containment; the Shift Coordinator maintains the shared incident bridge until the Incident Commander takes over. 

Cross-Function Ticket Routing and Escalation

- Monitor NOC, SOC, and Service Desk queues in the ITSM platform; ensure tickets are correctly categorized and assigned per the RACI. 
 - Route security-relevant events from the NOC or Service Desk to the SOC per the defined Escalation pathway with enriched context. 
 - Route operational recovery actions from the SOC to the NOC or regional IT Operations per the defined protocol. 
 - Escalate to the Director of Technical Service Operations for any issue that exceeds shift authority. 

Compliance Evidence and Documentation

- Ensure shift activities produce audit-ready evidence supporting PCI DSS v4. 0. 1 Requirement 10 and Requirement 12. 10, and ISO/IEC 27001: 2022 A. 5. 24-A. 5. 28 and A. 8. 15-A. 8. 16. 
 - Verify handover records, incident timelines, and containment action logs are complete and accurate before shift close. 
 - Support monthly and quarterly evidence pack preparation. 

Continuous Improvement Contribution

- Identify recurring patterns during the shift (repeat incidents, noisy alerts, gaps in playbook coverage) and log them for review by the NOC, SOC, and Service Desk Managers. 
 - Participate in post-incident reviews and contribute to the Continual Improvement Register per ITIL 4 Continual Improvement practice. 
 - Recommend changes to shift-level procedures where the shift experience identifies opportunities. 

General Duties And Responsibilities

- Reliably demonstrate accountability for work assignments and proactive communications about issues and status. A strong history of proactively identifying effective solutions for challenges. 
 - Able to work effectively and uphold professional standards, with the customer and system stakeholders. 
 - Self-motivated and able to work unsupervised. 
 - Methodical and attentive to detail. 
 - Proactive in seeking advice from senior operations and security subject matter experts when required. 
 - Comfortable working with staff at all levels and in other geographical locations within the organization. 
 - Comply with Cubic's Quality Management System. 
 - Comply with Cubic's quality, health, safety, and security policies. 
 - Support the company's strategic objectives and collaborate across departments. 
 - Comply with Cubic Human Resources Procedures. 

Skills / Experience / Knowledge

Essential: 

- Experience providing direct supervision to a team of individual contributors in a technology operations, security operations, or service desk environment. 
 - Working knowledge of NOC operations: event monitoring, incident management, SLA management, change and configuration control. 
 - Working knowledge of SOC operations: SIEM and EDR alert triage, security incident classification, escalation protocols. 
 - Working knowledge of Service Desk operations under a Tier 1-3 tiered model. 
 - Familiarity with ITIL 4 practices, in particular Monitoring and Event Management and Incident Management. 
 - Ability to interpret and explain incident status, containment actions, and escalation decisions to peers, subordinate staff, and functional peer groups. Consistent with Cubic Path Matrix M2 Collaboration and Interaction expectations. 
 - Sound judgment in resolving problems that require analysis of data and relevant factors under real-time pressure. Consistent with Cubic Path Matrix M2 Complexity and Problem Solving expectations. 
 - Ability to develop and manage routine operational plans and meet targets against a monthly performance plan. Consistent with Cubic Path Matrix M2 Discretion and Impact expectations. 
 - Experience preparing accurate shift reports and handover records. 
 - Comfort operating 24x7 shift patterns, including nights, weekends, and public holidays. 

Desirable: 

- Familiarity with PCI DSS v4. 0. 1 requirements, in particular Requirement 10, Requirement 11. 5, and Requirement 12. 10. 
 - Familiarity with ISO/IEC 27001: 2022 Annex A controls covering logging (A. 8. 15), monitoring activities (A. 8. 16), and incident management (A. 5. 24 to A. 5. 28). 
 - Exposure to NIST Cybersecurity Framework 2. 0 (NIST CSWP 29) Detect and Respond Functions. 
 - Working knowledge of ServiceNow (or equivalent enterprise ITSM) and Jira. 
 - Understanding of the ITIL 4 Major Incident model and Problem Management practice. 
 - Experience coordinating across NOC, SOC, and Service Desk boundaries. 

Qualifications

Essential: 

- Must be able to work on-site at Cubic Hyderabad, Aparna Plaza, on a 24x7 rotating shift pattern. 
 - Minimum 5-8 years of related experience with a Bachelor's degree. 
 - University degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or other technical field; or Business Administration with relevant IT work experience. 
 - At least 5 years of experience in a Tier 1-3 operations environment (NOC, SOC, Service Desk, or NOC/SOC hybrid). 
 - At least 3 years' experience managing shift workers. 
 - Demonstrated ability to make severity classification and escalation decisions in a real-time operations setting. 
 - Demonstrated ability to lead a team through a shift, including workload assignment, coaching, and formal handover. 
 - At least 3 years' experience working in an ITIL 4 operation. 

Desirable: 

- ITIL 4 Foundation certification; ITIL 4 Managing Professional or Strategic Leader preferred. 
 - CompTIA Security+, ISC2 SSCP, or equivalent security operations certification. 
 - ServiceNow ITSM administrator or user certification. 
 - Experience in a payment card processing environment, or in a similarly regulated real-time operations environment. 
 - Experience with global follow-the-sun shift models spanning NAM, EMEA, and APAC time zones. 

Condition of Employment: 

Successful outcome of a National Police Check

The description provided above is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all job duties, responsibilities and requirements. Duties, responsibilities and requirements may change over time and according to business need. 



Worker Type: 

Employee



We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace and welcome applications from people of all backgrounds. We do not discriminate based on any protected characteristic under applicable law.

data.title: Platform Engineering Manager
data.description:
About Euromonitor

Euromonitor International leads the world in data analytics and research into markets, industries, economies and consumers. We provide truly global insight and data on thousands of products and services; we are the first destination for organisations seeking growth. With our guidance, our clients can make bold, strategic decisions with confidence. 

Overview Of The Role

The Platform Engineering Manager leads Cloud Engineering and Platform Engineering teams distributed globally, creating the conditions for engineers to do their best work. The role is a people-first leadership position with strong technical leadership accountability: setting direction, removing obstacles, and ensuring the team delivers reliable platform capabilities that enable product teams to move quickly and safely. 

The Manager partners closely with Team Leaders to build a healthy, inclusive, and high-performing culture grounded in trust and psychological safety. They hire, coach, and develop engineers and leaders through regular 1: 1s, feedback, and performance reviews, applying servant leadership and demonstrating empathy for day-to-day engineering challenges (delivery pressure, incidents, technical debt, ambiguity) while supporting sustainable pace. 

The Manager provides technical leadership focused on enabling product teams through value-add platform services and capabilities. They bring a deep understanding of the problems software engineers face when building and running products-delivery friction, environment inconsistency, reliability issues, security constraints, and managing technical debt-and use that insight to shape platform roadmaps, standards, and guardrails that remove toil and accelerate delivery. 

They own the team's backlog and roadmap, aligning stakeholders on outcomes and priorities: gathering requirements and feedback, translating them into well-shaped work items, and facilitating collaboration across teams. They ensure functional and non-functional requirements are captured, and they play a key role in FinOps governance to manage public cloud costs responsibly. When critical issues occur, the Manager helps coordinate an effective response to restore service quickly and drive learning through clear follow-up actions. 

Requirements

What you'll do

People Leadership & Team Health - Hire, coach and develop engineers and Team Leaders through regular 1: 1s, feedback and performance reviews; foster an inclusive, psychologically safe culture; maintain sustainable pace and team morale; and actively remove blockers so the team can deliver. 

Delivery, Backlog & Stakeholder Alignment - Own and prioritise the backlog and roadmap for platform services/capabilities; align stakeholders and product teams on outcomes, scope and timelines; manage dependencies, risks and delivery plans; communicate clearly "why" and "what" to the team; and ensure services are production-ready (SLAs/SLOs, runbooks, on-call readiness, release and change practices). 

Continuous Improvement - Drive continuous improvement based on data and feedback; identify and remove sources of toil and delivery friction; and improve developer experience for product teams through automation, standardisation and self-service capabilities. 

Strategy & Outcomes - Define team goals/OKRs aligned to company and technology strategy; translate strategy into an executable roadmap; balance near-term delivery with platform sustainability (reliability, security, maintainability, cost)

Learning & Technical Currency - Stay current with public cloud services, CNCF ecosystem and modern engineering practices; bring relevant ideas into the roadmap; and ensure the team has time and support to learn and apply them pragmatically. 

Technical Leadership & Platform Design - Provide technical leadership on platform and cloud solution design, applying strong software engineering principles and non-functional requirements (scalability, reliability, security, operability). data.title: Technical Director (Unreal 5)
data.description:
About Shortgun and Project Takedown

Shortgun is an ambitious, homegrown Indian studio pioneering premium console game development from the heart of the country. Our debut title, Project Takedown, is a grounded, third-person narrative action-adventure set in Mumbai. We are committed to delivering high-fidelity, culturally authentic experiences for a global audience. 

Role Description

As the Technical Director (Programming), you will serve as the chief software architect and technical authority for Project Takedown. You will define the technical vision, establish coding standards, and guide the engineering team to ensure stable, scalable, and high-performance delivery in Unreal Engine 5. 

You will work closely with creative leadership, production, and departmental leads to translate ambitious gameplay, animation, and visual goals into robust, maintainable systems. 

Daily tasks include architecting foundational C++ systems, overseeing engine-level modifications and source builds, profiling CPU/GPU performance and memory budgets, reviewing pull requests, unblocking team members on deep technical bugs, build distribution, and version control pipelines. 

This is a leadership role requiring hands-on technical work, guidance and close collaboration with the local development team in Mumbai to ensure the project runs smoothly across target platforms. 

Key Responsibilities

- Define, document, and enforce the project's technical architecture, coding standards, and engineering best practices. 
 - Lead the engineering team, conducting code reviews, mentoring programmers, and aligning technical milestones with production schedules. 
 - Architect and implement core gameplay frameworks, engine subsystems, and memory management strategies in C++. 
 - Partner with Technical Art and Animation leads to optimize rendering pipelines, asset streaming, World Partition, and complex runtime systems (e. g. , MetaHumans, physics, animation graphs). 
 - Drive platform-specific optimization and debugging, maintaining strict frame-rate targets and memory footprints across console and PC targets. 
 - Oversee build pipelines, automated testing, crash reporting systems, and multi-branch version control infrastructure (Diversion). 

Qualifications

- 10+ years of professional game development experience, with at least one shipped title as a Technical Director, Lead Programmer, or Principal Software Engineer (ideally on current-gen consoles or high-end PC). 
 - Expert-level mastery of C++, object-oriented design, software architecture patterns, and data-oriented design principles. 
 - Deep, under-the-hood expertise in Unreal Engine 5 source code, runtime subsystems, garbage collection, multithreading, and memory allocators. 
 - Extensive experience profiling, debugging, and optimizing games using tools such as Unreal Insights, Unreal Memory Insights, Visual Studio, and platform-specific profilers (e. g. , RenderDoc, PIX, Razor). 
 - Strong working knowledge of key UE5 technologies (World Partition, Nanite, Lumen, Chaos Physics, and modular gameplay architectures like the Gameplay Ability System). 
 - Proven track record of managing and mentoring engineering teams, fostering clear technical communication across disciplines, and driving architectural consensus. 
 - Strong grasp of source control workflows (Diversion/Perforce/Git), automated build machines (Jenkins, TeamCity, or GitHub Actions), and Unreal Build Tool (UBT/UAT). 
 - Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical production experience.

data.title: Staff AI Engineer
data.description:
Staff AI Engineer

Hyderabad/Pune/Bangalore (hybrid)

Experience Level- 6+ years

(Candidates Preferred with Product Background with Tier 1 Educational Background)

Our Company: 

What You'll Do: Shape the Way the World Understands Data

Teradata is building the next generation of AI-native analytics, enabling customers to deploy production-grade Generative AI systems directly where enterprise data lives. We are looking for a Staff AI Engineer to play a key role in designing and building the LLM, agent and ModelOps capabilities of Teradata's cloud and SaaS platform, taking them from prototype to secure, observable, multi-tenant production services. 

This role is ideal for an engineer who thrives at the intersection of LLMs, agentic systems and cloud-native engineering, and wants to work on core platform capabilities, not just application demos. 

You will: 

- Own the architecture and technical direction of Teradata's agentic AI platform, delivered as a secure, multi-tenant, cloud-native SaaS service. 
 - Design and build agent runtimes and harnesses: tool calling, planning, memory, context management, multi-agent orchestration, sandboxed execution and human-in-the-loop controls. 
 - Design, build and secure MCP servers and clients, and other agent and tool protocols, that expose Teradata capabilities to agents through governed, well-documented APIs. 
 - Integrate and serve LLMs, both hosted APIs and self-hosted open-weight models: model gateway, routing, caching, fallbacks, token budgets, latency and cost control. 
 - Build ModelOps / LLMOps pipelines: model, prompt and agent registries and versioning, CI/CD with evaluation gates, canary releases and rollback, and quality and drift monitoring. 
 - Build evaluation and observability frameworks for LLM and agent systems: offline evals, LLM-as-judge, tracing, regression suites, and quality, safety, latency and cost metrics. 
 - Implement AI guardrails and responsible-AI controls: prompt-injection defense, PII handling, permissions, policy enforcement and audit trails for regulated industries. 
 - Run AI services as SaaS on AWS, Azure and Google Cloud: tenant isolation, authentication and authorization, quotas, usage metering, SLOs, and production and on-call readiness. 
 - Drive scalability, performance, reliability and cost efficiency of AI workloads, using Kubernetes and infrastructure-as-code. 
 - Where use cases call for it, apply RAG, vector search and semantic retrieval patterns, including Teradata's vector store. 
 - Lead technical design reviews and influence cross-team architectural decisions; identify risks early and drive solutions. 
 - Collaborate with product, research and platform teams to turn customer use cases into scalable features, and benchmark against cloud and open-source alternatives. 

Who You'll Work With: Join Forces with the Best

You'll collaborate with a world-class team of AI architects, ML engineers and domain experts across India and Silicon Valley, working together to build the next generation of enterprise AI systems. 

You'll also work cross-functionally with: 

- Product managers and UX designers to craft agentic workflows that are intuitive and impactful. 
 - Domain specialists to ensure solutions fit real business problems in regulated industries. 
 - Cloud, SaaS and infrastructure teams responsible for deploying, evaluating and scaling AI workloads. This is a rare opportunity to shape foundational AI capabilities within a global, data-driven company. This is a deeply collaborative environment where technical innovation meets real-world application, where your ideas are not only heard but implemented to shape the next generation of data interaction. 

Minimum Requirements

- BS/MS/PhD in Computer Science, AI/ML, or a related field. 
 - 8+ years of professional software engineering experience, including ownership of complex production systems, and 2+ years building LLM-based applications or platforms in production. 
 - Strong cloud engineering on AWS, Azure or Google Cloud: Kubernetes and containers, infrastructure-as-code (for example Terraform), and CI/CD. 
 - Experience building and operating SaaS services: multi-tenancy, API design, authentication and authorization (OAuth/OIDC), observability, SLOs and reliability engineering. 
 - Hands-on LLM experience: prompt and context engineering, function and tool calling, structured outputs, and working with both commercial and open-weight models. 
 - Experience designing agentic systems: planning, memory, orchestration and custom agent harnesses, plus familiarity with agent frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain or equivalent. 
 - Experience with ModelOps / LLMOps: deploying, versioning, evaluating and monitoring models, prompts and agents in production. 
 - Working knowledge of methods for evaluating LLM and agent quality, safety, latency and cost. 
 - Proficiency in Python (and/or Java or Go), with experience shipping production-grade systems. 
 - Experience with large-scale data and performance-sensitive distributed systems. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with LLM inference and serving optimization (for example vLLM or Triton, quantization, GPU scheduling). 
 - Experience with fine-tuning and post-training of open-weight models (for example LoRA, preference optimization, distillation). 
 - Experience implementing AI guardrails, red-teaming and security controls for agents, such as prompt-injection defense. 
 - Familiarity with agent-to-agent protocols and tracing standards such as A2A and OpenTelemetry for GenAI. 
 - Experience with analytics platforms, data warehouses and SQL-based workloads. 
 - m impact.

data.title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer
data.description:
Job Description

For a Senior Site Reliability Engineer, this environment provides hands-on ownership of business-critical production systems, complex database and infrastructure troubleshooting, patching and deployment automation, and continuous improvement of service reliability. 

The Senior Site Reliability Engineer will support the reliability, scalability, performance, and operational lifecycle of Autonomous Database Serverless (ADBS) infrastructure and services. The role requires deep expertise in Oracle RAC, Exadata, OCI, database/infrastructure upgrades and patching, incident response, automation, capacity management, and production troubleshooting, including the ability to troubleshoot across the Exadata and OS layers. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design, operate, and continuously improve highly reliable and scalable infrastructure supporting Autonomous Database Serverless (ADBS). 
 - Administer and optimize high-availability Oracle database environments using Oracle RAC and ASM, with responsibility for service health, performance, capacity, and operational reliability. 
 - Execute end-to-end Exadata lifecycle management, including infrastructure upgrades, storage expansion, quarterly patching/QFSDP activities, and related maintenance across Exadata generations. 
 - Monitor, troubleshoot, and resolve production issues across Exadata hardware, database, network, and OS layers, including incident response, root cause analysis, and post-mortem activities. 
 - Use Exadata capabilities and database performance techniques, including SQL tuning, Smart Scans, Storage Indexes, and Hybrid Columnar Compression (HCC), to improve performance and resource efficiency. 
 - Develop and maintain automation using Shell scripting, Python, or Ansible for infrastructure provisioning, database operations, monitoring, remediation, and recurring maintenance. 
 - Partner with software development and cross-functional teams to assess infrastructure changes, capacity requirements, deployments, reliability risks, and operational impact. 
 - Participate in on-call operations, health/performance reporting, technical analysis, and continuous improvement initiatives aligned to service reliability and SLOs.

Qualifications & Skills

Mandatory

- Strong hands-on experience with Oracle RAC and ASM in production environments. 
 - Hands-on experience managing and optimizing Oracle databases on Exadata physical infrastructure. 
 - Proven experience with Exadata infrastructure upgrades and patching, including end-to-end lifecycle activities across multiple Exadata generations. 
 - Practical experience with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI); exact OCI services to be confirmed. 
 - Ability to troubleshoot issues across the Exadata and operating-system layers. 
 - Experience with production incident response, technical troubleshooting, RCA, post-mortems, and on-call support. 
 - Experience with capacity, health, and performance management for database/infrastructure services. 
 - Experience developing operational automation using Shell scripting, Python, or Ansible. 
 - Experience with Oracle database performance tuning, including SQL tuning and Exadata-engineered features such as Smart Scans, Storage Indexes, and HCC. 
 - Experience supporting highly available database/infrastructure environments and working with software/development teams.

- Direct experience supporting Autonomous Database Serverless (ADBS).

 - Experience using CellCLI, DCLI, and Oracle Enterprise Manager (OEM) Cloud Control.
