data.title: Software Engineer III
data.description:
About Team

The Health & Wellness Engineering team at Walmart is on a mission to make healthcare more accessible, affordable, and convenient for millions of customers across the US. We build the technology that powers Walmart's pharmacy, specialty pharmacy, and wellness platforms spanning prescription management, clinical workflows, patient-facing digital experiences, and health program delivery. Our systems process millions of prescriptions annually and connect patients, pharmacists, prescribers, and payers in real time. The team operates at the intersection of technology and healthcare, building platforms that have a direct, measurable impact on patient outcomes and community health. 

What You'll Do

As a Software Engineer III for Walmart Health & Wellness, you'll have the opportunity to: 

Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend services and patient-facing applications that power Walmart's pharmacy and health platforms

Collaborate with product managers, clinical stakeholders, and cross-functional engineering teams to translate healthcare requirements into reliable, compliant software solutions

Build and maintain secure, HIPAA-compliant systems that handle sensitive patient health information (ePHI) with the highest standards of data privacy and integrity

Participate in design and architecture reviews to ensure systems meet performance, scalability, fault tolerance, and regulatory compliance requirements

Develop integrations with third-party healthcare systems

Write well-tested, production-grade code; contribute to CI/CD pipelines and champion engineering best practices including code reviews, automated testing, and observability

Troubleshoot and resolve complex production issues quickly to ensure high availability of systems that patients and pharmacists depend on daily

Adhere to Company policies, procedures, mission, values, and standards of ethics and integrity

What You'll Bring

3-5 years of professional software engineering experience with a strong full-stack background

Backend: Java & Spring Boot - Production-grade REST APIs, Spring MVC, DI, JPA/Hibernate, JUnit 5 + Mockito, Maven/Gradle

Frontend: React & TypeScript - Functional components, Hooks (useState, useEffect, useMemo, etc. ), React Router, TypeScript (interfaces, generics, enums)

State Management & UI - Redux / Redux Toolkit or Zustand; CSS Modules, styled-components, or Tailwind CSS; React Hooks/ Formik

REST API Design - Versioning, status codes, error contracts; Axios/Fetch integration with async state handling

Database - SQL (joins, aggregations, window functions), PostgreSQL/MySQL, ACID transactions, indexing, query optimization

DevOps Basics - Docker, CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins / GitHub Actions / Concord), Linux/CLI proficiency

Engineering Fundamentals - OOP, SOLID, DSA, Git branching strategies, unit & integration testing

Soft Skills - Strong ownership, clear communication, collaborative, active code-review participant

About Walmart Global Tech

Imagine working in an environment where one line of code can make life easier for hundreds of millions of people. That's what we do at Walmart Global Tech. We're a team of software engineers, data scientists, cybersecurity expert's and service professionals within the world's leading retailer who make an epic impact and are at the forefront of the next retail disruption. People are why we innovate, and people power our innovations. We are people-led and tech-empowered. 

We train our team in the skillsets of the future and bring in experts like you to help us grow. We have roles for those chasing their first opportunity as well as those looking for the opportunity that will define their career. Here, you can kickstart a great career in tech, gain new skills and experience for virtually every industry, or leverage your expertise to innovate at scale, impact millions and reimagine the future of retail. 

Walmart's culture sets us apart, and we know being together helps us innovate, learn and grow great careers. This role is based in our [Bangalore/Chennai] office for daily work, with the flexibility for associates to manage their personal lives. 

Benefits

Beyond our great compensation package, you can receive incentive awards for your performance. Other great perks include a host of best-in-class benefits maternity and parental leave, pto, health benefits, and much more. 

Belonging

We aim to create a culture where every associate feels valued for who they are, rooted in respect for the individual. Our goal is to foster a sense of belonging, to create opportunities for all our associates, customers and suppliers, and to be a Walmart for everyone. 

At Walmart, our vision is "everyone included. " by fostering a workplace culture where everyone is-and feels-included, everyone wins. Our associates and customers reflect the makeup of all 19 countries where we operate. By making Walmart a welcoming place where all people feel like they belong, we're able to engage associates, strengthen our business, improve our ability to serve customers, and support the communities where we operate. 

Equal opportunity employer

Walmart, inc. , is an equal opportunities employer - by choice. We believe we are best equipped to help our associates, customers and the communities we serve live better when we really know them. That means understanding, respecting and valuing unique styles, experiences, identities, ideas and opinions - while being inclusive of all people

Option 1: Bachelor's degree in computer science, computer engineering, computer information systems, software engineering, or related area and 2 years' experience in software engineering or related area. 

Option 2: 4 years' experience in software engineering or related area.

Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Information Systems, Cybersecurity, or related area, We value candidates with a background in creating inclusive digital experiences, demonstrating knowledge in implementing Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2. 2 AA standards, assistive technologies, and integrating digital accessibility seamlessly. data.title: AI Infrastructure Engineer – Generative AI Model Serving (Go / Rust / GPU)
data.description:
Our Company: 

At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI. 

Power the Platform Behind Enterprise Generative AI

At Teradata, we're not just managing data; we're unleashing its full potential. Our ClearScape AnalyticsTM platform and Enterprise Vector Store help the world's largest enterprises derive value from their most complex data. Generative AI and agentic systems are the next frontier, and they run on infrastructure that has to be fast, efficient, and dependable at scale. 

As an AI Infrastructure Engineer, you will build the serving layer that runs large language models and other generative models inside the Teradata Vantage ecosystem. You will work on GPU-accelerated inference, high-performance Go and Rust services, and the cloud-native platform that lets teams ship models to production with confidence. You will own systems end to end, from a CUDA kernel profile to a Kubernetes rollout. 

What You'll Do

- Design, build, and operate scalable, low-latency model-serving platforms for LLMs and generative models, covering batching, streaming, routing, autoscaling, and multi-tenant isolation. 
 - Develop high-performance control-plane and data-plane services in Go and performance-critical components (tokenizers, schedulers, runtimes, gRPC/HTTP gateways, native extensions) in Rust. 
 - Optimize GPU inference for throughput, latency, and cost using continuous batching, KV-cache management, quantization (INT8/FP8/AWQ/GPTQ), speculative decoding, tensor/pipeline parallelism, and efficient memory use. 
 - Integrate and extend inference engines such as vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, Triton Inference Server, Ray Serve, KServe, SGLang, llama. cpp, and ONNX Runtime; contribute fixes upstream where it makes sense. 
 - Build and manage GPU cluster infrastructure on Kubernetes (NVIDIA GPU Operator, device plugins, MIG/time-slicing, node pools, scheduling and bin-packing) across cloud and on-prem environments. 
 - Own the full delivery path: CI/CD pipelines, model packaging and registries, canary and blue/green rollouts, infrastructure as code, and automated performance regression testing. 
 - Build AI observability into everything: metrics, logs, and traces for token throughput, time-to-first-token, GPU utilization, queue depth, error and hallucination signals, using OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, and Grafana. 
 - Provide clean APIs, SDKs, and developer tooling (OpenAI-compatible endpoints, internal services, and lightweight UIs or dashboards) so AI engineers and agent builders can deploy and monitor models self-serve. 
 - Support agentic and RAG workloads by serving embedding, reranking, and generation models alongside the Enterprise Vector Store, with predictable latency and graceful degradation. 
 - Drive reliability, security, and cost efficiency: SLOs, load and chaos testing, capacity planning, GPU cost attribution, and secure model and tenant isolation. 

Who You'll Work With

You will collaborate daily with AI researchers, ML engineers, data scientists, and platform and SRE teams who champion diversity, equity, and inclusion as fundamental to our success. You'll be part of a cohesive team delivering high-quality, highly visible AI/ML functionality within the Teradata Vantage platform. You will report to the Sr. Manager, Software Engineering, who will champion your growth and empower your contributions. 

What Makes You a Qualified Candidate

- 3+ years of professional software engineering experience in backend systems, distributed systems, or AI/ML infrastructure. 
 - Strong, production-level proficiency in Go (concurrency, gRPC, profiling, service design) and working proficiency, or a demonstrated passion for learning, Rust (ownership, async runtimes such as Tokio, FFI, performance tuning). 
 - Hands-on experience with GPU computing for ML: CUDA fundamentals, GPU profiling (Nsight, nvidia-smi/DCGM), memory and bandwidth tradeoffs, and multi-GPU or multi-node inference. 
 - Experience serving LLMs or generative models in production, with practical knowledge of inference optimization techniques and the serving frameworks listed above. 
 - Solid understanding of transformer architectures and the LLM inference lifecycle (prefill vs. decode, attention, KV cache, sampling), plus familiarity with PyTorch and Hugging Face tooling. 
 - Strong system design skills and a deep understanding of distributed systems, networking, concurrency, and failure modes. 
 - Experience with containers and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes, Helm) and CI/CD (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Argo CD, or similar), plus infrastructure as code (Terraform). 
 - Full-stack engineering experience: comfortable building REST/gRPC APIs and a pragmatic front end (React or similar) for dashboards, playgrounds, or admin tools; Python for glue, tooling, and ML integration. 
 - Experience with observability practices and tools (OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, tracing) applied to ML or LLM workloads. 
 - You are obsessive about reliability, debuggability, and ensuring AI systems behave predictably and deterministically when needed. 
 - You code daily, own systems end to end, and are knowledgeable about open-source tools and know how to leverage and extend them. 

What You Bring

- A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - Genuine excitement for AI, LLMs, and the systems that make them efficient and affordable to run at scale. 
 - Strong communication skills and a bias toward measuring, benchmarking, and iterating. 
 - Familiarity with modern data platforms such as Teradata, Snowflake, or Databricks is a plus. 

Bonus Points

- Experience writing or tuning CUDA / Triton (OpenAI) / CUTLASS kernels, or contributing to inference engines. 
 - Experience with on-device or edge ML inference (ONNX, TFLite, llama. cpp, quantized small language models), embedded or mobile deployment. 
 - Knowledge of RAG pipelines, vector databases, embeddings, and agent frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, ReAct-style agents). 
 - Experience with model monitoring, drift detection, evaluation harnesses, and responsible AI practices. 
 - Open-source contributions, technical writing, or public projects in ML systems, Go, or Rust. 
 - Experience with service meshes, RDMA/InfiniBand/NCCL, Slurm, or Ray clusters. 

Why We Think You'll Love Teradata

We prioritize a people-first culture because we know our people are at the very heart of our success. We embrace a flexible work model because we trust our people to make decisions about how, when, and where they work. We focus on well-being because we care about our people and their ability to thrive both personally and professionally. We are an anti-racist company because our dedication to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion is more than a statement. It is a deep commitment to doing the work to foster an equitable environment that celebrates people for all of who they are. 

Teradata invites all identities and backgrounds in the workplace. We work with deliberation and intent to ensure we are cultivating collaboration and inclusivity across our global organization. We are proud to be an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, color, ancestry, religion, creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, or related conditions), national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, medical condition, genetic information, gender identity or expression, military and veteran status, or any other legally protected status.

data.title: Advanced Specialist - Incoming Quality

We are working to increase vehicle safety by developing seatbelts, airbags and steering wheels and you can be part of our team as Advanced Specialist / Senior Executive (Incoming Quality). 

We are seeking an experienced Advanced Specialist / Senior Executive (Incoming Quality) to join our Quality team. The role is responsible for ensuring supplier part quality, managing incoming inspections, supporting production quality requirements, and driving continuous improvement initiatives. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in quality inspection, supplier quality management, measurement systems, and problem-solving methodologies within a manufacturing environment. 

Key Responsibilities

Incoming Quality Management

- Execute incoming material inspections as per defined sampling plans and quality standards. 
 - Ensure supplier parts meet quality requirements before release to production. 
 - Develop and maintain part inspection standards and related documentation. 
 - Monitor incoming quality performance and drive improvement actions. 

Supplier Quality Management

- Investigate supplier-related quality issues and implement containment actions. 
 - Conduct joint inspections and quality reviews with suppliers. 
 - Review supplier corrective action plans and 8D reports. 
 - Raise supplier quality defects in the system and ensure timely closure. 

Production Line Support

- Address line quality concerns related to supplier parts. 
 - Perform root cause analysis and drive corrective and preventive actions. 
 - Support production teams to minimize quality-related disruptions. 

Team & Shift Operations

- Manage and guide a team of 5-6 inspectors, including supplier representatives. 
 - Ensure smooth execution of incoming quality activities across shifts. 
 - Drive inspection strengthening and quality improvement initiatives. 

Quality Systems & Reporting

- Maintain inspection records, rejection reports, dashboards, and PPM data. 
 - Support customer, system, and internal audits. 
 - Manage rejection, segregation, material disposition, and supplier returns. 
 - Coordinate with cross-functional teams to ensure uninterrupted material flow. 

Calibration & Testing

- Manage calibration of measuring instruments as per schedule. 
 - Ensure raw material testing activities are completed as planned. 
 - Maintain compliance with quality standards and procedures. 

Required Technical Skills

- Hands-on experience with measuring instruments such as: 
 - Vernier Caliper
 - Micrometer
 - Height Gauge
 - CMM
 - VMM
 - Vision Measurement Systems
 - Strong knowledge of engineering drawings and GD&T. 
 - Understanding of: 
 - MSA (Measurement System Analysis)
 - SPC (Statistical Process Control)
 - 7 QC Tools
 - Root Cause Analysis and Problem-Solving Techniques
 - Good presentation, reporting, and documentation skills. 
Behavioral Competencies

- Integrity
 - Customer Focus
 - Accountability
 - Execution Excellence
 - Collaboration
 - Trust Building
 - Effective Communication
 - Stakeholder Management

Personal Attributes

- Ethical and professional approach
 - Open-minded and adaptable
 - Strong observational and analytical skills
 - Tactful in handling stakeholders and suppliers
 - Versatile and proactive
 - Innovative problem solver

Qualifications

- BE / B. Tech in Mechanical, Production, Industrial, Automotive, or related Engineering discipline. 

Experience

- 6-9 years of experience in Incoming Quality, Supplier Quality, Manufacturing Quality, or Automotive Quality functions. 

We will be more than glad to chat with you about your experience and your career goals. 

In our international work setting, you will find a range of opportunities that are designed to enhance your career and personal development. Including new and different perspectives is part of what ensures the team's success. We are committed to develop people's skills, knowledge and creative potential. Our training and development programs emphasize technical competency, leadership development and business management skill. 

More lives saved - more life lived!

data.title: Engineering Excellence Manager
data.description:
Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world's manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28, 000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers - amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility - our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better. 

We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that's you we would love to have you join us!

Description

Job Description

Engineering Excellence Manager

Industrial Automation and Control

As Engineering Excellence Manager, you will raise the quality, consistency and repeatability of the industrial automation and control solutions we engineer for our customers. You will lead the engineering standards, design practices, trusted content and quality gates that our project teams work to, and you will hold the organisation accountable for applying them across process, discrete and hybrid engagements. Your remit covers engineering governance, design assurance, continuous improvement and technical competency development, so that every project starts from content rather than a blank page. 

You will have the Engineering Standards and Trusted Content, Design Assurance and Quality, Engineering Continuous Improvement, and Technical Competency and Training functions reporting to you. You will build a engineering chain, assuring the development of technical resources, and preparing the structure to support new delivery strategies as our automation and digital transformation portfolio grows. You will be responsible for resource development, with Engineering Domain Expertise Management. 

You will report to the Director of Engineering Delivery and have a hybrid schedule working in Pune, India. 

Your Responsibilities

Under your leadership, the following functions will have the following responsibilities -

Technical Competency and Training

- Lead a team of Technical Leads and Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) across automation domains, providing direction, coaching, performance development, and succession planning to provide a strong and sustainable technical organisation. 
 - Establish clear ownership and accountability for domain expertise, ensuring that SMEs maintain deep technical knowledge aligned with current and latest technologies. 
 - Provide leadership and oversight to the Technical Lead and SME community, ensuring technical decision-making, knowledge sharing, and understanding of engineering practices across projects, industries, and regions. 
 - Be a final escalation point for complex technical challenges and cross-domain engineering decisions that require expert judgement and resolution. 

Engineering Standards and Trusted Content

This department will be responsible for governing the usage of Trusted Content and standard templates in project execution, and will be the focal point for resolving all critical engineering problems. It will define, publish and version-control the engineering standards, design templates and reusable control libraries built on Logix controllers, FactoryTalk software and Rockwell Automation reference architectures, so that engineers across the region design from the same proven baseline. 

Design Assurance and Quality

This department will maintain engineering quality control by using our Global Quality Management System in the design and delivery of our projects and services. It will operate design reviews and quality gates across the full lifecycle, from functional design specification through factory acceptance testing, site acceptance testing and handover, and will confirm that deliverables meet the applicable functional safety, cybersecurity and industry standards including IEC 61511, IEC 62443, ISA-88 and ISA-95. 

Engineering Continuous Improvement

This department will help use Lean, Six Sigma, Agile and other quality methodologies within the engineering community. It will ensure that productivity projects are identified and executed through the year for measurable results, reducing engineering effort per deliverable without conceding quality. It will also introduce tooling that raises productivity, including configuration-driven code generation, automated testing, emulation and disciplined version control, and will own the lessons-learned process so that an issue surfaced on one project becomes standard practice on the next. 

Technical Competency and Training

This function is responsible for managing the competency needs of the engineering organisation and for the programmes that feed it. It will maintain a competency framework covering process, discrete, hybrid, safety and information solutions disciplines with clear proficiency levels, run technical training, certification and mentoring from graduate trainee through to technical lead, and work with engineering managers to close skill gaps against the forward order book. 

Technical Authority and Customer Engagement

You will act as the senior technical authority for PLC, HMI, SCADA, drives, motion and safety applications, reviewing complex or high-risk designs covering network topology, controller sizing, redundancy strategy, functional safety and industrial cybersecurity before they reach the customer. You will guide the adoption of Rockwell Automation platforms in delivery engagements, including Studio 5000, FactoryTalk View, FactoryTalk Optix, PlantPAx and Emulate3D, support proposal engineering with technical solution reviews and estimating norms, and represent engineering quality in customer design reviews, audits and escalations. 

All the above roles will work with the relevant global teams to make this happen. 

The Essentials - You Will Have

- You will have a bachelor's degree in Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation, Control Systems or Mechatronics Engineering. 
 - You will have 15 or more years in industrial automation engineering, including experience leading engineering teams, technical governance or an engineering excellence function. 
 - You will be Six Sigma certified. 
 - You will understand process and discrete automation and the relevant control systems, with hands-on design and commissioning background across PLC, HMI, SCADA and drive systems. 
 - You will have overseen engineering standards, design reviews or quality systems in a project delivery environment. 
 - You will display, communication, partner management. 
 - You will have experience building technical teams while promoting a culture of collaboration, innovation, and learning. 
 - Expertise in managing diverse technical expert teams across multiple industries, technologies, and geographical regions. 

What You Will Be Measured On

- Provide a quarterly engineering excellence update to leadership. 
 - Fulfilment of important talent development plans across the engineering population. 
 - Manage turnover of necessary technical talent no higher than the turnover of the location. 
 - Lead engineering quality management and reduce rework hours and defects found at site acceptance testing. 
 - Conduct the monthly engineering governance meetings, including the design review board, the trusted content and standards review, and engineering quality reporting. 
 - Grow the reuse of control modules and templates across industry segments and report adoption. 
 - Support employee engagement, retention, and career development outcomes within the Technical Lead and SME organisation. 
 - Maintain a pipeline of technical talent through coaching, mentoring, succession planning, and career progression of Technical Leads and SMEs. 
 - Improve technical competency maturity across the organisation through measurable growth in certifications, domain expertise, and technical capability development. 

What We Offer

Our benefits package includes . . . 

- Comprehensive mindfulness programmes with a premium membership to Calm
 - Volunteer Paid Time off available after 6 months of employment for eligible employees
 - Company volunteer and donation matching programme - Your volunteer hours or personal cash donations to an eligible charity can be matched with a charitable donation. 
 - Employee Assistance Program
 - Personalised wellbeing programs through our OnTrack programme
 - On-demand digital course library for professional development
 - and other local benefits!

At Rockwell Automation we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right person for this or other roles. 

Rockwell Automation's hybrid policy aligns that employees are expected to work at a Rockwell location at least Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays unless they have a business obligation out of the office.

data.title: Senior QA Test Engineer
data.description:
Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic and labelling is accurate. 

The Eurofins network of companies believes that it is a global leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing and in discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and AgroScience contract research services. It is also one of the market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, and in the support of clinical studies, as well as in biopharma contract development and manufacturing. It also has a rapidly developing presence in highly specialised and molecular clinical diagnostic testing and in-vitro diagnostic products. 

In over 37 years, Eurofins has grown from one laboratory in Nantes, France to over 65, 000 staff across a decentralised and entrepreneurial network of more than 950 laboratories in over 1, 000 companies across 59 countries. Eurofins companies offer a portfolio of over 200, 000 analytical methods to evaluate the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin, traceability and purity of biological substances and products. 

In 2024, Eurofins generated total revenues of EUR 6. 95 billion; and has been among the best performing stocks in Europe over the past 20 years. 

Job Description

Senior QA Test Engineer

Eurofins IT Solutions, Bengaluru, Karnataka, India

With 36 facilities worldwide, Eurofins BioPharma Product Testing (BPT) is the largest network of bio/pharmaceutical GMP product testing laboratories providing comprehensive laboratory services for the world's largest pharmaceutical, biopharmaceutical, and medical device companies. 

BPT is enabled by global engineering teams working on next-generation applications and Laboratory Information Management Systems (LIMS). As Senior QA Engineer, you will be a crucial part of our delivery team, ensuring the product features are completely automated and reducing the idea to live time to Business. As a technology leader, BPT wants to give you the opportunity not just to accept new challenges and opportunities but to impress with your ingenuity, focus, attention to detail and collaboration with a global team of professionals. 

This role reports to a Manager. 

Required Experience and Skills

Experience: 

- Experience between 6 to 9 yrs. 
 - Expertise in Automation Testing of Web applications
 - Good experience in building and using automation frameworks using technologies: Java/ C#. 
 - Experience in doing in-sprint automation. 
 - Strong Automation background with experience in identifying and reviewing test cases and testing results. 
 - Ability to understand complex requirements and transform those into Test Scenarios, Test cases and Test Scripts. 
 - Proficient in Version Control tool (ex: GIT )
 - Good Knowledge of Manual Testing of Web and Windows-based applications. 
 - Have an excellent understanding of SDLC and STLC lifecycles. 
 - Hands-on work experience in preparing Test Strategy, Test plans and Requirement traceability matrix. 
 - Exposure to different Testing types - Sanity, Functional, Integration, Exploratory and System testing. 
 - Understanding of Agile/Scrum methodology and working experience in an Agile environment. 
 - Proficient in creating Test Reports. 
 - Should know about analyzing the Risks. 
 - Prior experience in testing LIMS would be an added advantage. Specific skills required

- Expertise in Automation Testing using Selenium/Specflow/BDD/Protractor. 
 - Hands-on experience in programming languages (C#, Java, Python). 
 - Experienced in Creating VM for Automation and setting up the configuration in the test suite and runners. 
 - Hands-on experience in SQL to write medium complex queries (e. g. Joins/sub-queries etc. ). 
 - Good understanding of JSON, XML, REST and experience in testing web services using POSTMAN, REST Assured, JSON Lint, SOAP UI. 
 - Experience with any defect tracking tool like Jira, TFS/MTM, Bugzilla, etc. 
 - Experience on any test management tools like TFS/MTM, ALM, etc
 - This is a role which would involve both Manual & Automation testing in the ratio of 60 : 40 Desirable Experience

- Knowledge of Performance testing. 
 - Knowledge of Security testing. 

Qualifications

Required Qualifications: 

Bachelors in Engineering, Computer Science or equivalent. 

Additional Information

Personal Skills: 

- Customer-service oriented with a problem-solving attitude; 
 - Strong attention to detail and accuracy is essential; 
 - Entrepreneurial thinking and flexibility to change; 
 - Very good English communication skills (concise writing and orally convincing); 
 - Structured and clear writing skills; 
 - Proven ability to solve complex business problems using analytical reasoning; 
 - Demonstrated positive attitude, self-motivated, team player. PERFORMANCE APPRAISAL CRITERIA: Eurofins has a strong focus on Performance Management system. This includes quarterly calibrations, half-yearly reviews and annual reviews. The KPIs shall be set and may vary slightly between projects. These will be clearly communicated, documented during the first 30 days of your joining.

data.title: Advisory Senior Manager - Development & QA Lead
data.description:
Job Description

At EisnerAmper, we look for individuals who welcome new ideas, encourage innovation, and are eager to make an impact. Whether you're starting out in your career or taking your next step as a seasoned professional, the EisnerAmper experience is one-of-a-kind. You can design a career you'll love from top to bottom - we give you the tools you need to succeed and the autonomy to reach your goals. 

We are seeking a Senior Manager to join the Technology practice, in our Hyderabad office. We are seeking someone who thrives in a growing environment and provides clients and internal partners with exceptional service. The Sr. Manager - IT Software Development Testing Lead directs the quality assurance function for custom internal and client-facing applications and custom reporting. This position owns the testing function across the software development life cycle, designs and maintains automated test frameworks, sets standards for unit and integration testing in collaboration with development teams, and leads a team of software test engineers. 

Working within a Microsoft-centered technology stack, the Testing Lead brings a software development background to quality engineering: writing and reviewing testing code, building automated regression testing, integrating tests into Azure DevOps pipelines, and building report testing meeting acceptability thresholds. The role also serves as the quality escalation point for release readiness decisions and reports quality metrics to technology and engagement leadership. 

What It Means To Work For EisnerAmper

- You will get to be part of one of the largest and fastest growing accounting and advisory firms in the industry
 - You will have the flexibility to manage your days in support of our commitment to work/life balance
 - You will join a culture that has received multiple top "Places to Work" awards
 - We believe that great work is accomplished when cultures, ideas and experiences come together to create new solutions
 - We understand that embracing our differences is what unites us as a team and strengthens our foundation
 - Showing up authentically is how we, both as professionals and a Firm, find inspiration to do our best work
 - Numerous Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) to support our Diversity, Equity, & Inclusion (DE&I) efforts
What Work You Will Be Responsible For

Test Strategy and Quality Leadership

- Owns the overall test strategy for assigned applications and engagements, covering unit, integration, system, regression, performance, and user acceptance testing. 
 - Establishes and maintains quality assurance standards, methodologies, entry and exit criteria, and metrics, and drives their adoption across development teams. 
 - Serves as the quality decision point for release readiness, presenting risk assessments and recommendations to technology and engagement leadership. 
 - Estimates testing effort and resources, prioritizes the test backlog, and confirms that testing tasks are delivered on schedule. 
 - Evaluates and recommends testing tools, frameworks, and platform investments, including build-versus-buy analysis and proof-of-concept work. 

Automated Test Development

- Designs, codes, reviews, and maintains automated test frameworks and reusable libraries in C# / . NET for UI, API, database, and end-to-end scenarios. 
 - Builds data-driven and behavior-driven automated suites, including test data management, environment configuration, and reporting. 
 - Integrates automated regression and smoke suites into Azure DevOps pipelines with gated builds, quality gates, and automated result publication. 
 - Monitors automation health - flaky test rates, execution time, and coverage - and refactors suites to keep results trustworthy and fast. 
 - Sets automation targets by release and reports progress against manual-to-automated conversion goals. 

Unit Testing and Shift-Left Quality

- Advises developers on unit test design, test doubles, and mocking strategy, and participates in code review with a focus on testability and coverage. 
 - Defines code coverage thresholds and static analysis rules with development leadership, and monitors adherence through build reporting. 
 - Writes unit and integration tests directly when supporting shared components, remediation work, or teams building new test capability. 
 - Promotes early defect detection through requirements review, design review, and acceptance criteria refinement before development begins. 

Test Case Design and Execution

- Analyzes requirements and design specifications to produce comprehensive test plans, test cases, and test scripts with expected results and traceability to acceptance criteria. 
 - Applies risk-based, boundary, negative, and equivalence-partitioning techniques to focus coverage where defect probability and business impact are highest. 
 - Reviews and approves test cases authored by team members, providing written feedback on coverage gaps, clarity, and reusability. 
 - Directs system, functional, regression, and end-to-end business scenario testing for new applications and enhancements. 
 - Maintains and manages manual test scripts, automated suites, and test databases under version control. 
 - Coordinates user acceptance testing with business stakeholders, including scenario preparation, facilitation, and results documentation. 

Defect Management and Metrics

- Verifies and traces evidence of reproduction for reported faults, and validates fixes along with impact analysis for related functionality. 
 - Manages the defect life cycle through triage, prioritization, assignment, and closure, and escalates aging or high-severity items. 
 - Tracks and reports quality metrics such as defect density, escape rate, open defect counts, coverage, and cycle time, and uses trends to guide process improvement. 
 - Leads root cause analysis on production escapes and translates findings into concrete process or automation changes. 

Collaboration and Communication

- Serves as liaison among analysts, developers, architects, and business domain owners to clarify requirements and produce effective test scripts. 
 - Keeps development teams, project management, and internal customers informed of testing progress, risks, and significant issues. 
 - Produces well-written internal and external documentation, and conducts workshops or training on areas of knowledge as needed. 
 - Assists and advises internal customers on technical issues, resolving assigned incidents in a timely manner and retaining ownership until closure. 
 - Builds and maintains trusted relationships with a diverse group of clients, team members, managers, and subject matter contacts. 

Team Leadership And Firm Responsibilities

- Leads, coaches, and develops software test engineers, including work assignment, code and test case review, on-the-job training, and performance feedback. 
 - Participates in hiring, onboarding, and skills development planning for the testing team, including automation upskilling. 
 - Works with supervisors to identify and understand engagement scope, manages day-to-day activities of completing work, and assists with oversight of overall quality control of client deliverables. 
 - Monitors workload to meet billable hour expectations and performs timely reviews of work products prior to submission to a supervisor. 
 - Maintains the required CPE for firm and licensing requirements. 
 - Complies with professional and firm requirements (e. g. , employee handbook requirements, time entry procedures). 

Other Duties

- Provides courteous and prompt service to all internal and external parties. Prioritizes and addresses requests and assignments in a professional and cooperative manner. 
 - Identifies opportunities and recommends methods to improve service, work processes, and financial performance (e. g. , procedure optimization). Assists in the implementation of quality improvement initiatives. 
 - Assists co-workers in the completion of tasks and assignments to support continuity of service. Actively supports teamwork throughout the organization. 
 - Performs other services as assigned. 

Basic Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or Information Systems and Decision Sciences is required. Coursework in data structures, algorithms, and software design is expected. 
 - ISTQB Advanced Level (Test Manager or Test Analyst) is preferred. 
 - Microsoft Certified: Azure Developer Associate, Azure DevOps Engineer, or comparable Microsoft credential is preferred. 
 - Certified ScrumMaster (CSM), Professional Scrum Master (PSM), or equivalent agile credential is preferred. 
 - 10+ years of progressive experience in software quality engineering and test automation across the full system development life cycle is required. 
 - 6+ years of experience leading, building, and developing test teams, including work assignment, review, and performance feedback, is required. 
 - 6+ years of hands-on experience designing, coding, and maintaining automated test suites - UI, API, and data layer is required. 
 - 6+ years of software development experience within the Microsoft stack, including C#, . NET / . NET Core, ASP. NET, and SQL Server / T-SQL, is preferred. 
 - Demonstrated experience writing and reviewing unit tests is required. 
 - Demonstrated experience authoring test plans, test cases, and test scripts from requirements and design specifications, including boundary, negative, and risk-based case design with traceability back to acceptance criteria, is required. 
 - Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions, including gated builds and release quality gates, is required. 
 - Experience with agile delivery, system development life cycle governance, and tools such as Azure DevOps (Boards, Repos, Pipelines, Test Plans), JIRA, Confluence, Zephyr, Xray, or TestRail is preferred. 
 - Experience with performance and load testing (JMeter, k6, Azure Load Testing), accessibility testing, or application security testing concepts is preferred. 
 - Experience in professional services, accounting, tax, or another regulated environment - including testing of financial calculations and data migrations - is preferred. 
 - Languages: C#, . NET / . NET Core, T-SQL, PowerShell, and JavaScript or TypeScript. 
 - Microsoft platform: Azure DevOps, Azure (App Service, Functions, SQL), SQL Server, Power BI, Power Platform, Dynamics 365, SharePoint, and Microsoft 365. 
 - Source control and branching strategy in Git, including pull request review and code review participation. 
 - Working knowledge of API design (REST, JSON, XML), relational data modeling, and query optimization sufficient to validate results independently. 
 - Working knowledge of Scrum, Kanban, or other agile methodologies, including estimation and sprint planning. 
 - Depth of knowledge in quality assurance and quality control processes, defect life cycle management, and release governance. 
 - Ability to translate technical quality data into clear recommendations for non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Ability to work in a dynamic, fast-paced, and continuously changing environment while holding the team to consistent standards. 
 - Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple projects and tasks with attention to detail and accuracy. 
 - Strong interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate professionally and appropriately with a diverse group of individuals. 
 - Demonstrates a positive attitude, proactive nature, and a high degree of professionalism, and maintains the highest level of confidentiality. 
 - Ability to work independently and within a team, and to coach others toward the same standard. 
 - Computer literacy at an intermediate or advanced level with the Microsoft Office suite of products (specifically Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and SharePoint).

data.title: Application Platform Architect
data.description:
As an Application Platform Architect at Zeta Global, you will be a visionary leader responsible for designing the foundational architecture that supports all of our applications and services. You will focus on building a scalable, reliable, and secure platform that empowers engineering teams to build and deploy applications with speed and efficiency. This role involves defining standards, selecting technologies, and guiding the development of core platform components such as microservices frameworks, APIs, and shared libraries-including those that enable AI agents and agentic workflows. 

Key Responsibilities

- Platform Strategy: Define the technical vision and roadmap for the Zeta application platform, ensuring it meets the long-term needs of the business and engineering teams. 
 - Architectural Design: Design and lead the implementation of core platform services, including reusable microservices, APIs, and shared components that serve all applications. 
 - AI Platform Integration: Architect and build the underlying platform services and APIs that enable the seamless integration of AI agents, large language models (LLMs), and agentic workflows. Design a robust and scalable infrastructure to support these advanced capabilities. 
 - Scalability & Reliability: Ensure the platform's architecture can handle increasing scale and complexity, with a focus on high availability, performance, and fault tolerance. 
 - Developer Enablement: Create tools, frameworks, and best practices that improve the developer experience, accelerate development velocity, and ensure consistency across all applications. 
 - Technology Evaluation: Research, evaluate, and recommend emerging technologies, tools, and architectural patterns to keep the platform at the forefront of innovation. 
 - Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with engineering, DevOps, and security teams to embed security, monitoring, and operational best practices into the platform's design and development lifecycle. 
 - Documentation & Governance: Create and maintain comprehensive documentation, guidelines, and governance standards for the platform's architecture and usage. Required Qualifications

- 10+ years of experience in software engineering, with at least 3-5 years in a lead architect or principal engineer role. 
 - Extensive experience designing and building large-scale, distributed application platforms. 
 - Deep expertise in microservices architecture, RESTful APIs, and event-driven systems. 
 - Proficiency in programming languages such as Java, Scala, or Python. 
 - Strong experience with cloud platforms (AWS preferred) and cloud-native services. 
 - Experience with containerization and orchestration technologies (Docker, Kubernetes). 
 - Experience with DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, and infrastructure as code (Terraform, Ansible). 
 - Excellent communication, presentation, and leadership skills. Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with AI/ML frameworks like LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar, and a proven track record of architecting platforms to support them. 
 - Experience with service meshes (Istio, Linkerd) and API gateways. 
 - Familiarity with identity and access management (IAM) systems. 
 - Experience with security architecture, including threat modeling and secure-by-design principles. 
 - A track record of contributing to open-source projects or speaking at industry conferences.   

Company Profile: 

Zeta Global is a data-powered marketing technology company with a heritage of innovation and industry leadership. Founded in 2007 by entrepreneur David A. Steinberg and John Sculley, former CEO of Apple Inc and Pepsi-Cola, the Company combines the industry's 3rd largest proprietary data set (2. 4B+ identities) with Artificial Intelligence to unlock consumer intent, personalize experiences and help our clients drive business growth. 

Zeta Global is a leading AI-powered marketing technology company that enables enterprise brands to acquire, grow, and retain customers through intelligent, data-driven engagement. At the center of its innovation is the Zeta Marketing Platform (ZMP), which unifies customer data, identity, and advanced analytics to transform billions of data signals into actionable marketing intelligence and measurable business outcomes. 

Publicly traded on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: ZETA), Zeta is redefining modern marketing with Athena by ZetaTM, a superintelligent, conversational agent embedded in ZMP that personalizes the marketer's workspace, surfaces platform generated insights through natural dialogue and recommends next-best actions to help brands accelerate and optimize their marketing outcomes.

The Information Technology group delivers secure, reliable technology solutions that enable DTCC to be the trusted infrastructure of the global capital markets. The team delivers high-quality technology solutions through activities that include software development, test automation, quality engineering, platform modernization, and implementation of data, security, and regulatory standards. 

Pay And Benefits

- Competitive compensation, including base pay and annual incentive
 - Comprehensive health and life insurance and well-being benefits, based on location

 - Paid Time Off and Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well-being
 - DTCC offers a flexible/hybrid model of 3 days onsite and 2 days remote (onsite Tuesdays, Wednesdays and a third day unique to each team or employee)

The Impact You Will Have In This Role

The SDET family is responsible for creating, designing, deploying, and supporting applications, programs, and software solutions. This may include new development, maintenance, automation, enhancement, and modernization of software products used internally and externally across DTCC platforms. 

As an Associate, Software Development Engineer in Test, you will help drive quality engineering practices across strategic initiatives and enterprise delivery streams. In this role, you will contribute to functional and automated testing, support shift-left quality practices, maintain end-to-end traceability, and help validate complex workflows spanning user interfaces, APIs, databases, regulatory reporting flows, file-based ingestion, and cross-system integrations. The role is expected to support secure, compliant, and scalable delivery by partnering closely with Software Engineers, Product Owners, Scrum teams, and partner platforms. This scope includes regulatory and reporting validation, schema and file-format transformations, traceability across testing tools, UI/API/backend coordination, and testing across database, integration, regression, and automation workflows. 

Your Primary Responsibilities

- Apply software development and testing methodologies, tools, and technologies to validate business, functional, and regulatory requirements across multiple enterprise applications and platforms. 
 - Design, execute, and maintain manual and automated tests across the delivery lifecycle, including functional, regression, integration, system, exploratory, and automation-assisted testing. 
 - Maintain traceability from user stories and acceptance criteria through test scenarios, test cases, automation assets, evidence, and defect tracking using tools such as JIRA and ALM/AQM. 
 - Partner with Software Engineers and Product Owners during refinement, story grooming, and scenario walkthroughs to clarify requirements, identify ambiguities early, and improve testability before code completion. 
 - Validate API, UI, and database behavior as required, including support for backend and data-level verification across enterprise systems where project scope requires it. 
 - Perform validation activities such as file ingestion, schema validation, field mapping, field transformation, XML/CSV processing, report verification, ACK/NACK handling, error validation, and simulator-driven testing. 
 - Support regulatory and control-focused testing needs, including validation of transaction/reporting accuracy, reporting timeliness, privacy and data masking, entitlements, auditability, portal access, and downstream impacts to related systems or reporting channels. 
 - Contribute to automation frameworks and continuous testing by integrating automated checks with CI/CD pipelines and supporting smoke, sanity, and regression execution as part of release readiness. 
 - Use enterprise testing and engineering tools effectively, including JIRA, ALM, Bitbucket, Jenkins, Splunk, database-driven validation platforms, simulator tools, and automation frameworks. 
 - Collaborate with internal and cross-functional teams on requirement analysis, UI/API integration, issue triage, dependency management, troubleshooting, and solution validation across shared and distributed teams. 
 - Create and maintain system, test, and execution documentation including test plans, scenario coverage, execution evidence, defect summaries, and test status reporting. 
 - Align risk and control processes into day-to-day responsibilities to monitor and mitigate risk, escalate issues appropriately, and support secure, compliant software delivery. 

Qualifications

- Minimum of 4 years of related experience in software testing, quality engineering, or test automation
 - Bachelor's degree preferred or equivalent experience
 - Experience in functional testing, automation testing, and defect lifecycle management in Agile delivery environments
 - Hands-on experience with test design techniques such as equivalence partitioning, boundary value analysis, decision table testing, pairwise testing, and exploratory testing
 - Experience working with JIRA and ALM for requirements traceability, test management, and issue tracking
 - Experience with one or more programming/scripting languages such as Java or Python
 - Familiarity with API testing and automation tools/frameworks such as Selenium, TestNG, Karate, or Rest Assured
 - Familiarity with Git / Bitbucket and CI/CD tooling such as Jenkins
 - Familiarity with AI Prompt Engineering and AI Agents
 - Experience validating file-based and data-intensive workflows involving XML, CSV, schema validations, field mappings, and database verification is preferred
 - Exposure to financial services, regulatory/reporting processes, onboarding flows, portal-based applications, or data-platform testing is preferred

Talents Needed For Success

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail
 - Ability to understand complex business workflows and translate requirements into effective test coverage
 - Strong collaboration skills and comfort working with Software Engineers, Product Owners, Scrum teams, and partner platforms
 - Effective written and verbal communication skills, including ability to document findings and present testing status clearly
 - Curiosity and ownership mindset with a strong quality-first orientation
 - Ability to balance manual validation with automation opportunities and continuously improve testing efficiency
 - Comfort working in fast-paced, iterative delivery environments with changing priorities
 - Awareness of privacy, security, risk, and regulatory expectations in enterprise software delivery
 - Willingness to learn domain-specific concepts across regulatory reporting, operational workflows, and UI/API integration models

Leads the architecture, design, and development of software solutions for the organization's most complex and high impact projects. - Deep understanding of modern machine learning workflows, deep learning frameworks, hyper parameter optimization, and developer tools.

 - Design and develop high-performance, robust, and scalable software tools, SDKs, and APIs that streamline the training, deployment, and optimization of deep learning models. 
 - Define robust system architectures across streaming vs. batch dataflows, concurrent capacity planning, networking/security fundamentals, and mobile integrations. 
 - Bachelors Degree or Advanced Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related engineering discipline
 - 10+ years of relevant experience with a Bachelors Degree or 7+ years of experience with an Advanced Degree
 - Equivalency: Equivalent work experience will be considered in lieu of a degree

Key Skills And Competencies

Deep understanding of modern machine learning workflows, deep learning frameworks, hyper parameter optimization, and developer tools. 

- Familiarity with parallel computing architectures, distributed training infrastructures, and low-level acceleration concepts (e. g. , CUDA, or OpenCL). Lead customer-facing technical discovery and feasibility assessments to evaluate customer requirements, validate hardware constraints, and de-risk pilots before deployment. 
 - Build and deliver lightweight POCs leveraging existing edge frameworks to validate technical assumptions regarding model sizing, latency trade-offs, and hardware sizing. 
 - Architect end-to-end edge AI solutions spanning edge hardware (NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin/Orin Nano), LLM serving frameworks (Ollama, vLLM, TensorRT-LLM), and computer vision pipelines (object detection, OCR, multi-modal AI). 
 - Design and develop high-performance, robust, and scalable software tools, SDKs, and APIs that streamline the training, deployment, and optimization of deep learning models. 
 - Define robust system architectures across streaming vs. batch dataflows, concurrent capacity planning, networking/security fundamentals, and mobile integrations. 
 - Serve as the technical bridge aligning Sales, Product, and Engineering teams to ensure accurate scoping and prevent costly engineering rework. 

Benefits

We understand the importance of work-life balance and wellbeing, which is why we offer flexibility for our teams including: hybrid work, adaptable hours, Summer Flex Fridays, Focus Fridays, and an annual companywide well-being day to promote revitalization and success. 

Job Posting Statement

To protect candidates from falling victim to online fraudulent activity involving fake job postings and employment offers, please be aware our recruiters will always connect with you via @zebra. com email accounts. Applications are only accepted through our applicant tracking system and only accept personal identifying information through that system. Our Talent Acquisition team will not ask for you to provide personal identifying information via e-mail or outside of the system. If you are a victim of identity theft contact your local police department. 

AI Technology Statement

Zebra Technologies leverages AI technology to evaluate job applications using objective, job-relevant criteria. This approach enhances efficiency and promotes fairness in the hiring process. However, every decision regarding interviews and hiring is made by our dedicated team, because we believe people make the best decisions about people. For more on how we use technology in hiring and how we process applicant data, see our Zebra Privacy Policy.

- Joining Arup

You will work closely with data engineers, analysts, data scientists, architects, product owners and business stakeholders to translate complex requirements into practical, reliable and scalable data services. You will bring strong technical judgement, a passion for engineering excellence and the ability to promote best practice across data engineering, governance and platform operations.

Is this role right for you?

- Strong production experience in Databricks, Spark, PySpark, SQL and Delta Lake. 
 - Experience designing scalable data pipelines, Lakehouse solutions and cloud-native data services. 
 - Knowledge of Unity Catalog, data governance, security and access control patterns. 
 - Confidence leading, mentoring and developing data engineers. 
 - A passion for engineering excellence, automation, reliability and continuous improvement. 

What We Offer You

At Arup, we care about each member's success, so we can grow together. 

Guided by our values, we provide an attractive total reward package that recognises the contribution of each of our members to our shared success. As well as competitive, fair and equitable pay, we offer a career in which all of our members can belong, grow and thrive - through benefits that support health and wellbeing, a wide range of learning opportunities and many possibilities to have an impact through the work they do. 

We are owned in trust on behalf of our members, giving us the freedom, with personal responsibility, to set our own direction and choose work that aligns with our purpose and adds to Arup's legacy. Our members collaborate on ambitious projects to deliver remarkable outcomes for our clients and communities. Profit Share is a key part of our reward, enabling members to share in the results of our collective efforts. 

Different people, shared values

Arup is an equal opportunity employer that actively promotes and nurtures a diverse and inclusive workforce. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds, regardless of age (within legal limits), gender identity or expression, marital status, disability, neurotype or mental health, race or ethnicity, faith or belief, sexual orientation, socioeconomic background, and whether you're pregnant or on family leave. We are an open environment that embraces diverse experiences, perspectives, and ideas - this drives our excellence. 

Guided by our values and alignment with the UN Sustainable Development Goals, we create and contribute to equitable spaces and systems, while cultivating a sense of belonging for all. Our internal employee networks support our inclusive culture: from race, ethnicity and cross-cultural working to gender equity and LGBTQ+ and disability inclusion - we aim to create a space for you to express yourself and make a positive difference. Discover more about life at Arup at Careers - Your Life at Arup . 

We are committed to making our recruitment process and workplaces accessible to all candidates. Please let us know if you need any assistance or reasonable adjustments throughout your application or interview process, and/or to perform the essential functions of the role. We will do everything we can to support you. 

Our Application Process

To understand what to expect next, please visit our Careers page Our aim is to make this process as streamlined and easy as possible for our applicants. 

Please note that all applicants must apply directly via the job portal and applications sent via email will not be considered. If this role is not quite what you are looking for, but you are interested in other opportunities for a future with purpose, please sign up to our Talent Community where you will be kept up to date with roles suitable for you to shape a better world. 

Stay safe online - Arup will never ask for payment or your bank details as part of our recruitment process. 

An environment that will give you freedom to design with a purpose, focus on your skills to deliver quality work to our clients, opportunity to learn and share knowledge openly. You will have the opportunity to utilise your technical expertise to improve the lives of the most vulnerable in the communities in which we live and work through Arup's community engagement programme. 

You'll have access to lots of learning opportunities and ongoing training through Arup university and other learning programmes.

Your Qualifications

Therefore, in addition to the traditional benefit scheme, we provide a good work-life balance: flexible working hours and a hybrid model. Simcorp follows a global hybrid policy, asking employees to work from the office two days each week while allowing remote work on other days. 

Simcorp does offer opportunities for professional development: there is never just only one route - we offer an individual approach to professional development to support the direction you want to take. 

NEXT STEPS

Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed. At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. WHO WE ARE?

For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world's leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 3, 000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, educations, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds. 

SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full, front-to-back offering for our clients.

We're a global, multi-disciplinary team that's putting the innovative power of technology to work and transforming tomorrow. At HARMAN Automotive, we give you the keys to fast-track your career.

About The Role

We are looking for an experienced Infotainment Test Engineer with strong Python programming skills to join our Automotive Software Engineering team. The candidate will be responsible for validating next-generation automotive infotainment systems, designing automated test frameworks, executing functional and integration testing, and ensuring high-quality software delivery for automotive products. 

What You Will Do

- Design, develop, and execute test cases for automotive infotainment systems. 
 - Develop and maintain test automation frameworks using Python. 
 - Perform functional, integration, regression, system, and end-to-end testing.

What Makes You Eligible

What We Offer

You Belong Here

HARMAN is committed to making every employee feel welcomed, valued, and empowered. data.title: Digital Portfolio QA Manager
data.description:
The Next Level of Fire & Life Safety Leadership

With more than two centuries of combined history, brands like Kidde, Kidde Commercial, Edwards, GST, Badger, and Aritech have been leading the way in protecting people and property around the world. Now, we're taking that leadership to the next level. Kidde Global Solutions brings together the most trusted and iconic brands in safety, building upon our shared experience and expertise to address the needs and challenges of more customers in more places. With an unmatched portfolio of solutions and services, and a commitment to constant innovation we're elevating the standards for an entire industry - and establishing the next level of fire and life safety leadership. 

At Kidde Global Solutions, you're joining a global technology leader in fire and life safety solutions and our employees are the heart of it all. With industry-defining brands in life safety and security, you'll be part of a legacy of leadership working with cutting-edge technologies that protect lives and property worldwide. As a leading fire safety brand, our mission is to provide solutions that protect people and property from the effects of fire and related hazards. We're committed to expanding our impact and providing dynamic opportunities for growth within our team. You'll be part of a company that prioritizes quality, integrity, collaboration, and customer care, with the resources, training, and incentives to ensure your success every step of the way. 

Kidde Global Solutions is seeking an experienced Digital Portfolio QA Manager to lead quality assurance for mobile, web, cloud, desktop software, API, and connected digital applications. The role will build and guide a strong QA team, strengthen automation and testing practices, adopt practical AI methods in day-to-day QA work, and ensure reliable, secure, and scalable digital experiences across IoT, intrusion, video, and access-control product ecosystems

Role Overview

The Digital Portfolio QA Manager will be responsible for defining and executing the QA approach across web, mobile, API, cloud, desktop software, and connected product platforms. This includes planning test coverage, improving automation, using AI to make testing faster and smarter, managing release readiness, and driving measurable quality outcomes for applications and tools used to configure, commission, monitor, and manage hardware devices. 

Key Responsibilities

Responsibilities

The role is accountable for team leadership, QA planning, automation, AI adoption in testing, and release confidence across mobile, web, API, cloud, desktop software, and connected digital applications. Key responsibilities include: 

- QA strategy and ownership: Define and continuously improve the quality engineering strategy for web, mobile, API, cloud, desktop software, and connected digital application releases in alignment with product, engineering, and business objectives. 
 - Team leadership: Lead, mentor, and develop a team of QA engineers responsible for mobile and web-based digital applications, promoting accountability, engineering discipline, collaboration, and continuous improvement. 
 - AI adoption in QA: Use practical AI methods to improve testing, including AI-assisted test case creation, test data generation, automation support, defect analysis, risk identification, and quality reporting. 
 - Testing and automation methods: Lead manual, automated, regression, integration, API, mobile, web, desktop, and end-to-end testing using scalable frameworks, reusable test assets, CI/CD integration, and clear effectiveness metrics. 
 - Digital application quality: Ensure functional, usability, compatibility, accessibility, performance, security, integration, and regression quality across Android, iOS, responsive web applications, portals, APIs, desktop tools, and cloud-connected workflows. 
 - IoT and security-domain alignment: Apply a fair understanding of IoT application behavior, device-to-cloud interactions, mobile app connectivity, user workflows, and system integrations; experience in intrusion, video, access control, security panels or connected security ecosystems is highly appreciated. 
 - Release governance and metrics: Establish release-readiness criteria, quality dashboards, defect governance, traceability, risk-based testing, and executive-level reporting to provide transparent quality signals and data-driven release recommendations. 
 - Continuous improvement: Improve test productivity, automation value, defect detection, regression cycle time, release predictability, and customer quality through better processes, metrics, and AI-enabled testing improvements. 
 - Cross-functional influence: Partner closely with product management, engineering, architecture, DevOps, customer support, and program teams to align quality priorities, resolve risks, improve product reliability, and deliver customer-ready digital products. 

Education

BE, B. Tech. , ME, or M. Tech. in Electronics, Communication, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related engineering discipline. 

Experience And Technical Qualifications

Minimum 12+ years of experience in software quality engineering, digital application testing, test automation, or QA leadership roles, including substantial experience managing QA teams for product-based mobile, web, API, cloud, desktop software, or connected application platforms. 

- Managerial QA leadership: Proven experience leading QA teams, defining team goals, managing delivery commitments, reviewing quality metrics, coaching engineers, and influencing engineering and product stakeholders in a product development environment. 
 - Mobile, web, and desktop application QA: Strong experience testing Android, iOS, responsive web applications, portals, desktop software used to configure and manage hardware devices, APIs, user workflows, cross-browser behavior, device compatibility, integration flows, and cloud-connected digital services. 
 - AI and automation outcomes: Demonstrated track record of using AI in QA processes to achieve measurable outcomes such as increased automation coverage, faster regression execution, improved defect prediction, reduced manual effort, better test design quality, and stronger release confidence. 
 - Automation and toolchain expertise: Hands-on background with modern automation frameworks and tools such as Selenium, Playwright, Appium, Robot Framework, PyTest, Postman, API automation, JIRA, X-Ray or equivalent test management platforms. 
 - Preferred domain experience: Fair understanding of IoT applications, device connectivity, cloud integrations, mobile-to-device interactions, and connected product behavior; prior exposure to intrusion, video surveillance, access control, security monitoring, or smart building/security domains is highly appreciated. 

Leadership and Managerial Competencies

- People leadership and ownership: Builds and leads high-performing QA teams with clear ownership, accountability, mentoring, performance orientation, and commitment to product quality outcomes. 
 - Strategic execution: Converts product priorities into practical QA plans, balances hands-on technical judgment with managerial decision-making, removes execution barriers, and escalates risks with clarity. 
 - Stakeholder communication: Communicates quality status, automation progress, AI adoption impact, release risks, and improvement plans effectively to engineering leaders, product owners, program teams, and business stakeholders. 
 - Collaboration and delivery: Collaborates effectively across teams and maintains accountability for timely, high-quality delivery. 
 - Continuous learning: Demonstrates curiosity, creativity, and a sustained commitment to continuous learning, engineering excellence, and professional growth. 

The ideal candidate will bring strong managerial maturity, digital QA depth, automation leadership, and a proven ability to convert AI adoption into tangible quality, productivity, and release-readiness outcomes for product-based digital applications. 

World Leaders in Fire and Life Safety

Kidde Global Solutions is a world leader in fire & life safety solutions tailored for complex commercial facilities to homes. Through iconic, industry-defining brands including Kidde, Kidde Commercial, Edwards, GST, Badger, and Aritech, we provide residential and commercial customers with advanced solutions and services to protect people and property in a wide range of applications, all around the globe.

Test Strategy and Quality Leadership

 - Establishes and maintains quality assurance standards, methodologies, entry and exit criteria, and metrics, and drives their adoption across development teams.

Test Case Design and Execution

data.title: Senior Network Automation & Agentic AI Developer
data.description:
Experience: 10+years

Work Mode: Hybrid/ 24/7 shift

Work Location: Hyderabad, Bangalore, Chennai, Noida, Pune, Kochi

Role Overview

We are seeking a visionary and hands-on Senior Network Automation & Agentic AI Developer to pioneer the next generation of intent-based, self-healing network infrastructures. In this role, you will bridge the gap between traditional enterprise networking and cutting-edge Artificial Intelligence. You will not just write scripts; you will architect autonomous AI Agents capable of diagnosing infrastructure faults, correlating real-time telemetry, and safely executing deterministic changes across a global multi-vendor environment. 

Key Responsibilities

- Advanced Ansible Engineering: Architect scalable, production-grade network configuration playbooks, custom roles, and execution environments using Ansible Automation Platform / AWX. Develop custom Python plugins/modules to extend Ansible functionality where native vendor support is limited. 
 - Multi-Vendor API Integration: Write highly concurrent Python middleware to interface natively with the REST APIs and SDKs of our core infrastructure stack (Cisco Nexus/ACI, Meraki Dashboard, Versa Director, and Zscaler). 
 - AI Agent Orchestration: Design, develop, and deploy autonomous multi-agent workflows using Generative AI frameworks (e. g. , LangGraph, CrewAI, LangChain) to automate complex network troubleshooting, validation, and root-cause analysis (RCA). 
 - Model Context Protocol (MCP): Build and maintain custom MCP clients and servers to securely expose internal networking tools, documentation (RAG), and script suites as executable "tools" for LLMs. 
 - Event-Driven Remediation: Build closed-loop automation systems using Event-Driven Ansible (EDA) or asynchronous message queues (Celery/Redis/Kafka) to ingest real-time syslogs and trigger proactive self-healing workflows. 
 - Guardrails & Safety Architecture: Implement strict software boundaries and input validation schemas (e. g. , Pydantic) ensuring LLM-generated variables are deterministically parsed, with mandatory Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) approval gates before configuration changes impact production. Required Technical Skill Set

- Automation & Programming: Advanced Ansible AAP, Python (Object-Oriented, Asyncio, FastAPI), robust try/except exception handling, Ansible Core, AWX/Tower, and Jinja2 templating. 
 - AI & GenAI Ecosystems: Deep practical experience with LangGraph, LangChain, or CrewAI; strict JSON/Function Calling; Model Context Protocol (MCP); Semantic Routing; and vector databases (Milvus, Chroma) for network RAG pipelines. 
 - Enterprise Networking & Security: Solid understanding of L2/L3 routing (BGP, OSPF, VXLAN EVPN), SD-WAN architectures, and Secure Service Edge (SSE) frameworks. 
 - Target Vendor Stack (Highly Desirable): Hands-on API experience with Cisco IOS-XE/NX-OS, Meraki SDK, Versa Analytics, and pyZscaler. 
 - DevOps & Observability: Git/GitOps workflows, CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions/GitLab CI), and log streaming architectures (ELK Stack, Kafka, or Splunk). Experience & Qualifications

- Total Experience: 10+ years in Enterprise Network Engineering, DevOps, or Systems Automation. 
 - Automation Focus: 3+ years of dedicated experience building infrastructure automation or developer toolchains. 
 - AI Exposure: 1+ years of hands-on application development involving LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, or local Ollama engines). 
 - Certifications (a plus): Cisco/Red Hat/Ansible
