The role will ensure that products, components, and systems meet defined reliability, durability, performance, and quality requirements through structured testing, data analysis, failure investigation, and continuous improvement. 

The role will work closely with Product Design, Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, and other cross-functional teams to plan and execute reliability tests, identify failure modes, determine root causes, and recommend design or process improvements. 

Key Responsibilities

- Plan, coordinate, and execute reliability, durability, life-cycle, and qualification testing in the Reliability Lab. 
 - Develop test plans, test procedures, test setups, and test schedules based on product and customer requirements. 
 - Operate and ensure proper utilization of reliability laboratory equipment, test rigs, instrumentation, and data-acquisition systems. 
 - Conduct reliability testing under thermal, mechanical, electrical, environmental, and other relevant stress conditions. 
 - Monitor tests, capture test data, identify abnormalities, and ensure timely escalation of test failures. 
 - Perform detailed analysis of test failures and support Root Cause Analysis (RCA), FMEA, 8D, and corrective actions. 
 - Work with Design Engineering to investigate failures and recommend design improvements to enhance product reliability. 
 - Ensure proper documentation of test results, observations, failures, corrective actions, and final conclusions. 
 - Prepare test reports, reliability reports, qualification reports, and technical presentations for engineering and leadership teams. 
 - Support new product development by providing reliability inputs during design verification and validation (DV/PV) activities. 
 - Support qualification and validation of design changes, components, materials, and suppliers. 
 - Ensure calibration and preventive maintenance of laboratory equipment and test infrastructure. 
 - Maintain laboratory standards, safety requirements, testing protocols, and documentation. 
 - Coordinate with external laboratories and testing agencies whenever specialized testing is required. 
 - Analyze reliability data and identify trends, recurring failures, and opportunities for improvement. 
 - Support development and improvement of reliability test methodologies and laboratory capabilities. 
 - Mentor junior engineers/technicians on reliability testing, instrumentation, data analysis, and troubleshooting. 

Key Technical Skills

- Strong knowledge of Reliability Engineering and Reliability Testing. 
 - Hands-on experience with reliability and environmental testing. 
 - Knowledge of FMEA, FTA, RCA, 8D, Weibull analysis, life testing, and accelerated life testing. 
 - Understanding of thermal, mechanical, electrical, and environmental stress testing. 
 - Experience with data acquisition systems, sensors, instrumentation, and test equipment. 
 - Ability to troubleshoot test setups and identify test-system vs. product failures. 
 - Strong data analysis and interpretation skills. 
 - Knowledge of relevant industry/testing standards and engineering practices. 
 - Good understanding of product design and manufacturing processes. 
 - Strong technical documentation and reporting skills. 

Education & Experience

- Bachelor's/Master's degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Electronics, Mechatronics, or related Engineering discipline. 
 - Typically 5-8 years of relevant experience in Reliability Engineering, Product Validation, Testing, or Engineering Laboratory functions. 
 - Hands-on experience working in a Reliability/Test/Validation Lab is preferred. 
 - Experience in HVAC, thermal management, cooling systems, data-center equipment, power electronics, or similar engineered products will be an advantage. 

Key Competencies

- Reliability & Failure Analysis
 - Laboratory & Test Management
 - Technical Problem Solving
 - Data Analysis
 - Root Cause Analysis
 - Product Testing & Validation
 - Project Ownership
 - Cross-functional Collaboration
 - Attention to Detail

Key KPIs

- On-time completion of reliability and qualification testing

About Us

data.description:
We're reinventing the market research industry. Let's reinvent it together. 

At Numerator, we believe tomorrow's success starts with today's market intelligence. We empower the world's leading brands and retailers with unmatched insights into consumer behavior and the influencers that drive it. 

Role overview

This role combines hands-on manual and exploratory testing with practical web test automation. You will assess product changes against requirements, investigate risks that scripted checks may miss, and automate agreed critical user journeys using Playwright and TypeScript. You will work closely with developers, product stakeholders, and QA colleagues to give the team clear, timely evidence about product quality. 

What you will do

Manual and exploratory testing

- Plan and perform functional testing from requirements, acceptance criteria, and product behavior. 
 - Explore new and changed features, edge cases, and end-to-end workflows; identify risks beyond the existing automated suite. 
 - Record reproducible defects with clear steps, expected and actual results, and supporting evidence. 
 - Retest fixes and run focused regression checks to support release decisions. 

Web test automation

- Turn stable, high-value scenarios into maintainable end-to-end tests using Playwright and TypeScript. 
 - Maintain shared fixtures, page objects, selectors, and test data so that tests remain readable and reusable. 
 - Automate critical public and signed-in journeys, including authentication, account and profile flows, surveys, transactions, and forms. 
 - Investigate failures, distinguish product defects from test or environment issues, and improve test reliability and diagnostics. 

Team quality practices

- Collaborate with engineering and product teams during refinement and delivery to clarify acceptance criteria and testability. 
 - Use Git and pull-request workflows to review and contribute automation changes. 
 - Contribute to agreed CI execution, test reporting, and continuous improvement of the team's testing approach. 
 - Use findings from manual and exploratory testing to prioritize new automation coverage. 

What You'll Bring to Numerator

Required Experience And Skills

- Experience performing manual functional testing and exploratory testing for web applications. 
 - Ability to design test scenarios from requirements, investigate unexpected behavior, and report defects clearly. 
 - Practical experience with browser-based test automation; Playwright with TypeScript or JavaScript is the primary stack for this role. 
 - Understanding of maintainable automation design, assertions, test data, and debugging test failures. 
 - Working knowledge of Git and collaborative code review practices. 
 - Clear communication and effective collaboration across QA, engineering, and product teams. 
 - Experience integrating automated tests into CI pipelines and interpreting pipeline results. 
 - Experience with API testing, including validating responses, authentication, and test data. 

Additional Experience

Familiarity with other browser automation tools may be useful as the team's needs evolve. 

How success is measured

- Manual and exploratory testing finds and communicates meaningful risks before release. 
 - Critical agreed user journeys have reliable, maintainable automated coverage. 
 - Test results and defect reports are timely, reproducible, and useful for release decisions. 
 - Automation failures are triaged promptly and avoidable flakiness is reduced. 
 - Changes to product behavior are reflected in relevant test scenarios and automation.

data.title: Director of Engineering, Data Platforms
data.description:
About The Role

Grade Level (for internal use): 

13

We are seeking a strong technical and people leader to join as Director of Engineering, Data Platforms for our offshore team in India. In this role, you will partner closely with the core Databricks team to support the transition of existing data pipelines to the target platform, while continuing to refine, enhance, and operationalize those pipelines for scale, quality, reliability, and secure cloud-native delivery on AWS. AWS data engineering practices commonly emphasize automated and orchestrated data flows, metadata-driven pipelines, and alignment to platform guardrails and security controls. 

This leader will manage a small, focused engineering team responsible for supporting offshore platform adoption and enabling asset-agnostic data onboarding into the enterprise data platform. The role is execution-oriented and collaborative in nature, with accountability for high-quality delivery, engineering rigor, and consistent partnership with global stakeholders. 

You will also support integrations with the enterprise data mastering platform to help ensure trusted, standardized, and reusable data flows across the ecosystem. Experience with NeoXam DataHub is a strong plus, particularly in environments where master, market, reference, risk, and investment data are managed across the full lifecycle-from acquisition through distribution-to create a trusted single source of truth. 

This role is ideal for someone who combines hands-on data platform depth with practical team leadership, strong cross-geography collaboration, and experience establishing repeatable cloud data engineering patterns across modern lakehouse and mastering ecosystems. 

Key Responsibilities

Data Pipeline Transition and Platform Delivery

- Partner with the core Databricks team to plan and execute the transition of existing data pipelines to the target data platform. 
 - Lead the offshore team in enhancing, stabilizing, and optimizing pipelines after transition, with a focus on performance, scalability, maintainability, operational excellence, and secure AWS deployment patterns. 
 - Drive implementation of repeatable engineering patterns for ingestion, transformation, testing, deployment, and monitoring across onboarded datasets. 
 - Ensure pipelines are built and managed in a way that supports long-term platform consistency, reliability, observability, and ease of support. 
 - Guide the design and operation of cloud-native data pipelines leveraging relevant AWS services such as Amazon S3 for durable storage, AWS Glue for integration and catalog-driven processing, and AWS Lake Formation for governed data lake controls. AWS training and prescriptive guidance for data engineering emphasize building, optimizing, and securing solutions with these services. 
 - Promote the use of AWS IAM, encryption, and environment-level controls to enforce secure access to platform resources and data products in line with enterprise governance expectations. AWS guidance highlights alignment with architectural guardrails and security controls for data engineering platforms. 

Data Onboarding and Asset-Agnostic Enablement

- Lead a small team responsible for supporting offshore teams with onboarding data to the enterprise platform in an asset-agnostic manner. 
 - Define and operationalize onboarding patterns that can support a broad range of data assets, domains, and source systems without requiring bespoke platform redesign for each use case. 
 - Work with partner teams to simplify and standardize how data is ingested, transformed, governed, and published to the platform. 
 - Help offshore teams adopt common onboarding frameworks, technical standards, and delivery practices that improve speed and reduce friction. 
 - Establish reusable ingestion and processing patterns across batch and streaming use cases using technologies such as AWS Glue, AWS Lambda, Amazon Kinesis, or event-driven integrations where appropriate to support scalable enterprise onboarding. AWS data engineering curricula and roadmap materials consistently position these services as core building blocks for modern cloud data engineering. 

Data Mastering Platform Integration

- Support integration of platform pipelines and datasets with the enterprise data mastering platform. 
 - Collaborate with upstream and downstream stakeholders to ensure mastered data can be consumed reliably through standardized interfaces and governed data flows. 
 - Help establish data quality controls, reconciliation processes, metadata alignment, and stewardship workflows needed to support trusted mastered data in the platform. 
 - Contribute to issue resolution and continuous improvement related to mastering-related ingestion and distribution workflows. 
 - Support data mastering capabilities aligned with platforms such as NeoXam DataHub, including data acquisition, cleansing, enrichment, mastering, and downstream distribution of trusted data products. NeoXam positions DataHub as a configurable enterprise data management platform for the financial industry that manages the full lifecycle of master, market, risk, and investment data. 
 - Work with business and platform stakeholders to support golden record / golden copy generation and maintenance for key financial datasets, including reference data, instruments, business entities, and related mastered domains. NeoXam DataHub is specifically positioned to provide a single source of truth and has been used in financial services environments for enterprise-level golden copy data management. 

Team Leadership and Delivery Management

- Lead, mentor, and develop a small team of data engineers supporting offshore onboarding and pipeline engineering. 
 - Set clear priorities, manage team execution, and ensure delivery commitments are met with quality and accountability. 
 - Provide day-to-day coaching, technical guidance, and performance feedback to team members. 
 - Foster a strong engineering culture centered on collaboration, continuous improvement, documentation, operational discipline, and measurable service ownership. 
 - Drive engineering rigor across sprint delivery, production readiness, support models, and incident management for business-critical data platforms. 

Collaboration, Governance, and Engineering Standards

- Partner effectively with global platform, architecture, governance, and Databricks-aligned teams to ensure offshore delivery aligns with enterprise standards. 
 - Contribute to design reviews, implementation planning, and technical discussions related to pipeline architecture, onboarding patterns, cloud platform controls, and mastering integrations. 
 - Support governance requirements through appropriate controls around lineage, schema consistency, data quality, retention, and secure access. 
 - Promote adoption of engineering best practices including automated testing, CI/CD, observability, incident response, and production support readiness. 
 - Help establish cloud engineering standards for infrastructure as code, release automation, and environment promotion using tools and services such as AWS CodePipeline, AWS CodeBuild, and infrastructure automation frameworks where appropriate. 
 - Ensure monitoring and operational health practices are in place using logging, alerting, and telemetry patterns appropriate for enterprise data platforms, including AWS-native operational tooling where relevant. 

Required Qualifications

Leadership and Delivery Experience

- 10+ years of experience in data engineering, data platforms, or related engineering domains. 
 - 5+ years of experience leading engineering teams, preferably in a distributed or offshore delivery model. 
 - Proven ability to lead a small, high-performing technical team in an execution-focused environment. 
 - Experience partnering with global or onshore stakeholders to deliver platform and pipeline initiatives across time zones. 

Technical Expertise

- Strong hands-on experience with modern data engineering and pipeline development, including batch and/or streaming data workflows. 
 - Experience working with Databricks-based data platforms and supporting migration or transition of pipelines into a lakehouse-oriented architecture. 
 - Strong familiarity with AWS cloud-native data engineering, including services such as Amazon S3, AWS Glue, AWS Lambda, AWS Lake Formation, and related orchestration, security, and monitoring capabilities used to build scalable and governed data platforms. AWS training materials for data engineering specifically emphasize designing, building, optimizing, and securing data solutions using AWS services. 
 - Working knowledge of technologies and concepts referenced in the source profile, such as Delta Lake, Apache Iceberg, and Databricks Unity Catalog, with the ability to apply them in practical engineering delivery contexts. 
 - Experience supporting data integration patterns involving mastering, MDM, or trusted data distribution workflows. 
 - Solid understanding of data quality, schema management, lineage, metadata, access control, and operational support for production data pipelines. 
 - Experience with AWS IAM, data lake governance, and metadata-driven controls to support secure, policy-aligned platform operations. AWS prescriptive guidance highlights the use of metadata automation, platform guardrails, and security controls in enterprise data engineering. 
 - Familiarity with engineering best practices such as version control, automated testing, CI/CD, infrastructure automation, and monitoring. 
 - Experience designing or overseeing data platform observability and reliability practices, including alerting, monitoring, and operational dashboards. 

Collaboration and Execution

- Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively across offshore and global teams. 
 - Ability to translate broader architectural direction into actionable team deliverables and implementation plans. 
 - Comfortable operating in a role that blends technical leadership, people management, and hands-on delivery oversight. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience supporting enterprise data onboarding frameworks across multiple business domains or asset types. 
 - Familiarity with enterprise data cataloging or metadata management environments, including integrations involving operational and business metadata platforms. 
 - Exposure to data mastering, MDM, reference data, market data, investment data, corporate actions, or golden record workflows in financial services environments. 
 - Knowledge of NeoXam DataHub is a strong plus, particularly for firms using it to centralize financial data, manage the data lifecycle from acquisition to distribution, enable automated workflows, and deliver a single source of truth for mastered datasets. 
 - Experience with NeoXam-style mastering workflows, including consolidation, cleansing, enrichment, reconciliation, and trusted downstream distribution of mastered data. 
 - Experience in regulated or complex enterprise environments where data governance, data controls, and auditability requirements are important. 
 - Databricks certifications, AWS certifications (such as AWS Certified Data Engineer or AWS Certified Solutions Architect), or equivalent practical platform experience are a plus. AWS certification paths remain relevant for modern cloud-native data engineering roles.

Reporting To: Founder / CEO

About the Role

The ideal candidate will have extensive experience in crane design, structural and mechanical calculations, engineering validation, and team leadership. The candidate will be responsible for developing standardized and scalable engineering processes, improving design quality, optimizing costs, and ensuring timely engineering deliverables while maintaining safety, reliability, and compliance with applicable standards. 

We are looking for a leader who can build a strong engineering team, establish systematic design processes, and reduce dependency on individual expertise. 

Key Responsibilities

1. Design & Engineering Leadership

Lead the complete design and engineering of EOT cranes and customized lifting systems. 

Oversee structural design, mechanical calculations, component selection, and technical validation. 

Ensure compliance with applicable IS standards, FEM standards, and customer-specific requirements. 

Review and approve General Arrangement (GA) drawings, detailed engineering drawings, and manufacturing documentation. 

2. Product Standardization & Engineering Systems

Develop standardized, modular, and configurable crane designs while accommodating customer-specific requirements. 

Establish engineering workflows covering customer requirements, GA drawings, detailed design, BOM preparation, and manufacturing release. 

Develop engineering libraries, design templates, calculation sheets, and standard operating procedures (SOPs). 

Implement structured design processes to reduce engineering lead time and dependency on individual team members. 

3. CAD Design & Technical Documentation

Lead the implementation and effective utilization of SolidWorks and 3D design tools. 

Ensure accuracy and timely release of engineering drawings, technical calculations, and Bills of Materials (BOMs). 

Maintain engineering documentation, revision control, and design records. 

Improve collaboration between design and manufacturing teams through effective 3D modelling and drawing practices. 

4. Design for Manufacturing & Cost Optimization

Drive Design for Manufacturing (DFM), value engineering, and cost optimization initiatives. 

Optimize material utilization, component selection, fabrication methods, and assembly processes. 

Identify opportunities to improve product performance, reduce costs, and enhance manufacturability without compromising safety or reliability. 

Work closely with Production, Purchase, Projects, and Quality teams to improve engineering efficiency. 

5. Design Quality & Continuous Improvement

Conduct design reviews, technical risk assessments, and root-cause analysis of engineering issues. 

Reduce design errors, manufacturing rework, and site modifications. 

Establish first-time-right engineering practices and quality checkpoints. 

Drive continuous improvement in design accuracy, engineering productivity, and delivery performance. 

6. Team Management & Cross-Functional Coordination

Build, lead, mentor, and develop a competent design and engineering team. 

Establish clear roles, responsibilities, performance expectations, and technical review mechanisms. 

Collaborate with Sales, Production, Purchase, Projects, Quality, Installation, and Service teams. 

Support technical discussions with customers and resolve complex engineering issues. 

Develop a knowledge-sharing culture to strengthen team capability and reduce key-person dependency. 

Required Skills & Competencies

Strong expertise in EOT crane and material-handling equipment design. 

Knowledge of structural and mechanical engineering calculations. 

Working knowledge of applicable IS standards, FEM standards, and customer specifications. 

Proficiency in SolidWorks, 3D modelling, and AutoCAD. 

Strong understanding of GA drawings, detailed engineering, BOM preparation, and manufacturing drawings. 

Experience in Design for Manufacturing (DFM), value engineering, and cost optimization. 

Strong technical problem-solving, design validation, and root-cause analysis skills. 

Proven experience in engineering team leadership and process development. 

Excellent coordination, decision-making, and communication skills. 

Candidate Profile

B. E. / B. Tech in Mechanical Engineering. 

10-15+ years of relevant experience in EOT cranes, material handling, heavy engineering, or industrial equipment. 

Demonstrated experience leading crane design and engineering teams. 

Strong understanding of end-to-end crane design, from customer requirements to manufacturing release. 

Experience in establishing engineering standards, design libraries, SOPs, and standardized product platforms. 

Ability to balance technical accuracy, safety, manufacturing feasibility, cost, and delivery timelines

data.title: Technical Team Lead – Applied & Agentic AI Systems
data.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. 

The Position

We are looking for a Technical Team Lead (Engineering Manager) who exhibits a player-coach and servant leadership mentality to lead a highly autonomous, multidisciplinary team of AI software developers. You will act as the defining engineering voice serving as the bridge between ambitious business goals and the technical reality of building scalable, ethical, and high-impact AI solutions within a highly regulated healthcare environment. You will collaborate with AI Product Managers, consultants, subject matter experts, platforms leadership and engineers, Roche Digital Technology (Roche IT) and business stakeholders to define, build and operate various kinds of AI solutions, driven by generative AI, agentic and classical Machine Learning. 

In this role, you must successfully balance being on the manager's- and maker's-schedule. You will likely step away from daily feature coding to guide system architecture and perform rigorous code reviews, while simultaneously providing empathetic people management necessary to cultivate a high-performing engineering squad. 

Description Of The Area
At Roche Digital Technology, we are advancing the boundaries of Applied AI. The Applied AI Engineering Team focuses on architecting, building, and operating high-value AI solutions to solve complex business challenges in healthcare. 

In the 2026 tech landscape, we operate in small agile teams (e. g. ~8 members) powered by advanced coding agents (like Claude Code) to develop and ship solutions faster than ever before (through applying Agentic SDLC). This team will not only build end-to-end solutions, but also support "buy and integrate" projects while gathering technical feedback to support the ongoing development of RDT AI Platforms. 

Job Responsibilities
Team Management

- Manage multi-disciplinary team members with different skill sets from your own, injecting stability into the squad within a complex organizational environment
 - Cultivate healthy team dynamics, collaboration, psychological safety, and open communication while maintaining a sustainable pace of work
 - Set clear focus and priorities for the team's delivery work, managing sprint goals in partnership with Product Managers while actively removing roadblocks. Engage in continuous product discovery in partnership with Product Managers and UX leads. Be willing and able to step into a Product Owner role when necessary. 
 - Explain the "WHY" and provide necessary context to your team members

Capability Development & Resource Management: 

- Encourage team members to self-define and drive their career journey and actively enable development opportunities that align with it
 - Manage hiring, onboarding, performance reviews, compensation calibration, succession planning, handling underperformance, and conflict resolution
 - Manage the team's budget, including headcount, software/infrastructure operational costs, and vendor contracts, ensuring financial responsibility

Technical Direction & Architecture: 

- Enable technical decision-making and design of robust, resilient, and highly available systems that integrate generative AI, multi-agent frameworks, RAG/GraphRAG pipelines, state machines, classical ML, and enterprise data ecosystems
 - Establish robust patterns for utilizing LLMs, multimodal foundation models, Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers/clients, and vector, graph and relational databases
 - Ensure newly developed AI applications fit within the context of RDT and Business functions, strictly following architectural patterns, standards, and data strategies established across the functions
 - Identify areas of technical debt and perform pragmatic cost/benefit analyses for resolving this debt, ensuring optimal cloud resource and model inference cost-efficiency
 - Establish and enforce rigorous enterprise standards for code, systems development, identity management, and authentication mechanisms across the team

Agentic SDLC & Code Quality: 

- Ensure the team effectively leverages agentic Software Development Lifecycle workflows and tools daily (e. g. , Claude Code, autonomous agents) to safely accelerate development and automated testing cycles
 - Act as the technical standards keeper; perform or enable effective, rigorous code reviews for both human-written and AI-generated code to maintain strict enterprise software engineering standards

Compliance & Regulatory Alignment: 

- Oversee compliance-by-design strategies for AI deployments, ensuring engineering deliverables are audit-ready and aligned with GxP compliance and Computerized System Validation (CSV)/Software Assurance (CSA) standards
 - Enforce strict data integrity controls (ALCOA+) to preserve validated infrastructure states

Qualifications & Experience

- Education: Bachelor or advanced degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Technology, Science, or a related field
 - Leadership Experience: 3+ years of experience in team leadership and people leadership in an agile product delivery environment, with a proven track record of building and leading high-performing teams
 - Technical Experience: 7+ years of experience working in AI software development teams, with at least 5 years as a hands-on engineer or architect designing cloud-native solutions
 - Regulated Domain Experience: Proven experience operating within a highly regulated environment (pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or clinical healthcare preferred) delivering validated applications
 - Exhibits servant and creative leadership (VACC) behavior
 - Possesses deep active listening and mentoring/coaching skills
 - Demonstrates a leadership presence, strong business acumen, ability to navigate ambiguity, and manage complexity
 - Is a decisive leader, comfortable making decisions in a fast-paced, dynamic environment
 - Brings an enterprise mindset that can break down silos, focusing on delivery through collaboration across organizational boundaries

Technical Skills

- AI & Orchestration Frameworks: Deep practical expertise in multi-agent system design, state machine logic, and orchestration frameworks such as LangChain or LangGraph
 - Classical Machine Learning: strong hands-on background in building applications driven by classical (pre-generative) Machine Learning and MLOps
 - Core Programming: Production-grade mastery in advanced Python for backend/AI workloads and TypeScript for modern frontend interfaces and generative AI and classical ML UX/UI. Strong foundational understanding of modern full-stack development environments
 - Data & Cloud Platforms: Strong architectural understanding of enterprise data platforms like Snowflake, vector databases (e. g. , AWS OpenSearch), and graph databases (e. g. , AWS Neptune)
 - Cloud Engineering & DevOps: High proficiency overseeing AWS cloud architecture (including serverless workloads, Amazon Bedrock, SageMaker, etc. ), managing fully automated CI/CD pipelines, containerization (Docker), and Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform)
 - AI Observability: Experience defining monitoring, logging, and telemetry strategies to track model drift, API/MCP health, resource utilization, and anomaly identification

Additional Qualifications

- Excels in communicating in English highly effectively and clearly, at the level of: C1+
 - Strong stakeholder management skills to influence non-technical Senior Stakeholders on complex architectural designs
 - Be passionate about AI, staying up-to-date with the latest developments in LLMs, GenAI, agentic, classical ML, cloud computing, and software architectures
 - Be team-oriented, proactive, and collaborative , with the ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment
 - Be an excellent problem solver and analytical thinker, detail-oriented and highly organized
 - Be willing to learn and expand their skill set in an environment where roles are fluid and multidisciplinary

Located in Hyderabad, India, with working hours structured to capture the 'golden hours' of overlap with Central European Time (typically running through the IST evening). 

Who we are

A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100'000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. 

Let's build a healthier future, together. 

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

data.title: Director of Engineering, Data Platforms
data.description:
About The Role

Grade Level (for internal use): 

13

We are seeking a strong technical and people leader to join as Director of Engineering, Data Platforms for our offshore team in India. In this role, you will partner closely with the core Databricks team to support the transition of existing data pipelines to the target platform, while continuing to refine, enhance, and operationalize those pipelines for scale, quality, reliability, and secure cloud-native delivery on AWS. AWS data engineering practices commonly emphasize automated and orchestrated data flows, metadata-driven pipelines, and alignment to platform guardrails and security controls. 

This leader will manage a small, focused engineering team responsible for supporting offshore platform adoption and enabling asset-agnostic data onboarding into the enterprise data platform. The role is execution-oriented and collaborative in nature, with accountability for high-quality delivery, engineering rigor, and consistent partnership with global stakeholders. 

You will also support integrations with the enterprise data mastering platform to help ensure trusted, standardized, and reusable data flows across the ecosystem. Experience with NeoXam DataHub is a strong plus, particularly in environments where master, market, reference, risk, and investment data are managed across the full lifecycle-from acquisition through distribution-to create a trusted single source of truth. 

This role is ideal for someone who combines hands-on data platform depth with practical team leadership, strong cross-geography collaboration, and experience establishing repeatable cloud data engineering patterns across modern lakehouse and mastering ecosystems. 

Key Responsibilities

Data Pipeline Transition and Platform Delivery

- Partner with the core Databricks team to plan and execute the transition of existing data pipelines to the target data platform. 
 - Lead the offshore team in enhancing, stabilizing, and optimizing pipelines after transition, with a focus on performance, scalability, maintainability, operational excellence, and secure AWS deployment patterns. 
 - Drive implementation of repeatable engineering patterns for ingestion, transformation, testing, deployment, and monitoring across onboarded datasets. 
 - Ensure pipelines are built and managed in a way that supports long-term platform consistency, reliability, observability, and ease of support. 
 - Guide the design and operation of cloud-native data pipelines leveraging relevant AWS services such as Amazon S3 for durable storage, AWS Glue for integration and catalog-driven processing, and AWS Lake Formation for governed data lake controls. AWS training and prescriptive guidance for data engineering emphasize building, optimizing, and securing solutions with these services. 
 - Promote the use of AWS IAM, encryption, and environment-level controls to enforce secure access to platform resources and data products in line with enterprise governance expectations. AWS guidance highlights alignment with architectural guardrails and security controls for data engineering platforms. 

Data Onboarding and Asset-Agnostic Enablement

- Lead a small team responsible for supporting offshore teams with onboarding data to the enterprise platform in an asset-agnostic manner. 
 - Define and operationalize onboarding patterns that can support a broad range of data assets, domains, and source systems without requiring bespoke platform redesign for each use case. 
 - Work with partner teams to simplify and standardize how data is ingested, transformed, governed, and published to the platform. 
 - Help offshore teams adopt common onboarding frameworks, technical standards, and delivery practices that improve speed and reduce friction. 
 - Establish reusable ingestion and processing patterns across batch and streaming use cases using technologies such as AWS Glue, AWS Lambda, Amazon Kinesis, or event-driven integrations where appropriate to support scalable enterprise onboarding. AWS data engineering curricula and roadmap materials consistently position these services as core building blocks for modern cloud data engineering. 

Data Mastering Platform Integration

- Support integration of platform pipelines and datasets with the enterprise data mastering platform. 
 - Collaborate with upstream and downstream stakeholders to ensure mastered data can be consumed reliably through standardized interfaces and governed data flows. 
 - Help establish data quality controls, reconciliation processes, metadata alignment, and stewardship workflows needed to support trusted mastered data in the platform. 
 - Contribute to issue resolution and continuous improvement related to mastering-related ingestion and distribution workflows. 
 - Support data mastering capabilities aligned with platforms such as NeoXam DataHub, including data acquisition, cleansing, enrichment, mastering, and downstream distribution of trusted data products. NeoXam positions DataHub as a configurable enterprise data management platform for the financial industry that manages the full lifecycle of master, market, risk, and investment data. 
 - Work with business and platform stakeholders to support golden record / golden copy generation and maintenance for key financial datasets, including reference data, instruments, business entities, and related mastered domains. NeoXam DataHub is specifically positioned to provide a single source of truth and has been used in financial services environments for enterprise-level golden copy data management. 

Team Leadership and Delivery Management

- Lead, mentor, and develop a small team of data engineers supporting offshore onboarding and pipeline engineering. 
 - Set clear priorities, manage team execution, and ensure delivery commitments are met with quality and accountability. 
 - Provide day-to-day coaching, technical guidance, and performance feedback to team members. 
 - Foster a strong engineering culture centered on collaboration, continuous improvement, documentation, operational discipline, and measurable service ownership. 
 - Drive engineering rigor across sprint delivery, production readiness, support models, and incident management for business-critical data platforms. 

Collaboration, Governance, and Engineering Standards

- Partner effectively with global platform, architecture, governance, and Databricks-aligned teams to ensure offshore delivery aligns with enterprise standards. 
 - Contribute to design reviews, implementation planning, and technical discussions related to pipeline architecture, onboarding patterns, cloud platform controls, and mastering integrations. 
 - Support governance requirements through appropriate controls around lineage, schema consistency, data quality, retention, and secure access. 
 - Promote adoption of engineering best practices including automated testing, CI/CD, observability, incident response, and production support readiness. 
 - Help establish cloud engineering standards for infrastructure as code, release automation, and environment promotion using tools and services such as AWS CodePipeline, AWS CodeBuild, and infrastructure automation frameworks where appropriate. 
 - Ensure monitoring and operational health practices are in place using logging, alerting, and telemetry patterns appropriate for enterprise data platforms, including AWS-native operational tooling where relevant. 

Required Qualifications

Leadership and Delivery Experience

- 10+ years of experience in data engineering, data platforms, or related engineering domains. 
 - 5+ years of experience leading engineering teams, preferably in a distributed or offshore delivery model. 
 - Proven ability to lead a small, high-performing technical team in an execution-focused environment. 
 - Experience partnering with global or onshore stakeholders to deliver platform and pipeline initiatives across time zones. 

Technical Expertise

- Strong hands-on experience with modern data engineering and pipeline development, including batch and/or streaming data workflows. 
 - Experience working with Databricks-based data platforms and supporting migration or transition of pipelines into a lakehouse-oriented architecture. 
 - Strong familiarity with AWS cloud-native data engineering, including services such as Amazon S3, AWS Glue, AWS Lambda, AWS Lake Formation, and related orchestration, security, and monitoring capabilities used to build scalable and governed data platforms. AWS training materials for data engineering specifically emphasize designing, building, optimizing, and securing data solutions using AWS services. 
 - Working knowledge of technologies and concepts referenced in the source profile, such as Delta Lake, Apache Iceberg, and Databricks Unity Catalog, with the ability to apply them in practical engineering delivery contexts. 
 - Experience supporting data integration patterns involving mastering, MDM, or trusted data distribution workflows. 
 - Solid understanding of data quality, schema management, lineage, metadata, access control, and operational support for production data pipelines. 
 - Experience with AWS IAM, data lake governance, and metadata-driven controls to support secure, policy-aligned platform operations. AWS prescriptive guidance highlights the use of metadata automation, platform guardrails, and security controls in enterprise data engineering. 
 - Familiarity with engineering best practices such as version control, automated testing, CI/CD, infrastructure automation, and monitoring. 
 - Experience designing or overseeing data platform observability and reliability practices, including alerting, monitoring, and operational dashboards. 

Collaboration and Execution

- Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively across offshore and global teams. 
 - Ability to translate broader architectural direction into actionable team deliverables and implementation plans.

data.description:

Job Description: Innovation Lead

Role Overview

Seeking a visionary and hands-on Innovation Lead to drive the design, prototyping, and delivery of next-generation solutions across the organization. This leader will identify emerging technologies-particularly in Artificial Intelligence / Generative AI, cloud (AWS), and data platforms-and translate them into production-grade capabilities built on a strong . NET/Java engineering foundation. The Innovation Lead will champion rapid experimentation, build reusable innovation frameworks, embed intelligent automation across the software delivery lifecycle, and mentor teams to adopt modern engineering practices at scale. 

Key Responsibilities

AI & Emerging Technology Innovation

- Define and drive the AI/innovation roadmap aligned to business strategy and measurable outcomes. 
 - Identify, evaluate, and prototype emerging technologies (Generative AI, LLMs, ML, agentic workflows, RAG) and convert successful proof-of-concepts into production solutions. 
 - Design and implement AI-powered features such as intelligent assistants, document/data extraction, recommendation systems, forecasting, and anomaly detection. 
 - Establish frameworks for LLM integration, prompt engineering, RAG pipelines, vector search, fine-tuning, and model evaluation. 
 - Implement Responsible AI practices-governance, bias mitigation, data privacy, guardrails, and cost/performance optimization. 
 - Run innovation sprints, hackathons, and tech-scouting to build a culture of experimentation. 

Cloud Solution Architecture (AWS)

- Architect scalable, secure, and cost-optimized solutions on AWS. 
 - Design and build using core AWS services: 
 - Compute: Lambda, ECS/EKS, EC2
 - AI/ML: Bedrock, SageMaker, Comprehend, Textract, Kendra
 - Data & Storage: S3, RDS, DynamoDB, Redshift, Aurora

 - Observability & Security: CloudWatch, IAM, KMS, Secrets Manager
 - Implement Infrastructure as Code (Terraform / AWS CDK / CloudFormation) for repeatable, automated deployments. 
 - Build ephemeral and self-service environments to accelerate prototyping and experimentation. 
 - Optimize cloud utilization, performance, and cost. 
Data & Database Engineering

- Design and optimize relational and NoSQL databases (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Oracle, DynamoDB, MongoDB). 
 - Architect data pipelines, ETL/ELT flows, and data models supporting analytics and AI workloads. 
 - Implement vector databases (pgvector, OpenSearch, Pinecone) to support semantic search and RAG. 
 - Ensure data quality, governance, lineage, security, and compliance. 
 - Enable data-driven decision-making through dashboards, analytics, and reporting. 

Application Engineering (. NET / Java)

- Lead the design and development of enterprise-grade applications and microservices using . NET (C#) and/or Java (Spring Boot). 
 - Define architecture standards, coding best practices, API design (REST/GraphQL/gRPC), and design patterns. 
 - Build robust, secure, high-performance backend services and integration layers. 
 - Modernize legacy applications and migrate workloads to cloud-native architectures. 

Automation & Engineering Excellence

- Embed intelligent automation across the full software delivery lifecycle. 
 - Design and build automated frameworks for: 
 - CI/CD and deployment automation
 - Testing (UI, API, end-to-end) using Playwright
 - Infrastructure provisioning and teardown
 - Data generation and environment setup
 - Create configurable mock services, simulators, and stubs for third-party dependencies to enable independent development and testing (success/failure scenarios, timeouts, latency, rate limiting, auth failures, edge cases). 
 - Integrate automation and quality gates into CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, Jenkins). 
 - Enable parallel execution, self-service capabilities, and reusable platforms for engineering teams. 
DevOps & Observability

- Champion DevOps culture-containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), automation, and continuous delivery. 
 - Implement monitoring, logging, tracing, and diagnostics for applications and infrastructure. 
 - Drive reliability, scalability, security, and execution speed across platforms. 

Leadership & Collaboration

- Mentor and technically lead cross-functional engineering teams. 
 - Partner with product, business, and leadership stakeholders to align innovation with strategic goals. 
 - Communicate complex technical concepts to technical and non-technical audiences. 
 - Evangelize best practices, reusable assets, and a culture of continuous learning. 

Required Skills

AI & Machine Learning

- Hands-on experience with Generative AI / LLMs (OpenAI, Anthropic, AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI). 
 - Experience with RAG, prompt engineering, embeddings, vector databases, and model evaluation. 
 - Familiarity with ML frameworks and MLOps concepts. 
 - Understanding of Responsible AI, governance, and security. 

Programming & Application Development

- Strong hands-on expertise in . NET (C#) and/or Java (Spring Boot). 
 - Experience designing microservices, APIs, and distributed systems. 
 - Working knowledge of Python and TypeScript/JavaScript is a strong plus. 

AWS & Cloud Infrastructure

- IAM, Lambda, ECS/EKS, API Gateway, S3, DynamoDB, RDS/Aurora, Step Functions, EventBridge, CloudWatch. 
 - AI/ML services: Bedrock, SageMaker, Textract, Comprehend. 
 - Infrastructure as Code: Terraform (preferred), AWS CDK, CloudFormation. 

Databases & Data

- Strong SQL and NoSQL database design and optimization. 
 - Data modeling, ETL/ELT pipelines, and data governance. 
 - Vector/semantic search technologies. 

Automation & DevOps

- Playwright for UI, API, and end-to-end automation; cross-browser testing (Chrome, Edge, Firefox). 
 - Service virtualization & mocking: WireMock, MockServer, Hoverfly, Mountebank, Pact. 
 - Containerization: Docker, Kubernetes. 
 - CI/CD: GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, Jenkins. 
 - Test data generation and management

Ideal Candidate Profile

- 12+ years of experience in software engineering, solution architecture, platform engineering, or innovation/R&D roles. 
 - Proven track record of taking AI and emerging-technology ideas from concept to production at scale. 
 - Strong AWS automation and Infrastructure-as-Code expertise. 
 - Deep hands-on . NET and/or Java development background with strong database engineering skills. 
 - Demonstrated experience building automation frameworks, mock services, and self-service platforms. 
 - Strong understanding of microservices, APIs, distributed systems, cloud-native design, and CI/CD practices. 
 - Excellent leadership, communication, and stakeholder-management skills. 
 - A builder's mindset-curious, pragmatic, and biased toward rapid experimentation and delivery.

data.title: Senior Software Engineer - Networking
data.description:
Join the Team That's Redefining Wireless Technology

At Tarana, we're more than just a fast-growing tech company-we're a team of bold innovators on a mission to revolutionize broadband. Our groundbreaking Fixed Wireless Access technology is delivering fiber-class internet speeds worldwide, bridging the digital divide in ways previously thought impossible. 

We are seeking an experienced Senior Software Engineer - Networking. This role involves technical ownership, hands-on design, and active participation across different stages of network and cloud software development. The ideal candidate will have a deep understanding of networking, software development best practices, and a passion for driving innovation. Experience shipping working products in the networking/telecom/embedded domain is essential. 

We don't just build next-gen wireless technology-we build people. 

What You'll Be Doing

You will be designing, developing, and integrating critical elements for the network stack of our wireless communication systems, including data plane, control plane, security, and remote/cloud management: 

- Data Plane & Packet Processing: Design and implement Layer 2 and Layer 3 networking features, packet forwarding, routing, bridging, switching, VLAN architectures, traffic management/classification, and SLA enforcement. 
 - Hardware & Device Interfacing: Implement software interfaces for underlying hardware devices (ASIC/FPGA), switch management, configuration engines, alarms, diagnostics, and WebUI/CLI backends. 
 - Security & Network Services: Build network security services, including authentication, encryption, encapsulation, and tunneling (e. g. , IPSec, CAPWAP, 802. 1x). 
 - Frameworks & Telemetry: Implement scalable network and cloud management frameworks for device provisioning, event logging, telemetry collection, and automated fault isolation/analysis. 
 - System Resilience: Design decentralized network services with a focus on scalability, resilience, high availability, and interoperability with customer networks. 

What You'll Need

- B. E. /B. Tech. /M. E. /M. Tech. /MS in Computer Science/Engineering with at least 7+ years of relevant software development experience, OR MS/PhD with at least 5+ years of relevant experience. 
 - Strong experience in socket, network, and systems programming using C or C++ on UNIX-style operating systems (IPC, multi-threading). 
 - Advanced knowledge of computer networks (TCP/IP), Internet architecture, and core protocols (e. g. , IGMP, DHCP, OSPF, BGP). 
 - Expertise in packet forwarding, routing, bridging, switching, VLANs, Ethernet services, and Ethernet OA&M. 
 - Familiarity with network/cloud management and configuration/provisioning systems (e. g. , YANG Models, gRPC, NETCONF, SNMP, TR-69, HTTP, OpenFlow). 
 - Strong debugging and problem-solving skills, with a proven ability to drive complex issues to closure. 
 - Previous experience in embedded software development for carrier and/or enterprise telecom products is a big plus. 

Nice to Have

- Strong C++ or Go programming experience; proficiency with scripting languages (Python, Bash). 
 - Experience using AI tools/agents across the software development lifecycle (from requirements analysis to field debugging). 
 - Background in MAC or network-layer implementations of 802. 11, LTE, or other OFDM wireless standards. 

Join Tarana and help shape the future of wireless connectivity. 

About Us

Tarana's mission is to accelerate the deployment of fast, affordable, and reliable internet access around the world. Through a decade of R&D and over $400M of investment, the Tarana team has created and continues to enhance a suite of next-generation fixed wireless access (ngFWA) technologies. data.title: Cloud Engineer - 5+yrs - SRE, Cloud Operations, DevOps / Platform Engineering
data.description:
Meet the Team

The Webex Contact Center team builds and operates a global, cloud-native customer-experience platform that helps organizations connect with their customers across voice and digital channels. Our services support business-critical customer interactions across multiple regions. 

Within Webex Contact Center, our Cloud Operations and Site Reliability Engineering team is responsible for the availability, performance, and operational health of shared AWS and Kubernetes platforms. We work closely with application engineering, infrastructure, security, and architecture teams to operate production services, improve observability, automate operational work, and make deployments safer. 

We are a collaborative team that learns from incidents and supports one another during operational challenges. If you enjoy troubleshooting production systems and turning recurring problems into automation, we would be excited to hear from you!

Your Impact

As a Cloud Engineer and Site Reliability Engineer, you will help us operate and improve the AWS- and Kubernetes-based platforms supporting Webex Contact Center. Together, we will monitor service health, investigate application and infrastructure failures, restore service during incidents, and implement improvements that prevent recurrence. 

You will participate in a shared on-call rotation and use PagerDuty, logs, metrics, traces, Kubernetes events, and infrastructure signals to understand customer and service impact. You will contribute to incident coordination, root-cause analysis, blameless post-incident reviews, and corrective actions that reduce recovery time and alert noise. 

You will use Python and Terraform to automate infrastructure provisioning, deployment validation, Kubernetes lifecycle activities, recovery procedures, and repetitive operational work. You will also help improve release safety through automated health checks, progressive delivery, rollback, and tested recovery procedures. 

Working with application and platform teams, you will improve logging, monitoring, and alerting using technologies such as Grafana, VictoriaMetrics, Splunk, OpenSearch, Elasticsearch, and CloudWatch. You will help define meaningful service-level indicators and objectives, improve capacity and performance, and create dashboards, runbooks, and troubleshooting procedures that make our services easier to operate. 

Success in this role means our services consistently meet their reliability objectives, incidents are detected and resolved faster, deployments become safer, and recurring operational problems are addressed through engineering and automation. 

Minimum Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, plus 5 years of relevant experience; a master's degree plus 3 years of relevant experience; or equivalent practical experience. 
 - Experience operating and improving business-critical production services, cloud infrastructure, or distributed applications in Site Reliability Engineering, cloud operations, DevOps, or platform engineering. 
 - Experience operating and troubleshooting production Kubernetes environments, preferably Amazon EKS, including Linux, containers, networking, storage, configuration, secrets, health probes, and resource management. 
 - Experience diagnosing application and infrastructure failures using logs, metrics, traces, Kubernetes events, network behavior, dependency information, and deployment history. 
 - Experience with AWS infrastructure and services such as VPC networking, IAM, load balancing, S3, and CloudWatch, along with Python and Terraform automation. 
 - Experience using Git and supporting CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, production deployments, health validation, and rollback. 
 - Experience participating in an on-call rotation and responding to production incidents, including triage, service restoration, communication, root-cause analysis, and corrective actions. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience creating actionable dashboards, alerts, service-level indicators, service-level objectives, and error-budget practices for customer-facing services. 
 - Experience with observability technologies such as Grafana, VictoriaMetrics, Splunk, OpenSearch, Elasticsearch, Prometheus, or CloudWatch. 
 - Experience troubleshooting Istio-based service communication and Kafka-based distributed services. 
 - Experience using PagerDuty or a comparable incident-management platform and improving escalation, incident-coordination, and alerting practices. 
 - Experience with Helm, Kustomize, Argo CD, GitLab, Jenkins, or comparable Kubernetes delivery technologies. 
 - Experience improving the availability, scalability, capacity, performance, disaster recovery, or cost efficiency of distributed cloud services. 
 - Experience leading incident investigations, operational-readiness reviews, or reliability improvements and helping other engineers develop production-support skills. 
 - Clear written and verbal communication skills, including experience creating runbooks, troubleshooting guides, operational procedures, and incident reports. 
 - Experience using AI-assisted engineering tools for code analysis, test development, incident investigation, documentation, or change-impact analysis. 

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we're revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era - and beyond. We've been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint. 

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you'll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. 

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you. 

Disclaimer

About

To ensure that we hire the best talent in the right way, we follow a strict hiring process and recently, Cisco has been made aware of fraudulent recruiters claiming to be from the company. Please be advised that any communication from Cisco about careers will: 

- be in direct response to an application you have submitted through the company career site
 - begin with screening or an interview
 - originate from a Cisco email address, and
 - be conducted across email, phone, or WebEx

Cisco will never make a job offer without conducting an interview process or ask you for money in any way. If you have been requested to apply for a role or have received an offer from a site other than https: //careers. cisco. com or cisco. wd5. myworkday. com, do not provide any personal identifying information, including your Aadhaar or other personal identifying number, birth certificate, banking information, driver's license, or passport. 

If you are the target of a recruiting scam, consider filing a report with your local law enforcement authorities. Cisco bears no responsibility, and cannot be held liable, for any claims, damages, expenses, or other inconvenience resulting from or in any way connected to recruiting scams.

data.title: Assistant Vice President – Quality Assurance (AML)
data.description:
Job Title: Assistant Vice President - Quality Assurance (AML)

Department: ISPL CEFS AML Operations

About Business Line/Function

CEFS team is leveraging an integrated model; the Team delivers a comprehensive range of solutions to various business lines of the Group across the globe. The services include referential data management, Know Your Customer (KYC), Due Diligence preparation (client recertification and onboarding), credit administration and post-trade client services, AML transaction monitoring and Actimize support Projects. 

Position Purpose

An Assistant Vice President (AVP) for Quality Assurance (QA) within the Anti-Money Laundering (AML) domain occupies a middle-management role. They act as a critical line of defense, ensuring that the processes used to detect, prevent, and report money laun dering and terrorist financing are effective, compliant, and operating according to regulatory standards. 

Responsibilities

- Alert Disposition & Investigation Validation
 - Decision Accuracy Review: Auditing a sample of "Closed/No Suspicion" alerts to ensure that investigators have provided sufficient rationale and that the activity truly does not warrant an escalation. 
 - Investigation Quality Assessment: Evaluating the depth of the "investigative trail"-ensuring investigators have looked beyond the single alert to review the client's historical behavior, source of wealth, and related party transactions. 
 - Narrative & Documentation Audit: Verifying that the written rationales in the Case Management System (CMS) are clear, logical, and would stand up to scrutiny from a regulator or internal auditor. 
 - Red Flag Identification: Ensuring that specific typologies (e. g. , structuring, smurfing, rapid movement of funds, or unusual geographic activity) were correctly identified and addressed during the investigation. 
 - Detection Logic & System Effectiveness (The "Second Line" view)
 - Threshold & Scenario Testing: Partnering with the TM Tuning team to validate whether current detection scenarios (rules) are effective or if they are producing excessive false positives/missed true positives. 
 - False Positive Analysis: Analyzing trends in "false positives" to identify if specific rules require recalibration or if they are no longer capturing relevant risk. 
 - Model Validation Support: Providing QA insights during the periodic review of the Transaction Monitoring System (TMS) to ensure the mathematical logic of the alerts aligns with the bank's risk appetite. 
 - Regulatory Reporting (SAR/STR) Oversight
 - Reporting Quality Assurance: Performing a final check on Suspicious Activity Reports (SARs) or Suspicious Transaction Reports (STRs) to ensure the "Who, What, Where, When, and Why" is clearly articulated. 
 - Timeliness Monitoring: Ensuring that the time elapsed from the initial alert trigger to the final regulatory filing meets the statutory deadlines (e. g. , the "30-day rule"). 
 - Escalation Integrity: Verifying that all alerts that met the threshold for "suspicion" were actually escalated to the SAR filing stage and not inappropriately dismissed. 
 - Risk-Based QA Strategy & Metrics
 - Risk-Based Sampling Design: Instead of random sampling, designing a QA program that prioritizes high-risk segments (e. g. , PEPs, high-risk jurisdictions, or correspondent banking) for deeper scrutiny. 
 - Error Trend Analysis: Categorizing errors (e. g. , "failure to identify source of funds, " "insufficient profile review, " or "incorrect data entry") to identify systemic training gaps. 
 - KPI/KRI Development: Defining and tracking specific Key Quality Indicators (KQIs) such as: 
 - Error Rate per Investigator. 
 - Percentage of overturned decisions (where QA disagrees with the Investigator). 
 - Average age of open alerts (Backlog Management). 
 - Stakeholder & Remediation Management
 - Feedback Loop Management: Implementing a formal process to provide "Return to Investigator" (RTI) feedback, ensuring that errors are corrected and lessons are learned. 
 - Remediation Oversight: Leading the QA effort during "look-back" projects (remediation exercises) where a systemic failure requires the re-review of months or years of transaction data. 
 - Audit Liaison: Acting as the subject matter expert (SME) for Transaction Monitoring when interviewed by Internal Audit or external regulators regarding the effectiveness of the monitoring program. 
 - People 
 - Provide leadership and direction to the CEFS department and its employees, set conditions and manage its resources in order to optimize departmental services for maximum fulfillment of (internal and external) client needs within determined strategy and budget. 
 - Work with ISPL CLM Operations sub-departments to develop a strong expertise & knowledge on end to end process / delivery. Coach & mentor top talent and define clear career path for them
 - Promote, within ISPL Client Engagement Operations department, a mindset around accountability, continuous improvement, client focus, change management & innovation
 - Proven aptitude to lead and manage high performing teams
 - Team Attrition & Engagement: Maintaining high employee morale and managing turnover within the monitoring team. 

Technical & Behavioral Competencies

- Proficiency in MS Office and VBA Macros. 
 - Rapid adaptability to new systems. 
 - Strong technical aptitude. 
 - Commitment to continuous technological learning. 
 - Logical problem-solving capabilities. 
 - Ability to work autonomously and collaborate with global teams. 
 - Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills. 
 - Decisive leadership on complex business and technical issues. 
 - Preferred experience in banking, payments, or compliance. 

Specific Qualifications

- Minimum 10-14 years of experience along with Bachelor's Degree - in management, finance, science, economics, related field or equivalent experience. 
 - Prior experience in similar domain. 

Skills Referential (Required Knowledge, Skills And Abilities)

- Collaborative teamwork. 
 - Strong oral and written communication. 
 - Ability to synthesize and simplify information. 
 - Strong organizational skills. 

Transversal Skills

- Strong analytical skills. 
 - Process development and adaptation. 
 - Project management proficiency. 
 - Meeting, seminar, committee, and training facilitation. 

Key Performance Indicators & Collaboration For The Role

- Departmental SLA Compliance: The percentage of total team alerts and investigations completed within regulatory or internal timelines. 
 - Resource Utilization & Capacity Planning: Efficiency in managing headcount against alert volumes (ensuring the team is neither over-burdened nor under-utilized). 
 - Backlog Management: Ability to control and reduce the volume of aged/overdue alerts to prevent regulatory breaches. 
 - Cost Per Alert/Investigation: Managing the operational budget by optimizing the cost of processing a single alert (balancing headcount vs. automation). 
 - Talent Development: Success in upskilling Associates into Seniors and Seniors into Leads (succession planning). 
 - Audit & Regulatory Exam Performance: The ability to defend the department's processes and findings during internal audits or external regulatory examinations. 
 - IT & Product Management: Partnering with technical teams to drive system upgrades, rule tuning, and the implementation of automation/AI tools. 
 - Cross-Functional Project Leadership: Leading multi-departmental task forces for large-scale system migrations or regulatory remediation projects. 
 - Representing CEFS ISPL locally and globally in all required forums, decision making and execution at ground level. 

Direct Report to: Vice President (VP)

Education Level: Bachelor Degree or equivalent

Location: Mumbai

About BNP Paribas Group

BNP Paribas is the European Union's leading bank and key player in international banking. It operates in 65 countries and has nearly 185, 000 employees, including more than 145, 000 in Europe. The Group has key positions in its three main fields of activity: Commercial, Personal Banking & Services for the Group's commercial & personal banking and several specialized businesses including BNP Paribas Personal Finance and Arval; Investment & Protection Services for savings, investment, and protection solutions; and Corporate & Institutional Banking, focused on corporate and institutional clients. Based on its strong diversified and integrated model, the Group helps all its clients (individuals, community associations, entrepreneurs, SMEs, corporates and institutional clients) to realize their projects through solutions spanning financing, investment, savings and protection insurance. In Europe, BNP Paribas has four domestic markets: Belgium, France, Italy, and Luxembourg. The Group is rolling out its integrated commercial & personal banking model across several Mediterranean countries, Turkey, and Eastern Europe. As a key player in international banking, the Group has leading platforms and business lines in Europe, a strong presence in the Americas as well as a solid and fast-growing business in Asia-Pacific. BNP Paribas has implemented a Corporate Social Responsibility approach in all its activities, enabling it to contribute to the construction of a sustainable future, while ensuring the Group's performance and stability. 

About BNP Paribas India Solutions

Established in 2005, BNP Paribas India Solutions is a wholly owned subsidiary of BNP Paribas SA, European Union's leading bank with an international reach. With delivery centers located in Bengaluru, Chennai and Mumbai, we are a 24x7 global delivery center. India Solutions services three business lines: Corporate and Institutional Banking, Investment Solutions and Retail Banking for BNP Paribas across the Group. Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

At BNP Paribas, we passionately embrace diversity and are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where all employees are valued, respected and can bring their authentic selves to work. We prohibit Discrimination and Harassment of any kind and our policies promote equal employment opportunity for all employees and applicants, irrespective of, but not limited to their gender, gender identity, sex, sexual orientation, ethnicity, race, colour, national origin, age, religion, social status, mental or physical disabilities, veteran status etc. As a global Bank, we truly believe that inclusion and diversity of our teams is key to our success in serving our clients and the communities we operate in. data.title: Hardware Developer
data.description:
Introduction

IBM System Z (IBM Z) mainframes are engineered for the highest levels of reliability, availability, and serviceability (RAS). Hardware validation ensures every subsystem of the platform meets IBM's strict quality standards before it is shipped to customers. 

Looking for a Hardware Engineer to work on our EST squad executing and automating test scenarios. This job role provides a wide range of technical experiences, from hardware handling to running programs on a variety of operating systems. It also offers a lot of troubleshooting, investigation and problem resolution. This encompasses several sub-roles including: machine configuration, operation, maintenance, error handling and investigation, troubleshooting bugs, defect reporting, operating system knowledge, and workload execution. In addition, there is a strong desire to transform traditional test methods to a more automated approach which will require a significant amount of programming & scripting. We need someone with the drive to find machine bugs and work with our development team until the issue has been resolved. A team player is a must! In order to ensure success, the candidate will need a willingness to continuously seek education to build their skills. This, along with a strong desire to replace traditional manually initiated workload/testing with automated execution techniques will be a big plus. 

Your Role And Responsibilities

This role is critical in validating enterprise‐class workloads on System Z platforms that support mission‐critical business operations worldwide. The scope includes testing and certification of complex System Z configurations, with emphasis on: 

- Design, develop, and execute IBM Z channel subsystem test plans for enterprise hardware platforms. 
 - Identifying existing manual test scenarios and workloads and design programmatic automation to replace them. 
 - Validate channel path configuration, I/O routing, adapter connectivity, and subsystem functionality. 
 - Perform high-availability and redundancy validation, including path failover and recovery testing. 
 - Investigate and debug I/O recovery failures through log analysis, diagnostics, and root-cause determination
 - Participate in test strategy, test planning, and customer-focused validation to ensure robust and reliable I/O recovery capabilities. 
 - Working with firmware development to understand the technical details of new firmware features in order to design appropriate test scenarios and workloads to validate them
 - Growing knowledge of physical server design and logical constructs behind its operation
 - Hardware handling, maintenance, changes and manipulation
 - Working with multiple Z mainframe operating systems to execute workloads that are used to verify the latest hardware and firmware deliveries
 - Large amount of troubleshooting, investigation and problem resolution. 

Preferred Education

Master's Degree

Required Technical And Professional Expertise

Required Technical and Professional Expertise with relevant experience of 8 to 10 years

- Hardware system testing and validation. 
 - I/O subsystem, networking, and storage technologies. 
 - Error injection and fault tolerance testing. 
 - Performance and stress testing methodologies. 
 - Test automation using Python, Shell scripting, or similar technologies. 
 - Debugging, log analysis, and root cause analysis. 
 - Knowledge of IBM Z, Linux, virtualization, or enterprise server environments is highly desirable. 
 - Strong understanding of computer architecture (CPU, memory hierarchy, buses, I/O subsystems). 
 - Familiarity with PCIe, USB, Ethernet, SAS/SATA, NVMe, DDR, or similar protocols. 
 - Good knowledge of firmware/BIOS, drivers, and low-level debugging. 
 - Gather and analyze hardware requirements to create detailed test plans, test matrices, and test strategies. 
 - Identify coverage gaps and ensure test completeness across hardware components. 
 - Proficiency in scripting (Python/Shell/Bash) for automation, tooling, and operational efficiency. 
 - Demonstrated experience in automation of deployments, monitoring, and operational workflows using scripting or orchestration tools. 
 - Strong team player with good communication and interpersonal skills. 
 - Proven ability to work effectively in a global team environment. 

Optional (Nice to Have)

Experience with CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure automation tools (e. g. , Ansible, Jenkins). 

Exposure to cloud-native architectures and container security best practices

Preferred Technical And Professional Experience

2+ of experience working with Z mainframe systems in some capacity Experience with one or more mainframe operating systems. Experience with practical applications of the mainframe Experience writing and executing test plans with the ability to ensure proper coverage based on customer requirements and workloads, and perform regression testing Hardware troubleshooting skills Knowledge of Agile practices Ability to handle testing and debugging tasks independently.

data.title: Principal Software Engineer, Device Security & Containers (NGFW) - NetSec
data.description:
Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks®, we're united by a shared mission-to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have.
