data.title: Lead Server Performance Architect
data.description:
ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD. 

At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world's most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future. 

Whether you're designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger - technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we'll advance your career. 

Lead Server Performance Architect

AMD is looking for an outstanding technical contributor to help architect, validate & optimize performance of new features through full chip simulation & emulation platforms for AMD-based next-generation servers. As a passionate and dedicated Server Systems Performance Architect in the Server Performance Group, you will identify new opportunities to optimize server silicon for throughput and latency by identifying opportunities across all parts of silicon micro architecture and design spanning CPU, Data Fabric, Memory subsystem and IO. You will validate and analyze performance of various design features in pre silcon design env and correlate the profiling data with AMD performance model and eventually AMD silicon. You will quantify and isolate performance bottlenecks and share the insights to help new drive features into the next generation of server CPUs. The ideal candidate is expected to be well informed on latest trends in server design and verification, have a well-rounded understanding of performance requirements for server market and be able to quickly ascertain, in a data-driven manner, how next generation server CPUs and platforms should be engineered to support those needs

Key Responsibilities

- Team Leadership
 - Lead and mentor a high-performing team of performance verification engineers. 
 - Foster a culture of innovation, technical rigor, and continuous improvement. 
 - Provide strategic direction across multiple concurrent verification programs. 
 - Program Leadership
 - Define and execute the performance verification strategy for high-performance x86 server CPU. 
 - Collaborate with architecture, u-arch, RTL, performance modeling, firmware, and software teams to define and validate performance KPIs. 
 - Ensure timely delivery of simulation/emulation results, and optimization feedback loops. 
 - Performance Analysis & Correlation
 - Develop and execute performance verification plans targeting IPC, latency, throughput, and power efficiency. 
 - Capability to debug performance outliers thru Performance Monitoring Counters (PMC). 
 - Drive correlation between RTL and performance models, ensuring architectural intent is met.

 - Build and maintain scalable, modular performance verification infrastructure. 
 - Lead emulation-based performance setup and debug, enabling early performance validation. 
 - Integrate performance regression, profiling, and analysis flows using industry-standard and custom tools. 
 - Collaborate with compiler and OS teams to ensure software stack alignment with hardware performance goals. 
 - AI-Driven Infrastructure
 - Drive the development of AI/ML-based infrastructure to automate performance analysis, anomaly detection, and efficiency improvements. 
 - Leverage data-driven techniques to optimize verification coverage and reduce debug cycles. 
 - Cross-Functional Collaboration
 - Partner with x86 architecture, RTL design, physical design, and software teams to ensure performance targets are met. 
 - Influence design decisions through data-backed performance insights.

 - Communicate performance status, risks, and trade-offs to executive leadership and stakeholders. 
 - Industry Awareness
 - Stay current with trends in CPU architecture, performance modeling, and verification technologies. 
 - Evaluate and adopt emerging tools and techniques to maintain a competitive edge. 
Preferred Experience

- 15+ years of industry experience with performance modeling and simulation tools (e. g. , cycle-accurate simulators, emulators) with strong background in CPU microarchitecture, performance analysis, and system-level performance verification. 
 - Proven leadership in managing large, cross-functional engineering teams. 
 - Familiarity with PMC DV, latency and throughput validation, emulation platforms, and performance debug flows. 
 - Deep understanding of x86 ISA, microarchitecture, and performance metrics. 
 - Experience in developing performance test suites, performance triage tools, and simulation/emulation infrastructure. 
 - Expertise in performance analysis tools, correlation techniques, and workload optimization. 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a data-driven mindset. 
 - Deep knowledge of modern out-of-order CPU cores, memory subsystems, and performance modeling is a plus. 
 - Experience with ML/AI techniques/frameworks for performance triage, infrastructure automation and prediction is a plus. 
 - Exposure to high-performance computing (HPC), virtualization, or server-class CPUs. 
 - Background in hardware/software co-design and performance-aware compiler optimizations. 
 - Familiarity with pre-silicon and post-silicon debug methodologies. 

Position Requirements

- Should have executed Emulation based functional and performance verification for multimillion gate SoC designs
 - Should have strong exposure to RTL coding and SOC bringup debug
 - Exceptional foundation in systems architecture, cutting across CPU, memory, storage and I/O subsystems
 - Experience with hardware performance counter monitoring tools
 - Should have exposure to performance profiling tools, preferably x86 based (e. g. linux perf, Windows perfmon)
 - MS/PhD in Computer Engineering / relevant coursework / thesis
 - Excellent communication skills (verbal, written, and presentation)
 - > 12 years relevant industry experience

Company Description: (https: //www. naxnova. com/)

Naxnova Technologies Private Limited (NTPL) is a leader in high-performance automotive customization solutions, offering advanced automotive decals, Paint Protection Films (PPF), Window Films and premium aftermarket accessories. Number of Position: 2

Job Title: Assistant Manager / Senior Executive - Inprocess Quality (IPQC)

Reporting To: Head - Quality

Work Location: Pelhar Plant, Vasai (Mumbai) (https: //share. google/p7B1A4oaoxW3yEF1i)

Department: Quality Assurance

Salary Budget: Up to 18 LPA

Role Overview

We are looking for result-oriented Quality professionals to manage In-Process Quality Assurance (IPQC) in a fast-paced manufacturing environment. The role focuses on process control, defect prevention, audit compliance and continuous improvement, aligned with IATF and Integrated Management Systems (IMS). This position requires strong analytical skills, hands-on shop-floor involvement and the ability to drive cross-functional quality initiatives. 

Key Responsibilities

In-Process Quality Assurance

- Monitor and control in-process quality through defect analysis and corrective actions
 - Ensure all materials and processes comply with defined Quality Plans and specifications
 - Perform stage-wise inspection (In-process, Final and Pre-Dispatch Inspection - PDI)
 - Verify dimensional, visual, and functional characteristics as per customer standards

Non-Conformance Management

- Identify, segregate, and control non-conforming materials (in-process & finished goods)
 - Maintain NC reports and ensure proper documentation and traceability
 - Lead/coordinate Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and CAPA implementation
 - Ensure effectiveness validation of corrective and preventive actions

Process Audits & Compliance

- Conduct Process, Product, and Layered Process Audits
 - Ensure adherence to SOPs, Work Instructions, Control Plans, and IMS requirements
 - Participate in internal and external audits (IATF 16949, ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001)
 - Ensure audit readiness and closure of non-conformities

Data Analysis & Continuous Improvement

- Analyze rejection, rework, and scrap data; drive reduction initiatives
 - Use quality tools (SPC, 7 QC Tools, Pareto, Fishbone, 5 Why, 8D)
 - Improve process capability and reduce variation
 - Lead/participate in Kaizen, Lean, and continual improvement projects

Reporting & Performance Monitoring

- Prepare and submit daily/weekly/monthly MIS reports
 - Present quality performance to management with actionable insightsTrack KPIs such as: 

- Internal rejection %
 - Rework & scrap cost
 - Process capability (CP/CPK)
 - Customer complaints

Cross-Functional Coordination

- Collaborate with Production, Engineering, Maintenance, and Supply Chain teams
 - Participate in QCRT (Quality Concern Resolution Team) for customer complaints
 - Drive closure of customer issues with structured problem-solving approach

New Product Development (NPD) Support

- Support APQP activities and new product trials
 - Conduct application trials and validation checks
 - Ensure readiness of quality systems for new launches

Team Handling & Training

- Train operators and inspectors on quality standards and checkpoints
 - Guide QC team for process adherence and improvements
 - Build quality awareness culture on shop floor

Required Knowledge

- In-Process Quality Control (IPQC)
 - SPC & Statistical Analysis
 - 7 QC Tools, 8D, CAPA, 5 Why, Fishbone
 - Lean Manufacturing / Kaizen
 - Integrated Management Systems (IATF 16949, ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001)
 - Manufacturing process control in Printing/Automotive industry

Key Skills

- Strong analytical and problem-solving ability
 - Effective communication & stakeholder management
 - High attention to detail
 - Proactive and result-driven approach
 - Time management and execution excellence
 - Ability to work in a shop-floor driven environment

Qualifications & Experience

- Engineering Graduate with minimum 5 Years of relevant experience in "In-process Quality". 

Additional Requirements

- Hands-on experience with SAP (preferred)
 - Exposure to customer audits and OEM requirements is an advantage
 - Willingness to work in a plant/shop-floor environment

What Makes This Role Attractive

- Exposure to automotive-grade systems (IATF 16949)
 - Strong learning in core manufacturing quality & problem-solving
 - Opportunity to grow into Quality Leadership roles
 - Work in a structured and system-driven organization

At EY, you'll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we're counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all. 

ECM Senior 1-3- Consulting

EY GDS Consulting digital, is looking out for experienced web content management expert, especially on Microsoft Office365. Resource will be part of Enterprise Content Management team delivering to clients across regions. 

The opportunity

We're looking for resources with expertise in O365 development, implementation and related technologies to join the group of our ECM Collaboration Consulting team. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading firm whilst being instrumental in the growth of our service offering. 

Your Key Responsibilities

- Produces high-quality solution or infrastructure deliverables in accordance with project timelines and specifications, using sound coding and programming skills
 - Performs coding, debugging, testing and troubleshooting throughout the development process contributing to moderately complex aspects of a project
 - Maintains and enhances systems by fixing complicated errors, raising risks and escalating issues where necessary
 - Works with users to capture detailed requirements, translating designs and solution architecture into design specifications
 - Monitors and reports on potential risks/opportunities of emerging technologies, and seeks areas for continuous improvement
 - Ensures all activities adhere to the relevant processes, procedures, standards and technical design
 - Develop and promote best practices for usage, operations and development
 - Strong analytical and communication skills with intense drive to learn and adopt. 

Skills And Attributes

- 4-7 years development in O365 implementation. 
 - Must have strong analytical and technical skills using SharePoint SPFx, C#, ASP. Net with MVC, JavaScript, and a variety of tools to deliver client-side solutions within Office 365. 
 - Strong knowledge in SharePoint Architecture Design (Extranet & Intranet). 
 - Must have good experience in SharePoint Framework (SPFx) & Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate) solutions. 
 - Good experience in JavaScript, TypeScript, React JS, AngularJS, Fluent UI, Knockout JS, HTML5, CSS, Ajax, JSON, jQuery etc

Core Skills: 

- SharePoint: SPFx, PnP Framework, PowerShell
 - Power Platform: Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI, Power Virtual Agents
 - Dataverse: Data modeling, APIs, integration with Power Platform
 - Web API Integration: REST, SOAP, authentication (OAuth, OpenID Connect)
 - PCF Controls: React, TypeScript, PCF control framework

Desirable Skills: 

- Microsoft Purview: Data governance, DLP, information protection
 - Microsoft Syntex: AI-driven content processing, document understanding, classification, and generation
 - AI Builder: Custom AI models, integration with Power Platform
 - Microsoft 365 Copilot: Integration with M365 apps
 - Azure DevOps: CI/CD, source control
 - Microsoft Teams: App development, integration
 - Passion for the web, open source development, and for helping us build meaningful experiences. 
 - Experience in consulting strongly preferred. 
 - Strong problem-solving abilities, taking initiative, and the ability to thrive under pressure. 
 - Maintain a positive and constructive outlook, focus on driving results, finding solutions / breakthroughs to solve problems and challenges; has a positive influence on peers. 
 - Interpersonal and communication skills. 
 - Respond positively to opportunities to be involved in brainstorming and iterative work. Handle times of change in a way that drives innovation and iteration. 
 - Work in collaborative and supportive manner. 
 - Listen carefully to provided information and ask clarifying questions. Actively listen as a learner rather than a passive recipient of information. 
 - Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or related discipline preferred. 

Soft Skills

- Excellent Communication Skills
 - Team Player
 - Self-starter and highly motivated
 - Ability to handle high pressure and fast paced situations
 - Excellent presentation skills
 - Ability to work with globally distributed teams

To qualify for the role, you must have

- A bachelor's or master's degree
 - A minimum of 8+ years of experience, preferably background in a professional services firm. 
 - Strong knowledge of SharePoint 2013/2016/2019/o365
 - Strong knowledge of SharePoint Framework (SPFx), Power Apps & Power Automate. 
 - Strong knowledge of TypeScript, React JS, AngularJS & Fluent UI. 
 - Strong knowledge of PowerShell & PnP. 
 - Excellent communication skills with consulting experience preferred

Ideally, you'll also have

- Analytical ability to manage multiple projects and prioritize tasks into manageable work products. 
 - Can operate independently or with minimum supervision

What Working At EY Offers

At EY, we're dedicated to helping our clients, from start-ups to Fortune 500 companies - and the work we do with them is as varied as they are. 

You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer: 

- Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
 - Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
 - The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that's right for you

EY | Building a better working world

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets. 

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate. 

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

data.title: DEVOPS TECHNICAL LEAD - Azure DevOps
data.description:
We are seeking a highly experienced and hands-on DevOps CI/CD Engineer to own the implementation, administration, optimization, and governance of our enterprise GitHub and CI/CD ecosystem. This is a technical ownership and engineering role ? not a traditional support position. You will be responsible for designing and maintaining scalable CI/CD workflows, establishing enterprise GitHub standards, troubleshooting complex pipeline issues, and driving adoption of modern DevOps and DevSecOps practices across engineering teams. 

You will work closely with development, QA, operations, security, architecture, and cloud engineering teams to build reliable, secure, and highly automated software delivery processes. The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in GitHub Enterprise, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, Git, Docker, Azure, AWS and AKS, combined with strong troubleshooting, automation, and stakeholder-management capabilities. 

Team & Key Projects

- Team
 - Purpose of this team/Key Projects
 - Reason for the Posting
 - Motivators for this need

OwnerSHIP: You treat GitHub Enterprise and CI/CD as a platform that you own and continuously improve ? not simply a tool that you operate. 

Problem Solver: You can independently investigate complex pipeline failures, identify root causes, and implement permanent solutions. 

Automation Mindset: You look for opportunities to eliminate repetitive manual work through scripting, workflow automation, and reusable pipeline components. 

Quality Focused: You understand that successful CI/CD is not simply about getting a pipeline to pass. Reliability, security, testing, compliance, and measurable delivery outcomes matter. 

Self-Directed: You can work independently, prioritize competing technical issues, and deliver outcomes without continuous supervision. 

Collaborative: You work effectively with developers, QA engineers, architects, security teams, cloud engineers, and operations teams. 

Continuous Improvement: You proactively identify opportunities to improve pipeline performance, developer experience, platform reliability, security, and engineering KPIs. 

Technical Communicator: You can explain complex CI/CD and GitHub concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders and create documentation that teams can actually use. 

Typical Day in the Role

- Day-to-day roles and responsibilities
 - Interaction level with team
 - Work environment description
 - GitHub Enterprise Platform Administration
 - Own the administration, configuration, and optimization of the enterprise GitHub environment. 
 - Configure and manage GitHub organizations, repositories, teams, permissions, policies, and enterprise-level settings. 
 - Establish and enforce repository governance standards including branch protection, pull request policies, CODEOWNERS, required status checks, and review requirements. 
 - Manage GitHub Enterprise integrations with CI/CD, security, cloud, testing, and deployment platforms. 
 - Configure and maintain GitHub Actions runners, including GitHub-hosted and self-hosted runner environments. 
 - Troubleshoot GitHub Enterprise and GitHub Actions issues across repositories, workflows, permissions, runners, integrations, and authentication. 
 - Support enterprise adoption and standardization of GitHub across development teams. 
 - CI/CD Pipeline Development & Engineering
 - Design, develop, implement, and maintain robust CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions and Azure DevOps. 
 - Build reusable and maintainable workflow and pipeline templates that can be adopted across multiple engineering teams. 
 - Automate end-to-end build, test, security scanning, artifact creation, and deployment processes. 
 - Implement multi-stage CI/CD workflows covering development, testing, quality validation, approvals, and production deployment. 
 - Integrate CI/CD pipelines with source control, testing frameworks, artifact repositories, security scanners, cloud platforms, and deployment tools. 
 - Implement pipeline automation that supports reliable and repeatable software delivery across environments. 
 - Develop appropriate branching, pull request, merge, and release strategies aligned with enterprise DevOps standards. 
 - Pipeline Troubleshooting & Performance Optimization
 - Act as a technical escalation point for complex CI/CD pipeline failures and deployment issues. 
 - Diagnose and resolve failures involving YAML configuration, authentication, permissions, runners/agents, dependencies, build tools, deployments, and integrations. 
 - Analyze pipeline execution time and identify opportunities to improve build and deployment performance. 
 - Optimize caching, parallel execution, dependencies, artifact handling, and runner utilization. 
 - Investigate intermittent and environment-specific pipeline failures and implement sustainable corrective actions. 
 - Establish troubleshooting standards, reusable diagnostics, and operational runbooks for common CI/CD issues. 
 - Azure & AWS Cloud, Docker & Kubernetes Engineering
 - Design and maintain CI/CD processes supporting cloud-native applications deployed on Microsoft Azure and AWS. 
 - Build and maintain Docker-based application build and deployment workflows. 
 - Integrate container image build, scanning, tagging, and publishing into CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Support deployments to Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) using appropriate deployment methodologies. 
 - Work with Kubernetes deployment mechanisms including Helm, kubectl, manifests, and related automation. 
 - Integrate pipelines with Azure and AWS services and cloud-native deployment architectures. 
 - Troubleshoot container build, registry, Kubernetes deployment, and application rollout issues. 
 - Collaborate with Azure and AWS architects and engineering teams to improve cloud deployment reliability, scalability, and automation. 
 - Hands-on experience with AWS cloud services and integrating AWS deployments into CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Experience with AWS services such as EKS, ECR, IAM, S3, CloudWatch, and related deployment and monitoring services. 
 - Build and maintain containerized application deployment workflows using AWS EKS and ECR. 
 - Implement secure authentication and access management for AWS-based CI/CD integrations using IAM roles and federated identity where applicable. 
 - DevSecOps & Security Integration
 - Implement security best practices throughout the CI/CD lifecycle. 
 - Integrate security scanning and quality controls into CI/CD workflows. 
 - Support implementation of SAST, dependency scanning, container vulnerability scanning, and other DevSecOps controls. 
 - Implement secure management of credentials, secrets, service connections, and pipeline variables. 
 - Apply least-privilege principles to GitHub, Azure DevOps, Azure, and CI/CD integrations. 
 - Support regular security assessments, vulnerability remediation, and CI/CD platform audits. 
 - Ensure CI/CD processes comply with organizational security, governance, and regulatory requirements. 
 - DevSecOps Metrics & KPI Improvement
 - Support initiatives focused on improving engineering and software delivery KPIs. 
 - Establish and improve visibility into DevSecOps metrics including Change Failure Rate, Deployment Frequency, Lead Time for Changes, Mean Time to Recovery (MTTR), Regression Testing Effectiveness, Escaped / Escape Defects, Pipeline Success Rate, Build and Deployment Duration, and Security Vulnerability Trends. 
 - Analyze CI/CD performance and identify opportunities for measurable improvement. 
 - Partner with engineering and QA teams to reduce failed deployments, regression defects, and production escapes. 
 - Provide data-driven recommendations to improve software delivery quality and reliability. 
 - Testing & Quality Engineering
 - Implement end-to-end testing within CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Integrate unit, integration, regression, API, security, and deployment validation testing as appropriate. 
 - Configure automated quality gates to prevent defective or non-compliant code from progressing through the delivery lifecycle. 
 - Integrate pipeline execution with test reporting and quality management frameworks. 
 - Troubleshoot test execution failures and identify whether failures originate from code, infrastructure, dependencies, configuration, or pipeline implementation. 
 - Continuously improve automated testing coverage and reliability within CI/CD workflows. 
 - Automation & Scripting
 - Develop automation scripts using PowerShell, Bash, Python, or similar scripting technologies. 
 - Automate repetitive administrative, deployment, validation, monitoring, and troubleshooting activities. 
 - Build reusable scripts and utilities that improve developer productivity and platform efficiency. 
 - Integrate scripting and automation into GitHub Actions and Azure DevOps workflows. 
 - Maintain clean, documented, secure, and supportable automation code. 
 - Collaboration, Technical Guidance & Leadership
 - Work closely with development, QA, operations, security, architecture, and cloud engineering teams. 
 - Provide technical guidance and mentoring on GitHub, Git, CI/CD, DevOps, and DevSecOps practices. 
 - Act as a subject matter expert for GitHub Enterprise and CI/CD engineering. 
 - Drive adoption of standardized CI/CD practices across engineering teams. 
 - Lead technical discussions around branching strategies, pipeline architecture, automation, security, and deployment practices. 
 - Identify opportunities to simplify and standardize engineering processes. 
 - Promote knowledge sharing and establish reusable patterns and best practices. 
 - Documentation & Operational Excellence
 - Create and maintain high-quality technical documentation for GitHub Enterprise and CI/CD processes. 
 - Develop architecture documentation, pipeline standards, troubleshooting guides, runbooks, and operational procedures. 
 - Document GitHub governance, branching strategies, security controls, and CI/CD best practices. 
 - Maintain accurate documentation of integrations, configurations, dependencies, and operational processes. 
 - Ensure lessons learned from incidents and recurring pipeline failures are incorporated into platform improvements. 

Compelling Story & Candidate Value Proposition

- What makes this role interesting
 - Unique selling points
 - Value added or experience gained

Candidate Requirements

- Years of experience required
 - Degrees or certifications required
 - Disqualifiers
 - Systems/Technology experience requirements
 - Required background experience

8+ Years (DevOps / CI/CD / Platform Engineering Focus)

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline. 
 - 8+ years of overall technical IT experience, with significant hands-on experience in DevOps, CI/CD, or Platform Engineering. 
 - Proven experience managing and supporting GitHub Enterprise environments. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with GitHub Actions and Azure DevOps. 
 - Deep understanding of Git, branching strategies, pull requests, code reviews, and repository governance. 
 - Proven experience designing, implementing, troubleshooting, and optimizing CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Hands-on experience with Docker and Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS). 
 - Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure. 
 - Experience implementing DevSecOps practices within CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Strong troubleshooting and debugging skills. 
 - Experience writing automation scripts using PowerShell, Bash, Python, or similar technologies. 
 - Demonstrated ability to work independently and collaborate effectively across global engineering teams. 
 - Strong communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

data.title: Principal Data System Software Engineer
data.description:
About the Team: 

Oracle's Exadata Database team is developing a cloud-native, autonomous, multi-tenant, database-optimized smart storage service built on the Exadata platform. 

Designed to support thousands of tenants, the service aims to deliver high performance, availability, scalability, and cost efficiency for diverse database workloads. 

The team contributes to Oracle Autonomous Database offerings across Oracle Cloud and Cloud@Customer environments. 

Engineers in this team combine hands-on software development with production ownership, solving complex challenges in distributed systems, highly available services, and virtualized cloud infrastructure. 

Job Summary: 

Owns feature areas with measurable business impact. Designs application services and schemas spanning Online Transaction Processing and Online Analytical Processing, JSON, spatial, and graph data models. Leads debugging across services and database layers; optimizes query and API performance to meet service-level agreements. Drives automated testing coverage and performance baselines; collaborates with product management and user experience to run experiments and analyze adoption and retention. 

Solve complex problems related to infrastructure cloud services and build automation to prevent problem recurrence. Design, develop, and deploy software to improve the availability, scalability, and efficiency of Oracle products and services. Design and develop designs, architectures, standards, and methods for large-scale distributed systems. Facilitate service capacity planning and demand forecasting, software performance analysis, and system tuning. 

Oracle Exadata Database team is building a new cloud native, Autonomous, multi-tenant, database optimized, smart storage cloud service. This service is expected to scale across thousands of tenants. It is based on the successful Exadata platform. This cost effective storage solution is engineered for highest performance and availability to run variety of workloads. We are hiring senior developers for this exciting team to build the service to power Autonomous database offerings in Oracle Cloud and Cloud at customer. 

We offer unique opportunities for smart, hands-on engineers with the expertise and passion to solve difficult problems in distributed highly available services and virtualized infrastructure. As part of the Oracle Database Exadata team, you will be continually challenged and have an opportunity to contribute. The role provides a mixture of production ownership and development. You will solve challenging technical problems, identify improvements and work on implementing your recommendations. 

Required Qualification: 

7+ years of hands on experience in software development, including design, implementation, debugging, and support, building distributed, scalable system software and/or Services preferably in the cloud

- BS or MS degree in Computer Science, or equivalent experience
 - Proficient with programming languages Java/Python; and scripting languages (Shell, Perl and Python)
 - Deep understanding of distributed systems and web services technology
 - Experienced in crafting, building and debugging large scale distributed systems
 - Strong at applying data structures, algorithms, and object oriented design, to solve challenging problems
 - Track record of building and delivering mission critical, 24x7 production software systems
 - Familiar with micro-services based software architecture and the evolving tools in the space like nomad/k8s
 - Experience with container run time (Docker, LXC/LXD)
 - Knowledge of professional software engineering practices & best practices for full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing and operations
 - Strong desire to build, sense of ownership, urgency, and drive. 
 - Systematic problem solving approach, combined with a strong sense of ownership and drive. 
 - Experience in communicating with users, other technical teams, and senior management to collect requirements, describe software product features, product strategy and influence outcomes in technical decision-making
 - Solid understanding of performance and efficiency with a strong customer focus
 - Demonstrated ability to mentor other software developers in all aspects of their engineering skillsets
 - Possess strong verbal and written communication skills

Key Responsibilities: 

Data Systems Software Development: 

- Own a feature area's data model across Online Transaction Processing/Online Analytical Processing, JSON, spatial, or graph. 
 - Define performance budgets and enforce query patterns that meet latency targets at scale. 
 - Partner with product management to design experiments that drive adoption, conversion, and retention; analyze results to inform roadmap. 
 - Architects existing and complex new services. 

Software Development and Coding - Design, Testing, and Optimization: 

- Designs software solutions and analyzes and identifies requirements to achieve business and operational goals, sharing results with manager upon completion. 
 - Adheres to and improves execution of all phases of the software development lifecycle; provides guidance and coaching to engineers to drive improvements. 
 - Utilizes advanced knowledge to develop and guide new software features and enhancements leading design specifications, ensuring accessibility, and develops documents to clarify software design and code. 
 - Leads code reviews in multiple areas to help drive improvements. 
 - Conducts debugging and troubleshooting to identify and fix complex software issues. 
 - Develops fixes for identified issues. 
 - Implements comprehensive software testing (e. g. , functional and non-functional testing), quality assurance processes, software error logging, monitoring, and observability for effective debugging, sharing work with manager and/or lead upon completion. 
 - Conducts performance profiling and optimization of coding, building scalable solutions, and anticipating and resolving potential outcomes. 
 - Troubleshoots and resolves complex issues related to application programming interface (API) functionality and integration. 
 - Implements complex API versioning, lifecycle, and interoperability strategies. 

Software Architecture - Software System Structural Design: 

- Implements and contributes to developing software, systems, and services, ensuring review by manager and/or senior technical leaders upon completion. Recommends project or design scope. 
 - Provides technical guidance and coaching to less experienced developers in existing software architecture. 
 - Contributes to periodic reviews and ensures adherence to architectural standards. 
 - Collaborates with stakeholders and networks externally to ensure work aligns with software architecture. 
 - Implements complex performance optimization and scalability strategies in software design. 
 - Occasionally conducts technology research and evaluation for potential architectural changes that may have an impact on results for the team. 

Issue/Defect Collaboration - Software Products Support: 

- Collaborates with stakeholders to understand customer issues and align solutions. 
 - May provide advanced technical guidance and support to customers regarding customer-reported issues. 
 - Advocates for customers' interests and suggests product enhancements based on feedback. 
 - Provides input to ensure customer satisfaction through timely resolution of issues and effective communication. 
 - Identifies and implements customer issue and/or defect handling and training processes. 
 - Investigates and troubleshoots complex and broad reaching/scoped maintenance issues to ensure customer agreement on short- and long-term solutions (e. g. , future enhancements). 

Practices and Standards Compliance - Security and Compliance: 

- Collaborates with the team and externally to follow development practices and coding standards, providing coaching to less experienced team members. 
 - Participates in peer review processes, provides technical leadership, and ensures code quality and adherence to broad acceptance criteria during development, independently. 
 - Demonstrates and shares advanced knowledge of industry best practices and applies them to software development processes. 
 - Implements complex secure coding practices to prevent security vulnerabilities. 

Development Operations - System Maintenance: 

- Performs periodic maintenance and testing operations for systems that require upgrading or patching (e. g. , for critical vulnerabilities), sharing results with manager upon completion. 
 - Drives improvements, ensures automation, testing, and debugging of systems to ensure service/product availability, health, support, and reliability.

data.title: Senior Automation Engineer
data.description:
About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Senior Automation Engineer to join our engineering team. In this role, you will be responsible for the end-to-end development, programming, and commissioning of industrial control systems. 

Note to Applicants: This is a traditional Industrial Automation / Controls Engineering role focused strictly on PLC, HMI, and hardware-level systems. This position does not involve PC-based software development, web coding, or IT-level automation. 

Responsibilities

- PLC & HMI Programming
 - Design, code, and test robust control logic and graphical interfaces from scratch based on functional specifications. 
 - 
 - System Architecture
 - Configure hardware layouts, remote I/O modules, VFDs. 
 - 
 - Network Integration
 - Establish and troubleshoot reliable communications between controllers, instruments, and plant-wide networks. 
 - 
 - Field Commissioning
 - Lead Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) and Site Acceptance Testing (SAT), ensuring systems launch smoothly on the factory floor. 

Qualifications

- Experience: 3 to 6 years of direct, hands-on experience in industrial automation and control systems design. 

Required Skills

- PLC Platforms: Strong proficiency with Rockwell Automation / Allen-Bradley (Studio 5000 / ControlLogix) and/or Siemens (TIA Portal / S7-1500) or Schneider (M340/M580)
 - Languages: Mastery of IEC 61131-3 languages, specifically Ladder Logic (LD) and FBD. 
 - HMI / SCADA: Proven experience developing operator interfaces using FactoryTalk View, Siemens WinCC, or Wonderware / Aveva. 
 - Industrial Networking: Practical knowledge of configuring and troubleshooting EtherNet/IP, PROFINET, and Modbus TCP/IP.

data.title: Principal Engineer - Verification
data.description:
Are you looking for a unique opportunity to be a part of something great? Want to join a 17, 000-member team that works on the technology that powers the world around us? Looking for an atmosphere of trust, empowerment, respect, diversity, and communication? How about an opportunity to own a piece of a multi-billion dollar (with a B!) global organization? We offer all that and more at Microchip Technology Inc. 

People come to work at Microchip because we help design the technology that runs the world. They stay because our culture supports their growth and stability. They are challenged and driven by an incredible array of products and solutions with unlimited career potential. Microchip's nationally-recognized Leadership Passage Programs support career growth where we proudly enroll over a thousand people annually. We take pride in our commitment to employee development, values-based decision making, and strong sense of community, driven by our Vision, Mission, and 11 Guiding Values; we affectionately refer to it as the Aggregate System and it's won us countless awards for diversity and workplace excellence. 

Our company is built by dedicated team players who love to challenge the status quo; we did not achieve record revenue and over 30 years of quarterly profitability without a great team dedicated to empowering innovation. People like you. 

Visit our careers page to see what exciting opportunities and company perks await!

Job Description

Microchip Technology Inc. is looking for a self motivated individual to fill the position of Principal Verification Engineer within our WSG product development team. The successful candidate will have the ability to architect and implement robust verification environments for both unit level and full chip verification. Managing complex verification projects and mentoring junior level engineers will be an integral part of this position. 

Key Responsibilities

- Develop an effective suite of tests and test environments using a mix of class based SystemVerilog and C based directed tests to achieve predefined functional verification goals. 
 - Actively participate in a team environment, working with verification, architecture, applications, and design teams to develop comprehensive verification plans and address issues. 
 - Own and drive verification related activities, provide technical support, and proactively manage tasks to meet schedule goals. 
 - Help define and develop effective functional assertions and cover points. 
 - Verify structural and functional coverage of module and system level test suite. 

Requirements/Qualifications

- BSEE minimum with at least 7 years experience in the verification of large, complex IP and ICs. 
 - Experience in project management and leadership of small teams. 
 - Understanding of Microcontroller architectures and products. 
 - Hands on experience with Questa or similar advanced simulation tools. 
 - Advanced skills in various programming languages such as Verilog, System Verilog, C, C++, PERL
 - Working experience using an industry standard verification methodology (UVM/AVM/VMM). 

Travel Time

0% - 25%

To all recruitment agencies: Microchip Technology Inc. does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our recruiting team or other Microchip employees. Microchip is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

data.title: Senior Application Engineer
data.description:
Senior UI Developer

Are you passionate about creating exceptional user interfaces that power enterprise-grade applications? Join our global team where you'll leverage cutting-edge UI technologies to build innovative solutions that drive business success. As our Senior UI Developer, you'll architect scalable frontend systems, mentor team members, and collaborate across global teams to deliver impactful products. 

About The Role

As a Senior UI Developer, you'll be the technical cornerstone of our product development lifecycle. You'll collaborate with Product Owners, Business Analysts, and UX teams to architect, implement, and maintain sophisticated user interfaces that meet business needs while delivering exceptional user experiences. 

Key Responsibilities

- Architect and implement scalable, high-performance UI solutions across multiple products 
 - Lead technical strategy for frontend development, ensuring maintainability and performance 
 - Establish and enforce coding standards, design patterns, and reusable component libraries 
 - Collaborate across global teams with both internal and external stakeholders 
 - Mentor junior developers and provide technical leadership within cross-functional teams 
 - Evaluate and integrate emerging frontend technologies through proof-of-concept initiatives 
 - Optimize performance and ensure accessibility compliance in all UI implementations 
 - Manage application lifecycle from planning through delivery, including risk assessment and task prioritization

About The Team

Our team is the global L&H Reinsurance Engineering team, responsible for the technical Architecture and Engineering of IT solutions for Reinsurance business unit. The team members are passionate about technologies in building enterprise grade products with a deep understanding of reinsurance business. We closely collaborate with other teams and colleagues around the globe to share knowledge and engineer solutions. 

Growing experience will, over time, give you a broad view on Architecture & Engineering of a global reinsurer and enable you to have a comprehensive understanding, people and systems involved and how these systems shape business outcomes. This will allow you to build up an excellent foundation for a next career step in a role closer to the operational business activities in our global organization. 

About You

You're a forward-thinking UI expert who thrives in collaborative environments. You approach challenges with creativity and pragmatism, balancing technical excellence with business needs. Your resilient personality enables you to navigate change effectively while mentoring others. You're passionate about creating elegant, efficient solutions and continuously expanding your technical expertise. 

We Are Looking For Candidates Who Meet These Requirements

- 10+ years of experience in UI technologies 
 - Expert-level proficiency in HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript (ES6+), TypeScript, and frontend frameworks (React. js preferred) 
 - Strong understanding of UI architecture, component-based development, and state management (Redux, Context API, MobX) 
 - Proven experience architecting large-scale, component-driven applications 
 - Experience defining design systems and maintaining component libraries

These Are Additional Nice To Haves

- Experience with testing frameworks (Jest, Cypress, Playwright) and CI/CD processes 
 - Familiarity with cloud-native architectures (AWS, Azure, GCP) and DevOps practices 
 - Knowledge of progressive web apps, server-side rendering, and headless CMS integrations 
 - Understanding of security best practices and data privacy compliance 
 - Contributions to open-source UI frameworks or community engagement 
 - Experience with high-performance, data-intensive UI applications 
 - Understanding of insurance/reinsurance business 
 - Strong communication skills and ability to work effectively across cultures and geographies

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, including gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. 

Our company has a hybrid work model where the expectation is that you will be in the office at least three days per week

About Swiss Re

Swiss Re is one of the world's leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. We cover both Property & Casualty and Life & Health. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. This is possible thanks to the collaboration of more than 15, 000 employees across the world. 

Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. We embrace a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. In our inclusive and flexible environment everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and their passion for sustainability. 

If you are an experienced professional returning to the workforce after a career break, we encourage you to apply for open positions that match your skills and experience. 

We may use AI-powered tools to support the review and evaluation of applications for this position. These tools provide additional insights to our recruitment teams, but all hiring decisions are carefully reviewed and made by people. To learn more about how we use AI in recruitment and how we handle your personal data, please review our Data Privacy Statement before applying.

data.title: Solution Architect - VP
data.description:
Join us as a Vice President - Solution Architect where you will spearhead the evolution of our infrastructure and deployment pipelines, driving innovation and operational excellence. You will harness cutting-edge technology to build and manage robust, scalable and secure infrastructure, ensuring seamless delivery of our digital solutions. 

To be successful as Vice President - Solution Architect you should have experience with: 

- Enterprise-scale solution architecture leadership, defining target architectures, technology roadmaps, design standards, and architectural governance across complex banking platforms. 
 - Experienced in architecting strategic banking platforms using event-driven, API-led, cloud-native, and domain-centric design principles. 
 - Extensive experience in designing and implementing large-scale modernization of legacy banking applications, including migration of Deposits, pricing, interest, and accounting capabilities to strategic platforms. 
 - Cloud and platform transformation, leading large-scale implementations on BCP (Barclays Cloud) or AWS with a strong focus on resilience, security, scalability, observability, and regulatory compliance. 

Some Other Highly Valued Skills May Include

- Good understanding of Demand Deposit Accounts (DDA), Cash Management, and Liquidity Management, including account servicing, balance management, cash concentration, sweeping, pooling, virtual accounts, and liquidity optimisation solutions. 
 - Strong understanding of corporate banking products and services, including payments, collections, receivables, account services, and treasury management. 
 - Strong data architecture and database expertise across enterprise relational, distributed, and NoSQL platforms. 
 - Proven experience in regulatory-driven architecture and design, ensuring auditability, traceability, data governance, and compliance with banking regulations. 
 - Experience delivering highly resilient and available banking platforms supporting critical customer journeys and large-scale transaction processing. 
 - Excellent senior stakeholder engagement and technology leadership skills, including mentoring architects, influencing strategic investment decisions, driving cross-functional alignment, and partnering with business and operations leadership. 

You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills. 

The role is based out of Pune. 

Purpose of the role

To lead the portfolio management team in the delivery of successful projects, while ensuring that portfolio management processes and practices are aligned with controls and governance standards and that projects are aligned with the organisation's strategic objectives. 

Accountabilities

- Leading of portfolio management team, including setting of portfolio vision, management of portfolio performance, and provision of guidance and support to portfolio analysts. 
 - Monitoring of portfolio performance, including tracking of project progress, managing budgets, identification of thematic risks and issues, and reporting on portfolio status to senior management. 
 - Management of portfolio documentation, including aggregation of portfolio book of work, schedules, and budgets, and ensuring that portfolio documentation is up-to-date and accurate. 
 - Facilitation of portfolio governance, including ensuring that projects are aligned with the organisation's strategic objectives, aligned with the controls and governance standards and that portfolio thematic risks and issues are managed effectively. 
 - Managing the portfolio Book of Work outlining the sequence and dependencies of change initiatives, considering factors like resource availability, stakeholder buy-in, and potential risks. 
 - Facilitation of change management activities, to ensure that change initiatives are successfully implemented and embedded in the organisation. 
 - Continuous improvement of portfolio management practices, including identification of areas for improvement and implementation of changes to improve portfolio performance. 
 - Collaboration with stakeholders, including senior management, project teams, and external partners, to ensure that portfolio management practices are aligned with their needs and expectations. 
 - Development of portfolio management processes that are aligned with controls and governance standards and that support the delivery of successful projects. 

Vice President Expectations

- To contribute or set strategy, drive requirements and make recommendations for change. Plan resources, budgets, and policies; manage and maintain policies/ processes; deliver continuous improvements and escalate breaches of policies/procedures. . 
 - If managing a team, they define jobs and responsibilities, planning for the department's future needs and operations, counselling employees on performance and contributing to employee pay decisions/changes. They may also lead a number of specialists to influence the operations of a department, in alignment with strategic as well as tactical priorities, while balancing short and long term goals and ensuring that budgets and schedules meet corporate requirements. . 
 - If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L - Listen and be authentic, E - Energise and inspire, A - Align across the enterprise, D - Develop others. .

data.title: Associate Director, Forward Deployed Engineering
data.description:
Job Description

Associate Director - Forward Deployed Engineering

The Opportunity

- Based in Hyderabad, join a global healthcare biopharma company and be part of a 130- year legacy of success backed by ethical integrity, forward momentum, and an inspiring mission to achieve new milestones in global healthcare. 
 - Be part of an organisation driven by digital technology and data-backed approaches that support a diversified portfolio of prescription medicines, vaccines, and animal health products. 
 - Drive innovation and execution excellence. Be a part of a team with passion for using data, analytics, and insights to drive decision-making, and which creates custom software, allowing us to tackle some of the world's greatest health threats. 

Our Technology Centers focus on creating a space where teams can come together to deliver business solutions that save and improve lives. An integral part of our companys' IT operating model, Tech Centers are globally distributed locations where each IT division has employees to enable our digital transformation journey and drive business outcomes. These locations, in addition to the other sites, are essential to supporting our business and strategy. 

A focused group of leaders in each Tech Center helps to ensure we can manage and improve each location, from investing in growth, success, and well-being of our people, to making sure colleagues from each IT division feel a sense of belonging to managing critical emergencies. And together, we must leverage the strength of our team to collaborate globally to optimize connections and share best practices across the Tech Centers. 

Role Overview

- Provide hands-on technical and engineering leadership for digitally enabled authoring and localization products, including AI-assisted authoring and machine translation. 
 - Embed with regulatory authors, translators, localization specialists and product teams to understand high-value problems, rapidly validate ideas and mature successful concepts into maintainable, production-grade solutions. 
 - Bridge regulatory needs, product strategy, architecture and engineering execution while ensuring security, privacy, validation, auditability, Responsible AI and operational supportability. 

Key Responsibilities

- Build a strong understanding of regulatory authoring processes, user needs, systems, data and content flows, including clinical and regulatory document development. 
 - Partner directly with regulatory authors, product managers, architects, data scientists, UX specialists and software engineers to identify high-impact opportunities and translate ambiguous requirements into practical technical solutions. 
 - Lead rapid discovery, prototyping, user validation, solution shaping, production delivery and adoption for digital and AI-enabled authoring capabilities. 
 - Design and deliver scalable capabilities for AI-assisted content generation, content reuse, structured content, review and quality control, source-to-output traceability and document intelligence. 
 - Design and deliver localization and machine-translation capabilities, including terminology management, translation memory, quality estimation, human review workflows, feedback capture and measurable translation-quality monitoring. 
 - Architect Generative AI solutions using large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, semantic search, enterprise knowledge retrieval and knowledge graph patterns where appropriate. 
 - Design agentic authoring and review workflows, including orchestration, tool integration, guardrails and human-in-the-loop controls. 
 - Establish prompt engineering, prompt management, evaluation, versioning, reuse and lifecycle practices for dependable Generative AI delivery. 
 - Design secure, modular and reusable cloud-native architectures, APIs, microservices, event-driven integrations and data pipelines across AWS and, where required, Google Cloud Platform, connecting authoring and localization solutions with regulatory platforms, structured data sources and enterprise AI services. 
 - Provide hands-on implementation support, reference architectures, design reviews, code-level guidance and reusable engineering patterns. 
 - Prefer enterprise and out-of-the-box capabilities over unnecessary custom solutions, while clearly documenting trade-offs where custom engineering is justified. 
 - Embed quality by design through automated testing, AI evaluation, grounding, hallucination controls, performance testing and production-readiness reviews. 
 - Drive DevOps and MLOps practices including CI/CD, infrastructure as code, automated deployment, monitoring, alerting, model/service observability and release governance. 
 - Ensure architecture and engineering decisions meet requirements for security, privacy, reliability, scalability, cost, validation, auditability and operational resilience in a regulated environment. 
 - Implement Responsible AI and AI governance controls, including risk assessment, explainability, transparency, human oversight, monitoring and regulatory readiness. 
 - Mentor engineers within the Hyderabad Technology Centre and strengthen modern software engineering, AI engineering and AI-assisted development practices. 
 - Create and maintain technical documentation, reference implementations, decision records and reusable assets that improve delivery consistency and long-term ownership. 
 - Act as a trusted technical bridge across Regulatory, Product, Architecture, AI/Data Science, Security, Quality and Engineering teams, with accountability for measurable business outcomes. 

Primary Skills

Software Engineering Leadership, Python, Generative AI/LLMs, Agentic AI, RAG, Prompt Engineering, REST APIs, SQL/Data Engineering, AWS, Git/GitHub, CI/CD, Docker, Automated Testing, Solution Architecture and Forward-Deployed Engineering. 

Secondary Skills

TypeScript/JavaScript, React, Vector Databases, Knowledge Graphs, Kubernetes, Infrastructure as Code, AI Observability/Evaluation, Enterprise Security, Veeva Vault and regulated life-sciences technology experience. 

What You Should Have

Education

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field. 
 - Significant experience in software engineering and solution architecture, with demonstrated technical leadership delivering complex enterprise platforms and products into production. 
 - Proven ability to lead multidisciplinary, globally distributed engineering teams and provide technical direction across architecture, engineering, AI and cloud technologies. 
 - Strong expertise in Python and modern backend engineering, including REST APIs, microservices and service-oriented architectures. 
 - Demonstrated experience architecting and delivering production-grade Generative AI solutions using LLMs, embeddings, RAG, vector/semantic search and prompt-driven workflows. 
 - Strong understanding of agentic AI architectures, including workflow orchestration, tool use, guardrails, human-in-the-loop controls and evaluation. 
 - Experience designing solutions involving structured and unstructured data, document processing, metadata, enterprise search/retrieval and scalable data pipelines. 
 - Experience with localisation or language technologies, including machine translation, multilingual NLP, terminology management, translation memory, automated quality evaluation or human-in-the-loop review. 
 - Strong experience with AWS and/or Google Cloud Platform and cloud-native architectures, including containers, Kubernetes and serverless patterns. 
 - Strong understanding of DevOps and MLOps engineering practices, including Git-based development, CI/CD, automated testing, deployment, monitoring and observability. 
 - Demonstrated ability to make architecture and engineering trade-off decisions across scalability, performance, security, reliability, maintainability, cost and speed of delivery. 
 - Ability to establish secure, resilient and compliant engineering solutions, including identity and access management, encryption, logging, auditability and operational controls. 
 - Strong understanding of AI evaluation, grounding, Responsible AI, model/service observability and AI risk controls. 
 - Ability to translate ambiguous business problems into technical strategy, architecture and executable engineering plans, working closely with Product, Business, Architecture and Engineering stakeholders. 
 - Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders, drive technical decisions and lead engineering teams through complex transformation and delivery. 

Our technology teams operate as business partners, proposing ideas and innovative solutions that enable new organizational capabilities. We collaborate internationally to deliver services and solutions that help everyone be more productive and enable innovation. 

Who We Are

We are known as Merck & Co. , Inc. , Rahway, New Jersey, USA in the United States and Canada and MSD everywhere else. For more than a century, we have been inventing , bringing forward medicines and vaccines for many of the world's most challenging diseases. Today, our company continues to be at the forefront of research to deliver innovative health solutions and advance the prevention and treatment of diseases that threaten people and animals around the world. 

What We Look For

Imagine getting up in the morning for a job as important as helping to save and improve lives around the world. Here, you have that opportunity. You can put your empathy, creativity, digital mastery, or scientific genius to work in collaboration with a diverse group of colleagues who pursue and bring hope to countless people who are battling some of the most challenging diseases of our time. Our team is constantly evolving, so if you are among the intellectually curious, join us-and start making your impact today.

data.title: Software Development Engineer - CFD
data.description:
We are Siemens

Siemens Digital Industries Software is a leading provider of solutions for the design, simulation, and manufacture of products across many different industries. Formula 1 cars, skyscrapers, ships, space exploration vehicles, and many of the objects we see in our daily lives are being conceived and manufactured using our software. 

Simcenter HyperMesh CFD is a powerful pre- and post-processing solution for Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD), designed to help engineers efficiently prepare models, generate high-quality meshes, and analyze complex simulation results. 

We are looking for a Software Developer - CFD Post Processing to join our development team and contribute to the continued evolution of the Simcenter HyperMesh CFD (HMCFD) interface. 

In this role, you will design, develop, and enhance GUI-based software capabilities used by engineers working with advanced CFD workflows. You will work closely with software developers, CFD experts, and users to understand technical requirements and translate them into intuitive, reliable, and high-performance software solutions. 

The role provides an opportunity to work across C/C++, Python, Tcl, GUI technologies, CFD, and engineering software, while contributing to a product used in complex engineering workflows. 

Key Responsibilities

- Develop core product capabilities: Design, implement, test, and enhance software features for the HMCFD graphical user interface using C/C++ and appropriate software engineering practices. 
 - Build intuitive engineering interfaces: Develop and maintain GUI functionality that enables engineers to efficiently prepare CFD models, interact with simulation data, and perform pre- and post-processing activities. 
 - Solve complex technical problems: Analyze user and product requirements, investigate technical challenges, and develop robust, maintainable solutions for complex engineering workflows. 
 - Develop automation and customization: Use Python and Tcl scripting to automate workflows, customize solutions, and improve productivity for specific CFD applications and user requirements. 
 - Collaborate across engineering teams: Work closely with software developers, CFD specialists, product teams, and users to understand requirements and deliver effective product capabilities. 
 - Ensure software quality: Perform development-level testing and QA activities, troubleshoot defects, and contribute to maintaining the reliability and usability of the product. 
 - Support product adoption: Contribute to technical documentation, user tutorials, and other technical content that helps customers and internal users effectively utilize HMCFD capabilities. 

Qualifications

- Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Aeronautical Engineering, or a related technical discipline. 
 - Strong hands-on programming experience in C/C++, with the ability to develop maintainable and production-quality software. 
 - Proficiency in Python and/or Tcl scripting for automation, customization, and engineering workflows. 
 - Experience developing GUI-based applications, with a good understanding of user interface design and software interaction patterns. 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to understand complex requirements and translate them into practical software solutions. 
 - Working knowledge of both Linux and Windows operating systems and experience developing or supporting software in a multiplatform environment. 
 - Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with software developers, engineering experts, and end users. 

Preferred Experience

- Experience with Qt and/or OpenGL. 
 - Basic to intermediate knowledge of Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) and common CFD workflows. 
 - Experience with Simcenter HyperWorks or other CAE/engineering software. 
 - Experience with CAD modeling or visualization software. 
 - Knowledge of Finite Element Method (FEM) and structural analysis. 
 - Experience developing software for engineering, scientific, simulation, or visualization applications. 
 - Familiarity with scripting-driven engineering workflows and application customization. 

Why Us

At Siemens Software, flexibility is how we work - hybrid by default, built on trust and autonomy. Together, 30, 000 people across more than 200 countries build technology that shapes the real world. You'll grow through real projects, strong technical peers, and global mobility, backed by the scale and benefits of an industrial software leader. We're committed to equality and inclusion, and we hire based on merit, skills, and impact. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!

Diversity & Inclusion

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities. At Siemens, we believe people who've had real experiences dealing with being different will excel as leaders. Let's foster a culture of creativity and innovation. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation. 

Siemens Software. Transform the Everyday

#DISWSIM

data.title: Senior Manager, Software Engineering
data.description:
Our Company: 

At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI. 

What You'll Do: 

We are seeking a Senior Manager to lead our Database Performance Testing and Characterization organization. This leader will manage a high-impact team responsible for performance benchmarking, regressions, scalability, and workload characterization across releases, platforms, and customer scenarios. 

You will also be accountable for transforming how performance testing is executed, analyzed, and validated-modernizing the practice through automation, AI/Agent-assisted analysis, intelligent validation, and resilient test pipelines. The ideal candidate has a proven track record of leading teams through transformation initiatives that measurably improve productivity, quality, cycle time, and operational resiliency. 

Your Opportunity: 

- Lead and grow a team of performance engineers responsible for end-to-end performance testing of a database product (benchmarks, workloads, regressions, scalability, concurrency, and reliability under load). 
 - Own the team's delivery commitments for performance characterization requests across internal stakeholders (engineering, product, release, support) and external/customer-driven scenarios. 
 - Drive a transformation roadmap for performance testing that improves: 
 - Execution automation (repeatable runs through orchestration pipelines that are self-healing, observable and secure)
 - Result analysis using AI and Agents(regression detection, noise modeling, confidence scoring, explainability)
 - Root Cause Analysis Automation using AI/ML techniques (root-cause hypothesis generation, correlation analysis, report synthesis for performance issues)
 - Modernize Test Framework to expand capabilities and assist in shift-left abilities
 - Partner with engineering, architecture, and release teams to translate product changes into performance risk assessments and targeted test plans. 
 - Influence design decisions by providing early performance insights and recommendations. 
 - Communicate clearly to senior leadership: performance readiness, risks, mitigation plans, and trends using metrics and executive-ready summaries. 
 - Implement governance: baselines, test data versioning, environment parity, noise controls, and auditability of results. 

Who you will work with: 

This opportunity is within the Internal Engineering Organization. Team comprises of multiple global scrum teams working towards a common goal to test and release Teradata Vantage Platform and AI Products on various on-prem and cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GC) with quality and performance guidelines. 

Fast-paced, flexible, fun. That describes our work environment. . . a place to brainstorm with the best data minds, engage customers and surprise yourself with what's possible, every day. 

What makes you a qualified candidate: 

- 10+ years in performance engineering, test engineering, systems engineering, or a related discipline; 4+ years leading teams and delivering transformation roadmaps. 
 - Demonstrated experience in database performance testing or closely related systems (distributed systems, storage engines, query optimizers, large-scale compute platforms). 
 - Strong understanding of performance metrics and analysis: CPU, I/O, memory, concurrency, latency/throughput, query plans, system contention, and benchmarking methodologies. 
 - Proven track record modernizing engineering practices through automation and operational rigor (CI/CD, test orchestration, observability, reliability engineering). 
 - Proven experience applying AI/ML and/or LLM-based tooling to improve engineering productivity (analysis automation, anomaly detection, summarization, intelligent triage). 
 - Strong cross-functional leadership skills: ability to align stakeholders, negotiate priorities, and deliver outcomes in complex environments. 
 - Excellent communication skills and experience presenting to senior leadership. 

What You'll Bring

- 
 - Hands-on experience with one or more: 
 - Database internals (optimizer behavior, execution engine, indexing, statistics)
 - Performance tooling (profilers, tracers, query plan analyzers, APM)
 - Python/SQL-based analytics and visualization; statistical methods for noise and confidence intervals
 - Cloud performance testing across AWS/Azure/GCP
 - Experience building internal platforms for: test scheduling/orchestration, results repositories, dashboards, automated regression detection using AI. 
 - Familiarity with modern AI/agent patterns for engineering workflows (RAG for runbooks, agentic root-cause assistants, evaluation harnesses). 
 - Experience with security and compliance expectations for AI-enabled systems (data handling, access controls, audit trails). 
 - Background working in organizations undergoing AI proficiency/AI adoption transformation. 

Why We Think You'll Love Teradata

We prioritize a people-first culture because we know our people are at the very heart of our success. We embrace a flexible work model because we trust our people to make decisions about how, when, and where they work. We focus on well-being because we care about our people and their ability to thrive both personally and professionally. We are an anti-racist company because our dedication to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion is more than a statement. It is a deep commitment to doing the work to foster an equitable environment that celebrates people for all of who they are. 

Teradata invites all identities and backgrounds in the workplace. We work with deliberation and intent to ensure we are cultivating collaboration and inclusivity across our global organization. We are proud to be an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, color, ancestry, religion, creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, or related conditions), national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, medical condition, genetic information, gender identity or expression, military and veteran status, or any other legally protected status.

data.description:
Job Description

Owns feature areas with measurable business impact. Designs application services and schemas spanning Online Transaction Processing and Online Analytical Processing, JSON, spatial, and graph data models. Leads debugging across services and database layers; optimizes query and API performance to meet service-level agreements. Drives automated testing coverage and performance baselines; collaborates with product management and user experience to run experiments and analyze adoption and retention. 

Solve complex problems related to infrastructure cloud services and build automation to prevent problem recurrence. Design, develop, and deploy software to improve the availability, scalability, and efficiency of Oracle products and services. Design and develop designs, architectures, standards, and methods for large-scale distributed systems. Facilitate service capacity planning and demand forecasting, software performance analysis, and system tuning. 

Oracle Exadata Database team is building a new cloud native, Autonomous, multi-tenant, database optimized, smart storage cloud service. This service is expected to scale across thousands of tenants. Job Title: Senior Automation Engineer - PLC, HMI & SCADA (3-6 Years Exp)

Location: [Ghaziabad, Uttar Pradesh]

Job Type: Full-time

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Senior Automation Engineer to join our engineering team. In this role, you will be responsible for the end-to-end development, programming, and commissioning of industrial control systems. 

Note to Applicants: This is a traditional Industrial Automation / Controls Engineering role focused strictly on PLC, HMI, and hardware-level systems. This position does not involve PC-based software development, web coding, or IT-level automation. 

What You Will Do

·              PLC & HMI Programming: Design, code, and test robust control logic and graphical interfaces from scratch based on functional specifications. 

·              System Architecture: Configure hardware layouts, remote I/O modules, VFDs. 

·              Network Integration: Establish and troubleshoot reliable communications between controllers, instruments, and plant-wide networks. 

·              Field Commissioning: Lead Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) and Site Acceptance Testing (SAT), ensuring systems launch smoothly on the factory floor. 

Required Qualifications & Technical Skills

·              Experience: 3 to 6 years of direct, hands-on experience in industrial automation and control systems design. 

·              PLC Platforms: Strong proficiency with Rockwell Automation / Allen-Bradley (Studio 5000 / ControlLogix) and/or Siemens (TIA Portal / S7-1500) or Schneider (M340/M580)

·              Languages: Mastery of IEC 61131-3 languages, specifically Ladder Logic (LD) and FBD. 

·              HMI / SCADA: Proven experience developing operator interfaces using FactoryTalk View, Siemens WinCC, or Wonderware / Aveva. 

·              Industrial Networking: Practical knowledge of configuring and troubleshooting EtherNet/IP, PROFINET, and Modbus TCP/IP.
